===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/catalogue-checks.ts\n===
/**
 * The catalogue as an action, a question's data source or a binding uses it (E-10, E-17, E-20):
 * `catalogue.*`, `action.repeatOnRead`, and `action.resultSavedTwice` (E-23; compiler.md 14.3 #1).
 */
import type { CatalogueRef, Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { CatalogueEntry } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { bindingById } from "./kinds-of.ts";
import { isObject, isString } from "./walk.ts";

type Expected = "operation" | "dataSource" | "trigger";

/** The entry when it exists and is of the expected kind, after reporting what is wrong with it. */
function entryAt(ctx: Context, out: Finding[], ref: unknown, location: Location, expected: Expected): CatalogueEntry | undefined {
  if (!isString(ref)) return undefined;
  const entry = ctx.catalogue.entry(ref);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== expected) {
    out.push(finding("catalogue.unknownEntry", location, { entry: ref as CatalogueRef, expected }));
    return undefined;
  }
  const connection = ctx.catalogue.connection(entry.connection);
  if (connection?.status === "notSetUp") out.push(finding("catalogue.connectionNotSetUp", location, { connection: connection.id }));
  if (connection?.status === "disabled") out.push(finding("catalogue.connectionDisabled", location, { connection: connection.id }));
  if (entry.status === "disabled") out.push(finding("catalogue.entryDisabled", location, { entry: ref as CatalogueRef }));
  return entry;
}

/** Required inputs not mapped, and mapped inputs the entry does not have. */
function inputs(ctx: Context, out: Finding[], item: string, prefix: string, entry: CatalogueEntry, mapped: unknown): void {
  const given = isObject(mapped) ? Object.keys(mapped) : [];
  const fields = ctx.catalogue.fields(entry, "input");
  for (const field of fields) if (field.required === true && !given.includes(field.id)) out.push(finding("catalogue.inputMissing", at(item, prefix), { input: field.id }));
  for (const key of given) if (!fields.some((f) => f.id === key)) out.push(finding("catalogue.unknownField", at(item, `${prefix}.${key}`), { field: key }));
}

/**
 * A binding's sent field that its trigger's event does not have (E-26). Reported at `requester`,
 * `answers.<question>`, or the side of an "only when" clause (`onlyWhen.<n>.left`, `.right`). Not
 * judged while the trigger is missing or unknown: that is the trigger's own To do.
 */
function unknownSentFields(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    if (n.sort !== "sentField" || !n.sent || !isString(n.field)) continue;
    const trigger = bindingById(ctx, n.item)?.trigger;
    if (ctx.catalogue.entry(trigger)?.kind !== "trigger" || ctx.catalogue.sentField(trigger, n.field)) continue;
    const side = n.clause === undefined ? undefined : n.path.slice(n.clause.length + 1).split(".")[0];
    const part = n.clause !== undefined && side ? `${n.clause}.${side}` : n.slot;
    const key = `${n.item} ${part} ${n.field}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push(finding("catalogue.unknownField", at(n.item, part), { field: n.field }));
  }
  return out;
}

export function catalogueChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const wf: unknown = ctx.workflow;
  const bindings = isObject(wf) && isObject(wf["start"]) && Array.isArray(wf["start"]["startsWhen"]) ? wf["start"]["startsWhen"] : [];
  for (const b of bindings) if (isObject(b) && isString(b["id"])) entryAt(ctx, out, b["trigger"], at(b["id"], "trigger"), "trigger");
  out.push(...unknownSentFields(ctx));

  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      if (action.type !== "useConnection") continue;
      const entry = entryAt(ctx, out, action.operation, at(action.id, "operation"), "operation");
      if (entry) {
        inputs(ctx, out, action.id, "inputs", entry, action.inputs);
        const results = ctx.catalogue.fields(entry, "result");
        for (const key of isObject(action.saveResults) ? Object.keys(action.saveResults) : [])
          if (!results.some((f) => f.id === key)) out.push(finding("catalogue.unknownField", at(action.id, `saveResults.${key}`), { field: key }));
        // The setting has no effect on a read: a read is made afresh on every entry.
        if (entry.kind === "operation" && entry.sort === "read" && action.ifStageEntersAgain !== undefined)
          out.push(finding("action.repeatOnRead", at(action.id), {}));
      }
      if (isObject(action.saveResults)) {
        const byValue = new Map<string, string[]>();
        for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(action.saveResults)) if (isString(value)) byValue.set(value, [...(byValue.get(value) ?? []), field]);
        for (const [value, fields] of byValue)
          if (fields.length > 1) out.push(finding("action.resultSavedTwice", at(action.id, `saveResults.${fields[fields.length - 1] ?? ""}`), { value: value as `v_${string}`, fields }));
      }
    }
    for (const task of view.tasks)
      for (const { question } of task.questions) {
        const c: unknown = question.choices;
        if (!isObject(c) || c["from"] !== "source") continue;
        const entry = entryAt(ctx, out, c["source"], at(question.id, "choices.source"), "dataSource");
        if (!entry) continue;
        inputs(ctx, out, question.id, "choices.inputs", entry, c["inputs"]);
        const item = ctx.catalogue.fields(entry, "item");
        for (const part of ["labelField", "storedField"] as const) {
          const field = c[part];
          if (isString(field) && !item.some((f) => f.id === field)) out.push(finding("catalogue.unknownField", at(question.id, `choices.${part}`), { field }));
        }
      }
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/check.ts\n===
/**
 * `check`: contract/core-api.md section 4. Every finding the server's publish check raises plus the
 * authoring checks, in document order of their item, then by code. Never throws on an unfinished
 * draft: a failure inside core is the finding `compile.internal`.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { catalogueChecks } from "./catalogue-checks.ts";
import { makeContext, workflowId, type Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { formulaChecks } from "./formulas.ts";
import { graphChecks } from "./graph-checks.ts";
import { groupReadInSameStep } from "./group-reads.ts";
import { kindChecks } from "./kind-checks.ts";
import { missingParts } from "./parts.ts";
import { pressedOutsideStage } from "./pressed.ts";
import { brokenReferences } from "./references.ts";
import { arrowRules, failureChecks, failureNotRead, nowhereToGo } from "./routing.ts";
import { bindingChecks, startChecks } from "./start.ts";
import { askedMayBeEmpty, mayBeEmpty, neverFilled, requesterMayBeEmpty } from "./values.ts";

const CHECKS: readonly ((ctx: Context) => Finding[])[] = [
  missingParts, brokenReferences, startChecks, bindingChecks, catalogueChecks, kindChecks, pressedOutsideStage,
  formulaChecks, nowhereToGo, arrowRules, failureChecks, failureNotRead, graphChecks, neverFilled, mayBeEmpty, askedMayBeEmpty,
  requesterMayBeEmpty, groupReadInSameStep,
];

function internal(workflow: unknown, error: unknown): Finding {
  const id = typeof workflow === "object" && workflow !== null && typeof (workflow as { id?: unknown }).id === "string" ? (workflow as { id: string }).id : "";
  const f = finding("compile.internal", at(id), {});
  f.debug = { detail: error instanceof Error ? `${error.name}: ${error.message}` : String(error) };
  return f;
}

/** Document order of the item (the workflow first), then the code; otherwise the order found. */
function sorted(ctx: Context, findings: Finding[]): Finding[] {
  const order = (f: Finding): number => ctx.ix.byId.get(f.location.item)?.order ?? (f.location.item === workflowId(ctx) ? -1 : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
  return findings
    .map((f, i) => ({ f, i, o: order(f) }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.o - b.o || (a.f.code < b.f.code ? -1 : a.f.code > b.f.code ? 1 : 0) || a.i - b.i)
    .map(({ f }) => f);
}

export function check(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue): Finding[] {
  let ctx: Context;
  try {
    ctx = makeContext(workflow, catalogue);
  } catch (error) {
    return [internal(workflow, error)];
  }
  const findings: Finding[] = [];
  let failed = false;
  for (const run of CHECKS) {
    try {
      findings.push(...run(ctx));
    } catch (error) {
      // The other checks still run: an author sees every problem core could find.
      if (!failed) findings.push(internal(workflow, error));
      failed = true;
    }
  }
  return sorted(ctx, findings);
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/context.ts\n===
/** What every check reads: the document's index, its stage graph, value kinds and the catalogue. */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Question, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Connection, Field } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { Flow } from "../facts/flow.ts";
import { stageGraph, type StageGraph } from "../facts/graph.ts";
import { questionKind, type Kinds } from "../facts/kinds.ts";
import { indexDocument, type DocIndex, type TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { isObject, isString, walkAll, type WalkNode } from "./walk.ts";

export class CatalogueIndex {
  private readonly entries = new Map<string, CatalogueEntry>();
  private readonly connections = new Map<string, Connection>();

  constructor(catalogue: Catalogue | undefined) {
    const c: unknown = catalogue;
    if (!isObject(c)) return;
    for (const e of Array.isArray(c["entries"]) ? c["entries"] : [])
      if (isObject(e) && isString(e["id"]) && !this.entries.has(e["id"])) this.entries.set(e["id"], e as unknown as CatalogueEntry);
    for (const x of Array.isArray(c["connections"]) ? c["connections"] : [])
      if (isObject(x) && isString(x["id"]) && !this.connections.has(x["id"])) this.connections.set(x["id"], x as unknown as Connection);
  }

  entry(id: unknown): CatalogueEntry | undefined {
    return isString(id) ? this.entries.get(id) : undefined;
  }

  connection(id: unknown): Connection | undefined {
    return isString(id) ? this.connections.get(id) : undefined;
  }

  /** The fields of an entry's part (`input`, `result`, `item`, `event`); empty when it has none. */
  fields(entry: CatalogueEntry | undefined, part: "input" | "result" | "item" | "event"): Field[] {
    const list: unknown = entry ? (entry as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[part] : undefined;
    return Array.isArray(list) ? list.filter((f): f is Field => isObject(f) && isString(f["id"])) : [];
  }

  /** A sent field of a trigger by its dotted id (`reporter.email`). */
  sentField(trigger: unknown, dotted: string): Field | undefined {
    const entry = this.entry(trigger);
    if (entry?.kind !== "trigger") return undefined;
    let fields = this.fields(entry, "event");
    let found: Field | undefined;
    for (const segment of dotted.split(".")) {
      found = fields.find((f) => f.id === segment);
      if (!found) return undefined;
      fields = Array.isArray(found.fields) ? found.fields : [];
    }
    return found;
  }
}

export interface Context {
  workflow: AuthoredWorkflow;
  ix: DocIndex;
  graph: StageGraph;
  /** Which values are filled where (facts/flow.ts). */
  flow: Flow;
  kinds: Kinds;
  catalogue: CatalogueIndex;
  /** Every node of every slot, in slot order. */
  nodes: WalkNode[];
  /** The start stage's task, when it has exactly one. */
  startTask?: TaskView;
  /** The registry's value IDs. */
  registered: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Every question with its task. */
  questions: ReadonlyMap<string, { question: Question; task: TaskView }>;
  /** Every action of every stage, by ID (the first when a draft holds an ID twice). */
  actions: ReadonlyMap<string, Action>;
}

export function makeContext(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue): Context {
  const ix = indexDocument(workflow);
  const startId = isObject(workflow) && isObject(workflow.start) ? workflow.start.stage : undefined;
  const startView = isString(startId) ? ix.stageById.get(startId) : undefined;
  const questions = new Map<string, { question: Question; task: TaskView }>();
  for (const view of ix.stages)
    for (const task of view.tasks)
      for (const { question } of task.questions) if (!questions.has(question.id)) questions.set(question.id, { question, task });
  const actions = new Map<string, Action>();
  for (const view of ix.stages) for (const a of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) if (!actions.has(a.id)) actions.set(a.id, a);
  const graph = stageGraph(ix);
  const flow = new Flow(ix, catalogue, graph);
  const ctx: Context = {
    workflow,
    ix,
    graph,
    flow,
    kinds: flow.kinds,
    catalogue: new CatalogueIndex(catalogue),
    nodes: walkAll(ix),
    registered: new Set(ix.items.filter((i) => i.kind === "value").map((i) => i.id)),
    questions,
    actions,
  };
  if (startView?.working && startView.tasks.length === 1 && startView.tasks[0]) ctx.startTask = startView.tasks[0];
  return ctx;
}

/** The workflow's own ID, or "" when it has none (core-api.md 3). */
export function workflowId(ctx: Context): string {
  return isObject(ctx.workflow) && isString(ctx.workflow.id) ? ctx.workflow.id : "";
}

/** The kind of value a question's answer gives (format, QuestionKind). */
export function answerKind(q: Question): ValueKind | undefined {
  return isString(q.kind) ? questionKind(q) : undefined;
}

/** The buttons a binding may press: its own, or the start task's only one. */
export function boundButton(ctx: Context, binding: { button?: unknown }): string | undefined {
  if (isString(binding.button)) return binding.button;
  const buttons = ctx.startTask?.buttons ?? [];
  return buttons.length === 1 ? buttons[0]?.id : undefined;
}

/** The questions a button needs: its own list plus every question of its task ticked "All" (format, Button). */
export function neededFor(task: TaskView, button: string): string[] {
  const b = task.buttons.find((x) => x.id === button);
  const own = b && Array.isArray(b.neededToPress) ? b.neededToPress.filter(isString) : [];
  return task.questions
    .map(({ question }) => question)
    .filter((q) => q.neededForEveryButton === true || own.includes(q.id))
    .map((q) => q.id);
}

export type Finding = Coded<FindingParams, {

/**
 * `formula.*`: each formula's chips are rewritten to identifiers (formula/chips.ts), declared with
 * the CEL type of what they name (formula/cel-kinds.ts, compiler.md 8.4: a date chip reads as a
 * timestamp), and the text is checked by the shared formula environment (formula/typing.ts, profile
 * cel-1). A map literal key starting with `$` is refused (E-27). Ranges are into the authored text.
 */
import { FORMULA_FUNCTIONS, type FormulaType } from "../../cel/formula-functions.ts";
import type { CelNode, CelProblem, CelType } from "../../cel/types.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { celTypeFitsKind, celTypeOfField, celTypeOfKind, formulaTypeOf, splitTypeList } from "../formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { rewriteChips, type Chip, type Rewritten, type TextRange } from "../formula/chips.ts";
import { formulaEnvironment } from "../formula/typing.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { slotKinds, isChainOf } from "./kind-checks.ts";
import { bindingById } from "./kinds-of.ts";
import type { WalkNode } from "./walk.ts";

/** Chips become `chip__<n>`: authored IDs never hold `__`, so no chip can be named by the author's text. */
const CHIP_NAME = /\bchip__\d+\b/g;
const CONDITION_SLOTS = new Set(["showWhen", "enabledWhen", "onlyWhen", "when.condition"]);
const PERSON: CelType = celTypeOfKind("person");

/** The first map literal key starting with `$`: the kernel refuses such keys in data. */
function reservedKey(node: CelNode): CelNode | undefined {
  switch (node.op) {
    case "literal":
    case "ident":
      return undefined;
    case "select":
      return reservedKey(node.operand);
    case "index":
      return reservedKey(node.operand) ?? reservedKey(node.index);
    case "call":
      return (node.target ? reservedKey(node.target) : undefined) ?? first(node.args);
    case "list":
      return first(node.elements);
    case "operator":
      return first(node.args);
    case "map":
      for (const [k, v] of node.entries) {
        if (k.op === "literal" && typeof k.value === "string" && k.value.startsWith("$")) return k;
        const found = reservedKey(k) ?? reservedKey(v);
        if (found) return found;
      }
      return undefined;
  }
}

function first(nodes: readonly CelNode[]): CelNode | undefined {
  for (const n of nodes) {
    const found = reservedKey(n);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return undefined;
}

type Formula = WalkNode & { sort: "formula" };

/** What one chip declares, or the finding that it names nothing this place can see. */
function declareChip(ctx: Context, n: Formula, chip: Chip): { type: CelType; date?: boolean } | Finding {
  const range = chip.range;
  const name = (text: string): Finding => finding("formula.unknownName", at(n.item, n.path), { ...range, name: text });
  switch (chip.sort) {
    case "unknown":
      return name(chip.text);
    case "value": {
      const known = ctx.registered.has(chip.value) || ctx.ix.fillsOf.has(chip.value);
      if (!known) return name(chip.value);
      // A binding reads only what the other system sent: no value exists yet (format, StartsWhen).
      if (n.sent) return finding("formula.notInScope", at(n.item, n.path), { ...range, name: chip.value, declaredAt: { item: chip.value } });
      const kind = ctx.kinds.valueKind(chip.value);
      return { type: celTypeOfKind(kind, resultField(ctx, chip.value), ctx.kinds.itemKind(chip.value)), date: kind === "date" };
    }
    case "requester":
      return n.sent ? name("request.requester") : { type: PERSON };
    case "startedOn":
      return n.sent ? name("request.startedOn") : { type: celTypeOfKind("date"), date: true };
    case "sent": {
      if (!n.sent) return name(`sent.${chip.field}`);
      const trigger = bindingById(ctx, n.item)?.trigger;
      if (!ctx.catalogue.entry(trigger)) return { type: celTypeOfKind(undefined) };
      const field = ctx.catalogue.sentField(trigger, chip.field);
      if (!field) return name(`sent.${chip.field}`);
      return { type: celTypeOfField(field), date: field.kind === "date" };
    }
  }
}

/** The catalogue field a value is saved from, which describes a list's or a field group's items. */
function resultField(ctx: Context, value: string) {
  const fill = ctx.ix.fillsOf.get(value)?.find((f) => f.by === "result");
  if (!fill || fill.field === undefined) return undefined;
  const action = ctx.actions.get(fill.at.item);
  const operation = action?.type === "useConnection" ? action.operation : undefined;
  return ctx.catalogue.fields(ctx.catalogue.entry(operation), "result").find((f) => f.id === fill.field);
}

const NAMES = new Set(FORMULA_FUNCTIONS.map((f) => f.name));

/** The function's expected argument types, for the form with as many arguments as were found. */
function expectedArgs(name: string, method: boolean, count: number): FormulaType[] {
  const entries = FORMULA_FUNCTIONS.filter((f) => f.name === name);
  const entry = entries.find((f) => (f.style === "method") === method) ?? entries[0];
  const forms = (entry?.overloads ?? []).map((o) => (o.receiver ? [o.receiver, ...o.args] : o.args));
  return forms.find((args) => args.length === count) ?? forms[0] ?? [];
}

function problemFinding(n: Formula, p: CelProblem, rw: Rewritten): Finding {
  const range: TextRange = rw.toAuthored(p.range);
  const where = at(n.item, n.path);
  const text = n.text.slice(range.start, range.end);
  const quoted = /'([^']*)'/.exec(p.message)?.[1];
  switch (p.code) {
    case "unknown-variable":
    case "no-such-key":
      return finding("formula.unknownName", where, { ...range, name: p.code === "no-such-key" ? (/: (\S+)$/.exec(p.message)?.[1] ?? text) : text });
    case "unknown-function":
      return finding("formula.unknownFunction", where, { ...range, name: quoted ?? text });
    case "time-zone-not-allowed":
      return finding("formula.notInProfile", where, { ...range, rule: "timeZone" });
    case "unicode-class-not-allowed":
      return finding("formula.notInProfile", where, { ...range, rule: "unicodeClass" });
    case "no-matching-overload": {
      // "found no matching overload for 'size(bool)'" or "'string.nosuch()'"
      const m = /for '(?:(.+)\.)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\((.*)\)'/.exec(p.message);
      const name = m?.[2] ?? text;
      if (!NAMES.has(name) || name.startsWith("cel1_")) return finding("formula.unknownFunction", where, { ...range, name });
      const found = [...(m?.[1] ? [m[1]] : []), ...splitTypeList(m?.[3] ?? "")].map(formulaTypeOf);
      return finding("formula.argumentMismatch", where, { ...range, function: name, expected: expectedArgs(name, !!m?.[1], found.length), found });
    }
    case "no-such-overload": {
      // "no such overload: double + int"
      const m = /no such overload: (\S+) (\S+) (\S+)/.exec(p.message);
      const op = m?.[2] ?? "";
      const found = m ? [formulaTypeOf(m[1] ?? "dyn"), formulaTypeOf(m[3] ?? "dyn")] : [];
      return finding("formula.argumentMismatch", where, { ...range, function: op, expected: expectedArgs(op, false, found.length), found });
    }
    case "invalid-condition-type": {
      const m = /got '([^']*)'/.exec(p.message);
      return finding("formula.argumentMismatch", where, { ...range, function: "?:", expected: expectedArgs("?:", false, 3), found: [formulaTypeOf(m?.[1] ?? "dyn")] });
    }
    default:
      return finding("formula.syntax", where, range);
  }
}

/** The kinds the formula's place takes, where the place says. */
function placeKinds(ctx: Context, n: Formula): ValueKind[] | undefined {
  if (n.clause !== undefined || n.piece !== undefined) return undefined;
  if (n.path === n.slot && CONDITION_SLOTS.has(n.slot)) return ["yesNo"];
  if (!isChainOf(n.path, n.slot)) return undefined;
  if (n.slot === "save") {
    const action = ctx.actions.get(n.item);
    const kind = action?.type === "saveValue" && typeof action.as === "string" ? ctx.kinds.valueKind(action.as) : undefined;
    return kind ? [kind] : undefined;
  }
  return slotKinds(ctx, n.item, n.slot);
}

export function formulaChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    if (n.sort !== "formula") continue;
    const variables: Record<string, CelType> = {};
    const rw = rewriteChips(n.text, (chip, i) => {
      const d = declareChip(ctx, n, chip);
      const id = `chip__${i}`;
      if ("code" in d) {
        out.push(d);
        variables[id] = celTypeOfKind(undefined);
        return id;
      }
      variables[id] = d.type;
      return d.date ? `date(${id})` : id;
    });
    // Text that spells a chip's identifier names nothing.
    for (const m of n.text.matchAll(CHIP_NAME)) {
      const start = m.index;
      if (rw.chips.some((c) => start >= c.range.start && start < c.range.end)) continue;
      out.push(finding("formula.unknownName", at(n.item, n.path), { start, end: start + m[0].length, name: m[0] }));
    }
    const result = formulaEnvironment(variables).check(rw.source);
    if (!result.ok) {
      const [problem] = result.problems;
      if (problem) out.push(problemFinding(n, problem, rw));
      continue;
    }
    const key = reservedKey(result.expression.tree);
    if (key) {
      out.push(finding("formula.notInProfile", at(n.item, n.path), { ...rw.toAuthored(key.range), rule: "reservedKey" }));
      continue;
    }
    const expected = placeKinds(ctx, n);
    const type = result.expression.type;
    if (expected?.length && !expected.some((k) => celTypeFitsKind(type, k)))
      out.push(finding("formula.kindMismatch", at(n.item, n.path), { start: 0, end: n.text.length, expected: expected[0] as ValueKind, found: formulaTypeOf(type) }));
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/graph-checks.ts\n===
/**
 * The stage graph (compiler.md 7.1): `stage.unreachable`, `stage.noWayToEnd` (spec: every stage can
 * reach a final stage) and `loop.noTask` (spec: every cycle passes a condition on a wait opened
 * inside it; compiler.md 14.2 counts a connection action only when it has no "Only when").
 */
import type { Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";

export function graphChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const { graph, ix } = ctx;
  if (graph.root !== undefined)
    for (const view of ix.stages) if (!graph.reachable.has(view.stage.id)) out.push(finding("stage.unreachable", at(view.stage.id), {}));

  // Backwards from the endings.
  const reachesEnd = new Set<string>(ix.stages.filter((v) => !v.working).map((v) => v.stage.id));
  for (let changed = true; changed; ) {
    changed = false;
    for (const view of ix.stages) {
      if (reachesEnd.has(view.stage.id)) continue;
      if ((graph.out.get(view.stage.id) ?? []).some((e) => reachesEnd.has(e.to))) {
        reachesEnd.add(view.stage.id);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }
  for (const view of ix.stages) if (view.working && !reachesEnd.has(view.stage.id)) out.push(finding("stage.noWayToEnd", at(view.stage.id), {}));

  out.push(...loopsWithNoTask(ctx));
  return out;
}

/** A stage that a request cannot pass without waiting: it has a task, or a connection action with no "Only when". */
function waits(view: StageView): boolean {
  return view.tasks.length > 0 || [...view.arrival, ...view.after].some((a) => a.type === "useConnection" && a.onlyWhen === undefined);
}

/**
 * A depth-first walk over the stages that do not wait, from the start first and then in document
 * order: each arrow back to a stage still on the walk closes a loop that would spin.
 */
function loopsWithNoTask(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const { graph, ix } = ctx;
  const spins = new Set<string>(ix.stages.filter((v) => v.working && !waits(v)).map((v) => v.stage.id));
  const order = [...graph.reachable, ...ix.stages.map((v) => v.stage.id).filter((id) => !graph.reachable.has(id))];
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const done = new Set<string>();
  const path: string[] = [];
  const visit = (stage: string): void => {
    path.push(stage);
    for (const edge of graph.out.get(stage) ?? []) {
      if (!spins.has(edge.to) || done.has(edge.to)) continue;
      const back = path.indexOf(edge.to);
      if (back >= 0) {
        const stages: Location[] = path.slice(back).map((id) => ({ item: id }));
        out.push(finding("loop.noTask", at(edge.arrow.id), { stages }));
      } else visit(edge.to);
    }
    path.pop();
    done.add(stage);
  };
  for (const stage of order) if (spins.has(stage) && !done.has(stage)) visit(stage);
  return out;
}

/**
 * `group.readInSameStep` (E-26; compiler.md 8.6, 14.3 #9): a group's members are read just before
 * the tasks step opens, so a group that the same tasks step fills cannot be read by that step's own
 * Show when, "Also only when", lookup input or early arrow. Reported at the clause, or at the part
 * that holds a `members` step outside a clause. The start form's conditions are
 * `start.directoryInCondition`'s, so they are not reported twice.
 */
import { isEarly } from "../facts/combos.ts";
import type { StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { expressionKindOf } from "./kinds-of.ts";
import { isObject, isString, readingPart, type WalkNode } from "./walk.ts";

/** The values the stage's tasks step fills: answers, "Button pressed" and "Answered by". */
function filledByTasks(view: StageView): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const t of view.tasks) {
    for (const v of [t.task.savesButtonPressedAs, t.task.savesAnsweredByAs]) if (isString(v)) out.add(v);
    for (const { question } of t.questions) if (isString(question.savedAs)) out.add(question.savedAs);
  }
  return out;
}

/** The values an expression reads, through its "If empty, use" chain. */
function valuesOf(e: unknown): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let cur = e; isObject(cur); cur = cur["ifEmptyUse"]) if (isString(cur["value"])) out.push(cur["value"]);
  return out;
}

/** The values a node reads as a group whose members are needed: a `members` step, or "is in" a group. */
function groupsRead(ctx: Context, n: WalkNode): string[] {
  if (n.sort === "reference")
    return Array.isArray(n.node["steps"]) && n.node["steps"].some((s) => isObject(s) && s["directory"] === "members") ? [n.value] : [];
  if (n.sort !== "clause" || !isObject(n.node)) return [];
  const c = n.node;
  const words = c["words"];
  const group = words === "person.isIn" || words === "person.isNotIn" ? c["right"] : isString(words) && words.startsWith("people.") ? c["left"] : undefined;
  return group !== undefined && expressionKindOf(ctx, group) === "group" ? valuesOf(group) : [];
}

/** Whether the node is read in its stage's tasks step: a form condition, a lookup input, an early arrow. */
function inTasksStep(ctx: Context, view: StageView, n: WalkNode): boolean {
  if (n.sent) return false;
  const item = ctx.ix.byId.get(n.item);
  if (!item) return false;
  if (item.kind === "arrow") return view.arrows.some((a) => a.id === n.item && isEarly(view, a));
  if (item.task === undefined || !view.tasks.some((t) => t.task.id === item.task)) return false;
  if (n.slot === "showWhen" || n.slot === "enabledWhen") return item.task !== ctx.startTask?.task.id;
  return item.kind === "question" && n.slot.startsWith("choices.inputs.");
}

export function groupReadInSameStep(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const filled = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    const stage = ctx.ix.byId.get(n.item)?.stage;
    const view = stage === undefined ? undefined : ctx.ix.stageById.get(stage);
    if (!view?.working) continue;
    const groups = groupsRead(ctx, n);
    if (!groups.length || !inTasksStep(ctx, view, n)) continue;
    let fills = filled.get(view.stage.id);
    if (!fills) filled.set(view.stage.id, (fills = filledByTasks(view)));
    for (const value of groups) {
      if (!fills.has(value)) continue;
      const location = at(n.item, readingPart(n));
      const key = `${location.item} ${location.part ?? ""} ${value}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      out.push(finding("group.readInSameStep", location, { value: { item: value } }));
    }
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/kind-checks.ts\n===
/**
 * Kinds: `expression.kindMismatch`, `clause.wordsDoNotFit`, `value.kindConflict`, and three
 * constructs the compiler has no rule for (E-23; compiler.md 14.3): `template.kindNotJoinable`,
 * `reference.stepsNotSupported`, `question.choicesNotSupported`.
 */
import {
  WORDS_FOR_KIND, WORDS_WITH_A_LIST, WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER, type ValueKind, type Words,
} from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { valueFacts } from "../facts/value-facts.ts";
import { answerKind, type Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { bindingById, expressionKindOf } from "./kinds-of.ts";
import { isObject, isString, type WalkNode } from "./walk.ts";

const WITH_A_LIST: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<Words>(WORDS_WITH_A_LIST);
const NOTHING_AFTER: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<Words>(WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER);
const WHO: ValueKind[] = ["person", "group", "people"];
const NOT_JOINABLE: ReadonlySet<ValueKind> = new Set<ValueKind>(["multipleChoice", "people", "list", "fieldGroup"]);

const fits = (kind: ValueKind, expected: readonly ValueKind[]): boolean =>
  expected.includes(kind) || ((kind === "text" || kind === "longText") && (expected.includes("text") || expected.includes("longText")));

/** The kinds a slot takes, where the slot says (core-api.md 4, `expression.kindMismatch`). */
export function slotKinds(ctx: Context, item: string, slot: string): ValueKind[] | undefined {
  const indexed = ctx.ix.byId.get(item);
  if (slot === "whoIsAsked" && indexed?.kind === "task") return WHO;
  if (slot === "choices.peopleIn") return ["group"];
  const binding = indexed?.kind === "startsWhen" ? bindingById(ctx, item) : undefined;
  if (binding) {
    if (slot === "requester") return ["person"];
    if (slot.startsWith("answers.")) {
      const q = ctx.questions.get(slot.slice("answers.".length))?.question;
      const kind = q ? answerKind(q) : undefined;
      return kind ? [kind] : undefined;
    }
    return undefined;
  }
  if (indexed?.kind !== "action" && indexed?.kind !== "question") return undefined;
  const action = ctx.actions.get(item);
  if (action?.type === "notify" && slot === "to") return WHO;
  const input = (entryRef: unknown, prefix: string): ValueKind[] | undefined => {
    if (!slot.startsWith(prefix)) return undefined;
    const field = ctx.catalogue.fields(ctx.catalogue.entry(entryRef), "input").find((f) => f.id === slot.slice(prefix.length));
    return field ? [field.kind] : undefined;
  };
  if (action?.type === "useConnection") return input(action.operation, "inputs.");
  const choices: unknown = ctx.questions.get(item)?.question.choices;
  if (isObject(choices) && choices["from"] === "source") return input(choices["source"], "choices.inputs.");
  return undefined;
}

/** What the right side of a clause must give, by its words and the left side's kind (compiler.md 8.3). */
function rightKinds(words: string, left: ValueKind): ValueKind[] | undefined {
  const set = words.split(".")[0];
  if (words === "date.isOnWeekday") return undefined;
  if (words === "person.isIn" || words === "person.isNotIn") return ["group", "people"];
  switch (set) {
    case "text":
      return ["text", "longText"];
    case "number":
    case "date":
      return [set];
    case "choice":
      return [left];
    case "person":
    case "people":
      return ["person"];
    case "list":
      // A multiple choice holds typed-in choices or, answered from a list, rows (compiler.md 5.1); its kind does not say which.
      return ["choice", "choiceFromList"];
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** Whether `path` is the slot's own expression or a fallback of it (`whoIsAsked.ifEmptyUse`). */
export const isChainOf = (path: string, root: string): boolean => path === root || (path.startsWith(`${root}.`) && /^(\.ifEmptyUse)+$/.test(path.slice(root.length)));

function triggerOf(ctx: Context, n: WalkNode): unknown {
  return n.sent ? bindingById(ctx, n.item)?.trigger : undefined;
}

function nodeKind(ctx: Context, n: WalkNode): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (n.sort === "formula" || n.sort === "clause") return undefined;
  return expressionKindOf(ctx, n.node, triggerOf(ctx, n));
}

export function kindChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const reported = new Set<string>();
  const mismatch = (item: string, part: string, expected: ValueKind[], found: ValueKind): void => {
    const key = `${item} ${part}`;
    if (reported.has(key)) return;
    reported.add(key);
    out.push(finding("expression.kindMismatch", at(item, part), { expected, found }));
  };

  for (const slot of ctx.ix.slots) {
    const part = slot.at.part ?? "";
    const expected = slotKinds(ctx, slot.at.item, part);
    if (expected && Array.isArray(slot.node) && !fits("text", expected)) mismatch(slot.at.item, part, expected, "text");
  }

  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    // A slot's own expression and its "If empty, use" chain.
    if (n.clause === undefined && n.piece === undefined && isChainOf(n.path, n.slot)) {
      const expected = slotKinds(ctx, n.item, n.slot);
      const kind = expected ? nodeKind(ctx, n) : undefined;
      if (expected && kind && !fits(kind, expected)) mismatch(n.item, n.slot, expected, kind);
    }
    if (n.sort === "reference" || n.sort === "request") {
      if (n.sort === "request" && Array.isArray(n.node["steps"]) && n.node["steps"].length > 0 && (n.request === "requester" || n.request === "startedOn"))
        out.push(finding("reference.stepsNotSupported", at(n.item, n.path), { request: n.request }));
    }
    // A piece of a text template sent to another system (compiler.md 8.4, TXT).
    if (n.piece !== undefined && n.path === `${n.slot}.${n.piece}` && /^(inputs|values|answers|choices\.inputs)\./.test(n.slot)) {
      const kind = nodeKind(ctx, n);
      if (kind && NOT_JOINABLE.has(kind)) out.push(finding("template.kindNotJoinable", at(n.item, n.path), { kind }));
    }
    if (n.sort === "clause" && isObject(n.node) && isString(n.node["words"]) && !("pressed" in n.node)) clauseChecks(ctx, n, out, mismatch);
  }

  for (const value of ctx.ix.items) {
    if (value.kind !== "value") continue;
    const kind = valueFacts(ctx.ix, ctx.kinds, value.id).kind;
    if (kind && typeof kind === "object") out.push(finding("value.kindConflict", at(value.id), { kinds: kind.conflict }));
  }

  for (const { question: q } of ctx.questions.values()) {
    const c: unknown = q.choices;
    const from = isObject(c) ? c["from"] : undefined;
    const unsupported =
      ((q.kind === "multipleChoice" || q.kind === "group") && (from === "source" || from === "directory")) ||
      (q.kind === "person" && (from === "typedIn" || from === "list"));
    if (unsupported) out.push(finding("question.choicesNotSupported", at(q.id, "choices"), { kind: q.kind, from: from as "typedIn" | "list" | "source" | "directory" }));
  }
  return out;
}

function clauseChecks(
  ctx: Context,
  n: WalkNode & { sort: "clause" },
  out: Finding[],
  mismatch: (item: string, part: string, expected: ValueKind[], found: ValueKind) => void,
): void {
  const c = n.node as Record<string, unknown>;
  const words = c["words"] as Words;
  const left = expressionKindOf(ctx, c["left"], triggerOf(ctx, n));
  if (!left) return;
  const set = WORDS_FOR_KIND[left];
  const right = c["right"];
  const shapeFits = NOTHING_AFTER.has(words)
    ? right === undefined
    : WITH_A_LIST.has(words)
      ? right === undefined || Array.isArray(right)
      : !Array.isArray(right);
  if (set === null || !words.startsWith(`${set}.`) || !shapeFits) {
    out.push(finding("clause.wordsDoNotFit", at(n.item, n.path), { words, kind: left }));
    return;
  }
  const expected = rightKinds(words, left);
  if (!expected) return;
  const sides = Array.isArray(right) ? right.map((r, i) => ({ r, part: `${n.path}.right.${i}` })) : [{ r: right, part: `${n.path}.right` }];
  for (const { r, part } of sides) {
    const kind = expressionKindOf(ctx, r, triggerOf(ctx, n));
    if (kind && !fits(kind, expected)) mismatch(n.item, part, expected, kind);
  }
}

/**
 * The kind an expression gives, where it is known without the formula checker: a value's kind
 * from its fillers (facts), a sent field's from the binding's trigger, a template is text.
 */
import type { StartsWhen, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { isObject, isString } from "./walk.ts";

/** The binding an item is, or undefined. */
export function bindingById(ctx: Context, id: string): StartsWhen | undefined {
  const wf: unknown = ctx.workflow;
  const list = isObject(wf) && isObject(wf["start"]) && Array.isArray(wf["start"]["startsWhen"]) ? wf["start"]["startsWhen"] : [];
  return list.find((b): b is StartsWhen => isObject(b) && b["id"] === id);
}

/** `trigger`: the binding's trigger, for a sent field. */
export function expressionKindOf(ctx: Context, e: unknown, trigger?: unknown): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (Array.isArray(e)) return "text";
  if (isObject(e) && "sentField" in e) {
    const field = isString(e["sentField"]) ? ctx.catalogue.sentField(trigger, e["sentField"]) : undefined;
    return field?.kind;
  }
  return ctx.kinds.expressionKind(e);
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/parts.ts\n===
/**
 * `item.partMissing` for the parts core-api.md section 4 lists, and `condition.noClauses` for an
 * empty "and" or "or" list anywhere but an arrow's `when.condition` (E-23; compiler.md 14.3 #6).
 * An empty "when" or "only when" is never read as "always true" (E-25).
 */
import { WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER, type Words } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { isObject, isString } from "./walk.ts";

const NOTHING_AFTER: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<Words>(WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER);
const blank = (x: unknown): boolean => !isString(x) || x.trim() === "";

export function missingParts(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const missing = (item: string, part: string): void => {
    out.push(finding("item.partMissing", at(item, part), {}));
  };
  /** The lists questions take their choices from. */
  const choiceLists = new Set<string>();
  const wf: unknown = ctx.workflow;
  const startsWhen = isObject(wf) && isObject(wf["start"]) && Array.isArray(wf["start"]["startsWhen"]) ? wf["start"]["startsWhen"] : [];
  for (const b of startsWhen) {
    if (!isObject(b) || !isString(b["id"])) continue;
    if (b["trigger"] === undefined) missing(b["id"], "trigger");
    if (b["button"] === undefined && (ctx.startTask?.buttons.length ?? 0) > 1) missing(b["id"], "button");
  }

  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    const stage = view.stage;
    if (blank(stage.name)) missing(stage.id, "name");
    const working = view.working;
    if (!working) continue;
    if (!Array.isArray(working.arrows) || working.arrows.length === 0) missing(stage.id, "arrows");
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      switch (action.type) {
        case "saveValue":
          if (action.save === undefined) missing(action.id, "save");
          if (action.as === undefined) missing(action.id, "as");
          break;
        case "notify":
          if (action.to === undefined) missing(action.id, "to");
          break;
        case "useConnection":
          if (action.operation === undefined) missing(action.id, "operation");
          break;
        case "tellOtherSystems":
          if (action.tell === undefined) missing(action.id, "tell");
          break;
      }
    }
    for (const task of view.tasks) {
      if (task.task.whoIsAsked === undefined) missing(task.task.id, "whoIsAsked");
      if (task.buttons.length === 0) missing(task.task.id, "buttons");
      for (const { question: q } of task.questions) {
        if (blank(q.label)) missing(q.id, "label");
        if (q.savedAs === undefined) missing(q.id, "savedAs");
        const c: unknown = q.choices;
        if (c === undefined && (q.kind === "choice" || q.kind === "multipleChoice")) missing(q.id, "choices");
        // A list choice without its list is parse.missingField: the format requires it (E-26).
        if (!isObject(c)) continue;
        // Typed-in choices with none in them: no answer could be given, as for a list with no rows (E-32).
        if (c["from"] === "typedIn" && Array.isArray(c["choices"]) && c["choices"].length === 0) missing(q.id, "choices");
        if (c["from"] === "list" && isString(c["list"])) choiceLists.add(c["list"]);
        if (c["from"] === "source") {
          if (c["source"] === undefined) missing(q.id, "choices.source");
          if (c["labelField"] === undefined) missing(q.id, "choices.labelField");
          if (c["storedField"] === undefined) missing(q.id, "choices.storedField");
        }
      }
      for (const b of task.buttons) if (blank(b.label)) missing(b.id, "label");
    }
    for (const arrow of view.arrows) {
      if (arrow.goTo === null || arrow.goTo === undefined) missing(arrow.id, "goTo");
      const when: unknown = arrow.when;
      // No "when" is "not decided", never "always" (E-25).
      if (when === undefined || when === null) missing(arrow.id, "when");
      if (!isObject(when)) continue;
      if (when["type"] === "buttonPressed" && !isString(when["button"])) missing(arrow.id, "when.button");
      if (when["type"] === "condition") {
        const c = when["condition"];
        const clauses = isObject(c) ? (c["allOf"] ?? c["anyOf"]) : undefined;
        if (c === undefined || (Array.isArray(clauses) && clauses.length === 0)) missing(arrow.id, "when.condition");
      }
    }
  }
  // A list that a question takes its choices from, with no rows: no answer could be given (E-27).
  for (const l of Array.isArray(ctx.workflow?.lists) ? ctx.workflow.lists : [])
    if (isObject(l) && isString(l.id) && choiceLists.has(l.id) && Array.isArray(l.rows) && l.rows.length === 0) {
      choiceLists.delete(l.id);
      missing(l.id, "rows");
    }
  for (const status of Array.isArray(ctx.workflow?.statuses) ? ctx.workflow.statuses : [])
    if (isObject(status) && isString(status.id) && blank(status.words)) missing(status.id, "words");
  for (const told of Array.isArray(ctx.workflow?.thingsTold) ? ctx.workflow.thingsTold : [])
    if (isObject(told) && isString(told.id) && blank(told.words)) missing(told.id, "words");

  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    if (n.sort === "formula" && blank(n.node["readsAs"])) missing(n.item, `${n.path}.readsAs`);
    if (n.sort === "sentence" && n.clauses.length === 0 && !(n.path === "when.condition" && n.path === n.slot))
      out.push(finding("condition.noClauses", at(n.item, n.path), {}));
    if (n.sort !== "clause") continue;
    const c = n.node;
    if (!isObject(c)) {
      missing(n.item, n.path);
      continue;
    }
    if ("pressed" in c) continue;
    if (c["left"] === undefined) missing(n.item, `${n.path}.left`);
    if (c["words"] === undefined) missing(n.item, `${n.path}.words`);
    else if (isString(c["words"]) && !NOTHING_AFTER.has(c["words"]) && (c["right"] === undefined || (Array.isArray(c["right"]) && c["right"].length === 0)))
      missing(n.item, `${n.path}.right`);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * `clause.pressedOutsideStage`: "is pressed" is legal only in the stage that owns the button, in its
 * arrows and its "After they respond" actions (format, PressedClause; compiler.md 6.5, 8.1). An
 * arrow whose "when" is a button of another stage is the same mistake (E-26).
 */
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { isObject, isString } from "./walk.ts";

export function pressedOutsideStage(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const after = new Set<string>(ctx.ix.stages.flatMap((v) => v.after.map((a) => a.id)));
  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    if (n.sort !== "clause" || !isObject(n.node) || !isString(n.node["pressed"])) continue;
    const button = n.node["pressed"];
    const owner = ctx.ix.buttonTask.get(button);
    if (!owner) continue; // a deleted button: item.brokenReference
    const item = ctx.ix.byId.get(n.item);
    const legalPlace = item?.kind === "arrow" || (item?.kind === "action" && after.has(n.item));
    if (!legalPlace || item?.stage !== owner.stage)
      out.push(finding("clause.pressedOutsideStage", at(n.item, n.path), { button: button as `btn_${string}` }));
  }
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages)
    for (const arrow of view.arrows) {
      const when: unknown = arrow.when;
      if (!isObject(when) || when["type"] !== "buttonPressed" || !isString(when["button"])) continue;
      const owner = ctx.ix.buttonTask.get(when["button"]);
      if (owner && owner.stage !== view.stage.id)
        out.push(finding("clause.pressedOutsideStage", at(arrow.id, "when.button"), { button: when["button"] as `btn_${string}` }));
    }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Every read of a value: a `{ value }` reference, or a `{{v_…}}` chip in formula text (with its
 * range). A reference inside a clause is reported at the clause; a chip at the part that holds its
 * formula (core-api.md 2.3).
 */
import type { Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { chipsOf, type TextRange } from "../formula/chips.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at } from "./findings.ts";
import { readingPart, type WalkNode } from "./walk.ts";

export interface Read {
  value: string;
  /** Where the read is reported. */
  location: Location;
  /** The reported part of the slot that holds it. */
  slot: string;
  /** In formula text: the chip. */
  range?: TextRange;
  node: WalkNode;
}

export function readsOf(ctx: Context): Read[] {
  const out: Read[] = [];
  for (const n of ctx.nodes) {
    if (n.sort === "reference") out.push({ value: n.value, location: at(n.item, readingPart(n)), slot: n.slot, node: n });
    if (n.sort === "formula" && !n.sent)
      for (const chip of chipsOf(n.text))
        if (chip.sort === "value") out.push({ value: chip.value, location: at(n.item, n.path), slot: n.slot, range: chip.range, node: n });
  }
  return out;
}

/** A finding's range params, when the read is a chip. */
export function rangeParams(read: Read): { start?: number; end?: number } {
  return read.range ? { start: read.range.start, end: read.range.end } : {};
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/references.ts\n===
/**
 * `item.brokenReference`: a reference to an item that no longer exists, reported at the referring
 * part. `start.stage` is `workflow.noStart`'s, a catalogue entry is `catalogue.unknownEntry`'s and
 * a chip in formula text is `formula.unknownName`'s, so none of them is reported here.
 */
import type { ItemKind, Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { ReferenceKind } from "../index-doc.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";

const KIND_OF: Record<Exclude<ReferenceKind, "catalogue">, ItemKind> = {
  stage: "stage", status: "status", value: "value", list: "list", column: "column", row: "row",
  choice: "choice", button: "button", question: "question", thingTold: "thingTold",
};

/** A column step is reported at the reference that holds it, not at `steps.<n>`. */
function referringPart(from: Location): Location {
  const part = from.part?.replace(/(^|\.)steps\.\d+$/, "");
  return at(from.item, part);
}

export function brokenReferences(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const exists = (id: string, kind: ItemKind): boolean => ctx.ix.byId.get(id)?.kind === kind;
  const report = (from: Location, target: string): void => {
    const location = referringPart(from);
    const key = `${location.item} ${location.part ?? ""} ${target}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push(finding("item.brokenReference", location, { target }));
  };
  for (const ref of ctx.ix.references) {
    if (ref.kind === "catalogue" || ref.kind === "value") continue;
    if (ref.from.part === "start.stage" && ctx.ix.byId.get(ref.from.item)?.kind === "workflow") continue;
    if (!exists(ref.to, KIND_OF[ref.kind])) report(ref.from, ref.to);
  }
  // Values: where they are filled, and where they are read outside formula text.
  for (const fill of ctx.ix.fills) if (!ctx.registered.has(fill.value)) report(fill.at, fill.value);
  for (const use of ctx.ix.uses) if (!use.inFormula && !ctx.registered.has(use.value)) report(use.at, use.value);
  return out;
}

/**
 * Where a request goes after a stage: every button or combination of buttons has an arrow
 * (compiler.md 6.3, 14.1), "In all other cases" is last and plain (E-18, E-23), arrows that are
 * never used (facts), and a carried-on failure has an arrow while a stopped one is never read.

const MAX_LISTED = 10;

const isOtherCases = (a: Arrow): boolean => isObject(a.when) && a.when.type === "inAllOtherCases";

/** An arrow whose "when" is not chosen yet: nothing can be said of it but its To do. */
function unfinished(a: Arrow): boolean {
  const w: unknown = a.when;
  if (!isObject(w)) return true;
  if (w["type"] === "buttonPressed") return !isString(w["button"]);
  if (w["type"] === "condition") {
    const c = w["condition"];
    const clauses = isObject(c) ? (c["allOf"] ?? c["anyOf"]) : undefined;
    return c === undefined || (Array.isArray(clauses) && clauses.length === 0);
  }
  return false;
}

function pressedRule(ctx: Context, view: StageView, combo: Combo): ClauseRule {
  return (c) => (isObject(c) && isString(c["pressed"]) ? pressed(ctx.ix, view, combo, c["pressed"]) : undefined);
}

/** Some arrow may fit: an unfinished arrow or "In all other cases" counts as fitting. */
function covered(view: StageView, rule: ClauseRule): boolean {
  return view.arrows.some((a) => isOtherCases(a) || unfinished(a) || arrowTri(a, rule) !== false);
}

/** The combinations in which every task is answered with a button, when they can be listed. */
function listedCombos(view: StageView): Combo[] | undefined {
  const combos = fullCombos(view);
  return combos.every((c) => c.choices.every((x) => x.kind === "button")) ? combos : undefined;
}

export function nowhereToGo(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    if (!view.working) continue;
    const combos = listedCombos(view);
    if (!combos) continue;
    const lost = combos.filter((combo) => !covered(view, pressedRule(ctx, view, combo)));
    if (!lost.length) continue;
    const [task] = view.tasks;
    if (view.tasks.length === 1 && task) {
      for (const combo of lost) {
        const choice = combo.choices[0];
        if (choice?.kind === "button") out.push(finding("stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo", at(choice.button.id), { task: { item: task.task.id } }));
      }
      continue;
    }
    const combinations = lost.slice(0, MAX_LISTED).map((combo) =>
      combo.choices.flatMap((choice, i) => {
        const t = view.tasks[i];
        return choice.kind === "button" && t ? [{ task: { item: t.task.id }, button: { item: choice.button.id } }] : [];
      }),
    );
    out.push(finding("stage.combinationHasNowhereToGo", at(view.stage.id, "arrows"), { combinations, total: lost.length }));
  }
  return out;
}

export function arrowRules(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const pressedElsewhere = new Set(pressedOutsideStage(ctx).map((f) => f.location.item));
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    view.arrows.forEach((arrow, i) => {
      if (!isOtherCases(arrow)) return;
      if (i !== view.arrows.length - 1) out.push(finding("arrow.otherCasesNotLast", at(arrow.id, "when"), {}));
      if (arrow.onlyWhen !== undefined) out.push(finding("arrow.otherCasesWithCondition", at(arrow.id, "onlyWhen"), {}));
      if (arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue === true) out.push(finding("arrow.otherCasesWithCondition", at(arrow.id, "goAsSoonAsTrue"), {}));
    });
    if (!view.working || !ctx.graph.reachable.has(view.stage.id)) continue; // arrows out of unreachable stages are not reported
    const usability = arrowUsability(ctx.ix, view);
    for (const arrow of view.arrows) {
      const u = usability.get(arrow.id);
      // An arrow with clause.pressedOutsideStage has that To do alone (E-27).
      if (!u || u.usable || unfinished(arrow) || pressedElsewhere.has(arrow.id)) continue;
      const params: FindingParams["arrow.neverUsed"] = { reason: u.reason };
      if (u.earlier) params.earlier = u.earlier;
      if (u.covering) params.covering = u.covering;
      out.push(finding("arrow.neverUsed", at(arrow.id), params));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The state just before an action of the stage, joined over every way the stage can be visited. */
function stateBefore(ctx: Context, view: StageView, action: string): State | undefined {
  const run = ctx.flow.run(view.stage.id);
  const i = view.arrival.findIndex((a) => a.id === action);
  if (i >= 0) return run.arrival[i];
  const j = view.after.findIndex((a) => a.id === action);
  return joinAll(run.combos.flatMap((c) => (c.after[j] ? [c.after[j]] : [])));
}

/** Whether something in the stage fills the value after the action (a later action or the tasks). */
function filledLater(ctx: Context, view: StageView, action: string, value: string): boolean {
  const order = ctx.ix.byId.get(action)?.order ?? 0;
  return (ctx.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? []).some((f) => f.at.item !== action && ctx.ix.byId.get(f.at.item)?.stage === view.stage.id && (ctx.ix.byId.get(f.at.item)?.order ?? 0) > order);
}

/** What a carried-on failure of `action` makes known at the arrows (compiler.md 11.2): "failed" is Yes, results keep what they had. */
function failureKnown(ctx: Context, view: StageView, action: UseConnection): Map<string, Known> {
  const known = new Map<string, Known>();
  const failedTo = isObject(action.saveFailureAs) ? action.saveFailureAs : {};
  if (isString(failedTo.failed) && !filledLater(ctx, view, action.id, failedTo.failed)) known.set(failedTo.failed, { constant: { yesNo: true } });
  if (isString(failedTo.code) && !filledLater(ctx, view, action.id, failedTo.code)) known.set(failedTo.code, "filled");
  const before = stateBefore(ctx, view, action.id);
  for (const value of isObject(action.saveResults) ? Object.values(action.saveResults) : []) {
    const i = isString(value) ? ctx.flow.valueIndex.get(value) : undefined;
    if (!isString(value) || i === undefined || !before || filledLater(ctx, view, action.id, value) || known.has(value)) continue;
    const flags = before.flags[i] ?? EMPTY;
    if (flags === EMPTY) known.set(value, "empty");
    else if (flags === FILLED) known.set(value, "filled");
  }
  return known;
}

export function failureChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const stuckFailureValues = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      if (action.type !== "useConnection") continue;
      const failedTo = isObject(action.saveFailureAs) ? action.saveFailureAs : {};
      if (action.ifItFails !== "carryOn") {
        for (const v of [failedTo.failed, failedTo.code]) if (isString(v) && !stuckFailureValues.has(v)) stuckFailureValues.set(v, action.id);
        continue;
      }
      if (view.arrows.length === 0) continue; // item.partMissing says it
      const known = failureKnown(ctx, view, action);
      const values = knownClause((left) => (isString(left["value"]) && !Array.isArray(left["steps"]) ? known.get(left["value"]) : undefined));
      const combos = listedCombos(view) ?? [];
      if (combos.some((combo) => !covered(view, eitherRule(pressedRule(ctx, view, combo), values)))) {
        const params: { failed?: `v_${string}`; code?: `v_${string}` } = {};
        if (isString(failedTo.failed)) params.failed = failedTo.failed;
        if (isString(failedTo.code)) params.code = failedTo.code;
        out.push(finding("action.failureHasNowhereToGo", at(action.id, "ifItFails"), params));
      }
    }
  }
  // A stopped failure is never saved: reading what it would save means nothing.
  const stopped = stoppedFailureValues(ctx);
  for (const read of readsOf(ctx)) {
    const action = stuckFailureValues.get(read.value);
    if (action && stopped.has(read.value)) out.push(finding("action.failureReadButStops", read.location, { ...rangeParams(read), action: { item: action } }));
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * `action.failureNotRead` (E-27): an action carries on after a failure, and nothing reads the values
 * the failure is saved as, or none is saved. Any read anywhere counts: an arrow, an "only when", a
 * later action, a message, a template or a condition.
 */
export function failureNotRead(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const read = new Set(readsOf(ctx).map((r) => r.value));
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages)
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      if (action.type !== "useConnection" || action.ifItFails !== "carryOn") continue;
      const failedTo = isObject(action.saveFailureAs) ? action.saveFailureAs : {};
      const params: { failed?: `v_${string}`; code?: `v_${string}` } = {};
      if (isString(failedTo.failed)) params.failed = failedTo.failed;
      if (isString(failedTo.code)) params.code = failedTo.code;
      if ((params.failed !== undefined && read.has(params.failed)) || (params.code !== undefined && read.has(params.code))) continue;
      out.push(finding("action.failureNotRead", at(action.id, "ifItFails"), params));
    }
  return out;
}

function isStopped(ctx: Context, action: string): boolean {
  const a = ctx.actions.get(action);
  return a?.type === "useConnection" && a.ifItFails !== "carryOn";
}

/** The values whose only fillers are the failure saves of actions that stop on failure. */
export function stoppedFailureValues(ctx: Context): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const f of ctx.ix.fills) if ((f.by === "failed" || f.by === "failureCode") && isStopped(ctx, f.at.item)) out.add(f.value);
  for (const v of [...out]) if (!(ctx.ix.fillsOf.get(v) ?? []).every((f) => (f.by === "failed" || f.by === "failureCode") && isStopped(ctx, f.at.item))) out.delete(v);
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/rows.ts\n===
/**
 * Which rows of a workflow list a list-choice value can hold when it reaches each stage. A row
 * leaves a route when an arrow taken there cannot fit with that row, or an earlier arrow surely
 * fits with it: "Domain needs no approval" (Needs approval is No) takes Internal tools away from the
 * route through "In all other cases". Buttons are known per combination; every other clause that
 * does not read the row is "not known". One value at a time, so the result is sound.
 */
import type { List } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { fullCombos, isEarly, partialCombos, pressed, type Combo } from "../facts/combos.ts";
import type { StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { arrowTri, eitherRule, knownClause, type ClauseRule, type Known } from "./tri.ts";
import { isObject, isString } from "./walk.ts";

type Rows = ReadonlySet<string>;

const isOtherCases = (a: StageView["arrows"][number]): boolean => isObject(a.when) && a.when.type === "inAllOtherCases";

/** The values a condition reads on the left of a clause. */
function leftValues(c: unknown, out: Set<string>): void {
  if (!isObject(c)) return;
  const clauses = c["allOf"] ?? c["anyOf"];
  for (const clause of Array.isArray(clauses) ? clauses : [])
    if (isObject(clause) && isObject(clause["left"]) && isString(clause["left"]["value"])) out.add(clause["left"]["value"]);
}

/** What one stage needs, worked out once. */
interface StageInfo {
  combos: Combo[];
  /** Values filled anywhere in the stage, and in its arrival section. */
  filled: ReadonlySet<string>;
  filledOnArrival: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Values a clause of an arrow reads on its left. */
  readByArrows: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Per arrow: whether it can be taken, knowing only the buttons. */
  takenByButtons: boolean[];
}

export class RowFlow {
  private readonly ctx: Context;
  /** The list each tracked value's rows come from. */
  private readonly lists = new Map<string, List>();
  /** Rows on the arrows into each stage, per value. */
  private readonly arrived = new Map<string, Map<string, Set<string>>>();
  private readonly info = new Map<string, StageInfo>();

  /** `wanted`: the values whose rows are asked for; only they are followed. */
  constructor(ctx: Context, wanted: ReadonlySet<string>) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
    for (const f of ctx.ix.fills) {
      if (f.by !== "question" || this.lists.has(f.value) || !wanted.has(f.value)) continue;
      const c: unknown = ctx.questions.get(f.at.item)?.question.choices;
      const lists = Array.isArray(ctx.workflow.lists) ? ctx.workflow.lists : [];
      const list = isObject(c) && c["from"] === "list" ? lists.find((l) => isObject(l) && l.id === c["list"]) : undefined;
      if (list && Array.isArray(list.rows) && ctx.kinds.valueKind(f.value) === "choiceFromList") this.lists.set(f.value, list);
    }
    if (this.lists.size) this.solve();
  }

  /** The list a value's rows come from, when it is tracked. */
  listOf(value: string): List | undefined {
    return this.lists.get(value);
  }

  private readonly rowsOf = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  /** Every row of the value's list. Shared: callers copy before they change it. */
  private all(value: string): ReadonlySet<string> {
    let rows = this.rowsOf.get(value);
    if (!rows) {
      rows = new Set((this.lists.get(value)?.rows ?? []).flatMap((r) => (isObject(r) && isString(r.id) ? [r.id] : [])));
      this.rowsOf.set(value, rows);
    }
    return rows;
  }

  private stageInfo(view: StageView): StageInfo {
    const known = this.info.get(view.stage.id);
    if (known) return known;
    const filled = new Set<string>();
    const filledOnArrival = new Set<string>();
    const arrival = new Set<string>(view.arrival.map((a) => a.id));
    for (const value of this.lists.keys())
      for (const f of this.ctx.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? [])
        if (this.ctx.ix.byId.get(f.at.item)?.stage === view.stage.id) {
          filled.add(f.value);
          if (arrival.has(f.at.item)) filledOnArrival.add(f.value);
        }
    const readByArrows = new Set<string>();
    for (const a of view.arrows) {
      if (isObject(a.when) && a.when.type === "condition") leftValues(a.when.condition, readByArrows);
      leftValues(a.onlyWhen, readByArrows);
    }
    const combos = [...fullCombos(view), ...partialCombos(view)];
    const buttons = (combo: Combo): ClauseRule => this.buttons(view, combo);
    const takenByButtons = view.arrows.map((_, index) => combos.some((combo) => this.mayTake(view, combo, index, buttons(combo))));
    const info: StageInfo = { combos, filled, filledOnArrival, readByArrows, takenByButtons };
    this.info.set(view.stage.id, info);
    return info;
  }

  /** The rows a value may hold when the stage's tasks open; undefined when it is not tracked or the stage is not reached. */
  rowsAtTasks(stage: string, value: string): Rows | undefined {
    if (!this.lists.has(value)) return undefined;
    const view = this.ctx.ix.stageById.get(stage);
    if (view && this.stageInfo(view).filledOnArrival.has(value)) return this.all(value);
    return this.entry(stage, value, stage !== this.ctx.graph.root);
  }

  /** On entry; a new request at the start stage may hold any row once it is filled. */
  private entry(stage: string, value: string, arrowsOnly = false): Set<string> | undefined {
    const arrived = this.arrived.get(stage)?.get(value);
    if (stage === this.ctx.graph.root && !arrowsOnly) return new Set([...this.all(value), ...(arrived ?? [])]);
    return arrived;
  }

  private solve(): void {
    const root = this.ctx.graph.root;
    if (root === undefined) return;
    const queue = [root];
    const queued = new Set(queue);
    while (queue.length) {
      const stage = queue.shift() ?? "";
      queued.delete(stage);
      const view = this.ctx.ix.stageById.get(stage);
      if (!view?.working) continue;
      const info = this.stageInfo(view);
      for (const value of this.lists.keys()) {
        const rows = info.filled.has(value) ? this.all(value) : this.entry(stage, value);
        if (!rows) continue;
        // An arrow that reads nothing of the value lets every row through, or none.
        const reads = info.readByArrows.has(value);
        view.arrows.forEach((arrow, index) => {
          const to = arrow.goTo;
          if (!isString(to) || !this.ctx.ix.stageById.has(to)) return;
          const taken = !reads
            ? info.takenByButtons[index] ? [...rows] : []
            : [...rows].filter((row) => info.combos.some((combo) => this.mayTake(view, combo, index, this.rule(view, combo, value, row))));
          if (!taken.length) return;
          const byValue = this.arrived.get(to) ?? new Map<string, Set<string>>();
          this.arrived.set(to, byValue);
          const before = byValue.get(value) ?? new Set<string>();
          const size = before.size;
          for (const row of taken) before.add(row);
          byValue.set(value, before);
          if (before.size !== size && !queued.has(to)) {
            queue.push(to);
            queued.add(to);
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }

  private buttons(view: StageView, combo: Combo): ClauseRule {
    return (c) => (isObject(c) && isString(c["pressed"]) ? pressed(this.ctx.ix, view, combo, c["pressed"]) : undefined);
  }

  private rule(view: StageView, combo: Combo, value: string, row: string): ClauseRule {
    const list = this.lists.get(value);
    const cells = list?.rows.find((r) => r?.id === row)?.cells;
    const known = (left: Record<string, unknown>): Known | undefined => {
      if (left["value"] !== value) return undefined;
      const steps = left["steps"];
      if (steps === undefined || (Array.isArray(steps) && steps.length === 0)) return { constant: { row } };
      if (!Array.isArray(steps) || steps.length !== 1 || !isObject(steps[0]) || !isString(steps[0]["column"])) return undefined;
      const cell: unknown = isObject(cells) ? cells[steps[0]["column"] as `col_${string}`] : undefined;
      return isObject(cell) ? { constant: cell } : "empty";
    };
    return eitherRule(this.buttons(view, combo), knownClause(known));
  }

  /** Whether the arrow can be the one taken with this combination, judged by `rule` (compiler.md 6.2, 6.4). */
  private mayTake(view: StageView, combo: Combo, index: number, rule: ClauseRule): boolean {
    const arrow = view.arrows[index];
    if (!arrow || (!combo.full && !isEarly(view, arrow))) return false;
    if (!isOtherCases(arrow) && arrowTri(arrow, rule) === false) return false;
    return !view.arrows.slice(0, index).some((e) => (combo.full || isEarly(view, e)) && !isOtherCases(e) && arrowTri(e, rule) === true);
  }
}
