/**
 * The start: `workflow.noStart`, `start.notOneTask`, `start.needsStatus` (E-16),
 * `start.directoryInCondition` (E-23), and the bindings' `startsWhen.neededNotFilled` (E-17, E-20),
 * `startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn` (E-23; compiler.md 14.3 #2) and `startsWhen.buttonNotOnStart` (E-26).
 */
import type { StartsWhen } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { boundButton, neededFor, workflowId, type Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { expressionKindOf } from "./kinds-of.ts";
import { isObject, isString, type WalkNode } from "./walk.ts";
import { chipsOf } from "../formula/chips.ts";

export function startChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const startId: unknown = isObject(ctx.workflow) && isObject(ctx.workflow.start) ? ctx.workflow.start.stage : undefined;
  const view = isString(startId) ? ctx.ix.stageById.get(startId) : undefined;
  if (!view?.working) {
    out.push(finding("workflow.noStart", at(workflowId(ctx), "start.stage"), {}));
    return out;
  }
  const stage = view.stage.id;
  if (view.tasks.length !== 1) out.push(finding("start.notOneTask", at(stage, "tasks"), { found: view.tasks.length }));
  const call = view.after.find((a) => a.type === "useConnection");
  if (call && view.working.status === undefined) out.push(finding("start.needsStatus", at(stage, "status"), { action: { item: call.id } }));
  if (ctx.startTask) out.push(...directoryOnStartForm(ctx, ctx.startTask));
  return out;
}

/** Whether a clause needs a group's members: a `members` step, or "is in" a group (compiler.md 8.6). */
function clauseReadsDirectory(ctx: Context, nodes: readonly WalkNode[], clause: WalkNode & { sort: "clause" }): boolean {
  const inside = nodes.filter((n) => n.item === clause.item && n.clause === clause.path);
  const members = inside.some(
    (n) => n.sort === "reference" && Array.isArray(n.node["steps"]) && n.node["steps"].some((s) => isObject(s) && s["directory"] === "members"),
  );
  if (members) return true;
  const c = clause.node;
  if (!isObject(c)) return false;
  const words = c["words"];
  if (words === "person.isIn" || words === "person.isNotIn") return expressionKindOf(ctx, c["right"]) === "group";
  if (isString(words) && words.startsWith("people.")) return expressionKindOf(ctx, c["left"]) === "group";
  return false;
}

/** Conditions on the start form: pages', questions' and texts' Show when, buttons' "Also only when". */
function directoryOnStartForm(ctx: Context, task: TaskView): Finding[] {
  const onForm = new Set<string>();
  for (const item of ctx.ix.items) if (item.task === task.task.id && item.kind !== "task") onForm.add(item.id);
  const nodes = ctx.nodes.filter((n) => onForm.has(n.item) && (n.slot === "showWhen" || n.slot === "enabledWhen"));
  return nodes
    .filter((n): n is WalkNode & { sort: "clause" } => n.sort === "clause" && clauseReadsDirectory(ctx, nodes, n))
    .map((n) => finding("start.directoryInCondition", at(n.item, n.path), {}));
}

function bindings(ctx: Context): StartsWhen[] {
  const wf: unknown = ctx.workflow;
  const list = isObject(wf) && isObject(wf["start"]) && Array.isArray(wf["start"]["startsWhen"]) ? wf["start"]["startsWhen"] : [];
  return list.filter((b): b is StartsWhen => isObject(b) && isString(b["id"]));
}

/** Whether a condition reads "Started on", by a reference or a chip. */
function readsStartedOn(ctx: Context, item: string, slot: string): boolean {
  return ctx.nodes.some(
    (n) =>
      n.item === item &&
      n.slot === slot &&
      ((n.sort === "request" && n.request === "startedOn") || (n.sort === "formula" && chipsOf(n.text).some((c) => c.sort === "startedOn"))),
  );
}

export function bindingChecks(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const task = ctx.startTask;
  if (!task) return out;
  for (const b of bindings(ctx)) {
    // A binding starts a request by pressing a start-form button (E-26). A deleted button is item.brokenReference.
    if (isString(b.button) && ctx.ix.buttonTask.has(b.button) && !task.buttons.some((x) => x.id === b.button))
      out.push(finding("startsWhen.buttonNotOnStart", at(b.id, "button"), { button: b.button }));
    const answers = isObject(b.answers) ? b.answers : {};
    const button = boundButton(ctx, b);
    if (button !== undefined && task.buttons.some((x) => x.id === button)) {
      // E-20: needed whether or not the question has a "Show when".
      const questions = neededFor(task, button).filter((q) => !(q in answers));
      if (questions.length) out.push(finding("startsWhen.neededNotFilled", at(b.id, "answers"), { button: button as `btn_${string}`, questions: questions as `q_${string}`[] }));
    }
    for (const q of Object.keys(answers)) {
      const entry = task.questions.find((x) => x.question.id === q);
      if (!entry) continue;
      if (readsStartedOn(ctx, entry.question.id, "showWhen") || readsStartedOn(ctx, entry.page.id, "showWhen"))
        out.push(finding("startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn", at(b.id, `answers.${q}`), { question: q as `q_${string}` }));
    }
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/tri.ts\n===
/**
 * Conditions worked out from partial knowledge: true, false, or not known (undefined). A clause is
 * judged by the caller's rule (buttons pressed, a list row, a failed action); "and" and "or" join
 * three-valued. Empty values follow E-22 and compiler.md 8.3.
 */
import type { Arrow } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { isObject, isString, type Obj } from "./walk.ts";

export type Tri = boolean | undefined;
export type ClauseRule = (clause: unknown) => Tri;

/** A condition; an absent one is true. A formula, or a sentence with no clauses, is not known. */
export function conditionTri(c: unknown, rule: ClauseRule): Tri {
  if (c === undefined) return true;
  if (!isObject(c)) return undefined;
  const all = Array.isArray(c["allOf"]);
  const clauses = all ? (c["allOf"] as unknown[]) : Array.isArray(c["anyOf"]) ? (c["anyOf"] as unknown[]) : undefined;
  if (!clauses || clauses.length === 0) return undefined;
  const values = clauses.map(rule);
  if (all) return values.includes(false) ? false : values.every((v) => v === true) ? true : undefined;
  return values.includes(true) ? true : values.every((v) => v === false) ? false : undefined;
}

export const and = (a: Tri, b: Tri): Tri => (a === false || b === false ? false : a === true && b === true ? true : undefined);

/** Whether an arrow fits: its "when" and its "+ only when". "In all other cases" is the caller's. */
export function arrowTri(arrow: Arrow, rule: ClauseRule): Tri {
  const w: unknown = arrow.when;
  if (!isObject(w)) return undefined;
  let when: Tri;
  switch (w["type"]) {
    case "whenDone":
      when = true;
      break;
    case "buttonPressed":
      when = isString(w["button"]) ? rule({ pressed: w["button"] }) : undefined;
      break;
    case "condition":
      when = w["condition"] === undefined ? undefined : conditionTri(w["condition"], rule);
      break;
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
  return and(when, conditionTri(arrow.onlyWhen, rule));
}

/** What is known about the left side of a clause: empty, filled with an unknown value, or a constant. */
export type Known = "empty" | "filled" | { constant: Obj };

const NEGATIVE = new Set([
  "text.isNot", "text.doesNotContain", "number.isNot", "choice.isNot", "choice.isNotOneOf", "person.isNot", "person.isNotIn",
  "people.doNotInclude", "list.doesNotInclude",
]);
const EMPTY_WORDS = new Set(["text.isEmpty", "number.isEmpty", "yesNo.isEmpty", "date.isEmpty", "choice.isEmpty", "person.isEmpty", "people.areEmpty", "list.isEmpty"]);
const FILLED_WORDS = new Set(["text.isFilled", "number.isFilled", "yesNo.isFilled", "date.isFilled", "choice.isFilled", "person.isFilled", "people.areFilled", "list.isFilled"]);

/** The comparable content of a constant: text, number, yes/no, a date, a choice, row or button ID, a failure code, a person's or group's ID. */
function scalar(c: Obj): string | number | boolean | undefined {
  for (const key of ["text", "number", "yesNo", "date", "choice", "row", "button", "failureCode"]) {
    const v = c[key];
    if (typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "boolean") return v;
  }
  for (const key of ["person", "group"]) {
    const ref = c[key];
    if (isObject(ref) && isString(ref["directoryId"])) return `${key}:${ref["directoryId"]}`;
  }
  const choice = c["connectionChoice"];
  if (isObject(choice) && (isString(choice["stored"]) || typeof choice["stored"] === "number")) return choice["stored"];
  return undefined;
}

/** A clause's words on a known left side and a constant right side (compiler.md 8.3). */
export function wordsTri(words: unknown, left: Known, right: unknown): Tri {
  if (!isString(words)) return undefined;
  if (left === "empty") return EMPTY_WORDS.has(words) || NEGATIVE.has(words);
  if (EMPTY_WORDS.has(words)) return false;
  if (FILLED_WORDS.has(words)) return true;
  if (left === "filled") return undefined;
  const l = scalar(left.constant);
  if (words === "yesNo.isYes") return typeof l === "boolean" ? l : undefined;
  if (words === "yesNo.isNo") return typeof l === "boolean" ? !l : undefined;
  if (l === undefined) return undefined;
  const list = Array.isArray(right) ? right : [right];
  if (!list.every(isObject)) return undefined;
  const rights = list.map((r) => scalar(r as Obj));
  if (rights.some((r) => r === undefined)) return undefined;
  const r = rights[0];
  switch (words) {
    case "text.is":
    case "number.is":
    case "date.is":
    case "choice.is":
    case "person.is":
      return l === r;
    case "text.isNot":
    case "number.isNot":
    case "choice.isNot":
    case "person.isNot":
      return l !== r;
    case "choice.isOneOf":
    case "person.isOneOf":
      return rights.includes(l);
    case "choice.isNotOneOf":
      return !rights.includes(l);
    case "text.contains":
      return typeof l === "string" && typeof r === "string" ? l.includes(r) : undefined;
    case "text.doesNotContain":
      return typeof l === "string" && typeof r === "string" ? !l.includes(r) : undefined;
    case "text.startsWith":
      return typeof l === "string" && typeof r === "string" ? l.startsWith(r) : undefined;
    case "number.isMoreThan":
    case "date.isAfter":
      return typeof l === typeof r && r !== undefined ? l > r : undefined;
    case "number.isLessThan":
    case "date.isBefore":
      return typeof l === typeof r && r !== undefined ? l < r : undefined;
    case "number.isAtLeast":
    case "date.isOnOrAfter":
      return typeof l === typeof r && r !== undefined ? l >= r : undefined;
    case "number.isAtMost":
    case "date.isOnOrBefore":
      return typeof l === typeof r && r !== undefined ? l <= r : undefined;
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** A clause whose left side is a plain value reference (no "If empty, use"), judged by what is known of that reference. */
export function knownClause(known: (left: Obj) => Known | undefined): ClauseRule {
  return (clause) => {
    if (!isObject(clause) || "pressed" in clause) return undefined;
    const left = clause["left"];
    if (!isObject(left) || !isString(left["value"]) || left["ifEmptyUse"] !== undefined) return undefined;
    const k = known(left);
    return k === undefined ? undefined : wordsTri(clause["words"], k, clause["right"]);
  };
}

/** Each clause by the first rule that knows it. */
export function eitherRule(...rules: ClauseRule[]): ClauseRule {
  return (clause) => {
    for (const rule of rules) {
      const v = rule(clause);
      if (v !== undefined) return v;
    }
    return undefined;
  };
}

/**
 * Whether a To do stops a request from running in Try it: the "Stops Try it" column of
 * core-api.md section 4 and the `item.partMissing` parts listed under it (E-20). For the test
 * host; Worth knowing never stops anything.
 */
import type { Finding, FindingCode } from "./findings.ts";

/** `bindingOnly`: refuses `startFrom` on that binding with `unfinished`; `start` is not blocked. */
export type TryItEffect = "stops" | "runs" | "bindingOnly";

const STOPS: ReadonlySet<FindingCode> = new Set<FindingCode>([
  "item.brokenReference", "workflow.noStart", "start.notOneTask", "start.directoryInCondition", "feature.notInThisBuild",
  "formula.syntax", "formula.unknownName", "formula.notInScope", "formula.unknownFunction", "formula.notInProfile",
  "formula.argumentMismatch", "formula.kindMismatch", "expression.kindMismatch", "clause.wordsDoNotFit",
  "clause.pressedOutsideStage", "value.kindConflict", "arrow.otherCasesNotLast", "catalogue.unknownEntry",
  "catalogue.unknownField", "action.resultSavedTwice", "question.choicesNotSupported", "arrow.otherCasesWithCondition",
  "condition.noClauses", "reference.stepsNotSupported", "template.kindNotJoinable", "group.readInSameStep", "compile.internal",
]);

/** To dos that stop only `startFrom` on their binding. */
const BINDING_ONLY: ReadonlySet<FindingCode> = new Set<FindingCode>(["startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn", "startsWhen.buttonNotOnStart"]);

/** A clause, or its left, words or right: the condition cannot be built. */
const CLAUSE_PART = /\.\d+(\.(left|words|right))?$/;

/**
 * The missing parts that leave nothing to compile: no answer, no operation, no destination. A task with
 * nobody asked still runs: the request reaches it and is stuck with nobody to ask (E-28).
 */
const MISSING_ITEMS: Readonly<Record<string, ReadonlySet<string>>> = {
  task: new Set(["buttons"]),
  action: new Set(["operation", "save", "as"]),
  arrow: new Set(["goTo", "when", "when.button", "when.condition"]),
  stage: new Set(["arrows"]),
  startsWhen: new Set(["trigger", "button"]),
};

/** `kindOf`: the kind of the finding's item, from the document (`IndexedItem.kind`). */
export function tryItEffect(f: Finding, kindOf: (item: string) => string | undefined): TryItEffect {
  if (f.severity === "worthKnowing") return "runs";
  if (BINDING_ONLY.has(f.code)) return "bindingOnly";
  if (STOPS.has(f.code)) return "stops";
  if (f.code !== "item.partMissing") return "runs";
  const part = f.location.part ?? "";
  if (CLAUSE_PART.test(part)) return "stops";
  const kind = kindOf(f.location.item);
  return kind !== undefined && MISSING_ITEMS[kind]?.has(part) === true ? "stops" : "runs";
}

/**
 * Reads of values that may find them empty. `value.neverFilled` anywhere; `value.mayBeEmpty` only
 * where an empty value stops or silently drops something (E-22): who is asked, a notification's
 * recipient, a directory group, a needed connection input. `task.askedMayBeEmpty` when who is
 * asked reads a list cell that a row reaching the task leaves "(not given)", and
 * `requester.mayBeEmpty` when bindings name no Requester, or one that may be empty (E-16, E-27).
 */
import type { Location, StartsWhenId } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { arrowUsability } from "../facts/arrows.ts";
import { BOTH, EMPTY, emptyRoute, FILLED, locationsOf, type State } from "../facts/fill-state.ts";
import { stateAt } from "../facts/scope.ts";
import { chipsOf } from "../formula/chips.ts";
import type { TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import type { Context } from "./context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "./findings.ts";
import { expressionKindOf } from "./kinds-of.ts";
import { readsOf, rangeParams } from "./reads.ts";
import { stoppedFailureValues } from "./routing.ts";
import { RowFlow } from "./rows.ts";
import { isObject, isString, readingPart, type Obj } from "./walk.ts";

/** The start task's who is asked matters only on a send-back (compiler.md 7.4): read it as the arrows leave it. */
function readState(ctx: Context, location: Location): State | undefined {
  const item = ctx.ix.byId.get(location.item);
  if (item?.kind === "task" && location.part?.startsWith("whoIsAsked") && item.stage !== undefined && item.stage === ctx.graph.root) {
    const run = ctx.flow.run(item.stage);
    return run.arrival[run.arrival.length - 1];
  }
  return stateAt(ctx.ix, ctx.flow, location);
}

function flagsOf(ctx: Context, state: State, value: string): number {
  const i = ctx.flow.valueIndex.get(value);
  return i === undefined ? EMPTY : (state.flags[i] ?? EMPTY);
}

function routeOf(ctx: Context, state: State, value: string): Location[] {
  const i = ctx.flow.valueIndex.get(value);
  return locationsOf((i === undefined ? undefined : emptyRoute(state, i)) ?? state.route);
}

export function neverFilled(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const stopped = stoppedFailureValues(ctx);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const read of readsOf(ctx)) {
    if (!ctx.registered.has(read.value) || stopped.has(read.value)) continue;
    const state = readState(ctx, read.location);
    if (!state || flagsOf(ctx, state, read.value) !== EMPTY) continue;
    const key = `${read.location.item} ${read.location.part ?? ""} ${read.value} ${read.range?.start ?? ""}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push(finding("value.neverFilled", read.location, { ...rangeParams(read), value: { item: read.value } }));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Walks the reads of one place where an empty value matters, through "If empty, use". */
class EmptyReads {
  private readonly ctx: Context;
  private readonly out: Finding[];
  private readonly seen = new Set<string>();

  constructor(ctx: Context, out: Finding[]) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
    this.out = out;
  }

  private report(location: Location, value: string, state: State, range?: { start: number; end: number }): void {
    if (!this.ctx.registered.has(value)) return;
    const key = `${location.item} ${location.part ?? ""} ${value} ${range?.start ?? ""}`;
    if (this.seen.has(key)) return;
    this.seen.add(key);
    const params = { ...(range ?? {}), value: { item: value }, skippedVia: routeOf(this.ctx, state, value) };
    this.out.push(finding("value.mayBeEmpty", location, params));
  }

  /** An expression at `path` of `item`, read with `state`; `clause`: where a read inside a clause is reported. */
  expression(e: unknown, item: string, path: string, state: State, clause?: string): void {
    if (Array.isArray(e)) {
      // A template is one text, empty only when every piece is (compiler.md 3.3, 8.4 TXT): a piece of
      // text, or a piece that is always filled, keeps it filled.
      // Text is empty only when it is "" (E-26): white space is not empty.
      if (e.some((p) => (isString(p) ? p !== "" : this.ctx.flow.expression(p, state).flags === FILLED))) return;
      e.forEach((p, i) => this.expression(p, item, `${path}.${i}`, state, clause));
      return;
    }
    if (!isObject(e)) return;
    const where = at(item, readingPart(clause === undefined ? { path } : { clause, path }));
    if (isString(e["value"])) {
      if (flagsOf(this.ctx, state, e["value"]) !== BOTH) return; // always filled, or never (value.neverFilled)
      if (e["ifEmptyUse"] === undefined) this.report(where, e["value"], state);
      else this.expression(e["ifEmptyUse"], item, `${path}.ifEmptyUse`, state, clause);
    } else if ("request" in e) {
      if (e["ifEmptyUse"] !== undefined && e["request"] === "requester") this.expression(e["ifEmptyUse"], item, `${path}.ifEmptyUse`, state, clause);
    } else if (isString(e["formula"])) {
      // A formula is empty when a chip it reads is (compiler.md 8.4, P(f)).
      for (const chip of chipsOf(e["formula"]))
        if (chip.sort === "value" && flagsOf(this.ctx, state, chip.value) === BOTH) this.report(at(item, path), chip.value, state, chip.range);
    }
  }

  /** Every `members` step and "is in" a group in a condition or expression of a slot. */
  directoryGroups(): void {
    for (const n of this.ctx.nodes) {
      if (n.sent) continue;
      if (n.sort === "reference" && Array.isArray(n.node["steps"]) && n.node["steps"].some((s) => isObject(s) && s["directory"] === "members")) {
        const state = readState(this.ctx, at(n.item, readingPart(n)));
        if (state) this.expression(n.node, n.item, n.path, state, n.clause);
      }
      if (n.sort !== "clause" || !isObject(n.node)) continue;
      const c = n.node;
      const group =
        c["words"] === "person.isIn" || c["words"] === "person.isNotIn" ? ["right", c["right"]] as const
          : isString(c["words"]) && c["words"].startsWith("people.") ? ["left", c["left"]] as const : undefined;
      if (!group || expressionKindOf(this.ctx, group[1]) !== "group") continue;
      const state = readState(this.ctx, at(n.item, n.path));
      if (state) this.expression(group[1], n.item, `${n.path}.${group[0]}`, state, n.path);
    }
  }
}

/** Whether a connection or data source input is required (catalogue: `required`). */
function requiredInput(ctx: Context, entryRef: unknown, field: string): boolean {
  return ctx.catalogue.fields(ctx.catalogue.entry(entryRef), "input").some((f) => f.id === field && f.required === true);
}

export function mayBeEmpty(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const reads = new EmptyReads(ctx, out);
  const place = (item: string, part: string, e: unknown): void => {
    const state = readState(ctx, at(item, part));
    if (state) reads.expression(e, item, part, state);
  };
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    for (const task of view.tasks) if (task.task.whoIsAsked !== undefined) place(task.task.id, "whoIsAsked", task.task.whoIsAsked);
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      if (action.type === "notify" && action.to !== undefined) place(action.id, "to", action.to);
      if (action.type === "useConnection" && isObject(action.inputs))
        for (const [field, input] of Object.entries(action.inputs))
          if (requiredInput(ctx, action.operation, field)) place(action.id, `inputs.${field}`, input);
    }
    for (const task of view.tasks)
      for (const { question } of task.questions) {
        const c: unknown = question.choices;
        if (!isObject(c)) continue;
        if (c["from"] === "directory" && c["peopleIn"] !== undefined) place(question.id, "choices.peopleIn", c["peopleIn"]);
        if (c["from"] === "source" && isObject(c["inputs"]))
          for (const [field, input] of Object.entries(c["inputs"]))
            if (requiredInput(ctx, c["source"], field)) place(question.id, `choices.inputs.${field}`, input);
      }
  }
  reads.directoryGroups();
  return out;
}

/** A cell is given unless it is absent or names a person or group with an empty directory ID (E-27). */
function cellGiven(cell: unknown): boolean {
  if (!isObject(cell)) return false;
  const ref = cell["person"] ?? cell["group"];
  return !(isObject(ref) && ref["directoryId"] === "");
}

/** Who is asked reads a list cell that some row reaching the task leaves "(not given)". */
export function askedMayBeEmpty(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  // Only values that who is asked reads through a column step need their rows followed.
  const wanted = new Set<string>();
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages)
    for (const task of view.tasks)
      for (let e: unknown = task.task.whoIsAsked; isObject(e); e = e["ifEmptyUse"]) {
        const steps = e["steps"];
        if (isString(e["value"]) && Array.isArray(steps) && isObject(steps[0]) && isString(steps[0]["column"])) wanted.add(e["value"]);
      }
  const rows = new RowFlow(ctx, wanted);
  /** Some row that can reach the task leaves the cell this link reads "(not given)". */
  const lacksCell = (task: TaskView, e: Obj): boolean => {
    const steps = e["steps"];
    const first: unknown = Array.isArray(steps) ? steps[0] : undefined;
    if (!isString(e["value"]) || !isObject(first) || !isString(first["column"])) return false;
    const possible = rows.rowsAtTasks(task.stage, e["value"]);
    const column = first["column"];
    return !!possible && (rows.listOf(e["value"])?.rows ?? []).some(
      (r) => isObject(r) && possible.has(r.id) && !(isObject(r.cells) && cellGiven((r.cells as Obj)[column])),
    );
  };
  // Each link of the "If empty, use" chain is read only when every link before it is empty: a link
  // that always gives someone ends the chain, and a missing cell counts only in the last link read.
  const check = (task: TaskView): void => {
    const state = readState(ctx, at(task.task.id, "whoIsAsked"));
    if (!state) return;
    for (let e: unknown = task.task.whoIsAsked; isObject(e); e = e["ifEmptyUse"]) {
      const lacking = lacksCell(task, e);
      const link: Obj = { ...e };
      delete link["ifEmptyUse"];
      const always = !lacking && (ctx.flow.expression(link, state).flags === FILLED || (isString(e["value"]) && flagsOf(ctx, state, e["value"]) === FILLED && Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length === 1));
      if (always) return;
      if (e["ifEmptyUse"] === undefined) {
        if (lacking && isString(e["value"]))
          out.push(finding("task.askedMayBeEmpty", at(task.task.id, "whoIsAsked"), { reason: "listMayBeEmpty", value: { item: e["value"] } }));
        return;
      }
    }
  };
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) if (ctx.graph.reachable.has(view.stage.id)) view.tasks.forEach(check);
  return out;
}

/** The last expression of an "If empty, use" chain: the one read with no fallback. */
function chainEnd(e: unknown): unknown {
  let cur = e;
  while (isObject(cur) && cur["ifEmptyUse"] !== undefined) cur = cur["ifEmptyUse"];
  return cur;
}

/** Whether a sent field may be left out: it, or a field it sits in, is not required. Unknown fields are catalogue.unknownField's. */
function sentFieldMayBeEmpty(ctx: Context, trigger: unknown, dotted: string): boolean {
  const segments = dotted.split(".");
  return segments.some((_, i) => ctx.catalogue.sentField(trigger, segments.slice(0, i + 1).join("."))?.required === false);
}

/** Whether a binding's Requester may be empty: it names none, or reads a sent field the event may leave out (E-27). */
function requesterMayBeAbsent(ctx: Context, binding: Obj): boolean {
  const r = binding["requester"];
  if (r === undefined) return true;
  if (!isObject(r)) return false;
  if (isString(r["sentField"])) return sentFieldMayBeEmpty(ctx, binding["trigger"], r["sentField"]);
  // A formula is empty when a chip it reads is (compiler.md 8.4, P(f)).
  if (isString(r["formula"])) return chipsOf(r["formula"]).some((c) => c.sort === "sent" && sentFieldMayBeEmpty(ctx, binding["trigger"], c.field));
  return false;
}

/** Whether an arrow that can be taken from a reachable stage leads to the start stage. */
function sentBackToStart(ctx: Context, root: string): boolean {
  return ctx.ix.stages.some((view) => {
    if (!view.working || !ctx.graph.reachable.has(view.stage.id) || !view.arrows.some((a) => a.goTo === root)) return false;
    const usability = arrowUsability(ctx.ix, view);
    return view.arrows.some((a) => a.goTo === root && usability.get(a.id)?.usable !== false);
  });
}

export function requesterMayBeEmpty(ctx: Context): Finding[] {
  const wf: unknown = ctx.workflow;
  const list = isObject(wf) && isObject(wf["start"]) && Array.isArray(wf["start"]["startsWhen"]) ? wf["start"]["startsWhen"] : [];
  const bindings = list.filter((b): b is Obj => isObject(b) && isString(b["id"]) && requesterMayBeAbsent(ctx, b)).map((b) => b["id"] as StartsWhenId);
  if (!bindings.length) return [];
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const asksRequester = (e: unknown): boolean => {
    const end = chainEnd(e);
    return isObject(end) && end["request"] === "requester";
  };
  // The start task asks again only on a send-back to the start (E-26, E-27).
  const root = ctx.graph.root;
  const backToStart = root !== undefined && sentBackToStart(ctx, root);
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    const asksAgain = view.stage.id !== root || backToStart;
    for (const task of view.tasks)
      if (asksAgain && asksRequester(task.task.whoIsAsked)) out.push(finding("requester.mayBeEmpty", at(task.task.id, "whoIsAsked"), { bindings: [...bindings] }));
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after])
      if (action.type === "notify" && asksRequester(action.to)) out.push(finding("requester.mayBeEmpty", at(action.id, "to"), { bindings: [...bindings] }));
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/check/walk.ts\n===
/**
 * Every expression, sentence, clause and formula inside the document's slots, with the part each
 * sits at (core-api.md 2.3: clauses and template pieces are numeric segments, a fallback is
 * `ifEmptyUse`). Never throws: anything of the wrong shape is skipped.
 */
import type { DocIndex, Slot } from "../index-doc.ts";

export type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
export const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
export const isString = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string";

interface Where {
  /** The item the slot belongs to. */
  item: string;
  /** The reported part of the slot (`whoIsAsked`, `inputs.summary`, `when.condition`). */
  slot: string;
  /** The exact part of this node. */
  path: string;
  /** The clause this node is inside (`onlyWhen.0`), if any. */
  clause?: string;
  /** Inside a "Starts when" binding: reads only what was sent. */
  sent: boolean;
  /** The slot is a template, or this node is one of its pieces. */
  piece?: number;
}

export type WalkNode =
  | (Where & { sort: "reference"; node: Obj; value: string })
  | (Where & { sort: "request"; node: Obj; request: unknown })
  | (Where & { sort: "sentField"; node: Obj; field: unknown })
  | (Where & { sort: "constant"; node: Obj })
  | (Where & { sort: "formula"; node: Obj; text: string })
  | (Where & { sort: "sentence"; node: Obj; clauses: readonly unknown[] })
  | (Where & { sort: "clause"; node: unknown; index: number; sentence: string });

const join = (path: string, segment: string | number): string => (path ? `${path}.${segment}` : String(segment));

class Walker {
  private readonly out: WalkNode[];
  constructor(out: WalkNode[]) {
    this.out = out;
  }

  expression(e: unknown, w: Where): void {
    if (!isObject(e)) return;
    if (isString(e["value"])) {
      this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "reference", node: e, value: e["value"] });
      this.expression(e["ifEmptyUse"], { ...w, path: join(w.path, "ifEmptyUse") });
    } else if ("request" in e) {
      this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "request", node: e, request: e["request"] });
      this.expression(e["ifEmptyUse"], { ...w, path: join(w.path, "ifEmptyUse") });
    } else if ("sentField" in e) {
      this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "sentField", node: e, field: e["sentField"] });
    } else if (Array.isArray(e["allOf"]) || Array.isArray(e["anyOf"])) {
      const clauses = (Array.isArray(e["allOf"]) ? e["allOf"] : e["anyOf"]) as unknown[];
      this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "sentence", node: e, clauses });
      clauses.forEach((c, i) => this.clause(c, i, w));
    } else if (isString(e["formula"])) {
      this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "formula", node: e, text: e["formula"] });
    } else {
      this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "constant", node: e });
    }
  }

  private clause(c: unknown, index: number, sentence: Where): void {
    const path = join(sentence.path, index);
    const w: Where = { ...sentence, path, clause: path };
    this.out.push({ ...w, sort: "clause", node: c, index, sentence: sentence.path });
    if (!isObject(c) || "pressed" in c) return;
    this.expression(c["left"], { ...w, path: join(path, "left") });
    const right = c["right"];
    if (Array.isArray(right)) right.forEach((r, i) => this.expression(r, { ...w, path: join(join(path, "right"), i) }));
    else this.expression(right, { ...w, path: join(path, "right") });
  }

  template(pieces: readonly unknown[], w: Where): void {
    pieces.forEach((piece, i) => {
      if (!isString(piece)) this.expression(piece, { ...w, path: join(w.path, i), piece: i });
    });
  }
}

/** The nodes of one slot, outermost first. */
export function walkSlot(slot: Slot, sent = slot.form === "sent"): WalkNode[] {
  const out: WalkNode[] = [];
  const part = slot.at.part ?? "";
  const w: Where = { item: slot.at.item, slot: part, path: part, sent };
  const walker = new Walker(out);
  const asTemplate = slot.form === "template" || ((slot.form === "expressionOrTemplate" || slot.form === "sent") && Array.isArray(slot.node));
  if (asTemplate) walker.template(Array.isArray(slot.node) ? slot.node : [], w);
  else walker.expression(slot.node, w);
  return out;
}

/** The nodes of every slot of the document, in slot order. */
export function walkAll(ix: DocIndex): WalkNode[] {
  return ix.slots.flatMap((slot) => walkSlot(slot));
}

/**
 * Where a read is reported (core-api.md 2.3): a read inside a clause is reported at the clause
 * (`onlyWhen.0`); any other read at its own part (`whoIsAsked.ifEmptyUse`, `message.1`).
 */
export function readingPart(n: { clause?: string; path: string }): string {
  return n.clause ?? n.path;
}

/**
 * `compile(workflow, catalogue)`: an authored workflow to its published definition (contract/core-api.md
 * section 12; engine/design/compiler.md). Pure, and never throws on a document `parse` accepted: a failure
 * inside core is the finding `compile.internal`.
 */
import { validateDefinitionShape, type ChildStage, type DeclaredTypes, type Json, type JsonSchema, type PublishedDefinition } from "../../format/index.ts";
import { checkDefinition } from "../../kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { check } from "../check/check.ts";
import { makeContext } from "../check/context.ts";
import { at, finding, type Finding } from "../check/findings.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { questionKind } from "../facts/kinds.ts";
import { checkPlace, questionSchema, sourceOf } from "./forms.ts";
import { compileRules, compileTriggers } from "./rules.ts";
import { cellSchema, fieldSchema, fieldsSchema, kindSchema, PERSON, STR, YESNO } from "./schemas.ts";
import { StageCompiler } from "./stage.ts";
import { childStage, Compiler, isObject, isString, Stop, type Step } from "./state.ts";
import type { CompileOptions, CompileResult } from "./types.ts";

/** The To dos that leave no definition to run at all (core-api.md 10.1). */
const FATAL: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["workflow.noStart", "start.notOneTask", "compile.internal"]);

function internal(workflow: unknown, detail: string): Finding {
  const id = isObject(workflow) && isString(workflow["id"]) ? workflow["id"] : "";
  const f = finding("compile.internal", at(id), {});
  f.debug = { detail };
  return f;
}

export function compile(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, options: CompileOptions = {}): CompileResult {
  const mode = options.mode ?? "publish";
  const findings = check(workflow, catalogue);
  if (mode === "publish" && findings.some((f) => f.severity === "todo")) return { ok: false, findings };
  if (findings.some((f) => FATAL.has(f.code))) return { ok: false, findings };
  let built: { definition: PublishedDefinition; compiler: Compiler };
  try {
    built = build(workflow, catalogue, findings, options);
  } catch (error) {
    return { ok: false, findings: [...findings, internal(workflow, error instanceof Error ? `${error.name}: ${error.message}` : String(error))] };
  }
  const { definition, compiler } = built;
  if (mode === "tryIt") return { ok: true, published: definition, findings, unfinished: compiler.unfinished };
  const problems: string[] = [...compiler.internal];
  const shape = validateDefinitionShape(definition);
  if (!shape.ok) problems.push(...shape.problems.map((p) => `shape ${p.problem} at ${p.pointer} (${p.expected})`));
  else {
    // A warning does not stop publishing (E-27); only an error is a reason to refuse.
    const errors = checkDefinition(definition).filter((p) => p.severity === "error");
    problems.push(...errors.map((p) => `publish ${p.code} at ${p.pointer} ${JSON.stringify(p.params)}`));
  }
  if (problems.length > 0) return { ok: false, findings: [...findings, internal(workflow, problems.join("; "))] };
  return { ok: true, published: definition, findings, unfinished: [] };
}

function build(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, findings: readonly Finding[], options: CompileOptions): { definition: PublishedDefinition; compiler: Compiler } {
  const ctx = makeContext(workflow, catalogue);
  const directory = isObject(catalogue) && isString(catalogue.directoryConnection) ? catalogue.directoryConnection : "directory";
  const c = new Compiler(ctx, findings, options.mode ?? "publish", directory);
  const startStage = workflow.start.stage;
  const startTask = ctx.startTask;
  if (!startTask) throw new Error("no start task");
  const startRequester = (Array.isArray(workflow.start.startsWhen) ? workflow.start.startsWhen : []).some((b) => isObject(b) && b.requester !== undefined);

  c.origin("stage:root", c.wf, null);
  const steps: Step[] = [];
  for (const view of ctx.ix.stages) {
    if (view.working) {
      steps.push(...new StageCompiler(c, view, startRequester).compile());
      continue;
    }
    c.origin(`stage:${view.stage.id}`, view.stage.id, null);
    steps.push({ id: view.stage.id, status: c.status(view.stage.status), waits: [], transitions: [] });
  }
  const stages: ChildStage[] = steps.map((s) => {
    const stage = childStage(s);
    if (!ctx.ix.stageById.get(s.id)?.working && ctx.ix.stageById.has(s.id)) stage.final = true;
    for (const t of stage.transitions) if (t.to.startsWith("\u0000entry:")) t.to = c.entries.get(t.to) ?? t.to;
    return stage;
  });
  const { notifications, events } = compileRules(c);
  const triggers = compileTriggers(c);
  const constants = listConstants(c);
  const definition: PublishedDefinition = {
    format: 1,
    workflow: options.workflow ?? "draft",
    version: options.version ?? 1,
    compiler: options.compiler ?? "core",
    runtime: { cel: "cel-1", validator: "jsonschema-1" },
    start: `${startStage}__tasks.${startTask.task.id}`,
    root: { initial: `${startStage}__tasks`, stages },
    statuses: (Array.isArray(workflow.statuses) ? workflow.statuses : [])
      .filter((s) => isObject(s) && isString(s.id))
      .map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: isString(s.words) ? s.words : "", color: isString(s.colour) ? s.colour : "grey" })),
    notifications,
    constants: constants.values,
    types: declaredTypes(c, stages, constants.types),
    schemas: c.schemas,
    origins: c.origins,
  };
  if (triggers.length > 0) definition.triggers = triggers;
  if (events.length > 0) definition.events = events;
  if (c.nobody.length > 0) definition.nobodyToAsk = c.nobody;
  return { definition, compiler: c };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ lists and declared types (compiler.md 3.4, 9)

/** A directory object ID (E-26): 1 to 255 characters, no white space, no control character. */
const DIRECTORY_ID = /^[^\s\p{Cc}]{1,255}$/u;

/**
 * A list cell as the JSON of core-api.md 2.4. A reference with no valid directory ID is left out, as a cell
 * "(not given)": the constant must fit its declared type, and no To do names such a cell.
 */
function cellJson(cell: unknown): Json | undefined {
  if (!isObject(cell)) return undefined;
  for (const key of ["text", "number", "yesNo", "date"]) if (key in cell) return cell[key] as Json;
  for (const [key, type] of [["person", "user"], ["group", "group"]] as const) {
    const ref = cell[key];
    if (isObject(ref) && isString(ref["directoryId"]) && DIRECTORY_ID.test(ref["directoryId"])) return { type, id: ref["directoryId"] };
  }
  return undefined;
}

function listConstants(c: Compiler): { values: Record<string, Json>; types: Record<string, JsonSchema> } {
  const values: Record<string, Json> = {};
  const types: Record<string, JsonSchema> = {};
  for (const list of Array.isArray(c.ctx.workflow.lists) ? c.ctx.workflow.lists : []) {
    if (!isObject(list) || !isString(list.id)) continue;
    const columns = (Array.isArray(list.columns) ? list.columns : []).filter((col) => isObject(col) && isString(col.id));
    const rows: Record<string, Json> = {};
    for (const row of Array.isArray(list.rows) ? list.rows : []) {
      if (!isObject(row) || !isString(row.id)) continue;
      const cells: Record<string, Json> = {};
      for (const col of columns) {
        const json = cellJson(isObject(row.cells) ? row.cells[col.id] : undefined);
        if (json !== undefined) cells[col.id] = json;
      }
      rows[row.id] = cells;
    }
    values[list.id] = rows;
    const properties: Record<string, JsonSchema> = {};
    for (const col of columns) properties[col.id] = cellSchema(col.kind);
    types[list.id] = { type: "object", additionalProperties: { type: "object", additionalProperties: false, properties } };
  }
  return { values, types };
}

/** The schema of an authored value: its first filler's (compiler.md 3.4). */
function valueSchema(c: Compiler, value: string): JsonSchema {
  for (const fill of c.ctx.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? []) {
    switch (fill.by) {
      case "question": {
        const q = c.ctx.questions.get(fill.at.item);
        if (!q) continue;
        try {
          return questionSchema(sourceOf(c), q.question, checkPlace(q.task, "", false));
        } catch (e) {
          if (!(e instanceof Stop)) throw e;
          return kindSchema(questionKind(q.question));
        }
      }
      case "result": {
        const action = c.ctx.actions.get(fill.at.item);
        const field = action?.type === "useConnection" ? c.resultFields(action.operation).find((f) => f.id === fill.field) : undefined;
        if (field) return fieldSchema(field);
        continue;
      }
      case "buttonPressed":
      case "failureCode":
        return STR;
      case "answeredBy":
        return PERSON;
      case "failed":
        return YESNO;
      case "save":
        return kindSchema(c.world.valueKind(value));
    }
  }
  return kindSchema(c.world.valueKind(value));
}

/** The `groups` result field of the directory's `membersOf@1`. */
function groupsSchema(c: Compiler): JsonSchema {
  const field = c.resultFields(`${c.directory}.membersOf@1`).find((f) => f.id === "groups");
  return field ? fieldSchema(field) : { type: "array" };
}

function declaredTypes(c: Compiler, stages: readonly ChildStage[], constants: Record<string, JsonSchema>): DeclaredTypes {
  const data: Record<string, JsonSchema> = {};
  const results: DeclaredTypes["results"] = {};
  for (const stage of stages) {
    for (const t of stage.transitions)
      for (const s of t.set) {
        const key = s.path[0];
        if (key === undefined || key in data) continue;
        if (key === "requester") data[key] = PERSON;
        else if (key.endsWith("__pressed") || key.endsWith("__early")) data[key] = STR;
        else if (key.endsWith("__groups")) data[key] = groupsSchema(c);
        else data[key] = valueSchema(c, key);
      }
    for (const w of stage.waits) {
      if (w.kind !== "call") continue;
      const ops = (results[w.connection] ??= {});
      ops[w.op] ??= fieldsSchema(c.resultFields(`${w.connection}.${w.op}`));
    }
  }
  return { data, constants, results };
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/compile/expr/condition.ts\n===
/**
 * `C(sentence)`: the condition builder's sentences as one CEL boolean (compiler.md 8.3), and a
 * formula condition as `P(f) && (F(f))` (8.4).
 *
 * An empty value makes a clause not true (E-22), except the empty words and the negative words,
 * which are true: every positive word tests each side it reads, and each negative word is `!` of
 * its positive word. In a list comparison an empty item is ignored (E-24).
 */
import { WORDS_WITH_A_LIST, WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER, type ValueKind, type Words } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { compileFormulaCondition } from "./formula.ts";
import { pressedRead, type Opt } from "./places.ts";
import { compileOpt, directoryRead, isObject, isString, type OptResult } from "./reference.ts";
import { and, not, safe, WEEKDAY_NUMBER } from "./text.ts";
import { noRule, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule, type Place } from "./types.ts";

export type ConditionResult = { ok: true; cel: string; reads: DirectoryRead[] } | NoRule;

const NOTHING_AFTER: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER);
const A_LIST: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(WORDS_WITH_A_LIST);

/** The negative words, each `!` of the positive word named. */
const NEGATIVE: Readonly<Partial<Record<Words, Words>>> = {
  "text.isNot": "text.is",
  "text.doesNotContain": "text.contains",
  "number.isNot": "number.is",
  "choice.isNot": "choice.is",
  "choice.isNotOneOf": "choice.isOneOf",
  "person.isNot": "person.is",
  "person.isNotIn": "person.isIn",
  "people.doNotInclude": "people.include",
  "list.doesNotInclude": "list.includes",
};

const EMPTY_WORDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["text.isEmpty", "number.isEmpty", "yesNo.isEmpty", "date.isEmpty", "choice.isEmpty", "person.isEmpty", "list.isEmpty"]);
const FILLED_WORDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["text.isFilled", "number.isFilled", "yesNo.isFilled", "date.isFilled", "choice.isFilled", "person.isFilled", "list.isFilled"]);

/** `<`, `>` ... for the ordering words. Dates compare as `YYYY-MM-DD` text, which orders as the date. */
const ORDER: Readonly<Partial<Record<Words, string>>> = {
  "number.is": "==", "number.isMoreThan": ">", "number.isLessThan": "<", "number.isAtLeast": ">=", "number.isAtMost": "<=",
  "date.is": "==", "date.isBefore": "<", "date.isAfter": ">", "date.isOnOrBefore": "<=", "date.isOnOrAfter": ">=",
  "text.is": "==", "person.is": "==",
};

interface Sides {
  place: Place;
  world: ExprWorld;
  path: (string | number)[];
  left: unknown;
  right: unknown;
  L: OptResult;
  R: OptResult[];
  reads: DirectoryRead[];
}

/** A choice from a data source compares its `stored` part (format, `choiceFromConnection`). */
function choiceValue(o: Opt, connection: boolean): string {
  return connection ? `${o.val}.stored` : o.val;
}

/** The recorded members of the group `group`, as the read made just before this step holds them. */
function groupTest(s: Sides, groupNode: unknown, groupPath: (string | number)[], test: (e: string) => string): string | NoRule {
  const read = directoryRead(s.place, s.world, groupNode, groupPath);
  if ("ok" in read) return read;
  s.reads.push(read);
  return `data.?${read.key}.orValue([]).exists(e, ${test("e")})`;
}

/** The positive words (and the empty words) as CEL. */
function positive(words: Words, s: Sides): string | NoRule {
  const { L } = s;
  const R = s.R[0] as OptResult;
  const l = L.opt;
  const r = R?.opt;
  if (FILLED_WORDS.has(words)) return l.has ?? "true";
  if (EMPTY_WORDS.has(words)) return l.has === null ? "false" : `!${l.has}`;
  const order = ORDER[words];
  if (order !== undefined && r) return and(l.has, r.has, `${l.val} ${order} ${r.val}`);
  switch (words) {
    case "text.contains":
      return and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, `${l.val}.contains(${r?.val})`);
    case "text.startsWith":
      return and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, `${l.val}.startsWith(${r?.val})`);
    case "yesNo.isYes":
      return l.has === null ? l.val : `${safe(l.opt)}.orValue(false)`;
    case "yesNo.isNo":
      return l.has === null ? not(l.val) : `!${safe(l.opt)}.orValue(true)`;
    case "date.isOnWeekday": {
      const day = isObject(s.right) && isString(s.right["weekday"]) ? WEEKDAY_NUMBER[s.right["weekday"]] : undefined;
      if (day === undefined) return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", [...s.path, "right"], "'is on a weekday' takes a weekday");
      return and(l.has, `date(${l.val}).getDayOfWeek() == ${day}`);
    }
    case "choice.is": {
      const connection = L.kind === "choiceFromConnection" || R?.kind === "choiceFromConnection";
      return and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, `${choiceValue(l, connection)} == ${r ? choiceValue(r, connection) : ""}`);
    }
    case "choice.isOneOf":
    case "person.isOneOf": {
      const connection = L.kind === "choiceFromConnection" || s.R.some((x) => x.kind === "choiceFromConnection");
      const items = s.R.map((x) => `(${and(x.opt.has, `${choiceValue(l, connection)} == ${choiceValue(x.opt, connection)}`)})`);
      return and(l.has, `(${items.join(" || ")})`);
    }
    case "person.isIn": {
      if (R?.kind === "people") return and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, `${r?.val}.exists(m, m == ${l.val})`);
      if (R?.kind !== "group") return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", [...s.path, "right"], "'is in' takes a group or people");
      const test = groupTest(s, s.right, [...s.path, "right"], (e) => `${e}.id == ${r?.val} && ${e}.members.exists(m, m == ${l.val})`);
      return typeof test === "string" ? and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, test) : test;
    }
    case "people.include":
    case "people.areFilled": {
      const filled = words === "people.areFilled";
      if (L.kind === "people") return filled ? and(l.has, `size(${l.val}) > 0`) : and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, `${l.val}.exists(m, m == ${r?.val})`);
      if (L.kind !== "group") return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", [...s.path, "left"], "people words take a group or people");
      const test = groupTest(s, s.left, [...s.path, "left"], (e) =>
        filled ? `${e}.id == ${l.val} && size(${e}.members) > 0` : `${e}.id == ${l.val} && ${e}.members.exists(m, m == ${r?.val})`,
      );
      if (typeof test !== "string") return test;
      return filled ? and(l.has, test) : and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, test);
    }
    case "people.areEmpty": {
      const filled = positive("people.areFilled", s);
      return typeof filled === "string" ? `!(${filled})` : filled;
    }
    case "list.includes":
      return and(l.has, r?.has ?? null, `${r?.val} in ${l.val}`);
    case "list.includesAnyOf": {
      const items = s.R.map((x) => `(${and(x.opt.has, `${x.opt.val} in ${l.val}`)})`);
      return and(l.has, `(${items.join(" || ")})`);
    }
    case "list.includesAllOf": {
      const items = s.R.map((x) => (x.opt.has === null ? `(${x.opt.val} in ${l.val})` : `(!${x.opt.has} || ${x.opt.val} in ${l.val})`));
      return and(l.has, ...items);
    }
    default:
      return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", s.path, `no rule for '${words}'`);
  }
}

const WORDS_SETS: Readonly<Record<string, readonly ValueKind[]>> = {
  text: ["text", "longText"],
  number: ["number"],
  yesNo: ["yesNo"],
  date: ["date"],
  choice: ["choice", "choiceFromList", "choiceFromConnection"],
  person: ["person"],
  people: ["group", "people"],
  list: ["multipleChoice"],
};

function compileClause(c: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[]): ConditionResult {
  if (!isObject(c)) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
  if ("pressed" in c) {
    const button = c["pressed"];
    const task = isString(button) ? world.buttonTask(button) : undefined;
    if (!isString(button) || task === undefined) return noRule("item.partMissing", [...path, "pressed"]);
    const cel = pressedRead(place, task, button);
    return cel === undefined ? noRule("clause.pressedOutsideStage", path, button) : { ok: true, cel, reads: [] };
  }
  const words = c["words"];
  if (!isString(words)) return noRule("item.partMissing", [...path, "words"]);
  if (c["left"] === undefined) return noRule("item.partMissing", [...path, "left"]);
  const L = compileOpt(c["left"], place, world, [...path, "left"]);
  if (!L.ok) return L;
  const set = words.split(".")[0] ?? "";
  if (L.kind !== undefined && !WORDS_SETS[set]?.includes(L.kind))
    return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", [...path, "left"], `'${words}' does not fit a ${L.kind}`);
  const R: OptResult[] = [];
  const right = c["right"];
  if (A_LIST.has(words)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(right) || right.length === 0) return noRule("item.partMissing", [...path, "right"]);
    for (let i = 0; i < right.length; i++) {
      const r = compileOpt(right[i], place, world, [...path, "right", i]);
      if (!r.ok) return r;
      R.push(r);
    }
  } else if (!NOTHING_AFTER.has(words) && words !== "date.isOnWeekday") {
    if (right === undefined || Array.isArray(right)) return noRule("item.partMissing", [...path, "right"]);
    const r = compileOpt(right, place, world, [...path, "right"]);
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    R.push(r);
  }
  const s: Sides = { place, world, path, left: c["left"], right, L, R, reads: [...L.reads, ...R.flatMap((r) => r.reads)] };
  const positiveOf = NEGATIVE[words as Words];
  const cel = positive(positiveOf ?? (words as Words), s);
  if (typeof cel !== "string") return cel;
  return { ok: true, cel: positiveOf ? `!(${cel})` : cel, reads: s.reads };
}

/**
 * A condition (a sentence, a formula, or a binding's sent condition) as one CEL boolean, in a
 * place. `allOf` joins clauses with `&&`, `anyOf` with `||`, each clause in parentheses; a list of
 * one clause is that clause. An empty list has no rule (14.3 item 6; E-25).
 */
export function compileCondition(cond: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): ConditionResult {
  if (!isObject(cond)) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
  if (isString(cond["formula"])) {
    const f = compileFormulaCondition(cond["formula"], place, world, path);
    return f.ok ? { ok: true, cel: f.cel, reads: [] } : f;
  }
  const all = Array.isArray(cond["allOf"]);
  const clauses = all ? cond["allOf"] : cond["anyOf"];
  if (!Array.isArray(clauses)) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
  if (clauses.length === 0) return noRule("condition.noClauses", path);
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < clauses.length; i++) {
    const r = compileClause(clauses[i], place, world, [...path, i]);
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    parts.push(r.cel);
    reads.push(...r.reads);
  }
  if (parts.length === 1) return { ok: true, cel: parts[0] as string, reads };
  return { ok: true, cel: parts.map((p) => `(${p})`).join(all ? " && " : " || "), reads };
}

/**
 * When a question is visible: `V(q) = C(page Show when) && C(question Show when)`, each absent part
 * left out (compiler.md 5.2). `null` when neither exists. Used for the checks of 5.2 and, in the
 * `sent` place, for `V_sent` (10.6).
 */
export function compileVisible(conditions: readonly unknown[], place: Place, world: ExprWorld): ConditionResult | null {
  const present = conditions.map((c, i) => [c, i] as const).filter(([c]) => c !== undefined);
  if (present.length === 0) return null;
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];
  for (const [c, i] of present) {
    const r = compileCondition(c, place, world, [i]);
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    parts.push(r.cel);
    reads.push(...r.reads);
  }
  return { ok: true, cel: parts.length === 1 ? (parts[0] as string) : parts.map((p) => `(${p})`).join(" && "), reads };
}

/**
 * Formulas (compiler.md 8.4): each chip is replaced by its read in the place, everything else is
 * kept byte for byte. `P(f)` is the presence test of every chip that can be empty, so an empty
 * value makes a formula condition not true and a formula value empty, never an error (E-22).
 * A date chip reads as a point in time (`date(...)`, midnight UTC), and a result that is a
 * timestamp is saved as a date with `asDate` (E-26).
 */
import { t, type CelType } from "../../../cel/types.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { celTypeOfKind, formulaTypeOf } from "../../formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { rewriteChips, type Chip } from "../../formula/chips.ts";
import { formulaType } from "../../formula/typing.ts";
import { always, maybe, NONE, requesterRead, sentRead, STARTED_ON, valueRead, type Opt } from "./places.ts";
import type { OptOrNoRule } from "./reference.ts";
import { safe } from "./text.ts";
import { noRule, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule, type Place } from "./types.ts";

const TIMESTAMP = "google.protobuf.Timestamp";

interface ChipRead {
  /** The text that replaces the chip. */
  text: string;
  /** Its presence test, or null when it cannot be empty. */
  has: string | null;
  /** The chip as the type check sees it: a variable of this type, wrapped in `date()` for a date. */
  type: CelType;
  date: boolean;
}

function chipRead(chip: Chip, place: Place, world: ExprWorld): ChipRead | string {
  const read = (opt: Opt, kind: ValueKind | undefined, item?: ValueKind): ChipRead => {
    const date = kind === "date";
    return { text: date ? `date(${opt.val})` : opt.val, has: opt.has, type: celTypeOfKind(kind, undefined, item), date };
  };
  switch (chip.sort) {
    case "value":
      return read(maybe(valueRead(place, chip.value)), world.valueKind(chip.value), world.itemKind?.(chip.value));
    case "requester":
      return read(maybe(requesterRead(place)), "person");
    case "startedOn":
      return place.in === "sent"
        ? "{{request.startedOn}} before the request exists"
        : { text: `date(${STARTED_ON})`, has: null, type: t.string, date: true };
    case "sent":
      return place.in === "sent" ? read(maybe(sentRead(chip.field)), place.fields[chip.field]) : `{{sent.${chip.field}}} outside a binding`;
    case "unknown":
      return `{{${chip.text}}} names nothing`;
  }
}

interface Rewritten {
  /** `F(f)`. */
  cel: string;
  /** `P(f)`, or null when no chip can be empty. */
  guard: string | null;
  /** The CEL type of `F(f)`. */
  type: string;
}

function rewrite(text: string, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[]): Rewritten | NoRule {
  const reads: ChipRead[] = [];
  let failure: NoRule | undefined;
  const chips = rewriteChips(text, (chip) => {
    const r = chipRead(chip, place, world);
    if (typeof r === "string") {
      failure ??= chip.sort === "startedOn" ? noRule("startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn", path) : noRule("formula.doesNotCheck", path, r);
      return "";
    }
    reads.push(r);
    return r.text;
  });
  if (failure) return failure;
  // Typed with each chip as a variable, as the checker does, so the result matches its kind.
  const variables: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  let i = 0;
  const typed = rewriteChips(text, () => {
    const r = reads[i] as ChipRead;
    const name = `chip__${i++}`;
    variables[name] = r.type;
    return r.date ? `date(${name})` : name;
  });
  const type = formulaType(typed.source, variables);
  if (!type.ok) return noRule("formula.doesNotCheck", path, type.problem?.message);
  const tests = [...new Set(reads.flatMap((r) => (r.has === null ? [] : [r.has])))];
  return { cel: chips.source, guard: tests.length ? tests.join(" && ") : null, type: type.type };
}

/** The kind a formula's CEL type gives, where one kind fits. A timestamp is saved as a date. */
function kindOfType(type: string): ValueKind | undefined {
  const found = formulaTypeOf(type);
  switch (found) {
    case "text":
    case "number":
    case "yesNo":
      return found;
    case "timestamp":
      return "date";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** A formula used as a value: `P(f) ? optional.of(F(f)) : optional.none()` (compiler.md 8.4). */
export function compileFormulaOpt(text: string, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): OptOrNoRule {
  const r = rewrite(text, place, world, path);
  if ("ok" in r) return r;
  const reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];
  const kind = kindOfType(r.type);
  if (r.type.startsWith("optional")) {
    // The author's formula gives an optional itself: `optional.none()` leaves the value empty.
    const opt = maybe(r.guard === null ? r.cel : `(${r.guard} ? ${safe(r.cel)} : ${NONE})`);
    return kind === undefined ? { ok: true, opt, reads } : { ok: true, opt, kind, reads };
  }
  const value = r.type === TIMESTAMP ? `asDate(${r.cel})` : r.cel;
  const opt = r.guard === null ? always(value) : maybe(`(${r.guard} ? optional.of(${value}) : ${NONE})`);
  return kind === undefined ? { ok: true, opt, reads } : { ok: true, opt, kind, reads };
}

/** The CEL type a formula gives in a place (`list<string>` ...), for a schema that must match it. */
export function compileFormulaType(text: string, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): { ok: true; type: string } | NoRule {
  const r = rewrite(text, place, world, path);
  return "ok" in r ? r : { ok: true, type: r.type };
}

/** A formula used as a condition: `P(f) && (F(f))` (compiler.md 8.3, 8.4). */
export function compileFormulaCondition(text: string, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): { ok: true; cel: string } | NoRule {
  const r = rewrite(text, place, world, path);
  if ("ok" in r) return r;
  if (formulaTypeOf(r.type) !== "yesNo" && formulaTypeOf(r.type) !== "any") return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", path, `the formula gives ${r.type}`);
  return { ok: true, cel: r.guard === null ? r.cel : `${r.guard} && (${r.cel})` };
}

/**
 * Expressions read as lists: "Who is asked" and a Notify's `to` (`ASK`, compiler.md 4.2, 10.2),
 * any person, group or list expression as its CEL list, and the `groups` argument of a directory
 * read (8.6).
 */
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { formulaTypeOf } from "../../formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { compileFormulaType } from "./formula.ts";
import { maybe } from "./places.ts";
import { compileOpt, isObject, type OptResult } from "./reference.ts";
import { safe } from "./text.ts";
import { noRule, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule, type Place } from "./types.ts";

const PEOPLE_FILTER = ".filter(r, r.type == 'user' || r.type == 'group')";
const GROUP_FILTER = ".filter(r, r.type == 'group')";

export interface ListResult {
  ok: true;
  /** The CEL list. */
  cel: string;
  reads: DirectoryRead[];
}

export interface AskResult extends ListResult {
  /**
   * Whether it may give a group: then the task gets its membership read `<tk>__members`
   * (compiler.md 4.2, 10.4). True for a group, "people in [group]", or a group anywhere in the
   * "If empty, use" chain.
   */
  mayGiveGroup: boolean;
  /** The membership read's `groups` argument, `ASK(T).filter(r, r.type == 'group')`; `[]` when it gives no group. */
  groups: string;
}

/** The kinds the links of an "If empty, use" chain give, the reference first; `formula` for a formula that gives people or groups. */
function chainKinds(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld): (ValueKind | "formula" | undefined)[] {
  const out: (ValueKind | "formula" | undefined)[] = [];
  for (let link = e; isObject(link); link = link["ifEmptyUse"]) {
    const r = compileOpt({ ...link, ifEmptyUse: undefined }, place, world);
    const kind = r.ok ? r.kind : undefined;
    out.push(kind === undefined && formulaGives(link, place, world) !== undefined ? "formula" : kind);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * What a formula gives under "Who is asked" or a Notify's "to", by its type, as the checker accepts it
 * (formula/cel-kinds.ts): one person or group (a map), or a list of them. Undefined for anything else.
 */
function formulaGives(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld): "one" | "list" | undefined {
  if (!isObject(e) || typeof e["formula"] !== "string") return undefined;
  const r = compileFormulaType(e["formula"], place, world);
  if (!r.ok) return undefined;
  const found = formulaTypeOf(r.type);
  const bare = found.startsWith("optionalOf:") ? found.slice("optionalOf:".length) : found;
  if (bare === "map") return "one";
  if (bare === "listOf:map" || bare === "listOf:any") return "list";
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * One value as a list of it, `(O? ? [O!]<filter> : [])`. A constant is `[O!]`: its kind is known, so
 * it needs no filter (compiler.md 15.7, "the `LIST` of a constant").
 */
function listOfOne(o: OptResult, filter: string): string {
  if (o.opt.constant) return `[${o.opt.val}]`;
  return o.opt.has === null ? `[${o.opt.val}]${filter}` : `(${o.opt.has} ? [${o.opt.val}]${filter} : [])`;
}

/**
 * Any expression as its CEL list: one person or group as a list of it, a people or list value as
 * itself, empty as `[]` (compiler.md 4.2, 8.5).
 */
export function compileAsList(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): ListResult | NoRule {
  const o = compileOpt(e, place, world, path);
  if (!o.ok) return o;
  switch (o.kind) {
    case "person":
    case "group":
    case "text":
    case "longText":
    case "number":
    case "yesNo":
    case "date":
    case "choice":
    case "choiceFromList":
    case "choiceFromConnection":
    case "fieldGroup":
      return { ok: true, cel: listOfOne(o, ""), reads: o.reads };
    case "people":
    case "multipleChoice":
    case "list":
      return { ok: true, cel: o.opt.has === null ? o.opt.val : `${o.opt.opt}.orValue([])`, reads: o.reads };
    default:
      return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", path, "the kind of the list is not known");
  }
}

/**
 * `ASK(T)`: who is asked, or a Notify's `to`, as a list of people and groups (compiler.md 4.2). A
 * reference whose last step is `members` names the group itself (E-24): the group is asked and no
 * directory read is placed for it. Absent (Try it only) is `[]`.
 */
export function compileWhoIsAsked(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): AskResult | NoRule {
  if (e === undefined) return { ok: true, cel: "[]", reads: [], mayGiveGroup: false, groups: "[]" };
  let node = e;
  let peopleIn = false;
  if (isObject(e) && Array.isArray(e["steps"])) {
    const steps = e["steps"];
    const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
    if (isObject(last) && last["directory"] === "members") {
      node = { ...e, steps: steps.slice(0, -1) };
      peopleIn = true;
    }
  }
  const o = compileOpt(node, place, world, path);
  if (!o.ok) return o;
  const kinds = chainKinds(node, place, world);
  const kind = peopleIn ? "group" : o.kind;
  const asked = kind === undefined ? formulaGives(node, place, world) : undefined;
  // A formula's type does not tell a person from a group, so a formula link may give a group.
  const mayGiveGroup = peopleIn || kinds.some((k) => k === "group" || k === "formula");
  let cel: string;
  if (kind === "person" || kind === "group" || asked === "one") cel = listOfOne(o, PEOPLE_FILTER);
  else if (kind === "people") cel = o.opt.has === null ? o.opt.val : `${o.opt.opt}.orValue([])${PEOPLE_FILTER}`;
  else if (asked === "list") cel = o.opt.has === null ? `${safe(o.opt.val)}${PEOPLE_FILTER}` : `${o.opt.opt}.orValue([])${PEOPLE_FILTER}`;
  else return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", path, "who is asked gives a person, a group or people");
  let groups = "[]";
  if (mayGiveGroup) groups = o.opt.constant && kind === "group" ? cel : `${cel}${GROUP_FILTER}`;
  return { ok: true, cel, reads: o.reads, mayGiveGroup, groups };
}

/**
 * `<GROUPS>`: the `groups` argument of a directory read step's `membersOf@1` call, every group the
 * served step names joined with `+` (compiler.md 8.6). Duplicates are left out; `[]` when none.
 */
export function groupsArg(reads: readonly DirectoryRead[]): string {
  const groups = [...new Set(reads.map((r) => r.group))];
  if (groups.length === 0) return "[]";
  return groups.map((g) => {
    const o = maybe(g);
    return `(${o.has} ? [${o.val}] : [])`;
  }).join(" + ");
}

/**
 * How each place reads a value, the Requester, "Started on" and a pressed button (compiler.md 8.1,
 * 6.5, 10.1). Every read is an optional, so an empty value never errors (8.5).
 */
import type { CheckPlace, Place } from "./types.ts";
import { celString, safe } from "./text.ts";

/**
 * An optional in three forms: the optional itself (`O(e)`), its presence test (`O(e)?`, null when
 * it is always present) and its value (`O(e)!`). Constants, "Started on" and sentences are always
 * present, so their presence test folds away (compiler.md 15.7: "the constant side's presence test
 * folded away").
 */
export interface Opt {
  opt: string;
  has: string | null;
  val: string;
  /** An authored constant: its value is known when compiled. */
  constant?: true;
}

/** An optional that may be empty. */
export function maybe(text: string): Opt {
  const s = safe(text);
  return { opt: text, has: `${s}.hasValue()`, val: `${s}.value()` };
}

/** An optional that always holds `value`. */
export function always(value: string, constant = false): Opt {
  const o: Opt = { opt: `optional.of(${value})`, has: null, val: safe(value) };
  if (constant) o.constant = true;
  return o;
}

/**
 * `a.or(b)` ("If empty, use", compiler.md 8.5). Its presence test is written out even when `b` is
 * a constant: only a constant's own test is folded away.
 */
export function orElse(a: Opt, b: Opt): Opt {
  return maybe(`${safe(a.opt)}.or(${b.opt})`);
}

/** `REQ`, the Requester (compiler.md 8.1, shapes 3.4). */
export const REQ = "data.?requester.or(request.by.type == 'user' ? optional.of(request.by) : optional.none())";

/** "Started on": the start day, `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC (compiler.md 8.2). */
export const STARTED_ON = "asDate(timestamp(request.at))";

export const NONE = "optional.none()";

function checkRead(place: CheckPlace, value: string): string | undefined {
  const questions = place.form[value];
  if (!questions || questions.length === 0) return undefined;
  // The later question in form order wins (compiler.md 5.2).
  return [...questions].reverse().map((q) => `input.?${q}`).join(".or(") + ")".repeat(questions.length - 1);
}

/** The optional CEL a value reads as in this place. */
export function valueRead(place: Place, value: string): string {
  switch (place.in) {
    case "data":
      return `data.?${value}`;
    case "tasks": {
      const w = place.answered[value];
      return w === undefined ? `data.?${value}` : safe(w);
    }
    case "check":
      return checkRead(place, value) ?? `data.?${value}`;
    case "sent": {
      const mapped = place.values?.[value];
      return mapped === undefined ? NONE : safe(mapped);
    }
  }
}

/** The optional CEL the Requester reads as in this place. */
export function requesterRead(place: Place): string {
  switch (place.in) {
    case "data":
    case "tasks":
      return REQ;
    case "check":
      return place.requesterInput ? `input.?requester.or(${REQ})` : REQ;
    case "sent":
      return place.requester === undefined ? NONE : safe(place.requester);
  }
}

/** A sent field, `sent.?a.?b` (compiler.md 10.6). */
export function sentRead(field: string): string {
  return `sent${field.split(".").map((f) => `.?${f}`).join("")}`;
}

/**
 * A pressed clause (compiler.md 6.5): in the tasks step the wait's outcome; after it, the button
 * recorded in `<tk>__pressed`. Undefined where a pressed clause has no rule.
 */
export function pressedRead(place: Place, task: string, button: string): string | undefined {
  switch (place.in) {
    case "data":
      return `data.?${task}__pressed.orValue('') == ${celString(button)}`;
    case "tasks":
      return `waits.${task}.outcome == ${celString(button)}`;
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** The values whose read in this place is not over data: they are filled in this step. */
export function filledHere(place: Place): ReadonlySet<string> {
  switch (place.in) {
    case "tasks":
      return new Set(Object.keys(place.answered));
    case "check":
      return new Set(Object.keys(place.form));
    default:
      return new Set();
  }
}

/**
 * `O(e)`: an authored expression as an optional (compiler.md 8.2), with the kind it gives and the
 * directory reads it needs (8.6).
 */
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { chipsOf } from "../../formula/chips.ts";
import { compileCondition } from "./condition.ts";
import { compileFormulaOpt } from "./formula.ts";
import { always, filledHere, maybe, NONE, orElse, requesterRead, sentRead, STARTED_ON, valueRead, type Opt } from "./places.ts";
import { constantLiteral } from "./text.ts";
import { noRule, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule, type Place } from "./types.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
export const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
export const isString = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string";

/** An expression compiled to an optional. */
export interface OptResult {
  ok: true;
  opt: Opt;
  kind?: ValueKind;
  reads: DirectoryRead[];
}

export type OptOrNoRule = OptResult | NoRule;

function result(opt: Opt, kind: ValueKind | undefined, reads: DirectoryRead[]): OptResult {
  const r: OptResult = { ok: true, opt, reads };
  if (kind !== undefined) r.kind = kind;
  return r;
}

/** Every value an expression reads, through references, fallbacks, formula chips and clauses. */
export function valuesReadBy(e: unknown, out: Set<string> = new Set()): Set<string> {
  if (Array.isArray(e)) {
    for (const x of e) valuesReadBy(x, out);
    return out;
  }
  if (!isObject(e)) return out;
  if (isString(e["value"])) out.add(e["value"]);
  if (isString(e["formula"])) for (const c of chipsOf(e["formula"])) if (c.sort === "value") out.add(c.value);
  valuesReadBy(e["ifEmptyUse"], out);
  for (const key of ["allOf", "anyOf"]) {
    const clauses = e[key];
    if (!Array.isArray(clauses)) continue;
    for (const c of clauses) {
      if (!isObject(c)) continue;
      valuesReadBy(c["left"], out);
      valuesReadBy(c["right"], out);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The directory read a group needs (compiler.md 8.6), or why there is none. `groupNode` is the
 * authored expression that gives the group. The read step is entered before the step that uses
 * it, so it reads the group over data; a group filled in this very step cannot be read there.
 */
export function directoryRead(place: Place, world: ExprWorld, groupNode: unknown, path: (string | number)[]): DirectoryRead | NoRule {
  if (place.in === "sent" || place.groupsKey === undefined) return noRule("directory.notHere", path);
  const here = filledHere(place);
  for (const v of valuesReadBy(groupNode)) if (here.has(v)) return noRule("group.readInSameStep", path, v);
  const group = compileOpt(groupNode, { in: "data", groupsKey: place.groupsKey }, world, path);
  if (!group.ok) return group;
  return { group: group.opt.opt, key: place.groupsKey };
}

/** `cond ? then : optional.none()`, or `then` when the condition always holds. */
function ifPresent(has: string | null, then: string): Opt {
  return maybe(has === null ? then : `(${has} ? ${then} : ${NONE})`);
}

function withSteps(place: Place, world: ExprWorld, node: Obj, base: OptResult, steps: readonly unknown[], path: (string | number)[]): OptOrNoRule {
  let { opt, kind } = base;
  const reads = [...base.reads];
  for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    const step = steps[i];
    const at = [...path, "steps", i];
    if (isObject(step) && isString(step["column"])) {
      const column = world.column(step["column"]);
      if (!column) return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", at, step["column"]);
      opt = ifPresent(opt.has, `${column.list}[${opt.val}].?${step["column"]}`);
      kind = column.kind;
    } else if (isObject(step) && step["directory"] === "members") {
      const read = directoryRead(place, world, { value: node["value"], steps: steps.slice(0, i) }, at);
      if ("ok" in read) return read;
      reads.push(read);
      opt = ifPresent(opt.has, `optional.of(data.?${read.key}.orValue([]).filter(e, e.id == ${opt.val})[0].members)`);
      kind = "people";
    } else return noRule("item.partMissing", at);
  }
  return result(opt, kind, reads);
}

/** `O(e)` for any authored expression, or a sent expression in a binding, in a place (compiler.md 8.2, 10.6). */
export function compileOpt(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): OptOrNoRule {
  if (!isObject(e)) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
  let base: OptOrNoRule;
  if (isString(e["value"])) {
    const r = result(maybe(valueRead(place, e["value"])), world.valueKind(e["value"]), []);
    base = Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0 ? withSteps(place, world, e, r, e["steps"], path) : r;
  } else if (e["request"] === "requester" || e["request"] === "startedOn") {
    if (Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0) return noRule("reference.stepsNotSupported", [...path, "steps"], e["request"]);
    if (e["request"] === "requester") base = result(maybe(requesterRead(place)), "person", []);
    else if (place.in === "sent") return noRule("startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn", path);
    else base = result(always(STARTED_ON), "date", []);
  } else if (isString(e["sentField"])) {
    if (place.in !== "sent") return noRule("item.partMissing", path, "a sent field outside a binding");
    base = result(maybe(sentRead(e["sentField"])), place.fields[e["sentField"]], []);
  } else if (Array.isArray(e["allOf"]) || Array.isArray(e["anyOf"])) {
    const c = compileCondition(e, place, world, path);
    if (!c.ok) return c;
    base = result(always(c.cel), "yesNo", c.reads);
  } else if (isString(e["formula"])) {
    base = compileFormulaOpt(e["formula"], place, world, path);
  } else if ("weekday" in e) {
    return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", path, "a weekday is only the right side of 'is on a weekday'");
  } else {
    const lit = constantLiteral(e);
    if (!lit) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
    base = result(always(lit.cel, true), lit.kind, []);
  }
  if (!base.ok || e["ifEmptyUse"] === undefined) return base;
  const fallback = compileOpt(e["ifEmptyUse"], place, world, [...path, "ifEmptyUse"]);
  if (!fallback.ok) return fallback;
  return result(orElse(base.opt, fallback.opt), base.kind ?? fallback.kind, [...base.reads, ...fallback.reads]);
}
