﻿/**
 * Templates (compiler.md 8.4): one CEL string for a Tell value, a call input or a binding answer;
 * message parts for a Notify. An empty value renders as nothing (E-22).
 */
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Opt } from "./places.ts";
import { compileOpt, isObject, isString, type OptResult } from "./reference.ts";
import { celString, safe } from "./text.ts";
import { noRule, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule, type Place } from "./types.ts";

/** `x? ? then : ''`, or `then` when `x` is always present. */
function ifPresent(o: Opt, then: string): string {
  return o.has === null ? then : `${o.has} ? ${then} : ''`;
}

/** The labels a choice expression renders with: its question's choices, its task's buttons, or its operations' failure codes. */
function choiceMap(e: unknown, world: ExprWorld): string | undefined {
  if (!isObject(e) || !isString(e["value"]) || (Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0)) return undefined;
  const labels = world.choiceLabels(e["value"]);
  if (labels.length === 0) return undefined;
  return `{${labels.map((c) => `${celString(c.id)}: ${celString(c.label)}`).join(", ")}}`;
}

/** Whether the expression reads a value an action saves its failure code as (E-29). */
function readsFailureCode(e: unknown, world: ExprWorld): boolean {
  return isObject(e) && isString(e["value"]) && !(Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0) && world.isFailureCode?.(e["value"]) === true;
}

/** A choice's label through the map; a failure code the map does not hold renders as the code itself. */
function labelThrough(map: string, o: Opt, failureCode: boolean): string {
  return failureCode ? `${map}[?${o.val}].orValue(${o.val})` : `${map}[${o.val}]`;
}

/** `TXT(e)` for one kind (compiler.md 8.4); `null` for a kind with no text rule. */
function textOf(kind: ValueKind, o: Opt, e: unknown, world: ExprWorld): string | null {
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
    case "longText":
    case "date":
      return o.has === null ? o.val : `${safe(o.opt)}.orValue('')`;
    case "number":
      return ifPresent(o, `string(${o.val})`);
    case "yesNo":
      return ifPresent(o, o.has === null ? `${o.val} ? 'Yes' : 'No'` : `(${o.val} ? 'Yes' : 'No')`);
    case "choice": {
      if (isObject(e) && (isString(e["choice"]) || isString(e["button"]))) {
        const id = (e["choice"] ?? e["button"]) as string;
        return celString(world.labelOf(id) ?? id);
      }
      if (isObject(e) && isString(e["failureCode"])) return celString(e["failureCode"]);
      const map = choiceMap(e, world);
      return map === undefined ? textOf("text", o, e, world) : ifPresent(o, labelThrough(map, o, readsFailureCode(e, world)));
    }
    case "choiceFromList": {
      const shown = isObject(e) && isString(e["value"]) && !(Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0) ? world.listChoice(e["value"]) : undefined;
      const column = shown?.shownColumn === undefined ? undefined : world.column(shown.shownColumn);
      if (!shown || shown.shownColumn === undefined || !column) return textOf("text", o, e, world);
      const cell = textOf(column.kind, { opt: `${shown.list}[${o.val}].?${shown.shownColumn}`, has: `${shown.list}[${o.val}].?${shown.shownColumn}.hasValue()`, val: `${shown.list}[${o.val}].?${shown.shownColumn}.value()` }, undefined, world);
      return cell === null ? null : ifPresent(o, safe(cell));
    }
    case "choiceFromConnection":
      return ifPresent(o, `${o.val}.label`);
    case "person":
    case "group":
      return ifPresent(o, `${o.val}.id`);
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * The kind a piece renders by. A plain value reference whose kind is not known has nothing that fills it
 * yet, so it is always empty and renders as empty text; any other piece of unknown kind has no rule.
 */
function pieceKind(o: OptResult, e: unknown, world: ExprWorld): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (o.kind !== undefined) return o.kind;
  if (!isObject(e) || !isString(e["value"]) || (Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0) || e["ifEmptyUse"] !== undefined) return undefined;
  return world.isFilled?.(e["value"]) === false ? "text" : undefined;
}

/** One expression piece of a template as CEL text, or why there is no rule. */
export function compileText(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): { ok: true; cel: string; reads: DirectoryRead[] } | NoRule {
  const o: OptResult | NoRule = compileOpt(e, place, world, path);
  if (!o.ok) return o;
  const kind = pieceKind(o, e, world);
  if (kind === undefined) return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", path, "the kind of the piece is not known");
  const cel = textOf(kind, o.opt, e, world);
  if (cel === null) return noRule("template.kindNotJoinable", path, o.kind);
  return { ok: true, cel, reads: o.reads };
}

/**
 * A template as one CEL string (compiler.md 8.4): the pieces joined with `+`, a string as a
 * literal, an expression through `TXT`. An empty template is `''`. Works for a binding's sent
 * template in the `sent` place, where an absent field is `''`.
 */
export function compileTextTemplate(template: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): { ok: true; cel: string; reads: DirectoryRead[] } | NoRule {
  if (!Array.isArray(template)) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
  const pieces: string[] = [];
  const reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < template.length; i++) {
    const piece: unknown = template[i];
    if (isString(piece)) {
      pieces.push(celString(piece));
      continue;
    }
    const t = compileText(piece, place, world, [...path, i]);
    if (!t.ok) return t;
    pieces.push(template.length === 1 ? t.cel : safe(t.cel));
    reads.push(...t.reads);
  }
  return { ok: true, cel: pieces.length === 0 ? "''" : pieces.join(" + "), reads };
}

/** A Notify message part (compiler.md 10.2): text as written, or a value the notifier renders by kind. */
export type MessagePart = { text: string } | { value: string; kind: ValueKind };

/**
 * A Notify message as parts: `{text}` for a string, `{value: O(e), kind}` for an expression. A
 * part's value may give `optional.none()`, which the notifier renders as nothing (E-22).
 */
export function compileMessageParts(template: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): { ok: true; parts: MessagePart[]; reads: DirectoryRead[] } | NoRule {
  if (!Array.isArray(template)) return noRule("item.partMissing", path);
  const parts: MessagePart[] = [];
  const reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < template.length; i++) {
    const piece: unknown = template[i];
    if (isString(piece)) {
      parts.push({ text: piece });
      continue;
    }
    const o = compileOpt(piece, place, world, [...path, i]);
    if (!o.ok) return o;
    const kind = pieceKind(o, piece, world);
    if (kind === undefined) return noRule("expression.kindMismatch", [...path, i], "the kind of the piece is not known");
    // A failure code's label is not in the authored source the page reads, so the part is its label as text.
    const map = kind === "choice" && readsFailureCode(piece, world) ? choiceMap(piece, world) : undefined;
    if (map !== undefined) parts.push({ value: o.opt.has === null ? `optional.of(${labelThrough(map, o.opt, true)})` : `${o.opt.has} ? optional.of(${labelThrough(map, o.opt, true)}) : optional.none()`, kind: "text" });
    else parts.push({ value: o.opt.opt, kind });
    reads.push(...o.reads);
  }
  return { ok: true, parts, reads };
}

/**
 * CEL text helpers: literals (compiler.md 8.2) and the few syntax rules the compiler needs to join
 * pieces of text without changing what they mean.
 */
import type { Constant, ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";

/** A single-quoted CEL string. Backslash, quote and control characters are escaped. */
export function celString(s: string): string {
  let out = "'";
  for (const ch of s) {
    const code = ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
    if (ch === "\\") out += "\\\\";
    else if (ch === "'") out += "\\'";
    else if (ch === "\n") out += "\\n";
    else if (ch === "\r") out += "\\r";
    else if (ch === "\t") out += "\\t";
    else if (code < 0x20 || code === 0x7f) out += `\\u${code.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")}`;
    else out += ch;
  }
  return `${out}'`;
}

/** A CEL double: an integral number gets `.0`, so `3` is `3.0` and never an int. */
export function celDouble(n: number): string {
  if (Number.isInteger(n) && Math.abs(n) < 1e21) return `${n.toFixed(0)}.0`;
  return String(n);
}

/** CEL's `getDayOfWeek` numbering: 0 is Sunday. */
export const WEEKDAY_NUMBER: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = {
  sunday: 0, monday: 1, tuesday: 2, wednesday: 3, thursday: 4, friday: 5, saturday: 6,
};

/**
 * A directory reference literal. Wrapped in `dyn(...)`: cel-1 does not type-check `==`, `or` or
 * `+` between a map literal and a reference typed by the person or group schema (compiler.md
 * section 19 item 5 has not been done in the environment).
 */
function refLiteral(type: "user" | "group", id: string): string {
  return `dyn({'type': ${celString(type)}, 'id': ${celString(id)}})`;
}

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
const isString = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string";

/** A constant's CEL literal and kind, or undefined for a weekday or a constant of the wrong shape. */
export function constantLiteral(c: Constant | unknown): { cel: string; kind: ValueKind } | undefined {
  if (!isObject(c)) return undefined;
  if (isString(c["text"])) return { cel: celString(c["text"]), kind: "text" };
  if (typeof c["number"] === "number" && Number.isFinite(c["number"])) return { cel: celDouble(c["number"]), kind: "number" };
  if (typeof c["yesNo"] === "boolean") return { cel: c["yesNo"] ? "true" : "false", kind: "yesNo" };
  if (isString(c["date"])) return { cel: celString(c["date"]), kind: "date" };
  if (isString(c["choice"])) return { cel: celString(c["choice"]), kind: "choice" };
  if (Array.isArray(c["choices"]) && c["choices"].every(isString))
    return { cel: `[${c["choices"].map(celString).join(", ")}]`, kind: "multipleChoice" };
  if (isString(c["row"])) return { cel: celString(c["row"]), kind: "choiceFromList" };
  if (isString(c["button"])) return { cel: celString(c["button"]), kind: "choice" };
  if (isString(c["failureCode"])) return { cel: celString(c["failureCode"]), kind: "choice" };
  for (const kind of ["person", "group"] as const) {
    const ref = c[kind];
    if (isObject(ref) && isString(ref["directoryId"])) return { cel: refLiteral(kind === "person" ? "user" : "group", ref["directoryId"]), kind };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(c["people"])) {
    const ids = c["people"].map((p) => (isObject(p) && isString(p["directoryId"]) ? p["directoryId"] : undefined));
    if (ids.every(isString)) return { cel: `[${ids.map((id) => refLiteral("user", id)).join(", ")}]`, kind: "people" };
    return undefined;
  }
  const cc = c["connectionChoice"];
  if (isObject(cc) && isString(cc["label"]) && (isString(cc["stored"]) || typeof cc["stored"] === "number")) {
    const stored = isString(cc["stored"]) ? celString(cc["stored"]) : celDouble(cc["stored"]);
    return { cel: `dyn({'stored': ${stored}, 'label': ${celString(cc["label"])}})`, kind: "choiceFromConnection" };
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Whether the text can take a method call or `.value()` after it without parentheses: nothing at
 * its top level but names, dots, calls, indexes and literals. `a.b(c ? d : e)[0]` is; `!a`, `a + b`
 * and `-1.0` are not.
 */
export function isPostfixSafe(text: string): boolean {
  let depth = 0;
  let quote: string | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text[i] as string;
    if (quote) {
      if (ch === "\\") i++;
      else if (ch === quote) quote = null;
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === "'" || ch === '"') quote = ch;
    else if (ch === "(" || ch === "[" || ch === "{") depth++;
    else if (ch === ")" || ch === "]" || ch === "}") depth--;
    else if (depth === 0 && !/[A-Za-z0-9_.?]/.test(ch)) return false;
    else if (depth === 0 && ch === "?" && text[i - 1] !== ".") return false;
  }
  return text.length > 0;
}

/** The text, parenthesized unless it is postfix-safe. */
export function safe(text: string): string {
  return isPostfixSafe(text) ? text : `(${text})`;
}

/** `!x`, parenthesizing `x` unless it is postfix-safe. */
export function not(text: string): string {
  return `!${safe(text)}`;
}

/** Joins the parts that are not null with `&&`; `true` when none is left. */
export function and(...parts: (string | null)[]): string {
  const kept = parts.filter((p): p is string => p !== null);
  return kept.length === 0 ? "true" : kept.join(" && ");
}

/**
 * What the expression compiler reads and returns (compiler.md sections 3, 5 and 8).
 *
 * Every function of this folder is pure: it turns an authored expression, condition or template
 * into cel-1 text for one place. It reads the document only through an `ExprWorld`, so the stage
 * compiler, `formState` and `evaluate` can each call it with what they already have.
 */
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";

/**
 * Where the compiled text is read (compiler.md 8.1). The place decides how a value, the Requester,
 * "Started on" and a pressed clause read.
 *
 * - `data`: arrival and after-response actions, gates, call arguments, the routing step,
 *   directory read steps, notification and Tell rules. A value reads `data.?v`.
 * - `tasks`: the tasks step (who is asked, early transitions, its Sets). A value filled in this
 *   tasks step reads the Set expression the caller wrote for it (`W`, compiler.md 4.6).
 * - `check`: checks, `may`, lookup inputs, and a form before it is sent. A value filled by this
 *   task's form reads the form's answer, `input.?q`.
 * - `sent`: a "Starts when" binding. A sent field reads `sent.?a.?b`. A value reads only what
 *   `values` maps it to (the mapping of the start-form question that fills it, for `V_sent`,
 *   compiler.md 10.6); any other value is `optional.none()`.
 */
export type Place = DataPlace | TasksPlace | CheckPlace | SentPlace;

interface Groups {
  /**
   * The data path holding the recorded directory read this place sees (`<st>__groups`,
   * compiler.md 8.6). Absent: a directory step or "is in" a group has no rule here.
   */
  groupsKey?: string;
}

export interface DataPlace extends Groups {
  in: "data";
}

export interface TasksPlace extends Groups {
  in: "tasks";
  /** Values filled in this tasks step, each with the optional CEL of its Set (`W`). */
  answered: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}

export interface CheckPlace extends Groups {
  in: "check";
  /** Values filled by this task's form, each with its questions in form order. */
  form: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  /** The start task when its schema has `requester`: the Requester is `RQ0` (compiler.md 8.1). */
  requesterInput?: boolean;
}

export interface SentPlace {
  in: "sent";
  /** The trigger's sent fields by dotted ID, with their kinds. */
  fields: Readonly<Record<string, ValueKind>>;
  /** For `V_sent`: values filled by a start-form question, each with the optional CEL of its mapping. */
  values?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  /** For `V_sent`: the optional CEL of the binding's requester mapping. */
  requester?: string;
}

/** What the compiler needs to know about the document. `worldFromDoc` builds one from the index. */
export interface ExprWorld {
  /** The value's kind, or undefined when nothing says it yet. */
  valueKind(value: string): ValueKind | undefined;
  /** For a multiple choice whose choices come from a formula: the kind of its items (E-27). */
  itemKind?(value: string): ValueKind | undefined;
  /** A column's list and kind. */
  column(column: string): { list: string; kind: ValueKind } | undefined;
  /** For a value of kind `choiceFromList`: its list and the column people see. */
  listChoice(value: string): { list: string; shownColumn?: string } | undefined;
  /** For a value of kind `choice`: its choices (or a task's buttons) with their labels, in order. */
  choiceLabels(value: string): readonly { id: string; label: string }[];
  /** The label of a choice or a button, for a constant in a template. */
  labelOf(id: string): string | undefined;
  /** The task that owns a button. */
  buttonTask(button: string): string | undefined;
  /**
   * Whether anything fills the value. A value nothing fills is always empty, so a template renders it as
   * empty text whatever its kind. Absent: not known, and a piece of unknown kind has no rule.
   */
  isFilled?(value: string): boolean;
  /**
   * Whether an action saves its failure code as the value (E-29). Its choices are failure codes, which
   * the authored source does not hold, so a message shows its label as text. Absent: no.
   */
  isFailureCode?(value: string): boolean;
}

/**
 * A directory read the compiled text needs (compiler.md 8.6). The caller places one read step
 * before the step that uses it; that step's `membersOf@1` call takes every `group` (compiled for
 * the read step, in the `data` place) and its `readOk` saves the result at `key`. `groupsArg`
 * joins them into the call's `groups` argument.
 */
export interface DirectoryRead {
  /** The group, as optional CEL read over data. */
  group: string;
  /** The data path the compiled text reads the recorded result from. */
  key: string;
}

/** Compiled text. `kind` is the kind of value an expression gives, when it is known. */
export interface Compiled {
  ok: true;
  cel: string;
  kind?: ValueKind;
  reads: DirectoryRead[];
}

/**
 * Something the compiler has no rule for. Each is a To do in core's checker; the codes are the
 * checker's finding codes where one exists (compiler.md 14.3, core-api.md section 4).
 */
export type NoRuleConstruct =
  /** An empty `allOf` or `anyOf` (14.3 item 6). */
  | "condition.noClauses"
  /** Steps after "Requester" or "Started on" (14.3 item 7). */
  | "reference.stepsNotSupported"
  /** A list kind inside a text template (14.3 item 8). */
  | "template.kindNotJoinable"
  /** "Started on" read before the request exists (14.3 item 2). */
  | "startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn"
  /** A directory read over a group filled in the same tasks step (14.3 item 9). */
  | "group.readInSameStep"
  /** A pressed clause where no button of this visit can be read. */
  | "clause.pressedOutsideStage"
  /** A directory step or "is in" a group where no read is placed (a binding, or no `groupsKey`). */
  | "directory.notHere"
  /** A part an unfinished draft has not filled (a clause's left, words or right; a reference). */
  | "item.partMissing"
  /** A kind the rule depends on is not known, or does not fit the words or the place. */
  | "expression.kindMismatch"
  /** A formula that does not type-check, or names a chip that is not here. */
  | "formula.doesNotCheck";

export interface NoRule {
  ok: false;
  construct: NoRuleConstruct;
  /** Where inside the compiled node: clause index, `left`, `right`, `ifEmptyUse`, template piece. */
  path: (string | number)[];
  detail?: string;
}

export type Result = Compiled | NoRule;

export function noRule(construct: NoRuleConstruct, path: (string | number)[] = [], detail?: string): NoRule {
  return detail === undefined ? { ok: false, construct, path } : { ok: false, construct, path, detail };
}

/** Prefixes a no-rule result's path. */
export function under(r: NoRule, ...prefix: (string | number)[]): NoRule {
  return { ...r, path: [...prefix, ...r.path] };
}

/**
 * The entry points for a value: an expression as its optional `O(e)`, an input or Tell value map,
 * the empty-value rule `N` (compiler.md 3.3), and a binding answer wrapped by `V_sent` (10.6).
 */
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { compileOpt, isObject } from "./reference.ts";
import { compileTextTemplate } from "./template.ts";
import { safe } from "./text.ts";
import { type Compiled, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule, type Place } from "./types.ts";

/**
 * An expression (a reference with steps, the Requester, "Started on", a sent field, a constant, a
 * sentence or a formula) as optional CEL in a place, with its kind and the directory reads it
 * needs (compiler.md 8.2). Every read uses optional syntax, so an empty value never errors (8.5).
 */
export function compileExpression(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): Compiled | NoRule {
  const o = compileOpt(e, place, world, path);
  if (!o.ok) return o;
  const out: Compiled = { ok: true, cel: o.opt.opt, reads: o.reads };
  if (o.kind !== undefined) out.kind = o.kind;
  return out;
}

/**
 * An expression or a template where either may stand (a call or lookup input, a Tell value, a
 * binding answer): `O(e)`, or `optional.of(<template string>)` (compiler.md 10.5, 11.1). An
 * optional that gives `optional.none()` leaves the input or name out.
 */
export function compileExpressionOrTemplate(e: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = []): Compiled | NoRule {
  if (Array.isArray(e)) {
    const t = compileTextTemplate(e, place, world, path);
    return t.ok ? { ok: true, cel: `optional.of(${t.cel})`, kind: "text", reads: t.reads } : t;
  }
  return compileExpression(e, place, world, path);
}

/** A map of inputs or Tell values, each through `compileExpressionOrTemplate`, in the map's order. */
export function compileValueMap(
  map: unknown, place: Place, world: ExprWorld, path: (string | number)[] = [],
): { ok: true; values: Record<string, string>; kinds: Record<string, ValueKind>; reads: DirectoryRead[] } | NoRule {
  const values: Record<string, string> = {};
  const kinds: Record<string, ValueKind> = {};
  const reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];
  if (!isObject(map)) return { ok: true, values, kinds, reads };
  for (const [name, e] of Object.entries(map)) {
    const r = compileExpressionOrTemplate(e, place, world, [...path, name]);
    if (!r.ok) return r;
    values[name] = r.cel;
    if (r.kind !== undefined) kinds[name] = r.kind;
    reads.push(...r.reads);
  }
  return { ok: true, values, kinds, reads };
}

/**
 * `N(kind, e)` (compiler.md 3.3): data never holds `""` or `[]`, so a write of one removes the value.
 * `e` is optional CEL.
 */
export function emptyRule(kind: ValueKind | undefined, e: string): string {
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
    case "longText":
      return `${safe(e)}.orValue('') == '' ? optional.none() : ${e}`;
    case "multipleChoice":
    case "people":
    case "list":
      return `${safe(e)}.hasValue() && size(${safe(e)}.value()) > 0 ? ${e} : optional.none()`;
    default:
      return e;
  }
}

/** `WRAP(q, e)` (compiler.md 10.6): `V_sent(q) ? e : optional.none()`, or `e` when the question has no Show when. */
export function wrapVisible(visible: string | null, e: string): string {
  return visible === null ? e : `${visible} ? ${e} : optional.none()`;
}

/** An `ExprWorld` read from the document's index and its value kinds. */
import type { ValueKind } from "../../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Kinds } from "../../facts/kinds.ts";
import type { DocIndex } from "../../index-doc.ts";
import type { ExprWorld } from "./types.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
const isString = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string";

export function worldFromDoc(ix: DocIndex, kinds: Kinds): ExprWorld {
  const labels = new Map<string, string>();
  const questionChoices = new Map<string, { id: string; label: string }[]>();
  const questionList = new Map<string, { list: string; shownColumn?: string }>();
  const taskButtons = new Map<string, { id: string; label: string }[]>();
  for (const task of ix.taskById.values()) {
    const buttons = task.buttons.filter((b) => isString(b.id)).map((b) => ({ id: b.id, label: isString(b.label) ? b.label : b.id }));
    taskButtons.set(task.task.id, buttons);
    for (const b of buttons) labels.set(b.id, b.label);
    for (const { question } of task.questions) {
      const choices: unknown = question.choices;
      if (!isObject(choices)) continue;
      if (choices["from"] === "typedIn" && Array.isArray(choices["choices"])) {
        const list = choices["choices"].filter((c): c is { id: string; label: string } => isObject(c) && isString(c["id"]))
          .map((c) => ({ id: c.id, label: isString(c.label) ? c.label : c.id }));
        questionChoices.set(question.id, list);
        for (const c of list) labels.set(c.id, c.label);
      }
      if (choices["from"] === "list" && isString(choices["list"]))
        questionList.set(question.id, isString(choices["shownColumn"]) ? { list: choices["list"], shownColumn: choices["shownColumn"] } : { list: choices["list"] });
    }
  }
  // A Save of a choice or button constant: the choice it saves, rendered by its label like a question's.
  const savedChoice = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const view of ix.stages)
    for (const a of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      const save: unknown = a.type === "saveValue" ? a.save : undefined;
      const id = isObject(save) ? (isString(save["choice"]) ? save["choice"] : isString(save["button"]) ? save["button"] : undefined) : undefined;
      if (id !== undefined) savedChoice.set(a.id, id);
    }
  const fills = (value: string) => ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? [];
  // A saved failure code: the operations' failure codes with the catalogue's labels (E-29).
  const failure = (value: string) => kinds.failureChoices(value);
  return {
    valueKind: (value) => kinds.valueKind(value),
    itemKind: (value) => kinds.itemKind(value),
    column: (column) => {
      const c = ix.columnById.get(column);
      return c && isString(c.list.id) && isString(c.column.kind) ? { list: c.list.id, kind: c.column.kind as ValueKind } : undefined;
    },
    listChoice: (value) => {
      for (const f of fills(value)) {
        if (f.by === "question") {
          const found = questionList.get(f.at.item);
          if (found) return found;
        }
      }
      return undefined;
    },
    choiceLabels: (value) => {
      const out: { id: string; label: string }[] = [];
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (const f of fills(value)) {
        const saved = f.by === "save" ? savedChoice.get(f.at.item) : undefined;
        const constant = saved === undefined ? undefined : [{ id: saved, label: labels.get(saved) ?? saved }];
        const list =
          f.by === "question" ? questionChoices.get(f.at.item)
            : f.by === "buttonPressed" ? taskButtons.get(f.at.item)
              : f.by === "failureCode" ? failure(value)
                : constant;
        for (const c of list ?? []) if (!seen.has(c.id)) {
          seen.add(c.id);
          out.push(c);
        }
      }
      return out;
    },
    labelOf: (id) => labels.get(id),
    buttonTask: (button) => ix.buttonTask.get(button)?.task.id,
    isFilled: (value) => fills(value).length > 0,
    isFailureCode: (value) => kinds.isFailureCode(value),
  };
}

/**
 * Forms (compiler.md 5): one schema per button, the checks of each button (4.5, 5.2, 5.4, 10.1) and the
 * lookups for answers chosen from the directory or a data source (5.4).
 *
 * This module owns the outcome schemas: the compiler and `formState` both build them with
 * `outcomeSchema`, so the form validates answers against the schema the act checks.
 */
import type { Check, JsonSchema, Lookup } from "../../format/index.ts";
import { neededFor, type CatalogueIndex } from "../check/context.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Page, Question } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import {
  celString, compileCondition, compileExpression, compileExpressionOrTemplate, compileFormulaOpt, compileFormulaType, compileVisible, not, safe,
  type CheckPlace, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld,
} from "./expr/index.ts";
import { questionKind } from "../facts/kinds.ts";
import { DATE, GROUP, LONG, NUMBER, PERSON, TEXT, YESNO, connectionChoice, enumOf, fieldSchema, kindSchema, manyOf } from "./schemas.ts";
import { Compiler, inOrder, isObject, isString, need, Stop, type Read } from "./state.ts";
import type { CompileMode } from "./types.ts";

/** What a form's schemas are built from: the document's lists, the catalogue and the value kinds. */
export interface SchemaSource {
  workflow: AuthoredWorkflow;
  catalogue: CatalogueIndex;
  world: ExprWorld;
}

export const sourceOf = (c: Compiler): SchemaSource => ({ workflow: c.ctx.workflow, catalogue: c.ctx.catalogue, world: c.world });

/** The schema of a formula's item, from the CEL type of the list it gives. */
function itemSchemaOf(type: string): JsonSchema {
  const inner = type.startsWith("list<") ? type.slice(5, -1) : type.startsWith("optional<list<") ? type.slice(14, -2) : "";
  switch (inner) {
    case "string":
      return { type: "string" };
    case "double":
      return { type: "number" };
    case "bool":
      return YESNO;
    default:
      return {};
  }
}

export interface QuestionInForm {
  question: Question;
  page: Page;
}

/** The answer's schema (compiler.md 5.1). Throws `Stop` where the question cannot give one. */
export function questionSchema(c: SchemaSource, q: Question, place: CheckPlace): JsonSchema {
  const choices: unknown = q.choices;
  const from = isObject(choices) ? choices["from"] : undefined;
  if (from === "formula" && isObject(choices) && isObject(choices["formula"]) && isString(choices["formula"]["formula"])) {
    const r = compileFormulaType(choices["formula"]["formula"], place, c.world, ["choices", "formula"]);
    const typed = need(r, q.id);
    const item = itemSchemaOf(typed.type);
    return q.kind === "multipleChoice" ? manyOf(item) : item;
  }
  switch (q.kind) {
    case "text":
      return TEXT;
    case "longText":
      return LONG;
    case "number":
      return NUMBER;
    case "yesNo":
      return YESNO;
    case "date":
      return DATE;
    case "person":
      return PERSON;
    case "group":
      return GROUP;
    case "choice":
    case "multipleChoice": {
      const many = q.kind === "multipleChoice";
      if (from === "typedIn" || from === "list") {
        const ids = choiceIds(c, q);
        if (ids === undefined) throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices" }, "no choices");
        return many ? manyOf(enumOf(ids)) : enumOf(ids);
      }
      if (from === "directory" && !many) return PERSON;
      if (from === "source" && !many && isObject(choices)) {
        const entry = c.catalogue.entry(choices["source"]);
        if (entry?.kind !== "dataSource") throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices.source" }, "no such data source");
        const stored = c.catalogue.fields(entry, "item").find((f) => f.id === choices["storedField"]);
        if (!stored) throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices.storedField" }, "no such item field");
        if (!isString(choices["labelField"])) throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices.labelField" }, "no label field");
        return connectionChoice(fieldSchema(stored));
      }
      throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices" }, "no choices the compiler has a rule for");
    }
    default:
      throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "kind" }, "no such kind");
  }
}

/** Typed-in choice IDs, or a list's row IDs, in order. */
export function choiceIds(c: SchemaSource, q: Question): string[] | undefined {
  const choices: unknown = q.choices;
  if (!isObject(choices)) return undefined;
  if (choices["from"] === "typedIn" && Array.isArray(choices["choices"]))
    return choices["choices"].filter((x) => isObject(x) && isString(x["id"])).map((x) => (x as { id: string }).id);
  if (choices["from"] === "list" && isString(choices["list"])) {
    const list = (Array.isArray(c.workflow.lists) ? c.workflow.lists : []).find((l) => isObject(l) && l.id === choices["list"]);
    if (!list) return undefined;
    return (Array.isArray(list.rows) ? list.rows : []).filter((r) => isObject(r) && isString(r.id)).map((r) => r.id);
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The check place of a task's form (compiler.md 5.2, 8.1). */
export function checkPlace(task: TaskView, groupsKey: string, requesterInput: boolean): CheckPlace {
  const form: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const { question } of task.questions) {
    if (!isString(question.savedAs)) continue;
    (form[question.savedAs] ??= []).push(question.id);
  }
  const place: CheckPlace = { in: "check", form, groupsKey };
  if (requesterInput) place.requesterInput = true;
  return place;
}

function addReads(reads: Read[], found: readonly DirectoryRead[], item: string, part: string): void {
  for (const r of found) reads.push({ ...r, at: { item, part } });
}

/** A question's visibility `V(q)` (compiler.md 5.2), or null when neither it nor its page has a Show when. */
function visibility(c: Compiler, entry: QuestionInForm, place: CheckPlace, reads: Read[]): { cel: string; item: string; part: string } | null {
  const { question: q, page } = entry;
  const r = compileVisible([page.showWhen, q.showWhen], place, c.world);
  if (r === null) return null;
  if (!r.ok) {
    const [index, ...rest] = r.path;
    const [item, part] = index === 0 ? [page.id, "showWhen"] : [q.id, "showWhen"];
    throw new Stop({ item, part: [part, ...rest].join(".") }, r);
  }
  const [item, part] = q.showWhen === undefined ? [page.id, "showWhen"] : [q.id, "showWhen"];
  addReads(reads, r.reads, item, part);
  return { cel: r.cel, item, part };
}

export interface CompiledOutcome {
  schema: JsonSchema;
  checks: { check: Check; item: string; part: string | null; whenPart?: string }[];
  lookups: { lookup: Lookup; item: string; inputParts: Record<string, string> }[];
}

/**
 * The schema of one button of a task (compiler.md 5.1): every question in form order, `requester` on a
 * start form a binding names a Requester for (10.1). `required` holds the needed questions with no Show
 * when on a page with no Show when; a needed question with a Show when is the check `<q>__needed`.
 * `unchecked` are the questions whose choices cannot be offered: in Try it they do not stop the form
 * (core-api.md section 4), and the answer is taken as its kind allows. In publish mode they throw `Stop`.
 */
export function outcomeSchema(
  c: SchemaSource, task: TaskView, button: string, place: CheckPlace, startRequester: boolean, mode: CompileMode,
): { schema: JsonSchema; unchecked: Set<string> } {
  const needed = new Set(neededFor(task, button));
  const properties: Record<string, JsonSchema> = {};
  const required: string[] = [];
  const unchecked = new Set<string>();
  for (const { question: q, page } of task.questions) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(properties, q.id)) continue;
    try {
      properties[q.id] = questionSchema(c, q, place);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof Stop) || mode === "publish") throw e;
      properties[q.id] = kindSchema(questionKind(q));
      unchecked.add(q.id);
      continue;
    }
    if (needed.has(q.id) && q.showWhen === undefined && page.showWhen === undefined) required.push(q.id);
  }
  if (startRequester) properties["requester"] = PERSON;
  return { schema: { type: "object", additionalProperties: false, required, properties }, unchecked };
}

/** Everything about one button of a task: its schema, its checks and its lookups. */
export function compileOutcome(
  c: Compiler, task: TaskView, button: string, place: CheckPlace, startRequester: boolean, reads: Read[],
): CompiledOutcome {
  const T = task.task.id;
  const needed = new Set(neededFor(task, button));
  const checks: CompiledOutcome["checks"] = [];
  if (startRequester) checks.push({ check: { id: `${T}__requester`, when: "actor.type == 'connection' || !has(input.requester)", message: "" }, item: T, part: null });
  const { schema, unchecked } = outcomeSchema(sourceOf(c), task, button, place, startRequester, c.mode);
  for (const entry of task.questions) {
    const q = entry.question;
    if (unchecked.has(q.id)) continue;
    const v = visibility(c, entry, place, reads);
    if (v !== null) {
      const shown = safe(v.cel);
      checks.push({ check: { id: `${q.id}__hidden`, when: `${shown} || !has(input.${q.id})`, message: "" }, item: v.item, part: v.part });
      if (needed.has(q.id)) checks.push({ check: { id: `${q.id}__needed`, when: `${not(v.cel)} || has(input.${q.id})`, message: "" }, item: q.id, part: null });
    }
    const choice = choiceCheck(c, q, place);
    if (choice !== undefined) checks.push(choice);
  }
  const b = task.buttons.find((x) => x.id === button);
  if (b?.enabledWhen !== undefined) {
    const r = need(compileCondition(b.enabledWhen, place, c.world, ["enabledWhen"]), button);
    addReads(reads, r.reads, button, "enabledWhen");
    checks.push({ check: { id: `${button}__also`, when: r.cel, message: isString(b.messageWhileDisabled) ? b.messageWhileDisabled : "" }, item: button, part: "enabledWhen" });
  }
  return { schema, checks, lookups: compileLookups(c, task, place, reads, unchecked) };
}

/**
 * `<q>__choice` (compiler.md 5.4): the order of a multiple choice, and formula choices. A multiple choice
 * also holds at least one item here, because jsonschema-1 has no `minItems` (empty is absent, core-api 2.4).
 */
function choiceCheck(c: Compiler, q: Question, place: CheckPlace): CompiledOutcome["checks"][number] | undefined {
  const choices: unknown = q.choices;
  if (!isObject(choices)) return undefined;
  const id = `${q.id}__choice`;
  const answer = `input.${q.id}`;
  const some = q.kind === "multipleChoice" ? `size(${answer}) > 0 && ` : "";
  if ((choices["from"] === "typedIn" || choices["from"] === "list") && q.kind === "multipleChoice") {
    const ids = choiceIds(sourceOf(c), q) ?? [];
    const list = `[${ids.map(celString).join(", ")}]`;
    return { check: { id, when: `!has(${answer}) || ${some}${list}.filter(c, c in ${answer}) == ${answer}`, message: "" }, item: q.id, part: "choices" };
  }
  if (choices["from"] === "formula" && isObject(choices["formula"]) && isString(choices["formula"]["formula"])) {
    const f = need(compileFormulaOpt(choices["formula"]["formula"], place, c.world, ["choices", "formula"]), q.id);
    const all = f.opt.has === null ? f.opt.val : `${safe(f.opt.opt)}.orValue([])`;
    const when = q.kind === "multipleChoice"
      ? `!has(${answer}) || ${some}${answer}.all(x, ${all}.exists(c, c == x))`
      : `!has(${answer}) || ${all}.exists(c, c == ${answer})`;
    return { check: { id, when, message: "" }, item: q.id, part: "choices", whenPart: "choices.formula" };
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** `LOOKUPS(T)` (compiler.md 5.4): one per question whose choices come from the directory or a data source. */
function compileLookups(c: Compiler, task: TaskView, place: CheckPlace, reads: Read[], unchecked: ReadonlySet<string>): CompiledOutcome["lookups"] {
  const out: CompiledOutcome["lookups"] = [];
  for (const { question: q } of task.questions) {
    const choices: unknown = q.choices;
    if (!isObject(choices) || unchecked.has(q.id)) continue;
    if (choices["from"] === "directory") {
      const group = need(compileExpression(choices["peopleIn"], place, c.world, ["choices", "peopleIn"]), q.id);
      addReads(reads, group.reads, q.id, "choices.peopleIn");
      out.push({
        lookup: { property: q.id, connection: c.directory, source: "groupMembers@1", inputs: { group: group.cel }, storedField: "id", labelField: "name", answer: "person" },
        item: q.id,
        inputParts: { group: "choices.peopleIn" },
      });
    } else if (choices["from"] === "source") {
      const entry = c.entry(choices["source"]);
      if (entry?.kind !== "dataSource") throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices.source" }, "no such data source");
      if (!isString(choices["storedField"]) || !isString(choices["labelField"])) throw new Stop({ item: q.id, part: "choices" }, "no stored or label field");
      const inputs: Record<string, string> = {};
      const inputParts: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const [field, e] of inOrder<unknown>(choices["inputs"], c.ctx.catalogue.fields(entry, "input"))) {
        const r = need(compileExpressionOrTemplate(e, place, c.world, ["choices", "inputs", field]), q.id);
        addReads(reads, r.reads, q.id, `choices.inputs.${field}`);
        inputs[field] = r.cel;
        inputParts[field] = `choices.inputs.${field}`;
      }
      out.push({
        lookup: {
          property: q.id, connection: entry.connection, source: `${entry.name}@${entry.version}`, inputs,
          storedField: choices["storedField"], labelField: choices["labelField"], answer: "item",
        },
        item: q.id,
        inputParts,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** `compile`: the authored workflow to its published definition (contract/core-api.md section 12). */
export { compile } from "./compile.ts";
export type { CompileMode, CompileOptions, CompileResult, Published, Unfinished } from "./types.ts";
