/**
 * The blocks `decide` never reads: notification rules (compiler.md 10.2, 10.3), event rules for Tell other
 * systems (10.5) and trigger bindings for Starts when (10.6).
 */
import type { EventRule, NotificationRule, RuleOn, TriggerBinding } from "../../format/index.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Field } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { celString, compileCondition, compileExpressionOrTemplate, compileVisible, safe, wrapVisible, type SentPlace } from "./expr/index.ts";
import { Compiler, isObject, isString, need, Stop } from "./state.ts";

/** `on` and the stage test of a rule hung on an action's run step, one copy or two (compiler.md 10.2). */
function onRun(runs: readonly string[], when: string | null): { on: RuleOn; when: string } {
  if (runs.length === 1) return { on: { event: "StageEntered", element: runs[0] as string }, when: when ?? "true" };
  const stages = `event.stage in [${runs.map(celString).join(", ")}]`;
  return { on: { event: "StageEntered", element: null }, when: when === null ? stages : `${stages} && (${when})` };
}

/** Authored Notify rules in document order, then `n_task` and `n_stopped`; Tell rules in document order. */
export function compileRules(c: Compiler): { notifications: NotificationRule[]; events: EventRule[] } {
  const notifications: NotificationRule[] = [];
  const events: EventRule[] = [];
  for (const view of c.ctx.ix.stages)
    for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
      const content = c.rules.get(action.id);
      const runs = c.runSteps.get(action.id) ?? [];
      if (!content || runs.length === 0) continue;
      const A = action.id;
      const { on, when } = onRun(runs, content.when);
      if (content.kind === "notify") {
        const key = `rule:${A}`;
        notifications.push({ id: A, on, when, send: { message: { parts: content.parts }, to: [{ type: "expr", expr: content.to }] } });
        c.origin(key, A, null);
        if (content.when !== null) c.field(key, "/when", A, "onlyWhen");
        c.field(key, "/send/to/0/expr", A, "to");
        content.parts.forEach((p, i) => {
          if ("value" in p) c.field(key, `/send/message/parts/${i}/value`, A, `message.${i}`);
        });
      } else {
        const key = `event:${A}`;
        events.push({ id: A, on, when, told: content.told, values: content.values });
        c.origin(key, A, null);
        if (content.when !== null) c.field(key, "/when", A, "onlyWhen");
        for (const name of Object.keys(content.values)) c.field(key, `/values/${name}`, A, `values.${name}`);
      }
    }
  notifications.push(
    {
      id: "n_task", on: { event: "WaitOpened", element: null }, when: "event.kind == 'person' && event.role == 'obligation'",
      send: { message: { words: "task.assigned" }, to: [{ type: "expr", expr: "event.assignees" }] },
    },
    { id: "n_stopped", on: { event: "Stuck", element: null }, when: "true", send: { message: { words: "request.stuck" }, to: [{ type: "workflowAdmins" }] } },
  );
  c.origin("rule:n_task", c.wf, null);
  c.origin("rule:n_stopped", c.wf, null);
  return { notifications, events };
}

/** A trigger's sent fields by dotted ID (`reporter.email`), with their kinds. */
function sentFields(fields: readonly Field[], prefix = "", out: Record<string, ValueKind> = {}): Record<string, ValueKind> {
  for (const f of fields) {
    if (!isObject(f) || !isString(f.id)) continue;
    out[`${prefix}${f.id}`] = f.kind;
    if (f.kind === "fieldGroup" && Array.isArray(f.fields)) sentFields(f.fields, `${prefix}${f.id}.`, out);
  }
  return out;
}

/** One `triggers` entry per binding, in `startsWhen` order (compiler.md 10.6). */
export function compileTriggers(c: Compiler): TriggerBinding[] {
  const out: TriggerBinding[] = [];
  const start = c.ctx.startTask;
  const bindings = Array.isArray(c.ctx.workflow.start?.startsWhen) ? c.ctx.workflow.start.startsWhen : [];
  for (const b of bindings) {
    if (!isObject(b) || !isString(b.id)) continue;
    const blocked = c.blockedAt(`binding:${b.id}`);
    if (blocked) {
      c.markUnfinished(blocked, undefined);
      continue;
    }
    try {
      if (!start) throw new Stop({ item: b.id }, "no start task");
      const entry = c.entry(b.trigger);
      if (entry?.kind !== "trigger") throw new Stop({ item: b.id, part: "trigger" }, "no such trigger");
      const fields = sentFields(c.ctx.catalogue.fields(entry, "event"));
      const place: SentPlace = { in: "sent", fields };
      const outcome = isString(b.button) ? b.button : start.buttons.length === 1 ? start.buttons[0]?.id : undefined;
      if (outcome === undefined) throw new Stop({ item: b.id, part: "button" }, "no button");
      const answers = isObject(b.answers) ? b.answers : {};
      // Each answered question's mapping, in form order. A value filled by several questions reads the last
      // one that is not empty (E-27).
      const mapped: { q: string; cel: string }[] = [];
      const values: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const { question: q } of start.questions) {
        const answer = answers[q.id];
        if (answer === undefined) continue;
        const r = need(compileExpressionOrTemplate(answer, place, c.world, ["answers", q.id]), b.id);
        mapped.push({ q: q.id, cel: r.cel });
        if (!isString(q.savedAs)) continue;
        const earlier = values[q.savedAs];
        values[q.savedAs] = earlier === undefined ? r.cel : `${safe(r.cel)}.or(${earlier})`;
      }
      let requester: string | undefined;
      if (b.requester !== undefined) requester = need(compileExpressionOrTemplate(b.requester, place, c.world, ["requester"]), b.id).cel;
      const visiblePlace: SentPlace = requester === undefined ? { ...place, values } : { ...place, values, requester };
      const data: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const { q, cel } of mapped) {
        const entryQ = start.questions.find((x) => x.question.id === q);
        if (!entryQ) continue;
        const v = compileVisible([entryQ.page.showWhen, entryQ.question.showWhen], visiblePlace, c.world);
        if (v !== null && !v.ok) throw new Stop({ item: b.id, part: `answers.${q}` }, v);
        data[q] = wrapVisible(v === null ? null : v.cel, cel);
      }
      if (requester !== undefined) data["requester"] = requester;
      const when = b.onlyWhen === undefined ? "true" : need(compileCondition(b.onlyWhen, place, c.world, ["onlyWhen"]), b.id).cel;
      out.push({ id: b.id, connection: entry.connection, event: `${entry.name}@${entry.version}`, when, outcome, data });
      const key = `trigger:${b.id}`;
      c.origin(key, b.id, null);
      if (b.onlyWhen !== undefined) c.field(key, "/when", b.id, "onlyWhen");
      for (const name of Object.keys(data)) c.field(key, `/data/${name}`, b.id, name === "requester" ? "requester" : `answers.${name}`);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof Stop)) throw e;
      c.fail(e.location, undefined, e.why);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/compile/schemas.ts\n===
/**
 * JSON schemas the compiler writes: the kind schemas of compiler.md 5.1 for answers and values, and the
 * schemas derived from catalogue fields (integrations-shapes.md 2.3) for results and saved results.
 */
import type { JsonSchema } from "../../format/index.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Field } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";

export const STR: JsonSchema = { type: "string" };
export const TEXT: JsonSchema = { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 1000 };
export const LONG: JsonSchema = { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 20000 };
/**
 * jsonschema-1 has no `minimum`, `maximum` or `minItems` (definition-format.md section 6), so compiler.md
 * 5.1's number bounds are left to the validator, which refuses an integer beyond 2^53 - 1 itself, and a
 * multiple choice's "at least one" is the `<q>__choice` check.
 */
export const NUMBER: JsonSchema = { type: "number" };

/** What no answer satisfies: a question whose choices cannot be offered (no list rows, no source). */
export const NOTHING: JsonSchema = { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 0 };
export const YESNO: JsonSchema = { type: "boolean" };
export const DATE: JsonSchema = { type: "string", format: "date" };

/**
 * A user or group reference. `type` says `"type": "string"` beside its `const`: the CEL wrapper types a
 * schema with no `type` as dyn, and then a recorded reference and `request.by` or `actor` would be two
 * object types that `or` and `==` refuse to mix (compiler.md 19 item 5).
 */
function ref(type: "user" | "group"): JsonSchema {
  return {
    type: "object",
    additionalProperties: false,
    required: ["type", "id"],
    properties: { type: { type: "string", const: type }, id: { type: "string", format: "directory-object-id" } },
  };
}

export const PERSON: JsonSchema = ref("user");
export const GROUP: JsonSchema = ref("group");

/** One of the IDs; with none (a list with no rows), nothing (jsonschema-1 refuses an empty `enum`). */
export function enumOf(ids: readonly string[]): JsonSchema {
  return ids.length === 0 ? NOTHING : { type: "string", enum: [...ids] };
}

/** A multiple-choice answer: unique items. That it holds at least one is the `<q>__choice` check. */
export function manyOf(item: JsonSchema): JsonSchema {
  return { type: "array", items: item, uniqueItems: true };
}

/** A choice from a data source: `{stored, label}`, `stored` typed by the source's stored field. */
export function connectionChoice(stored: JsonSchema): JsonSchema {
  return {
    type: "object",
    additionalProperties: false,
    required: ["stored", "label"],
    properties: { stored, label: { type: "string" } },
  };
}

const ANY_STORED: JsonSchema = { type: ["string", "number"] };

/**
 * The schema of a value of this kind where nothing more is known (a saved expression, a list cell). Choices
 * are plain strings here: the enum belongs to the question that offers them.
 */
export function kindSchema(kind: ValueKind | undefined): JsonSchema {
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
      return TEXT;
    case "longText":
      return LONG;
    case "number":
      return { type: "number" };
    case "yesNo":
      return YESNO;
    case "date":
      return DATE;
    case "choice":
    case "choiceFromList":
      return STR;
    case "multipleChoice":
      return { type: "array", items: STR, uniqueItems: true };
    case "person":
      return PERSON;
    case "group":
      return GROUP;
    case "people":
      return { type: "array", items: PERSON, uniqueItems: true };
    case "choiceFromConnection":
      return connectionChoice(ANY_STORED);
    case "list":
      return { type: "array" };
    case "fieldGroup":
      return { type: "object" };
    default:
      return {};
  }
}

/** A list column's cell. Text is a plain string, so a list may hold any text the author typed. */
export function cellSchema(kind: unknown): JsonSchema {
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
      return STR;
    case "number":
      return { type: "number" };
    case "yesNo":
      return YESNO;
    case "date":
      return DATE;
    case "person":
      return PERSON;
    case "group":
      return GROUP;
    default:
      return {};
  }
}

const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Record<string, unknown> => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);

/** An object of catalogue fields (integrations-shapes.md 2.3). */
export function fieldsSchema(fields: readonly Field[]): JsonSchema {
  const valid = fields.filter((f) => isObject(f) && typeof f.id === "string");
  const properties: Record<string, JsonSchema> = {};
  for (const f of valid) properties[f.id] = fieldSchema(f);
  return {
    type: "object",
    additionalProperties: false,
    required: valid.filter((f) => f.required === true).map((f) => f.id),
    properties,
  };
}

/** One catalogue field (integrations-shapes.md 2.3). */
export function fieldSchema(field: Field): JsonSchema {
  const choices = Array.isArray(field.choices) ? field.choices.filter(isObject).map((c) => String(c.value)) : [];
  switch (field.kind) {
    case "text":
    case "longText":
      return STR;
    case "number":
      return { type: "number" };
    case "yesNo":
      return YESNO;
    case "date":
      return DATE;
    case "choice":
      return enumOf(choices);
    case "multipleChoice":
      return { type: "array", items: enumOf(choices), uniqueItems: true };
    case "person":
      return PERSON;
    case "group":
      return GROUP;
    case "people":
      return { type: "array", items: PERSON, uniqueItems: true };
    case "choiceFromConnection":
      return connectionChoice(ANY_STORED);
    case "list":
      if (Array.isArray(field.fields)) return { type: "array", items: fieldsSchema(field.fields) };
      return { type: "array", items: field.itemKind ? fieldSchema({ id: field.id, label: field.label, kind: field.itemKind as Field["kind"], required: true }) : {} };
    case "fieldGroup":
      return fieldsSchema(Array.isArray(field.fields) ? field.fields : []);
    default:
      return {};
  }
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/compile/stage.ts\n===
/**
 * One authored working stage as its chain of engine stages (compiler.md 2): arrival actions, the directory
 * read and the tasks step, after-response actions, the directory read and the routing step, once per copy
 * (7.2). Targets into other chains are placeholders until every chain is built.
 */
import type { CallWait, Outcome, PersonWait, SetEntry, Transition, Wait } from "../../format/index.ts";
import type { Action, Arrow, Location, WorkingStage } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { StageView, TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import {
  compileCondition, compileExpression, compileExpressionOrTemplate, compileMessageParts, compileValueMap, compileWhoIsAsked, emptyRule,
  groupsArg, NONE, pressedRead, REQ, safe, celString, type DataPlace, type DirectoryRead, type Place, type TasksPlace,
} from "./expr/index.ts";
import { checkPlace, compileOutcome } from "./forms.ts";
import { Compiler, entryOf, inOrder, isObject, isString, need, NEXT, pastOf, Stop, type Read, type Step } from "./state.ts";

type Copy = "normal" | "back";

/** A Set before it is written, with the authored part it comes from (absent for a merged Set). */
interface SetDraft {
  path: string;
  expr: string;
  origin?: Location;
}

/** The Requester in parentheses, as compiler.md 15.2 abbreviates it. */
const REQP = `(${REQ})`;

const opt = (s: string): string => `optional.of(${s})`;

function withReads(reads: Read[], found: readonly DirectoryRead[], at: Location): void {
  for (const r of found) reads.push({ ...r, at });
}

/** Every button named by a pressed clause anywhere inside `node`. */
function pressedButtons(node: unknown, out: Set<string>): void {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) for (const x of node) pressedButtons(x, out);
  else if (isObject(node)) {
    if (isString(node["pressed"])) out.add(node["pressed"]);
    for (const v of Object.values(node)) pressedButtons(v, out);
  }
}

export class StageCompiler {
  private readonly c: Compiler;
  private readonly view: StageView;
  private readonly working: WorkingStage;
  private readonly S: string;
  private readonly tasks: TaskView[];
  private readonly isStart: boolean;
  /** Some binding names a Requester: the start form takes `requester` (compiler.md 10.1). */
  private readonly startRequester: boolean;
  private readonly early: Arrow[];
  /** Tasks whose pressed button is read after the tasks step: they get `<tk>__pressed` (compiler.md 3.1). */
  private readonly pressed: string[];
  private readonly groupsKey: string;
  private readonly data: DataPlace;
  private usesGroups = false;
  private answered?: { sets: SetDraft[]; map: Record<string, string> };
  /** `ar__unfinished` stages (Try it), emitted after the chains. */
  private readonly unfinishedStages: Step[] = [];

  constructor(c: Compiler, view: StageView, startRequester: boolean) {
    this.c = c;
    this.view = view;
    this.working = view.working as WorkingStage;
    this.S = view.stage.id;
    this.tasks = view.tasks;
    this.isStart = c.ctx.workflow.start?.stage === this.S;
    this.startRequester = this.isStart && startRequester;
    this.early = this.tasks.length >= 2 ? view.arrows.filter((a) => a.goAsSoonAsTrue === true && a.when?.type !== "inAllOtherCases") : [];
    const buttons = new Set<string>();
    pressedButtons(view.after, buttons);
    for (const a of view.arrows) {
      pressedButtons([a.when, a.onlyWhen], buttons);
      if (a.when?.type === "buttonPressed" && isString(a.when.button)) buttons.add(a.when.button);
    }
    this.pressed = this.tasks.filter((t) => t.buttons.some((b) => buttons.has(b.id))).map((t) => t.task.id);
    this.groupsKey = `${this.S}__groups`;
    this.data = { in: "data", groupsKey: this.groupsKey };
  }

  /** Every engine stage of this authored stage, normal copy first. */
  compile(): Step[] {
    const normal = this.chain("normal");
    const back = this.c.backCopies.has(this.S) ? this.chain("back") : [];
    if (this.usesGroups)
      for (const step of [...normal, ...back])
        if (step.id === `${this.S}__route` || step.id === `${this.S}__routeBack`)
          for (const t of step.transitions) t.set.push({ path: [this.groupsKey], expr: NONE });
    return [...normal, ...back, ...this.unfinishedStages];
  }

  private status(copy: Copy): string | null {
    const normal = this.c.status(this.working.status);
    return copy === "normal" ? normal : (this.c.status(this.working.ifSentBackStatus) ?? normal);
  }

  private chain(copy: Copy): Step[] {
    const steps: Step[] = [];
    if (!(this.isStart && copy === "normal")) for (const a of this.view.arrival) steps.push(...this.actionSteps(a, copy));
    if (this.tasks.length > 0) steps.push(...this.tasksSteps(copy));
    for (const a of this.view.after) steps.push(...this.actionSteps(a, copy));
    steps.push(...this.routeSteps(copy));
    // Each step's NEXT is the step after it; a gate's skip goes past its call step.
    steps.forEach((step, i) => {
      for (const t of step.transitions) {
        if (t.to === NEXT) t.to = steps[i + 1]?.id ?? t.to;
        else if (t.to.startsWith("\u0000past:")) {
          const past = steps.findIndex((s) => s.id === t.to.slice("\u0000past:".length));
          t.to = steps[past + 1]?.id ?? t.to;
        }
      }
    });
    const first = steps[0];
    if (first) this.c.entries.set(entryOf(this.S, copy === "back"), first.id);
    return steps;
  }

  private newStep(id: string, copy: Copy, item: string, part: string | null): Step {
    this.c.origin(`stage:${id}`, item, part);
    return { id, status: this.status(copy), waits: [], transitions: [] };
  }

  /** A directory read step just before the step it serves (compiler.md 8.6). */
  private readStep(id: string, owner: string, reads: readonly Read[], copy: Copy, item: string, part: string | null): Step {
    this.usesGroups = true;
    const step = this.newStep(id, copy, item, part);
    const wait: CallWait = {
      id: `${owner}__read`, kind: "call", connection: this.c.directory, op: "membersOf@1",
      args: { groups: groupsArg(reads) }, effect: "read", onFailure: "fault", keyScope: "activation", idempotencyKey: null,
    };
    step.waits.push(wait);
    const waitKey = `wait:${id}.${wait.id}`;
    this.c.origin(waitKey, item, part);
    const parts = new Set(reads.map((r) => `${r.at.item}\u0000${r.at.part ?? ""}`));
    const one = reads[0];
    if (parts.size === 1 && one) this.c.field(waitKey, "/args/groups", one.at.item, one.at.part ?? null);
    step.transitions.push({
      id: `${owner}__readOk`, otherwise: false, when: `waits.${owner}__read.outcome == 'ok'`,
      set: [{ path: [this.groupsKey], expr: `optional.of(waits.${owner}__read.data.groups)` }], to: NEXT,
    });
    this.c.origin(`transition:${id}.${owner}__readOk`, item, part);
    return step;
  }

  private setsOf(drafts: readonly SetDraft[], transitionKey: string): SetEntry[] {
    return drafts.map((d, i) => {
      if (d.origin) this.c.field(transitionKey, `/set/${i}/expr`, d.origin.item, d.origin.part ?? null);
      return { path: [d.path], expr: d.expr };
    });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the tasks step (compiler.md 2.3, 4)

  /**
   * The Sets of `S__answered` and of every early transition (compiler.md 4.6): authored values in document
   * order of their first filler, the Requester on the start stage, then `<tk>__pressed`. Two fillers of one
   * value are merged: the later task wraps the earlier, and within a task its questions wrap its extra
   * answer (E-26). A task's questions saved as one value are one filler: the last answered in form order
   * is kept, and the value is removed only when all of them are empty (E-27), as the form's checks read
   * it (places.ts). `map` is what the tasks place reads a value filled here as.
   */
  private answeredSets(): { sets: SetDraft[]; map: Record<string, string> } {
    if (this.answered) return this.answered;
    type Filler = { task: TaskView; questions?: string[]; extra?: "outcome" | "by"; at: Location };
    const order: string[] = [];
    const wrap = new Map<string, Filler[]>();
    const add = (value: unknown, f: Filler, first: boolean): void => {
      if (!isString(value)) return;
      if (first && !order.includes(value)) order.push(value);
      if (!first) {
        const list = wrap.get(value);
        const same = list?.at(-1);
        // Another question of the same task: it joins that task's filler.
        if (same && same.task === f.task && same.questions && f.questions) same.questions.push(...f.questions);
        else if (list) list.push(f);
        else wrap.set(value, [f]);
      }
    };
    for (const task of this.tasks) {
      const T = task.task;
      const fillers: [unknown, Filler][] = [
        ...task.questions.map(({ question: q }): [unknown, Filler] => [q.savedAs, { task, questions: [q.id], at: { item: q.id, part: "savedAs" } }]),
        [T.savesButtonPressedAs, { task, extra: "outcome", at: { item: T.id, part: "savesButtonPressedAs" } }],
        [T.savesAnsweredByAs, { task, extra: "by", at: { item: T.id, part: "savesAnsweredByAs" } }],
      ];
      for (const [v, f] of fillers) add(v, f, true);
      // Wrap order: the extra answers first, so the task's own questions win over them (E-26).
      for (const [v, f] of [...fillers.slice(-2), ...fillers.slice(0, -2)]) add(v, f, false);
    }
    const sets: SetDraft[] = [];
    const map: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const v of order) {
      let expr = `data.?${v}`;
      let base = true;
      const fillers = wrap.get(v) ?? [];
      for (const f of fillers) {
        const T = f.task.task.id;
        const prev = base ? expr : `(${expr})`;
        if (f.questions !== undefined) {
          const qs = [...f.questions].reverse();
          const answer = qs.map((q) => `waits.${T}.data.?${q}`).join(".or(") + ")".repeat(qs.length - 1);
          const branches = f.task.buttons.map((b) => `waits.${T}.outcome == ${celString(b.id)} ? ${answer}`);
          expr = branches.length === 0 ? prev : `${branches.join(" : ")} : ${prev}`;
        } else {
          const x = f.extra === "outcome" ? `waits.${T}.outcome` : `waits.${T}.by`;
          expr = `waits.${T}.status == 'completed' ? ${opt(x)} : ${base ? NONE : prev}`;
        }
        base = false;
      }
      const draft: SetDraft = { path: v, expr };
      const only = fillers[0];
      if (fillers.length === 1 && only && (only.questions?.length ?? 1) === 1) draft.origin = only.at;
      sets.push(draft);
      map[v] = expr;
    }
    if (this.isStart) {
      const start = this.tasks[0];
      let expr = "data.?requester";
      if (this.startRequester && start) {
        const T = start.task.id;
        const branches = start.buttons.map((b) => `waits.${T}.outcome == ${celString(b.id)} ? waits.${T}.data.?requester`);
        expr = `(${[...branches, NONE].join(" : ")}).or(data.?requester)`;
      }
      sets.push(start ? { path: "requester", expr, origin: { item: start.task.id } } : { path: "requester", expr });
    }
    for (const T of this.pressed)
      sets.push({ path: `${T}__pressed`, expr: `waits.${T}.status == 'completed' ? ${opt(`waits.${T}.outcome`)} : ${NONE}`, origin: { item: T } });
    this.answered = { sets, map };
    return this.answered;
  }

  private tasksSteps(copy: Copy): Step[] {
    const sfx = copy === "back" ? "Back" : "";
    const id = `${this.S}__tasks${sfx}`;
    const step = this.newStep(id, copy, this.S, "tasks");
    const blocked = this.c.blockedAt(`tasks:${this.S}`);
    if (blocked) {
      this.c.markUnfinished(blocked, id);
      return [step];
    }
    const reads: Read[] = [];
    const nobody: typeof this.c.nobody = [];
    try {
      const answered = this.answeredSets();
      for (const task of this.tasks) this.taskWaits(task, copy, id, step.waits, reads, nobody);
      const earlyKey = `${this.S}__early`;
      const done = (T: string): string => `waits.${T}.status == 'completed'`;
      const tasksPlace: TasksPlace = { in: "tasks", answered: answered.map, groupsKey: this.groupsKey };
      for (const ar of this.early) {
        const when = this.arrowWhen(ar, tasksPlace, reads);
        const any = (s: string): string => this.tasks.map((t) => `waits.${t.task.id}.${s}`).join(" || ");
        const tid = `${ar.id}__early`;
        const key = `transition:${id}.${tid}`;
        this.c.origin(key, ar.id, "goAsSoonAsTrue");
        this.c.field(key, "/when", ar.id, "when");
        const drafts = [...answered.sets, { path: earlyKey, expr: opt(celString(ar.id)) }];
        step.transitions.push({
          id: tid, otherwise: false,
          when: `(${any("status == 'completed'")}) && (${any("status == 'open'")}) && ${safe(when.cel)}`,
          set: this.setsOf(drafts, key), to: NEXT,
        });
      }
      const tid = `${this.S}__answered`;
      const key = `transition:${id}.${tid}`;
      this.c.origin(key, this.S, "tasks");
      const drafts = this.early.length > 0 ? [...answered.sets, { path: earlyKey, expr: NONE }] : answered.sets;
      step.transitions.push({
        id: tid, otherwise: false, when: this.tasks.map((t) => done(t.task.id)).join(" && "), set: this.setsOf(drafts, key), to: NEXT,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof Stop)) throw e;
      this.c.fail(e.location, id, e.why);
      step.waits = [];
      step.transitions = [];
      return [step];
    }
    this.c.nobody.push(...nobody);
    if (reads.length === 0) return [step];
    return [this.readStep(`${this.S}__groupsTasks${sfx}`, this.S, reads, copy, this.S, "tasks"), step];
  }

  private taskWaits(task: TaskView, copy: Copy, stageId: string, waits: Wait[], reads: Read[], nobody: typeof this.c.nobody): void {
    const T = task.task.id;
    const ask = need(compileWhoIsAsked(task.task.whoIsAsked, { in: "tasks", answered: {} }, this.c.world, ["whoIsAsked"]), T);
    if (ask.reads.length > 0) throw new Stop({ item: T, part: "whoIsAsked" }, "a directory step under who is asked that is not the last");
    if (ask.mayGiveGroup) {
      const members: CallWait = {
        id: `${T}__members`, kind: "call", connection: this.c.directory, op: "membersOf@1",
        args: { groups: ask.groups }, effect: "read", onFailure: "outcome", keyScope: "activation", idempotencyKey: null,
      };
      waits.push(members);
      this.c.origin(`wait:${stageId}.${members.id}`, T, "whoIsAsked");
    }
    const mayAll = task.task.requesterCanAnswer !== false || (this.isStart && copy === "normal");
    const may = mayAll ? "true" : `!(${REQP}.hasValue() && actor == ${REQP}.value())`;
    const place = checkPlace(task, this.groupsKey, this.startRequester);
    const outcomes: Outcome[] = [];
    const waitKey = `wait:${stageId}.${T}`;
    const pending: (() => void)[] = [];
    for (const b of task.buttons) {
      const o = compileOutcome(this.c, task, b.id, place, this.startRequester, reads);
      const ref = `${T}.${b.id}@1`;
      this.c.schemas[ref] ??= { id: `${T}.${b.id}`, version: 1, schema: o.schema };
      outcomes.push({ id: b.id, schema: ref, checks: o.checks.map((x) => x.check), lookups: o.lookups.map((x) => x.lookup) });
      pending.push(() => {
        const outcomeKey = `outcome:${stageId}.${T}/${b.id}`;
        this.c.origin(outcomeKey, b.id, null);
        o.lookups.forEach((l, n) => {
          this.c.field(outcomeKey, `/lookups/${n}`, l.item, "choices");
          for (const [f, part] of Object.entries(l.inputParts)) this.c.field(outcomeKey, `/lookups/${n}/inputs/${f}`, l.item, part);
        });
        for (const ch of o.checks) {
          const checkKey = `check:${stageId}.${T}/${b.id}/${ch.check.id}`;
          this.c.origin(checkKey, ch.item, ch.part);
          if (ch.whenPart !== undefined) this.c.field(checkKey, "/when", ch.item, ch.whenPart);
        }
      });
    }
    const wait: PersonWait = { id: T, kind: "person", role: "obligation", assignees: ask.cel, may, outcomes };
    waits.push(wait);
    this.c.origin(waitKey, T, null);
    this.c.field(waitKey, "/assignees", T, "whoIsAsked");
    this.c.field(waitKey, "/may", T, "requesterCanAnswer");
    for (const p of pending) p();
    const ruleId = `${stageId}.${T}__nobody`;
    nobody.push({ id: ruleId, wait: `${stageId}.${T}`, members: ask.mayGiveGroup ? `${stageId}.${T}__members` : null, excludeRequester: !mayAll });
    this.c.origin(`nobody:${ruleId}`, T, "whoIsAsked");
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ arrows (compiler.md 6)

  /** `A(ar)` in a place, with the part that contributes to its `when` (compiler.md 6.1, 12.2). */
  private arrowWhen(ar: Arrow, place: Place, reads: Read[]): { cel: string; part: string | null } {
    const when: unknown = ar.when;
    let cel: string;
    let part: string | null;
    if (!isObject(when)) throw new Stop({ item: ar.id, part: "when" }, "no when");
    switch (when["type"]) {
      case "buttonPressed": {
        const button = when["button"];
        const task = isString(button) ? this.c.world.buttonTask(button) : undefined;
        const read = isString(button) && task !== undefined ? pressedRead(place, task, button) : undefined;
        if (read === undefined) throw new Stop({ item: ar.id, part: "when.button" }, "no button");
        [cel, part] = [read, "when.button"];
        break;
      }
      case "condition": {
        const r = need(compileCondition(when["condition"], place, this.c.world, ["when", "condition"]), ar.id);
        withReads(reads, r.reads, { item: ar.id, part: "when.condition" });
        [cel, part] = [r.cel, "when.condition"];
        break;
      }
      case "whenDone":
        [cel, part] = ["true", null];
        break;
      default:
        throw new Stop({ item: ar.id, part: "when" }, "no rule for this when");
    }
    if (ar.onlyWhen === undefined) return { cel, part };
    const o = need(compileCondition(ar.onlyWhen, place, this.c.world, ["onlyWhen"]), ar.id);
    withReads(reads, o.reads, { item: ar.id, part: "onlyWhen" });
    return cel === "true" ? { cel: o.cel, part: "onlyWhen" } : { cel: `(${cel}) && (${o.cel})`, part: null };
  }

  private routeSteps(copy: Copy): Step[] {
    const sfx = copy === "back" ? "Back" : "";
    const id = `${this.S}__route${sfx}`;
    const step = this.newStep(id, copy, this.S, "arrows");
    const reads: Read[] = [];
    if (this.view.arrows.length === 0) this.c.fail({ item: this.S, part: "arrows" }, id, "no arrows");
    const remove: SetEntry[] = [
      ...this.pressed.map((T) => ({ path: [`${T}__pressed`], expr: NONE })),
      ...(this.early.length > 0 ? [{ path: [`${this.S}__early`], expr: NONE }] : []),
    ];
    const earlyKey = `${this.S}__early`;
    const earlyIds = new Set(this.early.map((a) => a.id));
    for (const ar of this.view.arrows) {
      const key = `transition:${id}.${ar.id}`;
      this.c.origin(key, ar.id, null);
      const t: Transition = { id: ar.id, otherwise: false, when: "true", set: remove.map((s) => ({ ...s, path: [...s.path] })), to: "" };
      const blocked = this.c.blockedAt(`arrow:${ar.id}`);
      let unfinishedAt: Location | undefined = blocked;
      let realWhen = blocked === undefined || blocked.part === "goTo";
      if (realWhen) {
        try {
          const arReads: Read[] = [];
          if (ar.when?.type === "inAllOtherCases") {
            if (ar.onlyWhen !== undefined || ar.goAsSoonAsTrue === true) throw new Stop({ item: ar.id, part: "onlyWhen" }, "in all other cases with a condition");
            t.otherwise = true;
            t.when = null;
          } else {
            const w = this.arrowWhen(ar, this.data, arReads);
            const not = `!has(data.${earlyKey})`;
            if (earlyIds.has(ar.id)) t.when = `data.?${earlyKey}.orValue('') == ${celString(ar.id)} || (${not} && ${safe(w.cel)})`;
            else if (this.early.length > 0) t.when = `${not} && ${safe(w.cel)}`;
            else t.when = w.cel;
            if (w.part !== null) this.c.field(key, "/when", ar.id, w.part);
          }
          reads.push(...arReads);
        } catch (e) {
          if (!(e instanceof Stop)) throw e;
          this.c.fail(e.location, `${ar.id}__unfinished`, e.why);
          unfinishedAt ??= e.location;
          realWhen = false;
          t.otherwise = false;
          t.when = "true";
        }
      }
      const target = this.c.targetOf(this.S, ar.goTo);
      if (target === undefined && unfinishedAt === undefined) {
        unfinishedAt = { item: ar.id, part: "goTo" };
        this.c.fail(unfinishedAt, `${ar.id}__unfinished`, "no destination");
      }
      if (unfinishedAt !== undefined) {
        if (this.c.mode === "tryIt") this.c.markUnfinished(unfinishedAt, `${ar.id}__unfinished`);
        t.to = this.unfinishedStage(ar, copy, unfinishedAt);
        if (!realWhen) {
          t.otherwise = false;
          t.when = "true";
          delete this.c.origins[`${key}#/when`];
        }
      } else t.to = target as string;
      step.transitions.push(t);
    }
    // Only one `otherwise`, last; an earlier one that Try it keeps becomes `true` (it fits where it stands).
    step.transitions.forEach((t, i) => {
      if (t.otherwise && i !== step.transitions.length - 1) {
        t.otherwise = false;
        t.when = "true";
      }
    });
    if (reads.length === 0) return [step];
    return [this.readStep(`${this.S}__groupsRoute${sfx}`, this.S, reads, copy, this.S, "arrows"), step];
  }

  /** `ar__unfinished` (Try it): no waits, no transitions, the source copy's status (compiler.md 13). */
  private unfinishedStage(ar: Arrow, copy: Copy, at: Location): string {
    const id = `${ar.id}__unfinished`;
    if (!this.unfinishedStages.some((s) => s.id === id)) this.unfinishedStages.push(this.newStep(id, copy, ar.id, at.part ?? null));
    return id;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ actions (compiler.md 2.2, 10, 11)

  private actionSteps(a: Action, copy: Copy): Step[] {
    const sfx = copy === "back" ? "Back" : "";
    const A = a.id;
    const runId = `${A}__run${sfx}`;
    const runs = this.c.runSteps.get(A);
    if (runs) runs.push(runId);
    else this.c.runSteps.set(A, [runId]);
    const run = this.newStep(runId, copy, A, null);
    const blocked = this.c.blockedAt(`action:${A}`);
    if (blocked && (a.type === "saveValue" || a.type === "useConnection")) {
      this.c.markUnfinished(blocked, runId);
      return [run];
    }
    const reads: Read[] = [];
    let gate: Step | undefined;
    try {
      switch (a.type) {
        case "saveValue":
          this.saveStep(a, run, reads);
          break;
        case "notify":
        case "tellOtherSystems":
          this.ruleStep(a, run, reads, blocked !== undefined);
          break;
        case "useConnection":
          gate = this.callStep(a, run, copy, reads);
          break;
        default:
          throw new Stop({ item: A }, "no such action");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof Stop)) throw e;
      this.c.fail(e.location, runId, e.why);
      run.waits = [];
      run.transitions = [];
      return [run];
    }
    const steps = gate ? [gate, run] : [run];
    if (reads.length === 0) return steps;
    return [this.readStep(`${A}__groups${sfx}`, A, reads, copy, A, null), ...steps];
  }

  private onlyWhen(a: Action, reads: Read[]): string | null {
    if (a.onlyWhen === undefined) return null;
    const r = need(compileCondition(a.onlyWhen, this.data, this.c.world, ["onlyWhen"]), a.id);
    withReads(reads, r.reads, { item: a.id, part: "onlyWhen" });
    return r.cel;
  }

  private saveStep(a: Extract<Action, { type: "saveValue" }>, run: Step, reads: Read[]): void {
    const A = a.id;
    if (!isString(a.as)) throw new Stop({ item: A, part: "as" }, "no value to save as");
    if (a.save === undefined) throw new Stop({ item: A, part: "save" }, "nothing to save");
    const when = this.onlyWhen(a, reads);
    const e = need(compileExpression(a.save, this.data, this.c.world, ["save"]), A);
    withReads(reads, e.reads, { item: A, part: "save" });
    const expr = emptyRule(this.c.world.valueKind(a.as) ?? e.kind, e.cel);
    const key = `transition:${run.id}.${A}__save`;
    this.c.origin(key, A, null);
    if (when !== null) this.c.field(key, "/when", A, "onlyWhen");
    this.c.field(key, "/set/0/expr", A, "save");
    run.transitions.push({ id: `${A}__save`, otherwise: false, when: when ?? "true", set: [{ path: [a.as], expr }], to: NEXT });
    if (when !== null) {
      run.transitions.push({ id: `${A}__skip`, otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: NEXT });
      this.c.origin(`transition:${run.id}.${A}__skip`, A, null);
    }
  }

  /** A Notify or a Tell: a step that moves on, and its rule's content (compiler.md 10.2, 10.5). */
  private ruleStep(a: Extract<Action, { type: "notify" | "tellOtherSystems" }>, run: Step, reads: Read[], blocked: boolean): void {
    const A = a.id;
    run.transitions.push({ id: `${A}__next`, otherwise: false, when: "true", set: [], to: NEXT });
    this.c.origin(`transition:${run.id}.${A}__next`, A, null);
    if (blocked) return;
    try {
      const ruleReads: Read[] = [];
      const when = this.onlyWhen(a, ruleReads);
      if (a.type === "notify") {
        if (a.to === undefined) return;
        const to = need(compileWhoIsAsked(a.to, this.data, this.c.world, ["to"]), A);
        const parts = need(compileMessageParts(a.message, this.data, this.c.world, ["message"]), A);
        withReads(ruleReads, parts.reads, { item: A, part: "message" });
        if (!this.c.rules.has(A)) this.c.rules.set(A, { kind: "notify", when, to: to.cel, parts: parts.parts });
      } else {
        if (!isString(a.tell)) return;
        const told = (Array.isArray(this.c.ctx.workflow.thingsTold) ? this.c.ctx.workflow.thingsTold : []).find((x) => isObject(x) && x.id === a.tell);
        if (!told) throw new Stop({ item: A, part: "tell" }, "no such thing told");
        const values = compileValueMap(Object.fromEntries(inOrder(a.values)), this.data, this.c.world, ["values"]);
        const v = need(values, A);
        for (const r of v.reads) ruleReads.push({ ...r, at: { item: A, part: "values" } });
        if (!this.c.rules.has(A)) this.c.rules.set(A, { kind: "tell", when, told: { id: told.id, words: isString(told.words) ? told.words : "" }, values: v.values });
      }
      reads.push(...ruleReads);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof Stop)) throw e;
      // A Notify or a Tell never stops a request: Try it leaves its rule out (compiler.md 13).
      if (this.c.mode === "publish") this.c.fail(e.location, undefined, e.why);
    }
  }

  private callStep(a: Extract<Action, { type: "useConnection" }>, run: Step, copy: Copy, reads: Read[]): Step | undefined {
    const A = a.id;
    const op = this.c.operation(a.operation);
    if (!op) throw new Stop({ item: A, part: "operation" }, "no such operation");
    const gateWhen = this.onlyWhen(a, reads);
    const args: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [field, e] of inOrder<unknown>(a.inputs, this.c.ctx.catalogue.fields(op, "input"))) {
      const r = need(compileExpressionOrTemplate(e, this.data, this.c.world, ["inputs", field]), A);
      withReads(reads, r.reads, { item: A, part: `inputs.${field}` });
      args[field] = r.cel;
    }
    const sort = op.sort;
    const repeat = a.ifStageEntersAgain ?? op.onRepeat;
    const once = sort !== "read" && repeat === "once";
    const carryOn = a.ifItFails === "carryOn";
    const wait: CallWait = {
      id: A, kind: "call", connection: op.connection, op: `${op.name}@${op.version}`, args,
      effect: sort === "read" ? "read" : "write", onFailure: carryOn ? "outcome" : "fault",
      keyScope: once ? null : "activation", idempotencyKey: once ? `'once.' + request.id + ${celString(`.${A}`)}` : null,
    };
    run.waits.push(wait);
    const waitKey = `wait:${run.id}.${A}`;
    this.c.origin(waitKey, A, null);
    for (const field of Object.keys(args)) this.c.field(waitKey, `/args/${field}`, A, `inputs.${field}`);
    if (once) this.c.field(waitKey, "/idempotencyKey", A, "ifStageEntersAgain");
    const results = this.c.resultFields(a.operation);
    const ok: SetDraft[] = [];
    for (const [field, value] of inOrder<unknown>(a.saveResults, results)) {
      if (!isString(value)) continue;
      const kind = results.find((f) => f.id === field)?.kind;
      ok.push({ path: value, expr: emptyRule(kind, `waits.${A}.data.?${field}`), origin: { item: A, part: `saveResults.${field}` } });
    }
    const failed = carryOn && isObject(a.saveFailureAs) && isString(a.saveFailureAs.failed) ? a.saveFailureAs.failed : undefined;
    const code = carryOn && isObject(a.saveFailureAs) && isString(a.saveFailureAs.code) ? a.saveFailureAs.code : undefined;
    if (failed !== undefined) ok.push({ path: failed, expr: opt("false"), origin: { item: A, part: "saveFailureAs.failed" } });
    const okKey = `transition:${run.id}.${A}__ok`;
    this.c.origin(okKey, A, null);
    run.transitions.push({ id: `${A}__ok`, otherwise: false, when: `waits.${A}.outcome == 'ok'`, set: this.setsOf(ok, okKey), to: NEXT });
    if (carryOn) {
      const bad: SetDraft[] = [];
      if (failed !== undefined) bad.push({ path: failed, expr: opt("true"), origin: { item: A, part: "saveFailureAs.failed" } });
      if (code !== undefined) bad.push({ path: code, expr: opt(`waits.${A}.data.code`), origin: { item: A, part: "saveFailureAs.code" } });
      const failedKey = `transition:${run.id}.${A}__failed`;
      this.c.origin(failedKey, A, null);
      run.transitions.push({ id: `${A}__failed`, otherwise: false, when: `waits.${A}.outcome == 'failed'`, set: this.setsOf(bad, failedKey), to: NEXT });
    }
    if (gateWhen === null) return undefined;
    const gate = this.newStep(`${A}__gate${copy === "back" ? "Back" : ""}`, copy, A, null);
    gate.transitions.push(
      { id: `${A}__go`, otherwise: false, when: gateWhen, set: [], to: run.id },
      { id: `${A}__skip`, otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: pastOf(run.id) },
    );
    this.c.origin(`transition:${gate.id}.${A}__go`, A, "onlyWhen");
    this.c.origin(`transition:${gate.id}.${A}__skip`, A, "onlyWhen");
    return gate;
  }
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/compile/state.ts\n===
/**
 * What every part of the compiler shares: the document's index and kinds, the catalogue, the parts a
 * blocking To do leaves unfinished, the origin map being built, and the record of what failed.
 */
import type { ChildStage, MessagePart, NobodyToAskRule, Origin, PinnedSchema, Transition, Wait } from "../../format/index.ts";
import type { Context } from "../check/context.ts";
import type { Finding } from "../check/findings.ts";
import { tryItEffect } from "../check/try-it.ts";
import type { Location, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { CatalogueEntry, Field, Operation } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { sendsBack } from "../facts/graph.ts";
import type { StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { compileExpression, worldFromDoc, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld, type NoRule } from "./expr/index.ts";
import type { CompileMode, Unfinished } from "./types.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
export const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
export const isString = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string";

/** A transition target the chain resolves once every chain is built. */
export const NEXT = "\u0000next";
export const pastOf = (stage: string): string => `\u0000past:${stage}`;
export const entryOf = (stage: string, back: boolean): string => `\u0000entry:${stage}:${back ? "back" : "normal"}`;

/** A part that cannot be compiled, thrown inside one element and caught at its edge. */
export class Stop {
  readonly location: Location;
  readonly why: NoRule | string;
  constructor(location: Location, why: NoRule | string) {
    this.location = location;
    this.why = why;
  }
}

/** The compiled result, or a `Stop` at the item and the part the expression compiler names. */
export function need<T extends { ok: true }>(r: T | NoRule, item: string): T {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Stop(locationOf(item, r.path), r);
  return r;
}

/**
 * The entries of an authored map in a fixed order: the catalogue's field order first, then any other key by
 * name. The compiled output then does not depend on the key order of the stored document.
 */
export function inOrder<T>(map: unknown, fields: readonly { id: string }[] = []): [string, T][] {
  if (!isObject(map)) return [];
  const rank = new Map(fields.map((f, i) => [f.id, i]));
  return (Object.entries(map) as [string, T][]).sort(([a], [b]) => {
    const ra = rank.get(a) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    const rb = rank.get(b) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    return ra !== rb ? ra - rb : a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
  });
}

/** A directory read a step needs (compiler.md 8.6), with the authored part that names the group. */
export interface Read extends DirectoryRead {
  at: Location;
}

/** A Notify's or a Tell's compiled rule, kept until every chain is built (compiler.md 10.2, 10.5). */
export type RuleContent =
  | { kind: "notify"; when: string | null; to: string; parts: MessagePart[] }
  | { kind: "tell"; when: string | null; told: { id: string; words: string }; values: Record<string, string> };

/** One engine stage of a chain, before its targets are resolved. */
export interface Step {
  id: string;
  status: string | null;
  waits: Wait[];
  transitions: Transition[];
}

export function childStage(step: Step): ChildStage {
  return { id: step.id, final: false, status: step.status, waits: step.waits, transitions: step.transitions };
}

/** Where a compile failure is: the item, and the part path the expression compiler reports. */
export function locationOf(item: string, path: readonly (string | number)[]): Location {
  return path.length === 0 ? { item } : { item, part: path.join(".") };
}

function sameOrigin(a: Origin, b: Origin): boolean {
  return a.item[0] === b.item[0] && a.part === b.part;
}

export class Compiler {
  readonly ctx: Context;
  readonly mode: CompileMode;
  readonly world: ExprWorld;
  readonly directory: string;
  readonly wf: string;
  readonly origins: Record<string, Origin> = {};
  readonly schemas: Record<string, PinnedSchema> = {};
  readonly unfinished: Unfinished[] = [];
  /** Failures that publish mode reports as `compile.internal`. */
  readonly internal: string[] = [];
  /** Element (`task:` stage, `arrow:`, `action:`, `binding:`) to the first blocking To do inside it. */
  readonly blocked = new Map<string, Finding>();
  /** The entry step of each chain, by `entryOf`. */
  readonly entries = new Map<string, string>();
  /** Stages that get a sent-back copy (compiler.md 7.2). */
  readonly backCopies = new Set<string>();
  /** Each action's `run` steps, one per copy it is emitted in. */
  readonly runSteps = new Map<string, string[]>();
  readonly rules = new Map<string, RuleContent>();
  readonly nobody: NobodyToAskRule[] = [];

  constructor(ctx: Context, findings: readonly Finding[], mode: CompileMode, directory: string) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
    this.mode = mode;
    this.directory = directory;
    this.wf = isObject(ctx.workflow) && isString(ctx.workflow.id) ? ctx.workflow.id : "";
    this.world = this.worldWithFormulaKinds(worldFromDoc(ctx.ix, ctx.kinds));
    if (mode === "tryIt") this.markBlocked(findings);
    this.findBackCopies();
  }

  /** A value saved only from a formula has the formula's kind (the checker leaves it unknown, E-26). */
  private worldWithFormulaKinds(base: ExprWorld): ExprWorld {
    const formulaKinds = new Map<string, ValueKind>();
    const world: ExprWorld = { ...base, valueKind: (v) => base.valueKind(v) ?? formulaKinds.get(v) };
    for (const view of this.ctx.ix.stages)
      for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) {
        if (action.type !== "saveValue" || !isString(action.as) || base.valueKind(action.as) !== undefined) continue;
        const save: unknown = action.save;
        if (!isObject(save) || !isString(save["formula"])) continue;
        const r = compileExpression(action.save, { in: "data" }, world);
        if (r.ok && r.kind !== undefined && !formulaKinds.has(action.as)) formulaKinds.set(action.as, r.kind);
      }
    return world;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ unfinished parts (compiler.md 13)

  /** The element a located To do makes unfinished, or undefined when it only shapes what people see. */
  private elementOf(item: string, part: string | undefined): string[] {
    const found = this.ctx.ix.byId.get(item);
    if (!found) return [];
    switch (found.kind) {
      case "arrow":
        return [`arrow:${item}`];
      case "action":
        return [`action:${item}`];
      case "startsWhen":
        return [`binding:${item}`];
      case "stage":
        return part === "arrows" ? [`arrows:${item}`] : [];
      case "text":
      case "choice":
        return [];
      case "value": {
        const places = [...(this.ctx.ix.fillsOf.get(item) ?? []).map((f) => f.at), ...(this.ctx.ix.usesOf.get(item) ?? []).map((u) => u.at)];
        return places.flatMap((l) => (l.item === item ? [] : this.elementOf(l.item, l.part)));
      }
      default:
        return found.task !== undefined && found.stage !== undefined ? [`tasks:${found.stage}`] : [];
    }
  }

  private markBlocked(findings: readonly Finding[]): void {
    const kindOf = (item: string): string | undefined => this.ctx.ix.byId.get(item)?.kind;
    for (const f of findings) {
      const effect = tryItEffect(f, kindOf);
      if (effect === "runs") continue;
      // A task nobody is asked compiles with `assignees: []` and is nobody-to-ask, as live (compiler.md 13).
      if (f.code === "item.partMissing" && f.location.part === "whoIsAsked" && kindOf(f.location.item) === "task") continue;
      for (const element of this.elementOf(f.location.item, f.location.part)) {
        if (effect === "bindingOnly" && !element.startsWith("binding:")) continue;
        if (!this.blocked.has(element)) this.blocked.set(element, f);
      }
    }
  }

  /** The first blocking To do inside the element, in Try it mode. */
  blockedAt(element: string): Location | undefined {
    return this.blocked.get(element)?.location;
  }

  /**
   * A part that cannot be compiled. In Try it it is listed as unfinished at `stage` (when given); in publish
   * mode check found no To do there, so it is a gap in core and becomes `compile.internal`.
   */
  fail(location: Location, stage: string | undefined, why: NoRule | string): void {
    if (this.mode === "publish") {
      const detail = typeof why === "string" ? why : `${why.construct}${why.detail === undefined ? "" : ` (${why.detail})`}`;
      const text = `${location.item}${location.part === undefined ? "" : `/${location.part}`}: ${detail}`;
      if (!this.internal.includes(text)) this.internal.push(text);
      return;
    }
    this.markUnfinished(location, stage);
  }

  markUnfinished(location: Location, stage: string | undefined): void {
    const entry: Unfinished = stage === undefined ? { location } : { location, stage };
    const same = (u: Unfinished): boolean => u.stage === entry.stage && u.location.item === location.item && u.location.part === location.part;
    if (!this.unfinished.some(same)) this.unfinished.push(entry);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ origins (compiler.md 12)

  origin(key: string, item: string, part: string | null): void {
    this.origins[key] = { item: [item], part };
  }

  /** A field key, written only when its origin differs from its element's (definition-format.md 3.11). */
  field(element: string, pointer: string, item: string, part: string | null): void {
    const mine: Origin = { item: [item], part };
    const parent = this.origins[element];
    if (parent !== undefined && sameOrigin(parent, mine)) return;
    this.origins[`${element}#${pointer}`] = mine;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the graph (compiler.md 7)

  private findBackCopies(): void {
    const start = this.ctx.workflow.start?.stage;
    for (const view of this.ctx.ix.stages)
      for (const arrow of view.arrows) {
        const to = arrow.goTo;
        if (!isString(to) || !sendsBack(this.ctx.graph, view.stage.id, to)) continue;
        const target = this.ctx.ix.stageById.get(to)?.working;
        if (!target) continue;
        if (to === start || (target.ifSentBackStatus !== undefined && target.ifSentBackStatus !== target.status)) this.backCopies.add(to);
      }
  }

  /** The target of an arrow out of `from` (compiler.md 7.3), or undefined when it names no stage. */
  targetOf(from: string, to: unknown): string | undefined {
    if (!isString(to)) return undefined;
    const view = this.ctx.ix.stageById.get(to);
    if (!view) return undefined;
    if (!view.working) return to;
    return entryOf(to, sendsBack(this.ctx.graph, from, to) && this.backCopies.has(to));
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the catalogue

  entry(id: unknown): CatalogueEntry | undefined {
    return this.ctx.catalogue.entry(id);
  }

  operation(id: unknown): Operation | undefined {
    const e = this.entry(id);
    return e?.kind === "operation" ? e : undefined;
  }

  resultFields(id: unknown): Field[] {
    return this.ctx.catalogue.fields(this.entry(id), "result");
  }

  /** `<connection>.<name>@<version>` split into the connection and `<name>@<version>`. */
  static split(ref: string): { connection: string; name: string } {
    const dot = ref.indexOf(".");
    return { connection: ref.slice(0, dot), name: ref.slice(dot + 1) };
  }

  /** The status ID of a stage, or null when it names no status of the document. */
  status(id: unknown): string | null {
    if (!isString(id)) return null;
    const statuses = Array.isArray(this.ctx.workflow.statuses) ? this.ctx.workflow.statuses : [];
    return statuses.some((s) => isObject(s) && s.id === id) ? id : null;
  }

  stageView(id: string): StageView | undefined {
    return this.ctx.ix.stageById.get(id);
  }
}
