/**
 * `evaluate` (core-api.md 6.2, R3): an authored expression, condition or template worked out over
 * the sample request, in the same CEL environment `decide` uses.
 *
 * The sample stands for the request at that point, so every value reads as the data holds it (the
 * compiler's `data` place): a value a form fills is its sample answer, and a pressed clause is true
 * when the sample's "Button pressed" value of that task is the button. A directory step or "is in"
 * a group reads the people the caller looked up; without them the answer is `needsLookups`.
 */
import type { JsonValue } from "../../cel/types.ts";
import { reservedKey } from "../../kernel/decide/sets.ts";
import {
  compileCondition, compileExpression, compileMessageParts, type DataPlace, type DirectoryRead,
} from "../compile/expr/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Expression, Location, SampleRequest, Template, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { sampleValuesIn, type SampleValues } from "./sample-values.ts";
import { docSetup, environmentFor, groupsKeyAt, isObject, isString, resolveGroups, run, withKind, type DocSetup } from "./setup.ts";
import type { EvaluateResult, Json, KnownLookups, MessagePart } from "./types.ts";

/** The parts that hold a whole condition: a sentence or a formula there is read as true or false. */
export const CONDITION_PARTS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["showWhen", "enabledWhen", "onlyWhen", "when.condition"]);

/**
 * What the compiler could not build (an unfinished draft, a construct with no rule) is the error
 * `other`: such a workflow cannot run, and `check` names the To do.
 */
const OTHER: EvaluateResult = { result: "error", error: "other", params: {} };

/** One compiled piece: a template's text, or CEL with the kind it gives. */
interface Piece {
  text?: string;
  cel?: string;
  kind?: ValueKind;
}

/** The data and request a sample stands for. */
export function sampleScene(s: DocSetup, sv: SampleValues, groupsKey: string): { data: Record<string, JsonValue>; request: Record<string, JsonValue> } {
  const data: Record<string, JsonValue> = { ...(sv.values as Record<string, JsonValue>) };
  for (const [task, view] of s.ix.taskById) {
    const pressed = view.task.savesButtonPressedAs;
    const value = isString(pressed) ? data[pressed] : undefined;
    if (isString(value)) data[`${task}__pressed`] = value;
  }
  data[groupsKey] = [];
  const request: Record<string, JsonValue> = { id: "sample", by: sv.requester ?? { type: "system", id: "engine" } };
  if (sv.startedOn !== undefined) request["at"] = `${sv.startedOn}T00:00:00.000Z`;
  return { data, request };
}

function isConditionNode(what: unknown): boolean {
  return isObject(what) && (Array.isArray(what["allOf"]) || Array.isArray(what["anyOf"]) || isString(what["formula"]));
}

/** `evaluate` on a document already read. */
export function evaluateIn(s: DocSetup, at: Location, what: unknown, sv: SampleValues, lookups?: KnownLookups): EvaluateResult {
  const groupsKey = groupsKeyAt(s, at);
  const place: DataPlace = { in: "data", groupsKey };
  const env = environmentFor(s, { groupsKey });
  const scene = sampleScene(s, sv, groupsKey);

  let reads: DirectoryRead[];
  let cels: Piece[];
  let template = false;
  if (Array.isArray(what)) {
    const parts = compileMessageParts(what, place, s.world);
    if (!parts.ok) return OTHER;
    template = true;
    reads = parts.reads;
    cels = parts.parts.map((p) => ("text" in p ? { text: p.text } : { cel: p.value, kind: p.kind }));
  } else if (at.part !== undefined && CONDITION_PARTS.has(at.part) && isConditionNode(what)) {
    const c = compileCondition(what, place, s.world);
    if (!c.ok) return OTHER;
    reads = c.reads;
    cels = [{ cel: c.cel, kind: "yesNo" }];
  } else {
    const e = compileExpression(what, place, s.world);
    if (!e.ok) return OTHER;
    reads = e.reads;
    cels = [e.kind === undefined ? { cel: e.cel } : { cel: e.cel, kind: e.kind }];
  }

  const context = { data: scene.data, request: scene.request };
  const groups = resolveGroups(env, reads, context, lookups);
  if (groups.needs.length > 0) return { result: "needsLookups", lookups: groups.needs };
  scene.data[groupsKey] = groups.entries as unknown as JsonValue;

  if (!template) {
    const only = cels[0] as Piece;
    const r = run(env, only.cel ?? "", context);
    // A saved value holding a key that starts with `$` faults the request's turn (spec section 2, Values).
    if (at.part === "save" && r.result === "value" && reservedKey(r.value) !== null) return { result: "error", error: "wrong-kind", params: {} };
    return withKind(r, only.kind);
  }
  const out: MessagePart[] = [];
  for (const p of cels) {
    if (p.text !== undefined) {
      out.push(p.text);
      continue;
    }
    const r = run(env, p.cel ?? "", context);
    if (r.result === "error") return r;
    const part: { value?: Json; kind?: ValueKind } = {};
    if (r.result === "value") part.value = r.value;
    if (p.kind !== undefined) part.kind = p.kind;
    out.push(part);
  }
  return { result: "value", value: out as Json };
}

export function evaluate(
  workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, at: Location, what: Expression | Template, sample: SampleRequest, lookups?: KnownLookups,
): EvaluateResult {
  const s = docSetup(workflow, catalogue);
  return evaluateIn(s, at, what, sampleValuesIn(s, sample), lookups);
}

/**
 * `sampleValues` (core-api.md 2.4): the sample request's constants as the JSON a request holds. A
 * value whose kind is not known yet, or whose constant does not fit its kind, is left out.
 */
import { isDate } from "../../schema/formats.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, SampleRequest } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { constantJson } from "./constants.ts";
import { choiceOrder, docSetup, isObject, isString, type DocSetup } from "./setup.ts";
import type { Ref, Values } from "./types.ts";

export interface SampleValues {
  values: Values;
  requester?: Ref;
  startedOn?: string;
}

/** The sample's values, Requester and start date, read with the document's value kinds. */
export function sampleValuesIn(s: DocSetup, sample: SampleRequest | undefined): SampleValues {
  const out: SampleValues = { values: {} };
  if (!isObject(sample)) return out;
  const answers: unknown = sample.answers;
  if (isObject(answers)) {
    for (const [value, constant] of Object.entries(answers)) {
      const json = constantJson(constant, s.kinds.valueKind(value), choiceOrder(s, value));
      if (json !== undefined) out.values[value as `v_${string}`] = json;
    }
  }
  const r: unknown = sample.requester;
  if (isObject(r) && isString(r["directoryId"]) && r["directoryId"] !== "") out.requester = { type: "user", id: r["directoryId"] };
  if (isString(sample.startedOn) && isDate(sample.startedOn)) out.startedOn = sample.startedOn;
  return out;
}

/**
 * The catalogue fixes the kind of a value saved from an operation's result, so it is a second
 * argument here too. Without it such a value's kind is unknown and the value is left out.
 */
export function sampleValues(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, sample: SampleRequest, catalogue?: Catalogue): SampleValues {
  return sampleValuesIn(docSetup(workflow, catalogue as Catalogue), sample);
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/evaluate/setup.ts\n===
/**
 * What `evaluate`, `evaluateSent`, `checkFormula` and `formState` share: the document read once,
 * the CEL environment its expressions run in, and the one way compiled text is run.
 *
 * Every expression is compiled by the expression compiler (compile/expr) and run by the engine's
 * CEL environment (src/cel), so the editor shows what the published workflow does. The environment
 * is typed the way the published definition types data (compiler.md 3.4): each value by its kind,
 * the Requester as a person, each list as a constant of its rows, the recorded directory read as
 * `membersOf@1`'s `groups` result.
 */
import { createCelEnvironment, type CelEnvironment } from "../../cel/environment.ts";
import { t, type CelResult, type CelType, type ExpressionErrorKind, type JsonValue } from "../../cel/types.ts";
import { CatalogueIndex } from "../check/context.ts";
import { worldFromDoc, type DirectoryRead, type ExprWorld } from "../compile/expr/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue, Field } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { Kinds } from "../facts/kinds.ts";
import { celTypeOfField, celTypeOfKind } from "../formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { indexDocument, type DocIndex } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { constantJson } from "./constants.ts";
import type { Json, KnownLookups, NeededLookup, Ref, SampleResult } from "./types.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
export const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
export const isString = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string";

const REF = celTypeOfKind("person");
const GROUPS_RESULT = t.list(t.object({ id: REF, members: t.list(REF) }));

/** The document read once for one call. */
export interface DocSetup {
  workflow: AuthoredWorkflow;
  ix: DocIndex;
  kinds: Kinds;
  world: ExprWorld;
  catalogue: CatalogueIndex;
}

export function docSetup(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue): DocSetup {
  const ix = indexDocument(workflow);
  const kinds = new Kinds(ix, catalogue);
  return { workflow, ix, kinds, world: worldFromDoc(ix, kinds), catalogue: new CatalogueIndex(catalogue) };
}

/** The catalogue field a value is saved from, which types a list's or a field group's items. */
function resultField(s: DocSetup, value: string): Field | undefined {
  const fill = s.ix.fillsOf.get(value)?.find((f) => f.by === "result");
  if (!fill || fill.field === undefined) return undefined;
  const action = s.ix.stages.flatMap((v) => [...v.arrival, ...v.after]).find((a) => a.id === fill.at.item);
  const operation = action?.type === "useConnection" ? action.operation : undefined;
  return s.catalogue.fields(s.catalogue.entry(operation), "result").find((f) => f.id === fill.field);
}

export function valueType(s: DocSetup, value: string): CelType {
  return celTypeOfKind(s.kinds.valueKind(value), resultField(s, value), s.kinds.itemKind(value));
}

/** The IDs of a multiple choice's typed-in choices, in the order of the question that fills it. */
export function choiceOrder(s: DocSetup, value: string): string[] | undefined {
  for (const f of s.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? []) {
    if (f.by !== "question") continue;
    const q = s.ix.taskById.get(s.ix.byId.get(f.at.item)?.task ?? "")?.questions.find((x) => x.question.id === f.at.item)?.question;
    const choices: unknown = q?.choices;
    if (isObject(choices) && choices["from"] === "typedIn" && Array.isArray(choices["choices"]))
      return choices["choices"].filter(isObject).map((c) => c["id"]).filter(isString);
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The stage the located item is in, for the key of its recorded directory read (`<st>__groups`). */
export function groupsKeyAt(s: DocSetup, at: Location): string {
  const stage = s.ix.byId.get(at.item)?.stage;
  return `${stage ?? "request"}__groups`;
}

/** What the data, input and sent variables hold besides the values. */
export interface Frame {
  groupsKey: string;
  /** The form's answers, typed by question (the `check` place). */
  input?: Record<string, CelType>;
  /** What the other system sent (the `sent` place). */
  sent?: CelType;
}

function lists(s: DocSetup): Record<string, { type: CelType; value: JsonValue }> {
  const out: Record<string, { type: CelType; value: JsonValue }> = {};
  for (const list of Array.isArray(s.workflow.lists) ? s.workflow.lists : []) {
    if (!isObject(list) || !isString(list.id)) continue;
    const columns = (Array.isArray(list.columns) ? list.columns : []).filter((c) => isObject(c) && isString(c.id));
    const row: Record<string, CelType> = {};
    for (const c of columns) row[c.id] = celTypeOfKind(c.kind);
    const rows: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
    for (const r of Array.isArray(list.rows) ? list.rows : []) {
      if (!isObject(r) || !isString(r.id)) continue;
      const cells: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
      for (const c of columns) {
        const j = constantJson(isObject(r.cells) ? r.cells[c.id] : undefined, c.kind as ValueKind);
        if (j !== undefined) cells[c.id] = j;
      }
      rows[r.id] = cells;
    }
    out[list.id] = { type: t.map(t.object(row)), value: rows };
  }
  return out;
}

const environments = new Map<string, CelEnvironment>();
const MAX_ENVIRONMENTS = 64;

/** The CEL environment for one place of the document, shared between calls with the same declarations. */
export function environmentFor(s: DocSetup, frame: Frame): CelEnvironment {
  const data: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  for (const v of s.ix.valueIds) data[v] = valueType(s, v);
  data["requester"] = REF;
  for (const task of s.ix.taskById.keys()) data[`${task}__pressed`] = t.string;
  data[frame.groupsKey] = GROUPS_RESULT;
  const variables: Record<string, CelType> = {
    data: t.object(data),
    request: t.object({ id: t.string, by: REF, at: t.string }),
  };
  if (frame.input) variables["input"] = t.object(frame.input);
  if (frame.sent) variables["sent"] = frame.sent;
  const constants = lists(s);
  const key = JSON.stringify([variables, constants]);
  let env = environments.get(key);
  if (!env) {
    if (environments.size >= MAX_ENVIRONMENTS) environments.clear();
    env = createCelEnvironment({ variables, constants });
    environments.set(key, env);
  }
  return env;
}

/** A sent field's CEL type, by the trigger's catalogue fields. */
export function sentType(fields: readonly Field[]): CelType {
  const out: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  for (const f of fields) if (isObject(f) && isString(f.id)) out[f.id] = celTypeOfField(f);
  return t.object(out);
}

function holdsNull(v: JsonValue): boolean {
  if (v === null) return true;
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.some(holdsNull);
  return typeof v === "object" && Object.values(v).some(holdsNull);
}

export type Run = SampleResult;

const error = (kind: ExpressionErrorKind, params: { key?: string; index?: number } = {}): Run => ({ result: "error", error: kind, params });

/**
 * Runs compiled text over a context. Text that does not type-check is the error `other`: the
 * publish check would refuse it, so no request can meet it. A null result is an error, as in
 * `decide` (the engine never writes null).
 */
export function run(env: CelEnvironment, cel: string, context: Record<string, JsonValue>): Run {
  const checked = env.check(cel);
  if (!checked.ok) return error("other");
  const r: CelResult = env.evaluate(checked.expression, context);
  if (r.kind === "error") {
    const params: { key?: string; index?: number } = {};
    if (r.key !== undefined) params.key = r.key;
    if (r.index !== undefined) params.index = r.index;
    return error(r.code, params);
  }
  if (r.kind === "absent") return { result: "absent" };
  if (holdsNull(r.value)) return error("wrong-kind");
  return { result: "value", value: r.value as Json };
}

/** The result with its kind, when one is known. */
export function withKind(r: Run, kind: ValueKind | undefined): Run {
  return r.result === "value" && kind !== undefined ? { ...r, kind } : r;
}

/**
 * The recorded directory read the compiled text needs, from what the caller looked up: each group
 * the reads name is worked out over data; a group whose people `lookups` lacks is needed. An empty
 * group expression names no group.
 */
export function resolveGroups(
  env: CelEnvironment, reads: readonly DirectoryRead[], context: Record<string, JsonValue>, lookups: KnownLookups | undefined,
): { needs: NeededLookup[]; entries: { id: Ref; members: Ref[] }[] } {
  const needs: NeededLookup[] = [];
  const entries: { id: Ref; members: Ref[] }[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const read of reads) {
    const g = run(env, read.group, context);
    if (g.result !== "value" || !isObject(g.value) || !isString(g.value["id"])) continue;
    const ref: Ref = { type: g.value["type"] === "user" ? "user" : "group", id: g.value["id"] };
    if (seen.has(ref.id)) continue;
    seen.add(ref.id);
    const members = lookups?.membersOf?.[ref.id];
    if (members === undefined) needs.push({ membersOf: ref });
    else entries.push({ id: ref, members: members.map((m) => ({ type: m.type, id: m.id })) });
  }
  return { needs, entries };
}

/** Arrows that can provably never be used, found from buttons alone (core-api.md `arrow.neverUsed`). */
import type { Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { DocIndex, StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { fits, fullCombos, isEarly, mayBeTaken, partialCombos } from "./combos.ts";

export type Usability =
  | { usable: true }
  /** `covering` with `earlierArrowAlwaysFits` only: the earlier arrows taken instead; `earlier` when one alone always fits. */
  | { usable: false; reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits" | "conditionNeverTrue"; earlier?: Location; covering?: Location[] };

/** Usability of each arrow of a working stage, by arrow ID. "Usable" means "not provably never". */
export function arrowUsability(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView): Map<string, Usability> {
  const result = new Map<string, Usability>();
  const full = fullCombos(view);
  const partial = partialCombos(view);
  view.arrows.forEach((arrow, index) => {
    const early = isEarly(view, arrow);
    const combos = early ? [...full, ...partial] : full;
    const possible = combos.filter((c) => fits(ix, view, c, arrow) !== false);
    if (possible.length === 0) return result.set(arrow.id, { usable: false, reason: "conditionNeverTrue" });
    if (possible.some((c) => mayBeTaken(ix, view, c, index))) return result.set(arrow.id, { usable: true });
    const before = view.arrows.slice(0, index);
    const surely = (c: (typeof possible)[number], e: (typeof before)[number]): boolean => (c.full || isEarly(view, e)) && fits(ix, view, c, e) === true;
    // Every earlier arrow that is taken instead in some case: the first that surely fits it, in document order.
    const taken = new Set(possible.map((c) => before.find((e) => surely(c, e))));
    const covering = before.filter((e) => taken.has(e)).map((e) => ({ item: e.id }));
    const earlier = before.find((e) => possible.every((c) => surely(c, e)));
    result.set(
      arrow.id,
      earlier ? { usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", earlier: { item: earlier.id }, covering } : { usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", covering },
    );
  });
  return result;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/combos.ts\n===
/**
 * How a visit of a stage can end: one choice per task (the button pressed, or cancelled by an early
 * arrow), and what that tells about "is pressed" clauses. Only buttons are read here: no expression
 * is evaluated, so a clause on a value is "unknown".
 */
import type { Arrow, Button, Condition } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { DocIndex, StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";

/**
 * - `button`: the task was answered with this button.
 * - `cancelled`: an early arrow was taken while the task was open (compiler.md 4.7).
 * - `any` / `anyOrCancelled`: some button, not enumerated (a task with no buttons yet, or too many combinations).
 */
export type Choice =
  | { kind: "button"; button: Button }
  | { kind: "cancelled" }
  | { kind: "any" }
  | { kind: "anyOrCancelled" };

export interface Combo {
  /** One per task of the stage, in task order. */
  choices: Choice[];
  /** Every task answered: the routing step. Otherwise an early arrow is being taken (compiler.md 6.4). */
  full: boolean;
}

/** Three-valued: true, false, or not known without evaluating an expression. */
export type Tri = boolean | undefined;

/** Beyond this many combinations a stage is analysed with `any` choices instead. */
const MAX_COMBOS = 512;

function product(options: Choice[][]): Choice[][] {
  return options.reduce<Choice[][]>((acc, opts) => acc.flatMap((head) => opts.map((o) => [...head, o])), [[]]);
}

function size(options: Choice[][]): number {
  return options.reduce((n, opts) => n * opts.length, 1);
}

const answered = (buttons: Button[]): Choice[] => (buttons.length ? buttons.map((button) => ({ kind: "button", button })) : [{ kind: "any" }]);

/** The combinations in which every task is answered. A stage with no tasks has one, empty. */
export function fullCombos(view: StageView): Combo[] {
  const options = view.tasks.map((t) => answered(t.buttons));
  if (size(options) > MAX_COMBOS) return [{ choices: view.tasks.map(() => ({ kind: "any" })), full: true }];
  return product(options).map((choices) => ({ choices, full: true }));
}

/** An early arrow is possible only in a stage with two or more tasks (compiler.md 6.4). */
export function isEarly(view: StageView, arrow: Arrow): boolean {
  return arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue === true && view.tasks.length >= 2;
}

/** The combinations in which some tasks are answered and the rest cancelled: an early arrow is taken. */
export function partialCombos(view: StageView): Combo[] {
  if (!view.arrows.some((a) => isEarly(view, a))) return [];
  const options = view.tasks.map((t): Choice[] => [...answered(t.buttons), { kind: "cancelled" }]);
  if (size(options) > MAX_COMBOS) return [{ choices: view.tasks.map(() => ({ kind: "anyOrCancelled" })), full: false }];
  return product(options)
    .filter((choices) => choices.some((c) => c.kind === "cancelled") && choices.some((c) => c.kind !== "cancelled"))
    .map((choices) => ({ choices, full: false }));
}

/** The buttons a combination pressed, in task order. */
export function pressedButtons(combo: Combo): Button[] {
  return combo.choices.flatMap((c) => (c.kind === "button" ? [c.button] : []));
}

/** "In this stage's current visit, that button was pressed" (format, PressedClause). */
export function pressed(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, combo: Combo | undefined, button: string): Tri {
  const owner = ix.buttonTask.get(button);
  if (!owner) return undefined; // a deleted button: a broken reference, nothing to say
  const at = view.tasks.indexOf(owner);
  if (at < 0) return false; // another stage's button is never pressed in this visit
  const choice = combo?.choices[at];
  if (!choice) return undefined;
  if (choice.kind === "button") return choice.button.id === button;
  return choice.kind === "cancelled" ? false : undefined;
}

const and = (a: Tri, b: Tri): Tri => (a === false || b === false ? false : a === true && b === true ? true : undefined);

/** A condition, knowing only which buttons were pressed. An absent condition is true. */
export function condition(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, combo: Combo | undefined, c: Condition | undefined): Tri {
  if (c === undefined) return true;
  if (typeof c !== "object" || c === null) return undefined;
  const all = "allOf" in c && Array.isArray(c.allOf);
  const clauses = all ? c.allOf : "anyOf" in c && Array.isArray(c.anyOf) ? c.anyOf : undefined;
  if (!clauses || clauses.length === 0) return undefined; // a formula, or an empty sentence: no guess (E-23)
  const values = clauses.map((clause): Tri =>
    typeof clause === "object" && clause !== null && "pressed" in clause ? pressed(ix, view, combo, clause.pressed) : undefined,
  );
  if (all) return values.includes(false) ? false : values.every((v) => v === true) ? true : undefined;
  return values.includes(true) ? true : values.every((v) => v === false) ? false : undefined;
}

/** Whether the arrow's "when" (without "+ only when") fits. "In all other cases" is decided by the caller. */
export function when(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, combo: Combo | undefined, arrow: Arrow): Tri {
  const w = arrow.when;
  if (typeof w !== "object" || w === null) return undefined;
  switch (w.type) {
    case "whenDone":
      return true;
    case "buttonPressed":
      return typeof w.button === "string" ? pressed(ix, view, combo, w.button) : undefined;
    case "condition":
      return w.condition === undefined ? undefined : condition(ix, view, combo, w.condition);
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** Whether the arrow fits: its "when" and its "+ only when". */
export function fits(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, combo: Combo | undefined, arrow: Arrow): Tri {
  if (arrow.when?.type === "inAllOtherCases") return undefined;
  return and(when(ix, view, combo, arrow), condition(ix, view, combo, arrow.onlyWhen));
}

/**
 * Whether `arrow` (at `index` of the stage's arrows) can be the one taken in `combo`: it may fit and
 * no arrow that is checked before it surely fits. In the routing step arrows are checked from the
 * top; while tasks are still open only the early arrows are, in order (compiler.md 6.2, 6.4).
 */
export function mayBeTaken(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, combo: Combo, index: number): boolean {
  const arrow = view.arrows[index];
  if (!arrow) return false;
  if (!combo.full && !isEarly(view, arrow)) return false;
  if (fits(ix, view, combo, arrow) === false) return false;
  return !view.arrows.slice(0, index).some((e) => (combo.full || isEarly(view, e)) && fits(ix, view, combo, e) === true);
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/facts.ts\n===
/** `facts`: contract/core-api.md section 5. */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { indexDocument } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { arrowUsability } from "./arrows.ts";
import { sendsBack, stageGraph } from "./graph.ts";
import { Kinds } from "./kinds.ts";
import type { ArrowFacts, Facts } from "./types.ts";
import { valueFacts } from "./value-facts.ts";

/** Per stage, arrow and value. Works on an unfinished draft and never throws. */
export function facts(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue): Facts {
  const ix = indexDocument(workflow);
  const graph = stageGraph(ix);
  const result: Facts = { stages: {}, arrows: {}, values: {} };
  for (const view of ix.stages) {
    const id = view.stage.id;
    if (result.stages[id]) continue; // a duplicated ID: the first stage speaks for it
    result.stages[id] = { incoming: [...(graph.incoming.get(id) ?? [])], reachable: graph.reachable.has(id) };
  }
  // Each arrow is judged as if its stage is reached (E-26): an unreachable stage is stage.unreachable's alone.
  for (const view of ix.stages) {
    const usability = arrowUsability(ix, view);
    for (const arrow of view.arrows) {
      if (result.arrows[arrow.id]) continue;
      const back = sendsBack(graph, view.stage.id, arrow.goTo);
      const u = usability.get(arrow.id) ?? { usable: true };
      const fact: ArrowFacts = u.usable ? { usable: true, sendsBack: back } : { ...u, sendsBack: back };
      result.arrows[arrow.id] = fact;
    }
  }
  // Only the registry's values (E-26): a value filled or read but not registered is item.brokenReference.
  const kinds = new Kinds(ix, catalogue);
  for (const item of ix.items)
    if (item.kind === "value" && !result.values[item.id as `v_${string}`]) result.values[item.id as `v_${string}`] = valueFacts(ix, kinds, item.id);
  return result;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/fill-state.ts\n===
/**
 * Whether each value is filled at a point: per value, the set of what it can be there, `FILLED`,
 * `EMPTY` or both, with one route on which it is empty. Routes are shared lists of stages, buttons
 * and arrows, newest last.
 *
 * Many values share one route, so a state keeps a small table of distinct routes and each value
 * points into it: moving a state one step moves each distinct route once, not each value (the
 * editor runs this on every edit, core-api.md 1: target 50 ms).
 */
import type { Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";

export const FILLED = 1;
export const EMPTY = 2;
export const BOTH = FILLED | EMPTY;

export interface Route {
  readonly loc: Location;
  readonly prev: Route | undefined;
}

export function routeTo(route: Route | undefined, item: string): Route {
  return { loc: { item }, prev: route };
}

export function locationsOf(route: Route | undefined): Location[] {
  const out: Location[] = [];
  for (let r = route; r; r = r.prev) out.push(r.loc);
  return out.reverse();
}

export interface State {
  /** Per value index: FILLED, EMPTY or BOTH. */
  readonly flags: Uint8Array;
  /** Per value index: 0, or 1 + the index in `routes` of a route on which the value is empty. */
  readonly emptyAt: Uint32Array;
  /** The distinct routes `emptyAt` points into. */
  readonly routes: Route[];
  /** A route that reaches this point. */
  route: Route | undefined;
}

/** Beyond this many routes, routes no value points at any more are dropped before a move. */
const COMPACT_AT = 64;

/** A route on which the value is empty here, when its flags hold EMPTY and one is known. */
export function emptyRoute(s: State, i: number): Route | undefined {
  const k = s.emptyAt[i] ?? 0;
  return k ? s.routes[k - 1] : undefined;
}

function slotOf(s: State, route: Route): number {
  let k = s.routes.indexOf(route);
  if (k < 0) {
    k = s.routes.length;
    s.routes.push(route);
  }
  return k + 1;
}

/** The state before anything is filled: every value empty. Room for a multiple of four values, which `mergeInto` compares at once. */
export function nothingFilled(count: number, route: Route): State {
  const size = Math.ceil(count / 4) * 4;
  return { flags: new Uint8Array(size).fill(EMPTY), emptyAt: new Uint32Array(size).fill(1), routes: [route], route };
}

export function copy(s: State): State {
  return { flags: s.flags.slice(), emptyAt: s.emptyAt.slice(), routes: s.routes.slice(), route: s.route };
}

export function setValue(s: State, i: number | undefined, flags: number, empty: Route | undefined): void {
  if (i === undefined) return;
  s.flags[i] = flags;
  const route = flags & EMPTY ? (empty ?? s.route) : undefined;
  s.emptyAt[i] = route ? slotOf(s, route) : 0;
}

/** Either state may hold: the union, keeping `a`'s routes where it has them. */
export function join(a: State, b: State): State {
  const out = copy(a);
  mergeInto(out, b);
  return out;
}

/** Adds `b`'s possibilities to `target`; true when a value gained one. */
export function mergeInto(target: State, b: State): boolean {
  let changed = false;
  const slots = new Map<number, number>(); // b's slot -> target's slot
  const one = (i: number): void => {
    const before = target.flags[i] ?? 0;
    const after = before | (b.flags[i] ?? 0);
    if (after === before) return;
    changed = true;
    target.flags[i] = after;
    if (!(after & EMPTY) || target.emptyAt[i]) return;
    const k = b.emptyAt[i] ?? 0;
    let slot = slots.get(k);
    if (slot === undefined) {
      const route = k ? b.routes[k - 1] : b.route;
      slot = route ? slotOf(target, route) : 0;
      slots.set(k, slot);
    }
    target.emptyAt[i] = slot;
  };
  // Four values at a time where nothing changes: most of a state is the same on every route.
  const n = target.flags.length;
  const words = n === b.flags.length && n % 4 === 0 && target.flags.byteOffset % 4 === 0 && b.flags.byteOffset % 4 === 0 ? n / 4 : 0;
  const t32 = new Uint32Array(target.flags.buffer, target.flags.byteOffset, words);
  const b32 = new Uint32Array(b.flags.buffer, b.flags.byteOffset, words);
  for (let w = 0; w < words; w++) {
    const t = t32[w] ?? 0;
    if (((t | (b32[w] ?? 0)) >>> 0) === t >>> 0) continue;
    for (let i = w * 4; i < w * 4 + 4; i++) one(i);
  }
  for (let i = words * 4; i < n; i++) one(i);
  target.route ??= b.route;
  return changed;
}

/** The union of the states (the first itself when there is one); undefined when there are none. */
export function joinAll(states: readonly State[]): State | undefined {
  const [first, ...rest] = states;
  if (!first || !rest.length) return first;
  const out = copy(first);
  for (const s of rest) mergeInto(out, s);
  return out;
}

/** Drops the routes no value points at any more. */
function compact(s: State): void {
  const remap = new Uint32Array(s.routes.length + 1);
  const routes: Route[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.emptyAt.length; i++) {
    const k = s.emptyAt[i] ?? 0;
    if (!k) continue;
    let slot = remap[k] ?? 0;
    if (!slot) {
      routes.push(s.routes[k - 1] as Route);
      slot = remap[k] = routes.length;
    }
    s.emptyAt[i] = slot;
  }
  s.routes.splice(0, s.routes.length, ...routes);
}

/** Moves the state one step further along every route, in place. */
export function advance(s: State, item: string): void {
  if (s.routes.length > COMPACT_AT) compact(s);
  const k = s.route ? s.routes.indexOf(s.route) : -1;
  for (let j = 0; j < s.routes.length; j++) s.routes[j] = routeTo(s.routes[j], item);
  s.route = k >= 0 ? s.routes[k] : routeTo(s.route, item);
}

/** The same state one step further along every route. */
export function along(s: State, item: string): State {
  const out = copy(s);
  advance(out, item);
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/flow.ts\n===
/**
 * Which values are filled where, over the whole workflow. Arrows that send a request back make the
 * graph cyclic, so the state on entry to each stage is a fixed point: it only grows, and a stage is
 * run again whenever the state arriving at it gains a possibility.
 */
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import type { DocIndex } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { mayBeTaken } from "./combos.ts";
import { advance, copy, joinAll, mergeInto, nothingFilled, routeTo, type State } from "./fill-state.ts";
import type { StageGraph } from "./graph.ts";
import { Kinds } from "./kinds.ts";
import { StageRunner, type StageRun } from "./stage-run.ts";

/** The stages reached from `root`, in reverse postorder of a depth-first walk along the arrows in order. */
function reversePostorder(graph: StageGraph, root: string): string[] {
  const post: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>([root]);
  const stack: { stage: string; next: number }[] = [{ stage: root, next: 0 }];
  while (stack.length) {
    const top = stack[stack.length - 1] as { stage: string; next: number };
    const edge = graph.out.get(top.stage)?.[top.next++];
    if (!edge) {
      post.push(top.stage);
      stack.pop();
    } else if (!seen.has(edge.to)) {
      seen.add(edge.to);
      stack.push({ stage: edge.to, next: 0 });
    }
  }
  return post.reverse();
}

export class Flow {
  readonly ix: DocIndex;
  readonly kinds: Kinds;
  readonly valueIndex: ReadonlyMap<string, number>;
  /** The state of a new request at the start form, before anything is filled. */
  readonly started: State | undefined;
  /** The state on the arrows into each stage that some arrow can reach. */
  readonly arrived = new Map<string, State>();
  private readonly runner: StageRunner;
  private readonly root: string | undefined;
  /** Each stage's visit once the entry states are final; callers read these and never change them. */
  private readonly runs = new Map<string, StageRun>();
  private solved = false;

  constructor(ix: DocIndex, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined, graph: StageGraph) {
    this.ix = ix;
    this.kinds = new Kinds(ix, catalogue);
    this.valueIndex = new Map(ix.valueIds.map((id, i) => [id, i]));
    const bindings = Array.isArray(ix.workflow?.start?.startsWhen) ? ix.workflow.start.startsWhen : [];
    this.runner = new StageRunner({
      ix,
      kinds: this.kinds,
      valueIndex: this.valueIndex,
      requesterMayBeEmpty: bindings.some((b) => typeof b === "object" && b !== null && b.requester === undefined),
    });
    this.root = graph.root;
    this.started = this.root === undefined ? undefined : nothingFilled(ix.valueIds.length, routeTo(undefined, this.root));
    this.solve(this.root === undefined ? [] : reversePostorder(graph, this.root));
  }

  /**
   * Round robin in reverse postorder: each pass runs the stages that changed, in the order a request
   * meets them, so everything a pass learns reaches the arrows that send back before the next pass.
   * A worklist taken first in, first out reran the whole workflow once per send-back it met:
   * quadratic in the number of stages.
   */
  private solve(order: readonly string[]): void {
    const dirty = new Set<string>(order.slice(0, 1));
    while (dirty.size)
      for (const stage of order) {
        if (!dirty.delete(stage)) continue;
        this.visit(stage, dirty);
      }
    this.solved = true;
  }

  /** Runs one stage and adds what leaves it by each arrow to the arrow's target; a target that gained something is dirty. */
  private visit(stage: string, dirty: Set<string>): void {
    const view = this.ix.stageById.get(stage);
    if (!view?.working) return;
    const run = this.run(stage);
    view.arrows.forEach((arrow, index) => {
      const to = arrow.goTo;
      if (typeof to !== "string" || !this.ix.stageById.has(to)) return;
      const taken = run.combos.filter((c) => mayBeTaken(this.ix, view, c.combo, index)).map((c) => c.end);
      const end = joinAll(taken);
      if (!end) return;
      const state = taken.length === 1 ? copy(end) : end; // a single state is the run's own
      advance(state, arrow.id);
      advance(state, to);
      const before = this.arrived.get(to);
      if (!before) this.arrived.set(to, state);
      else if (!mergeInto(before, state)) return;
      dirty.add(to);
    });
  }

  /** One visit of a working stage with the entry states found so far. */
  run(stage: string): StageRun {
    const known = this.runs.get(stage);
    if (known) return known;
    const view = this.ix.stageById.get(stage);
    const none: StageRun = { arrival: [], tasks: undefined, combos: [] };
    if (!view?.working) return none;
    const run = this.runner.run(view, this.arrived.get(stage), stage === this.root ? this.started : undefined);
    if (this.solved) this.runs.set(stage, run);
    return run;
  }

  /** The state when the stage is entered, by an arrow or, for the start stage, by a new request. */
  entered(stage: string): State | undefined {
    const arrived = this.arrived.get(stage);
    const started = stage === this.root ? this.started : undefined;
    return joinAll([arrived, started].filter((s): s is State => s !== undefined));
  }

  expression(e: unknown, s: State): ReturnType<StageRunner["expression"]> {
    return this.runner.expression(e, s);
  }
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/graph.ts\n===
/**
 * The authored stage graph (compiler.md 7.1): nodes are the stages, edges the arrows whose `goTo`
 * names a stage, the root is `start.stage`. Reachability and dominance are over this graph.
 */
import type { Arrow, ArrowId } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { DocIndex } from "../index-doc.ts";

export interface Edge {
  arrow: Arrow;
  from: string;
  to: string;
}

export interface StageGraph {
  root?: string;
  /** Edges out of each stage, in arrow order. */
  out: ReadonlyMap<string, Edge[]>;
  /** Arrows into each stage, in document order, from any stage. */
  incoming: ReadonlyMap<string, ArrowId[]>;
  reachable: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** For each reachable stage, the stages on every route from the root to it (itself included). */
  dominators: ReadonlyMap<string, ReadonlySet<string>>;
}

export function stageGraph(ix: DocIndex): StageGraph {
  const out = new Map<string, Edge[]>();
  const incoming = new Map<string, ArrowId[]>();
  const predecessors = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const view of ix.stages) {
    const from = view.stage.id;
    if (!out.has(from)) out.set(from, []);
    if (!incoming.has(from)) incoming.set(from, []);
  }
  for (const view of ix.stages) {
    const from = view.stage.id;
    for (const arrow of view.arrows) {
      const to = arrow.goTo;
      if (typeof to !== "string" || !ix.stageById.has(to)) continue;
      out.get(from)?.push({ arrow, from, to });
      incoming.get(to)?.push(arrow.id);
      const known = predecessors.get(to);
      if (known) known.push(from);
      else predecessors.set(to, [from]);
    }
  }

  const start = ix.workflow?.start?.stage;
  const root = typeof start === "string" && ix.stageById.has(start) ? start : undefined;
  const order: string[] = [];
  const reachable = new Set<string>();
  if (root !== undefined) {
    order.push(root);
    reachable.add(root);
    for (let i = 0; i < order.length; i++)
      for (const edge of out.get(order[i] ?? "") ?? [])
        if (!reachable.has(edge.to)) {
          reachable.add(edge.to);
          order.push(edge.to);
        }
  }

  // Iterative dominators over the reachable stages, in breadth-first order (small graphs).
  const dominators = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const stage of order) dominators.set(stage, stage === root ? new Set([stage]) : new Set(order));
  for (let changed = true; changed; ) {
    changed = false;
    for (const stage of order) {
      if (stage === root) continue;
      let meet: Set<string> | undefined;
      for (const p of predecessors.get(stage) ?? []) {
        const dp = dominators.get(p);
        if (!dp) continue; // an unreachable predecessor adds no route
        meet = meet ? new Set([...meet].filter((s) => dp.has(s))) : new Set(dp);
      }
      const next = new Set(meet ?? []);
      next.add(stage);
      if (next.size !== dominators.get(stage)?.size) {
        dominators.set(stage, next);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }
  const graph: StageGraph = { out, incoming, reachable, dominators };
  if (root !== undefined) graph.root = root;
  return graph;
}

/**
 * E-14, compiler.md 7.1: an arrow sends back when its target is on every route from the start to
 * its source. An arrow out of a stage no route reaches does not send back.
 */
export function sendsBack(graph: StageGraph, from: string, to: string | null): boolean {
  if (typeof to !== "string") return false;
  return graph.dominators.get(from)?.has(to) ?? false;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/kinds.ts\n===
/**
 * A value's kind, worked out from what fills it (authored format, "Values"): a question's kind, a
 * task's extra answers, a saved expression, an operation's result field in the catalogue. A formula
 * gives the kind `checkFormula` reports for it: its chips are typed by the kinds worked out here, in
 * the same pass, so no second pass is needed.
 */
import type { Catalogue, Field, Operation } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import type { Expression, Location, Question, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { celTypeOfKind } from "../formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { formulaCelType, formulaItemKind, formulaValueKind } from "../formula/formula-kind.ts";
import type { DocIndex, ValueFill } from "../index-doc.ts";

export interface KindAt {
  kind: ValueKind;
  at: Location;
}

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);

const CONSTANT_KINDS: readonly (readonly [string, ValueKind])[] = [
  ["text", "text"], ["number", "number"], ["yesNo", "yesNo"], ["date", "date"], ["choice", "choice"],
  ["choices", "multipleChoice"], ["row", "choiceFromList"], ["button", "choice"], ["failureCode", "choice"], ["person", "person"],
  ["group", "group"], ["people", "people"], ["connectionChoice", "choiceFromConnection"],
];

/** The kind a question's answer gives; `choice` from a list, a data source or the directory differs (format, QuestionKind). */
export function questionKind(q: Question): ValueKind | undefined {
  const from = isObject(q.choices) ? q.choices.from : undefined;
  if (from === "formula") return undefined; // the formula's item kind (compiler.md 5.1)
  if (q.kind === "choice" && from === "list") return "choiceFromList";
  if (q.kind === "choice" && from === "source") return "choiceFromConnection";
  if (q.kind === "choice" && from === "directory") return "person"; // a person from the group (E-26)
  return typeof q.kind === "string" ? q.kind : undefined; // never throw on a document parse refuses

}

export class Kinds {
  private readonly ix: DocIndex;
  private readonly catalogue: Catalogue | undefined;
  private readonly memo = new Map<string, ValueKind | undefined>();
  private readonly visiting = new Set<string>();
  private readonly questions = new Map<string, Question>();
  private readonly actions = new Map<string, Obj>();

  constructor(ix: DocIndex, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined) {
    this.ix = ix;
    this.catalogue = isObject(catalogue) ? catalogue : undefined;
    for (const view of ix.stages) {
      for (const task of view.tasks) for (const { question } of task.questions) this.questions.set(question.id, question);
      for (const action of [...view.arrival, ...view.after]) this.actions.set(action.id, action as unknown as Obj);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Every filler of the value whose kind is known, in document order. A formula filler counts only
   * when no other filler says a kind: it gives the kind `checkFormula` reports, while a formula that
   * fills a value of a known kind takes that kind (a text formula saved into a date is a date).
   */
  fillerKinds(value: string): KindAt[] {
    const fills = this.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? [];
    const known = (kindOf: (f: ValueFill) => ValueKind | undefined): KindAt[] =>
      fills.flatMap((f) => {
        const kind = kindOf(f);
        return kind ? [{ kind, at: f.at }] : [];
      });
    const plain = known((f) => (this.formulaOf(f) === undefined ? this.fillKind(f) : undefined));
    return plain.length > 0 ? plain : known((f) => this.formulaKind(f));
  }

  /** The formula text a filler fills its value from: a Save a value of a formula, or a choice question's choices formula. */
  private formulaOf(f: ValueFill): { text: string; choices: boolean } | undefined {
    if (f.by === "save") {
      const save = this.actions.get(f.at.item)?.["save"];
      return isObject(save) && typeof save["formula"] === "string" ? { text: save["formula"], choices: false } : undefined;
    }
    if (f.by !== "question") return undefined;
    const choices: unknown = this.questions.get(f.at.item)?.choices;
    const node = isObject(choices) && choices["from"] === "formula" ? choices["formula"] : undefined;
    return isObject(node) && typeof node["formula"] === "string" ? { text: node["formula"], choices: true } : undefined;
  }

  /** A formula filler's kind: what the formula gives, or, for a choice question, one of its items (compiler.md 5.1). */
  private formulaKind(f: ValueFill): ValueKind | undefined {
    const formula = this.formulaOf(f);
    if (!formula) return undefined;
    if (!formula.choices) return formulaValueKind(this.formulaType(formula.text));
    const item = formulaItemKind(this.formulaType(formula.text));
    // A multiple choice is `multipleChoice`, its items of the formula's item kind (`itemKind`, E-27).
    const kind = this.questions.get(f.at.item)?.kind;
    return kind === "choice" ? item : kind === "multipleChoice" && item !== undefined ? "multipleChoice" : undefined;
  }

  /**
   * The kind of one item of a multiple choice whose choices come from a formula (E-27): the formula's
   * item kind. Undefined for any other value, or when the formula's items have no value kind.
   */
  itemKind(value: string): ValueKind | undefined {
    const items = new Set<ValueKind | undefined>();
    for (const f of this.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? []) {
      const formula = this.formulaOf(f);
      if (!formula?.choices || this.questions.get(f.at.item)?.kind !== "multipleChoice") continue;
      items.add(formulaItemKind(this.formulaType(formula.text)));
    }
    return items.size === 1 ? [...items][0] : undefined;
  }

  /** The value's one kind, or undefined when nothing says it or its fillers disagree. */
  valueKind(value: string): ValueKind | undefined {
    if (this.memo.has(value)) return this.memo.get(value);
    if (this.visiting.has(value)) return undefined; // a value saved from itself, round a loop
    this.visiting.add(value);
    const kinds = new Set(this.fillerKinds(value).map((k) => k.kind));
    this.visiting.delete(value);
    const kind = kinds.size === 1 ? [...kinds][0] : undefined;
    // Only an outermost answer is final: an inner one may have met the outer value half worked out.
    if (this.visiting.size === 0) this.memo.set(value, kind);
    return kind;
  }

  private fillKind(f: ValueFill): ValueKind | undefined {
    switch (f.by) {
      case "question": {
        const q = this.questions.get(f.at.item);
        return q ? questionKind(q) : undefined;
      }
      case "buttonPressed":
        return "choice";
      case "answeredBy":
        return "person";
      case "failed":
        return "yesNo";
      case "failureCode":
        return "choice";
      case "save":
        return this.expressionKind(this.actions.get(f.at.item)?.["save"]);
      case "result":
        return this.resultField(this.actions.get(f.at.item)?.["operation"], f.field)?.kind;
    }
  }

  /** The operation an entry reference names, from the catalogue. */
  private operation(ref: unknown): Operation | undefined {
    if (typeof ref !== "string" || !this.catalogue) return undefined;
    const entries = Array.isArray(this.catalogue["entries"]) ? this.catalogue.entries : [];
    return entries.find((e): e is Operation => isObject(e) && e.id === ref && e.kind === "operation");
  }

  /** The operation's result field, from the catalogue. */
  resultField(operation: unknown, field: string | undefined): Field | undefined {
    if (field === undefined) return undefined;
    const entry = this.operation(operation);
    return (Array.isArray(entry?.result) ? entry.result : []).find((r) => isObject(r) && r.id === field);
  }

  /** Whether some action saves its failure code as the value (saveFailureAs.code). */
  isFailureCode(value: string): boolean {
    return (this.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? []).some((f) => f.by === "failureCode");
  }

  /**
   * The choices of a value an action saves its failure code as (E-29): the failure codes of each such
   * action's operation, with the catalogue's labels, in document order. Where one code has two labels, the
   * first action's wins.
   */
  failureChoices(value: string): { id: string; label: string }[] {
    const out: { id: string; label: string }[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (const f of this.ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? []) {
      if (f.by !== "failureCode") continue;
      const codes: unknown = this.operation(this.actions.get(f.at.item)?.["operation"])?.failureCodes;
      for (const c of Array.isArray(codes) ? codes : []) {
        if (!isObject(c) || typeof c["code"] !== "string" || seen.has(c["code"])) continue;
        seen.add(c["code"]);
        out.push({ id: c["code"], label: typeof c["label"] === "string" ? c["label"] : c["code"] });
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** The kind an expression gives, where that is known without the formula checker. */
  expressionKind(e: Expression | unknown): ValueKind | undefined {
    if (!isObject(e)) return undefined;
    if (typeof e["value"] === "string") return this.withSteps(this.valueKind(e["value"]), e["steps"]);
    if (e["request"] === "requester" || e["request"] === "startedOn") {
      if (Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length) return undefined; // no rule for steps here (E-23)
      return e["request"] === "requester" ? "person" : "date";
    }
    if ("allOf" in e || "anyOf" in e) return "yesNo";
    if ("formula" in e) return undefined; // a value filled by a formula: see fillerKinds
    return CONSTANT_KINDS.find(([key]) => key in e)?.[1];
  }

  /**
   * A formula's CEL type, each chip typed by the kind of what it names, as `checkFormula` types it
   * (formula/formula-kind.ts). A value read round a loop has no kind yet, so it reads as untyped.
   */
  private formulaType(text: string): string | undefined {
    return formulaCelType(text, (chip) => {
      switch (chip.sort) {
        case "value": {
          const kind = this.valueKind(chip.value);
          return { type: celTypeOfKind(kind), date: kind === "date" };
        }
        case "requester":
          return { type: celTypeOfKind("person") };
        case "startedOn":
          return { type: celTypeOfKind("date"), date: true };
        default:
          return undefined;
      }
    });
  }

  private withSteps(kind: ValueKind | undefined, steps: unknown): ValueKind | undefined {
    let result = kind;
    for (const step of Array.isArray(steps) ? steps : []) {
      if (!isObject(step)) return undefined;
      if (typeof step["column"] === "string") result = this.ix.columnById.get(step["column"])?.column.kind;
      else if (step["directory"] === "members") result = "people";
      else return undefined;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

/**
 * `valuesInScope`: contract/core-api.md section 5. `at` is the moment its part is evaluated: a
 * stage's part when that section starts, an action after the earlier actions of its section, a form
 * item when the form is shown plus the answers on the same form, an arrow after the after-response
 * actions (E-22).
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { indexDocument, type DocIndex, type StageView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { condition, fits, isEarly, when } from "./combos.ts";
import { BOTH, copy, EMPTY, emptyRoute, FILLED, joinAll, locationsOf, setValue, type State } from "./fill-state.ts";
import { Flow } from "./flow.ts";
import { stageGraph } from "./graph.ts";
import type { ComboRun, StageRun } from "./stage-run.ts";
import type { ValueInScope } from "./types.ts";
import { valueFacts } from "./value-facts.ts";

const FORM_ITEMS = new Set(["page", "question", "text", "choice", "button"]);

/** Each value of the registry at `at`. Works on an unfinished draft and never throws. */
export function valuesInScope(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, at: Location): ValueInScope[] {
  const ix = indexDocument(workflow);
  const flow = new Flow(ix, catalogue, stageGraph(ix));
  const state = stateAt(ix, flow, at);
  const out: ValueInScope[] = [];
  for (const value of Array.isArray(workflow?.values) ? workflow.values : []) {
    if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || typeof value.id !== "string") continue;
    const f = valueFacts(ix, flow.kinds, value.id);
    const entry: ValueInScope = { id: value.id, name: typeof value.name === "string" ? value.name : "", filledAt: f.filledAt, usedAt: f.usedAt, state: "never" };
    if (typeof f.kind === "string") entry.kind = f.kind;
    else if (f.kind) entry.kind = { conflict: [...new Set(f.kind.conflict.map((k) => k.kind))] };
    const i = flow.valueIndex.get(value.id);
    const flags = state && i !== undefined ? (state.flags[i] ?? EMPTY) : EMPTY;
    if (flags === FILLED) entry.state = "always";
    else if (flags === BOTH && state && i !== undefined) {
      entry.state = "mayBeEmpty";
      entry.skippedVia = locationsOf(emptyRoute(state, i) ?? state.route);
    }
    out.push(entry);
  }
  return out;
}

/** The state at `at`; undefined where no route reaches it (then nothing is filled there). */
export function stateAt(ix: DocIndex, flow: Flow, at: Location): State | undefined {
  const item = ix.byId.get(at?.item);
  const part = typeof at?.part === "string" ? at.part : "";
  const view = item?.stage !== undefined ? ix.stageById.get(item.stage) : undefined;
  if (!item || !view) return flow.started; // the workflow, a binding, a registry entry: before anything is filled
  if (!view.working) return flow.entered(view.stage.id);
  const run = flow.run(view.stage.id);
  const section = part.split(".")[0];
  switch (item.kind) {
    case "stage":
      if (section === "whenThisStageStarts") return run.arrival[0] ?? undefined;
      if (section === "tasks") return run.tasks;
      if (section === "afterTheyRespond") return joinAll(run.combos.map((c) => c.after[0] ?? c.end));
      if (section === "arrows") return joinAll(run.combos.filter((c) => c.combo.full).map((c) => c.end));
      return flow.entered(view.stage.id);
    case "action":
      return actionState(ix, view, run, item.id, section);
    case "arrow":
      return arrowState(ix, view, run, item.id, section);
    case "task":
      return run.tasks;
    default:
      return FORM_ITEMS.has(item.kind) && item.task !== undefined ? withFormAnswers(ix, flow, run.tasks, item.task) : run.tasks;
  }
}

function actionState(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, run: StageRun, id: string, section: string | undefined): State | undefined {
  const arrival = view.arrival.findIndex((a) => a.id === id);
  if (arrival >= 0) return run.arrival[arrival];
  const index = view.after.findIndex((a) => a.id === id);
  const action = view.after[index];
  if (!action) return undefined;
  // An action's other parts are worked out only when its "Only when" is true.
  const evaluated =
    section === "onlyWhen" ? run.combos : run.combos.filter((c) => condition(ix, view, c.combo, action.onlyWhen) !== false);
  return joinAll((evaluated.length ? evaluated : run.combos).map((c) => c.after[index] ?? c.end));
}

function arrowState(ix: DocIndex, view: StageView, run: StageRun, id: string, section: string | undefined): State | undefined {
  const index = view.arrows.findIndex((a) => a.id === id);
  const arrow = view.arrows[index];
  if (!arrow) return undefined;
  const early = isEarly(view, arrow);
  const considered = (c: ComboRun): boolean => c.combo.full || early;
  const reached = (c: ComboRun): boolean =>
    !view.arrows.slice(0, index).some((e) => (c.combo.full || isEarly(view, e)) && fits(ix, view, c.combo, e) === true);
  // An arrow is read when no arrow before it surely fits; its "+ only when" only when its "when" fits too.
  const evaluated = run.combos.filter(
    (c) => considered(c) && reached(c) && (section !== "onlyWhen" || when(ix, view, c.combo, arrow) !== false),
  );
  const fallback = run.combos.filter(considered);
  // Taken early, an arrow is checked in the tasks step, before the after-response actions (compiler.md 6.4).
  return joinAll((evaluated.length ? evaluated : fallback).map((c) => (c.combo.full ? c.end : (c.after[0] ?? c.end))));
}

/** compiler.md 5.2: a form's own conditions read its answers as the values they are saved as. */
function withFormAnswers(ix: DocIndex, flow: Flow, tasks: State | undefined, task: string): State | undefined {
  if (!tasks) return undefined;
  const s = copy(tasks);
  for (const { question } of ix.taskById.get(task)?.questions ?? []) {
    const i = typeof question.savedAs === "string" ? flow.valueIndex.get(question.savedAs) : undefined;
    if (i !== undefined) setValue(s, i, BOTH, s.flags[i] === FILLED ? s.route : (emptyRoute(s, i) ?? s.route));
  }
  return s;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/stage-run.ts\n===
/**
 * One visit of a working stage, in the order rule of the authored format (rule 5): arrival actions,
 * tasks, after-response actions, arrows. Saves take effect in listed order; "Only when" makes an
 * action conditional unless the buttons pressed decide it.
 */
import type { Action, Page, Question } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { DocIndex, StageView, TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";
import { condition, fullCombos, partialCombos, pressedButtons, type Choice, type Combo } from "./combos.ts";
import { advance, BOTH, copy, EMPTY, emptyRoute, FILLED, join, setValue, type Route, type State } from "./fill-state.ts";
import type { Kinds } from "./kinds.ts";

export interface ComboRun {
  combo: Combo;
  /** The state before each after-response action, then after the last: what the arrows read. */
  after: State[];
  end: State;
}

export interface StageRun {
  /** Before each arrival action, then after the last. Empty when only the start reaches the stage. */
  arrival: State[];
  /** When the tasks open. */
  tasks: State | undefined;
  combos: ComboRun[];
}

/** What a stage visit needs besides the document. */
export interface RunContext {
  ix: DocIndex;
  kinds: Kinds;
  valueIndex: ReadonlyMap<string, number>;
  /** Some "Starts when" binding names no Requester (E-16), so the Requester may be empty. */
  requesterMayBeEmpty: boolean;
}

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);

interface Flags {
  flags: number;
  empty: Route | undefined;
}

/** A value filled in the tasks step, in document order (compiler.md 4.6: the later filler wraps the earlier). */
interface TaskFill {
  task: number;
  value: string;
  question?: { question: Question; page: Page };
  /** An earlier filler of the same value in this tasks step. */
  afterAnother: boolean;
}

function taskFills(view: StageView): TaskFill[] {
  const out: TaskFill[] = [];
  const add = (fill: Omit<TaskFill, "afterAnother">): void => {
    out.push({ ...fill, afterAnother: out.some((f) => f.value === fill.value) });
  };
  view.tasks.forEach((t, task) => {
    for (const value of [t.task.savesButtonPressedAs, t.task.savesAnsweredByAs])
      if (typeof value === "string") add({ task, value });
    for (const q of t.questions) if (typeof q.question.savedAs === "string") add({ task, value: q.question.savedAs, question: q });
  });
  return out;
}

/** Needed for this button and never hidden: then a completed task always fills it (format, Button.neededToPress). */
function surelyAnswered(q: { question: Question; page: Page }, task: TaskView, button: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (q.question.showWhen !== undefined || q.page.showWhen !== undefined) return false;
  const needed = (b: TaskView["buttons"][number]): boolean =>
    q.question.neededForEveryButton === true || (Array.isArray(b.neededToPress) && b.neededToPress.includes(q.question.id));
  if (button !== undefined) return task.buttons.some((b) => b.id === button && needed(b));
  return task.buttons.length > 0 && task.buttons.every(needed);
}

export class StageRunner {
  private readonly ctx: RunContext;

  constructor(ctx: RunContext) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
  }

  /** `arrived`: the state on the arrows into the stage. `started`: a new request at the start form, which skips the arrival actions (E-14). */
  run(view: StageView, arrived: State | undefined, started: State | undefined): StageRun {
    const arrival: State[] = [];
    let afterArrival: State | undefined;
    if (arrived) {
      let s = copy(arrived);
      for (const action of view.arrival) {
        arrival.push(s);
        s = this.action(s, action, view, undefined);
      }
      arrival.push(s);
      afterArrival = s;
    }
    // The new request first, so the shortest route is the one kept.
    const tasks = afterArrival && started ? join(started, afterArrival) : (afterArrival ?? started);
    if (!tasks) return { arrival, tasks, combos: [] };
    const fills = taskFills(view);
    const combos = [...fullCombos(view), ...partialCombos(view)].map((combo): ComboRun => {
      let s = copy(tasks);
      for (const button of pressedButtons(combo)) advance(s, button.id);
      for (const fill of fills) this.taskFill(s, fill, view, combo.choices[fill.task]);
      const after: State[] = [];
      for (const action of view.after) {
        after.push(s);
        s = this.action(s, action, view, combo);
      }
      after.push(s);
      return { combo, after, end: s };
    });
    return { arrival, tasks, combos };
  }

  private index(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    return typeof value === "string" ? this.ctx.valueIndex.get(value) : undefined;
  }

  /** compiler.md 4.6, 4.7: an answered task writes its answers (an empty one removes the value); a cancelled one keeps its questions' values and empties its extra answers. */
  private taskFill(s: State, fill: TaskFill, view: StageView, choice: Choice | undefined): void {
    const i = this.index(fill.value);
    if (i === undefined || !choice) return;
    const task = view.tasks[fill.task];
    if (!task) return;
    const answered = (button: string | undefined): number =>
      !fill.question || surelyAnswered(fill.question, task, button) ? FILLED : BOTH;
    const cancelled = (): number | "keep" => (fill.question || fill.afterAnother ? "keep" : EMPTY);
    let result: number | "keep";
    switch (choice.kind) {
      case "button":
        result = answered(choice.button.id);
        break;
      case "any":
        result = answered(undefined);
        break;
      case "cancelled":
        result = cancelled();
        break;
      case "anyOrCancelled": {
        const c = cancelled();
        result = answered(undefined) | (c === "keep" ? (s.flags[i] ?? 0) : c);
        break;
      }
    }
    if (result === "keep") return;
    // Emptied here, unless the value may just have kept an empty it already had.
    const keptEmpty = choice.kind === "anyOrCancelled" ? emptyRoute(s, i) : undefined;
    setValue(s, i, result, keptEmpty ?? s.route);
  }

  /** An action of either section. `combo` is absent in the arrival section, where nothing is pressed yet. */
  private action(s: State, action: Action, view: StageView, combo: Combo | undefined): State {
    const when = condition(this.ctx.ix, view, combo, action.onlyWhen);
    if (when === false || (action.type !== "saveValue" && action.type !== "useConnection")) return s; // nothing else fills a value
    const done = this.perform(copy(s), action);
    return when === true ? done : join(done, s);
  }

  private perform(s: State, action: Action): State {
    switch (action.type) {
      case "saveValue": {
        if (action.save === undefined) return s;
        const r = this.expression(action.save, s);
        setValue(s, this.index(action.as), r.flags, r.empty);
        return s;
      }
      case "useConnection": {
        // compiler.md 11.2: on success each result is written (an absent one removes the value); on a
        // carried-on failure the results keep what they had and the failure values are written.
        const ok = s;
        const failedTo: { failed?: unknown; code?: unknown } = isObject(action.saveFailureAs) ? action.saveFailureAs : {};
        const failed = copy(s);
        if (isObject(action.saveResults))
          for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(action.saveResults)) {
            const required = this.ctx.kinds.resultField(action.operation, field)?.required === true;
            setValue(ok, this.index(value), required ? FILLED : BOTH, ok.route);
          }
        setValue(ok, this.index(failedTo.failed), FILLED, undefined);
        if (action.ifItFails !== "carryOn") return ok;
        setValue(failed, this.index(failedTo.failed), FILLED, undefined);
        setValue(failed, this.index(failedTo.code), FILLED, undefined);
        return join(ok, failed);
      }
      default:
        return s;
    }
  }

  /** Whether an expression gives a value (compiler.md 3.3, 8.2: empty text and empty lists are empty). */
  expression(e: unknown, s: State): Flags {
    const maybe: Flags = { flags: BOTH, empty: s.route };
    if (!isObject(e)) return maybe;
    if (typeof e["value"] === "string") {
      const i = this.index(e["value"]);
      let r: Flags = i === undefined ? { flags: EMPTY, empty: s.route } : { flags: s.flags[i] ?? EMPTY, empty: emptyRoute(s, i) ?? s.route };
      for (const step of Array.isArray(e["steps"]) ? e["steps"] : []) {
        const always = isObject(step) && typeof step["column"] === "string" && this.cellAlwaysGiven(step["column"]);
        r = { flags: (r.flags & FILLED ? (always ? FILLED : BOTH) : 0) | (r.flags & EMPTY), empty: r.empty ?? s.route };
      }
      return this.orElse(r, e["ifEmptyUse"], s);
    }
    if ("request" in e) {
      const steps = Array.isArray(e["steps"]) && e["steps"].length > 0;
      const flags = steps ? BOTH : e["request"] === "requester" && this.ctx.requesterMayBeEmpty ? BOTH : FILLED;
      return this.orElse({ flags, empty: s.route }, e["ifEmptyUse"], s);
    }
    if ("allOf" in e || "anyOf" in e) return { flags: FILLED, empty: undefined };
    if ("formula" in e) return maybe;
    const empty: Flags = { flags: EMPTY, empty: s.route };
    if ("text" in e) return e["text"] === "" ? empty : { flags: FILLED, empty: undefined };
    if ("choices" in e || "people" in e) {
      const items = e["choices"] ?? e["people"];
      return Array.isArray(items) && items.length === 0 ? empty : { flags: FILLED, empty: undefined };
    }
    if ("weekday" in e) return empty; // never a value (core-api.md 2.4)
    return { flags: FILLED, empty: undefined };
  }

  private orElse(r: Flags, fallback: unknown, s: State): Flags {
    if (!(r.flags & EMPTY) || fallback === undefined) return r;
    const f = this.expression(fallback, s);
    return { flags: (r.flags & FILLED) | f.flags, empty: f.flags & EMPTY ? f.empty : undefined };
  }

  /** Every row of the column's list has the cell, so a chosen row always gives it. */
  private cellAlwaysGiven(column: string): boolean {
    const entry = this.ctx.ix.columnById.get(column);
    const rows = entry && Array.isArray(entry.list.rows) ? entry.list.rows : undefined;
    return !!rows && rows.every((row) => isObject(row) && isObject(row.cells) && row.cells[column as `col_${string}`] !== undefined);
  }
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/facts/types.ts\n===
/** `facts` and `valuesInScope` results, exactly as contract/core-api.md section 5. */
import type { ArrowId, Location, StageId, ValueId, ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";

export interface Facts {
  stages: Partial<Record<StageId, StageFacts>>;
  arrows: Partial<Record<ArrowId, ArrowFacts>>;
  values: Partial<Record<ValueId, ValueFacts>>;
}

/** `incoming` in document order. */
export interface StageFacts {
  incoming: ArrowId[];
  reachable: boolean;
}

export type ArrowFacts =
  | { usable: true; sendsBack: boolean }
  /**
   * `covering`, present exactly with `earlierArrowAlwaysFits`: every earlier arrow taken instead in some case (the first
   * that surely fits it), in document order. `earlier`: the one earlier arrow that alone always fits, when there is one.
   */
  | { usable: false; reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits" | "conditionNeverTrue"; earlier?: Location; covering?: Location[]; sendsBack: boolean };

export interface ValueFacts {
  /** Absent: nothing that fills it says its kind yet. */
  kind?: ValueKind | { conflict: { kind: ValueKind; at: Location }[] };
  filledAt: Location[];
  usedAt: Location[];
}

export interface ValueInScope {
  id: ValueId;
  name: string;
  kind?: ValueKind | { conflict: ValueKind[] };
  filledAt: Location[];
  usedAt: Location[];
  state: "never" | "mayBeEmpty" | "always";
  /** With mayBeEmpty: one route that reaches `at` without filling it. */
  skippedVia?: Location[];
}
