/** Per value: its kind or the conflict, where it is filled and where it is used, in document order. */
import type { Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { DocIndex } from "../index-doc.ts";
import type { Kinds } from "./kinds.ts";
import type { ValueFacts } from "./types.ts";

function inDocumentOrder<T>(ix: DocIndex, items: readonly T[], at: (t: T) => Location): T[] {
  const order = (t: T): number => ix.byId.get(at(t).item)?.order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  return items.map((t, i) => ({ t, i })).sort((a, b) => order(a.t) - order(b.t) || a.i - b.i).map(({ t }) => t);
}

export function valueFacts(ix: DocIndex, kinds: Kinds, value: string): ValueFacts {
  const filledAt = inDocumentOrder(ix, ix.fillsOf.get(value) ?? [], (f) => f.at).map((f) => f.at);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const usedAt: Location[] = [];
  for (const use of inDocumentOrder(ix, ix.usesOf.get(value) ?? [], (u) => u.slot)) {
    const key = `${use.slot.item} ${use.slot.part ?? ""}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    usedAt.push(use.slot);
  }
  const known = inDocumentOrder(ix, kinds.fillerKinds(value), (k) => k.at);
  const distinct = new Set(known.map((k) => k.kind));
  const facts: ValueFacts = { filledAt, usedAt };
  const [only] = distinct;
  if (distinct.size === 1 && only) facts.kind = only;
  else if (distinct.size > 1) facts.kind = { conflict: known };
  return facts;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/form/form-state.ts\n===
/**
 * `formState` (core-api.md 7, R2): which pages, questions and texts of a task's form are shown with
 * the answers so far, the choices a formula gives, every answer the act would refuse, and for each
 * button what it still needs.
 *
 * It reads the form as the act's checks do (compiler.md 4.5, 5): every condition is compiled by the
 * expression compiler in the `check` place, where a value this form fills reads the form's answer,
 * and run by the engine's CEL environment; the answers are validated against the button's outcome
 * schema by the kernel's own validator (src/schema). So an answer set this calls available is one
 * the act's schema step and checks accept.
 *
 * Refusal order follows the act: the schema's failures first (in form order), then the form's rules
 * (a Show when or choices formula that errors, an answer to a hidden question, an answer that is not
 * one of a formula's choices), then the button's "Also only when".
 */
import { celTypeFromSchema } from "../../cel/json.ts";
import type { CelType, JsonValue } from "../../cel/types.ts";
import type { JsonSchema } from "../../format/index.ts";
import { jsonEqual } from "../../schema/equal.ts";
import type { InvalidDataRule } from "../../schema/types.ts";
import { validateBySchema } from "../../schema/validate.ts";
import { neededFor } from "../check/context.ts";
import { compileCondition, compileFormulaOpt, type CheckPlace, type DirectoryRead } from "../compile/expr/index.ts";
import { checkPlace, choiceIds, outcomeSchema } from "../compile/forms.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Location, Question, QuestionId } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import { docSetup, environmentFor, isObject, isString, resolveGroups, run, type DocSetup } from "../evaluate/setup.ts";
import type { Answers, FormRefusal, Json, KnownLookups, NeededLookup, Ref, Values } from "../evaluate/types.ts";
import type { TaskView } from "../index-doc.ts";

export interface FormButtonState {
  button: ButtonId;
  /** `missing` is empty and there is no refusal. */
  available: boolean;
  /** Needed questions that are shown and still empty, in form order. */
  missing: QuestionId[];
  /** The first refusal the act would give besides `missing`. */
  refusal?: FormRefusal;
}

export interface FormState {
  /** Pages, questions and texts shown, in form order; anything else is hidden. */
  shown: string[];
  /** Only for shown questions whose choices come from a formula that could be worked out. */
  choices: Partial<Record<QuestionId, Json[]>>;
  /** One per button, display order. */
  buttons: FormButtonState[];
  /** Every answer the act would refuse with `invalid-data`, in form order. Omitted when there is none. */
  invalid?: FormRefusal[];
}

export type FormStateResult =
  | { result: "state"; state: FormState }
  | { result: "needsLookups"; lookups: NeededLookup[] };

/** What a condition gives on the form: true, false, or an error that counts as true. */
type Truth = { value: boolean; error?: FormRefusal };

/** A compiled condition with where it was written; `null` cel: none, or one the compiler has no rule for. */
interface Compiled {
  at: Location;
  cel: string | null;
}

const invalidData = (rule: InvalidDataRule, location: Location): FormRefusal & { code: "invalid-data" } => ({ code: "invalid-data", location, params: { rule } });

/** Whether a binding of the workflow names a Requester: then the start task's schemas take one (compiler.md 10.1). */
function startTakesRequester(s: DocSetup, view: TaskView): boolean {
  const start = isObject(s.workflow.start) ? s.workflow.start : undefined;
  if (start?.stage !== view.stage) return false;
  return (Array.isArray(start.startsWhen) ? start.startsWhen : []).some((b) => isObject(b) && b.requester !== undefined);
}

/** The check place of the task's form, as the compiler builds it for the act's checks. */
function formPlace(s: DocSetup, view: TaskView): CheckPlace {
  return checkPlace(view, `${view.stage}__groups`, startTakesRequester(s, view));
}

/**
 * The outcome schema of one button: the compiler's own (compile/forms.ts), as Try it compiles it, so a
 * question whose choices cannot be offered takes any answer of its kind.
 */
export function buttonSchema(s: DocSetup, view: TaskView, button: ButtonId): JsonSchema {
  try {
    return outcomeSchema(s, view, button, formPlace(s, view), startTakesRequester(s, view), "tryIt").schema;
  } catch {
    // An unfinished draft the compiler cannot read at all: it has no schema to hold answers to.
    return { type: "object" };
  }
}

/** The CEL type of each answer, as the act's checks read `input`: from the outcome schema. */
function answerTypes(schema: JsonSchema): Record<string, CelType> {
  const properties = isObject(schema["properties"]) ? schema["properties"] : {};
  const out: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  for (const [q, sub] of Object.entries(properties)) out[q] = celTypeFromSchema(sub as Parameters<typeof celTypeFromSchema>[0]);
  return out;
}

/** The question an RFC 6901 pointer into the answers starts with. */
function questionOf(pointer: string): string {
  const first = pointer.split("/")[1] ?? "";
  return first.replace(/~1/g, "/").replace(/~0/g, "~");
}

class Form {
  readonly s: DocSetup;
  readonly view: TaskView;
  readonly place: CheckPlace;
  readonly reads: DirectoryRead[] = [];

  constructor(s: DocSetup, view: TaskView) {
    this.s = s;
    this.view = view;
    this.place = formPlace(s, view);
  }

  condition(cond: unknown, at: Location): Compiled {
    if (cond === undefined) return { at, cel: null };
    const c = compileCondition(cond, this.place, this.s.world);
    if (!c.ok) return { at, cel: null };
    this.reads.push(...c.reads);
    return { at, cel: c.cel };
  }

  formula(q: Question): Compiled | undefined {
    const choices: unknown = q.choices;
    if (!isObject(choices) || choices["from"] !== "formula" || !isObject(choices["formula"]) || !isString(choices["formula"]["formula"])) return undefined;
    const at = { item: q.id, part: "choices.formula" };
    const f = compileFormulaOpt(choices["formula"]["formula"], this.place, this.s.world);
    if (!f.ok) return { at, cel: null };
    this.reads.push(...f.reads);
    return { at, cel: f.opt.opt };
  }
}

/** The answers the schema step refuses, and the answers fit to be read by the form's conditions. */
function validate(view: TaskView, given: Record<string, Json>, schema: JsonSchema): { invalid: FormRefusal[]; fit: Record<string, Json>; first: FormRefusal | undefined } {
  const invalid: FormRefusal[] = [];
  const refused = new Set<string>();
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const add = (q: string, r: FormRefusal & { code: "invalid-data" }) => {
    const key = `${q} ${r.params.rule}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    refused.add(q);
    invalid.push(r);
  };
  for (const f of validateBySchema(schema, given)) {
    const q = questionOf(f.pointer);
    // A needed question that is empty is reported as `missing`; a part missing inside an answer (a choice
    // from a connection without its label) is an answer the act refuses.
    if (f.rule === "required" && !Object.hasOwn(given, q)) continue;
    const isQuestion = view.questions.some(({ question }) => question.id === q);
    if (!isQuestion) add(q, invalidData(f.rule, { item: view.task.id }));
    else add(q, invalidData(f.rule, f.rule === "not-a-choice" ? { item: q, part: "choices" } : { item: q }));
  }
  const schemaStep = invalid.length;
  for (const { question } of view.questions) {
    const a = given[question.id];
    // jsonschema-1 has no `minItems`: an empty multiple choice is refused by a check after the schema step (core-api.md 2.4).
    if (question.kind === "multipleChoice" && Array.isArray(a) && a.length === 0) add(question.id, invalidData("too-short", { item: question.id }));
  }
  const order = new Map(view.questions.map(({ question }, i) => [question.id as string, i]));
  // The act refuses with its schema step's failures before any check: the first of those, in form order, then
  // an answer to no question of the form, as the schema step lists them.
  const at = (r: FormRefusal) => order.get(r.location?.item ?? "") ?? order.size;
  const first = invalid.slice(0, schemaStep).sort((a, b) => at(a) - at(b))[0];
  invalid.sort((a, b) => at(a) - at(b));
  const fit: Record<string, Json> = {};
  for (const [q, a] of Object.entries(given)) if (!refused.has(q) && order.has(q)) fit[q] = a;
  return { invalid, fit, first };
}

export function formState(
  workflow: AuthoredWorkflow,
  catalogue: Catalogue,
  task: Location,
  answers: Answers,
  values: Values,
  request?: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string },
  lookups?: KnownLookups,
): FormStateResult {
  const s = docSetup(workflow, catalogue);
  const view = isObject(task) && isString(task.item) ? s.ix.taskById.get(task.item) : undefined;
  if (!view) return { result: "state", state: { shown: [], choices: {}, buttons: [] } };
  const form = new Form(s, view);
  const given = givenAnswers(answers);
  // The first button's schema: every button's has the same questions; only `required` differs, which is `missing`.
  const button = view.buttons[0];
  const schema = button ? buttonSchema(s, view, button.id) : { ...buttonSchema(s, view, "" as ButtonId), required: [] };
  const { invalid, fit, first } = validate(view, given, schema);

  // Compile every condition and choices formula first: their directory reads are looked up together.
  const pages = (isObject(view.task.form) && Array.isArray(view.task.form.pages) ? view.task.form.pages : []).filter((p) => isObject(p) && isString(p.id));
  const pageConds = pages.map((p) => form.condition(p.showWhen, { item: p.id, part: "showWhen" }));
  const itemConds = pages.map((p) =>
    (Array.isArray(p.items) ? p.items : []).filter((i) => isObject(i) && isString(i.id)).map((i) => ({ item: i, cond: form.condition(i.showWhen, { item: i.id, part: "showWhen" }) })),
  );
  const formulas = new Map<string, Compiled>();
  for (const { question } of view.questions) {
    const f = form.formula(question);
    if (f) formulas.set(question.id, f);
  }
  const buttonConds = view.buttons.map((b) => form.condition(b.enabledWhen, { item: b.id, part: "enabledWhen" }));

  const env = environmentFor(s, { groupsKey: form.place.groupsKey as string, input: answerTypes(schema) });
  const data: Record<string, JsonValue> = { ...((isObject(values) ? values : {}) as Record<string, JsonValue>), [form.place.groupsKey as string]: [] };
  const req: Record<string, JsonValue> = { id: "form", by: request?.requester ? { type: request.requester.type, id: request.requester.id } : { type: "system", id: "engine" } };
  if (isString(request?.startedOn)) req["at"] = `${request.startedOn}T00:00:00.000Z`;
  const groups = resolveGroups(env, form.reads, { data, request: req }, lookups);
  if (groups.needs.length > 0) return { result: "needsLookups", lookups: groups.needs };
  data[form.place.groupsKey as string] = groups.entries as unknown as JsonValue;
  const context: Record<string, JsonValue> = { data, request: req, input: fit as Record<string, JsonValue> };

  const truth = (c: Compiled): Truth => {
    if (c.cel === null) return { value: true };
    const r = run(env, c.cel, context);
    if (r.result === "value" && typeof r.value === "boolean") return { value: r.value };
    return { value: true, error: { code: "rule-error", location: c.at, params: { error: r.result === "error" ? r.error : "wrong-kind" } } };
  };
  // `V(q) = page && question` with CEL's `&&`: false wins over an error (compiler.md 5.2).
  const both = (a: Truth, b: Truth): Truth => {
    if (!a.value && !a.error) return a;
    if (!b.value && !b.error) return b;
    return a.error ? a : b;
  };

  const shown: string[] = [];
  const visible = new Set<string>();
  const formErrors: FormRefusal[] = [];
  const hiddenBy = new Map<string, Location>();
  pages.forEach((page, p) => {
    const pageTruth = truth(pageConds[p] as Compiled);
    if (pageTruth.value) shown.push(page.id);
    for (const { item, cond } of itemConds[p] ?? []) {
      const own = pageTruth.value || pageTruth.error ? truth(cond) : { value: false };
      const v = both(pageTruth, own);
      if (v.value) {
        shown.push(item.id);
        if (item.type === "question") visible.add(item.id);
      } else if (item.type === "question") hiddenBy.set(item.id, pageTruth.value ? cond.at : (pageConds[p] as Compiled).at);
      // A text has no answer: the act never reads its Show when (compiler.md 5.3).
      if (v.error && item.type === "question") formErrors.push(v.error);
    }
  });

  const choices: Partial<Record<QuestionId, Json[]>> = {};
  const formRules: FormRefusal[] = [];
  // The act's checks, in the order it runs them: question by question in form order.
  const checkStep: FormRefusal[] = [];
  const rule = (r: FormRefusal): void => {
    formRules.push(r);
    checkStep.push(r);
  };
  for (const { question } of view.questions) {
    const q = question.id;
    if (given[q] !== undefined && hiddenBy.has(q)) rule(invalidData("hidden-answered", { ...(hiddenBy.get(q) as Location) }));
    const short = invalid.find((r) => r.location?.item === q && r.code === "invalid-data" && r.params.rule === "too-short");
    if (short) checkStep.push(short);
    const f = formulas.get(q);
    let offered: Json[] | undefined;
    if (f && visible.has(q) && f.cel !== null) {
      const r = run(env, f.cel, context);
      if (r.result === "error") formErrors.push({ code: "rule-error", location: f.at, params: { error: r.error } });
      else if (r.result === "absent") offered = [];
      else if (Array.isArray(r.value)) offered = r.value;
      else formErrors.push({ code: "rule-error", location: f.at, params: { error: "wrong-kind" } });
      if (offered) choices[q] = offered;
    }
    const a = fit[q];
    if (a === undefined || !visible.has(q)) continue;
    const among = (list: readonly Json[], x: Json) => list.some((c) => jsonEqual(c, x));
    if (offered) {
      const ok = question.kind === "multipleChoice" ? Array.isArray(a) && a.every((x) => among(offered, x)) : among(offered, a);
      if (!ok) rule(invalidData("not-a-choice", { item: q, part: "choices" }));
    }
    // A multiple choice keeps the choices' order (compiler.md 5.4, check `q__choice`).
    const ids = question.kind === "multipleChoice" ? choiceIds(s, question) : undefined;
    if (ids && Array.isArray(a) && !jsonEqual(ids.filter((c) => a.includes(c)), a)) rule(invalidData("not-a-choice", { item: q, part: "choices" }));
  }
  const allInvalid = [...invalid, ...formRules];
  const formRefusal = first ?? checkStep[0] ?? allInvalid[0] ?? formErrors[0];

  const buttons = view.buttons.map((b, i): FormButtonState => {
    const needed = new Set(neededFor(view, b.id));
    const missing = view.questions.map(({ question }) => question.id).filter((q) => needed.has(q) && visible.has(q) && given[q] === undefined);
    let refusal = formRefusal;
    if (!refusal) {
      const also = truth(buttonConds[i] as Compiled);
      if (also.error) refusal = also.error;
      else if (!also.value) {
        refusal = { code: "check", location: { item: b.id, part: "enabledWhen" }, params: { button: b.id } };
        if (isString(b.messageWhileDisabled)) refusal.message = b.messageWhileDisabled;
      }
    }
    const state: FormButtonState = { button: b.id, available: missing.length === 0 && !refusal, missing: [...new Set(missing)] as QuestionId[] };
    if (refusal) state.refusal = refusal;
    return state;
  });
  const state: FormState = { shown, choices, buttons };
  if (allInvalid.length > 0) state.invalid = allInvalid;
  return { result: "state", state };
}

/** The answers given, without keys whose value is undefined: those are empty. */
function givenAnswers(answers: Answers): Record<string, Json> {
  const out: Record<string, Json> = {};
  for (const [q, a] of Object.entries(isObject(answers) ? answers : {})) if (a !== undefined) out[q] = a as Json;
  return out;
}

/**
 * Value kinds as CEL types, and CEL types as the formula types an author meets (compiler.md 3.4,
 * 5.1 and 8.4; core-api.md 6.4). Shared by the checker and the compiler.
 */
import { t, type CelType } from "../../cel/types.ts";
import type { FormulaType } from "../../cel/formula-functions.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Field } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";

const REF = t.object({ type: t.string, id: t.string });

/**
 * The CEL type a value of this kind reads as (core-api.md 2.4): a date is its `YYYY-MM-DD` text,
 * a choice its ID, a person or group `{type, id}`. `field` refines a `list` or `fieldGroup` filled
 * from a catalogue field; without it their items are `dyn`. `item` is the kind of a multiple choice's
 * items when its choices come from a formula (E-27); without it they are choice IDs, text.
 */
export function celTypeOfKind(kind: ValueKind | undefined, field?: Field, item?: ValueKind): CelType {
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
    case "longText":
    case "date":
    case "choice":
    case "choiceFromList":
      return t.string;
    case "number":
      return t.double;
    case "yesNo":
      return t.bool;
    case "multipleChoice":
      return t.list(item === undefined ? t.string : celTypeOfKind(item));
    case "person":
    case "group":
      return REF;
    case "people":
      return t.list(REF);
    case "choiceFromConnection":
      return t.object({ stored: t.dyn, label: t.string });
    case "list":
      if (field?.fields) return t.list(fieldsType(field.fields));
      return t.list(field?.itemKind ? celTypeOfKind(field.itemKind) : t.dyn);
    case "fieldGroup":
      return field?.fields ? fieldsType(field.fields) : t.map(t.dyn);
    default:
      return t.dyn;
  }
}

/** A catalogue field as a CEL type. */
export function celTypeOfField(field: Field): CelType {
  return celTypeOfKind(field.kind, field);
}

function fieldsType(fields: readonly Field[]): CelType {
  const out: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  for (const f of fields) if (typeof f?.id === "string") out[f.id] = celTypeOfField(f);
  return t.object(out);
}

const TIMESTAMP = "google.protobuf.Timestamp";
const DURATION = "google.protobuf.Duration";

/** Splits `a, b<c, d>` at its top-level commas. */
export function splitTypeList(args: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let depth = 0;
  let from = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const c = args[i];
    if (c === "<" || c === "(") depth++;
    else if (c === ">" || c === ")") depth--;
    else if (c === "," && depth === 0) {
      out.push(args.slice(from, i).trim());
      from = i + 1;
    }
  }
  const last = args.slice(from).trim();
  if (last) out.push(last);
  return out;
}

/** A CEL type as the library names it (`double`, `list<string>`, `google.protobuf.Timestamp`) as a `FormulaType`. */
export function formulaTypeOf(celType: string): FormulaType {
  const type = celType.trim();
  const open = type.indexOf("<");
  const head = open < 0 ? type : type.slice(0, open);
  const inner = open < 0 ? "" : type.slice(open + 1, type.lastIndexOf(">"));
  switch (head) {
    case "string":
      return "text";
    case "double":
      return "number";
    case "bool":
      return "yesNo";
    case "int":
    case "uint":
      return "int";
    case TIMESTAMP:
      return "timestamp";
    case DURATION:
      return "duration";
    case "list":
      return `listOf:${inner ? formulaTypeOf(splitTypeList(inner)[0] ?? "dyn") : "any"}`;
    case "optional":
      return `optionalOf:${inner ? formulaTypeOf(inner) : "any"}`;
    case "dyn":
      return "any";
    default:
      return "map"; // map<...> and the object types registered for people, groups and catalogue fields
  }
}

/**
 * Whether a formula result of this CEL type can fill a place of this kind. A place that needs a
 * date takes a timestamp, to which the compiler applies `asDate` (compiler.md 8.4, E-23). An
 * optional is read as its value: `optional.none()` leaves the place empty.
 */
export function celTypeFitsKind(celType: string, kind: ValueKind): boolean {
  const found = formulaTypeOf(celType);
  const bare = found.startsWith("optionalOf:") ? found.slice("optionalOf:".length) : found;
  if (bare === "any") return true;
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
    case "longText":
    case "choice":
    case "choiceFromList":
      return bare === "text";
    case "date":
      return bare === "text" || bare === "timestamp";
    case "number":
      return bare === "number";
    case "yesNo":
      return bare === "yesNo";
    case "person":
    case "group":
    case "choiceFromConnection":
    case "fieldGroup":
      return bare === "map";
    case "multipleChoice":
    case "people":
    case "list":
      return bare.startsWith("listOf:");
  }
}

 * there. The formula is put into a copy of the document and the checker's own formula and value

import type { SampleResult } from "../evaluate/types.ts";
import { celTypeFitsKind, celTypeOfField, celTypeOfKind, formulaTypeOf } from "./cel-kinds.ts";
import type { Chip } from "./chips.ts";
import { formulaCelType, formulaItemKind, formulaValueKind, type ChipType } from "./formula-kind.ts";
import { placeFormula } from "./place.ts";

type ErrorCode =
  | "formula.syntax" | "formula.unknownName" | "formula.notInScope" | "formula.unknownFunction" | "formula.notInProfile"
  | "formula.argumentMismatch" | "formula.kindMismatch" | "value.neverFilled" | "value.mayBeEmpty" | "action.failureReadButStops";

export type FormulaError = Coded<Pick<FindingParams, ErrorCode>, FormulaRange>;

export type FormulaResult =
  | { ok: true; kind: ValueKind; sample?: SampleResult }
  | { ok: false; error: FormulaError };

/** The order errors are looked for in: what the formula says by itself, then what its place makes of it. */
const CODES: readonly ErrorCode[] = [
  "formula.unknownName", "formula.syntax", "formula.unknownFunction", "formula.notInProfile", "formula.argumentMismatch",
  "formula.notInScope", "formula.kindMismatch", "value.neverFilled", "value.mayBeEmpty", "action.failureReadButStops",
];
const CONDITION_SLOTS = new Set(["showWhen", "enabledWhen", "onlyWhen", "when.condition"]);

function rangeOf(f: Finding, text: string): FormulaRange {
  const p = f.params as Partial<FormulaRange>;
  return p.start !== undefined && p.end !== undefined ? { start: p.start, end: p.end } : { start: 0, end: text.length };
}

function toError(f: Finding, text: string): FormulaError {
  return { ...rangeOf(f, text), code: f.code, params: f.params } as FormulaError;
}

/** The errors the checker reports for the formula node, in `CODES` order, then in the order found. */
function errorsAt(ctx: Context, node: WalkNode, scratch: boolean): Finding[] {
  const found = scratch
    ? formulaChecks(ctx)
    : [...formulaChecks(ctx), ...neverFilled(ctx), ...mayBeEmpty(ctx), ...failureChecks(ctx)];
  const here = found.filter((f) => {
    if (f.location.item !== node.item) return false;
    if (f.location.part === node.path) return true;
    // A read inside a clause is reported at the clause, with the formula's range.
    return node.clause !== undefined && f.location.part === node.clause && (f.params as Partial<FormulaRange>).start !== undefined;
  });
  return here
    .map((f, i) => ({ f, i, o: CODES.indexOf(f.code as ErrorCode) }))
    .filter((x) => x.o >= 0)
    .sort((a, b) => a.o - b.o || a.i - b.i)
    .map((x) => x.f);
}

/** What a chip names, as the checker declares it (check/formulas.ts). */
function chipTypes(ctx: Context, node: WalkNode): (chip: Chip) => ChipType | undefined {
  return (chip) => {
    switch (chip.sort) {
      case "value": {
        const kind = ctx.kinds.valueKind(chip.value);
        return { type: celTypeOfKind(kind, undefined, ctx.kinds.itemKind(chip.value)), date: kind === "date" };
      }
      case "requester":
        return { type: celTypeOfKind("person") };
      case "startedOn":
        return { type: celTypeOfKind("date"), date: true };
      case "sent": {
        const trigger = bindingById(ctx, node.item)?.trigger;
        if (!ctx.catalogue.entry(trigger)) return { type: celTypeOfKind(undefined) };
        const field = ctx.catalogue.sentField(trigger, chip.field);
        return field ? { type: celTypeOfField(field), date: field.kind === "date" } : undefined;
      }
      default:
        return undefined;
    }
  };
}

/** The kinds the formula's place takes, where the place says. */
function placeKinds(ctx: Context, node: WalkNode): ValueKind[] | undefined {
  if (node.clause !== undefined || node.piece !== undefined || node.path !== node.slot) return undefined;
  if (CONDITION_SLOTS.has(node.slot)) return ["yesNo"];
  if (node.slot === "save") {
    const action = ctx.actions.get(node.item);
    const kind = action?.type === "saveValue" && typeof action.as === "string" ? ctx.kinds.valueKind(action.as) : undefined;
    return kind ? [kind] : undefined;
  }
  return slotKinds(ctx, node.item, node.slot);
}

function kindMismatch(text: string, expected: ValueKind, found: FormulaType): FormulaResult {
  const range = { start: 0, end: text.length };
  return { ok: false, error: { ...range, code: "formula.kindMismatch", params: { ...range, expected, found } } };
}

/** The kind the formula gives at its place, or the mismatch when its type is not a value kind. */
function kindAt(ctx: Context, node: WalkNode, text: string): FormulaResult {
  const type = formulaCelType(text, chipTypes(ctx, node)) ?? "dyn";
  const found = formulaTypeOf(type);
  if (node.path === "choices.formula" && node.slot === "choices.formula") {
    if (found === "any") return { ok: true, kind: "text" };
    const item = formulaItemKind(type);
    return item ? { ok: true, kind: item } : kindMismatch(text, "text", found);
  }
  const expected = placeKinds(ctx, node);
  const fits = expected?.find((k) => celTypeFitsKind(type, k));
  if (fits) return { ok: true, kind: fits };
  const kind = formulaValueKind(type);
  if (kind) return { ok: true, kind };
  // Not a value kind (core-api.md 6.4): a whole number wants `double()`, anything else a value.
  const want: ValueKind = expected?.[0] ?? (found === "int" ? "number" : found === "duration" ? "date" : "text");
  return kindMismatch(text, want, found);
}

export function checkFormula(
  workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, at: Location, formula: string, sample?: SampleRequest,
): FormulaResult {
  const text = typeof formula === "string" ? formula : "";
  let placed = placeFormula(workflow, at, text);
  let ctx = makeContext(placed.doc, catalogue);
  const find = () => ctx.nodes.find((n) => n.sort === "formula" && n.item === placed.at.item && n.path === placed.at.part);
  let node = find();
  if (!node) {
    // A part that holds no expression: the formula is checked on its own.
    placed = placeFormula(workflow, { item: "" }, text);
    ctx = makeContext(placed.doc, catalogue);
    node = find();
  }
  if (!node) return kindMismatch(text, "text", "any");
  const [first] = errorsAt(ctx, node, placed.scratch);
  if (first) return { ok: false, error: toError(first, text) };
  const result = kindAt(ctx, node, text);
  if (!result.ok || sample === undefined || placed.scratch) return result;
  const formulaNode = { formula: text, readsAs: "formula" };
  let worked: SampleResult | { result: "needsLookups" };
  if (node.sent) worked = evaluateSent(placed.doc, catalogue, placed.at, formulaNode);
  else {
    const s = docSetup(placed.doc, catalogue);
    worked = evaluateIn(s, placed.at, formulaNode, sampleValuesIn(s, sample));
  }
  return worked.result === "needsLookups" ? result : { ...result, sample: worked };
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/formula/chips.ts\n===
/**
 * Chips in formula text (authored format, `Formula`): `{{<value id>}}`, `{{request.requester}}`,
 * `{{request.startedOn}}` and, inside a "Starts when" binding, `{{sent.<field>}}`. The checker and
 * the compiler both read chips here and rewrite them through `rewriteChips`, each with its own
 * replacement text (compiler.md 8.4), so the two cannot disagree on what a chip is.
 */

/** A half-open range of UTF-16 offsets into the authored formula text. */
export interface TextRange {
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

export type Chip =
  | { sort: "value"; value: string; range: TextRange }
  | { sort: "requester"; range: TextRange }
  | { sort: "startedOn"; range: TextRange }
  /** `field` is the dotted field id of what the other system sent (`reporter.email`). */
  | { sort: "sent"; field: string; range: TextRange }
  /** `{{...}}` that names nothing a chip can name. `text` is what is between the braces. */
  | { sort: "unknown"; text: string; range: TextRange };

const CHIP = /\{\{([^{}]*)\}\}/g;
const VALUE = /^v_[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/;
const SENT = /^sent\.([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*)$/;

function chipOf(text: string, range: TextRange): Chip {
  if (VALUE.test(text)) return { sort: "value", value: text, range };
  if (text === "request.requester") return { sort: "requester", range };
  if (text === "request.startedOn") return { sort: "startedOn", range };
  const sent = SENT.exec(text);
  if (sent?.[1] !== undefined) return { sort: "sent", field: sent[1], range };
  return { sort: "unknown", text, range };
}

/** Every chip of the text, in order. */
export function chipsOf(formula: string): Chip[] {
  const out: Chip[] = [];
  for (const m of formula.matchAll(CHIP)) {
    const start = m.index;
    out.push(chipOf(m[1] ?? "", { start, end: start + m[0].length }));
  }
  return out;
}

export interface Rewritten {
  /** The text with every chip replaced. */
  source: string;
  /** The chips, in order, as found in the authored text. */
  chips: Chip[];
  /** A range in `source` as a range in the authored text; a range inside a replacement covers its whole chip. */
  toAuthored(range: TextRange): TextRange;
}

/** `has({{chip}}.a.b)`: a test that a field of what a chip names is present. */
const HAS_ON_CHIP = /\bhas\(\s*(\{\{[^{}]*\}\})((?:\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)+)\s*\)/g;

/** Each `has({{chip}}.a.b)` by the offset of its chip: the whole test's range and the fields it tests. */
function hasTests(formula: string): Map<number, { range: TextRange; fields: string[] }> {
  const out = new Map<number, { range: TextRange; fields: string[] }>();
  for (const m of formula.matchAll(HAS_ON_CHIP)) {
    const fields = (m[2] ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, "").slice(1).split(".");
    out.set(m.index + m[0].indexOf("{{"), { range: { start: m.index, end: m.index + m[0].length }, fields });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Replaces each chip by `replace(chip, index)`; everything else is kept byte for byte (compiler.md 8.4).
 * One exception: `has({{chip}}.a.b)` becomes `(<chip>).?a.?b.hasValue()`, an optional read of the field
 * (E-27). The library refuses has() on a call, and the compiler reads a chip as `<read>.value()`. The
 * checker and the compiler both rewrite here, so they type the same text.
 */
export function rewriteChips(formula: string, replace: (chip: Chip, index: number) => string): Rewritten {
  const chips = chipsOf(formula);
  const has = hasTests(formula);
  const pieces: { newStart: number; newEnd: number; chip: Chip; span: TextRange }[] = [];
  let source = "";
  let at = 0;
  chips.forEach((chip, i) => {
    const test = has.get(chip.range.start);
    const span = test?.range ?? chip.range;
    source += formula.slice(at, span.start);
    const replaced = replace(chip, i);
    const text = test === undefined ? replaced : `(${replaced})${test.fields.map((f) => `.?${f}`).join("")}.hasValue()`;
    pieces.push({ newStart: source.length, newEnd: source.length + text.length, chip, span });
    source += text;
    at = span.end;
  });
  source += formula.slice(at);

  const toAuthoredAt = (pos: number, isEnd: boolean): number => {
    let shift = 0;
    for (const p of pieces) {
      if (pos < p.newStart || (isEnd && pos === p.newStart)) break;
      if (pos < p.newEnd || (isEnd && pos === p.newEnd)) return isEnd ? p.span.end : p.span.start;
      shift = p.span.end - p.newEnd;
    }
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(formula.length, pos + shift));
  };
  return {
    source,
    chips,
    toAuthored: (r) => {
      const start = toAuthoredAt(r.start, false);
      return { start, end: Math.max(start, toAuthoredAt(r.end, true)) };
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The kind of value a formula gives (core-api.md 6.1, 6.4): its chips are typed by what they name,
 * the text is type-checked by the engine's CEL environment, and the CEL type is read as a value
 * kind. `checkFormula` and the value kinds of the facts both use it, so a value filled only by a
 * formula has the kind `checkFormula` reports.
 */
import type { CelType } from "../../cel/types.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import { formulaTypeOf } from "./cel-kinds.ts";
import { rewriteChips, type Chip } from "./chips.ts";
import { formulaType } from "./typing.ts";

/** What a chip reads as for the type check: a CEL type, read through `date()` for a date. */
export interface ChipType {
  type: CelType;
  date?: boolean;
}

/**
 * The CEL type of the formula with each chip declared as `chipType` says, or undefined when it does
 * not type-check or a chip names nothing (`chipType` gives undefined).
 */
export function formulaCelType(text: string, chipType: (chip: Chip) => ChipType | undefined): string | undefined {
  const variables: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  let unknown = false;
  const rw = rewriteChips(text, (chip, i) => {
    const declared = chipType(chip);
    const name = `chip__${i}`;
    if (!declared) {
      unknown = true;
      return name;
    }
    variables[name] = declared.type;
    return declared.date ? `date(${name})` : name;
  });
  if (unknown) return undefined;
  const r = formulaType(rw.source, variables);
  return r.ok ? r.type : undefined;
}

/**
 * The value kind a value saved from a formula of this CEL type has. A timestamp is saved as a date
 * (`asDate`, E-23); an optional is read as its value. Only text, number, yes/no and date are read
 * here, as the compiler reads them (compiler.md 8.4); any other type says no kind.
 */
export function formulaValueKind(celType: string | undefined): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (celType === undefined) return undefined;
  const found = formulaTypeOf(celType);
  const bare = found.startsWith("optionalOf:") ? found.slice("optionalOf:".length) : found;
  switch (bare) {
    case "text":
    case "number":
    case "yesNo":
      return bare;
    case "timestamp":
      return "date";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** The kind of one choice a choices formula gives: the kind of its list's items. */
export function formulaItemKind(celType: string | undefined): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (celType === undefined) return undefined;
  const found = formulaTypeOf(celType);
  if (!found.startsWith("listOf:")) return undefined;
  const item = found.slice("listOf:".length);
  switch (item) {
    case "text":
    case "number":
    case "yesNo":
      return item;
    case "timestamp":
      return "date";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * A copy of the document with a formula standing at a reported part (core-api.md 2.3), so a formula
 * can be checked "as if it stood at `at` in place of what is there" (6.1) by the same checks `check`
 * runs on the document.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Formula, Location } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);

/** The first object in document order whose `id` is `id`. */
function findItem(node: unknown, id: string): Obj | undefined {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    for (const x of node) {
      const found = findItem(x, id);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return undefined;
  }
  if (!isObject(node)) return undefined;
  if (node["id"] === id) return node;
  for (const v of Object.values(node)) {
    const found = findItem(v, id);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Puts `value` at `part` inside `item`. A numeric segment after a sentence is its clause (the
 * `allOf` or `anyOf` level is not in the part, 2.3); a missing step is created. False when the part
 * cannot be reached.
 */
function setPart(item: Obj, part: string, value: unknown): boolean {
  const segments = part.split(".");
  let at: unknown = item;
  for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
    const segment = segments[i] as string;
    const last = i === segments.length - 1;
    const index = /^\d+$/.test(segment) ? Number(segment) : undefined;
    let container: unknown = at;
    if (index !== undefined && isObject(container)) container = Array.isArray(container["allOf"]) ? container["allOf"] : container["anyOf"];
    if (Array.isArray(container) && index !== undefined) {
      if (last) container[index] = value;
      else {
        if (!isObject(container[index]) && !Array.isArray(container[index])) container[index] = {};
        at = container[index];
      }
    } else if (isObject(container)) {
      if (last) container[segment] = value;
      else {
        if (!isObject(container[segment]) && !Array.isArray(container[segment])) container[segment] = {};
        at = container[segment];
      }
    } else return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** A stage and a Save a value, apart from everything, for a formula whose item is not found. */
const SCRATCH_STAGE = "st_checkFormulaScratch";
const SCRATCH_ACTION = "act_checkFormulaScratch";

/**
 * A copy of `workflow` with `{ formula, readsAs }` at `at`, and the location it stands at. A choices
 * formula makes the question's choices come from it; a "when" condition makes the arrow's "when" a
 * condition. When `at` names no item, the formula stands in a Save a value of a stage nothing
 * reaches, so only what the formula says by itself is checked.
 */
export function placeFormula(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, at: Location, formula: string): { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; at: Location; scratch: boolean } {
  const doc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(workflow ?? {})) as AuthoredWorkflow;
  const node: Formula = { formula, readsAs: "formula" };
  const item = typeof at?.item === "string" ? findItem(doc, at.item) : undefined;
  const part = typeof at?.part === "string" && at.part !== "" ? at.part : undefined;
  if (item && part !== undefined) {
    let placed: boolean;
    if (part === "choices.formula") placed = setPart(item, "choices", { from: "formula", formula: node });
    else if (part === "when.condition") placed = setPart(item, "when", { type: "condition", condition: node });
    else placed = setPart(item, part, node);
    if (placed) return { doc, at: { item: at.item, part }, scratch: false };
  }
  const stages = Array.isArray(doc.stages) ? doc.stages : (doc.stages = []);
  stages.push({
    id: SCRATCH_STAGE, kind: "automatic", name: "scratch", whenThisStageStarts: [{ id: SCRATCH_ACTION, type: "saveValue", save: node }],
    tasks: [], afterTheyRespond: [], arrows: [],
  });
  return { doc, at: { item: SCRATCH_ACTION, part: "save" }, scratch: true };
}

/**
 * The type a formula gives, with each chip declared as a variable of the CEL type of what it names
 * (compiler.md 8.4). The checker and the compiler both type formulas this way.
 */
import { createCelEnvironment, type CelEnvironment } from "../../cel/environment.ts";
import type { CelProblem, CelType } from "../../cel/types.ts";

/** Environments by their declarations: building one registers every function, so they are reused. */
const environments = new Map<string, CelEnvironment>();
const MAX_ENVIRONMENTS = 256;

export function formulaEnvironment(variables: Readonly<Record<string, CelType>>): CelEnvironment {
  const key = JSON.stringify(variables);
  let env = environments.get(key);
  if (!env) {
    if (environments.size >= MAX_ENVIRONMENTS) environments.clear();
    env = createCelEnvironment({ variables, requestRooted: [] });
    environments.set(key, env);
  }
  return env;
}

/** The CEL type of `source` (`string`, `double`, `google.protobuf.Timestamp` ...), or its first problem. */
export function formulaType(source: string, variables: Readonly<Record<string, CelType>>): { ok: true; type: string } | { ok: false; problem: CelProblem | undefined } {
  const r = formulaEnvironment(variables).check(source);
  return r.ok ? { ok: true, type: r.expression.type } : { ok: false, problem: r.problems[0] };
}

===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/host/fakes.ts\n===
/**
 * The test host's stand-ins for the outside (core-api.md 10.2: only I/O is replaced). Memberships,
 * membership reads and directory choices read `groups`; data sources read `sources` or the catalogue
 * sample; calls are answered from the call fakes or the catalogue sample. The fakes always answer, so
 * `membership-unavailable` and `source-unavailable` never occur.
 */
import type { JsonObject } from "../../format/index.ts";
import type { LookupAnswer, PlannedLookup } from "../../kernel/index.ts";
import { jsonEqual } from "../../schema/equal.ts";
import type { CatalogueIndex } from "../check/context.ts";
import type { Json, Ref } from "../evaluate/types.ts";
import type { CallFake, Fakes } from "./types.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, Json>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);

export class FakeWorld {
  private readonly groups: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>;
  private readonly sources: Partial<Record<string, Obj[]>>;
  readonly admins: readonly Ref[];
  readonly catalogue: CatalogueIndex;
  readonly directory: string;

  constructor(fakes: Fakes, catalogue: CatalogueIndex, directory: string) {
    // Copied: the fakes hold for the life of the host, whatever the caller does to its object later.
    this.groups = new Map(Object.entries(fakes.groups).map(([g, users]) => [g, [...(users ?? [])]]));
    this.sources = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fakes.sources ?? {})) as Partial<Record<string, Obj[]>>;
    this.admins = fakes.stuckRequestsGoTo.map((r) => ({ type: r.type, id: r.id }));
    this.catalogue = catalogue;
    this.directory = directory;
  }

  /** A group's people; a group the fakes do not name has nobody in it. */
  members(group: string): readonly string[] {
    return this.groups.get(group) ?? [];
  }

  groupsOf(user: string): string[] {
    return [...this.groups.entries()].filter(([, users]) => users.includes(user)).map(([g]) => g);
  }

  /** Groups expanded to their people, each person once, in order. */
  people(refs: readonly Ref[]): Ref[] {
    const out: Ref[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const add = (id: string): void => {
      if (seen.has(id)) return;
      seen.add(id);
      out.push({ type: "user", id });
    };
    for (const r of refs) {
      if (r.type === "user") add(r.id);
      else for (const u of this.members(r.id)) add(u);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Whether a person is among those who look after stuck requests, directly or through a group. */
  isAdmin(as: Ref | undefined): boolean {
    if (as?.type !== "user") return false;
    return this.admins.some((a) => (a.type === "user" ? a.id === as.id : this.members(a.id).includes(as.id)));
  }

  /**
   * The items of a data source for some inputs. The directory's group members are the group's people from
   * `groups`. Any other source lists its fake items, or the catalogue sample; an input whose field the
   * item also has keeps only the items with that value, which is how a fake honours a filter.
   */
  items(source: string, inputs: JsonObject): Obj[] {
    if (source === `${this.directory}.groupMembers@1`) {
      const group = inputs["group"];
      const id = isObject(group) && typeof group["id"] === "string" ? group["id"] : undefined;
      return id === undefined ? [] : this.members(id).map((u) => ({ id: u, name: u }));
    }
    const entry = this.catalogue.entry(source);
    const sample = entry?.kind === "dataSource" && Array.isArray(entry.sample?.items) ? (entry.sample.items as Obj[]) : [];
    const items = this.sources[source] ?? sample;
    return items.filter((item) => Object.entries(inputs).every(([field, value]) => !(field in item) || jsonEqual(item[field], value as Json)));
  }

  /** The act-time lookup of an answer by its stored value, with the same inputs. */
  lookup(p: PlannedLookup): LookupAnswer {
    const item = this.items(`${p.connection}.${p.source}`, p.inputs).find((i) => i[p.storedField] === p.stored);
    if (item === undefined) return { found: false };
    if (p.answer === "person") return { found: true, label: null };
    const label = item[p.labelField];
    return { found: true, label: typeof label === "string" ? label : label === undefined ? "" : JSON.stringify(label) };
  }

  lookups(planned: readonly PlannedLookup[]): Record<string, LookupAnswer> {
    return Object.fromEntries(planned.map((p) => [p.property, this.lookup(p)]));
  }

  /** The directory's answer to a membership read: each group asked, with its people now. */
  membersOf(args: JsonObject): JsonObject {
    const asked = Array.isArray(args["groups"]) ? args["groups"] : [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const groups: Json[] = [];
    for (const g of asked) {
      if (!isObject(g) || g["type"] !== "group" || typeof g["id"] !== "string" || seen.has(g["id"])) continue;
      seen.add(g["id"]);
      groups.push({ id: { type: "group", id: g["id"] }, members: this.members(g["id"]).map((u) => ({ type: "user", id: u })) });
    }
    return { groups };
  }

  /**
   * The answer a call gets at once, or undefined for one held until `answerCall`. `fake` is the call's own
   * fake, fixed when it was opened; without one a membership read reads `groups` and anything else
   * answers with the catalogue sample.
   */
  answer(operation: string, args: JsonObject, fake: CallFake | undefined): { outcome: "ok" | "failed"; data: JsonObject } | undefined {
    const mode = fake ?? (operation === `${this.directory}.membersOf@1` ? undefined : { mode: "sample" as const });
    if (mode === undefined) return { outcome: "ok", data: this.membersOf(args) };
    switch (mode.mode) {
      case "hold":
        return undefined;
      case "result":
        return { outcome: "ok", data: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mode.data)) as JsonObject };
      case "fail":
        return { outcome: "failed", data: this.failure(operation, mode.error) };
      case "sample": {
        const entry = this.catalogue.entry(operation);
        const result = entry?.kind === "operation" ? entry.sample?.result : undefined;
        return { outcome: "ok", data: isObject(result) ? (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result)) as JsonObject) : {} };
      }
    }
  }

  /** A failure as recorded: `{ code, message }`, the message defaulting to the sample's for that code (core-api.md 10.1). */
  failure(operation: string, error: { code: string; message?: string }): { code: string; message: string } {
    if (error.message !== undefined) return { code: error.code, message: error.message };
    const entry = this.catalogue.entry(operation);
    const sample = entry?.kind === "operation" ? entry.sample?.failure : null;
    return { code: error.code, message: sample !== null && sample !== undefined && sample.code === error.code ? sample.message : "" };
  }
}

/**
 * What one committed turn sends out, as Try it's outbox shows it (core-api.md 10.3): the messages the
 * notification rules set off and what other systems are told. Worked out by the same rule matchers the
 * notifier and the publisher run (src/kernel/notify), then located in authored terms.
 */
import type { Json as EventJson, PersonWaitOpened } from "../../format/index.ts";
import { matchNotifications, outboundEvents, type NotifyPart } from "../../kernel/notify/index.ts";
import type { StageId, TaskId, ToldId } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Json, Ref } from "../evaluate/types.ts";
import { timestamp } from "../view/ids.ts";
import type { Reading } from "../view/reading.ts";
import type { TurnRecord } from "../view/replay.ts";
import { asRefs } from "../view/tasks.ts";
import type { FakeWorld } from "./fakes.ts";
import type { BuiltInTold, MessagePart, OutboxEntry } from "./types.ts";

/** An entry with the seq of the event that set it off, so a turn's entries can be put in event order. */
export interface Sourced {
  seq: number;
  entry: OutboxEntry;
}

/** JSON with every null left out: the contract's JSON never holds null (core-api.md 1). */
function withoutNulls(x: unknown): Json | undefined {
  if (x === null || x === undefined) return undefined;
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(withoutNulls).filter((v): v is Json => v !== undefined);
  if (typeof x === "object") {
    const out: Record<string, Json> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(x)) {
      const j = withoutNulls(v);
      if (j !== undefined) out[k] = j;
    }
    return out;
  }
  return typeof x === "string" || typeof x === "number" || typeof x === "boolean" ? x : undefined;
}

function part(p: NotifyPart): MessagePart {
  if ("text" in p) return p.text;
  return p.value === undefined ? { kind: p.kind } : { value: p.value as Json, kind: p.kind };
}

export function notifications(r: Reading, world: FakeWorld, t: TurnRecord, requestId: string): Sourced[] {
  const out: Sourced[] = [];
  const result = matchNotifications(r.def, t.before, t.events, t.after);
  for (const m of result.messages) {
    const at = timestamp(m.event.at);
    if (m.rule === "n_task") {
      const p = m.event.payload as PersonWaitOpened;
      const task = r.taskOf(p.wait.element);
      const stage = r.authoredStage(p.wait.element.slice(0, p.wait.element.indexOf(".")));
      if (task === undefined || stage === undefined) continue;
      const askedOf = asRefs(p.assignees);
      const from = { builtIn: { code: "task.assigned" as const, params: { stage: stage as StageId, task: task as TaskId, askedOf } } };
      out.push({ seq: m.event.seq, entry: { kind: "notification", requestId, at, from, to: askedOf, recipients: world.people(askedOf) } });
    } else if (m.rule === "n_stopped") {
      const stuck = t.stuck;
      // The matcher's Stuck event names the authored stage already (`authoredStageOf`).
      const reported = (m.event.payload as { stage?: unknown }).stage;
      const stage = typeof reported === "string" ? r.stageOfItem(reported) : undefined;
      // Try it's `unfinished` is not a stuck reason a live request can have: nobody is told (E-32).
      if (stuck === null || stage === undefined || stuck.reason === "unfinished") continue;
      const params: { stage: StageId; reason: typeof stuck.reason; location?: typeof stuck.location } = { stage: stage as StageId, reason: stuck.reason };
      if (stuck.location !== undefined) params.location = stuck.location;
      const to = [...world.admins];
      out.push({ seq: m.event.seq, entry: { kind: "notification", requestId, at, from: { builtIn: { code: "request.stuck", params } }, to, recipients: world.people(to) } });
    } else if (r.kindOf(m.rule) === "action") {
      const to: Ref[] = m.to.flatMap((x): Ref[] => ("id" in x ? asRefs([x]) : [...world.admins]));
      const message = "parts" in m.message ? m.message.parts.map(part) : [];
      out.push({ seq: m.event.seq, entry: { kind: "notification", requestId, at, from: { action: { item: m.rule } }, to, recipients: world.people(to), message } });
    }
  }
  // A message addressed to nobody is not sent: a task asked of nobody is a stuck request, told as such.
  return out.filter((s) => s.entry.kind !== "notification" || s.entry.to.length > 0);
}

const BUILT_IN: Readonly<Record<string, BuiltInTold>> = {
  "request.started@1": "requestStarted",
  "request.statusChanged@1": "statusChanged",
  "request.stuck@1": "stuck",
  "request.unstuck@1": "unstuck",
  "request.ended@1": "ended",
};

export function told(r: Reading, t: TurnRecord, requestId: string): Sourced[] {
  const out: Sourced[] = [];
  const result = outboundEvents(r.def, t.before, t.events, t.after);
  for (const row of result.events) {
    const at = timestamp(row.body.time);
    const data = row.body.data as unknown as Record<string, EventJson>;
    if (row.body.type === "request.told@1") {
      const toldData = data as unknown as { told: { id: string }; values: Record<string, EventJson> };
      const values = (withoutNulls(toldData.values) ?? {}) as Record<string, Json>;
      out.push({ seq: row.seq, entry: { kind: "told", requestId, at, what: { tell: toldData.told.id as ToldId, action: { item: row.ruleId } }, values } });
      continue;
    }
    const builtIn = BUILT_IN[row.body.type];
    if (builtIn === undefined) continue;
    const values = (withoutNulls(data) ?? {}) as Record<string, Json>;
    // A stuck state names the authored stage, which the publisher's rows carry already (`authoredStageOf`),
    // and the reason people see.
    if (builtIn === "stuck" || builtIn === "unstuck") {
      const stuck = builtIn === "stuck" ? t.stuck : t.stuckBefore;
      // Try it's `unfinished` is told to no other system, so neither is its end (E-32).
      if (stuck?.reason === "unfinished") continue;
      const reported = data["stage"];
      const stage = typeof reported === "string" ? r.stageOfItem(reported) : undefined;
      if (stuck !== null) values["reason"] = stuck.reason;
      if (stage === undefined) delete values["stage"];
      else values["stage"] = stage;
    }
    out.push({ seq: row.seq, entry: { kind: "told", requestId, at, what: { builtIn }, values } });
  }
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/authored/host/test-host.ts\n===
/**
 * Try it's test host (core-api.md section 10): runs requests on a draft compiled in Try it mode, in
 * memory, through the kernel's one turn function, with the outside replaced by fakes. Every answer it
 * gives is in authored terms: refusals, the request view, the story and the outbox name no engine stage,
 * compiled ID or kernel code (E-7).
 *
 * - After each turn the host answers every call opened in it, in declared order, each as its own turn,
 *   as the dispatcher would; a call whose fake is `hold` waits for `answerCall`.
 * - The clock starts at `fakes.startAt` and moves 1 s for every turn recorded. A call may give its own time
 *   (`at`); a turn's time is never earlier than the request's previous event.
 * - A request that reaches an unfinished part of the draft is stuck with reason `unfinished`.
 */
import type { AnyEventRecord, By as EventBy, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition, StartTrigger, WaitId } from "../../format/index.ts";
import { evaluate } from "../../kernel/decide/expressions.ts";
import { emptyState, lookupsToMake, turn as runTurn, validateCallResult, type DecideContext, type DecideInput, type RequestState, type TraceEntry } from "../../kernel/index.ts";
import { compile } from "../compile/compile.ts";
import type { Unfinished } from "../compile/types.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, CatalogueRef, Location, StartsWhenId } from "../contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../contract/catalogue.ts";
import type { Answers, Json, Ref } from "../evaluate/types.ts";
import { badTime, callRef, kernelAt, openedSeqOf, timestamp } from "../view/ids.ts";
import { readingOf, type PublishedVersion, type Reading } from "../view/reading.ts";
import { replay, type TurnRecord } from "../view/replay.ts";
import { requestView } from "../view/request-view.ts";
import { refusalOf, type RefusalContext } from "../view/refusals.ts";
import { openTasks as openTasksOf, type Viewer } from "../view/tasks.ts";
import type { CallRef, OpenTask, Refusal, RequestView, Timestamp, TurnResult } from "../view/types.ts";
import { runBinding } from "./binding.ts";
import { FakeWorld } from "./fakes.ts";
import { notifications, told, type Sourced } from "./outbox.ts";
import type { CallAnswer, CallFake, ChoicesArgs, ChoicesPage, Fakes, HostResult, OutboxEntry, TestHost } from "./types.ts";

type CallEntry = Extract<OutboxEntry, { kind: "call" }>;

interface Held {
  requestId: string;
  events: AnyEventRecord[];
  state: RequestState;
  /** `decide`'s trace of each turn, by turn: Try it's "why". */
  traces: Map<number, TraceEntry[]>;
}

interface CallRecord {
  entry: CallEntry;
  requestId: string;
  wait: WaitId;
  args: JsonObject;
  /** Fixed when the call was opened (`setCallFake` changes only later calls). */
  fake: CallFake | undefined;
}

/** How many calls one input may answer by itself before the rest are left pending: a loop guard. */
const AUTOMATIC_ANSWERS = 1000;

const refused = (...refusals: Refusal[]): { ok: false; refusals: Refusal[] } => ({ ok: false, refusals });

function toJsonObject(answers: Answers | Record<string, Json>): JsonObject {
  const out: JsonObject = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(answers)) if (v !== undefined) out[k] = v as JsonObject[string];
  return out;
}

/** The kernel's clock: the contract's millisecond time with six fractional digits. */
function kernelTime(startAt: string, seconds: number): string {
  const base = Date.parse(startAt);
  const ms = Number.isNaN(base) ? Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1) : base;
  return new Date(ms + seconds * 1000).toISOString().replace(/Z$/, "000Z");
}

export function createTestHost(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, fakes: Fakes): HostResult {
  const compiled = compile(workflow, catalogue, { mode: "tryIt" });
  if (!compiled.ok) return { ok: false, findings: compiled.findings };
  const unfinished: Location[] = [];
  for (const u of compiled.unfinished)
    if (!unfinished.some((x) => x.item === u.location.item && x.part === u.location.part)) unfinished.push(u.location);
  const host = new Host(compiled.published, workflow, catalogue, fakes, compiled.unfinished);
  return { ok: true, host, unfinished, findings: compiled.findings };
}

class Host implements TestHost {
  private readonly def: PublishedDefinition;
  private readonly r: Reading;
  private readonly published: PublishedVersion;
  private readonly world: FakeWorld;
  private readonly unfinished: readonly Unfinished[];
  private readonly startAt: string;
  private readonly requests = new Map<string, Held>();
  private readonly calls = new Map<CallRef, CallRecord>();
  private readonly callFakes = new Map<string, CallFake>();
  private readonly entries: OutboxEntry[] = [];
  private seconds = 0;
  /** The time the caller gave for the call being served, as the kernel's. */
  private pinned: string | undefined;
  private nextRequest = 1;
  private nextEvent = 1;

  constructor(def: PublishedDefinition, source: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, fakes: Fakes, unfinished: readonly Unfinished[]) {
    this.def = def;
    this.published = { definition: def, source, catalogue };
    this.r = readingOf(this.published);
    this.world = new FakeWorld(fakes, this.r.catalogue, this.r.directory);
    this.unfinished = unfinished;
    this.startAt = fakes.startAt;
    for (const [op, fake] of Object.entries(fakes.calls ?? {})) if (fake !== undefined) this.callFakes.set(op, fake);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ turns

  /** The turn's time: the caller's, else the host's clock; never earlier than the request's previous event. */
  private now(h?: Held): string {
    const base = this.pinned ?? kernelTime(this.startAt, this.seconds);
    const previous = h?.events.at(-1)?.at;
    return previous !== undefined && previous > base ? previous : base;
  }

  /** Serves one call at the caller's time, if given; an `at` that is not RFC 3339 is refused. */
  private at<T>(at: string | undefined, serve: () => T): T | { ok: false; refusals: Refusal[] } {
    if (at === undefined) return serve();
    const pinned = kernelAt(at);
    if (pinned === undefined) return refused(badTime());
    this.pinned = pinned;
    try {
      return serve();
    } finally {
      this.pinned = undefined;
    }
  }

  /** One input through the kernel's turn function; then the outbox; then the calls it opened are answered. */
  private turn(h: Held, input: DecideInput, context: Omit<DecideContext, "at">, ctx: RefusalContext = {}): TurnResult {
    const result = runTurn(this.def, h.state, input, { ...context, at: this.now(h) });
    if (!result.ok) return refused(...result.refusals.map((k) => refusalOf(this.published, k, ctx)));
    if (result.events.length === 0) return { ok: true };
    this.seconds += 1;
    const opened = this.record(h, result.events, result.trace, result.state);
    this.settle(opened);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /** Appends a turn's events and its outbox entries; returns the calls the turn opened. */
  private record(h: Held, events: AnyEventRecord[], trace: TraceEntry[], after: RequestState): CallRecord[] {
    const before = h.state;
    const first = events[0];
    h.events.push(...events);
    h.state = after;
    if (first !== undefined) h.traces.set(first.turn, trace);
    const records = replay(this.r, h.events, { unfinished: this.unfinished });
    const t: TurnRecord = { ...(records.at(-1) as TurnRecord), before };
    const sourced: Sourced[] = [];
    const opened: CallRecord[] = [];
    for (const e of events) {
      if (e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "call") {
        const c = this.openCall(h.requestId, e);
        opened.push(c);
        sourced.push({ seq: e.seq, entry: c.entry });
      } else if (e.type === "WaitCompleted" || e.type === "CallResultLate") {
        this.closeCall(h.requestId, e);
      }
    }
    sourced.push(...notifications(this.r, this.world, t, h.requestId), ...told(this.r, t, h.requestId));
    sourced.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
    this.entries.push(...sourced.map((s) => s.entry));
    return opened;
  }

  private openCall(requestId: string, e: Extract<AnyEventRecord, { type: "WaitOpened" }>): CallRecord {
    const p = e.payload;
    if (p.kind !== "call") throw new Error("not a call");
    const operation = `${p.connection}.${p.op}` as CatalogueRef;
    const ref = callRef(requestId, e.seq);
    const action = this.r.actionOf(p.wait.element);
    const location = action !== undefined ? { item: action } : (this.r.locate(p.wait.element) ?? { item: "" });
    const entry: CallEntry = {
      kind: "call", call: ref, requestId, at: timestamp(e.at), action: location, operation, sort: this.r.sortOf(p.connection, p.op),
      inputs: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p.args)) as Record<string, Json>, state: "pending",
    };
    const record: CallRecord = { entry, requestId, wait: p.wait, args: p.args, fake: this.callFakes.get(operation) };
    this.calls.set(ref, record);
    return record;
  }

  private closeCall(requestId: string, e: Extract<AnyEventRecord, { type: "WaitCompleted" | "CallResultLate" }>): void {
    const record = [...this.calls.values()].find((c) => c.requestId === requestId && sameWait(c.wait, e.payload.wait));
    if (record === undefined) return;
    const data = e.payload.data;
    const late = e.type === "CallResultLate";
    record.entry.state = late ? "late" : e.payload.outcome === "ok" ? "ok" : "failed";
    if (e.payload.outcome === "ok") record.entry.result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)) as Record<string, Json>;
    else record.entry.failure = { code: String(data["code"] ?? ""), message: String(data["message"] ?? "") };
  }

  /** Answers calls, each as its own turn, and then the calls those turns open, until none is left. */
  private settle(opened: CallRecord[]): void {
    const queue = [...opened];
    let budget = AUTOMATIC_ANSWERS;
    while (queue.length > 0 && budget > 0) {
      const c = queue.shift() as CallRecord;
      const answer = this.world.answer(c.entry.operation, c.args, c.fake);
      if (answer === undefined) continue;
      budget -= 1;
      const delivered = this.deliver(c, answer);
      if (delivered.ok) queue.push(...delivered.opened);
    }
  }

  /** A call's result: checked against the operation's shape before the turn, as the dispatcher does. */
  private deliver(c: CallRecord, answer: { outcome: "ok" | "failed"; data: JsonObject }): { ok: true; opened: CallRecord[] } | { ok: false; refusals: Refusal[] } {
    const h = this.requests.get(c.requestId);
    if (h === undefined || c.entry.state !== "pending") return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "call" } });
    const check = validateCallResult(this.def, c.wait, answer);
    if (!check.ok) return refused({ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "/data", problem: "type" } });
    const result = runTurn(this.def, h.state, { kind: "callResult", wait: c.wait, outcome: answer.outcome, data: answer.data }, { at: this.now(h) });
    if (!result.ok) return refused(...result.refusals.map((k) => refusalOf(this.published, k)));
    if (result.events.length === 0) {
      // Dropped: a read whose wait closed before it answered. It acted nowhere, so nothing is recorded.
      c.entry.state = "late";
      if (answer.outcome === "ok") c.entry.result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(answer.data)) as Record<string, Json>;
      else c.entry.failure = { code: String(answer.data["code"] ?? ""), message: String(answer.data["message"] ?? "") };
      return { ok: true, opened: [] };
    }
    this.seconds += 1;
    return { ok: true, opened: this.record(h, result.events, result.trace, result.state) };
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the contract

  start(as: Ref, button: ButtonId, answers: Answers, at?: Timestamp): TurnResult<{ requestId: string }> {
    return this.at(at, () => this.startNow(as, button, answers));
  }

  private startNow(as: Ref, button: ButtonId, answers: Answers): TurnResult<{ requestId: string }> {
    const task = this.r.startTask();
    const taskAt = task === undefined ? {} : { location: { item: task } };
    if (this.r.waitDef(this.def.start)?.kind !== "person") return refused({ code: "unfinished", params: {}, ...taskAt });
    return this.startWith({ type: "user", id: as.id }, button, toJsonObject(answers), null);
  }

  private startWith(by: EventBy, button: string, data: JsonObject, trigger: StartTrigger | null): TurnResult<{ requestId: string }> {
    const wait = this.r.waitDef(this.def.start);
    const task = this.r.startTask();
    if (wait?.kind !== "person" || !wait.outcomes.some((o) => o.id === button)) {
      return refused({ code: "unknown-button", params: { button: button as ButtonId }, ...(task === undefined ? {} : { location: { item: task } }) });
    }
    const n = this.nextRequest;
    const requestId = `R${n}`;
    const input: DecideInput = { kind: "start", requestId, readableId: n, by, outcome: button, data, trigger };
    const h: Held = { requestId, events: [], state: emptyState(), traces: new Map() };
    this.requests.set(requestId, h);
    // The start turn runs at this time, so a lookup input reading `request.at` sees it.
    const lookups = this.world.lookups(lookupsToMake(this.def, h.state, input, this.now()));
    const result = this.turn(h, input, { lookups }, { element: this.def.start, button, answers: data });
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.requests.delete(requestId);
      return result;
    }
    this.nextRequest += 1;
    return { ok: true, requestId };
  }

  startFrom(binding: StartsWhenId, sent: Record<string, Json>, at?: Timestamp): TurnResult<{ started: true; requestId: string } | { started: false; reason: "onlyWhenNotTrue" }> {
    return this.at(at, () => this.startFromNow(binding, sent));
  }

  private startFromNow(binding: StartsWhenId, sent: Record<string, Json>): TurnResult<{ started: true; requestId: string } | { started: false; reason: "onlyWhenNotTrue" }> {
    if (this.r.kindOf(binding) !== "startsWhen") return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "binding" } });
    const trigger = this.def.triggers?.find((x) => x.id === binding);
    if (trigger === undefined || this.r.waitDef(this.def.start)?.kind !== "person") return this.refuseStart(binding, [{ code: "unfinished", params: {}, location: { item: binding } }]);
    const run = runBinding(this.r, trigger, toJsonObject(sent));
    if (run.kind === "notMatched") return { ok: true, started: false, reason: "onlyWhenNotTrue" };
    if (run.kind === "mappingError") return this.refuseStart(binding, [{ code: "mapping-error", params: { error: run.error }, location: run.location }]);
    const eventId = `tryit-${this.nextEvent++}`;
    const by: EventBy = { type: "connection", id: trigger.connection };
    const started = this.startWith(by, run.outcome, run.data, { kind: "event", id: trigger.id, connection: trigger.connection, event: trigger.event, eventId });
    if (!started.ok) return this.refuseStart(binding, started.refusals);
    return { ok: true, started: true, requestId: started.requestId };
  }

  /** A refused start, with the one `start.refused` message to the people who look after stuck requests (E-16). */
  private refuseStart(binding: StartsWhenId, refusals: Refusal[]): { ok: false; refusals: Refusal[] } {
    const to = [...this.world.admins];
    this.entries.push({
      kind: "notification", at: timestamp(this.now()), from: { builtIn: { code: "start.refused", params: { binding, refusals } } }, to, recipients: this.world.people(to),
    });
    return refused(...refusals);
  }

  choices(args: ChoicesArgs): ChoicesPage {
    let element = this.def.start;
    let state = emptyState();
    if ("requestId" in args.form) {
      const h = this.requests.get(args.form.requestId);
      const seq = openedSeqOf(args.form.task);
      const w = h?.state.waits.find((x) => x.openedSeq === seq && x.kind === "person");
      if (h === undefined || w === undefined) return { choices: [] };
      element = w.id.element;
      state = h.state;
    }
    const wait = this.r.waitDef(element);
    if (wait?.kind !== "person") return { choices: [] };
    const found = wait.outcomes.flatMap((o) => o.lookups.map((l) => ({ o, l }))).find((x) => x.l.property === args.question);
    if (found === undefined) return { choices: [] };
    const { o, l } = found;
    const source = `${l.connection}.${l.source}`;
    const inputs: JsonObject = {};
    for (const [name, cel] of Object.entries(l.inputs)) {
      const v = evaluate(this.def, state, { kind: "lookup", schema: o.schema }, cel, { input: toJsonObject(args.answers) });
      if (v.kind === "error") return { choices: [] };
      if (v.kind === "value") inputs[name] = v.value;
    }
    const entry = this.r.catalogue.entry(source);
    const required = this.r.catalogue.fields(entry, "input").filter((f) => f.required).map((f) => f.id);
    if (required.some((f) => !(f in inputs))) return { choices: [] };
    const search = args.search?.toLowerCase();
    const all = this.world.items(source, inputs).flatMap((item) => {
      const stored = item[l.storedField];
      const label = item[l.labelField];
      if ((typeof stored !== "string" && typeof stored !== "number") || typeof label !== "string") return [];
      if (search !== undefined && !label.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return [];
      const value: Json = l.answer === "person" ? { type: "user", id: String(stored) } : { stored, label };
      return [{ value, label }];
    });
    const offset = Math.max(0, Number.parseInt(args.cursor ?? "0", 10) || 0);
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(1, args.limit ?? 50), 100);
    const page: ChoicesPage = { choices: all.slice(offset, offset + limit) };
    if (offset + limit < all.length) page.next = String(offset + limit);
    return page;
  }

  private viewer(as: Ref | undefined): Viewer {
    const v: Viewer = { isAdmin: this.world.isAdmin(as), groupsOf: (user) => this.world.groupsOf(user) };
    if (as !== undefined) v.as = { type: as.type, id: as.id };
    return v;
  }

  openTasks(filter: { requestId?: string; askedOf?: Ref; as?: Ref } = {}): OpenTask[] {
    const viewer = filter.as === undefined ? undefined : this.viewer(filter.as);
    const out: OpenTask[] = [];
    for (const h of this.requests.values()) {
      if (filter.requestId !== undefined && h.requestId !== filter.requestId) continue;
      for (const t of openTasksOf(this.r, h.requestId, h.state, viewer)) {
        const asked = filter.askedOf;
        if (asked !== undefined) {
          const groups = asked.type === "user" ? this.world.groupsOf(asked.id) : [];
          const hit = t.askedOf.some((a) => (a.type === asked.type && a.id === asked.id) || (a.type === "group" && groups.includes(a.id)));
          if (!hit) continue;
        }
        out.push(t);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  act(as: Ref, requestId: string, task: string, button: ButtonId, answers: Answers, at?: Timestamp): TurnResult {
    return this.at(at, () => this.actNow(as, requestId, task, button, answers));
  }

  private actNow(as: Ref, requestId: string, task: string, button: ButtonId, answers: Answers): TurnResult {
    const h = this.requests.get(requestId);
    if (h === undefined) return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
    const seq = openedSeqOf(task);
    const w = h.state.waits.find((x) => x.openedSeq === seq && x.kind === "person");
    if (w === undefined) return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "task" } });
    const ctx: RefusalContext = { element: w.id.element, button, answers };
    const opened = w.opened;
    if (opened.kind !== "person" || !opened.outcomes.some((o) => o.id === button)) {
      const item = this.r.taskOf(w.id.element);
      return refused({ code: "unknown-button", params: { button }, ...(item === undefined ? {} : { location: { item } }) });
    }
    const input: DecideInput = { kind: "act", by: { type: "user", id: as.id }, wait: w.id, outcome: button, data: toJsonObject(answers) };
    const lookups = this.world.lookups(lookupsToMake(this.def, h.state, input));
    return this.turn(h, input, { lookups, memberships: { groups: this.world.groupsOf(as.id) } }, ctx);
  }

  admin(as: Ref, requestId: string, action: "retry" | "close", reason: string, at?: Timestamp): TurnResult {
    return this.at(at, () => this.adminNow(as, requestId, action, reason));
  }

  private adminNow(as: Ref, requestId: string, action: "retry" | "close", reason: string): TurnResult {
    const h = this.requests.get(requestId);
    if (h === undefined) return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
    if (!this.world.isAdmin(as)) return refused({ code: "not-admin", params: {} });
    if (reason.trim() === "") return refused({ code: "reason-required", params: {} });
    // runtime-api.md 5.1: a reason is 1 to 2000 characters after trimming.
    if (reason.trim().length > 2000) return refused({ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "/reason", problem: "tooLong" } });
    if (h.state.closed !== null) return refused({ code: "request-closed", params: {} });
    const by: EventBy = { type: "user", id: as.id };
    if (action === "close") return this.turn(h, { kind: "admin", by, reason, actions: [{ type: "close" }] }, { isAdmin: true });
    const stuck = replay(this.r, h.events, { unfinished: this.unfinished }).at(-1)?.stuck ?? null;
    if (stuck === null) return refused({ code: "not-stuck", params: {} });
    if (stuck.reason !== "action-failed" && stuck.reason !== "nobody-to-ask") return refused({ code: "not-retryable", params: { reason: stuck.reason } });
    return this.turn(h, { kind: "admin", by, reason, actions: [{ type: "retry" }] }, { isAdmin: true });
  }

  answerCall(call: CallRef, answer: CallAnswer, at?: Timestamp): TurnResult {
    return this.at(at, () => this.answerCallNow(call, answer));
  }

  private answerCallNow(call: CallRef, answer: CallAnswer): TurnResult {
    const c = this.calls.get(call);
    if (c === undefined || c.entry.state !== "pending") return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "call" } });
    const data: JsonObject = answer.outcome === "ok" ? toJsonObject(answer.data) : this.world.failure(c.entry.operation, answer.error);
    const delivered = this.deliver(c, { outcome: answer.outcome, data });
    if (!delivered.ok) return delivered;
    this.settle(delivered.opened);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  setCallFake(operation: CatalogueRef, fake: CallFake): void {
    this.callFakes.set(operation, fake);
  }

  outbox(requestId?: string): OutboxEntry[] {
    const list = this.entries.filter((e) => requestId === undefined || e.requestId === requestId);
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(list)) as OutboxEntry[];
  }

  request(requestId: string, as?: Ref): RequestView | { ok: false; refusals: Refusal[] } {
    const h = this.requests.get(requestId);
    if (h === undefined) return refused({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
    return requestView(this.published, h.events, {
      viewer: this.viewer(as), why: h.traces, calls: true, unfinished: this.unfinished, attempts: () => 1,
    });
  }
}

function sameWait(a: WaitId, b: WaitId): boolean {
  return a.element === b.element && a.activation === b.activation && a.key === b.key && a.seq === b.seq;

 * kernel's `at`). It is never earlier than the request's previous event: an earlier one is taken as that event's

/** The authored ID rule (authored format rule 2; E-23). */
import { ID_PATTERN, ITEM_KINDS, type ItemKind } from "./contract/authored-format.ts";

const PATTERN = new RegExp(ID_PATTERN);

export type IdPrefix = keyof typeof ITEM_KINDS;

/** Matches `ID_PATTERN` (so at most 40 characters) and holds no `__`, which the compiler reserves. */
export function followsIdRule(id: string): boolean {
  return PATTERN.test(id) && !id.includes("__");
}

/** Whether `id` carries `prefix` followed by `_`. */
export function hasPrefix(id: string, prefix: IdPrefix): boolean {
  return id.startsWith(`${prefix}_`);
}

/** The kind of item an ID names by its prefix, or undefined. */
export function kindOfId(id: string): ItemKind | undefined {
  const cut = id.indexOf("_");
  if (cut <= 0) return undefined;
  const prefix = id.slice(0, cut);
  return Object.hasOwn(ITEM_KINDS, prefix) ? ITEM_KINDS[prefix as IdPrefix] : undefined;
}
