/**
 * JSON to CEL runtime values, by declared type (cel-1, E-18).
 * - A declared `int` must be a JSON integer within +/-(2^53 - 1); it becomes a BigInt.
 * - A declared `double` is any JSON number; it stays a JS number, even when it has no fraction.
 * - Under `dyn`, a safe integer becomes an `int` and any other number a `double`
 *   (after `JSON.parse`, `3` and `3.0` cannot be told apart).
 * - Objects become `Map`s, so no key can reach a prototype.
 * Pure; no library import.
 */
import type { CelType, JsonValue, PathSegment } from "./types.ts";

export class ContextTypeError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly path: PathSegment[];
  constructor(code: string, path: PathSegment[], message: string) {
    super(`${path.join(".") || "(root)"}: ${message}`);
    this.name = "ContextTypeError";
    this.code = code;
    this.path = path;
  }
}

export const JSON_SAFE_MAX = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; // 2^53 - 1

function describe(value: JsonValue): string {
  if (value === null) return "null";
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return "array";
  return typeof value;
}

function mismatch(path: PathSegment[], expected: string, value: JsonValue): never {
  throw new ContextTypeError("context-type-mismatch", path, `expected ${expected}, got ${describe(value)}`);
}

export function jsonToCel(value: JsonValue, type: CelType, path: PathSegment[] = []): unknown {
  switch (type.kind) {
    case "string":
      return typeof value === "string" ? value : mismatch(path, "string", value);
    case "bool":
      return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : mismatch(path, "bool", value);
    case "int":
      if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(value)) return mismatch(path, "int", value);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) {
        throw new ContextTypeError("int-out-of-range", path, `integer ${value} is outside +/-(2^53 - 1)`);
      }
      return BigInt(value);
    case "double":
      return typeof value === "number" ? value : mismatch(path, "double", value);
    case "list":
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) return mismatch(path, "list", value);
      return value.map((v, i) => jsonToCel(v, type.element, [...path, i]));
    case "map": {
      if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return mismatch(path, "map", value);
      const out = new Map<string, unknown>();
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) out.set(k, jsonToCel(v, type.value, [...path, k]));
      return out;
    }
    case "object": {
      if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return mismatch(path, "object", value);
      const out = new Map<string, unknown>();
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
        out.set(k, jsonToCel(v, Object.hasOwn(type.fields, k) ? (type.fields[k] as CelType) : { kind: "dyn" }, [...path, k]));
      }
      return out;
    }
    case "dyn":
      return dynToCel(value, path);
  }
}

/** The subset of JSON Schema 2020-12 that decides a CEL type. */
export interface SchemaLike {
  type?: string | string[];
  properties?: Record<string, SchemaLike>;
  additionalProperties?: boolean | SchemaLike;
  items?: SchemaLike;
}

/**
 * The declared CEL type of a JSON Schema. `"number"` is always `double`; `"integer"` is `int`.
 * `date` and `date-time` strings stay strings: an expression reads them with `date()` and `timestamp()`.
 * Anything this cannot type exactly is `dyn`.
 */
export function celTypeFromSchema(schema: SchemaLike): CelType {
  switch (schema.type) {
    case "string":
      return { kind: "string" };
    case "integer":
      return { kind: "int" };
    case "number":
      return { kind: "double" };
    case "boolean":
      return { kind: "bool" };
    case "array":
      return { kind: "list", element: schema.items ? celTypeFromSchema(schema.items) : { kind: "dyn" } };
    case "object": {
      if (schema.properties) {
        const fields: Record<string, CelType> = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(schema.properties)) fields[k] = celTypeFromSchema(v);
        return { kind: "object", fields };
      }
      const ap = schema.additionalProperties;
      return { kind: "map", value: typeof ap === "object" ? celTypeFromSchema(ap) : { kind: "dyn" } };
    }
    default:
      return { kind: "dyn" };
  }
}

function dynToCel(value: JsonValue, path: PathSegment[]): unknown {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "boolean") return value;
  if (typeof value === "number") return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? BigInt(value) : value;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v, i) => dynToCel(v, [...path, i]));
  const out = new Map<string, unknown>();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) out.set(k, dynToCel(v, [...path, k]));
  return out;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/cel/reads.ts\n===
/**
 * What an expression read (E-18, E-20; kernel spec section 5, `TransitionFired.reads`;
 * definition-format.md section 5.8): every path it selected from the request, with the value at
 * its end or absent.
 *
 * Derived from the expression tree, not from the evaluator, so it does not depend on the library's
 * evaluation order:
 * 1. At check time, collect every maximal selection chain rooted at a request-rooted variable
 *    (`data`, `waits`, `request`, `actor`, `input`, as the caller marks them).
 *    - An index with a literal key, or with a key that is itself a request chain, continues the chain;
 *      the key's chain is also a read.
 *    - Any other index ends the chain at its receiver; the key's own chains are reads.
 *    - Constants are not roots, so they are never recorded: `approverGroup[data.form.primaryDomain]`
 *      reads only `data.form.primaryDomain`.
 *    - A chain rooted at a comprehension or `cel.bind` variable is not a read; the range is.
 * 2. At evaluation, each chain is looked up in the JSON context. A missing field, key or index is `absent`.
 *    Every chain is listed, including one that short-circuiting skipped. Order: where the path begins in
 *    the source. Each path once.
 * Pure; no library import.
 */
import type { CelNode, JsonValue, PathSegment, CelRead } from "./types.ts";

export type ChainStep =
  | { kind: "segment"; segment: PathSegment }
  | { kind: "key"; chain: ReadChain };

export interface ReadChain {
  root: string;
  steps: ChainStep[];
  /** Where the path begins in the authored source; reads are listed in this order. */
  start: number;
}

const COMPREHENSIONS = new Set(["all", "exists", "exists_one", "map", "filter"]);

export function deriveReadChains(node: CelNode, roots: ReadonlySet<string>): ReadChain[] {
  const out: ReadChain[] = [];

  const asChain = (n: CelNode, bound: ReadonlySet<string>): ReadChain | null => {
    switch (n.op) {
      case "ident":
        return !bound.has(n.name) && roots.has(n.name) ? { root: n.name, steps: [], start: n.range.start } : null;
      case "select": {
        const c = asChain(n.operand, bound);
        return c ? { ...c, steps: [...c.steps, { kind: "segment", segment: n.field }] } : null;
      }
      case "index": {
        const c = asChain(n.operand, bound);
        if (!c) return null;
        const k = n.index;
        if (k.op === "literal") {
          if (typeof k.value === "string") return { ...c, steps: [...c.steps, { kind: "segment", segment: k.value }] };
          if (typeof k.value === "bigint" || typeof k.value === "number") {
            return { ...c, steps: [...c.steps, { kind: "segment", segment: Number(k.value) }] };
          }
          return null;
        }
        const kc = asChain(k, bound);
        return kc ? { ...c, steps: [...c.steps, { kind: "key", chain: kc }] } : null;
      }
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  const push = (c: ReadChain): void => {
    for (const s of c.steps) if (s.kind === "key") push(s.chain);
    out.push(c);
  };

  const visit = (n: CelNode, bound: ReadonlySet<string>): void => {
    const c = asChain(n, bound);
    if (c) {
      push(c);
      return;
    }
    switch (n.op) {
      case "literal":
      case "ident":
        return;
      case "select":
        visit(n.operand, bound);
        return;
      case "index":
        visit(n.operand, bound);
        visit(n.index, bound);
        return;
      case "list":
        for (const e of n.elements) visit(e, bound);
        return;
      case "map":
        for (const [k, v] of n.entries) {
          visit(k, bound);
          visit(v, bound);
        }
        return;
      case "operator":
        for (const a of n.args) visit(a, bound);
        return;
      case "call": {
        const first = n.args[0];
        const isComprehension = n.target !== null && COMPREHENSIONS.has(n.name) && first?.op === "ident";
        const isBind = n.name === "bind" && n.target?.op === "ident" && n.target.name === "cel" && first?.op === "ident";
        if (isComprehension && first?.op === "ident") {
          if (n.target) visit(n.target, bound);
          const inner = new Set(bound).add(first.name);
          for (const a of n.args.slice(1)) visit(a, inner);
          return;
        }
        if (isBind && first?.op === "ident") {
          const init = n.args[1];
          const body = n.args[2];
          if (init) visit(init, bound);
          if (body) visit(body, new Set(bound).add(first.name));
          return;
        }
        if (n.target) visit(n.target, bound);
        for (const a of n.args) visit(a, bound);
        return;
      }
    }
  };

  visit(node, new Set());
  // Array.prototype.sort is stable, so chains that begin at one position keep tree order.
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
}

type Lookup = { present: true; value: JsonValue } | { present: false };

function step(cur: JsonValue, seg: PathSegment): Lookup {
  if (typeof seg === "number") {
    if (Array.isArray(cur) && Number.isInteger(seg) && seg >= 0 && seg < cur.length) return { present: true, value: cur[seg] as JsonValue };
    return { present: false };
  }
  if (cur !== null && typeof cur === "object" && !Array.isArray(cur) && Object.hasOwn(cur, seg)) {
    return { present: true, value: cur[seg] as JsonValue };
  }
  return { present: false };
}

/** Looks one chain up. A key that cannot be resolved to a string or number ends the path at its receiver. */
export function resolveChain(chain: ReadChain, context: Readonly<Record<string, JsonValue>>): CelRead {
  const path: PathSegment[] = [chain.root];
  let cur: Lookup = Object.hasOwn(context, chain.root)
    ? { present: true, value: context[chain.root] as JsonValue }
    : { present: false };
  for (const s of chain.steps) {
    let seg: PathSegment;
    if (s.kind === "segment") seg = s.segment;
    else {
      const key = resolveChain(s.chain, context);
      if (!("value" in key) || (typeof key.value !== "string" && typeof key.value !== "number")) break;
      seg = key.value;
    }
    path.push(seg);
    cur = cur.present ? step(cur.value, seg) : cur;
  }
  return cur.present ? { path, value: cur.value } : { path, absent: true };
}

export function resolveReads(chains: readonly ReadChain[], context: Readonly<Record<string, JsonValue>>): CelRead[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const reads: CelRead[] = [];
  for (const c of chains) {
    const r = resolveChain(c, context);
    const k = JSON.stringify(r.path);
    if (seen.has(k)) continue;
    seen.add(k);
    reads.push(r);
  }
  return reads;
}

/**
 * The engine's own CEL vocabulary. Nothing in this file depends on the CEL library;
 * only `environment.ts` imports it.
 */

/** A JSON value as it is stored in data, events and definitions. `null` only where a payload field is nullable. */
export type JsonValue = string | number | boolean | null | JsonValue[] | { [key: string]: JsonValue };

/**
 * A declared type. Derived from the JSON Schemas of the definition (forms, connector results),
 * from the CEL context the spec defines, and from constants.
 * - `int` is a JSON integer (`"type": "integer"`); `double` is any JSON number (`"type": "number"`).
 * - `object` is a JSON object with known properties. A property may be absent.
 * - `map` is a JSON object with string keys and values of one type.
 */
export type CelType =
  | { kind: "string" }
  | { kind: "int" }
  | { kind: "double" }
  | { kind: "bool" }
  | { kind: "dyn" }
  | { kind: "list"; element: CelType }
  | { kind: "map"; value: CelType }
  | { kind: "object"; fields: Readonly<Record<string, CelType>> };

export const t = {
  string: { kind: "string" } as CelType,
  int: { kind: "int" } as CelType,
  double: { kind: "double" } as CelType,
  bool: { kind: "bool" } as CelType,
  dyn: { kind: "dyn" } as CelType,
  list: (element: CelType): CelType => ({ kind: "list", element }),
  map: (value: CelType): CelType => ({ kind: "map", value }),
  object: (fields: Record<string, CelType>): CelType => ({ kind: "object", fields }),
};

/** What an environment declares: variables supplied per evaluation, and constants fixed at publish. */
export interface CelDeclarations {
  variables: Readonly<Record<string, CelType>>;
  constants?: Readonly<Record<string, { type: CelType; value: JsonValue }>>;
  /**
   * The variables whose paths are recorded as reads (kernel spec section 5, `TransitionFired.reads`).
   * Omitted: those of `REQUEST_ROOTED_VARIABLES` that are declared. A name that is not a declared
   * variable is an error.
   */
  requestRooted?: readonly string[];
}

/** The context variables rooted in the request (E-20): the default for `CelDeclarations.requestRooted`. */
export const REQUEST_ROOTED_VARIABLES: readonly string[] = ["data", "waits", "request", "actor", "input"];

/** A half-open range of UTF-16 code unit offsets into the expression source. */
export interface SourceRange {
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

/** A parse or type-check problem. `code` is kebab-case. */
export interface CelProblem {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  range: SourceRange;
  /** The library's own code, for engineers. Not stable across library versions. */
  libraryCode?: string;
}

/** What went wrong while evaluating (contract/core-api.md, `ExpressionErrorKind`). Open list. */
export type ExpressionErrorKind =
  | "no-such-key"
  | "index-out-of-range"
  | "absent-value"
  | "wrong-kind"
  | "division-by-zero"
  | "overflow"
  | "other";

/** The result of evaluating a checked expression. */
export type CelResult =
  | { kind: "value"; value: JsonValue }
  /** The expression returned `optional.none()`. A Set removes the path. */
  | { kind: "absent" }
  | {
      kind: "error";
      code: ExpressionErrorKind;
      /** The specific cause, kebab-case: `invalid-date`, `int-out-of-range`, `no-matching-overload`. */
      detail: string;
      message: string;
      range?: SourceRange;
      /** For `no-such-key`: the key that was missing, as text. */
      key?: string;
      /** For `index-out-of-range`: the list position that was asked for. */
      index?: number;
      /** The library's own code, for engineers. Not stable across library versions. */
      libraryCode?: string;
    };

/** One segment of a read path: a field name or map key, or a list index. */
export type PathSegment = string | number;

/**
 * What an expression read: the value at the end of a selected path, or absent. The stored format's `Read`
 * (format/events.ts) is the same shape over stored JSON; this one is the expression module's own.
 */
export type CelRead = { path: PathSegment[]; value: JsonValue } | { path: PathSegment[]; absent: true };

/**
 * The engine's own expression tree, converted from the library's AST.
 * Used for read derivation and for the checks the wrapper adds. Positions are into the authored source.
 */
export type CelNode =
  | { op: "literal"; value: string | number | bigint | boolean | null | Uint8Array; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "ident"; name: string; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "select"; optional: boolean; operand: CelNode; field: string; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "index"; optional: boolean; operand: CelNode; index: CelNode; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "call"; name: string; target: CelNode | null; args: CelNode[]; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "list"; elements: CelNode[]; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "map"; entries: [CelNode, CelNode][]; range: SourceRange }
  | { op: "operator"; operator: string; args: CelNode[]; range: SourceRange };
===\nengine/packages/core/src/format/definition-shape.ts\n===
/**
 * validateDefinitionShape: does a JSON value have the shape of a published definition, format 1
 * (definition-format.md sections 1, 3 and 8)? Used to load a stored definition safely before `decide` reads it.
 *
 * Shape only: field presence, JSON types, the literal values the format fixes, `null` only where a field is
 * nullable, and no key starting with `$` (section 1). ID patterns, references between elements and CEL are
 * publish checks (section 9), not shape.
 */
import { VALUE_KINDS, type PublishedDefinition } from "./definition.ts";
import { isJsonObject } from "./json.ts";

export interface DefinitionShapeProblem {
  /** RFC 6901 pointer into the document. */
  pointer: string;
  problem: "missing" | "unknown-field" | "wrong-type" | "wrong-value" | "dollar-key";
  /** What was expected there, for engineers: "string", "integer", `"person" | "call"`. */
  expected: string;
}

export type DefinitionShapeResult =
  | { ok: true; definition: PublishedDefinition }
  | { ok: false; problems: DefinitionShapeProblem[] };

type Out = DefinitionShapeProblem[];
type Shape = (value: unknown, pointer: string, out: Out) => void;

function child(pointer: string, key: string | number): string {
  return `${pointer}/${String(key).replace(/~/g, "~0").replace(/\//g, "~1")}`;
}

const str: Shape = (v, p, out) => {
  if (typeof v !== "string") out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "string" });
};

const bool: Shape = (v, p, out) => {
  if (typeof v !== "boolean") out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "boolean" });
};

/** An integer from 1, as every version number in the format is. */
const positiveInt: Shape = (v, p, out) => {
  if (typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(v) || v < 1) {
    out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "integer from 1" });
  }
};

function literal(...values: readonly (string | number | null)[]): Shape {
  const expected = values.map((x) => JSON.stringify(x)).join(" | ");
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (!values.includes(v as string | number | null)) {
      const problem = typeof v === typeof values[0] ? "wrong-value" : "wrong-type";
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem, expected });
    }
  };
}

function nullable(shape: Shape): Shape {
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (v !== null) shape(v, p, out);
  };
}

function array(item: Shape): Shape {
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(v)) {
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "array" });
      return;
    }
    v.forEach((x, i) => item(x, child(p, i), out));
  };
}

function dollarKeys(v: Record<string, unknown>, p: string, out: Out): void {
  for (const key of Object.keys(v)) {
    if (key.startsWith("$")) out.push({ pointer: child(p, key), problem: "dollar-key", expected: "no key starting with $" });
  }
}

/** A map with string keys; no key starts with `$` (section 1). */
function record(value: Shape): Shape {
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (!isJsonObject(v)) {
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "object" });
      return;
    }
    dollarKeys(v, p, out);
    for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) if (!k.startsWith("$")) value(x, child(p, k), out);
  };
}

/** JSON with no null anywhere (section 1: constants, types, schemas and parameters never hold null). */
const json: Shape = (v, p, out) => {
  if (typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "boolean") return;
  if (typeof v === "number") {
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "JSON value" });
    return;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return array(json)(v, p, out);
  if (isJsonObject(v)) return record(json)(v, p, out);
  out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "JSON value other than null" });
};

interface ObjectOptions {
  optional?: readonly string[];
  /** Keys not listed are allowed and not read (only the top level: section 1 lets a new block be added). */
  open?: boolean;
}

function object(fields: Record<string, Shape>, options: ObjectOptions = {}): Shape {
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (!isJsonObject(v)) {
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "object" });
      return;
    }
    dollarKeys(v, p, out);
    for (const [name, shape] of Object.entries(fields)) {
      if (!Object.hasOwn(v, name)) {
        if (!options.optional?.includes(name)) out.push({ pointer: child(p, name), problem: "missing", expected: "present" });
        continue;
      }
      shape(v[name], child(p, name), out);
    }
    if (options.open) return;
    for (const key of Object.keys(v)) {
      if (!key.startsWith("$") && !Object.hasOwn(fields, key)) {
        out.push({ pointer: child(p, key), problem: "unknown-field", expected: "absent" });
      }
    }
  };
}

/** One of several object shapes, chosen by the value of one field. */
function tagged(tag: string, variants: Record<string, Shape>): Shape {
  const expected = Object.keys(variants)
    .map((x) => JSON.stringify(x))
    .join(" | ");
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (!isJsonObject(v)) {
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "object" });
      return;
    }
    const t = v[tag];
    const variant = typeof t === "string" && Object.hasOwn(variants, t) ? variants[t] : undefined;
    if (variant === undefined) {
      out.push({ pointer: child(p, tag), problem: Object.hasOwn(v, tag) ? "wrong-value" : "missing", expected });
      return;
    }
    variant(v, p, out);
  };
}

/** One of several object shapes, chosen by which distinguishing field is present. */
function byField(variants: Record<string, Shape>): Shape {
  const expected = Object.keys(variants).join(" | ");
  return (v, p, out) => {
    if (!isJsonObject(v)) {
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "wrong-type", expected: "object" });
      return;
    }
    const field = Object.keys(variants).find((f) => Object.hasOwn(v, f));
    const variant = field === undefined ? undefined : variants[field];
    if (variant === undefined) {
      out.push({ pointer: p, problem: "missing", expected: `one of ${expected}` });
      return;
    }
    variant(v, p, out);
  };
}

function both(...shapes: Shape[]): Shape {
  return (v, p, out) => {
    const before = out.length;
    for (const shape of shapes) {
      shape(v, p, out);
      if (out.length > before) return;
    }
  };
}

/** `when` is null exactly when `otherwise` is true (section 3.4). */
const otherwiseRule: Shape = (v, p, out) => {
  const t = v as { otherwise: boolean; when: unknown };
  if (t.otherwise !== (t.when === null)) {
    out.push({ pointer: child(p, "when"), problem: "wrong-value", expected: t.otherwise ? "null" : "string" });
  }
};

/** Exactly one of `keyScope` and `idempotencyKey` is non-null (section 3.3). */
const keyRule: Shape = (v, p, out) => {
  const c = v as { keyScope: unknown; idempotencyKey: unknown };
  if ((c.keyScope === null) === (c.idempotencyKey === null)) {
    out.push({ pointer: child(p, "idempotencyKey"), problem: "wrong-value", expected: "exactly one of keyScope and idempotencyKey" });
  }
};

const path = array(str);
const cel = str;
const jsonSchema = record(json);

const check = object({ id: str, when: cel, message: str });

const lookup = object({
  property: str,
  connection: str,
  source: str,
  inputs: record(cel),
  storedField: str,
  labelField: str,
  answer: literal("item", "person"),
});

const outcome = object({ id: str, schema: str, checks: array(check), lookups: array(lookup) });

const personWait = object({
  id: str,
  kind: literal("person"),
  role: literal("obligation", "option"),
  assignees: cel,
  may: cel,
  outcomes: array(outcome),
});

const callWait = both(
  object({
    id: str,
    kind: literal("call"),
    connection: str,
    op: str,
    args: record(cel),
    effect: literal("read", "write"),
    onFailure: literal("fault", "outcome"),
    keyScope: nullable(literal("activation")),
    idempotencyKey: nullable(cel),
  }),
  keyRule,
);

const wait = tagged("kind", { person: personWait, call: callWait });

const transition = both(
  object({
    id: str,
    otherwise: bool,
    when: nullable(cel),
    set: array(object({ path, expr: cel })),
    to: str,
  }),
  otherwiseRule,
);

const childStage = object({
  id: str,
  final: bool,
  status: nullable(str),
  waits: array(wait),
  transitions: array(transition),
});

const rootStage = object({ initial: str, stages: array(childStage) });

const status = object({ id: str, label: str, color: str });

const ruleOn = object({ event: str, element: nullable(str) });

const messagePart = byField({
  text: object({ text: str }),
  value: object({ value: cel, kind: literal(...VALUE_KINDS) }),
});

const message = byField({
  words: object({ words: str }),
  parts: object({ parts: array(messagePart) }),
});

const recipient = tagged("type", {
  expr: object({ type: literal("expr"), expr: cel }),
  workflowAdmins: object({ type: literal("workflowAdmins") }),
});

const notificationRule = object({
  id: str,
  on: ruleOn,
  when: cel,
  send: object({ message, to: array(recipient) }),
});

const triggerBinding = object({
  id: str,
  connection: str,
  event: str,
  when: cel,
  outcome: str,
  data: record(cel),
});

const eventRule = object({
  id: str,
  on: ruleOn,
  when: cel,
  told: object({ id: str, words: str }),
  values: record(cel),
});

const nobodyToAskRule = object({ id: str, wait: str, members: nullable(str), excludeRequester: bool });

const origin = object({ item: array(str), part: nullable(str) });

const declaredTypes = object({
  data: record(jsonSchema),
  constants: record(jsonSchema),
  results: record(record(jsonSchema)),
});

const pinnedSchema = object({ id: str, version: positiveInt, schema: jsonSchema });

const definition = object(
  {
    format: literal(1),
    workflow: str,
    version: positiveInt,
    compiler: str,
    runtime: object({ cel: literal("cel-1"), validator: literal("jsonschema-1") }),
    start: str,
    root: rootStage,
    statuses: array(status),
    notifications: array(notificationRule),
    constants: record(json),
    types: declaredTypes,
    schemas: record(pinnedSchema),
    origins: record(origin),
    triggers: array(triggerBinding),
    events: array(eventRule),
    nobodyToAsk: array(nobodyToAskRule),
  },
  { optional: ["triggers", "events", "nobodyToAsk"], open: true },
);

export function validateDefinitionShape(value: unknown): DefinitionShapeResult {
  const problems: Out = [];
  definition(value, "", problems);
  return problems.length === 0 ? { ok: true, definition: value as PublishedDefinition } : { ok: false, problems };
}

/**
 * The published definition, JSON format 1, exactly as engine/design/definition-format.md section 8 declares it.
 * Kept for ever once the first request runs: a change `decide` would see is a new format number.
 */
import type { Json } from "./json.ts";

/** CEL source text, profile cel-1. */
export type Cel = string;
export type WorkflowId = string; // ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$
export type StageId = string; // Name; "root" for the root stage
export type LocalId = string; // Names joined by "."
export type FullId = string; // `${StageId}.${LocalId}`
export type SchemaRef = string; // `${schemaId}@${version}`
export type ConnectionId = string; // ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$
export type EntryRef = string; // `${name}@${version}`, without the connection
export type Path = string[];
export type JsonSchema = { [keyword: string]: Json }; // profile jsonschema-1

export interface PublishedDefinition {
  format: 1;
  workflow: WorkflowId;
  version: number;
  compiler: string;
  runtime: Runtime;
  start: FullId;
  root: RootStage;
  statuses: Status[];
  notifications: NotificationRule[];
  constants: { [name: string]: Json };
  types: DeclaredTypes;
  schemas: { [ref: SchemaRef]: PinnedSchema };
  origins: { [originKey: string]: Origin };
  triggers?: TriggerBinding[]; // absent when empty; decide never reads it
  events?: EventRule[]; // absent when empty; decide never reads it
  nobodyToAsk?: NobodyToAskRule[]; // absent when empty; decide never reads it
}

export interface Runtime {
  cel: "cel-1";
  validator: "jsonschema-1";
}

/** The root stage is always active and declares only its child stages (spec section 2). */
export interface RootStage {
  initial: StageId;
  stages: ChildStage[];
}

export interface ChildStage {
  id: StageId;
  final: boolean;
  status: string | null; // a status ID
  waits: Wait[];
  transitions: Transition[];
}

export type Wait = PersonWait | CallWait;

export interface PersonWait {
  id: LocalId;
  kind: "person";
  role: "obligation" | "option";
  assignees: Cel; // -> list<{type, id}>
  may: Cel; // -> bool
  outcomes: Outcome[];
}

export interface Outcome {
  id: string;
  schema: SchemaRef;
  checks: Check[];
  lookups: Lookup[];
}

export interface Check {
  id: string;
  when: Cel; // -> bool; true means the check passes
  message: string;
}

export interface Lookup {
  property: string;
  connection: ConnectionId;
  source: EntryRef; // a dataSource entry
  inputs: { [field: string]: Cel }; // over input, data, constants
  storedField: string;
  labelField: string;
  answer: "item" | "person";
}

export interface CallWait {
  id: LocalId;
  kind: "call";
  connection: ConnectionId;
  op: EntryRef; // an operation entry
  args: { [name: string]: Cel };
  effect: "read" | "write";
  onFailure: "fault" | "outcome";
  keyScope: "activation" | null;
  idempotencyKey: Cel | null;
}

export interface Transition {
  id: LocalId;
  otherwise: boolean;
  when: Cel | null; // null exactly when otherwise is true
  set: SetEntry[];
  to: StageId;
}

export interface SetEntry {
  path: Path;
  expr: Cel;
}

export interface Status {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  color: "grey" | "red" | "amber" | "green" | "blue" | "purple" | "teal" | "pink" | (string & {});
}

export interface NotificationRule {
  id: string;
  on: RuleOn;
  when: Cel;
  send: { message: Message; to: Recipient[] };
}

export interface RuleOn {
  event: string; // a recorded event type, or "Stuck"
  element: string | null;
}

export type Message =
  | { words: string } // a key of contract/words/notifications.json
  | { parts: MessagePart[] };

export type MessagePart = { text: string } | { value: Cel; kind: ValueKind };

/** contract/authored-format.ts ValueKind. */
export type ValueKind =
  | "text"
  | "longText"
  | "number"
  | "yesNo"
  | "date"
  | "choice"
  | "multipleChoice"
  | "person"
  | "group"
  | "choiceFromList"
  | "choiceFromConnection"
  | "people"
  | "list"
  | "fieldGroup";

export const VALUE_KINDS: readonly ValueKind[] = [
  "text",
  "longText",
  "number",
  "yesNo",
  "date",
  "choice",
  "multipleChoice",
  "person",
  "group",
  "choiceFromList",
  "choiceFromConnection",
  "people",
  "list",
  "fieldGroup",
];

export type Recipient = { type: "expr"; expr: Cel } | { type: "workflowAdmins" };

export interface TriggerBinding {
  id: string; // sw_...
  connection: ConnectionId;
  event: EntryRef; // a trigger entry
  when: Cel; // over sent and constants
  outcome: string; // an outcome of the start wait
  data: { [property: string]: Cel }; // over sent and constants; "requester" names the Requester
}

export interface EventRule {
  id: string; // act_...
  on: RuleOn;
  when: Cel;
  told: { id: string; words: string };
  values: { [name: string]: Cel };
}

export interface NobodyToAskRule {
  id: string; // `${waitFullId}__nobody`
  wait: FullId;
  members: FullId | null;
  excludeRequester: boolean;
}

export interface Origin {
  item: string[];
  part: string | null;
}

export interface DeclaredTypes {
  data: { [key: string]: JsonSchema };
  constants: { [name: string]: JsonSchema };
  results: { [connection: ConnectionId]: { [op: EntryRef]: JsonSchema } };
}

export interface PinnedSchema {
  id: string;
  version: number;
  schema: JsonSchema;
}

/**
 * Every event at `v: 1` with its envelope, exactly as engine/design/event-payloads.md declares them.
 * Kept for ever once the first request runs: a field added, removed, renamed or retyped is a new `v`.
 */
import type { Json, JsonObject } from "./json.ts";

/** Who caused something. type is an open enum. */
export interface By {
  type: "user" | "connection" | "system" | (string & {});
  id: string; // user: the directory's immutable object ID; connection: the connection ID; system: "engine"
}

/** A user or group reference (E-20): the only form of a person or group in data. */
export interface Ref {
  type: "user" | "group" | (string & {});
  id: string; // the directory's immutable object ID
}

/** A wait instance's identity (spec section 2). */
export interface WaitId {
  element: string; // full element ID: "Pending.primary.decision"
  activation: string; // the activation of its stage: "a3"
  key: string; // always ""
  seq: number; // ordinal per (element, activation, key), from 1
}

export interface StatusRef {
  id: string; // the status ID
  label: string; // its words at the request's definition version
}

/** One write to the data document. */
export type PatchOp = { op: "set"; path: string[]; value: Json } | { op: "remove"; path: string[] };

/** One path an expression read (event-payloads.md section 3.5). A list index is a number segment. */
export type Read = { path: (string | number)[]; value: Json } | { path: (string | number)[]; absent: true };

// Section 4: envelope.

export type EventType =
  | "RequestStarted"
  | "WaitCompleted"
  | "CallResultLate"
  | "Overridden"
  | "TransitionFired"
  | "StageEntered"
  | "StageExited"
  | "WaitOpened"
  | "WaitCancelled"
  | "WaitSkipped"
  | "DataSet"
  | "Faulted"
  | "RequestClosed";

export const EVENT_TYPES: readonly EventType[] = [
  "RequestStarted",
  "WaitCompleted",
  "CallResultLate",
  "Overridden",
  "TransitionFired",
  "StageEntered",
  "StageExited",
  "WaitOpened",
  "WaitCancelled",
  "WaitSkipped",
  "DataSet",
  "Faulted",
  "RequestClosed",
];

/** The four input event types (spec section 5); every other type is a decision. */
export const INPUT_EVENT_TYPES: readonly EventType[] = ["RequestStarted", "WaitCompleted", "CallResultLate", "Overridden"];

export type PayloadOf<T extends EventType> = {
  RequestStarted: RequestStarted;
  WaitCompleted: WaitCompleted;
  CallResultLate: CallResultLate;
  Overridden: Overridden;
  TransitionFired: TransitionFired;
  StageEntered: StageEntered;
  StageExited: StageExited;
  WaitOpened: WaitOpened;
  WaitCancelled: WaitCancelled;
  WaitSkipped: WaitSkipped;
  DataSet: DataSet;
  Faulted: Faulted;
  RequestClosed: RequestClosed;
}[T];

export interface EventRecord<T extends EventType = EventType> {
  requestId: string;
  seq: number; // 1, 2, 3 ... per request, gap-free
  type: T;
  at: string; // RFC 3339 UTC, 6 fractional digits; the only clock
  turn: number; // seq of the input that caused it
  v: number; // schema version of this event type; 1 for every type now
  engineBuild: string; // diagnostic: core version and commit
  payload: PayloadOf<T>;
}

/** Any event, discriminated by `type` so a reader can narrow its payload. */
export type AnyEventRecord = { [T in EventType]: EventRecord<T> }[EventType];

// Section 5: payloads.

export interface RequestStarted {
  workflow: string; // the workflow ID (L1, E-23; the spec's "definition")
  version: number; // the definition version
  readableId: number;
  by: By; // the starter: a user, or the connection of a binding
  input: { outcome: string; data: JsonObject }; // for the start wait
  trigger: StartTrigger | null; // null when a person started the request
}

/** A start through a binding of the `triggers` block. `kind` is an open enum; `event` is the only kind written. */
export type StartTrigger = EventTrigger;
export interface EventTrigger {
  kind: "event";
  id: string; // the binding's ID in the triggers block of this version
  connection: string; // the connection ID; equals by.id
  event: string; // the catalogue trigger, "<name>@<version>"
  eventId: string; // the sender's ID for this occurrence, 1 to 255 characters
}

export interface WaitCompleted {
  wait: WaitId;
  outcome: string; // person: the outcome ID; call: "ok" | "failed"
  data: JsonObject; // person: the submitted data after lookups; call: the result, or { code, message }
  by: By; // person: the actor; call: { type: "connection", id }
  evidence: Evidence | null; // null for a call wait
}

export interface Evidence {
  memberOf: string[]; // group IDs among the recorded assignees the actor belongs to
  checks: { id: string; reads: Read[] }[]; // each check that ran, in order
  lookups: LookupFound[]; // one per data-source answer looked up, in the outcome's lookups order
}

export interface LookupFound {
  property: string; // the question ID
  connection: string;
  source: string; // "<name>@<version>"
  inputs: JsonObject; // as evaluated for this act; an input whose expression gave none is absent
  stored: string | number; // what was looked up: the answer's stored value, or a person's id
  label: string | null; // the item's labelField value; null for answer "person"
}

export interface CallResultLate {
  wait: WaitId;
  outcome: "ok" | "failed" | (string & {});
  data: JsonObject; // the result, or { code, message }
}

export interface Overridden {
  by: By;
  reason: string;
  actions: AdminAction[]; // applied in order
}

/** Spec section 4: retry clears any fault and re-enters the active child stage; close ends the request. */
export type AdminAction = { type: "retry" } | { type: "close" };

export interface TransitionFired {
  transition: string; // local ID: "t_accept"
  stage: string; // the declaring stage (L8)
  activation: string; // the declaring stage's activation
  reads: Read[]; // what `when` read; [] for otherwise
}

export interface StageEntered {
  activation: string;
  stage: string;
  status: StatusRef | null; // the stage's status at this version, or null (always null for root)
  parentActivation: string | null; // null for the root
}

export interface StageExited {
  activation: string;
  stage: string; // L8
  mode: "normal" | "forced" | (string & {});
}

export type WaitOpened = PersonWaitOpened | CallWaitOpened;

export interface PersonWaitOpened {
  wait: WaitId;
  kind: "person";
  role: "obligation" | "option" | (string & {});
  assignees: Ref[]; // resolved, not expanded; only user and group references; may be []
  outcomes: { id: string; schema: string }[]; // schema reference into the definition's schemas

/**
 * JSON as the stored formats hold it (event-payloads.md section 2, definition-format.md section 8).
 * A data value never holds null.
 */

/** JSON with no null: every data value. */
export type Json = string | number | boolean | Json[] | { [key: string]: Json };
export type JsonObject = { [key: string]: Json };

/** A plain JSON object (not an array, not null). */
export function isJsonObject(value: unknown): value is JsonObject {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const proto: unknown = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/host/fixtures.ts\n===
/**
 * The live lookups a host makes before a turn, answered from in-memory fixtures (contract/core-api.md
 * section 10.2: only I/O is replaced). The directory gives memberships; the sources give data-source items.
 */
import type { Json, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition } from "../format/index.ts";
import { lookupsToMake, type ActInput, type LookupAnswer, type RequestState, type StartInput } from "../kernel/index.ts";

export interface Fixtures {
  /** Group ID to the user IDs in it. */
  directory?: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  /** User IDs who are admins of every request (spec section 4: decided outside the kernel). */
  admins?: readonly string[];
  /** `<connection>/<source>` to the source's items. A source not listed cannot be reached. */
  sources?: Readonly<Record<string, readonly JsonObject[]>>;
}

/** The groups the actor is in, or undefined without a directory (an act on a group's wait is then refused "try again"). */
export function membershipsOf(fixtures: Fixtures, userId: string): { groups: string[] } | undefined {
  if (fixtures.directory === undefined) return undefined;
  return { groups: Object.entries(fixtures.directory).filter(([, members]) => members.includes(userId)).map(([group]) => group) };
}

function sameStored(a: Json | undefined, b: string | number): boolean {
  return a === b;
}

/** Each lookup the input needs, looked up by its stored value in the fixtures. `at` is the turn's time. */
export function lookupAnswers(fixtures: Fixtures, def: PublishedDefinition, state: RequestState, input: StartInput | ActInput, at: string): Record<string, LookupAnswer> {
  const answers: Record<string, LookupAnswer> = {};
  for (const l of lookupsToMake(def, state, input, at)) {
    const items = fixtures.sources?.[`${l.connection}/${l.source}`];
    if (items === undefined) {
      answers[l.property] = { unavailable: true };
      continue;
    }
    const item = items.find((i) => sameStored(i[l.storedField], l.stored));
    const label = item?.[l.labelField];
    answers[l.property] = item === undefined ? { found: false } : { found: true, label: l.answer === "item" ? (typeof label === "string" ? label : String(label ?? "")) : null };
  }
  return answers;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/src/host/host.ts\n===
/**
 * An in-memory host: the seed of the test host of contract/core-api.md section 10. It owns each request's
 * events, applies a turn with the kernel's `turn` (as the server's transaction does), checks a call's result
 * with `validateCallResult` before its turn, keeps an attempts log, works out the stuck state once per turn,
 * and lists the calls a turn opened so a test, and later Try it, can answer them. No persistence and no
 * clock: the time of every turn is passed in.
 */
import type { AdminAction, AnyEventRecord, By, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition, StartTrigger, WaitId } from "../format/index.ts";
import {
  DEFAULT_ENGINE_BUILD,
  emptyState,
  isWaitOpen,
  sameWait,
  turn as runTurn,
  validateCallResult,
  type CallResultCheck,
  type DecideContext,
  type DecideInput,
  type DropReason,
  type KernelRefusal,
  type RequestState,
  type TraceEntry,
} from "../kernel/index.ts";
import { lookupAnswers, membershipsOf, type Fixtures } from "./fixtures.ts";
import { stuckStateOf, type StuckState } from "../kernel/stuck/index.ts";

export interface MemoryHostOptions extends Fixtures {
  engineBuild?: string;
  /** Request IDs are `<prefix><n>`; default `req-`. */
  requestIdPrefix?: string;
  /** The first request's `n` and readable ID; default 1. */
  firstRequestNumber?: number;
}

/** A call a turn opened that has no recorded result yet. `waitOpen` is false once its wait was cancelled or skipped. */
export interface PendingCall {
  requestId: string;
  wait: WaitId;
  connection: string;
  op: string;
  effect: string;
  args: JsonObject;
  idempotencyKey: string;
  waitOpen: boolean;
}

/** A refused input that is an attempt (spec section 2: it goes to an attempts log outside history). */
export interface Attempt {
  requestId: string | null;
  input: DecideInput["kind"];
  at: string;
  refusals: KernelRefusal[];
}

export interface HostStuck extends StuckState {
  /** The `at` of the last event of the turn in which the request entered this stuck state. */
  at: string;
}

export type HostTurn =
  | { ok: true; requestId: string; events: AnyEventRecord[]; trace: TraceEntry[]; dropped: DropReason | null; stuck: HostStuck | null }
  /**
   * Not recorded. `resultInvalid` is set, and `refusals` is empty, when a call result does not fit its declared
   * shape: the call stays pending, as the dispatcher keeps it pending (integrations.md section 10.3).
   */
  | { ok: false; refusals: KernelRefusal[]; resultInvalid?: Extract<CallResultCheck, { ok: false }> };

export interface MemoryHost {
  start(input: { by: By; outcome: string; data: JsonObject; trigger?: StartTrigger | null }, at: string): HostTurn;
  act(requestId: string, input: { by: By; wait: WaitId; outcome: string; data: JsonObject }, at: string): HostTurn;
  answerCall(requestId: string, wait: WaitId, result: { outcome: "ok" | "failed"; data: JsonObject }, at: string): HostTurn;
  admin(requestId: string, input: { by: By; reason: string; actions: AdminAction[] }, at: string): HostTurn;
  events(requestId: string): readonly AnyEventRecord[];
  state(requestId: string): RequestState;
  stuck(requestId: string): HostStuck | null;
  pendingCalls(requestId?: string): PendingCall[];
  attempts(): readonly Attempt[];
}

interface Held {
  events: AnyEventRecord[];
  state: RequestState;
  pending: PendingCall[];
  stuck: HostStuck | null;
}

function sameStuck(a: StuckState | null, b: StuckState | null): boolean {
  return a === null || b === null ? a === b : a.reason === b.reason && a.stage === b.stage;
}

/** Keeps the pending calls in step with the events just appended. */
function trackCalls(held: Held, requestId: string, events: readonly AnyEventRecord[]): void {
  for (const e of events) {
    if (e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "call") {
      const p = e.payload;
      held.pending.push({ requestId, wait: p.wait, connection: p.connection, op: p.op, effect: p.effect, args: p.args, idempotencyKey: p.idempotencyKey, waitOpen: true });
    } else if (e.type === "WaitCompleted" || e.type === "CallResultLate") {
      const wait = e.payload.wait;
      held.pending = held.pending.filter((c) => !sameWait(c.wait, wait));
    } else if (e.type === "WaitCancelled" || e.type === "WaitSkipped") {
      const wait = e.payload.wait;
      held.pending = held.pending.map((c) => (sameWait(c.wait, wait) ? { ...c, waitOpen: false } : c));
    }
  }
}

export function createMemoryHost(definition: PublishedDefinition, options: MemoryHostOptions = {}): MemoryHost {
  const requests = new Map<string, Held>();
  const attemptsLog: Attempt[] = [];
  const prefix = options.requestIdPrefix ?? "req-";
  let next = options.firstRequestNumber ?? 1;
  const engineBuild = options.engineBuild ?? DEFAULT_ENGINE_BUILD;

  function held(requestId: string): Held {
    const h = requests.get(requestId);
    if (h === undefined) throw new Error(`no request ${requestId} in this host`);
    return h;
  }

  function turn(requestId: string, h: Held, input: DecideInput, context: DecideContext): HostTurn {
    const result = runTurn(definition, h.state, input, context);
    if (!result.ok) {
      if (result.refusals.some((r) => r.attempt)) {
        attemptsLog.push({ requestId: input.kind === "start" ? null : requestId, input: input.kind, at: context.at, refusals: result.refusals });
      }
      return { ok: false, refusals: result.refusals };
    }
    h.state = result.state;
    h.events.push(...result.events);
    trackCalls(h, requestId, result.events);
    if (result.dropped !== null && input.kind === "callResult") h.pending = h.pending.filter((c) => !sameWait(c.wait, input.wait));
    const stuck = stuckStateOf(definition, h.state);
    if (!sameStuck(stuck, h.stuck)) h.stuck = stuck === null ? null : { ...stuck, at: h.state.lastAt };
    return { ok: true, requestId, events: result.events, trace: result.trace, dropped: result.dropped, stuck: h.stuck };
  }

  return {
    start(input, at) {
      const requestId = `${prefix}${next}`;
      const h: Held = { events: [], state: emptyState(), pending: [], stuck: null };
      const startInput = { kind: "start", requestId, readableId: next, by: input.by, outcome: input.outcome, data: input.data, trigger: input.trigger ?? null } as const;
      const result = turn(requestId, h, startInput, { at, engineBuild, lookups: lookupAnswers(options, definition, h.state, startInput, at) });
      if (result.ok) {
        requests.set(requestId, h);
        next += 1;
      }
      return result;
    },
    act(requestId, input, at) {
      const h = held(requestId);
      const actInput = { kind: "act", ...input } as const;
      const context: DecideContext = { at, engineBuild, lookups: lookupAnswers(options, definition, h.state, actInput, at) };
      // Lookups are made only after an unlocked check that the wait is open (spec section 2, Person).
      const memberships = input.by.type === "user" && isWaitOpen(h.state, input.wait) ? membershipsOf(options, input.by.id) : undefined;
      return turn(requestId, h, actInput, memberships === undefined ? context : { ...context, memberships });
    },
    answerCall(requestId, wait, result, at) {
      const h = held(requestId);
      // Checked before the turn, as the dispatcher checks it. A wait that is not a call of the definition is
      // left to decide, which refuses it as an input naming an unknown wait.
      const check = validateCallResult(definition, wait, result);
      if (!check.ok && check.reason !== "unknown-call") return { ok: false, refusals: [], resultInvalid: check };
      return turn(requestId, h, { kind: "callResult", wait, outcome: result.outcome, data: result.data }, { at, engineBuild });
    },
    admin(requestId, input, at) {
      const h = held(requestId);
      const isAdmin = input.by.type === "user" && (options.admins ?? []).includes(input.by.id);
      const adminInput = { kind: "admin", by: input.by, reason: input.reason, actions: input.actions } as const;
      return turn(requestId, h, adminInput, { at, engineBuild, isAdmin });
    },
    events: (requestId) => held(requestId).events,
    state: (requestId) => held(requestId).state,
    stuck: (requestId) => held(requestId).stuck,
    pendingCalls: (requestId) => [...requests.values()].flatMap((h) => h.pending).filter((c) => requestId === undefined || c.requestId === requestId),
    attempts: () => attemptsLog,
  };
}
