/** Small authored documents built in tests, so each rule can be shown on a few stages. */
import type {
  Action, Arrow, ArrowWhen, AuthoredWorkflow, Condition, Expression, Question, Stage, Task, Value,
} from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";

export interface QuestionSpec {
  id: `q_${string}`;
  savedAs?: `v_${string}`;
  kind?: Question["kind"];
  /** Buttons that need it; "all" sets `neededForEveryButton`. */
  neededBy?: readonly `btn_${string}`[] | "all";
  showWhen?: Condition;
  pageShowWhen?: Condition;
}

export function task(
  id: `tk_${string}`,
  buttons: readonly `btn_${string}`[],
  questions: readonly QuestionSpec[] = [],
  extra: Partial<Task> = {},
): Task {
  const plain = questions.filter((q) => !q.pageShowWhen);
  const hidden = questions.filter((q) => q.pageShowWhen);
  const toQuestion = (q: QuestionSpec): Question => ({
    type: "question",
    id: q.id,
    label: q.id,
    kind: q.kind ?? "text",
    ...(q.savedAs ? { savedAs: q.savedAs } : {}),
    ...(q.showWhen ? { showWhen: q.showWhen } : {}),
    ...(q.neededBy === "all" ? { neededForEveryButton: true } : {}),
  });
  const pages: Task["form"]["pages"] = [{ id: `pg_${id}`, items: plain.map(toQuestion) }];
  hidden.forEach((q, i) => pages.push({ id: `pg_${id}_hidden_${i}`, showWhen: q.pageShowWhen ?? { allOf: [] }, items: [toQuestion(q)] }));
  return {
    id,
    whoIsAsked: { request: "requester" },
    groupRule: "firstAnswerDecides",
    requesterCanAnswer: true,
    form: { pages },
    buttons: buttons.map((b) => ({
      id: b,
      label: b,
      look: "primary",
      neededToPress: questions.filter((q) => Array.isArray(q.neededBy) && q.neededBy.includes(b)).map((q) => q.id),
    })),
    ...extra,
  };
}

export function stage(
  id: `st_${string}`,
  parts: { arrival?: Action[]; tasks?: Task[]; after?: Action[]; arrows?: Arrow[]; kind?: "form" | "automatic" | "work" } = {},
): Stage {
  return {
    id,
    kind: parts.kind ?? (parts.tasks?.length ? "work" : "automatic"),
    name: id,
    whenThisStageStarts: parts.arrival ?? [],
    tasks: parts.tasks ?? [],
    afterTheyRespond: parts.after ?? [],
    arrows: parts.arrows ?? [],
  };
}

export const ending = (id: `st_${string}`): Stage => ({ id, kind: "ending", name: id });

export function arrow(id: `ar_${string}`, when: ArrowWhen | `btn_${string}` | "done" | "other", goTo: `st_${string}` | null, extra: Partial<Arrow> = {}): Arrow {
  const w: ArrowWhen =
    when === "done" ? { type: "whenDone" } : when === "other" ? { type: "inAllOtherCases" } : typeof when === "string" ? { type: "buttonPressed", button: when } : when;
  return { id, when: w, goTo, ...extra };
}

export const pressedWhen = (...buttons: `btn_${string}`[]): Condition => ({ anyOf: buttons.map((pressed) => ({ pressed })) });
export const isFilled = (value: `v_${string}`): Condition => ({ allOf: [{ left: { value }, words: "text.isFilled" }] });

export function save(id: `act_${string}`, value: `v_${string}`, what: Expression, onlyWhen?: Condition): Action {
  return { id, type: "saveValue", save: what, as: value, ...(onlyWhen ? { onlyWhen } : {}) };
}

export function notify(id: `act_${string}`, to: Expression, onlyWhen?: Condition): Action {
  return { id, type: "notify", to, message: ["Hello"], ...(onlyWhen ? { onlyWhen } : {}) };
}

/** A workflow whose first stage is the start. Every value used is put in the registry. */
export function workflow(stages: Stage[], values: readonly `v_${string}`[], extra: Partial<AuthoredWorkflow> = {}): AuthoredWorkflow {
  return {
    formatVersion: 0,
    id: "wf_test",
    start: { by: "personSubmitsForm", stage: stages[0]?.id ?? "st_none", startsWhen: [] },
    stages,
    statuses: [],
    thingsTold: [],
    values: values.map((id): Value => ({ id, name: id })),
    lists: [],
    ...extra,
  };
}

/**
 * The mock catalogue, contract/fixtures/catalogue.json (decision E-27): its version, its two
 * platform settings, the words authors read and its samples.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Catalogue, Field } from "../../src/authored/contract/catalogue.ts";
import { compile } from "../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "./fixtures.ts";

/** RFC 8785 for what a catalogue holds: strings, integers, booleans, null, arrays and objects. */
function jcs(v: unknown): string {
  if (v === null || typeof v !== "object") {
    if (typeof v === "number" && !Number.isInteger(v)) throw new Error("the catalogue holds only integers");
    return JSON.stringify(v);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return `[${v.map(jcs).join(",")}]`;
  const o = v as Record<string, unknown>;
  const keys = Object.keys(o).filter((k) => o[k] !== undefined).sort((a, b) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
  return `{${keys.map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${jcs(o[k])}`).join(",")}}`;
}

function versionOf(c: Catalogue): string {
  const { connections, entries, directoryConnection, notifyConnection } = c;
  const body = jcs({ connections, entries, directoryConnection, notifyConnection });
  return `cat1.${createHash("sha256").update(body, "utf8").digest("base64url")}`;
}

/** Every label and description an author can read, with where it is. */
function words(c: Catalogue): { at: string; text: string }[] {
  const out: { at: string; text: string }[] = [];
  const fields = (at: string, list: unknown): void => {
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) return;
    for (const f of list as Record<string, unknown>[]) {
      out.push({ at: `${at}.${String(f.id)}`, text: String(f.label) });
      for (const ch of (f.choices as { value: string; label: string }[] | undefined) ?? []) out.push({ at: `${at}.${String(f.id)}.${ch.value}`, text: ch.label });
      fields(`${at}.${String(f.id)}`, f.fields);
    }
  };
  for (const conn of c.connections) {
    out.push({ at: conn.id, text: conn.label });
    if (conn.description !== null) out.push({ at: conn.id, text: conn.description });
  }
  for (const e of c.entries) {
    out.push({ at: e.id, text: e.label });
    if (e.description !== null) out.push({ at: e.id, text: e.description });
    const r = e as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const part of ["input", "result", "item", "event"]) fields(`${e.id} ${part}`, r[part]);
    for (const fc of (r.failureCodes as { code: string; label: string }[] | undefined) ?? []) out.push({ at: `${e.id} ${fc.code}`, text: fc.label });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Every object inside the entries' samples, with where it is. */
function sampleObjects(c: Catalogue): { at: string; value: Record<string, unknown> }[] {
  const out: { at: string; value: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];
  const walk = (at: string, v: unknown): void => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach((x, i) => walk(`${at}[${i}]`, x));
    else if (v !== null && typeof v === "object") {
      out.push({ at, value: v as Record<string, unknown> });
      for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) walk(`${at}.${k}`, x);
    }
  };
  for (const e of c.entries) walk(e.id, (e as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).sample);
  return out;
}

const isRef = (o: Record<string, unknown>): boolean => (o.type === "user" || o.type === "group") && typeof o.id === "string";

/**

 * All four are finished workflows, so none raises a To do. Only the integrated sample raises a

 *   approval" takes it past Domain approval and nothing is raised (rows.ts).

      const next: `st_${string}` = i === 29 ? "st_end" : `st_s${i + 1}`;
      return stage(`st_s${i}`, {
        tasks: [task(`tk_s${i}`, [`btn_ok${i}`, `btn_back${i}`], [{ id: `q_s${i}`, savedAs: `v_s${i}`, neededBy: [`btn_ok${i}`] }])],
        after: [notify(`act_s${i}`, { value: `v_s${Math.max(0, i - 1)}` }, isFilled(`v_s${i}`))],
        arrows: [arrow(`ar_ok${i}`, `btn_ok${i}`, next), arrow(`ar_back${i}`, `btn_back${i}`, "st_s0")],
      });
    });
    const doc = workflow([...stages, ending("st_end")], Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i): `v_${string}` => `v_s${i}`));
    const cat = catalogue();
    check(doc, cat);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) check(doc, cat);
    expect((performance.now() - t0) / 5).toBeLessThan(50);
  });
});

/**
 * `check`: formulas, checked through the engine's CEL environment once their chips are rewritten
 * (formula/chips.ts). Each `formula.*` code has a document that raises it and a near miss.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Formula } from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Finding } from "../../src/authored/check/findings.ts";
import { broken, jira, run, stage } from "./check-helpers.ts";

/** The change request with this formula as Create Jira issue's "Only when". */
const onlyWhen = (formula: string): AuthoredWorkflow =>
  broken("change-request", (d) => {
    jira(d).onlyWhen = { formula, readsAs: "A rule" };
  });
const formulaFindings = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Finding[] => run(doc).filter((f) => f.code.startsWith("formula."));
const at = { item: "act_create_jira_issue", part: "onlyWhen" };

describe("formula.syntax", () => {
  it("text that does not parse, the range mapped back through the chip", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}} +"))).toEqual([{ code: "formula.syntax", severity: "todo", location: at, params: { start: 13, end: 13 } }]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}} + 'x' == 'y'"))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("formula.unknownName", () => {
  it("a chip that names nothing, a name the formula language does not have, a reserved name", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_gone}} == 'x'"))).toEqual([
      { code: "formula.unknownName", severity: "todo", location: at, params: { start: 0, end: 10, name: "v_gone" } },
    ]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("data.x == 1")).map((f) => f.params)).toEqual([{ start: 0, end: 4, name: "data" }]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("cel1_x")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toEqual([["formula.unknownName", { start: 0, end: 6, name: "cel1_x" }]]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{today}}")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toEqual([["formula.unknownName", { start: 0, end: 9, name: "today" }]]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("chip__0 == 'x'")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toContainEqual(["formula.unknownName", { start: 0, end: 7, name: "chip__0" }]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{sent.title}} == 'x'")).map((f) => [f.code, (f.params as { name: string }).name])).toEqual([["formula.unknownName", "sent.title"]]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{request.requester}}.nope == 'x'")).map((f) => [f.code, (f.params as { name: string }).name])).toEqual([["formula.unknownName", "nope"]]);
  });

  it("near miss: chips for a value, the Requester and Started on; a date chip reads as a timestamp (compiler.md 8.4)", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}} != '' && {{request.requester}}.type == 'user' && {{request.startedOn}} < {{v_planned_release_date}}"))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("formula.notInScope", () => {
  it("a value in a binding, which reads only what was sent; a sent field is fine", () => {
    const doc = broken("integrated-sample", (d) => {
      d.start.startsWhen[0]!.onlyWhen = { formula: "{{v_summary}} == 'x'", readsAs: "Summary is x" };
    });
    expect(formulaFindings(doc)).toEqual([
      { code: "formula.notInScope", severity: "todo", location: { item: "sw_helpdesk_ticket", part: "onlyWhen" }, params: { start: 0, end: 13, name: "v_summary", declaredAt: { item: "v_summary" } } },
    ]);
    const sent = broken("integrated-sample", (d) => {
      d.start.startsWhen[0]!.onlyWhen = { formula: "{{sent.category}} == 'Service change' && {{sent.reporter}}.type == 'user'", readsAs: "A service change" };
    });
    expect(formulaFindings(sent)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("formula.unknownFunction", () => {
  it("not in the formula functions, or reserved", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("nosuch({{v_title}})")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toEqual([["formula.unknownFunction", { start: 0, end: 19, name: "nosuch" }]]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("cel1_int(1) == 1")).map((f) => [f.code, (f.params as { name: string }).name])).toEqual([["formula.unknownFunction", "cel1_int"]]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("size({{v_title}}) > 3"))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("formula.notInProfile", () => {
  it("a time zone, and \\p in a pattern (cel-1)", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_planned_release_date}}.getHours('Europe/Berlin') == 0")).map((f) => [f.code, (f.params as { rule: string }).rule])).toEqual([
      ["formula.notInProfile", "timeZone"],
    ]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}}.matches('\\\\p{L}')")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toEqual([
      ["formula.notInProfile", { start: 20, end: 28, rule: "unicodeClass" }],
    ]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_planned_release_date}}.getHours() == 0 && {{v_title}}.matches('[A-Z]')"))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a map literal key starting with $, at the key's range (E-27)", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}} in {'a': 1, '$x': 2}"))).toEqual([
      { code: "formula.notInProfile", severity: "todo", location: at, params: { start: 24, end: 28, rule: "reservedKey" } },
    ]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("size([{'b': {'$r': true}}]) == 1")).map((f) => f.params)).toEqual([{ start: 13, end: 17, rule: "reservedKey" }]);
    // Near miss: `$` inside a key, a `$` value, and a key built at run time (refused when saved).
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}} in {'a$': '$x'} && {{v_title}} in {{{v_title}}: 1}"))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("formula.argumentMismatch", () => {
  it("a whole number and a number mixed; a function given the wrong kind", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("size({{v_title}}) + 1.0 > 2.0")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toEqual([
      ["formula.argumentMismatch", { start: 0, end: 23, function: "+", expected: ["number", "number"], found: ["int", "number"] }],
    ]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("size({{v_title}} == 'x') > 1")).map((f) => [f.code, f.params])).toEqual([
      ["formula.argumentMismatch", { start: 0, end: 24, function: "size", expected: ["text"], found: ["yesNo"] }],
    ]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("size({{v_title}}) + 1 > 2"))).toEqual([]);
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("({{v_title}} ? 1 : 2) > 1")).map((f) => [f.code, (f.params as { function: string; found: string[] }).function, (f.params as { found: string[] }).found])).toEqual([
      ["formula.argumentMismatch", "?:", ["text"]],
    ]);
  });
});

describe("formula.kindMismatch", () => {
  it("a condition that gives text; a connection input that gives a whole number", () => {
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("{{v_title}}"))).toEqual([
      { code: "formula.kindMismatch", severity: "todo", location: at, params: { start: 0, end: 11, expected: "yesNo", found: "text" } },
    ]);
    const input = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      jira(d).inputs["summary"] = { formula: "size({{v_title}})", readsAs: "The title's length" } satisfies Formula;
    });
    expect(formulaFindings(input)).toEqual([
      { code: "formula.kindMismatch", severity: "todo", location: { item: "act_create_jira_issue", part: "inputs.summary" }, params: { start: 0, end: 17, expected: "text", found: "int" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("near miss: text for a text input; a timestamp for a date (the compiler applies asDate)", () => {
    // compiler.md 8.4 reads a date chip as date(...) already, so date({{v_due}}) would be refused.
    expect(formulaFindings(onlyWhen("date({{v_planned_release_date}}) > date('2026-01-01')")).map((f) => f.code)).toEqual(["formula.argumentMismatch"]);
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      jira(d).inputs["summary"] = { formula: "{{v_title}} + ' (CHG)'", readsAs: "The title" };
      stage(d, "st_development").afterTheyRespond.push({
        id: "act_later", type: "saveValue", save: { formula: "{{v_planned_release_date}} + days(3)", readsAs: "Three days later" }, as: "v_planned_release_date",
      });
    });
    expect(formulaFindings(doc)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/check-helpers.ts\n===
/** Helpers for the `check` tests: a fixture with one change made to it, and finding filters. */
import type {
  Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Question, UseConnection, WorkingStage,
} from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Catalogue } from "../../src/authored/contract/catalogue.ts";
import { check } from "../../src/authored/check/check.ts";
import type { Finding } from "../../src/authored/check/findings.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, type FixtureName } from "./fixtures.ts";

/** A fixture with one change made to it. */
export function broken(name: FixtureName, change: (doc: AuthoredWorkflow) => void): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const doc = fixture(name);
  change(doc);
  return doc;
}

export const stage = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): WorkingStage => doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === id) as WorkingStage;

export function action<T extends Action = Action>(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): T {
  const all = doc.stages.flatMap((s) => (s.kind === "ending" ? [] : [...s.whenThisStageStarts, ...s.afterTheyRespond]));
  return all.find((a) => a.id === id) as T;
}

export const jira = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow): UseConnection => action<UseConnection>(doc, "act_create_jira_issue");

export function question(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Question {
  const items = doc.stages.flatMap((s) => (s.kind === "ending" ? [] : s.tasks.flatMap((t) => t.form.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items))));
  return items.find((i) => i.id === id) as Question;
}

export const run = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, cat: Catalogue = catalogue()): Finding[] => check(doc, cat);
export const withCode = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, code: Finding["code"], cat?: Catalogue): Finding[] => run(doc, cat).filter((f) => f.code === code);
export const codes = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, cat?: Catalogue): string[] => run(doc, cat).map((f) => f.code);

/** The catalogue with one change made to it. */
export function brokenCatalogue(change: (c: Catalogue) => void): Catalogue {
  const c = catalogue();
  change(c);
  return c;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

  it("a data source's input, a binding's requester and answer, a directory group", () => {

      (question(d, "q_eng_lead").choices as { peopleIn: unknown }).peopleIn = { value: "v_title" };

===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/check-mutations.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Property-style: `check` on drafts made from the change request by deleting an item, clearing or
 * nulling a field, or pointing a reference at nothing. It never throws, never reports an internal
 * failure, and every Location it returns names an item of the draft (or the item just removed),
 * with a part that is a non-empty path when there is one.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { check } from "../../src/authored/check/check.ts";
import type { Finding } from "../../src/authored/check/findings.ts";
import { parse } from "../../src/authored/parse/parse.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "./fixtures.ts";
import { mutations } from "./mutations.ts";

type Node = Record<string | number, unknown>;
const isNode = (x: unknown): x is Node => typeof x === "object" && x !== null;

/** Every string `id` in the document. */
function idsOf(doc: unknown): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  const walk = (x: unknown): void => {
    if (!isNode(x)) return;
    if (typeof x["id"] === "string") out.add(x["id"]);
    Object.values(x).forEach(walk);
  };
  walk(doc);
  return out;
}

/** Each item inside an array, removed in turn. */
function* deletions(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Generator<{ doc: AuthoredWorkflow; removed: string }> {
  const paths: (string | number)[][] = [];
  const walk = (x: unknown, path: (string | number)[]): void => {
    if (!isNode(x)) return;
    if (Array.isArray(x)) x.forEach((y, i) => isNode(y) && typeof y["id"] === "string" && paths.push([...path, i]));
    Object.entries(x).forEach(([k, v]) => walk(v, [...path, Array.isArray(x) ? Number(k) : k]));
  };
  walk(doc, []);
  for (const path of paths) {
    const copy = structuredClone(doc) as unknown as Node;
    let node: Node = copy;
    for (const seg of path.slice(0, -1)) node = node[seg] as Node;
    const list = node as unknown as unknown[];
    const index = path[path.length - 1] as number;
    const removed = (list[index] as Node)["id"] as string;
    list.splice(index, 1);
    yield { doc: copy as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow, removed };
  }
}

/** Each string that names another item, pointed at an ID that names nothing. The sample request is the editor's, not compiled. */
function* danglings(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Generator<AuthoredWorkflow> {
  const ids = idsOf(doc);
  const paths: (string | number)[][] = [];
  const walk = (x: unknown, path: (string | number)[]): void => {
    if (!isNode(x)) return;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(x)) {
      if (path.length === 0 && k === "sampleRequest") continue;
      const seg = Array.isArray(x) ? Number(k) : k;
      if (typeof v === "string" && k !== "id" && ids.has(v)) paths.push([...path, seg]);
      walk(v, [...path, seg]);
    }
  };
  walk(doc, []);
  for (const path of paths) {
    const copy = structuredClone(doc) as unknown as Node;
    let node: Node = copy;
    for (const seg of path.slice(0, -1)) node = node[seg] as Node;
    const last = path[path.length - 1] as string | number;
    node[last] = `${String(node[last])}_gone`;
    yield copy as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow;
  }
}

function expectSound(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, removed?: string): Finding[] {
  let found: Finding[] = [];
  expect(() => (found = check(doc, catalogue()))).not.toThrow();
  expect(found.filter((f) => f.code === "compile.internal")).toEqual([]);
  const parsed = parse(doc);
  const ids = idsOf(parsed.ok ? parsed.workflow : doc);
  for (const f of found) {
    const ok = ids.has(f.location.item) || f.location.item === removed;
    if (!ok) throw new Error(`${f.code} names ${f.location.item}, which is not an item of the draft`);
    if (f.location.part !== undefined) expect(f.location.part).toMatch(/^[^.]+(\.[^.]+)*$/);
  }
  return found;
}

describe("check on mutated drafts of the change request", () => {
  const base = fixture("change-request");

  it("deleting any item", () => {
    let n = 0;
    for (const { doc, removed } of deletions(base)) {
      expectSound(doc, removed);
      n++;
    }
    expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(50);
  });

  it("clearing or nulling any field", () => {
    let n = 0;
    for (const doc of mutations(base)) {
      expectSound(doc);
      n++;
    }
    expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(500);
  });

  it("pointing any reference at nothing raises a finding there", () => {
    let n = 0;
    for (const doc of danglings(base)) {
      const found = expectSound(doc);
      expect(found.some((f) => f.severity === "todo")).toBe(true);
      n++;
    }
    expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(20);
  });

  it("the same for the integrated sample, which has a binding, data sources and failures", () => {
    const sample = fixture("integrated-sample");
    for (const { doc, removed } of deletions(sample)) expectSound(doc, removed);
    for (const doc of mutations(sample)) expectSound(doc);
    for (const doc of danglings(sample)) expectSound(doc);
  });

  it.each(["blank", "several-at-once"] as const)("the same for %s", (name) => {
    const doc = fixture(name);
    for (const { doc: d, removed } of deletions(doc)) expectSound(d, removed);
    for (const d of mutations(doc)) expectSound(d);
    for (const d of danglings(doc)) expectSound(d);
  });
});

  });

  it("near miss: a binding without a button when the start form has one; a stage or ending without a status", () => {
    const doc = broken("integrated-sample", (d) => {
      delete d.start.startsWhen[0]!.button;
      delete stage(d, "st_deploy").status;
      delete (d.stages.find((s) => s.id === "st_deployed") as { status?: string }).status;
    });

  });
});

describe("the start", () => {
  it("workflow.noStart: the start names no stage, or an ending", () => {
    const gone = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      d.start.stage = "st_gone";
    });
    expect(run(gone)[0]).toEqual({ code: "workflow.noStart", severity: "todo", location: { item: "wf_change_request", part: "start.stage" }, params: {} });
    expect(codes(gone)).not.toContain("item.brokenReference");
    const ending = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      d.start.stage = "st_released";
    });
    expect(codes(ending)).toContain("workflow.noStart");
  });

  it("start.notOneTask: two tasks, or none", () => {
    const two = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      const s = stage(d, "st_request_form");
      s.tasks.push({ ...structuredClone(s.tasks[0]!), id: "tk_second", form: { pages: [] }, buttons: [] });
    });
    expect(withCode(two, "start.notOneTask")).toEqual([{ code: "start.notOneTask", severity: "todo", location: { item: "st_request_form", part: "tasks" }, params: { found: 2 } }]);
    const none = broken("blank", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").tasks = [];
    });
    expect(withCode(none, "start.notOneTask").map((f) => f.params)).toEqual([{ found: 0 }]);
    expect(withCode(fixture("blank"), "start.notOneTask")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("start.needsStatus: a connection action after the start form and no status (E-16); none with a status", () => {
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").afterTheyRespond.push({ ...structuredClone(jira(d)), id: "act_jira_early" });
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "start.needsStatus")).toEqual([
      { code: "start.needsStatus", severity: "todo", location: { item: "st_request_form", part: "status" }, params: { action: { item: "act_jira_early" } } },
    ]);
    const withStatus = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").afterTheyRespond.push({ ...structuredClone(jira(d)), id: "act_jira_early" });
      stage(d, "st_request_form").status = "stat_creating_jira_issue";
    });
    expect(withCode(withStatus, "start.needsStatus")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("start.directoryInCondition: \"is in\" a group, or a members step, in a start-form condition; not on a later form", () => {
    const security = { group: { directoryId: "dir-group-security", name: "Security" } };
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      question(d, "q_title").showWhen = { allOf: [{ left: { request: "requester" }, words: "person.isIn", right: security }] };
      stage(d, "st_request_form").tasks[0]!.buttons[0]!.enabledWhen = {
        anyOf: [
          { left: { value: "v_title" }, words: "text.isFilled" },
          { left: { request: "requester" }, words: "person.isIn", right: { value: "v_primary_domain", steps: [{ column: "col_approvers" }, { directory: "members" }] } },
        ],
      };
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "start.directoryInCondition").map((f) => f.location)).toEqual([
      { item: "q_title", part: "showWhen.0" },
      { item: "btn_rf_submit", part: "enabledWhen.1" },
    ]);
    const peopleWords = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      question(d, "q_title").showWhen = { allOf: [{ left: security, words: "people.include", right: { request: "requester" } }] };
    });
    expect(withCode(peopleWords, "start.directoryInCondition").map((f) => f.location)).toEqual([{ item: "q_title", part: "showWhen.0" }]);
    const later = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      question(d, "q_release_notes").showWhen = { allOf: [{ left: { request: "requester" }, words: "person.isIn", right: security }] };
    });
    expect(withCode(later, "start.directoryInCondition")).toEqual([]);
  });
});

      d.start.startsWhen[0]!.button = "btn_approve";
    });
    expect(run(doc)).toEqual([
      { code: "startsWhen.buttonNotOnStart", severity: "todo", location: { item: "sw_helpdesk_ticket", part: "button" }, params: { button: "btn_approve" } },
      sampleRequester,
    ]);

      d.start.startsWhen[0]!.button = "btn_gone";
    });
    expect(codes(gone)).toEqual(["item.brokenReference", "requester.mayBeEmpty"]);
  });

  it("startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn: a mapped question whose Show when reads Started on (E-23)", () => {

      question(d, "q_helpdesk_ticket").showWhen = { allOf: [{ left: { request: "startedOn" }, words: "date.isAfter", right: { date: "2026-01-01" } }] };

    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn").map((f) => [f.location.part, f.params])).toEqual([

    ]);
    const unmapped = broken("integrated-sample", (d) => {

describe("arrows", () => {
  it("stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo: one task, a button no arrow takes", () => {
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.splice(1, 1);
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([
      { code: "stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo", severity: "todo", location: { item: "btn_da_reject" }, params: { task: { item: "tk_domain_approval" } } },
    ]);
    const otherwise = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.splice(1, 1, { id: "ar_da_else", when: { type: "inAllOtherCases" }, goTo: "st_rejected" });
    });
    expect(withCode(otherwise, "stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("stage.combinationHasNowhereToGo: two tasks, a combination no arrow takes", () => {
    const doc = broken("several-at-once", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.pop();
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "stage.combinationHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([
      {
        code: "stage.combinationHasNowhereToGo", severity: "todo", location: { item: "st_domain_approval", part: "arrows" },
        params: { combinations: [[{ task: { item: "tk_domain_approval" }, button: { item: "btn_da_approve" } }, { task: { item: "tk_security_review" }, button: { item: "btn_sec_approve" } }]], total: 1 },
      },
    ]);
    expect(withCode(fixture("several-at-once"), "stage.combinationHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a condition on a value may fit, so it is not judged (only buttons are)", () => {
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").arrows.pop();
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("arrow.otherCasesNotLast: a second \"In all other cases\", and one moved to the top", () => {
    const second = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").arrows.push({ id: "ar_x", when: { type: "inAllOtherCases" }, goTo: "st_rejected" });
    });
    expect(withCode(second, "arrow.otherCasesNotLast")).toEqual([{ code: "arrow.otherCasesNotLast", severity: "todo", location: { item: "ar_rf_other", part: "when" }, params: {} }]);
    const reversed = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").arrows.reverse();
    });
    expect(withCode(reversed, "arrow.otherCasesNotLast").map((f) => f.location)).toEqual([{ item: "ar_rf_other", part: "when" }]);
    expect(withCode(fixture("change-request"), "arrow.otherCasesNotLast")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("arrow.otherCasesWithCondition: \"In all other cases\" with \"+ only when\" or \"Don't wait for the others\" (E-23)", () => {
    const doc = broken("several-at-once", (d) => {
      const other = stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows[2]!;
      other.onlyWhen = { allOf: [{ pressed: "btn_da_approve" }] };
      other.goAsSoonAsTrue = true;
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "arrow.otherCasesWithCondition").map((f) => f.location)).toEqual([
      { item: "ar_da_other", part: "onlyWhen" },
      { item: "ar_da_other", part: "goAsSoonAsTrue" },
    ]);
    const plain = broken("several-at-once", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows[2]!.goAsSoonAsTrue = false;
    });
    expect(withCode(plain, "arrow.otherCasesWithCondition")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("arrow.neverUsed: an earlier arrow always fits (a To do, E-25)", () => {
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.splice(1, 0, {
        id: "ar_da_high", when: { type: "buttonPressed", button: "btn_da_approve" },
        onlyWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_risk" }, words: "choice.is", right: { choice: "ch_risk_high" } }] },
        goTo: "st_development",
      });
    });
    expect(run(doc)).toEqual([
      { code: "arrow.neverUsed", severity: "todo", location: { item: "ar_da_high" }, params: { reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", earlier: { item: "ar_da_approve" }, covering: [{ item: "ar_da_approve" }] } },
    ]);
  });

  it("arrow.neverUsed: several earlier arrows together cover it; covering names each, earlier none (E-32)", () => {
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.push({
        id: "ar_da_high", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_risk" }, words: "choice.is", right: { choice: "ch_risk_high" } }] } },
        goTo: "st_development",
      });
    });
    expect(run(doc)).toEqual([
      {
        code: "arrow.neverUsed", severity: "todo", location: { item: "ar_da_high" },
        params: { reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", covering: [{ item: "ar_da_approve" }, { item: "ar_da_reject" }, { item: "ar_da_request_changes" }] },
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("arrow.neverUsed: its \"when\" can never be true", () => {
    const doc = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.unshift({
        id: "ar_da_both", goTo: "st_rejected",
        when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ pressed: "btn_da_approve" }, { pressed: "btn_da_reject" }] } },
      });
    });
    expect(run(doc)).toEqual([{ code: "arrow.neverUsed", severity: "todo", location: { item: "ar_da_both" }, params: { reason: "conditionNeverTrue" } }]);
  });

  it("near miss: not said of an arrow whose \"when\" is not chosen yet, nor of arrows out of a stage no route reaches", () => {
    const fresh = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.push({ id: "ar_da_new", when: { type: "buttonPressed", button: null }, goTo: null });
    });
    expect(withCode(fresh, "arrow.neverUsed")).toEqual([]);
    const unreachable = broken("change-request", (d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").arrows = [{ id: "ar_rf_only", when: { type: "buttonPressed", button: "btn_rf_submit" }, goTo: "st_create_jira_issue" }];
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows.unshift({ id: "ar_da_both", goTo: "st_rejected", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ pressed: "btn_da_approve" }, { pressed: "btn_da_reject" }] } } });
    });
    expect(withCode(unreachable, "arrow.neverUsed")).toEqual([]);
    expect(withCode(unreachable, "stage.unreachable").map((f) => f.location.item)).toEqual(["st_domain_approval", "st_rejected"]);
  });
});

describe("group.readInSameStep (E-26; compiler.md 8.6, 14.3 #9)", () => {
  const isIn = (group: object): object => ({ allOf: [{ left: { request: "requester" }, words: "person.isIn", right: group }] });
  const team = { value: "v_team" };
  const members = { value: "v_team", steps: [{ directory: "members" }] };
  /** Domain approval answers the Team; `place` reads it somewhere. */
  const answered = (place: (d: ReturnType<typeof fixture>) => void, onStartForm = false) =>
    broken("several-at-once", (d) => {
      d.values.push({ id: "v_team", name: "Team" });
      const items = onStartForm ? stage(d, "st_request_form").tasks[0]!.form.pages[0]!.items : stage(d, "st_domain_approval").tasks[0]!.form.pages[0]!.items;
      items.push({ type: "question", id: "q_team", label: "Team", kind: "group", savedAs: "v_team" });
      place(d);
    });
  const security = (d: ReturnType<typeof fixture>) => stage(d, "st_domain_approval").tasks[1]!;

  it("read by the same step's Show when, \"Also only when\", lookup input and early arrow", () => {
    const doc = answered((d) => {
      question(d, "q_security_notes").showWhen = isIn(team) as never;
      security(d).form.pages[0]!.items.push({
        type: "question", id: "q_svc", label: "Service", kind: "choice", savedAs: "v_title",
        choices: { from: "source", source: "servicecatalog.services@1", inputs: { owners: members as never }, labelField: "name", storedField: "id" },
      });
      security(d).buttons[0]!.enabledWhen = { anyOf: [{ left: members as never, words: "people.include", right: { request: "requester" } }] };
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows[0]!.onlyWhen = isIn(team) as never;
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([
      { code: "group.readInSameStep", severity: "todo", location: { item: "q_security_notes", part: "showWhen.0" }, params: { value: { item: "v_team" } } },
      { code: "group.readInSameStep", severity: "todo", location: { item: "q_svc", part: "choices.inputs.owners" }, params: { value: { item: "v_team" } } },
      { code: "group.readInSameStep", severity: "todo", location: { item: "btn_sec_approve", part: "enabledWhen.0" }, params: { value: { item: "v_team" } } },
      { code: "group.readInSameStep", severity: "todo", location: { item: "ar_da_reject", part: "onlyWhen.0" }, params: { value: { item: "v_team" } } },
    ]);
  });

  it("near miss: the routing step reads it, or the group was filled before the step", () => {
    const routed = answered((d) => {
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows[1]!.onlyWhen = isIn(team) as never;
    });
    expect(withCode(routed, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
    const earlier = answered((d) => {
      question(d, "q_security_notes").showWhen = isIn(team) as never;
      stage(d, "st_domain_approval").arrows[0]!.onlyWhen = isIn(team) as never;
    }, true);
    expect(withCode(earlier, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("near miss: the start form's own conditions are start.directoryInCondition's alone", () => {
    const doc = answered((d) => {
      question(d, "q_title").showWhen = isIn(team) as never;
    }, true);
    expect(withCode(doc, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
    expect(withCode(doc, "start.directoryInCondition").map((f) => f.location)).toEqual([{ item: "q_title", part: "showWhen.0" }]);
  });

  it("E-27 limit: a question's \"people in\" group is not such a read", () => {
    const doc = answered((d) => {
      security(d).form.pages[0]!.items.push({ type: "question", id: "q_pick", label: "Pick", kind: "person", savedAs: "v_title", choices: { from: "directory", peopleIn: team as never } });
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
    const members2 = answered((d) => {
      security(d).form.pages[0]!.items.push({ type: "question", id: "q_pick", label: "Pick", kind: "person", savedAs: "v_title", choices: { from: "directory", peopleIn: members as never } });
    });
    expect(withCode(members2, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("E-27 limit: formulas are not judged", () => {
    const doc = answered((d) => {
      question(d, "q_security_notes").showWhen = { formula: "{{v_team}}.id != ''", readsAs: "Team is set" } as never;
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("E-27 limit: on the start form, \"Also only when\" is start.directoryInCondition's, and a lookup input is reported here", () => {
    const enabled = answered((d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").tasks[0]!.buttons[0]!.enabledWhen = isIn(team) as never;
    }, true);
    expect(withCode(enabled, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([]);
    expect(withCode(enabled, "start.directoryInCondition").map((f) => f.location.part)).toEqual(["enabledWhen.0"]);
    const lookup = answered((d) => {
      stage(d, "st_request_form").tasks[0]!.form.pages[0]!.items.push({
        type: "question", id: "q_svc", label: "Service", kind: "choice", savedAs: "v_title",
        choices: { from: "source", source: "servicecatalog.services@1", inputs: { owners: members as never }, labelField: "name", storedField: "id" },
      });
    }, true);
    expect(withCode(lookup, "group.readInSameStep")).toEqual([
      { code: "group.readInSameStep", severity: "todo", location: { item: "q_svc", part: "choices.inputs.owners" }, params: { value: { item: "v_team" } } },
    ]);
  });
});

describe("failures of connection actions", () => {
  const carryOn = (arrows: WorkingStage["arrows"]) =>
    broken("change-request", (d) => {
      d.values.push({ id: "v_jf", name: "Jira failed" });
      const a = jira(d);
      a.ifItFails = "carryOn";
      a.saveFailureAs = { failed: "v_jf" };
      stage(d, "st_create_jira_issue").arrows = arrows;
    });

  it("action.failureHasNowhereToGo: only \"Jira failed is No\" goes on", () => {
    const doc = carryOn([{ id: "ar_cji_ok", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_jf" }, words: "yesNo.isNo" }] } }, goTo: "st_development" }]);
    expect(withCode(doc, "action.failureHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([
      { code: "action.failureHasNowhereToGo", severity: "todo", location: { item: "act_create_jira_issue", part: "ifItFails" }, params: { failed: "v_jf" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("action.failureHasNowhereToGo: after a failure the results keep what they had, empty when nothing filled them before", () => {
    const doc = broken("integrated-sample", (d) => {
      // Without "Send back", Find service owner is visited once, so a failed look-up leaves the tier empty.
      stage(d, "st_approve").tasks[0]!.buttons.pop();
      stage(d, "st_approve").arrows.pop();
      const s = stage(d, "st_find_owner");
      (s.whenThisStageStarts[0] as UseConnection).ifItFails = "carryOn";
      s.arrows[1] = { id: "ar_fo_done", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_service_tier" }, words: "text.isFilled" }] } }, goTo: "st_deploy" };
    });
    expect(withCode(doc, "action.failureHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([
      { code: "action.failureHasNowhereToGo", severity: "todo", location: { item: "act_look_up_service", part: "ifItFails" }, params: {} },
    ]);
    // With "Send back", a second visit keeps the tier the first one found, so an arrow may fit.
    const again = broken("integrated-sample", (d) => {
      const s = stage(d, "st_find_owner");
      (s.whenThisStageStarts[0] as UseConnection).ifItFails = "carryOn";
      s.arrows[1] = { id: "ar_fo_done", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_service_tier" }, words: "text.isFilled" }] } }, goTo: "st_deploy" };
    });
    expect(withCode(again, "action.failureHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("near miss: \"When done\" covers a failure; so do an arrow for each case", () => {
    expect(withCode(carryOn([{ id: "ar_cji_done", when: { type: "whenDone" }, goTo: "st_development" }]), "action.failureHasNowhereToGo")).toEqual([]);
    const both = carryOn([
      { id: "ar_cji_failed", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_jf" }, words: "yesNo.isYes" }] } }, goTo: "st_rejected" },
      { id: "ar_cji_ok", when: { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_jf" }, words: "yesNo.isNo" }] } }, goTo: "st_development" },
    ]);
    expect(run(both).filter((f) => f.code.includes("NowhereToGo"))).toEqual([]);

/** Which To dos stop a request in Try it (core-api.md section 4, last column), and `compile.internal`. */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Catalogue } from "../../src/authored/contract/catalogue.ts";
import { check } from "../../src/authored/check/check.ts";
import { finding, type Finding, type FindingCode } from "../../src/authored/check/findings.ts";
import { tryItEffect, type TryItEffect } from "../../src/authored/check/try-it.ts";
import { fixture } from "./fixtures.ts";

const KINDS: Record<string, string> = {
  tk_x: "task", act_x: "action", ar_x: "arrow", st_x: "stage", sw_x: "startsWhen", q_x: "question", btn_x: "button", stat_x: "status", ls_x: "list",
};
const effect = (f: Finding): string => tryItEffect(f, (item) => KINDS[item]);
const missing = (item: string, part: string): Finding => finding("item.partMissing", { item, part }, {});

describe("tryItEffect", () => {
  it("missing parts that leave nothing to run stop it; words, labels, a task's Who is asked, a Notify's to and a question's value do not", () => {
    const stops = [missing("tk_x", "buttons"), missing("act_x", "operation"), missing("act_x", "save"), missing("act_x", "as"),
      missing("ar_x", "goTo"), missing("ar_x", "when.button"), missing("ar_x", "when.condition"), missing("st_x", "arrows"), missing("ar_x", "when.condition.0.left"),
      missing("q_x", "showWhen.1.words"), missing("btn_x", "enabledWhen.0"), missing("sw_x", "trigger"), missing("sw_x", "button")];
    expect(stops.map(effect)).toEqual(stops.map(() => "stops"));
    const runs = [missing("st_x", "name"), missing("q_x", "label"), missing("btn_x", "label"), missing("act_x", "onlyWhen.readsAs"), missing("stat_x", "words"),
      missing("q_x", "savedAs"), missing("q_x", "choices"), missing("act_x", "to"), missing("act_x", "tell"),
      // E-28: the request runs to the task and is stuck there with nobody to ask.
      missing("tk_x", "whoIsAsked")];
    expect(runs.map(effect)).toEqual(runs.map(() => "runs"));
  });

  it("by code: a broken reference stops it, a button with nowhere to go does not, a binding reading Started on stops only that binding", () => {
    expect(effect(finding("item.brokenReference", { item: "ar_x", part: "goTo" }, { target: "st_gone" }))).toBe("stops");
    expect(effect(finding("formula.syntax", { item: "act_x", part: "onlyWhen" }, { start: 0, end: 1 }))).toBe("stops");
    expect(effect(finding("stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo", { item: "btn_x" }, { task: { item: "tk_x" } }))).toBe("runs");
    expect(effect(finding("catalogue.connectionNotSetUp", { item: "act_x", part: "operation" }, { connection: "jira" }))).toBe("runs");
    expect(effect(finding("startsWhen.showWhenReadsStartedOn", { item: "sw_x", part: "answers.q_x" }, { question: "q_x" }))).toBe("bindingOnly");
    expect(effect(finding("arrow.neverUsed", { item: "ar_x" }, { reason: "conditionNeverTrue" }))).toBe("runs");
  });

  it("the codes E-25 and E-26 add or change", () => {
    expect(effect(finding("group.readInSameStep", { item: "q_x", part: "showWhen.0" }, { value: { item: "v_x" } }))).toBe("stops");
    expect(effect(finding("startsWhen.buttonNotOnStart", { item: "sw_x", part: "button" }, { button: "btn_x" }))).toBe("bindingOnly");
    expect(effect(finding("clause.pressedOutsideStage", { item: "ar_x", part: "when.button" }, { button: "btn_x" }))).toBe("stops");
    expect(effect(finding("catalogue.unknownField", { item: "sw_x", part: "requester" }, { field: "x" }))).toBe("stops");
    expect(effect(missing("ar_x", "when"))).toBe("stops");
    // arrow.neverUsed is a To do now, and still does not stop a request.
    const neverUsed = finding("arrow.neverUsed", { item: "ar_x" }, { reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits" });
    expect([neverUsed.severity, effect(neverUsed)]).toEqual(["todo", "runs"]);
    expect(effect(finding("requester.mayBeEmpty", { item: "tk_x", part: "whoIsAsked" }, { bindings: ["sw_x"] }))).toBe("runs");
  });

  it("the codes E-27 adds or changes: a list with no rows runs as a question without choices does", () => {
    expect([effect(missing("ls_x", "rows")), effect(missing("q_x", "choices"))]).toEqual(["runs", "runs"]);
    const notRead = finding("action.failureNotRead", { item: "act_x", part: "ifItFails" }, { failed: "v_x" });
    expect([notRead.severity, effect(notRead)]).toEqual(["worthKnowing", "runs"]);
    const reserved = finding("formula.notInProfile", { item: "act_x", part: "onlyWhen" }, { start: 1, end: 5, rule: "reservedKey" });
    expect([reserved.severity, effect(reserved)]).toEqual(["todo", "stops"]);
  });
});

===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/compile/differential.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Differential test of the compiler. A small interpreter of the authored format's meaning, written from
 * contract/authored-format.md and compiler.md's rules (not from the compiler's code), runs a few hundred
 * random small workflows beside the compiled definitions in the in-memory host. After every act they must
 * agree on the stage reached, the tasks open, the status shown, the values held and why a request is stuck.
 *
 * Also the properties: a draft with no To do that stops compiling compiles in Try it mode; one with no
 * To do compiles in publish mode and passes checkDefinition; and no compiled definition faults on answers
 * its forms accept.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { check } from "../../../src/authored/check/check.ts";
import { tryItEffect } from "../../../src/authored/check/try-it.ts";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { indexDocument } from "../../../src/authored/index-doc.ts";
import { checkDefinition } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { catalogue } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { differ, randomWorkflow } from "./differential.ts";

const SEEDS = Array.from({ length: 400 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
const cat = catalogue();

interface Case { seed: number; wf: AuthoredWorkflow; todos: string[]; stops: string[]; neverUsed: string[] }

const CASES: Case[] = SEEDS.map((seed) => {
  const wf = randomWorkflow(seed);
  const findings = check(wf, cat);
  const ix = indexDocument(wf);
  return {
    seed, wf,
    todos: findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo").map((f) => f.code as string),
    stops: findings.filter((f) => tryItEffect(f, (item) => ix.byId.get(item)?.kind) === "stops").map((f) => f.code as string),
    neverUsed: findings.filter((f) => f.code === "arrow.neverUsed").map((f) => f.location.item),
  };
});

describe("differential: the compiled definition against the authored meaning", () => {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const takenButNeverUsed: string[] = [];

  it("random workflows agree with the interpreter after every act", () => {
    const bad: string[] = [];
    let ran = 0;
    for (const c of CASES) {
      if (c.stops.length > 0) continue;
      const r = compile(c.wf, cat, { mode: "tryIt" });
      if (!r.ok) { bad.push(`seed ${c.seed}: Try it refused ${JSON.stringify(r.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo").map((f) => f.code))}`); continue; }
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        ran++;
        const here = new Set<string>();
        const d = differ(c.wf, r.published, c.seed * 10 + k, here);
        for (const s of here) seen.add(s.startsWith("taken:") ? "taken" : s);
        for (const a of c.neverUsed) if (here.has(`taken:${a}`)) takenButNeverUsed.push(`seed ${c.seed}/${k}: ${a}`);
        if (d) { bad.push(`seed ${c.seed}/${k}:\n${d}`); break; }
      }
    }
    expect(ran).toBeGreaterThan(900);
    expect(bad.slice(0, 3)).toEqual([]);
  }, 300_000);

  it("the runs exercised every rule they are meant to compare", () => {
    for (const s of [
      "fired:answered", "fired:early", "fired:save", "fired:skip", "fired:arrow", "entered:tasksBack", "entered:routeBack",
      "stuck:nobody-to-ask", "refused:may", "refused:not-assignee",
      // Several questions of one task saved as one value, on one page and on alternate pages (E-27).
      "alternate:answered", "merge:earlierKept", "merge:laterWins", "merge:allEmpty",
    ]) expect(seen, s).toContain(s);
  });

  it("no arrow core reports as never used is ever taken", () => {
    expect(takenButNeverUsed).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a draft with no To do compiles in publish mode and passes checkDefinition", () => {
    const bad: string[] = [];
    let checked = 0;
    for (const c of CASES) {
      if (c.todos.length > 0) continue;
      checked++;
      const r = compile(c.wf, cat);
      if (!r.ok) bad.push(`seed ${c.seed}: ${JSON.stringify(r.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo"))}`);
      else {
        const problems = checkDefinition(r.published);
        if (problems.length > 0) bad.push(`seed ${c.seed}: ${JSON.stringify(problems)}`);
      }
    }
    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    expect(bad).toEqual([]);
  }, 300_000);
});
===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/compile/differential.ts\n===
/**
 * The differential test's parts: random small workflows and an interpreter of the authored meaning,
 * written from contract/authored-format.md and compiler.md (not from the compiler's code), and a driver
 * that runs both side by side.
 */
import type {
  Action, Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Clause, Condition, Expression, Question, Sentence, Stage, Task, WorkingStage,
} from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { By, Json as JsonValue, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { createMemoryHost, type MemoryHost } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";

// ── Random numbers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function rng(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

class Rand {
  readonly next: () => number;
  constructor(next: () => number) {
    this.next = next;
  }
  int(lo: number, hi: number): number {
    return lo + Math.floor(this.next() * (hi - lo + 1));
  }
  pick<T>(xs: readonly T[]): T {
    return xs[Math.floor(this.next() * xs.length)] as T;
  }
  chance(p: number): boolean {
    return this.next() < p;
  }
}

// ── The random workflow ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Kind = "yesNo" | "number" | "text" | "choice";
const VALUE_KIND: Record<string, Kind> = { v_yn: "yesNo", v_num: "number", v_txt: "text", v_ch: "choice" };
const CHOICES = ["ch_a", "ch_b", "ch_c"] as const;
const USERS = ["dir-user-u0", "dir-user-u1", "dir-user-u2"] as const;
const REQUESTER = "dir-user-u0";
const STATUSES = ["stat_a", "stat_b", "stat_c"] as const;

function clauseOver(r: Rand, value: string): Clause {
  const left: Expression = { value: value as `v_${string}` };
  switch (VALUE_KIND[value]) {
    case "yesNo":
      return { left, words: r.pick(["yesNo.isYes", "yesNo.isNo", "yesNo.isFilled", "yesNo.isEmpty"] as const) };
    case "number": {
      const words = r.pick(["number.isMoreThan", "number.isAtMost", "number.is", "number.isNot", "number.isEmpty", "number.isLessThan"] as const);
      if (words === "number.isEmpty") return { left, words };
      return { left, words, right: r.chance(0.2) ? { value: "v_num" } : { number: r.pick([0, 5, 10]) } };
    }
    case "text": {
      const words = r.pick(["text.isFilled", "text.isEmpty", "text.is", "text.contains", "text.isNot"] as const);
      if (words === "text.isFilled" || words === "text.isEmpty") return { left, words };
      return { left, words, right: { text: r.pick(["a", "ell", "hello"]) } };
    }
    default: {
      const words = r.pick(["choice.is", "choice.isNot", "choice.isOneOf", "choice.isNotOneOf", "choice.isEmpty"] as const);
      if (words === "choice.isEmpty") return { left, words };
      if (words === "choice.isOneOf" || words === "choice.isNotOneOf") return { left, words, right: [{ choice: r.pick(CHOICES) }, { choice: r.pick(CHOICES) }] };
      return { left, words, right: { choice: r.pick(CHOICES) } };
    }
  }
}

function sentence(r: Rand, values: readonly string[], buttons: readonly string[]): Sentence {
  const n = r.int(1, 3);
  const clauses: Clause[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (buttons.length > 0 && r.chance(0.3)) clauses.push({ pressed: r.pick(buttons) as `btn_${string}` });
    else clauses.push(clauseOver(r, r.pick(values)));
  }
  return r.chance(0.5) ? { allOf: clauses } : { anyOf: clauses };
}

function constantFor(r: Rand, value: string): Expression {
  switch (VALUE_KIND[value]) {
    case "yesNo":
      return { yesNo: r.chance(0.5) };
    case "number":
      return { number: r.pick([0, 5, 10, 11]) };
    case "text":
      return { text: r.pick(["a", "hello"]) };
    default:
      return { choice: r.pick(CHOICES) };
  }
}

function saves(r: Rand, prefix: string, n: number, buttons: readonly string[]): Action[] {
  const out: Action[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const as = r.pick(["v_yn", "v_num", "v_txt", "v_ch"]);
    out.push({
      id: `act_${prefix}_${i}`, type: "saveValue", save: constantFor(r, as), as: as as `v_${string}`,
      ...(r.chance(0.5) ? { onlyWhen: sentence(r, Object.keys(VALUE_KIND), buttons) } : {}),
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** The start form fills every value once (so none is "never filled"); later forms fill some again. */
function question(r: Rand, id: string, start: number | null): Question {
  if (start === 0) return { type: "question", id: id as `q_${string}`, label: id, kind: "choice", savedAs: "v_ch", choices: { from: "typedIn", choices: CHOICES.map((c) => ({ id: c, label: c })) } };
  const kind = start !== null ? (["yesNo", "number", "text"] as const)[(start - 1) % 3] as "yesNo" | "number" | "text" : r.pick(["yesNo", "number", "text"] as const);
  const savedAs = ({ yesNo: "v_yn", number: "v_num", text: "v_txt" } as const)[kind];
  return { type: "question", id: id as `q_${string}`, label: id, kind, savedAs };
}

/**
 * Alternate pages (E-27): two pages, one shown when v_yn is Yes and one when it is No, each with a question
 * saved as the same value; sometimes the main page fills that value too, earlier in the form. The main
 * page then holds no question saved as v_yn, so the pages' Show when reads the request's data. Drawn from
 * its own random numbers, so the rest of each workflow is as before.
 */
function alternatePages(alt: Rand, id: string, items: Question[]): Task["form"]["pages"] {
  const main: Task["form"]["pages"][number] = { id: `pg_${id.slice(3)}`, items };
  if (!alt.chance(0.35)) return [main];
  const kind = alt.pick(["number", "text"] as const);
  const value = kind === "number" ? "v_num" : "v_txt";
  const q = (suffix: string): Question => ({ type: "question", id: `q_${id.slice(3)}_${suffix}` as `q_${string}`, label: suffix, kind, savedAs: value });
  main.items = items.filter((x) => x.type !== "question" || x.savedAs !== "v_yn");
  if (alt.chance(0.5)) main.items.push(q("first"));
  const when = (words: "yesNo.isYes" | "yesNo.isNo") => ({ allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_yn" as const }, words }] });
  return [
    main,
    { id: `pg_${id.slice(3)}_yes` as const, showWhen: when("yesNo.isYes"), items: [q("yes")] },
    { id: `pg_${id.slice(3)}_no`, showWhen: when("yesNo.isNo"), items: [q("no")] },
  ];
}

function makeTask(r: Rand, id: string, start: boolean, alt: Rand): Task {
  const nq = start ? 4 : r.int(0, 2);
  const items = Array.from({ length: nq }, (_, i) => question(r, `q_${id.slice(3)}_${i}`, start ? i : null));
  const nb = r.int(1, 3);
  return {
    id: id as `tk_${string}`,
    whoIsAsked: start ? { request: "requester" } : r.pick<Expression>([{ request: "requester" }, { person: { directoryId: "dir-user-u1", name: "U1" } }, { person: { directoryId: "dir-user-u2", name: "U2" } }]),
    groupRule: "firstAnswerDecides",
    requesterCanAnswer: start ? true : r.chance(0.7),
    form: { pages: start ? [{ id: `pg_${id.slice(3)}`, items }] : alternatePages(alt, id, items) },
    buttons: Array.from({ length: nb }, (_, j) => ({ id: `btn_${id.slice(3)}_${j}` as `btn_${string}`, label: "b", look: "primary" as const, neededToPress: [] })),
    ...(r.chance(0.3) ? { savesButtonPressedAs: `v_bp_${id.slice(3)}` as `v_${string}` } : {}),
  };
}

export function randomWorkflow(seed: number): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const r = new Rand(rng(seed));
  const alt = new Rand(rng(seed * 31 + 7));
  const n = r.int(2, 6);
  const endings = ["st_end_a", "st_end_b"];
  const ids = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => `st_${i}`);
  const stages: Stage[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const automatic = i > 0 && r.chance(0.2);
    const tasks = automatic ? [] : Array.from({ length: i === 0 ? 1 : r.int(1, 3) }, (_, t) => makeTask(r, `tk_${i}_${t}`, i === 0, alt));
    const buttons = tasks.flatMap((t) => t.buttons.map((b) => b.id));
    const forward = [...ids.slice(i + 1), ...endings];
    const anywhere = [...ids, ...endings];
    const arrows: Arrow[] = [];
    const na = r.int(0, 3);
    for (let a = 0; a < na; a++) {
      // An Automatic stage only goes forward, so every loop passes a task (loop.noTask).
      const goTo = (automatic ? r.pick(forward) : r.pick(anywhere)) as `st_${string}`;
      const button = buttons.length > 0 && r.chance(0.4);
      arrows.push({
        id: `ar_${i}_${a}` as `ar_${string}`,
        when: button ? { type: "buttonPressed", button: r.pick(buttons) as `btn_${string}` } : { type: "condition", condition: sentence(r, Object.keys(VALUE_KIND), buttons) },
        goTo,
        ...(r.chance(0.25) ? { onlyWhen: sentence(r, Object.keys(VALUE_KIND), buttons) } : {}),
        ...(tasks.length >= 2 && r.chance(0.5) ? { goAsSoonAsTrue: true } : {}),
      });
    }
    // The last arrow covers every other case and goes forward, so every stage reaches an ending.
    if (!r.chance(0.08)) arrows.push({ id: `ar_${i}_other` as `ar_${string}`, when: automatic && r.chance(0.5) ? { type: "whenDone" } : { type: "inAllOtherCases" }, goTo: r.pick(forward) as `st_${string}` });
    const stage: WorkingStage = {
      id: ids[i] as `st_${string}`,
      kind: automatic ? "automatic" : i === 0 ? "form" : "work",
      name: ids[i] as string,
      ...(r.chance(0.6) ? { status: r.pick(STATUSES) } : {}),
      ...(r.chance(0.4) ? { ifSentBackStatus: r.pick(STATUSES) } : {}),
      whenThisStageStarts: saves(r, `${i}_in`, r.chance(0.3) ? r.int(1, 2) : 0, []),
      tasks,
      afterTheyRespond: saves(r, `${i}_out`, r.chance(0.4) ? r.int(1, 2) : 0, buttons),
      arrows,
    };
    stages.push(stage);
  }
  for (const e of endings) stages.push({ id: e as `st_${string}`, kind: "ending", name: e, ...(r.chance(0.5) ? { status: r.pick(STATUSES) } : {}) });
  const bp = stages.flatMap((s) => (s.kind === "ending" ? [] : s.tasks.flatMap((t) => (t.savesButtonPressedAs ? [t.savesButtonPressedAs] : []))));
  return {
    formatVersion: 0,
    id: "wf_fuzz",
    start: { by: "personSubmitsForm", stage: "st_0", startsWhen: [] },
    stages,
    statuses: STATUSES.map((id) => ({ id, words: id, colour: "grey" as const })),
    thingsTold: [],
    values: [...Object.keys(VALUE_KIND), ...bp].map((id) => ({ id: id as `v_${string}`, name: id })),
    lists: [],
  };
}

// ── The interpreter: the authored meaning ────────────────────────────────────

type Values = Map<string, JsonValue>;
type Answer = { button: string; data: Record<string, JsonValue> };

/** The value an expression gives, or undefined when empty. */
function valueOf(e: Expression, values: Values): JsonValue | undefined {
  if ("value" in e) return values.get(e.value);
  if ("yesNo" in e) return e.yesNo;
  if ("number" in e) return e.number;
  if ("text" in e) return e.text;
  if ("choice" in e) return e.choice;
  throw new Error(`no meaning for ${JSON.stringify(e)}`);
}

/** E-22: an empty value makes a clause not true, except the empty words and the negative words. */
function clauseTrue(c: Clause, values: Values, pressed: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): boolean {
  if ("pressed" in c) return [...pressed.values()].includes(c.pressed);
  const L = valueOf(c.left as Expression, values);
  const right = c.right;
  const R = right === undefined || Array.isArray(right) ? undefined : valueOf(right, values);
  const has = (x: unknown): boolean => x !== undefined;
  const pos = (f: () => boolean): boolean => has(L) && has(R) && f();
  switch (c.words) {
    case "yesNo.isYes": return L === true;
    case "yesNo.isNo": return L === false;
    case "yesNo.isFilled": case "number.isFilled": case "text.isFilled": case "choice.isFilled": return has(L);
    case "yesNo.isEmpty": case "number.isEmpty": case "text.isEmpty": case "choice.isEmpty": return !has(L);
    case "number.isMoreThan": return pos(() => (L as number) > (R as number));
    case "number.isLessThan": return pos(() => (L as number) < (R as number));
    case "number.isAtMost": return pos(() => (L as number) <= (R as number));
    case "number.is": case "text.is": case "choice.is": return pos(() => L === R);
    case "number.isNot": case "text.isNot": case "choice.isNot": return !pos(() => L === R);
    case "text.contains": return pos(() => (L as string).includes(R as string));
    case "choice.isOneOf": case "choice.isNotOneOf": {
      const items = (right as Expression[]).map((x) => valueOf(x, values)).filter(has);
      const one = has(L) && items.includes(L as JsonValue);
      return c.words === "choice.isOneOf" ? one : !one;
    }
    default:
      throw new Error(`no meaning for ${c.words}`);
  }
}

function conditionTrue(c: Condition, values: Values, pressed: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): boolean {
  if ("allOf" in c) return c.allOf.every((x) => clauseTrue(x, values, pressed));
  if ("anyOf" in c) return c.anyOf.some((x) => clauseTrue(x, values, pressed));
  throw new Error("formula");
}

/** Dominators of the authored stage graph (iterative, from the definition of dominance). */
function dominators(wf: AuthoredWorkflow): Map<string, Set<string>> {
  const all = wf.stages.map((s) => s.id as string);
  const preds = new Map<string, string[]>(all.map((s) => [s, []]));
  for (const s of wf.stages) if (s.kind !== "ending") for (const a of s.arrows) if (a.goTo) preds.get(a.goTo)?.push(s.id);
  const reach = new Set<string>([wf.start.stage]);
  for (let changed = true; changed; ) {
    changed = false;
    for (const s of wf.stages) if (reach.has(s.id) && s.kind !== "ending") for (const a of s.arrows) if (a.goTo && !reach.has(a.goTo)) { reach.add(a.goTo); changed = true; }
  }
  const dom = new Map<string, Set<string>>(all.map((s) => [s, s === wf.start.stage ? new Set([s]) : new Set(all)]));
  for (let changed = true; changed; ) {
    changed = false;
    for (const s of all) {
      if (s === wf.start.stage || !reach.has(s)) continue;
      const ps = (preds.get(s) ?? []).filter((p) => reach.has(p));
      const next = new Set<string>(ps.length ? [...(dom.get(ps[0] as string) as Set<string>)].filter((x) => ps.every((p) => dom.get(p)?.has(x))) : []);
      next.add(s);
      if (next.size !== dom.get(s)?.size) { dom.set(s, next); changed = true; }
    }
  }
  for (const s of all) if (!reach.has(s)) dom.set(s, new Set());
  return dom;
}

export class Meaning {
  values: Values = new Map();
  stage: string | null = null;
  status: string | null = null;
  closed: string | null = null;
  stuck: "nothing-fits" | null = null;
  open = new Map<string, Task>();
  done = new Map<string, Answer>();
  private readonly byId = new Map<string, Stage>();
  private readonly dom: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  /** Every arrow this run took. */
  readonly taken = new Set<string>();
  private hops = 0;

  readonly wf: AuthoredWorkflow;

  constructor(wf: AuthoredWorkflow) {
    this.wf = wf;
    for (const s of wf.stages) this.byId.set(s.id, s);
    this.dom = dominators(wf);
  }

  private working(id: string): WorkingStage {
    return this.byId.get(id) as WorkingStage;
  }

  start(answer: Answer): void {
    const s = this.working(this.wf.start.stage);
    this.stage = s.id;
    this.status = s.status ?? null;
    this.open = new Map(s.tasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
    this.done = new Map();
    this.answer(s.tasks[0]?.id as string, answer);
  }

  /** Who may answer a task: its assignees, less the Requester when they may not answer. */
  mayAnswer(t: Task, user: string): boolean {
    const asked = !t.whoIsAsked ? [] : "request" in t.whoIsAsked ? [REQUESTER] : "person" in t.whoIsAsked ? [t.whoIsAsked.person.directoryId] : [];
    return asked.includes(user) && (t.requesterCanAnswer || user !== REQUESTER);
  }

  private enter(id: string, sentBack: boolean): void {
    if (++this.hops > 200) throw new Error("interpreter loop");
    const s = this.byId.get(id) as Stage;
    this.stage = id;
    this.open = new Map();
    this.done = new Map();
    if (s.kind === "ending") {
      this.closed = id;
      this.status = s.status ?? null;
      return;
    }
    this.status = (sentBack ? s.ifSentBackStatus ?? s.status : s.status) ?? null;
    this.runActions(s.whenThisStageStarts, new Map());
    if (s.tasks.length > 0) {
      this.open = new Map(s.tasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
      return;
    }
    // The order rule holds for a stage with no tasks too: its "After they respond" runs before its arrows.
    this.runActions(s.afterTheyRespond, new Map());
    this.route(s, new Map(), null);
  }

  private runActions(actions: readonly Action[], pressed: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): void {
    for (const a of actions) {
      if (a.type !== "saveValue") throw new Error("only saves");
      if (a.onlyWhen && !conditionTrue(a.onlyWhen, this.values, pressed)) continue;
      this.values.set(a.as as string, valueOf(a.save as Expression, this.values) as JsonValue);
    }
  }

  /** The values as they are after the tasks step: answered tasks in document order; a cancelled task empties its "Button pressed". */
  private afterTasks(s: WorkingStage): Values {
    const v = new Map(this.values);
    for (const t of s.tasks) {
      const a = this.done.get(t.id);
      if (t.savesButtonPressedAs) {
        if (a) v.set(t.savesButtonPressedAs, a.button);
        else v.delete(t.savesButtonPressedAs);
      }
      if (!a) continue;
      // Questions of one task saved as one value: the last answered in form order is kept; the value is
      // removed only when all of them are empty (E-27).
      const answered = new Map<string, JsonValue | undefined>();
      for (const p of t.form.pages) for (const q of p.items) {
        if (q.type !== "question" || !q.savedAs) continue;
        if (q.id in a.data) answered.set(q.savedAs, a.data[q.id] as JsonValue);
        else if (!answered.has(q.savedAs)) answered.set(q.savedAs, undefined);
      }
      for (const [value, x] of answered) {
        if (x === undefined) v.delete(value);
        else v.set(value, x);
      }
    }
    return v;
  }

  private pressed(): Map<string, string> {
    return new Map([...this.done].map(([t, a]) => [t, a.button]));
  }

  private fits(ar: Arrow, values: Values, pressed: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): boolean {
    const w = ar.when;
    const base = w.type === "buttonPressed" ? [...pressed.values()].includes(w.button as string)
      : w.type === "condition" ? conditionTrue(w.condition as Condition, values, pressed)
      : w.type === "whenDone";
    return base && (!ar.onlyWhen || conditionTrue(ar.onlyWhen, values, pressed));
  }

  answer(task: string, answer: Answer): void {
    const s = this.working(this.stage as string);
    this.open.delete(task);
    this.done.set(task, answer);
    const after = this.afterTasks(s);
    if (this.open.size > 0) {
      const early = s.arrows.find((ar) => ar.goAsSoonAsTrue && this.fits(ar, after, this.pressed()));
      if (!early) return;
      this.open = new Map();
      this.values = after;
      this.runActions(s.afterTheyRespond, this.pressed());
      this.route(s, this.pressed(), early);
      return;
    }
    this.values = after;
    this.runActions(s.afterTheyRespond, this.pressed());
    this.route(s, this.pressed(), null);
  }

  private route(s: WorkingStage, pressed: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, early: Arrow | null): void {
    const chosen = early ?? s.arrows.find((ar) => ar.when.type !== "inAllOtherCases" && this.fits(ar, this.values, pressed)) ?? s.arrows.find((ar) => ar.when.type === "inAllOtherCases");
    if (!chosen || !chosen.goTo) {
      this.stuck = "nothing-fits";
      return;
    }
    this.taken.add(chosen.id);
    const target = chosen.goTo;
    this.enter(target, this.dom.get(s.id)?.has(target) ?? false);
  }

  /** Why the request is stuck, as the host should say. */
  stuckReason(): string | null {
    if (this.stuck) return this.stuck;
    if ([...this.open.values()].some((t) => !USERS.some((u) => this.mayAnswer(t, u)))) return "nobody-to-ask";
    return null;
  }
}

// ── Driving both ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const user = (id: string): By => ({ type: "user", id });
const at = (n: number): string => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 16, 9, 0, 0) + n * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");

/** Random answers to the questions shown; a question on a page that is not shown is left empty. */
function randomAnswer(r: Rand, t: Task, values: Values): Answer {
  const data: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
  for (const p of t.form.pages) {
    const shown = !p.showWhen || conditionTrue(p.showWhen, values, new Map());
    for (const q of p.items) {
      if (q.type !== "question" || r.chance(0.2)) continue;
      const x = q.kind === "yesNo" ? r.chance(0.5) : q.kind === "number" ? r.pick([-1, 0, 5, 10, 11]) : q.kind === "text" ? r.pick(["a", "hello", "x"]) : r.pick(CHOICES);
      if (shown) data[q.id] = x;
    }
  }
  return { button: r.pick(t.buttons).id, data };
}

/** What an answer shows of the merge of one task's questions saved as one value. */
function noteMerge(seen: Set<string>, t: Task, a: Answer): void {
  const byValue = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const p of t.form.pages) for (const q of p.items) {
    if (q.type !== "question" || !q.savedAs) continue;
    byValue.set(q.savedAs, [...(byValue.get(q.savedAs) ?? []), q.id]);
    if (p.showWhen && q.id in a.data) seen.add("alternate:answered");
  }
  for (const qs of byValue.values()) {
    if (qs.length < 2) continue;
    const answered = qs.map((q) => q in a.data);
    const last = answered.lastIndexOf(true);
    if (last >= 0 && last < qs.length - 1) seen.add("merge:earlierKept");
    if (answered.filter(Boolean).length >= 2) seen.add("merge:laterWins");
    if (last < 0) seen.add("merge:allEmpty");
  }
}

function authoredStageOf(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, engineStage: string): string {
  const item = engineStage.split("__")[0] as string;
  if (item.startsWith("st_")) return item;
  const owner = wf.stages.find((s) => s.kind !== "ending" && [...s.whenThisStageStarts, ...s.afterTheyRespond].some((a) => a.id === item));
  return owner?.id ?? item;
}

interface Observed {
  stage: string | null;
  open: string[];
  status: string | null;
  closed: string | null;
  values: Record<string, JsonValue>;
  stuck: string | null;
}

function observeHost(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, host: MemoryHost, id: string): Observed {
  const st = host.state(id);
  const active = st.activeStages.filter((a) => a.stage !== "root").map((a) => a.stage);
  const values = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(st.data).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith("v_")));
  return {
    stage: st.closed ? st.closed.stage : active.length ? authoredStageOf(wf, active[active.length - 1] as string) : null,
    open: st.waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open" && w.kind === "person").map((w) => w.id.element.split(".")[1] as string).sort(),
    status: st.status?.id ?? null,
    closed: st.closed?.stage ?? null,
    values,
    stuck: host.stuck(id)?.reason ?? null,
  };
}

function observeMeaning(m: Meaning): Observed {
  return {
    stage: m.stage,
    open: [...m.open.keys()].sort(),
    status: m.status,
    closed: m.closed,
    values: Object.fromEntries([...m.values].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))),
    stuck: m.stuckReason(),
  };
}

function sortKeys(o: Observed): Observed {
  return { ...o, values: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o.values).sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))) };
}

/**
 * Runs one workflow both ways with random answers; returns the first difference, or null. `seen` collects
 * what the run exercised (transitions fired, copies entered, refusals, stuck reasons, arrows taken).
 */
export function differ(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, def: PublishedDefinition, seed: number, seen?: Set<string>): string | null {
  const r = new Rand(rng(seed * 7919 + 1));
  const host = createMemoryHost(def, {});
  const m = new Meaning(wf);
  const startTask = (wf.stages[0] as WorkingStage).tasks[0] as Task;
  let t = 0;
  const first = randomAnswer(r, startTask, new Map());
  const started = host.start({ by: user(REQUESTER), outcome: first.button, data: first.data as JsonObject }, at(t++));
  if (!started.ok) return `start refused: ${JSON.stringify(started.refusals)}`;
  const id = started.requestId;
  m.start(first);
  const log: string[] = [`start ${JSON.stringify(first)}`];
  for (let step = 0; step < 25; step++) {
    const h = sortKeys(observeHost(wf, host, id));
    const e = observeMeaning(m);
    const faults = host.events(id).filter((x) => x.type === "Faulted");
    if (faults.length > 0) return `${log.join("\n")}\nfaulted: ${JSON.stringify(faults.map((f) => f.payload))}`;
    if (JSON.stringify(h) !== JSON.stringify(e)) return `${log.join("\n")}\nhost:    ${JSON.stringify(h)}\nmeaning: ${JSON.stringify(e)}`;
    if (seen) note(seen, host, id, m);
    if (m.closed || m.stuck || m.open.size === 0) return null;
    const task = r.pick([...m.open.values()]);
    const by = r.pick(USERS);
    const answer = randomAnswer(r, task, m.values);
    const wait = host.state(id).waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open" && w.id.element.endsWith(`.${task.id}`)).at(-1);
    if (!wait) return `${log.join("\n")}\n${task.id} is not open in the host`;
    const turn = host.act(id, { by: user(by), wait: wait.id, outcome: answer.button, data: answer.data as JsonObject }, at(t++));
    const may = m.mayAnswer(task, by);
    if (seen && !turn.ok) for (const x of turn.refusals) seen.add(`refused:${x.reason}`);
    log.push(`${by} answers ${task.id} ${JSON.stringify(answer)}: host ${turn.ok ? "ok" : JSON.stringify(turn.refusals.map((x) => x.reason))}, meaning ${may ? "ok" : "refused"}`);
    if (turn.ok !== may) return log.join("\n");
    if (may) {
      if (seen) noteMerge(seen, task, answer);
      m.answer(task.id, answer);
    }
    if (!USERS.some((u) => [...m.open.values()].some((o) => m.mayAnswer(o, u)))) {
      // Nobody can answer what is open: compare once more and stop.
      if (seen) note(seen, host, id, m);
      const h2 = sortKeys(observeHost(wf, host, id));
      const e2 = observeMeaning(m);
      return JSON.stringify(h2) === JSON.stringify(e2) ? null : `${log.join("\n")}\nhost:    ${JSON.stringify(h2)}\nmeaning: ${JSON.stringify(e2)}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}


function note(seen: Set<string>, host: MemoryHost, id: string, m: Meaning): void {
  for (const e of host.events(id)) {
    if (e.type === "TransitionFired") seen.add(`fired:${e.payload.transition.split("__")[1] ?? "arrow"}`);
    if (e.type === "StageEntered" && e.payload.stage.endsWith("Back")) seen.add(`entered:${e.payload.stage.split("__")[1] ?? ""}`);
  }
  const stuck = host.stuck(id);
  if (stuck) seen.add(`stuck:${stuck.reason}`);
  for (const a of m.taken) seen.add(`taken:${a}`);
}
