/**
 * Runs a compiled definition through the in-memory host (the kernel's turn function), with helpers to act
 * on the open task of an element, answer its calls and read what happened.
 */
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { compile, type CompileOptions } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { AnyEventRecord, By, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition, WaitId } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { createMemoryHost, type HostTurn, type MemoryHost, type MemoryHostOptions } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import { catalogue } from "../fixtures.ts";

export function compiled(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, options: CompileOptions = {}): PublishedDefinition {
  const r = compile(wf, catalogue(), options);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`compile refused: ${JSON.stringify(r.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo"))}`);
  return r.published;
}

export const user = (id: string): By => ({ type: "user", id });
const at = (n: number): string => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 15, 9, 0, n)).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");

function ok(r: HostTurn): Extract<HostTurn, { ok: true }> {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(r)}`);
  return r;
}

export class Run {
  readonly host: MemoryHost;
  readonly definition: PublishedDefinition;
  requestId = "";
  private t = 0;

  constructor(definition: PublishedDefinition, options: MemoryHostOptions) {
    this.definition = definition;
    this.host = createMemoryHost(definition, options);
  }

  start(by: By, outcome: string, data: JsonObject): this {
    this.requestId = ok(this.host.start({ by, outcome, data }, at(this.t++))).requestId;
    return this;
  }

  /** The open wait of a full element ID, or a failure naming what is open. */
  open(element: string): WaitId {
    const w = this.host.state(this.requestId).waits.filter((x) => x.status === "open" && x.id.element === element).at(-1);
    if (!w) throw new Error(`${element} is not open; open: ${this.openElements().join(", ")}`);
    return w.id;
  }

  openElements(): string[] {
    return this.host.state(this.requestId).waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open").map((w) => w.id.element);
  }

  act(element: string, by: By, outcome: string, data: JsonObject = {}): HostTurn {
    return this.host.act(this.requestId, { by, wait: this.open(element), outcome, data }, at(this.t++));
  }

  actOk(element: string, by: By, outcome: string, data: JsonObject = {}): this {
    ok(this.act(element, by, outcome, data));
    return this;
  }

  answer(element: string, outcome: "ok" | "failed", data: JsonObject): this {
    ok(this.host.answerCall(this.requestId, this.open(element), { outcome, data }, at(this.t++)));
    return this;
  }

  events(): readonly AnyEventRecord[] {
    return this.host.events(this.requestId);
  }

  /** Every engine stage entered, in order. */
  stagesEntered(): string[] {
    return this.events().flatMap((e) => (e.type === "StageEntered" && e.payload.stage !== "root" ? [e.payload.stage] : []));
  }

  /** Every person wait opened, with its assignees. */
  tasksOpened(): { element: string; assignees: string[] }[] {
    return this.events().flatMap((e) =>
      e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "person" ? [{ element: e.payload.wait.element, assignees: e.payload.assignees.map((r) => `${r.type}:${r.id}`) }] : [],
    );
  }

  data(): JsonObject {
    return this.host.state(this.requestId).data;
  }

  closedAt(): string | null | undefined {
    return this.host.state(this.requestId).closed?.stage;
  }

  expectStatus(id: string | null): void {
    expect(this.host.state(this.requestId).status?.id ?? null).toBe(id);
  }
}

/**
 * The condition builder (compiler.md 8.3): every kind of WORDS_FOR_KIND, every word offered for it,
 * filled and empty left sides, empty and filled right sides, and list right sides with empty items.
 * Each compiled clause is type-checked and run in the cel-1 environment and compared with the

 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { WORDS, WORDS_FOR_KIND, WORDS_WITH_A_LIST, WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER, type ValueKind, type Words } from "../../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";

  choice: ["ch_a", "ch_b"],

  multipleChoice: [["ch_a", "ch_b"], ["ch_b"]],
  person: [user("u1"), user("u2")],
  group: [group("g_full"), group("g_empty"), group("g_other")],
  people: [[user("u1"), user("u2")], [user("u2")]],

/** A constant of the kind holding the sample, for a right side the compiler folds. */
function constantOf(kind: ValueKind, v: JsonValue): JsonValue {
  const ref = (x: JsonValue) => ({ directoryId: (x as { id: string }).id, name: "n" });
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
    case "longText":
      return { text: v };
    case "number":
      return { number: v };
    case "yesNo":
      return { yesNo: v };
    case "date":
      return { date: v };
    case "choice":
      return { choice: v };
    case "choiceFromList":
      return { row: v };
    case "choiceFromConnection":
      return { connectionChoice: v };
    case "person":
      return { person: ref(v) };
    case "group":
      return { group: ref(v) };
    case "people":
      return { people: (v as JsonValue[]).map(ref) };
    default:
      throw new Error(kind);
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the meaning, written out

const same = (a: V, b: V): boolean => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
const stored = (a: V): V => (a !== null && typeof a === "object" && !Array.isArray(a) && "stored" in a ? a["stored"] : a);
const membersOf = (g: V): JsonValue[] => MEMBERS[(g as { id: string }).id] ?? [];
const isGroup = (x: V): boolean => (x as { type?: string } | undefined)?.type === "group";
const day = (d: V): number => new Date(`${d as string}T00:00:00Z`).getUTCDay();

/**
 * Each word, given the left value, the right value or list, and the weekday asked for. An empty
 * value is undefined. Positive words are not true when a side they read is empty; the empty words
 * and the negative words are true then; empty items of a list are ignored.
 */
const MEANING: Record<Words, (l: V, r: V | V[], weekday?: number) => boolean> = {
  "text.is": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && l === r,
  "text.isNot": (l, r) => l === undefined || r === undefined || l !== r,
  "text.contains": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as string).includes(r as string),
  "text.doesNotContain": (l, r) => l === undefined || r === undefined || !(l as string).includes(r as string),
  "text.startsWith": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as string).startsWith(r as string),
  "text.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "text.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
  "number.is": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && l === r,
  "number.isNot": (l, r) => l === undefined || r === undefined || l !== r,
  "number.isMoreThan": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as number) > (r as number),
  "number.isLessThan": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as number) < (r as number),
  "number.isAtLeast": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as number) >= (r as number),
  "number.isAtMost": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as number) <= (r as number),
  "number.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "number.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
  "yesNo.isYes": (l) => l === true,
  "yesNo.isNo": (l) => l === false,
  "yesNo.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "yesNo.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
  "date.is": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && Date.parse(l as string) === Date.parse(r as string),
  "date.isBefore": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && Date.parse(l as string) < Date.parse(r as string),
  "date.isAfter": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && Date.parse(l as string) > Date.parse(r as string),
  "date.isOnOrBefore": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && Date.parse(l as string) <= Date.parse(r as string),
  "date.isOnOrAfter": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && Date.parse(l as string) >= Date.parse(r as string),
  "date.isOnWeekday": (l, _r, weekday) => l !== undefined && day(l) === weekday,
  "date.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "date.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
  "choice.is": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && same(stored(l), stored(r as V)),
  "choice.isNot": (l, r) => l === undefined || r === undefined || !same(stored(l), stored(r as V)),
  "choice.isOneOf": (l, r) => l !== undefined && (r as V[]).some((x) => x !== undefined && same(stored(l), stored(x))),
  "choice.isNotOneOf": (l, r) => !(l !== undefined && (r as V[]).some((x) => x !== undefined && same(stored(l), stored(x)))),
  "choice.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "choice.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
  "person.is": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && same(l, r as V),
  "person.isNot": (l, r) => l === undefined || r === undefined || !same(l, r as V),
  "person.isOneOf": (l, r) => l !== undefined && (r as V[]).some((x) => x !== undefined && same(l, x)),
  "person.isIn": (l, r) =>
    l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (isGroup(r as V) ? membersOf(r as V) : (r as JsonValue[])).some((m) => same(m, l)),
  "person.isNotIn": (l, r) => !MEANING["person.isIn"](l, r),
  "person.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "person.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
  "people.include": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (isGroup(l) ? membersOf(l) : (l as JsonValue[])).some((m) => same(m, r as V)),
  "people.doNotInclude": (l, r) => !MEANING["people.include"](l, r),
  "people.areFilled": (l) => l !== undefined && (isGroup(l) ? membersOf(l) : (l as JsonValue[])).length > 0,
  "people.areEmpty": (l) => !(l !== undefined && (isGroup(l) ? membersOf(l) : (l as JsonValue[])).length > 0),
  "list.includes": (l, r) => l !== undefined && r !== undefined && (l as JsonValue[]).includes(r as JsonValue),
  "list.doesNotInclude": (l, r) => l === undefined || r === undefined || !(l as JsonValue[]).includes(r as JsonValue),
  "list.includesAnyOf": (l, r) => l !== undefined && (r as V[]).some((x) => x !== undefined && (l as JsonValue[]).includes(x)),
  "list.includesAllOf": (l, r) => l !== undefined && (r as V[]).every((x) => x === undefined || (l as JsonValue[]).includes(x)),
  "list.isFilled": (l) => l !== undefined,
  "list.isEmpty": (l) => l === undefined,
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the right side each word takes

/** The kinds the right side of a word may have, for a left side of this kind. */
function rightKinds(word: Words, left: ValueKind): ValueKind[] {
  if ((WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER as readonly string[]).includes(word) || word === "date.isOnWeekday") return [];
  if (word === "person.isIn" || word === "person.isNotIn") return ["group", "people"];
  if (word.startsWith("people.")) return ["person"];
  if (word.startsWith("list.")) return ["choice"];
  if (word.startsWith("person.")) return ["person"];
  return [left];
}

const RIGHT_SAMPLES: Partial<Record<ValueKind, JsonValue[]>> = { choice: ["ch_a", "ch_c"] };

interface Case {
  left: V;
  right: V | V[];
  constantRight: boolean;
}

function cases(word: Words, left: ValueKind, right: ValueKind | undefined): Case[] {
  const lefts: V[] = [undefined, ...(SAMPLES[left] ?? [])];
  if (right === undefined) return lefts.map((l) => ({ left: l, right: undefined, constantRight: false }));
  const rs: V[] = [undefined, ...(RIGHT_SAMPLES[right] ?? SAMPLES[right] ?? [])];
  const out: Case[] = [];
  for (const l of lefts) {
    if ((WORDS_WITH_A_LIST as readonly string[]).includes(word)) {
      for (const a of rs) {
        out.push({ left: l, right: [a], constantRight: false });
        for (const b of rs) out.push({ left: l, right: [a, b], constantRight: false });
      }
    } else {
      for (const r of rs) {
        out.push({ left: l, right: r, constantRight: false });
        if (r !== undefined) out.push({ left: l, right: r, constantRight: true });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const PLACE: DataPlace = { in: "data", groupsKey: GROUPS_KEY };

describe("every word for every kind, against its meaning (compiler.md 8.3)", () => {
  for (const [kind, set] of Object.entries(WORDS_FOR_KIND) as [ValueKind, keyof typeof WORDS | null][]) {
    if (set === null) continue;
    for (const word of WORDS[set] as readonly Words[]) {
      const rights = rightKinds(word, kind);
      for (const right of rights.length ? rights : [undefined]) {
        it(`${kind} ${word}${right ? ` ${right}` : ""}`, () => {
          const spec: Spec = { values: { v_l: kind, ...(right ? { v_r0: right, v_r1: right } : {}) } };
          const env = environment(spec);
          const w = world(spec);
          const weekdays = word === "date.isOnWeekday" ? (["monday", "friday", "sunday"] as const) : ([undefined] as const);
          for (const weekday of weekdays) {
            for (const c of cases(word, kind, right)) {
              const data: Record<string, JsonValue> = { [GROUPS_KEY]: RECORDED };
              if (c.left !== undefined) data["v_l"] = c.left;
              let rightNode: unknown;
              if (weekday !== undefined) rightNode = { weekday };
              else if ((WORDS_WITH_A_LIST as readonly string[]).includes(word) && Array.isArray(c.right) && right) {
                rightNode = c.right.map((_x, i) => ({ value: `v_r${i}` }));
                c.right.forEach((x, i) => {
                  if (x !== undefined) data[`v_r${i}`] = x;
                });
              } else if (c.right !== undefined && right) {
                rightNode = c.constantRight ? constantOf(right, c.right as JsonValue) : { value: "v_r0" };
                if (!c.constantRight) data["v_r0"] = c.right as JsonValue;
              } else if (right) rightNode = { value: "v_r0" };
              const clause = rightNode === undefined ? { left: { value: "v_l" }, words: word } : { left: { value: "v_l" }, words: word, right: rightNode };
              const compiled = compileCondition({ allOf: [clause] }, PLACE, w);
              if (!compiled.ok) throw new Error(`${word}: ${JSON.stringify(compiled)}`);
              const got = run(env, compiled.cel, { data }, "bool");
              const n = weekday === undefined ? undefined : { sunday: 0, monday: 1, friday: 5 }[weekday];
              const expected = MEANING[word](c.left, c.right, n);
              expect(got, `${compiled.cel}\nleft ${JSON.stringify(c.left)} right ${JSON.stringify(c.right)}${c.constantRight ? " (constant)" : ""}`).toEqual({
                kind: "value",
                value: expected,
              });
            }
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }

  it("covers every word of WORDS", () => {
    const covered = new Set(Object.values(WORDS_FOR_KIND).flatMap((s) => (s ? [...WORDS[s]] : [])));
    expect([...covered].sort()).toEqual(Object.values(WORDS).flat().sort());
  });
});

describe("joining clauses", () => {
  const spec: Spec = { values: { v_a: "yesNo", v_b: "text" } };
  const w = world(spec);
  const env = environment(spec);
  const yes = { left: { value: "v_a" }, words: "yesNo.isYes" };
  const filled = { left: { value: "v_b" }, words: "text.isFilled" };

  it("allOf joins with &&, anyOf with ||, each clause in parentheses; one clause is itself", () => {
    expect(compileCondition({ allOf: [yes, filled] }, PLACE, w)).toMatchObject({ cel: "(data.?v_a.orValue(false)) && (data.?v_b.hasValue())" });
    expect(compileCondition({ anyOf: [yes, filled] }, PLACE, w)).toMatchObject({ cel: "(data.?v_a.orValue(false)) || (data.?v_b.hasValue())" });
    expect(compileCondition({ anyOf: [yes] }, PLACE, w)).toMatchObject({ cel: "data.?v_a.orValue(false)" });
  });

  it("evaluates and / or", () => {
    const all = compileCondition({ allOf: [yes, filled] }, PLACE, w);
    const any = compileCondition({ anyOf: [yes, filled] }, PLACE, w);
    if (!all.ok || !any.ok) throw new Error("no rule");
    for (const [a, b] of [[true, "x"], [true, undefined], [false, "x"], [undefined, undefined]] as const) {
      const data: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};

      expect(run(env, any.cel, { data }, "bool")).toEqual({ kind: "value", value: a === true || b !== undefined });
    }
  });

  it("negative words wrap their positive word, so precedence holds inside an allOf", () => {
    const r = compileCondition({ allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_b" }, words: "text.isNot", right: { text: "x" } }, yes] }, PLACE, w);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ cel: "(!(data.?v_b.hasValue() && data.?v_b.value() == 'x')) && (data.?v_a.orValue(false))" });
  });

  it("a constant's presence test is folded away (compiler.md 15.7)", () => {
    expect(compileCondition({ allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_b" }, words: "text.is", right: { text: "Service change" } }] }, PLACE, w)).toMatchObject({
      cel: "data.?v_b.hasValue() && data.?v_b.value() == 'Service change'",
    });
  });
});

  values: { v_due: "date", v_n: "number", v_title: "text", v_owner: "person" },

const w = world(spec);
const env = environment(spec);
const DATA: Place = { in: "data" };
const f = (formula: string) => ({ formula, readsAs: "x" });

function value(e: unknown, place: Place, context: Record<string, JsonValue>): JsonValue | undefined {
  const r = compileExpression(e, place, w);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  return valueOf(run(env, r.cel, context, /^optional/));
}

describe("a formula as a value", () => {
  it("is guarded by every chip that can be empty, in chip order, each once", () => {
    const r = compileExpression(f("{{v_n}} * 2.0 + {{v_n}}"), DATA, w);
    expect(r).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      cel: "(data.?v_n.hasValue() ? optional.of(data.?v_n.value() * 2.0 + data.?v_n.value()) : optional.none())",
      kind: "number",
      reads: [],
    });
    expect(value(f("{{v_n}} * 2.0"), DATA, { data: { v_n: 4 } })).toBe(8);
    expect(value(f("{{v_n}} * 2.0"), DATA, { data: {} })).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("with no chip is always present", () => {
    expect(compileExpression(f("1.0 + 2.0"), DATA, w)).toMatchObject({ cel: "optional.of(1.0 + 2.0)", kind: "number" });
  });

      cel: "(data.?v_due.hasValue() ? optional.of(asDate(date(data.?v_due.value()) + days(3))) : optional.none())",
      kind: "date",
    });
    expect(value(f("{{v_due}} + days(3)"), DATA, { data: { v_due: "2026-12-30" } })).toBe("2027-01-02");
  });

  it("reads Started on as the start day at midnight UTC, never empty", () => {

    expect(r).toMatchObject({ cel: "optional.of(asDate(date(asDate(timestamp(request.at))) + days(1)))" });

  });

  it("reads the Requester through REQ, so a person's start has one", () => {
    const r = compileExpression(f("{{request.requester}}.id"), DATA, w);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ cel: `(${REQ}.hasValue() ? optional.of(${REQ}.value().id) : optional.none())` });
    expect(value(f("{{request.requester}}.id"), DATA, { data: {} })).toBe(REQUEST.by.id);
  });

  });

  it("reads sent fields in a binding", () => {

    expect(value(f("'K-' + {{sent.key}}"), place, { sent: { key: "1" } })).toBe("K-1");
    expect(value(f("'K-' + {{sent.key}}"), place, { sent: {} })).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("an author's optional result stays an optional", () => {
    const r = compileExpression(f("{{v_n}} > 0.0 ? optional.of({{v_title}}) : optional.none()"), DATA, w);

  });
});

/**
 * A small world for the expression compiler's tests, and the engine's CEL environment typed the way
 * the published definition types data (compiler.md 3.4): each value by its kind, the Requester as a
 * person, `<st>__groups` as the recorded `membersOf@1` result, lists as constants.
 */
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { createCelEnvironment, type CelEnvironment } from "../../../../src/cel/environment.ts";
import { t, type CelResult, type CelType, type JsonValue } from "../../../../src/cel/types.ts";
import type { ValueKind } from "../../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { celTypeOfKind } from "../../../../src/authored/formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import type { ExprWorld } from "../../../../src/authored/compile/expr/index.ts";

export const GROUPS_KEY = "st_s__groups";
const REF = t.object({ type: t.string, id: t.string });

export interface ListSpec {
  columns: Record<string, ValueKind>;
  rows: Record<string, Record<string, JsonValue>>;
}

export interface Spec {
  values: Record<string, ValueKind>;
  lists?: Record<string, ListSpec>;
  /** Typed-in choices (or buttons) of a choice value. */
  choices?: Record<string, { id: string; label: string }[]>;
  listChoice?: Record<string, { list: string; shownColumn?: string }>;
  /** Button to task. */
  buttons?: Record<string, string>;
  labels?: Record<string, string>;
  /** The form's answers by question, with kinds. */
  input?: Record<string, ValueKind>;
  /** A trigger's sent fields by top-level id. */
  sent?: Record<string, CelType>;
  /** Person waits by ID, with the kinds of their outcome data. */
  waits?: Record<string, Record<string, ValueKind>>;
}

export function world(spec: Spec): ExprWorld {
  const columns = new Map<string, { list: string; kind: ValueKind }>();
  for (const [list, l] of Object.entries(spec.lists ?? {})) for (const [c, kind] of Object.entries(l.columns)) columns.set(c, { list, kind });
  return {
    valueKind: (v) => spec.values[v],
    column: (c) => columns.get(c),
    listChoice: (v) => spec.listChoice?.[v],
    choiceLabels: (v) => spec.choices?.[v] ?? [],
    labelOf: (id) => spec.labels?.[id],
    buttonTask: (b) => spec.buttons?.[b],
  };
}

function objectOf(kinds: Record<string, ValueKind>): CelType {
  return t.object(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(kinds).map(([k, kind]) => [k, celTypeOfKind(kind)])));
}

/** The CEL environment the compiled text must type-check and run in. */
export function environment(spec: Spec): CelEnvironment {
  const data: Record<string, CelType> = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(spec.values).map(([k, kind]) => [k, celTypeOfKind(kind)]));
  data["requester"] = REF;
  data[GROUPS_KEY] = t.list(t.object({ id: REF, members: t.list(REF) }));
  for (const task of new Set(Object.values(spec.buttons ?? {}))) data[`${task}__pressed`] = t.string;
  const waits: Record<string, CelType> = {};
  for (const [w, kinds] of Object.entries(spec.waits ?? {}))
    waits[w] = t.object({ status: t.string, outcome: t.string, by: REF, data: objectOf(kinds) });
  const constants: Record<string, { type: CelType; value: JsonValue }> = {};
  for (const [name, l] of Object.entries(spec.lists ?? {})) constants[name] = { type: t.map(objectOf(l.columns)), value: l.rows };
  return createCelEnvironment({
    variables: {
      data: t.object(data),
      request: t.object({ id: t.string, by: REF, at: t.string }),
      actor: REF,
      input: objectOf({ ...spec.input, requester: "person" }),
      waits: t.object(waits),
      sent: t.object(spec.sent ?? {}),
    },
    constants,
  });
}

export const REQUEST = { id: "r1", by: { type: "user", id: "u_starter" }, at: "2026-11-15T10:30:00Z" };

/** Type-checks the text, expects the given result type, and evaluates it over the context. */
export function run(env: CelEnvironment, cel: string, context: Record<string, JsonValue>, type?: RegExp | string): CelResult {
  const checked = env.check(cel);
  if (!checked.ok) throw new Error(`does not type-check: ${cel}\n${JSON.stringify(checked.problems)}`);
  if (type !== undefined) {
    if (typeof type === "string") expect(checked.expression.type, cel).toBe(type);
    else expect(checked.expression.type, cel).toMatch(type);
  }
  return env.evaluate(checked.expression, { request: REQUEST, ...context });
}

/** The value of an optional result: the JSON, or undefined when absent. Throws on an error. */
export function valueOf(r: CelResult): JsonValue | undefined {
  if (r.kind === "error") throw new Error(`expression error: ${r.detail} ${r.message}`);
  return r.kind === "absent" ? undefined : r.value;
}

export const user = (id: string) => ({ type: "user", id });
export const group = (id: string) => ({ type: "group", id });

    },
  },
  input: { q_title: "text", q_title2: "text" },
  waits: { tk_t: { q_title: "text" } },

function value(e: unknown, place: Place, context: Record<string, JsonValue>): JsonValue | undefined {
  const r = compileExpression(e, place, w);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  return valueOf(run(env, r.cel, context, /^optional/));
}

  });

    expect(value({ value: "v_title" }, place, { data: { v_title: "old" }, waits })).toBe("new");

    expect(value({ value: "v_title" }, place, { data: { v_title: "saved" }, input: { q_title: "one", q_title2: "two" } })).toBe("two");
    expect(compileExpression({ value: "v_due" }, place, w)).toMatchObject({ cel: "data.?v_due" });
  });

    expect(compileExpression({ value: "v_due" }, place, w)).toMatchObject({ cel: "optional.none()" });

/**
 * The worked examples of compiler.md 15.3, 15.6 and 15.7, character for character where they show
 * expression text, and a sweep that compiles every expression slot of the four fixtures and
 * type-checks it in the cel-1 environment under the types the value kinds give.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  compileCondition, compileExpression, compileExpressionOrTemplate, compileMessageParts, compileValueMap, compileWhoIsAsked,
  worldFromDoc, type ExprWorld, type Place, type SentPlace,
} from "../../../../src/authored/compile/expr/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ValueKind } from "../../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { Field } from "../../../../src/authored/contract/catalogue.ts";
import { Kinds } from "../../../../src/authored/facts/kinds.ts";
import { celTypeOfField } from "../../../../src/authored/formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { indexDocument, type DocIndex } from "../../../../src/authored/index-doc.ts";
import type { CelType, JsonValue } from "../../../../src/cel/types.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, FIXTURES, type FixtureName } from "../../fixtures.ts";
import { environment, GROUPS_KEY, run, type Spec } from "./harness.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);

function load(name: FixtureName): { wf: AuthoredWorkflow; ix: DocIndex; w: ExprWorld; kinds: Kinds } {
  const wf = fixture(name);
  const ix = indexDocument(wf);
  const kinds = new Kinds(ix, catalogue());
  return { wf, ix, w: worldFromDoc(ix, kinds), kinds };
}

const DATA: Place = { in: "data", groupsKey: GROUPS_KEY };

/** An item of the document by ID, as JSON. */
function item(ix: DocIndex, id: string): Obj {
  const found = JSON.stringify(ix.workflow);
  const all: Obj[] = [];
  const walk = (x: unknown): void => {
    if (Array.isArray(x)) x.forEach(walk);
    else if (isObject(x)) {
      if (x["id"] === id) all.push(x);
      Object.values(x).forEach(walk);
    }
  };
  walk(JSON.parse(found));
  if (!all[0]) throw new Error(`no item ${id}`);
  return all[0];
}

const ok = <T extends { ok: boolean }>(r: T): Extract<T, { ok: true }> => {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  return r as Extract<T, { ok: true }>;
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ every slot of every fixture type-checks

function sentFields(trigger: string): Record<string, ValueKind> {
  const entry = catalogue().entries.find((e) => e.id === trigger) as { event?: Field[] } | undefined;
  const out: Record<string, ValueKind> = {};
  const walk = (fields: Field[], prefix: string): void => {
    for (const f of fields) {
      out[`${prefix}${f.id}`] = f.kind;
      if (f.fields) walk(f.fields, `${prefix}${f.id}.`);
    }
  };
  walk(entry?.event ?? [], "");
  return out;
}

function sentType(trigger: string): Record<string, CelType> {
  const entry = catalogue().entries.find((e) => e.id === trigger) as { event?: Field[] } | undefined;
  return Object.fromEntries((entry?.event ?? []).map((f) => [f.id, celTypeOfField(f)]));
}

function cellJson(c: unknown): JsonValue {
  if (!isObject(c)) return null;
  for (const k of ["text", "number", "yesNo", "date", "choice", "row"]) if (k in c) return c[k] as JsonValue;
  if (isObject(c["person"])) return { type: "user", id: c["person"]["directoryId"] as string };
  if (isObject(c["group"])) return { type: "group", id: c["group"]["directoryId"] as string };
  return null;
}

function specOf(ix: DocIndex, kinds: Kinds, trigger?: string): Spec {
  const values: Record<string, ValueKind> = {};
  for (const v of ix.valueIds) {
    const k = kinds.valueKind(v);
    if (k) values[v] = k;
  }
  const lists: Spec["lists"] = {};
  for (const l of ix.workflow.lists) {
    lists[l.id] = {
      columns: Object.fromEntries(l.columns.map((c) => [c.id, c.kind])),
      rows: Object.fromEntries(l.rows.map((r) => [r.id, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r.cells).map(([c, v]) => [c, cellJson(v)]))])),
    };
  }
  const buttons = Object.fromEntries([...ix.buttonTask].map(([b, t]) => [b, t.task.id]));
  const spec: Spec = { values, lists, buttons };
  if (trigger) spec.sent = sentType(trigger);
  return spec;
}

describe("every expression slot of every fixture compiles and type-checks", () => {
  for (const name of FIXTURES) {
    it(name, () => {
      const { ix, w, kinds, wf } = load(name);
      const trigger = wf.start.startsWhen[0]?.trigger;
      const env = environment(specOf(ix, kinds, trigger));
      const sent: SentPlace = { in: "sent", fields: trigger ? sentFields(trigger) : {} };
      const checkType = (cel: string, type: RegExp, where: string): void => {
        const r = env.check(cel);
        expect(r.ok ? r.expression.type : JSON.stringify(r.problems), `${where}: ${cel}`).toMatch(type);
      };
      let count = 0;
      for (const slot of ix.slots) {
        const where = `${slot.at.item} ${slot.at.part ?? ""}`;
        const part = slot.at.part ?? "";
        count++;
        if (slot.form === "sent") {
          if (part === "onlyWhen") checkType(ok(compileCondition(slot.node, sent, w)).cel, /^bool$/, where);
          else checkType(ok(compileExpressionOrTemplate(slot.node, sent, w)).cel, /^optional/, where);
        } else if (slot.form === "condition") {
          checkType(ok(compileCondition(slot.node, DATA, w)).cel, /^bool$/, where);
        } else if (part === "whoIsAsked" || part === "to") {
          const r = ok(compileWhoIsAsked(slot.node, DATA, w));
          checkType(r.cel, /^list/, where);
          checkType(r.groups, /^list/, where);
        } else if (slot.form === "template") {
          for (const p of ok(compileMessageParts(slot.node, DATA, w)).parts) if ("value" in p) checkType(p.value, /^optional/, where);
        } else {
          checkType(ok(compileExpressionOrTemplate(slot.node, DATA, w)).cel, /^optional/, where);
        }
      }
      expect(count).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  }

  it("the change-request arrow evaluates over its own list", () => {
    const { ix, w, kinds } = load("change-request");
    const env = environment(specOf(ix, kinds));
    const cel = ok(compileCondition((item(ix, "ar_rf_no_approval")["when"] as Obj)["condition"], DATA, w)).cel;
    expect(run(env, cel, { data: { v_primary_domain: "row_internal_tools" } }, "bool")).toEqual({ kind: "value", value: true });
    expect(run(env, cel, { data: { v_primary_domain: "row_payments" } }, "bool")).toEqual({ kind: "value", value: false });
    expect(run(env, cel, { data: {} }, "bool")).toEqual({ kind: "value", value: false });
  });
});

/**
 * The four fixtures compile, pass the shape check and the kernel publish check (acceptance item 1), compile
 * to byte-identical JSON every time, whatever the key order of the stored document (item 5), and match the
 * worked examples of compiler.md 15.3, 15.6 and 15.7 and the hand-written demo definition where the same
 * construct appears (item 4).
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { validateDefinitionShape, type ChildStage, type PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { checkDefinition } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, FIXTURES } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { compiled } from "./drive.ts";

const design = (name: string): string => readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL(`../../../../../design/${name}`, import.meta.url)), "utf8");

function stage(def: PublishedDefinition, id: string): ChildStage {
  const s = def.root.stages.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!s) throw new Error(`no stage ${id}; stages: ${def.root.stages.map((x) => x.id).join(", ")}`);
  return s;
}

/** The same document with every object's keys in reverse order (arrays keep theirs). */
function reversedKeys(x: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(reversedKeys);
  if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) return x;
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(x).reverse().map(([k, v]) => [k, reversedKeys(v)]));
}

describe("the four fixtures (acceptance 1)", () => {
  for (const name of FIXTURES) {
    it(`${name} compiles in publish mode and passes validateDefinitionShape and checkDefinition`, () => {
      const r = compile(fixture(name), catalogue());
      expect(r.ok ? [] : r.findings).toEqual([]);
      if (!r.ok) return;
      expect(r.findings.every((f) => f.severity === "worthKnowing")).toBe(true);
      expect(r.unfinished).toEqual([]);
      expect(validateDefinitionShape(r.published).ok).toBe(true);
      expect(checkDefinition(r.published)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it(`${name} compiles in Try it mode to the same definition, with nothing unfinished`, () => {
      const tryIt = compile(fixture(name), catalogue(), { mode: "tryIt" });
      expect(tryIt.ok && tryIt.unfinished).toEqual([]);
      expect(tryIt.ok && JSON.stringify(tryIt.published)).toBe(JSON.stringify(compiled(fixture(name))));
    });
  }
});

describe("determinism (acceptance 5)", () => {

﻿/**
 * Acceptance item 2, over a few hundred mutated fixtures (a key deleted, a reference broken, a value
 * emptied), chosen deterministically: compile never throws; a draft whose check has no To do that stops
 * compiling compiles in Try it mode to a definition of the right shape with nothing unfinished; a draft with
 * no To do at all compiles in publish mode and passes checkDefinition, and never fails with compile.internal.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { check } from "../../../src/authored/check/check.ts";
import { tryItEffect } from "../../../src/authored/check/try-it.ts";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { indexDocument } from "../../../src/authored/index-doc.ts";
import { parse } from "../../../src/authored/parse/parse.ts";
import { validateDefinitionShape } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { checkDefinition } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { catalogue, FIXTURES, rawFixture } from "../fixtures.ts";

type Path = (string | number)[];
type Mutation = { name: string; doc: unknown };

const REFERENCE = /^(st|tk|q|btn|act|ar|v|ls|col|row|ch|stat|told|sw|pg)_/;

function paths(node: unknown, at: Path = [], out: { path: Path; value: unknown }[] = []): { path: Path; value: unknown }[] {
  const members: [string | number, unknown][] = Array.isArray(node) ? node.map((x, i) => [i, x]) : typeof node === "object" && node !== null ? Object.entries(node) : [];
  for (const [key, value] of members) {
    out.push({ path: [...at, key], value });
    paths(value, [...at, key], out);
  }
  return out;
}

function edit(doc: unknown, path: Path, change: (parent: Record<string | number, unknown>, key: string | number) => void): unknown {
  const copy = structuredClone(doc) as Record<string | number, unknown>;
  let node = copy;
  for (const seg of path.slice(0, -1)) node = node[seg] as Record<string | number, unknown>;
  change(node, path[path.length - 1] as string | number);
  return copy;
}

/** Every mutation of the three sorts the document allows, in document order. */
function allMutations(name: string, doc: unknown): Mutation[] {
  const out: Mutation[] = [];
  for (const { path, value } of paths(doc)) {
    const at = path.join("/");
    out.push({ name: `${name}: delete ${at}`, doc: edit(doc, path, (p, k) => (Array.isArray(p) ? p.splice(k as number, 1) : delete p[k])) });
    if (typeof value === "string" && REFERENCE.test(value) && path[path.length - 1] !== "id")
      out.push({ name: `${name}: break ${at}`, doc: edit(doc, path, (p, k) => (p[k] = `${value}_gone`)) });
    const empty = typeof value === "string" ? "" : Array.isArray(value) ? [] : typeof value === "object" && value !== null ? {} : undefined;
    if (empty !== undefined) out.push({ name: `${name}: empty ${at}`, doc: edit(doc, path, (p, k) => (p[k] = empty)) });
  }
  return out;
}

/** About `perFixture` mutations of each fixture that `parse` accepts, evenly spread over the document. */
function sample(perFixture: number): Mutation[] {
  return FIXTURES.flatMap((name) => {
    const all = allMutations(name, rawFixture(name)).filter((m) => parse(m.doc).ok);
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(all.length / perFixture));
    return all.filter((_, i) => i % step === 0);
  });
}

/** Every arrow pointed at every other stage: loops, stages with no way to end, new send-backs. */
function redirects(): Mutation[] {
  return FIXTURES.flatMap((name) => {
    const doc = rawFixture(name) as { stages: { id: string; arrows?: { goTo: string | null }[] }[] };
    return doc.stages.flatMap((s, si) =>
      (s.arrows ?? []).flatMap((a, ai) =>
        doc.stages.filter((t) => t.id !== a.goTo).map((t) => ({
          name: `${name}: redirect stages/${si}/arrows/${ai} to ${t.id}`,
          doc: edit(doc, ["stages", si, "arrows", ai, "goTo"], (p, k) => (p[k] = t.id)),
        })),
      ),
    );
  });
}

const MUTATIONS = [...sample(120), ...redirects()];
const cat = catalogue();

describe("compile over mutated fixtures (acceptance 2)", () => {
  it(`covers a few hundred parsed drafts (${MUTATIONS.length} mutations)`, () => {
    const parsed = MUTATIONS.filter((m) => parse(m.doc).ok);
    expect(parsed.length).toBeGreaterThan(300);
  }, 120_000);

  const outcomes = MUTATIONS.flatMap((m) => {
    const p = parse(m.doc);
    if (!p.ok) return [];
    const wf: AuthoredWorkflow = p.workflow;
    const findings = check(wf, cat);
    const ix = indexDocument(wf);
    const stops = findings.filter((f) => tryItEffect(f, (item) => ix.byId.get(item)?.kind) === "stops");
    return [{ name: m.name, wf, findings, stops }];
  });

    for (const o of outcomes) {
      expect(() => compile(o.wf, cat, { mode: "tryIt" }), o.name).not.toThrow();
      expect(() => compile(o.wf, cat), o.name).not.toThrow();
    }
  }, 120_000);

  it("no To do that stops compiling: Try it compiles, the shape is valid, nothing but a binding is unfinished", () => {
    const bad: string[] = [];
    let checked = 0;
    for (const o of outcomes) {
      if (o.stops.length > 0) continue;
      checked++;
      const r = compile(o.wf, cat, { mode: "tryIt" });
      if (!r.ok) bad.push(`${o.name}: refused ${JSON.stringify(r.findings.filter((f) => f.code === "compile.internal" || f.code === "workflow.noStart" || f.code === "start.notOneTask"))}`);
      else {
        const shape = validateDefinitionShape(r.published);
        if (!shape.ok) bad.push(`${o.name}: shape ${JSON.stringify(shape.problems.slice(0, 2))}`);
        const stages = r.unfinished.filter((u) => u.stage !== undefined);
        if (stages.length > 0) bad.push(`${o.name}: unfinished ${JSON.stringify(stages)}`);
      }
    }
    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    expect(bad).toEqual([]);
  }, 120_000);

  it("no To do at all: publish compiles and passes checkDefinition", () => {
    const bad: string[] = [];

    for (const o of outcomes) {
      if (o.findings.some((f) => f.severity === "todo")) continue;
      checked++;
      const r = compile(o.wf, cat);
      if (!r.ok) bad.push(`${o.name}: ${JSON.stringify(r.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo"))}`);
      else if (checkDefinition(r.published).length > 0) bad.push(`${o.name}: ${JSON.stringify(checkDefinition(r.published))}`);
    }
    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThan(50);
    expect(bad).toEqual([]);
  }, 120_000);

    // These To dos leave a definition Try it can run but the kernel publish check refuses; publish never
    // reaches the kernel check with them. Any other publish problem is a compiler bug.
    const EXPLAINED_BY: Record<string, string[]> = {
      "binding-answer-missing": ["startsWhen.neededNotFilled"],
      "stage-cannot-end": ["stage.noWayToEnd"],
      "cycle-without-wait": ["loop.noTask"],
    };
    const unexplained: string[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (const o of outcomes) {
      if (o.stops.length > 0) continue;
      const r = compile(o.wf, cat, { mode: "tryIt" });
      if (!r.ok) continue;
      const todos = new Set(o.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo").map((f) => f.code as string));
      for (const p of checkDefinition(r.published)) {
        seen.add(p.code);
        if (!(EXPLAINED_BY[p.code] ?? []).some((code) => todos.has(code))) unexplained.push(`${o.name}: ${JSON.stringify(p)} with ${[...todos].join(", ")}`);
      }
    }
    expect(unexplained).toEqual([]);
    expect([...seen].sort()).toEqual(["binding-answer-missing", "stage-cannot-end"]);
  }, 120_000);
});

/**
 * The origin map (compiler.md 12): every engine element and every expression of a compiled definition
 * resolves to a Location whose item exists in the authored document and whose part names a field that
 * exists in that item; and no field key points at a field the element does not hold.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, FIXTURES } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { randomWorkflow } from "./differential.ts";

type Node = Record<string, unknown>;

/** Every element key of a definition, with the element and the JSON pointers of its CEL fields. */
function elements(def: PublishedDefinition): { key: string; cel: string[] }[] {
  const out: { key: string; cel: string[] }[] = [{ key: "stage:root", cel: [] }];
  for (const s of def.root.stages) {
    out.push({ key: `stage:${s.id}`, cel: [] });
    for (const w of s.waits) {
      if (w.kind === "person") {
        out.push({ key: `wait:${s.id}.${w.id}`, cel: ["/assignees", "/may"] });
        for (const o of w.outcomes) {
          out.push({ key: `outcome:${s.id}.${w.id}/${o.id}`, cel: o.lookups.flatMap((l, n) => [`/lookups/${n}`, ...Object.keys(l.inputs).map((f) => `/lookups/${n}/inputs/${f}`)]) });
          for (const c of o.checks) out.push({ key: `check:${s.id}.${w.id}/${o.id}/${c.id}`, cel: ["/when"] });
        }
      } else {
        out.push({ key: `wait:${s.id}.${w.id}`, cel: [...Object.keys(w.args).map((a) => `/args/${a}`), ...(w.idempotencyKey !== null ? ["/idempotencyKey"] : [])] });
      }
    }
    for (const t of s.transitions) out.push({ key: `transition:${s.id}.${t.id}`, cel: [...(t.when !== null ? ["/when"] : []), ...t.set.map((_, n) => `/set/${n}/expr`)] });
  }
  for (const r of def.notifications) {
    const parts = "parts" in r.send.message ? r.send.message.parts : [];
    out.push({
      key: `rule:${r.id}`,
      cel: ["/when", ...r.send.to.flatMap((t, n) => (t.type === "expr" ? [`/send/to/${n}/expr`] : [])), ...parts.flatMap((p, n) => ("value" in p ? [`/send/message/parts/${n}/value`] : []))],
    });
  }
  for (const r of def.nobodyToAsk ?? []) out.push({ key: `nobody:${r.id}`, cel: [] });
  for (const t of def.triggers ?? []) out.push({ key: `trigger:${t.id}`, cel: ["/when", ...Object.keys(t.data).map((d) => `/data/${d}`)] });
  for (const e of def.events ?? []) out.push({ key: `event:${e.id}`, cel: ["/when", ...Object.keys(e.values).map((v) => `/values/${v}`)] });
  return out;
}

/** The authored object with this ID (the workflow's own ID gives the document). */
function findItem(doc: unknown, id: string): Node | undefined {
  if (typeof doc !== "object" || doc === null) return undefined;
  if (!Array.isArray(doc) && (doc as Node)["id"] === id) return doc as Node;
  for (const v of Object.values(doc)) {
    const found = findItem(v, id);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** Why a Location does not resolve, or null when it does. A part may not enter another item. */
function unresolved(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, item: string, part: string | null): string | null {
  const node = findItem(wf, item);
  if (!node) return `no item ${item}`;
  if (part === null) return null;
  let at: unknown = node;
  // The catalogue's default fills an absent "If the stage enters again" (compiler.md 11.3); the origin still
  // names the field, where the author would change it.
  if (part === "ifStageEntersAgain" && node["type"] === "useConnection") return null;
  for (const seg of part.split(".")) {
    if (typeof at !== "object" || at === null || !(seg in at)) return `${item} has no part ${part}`;
    at = (at as Node)[seg];
    if (typeof at === "object" && at !== null && !Array.isArray(at) && typeof (at as Node)["id"] === "string" && /^[a-z]+_/.test((at as Node)["id"] as string))
      return `${item}: part ${part} enters another item`;
  }
  return null;
}

function problems(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, def: PublishedDefinition): string[] {
  const bad: string[] = [];
  const known = new Set<string>();
  for (const { key, cel } of elements(def)) {
    known.add(key);
    const own = def.origins[key];
    if (!own) { bad.push(`${key}: no origin`); continue; }
    if (own.item.length !== 1) bad.push(`${key}: origin ${JSON.stringify(own)}`);
    const why = unresolved(wf, own.item[0] as string, own.part);
    if (why) bad.push(`${key}: ${why}`);
    for (const p of cel) {
      known.add(`${key}#${p}`);
      const field = def.origins[`${key}#${p}`];
      if (!field) continue;
      const fieldWhy = unresolved(wf, field.item[0] as string, field.part);
      if (fieldWhy) bad.push(`${key}#${p}: ${fieldWhy}`);
    }
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(def.origins)) if (!known.has(key)) bad.push(`${key}: names nothing in the definition`);
  return bad;
}

describe("the origin map resolves to the authored document (compiler.md 12)", () => {
  for (const name of FIXTURES) {
    it(`${name}: every element and expression maps to an existing item and part`, () => {
      const wf = fixture(name);
      const r = compile(wf, catalogue());
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r.findings));
      expect(problems(wf, r.published)).toEqual([]);
    });
  }

  it("random workflows (Try it mode): every element and expression maps to an existing item and part", () => {
    const bad: string[] = [];
    for (let seed = 1; seed <= 150; seed++) {
      const wf = randomWorkflow(seed);
      const r = compile(wf, catalogue(), { mode: "tryIt" });
      if (r.ok) bad.push(...problems(wf, r.published).map((p) => `seed ${seed}: ${p}`));
    }
    expect(bad.slice(0, 10)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("the checker of this file finds a broken origin", () => {
    const wf = fixture("change-request");
    const r = compile(wf, catalogue());
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("refused");
    const def = structuredClone(r.published);
    const [key] = Object.keys(def.origins).filter((k) => k.startsWith("transition:") && !k.includes("#"));
    def.origins[key as string] = { item: [def.origins[key as string]?.item[0] as string], part: "noSuchPart" };
    def.origins["stage:nowhere"] = { item: ["st_request_form"], part: null };
    expect(problems(wf, def)).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});

/**
 * compile in publish mode refuses only for a publish problem of severity error; a warning does not stop
 * publishing (E-27). The kernel has no warning code today, so its publish check is given one extra problem here.
 */
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { PublishProblem } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";

const extra: { problem: PublishProblem | undefined } = { problem: undefined };

vi.mock("../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts", async (importOriginal) => {
  const original = await importOriginal<typeof import("../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts")>();
  const checkDefinition: typeof original.checkDefinition = (...args) => [...original.checkDefinition(...args), ...(extra.problem === undefined ? [] : [extra.problem])];
  return { ...original, checkDefinition };
});

describe("compile and the publish check's severities", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    extra.problem = undefined;
  });

  it("a warning does not refuse the publish", () => {
    extra.problem = { code: "stage-cannot-end", severity: "warning", pointer: "/root/stages/0", params: { stage: "s" } };
    const r = compile(fixture("change-request"), catalogue());
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("an error refuses it, as an internal finding", () => {
    extra.problem = { code: "stage-cannot-end", severity: "error", pointer: "/root/stages/0", params: { stage: "s" } };
    const r = compile(fixture("change-request"), catalogue());
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(r.findings.map((f) => f.code)).toEqual(["compile.internal"]);
  });
});

/**
 * Rules of compiler.md that the review found untested, each run through the host.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { arrow, ending, save, stage, task, workflow } from "../build.ts";
import { compiled, Run, user } from "./drive.ts";

const requester = user("dir-user-a");
const other = user("dir-user-b");

describe("the start task's sent-back copy (compiler.md 4.3, 7.4)", () => {
  // The start task may not be answered by the Requester; a reviewer sends the request back.
  const wf = workflow(
    [
      stage("st_start", { tasks: [task("tk_s", ["btn_s"], [], { requesterCanAnswer: false })], arrows: [arrow("ar_s", "btn_s", "st_review")] }),
      stage("st_review", {
        tasks: [task("tk_r", ["btn_back", "btn_ok"], [], { whoIsAsked: { person: { directoryId: "dir-user-b", name: "B" } } })],
        arrows: [arrow("ar_back", "btn_back", "st_start"), arrow("ar_ok", "btn_ok", "st_done")],
      }),
      ending("st_done"),
    ],
    [],
  );

  it("the normal copy lets the starter submit; the sent-back copy takes MAY from requesterCanAnswer", () => {
    const def = compiled(wf);
    const wait = (s: string) => def.root.stages.find((x) => x.id === s)?.waits.find((w) => w.id === "tk_s");
    expect(wait("st_start__tasks")).toMatchObject({ may: "true" });
    expect(wait("st_start__tasksBack")).toMatchObject({ may: expect.stringContaining("actor ==") });
    expect(def.nobodyToAsk?.filter((r) => r.wait.endsWith(".tk_s")).map((r) => [r.wait, r.excludeRequester])).toEqual([
      ["st_start__tasks.tk_s", false],
      ["st_start__tasksBack.tk_s", true],
    ]);
    const run = new Run(def, {}).start(requester, "btn_s", {});
    run.actOk("st_review__tasks.tk_r", other, "btn_back");
    const own = run.act("st_start__tasksBack.tk_s", requester, "btn_s");
    expect(own.ok ? [] : own.refusals.map((r) => r.reason)).toEqual(["may"]);
    expect(run.host.stuck(run.requestId)).toMatchObject({ reason: "nobody-to-ask" });
  });
});

describe("a stage with no tasks (compiler.md 2.1, authored-format.md rule 5)", () => {
  it("its 'After they respond' actions run, in order, before its arrows are checked", () => {
    const wf = workflow(
      [
        stage("st_start", { tasks: [task("tk_s", ["btn_s"])], arrows: [arrow("ar_s", "btn_s", "st_auto")] }),
        stage("st_auto", {
          arrival: [save("act_first", "v_x", { text: "first" })],
          after: [save("act_second", "v_x", { text: "second" })],
          arrows: [
            arrow("ar_second", { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_x" }, words: "text.is", right: { text: "second" } }] } }, "st_yes"),
            arrow("ar_other", "other", "st_no"),
          ],
        }),
        ending("st_yes"),
        ending("st_no"),
      ],
      ["v_x"],
    );
    const run = new Run(compiled(wf), {}).start(requester, "btn_s", {});
    expect(run.stagesEntered()).toEqual(["st_start__tasks", "st_start__route", "act_first__run", "act_second__run", "st_auto__route", "st_yes"]);
    expect(run.data()).toEqual({ v_x: "second" });
  });
});

/**
 * One test per rule of compiler.md that the fixtures do not exercise as they are: each document is a fixture
 * with one construct added, compiled in publish mode (so it also passes the kernel publish check), and where
 * it changes what a request does, run through the host.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { makeContext } from "../../../src/authored/check/context.ts";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import { Compiler } from "../../../src/authored/compile/state.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { CallWait, ChildStage, PersonWait, PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { compiled, Run, user } from "./drive.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, any>; // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any

function stage(def: PublishedDefinition, id: string): ChildStage {
  const s = def.root.stages.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!s) throw new Error(`no stage ${id}; stages: ${def.root.stages.map((x) => x.id).join(", ")}`);
  return s;
}
const person = (s: ChildStage, id: string): PersonWait => s.waits.find((w) => w.id === id) as PersonWait;
const call = (s: ChildStage, id: string): CallWait => s.waits.find((w) => w.id === id) as CallWait;

/** A fixture as a plain object to change, and a finder for its items. */
function edit(name: Parameters<typeof fixture>[0], change: (wf: Obj, find: (id: string) => Obj) => void): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const wf = structuredClone(fixture(name)) as unknown as Obj;
  const find = (id: string): Obj => {
    let found: Obj | undefined;
    const walk = (x: unknown): void => {
      if (found || typeof x !== "object" || x === null) return;
      if (!Array.isArray(x) && (x as Obj)["id"] === id) found = x as Obj;
      else Object.values(x).forEach(walk);
    };
    walk(wf);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`no item ${id}`);
    return found;
  };
  change(wf, find);
  return wf as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow;
}

const priya = user("dir-user-priya-raman");
const marcus = user("dir-user-marcus-lee");
const diego = user("dir-user-diego-santos");
const directory = { "dir-group-payments-approvers": ["dir-user-marcus-lee"], "dir-group-payments-engineering": ["dir-user-diego-santos"] };
const sources = { "directory/groupMembers@1": [{ id: "dir-user-diego-santos", name: "Diego Santos" }] };
const form = (risk = "ch_risk_medium") => ({ q_title: "T", q_primary_domain: "row_payments", q_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", q_risk: risk });
const riskIs = (choice: string) => ({ allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_risk" }, words: "choice.is", right: { choice } }] });
const RISK_HIGH = "data.?v_risk.hasValue() && data.?v_risk.value() == 'ch_risk_high'";
const addValue = (wf: Obj, id: string) => wf["values"].push({ id, name: id });

/** Through the approval to the issue's step, with marcus approving. */
function toIssue(def: PublishedDefinition, risk = "ch_risk_medium"): Run {
  const run = new Run(def, { directory, sources });
  run.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", form(risk));
  run.actOk("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", marcus, "btn_da_approve", { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" } });
  return run;
}

describe("Save a value (compiler.md 2.2, 3.3)", () => {
  const wf = edit("change-request", (wf, find) => {
    addValue(wf, "v_note");
    find("st_create_jira_issue")["whenThisStageStarts"].unshift({ id: "act_save_note", type: "saveValue", save: { text: "high risk" }, as: "v_note", onlyWhen: riskIs("ch_risk_high") });
  });
  const def = compiled(wf);

  it("A__save with Only when and N(text), A__skip otherwise; the step is the chain's entry", () => {
    expect(stage(def, "act_save_note__run").transitions).toEqual([
      { id: "act_save_note__save", otherwise: false, when: RISK_HIGH, set: [{ path: ["v_note"], expr: "optional.of('high risk').orValue('') == '' ? optional.none() : optional.of('high risk')" }], to: "act_create_jira_issue__run" },
      { id: "act_save_note__skip", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "act_create_jira_issue__run" },
    ]);
    expect(stage(def, "st_domain_approval__route").transitions[0]?.to).toBe("act_save_note__run");
    expect(def.origins["transition:act_save_note__run.act_save_note__save#/when"]).toEqual({ item: ["act_save_note"], part: "onlyWhen" });
    expect(def.origins["transition:act_save_note__run.act_save_note__save#/set/0/expr"]).toEqual({ item: ["act_save_note"], part: "save" });
  });

  it("runs: saved when the Only when is true, the value keeps what it had otherwise", () => {
    expect(toIssue(def, "ch_risk_high").data()["v_note"]).toBe("high risk");
    expect(toIssue(def).data()).not.toHaveProperty("v_note");
  });

  it("a formula that gives a timestamp is saved as a date (asDate), and the value is typed as a date", () => {
    const due = compiled(edit("change-request", (wf, find) => {
      addValue(wf, "v_due");
      find("st_create_jira_issue")["whenThisStageStarts"].unshift({ id: "act_save_due", type: "saveValue", save: { formula: "{{v_planned_release_date}} + days(3)", readsAs: "three days later" }, as: "v_due" });
    }));
    expect(stage(due, "act_save_due__run").transitions[0]?.set[0]?.expr).toBe(
      "(data.?v_planned_release_date.hasValue() ? optional.of(asDate(date(data.?v_planned_release_date.value()) + days(3))) : optional.none())",
    );
    expect(due.types.data["v_due"]).toEqual({ type: "string", format: "date" });
    expect(toIssue(due).data()["v_due"]).toBe("2026-12-05");
  });
});

describe("Use a connection with Only when: the gate (compiler.md 2.2, 11)", () => {

describe("directory read steps (compiler.md 8.6)", () => {
  const inEngineering = { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_eng_lead" }, words: "person.isIn", right: { value: "v_primary_domain", steps: [{ column: "col_engineering_group" }] } }] };

describe("forms (compiler.md 5)", () => {
  const def = compiled(edit("change-request", (wf, find) => {
    addValue(wf, "v_extra");
    addValue(wf, "v_areas");
    addValue(wf, "v_count");
    const page = find("pg_development_1");
    page["items"].push(
      { type: "question", id: "q_extra", label: "Extra", kind: "text", savedAs: "v_extra", showWhen: riskIs("ch_risk_high"), neededForEveryButton: true },
      { type: "question", id: "q_areas", label: "Areas", kind: "multipleChoice", savedAs: "v_areas", choices: { from: "typedIn", choices: [{ id: "ch_a", label: "A" }, { id: "ch_b", label: "B" }] } },
      { type: "question", id: "q_count", label: "Count", kind: "number", savedAs: "v_count" },
    );
    const button = find("btn_dev_mark_released");
    button["enabledWhen"] = { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_release_notes" }, words: "text.contains", right: { text: "ok" } }] };
    button["messageWhileDisabled"] = "Say ok";
  }));
  const outcome = person(stage(def, "st_development__tasks"), "tk_development").outcomes[0];

  it("a needed question with a Show when is not required; hidden and needed checks enforce it", () => {
    const schema = def.schemas["tk_development.btn_dev_mark_released@1"]?.schema as Obj;
    expect(schema["required"]).toEqual(["q_release_notes"]);
    expect(schema["properties"]["q_count"]).toEqual({ type: "number" });
    expect(schema["properties"]["q_areas"]).toEqual({ type: "array", items: { type: "string", enum: ["ch_a", "ch_b"] }, uniqueItems: true });
    expect(outcome?.checks).toEqual([
      { id: "q_extra__hidden", when: `(${RISK_HIGH}) || !has(input.q_extra)`, message: "" },
      { id: "q_extra__needed", when: `!(${RISK_HIGH}) || has(input.q_extra)`, message: "" },
      { id: "q_areas__choice", when: "!has(input.q_areas) || size(input.q_areas) > 0 && ['ch_a', 'ch_b'].filter(c, c in input.q_areas) == input.q_areas", message: "" },
      { id: "btn_dev_mark_released__also", when: "input.?q_release_notes.hasValue() && input.?q_release_notes.value().contains('ok')", message: "Say ok" },
    ]);
    expect(def.origins["check:st_development__tasks.tk_development/btn_dev_mark_released/q_extra__hidden"]).toEqual({ item: ["q_extra"], part: "showWhen" });
    expect(def.origins["check:st_development__tasks.tk_development/btn_dev_mark_released/btn_dev_mark_released__also"]).toEqual({ item: ["btn_dev_mark_released"], part: "enabledWhen" });
  });

  it("runs: the checks refuse what the form would not allow", () => {
    const run = toIssue(def, "ch_risk_high");
    run.answer("act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue", "ok", { key: "K", url: "u" });
    const refused = (data: Obj) => {
      const r = run.act("st_development__tasks.tk_development", diego, "btn_dev_mark_released", data);
      return r.ok ? [] : r.refusals.map((x) => `${x.reason}:${String(x.params["check"] ?? JSON.stringify(x.params))}`);
    };
    expect(refused({ q_release_notes: "ok" })).toEqual(["check:q_extra__needed"]);
    expect(refused({ q_release_notes: "no", q_extra: "x" })).toEqual(["check:btn_dev_mark_released__also"]);
    expect(refused({ q_release_notes: "ok", q_extra: "x", q_areas: ["ch_b", "ch_a"] })).toEqual(["check:q_areas__choice"]);
    expect(refused({ q_release_notes: "ok", q_extra: "x", q_areas: [] })).toEqual(["check:q_areas__choice"]);
    expect(refused({ q_release_notes: "ok", q_extra: "x", q_areas: ["ch_a", "ch_b"], q_count: 3 })).toEqual([]);
    expect(run.data()).toMatchObject({ v_areas: ["ch_a", "ch_b"], v_count: 3 });
  });

  it("the page's Show when alone: the check's origin is the page", () => {
    const paged = compiled(edit("change-request", (_wf, find) => (find("pg_development_1")["showWhen"] = riskIs("ch_risk_high"))));
    expect(paged.origins["check:st_development__tasks.tk_development/btn_dev_mark_released/q_release_notes__hidden"]).toEqual({ item: ["pg_development_1"], part: "showWhen" });
    expect(paged.schemas["tk_development.btn_dev_mark_released@1"]?.schema["required"]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("formula choices: the item kind's schema and a check over the formula", () => {
    const f = compiled(edit("change-request", (wf, find) => {
      addValue(wf, "v_size");
      find("pg_development_1")["items"].push({ type: "question", id: "q_size", label: "Size", kind: "choice", savedAs: "v_size", choices: { from: "formula", formula: { formula: "['S', 'M', 'L']", readsAs: "sizes" } } });
    }));
    const schema = f.schemas["tk_development.btn_dev_mark_released@1"]?.schema as Obj;
    expect(schema["properties"]["q_size"]).toEqual({ type: "string" });
    expect(person(stage(f, "st_development__tasks"), "tk_development").outcomes[0]?.checks).toEqual([
      { id: "q_size__choice", when: "!has(input.q_size) || ['S', 'M', 'L'].exists(c, c == input.q_size)", message: "" },
    ]);
    expect(f.origins["check:st_development__tasks.tk_development/btn_dev_mark_released/q_size__choice#/when"]).toEqual({ item: ["q_size"], part: "choices.formula" });
  });

  it("a choice from a list with no rows can be answered by nothing (jsonschema-1 has no empty enum)", () => {

/**
 * Compiled fixtures run through the kernel's turn function in the in-memory host, start to end
 * (acceptance item 3): the main path, a send-back, a failed call, an early arrow that cancels a task, and
 * the integrated sample with call results supplied.

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { nobodyToAsk } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import { fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { compiled, Run, user } from "./drive.ts";

const priya = user("dir-user-priya-raman");
const marcus = user("dir-user-marcus-lee");
const diego = user("dir-user-diego-santos");
const sam = user("dir-user-sam-carter");

const directory = {
  "dir-group-payments-approvers": ["dir-user-marcus-lee", "dir-user-priya-raman"],
  "dir-group-payments-engineering": ["dir-user-diego-santos"],
  "dir-group-security-team": ["dir-user-sam-carter"],
  "dir-group-platform-team": ["dir-user-sam-carter", "dir-user-mei-lin"],
};
const sources = { "directory/groupMembers@1": [{ id: "dir-user-diego-santos", name: "Diego Santos" }] };
const form = { q_title: "Rotate keys", q_primary_domain: "row_payments", q_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", q_risk: "ch_risk_medium" };
const approvers = (groups: string[]) => ({ groups: [{ id: { type: "group", id: groups[0] as string }, members: groups.slice(1).map((id) => ({ type: "user", id })) }] });

function changeRequest(): Run {
  const run = new Run(compiled(fixture("change-request")), { directory, sources, admins: ["dir-user-admin"] });
  return run.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", form);
}

describe("change-request through the host", () => {
  it("main path: approval, the issue, development, released", () => {
    const run = changeRequest();
    expect(run.stagesEntered()).toEqual(["st_request_form__tasks", "st_request_form__route", "st_domain_approval__tasks"]);
    expect(run.openElements()).toEqual(["st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval__members", "st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval"]);
    expect(run.tasksOpened()).toEqual([
      { element: "st_request_form__tasks.tk_request_form", assignees: ["user:dir-user-priya-raman"] },
      { element: "st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", assignees: ["group:dir-group-payments-approvers"] },
    ]);
    run.expectStatus("stat_waiting_for_approval");
    run.answer("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval__members", "ok", approvers(["dir-group-payments-approvers", "dir-user-marcus-lee", "dir-user-priya-raman"]));
    // The Requester is in the group but may not answer their own request.
    const own = run.act("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", priya, "btn_da_approve", { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" } });
    expect(own.ok ? [] : own.refusals.map((r) => r.reason)).toEqual(["may"]);
    run.actOk("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", marcus, "btn_da_approve", { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" } });
    expect(run.stagesEntered().slice(3)).toEqual(["act_notify_requester_rejected__run", "st_domain_approval__route", "act_create_jira_issue__run"]);
    const call = run.host.pendingCalls(run.requestId).find((c) => c.waitOpen);
    expect(call).toMatchObject({
      connection: "jira", op: "createIssue@1", effect: "write", idempotencyKey: `once.${run.requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`,
      args: { project: "CHG", summary: "Rotate keys", assignee: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" } },
    });
    run.answer("act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue", "ok", { key: "CHG-1", url: "http://jira.test/CHG-1" });
    expect(run.stagesEntered().slice(6)).toEqual(["act_notify_eng_lead__run", "st_create_jira_issue__route", "st_development__tasks"]);
    expect(run.tasksOpened().at(-1)).toEqual({ element: "st_development__tasks.tk_development", assignees: ["user:dir-user-diego-santos"] });
    run.actOk("st_development__tasks.tk_development", diego, "btn_dev_mark_released", { q_release_notes: "Done" });
    expect(run.stagesEntered().slice(9)).toEqual(["st_development__route", "st_released"]);
    expect(run.closedAt()).toBe("st_released");
    expect(run.data()).toEqual({
      v_title: "Rotate keys", v_primary_domain: "row_payments", v_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", v_risk: "ch_risk_medium",
      v_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" }, v_da_button_pressed: "btn_da_approve", v_da_answered_by: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-marcus-lee" },
      v_jira_issue: "CHG-1", v_release_notes: "Done",
    });
  });

  it("a domain that needs no approval goes straight to the issue, assigned to the default lead", () => {
    const run = new Run(compiled(fixture("change-request")), { directory, sources });
    run.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", { ...form, q_primary_domain: "row_internal_tools" });
    expect(run.stagesEntered()).toEqual(["st_request_form__tasks", "st_request_form__route", "act_create_jira_issue__run"]);

  });

  it("send-back path: request changes, the sent-back copy with its status, resubmit, reject", () => {
    const run = changeRequest();
    run.actOk("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", marcus, "btn_da_request_changes", { q_reason: "Say which keys" });
    expect(run.stagesEntered().slice(3)).toEqual(["act_notify_requester_rejected__run", "st_domain_approval__route", "st_request_form__tasksBack"]);
    run.expectStatus("stat_needs_changes");

    expect(run.data()).toMatchObject({ v_reason: "Say which keys", v_da_button_pressed: "btn_da_request_changes" });

    run.actOk("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", marcus, "btn_da_reject", { q_reason: "No" });
    expect(run.stagesEntered().slice(8)).toEqual(["act_notify_requester_rejected__run", "st_domain_approval__route", "st_rejected"]);
    expect(run.closedAt()).toBe("st_rejected");
    expect(run.data()).toMatchObject({ v_reason: "No", v_da_button_pressed: "btn_da_reject" });
  });

  it("a failed call: stuck with action-failed at the action's step; Retry re-enters it with the same 'once' key", () => {
    const run = changeRequest();
    run.actOk("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval", marcus, "btn_da_approve", { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" } });
    run.answer("act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue", "failed", { code: "project-not-found", message: "No CHG" });
    const fault = run.events().find((e) => e.type === "Faulted");
    expect(fault?.payload).toMatchObject({ kind: "error", element: "act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue", error: { code: "call-failed" } });
    expect(run.host.stuck(run.requestId)).toMatchObject({ reason: "action-failed", stage: "act_create_jira_issue__run" });
    const retry = run.host.admin(run.requestId, {
      by: user("dir-user-admin"), reason: "fixed the project",
      actions: [{ type: "retry" }],
    }, "2026-11-15T10:00:00.000000Z");
    expect(retry.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(run.host.stuck(run.requestId)).toBeNull();
    const keys = run.events().flatMap((e) => (e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "call" && e.payload.op === "createIssue@1" ? [e.payload.idempotencyKey] : []));
    expect(keys).toEqual([`once.${run.requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`, `once.${run.requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`]);
  });

  it("a group with nobody but the Requester in it: nobody to ask once the membership read answers", () => {
    const run = changeRequest();
    const task = () => run.host.state(run.requestId).waits.find((w) => w.id.element === "st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval");
    // While the read has no result, a wait that asks a group does not match.
    expect(nobodyToAsk(run.definition, run.host.state(run.requestId), task()!)).toBe(false);
    run.answer("st_domain_approval__tasks.tk_domain_approval__members", "ok", approvers(["dir-group-payments-approvers", "dir-user-priya-raman"]));
    expect(run.host.stuck(run.requestId)).toMatchObject({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_domain_approval__tasks" });
  });

/**
 * The copies under src/authored/contract/ are the contract's files with a two-line header and
 * nothing else changed (scripts/sync-contract.mjs). This fails when a copy is edited by hand or
 * the contract moved on without the script being run again.
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const contract = (name: string): string => fileURLToPath(new URL(`../../../../../contract/${name}`, import.meta.url));
const copy = (name: string): string => fileURLToPath(new URL(`../../src/authored/contract/${name}`, import.meta.url));

describe("contract copies", () => {
  for (const name of ["authored-format.ts", "catalogue.ts"]) {
    it(`${name} is the contract's file with the copy header`, () => {
      const copied = readFileSync(copy(name), "utf8");
      const lines = copied.split("\n");
      expect(lines[0]).toBe(
        `// COPY of contract/${name}, made by engine/packages/core/scripts/sync-contract.mjs. Do not edit:`,
      );
      expect(lines[1]).toBe(
        `// change contract/${name} and run the script again. test/authored/contract-sync.test.ts checks it.`,
      );
      const body = lines.slice(2).join("\n");
      // Not toBe: a failure should name the file, not print two whole files.
      expect(body === readFileSync(contract(name), "utf8"), `src/authored/contract/${name} differs from contract/${name}: run scripts/sync-contract.mjs`).toBe(true);
    });
  }
});
