import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, WorkingStage } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { diff } from "../../../src/authored/diff/index.ts";
import { arrow, ending, notify, stage, task, workflow } from "../build.ts";
import { reverseKeys } from "./helpers.ts";

/** The smallest workflow with one of each thing the tests change. */
function base(): AuthoredWorkflow {
  return workflow(
    [
      stage("st_a", {
        tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_ok"], [{ id: "q_x", savedAs: "v_x" }])],
        arrows: [arrow("ar_1", "btn_ok", "st_end")],
      }),
      ending("st_end"),
    ],
    ["v_x"],
  );
}
const working = (wf: AuthoredWorkflow, i = 0): WorkingStage => wf.stages[i] as WorkingStage;
const change = (f: (wf: AuthoredWorkflow) => void): AuthoredWorkflow => {
  const wf = base();
  f(wf);
  return wf;
};

describe("diff: no change", () => {
  it("finds none between two equal documents", () => {
    expect(diff(base(), base())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("finds none when only the order of keys differs", () => {
    expect(diff(base(), reverseKeys(base()))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("treats null as absent", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => Object.assign(wf.stages[0] as object, { status: null }));
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("ignores the diagram, the sample request and removed names", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => {
      wf.diagram = { positions: { st_a: { x: 1, y: 2 } } };
      wf.sampleRequest = { name: "Sample", answers: {} };
      wf.removedNames = { st_gone: "Gone" };
    });
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("diff: each change code", () => {
  it("item.added: a new button, and nothing about its task", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => working(wf).tasks[0]?.buttons.push({ id: "btn_no", label: "No", look: "danger", neededToPress: [] }));
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([{ code: "item.added", location: { item: "btn_no" }, params: { itemKind: "button" } }]);
  });

  it("item.removed: an arrow, located in before", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => (working(wf).arrows = []));
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([{ code: "item.removed", location: { item: "ar_1" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow" } }]);
  });

  it("part.changed: a renamed stage is one change, with before and after", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => (working(wf).name = "Review"));
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "st_a", part: "name" }, params: { itemKind: "stage", before: "st_a", after: "Review" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("part.changed: a part added has no before, a part removed no after", () => {
    const added = change((wf) => ((working(wf).arrows[0] as { words?: string }).words = "Go"));
    expect(diff(base(), added)).toEqual([{ code: "part.changed", location: { item: "ar_1", part: "words" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow", after: "Go" } }]);
    expect(diff(added, base())).toEqual([{ code: "part.changed", location: { item: "ar_1", part: "words" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow", before: "Go" } }]);
  });

  it("part.changed: a field the reported parts do not list is named by its own field", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => {
      const button = working(wf).tasks[0]?.buttons[0];
      if (button) button.look = "danger";
    });
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "btn_ok", part: "look" }, params: { itemKind: "button", before: "primary", after: "danger" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("part.changed: a change deep in a part is named by the reported part that holds it, with no before or after", () => {
    const before = change((wf) => ((working(wf).arrows[0] as { onlyWhen?: unknown }).onlyWhen = { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_x" }, words: "text.is", right: { text: "a" } }] }));
    const after = change((wf) => ((working(wf).arrows[0] as { onlyWhen?: unknown }).onlyWhen = { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_x" }, words: "text.is", right: { text: "b" } }] }));
    expect(diff(before, after)).toEqual([{ code: "part.changed", location: { item: "ar_1", part: "onlyWhen" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow" } }]);
  });

  it("part.changed: the longest reported part is used (whoIsAsked.ifEmptyUse, inputs.<field>)", () => {
    const ask = (fallback: string) => (wf: AuthoredWorkflow) => {
      const t = working(wf).tasks[0];
      if (t) t.whoIsAsked = { value: "v_x", ifEmptyUse: { value: fallback as `v_${string}` } };
      working(wf).whenThisStageStarts = [
        { id: "act_c", type: "useConnection", operation: "sys.op@1", inputs: { summary: ["Hi ", { value: fallback as `v_${string}` }] }, saveResults: {}, ifItFails: "stuck" },
      ];
    };
    expect(diff(change(ask("v_a")), change(ask("v_b")))).toEqual([
      // "When this stage starts" comes before the tasks in document order.
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "act_c", part: "inputs.summary" }, params: { itemKind: "action" } },
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "tk_a", part: "whoIsAsked.ifEmptyUse" }, params: { itemKind: "task" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("part.changed: a part added inside an object that was absent is named by the deepest reported part (E-32)", () => {
    const action = (saveFailureAs?: object) => (wf: AuthoredWorkflow) => {
      working(wf).whenThisStageStarts = [
        { id: "act_c", type: "useConnection", operation: "sys.op@1", inputs: {}, saveResults: {}, ifItFails: "carryOn", ...(saveFailureAs ? { saveFailureAs } : {}) },
      ];
    };
    expect(diff(change(action()), change(action({ failed: "v_x" })))).toEqual([
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "act_c", part: "saveFailureAs.failed" }, params: { itemKind: "action", after: "v_x" } },
    ]);
    expect(diff(change(action({ failed: "v_x", code: "v_x" })), change(action()))).toEqual([
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "act_c", part: "saveFailureAs.failed" }, params: { itemKind: "action", before: "v_x" } },
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "act_c", part: "saveFailureAs.code" }, params: { itemKind: "action", before: "v_x" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("part.changed: a new order of items in one field is a change of the parent at that field", () => {
    const two = (wf: AuthoredWorkflow): void => void working(wf).arrows.push(arrow("ar_2", "other", "st_end"));
    const after = change((wf) => {
      two(wf);
      working(wf).arrows.reverse();
    });
    expect(diff(change(two), after)).toEqual([
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "st_a", part: "arrows" }, params: { itemKind: "stage", before: ["ar_1", "ar_2"], after: ["ar_2", "ar_1"] } },
    ]);
  });

  it("item.moved: an action from one section of its stage to another", () => {
    const act: Action = notify("act_n", { request: "requester" });
    const before = change((wf) => working(wf).whenThisStageStarts.push(act));
    const after = change((wf) => working(wf).afterTheyRespond.push(act));
    expect(diff(before, after)).toEqual([
      {
        code: "item.moved",
        location: { item: "act_n" },
        params: { itemKind: "action", from: { item: "st_a", part: "whenThisStageStarts" }, to: { item: "st_a", part: "afterTheyRespond" } },
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("item.moved: an arrow to another stage, and its own change after it", () => {
    const two = (wf: AuthoredWorkflow): void => void wf.stages.splice(1, 0, stage("st_b", { arrows: [] }));
    const before = change(two);
    const after = change((wf) => {
      two(wf);
      const moved = working(wf).arrows.pop();
      if (moved) working(wf, 1).arrows.push({ ...moved, words: "Done" });
    });
    expect(diff(before, after)).toEqual([
      { code: "item.moved", location: { item: "ar_1" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow", from: { item: "st_a", part: "arrows" }, to: { item: "st_b", part: "arrows" } } },
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "ar_1", part: "words" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow", after: "Done" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("an ID changed is a removal and an addition", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => ((working(wf).arrows[0] as { id: string }).id = "ar_9"));
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([
      { code: "item.added", location: { item: "ar_9" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow" } },
      { code: "item.removed", location: { item: "ar_1" }, params: { itemKind: "arrow" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("the workflow is matched whatever its ID", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => (wf.id = "wf_other"));
    expect(diff(base(), after)).toEqual([
      { code: "part.changed", location: { item: "wf_other", part: "id" }, params: { itemKind: "workflow", before: "wf_test", after: "wf_other" } },
    ]);
  });
});

describe("diff: order", () => {
  it("lists changes in the document order of their item in after; a removed item just before the next item still there", () => {
    const before = base();
    const after = change((wf) => {
      working(wf).name = "A";
      (working(wf).arrows as unknown[]) = [];
      working(wf).tasks[0]?.buttons.push({ id: "btn_no", label: "No", look: "danger", neededToPress: [] });
      (wf.stages[1] as { name: string }).name = "End";
    });
    expect(diff(before, after).map((c) => [c.code, c.location.item])).toEqual([
      ["part.changed", "st_a"],
      ["item.added", "btn_no"],
      ["item.removed", "ar_1"],
      ["part.changed", "st_end"],
    ]);
  });

  it("orders an item's parts as LOCATION_PARTS lists them, then the others by name", () => {
    const after = change((wf) => {
      const s = working(wf);
      s.kind = "approval";
      s.status = "stat_x";
      s.name = "N";
    });
    expect(diff(base(), after).map((c) => c.location.part)).toEqual(["name", "status", "kind"]);
  });

    const after = change((wf) => {
      working(wf).name = "A";
      working(wf).arrows.push(arrow("ar_2", "other", "st_end"));
    });
    expect(diff(reverseKeys(base()), reverseKeys(after))).toEqual(diff(base(), after));
  });
});

    const result = diff(base(), after);
    expect(JSON.stringify(result)).not.toContain("null");
    expect(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result))).toEqual(result);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, WorkingStage } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { diff, type Change } from "../../../src/authored/diff/index.ts";
import { FIXTURES, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { reverseKeys } from "./helpers.ts";

const workingStages = (wf: AuthoredWorkflow): WorkingStage[] => wf.stages.filter((s): s is WorkingStage => s.kind !== "ending");

interface Edit {
  name: string;
  /** Changes `wf` and returns the one change expected, or undefined when the fixture has nothing to edit. */
  apply: (wf: AuthoredWorkflow) => Change | undefined;
}

const EDITS: Edit[] = [
  {
    name: "rename a stage",
    apply: (wf) => {
      const s = wf.stages[0];
      if (!s) return undefined;
      const before = s.name;
      s.name = `${before} (new)`;
      return { code: "part.changed", location: { item: s.id, part: "name" }, params: { itemKind: "stage", before, after: s.name } };
    },
  },
  {
    name: "remove an arrow",
    apply: (wf) => {
      const s = workingStages(wf).find((x) => x.arrows.length > 0);
      const gone = s?.arrows.pop();
      return gone && { code: "item.removed", location: { item: gone.id }, params: { itemKind: "arrow" } };
    },
  },
  {
    name: "add a button",
    apply: (wf) => {
      const t = workingStages(wf).flatMap((s) => s.tasks)[0];
      if (!t) return undefined;
      t.buttons.push({ id: "btn_added_by_test", label: "Added", look: "secondary", neededToPress: [] });
      return { code: "item.added", location: { item: "btn_added_by_test" }, params: { itemKind: "button" } };
    },
  },
  {
    name: "move an arrow to another stage",
    apply: (wf) => {
      const [from, to] = workingStages(wf);
      const moved = from?.arrows.pop();
      if (!from || !to || !moved) return undefined;
      to.arrows.push(moved);
      return {
        code: "item.moved",
        location: { item: moved.id },
        params: { itemKind: "arrow", from: { item: from.id, part: "arrows" }, to: { item: to.id, part: "arrows" } },
      };
    },
  },
  {
    name: "put a stage's arrows in another order",
    apply: (wf) => {
      const s = workingStages(wf).find((x) => x.arrows.length > 1);
      if (!s) return undefined;
      const before = s.arrows.map((a) => a.id);
      s.arrows.reverse();
      return { code: "part.changed", location: { item: s.id, part: "arrows" }, params: { itemKind: "stage", before, after: s.arrows.map((a) => a.id) } };
    },
  },
  {
    name: "change a status's colour",
    apply: (wf) => {
      const st = wf.statuses[0];
      if (!st) return undefined;
      const before = st.colour;
      st.colour = before === "pink" ? "teal" : "pink";
      return { code: "part.changed", location: { item: st.id, part: "colour" }, params: { itemKind: "status", before, after: st.colour } };
    },
  },
];

describe("diff on the contract's fixtures", () => {
  for (const name of FIXTURES) {
    it(`${name}: no change against itself or a copy with its keys in another order`, () => {
      expect(diff(fixture(name), fixture(name))).toEqual([]);
      expect(diff(fixture(name), reverseKeys(fixture(name)))).toEqual([]);
    });
  }

  for (const edit of EDITS) {
    it(`each fixture against a copy with one edit: ${edit.name}`, () => {
      let ran = 0;
      for (const name of FIXTURES) {
        const after = fixture(name);
        const expected = edit.apply(after);
        if (!expected) continue;
        ran++;
        expect(diff(fixture(name), after), name).toEqual([expected]);
        expect(diff(reverseKeys(fixture(name)), after), name).toEqual([expected]);
      }
      expect(ran).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    });
  }
});
===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/diff/helpers.ts\n===
/** Helpers for the diff tests: copies with keys in another order, and a seeded random source. */

/** A deep copy with every object's keys in reverse order. */
export function reverseKeys<T>(x: T): T {
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(reverseKeys) as T;
  if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) return x;
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(x).reverse()) out[key] = reverseKeys((x as Record<string, unknown>)[key]);
  return out as T;
}

/** mulberry32: a small seeded generator, so a run is the same every time. */
export function random(seed: number): { next: () => number; int: (n: number) => number; pick: <T>(xs: readonly T[]) => T } {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  const next = (): number => {
    s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = s;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
  const int = (n: number): number => Math.floor(next() * n);
  const pick = <T>(xs: readonly T[]): T => xs[int(xs.length)] as T;
  return { next, int, pick };
}

/**
 * diff against mutated fixtures, a few hundred pairs from a fixed seed. An independent reading of
 * the two documents finds every item that differs; the reported changes must cover each one (no
 * silent difference), and every reported change must be real.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { diff, type Change } from "../../../src/authored/diff/index.ts";
import { indexDocument } from "../../../src/authored/index-doc.ts";
import { FIXTURES, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { mutations } from "../mutations.ts";
import { random } from "./helpers.ts";

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Obj => typeof x === "object" && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x);
const IGNORED = ["diagram", "sampleRequest", "removedNames"];

/** JSON with sorted keys and no null members, for comparing. */
function canonical(x: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return `[${x.map(canonical).join(",")}]`;
  if (isObject(x))
    return `{${Object.keys(x)
      .filter((k) => x[k] !== null && x[k] !== undefined)
      .sort()
      .map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonical(x[k])}`)
      .join(",")}}`;
  return x === undefined ? "absent" : JSON.stringify(x);
}

// The independent reading

interface Item {
  kind: string;
  parent: string | null;
  field: string;
  /** Own content with child items left out of their lists. */
  own: unknown;
  /** Own content with child items written as their IDs. */
  shown: unknown;
}
interface Reading {
  rootId: string;
  root: Item;
  items: Map<string, Item>;
  /** Child IDs in order, per parent and field. */
  fields: Map<string, string[]>;
}

function reading(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Reading {
  const known = indexDocument(doc).byId;
  const rootId = isObject(doc) && typeof doc["id"] === "string" ? doc["id"] : "";
  const items = new Map<string, Item>();
  const fields = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const isItem = (x: unknown): x is Obj & { id: string } =>
    isObject(x) && typeof x["id"] === "string" && x["id"] !== rootId && known.has(x["id"]) && !items.has(x["id"]);

  // Returns [own, shown].
  const walk = (node: unknown, owner: string | null, path: string[], top: boolean): [unknown, unknown] => {
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      const own: unknown[] = [];
      const shown: unknown[] = [];
      for (const x of node) {
        if (isItem(x)) {
          const key = JSON.stringify([owner, path.join(".")]);
          fields.set(key, [...(fields.get(key) ?? []), x.id]);
          visit(x, owner, path.join("."));
          shown.push(x.id);
        } else {
          const [o, s] = walk(x, owner, [...path, String(own.length)], false);
          own.push(o);
          shown.push(s);
        }
      }
      return [own, shown];
    }
    if (!isObject(node)) return [node, node];
    const own: Obj = {};
    const shown: Obj = {};
    for (const key of Object.keys(node).sort()) {
      const v = node[key];
      if (v === null || v === undefined || (top && owner !== null && key === "id") || (owner === null && top && IGNORED.includes(key))) continue;
      [own[key], shown[key]] = walk(v, owner, [...path, key], false);
    }
    return [own, shown];
  };
  const visit = (x: Obj & { id: string }, parent: string | null, field: string): void => {
    const item: Item = { kind: known.get(x.id)?.kind ?? "", parent, field, own: undefined, shown: undefined };
    items.set(x.id, item);
    [item.own, item.shown] = walk(x, x.id, [], true);
  };
  const [own, shown] = walk(doc, null, [], true);
  return { rootId, root: { kind: "workflow", parent: null, field: "", own, shown }, items, fields };
}

const at = (x: unknown, part: string | undefined): unknown => {
  let node = x;
  for (const key of part ? part.split(".") : []) node = isObject(node) ? node[key] : undefined;
  return node;
};
function put(x: unknown, part: string | undefined, value: unknown, target?: unknown): unknown {
  if (!part) return structuredClone(value);
  const keys = part.split(".");
  const root = isObject(x) ? x : {};
  let node: Obj = root;
  keys.slice(0, -1).forEach((k) => {
    if (!isObject(node[k])) node[k] = {};
    node = node[k] as Obj;
  });
  const last = keys[keys.length - 1] as string;
  if (value === undefined) {
    delete node[last];
    // A part is named by the deepest reported part that holds it (E-32): removing the last such part of an
    // object that the other side does not have removes the object, which held nothing else.
    for (let i = keys.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const holder = keys.slice(0, i).join(".");
      const parent = at(root, keys.slice(0, i - 1).join(".") || undefined) as Obj;
      const child = parent[keys[i - 1] as string];
      if (isObject(child) && Object.keys(child).length === 0 && at(target, holder) === undefined) delete parent[keys[i - 1] as string];
      else break;
    }
  } else node[last] = structuredClone(value);
  return root;
}
const isPrefix = (part: string | undefined, path: string): boolean =>
  part === undefined || path === part || path.startsWith(`${part}.`);

/** Checks one pair; returns problems found, empty when diff is right. */
function verify(before: AuthoredWorkflow, after: AuthoredWorkflow, changes: Change[]): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const b = reading(before);
  const a = reading(after);
  const same = (id: string): boolean => b.items.has(id) && a.items.has(id) && b.items.get(id)?.kind === a.items.get(id)?.kind;
  const of = (code: string, item: string): Change[] => changes.filter((c) => c.code === code && c.location.item === item);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const c of changes) {
    const key = canonical([c.code, c.location]);
    if (seen.has(key)) problems.push(`duplicate ${key}`);
    seen.add(key);
  }

  // Added, removed, moved.
  for (const [id, item] of a.items)
    if (!same(id) && of("item.added", id).length !== 1) problems.push(`not reported added: ${id} (${item.kind})`);
  for (const [id] of b.items) if (!same(id) && of("item.removed", id).length !== 1) problems.push(`not reported removed: ${id}`);
  for (const c of changes) {
    if (c.code === "item.added" && (!a.items.has(c.location.item) || same(c.location.item))) problems.push(`wrongly added: ${c.location.item}`);
    if (c.code === "item.removed" && (!b.items.has(c.location.item) || same(c.location.item))) problems.push(`wrongly removed: ${c.location.item}`);
  }
  const place = (r: Reading, item: Item): unknown => ({ item: item.parent ?? r.rootId, ...(item.field ? { part: item.field } : {}) });
  for (const [id, y] of a.items) {
    if (!same(id)) continue;
    const x = b.items.get(id) as Item;
    const moved = of("item.moved", id);
    const expected = x.parent !== y.parent || x.field !== y.field;
    if (expected !== (moved.length === 1)) problems.push(`moved wrong: ${id}`);
    const m = moved[0];
    if (expected && m?.code === "item.moved" && canonical([m.params.from, m.params.to]) !== canonical([place(b, x), place(a, y)]))
      problems.push(`moved from/to wrong: ${id}`);
  }

  // Applying each reported part to before's content gives after's: no silent difference.
  const apply = (id: string | null, x: Item, y: Item): void => {
    const item = id ?? a.rootId;
    let own = structuredClone(x.own);
    for (const c of changes) if (c.code === "part.changed" && c.location.item === item) own = put(own, c.location.part, at(y.own, c.location.part), y.own);
    if (canonical(own) !== canonical(y.own)) problems.push(`silent difference in ${item}`);
  };
  apply(null, b.root, a.root);
  for (const [id, y] of a.items) if (same(id)) apply(id, b.items.get(id) as Item, y);

  // A new order inside one field is reported on the parent.
  for (const [key, list] of a.fields) {
    const [parent, field] = JSON.parse(key) as [string | null, string];
    if (parent !== null && !same(parent)) continue;
    const old = b.fields.get(key) ?? [];
    const common1 = old.filter((id) => list.includes(id));
    const common2 = list.filter((id) => old.includes(id));
    if (common1.join() === common2.join()) continue;
    const item = parent ?? a.rootId;
    if (!of("part.changed", item).some((c) => isPrefix(c.location.part, field))) problems.push(`order not reported: ${item} ${field}`);
  }

  // Every part.changed is real, and its before and after are the parts' values.
  for (const c of changes) {
    if (c.code !== "part.changed") continue;
    const id = c.location.item;
    const x = id === a.rootId ? b.root : b.items.get(id);
    const y = id === a.rootId ? a.root : a.items.get(id);
    if (!x || !y) {
      problems.push(`part.changed on an unmatched item: ${id}`);
      continue;
    }
    const was = at(x.shown, c.location.part);
    const is = at(y.shown, c.location.part);
    if (canonical(was) === canonical(is)) problems.push(`not a change: ${canonical(c.location)}`);
    if (c.params.before !== undefined && canonical(c.params.before) !== canonical(was)) problems.push(`wrong before: ${canonical(c.location)}`);
    if (c.params.after !== undefined && canonical(c.params.after) !== canonical(is)) problems.push(`wrong after: ${canonical(c.location)}`);
  }
  return problems;
}

// Mutations

type Path = (string | number)[];
function nodes(doc: unknown): { path: Path; node: unknown }[] {
  const out: { path: Path; node: unknown }[] = [];
  const walk = (node: unknown, path: Path): void => {
    out.push({ path, node });
    if (Array.isArray(node)) node.forEach((x, i) => walk(x, [...path, i]));
    else if (isObject(node)) for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(node)) walk(v, [...path, k]);
  };
  walk(doc, []);
  return out;
}
const get = (doc: unknown, path: Path): unknown => path.reduce<unknown>((n, k) => (n as Record<string | number, unknown>)?.[k], doc);
const isIdItem = (x: unknown): x is Obj & { id: string } => isObject(x) && typeof x["id"] === "string";

let fresh = 0;
function mutate(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, rng: ReturnType<typeof random>): void {
  const all = nodes(doc).filter((n) => n.path.length > 0);
  const arrays = all.filter((n) => Array.isArray(n.node)) as { path: Path; node: unknown[] }[];
  const kind = rng.int(8);
  if (kind === 0) {
    // Change one scalar.
    const leaves = all.filter((n) => !isObject(n.node) && !Array.isArray(n.node) && n.node !== null);
    const leaf = leaves.length ? rng.pick(leaves) : undefined;
    if (!leaf) return;
    const parent = get(doc, leaf.path.slice(0, -1)) as Record<string | number, unknown>;
    const last = leaf.path[leaf.path.length - 1] as string | number;
    const v = leaf.node;
    parent[last] = typeof v === "string" ? `${v}x` : typeof v === "number" ? v + 1 : !v;
  } else if (kind === 1 || kind === 2) {
    // Remove a member, or set it to null.
    const members = all.filter((n) => typeof n.path[n.path.length - 1] === "string");
    const m = members.length ? rng.pick(members) : undefined;
    if (!m) return;
    const parent = get(doc, m.path.slice(0, -1)) as Obj;
    const last = m.path[m.path.length - 1] as string;
    if (kind === 1) delete parent[last];
    else parent[last] = null;
  } else if (kind === 3) {
    // Remove an element of a list.
    const full = arrays.filter((n) => n.node.length > 0);
    if (!full.length) return;
    const list = rng.pick(full).node;
    list.splice(rng.int(list.length), 1);
  } else if (kind === 4) {
    // Swap two elements of a list.
    const long = arrays.filter((n) => n.node.length > 1);
    if (!long.length) return;
    const list = rng.pick(long).node;
    const i = rng.int(list.length);
    const j = (i + 1 + rng.int(list.length - 1)) % list.length;
    [list[i], list[j]] = [list[j], list[i]];
  } else if (kind === 5 || kind === 6) {
    // Move an item to another list holding the same kind of item, or add a copy with new IDs.
    const holders = arrays.filter((n) => n.node.some(isIdItem));
    if (!holders.length) return;
    const from = rng.pick(holders).node;
    const items = from.filter(isIdItem);
    const item = rng.pick(items);
    const prefix = item.id.split("_")[0];
    if (kind === 5) {
      const targets = holders.filter((n) => n.node !== from && n.node.some((x) => isIdItem(x) && x.id.split("_")[0] === prefix));
      if (!targets.length) return;
      from.splice(from.indexOf(item), 1);
      const to = rng.pick(targets).node;
      to.splice(rng.int(to.length + 1), 0, item);
    } else {
      const copy = structuredClone(item);
      fresh++;
      for (const n of nodes(copy)) if (isIdItem(n.node)) n.node.id = `${n.node.id}_n${fresh}`;
      from.splice(rng.int(from.length + 1), 0, copy);
    }
  } else {
    // Change an ignored field: no change expected from it.
    doc.diagram = { positions: { st_x: { x: rng.int(100), y: 0 } } };
  }
}

describe("diff: unfinished and broken drafts", () => {
  for (const name of FIXTURES) {
    it(`${name}: every second draft with a member removed or set to null, one way or the other`, () => {
      const original = fixture(name);
      let n = 0;
      for (const draft of mutations(original)) {
        if (n % 4 === 0) expect(verify(original, draft, diff(original, draft))).toEqual([]);
        if (n % 4 === 2) expect(verify(draft, original, diff(draft, original))).toEqual([]);
        n++;
      }
      expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    }, 30_000);
  }
});

describe("diff: no silent difference, over mutated fixtures", () => {

    let pairs = 0;
    let changed = 0;
    const codes = new Set<string>();
    for (let round = 0; round < 120; round++) {
      for (const name of FIXTURES) {
        const before = fixture(name);
        const after = fixture(name);
        if (rng.int(4) === 0) mutate(before, rng);
        const n = 1 + rng.int(3);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) mutate(after, rng);
        const changes = diff(before, after);
        expect(diff(before, after)).toEqual(changes);
        expect(verify(before, after, changes), `${name} round ${round}`).toEqual([]);
        pairs++;
        if (changes.length) changed++;
        for (const c of changes) codes.add(c.code);
      }
    }
    expect(pairs).toBe(480);
    expect(changed).toBeGreaterThan(300);
    expect([...codes].sort()).toEqual(["item.added", "item.moved", "item.removed", "part.changed"]);
  });
});

/**

 * make a request stuck with reason `error` at that point"). Each formula is put into a Save a value action at

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, SampleRequest } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { docSetup } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/setup.ts";
import { evaluate } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/index.ts";

const cat = catalogue();

function withProbe(formula: string): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const wf = fixture("change-request");
  const dev = wf.stages.find((s) => s.id === "st_development");
  if (dev === undefined || dev.kind === "ending") throw new Error("no stage");
  wf.values.push({ id: "v_probe", name: "Probe" } as never);
  dev.whenThisStageStarts.push({ id: "act_probe", type: "saveValue", save: { formula, readsAs: "probe" }, as: "v_probe" } as never);
  return wf;

/** A value as the sample request's constant, by its kind; undefined where no constant can say it. */
function constantOf(kind: string | undefined, v: Json): unknown {
  const ref = (x: Json) => ({ directoryId: (x as { id: string }).id, name: "x" });
  switch (kind) {
    case "text": case "longText": return { text: v };
    case "number": return { number: v };
    case "yesNo": return { yesNo: v };
    case "date": return { date: v };
    case "choice": return { choice: v };
    case "multipleChoice": return { choices: v };
    case "choiceFromList": return { row: v };
    case "choiceFromConnection": return { connectionChoice: v };
    case "person": return { person: ref(v) };
    case "group": return { group: ref(v) };
    case "people": return { people: (v as Json[]).map(ref) };
    default: return undefined;
  }
}

/** Runs the request to the probe; what it saved or why it stopped, and the sample of its values before. */
function runTo(formula: string) {
  const wf = withProbe(formula);
  const h = hostFor(wf);
  const id = ok(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", FORM)).requestId;
  ok(h.act(marcus, id, taskOf(h, id, "tk_domain_approval"), "btn_da_approve", { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: diego.id } } as never));
  const view = viewOf(h, id, { type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" });
  const s = docSetup(wf, cat);
  const answers: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(view.values)) {
    if (k === "v_probe" || v === undefined) continue;
    const c = constantOf(s.kinds.valueKind(k), v);

  return { wf, view, sample };
}

/**
 * Robustness (core-api.md 1: "Every function accepts an unfinished draft and never throws on one"). Drafts
 * that `parse` accepts but that are unfinished (each member of a fixture removed or set to null in turn,
 * kept when parse still accepts it) go through every function the editor and Try it call: sampleValues,
 * checkFormula, evaluate, evaluateSent, formState, createTestHost and a short run of the host with its views,
 * story and outbox. None may throw.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location, SampleRequest } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { evaluate, evaluateSent, sampleValues } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/index.ts";
import { formState } from "../../../src/authored/form/index.ts";
import { checkFormula } from "../../../src/authored/formula/index.ts";
import { createTestHost } from "../../../src/authored/host/index.ts";
import { indexDocument } from "../../../src/authored/index-doc.ts";
import { parse } from "../../../src/authored/parse/parse.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, type FixtureName } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { GROUPS, START_AT } from "../host/drive.ts";
import { mutations } from "../mutations.ts";

const cat = catalogue();
const PARTS = ["onlyWhen", "showWhen", "enabledWhen", "when.condition", "save", "message", "choices.formula", "inputs.summary", "requester", undefined];
const FORMULAS = ["{{v_title}}", "{{v_amount}} + 1.0", "size({{v_title}}) > 3", "", "((", "{{v_nowhere}}", "{{request.requester}}", "asDate({{request.startedOn}} + days(3))", "{'$x': 1}", "[1, 'a']"];

/** Every call the editor and Try it make on one draft; returns the first that threw. */
function exercise(wf: AuthoredWorkflow): string | null {
  const attempt = (what: string, f: () => unknown): string | null => {
    try {
      f();
      return null;
    } catch (e) {
      return `${what}: ${e instanceof Error ? (e.stack ?? e.message).split("\n").slice(0, 4).join(" | ") : String(e)}`;
    }
  };
  const ix = attempt("index", () => indexDocument(wf));
  if (ix !== null) return ix;
  // Every fifth item, so one draft takes well under a second; the items differ from draft to draft.
  const items = [...indexDocument(wf).byId.keys()].filter((_, i) => i % 5 === 0);
  const sample = wf.sampleRequest ?? ({} as SampleRequest);
  const checks: [string, () => unknown][] = [["sampleValues", () => sampleValues(wf, sample, cat)]];
  for (const item of items) {
    for (const part of PARTS) {
      const at: Location = part === undefined ? { item } : { item, part };
      for (const formula of FORMULAS.slice(0, 4)) checks.push([`checkFormula ${item} ${part} ${formula}`, () => checkFormula(wf, cat, at, formula, sample)]);
      checks.push([`evaluate ${item} ${part}`, () => evaluate(wf, cat, at, { formula: "{{v_title}}", readsAs: "x" } as never, sample)]);
      checks.push([`evaluate template ${item} ${part}`, () => evaluate(wf, cat, at, ["a", { value: "v_title" }] as never, sample)]);
    }
  }
  for (const b of wf.start?.startsWhen ?? []) {
    checks.push([`evaluateSent ${b.id}`, () => evaluateSent(wf, cat, { item: b.id, part: "onlyWhen" }, (b.onlyWhen ?? { formula: "true", readsAs: "x" }) as never)]);
    for (const [q, m] of Object.entries(b.answers ?? {})) checks.push([`evaluateSent ${b.id} ${q}`, () => evaluateSent(wf, cat, { item: b.id, part: `answers.${q}` }, m as never)]);
  }
  for (const task of indexDocument(wf).taskById.keys()) {
    checks.push([`formState ${task}`, () => formState(wf, cat, { item: task }, {}, {}, {})]);
    checks.push([`formState ${task} answered`, () => formState(wf, cat, { item: task }, { q_title: "x", q_risk: "ch_nowhere" } as never, { v_title: 3 } as never, { startedOn: "nope" })]);
  }
  checks.push([
    "test host",
    () => {
      const r = createTestHost(wf, cat, { groups: GROUPS, stuckRequestsGoTo: [{ type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" }], startAt: START_AT });
      if (!r.ok) return;
      const h = r.host;
      const start = indexDocument(wf).taskById.get(r.host === undefined ? "" : ((wf.stages.find((s) => s.id === wf.start?.stage) as { tasks?: { id: string }[] } | undefined)?.tasks?.[0]?.id ?? ""));
      const button = start?.buttons[0]?.id ?? "btn_none";
      const s = h.start({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-priya-raman" }, button, {});
      for (const b of wf.start?.startsWhen ?? []) h.startFrom(b.id, {});
      h.outbox();
      h.openTasks();
      if (s.ok) {
        h.request(s.requestId, { type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" });
        for (const t of h.openTasks({ requestId: s.requestId })) h.act({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-priya-raman" }, s.requestId, t.task, "btn_none" as never, {});
        h.admin({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" }, s.requestId, "retry", "x");
        h.admin({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" }, s.requestId, "close", "x");
        h.request(s.requestId);
      }
    },
  ]);
  for (const [what, f] of checks) {
    const failed = attempt(what, f);
    if (failed !== null) return failed;
  }
  return null;
}

const NAMES: FixtureName[] = ["change-request", "integrated-sample", "several-at-once", "blank"];

/** A deterministic random source (mulberry32). */
function random(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const REFERENCE_KEYS = new Set(["goTo", "button", "value", "save", "as", "savedAs", "list", "column", "stage", "operation", "trigger", "source", "choice", "row", "pressed", "storedField", "labelField", "tell", "status"]);

/**
 * Unfinished drafts the way an author makes them: a list emptied or one member gone, a reference pointing
 * nowhere or cleared, a formula left empty or broken. One to three edits, kept only when parse accepts.
 */
function* unfinished(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, seed: number, count: number): Generator<AuthoredWorkflow> {
  const rnd = random(seed);
  let made = 0;
  for (let tries = 0; tries < count * 20 && made < count; tries++) {
    const copy = structuredClone(doc) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    const edits = 1 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3);
    for (let e = 0; e < edits; e++) {
      const spots: { parent: Record<string | number, unknown>; key: string | number; value: unknown }[] = [];
      const walk = (node: unknown): void => {
        if (Array.isArray(node)) node.forEach((x, i) => { spots.push({ parent: node as never, key: i, value: x }); walk(x); });
        else if (typeof node === "object" && node !== null) for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(node)) { spots.push({ parent: node as never, key: k, value: x }); walk(x); }
      };
      walk(copy);
      const spot = spots[Math.floor(rnd() * spots.length)];
      if (spot === undefined) continue;
      const { parent, key, value } = spot;
      const roll = rnd();
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (roll < 0.5) parent[key] = [];
        else value.splice(Math.floor(rnd() * value.length), 1);
      } else if (typeof value === "string" && key === "formula") {
        parent[key] = ["", "((", "{{v_nowhere}} + 1", "{{v_title}} +", "1 / 0"][Math.floor(rnd() * 5)];
      } else if (typeof value === "string" && typeof key === "string" && REFERENCE_KEYS.has(key)) {
        parent[key] = roll < 0.5 ? null : `${value.split("_")[0] ?? "x"}_nowhere`;
      } else if (Array.isArray(parent)) {
        parent.splice(key as number, 1);
      } else {
        delete parent[key];
      }
    }
    if (!parse(copy).ok) continue;
    made += 1;
    yield copy as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow;
  }
}

describe("no function the editor or Try it calls throws on an unfinished draft", () => {
  for (const name of NAMES) {
    it(`${name}: generated unfinished drafts, and each member removed or set to null where parse accepts it`, () => {
      const failures: string[] = [];
      let tried = 0;
      const drafts = [...unfinished(fixture(name), 11, 20), ...[...mutations(fixture(name))].filter((_, i) => i % 40 === 0).filter((d) => parse(d).ok)];
      for (const draft of drafts) {
        tried += 1;
        const f = exercise(draft);
        if (f !== null && !failures.some((x) => x.split(":")[0] === f.split(":")[0])) failures.push(f);
        if (failures.length >= 5) break;
      }
      expect(failures).toEqual([]);
      if (name !== "blank") expect(tried).toBeGreaterThan(15);
    }, 300_000);
  }
});

  return workflow(

  );

      v_pressed: { button: "btn_no" },
      v_by: { person: { directoryId: "u2", name: "Two" } },
      v_people: { people: [{ directoryId: "u1", name: "U" }, { directoryId: "u3", name: "T" }, { directoryId: "u1", name: "U" }] },
    }), cat);
    expect(r.values).toEqual({
      v_text: "hello",
      v_long: "long",
      v_number: 3,
      v_yes: false,
      v_date: "2026-02-28",
      v_choice: "ch_b",
      // In the question's choice order, each once.
      v_multi: ["ch_x", "ch_z"],
      v_row: "row_1",
      v_source: { stored: "svc-ledger", label: "Ledger" },
      // A choice of the people in a group gives a person (E-26).
      v_dir: { type: "user", id: "u7" },
      v_person: { type: "user", id: "u1" },
      v_group: { type: "group", id: "g1" },
      v_pressed: "btn_no",
      v_by: { type: "user", id: "u2" },
      v_people: [{ type: "user", id: "u1" }, { type: "user", id: "u3" }],
    });
  });

  it("reads the Requester as a person and Started on as a date", () => {
    expect(sampleValues(wf, sample({}, { requester: { directoryId: "u9", name: "Nine" }, startedOn: "2026-11-10" }), cat))
      .toEqual({ values: {}, requester: { type: "user", id: "u9" }, startedOn: "2026-11-10" });
  });

  it("leaves out a Started on that is not a real date", () => {
    expect(sampleValues(wf, sample({}, { startedOn: "2026-02-30" }), cat)).toEqual({ values: {} });
  });

  it("leaves out empty constants: empty is absent", () => {
    const r = sampleValues(wf, sample({ v_text: { text: "" }, v_multi: { choices: [] }, v_people: { people: [] } }), cat);
    expect(r.values).toEqual({});
  });

  it("leaves out a constant that does not fit the value's kind", () => {
    const r = sampleValues(wf, sample({ v_number: { text: "3" }, v_date: { date: "15/11/2026" }, v_person: { group: { directoryId: "g", name: "G" } }, v_choice: { row: "row_1" } }), cat);
    expect(r.values).toEqual({});
  });

  it("leaves out a number that is a whole number beyond 2^53 - 1", () => {
    expect(sampleValues(wf, sample({ v_number: { number: 2 ** 53 } }), cat).values).toEqual({});
  });

  it("leaves out a value whose kind is not known yet", () => {
    expect(sampleValues(wf, sample({ v_unknown: { text: "x" } }), cat).values).toEqual({});
  });

  it("takes the kind of a value saved from an operation's result from the catalogue", () => {
    expect(sampleValues(wf, sample({ v_result: { text: "Tier 1" } }), cat).values).toEqual({ v_result: "Tier 1" });
    expect(sampleValues(wf, sample({ v_result: { text: "Tier 1" } })).values).toEqual({});
  });

  it("converts the change-request fixture's sample", () => {
    const cr = fixture("change-request");
    const r = sampleValues(cr, cr.sampleRequest as SampleRequest, cat);
    expect(r.requester).toEqual({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-priya-raman" });
    expect(r.startedOn).toBe("2026-11-10");
    expect(r.values["v_primary_domain"]).toBe("row_payments");
    expect(r.values["v_da_button_pressed"]).toBe("btn_da_approve");
    expect(r.values["v_eng_lead"]).toEqual({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" });
    expect(Object.keys(r.values)).toHaveLength(10);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ValueKind } from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { facts } from "../../src/authored/facts/facts.ts";
import { arrow, ending, pressedWhen, save, stage, task, workflow } from "./build.ts";

const CATALOGUE = catalogue();

describe("facts: change-request, checked by hand", () => {
  const f = facts(fixture("change-request"), CATALOGUE);

  // stage                 | incoming arrows (document order)         | reachable
  const STAGES: [string, string[], boolean][] = [
    ["st_request_form",      ["ar_da_request_changes"],                   true],
    ["st_domain_approval",   ["ar_rf_other"],                             true],
    ["st_create_jira_issue", ["ar_rf_no_approval", "ar_da_approve"],      true],
    ["st_development",       ["ar_cji_done"],                             true],
    ["st_released",          ["ar_dev_released"],                         true],
    ["st_rejected",          ["ar_da_reject"],                            true],
  ];
  it.each(STAGES)("stage %s: incoming %j, reachable %s", (id, incoming, reachable) => {
    expect(f.stages[id as `st_${string}`]).toEqual({ incoming, reachable });
  });
  it("has exactly these stages", () => expect(Object.keys(f.stages)).toEqual(STAGES.map((s) => s[0])));

  // Dominance from st_request_form: domain approval and create Jira issue are dominated by the
  // request form only; development by the request form and create Jira issue (compiler.md 15.1).
  // arrow                    | usable | sends back
  const ARROWS: [string, boolean, boolean][] = [
    ["ar_rf_no_approval",     true,    false],
    ["ar_rf_other",           true,    false],
    ["ar_da_approve",         true,    false],
    ["ar_da_reject",          true,    false],
    ["ar_da_request_changes", true,    true],  // to the start stage, which dominates every stage
    ["ar_cji_done",           true,    false],
    ["ar_dev_released",       true,    false],
  ];
  it.each(ARROWS)("arrow %s: usable %s, sends back %s", (id, usable, sendsBack) => {
    expect(f.arrows[id as `ar_${string}`]).toEqual({ usable, sendsBack });
  });
  it("has exactly these arrows", () => expect(Object.keys(f.arrows)).toEqual(ARROWS.map((a) => a[0])));

  // value                   | kind                   | filled at (item.part)                           | used at (item.part), document order
  const VALUES: [string, ValueKind, string[], string[]][] = [
    ["v_title",                "text",           ["q_title.savedAs"],                              ["tx_the_request.content", "act_create_jira_issue.inputs.summary"]],
    ["v_description",          "longText",       ["q_description.savedAs"],                        ["tx_the_request.content"]],
    ["v_primary_domain",       "choiceFromList", ["q_primary_domain.savedAs"],                     ["ar_rf_no_approval.when.condition", "tk_domain_approval.whoIsAsked", "tx_the_request.content", "q_eng_lead.choices.peopleIn", "act_create_jira_issue.inputs.assignee", "act_notify_eng_lead.to", "tk_development.whoIsAsked"]],
    ["v_planned_release_date", "date",           ["q_planned_release_date.savedAs"],               ["tx_the_request.content"]],
    ["v_risk",                 "choice",         ["q_risk.savedAs"],                               ["tx_the_request.content"]],
    ["v_eng_lead",             "person",         ["q_eng_lead.savedAs"],                           ["act_create_jira_issue.inputs.assignee", "act_notify_eng_lead.to", "tk_development.whoIsAsked"]],
    ["v_reason",               "longText",       ["q_reason.savedAs"],                             ["tx_sent_back_note.content"]],
    ["v_da_button_pressed",    "choice",         ["tk_domain_approval.savesButtonPressedAs"],      ["tx_sent_back_note.showWhen"]],
    ["v_da_answered_by",       "person",         ["tk_domain_approval.savesAnsweredByAs"],         ["tx_sent_back_note.content"]],
    ["v_jira_issue",           "text",           ["act_create_jira_issue.saveResults.key"],        ["act_notify_eng_lead.message"]],
    ["v_release_notes",        "longText",       ["q_release_notes.savedAs"],                      []],
  ];
  const loc = (s: string) => {
    const dot = s.indexOf(".");
    return { item: s.slice(0, dot), part: s.slice(dot + 1) };
  };
  it.each(VALUES)("value %s: %s, filled at %j, used at %j", (id, kind, filledAt, usedAt) => {
    expect(f.values[id as `v_${string}`]).toEqual({ kind, filledAt: filledAt.map(loc), usedAt: usedAt.map(loc) });
  });
  it("has exactly these values", () => expect(Object.keys(f.values)).toEqual(VALUES.map((v) => v[0])));
});

describe("facts: reachability and sending back (dominance, E-14)", () => {
  // st_s -> st_x, st_y; st_x -> st_z; st_y -> st_z; st_z -> st_x, st_s, st_z, st_end; st_lost -> st_x (no route reaches st_lost)
  const wf = workflow(
    [
      stage("st_s", { tasks: [task("tk_s", ["btn_x", "btn_y"])], arrows: [arrow("ar_s_x", "btn_x", "st_x"), arrow("ar_s_y", "btn_y", "st_y")] }),
      stage("st_x", { arrows: [arrow("ar_x_z", "done", "st_z")] }),
      stage("st_y", { arrows: [arrow("ar_y_z", "done", "st_z")] }),
      stage("st_z", {
        tasks: [task("tk_z", ["btn_zx", "btn_zs", "btn_zz", "btn_end"])],
        arrows: [arrow("ar_z_x", "btn_zx", "st_x"), arrow("ar_z_s", "btn_zs", "st_s"), arrow("ar_z_z", "btn_zz", "st_z"), arrow("ar_z_end", "btn_end", "st_end")],
      }),
      stage("st_lost", { arrows: [arrow("ar_lost_x", "done", "st_x"), arrow("ar_lost_self", "done", "st_lost")] }),
      ending("st_end"),
    ],
    [],
  );
  const f = facts(wf, CATALOGUE);

  it.each([
    ["ar_z_x", false], // st_z is also reached through st_y, so st_x is not on every route to it
    ["ar_z_s", true], // the start is on every route
    ["ar_z_z", true], // a stage dominates itself
    ["ar_s_x", false],
    ["ar_z_end", false],
    ["ar_lost_self", false], // out of a stage no route reaches
  ])("%s sends back: %s", (id, back) => {
    expect(f.arrows[id as `ar_${string}`]?.sendsBack).toBe(back);
  });

  it("an unreachable stage is marked, and its arrows still count as incoming", () => {
    expect(f.stages.st_lost).toEqual({ incoming: ["ar_lost_self"], reachable: false });
    expect(f.stages.st_x).toEqual({ incoming: ["ar_s_x", "ar_z_x", "ar_lost_x"], reachable: true });
  });

  it("with no valid start, nothing is reachable and nothing sends back", () => {
    const noStart = { ...wf, start: { ...wf.start, stage: "st_gone" } } as AuthoredWorkflow;
    const g = facts(noStart, CATALOGUE);
    expect(Object.values(g.stages).every((s) => s && !s.reachable)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.values(g.arrows).every((a) => a && !a.sendsBack)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("facts: arrows that can never be used, from buttons alone", () => {
  const one = (arrows: ReturnType<typeof arrow>[]) =>
    facts(workflow([stage("st_a", { tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_a", "btn_b"])], arrows }), stage("st_b", { tasks: [task("tk_b", ["btn_other"])], arrows: [arrow("ar_b", "btn_other", "st_a")] }), ending("st_end")], []), CATALOGUE).arrows;

  it("an arrow for a button an earlier arrow already takes", () => {
    const a = one([arrow("ar_1", "btn_a", "st_b"), arrow("ar_2", "btn_b", "st_end"), arrow("ar_3", "btn_a", "st_end", { onlyWhen: { formula: "true", readsAs: "always" } })]);
    expect(a.ar_3).toEqual({ usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", earlier: { item: "ar_1" }, covering: [{ item: "ar_1" }], sendsBack: false });
    expect(a.ar_1?.usable).toBe(true);
  });

  it("an earlier arrow with its own '+ only when' does not always fit", () => {
    const a = one([arrow("ar_1", "btn_a", "st_b", { onlyWhen: { formula: "true", readsAs: "always" } }), arrow("ar_2", "btn_a", "st_end")]);
    expect(a.ar_2?.usable).toBe(true);
  });

  it("'In all other cases' after arrows that cover every button: no single earlier arrow is named", () => {
    const a = one([arrow("ar_1", "btn_a", "st_b"), arrow("ar_2", { type: "condition", condition: pressedWhen("btn_b") }, "st_end"), arrow("ar_3", "other", "st_end")]);
    // Together they cover it: each is named in `covering` (E-32).
    expect(a.ar_3).toEqual({ usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", covering: [{ item: "ar_1" }, { item: "ar_2" }], sendsBack: false });
    expect(a.ar_2?.usable).toBe(true);
  });

  it("'In all other cases' after a condition on a value stays usable", () => {
    const a = one([arrow("ar_1", "btn_a", "st_b"), arrow("ar_2", { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_x" }, words: "text.isFilled" }] } }, "st_end"), arrow("ar_3", "other", "st_end")]);
    expect(a.ar_3?.usable).toBe(true);
  });

  it("an arrow after 'When done'", () => {
    const f = facts(workflow([stage("st_a", { arrows: [arrow("ar_1", "done", "st_end"), arrow("ar_2", { type: "condition", condition: { formula: "true", readsAs: "x" } }, "st_end")] }), ending("st_end")], []), CATALOGUE);
    expect(f.arrows.ar_2).toEqual({ usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", earlier: { item: "ar_1" }, covering: [{ item: "ar_1" }], sendsBack: false });
  });

  it.each([
    ["a button of another stage", arrow("ar_x", "btn_other", "st_end")],
    ["two buttons of one task pressed together", arrow("ar_x", { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [{ pressed: "btn_a" }, { pressed: "btn_b" }] } }, "st_end")],
    ["'+ only when' another button of the same task", arrow("ar_x", "btn_a", "st_end", { onlyWhen: pressedWhen("btn_b") })],
  ])("a condition that is never true: %s", (_, a) => {
    expect(one([a])["ar_x"]).toEqual({ usable: false, reason: "conditionNeverTrue", sendsBack: false });
  });

  it("an unfinished arrow is not called never used", () => {
    const a = one([arrow("ar_1", { type: "buttonPressed", button: null }, "st_end"), arrow("ar_2", { type: "condition" }, "st_end"), arrow("ar_3", "btn_gone", "st_end"), arrow("ar_4", { type: "condition", condition: { allOf: [] } }, null)]);
    expect([a.ar_1?.usable, a.ar_2?.usable, a.ar_3?.usable, a.ar_4?.usable]).toEqual([true, true, true, true]);
  });

  describe("'Don't wait for the others' (compiler.md 6.4)", () => {
    const two = (arrows: ReturnType<typeof arrow>[], tasks = [task("tk_1", ["btn_ok1", "btn_no1"]), task("tk_2", ["btn_ok2", "btn_no2"])]) =>
      facts(workflow([stage("st_a", { tasks, arrows }), ending("st_end")], []), CATALOGUE).arrows;

    it("an early arrow is checked while tasks are open, so an earlier ordinary arrow does not hide it", () => {
      const a = two([arrow("ar_1", "btn_no1", "st_end"), arrow("ar_early", "btn_no1", "st_end", { goAsSoonAsTrue: true }), arrow("ar_rest", "other", "st_end")]);
      expect(a.ar_early?.usable).toBe(true);
    });

    it("an earlier early arrow does hide a later one", () => {
      const a = two([arrow("ar_1", "btn_no1", "st_end", { goAsSoonAsTrue: true }), arrow("ar_2", "btn_no1", "st_end", { goAsSoonAsTrue: true }), arrow("ar_rest", "other", "st_end")]);
      expect(a.ar_2).toEqual({ usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", earlier: { item: "ar_1" }, covering: [{ item: "ar_1" }], sendsBack: false });
    });

    it("with one task 'Don't wait' means nothing, so the earlier arrow hides it", () => {
      const a = two([arrow("ar_1", "btn_no1", "st_end"), arrow("ar_early", "btn_no1", "st_end", { goAsSoonAsTrue: true })], [task("tk_1", ["btn_ok1", "btn_no1"])]);
      expect(a.ar_early).toEqual({ usable: false, reason: "earlierArrowAlwaysFits", earlier: { item: "ar_1" }, covering: [{ item: "ar_1" }], sendsBack: false });
    });

describe("facts: a value's kind from every filler", () => {
  const f = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow) => facts(doc, CATALOGUE).values;

  it("two fillers of different kinds are a conflict, listing each filler", () => {
    const v = f(workflow([stage("st_a", { tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_a"], [{ id: "q_a", savedAs: "v_x", kind: "text" }])], after: [save("act_n", "v_x", { number: 3 })], arrows: [arrow("ar_a", "btn_a", null)] })], ["v_x"]));
    expect(v.v_x?.kind).toEqual({ conflict: [{ kind: "text", at: { item: "q_a", part: "savedAs" } }, { kind: "number", at: { item: "act_n", part: "as" } }] });
  });

  it("two fillers of the same kind agree", () => {
    const v = f(workflow([stage("st_a", { tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_a"], [{ id: "q_a", savedAs: "v_x", kind: "date" }])], after: [save("act_n", "v_x", { date: "2026-01-01" })], arrows: [] })], ["v_x"]));
    expect(v.v_x?.kind).toBe("date");
  });

  it.each<[string, unknown, ValueKind | undefined]>([
    ["a sentence", { allOf: [] }, "yesNo"],
    ["the Requester", { request: "requester" }, "person"],
    ["Started on", { request: "startedOn" }, "date"],
    ["another value", { value: "v_src" }, "longText"],
    ["a list cell", { value: "v_row", steps: [{ column: "col_lead" }] }, "person"],
    ["a group's people", { value: "v_row", steps: [{ column: "col_team" }, { directory: "members" }] }, "people"],
    ["a formula (the kind checkFormula gives)", { formula: "1.0", readsAs: "one" }, "number"],
    ["a formula reading a value", { formula: "{{v_src}} + '!'", readsAs: "loud" }, "text"],
    ["a formula giving a whole number (not a value kind)", { formula: "1", readsAs: "one" }, undefined],
    ["a constant row", { row: "row_1" }, "choiceFromList"],
    ["a constant button", { button: "btn_a" }, "choice"],
  ])("a save of %s", (_, what, kind) => {
    const doc = workflow(
      [stage("st_a", {
        tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_a"], [{ id: "q_src", savedAs: "v_src", kind: "longText" }])],
        after: [save("act_s", "v_x", what as never)],
        arrows: [],
      })],
      ["v_x", "v_src"],
      { lists: [{ id: "ls_l", name: "L", columns: [{ id: "col_lead", name: "Lead", kind: "person" }, { id: "col_team", name: "Team", kind: "group" }], rows: [{ id: "row_1", cells: {} }] }] },
    );
    const row = doc.stages[0]?.kind !== "ending" ? doc.stages[0]?.tasks[0]?.form.pages[0]?.items : undefined;
    row?.push({ type: "question", id: "q_row", label: "Row", kind: "choice", savedAs: "v_row", choices: { from: "list", list: "ls_l" } });
    expect(f(doc).v_x?.kind).toBe(kind);
  });

  it("a saved result takes the operation's result field kind; an unknown operation says nothing", () => {
    const call = (operation: string) => ({ id: "act_c" as const, type: "useConnection" as const, operation: operation as `${string}.${string}@${number}`, inputs: {}, saveResults: { owner: "v_owner" as const }, ifItFails: "stuck" as const });
    expect(f(workflow([stage("st_a", { arrival: [call("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1")] })], ["v_owner"])).v_owner?.kind).toBe("person");
    expect(f(workflow([stage("st_a", { arrival: [call("nowhere.nothing@1")] })], ["v_owner"])).v_owner?.kind).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("a value nothing fills has no kind, and a value saved from itself round a loop does not hang", () => {
    const v = f(workflow([stage("st_a", { after: [save("act_1", "v_a", { value: "v_b" }), save("act_2", "v_b", { value: "v_a" })] })], ["v_a", "v_b", "v_c"]));
    expect(v.v_a).toEqual({ filledAt: [{ item: "act_1", part: "as" }], usedAt: [{ item: "act_2", part: "save" }] });
    expect(v.v_c).toEqual({ filledAt: [], usedAt: [] });
  });

  it("a choice question's kind follows where its choices come from", () => {
    const q = (id: `q_${string}`, savedAs: `v_${string}`, choices: object) => ({ type: "question" as const, id, label: id, kind: "choice" as const, savedAs, choices: choices as never });
    const doc = workflow([stage("st_a", { tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_a"])] })], ["v_list", "v_source", "v_typed", "v_formula"]);
    const items = doc.stages[0]?.kind !== "ending" ? doc.stages[0]?.tasks[0]?.form.pages[0]?.items : undefined;
    items?.push(
      q("q_list", "v_list", { from: "list", list: "ls_x" }),
      q("q_source", "v_source", { from: "source", inputs: {} }),
      q("q_typed", "v_typed", { from: "typedIn", choices: [] }),
      q("q_formula", "v_formula", { from: "formula", formula: { formula: "['a']", readsAs: "a" } }),
    );
    const v = f(doc);
    // A choice from a formula is one of its items: the kind checkFormula gives for the choices formula.
    expect([v.v_list?.kind, v.v_source?.kind, v.v_typed?.kind, v.v_formula?.kind]).toEqual(["choiceFromList", "choiceFromConnection", "choice", "text"]);
  });

  it("a choice question whose choices are the people in a group gives a person (E-26)", () => {
    const doc = workflow([stage("st_a", { tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_a"])] })], ["v_lead", "v_typed"]);
    const items = doc.stages[0]?.kind !== "ending" ? doc.stages[0]?.tasks[0]?.form.pages[0]?.items : undefined;
    items?.push(

/**
 * Agreement over generated answer sets: for every fixture's start form and for every task form a random
 * walk reaches, "this can be sent" (`formState`'s `available`) equals the kernel's acceptance of the same
 * answers on the definition `compile` builds for Try it. The answer sets mix missing answers, answers of
 * the wrong kind, out of range, unknown choices, answers to hidden questions and unknown questions.
 *
 * An act refused with `choice-unknown` is left out: that needs the live lookup, which formState never makes
 * (core-api.md 7.1).
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Answers, Json } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/types.ts";
import type { KernelRefusal } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import type { Fakes } from "../../../src/authored/host/index.ts";
import { toRefusal } from "../../../src/authored/view/index.ts";
import { arrow } from "../build.ts";
import { fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { Compiled, formStateOf, KernelRun, PEOPLE, pickWith, random, randomAnswers } from "../host/walk.ts";
import { doc } from "./rich-form.ts";

const PRIYA = "dir-user-priya-raman";
const ACTOR_REFUSALS = new Set(["not-assignee", "may", "membership-unavailable"]);

interface Mismatch {
  task: string;
  button: string;
  answers: Answers;
  form: unknown;
  kernel: KernelRefusal[] | "accepted";
}

/** Compares one answer set on every button; returns the mismatches and the accepted inputs. */
function compare(
  c: Compiled, run: KernelRun, task: string, answers: Answers, actors: readonly string[],
  aim: (as: string, button: string, a: Answers) => ReturnType<KernelRun["startInput"]>,
): { mismatches: Mismatch[]; accepted: { as: string; button: string; answers: Answers }[]; compared: number } {
  const { values, request } = run.formRequest();
  const form = formStateOf(c, task, answers, values, request);
  const mismatches: Mismatch[] = [];
  const accepted: { as: string; button: string; answers: Answers }[] = [];
  let compared = 0;
  for (const b of form.buttons) {
    let result: ReturnType<KernelRun["peek"]> | undefined;
    let actor = "";
    for (const as of actors) {
      const { input, context } = aim(as, b.button, answers);
      const r = run.peek(input, context);
      if (!r.ok && r.refusals.some((x) => ACTOR_REFUSALS.has(x.reason))) continue;
      result = r;
      actor = as;
      break;
    }
    if (result === undefined) continue;
    if (!result.ok && result.refusals.some((x) => x.reason === "choice-unknown")) continue;
    compared += 1;
    if (result.ok) accepted.push({ as: actor, button: b.button, answers });
    if (b.available !== result.ok) mismatches.push({ task, button: b.button, answers, form: b, kernel: result.ok ? "accepted" : result.refusals });
    else if (!result.ok) {
      // Refused on both sides: the act's first refusal, as the contract reports it, is what the form says.
      const element = aim(actor, b.button, answers).input;
      const first = toRefusal(c.r, result.refusals[0] as KernelRefusal, { element: element.kind === "act" ? element.wait.element : c.def.start, button: b.button, answers: answers as Record<string, unknown> });
      const rule = first.code === "invalid-data" ? first.params.rule : undefined;
      const formSays = rule === "required" ? b.missing.length > 0 || (b.refusal?.code === "invalid-data" && b.refusal.params.rule === "required") : b.refusal?.code === first.code && (rule === undefined || (b.refusal.code === "invalid-data" && b.refusal.params.rule === rule));
      if (!formSays) mismatches.push({ task, button: b.button, answers, form: b, kernel: result.refusals });
    }
  }
  return { mismatches, accepted, compared };
}

const short = (m: Mismatch[]): string =>
  JSON.stringify(m.slice(0, 3), (_k, v: unknown) => (typeof v === "string" && v.length > 40 ? `${v.slice(0, 20)}...(${v.length})` : v), 1);

const DOCS = {
  "change-request": () => fixture("change-request"),
  "integrated-sample": () => fixture("integrated-sample"),
  "several-at-once": () => fixture("several-at-once"),
  "rich form": () => doc(),
  "rich form, walked on to its review task": () => {
    const wf = doc();
    const first = wf.stages[0];
    const review = wf.stages[1];
    if (first === undefined || first.kind === "ending" || review === undefined || review.kind === "ending") throw new Error("no stages");
    first.arrows = [arrow("ar_on", "other", "st_r")];
    review.arrows = [arrow("ar_back", "other", "st_f")];
    return wf;
  },
};

  },

const fakesOf = (name: string): Partial<Fakes> => (name === "integrated-sample" ? TIER_2 : {});

describe("formState agrees with the kernel over generated answer sets", () => {
  for (const [name, make] of Object.entries(DOCS)) {
    it(`${name}: the start form, 300 answer sets`, () => {
      const c = new Compiled(make(), fakesOf(name));
      const task = c.r.startTask() ?? "";
      const rnd = random(7);
      const run = new KernelRun(c, 1, { seconds: 0 });
      const offered = formStateOf(c, task, {}, {}, { requester: { type: "user", id: PRIYA }, startedOn: "2026-11-16" }).choices as Partial<Record<string, Json[]>>;
      const all: Mismatch[] = [];
      let compared = 0;
      let accepted = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
        const answers = randomAnswers(c, task, rnd, offered);
        // The start form: the page's own Requester and date, as on the start page.
        const form = { values: {}, request: { requester: { type: "user" as const, id: PRIYA }, startedOn: "2026-11-16" } };
        run.formRequest = () => form;
        const r = compare(c, run, task, answers, [PRIYA], (as, button, a) => run.startInput(as, button, a));
        all.push(...r.mismatches);
        compared += r.compared;
        accepted += r.accepted.length;
      }
      expect(all.length, short(all)).toBe(0);
      expect(compared).toBeGreaterThan(200);
      expect(accepted).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it(`${name}: every task form a random walk reaches`, () => {
      const c = new Compiled(make(), fakesOf(name));
      const start = c.r.startTask() ?? "";
      const all: Mismatch[] = [];
      const reached = new Set<string>();
      let compared = 0;
      for (let seed = 1; seed <= 4; seed++) {
        const rnd = random(seed * 101);
        const pick = pickWith(rnd);
        let run = new KernelRun(c, 1, { seconds: 0 });
        const offered = formStateOf(c, start, {}, {}, { requester: { type: "user", id: PRIYA }, startedOn: "2026-11-16" }).choices as Partial<Record<string, Json[]>>;
        // Starts until one leaves a task open: some starts run straight to an ending or get stuck.
        let begun = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !begun; i++) {
          run = new KernelRun(c, 1, { seconds: 0 });
          const answers = randomAnswers(c, start, rnd, offered, 0);
          const b = pick(c.s.ix.taskById.get(start)?.buttons ?? []);
          const { input, context } = run.startInput(PRIYA, b?.id ?? "", answers);
          begun = run.apply(input, context) && run.state.waits.some((w) => w.status === "open" && w.kind === "person");
        }
        if (!begun) continue;
        for (let step = 0; step < 12; step++) {
          const open = run.state.waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open" && w.kind === "person");
          if (open.length === 0 || run.state.closed !== null) break;
          const w = pick(open);
          const task = c.r.taskOf(w.id.element);
          if (task === undefined) break;
          reached.add(task);
          const { values, request } = run.formRequest();
          const choices = formStateOf(c, task, {}, values, request).choices as Partial<Record<string, Json[]>>;
          const accepted: { as: string; button: string; answers: Answers }[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            const answers = randomAnswers(c, task, rnd, choices, i % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 0.3);
            const r = compare(c, run, task, answers, [PRIYA, ...PEOPLE], (as, button, a) => run.actInput(as, w.id, button, a));
            all.push(...r.mismatches);
            accepted.push(...r.accepted);
            compared += r.compared;
          }
          if (accepted.length === 0) break;
          const go = pick(accepted);
          const { input, context } = run.actInput(go.as, w.id, go.button, go.answers);
          if (!run.apply(input, context)) throw new Error("an accepted act was refused when applied");
        }
      }
      expect(all.length, `${[...reached].join(", ")}: ${short(all)}`).toBe(0);
      // The rich form's start stage has no arrow: a request never gets past it.
      if (name !== "rich form") expect(compared).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }, 60_000);
  }
});

/**
 * Agreement: an answer set that formState calls sendable is one the kernel accepts.
 *
 * Twice, on the change-request fixture's start form: against the compiler's own worked example
 * (engine/design/compiler.md 15.6, read from the document) through the kernel's submission step
 * (`checkSubmission`: `may`, the schema, the lookups, the checks), comparing the refusal rules too;

 * available exactly when accepted.
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { buttonSchema, formState } from "../../../src/authored/form/index.ts";
import { docSetup } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/setup.ts";
import type { PersonWait, PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";

import { emptyState } from "../../../src/kernel/state.ts";
import { checkSchemaProfile } from "../../../src/schema/profile.ts";

/** The JSON block of compiler.md 15.6, with the parts of a definition the submission step reads. */
function workedExample(): PublishedDefinition {
  const text = readFileSync(COMPILER, "utf8");
  const section = text.slice(text.indexOf("### 15.6"));
  const block = /```json\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/.exec(section)?.[1];
  if (!block) throw new Error("compiler.md 15.6 has no JSON block");
  const part = JSON.parse(block) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return { ...part, constants: {}, types: { data: {}, constants: {}, results: {} } } as unknown as PublishedDefinition;
}

const ELEMENT = "st_request_form__tasks.tk_request_form";

function kernelAccepts(def: PublishedDefinition, data: Record<string, unknown>): { ok: boolean; rules: string[] } {
  const stage = (def.root.stages ?? []).find((s) => s.id === "st_request_form__tasks");
  const wait = stage?.waits.find((w) => w.id === "tk_request_form") as PersonWait;
  const state = emptyState();
  state.request = { id: "r1", by: { type: "user", id: "u_me" }, at: "2026-11-15T09:30:00.000000Z", readableId: 1 };
  const r = checkSubmission(def, state, { element: ELEMENT, wait, outcome: "btn_rf_submit", actor: { type: "user", id: "u_me" }, data: data as never, memberOf: [] }, { at: "2026-11-15T09:30:00.000000Z" });
  if (r.ok) return { ok: true, rules: [] };
  return { ok: false, rules: [...new Set(r.refusals.map((x) => String(x.params["rule"] ?? x.reason)))].sort() };
}

const without = (key: string) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(FULL).filter(([k]) => k !== key));

      if (r.result !== "state") throw new Error("no lookup is needed");

      const kernel = kernelAccepts(def, answers);
      expect(b.available).toBe(kernel.ok);
      const rules = [...new Set([...(r.state.invalid ?? []).map((x) => ("rule" in x.params ? x.params.rule : x.code)), ...(b.missing.length > 0 ? ["required"] : [])])].sort();

/**
 * formState (core-api.md 7): the result types, every rule of 7.1 and every row of 7.2, on a form

const cat = catalogue();

function stateOf(r: FormStateResult): FormState {
  if (r.result !== "state") throw new Error(`expected a state, got ${JSON.stringify(r)}`);
  return r.state;
}
const form = (answers: Record<string, unknown>, values: Record<string, unknown> = {}, request?: { requester?: { type: "user"; id: string }; startedOn?: string }) =>
  stateOf(formState(doc(), cat, { item: "tk_f" }, answers as never, values as never, request));
const button = (s: FormState, id: string) => s.buttons.find((b) => b.button === id);

describe("formState: what shows", () => {
  it("shows pages, questions and texts in form order; anything else is hidden", () => {

  });

  it("works with no request: an answer counts as its value, so a Show when on the same form sees it", () => {
    expect(form({ q_kind: "ch_complex" }).shown).toEqual(["pg_1", "q_kind", "q_detail", "q_count", "q_due", "q_multi", "q_size", "q_row", "q_who", "q_service", "tx_note"]);
  });

  it("a page's Show when shows or hides its questions", () => {
    expect(form({ q_count: 11 }).shown).toContain("q_extra");

    expect(form({ q_count: 10 }).shown).not.toContain("q_extra");
  });

    expect(s.shown).toEqual(["pg_r", "q_late"]);
  });

    expect(s.shown).toEqual(["pg_r"]);
  });

describe("formState: buttons and what they still need", () => {
  it("lists one state per button in display order, with the needed questions that are shown and empty", () => {

    expect(s.buttons).toEqual([
      { button: "btn_send", available: false, missing: ["q_kind"] },

    ]);
  });

  it("a hidden question is never needed", () => {

    expect(button(form({ q_kind: "ch_complex", q_count: 5 }), "btn_send")).toEqual({ button: "btn_send", available: false, missing: ["q_detail"] });

  it("a question ticked All is needed for every button, when shown", () => {

    expect(button(s, "btn_send")?.missing).toEqual(["q_extra"]);
    expect(button(s, "btn_draft")?.missing).toEqual(["q_extra"]);
  });

  it("'Also only when' not true is a check refusal at the button, with the author's message", () => {
    const s = form({ q_kind: "ch_simple", q_count: 101, q_extra: "x" });

      button: "btn_send", available: false, missing: [],

    });
    expect(button(s, "btn_draft")?.available).toBe(true);
  });

  it("an empty value makes 'Also only when' not true (E-22); a negative word is then true", () => {
    expect(button(form({ q_kind: "ch_simple" }), "btn_send")?.refusal?.code).toBe("check");
    const negative = stateOf(formState(withEnabledWhen(is("v_count", "number.isNot", { number: 0 })), cat, { item: "tk_f" }, { q_kind: "ch_simple" }, {}));
    expect(button(negative, "btn_send")).toEqual({ button: "btn_send", available: true, missing: [] });
  });

  it("reads the request's values in 'Also only when' when the form does not fill them", () => {
    const d = withEnabledWhen(is("v_note", "text.isFilled"));
    expect(button(stateOf(formState(d, cat, { item: "tk_f" }, { q_kind: "ch_simple" }, {})), "btn_send")?.refusal?.code).toBe("check");
    expect(button(stateOf(formState(d, cat, { item: "tk_f" }, { q_kind: "ch_simple" }, { v_note: "x" })), "btn_send")?.available).toBe(true);
  });
});

function withEnabledWhen(cond: Condition): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const d = doc();
  const t = (d.stages[0] as { tasks: Task[] }).tasks[0] as Task;
  t.buttons[0]!.enabledWhen = cond;
  return d;
}

function withShowWhen(item: string, cond: Condition): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const d = doc();
  const t = (d.stages[0] as { tasks: Task[] }).tasks[0] as Task;
  for (const p of t.form.pages) {
    if (p.id === item) p.showWhen = cond;
    for (const i of p.items) if (i.id === item) i.showWhen = cond;
  }
  return d;
}

describe("formState: where choices come from", () => {

    expect(form({ q_kind: "ch_complex" }).choices).toEqual({ q_size: ["small", "large"] });
    // A formula that reads an empty value gives nothing (compiler.md 8.4): no choices yet.

  it("gives no entry for typed-in, list, directory or source choices", () => {

    expect(form({ q_kind: "ch_complex", q_size: "large" }).invalid).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("does not check a source answer: that is looked up when the person acts (choice-unknown)", () => {

/** The form every formState rule is shown on, and a second task for the directory and for request values. */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Condition, FormItem, Page, Question, Task } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { stage, workflow } from "../build.ts";

export const question = (id: `q_${string}`, kind: Question["kind"], extra: Partial<Question> = {}): Question =>
  ({ type: "question", id, label: id, kind, savedAs: `v_${id.slice(2)}`, ...extra });
export const is = (value: `v_${string}`, words: string, right?: unknown): Condition =>
  ({ allOf: [{ left: { value }, words, ...(right === undefined ? {} : { right }) }] } as Condition);
export const formula = (text: string): Condition => ({ formula: text, readsAs: "x" });

export function taskOf(id: `tk_${string}`, pages: Page[], buttons: Task["buttons"]): Task {
  return { id, whoIsAsked: { request: "requester" }, groupRule: "firstAnswerDecides", requesterCanAnswer: true, form: { pages }, buttons };
}

/** The form every rule is shown on. */
export function doc(): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const page1: FormItem[] = [
    question("q_kind", "choice", { choices: { from: "typedIn", choices: [{ id: "ch_simple", label: "Simple" }, { id: "ch_complex", label: "Complex" }] } }),
    question("q_detail", "longText", { showWhen: is("v_kind", "choice.is", { choice: "ch_complex" }) }),
    question("q_count", "number"),
    question("q_due", "date"),
    question("q_multi", "multipleChoice", { choices: { from: "typedIn", choices: [{ id: "ch_a", label: "A" }, { id: "ch_b", label: "B" }, { id: "ch_c", label: "C" }] } }),
    question("q_size", "choice", { choices: { from: "formula", formula: { formula: "{{v_kind}} == 'ch_complex' ? ['small', 'large'] : ['small']", readsAs: "x" } } }),
    question("q_row", "choice", { choices: { from: "list", list: "ls_l" } }),
    question("q_who", "person"),
    question("q_service", "choice", { choices: { from: "source", source: "servicecatalog.services@1", inputs: {}, labelField: "name", storedField: "id" } }),
    { type: "text", id: "tx_note", content: ["Complex"], showWhen: is("v_kind", "choice.is", { choice: "ch_complex" }) },
  ];
  const page2: FormItem[] = [question("q_extra", "text", { neededForEveryButton: true })];
  const t = taskOf("tk_f", [
    { id: "pg_1", items: page1 },
    { id: "pg_2", showWhen: is("v_count", "number.isMoreThan", { number: 10 }), items: page2 },
  ], [
    { id: "btn_send", label: "Send", look: "primary", neededToPress: ["q_kind", "q_detail"], enabledWhen: is("v_count", "number.isAtMost", { number: 100 }), messageWhileDisabled: "Too many" },
    { id: "btn_draft", label: "Draft", look: "secondary", neededToPress: [] },
  ]);
  // A second task reads a request value and the directory.
  const review = taskOf("tk_review", [{
    id: "pg_r",
    items: [
      question("q_note", "text", { showWhen: is("v_who", "person.isIn", { value: "v_team" }) }),
      question("q_late", "yesNo", { showWhen: formula("{{v_due}} < {{request.startedOn}}") }),
    ],
  }], [{ id: "btn_ok", label: "OK", look: "primary", neededToPress: ["q_note"] }]);
  const values = ["v_kind", "v_detail", "v_count", "v_due", "v_multi", "v_size", "v_row", "v_who", "v_service", "v_extra", "v_note", "v_late", "v_team"] as const;
  return workflow(
    [
      stage("st_f", { tasks: [t], kind: "form" }),

    ],
    values,
    { lists: [{ id: "ls_l", name: "L", columns: [], rows: [{ id: "row_1", cells: {} }, { id: "row_2", cells: {} }] }] },
