/**
 * Each fixture's start form through formState with empty, partial and full answers. Full answers
 * are the sample request's values of the questions' saved values.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, SampleRequest } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { sampleValues } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/index.ts";
import { formState, type FormState } from "../../../src/authored/form/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, FIXTURES, type FixtureName } from "../fixtures.ts";

const cat = catalogue();

interface StartForm {
  task: string;
  questions: { id: string; savedAs?: string }[];
  buttons: { id: string; needed: string[] }[];
}

function startForm(w: AuthoredWorkflow): StartForm {
  const stage = w.stages.find((s) => s.id === w.start.stage) as { tasks: { id: string; form: { pages: { items: { type: string; id: string; savedAs?: string; neededForEveryButton?: boolean }[] }[] }; buttons: { id: string; neededToPress: string[] }[] }[] };
  const t = stage.tasks[0]!;
  const questions = t.form.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items).filter((i) => i.type === "question");
  const all = questions.filter((q) => q.neededForEveryButton).map((q) => q.id);
  return {
    task: t.id,
    questions: questions.map((q) => (q.savedAs ? { id: q.id, savedAs: q.savedAs } : { id: q.id })),
    buttons: t.buttons.map((b) => ({ id: b.id, needed: questions.map((q) => q.id).filter((q) => all.includes(q) || b.neededToPress.includes(q)) })),
  };
}

/** The sample's value of every question's saved value. */
function fullAnswers(w: AuthoredWorkflow, f: StartForm): Record<string, unknown> {
  const values = sampleValues(w, (w.sampleRequest ?? { name: "", answers: {} }) as SampleRequest, cat).values as Record<string, unknown>;
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const q of f.questions) if (q.savedAs && values[q.savedAs] !== undefined) out[q.id] = values[q.savedAs];
  return out;
}

function run(name: FixtureName, answers: Record<string, unknown>, values: Record<string, unknown> = {}): FormState {
  const w = fixture(name);
  const r = formState(w, cat, { item: startForm(w).task }, answers as never, values as never, { requester: { type: "user", id: "u_me" }, startedOn: "2026-11-15" });
  if (r.result !== "state") throw new Error("a start form needs no lookup");
  return r.state;
}

/** Answers for the integrated sample's source question, which its sample does not hold. */
const EXTRA: Partial<Record<FixtureName, Record<string, unknown>>> = {
  "integrated-sample": { q_service: { stored: "svc-payments-api", label: "Payments API" } },
};

describe.each(FIXTURES)("the start form of %s", (name) => {
  const w = fixture(name);
  const f = startForm(w);
  const full = { ...fullAnswers(w, f), ...EXTRA[name] };

  it("empty: every needed question is missing, nothing is invalid", () => {
    const s = run(name, {});
    expect(s.invalid).toBeUndefined();
    for (const b of f.buttons) expect(s.buttons.find((x) => x.button === b.id)).toEqual({ button: b.id, available: b.needed.length === 0, missing: b.needed });
  });

  it("partial: the first needed question answered is no longer missing", () => {
    const first = f.buttons.flatMap((b) => b.needed)[0];
    if (first === undefined) return;
    const s = run(name, { [first]: full[first] });
    expect(s.invalid).toBeUndefined();
    for (const b of f.buttons) expect(s.buttons.find((x) => x.button === b.id)?.missing).toEqual(b.needed.filter((q) => q !== first));
  });

  it("full: every button is available", () => {
    const s = run(name, full);
    expect(s.invalid).toBeUndefined();
    expect(s.buttons.map((b) => b.available)).toEqual(f.buttons.map(() => true));
    expect(s.buttons.every((b) => b.missing.length === 0 && b.refusal === undefined)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("shows the page and every question with no Show when", () => {
    const s = run(name, full);
    for (const q of f.questions) expect(s.shown).toContain(q.id);
  });
});

describe("the change-request start form when sent back", () => {
  it("shows the note only when the request was sent back for changes", () => {
    expect(run("change-request", {}).shown).not.toContain("tx_sent_back_note");
    expect(run("change-request", {}, { v_da_button_pressed: "btn_da_request_changes" }).shown).toContain("tx_sent_back_note");
    expect(run("several-at-once", {}, { v_da_button_pressed: "btn_da_request_changes" }).shown).toContain("tx_sent_back_note");
  });

  it("names exactly the full sample answers", () => {
    const w = fixture("change-request");
    expect(Object.keys(fullAnswers(w, startForm(w)))).toEqual(["q_title", "q_description", "q_primary_domain", "q_planned_release_date", "q_risk"]);
  });
});

/** formula/chips.ts and formula/cel-kinds.ts: what a chip is, how it is rewritten, kinds as CEL types. */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { t } from "../../src/cel/types.ts";
import { celTypeFitsKind, celTypeOfKind, formulaTypeOf } from "../../src/authored/formula/cel-kinds.ts";
import { chipsOf, rewriteChips } from "../../src/authored/formula/chips.ts";

describe("chips", () => {
  it("reads every chip the format names, and anything else between braces as unknown", () => {
    expect(chipsOf("{{v_a}} + {{request.requester}} {{request.startedOn}} {{sent.reporter.email}} {{v a}} {{}}")).toEqual([
      { sort: "value", value: "v_a", range: { start: 0, end: 7 } },
      { sort: "requester", range: { start: 10, end: 31 } },
      { sort: "startedOn", range: { start: 32, end: 53 } },
      { sort: "sent", field: "reporter.email", range: { start: 54, end: 77 } },
      { sort: "unknown", text: "v a", range: { start: 78, end: 85 } },
      { sort: "unknown", text: "", range: { start: 86, end: 90 } },
    ]);
  });

  it("rewrites chips and maps ranges back: inside a replacement to the whole chip, after it shifted", () => {
    const text = "{{v_title}} + x + {{v_due}}";
    const rw = rewriteChips(text, (c, i) => (c.sort === "value" && c.value === "v_due" ? `date(c${i})` : `c${i}`));
    expect(rw.source).toBe("c0 + x + date(c1)");
    expect(rw.toAuthored({ start: 0, end: 2 })).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 11 });
    expect(rw.toAuthored({ start: 5, end: 6 })).toEqual({ start: 14, end: 15 });
    expect(rw.toAuthored({ start: 9, end: 17 })).toEqual({ start: 18, end: 27 });
    expect(rw.toAuthored({ start: 17, end: 17 })).toEqual({ start: 27, end: 27 });
  });

  it("keeps text without chips byte for byte", () => {
    const rw = rewriteChips("'{{' + x", () => "never");
    expect(rw.source).toBe("'{{' + x");
    expect(rw.toAuthored({ start: 2, end: 4 })).toEqual({ start: 2, end: 4 });
  });
});

describe("kinds as CEL types (compiler.md 3.4, 8.4)", () => {
  it("a value's JSON as CEL reads it", () => {
    expect(celTypeOfKind("number")).toEqual(t.double);
    expect(celTypeOfKind("date")).toEqual(t.string);
    expect(celTypeOfKind("people")).toEqual(t.list(t.object({ type: t.string, id: t.string })));
    expect(celTypeOfKind("list", { id: "tags", label: "Tags", kind: "list", required: true, itemKind: "text" })).toEqual(t.list(t.string));
    expect(celTypeOfKind(undefined)).toEqual(t.dyn);
  });

  it("formula types from the library's type names", () => {
    expect(["double", "int", "string", "bool", "google.protobuf.Timestamp", "list<string>", "optional<double>", "map<string, dyn>", "dyn"].map(formulaTypeOf)).toEqual([
      "number", "int", "text", "yesNo", "timestamp", "listOf:text", "optionalOf:number", "map", "any",
    ]);
  });

  it("which results fit which place: a timestamp fits a date, an int never fits a number", () => {
    expect(celTypeFitsKind("google.protobuf.Timestamp", "date")).toBe(true);
    expect(celTypeFitsKind("google.protobuf.Timestamp", "text")).toBe(false);
    expect(celTypeFitsKind("int", "number")).toBe(false);
    expect(celTypeFitsKind("optional<string>", "text")).toBe(true);
    expect(celTypeFitsKind("dyn", "person")).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * The checker and the compiler agree on formulas (E-27): a formula `checkFormula` accepts at a part compiles
 * there, and the compiled definition passes the kernel's publish check, so the compiled text type-checks.
 * Run over the formula corpus: every row of core-api.md 6.4, has() on a chip's field, and every formula of
 * the fixtures, each put where an arrow's condition and a Notify's message piece stand.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { checkFormula } from "../../../src/authored/formula/index.ts";
import { placeFormula } from "../../../src/authored/formula/place.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, FIXTURES } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { HAS_ON_CHIP, TRUE } from "./corpus.ts";

const cat = catalogue();

/** Every formula text in a document. */
function formulasIn(node: unknown, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) for (const x of node) formulasIn(x, out);
  else if (typeof node === "object" && node !== null) {
    const o = node as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof o["formula"] === "string") out.push(o["formula"]);
    for (const v of Object.values(o)) formulasIn(v, out);
  }
  return out;
}

const CORPUS = [...new Set([
  ...TRUE.map(([, f]) => f),
  ...HAS_ON_CHIP,
  ...FIXTURES.flatMap((name) => formulasIn(fixture(name))),
  // Accepted or refused, each must agree.
  "{{v_title}}.size() > 3",
  "has({{v_title}}.size)",
  "{{v_eng_lead}}.id == {{request.requester}}.id",
  "{{request.startedOn}} + days(1) > {{v_planned_release_date}}",
])];

const PLACES: readonly Location[] = [
  { item: "ar_rf_no_approval", part: "when.condition" },
  { item: "act_notify_eng_lead", part: "message.1" },
];

describe("checkFormula and compile agree", () => {
  it("the corpus is not trivial", () => {
    expect(CORPUS.length).toBeGreaterThan(50);
  });

  for (const at of PLACES) {
    it(`every formula checkFormula accepts at ${at.item} ${at.part} compiles and passes the publish check`, () => {
      const wf: AuthoredWorkflow = fixture("change-request");
      const bad: string[] = [];
      let accepted = 0;
      for (const formula of CORPUS) {
        if (!checkFormula(wf, cat, at, formula).ok) continue;
        accepted++;
        const placed = placeFormula(wf, at, formula);
        const r = compile(placed.doc, cat);
        const internal = r.findings.filter((f) => f.code === "compile.internal");
        if (internal.length > 0) bad.push(`${formula}: ${JSON.stringify(internal.map((f) => f.debug))}`);
      }
      expect(accepted).toBeGreaterThan(40);
      expect(bad).toEqual([]);
    }, 120_000);
  }
});

/**

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const SUMMARY = { item: "act_create_jira_issue", part: "inputs.summary" };

function stageOf(w: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Stage & { whenThisStageStarts: Action[] } {
  return w.stages.find((s) => s.id === id) as Stage & { whenThisStageStarts: Action[] };
}

/** The fixture with a Save a value into a new value, and a question whose choices come from a formula. */
function withExtras(): AuthoredWorkflow {

describe("checkFormula: errors, with the range in the author's text", () => {

  });

  it("formula.unknownName for a chip that names nothing", () => {
    expect(checkFormula(cr(), cat, SUMMARY, "'a' + {{v_nothing}}")).toEqual({
      ok: false, error: { start: 6, end: 19, code: "formula.unknownName", params: { start: 6, end: 19, name: "v_nothing" } },
    });
  });

  });

    });

    expect(checkFormula(cr(), cat, ARROW, "{{v_title}}.matches('\\\\p{L}')")).toMatchObject({
      ok: false, error: { code: "formula.notInProfile", params: { rule: "unicodeClass" } },
    });
  });

  it("formula.argumentMismatch: a number and a whole number never mix", () => {
    const w = cr();

  it("yes/no at a condition part", () => {

/**
 * A value filled only by a formula takes the kind checkFormula gives (E-26's known limit, closed):
 * a Save a value of a formula, and a choice question whose choices come from a formula. The facts
 * and checkFormula must say the same kind.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Question } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { facts } from "../../../src/authored/facts/facts.ts";
import { checkFormula } from "../../../src/authored/formula/index.ts";
import { save, stage, task, workflow } from "../build.ts";
import { catalogue } from "../fixtures.ts";

const cat = catalogue();

function doc(formula: string, extra: Partial<Question> = {}): AuthoredWorkflow {
  const t = task("tk_a", ["btn_a"], [{ id: "q_date", savedAs: "v_date", kind: "date" }, { id: "q_text", savedAs: "v_text", kind: "text" }]);
  t.form.pages[0]!.items.push({ type: "question", id: "q_pick", label: "Pick", kind: "choice", savedAs: "v_pick", choices: { from: "formula", formula: { formula: "['a', 'b']", readsAs: "x" } }, ...extra });
  return workflow(
    [stage("st_a", { tasks: [t], after: [save("act_s", "v_x", { formula, readsAs: "x" }), save("act_t", "v_y", { value: "v_x" })] })],
    ["v_date", "v_text", "v_pick", "v_x", "v_y"],
  );
}

describe("the kind of a value filled only by a formula", () => {
  it.each([
    ["{{v_date}} + days(3)", "date"],
    ["{{v_text}} + '!'", "text"],
    ["size({{v_text}}) > 3", "yesNo"],
    ["double(size({{v_text}}))", "number"],
    ["{{v_text}} == '' ? optional.none() : optional.of({{v_text}})", "text"],
  ])("%s gives %s, in the facts and in checkFormula", (formula, kind) => {
    const w = doc(formula);
    expect(facts(w, cat).values["v_x"]?.kind).toBe(kind);
    expect(checkFormula(w, cat, { item: "act_s", part: "save" }, formula)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, kind });
  });

  it("passes on to a value saved from it", () => {
    expect(facts(doc("{{v_date}} + days(3)"), cat).values["v_y"]?.kind).toBe("date");
  });

  it("is unknown for a type that is not a value kind", () => {
    expect(facts(doc("size({{v_text}})"), cat).values["v_x"]?.kind).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("ends for a formula that reads the value it fills: that chip is untyped", () => {
    expect(facts(doc("{{v_x}}"), cat).values["v_x"]?.kind).toBeUndefined();
    // The rest of the formula can still say the kind.
    expect(facts(doc("{{v_x}} + '!'"), cat).values["v_x"]?.kind).toBe("text");
  });

  it("a choice from a formula is one of its items", () => {
    expect(facts(doc("1.0"), cat).values["v_pick"]?.kind).toBe("text");
    const numbers = doc("1.0");
    const q = (numbers.stages[0] as { tasks: { form: { pages: { items: Question[] }[] } }[] }).tasks[0]!.form.pages[0]!.items.find((i) => i.id === "q_pick")!;
    q.choices = { from: "formula", formula: { formula: "[1.0, 2.0]", readsAs: "x" } };
    expect(facts(numbers, cat).values["v_pick"]?.kind).toBe("number");
    expect(checkFormula(numbers, cat, { item: "q_pick", part: "choices.formula" }, "[1.0, 2.0]")).toEqual({ ok: true, kind: "number" });
  });

  it("a multiple choice from a formula is multipleChoice (E-27); checkFormula gives the kind of one of its items", () => {
    expect(facts(doc("1.0", { kind: "multipleChoice" }), cat).values["v_pick"]?.kind).toBe("multipleChoice");
    expect(checkFormula(doc("1.0", { kind: "multipleChoice" }), cat, { item: "q_pick", part: "choices.formula" }, "['a', 'b']")).toEqual({ ok: true, kind: "text" });
  });

  it("a multiple choice from a formula whose items have no value kind has no kind", () => {
    const w = doc("1.0", { kind: "multipleChoice", choices: { from: "formula", formula: { formula: "[{'a': 1}]", readsAs: "x" } } });
    expect(facts(w, cat).values["v_pick"]?.kind).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

﻿/**
 * Every row of core-api.md 6.4's tables (operators, functions, refused in cel-1), each worked out

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, SampleRequest } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { evaluate } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/index.ts";
import { checkFormula } from "../../../src/authored/formula/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { HAS_ON_CHIP, TRUE } from "./corpus.ts";

const cat = catalogue();
const wf = (): AuthoredWorkflow => fixture("change-request");
const AT = { item: "act_notify_eng_lead", part: "message.1" };
const run = (formula: string) => evaluate(wf(), cat, AT, { formula, readsAs: "x" }, wf().sampleRequest as SampleRequest);

describe("6.4 operators and functions, worked out", () => {
  for (const [row, formula] of TRUE) {
    it(row, () => {
      expect(run(formula)).toEqual({ result: "value", value: true, kind: "yesNo" });
    });
  }

  it("has: the checker accepts it on a chip's field", () => {
    expect(checkFormula(wf(), cat, { item: "ar_rf_no_approval", part: "when.condition" }, "has({{request.requester}}.id)")).toEqual({ ok: true, kind: "yesNo" });
  });

  // The library refuses has() on a call, and a chip reads as `<read>.value()`: the compiler writes an
  // optional read of the field instead (E-27).
  it("has: a chip's field is present", () => {
    expect(run("has({{request.requester}}.id)")).toEqual({ result: "value", value: true, kind: "yesNo" });
  });

  for (const formula of HAS_ON_CHIP) {
    it(`has on a chip, worked out: ${formula}`, () => {
      expect(run(formula)).toEqual({ result: "value", value: true, kind: "yesNo" });
    });
  }

  it("a && b: an error on one side is ignored when the other side decides", () => {
    expect(run("false && (1 / 0 == 1)")).toEqual({ result: "value", value: false, kind: "yesNo" });
    expect(run("true || (1 / 0 == 1)")).toEqual({ result: "value", value: true, kind: "yesNo" });
  });

  it("a / b: a whole number divided by 0 is an error; a number divided by 0 kept as a value is overflow", () => {
    expect(run("1 / 0")).toMatchObject({ result: "error", error: "division-by-zero" });
    expect(run("1.0 / 0.0")).toMatchObject({ result: "error", error: "overflow" });
  });

  it("a % b: by 0 is division-by-zero", () => {
    expect(run("7 % 0")).toMatchObject({ result: "error", error: "division-by-zero" });
  });

  it("a[i], m[k]: missing is index-out-of-range or no-such-key", () => {
    expect(run("[1][3]")).toEqual({ result: "error", error: "index-out-of-range", params: { index: 3 } });
    expect(run("{'a': 1}['z']")).toEqual({ result: "error", error: "no-such-key", params: { key: "z" } });
  });

  it("matches: a bad pattern is an error", () => {
    expect(run("'a'.matches('(')")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("substring: out of range is an error", () => {
    expect(run("'ab'.substring(5)")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("date: a date that does not exist is an error", () => {
    expect(run("date('2026-02-30')")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("days: beyond 3,650,000 days is overflow", () => {
    expect(run("{{v_planned_release_date}} + days(3650001)")).toMatchObject({ result: "error", error: "overflow" });
  });

  it("asDate: a timestamp outside the years 0001 to 9999 is an error", () => {
    expect(run("asDate(timestamp('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z') + days(2))")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("int: beyond the 64-bit range is an error", () => {
    expect(run("int(1e30)")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("bool: anything else is an error", () => {
    expect(run("bool('yes')")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("value: an absent optional is an error", () => {
    expect(run("optional.none().value() == 1")).toMatchObject({ result: "error" });
  });

  it("optional.none() as the formula's result leaves the value empty", () => {
    expect(run("optional.none()")).toEqual({ result: "absent" });
  });
});

describe("6.4 refused in cel-1", () => {

    expect([k.valueKind("v_m"), k.itemKind("v_m")]).toEqual(["multipleChoice", "number"]);
  });

  it("text: multipleChoice of text", () => {
    const k = kinds(withChoices("['a', 'b']"));
    expect([k.valueKind("v_m"), k.itemKind("v_m")]).toEqual(["multipleChoice", "text"]);
  });

  it("items with no value kind: no kind, as before", () => {
    const k = kinds(withChoices("[{'a': 1}]"));
    expect([k.valueKind("v_m"), k.itemKind("v_m")]).toEqual([undefined, undefined]);
  });

  it("a single choice still has the item kind itself", () => {

describe("a formula reading it", () => {
  const wf = withChoices("[1.0, 2.5]");
  const ix = indexDocument(wf);
  const world = worldFromDoc(ix, new Kinds(ix, cat));
  const CASES = [
    ["size({{v_m}}) > 0", true],
    ["{{v_m}}[0] + 1.0 > 2.0", true],
    ["{{v_m}}.exists(x, x > 2.0)", true],
    ["{{v_m}}[0] + 'x' == 'y'", false],
  ] as const;

  for (const [formula, ok] of CASES) {
    it(`the compiler types the items as numbers: ${formula} ${ok ? "compiles" : "does not type-check"}`, () => {
      expect(compileCondition({ formula, readsAs: "f" }, { in: "data" }, world).ok).toBe(ok);
    });
  }

  it("a formula that holds for any item kind: checked, compiled and passing the publish check", () => {
    const formula = "size({{v_m}}) > 0";
    expect(checkFormula(wf, cat, ARROW, formula).ok).toBe(true);
    const r = compile(placeFormula(wf, ARROW, formula).doc, cat);
    expect(r.findings.filter((f) => f.code === "compile.internal")).toEqual([]);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("checkFormula agrees: a number item is accepted as a number", () => {
    expect(checkFormula(wf, cat, ARROW, "{{v_m}}[0] + 1.0 > 2.0").ok).toBe(true);
  });
  it("checkFormula agrees: a number item is refused as text", () => {
    expect(checkFormula(wf, cat, ARROW, "{{v_m}}[0] + 'x' == 'y'").ok).toBe(false);
  });
  it("check agrees: a formula that reads the items as numbers has no formula finding; one that reads them as text has", () => {
    const findings = (formula: string): string[] =>
      check(placeFormula(wf, ARROW, formula).doc, cat).filter((f) => f.code.startsWith("formula.")).map((f) => f.code);
    expect(findings("{{v_m}}[0] + 1.0 > 2.0")).toEqual([]);
    expect(findings("{{v_m}}[0] + 'x' == 'y'")).not.toEqual([]);
  });
});

/**
 * E-32: the test host takes a time for each call that runs a turn (`at`), never earlier than the request's
 * previous event. Without it each turn is 1 s after the host's last, as before.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { StoryEntry } from "../../../src/authored/story/index.ts";
import { admin, diego, host, marcus, ok, priya, refusals, taskOf, viewOf } from "./drive.ts";

const FORM = { q_title: "Rotate keys", q_primary_domain: "row_payments", q_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", q_risk: "ch_risk_medium" };
const LEAD = { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: "dir-user-diego-santos" } };
const at = (story: readonly StoryEntry[], code: string): string[] => story.filter((e) => e.code === code).map((e) => e.at);

describe("the test host's clock (E-32)", () => {
  it("each call may give its time; the calls it sets off run at that time too", () => {
    const h = host("change-request");
    const { requestId } = ok(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", FORM, "2026-11-03T10:00:00Z"));
    expect(viewOf(h, requestId).startedAt).toBe("2026-11-03T10:00:00.000Z");
    ok(h.act(marcus, requestId, taskOf(h, requestId, "tk_domain_approval"), "btn_da_approve", LEAD, "2026-11-05T12:30:00.250+02:00"));
    const view = viewOf(h, requestId);
    expect(at(view.story, "task.answered")).toEqual(["2026-11-05T10:30:00.250Z"]);
    // The Jira call the approval set off was answered in the same moment, never before it.
    expect(at(view.story, "action.done")).toEqual(["2026-11-05T10:30:00.250Z"]);
    ok(h.admin(admin, requestId, "close", "Not needed", "2026-11-06T08:00:00.123456Z"));
    expect(viewOf(h, requestId).closed?.at).toBe("2026-11-06T08:00:00.123Z");
  });

  it("a time earlier than the request's previous event is taken as that event's time", () => {
    const h = host("change-request");
    const { requestId } = ok(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", FORM, "2026-11-03T10:00:00Z"));
    ok(h.act(marcus, requestId, taskOf(h, requestId, "tk_domain_approval"), "btn_da_approve", LEAD, "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"));
    expect(at(viewOf(h, requestId).story, "task.answered")).toEqual(["2026-11-03T10:00:00.000Z"]);
  });

  it("without a time each turn is 1 s after the host's last, as before", () => {
    const h = host("change-request");
    const { requestId } = ok(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", FORM));
    ok(h.act(marcus, requestId, taskOf(h, requestId, "tk_domain_approval"), "btn_da_approve", LEAD));
    ok(h.act(diego, requestId, taskOf(h, requestId, "tk_development"), "btn_dev_mark_released", { q_release_notes: "Done" }));
    expect(viewOf(h, requestId).closed?.at).toBe("2026-11-16T09:00:04.000Z");
  });

  it("answerCall and startFrom take a time too; one that is not RFC 3339 is refused", () => {
    const h = host("integrated-sample");
    h.setCallFake("deploy.runPipeline@1", { mode: "hold" });
    h.setCallFake("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1", { mode: "result", data: { id: "svc-payments-api", name: "Payments API", tier: "Tier 1", status: "active" } });
    const started = ok(h.startFrom("sw_helpdesk_ticket", {
      key: "HD-1", title: "Raise limits", category: "Service change", priority: "high", service: { stored: "svc-payments-api", label: "Payments" },
      reporter: { type: "user", id: priya.id }, url: "http://helpdesk.mock.test/tickets/HD-1",
    }, "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z"));
    if (!started.started) throw new Error("not started");
    const view = viewOf(h, started.requestId);
    expect(view.startedAt).toBe("2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z");
    const call = view.actions[0]?.call ?? "";
    expect(refusals(h.answerCall(call, { outcome: "ok", data: { runLink: "http://x" } }, "1 October"))).toEqual([{ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "/at", problem: "format" } }]);
    ok(h.answerCall(call, { outcome: "ok", data: { runLink: "http://x" } }, "2026-10-02T09:00:00Z"));
    expect(at(viewOf(h, started.requestId).story, "action.done").at(-1)).toBe("2026-10-02T09:00:00.000Z");
    expect(refusals(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", {}, "2026-13-01T00:00:00Z"))).toEqual([{ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "/at", problem: "format" } }]);
  });

/**
 * Shared set-up for the test host's tests: the fixtures with their fakes, the people, and small readers
 * of what a host shows. Everything goes through the test host's API.
 */
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { createTestHost, type Fakes, type OutboxEntry, type TestHost } from "../../../src/authored/host/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import type { StoryEntry } from "../../../src/authored/story/index.ts";
import type { Ref, RequestView } from "../../../src/authored/view/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture, type FixtureName } from "../fixtures.ts";

export const user = (id: string): Ref => ({ type: "user", id });
export const group = (id: string): Ref => ({ type: "group", id });

export const priya = user("dir-user-priya-raman");
export const marcus = user("dir-user-marcus-lee");
export const diego = user("dir-user-diego-santos");
export const sam = user("dir-user-sam-carter");
export const mei = user("dir-user-mei-lin");
export const omar = user("dir-user-omar-haddad");
export const ruth = user("dir-user-ruth-okafor");
export const admin = user("dir-user-admin");
export const platform = group("dir-group-platform-team");

export const GROUPS: Fakes["groups"] = {
  "dir-group-payments-approvers": ["dir-user-marcus-lee", "dir-user-priya-raman"],
  "dir-group-payments-engineering": ["dir-user-diego-santos"],
  "dir-group-security-team": ["dir-user-sam-carter"],
  "dir-group-platform-team": ["dir-user-sam-carter", "dir-user-mei-lin"],
};

export const START_AT = "2026-11-16T09:00:00.000Z";

export function hostFor(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, fakes: Partial<Fakes> = {}): TestHost {
  const r = createTestHost(wf, catalogue(), { groups: GROUPS, stuckRequestsGoTo: [admin], startAt: START_AT, ...fakes });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`no host: ${JSON.stringify(r.findings)}`);
  return r.host;
}

export function host(name: FixtureName, fakes: Partial<Fakes> = {}): TestHost {
  return hostFor(fixture(name), fakes);
}

/** A turn that must be accepted; the value it gives. */
export function ok<T extends { ok: boolean }>(r: T): Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(r)}`);
  return r as Extract<T, { ok: true }>;
}

/** The request view of a request the host holds; a refusal fails the test. */
export function viewOf(h: TestHost, requestId: string, as?: Ref): RequestView {
  const v = h.request(requestId, as);
  if ("ok" in v) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(v)}`);
  return v;
}

/** The refusals of a turn that must be refused. */
export function refusals(r: { ok: boolean; refusals?: unknown }): unknown[] {
  expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
  return (r as { refusals: unknown[] }).refusals;
}

/** The one open task of a request whose location is the task. */
export function taskOf(h: TestHost, requestId: string, task: string): string {
  const t = h.openTasks({ requestId }).find((x) => x.location.item === task);
  if (t === undefined) throw new Error(`${task} is not open: ${JSON.stringify(h.openTasks({ requestId }).map((x) => x.location))}`);
  return t.task;
}

/** The story's codes, oldest first. */
export function codes(story: readonly StoryEntry[]): string[] {
  return story.map((e) => e.code);
}

/** The story's moves, as from -> to. */
export function moves(story: readonly StoryEntry[]): string[] {
  return story.flatMap((e) => (e.code === "moved" ? [`${e.params.from} -> ${e.params.to}`] : []));
}

export type Told = Extract<OutboxEntry, { kind: "told" }>;
export type Note = Extract<OutboxEntry, { kind: "notification" }>;
export type Call = Extract<OutboxEntry, { kind: "call" }>;

export const toldOf = (entries: readonly OutboxEntry[]): Told[] => entries.filter((e): e is Told => e.kind === "told");
export const notesOf = (entries: readonly OutboxEntry[]): Note[] => entries.filter((e): e is Note => e.kind === "notification");
export const callsOf = (entries: readonly OutboxEntry[]): Call[] => entries.filter((e): e is Call => e.kind === "call");

/** What other systems were told, as `builtIn` names or the thing told. */
export function toldNames(entries: readonly OutboxEntry[]): string[] {
  return toldOf(entries).map((e) => ("builtIn" in e.what ? e.what.builtIn : e.what.tell));
}

/** Every string anywhere in a value, with its path. */
export function strings(x: unknown, path = "$"): { path: string; value: string }[] {
  if (typeof x === "string") return [{ path, value: x }];
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.flatMap((v, i) => strings(v, `${path}[${i}]`));
  if (typeof x === "object" && x !== null) return Object.entries(x).flatMap(([k, v]) => [...strings(k, `${path}.<key>`), ...strings(v, `${path}.${k}`)]);
  return [];
}

  const s = wf.stages.find((x) => x.id === id);

/**
 * The test host against the kernel (core-api.md 10.2, "Same kernel"): the same inputs through
 * `createTestHost` and through the kernel's turn function on the definition `compile` builds for Try it,
 * with the same fakes and clock, are accepted or refused alike and give the same request: the same story
 * (built from the events, so the same events), values, stage, open tasks and actions, and stuck state.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { createTestHost, type Fakes, type TestHost } from "../../../src/authored/host/index.ts";
import type { Ref } from "../../../src/authored/view/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { doc } from "../form/rich-form.ts";
import { GROUPS, START_AT, viewOf } from "./drive.ts";
import { Compiled, formStateOf, KernelRun, PEOPLE, pickWith, random, randomAnswers } from "./walk.ts";

const ADMIN: Ref = { type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" };
const PRIYA = "dir-user-priya-raman";

const FAILING_DEPLOY: Partial<Fakes> = {
  calls: {
    "servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1": { mode: "result", data: { id: "svc-ledger", name: "Ledger", tier: "Tier 2", status: "active" } },
    "deploy.runPipeline@1": { mode: "fail", error: { code: "tests-failed" } },
  },
};

function hostOf(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, fakes: Partial<Fakes>): TestHost {
  const r = createTestHost(wf, catalogue(), { groups: GROUPS, stuckRequestsGoTo: [ADMIN], startAt: START_AT, ...fakes });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("no host");
  return r.host;
}

/** What both sides show of a request; `why.notFitting` is in it, since both keep decide's trace. */
function shown(v: ReturnType<KernelRun["view"]>) {
  return { ...v };
}

/** Every result a caller of the host or of formState saw during the walks, for the leak scan. */
const returned: unknown[] = [];
function keep<T>(x: T): T {
  returned.push(x);
  return x;
}

/** The codes core-api.md sections 2.6, 8 and 9 list; any other code is unlisted. */
const REFUSAL_CODES = new Set([
  "unauthenticated", "forbidden", "not-found", "invalid-body", "too-large", "busy", "internal", "invalid-document", "authored-format-unsupported",
  "stale-revision", "core-version-mismatch", "has-todo", "last-author", "client-token-reused", "unknown-button", "wait-not-open",
  "membership-unavailable", "not-assignee", "may", "invalid-data", "source-unavailable", "choice-unknown", "check", "rule-error", "mapping-error",
  "unfinished", "not-admin", "reason-required", "stale", "request-closed", "not-stuck", "not-retryable",
]);
const STORY_CODES = new Set(["started", "task.opened", "task.answered", "task.noLongerNeeded", "action.waiting", "action.done", "action.failed", "value.saved", "moved", "status.changed", "stuck", "retried", "closed", "ended"]);
const RULES = new Set(["required", "wrong-kind", "not-a-choice", "too-long", "too-short", "out-of-range", "bad-format", "unknown-question", "hidden-answered"]);
const ERRORS = new Set(["no-such-key", "index-out-of-range", "absent-value", "wrong-kind", "division-by-zero", "overflow", "other"]);
const REASONS = new Set(["action-failed", "nobody-to-ask", "nothing-fits", "error", "unfinished"]);

/** Every leak in what was returned: a compiled ID (it has `__`), or a code, rule, error or reason the contract does not list. */
function leaks(x: unknown, path = "$", out: string[] = []): string[] {
  if (typeof x === "string") {
    if (x.includes("__")) out.push(`${path}: ${x}`);
    return out;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(x)) {
    x.forEach((v, i) => leaks(v, `${path}[${i}]`, out));
    return out;
  }
  if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) return out;
  const o = x as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof o["code"] === "string" && "params" in o) {
    const code = o["code"];
    if (!REFUSAL_CODES.has(code) && !STORY_CODES.has(code)) out.push(`${path}.code: ${code}`);
    const p = o["params"] as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (code === "invalid-data" && !RULES.has(String(p["rule"]))) out.push(`${path}.params.rule: ${String(p["rule"])}`);
    if ((code === "rule-error" || code === "mapping-error") && !ERRORS.has(String(p["error"]))) out.push(`${path}.params.error: ${String(p["error"])}`);
  }
  if (path.endsWith(".stuck") && typeof o["reason"] === "string" && !REASONS.has(o["reason"])) out.push(`${path}.reason: ${o["reason"]}`);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) {
    if (k === "debug") continue;
    if (k.includes("__")) out.push(`${path}.<key>: ${k}`);
    leaks(v, `${path}.${k}`, out);
  }
  return out;
}

/** One walk; returns the first difference, or null. */
function walk(wf: () => AuthoredWorkflow, fakes: Partial<Fakes>, seed: number, steps: number): string | null {
  const rnd = random(seed);
  const pick = pickWith(rnd);
  const host = hostOf(wf(), fakes);
  const c = new Compiled(wf(), fakes);
  const clock = { seconds: 0 };
  const run = new KernelRun(c, 1, clock);
  const start = c.r.startTask() ?? "";
  const offered = formStateOf(c, start, {}, {}, { requester: { type: "user", id: PRIYA }, startedOn: "2026-11-16" }).choices;
  const log: string[] = [];
  const differ = (what: string): string => `seed ${seed}: ${what}\n${log.join("\n")}`;

  // Starts: refused ones too, until one is accepted.
  let started = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !started; i++) {
    const answers = randomAnswers(c, start, rnd, offered as never, i < 5 ? 0.5 : 0);
    const button = pick(c.s.ix.taskById.get(start)?.buttons ?? [])?.id ?? "";
    const h = keep(host.start({ type: "user", id: PRIYA }, button, answers));
    const { input, context } = run.startInput(PRIYA, button, answers);
    const k = run.apply(input, context);
    log.push(`start ${button} ${JSON.stringify(answers).slice(0, 80)} host ${h.ok} kernel ${k}`);
    if (h.ok !== k) return differ("start accepted on one side only");
    started = h.ok;
  }
  if (!started) return null;

  for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
    const compare = (as?: Ref): string | null => {
      const a = JSON.stringify(shown(keep(viewOf(host, "R1", as))));
      const b = JSON.stringify(shown(run.view(as)));
      return a === b ? null : differ(`views differ for ${as?.id ?? "nobody"}:\nhost   ${a}\nkernel ${b}`);
    };
    const d = compare() ?? compare(ADMIN) ?? compare({ type: "user", id: PRIYA });
    if (d !== null) return d;
    if (run.state.closed !== null) break;

    const roll = rnd();
    const open = run.state.waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open" && w.kind === "person");
    if (roll < 0.1 || open.length === 0) {
      const action = rnd() < 0.7 ? "retry" : "close";
      const h = keep(host.admin(ADMIN, "R1", action, "test"));
      log.push(`admin ${action} host ${h.ok ? "ok" : JSON.stringify(h.refusals)}`);
      if (!h.ok) {
        if (open.length === 0 && action === "retry") break;
        continue;
      }
      const k = run.apply({ kind: "admin", by: { type: "user", id: ADMIN.id }, reason: "test", actions: [{ type: action }] }, { isAdmin: true });
      if (!k) return differ("an admin turn the host took was refused by the kernel");
      continue;
    }
    const w = pick(open);
    const task = c.r.taskOf(w.id.element) ?? "";
    const { values, request } = run.formRequest();
    const choices = formStateOf(c, task, {}, values, request).choices;
    const answers = randomAnswers(c, task, rnd, choices as never, 0.15);
    const button = pick((w.opened.kind === "person" ? w.opened.outcomes : []).map((o) => o.id));
    const as = pick([PRIYA, ...PEOPLE]);
    const h = keep(host.act({ type: "user", id: as }, "R1", `t${w.openedSeq}`, button as never, answers));
    keep(formStateOf(c, task, answers, values, request));
    const { input, context } = run.actInput(as, w.id, button, answers);
    const k = run.apply(input, context);
    log.push(`act ${task} ${button} by ${as} host ${h.ok ? "ok" : (h.refusals[0]?.code ?? "")} kernel ${k}`);
    if (h.ok !== k) return differ("an act accepted on one side only");
  }
  return null;
}

const DOCS: [string, () => AuthoredWorkflow, Partial<Fakes>][] = [
  ["change-request", () => fixture("change-request"), {}],
  ["integrated-sample", () => fixture("integrated-sample"), FAILING_DEPLOY],
  ["several-at-once", () => fixture("several-at-once"), {}],
  ["rich form", () => doc(), {}],
];

describe("the test host runs the kernel's turn function and nothing else", () => {
  for (const [name, wf, fakes] of DOCS) {
    it(`${name}: 25 random walks give the same request on both sides`, () => {
      const failures: string[] = [];
      for (let seed = 1; seed <= 25 && failures.length === 0; seed++) {
        const f = walk(wf, fakes, seed, 30);
        if (f !== null) failures.push(f);
      }
      expect(failures).toEqual([]);
    });
  }

  it("nothing the walks returned names a compiled ID or a code the contract does not list", () => {
    expect(returned.length).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    expect([...new Set(leaks(returned).map((l) => l.replace(/\[\d+\]/g, "[]")))]).toEqual([]);
  });
});

/** The look-up answers with the service's details, as the catalog holds them now. */
function lookUp(h: TestHost, svc: { id: string }): void {
  const details = DETAILS[svc.id];
  if (details === undefined) h.setCallFake("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1", { mode: "fail", error: { code: "service-not-found", message: `No service with ID ${svc.id}.` } });
  else h.setCallFake("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1", { mode: "result", data: details });
}

/** A person's start on a service, with the look-up and the deploy answered as the case says. */
function personStart(h: TestHost, as: typeof priya, svc: typeof PAYMENTS | typeof LEDGER, summary = "Raise payment API rate limit"): string {

  return ok(h.start(as, "btn_rf_submit", { q_summary: summary, q_service: service(svc) })).requestId;
}

    expect(told.slice(-4).map((t) => ("builtIn" in t.what ? t.what.builtIn : t.what.tell))).toEqual(["statusChanged", "told_change_deployed", "statusChanged", "ended"]);
    expect(told.at(-4)?.values).toEqual({ from: { id: "stat_needs_fixing", label: "Needs fixing" }, to: { id: "stat_deploying", label: "Deploying" } });

    expect(toldNames(h.outbox(id))).not.toContain("unstuck");

    const call = callsOf(h.outbox(id)).find((c) => c.operation === "deploy.runPipeline@1");

    expect(callsOf(h.outbox(id)).find((c) => c.call === call?.call)?.state).toBe("late");

  it("I26c: a sent-back start form: the Requester is asked and can neither supply nor change the Requester", () => {

  it("I29: a retry that ends stuck again tells no one; Close tells unstuck and ended", () => {
    const wf = fixture("integrated-sample");
    const fix = wf.stages.find((s) => s.id === "st_fix_deployment");
    if (fix === undefined || fix.kind === "ending") throw new Error("no Fix deployment");

    task.whoIsAsked = { value: "v_service_owner" };
    const h = sample({}, wf);
    h.setCallFake("deploy.runPipeline@1", { mode: "fail", error: { code: "tests-failed" } });
    const id = personStart(h, priya, LEDGER, "Rotate keys");
    expect(viewOf(h, id).stuck).toMatchObject({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", location: { item: "tk_fix_deployment", part: "whoIsAsked" } });
    expect(toldOf(h.outbox(id)).at(-1)?.values).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_fix_deployment" });
    const before = h.outbox(id).length;
    const stories = viewOf(h, id).story.filter((e) => e.code === "stuck").length;
    const since = viewOf(h, id).stuck?.at;
    ok(h.admin(sam, id, "retry", "Try again"));

    expect(viewOf(h, id).stuck?.at).toBe(since);
    expect(h.outbox(id).slice(before)).toEqual([]);
    expect(viewOf(h, id).story.filter((e) => e.code === "stuck").length).toBe(stories);
    expect(viewOf(h, id).stuck?.reason).toBe("nobody-to-ask");
    ok(h.admin(sam, id, "close", "No owner"));
    expect(toldOf(h.outbox(id).slice(before)).map((t) => [("builtIn" in t.what ? t.what.builtIn : t.what.tell), t.values])).toEqual([
      ["unstuck", { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_fix_deployment", by: { type: "user", id: sam.id } }],
      ["ended", { status: { id: "stat_needs_fixing", label: "Needs fixing" }, closedBy: "admin", by: { type: "user", id: sam.id } }],
    ]);

/**
 * Cases this API cannot express, and why. Each needs the server or something Try it leaves out by design
 * (core-api.md 10.2: one draft, fakes that always answer, nothing leaves the browser):
 * - I3 (dedupe of a repeated event), I6 (pausing a binding), I23 (racing deliveries), I24 (inbound
 *   signature, size, unknown connection), I27 and I28 (live bindings across versions, dedupe per
 *   workflow), I30 (the refused-starts list and its run again): the inbound handler and the store.
 * - I8's "source down" steps and I18's "directory down" steps: the fakes always answer, so
 *   `source-unavailable` and `membership-unavailable` never occur in Try it.
 * - I10b and I10c (timeouts, a lost answer), I11 to I14 (accepted, callbacks, polling, stale and forged
 *   callbacks, a callback while stuck), I16b and I16c (a call never sent, a call sent without a clear
 *   answer), I17 (overdue alerts), I25 (a changed catalogue shape): the dispatcher, the reconciler and
 *   the connectors. Try it answers every call at once or holds it.
 * - I19b, I27: a second published version. A test host holds one draft.
 * - I21, I22: delivery to subscribers and the pull feed; alerts in general (I5, I9, I10, I17, I21, I26b):
 *   Try it's outbox holds only the three built-in messages, never an alert (core-api.md 10.3).
 * - Every `events`, `calls` and `tables` line: illustrations, not asserted (E-24).
 */
===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/host/leak.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Acceptance 3: nothing engine-internal reaches a caller. Every string in the request views, the stories,
 * the outbox, the refusals and the choices of the sample runs is walked; a compiled ID has a double
 * underscore (compiler.md 1.1), and authored IDs never do, so any such string is a leak.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { TestHost } from "../../../src/authored/host/index.ts";
import { compile } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { Ref } from "../../../src/authored/view/index.ts";
import { catalogue, fixture } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { admin, diego, hostFor, marcus, mei, omar, platform, priya, sam, strings, taskOf, viewOf } from "./drive.ts";

const COMPILED = /__/;
const PEOPLE: Ref[] = [priya, marcus, diego, sam, mei, omar, admin];

/** Everything a caller of the host can see after a run, plus what the run's own calls returned. */
function seen(h: TestHost, returned: unknown[]): unknown[] {
  const out: unknown[] = [...returned, h.outbox(), h.openTasks()];
  for (const as of PEOPLE) out.push(h.openTasks({ as }));
  for (let n = 1; ; n++) {
    let ok = true;
    try {
      out.push(viewOf(h, `R${n}`));
      for (const as of PEOPLE) out.push(viewOf(h, `R${n}`, as));
    } catch {
      ok = false;
    }
    if (!ok) break;
  }
  return out;
}

function leaks(values: unknown[]): string[] {
  return values.flatMap((v) => strings(v)).filter((s) => COMPILED.test(s.value)).map((s) => `${s.path}: ${s.value}`);
}

const LEDGER = { stored: "svc-ledger", label: "Ledger" };
const DOCS_DETAILS = { id: "svc-docs-site", name: "Docs site", tier: "Tier 3", status: "active", owner: { type: "user", id: mei.id } };

function integrated(groups?: Record<string, string[]>): TestHost {
  return hostFor(fixture("integrated-sample"), { stuckRequestsGoTo: [platform], ...(groups === undefined ? {} : { groups }) });
}

describe("no compiled ID reaches a caller", () => {
  it("the scan finds a compiled ID where one is", () => {
    const r = compile(fixture("change-request"), catalogue());
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("compile refused");
    expect(leaks([r.published.root.initial]).length).toBe(1);
  });

  it("integrated sample: the walk, a failure and retry, a send-back, a late result, nobody to ask, a refused start", () => {
    const returned: unknown[] = [];
    const keep = <T>(x: T): T => {
      returned.push(x);
      return x;
    };

    // The walk on Ledger: the Platform team is asked; Jira fails once; a retry; Deploy again; deployed.
    const h = integrated();
    h.setCallFake("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1", { mode: "result", data: { id: "svc-ledger", name: "Ledger", tier: "Tier 2", status: "active" } });
    h.setCallFake("deploy.runPipeline@1", { mode: "fail", error: { code: "tests-failed" } });
    h.setCallFake("jira.createIssue@1", { mode: "fail", error: { code: "permission-denied", message: "No" } });
    keep(h.choices({ form: { workflow: "w", version: 1 }, question: "q_service", answers: {} }));
    const r1 = keep(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", { q_summary: "Rotate Ledger database credentials", q_service: LEDGER }));
    const id = r1.ok ? r1.requestId : "";
    keep(h.admin(omar, id, "retry", "x"));
    h.setCallFake("jira.createIssue@1", { mode: "sample" });
    keep(h.admin(sam, id, "retry", "Jira permission restored"));
    const task = taskOf(h, id, "tk_fix_deployment");
    keep(h.act(omar, id, task, "btn_fix_mark_fixed", {}));
    h.setCallFake("deploy.runPipeline@1", { mode: "hold" });
    keep(h.act(mei, id, task, "btn_fix_deploy_again", {}));
    keep(h.act(mei, id, task, "btn_fix_deploy_again", {}));
    keep(h.admin(sam, id, "retry", "x"));
    const pending = viewOf(h, id).actions[0]?.call ?? "";
    keep(h.admin(sam, id, "close", "Done by hand"));
    keep(h.answerCall(pending, { outcome: "ok", data: { runLink: "http://deploy.mock.test/runs/run-5002" } }));

    // A ticket by Mei for Docs site: she may not approve; Sam sends it back; she cannot name another Requester.
    h.setCallFake("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1", { mode: "result", data: DOCS_DETAILS });
    const sent = { key: "HD-2291", title: "Publish the new docs theme", category: "Service change", service: { stored: "svc-docs-site", label: "Docs" }, reporter: { type: "user", id: mei.id } };
    const r2 = keep(h.startFrom("sw_helpdesk_ticket", sent));
    const id2 = r2.ok && r2.started ? r2.requestId : "";
    const approve = taskOf(h, id2, "tk_approve");
    keep(h.act(mei, id2, approve, "btn_approve", {}));
    keep(h.act(sam, id2, approve, "btn_approve_send_back", {}));
    const form = taskOf(h, id2, "tk_request_form");
    keep(h.choices({ form: { requestId: id2, task: form }, question: "q_service", answers: {} }));
    keep(h.act(mei, id2, form, "btn_rf_submit", { q_summary: "x", q_service: { stored: "svc-docs-site", label: "Docs site" }, requester: { type: "user", id: sam.id } } as never));
    keep(h.startFrom("sw_helpdesk_ticket", { ...sent, title: "" }));
    keep(h.startFrom("sw_helpdesk_ticket", { ...sent, category: "Other" }));
    keep(h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", { q_summary: "x", q_service: { stored: "svc-old-billing", label: "Old billing" } }));

    // Nobody to ask: the group holds only the Requester.
    const lonely = integrated({ "dir-group-platform-team": [mei.id] });
    lonely.setCallFake("servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1", { mode: "result", data: DOCS_DETAILS });
    const r3 = keep(lonely.startFrom("sw_helpdesk_ticket", sent));
    keep(lonely.admin(mei, r3.ok && r3.started ? r3.requestId : "", "retry", "again"));

    expect(leaks(seen(h, returned))).toEqual([]);
    expect(leaks(seen(lonely, []))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("change-request: the main path, a send-back, a call failure, an unfinished part and an error", () => {
    const returned: unknown[] = [];
    const form = { q_title: "Rotate keys", q_primary_domain: "row_payments", q_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", q_risk: "ch_risk_medium" };
    const lead = { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: diego.id } };
    const wf = fixture("change-request");
    const dev = wf.stages.find((s) => s.id === "st_development");
    if (dev === undefined || dev.kind === "ending") throw new Error("no stage");
    dev.whenThisStageStarts.push({ id: "act_bad", type: "saveValue", save: { formula: "string(size({{v_title}}) / 0)", readsAs: "x" }, as: "v_shout" });
    wf.values.push({ id: "v_shout", name: "Shout" });
    const rejected = wf.stages.find((s) => s.id === "st_domain_approval");
    if (rejected === undefined || rejected.kind === "ending") throw new Error("no stage");
    rejected.arrows = rejected.arrows.filter((a) => a.id !== "ar_da_reject");

    const h = hostFor(wf);
    h.setCallFake("jira.createIssue@1", { mode: "fail", error: { code: "project-not-found" } });
    const r = h.start(priya, "btn_rf_submit", form);
    returned.push(r);

/**
 * A request run twice: through the test host, and by hand through the kernel's turn function on the
 * definition `compile` builds for Try it, with the same fakes, the same clock and the same call answering.
 * Also random answer sets for any task's form, so a test can compare `formState` with what the act does.
 */
import { compile, type Unfinished } from "../../../src/authored/compile/index.ts";
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Question } from "../../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { docSetup, type DocSetup } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/setup.ts";
import type { Answers, Json, KnownLookups, Ref } from "../../../src/authored/evaluate/types.ts";
import { questionKind } from "../../../src/authored/facts/kinds.ts";
import { formState } from "../../../src/authored/form/index.ts";
import { choiceIds } from "../../../src/authored/compile/forms.ts";
import { FakeWorld } from "../../../src/authored/host/fakes.ts";
import type { CallFake, Fakes } from "../../../src/authored/host/index.ts";
import { readingOf, requestView, requesterOf, valuesOf, type PublishedVersion, type Reading } from "../../../src/authored/view/index.ts";
import type { AnyEventRecord, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition, WaitId } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import {
  emptyState, lookupsToMake, turn, validateCallResult, type DecideContext, type DecideInput, type DecideResult, type RequestState, type TraceEntry,
} from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { decide } from "../../../src/kernel/decide/decide.ts";
import { catalogue } from "../fixtures.ts";
import { GROUPS, START_AT } from "./drive.ts";

/** A deterministic random source (mulberry32), so a failing seed can be replayed. */
export function random(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

export const pickWith = (rnd: () => number) => <T>(xs: readonly T[]): T => xs[Math.floor(rnd() * xs.length)] as T;

/** The test host's clock: the contract's time with six fractional digits, one second per recorded turn. */
function kernelTime(seconds: number): string {
  return new Date(Date.parse(START_AT) + seconds * 1000).toISOString().replace(/Z$/, "000Z");
}

export const PEOPLE: string[] = [...new Set([...Object.values(GROUPS).flatMap((g) => g ?? []), "dir-user-ruth-okafor", "dir-user-omar-haddad", "dir-user-admin"])];

/** The definition compiled for Try it, with what a reader needs of it. */
export class Compiled {
  readonly wf: AuthoredWorkflow;
  readonly def: PublishedDefinition;
  readonly published: PublishedVersion;
  readonly r: Reading;
  readonly unfinished: readonly Unfinished[];
  readonly world: FakeWorld;
  readonly s: DocSetup;
  readonly calls: Partial<Record<string, CallFake>>;

  constructor(wf: AuthoredWorkflow, fakes: Partial<Fakes> = {}) {
    this.calls = fakes.calls ?? {};
    const c = compile(wf, catalogue(), { mode: "tryIt" });
    if (!c.ok) throw new Error(`compile refused: ${JSON.stringify(c.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "todo"))}`);
    this.wf = wf;
    this.def = c.published;
    this.unfinished = c.unfinished;
    this.published = { definition: c.published, source: wf, catalogue: catalogue() };
    this.r = readingOf(this.published);
    this.world = new FakeWorld({ groups: GROUPS, stuckRequestsGoTo: [{ type: "user", id: "dir-user-admin" }], startAt: START_AT, ...fakes }, this.r.catalogue, this.r.directory);
    this.s = docSetup(wf, catalogue());
  }
}

/** One request driven through the kernel's turn function as the test host drives it. */
export class KernelRun {
  readonly c: Compiled;
  readonly requestId: string;
  readonly readableId: number;
  state: RequestState = emptyState();
  events: AnyEventRecord[] = [];
  traces = new Map<number, TraceEntry[]>();
  /** Shared with the other requests of the same host: the clock is the host's. */
  readonly clock: { seconds: number };

  constructor(c: Compiled, n: number, clock: { seconds: number }) {
    this.c = c;
    this.requestId = `R${n}`;
    this.readableId = n;
    this.clock = clock;
  }

  now(): string {
    return kernelTime(this.clock.seconds);
  }

  /** Decide only: the turn's result for this input, nothing kept. */
  peek(input: DecideInput, context: Omit<DecideContext, "at">): DecideResult {
    return decide(this.c.def, this.state, input, { ...context, at: this.now() });
  }

  apply(input: DecideInput, context: Omit<DecideContext, "at">): boolean {
    const r = turn(this.c.def, this.state, input, { ...context, at: this.now() });
    if (!r.ok) return false;
    if (r.events.length === 0) return true;
    this.clock.seconds += 1;
    this.keep(r.events, r.trace, r.state);
    return true;
  }

  private keep(events: AnyEventRecord[], trace: TraceEntry[], after: RequestState): void {
    const first = events[0];
    if (first !== undefined) this.traces.set(first.turn, trace);
    this.events.push(...events);
    this.state = after;
    const queue: { wait: WaitId; operation: string; args: JsonObject }[] = [];
    for (const e of events) if (e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "call") queue.push({ wait: e.payload.wait, operation: `${e.payload.connection}.${e.payload.op}`, args: e.payload.args });
    this.settle(queue);
  }

  private settle(queue: { wait: WaitId; operation: string; args: JsonObject }[]): void {
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const call = queue.shift() as (typeof queue)[number];
      const answer = this.c.world.answer(call.operation, call.args, this.c.calls[call.operation]);
      if (answer === undefined) continue;
      if (!validateCallResult(this.c.def, call.wait, answer).ok) continue;
      const r = turn(this.c.def, this.state, { kind: "callResult", wait: call.wait, outcome: answer.outcome, data: answer.data }, { at: this.now() });
      if (!r.ok || r.events.length === 0) continue;
      this.clock.seconds += 1;
      const first = r.events[0];
      if (first !== undefined) this.traces.set(first.turn, r.trace);
      this.events.push(...r.events);
      this.state = r.state;
      for (const e of r.events) if (e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "call") queue.push({ wait: e.payload.wait, operation: `${e.payload.connection}.${e.payload.op}`, args: e.payload.args });
    }
  }

  startInput(as: string, button: string, answers: Answers): { input: DecideInput; context: Omit<DecideContext, "at"> } {
    const input: DecideInput = { kind: "start", requestId: this.requestId, readableId: this.readableId, by: { type: "user", id: as }, outcome: button, data: toObject(answers), trigger: null };
    // The start turn runs at this time, so a lookup input reading `request.at` sees it.
    return { input, context: { lookups: this.c.world.lookups(lookupsToMake(this.c.def, this.state, input, this.now())) } };
  }

  actInput(as: string, wait: WaitId, button: string, answers: Answers): { input: DecideInput; context: Omit<DecideContext, "at"> } {
    const input: DecideInput = { kind: "act", by: { type: "user", id: as }, wait, outcome: button, data: toObject(answers) };
    return { input, context: { lookups: this.c.world.lookups(lookupsToMake(this.c.def, this.state, input)), memberships: { groups: this.c.world.groupsOf(as) } } };
  }

  /** What the page would pass to formState for an open task of this request. */
  formRequest(): { values: Record<string, Json>; request: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string } } {
    const request: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string } = {};
    const requester = requesterOf(this.state.data, this.state.request?.by);
    if (requester !== undefined) request.requester = requester;
    if (this.state.request !== null) request.startedOn = this.state.request.at.slice(0, 10);
    return { values: valuesOf(this.c.r, this.state.data) as Record<string, Json>, request };
  }

  view(as?: Ref) {
    const viewer = { isAdmin: as !== undefined && this.c.world.isAdmin(as), groupsOf: (u: string) => this.c.world.groupsOf(u), ...(as === undefined ? {} : { as }) };
    return requestView(this.c.published, this.events, { viewer, why: this.traces, calls: true, unfinished: this.c.unfinished, attempts: () => 1 });
  }
}

export function toObject(answers: Answers | Record<string, Json>): JsonObject {
  const out: JsonObject = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(answers)) if (v !== undefined) out[k] = v as JsonObject[string];
  return out;
}

/** The group members formState needs, from the same fakes. */
export function lookupsFor(needs: readonly { membersOf: Ref }[]): KnownLookups {
  const membersOf: Record<string, Ref[]> = {};
  for (const n of needs) membersOf[n.membersOf.id] = (GROUPS[n.membersOf.id] ?? []).map((id) => ({ type: "user", id }));
  return { membersOf };
}

/** formState with the lookups it asks for. */
export function formStateOf(c: Compiled, task: string, answers: Answers, values: Record<string, Json>, request: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string }) {
  const cat = catalogue();
  const first = formState(c.wf, cat, { item: task }, answers, values, request);
  if (first.result === "state") return first.state;
  const again = formState(c.wf, cat, { item: task }, answers, values, request, lookupsFor(first.lookups));
  if (again.result !== "state") throw new Error("formState asked for lookups twice");
  return again.state;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ answers

type Gen = () => Json;

/** Answers that fit a question, and answers that do not, by its kind and its choices. */
export function answerKinds(c: Compiled, q: Question, formulaChoices: readonly Json[] = []): { valid: Gen[]; invalid: Gen[] } {
  const kind = questionKind(q);
  const ids = choiceIds(c.s, q);
  const choices: unknown = q.choices;
  const from = typeof choices === "object" && choices !== null ? (choices as Record<string, unknown>)["from"] : undefined;
  const user = (id: string): Json => ({ type: "user", id });
  const valid: Gen[] = [];
  const invalid: Gen[] = [
    () => null as unknown as Json, // not JSON a page sends; must still never throw
    () => ({ $redacted: true }),
  ];
  if (from === "formula") {
    for (const x of formulaChoices) valid.push(() => x);
    invalid.push(() => "not-offered", () => 3);
    if (q.kind === "multipleChoice") {
      valid.length = 0;
      if (formulaChoices.length > 0) valid.push(() => [formulaChoices[0] as Json]);
      invalid.push(() => [], () => ["not-offered"]);
    }
    return { valid, invalid };
  }
  if (from === "source") {
    const source = (choices as Record<string, unknown>)["source"];
    const entry = c.r.catalogue.entry(source);
    const items = entry?.kind === "dataSource" && Array.isArray(entry.sample?.items) ? (entry.sample.items as Record<string, Json>[]) : [];
    const stored = String((choices as Record<string, unknown>)["storedField"]);
    const label = String((choices as Record<string, unknown>)["labelField"]);
    for (const item of items) if (item[stored] !== undefined) valid.push(() => ({ stored: item[stored] as Json, label: String(item[label] ?? "") }));
    invalid.push(() => ({ stored: "svc-nowhere", label: "Nowhere" }), () => "svc-ledger", () => ({ stored: "svc-ledger" }), () => ({ stored: "svc-ledger", label: "L", extra: 1 }));
    return { valid, invalid };
  }
  if (from === "directory") {
    for (const p of PEOPLE) valid.push(() => user(p));
    invalid.push(() => "dir-user-mei-lin", () => ({ type: "group", id: "dir-group-platform-team" }));
    return { valid, invalid };
  }
  switch (kind) {
    case "text":
      valid.push(() => "Rotate keys", () => "x".repeat(1000), () => " ");
      invalid.push(() => "", () => "x".repeat(1001), () => 3, () => ["a"]);
      break;
    case "longText":
      valid.push(() => "Long", () => "y".repeat(20000));
      invalid.push(() => "", () => "y".repeat(20001), () => true);
      break;
    case "number":
      valid.push(() => 5, () => 0, () => -3.5, () => 101, () => 9007199254740991, () => 11);
      invalid.push(() => "5", () => 9007199254740992, () => -9007199254740992, () => 1e300, () => true);
      break;
    case "yesNo":
      valid.push(() => true, () => false);
      invalid.push(() => "yes", () => 1);
      break;
    case "date":
      valid.push(() => "2026-12-02", () => "2024-02-29", () => "2026-11-16");
      invalid.push(() => "2026-02-30", () => "soon", () => "2026-12-02T00:00:00Z", () => "0000-01-01", () => 20261202);
      break;
    case "choice":
    case "choiceFromList":
      for (const id of ids ?? []) valid.push(() => id);
      invalid.push(() => "ch_nowhere", () => "row_nowhere", () => "", () => [ids?.[0] ?? "x"]);
      break;
    case "multipleChoice":
      if (ids !== undefined && ids.length > 0) {
        valid.push(() => [ids[0] as string], () => [...ids]);
        if (ids.length > 1) invalid.push(() => [...ids].reverse(), () => [ids[0] as string, ids[0] as string]);
      }
      invalid.push(() => [], () => ["ch_nowhere"], () => ids?.[0] ?? "x");
      break;
    case "person":
      for (const p of PEOPLE) valid.push(() => user(p));
      invalid.push(() => "dir-user-mei-lin", () => ({ type: "group", id: "g" }), () => ({ type: "user", id: "" }), () => ({ type: "user", id: "a b" }), () => ({ type: "user", id: "x", name: "X" }));
      break;
    case "group":
      valid.push(() => ({ type: "group", id: "dir-group-platform-team" }));
      invalid.push(() => ({ type: "user", id: "dir-user-mei-lin" }));
      break;
    case "people":
      valid.push(() => [user("dir-user-mei-lin")], () => [user("dir-user-mei-lin"), user("dir-user-sam-carter")]);
      invalid.push(() => [], () => [user("dir-user-mei-lin"), user("dir-user-mei-lin")]);
      break;
    default:
      valid.push(() => "x");
  }
  return { valid, invalid };
}

/** A random answer set for a task's form: each question omitted, answered well or answered badly. */
export function randomAnswers(c: Compiled, task: string, rnd: () => number, formulaChoices: Partial<Record<string, Json[]>> = {}, badness = 0.2): Answers {
  const view = c.s.ix.taskById.get(task);
  const out: Record<string, Json> = {};
  for (const { question } of view?.questions ?? []) {
    const roll = rnd();
    if (roll < 0.3) continue;
    const g = answerKinds(c, question, formulaChoices[question.id] ?? []);
    const list = roll < 1 - badness || g.invalid.length === 0 ? (g.valid.length > 0 ? g.valid : g.invalid) : g.invalid;
    if (list.length === 0) continue;
    out[question.id] = pickWith(rnd)(list)();
  }
  if (rnd() < 0.05) out["q_nowhere"] = "x";
  return out as Answers;
}

===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/mutations.ts\n===
/** Unfinished and broken drafts made from a document: each member removed in turn, and each set to null. */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";

export function* mutations(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Generator<AuthoredWorkflow> {
  const paths: (string | number)[][] = [];
  const walk = (node: unknown, path: (string | number)[]): void => {
    const members: [string | number, unknown][] = Array.isArray(node)
      ? node.map((x, i): [number, unknown] => [i, x])
      : typeof node === "object" && node !== null
        ? Object.entries(node)
        : [];
    for (const [key, value] of members) {
      paths.push([...path, key]);
      walk(value, [...path, key]);
    }
  };
  walk(doc, []);
  for (const path of paths) {
    for (const replace of [undefined, null]) {
      const copy = structuredClone(doc) as unknown as Record<string | number, unknown>;
      let node: Record<string | number, unknown> = copy;
      for (const seg of path.slice(0, -1)) node = node[seg] as Record<string | number, unknown>;
      const last = path[path.length - 1] ?? "";
      if (replace === undefined && !Array.isArray(node)) delete node[last];
      else node[last] = replace;
      yield copy as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow;
    }
  }
}
===\nengine/packages/core/test/authored/parse.test.ts\n===
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { parse } from "../../src/authored/parse/parse.ts";
import type { ParseProblem } from "../../src/authored/parse/problems.ts";
import { FIXTURES, rawFixture } from "./fixtures.ts";

type Box = Record<string, unknown> | unknown[];

/** Walks to the parent of a JSON Pointer and returns it with the last segment. */
function parent(doc: unknown, pointer: string): [Box, string] {
  const segments = pointer.split("/").slice(1);
  const last = segments.pop() ?? "";
  let node = doc;
  for (const s of segments) node = (node as Record<string, unknown>)[s];
  return [node as Box, last];
}
function set(doc: unknown, pointer: string, value: unknown): void {
  const [box, key] = parent(doc, pointer);
  (box as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = value;
}
function remove(doc: unknown, pointer: string): void {
  const [box, key] = parent(doc, pointer);
  delete (box as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
}
function push(doc: unknown, pointer: string, value: unknown): void {
  const [box, key] = parent(doc, pointer);
  ((box as Record<string, unknown[]>)[key] as unknown[]).push(value);
}

const blank = (): unknown => rawFixture("blank");
const LONG_ID = "st_" + "x".repeat(38); // 41 characters

describe("parse: the fixtures", () => {
  for (const name of FIXTURES) {
    it(`${name} parses clean and is returned whole`, () => {
      const doc = rawFixture(name);
      const result = parse(doc);
      expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, workflow: doc });
    });
  }
});

/**
 * Found in review: each case failed before its fix. Early arrows read the tasks step's state (compiler.md
 * 6.4), a text template is empty only when all of it is (compiler.md 8.4, TXT), a multiple choice from a
 * list compares rows (compiler.md 5.1), and the value flow stays linear in the stages on long workflows.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Stage, UseConnection } from "../../src/authored/contract/authored-format.ts";
import { check } from "../../src/authored/check/check.ts";
import { facts } from "../../src/authored/facts/facts.ts";
import { valuesInScope } from "../../src/authored/facts/scope.ts";
import { StageRunner } from "../../src/authored/facts/stage-run.ts";
import { arrow, ending, save, stage, task, workflow } from "./build.ts";
import { broken } from "./check-helpers.ts";
import { catalogue } from "./fixtures.ts";

const CATALOGUE = catalogue();
const stateOf = (wf: AuthoredWorkflow, at: { item: string; part?: string }, value: string): string | undefined =>
  valuesInScope(wf, CATALOGUE, at).find((v) => v.id === value)?.state;

describe("an early arrow reads the state of the tasks step when it is taken early (compiler.md 6.4)", () => {
  // st_b has two tasks; "No" on either is an early arrow whose "+ only when" reads a value that the
  // stage's own after-response action saves. Taken early, it is checked in the tasks step, before that
  // action has run, so on the first visit the value is still empty there.
  const build = (): AuthoredWorkflow => {
    const early: Arrow = arrow("ar_no", { type: "condition", condition: { anyOf: [{ pressed: "btn_x_no" }, { pressed: "btn_y_no" }] } }, "st_end", {
      goAsSoonAsTrue: true,
      onlyWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: "v_mark" }, words: "text.isEmpty" }] },
    });
    return workflow(
      [
        stage("st_a", { tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_go"])], arrows: [arrow("ar_go", "btn_go", "st_b")] }),
        stage("st_b", {
          tasks: [task("tk_x", ["btn_x_yes", "btn_x_no"]), task("tk_y", ["btn_y_yes", "btn_y_no"])],
          after: [save("act_mark", "v_mark", { text: "marked" })],
          arrows: [early, arrow("ar_other", "other", "st_end")],
        }),
        ending("st_end"),
      ],
      ["v_mark"],
    );
  };

  it("its \"+ only when\" may find the value empty", () => {
    expect(stateOf(build(), { item: "ar_no", part: "onlyWhen" }, "v_mark")).toBe("mayBeEmpty");
  });

  it("near miss: an arrow checked only in the routing step reads the state after the after-response actions", () => {
    expect(stateOf(build(), { item: "ar_other" }, "v_mark")).toBe("always");
  });
});

describe("a text template sent to another system is empty only when every piece is (compiler.md 8.4, TXT)", () => {
  const build = (summary: unknown[]): AuthoredWorkflow => {
    const call: UseConnection = {
      id: "act_jira", type: "useConnection", operation: "jira.createIssue@1",
      inputs: { project: { text: "CHG" }, summary: summary as UseConnection["inputs"][string] }, saveResults: {}, ifItFails: "stuck",
    };
    const stages: Stage[] = [
      stage("st_a", {
        tasks: [task("tk_a", ["btn_go"], [{ id: "q_title", savedAs: "v_title", neededBy: "all" }, { id: "q_more", savedAs: "v_more" }])],
        arrows: [arrow("ar_go", "btn_go", "st_b")],
      }),
      stage("st_b", { arrival: [call], arrows: [arrow("ar_done", "done", "st_end")] }),
      ending("st_end"),
    ];
    return workflow(stages, ["v_title", "v_more"]);
  };
  const mayBeEmpty = (wf: AuthoredWorkflow) => check(wf, CATALOGUE).filter((f) => f.code === "value.mayBeEmpty").map((f) => f.location);

  it("a piece that is always filled keeps the whole template filled", () => {
    expect(mayBeEmpty(build([{ value: "v_title" }, { value: "v_more" }]))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("near miss: when every piece may be empty, each is reported", () => {
    expect(mayBeEmpty(build([{ value: "v_more" }]))).toEqual([{ item: "act_jira", part: "inputs.summary.0" }]);
  });
});

describe("task.askedMayBeEmpty follows who is asked through \"If empty, use\"", () => {
  // Development asks "Eng lead (if empty, use Primary domain's default lead)". Eng lead is empty only
  // on the route that skips approval, which only Internal tools takes.

    });

  it("the fallback's cell is missing for a row that reaches the task with Eng lead empty", () => {

    ]);
  });

  it("near miss: a first link that always gives someone ends the chain", () => {
    const wf = without("row_internal_tools");
    const dev = wf.stages.find((s) => s.id === "st_development") as { tasks: { whoIsAsked?: unknown }[] };
    dev.tasks[0]!.whoIsAsked = { request: "requester", ifEmptyUse: { value: "v_primary_domain", steps: [{ column: "col_default_lead" }] } };
    expect(asked(wf)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("sendsBack is dominance (E-14, compiler.md 7.1), on 300 random stage graphs", () => {
  it("an arrow sends back exactly when its source is reached and every route to it passes its target", () => {
    let seed = 7;
    const rnd = (): number => (seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648) / 2147483648;
    for (let trial = 0; trial < 300; trial++) {
      const n = 2 + Math.floor(rnd() * 9);
      const edges: [number, number][] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (let k = Math.floor(rnd() * 3); k > 0; k--) edges.push([i, Math.floor(rnd() * (n + 1))]);
      const id = (i: number): `st_${string}` => (i === n ? "st_end" : `st_${i}`);
      const stages: Stage[] = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) =>
        stage(id(i), { tasks: [task(`tk_${i}`, [`btn_${i}`])], arrows: edges.filter(([a]) => a === i).map(([, b], j) => arrow(`ar_${i}_${j}`, `btn_${i}`, id(b))) }),
      );
      const f = facts(workflow([...stages, ending("st_end")], []), CATALOGUE);
      const reach = (removed: number): Set<number> => {
        const seen = new Set<number>(removed === 0 ? [] : [0]);
        for (const x of seen) for (const [a, b] of edges) if (a === x && b !== removed && !seen.has(b)) seen.add(b);
        return seen;
      };
      const all = reach(-1);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
        edges.filter(([a]) => a === i).forEach(([a, b], j) => {
          const expected = all.has(a) && b !== n && (b === a || !reach(b).has(a));
          expect(f.arrows[`ar_${i}_${j}`]?.sendsBack, JSON.stringify(edges)).toBe(expected);
        });
    }
  });
});

describe("the value flow is linear in the stages (core-api.md 1: check and facts run on every edit)", () => {
  /** n stages in a row, each one task: Next goes on, Back sends the request back to the start. */
  function long(n: number): AuthoredWorkflow {
    const stages: Stage[] = [];
    const values: `v_${string}`[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const next = i + 1 < n ? `st_${i + 1}` as const : "st_end";
      values.push(`v_${i}`);
      stages.push(
        stage(`st_${i}`, {
          tasks: [task(`tk_${i}`, [`btn_next_${i}`, `btn_back_${i}`], [{ id: `q_${i}`, savedAs: `v_${i}`, neededBy: "all" }])],
          arrows: [arrow(`ar_next_${i}`, `btn_next_${i}`, next), arrow(`ar_back_${i}`, `btn_back_${i}`, "st_0")],
        }),
      );
    }
    return workflow([...stages, ending("st_end")], values);
  }

  it("each stage of a 60-stage workflow with send-backs to the start is run a few times, not once per send-back", () => {
    let runs = 0;
    const original = StageRunner.prototype.run;
    StageRunner.prototype.run = function (this: StageRunner, ...args: Parameters<StageRunner["run"]>) {
      runs++;
      return original.apply(this, args);
    };
    try {
      valuesInScope(long(60), CATALOGUE, { item: "tk_59", part: "whoIsAsked" });
    } finally {
      StageRunner.prototype.run = original;
    }
    expect(runs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3 * 60);
  });

  it("near miss: the answers are the same as on a short one", () => {
    expect(stateOf(long(60), { item: "tk_59", part: "whoIsAsked" }, "v_58")).toBe("always");
    expect(stateOf(long(60), { item: "tk_0", part: "whoIsAsked" }, "v_59")).toBe("mayBeEmpty");
    expect(stateOf(long(60), { item: "tk_30", part: "whoIsAsked" }, "v_31")).toBe("mayBeEmpty");
  });
});
