/**
 * The demo cases' `notify` lines, checked in full against `matchNotifications` on what the host records:
 * - `n_task` (`on: WaitOpened`, a person obligation) goes to the opened wait's recorded assignees, a group
 *   as a group reference, with the words `task.assigned`; never for a wait completed in the same turn.
 * - `n_stopped` (`on: Stuck`) goes to the workflow admins with `request.stuck`; its event is the host's
 *   stuck state `{reason, stage}`, at the turn's last event, and it matches exactly the turns in which the
 *   host's stuck state changed to a stuck one.
 * - No rule of the demo errors on any turn.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { WaitOpened } from "../../src/format/index.ts";
import { createMemoryHost, type HostStuck } from "../../src/host/index.ts";
import { emptyState } from "../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { matchNotifications, type Notification } from "../../src/kernel/notify/index.ts";
import { expandTurns, loadExampleDefinition, loadWorkflowCases, runInput } from "../kernel/cases/workflow-cases.ts";

const file = loadWorkflowCases("change-request-demo");
const definition = loadExampleDefinition("change-request-demo");
const START = Date.parse("2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z");
const turnAt = (n: number): string => new Date(START + n * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");

/** The stuck state each `n_stopped` line expects, by case and turn: the reason the case's comment gives. */
const STOPPED: Record<string, { reason: string; stage: string }> = {
  "D5 2": { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Pending" },
  "D5b 2": { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Pending" },
  "D7 4": { reason: "action-failed", stage: "CreateTicket" },
  "D8 2": { reason: "error", stage: "AssignLead" },
  "D8b 2": { reason: "action-failed", stage: "AssignLead" },
  "D9 1": { reason: "error", stage: "Pending" },
  "D12 2": { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Pending" },
};

function sameStuck(a: HostStuck | null, b: HostStuck | null): boolean {
  return a === null || b === null ? a === b : a.reason === b.reason && a.stage === b.stage;
}

describe("the notify lines, as matchNotifications matches them", () => {
  for (const c of file.cases) {
    it(`${c.id}`, () => {
      const host = createMemoryHost(definition, { directory: file.fixtures.directory, admins: [file.fixtures.people["admin"] ?? ""] });
      let stuckBefore: HostStuck | null = null;
      const problems: string[] = [];
      expandTurns(c, file.cases).forEach((t, i) => {
        const where = `turn ${i + 1}`;
        const before = i === 0 ? emptyState() : host.state("req-1");
        const r = runInput(host, "req-1", t.input ?? {}, turnAt(i));
        if (!r.ok) {
          if (t.notify !== undefined) problems.push(`${where}: refused, but a notify line is given`);
          return;
        }
        const after = host.state("req-1");
        const { messages, errors } = matchNotifications(definition, before, r.events, after);
        if (errors.length > 0) problems.push(`${where}: rule errors ${JSON.stringify(errors)}`);

        // n_stopped agrees with the host's stuck state, on every turn.
        const stopped = messages.filter((m) => m.rule === "n_stopped");
        const hostChanged = r.stuck !== null && !sameStuck(stuckBefore, r.stuck);
        if ((stopped.length === 1) !== hostChanged || stopped.length > 1) problems.push(`${where}: n_stopped ${stopped.length}, host stuck changed ${hostChanged}`);
        stuckBefore = r.stuck;

        if (t.notify === undefined) return;
        const rules = messages.map((m) => m.rule);
        if (JSON.stringify(rules) !== JSON.stringify(t.notify)) problems.push(`${where}: notify ${JSON.stringify(t.notify)}, matched ${JSON.stringify(rules)}`);
        for (const m of messages) problems.push(...check(m, r.events.at(-1)?.seq ?? 0, STOPPED[`${c.id} ${i + 1}`]).map((p) => `${where}: ${p}`));
      });
      expect(problems).toEqual([]);
    });
  }
});

function check(m: Notification, lastSeq: number, stopped: { reason: string; stage: string } | undefined): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  if (m.rule === "n_task") {
    const opened = m.event.payload as WaitOpened;
    if (m.event.type !== "WaitOpened" || opened.kind !== "person" || opened.role !== "obligation") problems.push(`n_task on ${m.event.type}`);
    else if (JSON.stringify(m.to) !== JSON.stringify(opened.assignees)) problems.push(`n_task to ${JSON.stringify(m.to)}, assignees ${JSON.stringify(opened.assignees)}`);
    if (JSON.stringify(m.message) !== JSON.stringify({ words: "task.assigned" })) problems.push(`n_task message ${JSON.stringify(m.message)}`);
  }
  if (m.rule === "n_stopped") {
    if (JSON.stringify(m.to) !== JSON.stringify([{ type: "workflowAdmins" }])) problems.push(`n_stopped to ${JSON.stringify(m.to)}`);
    if (JSON.stringify(m.message) !== JSON.stringify({ words: "request.stuck" })) problems.push(`n_stopped message ${JSON.stringify(m.message)}`);
    if (m.event.type !== "Stuck" || m.event.seq !== lastSeq) problems.push(`n_stopped on ${m.event.type} at ${m.event.seq}, last event ${lastSeq}`);
    if (JSON.stringify(m.event.payload) !== JSON.stringify(stopped)) problems.push(`n_stopped event ${JSON.stringify(m.event.payload)}, expected ${JSON.stringify(stopped)}`);
  }
  if (m.skipped.length > 0) problems.push(`${m.rule} skipped ${JSON.stringify(m.skipped)}`);
  return problems;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/test/host/purity.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Determinism, purity and replay over every acceptance case (engine/spec/workflows/change-request-demo):
 * - the same inputs give byte-identical events, refusals and traces, also on a fresh copy of the definition
 *   (so nothing cached on the first copy decides anything);
 * - `decide` and `evolve` change none of their arguments: every definition, state, input, context and event
 *   is deeply frozen, and a write to any of them would throw (ES modules are strict);
 * - replay: folding a case's events from nothing gives exactly the state the host held (kernel spec section 3,
 *   "evolve is the only code replay uses"), for every case, not only D10.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AnyEventRecord, PublishedDefinition } from "../../src/format/index.ts";
import { createMemoryHost, lookupAnswers, membershipsOf, type Fixtures, type HostTurn, type MemoryHost } from "../../src/host/index.ts";
import { decide, emptyState, evolve, fold, type DecideContext, type DecideInput, type RequestState } from "../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { expandTurns, loadExampleDefinition, loadWorkflowCases, runInput, type WorkflowCase } from "../kernel/cases/workflow-cases.ts";

const file = loadWorkflowCases("change-request-demo");
const REQUEST_ID = "req-1";
const START = Date.parse("2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z");
const fixtures: Fixtures = { directory: file.fixtures.directory, admins: [file.fixtures.people["admin"] ?? ""] };

function turnAt(n: number): string {
  return new Date(START + n * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");
}

function deepFreeze<T>(value: T): T {
  if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
    for (const child of Object.values(value)) deepFreeze(child);
    Object.freeze(value);
  }
  return value;
}

/** A host that calls `decide` and `evolve` itself, with every argument and every result frozen. */
function freezingHost(definition: PublishedDefinition): MemoryHost {
  const def = deepFreeze(definition);
  let state: RequestState = deepFreeze(emptyState());
  const events: AnyEventRecord[] = [];
  const turn = (input: DecideInput, context: DecideContext): HostTurn => {
    const result = decide(def, state, deepFreeze(input), deepFreeze(context));
    if (!result.ok) return deepFreeze(result);
    deepFreeze(result);
    for (const e of result.events) state = deepFreeze(evolve(state, e));
    events.push(...result.events);
    return { ok: true, requestId: REQUEST_ID, events: result.events, trace: result.trace, dropped: result.dropped, stuck: null };
  };
  return {
    start(i, at) {
      const input: DecideInput = { kind: "start", requestId: REQUEST_ID, readableId: 1, by: i.by, outcome: i.outcome, data: i.data, trigger: i.trigger ?? null };
      return turn(input, { at, lookups: lookupAnswers(fixtures, def, state, input, at) });
    },
    act(_requestId, i, at) {
      const input = { kind: "act", ...i } as const;
      const memberships = i.by.type === "user" ? membershipsOf(fixtures, i.by.id) : undefined;
      const context: DecideContext = { at, lookups: lookupAnswers(fixtures, def, state, input, at) };
      return turn(input, memberships === undefined ? context : { ...context, memberships });
    },
    answerCall: (_requestId, wait, result, at) => turn({ kind: "callResult", wait, outcome: result.outcome, data: result.data }, { at }),
    admin: (_requestId, i, at) =>
      turn({ kind: "admin", by: i.by, reason: i.reason, actions: i.actions }, { at, isAdmin: i.by.type === "user" && (fixtures.admins ?? []).includes(i.by.id) }),
    events: () => events,
    state: () => state,
    stuck: () => null,
    pendingCalls: () => [],
    attempts: () => [],
  };
}

interface Run {
  host: MemoryHost;
  /** Every turn's result without the host's own stuck state, as JSON. */
  turns: string;
}

function run(c: WorkflowCase, host: MemoryHost): Run {
  const results = expandTurns(c, file.cases).map((t, i) => {
    const r = runInput(host, REQUEST_ID, t.input ?? {}, turnAt(i));
    return r.ok ? { events: r.events, trace: r.trace, dropped: r.dropped } : { refusals: r.refusals };
  });
  return { host, turns: JSON.stringify(results) };
}

const fresh = (): PublishedDefinition => loadExampleDefinition("change-request-demo");

describe("every acceptance case, run again", () => {
  for (const c of file.cases) {
    describe(c.id, () => {
      const first = run(c, createMemoryHost(fresh(), fixtures));

      it("gives byte-identical events, refusals and traces on the same definition and on a fresh copy", () => {
        const sharedDefinition = fresh();
        const a = run(c, createMemoryHost(sharedDefinition, fixtures));
        const b = run(c, createMemoryHost(sharedDefinition, fixtures));
        expect(a.turns).toBe(first.turns);
        expect(b.turns).toBe(first.turns);
      });

      it("changes none of its arguments: frozen definition, state, inputs, context and events give the same turns", () => {
        expect(run(c, freezingHost(fresh())).turns).toBe(first.turns);
      });

      it("replays: folding its events from nothing gives the state the host held", () => {
        const events = first.host.events(REQUEST_ID);
        expect(events.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(fold(events)).toEqual(first.host.state(REQUEST_ID));
        expect(JSON.stringify(fold(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(events)) as AnyEventRecord[]))).toBe(JSON.stringify(first.host.state(REQUEST_ID)));
      });
    });
  }
});

/**
 * The nobody-to-ask match over values that are not of the expected shape (integrations.md section 11.5): a rule
 * that cannot be worked out counts as no match, so such a value never makes a request look stuck.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Json, PublishedDefinition } from "../../src/format/index.ts";
import { nobodyToAsk } from "../../src/host/index.ts";
import { call, definition, Driver, emitted, person, stage, waitId, when } from "../kernel/decide/build.ts";

const ODD = { kind: "other" } as const;

function ask(assignees: string, rule: { members: boolean; excludeRequester: boolean }, groups: Json | null, data: Record<string, Json> = {}): boolean {
  const def: PublishedDefinition = {
    ...definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Ask")] }),
        stage("Ask", { waits: [call("members", { onFailure: "outcome" }), person("task", { assignees })] }),
      ],
    }),
    nobodyToAsk: [{ id: "Ask.task__nobody", wait: "Ask.task", members: rule.members ? "Ask.members" : null, excludeRequester: rule.excludeRequester }],
  };
  const d = new Driver(def);
  emitted(d.start());
  if (groups !== null) emitted(d.result(waitId("Ask.members", "a3"), "ok", { groups }));
  d.state = { ...d.state, data };
  const task = d.state.waits.find((w) => w.id.element === "Ask.task");
  if (task === undefined) throw new Error("no task");
  return nobodyToAsk(def, d.state, task);
}

const GROUP = "[{'type': 'group', 'id': 'g'}]";

describe("nobody-to-ask: a value not of the expected shape is no match", () => {
  it("a group entry whose id is not a group reference is not a group missing from the result", () => {
    expect(ask(GROUP, { members: true, excludeRequester: false }, [{ id: { type: "group", id: "other" }, members: [] }])).toBe(true);
    expect(ask(GROUP, { members: true, excludeRequester: false }, [{ id: ODD, members: [{ type: "user", id: "alice" }] }])).toBe(false);
    expect(ask(GROUP, { members: true, excludeRequester: false }, [ODD])).toBe(false);
  });

  it("a Requester that is not a user reference is not replaced by the starter", () => {
    expect(ask("[request.by]", { members: false, excludeRequester: true }, null, { requester: { type: "user", id: "alice" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(ask("[request.by]", { members: false, excludeRequester: true }, null, {})).toBe(true);
    expect(ask("[request.by]", { members: false, excludeRequester: true }, null, { requester: ODD })).toBe(false);
  });
});

/**
 * validateCallResult (E-26; integrations.md sections 8.3 and 10.3): a call's result is checked against its

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { WaitId } from "../../src/format/index.ts";
import { validateCallResult } from "../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { call, definition, person, stage } from "./decide/build.ts";

const def = definition({
  stages: [stage("Start", { waits: [person("form"), call("ticket", { connection: "jira", op: "createIssue@1", effect: "write" }), call("loose", { connection: "x", op: "undeclared@1" })] })],
  results: {
    jira: {
      "createIssue@1": { type: "object", required: ["key"], properties: { key: { type: "string" }, n: { type: "integer" } }, additionalProperties: false },
    },
  },
});
const ticket = { element: "Start.ticket" };

function check(outcome: string, data: unknown, wait = ticket) {
  return validateCallResult(def, wait, { outcome, data });
}

describe("validateCallResult", () => {
  it("accepts an ok result that fits the operation's declared result type", () => {
    expect(check("ok", { key: "CHG-1" })).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(check("ok", { key: "CHG-1", n: 3 })).toEqual({ ok: true });
  });

  it("refuses an ok result that does not fit, with each failure", () => {
    expect(check("ok", {})).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "invalid-data", failures: [{ pointer: "/key", keyword: "required", rule: "required" }] });
    expect(check("ok", { key: 1 })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/key", keyword: "type" }] });
    expect(check("ok", { key: "K", extra: true })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/extra", rule: "unknown-question" }] });
  });

  it("refuses null anywhere and any key starting with $", () => {
    expect(check("ok", { key: "K", n: null })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/n", rule: "wrong-kind" }] });
    expect(check("ok", { key: "K", $redacted: true })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/$redacted", rule: "wrong-kind" }] });
    expect(check("ok", { $redacted: true })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, reason: "invalid-data" });
    expect(check("ok", { key: "K" }, { element: "Start.loose" })).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(check("ok", { deep: [{ $x: 1 }] }, { element: "Start.loose" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/deep/0/$x", rule: "wrong-kind" }] });
    expect(check("ok", { deep: [null] }, { element: "Start.loose" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/deep/0", rule: "wrong-kind" }] });
  });

  it("refuses data that is not an object", () => {
    for (const data of [null, "K", 3, ["K"]]) {
      expect(check("ok", data), JSON.stringify(data)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "invalid-data", failures: [{ pointer: "", keyword: "type", rule: "wrong-kind" }] });
    }
  });

  it("checks a failed result's data as {code, message}, two strings and nothing else", () => {
    expect(check("failed", { code: "down", message: "Jira is down" })).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(check("failed", { code: "down", message: "" })).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(check("failed", { code: "down" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/message", rule: "required" }] });
    expect(check("failed", { code: "", message: "m" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/code", rule: "too-short" }] });
    expect(check("failed", { code: "down", message: "m", key: "K" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/key" }] });
    expect(check("failed", { code: 5, message: "m" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failures: [{ pointer: "/code", rule: "wrong-kind" }] });
    // The ok shape does not apply to a failure, nor the failure shape to an ok result.
    expect(check("ok", { code: "down", message: "m" })).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
  });

  it("names an outcome that is neither ok nor failed, and an element that is not a call of the definition", () => {
    expect(check("accepted", { key: "K" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unknown-outcome", failures: [] });
    expect(check("ok", { key: "K" }, { element: "Start.form" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unknown-call", failures: [] });
    expect(check("ok", { key: "K" }, { element: "Nowhere.ticket" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unknown-call", failures: [] });
  });

  it("takes a full wait ID as well as an element", () => {
    const wait: WaitId = { element: "Start.ticket", activation: "a2", key: "", seq: 1 };
    expect(validateCallResult(def, wait, { outcome: "ok", data: { key: "K" } })).toEqual({ ok: true });
  });
});

===\nengine/packages/core/test/kernel/cases/notation.ts\n===
/**
 * The short notation of the spec's case files (engine/spec/kernel/replay-only.yaml and
 * engine/spec/workflows/<workflow>/test-cases.yaml), read into the JSON of event-payloads.md.
 *
 * - A wait is `<stage>.<element>[<key>]@<activation>`; `seq` is given beside it, or is 1.
 * - `by: rita` is `{type: user, id: rita}`; `"system:engine"` and `"connection:helpdesk"` name the type.
 * - With `refs`, a string `"user:lee"` or `"group:grp-a"` in a data position is `{type, id}` (the demo
 *   cases' convention; replay-only.yaml writes references in full).
 * - An admin action `{ retry: {} }` is `{type: "retry"}`, and likewise for close.
 */
import type { AdminAction, By, Json, WaitId } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";

export type Notation = unknown;

export class NotationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "NotationError";
  }
}

export function isRecord(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return v !== null && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v);
}

const WAIT = /^([^@[\]]+)(?:\[([^\]]*)\])?@([^@[\]]+)$/;

/** `Pending.review@a2` with seq 1, or `PendingApproval.items[lineage]@a2` with the seq given. */
export function parseWait(text: Notation, seq: Notation = 1): WaitId {
  if (isRecord(text)) return text as unknown as WaitId;
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new NotationError(`wait: expected a string, got ${JSON.stringify(text)}`);
  const m = WAIT.exec(text);
  if (m === null || m[1] === undefined || m[3] === undefined) throw new NotationError(`wait: cannot read ${text}`);
  if (typeof seq !== "number") throw new NotationError(`wait ${text}: seq must be a number`);
  return { element: m[1], activation: m[3], key: m[2] ?? "", seq };
}

/** The notation of a wait: the inverse of parseWait, without the seq. */
export function waitText(id: WaitId): string {
  return `${id.element}${id.key === "" ? "" : `[${id.key}]`}@${id.activation}`;
}

const TYPED = /^(user|group|connection|system):(.+)$/;

/** `rita` is a user; `connection:helpdesk`, `system:engine` name their type. */
export function parseBy(v: Notation): By {
  if (isRecord(v)) return v as unknown as By;
  if (typeof v !== "string") throw new NotationError(`by: expected a string, got ${JSON.stringify(v)}`);
  const m = TYPED.exec(v);
  return m !== null && m[1] !== undefined && m[2] !== undefined ? { type: m[1], id: m[2] } : { type: "user", id: v };
}

/** A data value: with `refs`, `"user:lee"` and `"group:grp-a"` become references, at any depth. */
export function dataValue(v: Notation, refs: boolean): Json {
  if (typeof v === "string") {
    const m = refs ? /^(user|group):(.+)$/.exec(v) : null;
    return m !== null && m[1] !== undefined && m[2] !== undefined ? { type: m[1], id: m[2] } : v;
  }
  if (typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "boolean") return v;
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map((x) => dataValue(x, refs));
  if (isRecord(v)) return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]) => [k, dataValue(x, refs)]));
  throw new NotationError(`data value: ${JSON.stringify(v)} is not JSON without null`);
}

/** `{ retry: {} }` is `{type: "retry"}`, and likewise for close; a written-out action is kept. */
export function adminAction(v: Notation): AdminAction {
  if (!isRecord(v)) throw new NotationError(`admin action: ${JSON.stringify(v)}`);
  if (typeof v["type"] === "string") return v as unknown as AdminAction;
  const keys = Object.keys(v);
  const [name] = keys;
  if (keys.length !== 1 || name === undefined) throw new NotationError(`admin action: one key expected in ${JSON.stringify(v)}`);
  return { type: name } as AdminAction;
}

export function patchOp(v: Notation, refs: boolean): Json {
  if (!isRecord(v)) throw new NotationError(`patch op: ${JSON.stringify(v)}`);
  const op: Record<string, Json> = { op: String(v["op"]), path: (v["path"] as string[]).map(String) };
  if (v["op"] !== "remove") op["value"] = dataValue(v["value"], refs);
  return op;
}
===\nengine/packages/core/test/kernel/cases/state-match.ts\n===
/**
 * The cases' `expectState` (replay-only.yaml) and `finalState` (the workflow cases) checked against a
 * folded RequestState. A subset match: keys not listed are not asserted; `absent` means the path is not
 * present. Returns every mismatch as a line, [] when the state matches.
 *
 * Keys read: `activeStages` (a set of `{activation, stage, parentActivation}`), `open` (the open wait
 * instances, as a set of wait notations), `waits` (each `{wait, seq, ...fields}` matched against that
 * instance), `readableId`, `trigger`, `startedBy`, `closed`, `data`, `status`, `faulted`. Any other key is
 * reported, so a new key is never skipped silently.
 */
import type { RequestState, WaitInstance } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { dataValue, isRecord, parseBy, parseWait, waitText, type Notation } from "./notation.ts";

function same(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
  return JSON.stringify(canonical(a)) === JSON.stringify(canonical(b));
}

function canonical(v: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(canonical);
  if (isRecord(v)) return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).sort().map((k) => [k, canonical(v[k])]));
  return v;
}

/** `expected` is a subset of `actual`: maps recursively, everything else by value; `absent` is a missing key. */
export function subsetMismatches(actual: unknown, expected: unknown, at: string): string[] {
  if (isRecord(expected) && isRecord(actual)) {
    return Object.entries(expected).flatMap(([k, x]) => {
      const here = `${at}.${k}`;
      if (x === "absent") return Object.hasOwn(actual, k) ? [`${here}: expected absent, got ${JSON.stringify(actual[k])}`] : [];
      if (!Object.hasOwn(actual, k)) return [`${here}: missing, expected ${JSON.stringify(x)}`];
      return subsetMismatches(actual[k], x, here);
    });
  }
  return same(actual, expected) ? [] : [`${at}: expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`];
}

function setMismatch(name: string, actual: string[], expected: string[]): string[] {
  const a = [...actual].sort();
  const e = [...expected].sort();
  return same(a, e) ? [] : [`${name}: expected ${JSON.stringify(e)}, got ${JSON.stringify(a)}`];
}

function waitFields(w: WaitInstance): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { status: w.status, outcome: w.outcome, data: w.data, by: w.by, evidence: w.evidence, kind: w.kind, role: w.role, cause: w.cause, late: w.late };
}

/** The cases' `faulted`: false is no fault, `error` a fault not cleared (a fault is always an error). */
export function faultedMismatches(state: RequestState, expected: unknown): string[] {
  if (expected !== false && expected !== "error") return [`faulted: ${JSON.stringify(expected)} is not false or error`];
  const actual = state.faults.length === 0 ? false : "error";
  return actual === expected ? [] : [`faulted: expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`];
}

export function stateMismatches(state: RequestState, expected: Record<string, unknown>, refs = false): string[] {
  return Object.entries(expected).flatMap(([key, x]): string[] => {
    switch (key) {
      case "activeStages": {
        const actual = state.activeStages.map((s) => JSON.stringify(canonical({ activation: s.activation, stage: s.stage, parentActivation: s.parentActivation })));
        return setMismatch(key, actual, (x as unknown[]).map((s) => JSON.stringify(canonical(s))));
      }
      case "open":
        return setMismatch(
          key,
          state.waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open").map((w) => waitText(w.id)),
          (x as Notation[]).map((w) => waitText(parseWait(w))),
        );
      case "waits":
        return (x as Record<string, unknown>[]).flatMap((e) => {
          const { wait, seq, ...fields } = e;
          const id = parseWait(wait, seq ?? 1);
          const found = state.waits.find((w) => w.id.element === id.element && w.id.activation === id.activation && w.id.key === id.key && w.id.seq === id.seq);
          if (found === undefined) return [`waits: no instance ${waitText(id)} seq ${id.seq}`];
          const want: Record<string, unknown> = { ...fields };
          if (Object.hasOwn(want, "data")) want["data"] = dataValue(want["data"], refs);
          if (Object.hasOwn(want, "by")) want["by"] = parseBy(want["by"]);
          return subsetMismatches(waitFields(found), want, `waits[${waitText(id)}#${id.seq}]`);
        });
      case "readableId":
        return subsetMismatches(state.request?.readableId, x, key);
      case "trigger":
        return subsetMismatches(state.start?.trigger ?? null, x, key);
      case "startedBy":
        return subsetMismatches(state.request?.by, parseBy(x), key);
      case "closed":
        return subsetMismatches(state.closed !== null, x, key);
      case "data":
        return subsetMismatches(state.data, dataValue(x, refs), key);
      case "status":
        return subsetMismatches(state.status, x, key);
      case "faulted":
        return faultedMismatches(state, x);
      default:
        return [`${key}: not a state key this matcher reads`];
    }
  });
}
===\nengine/packages/core/test/kernel/cases/translate.ts\n===
/**
 * The translator from the case files' notation (`[EventType, payload]` entries) to the event JSON of
 * engine/design/event-payloads.md. Kept in test code: the replay cases use it, and the workflow cases
 * (engine/spec/workflows/<workflow>/test-cases.yaml) reuse it.
 *
 * Two modes:
 * - `fill: true` (default) writes every field the payload always carries, so the events can be folded.
 *   A field the notation leaves out gets the default below; the cases do not assert those fields
 *   ("Fields not listed are not asserted"), so a default is a placeholder, not a claim.
 * - `fill: false` converts only the fields given, for a subset match against events `decide` wrote.
 *
 * Defaults when filling: RequestStarted `workflow` (option), `version: 1`, `readableId: 1`,
 * `input: {outcome: "submit", data: {}}`, `trigger: null`. WaitOpened `kind: "person"`; person:
 * `role: "obligation"`, `assignees: []`, `outcomes: []`; call: `role: null`, `args: {}`, `effect: "read"`,
 * connection and op placeholders, the derived key. A given `idempotencyKey` is literal text in which
 * `{requestId}` stands for the request's ID. WaitCompleted
 * `data: {}`, `by` the call's connection for a call, `evidence: null` for a call and the empty evidence for
 * a person (merged with what is given). Overridden `reason: ""`, `actions: []`. TransitionFired
 * `reads: []`. StageEntered `status: null`, `parentActivation: null`.
 * StageExited `mode: "normal"`. WaitCancelled `cause: "stage-exit"`. DataSet `source: "transition"`,
 * `element: null`. Faulted `element: null`, `error: null` (a given error gets `field: null`, `params: {}`,
 * `detail: ""`). RequestClosed `stage: null`. CallResultLate `data: {}`.
 *
 * Envelope: `seq` counts from 1 across the translator's life. `history` sets each event's `turn` to the seq
 * of the input that caused it (inputs: RequestStarted, WaitCompleted, CallResultLate, Overridden); a
 * WaitCompleted is a consequence of the start turn when it comes before any other input and its `by` is the
 * starter (spec section 3: the start wait's completion). `block` gives every event of one block the seq of
 * the block's first event (the workflow cases' convention). `at` is one second per seq from `startAt`.
 */
import type { AnyEventRecord, By, EventType, Json, WaitId } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { EVENT_TYPES } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { adminAction, dataValue, isRecord, NotationError, parseBy, parseWait, patchOp, type Notation } from "./notation.ts";

export interface TranslatorOptions {
  requestId?: string;
  workflow?: string;
  /** Read `"user:x"` and `"group:x"` in data positions as references (the workflow cases' convention). */
  refs?: boolean;
  fill?: boolean;
  startAt?: string;
  engineBuild?: string;
}

export interface Translator {
  history(entries: readonly Notation[]): AnyEventRecord[];
  block(entries: readonly Notation[]): AnyEventRecord[];
  payload(type: EventType, notation: Notation): Record<string, unknown>;
}

/** Kernel spec section 2, Call: `<request ID>/<element ID>@<activation>#<seq>`, `[<key>]` after the element when the key is set. */
export function derivedKey(requestId: string, wait: WaitId): string {
  return `${requestId}/${wait.element}${wait.key === "" ? "" : `[${wait.key}]`}@${wait.activation}#${wait.seq}`;
}

const ALLOWED: Record<EventType, readonly string[]> = {
  RequestStarted: ["workflow", "version", "readableId", "by", "input", "trigger"],
  WaitCompleted: ["wait", "seq", "outcome", "data", "by", "evidence"],
  CallResultLate: ["wait", "seq", "outcome", "data"],
  Overridden: ["by", "reason", "actions"],
  TransitionFired: ["transition", "stage", "activation", "reads"],
  StageEntered: ["activation", "stage", "status", "parentActivation"],
  StageExited: ["activation", "stage", "mode"],
  WaitOpened: ["wait", "seq", "kind", "role", "assignees", "outcomes", "connection", "op", "effect", "args", "idempotencyKey"],
  WaitCancelled: ["wait", "seq", "cause"],
  WaitSkipped: ["wait", "seq"],
  DataSet: ["patch", "source", "element"],
  Faulted: ["kind", "element", "error"],
  RequestClosed: ["stage"],
};

const INPUTS: readonly EventType[] = ["RequestStarted", "WaitCompleted", "CallResultLate", "Overridden"];

function ref(v: Notation): Json {
  if (typeof v === "string") {
    const by = parseBy(v);
    return { type: by.type, id: by.id };
  }
  return dataValue(v, false);
}

function waitKey(id: WaitId): string {
  return JSON.stringify([id.element, id.activation, id.key, id.seq]);
}

export function createTranslator(options: TranslatorOptions = {}): Translator {
  const requestId = options.requestId ?? "req-1";
  const refs = options.refs ?? false;
  const fill = options.fill ?? true;
  const startMs = Date.parse(options.startAt ?? "2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z");
  const engineBuild = options.engineBuild ?? "core 0.0.0+cases";
  const opened = new Map<string, { kind: string; connection: string }>();
  let seq = 0;
  let turn = 0;
  let starter: By | null = null;
  let startTurnOpen = false;

  function payload(type: EventType, notation: Notation): Record<string, unknown> {
    const raw = notation ?? {};
    if (!isRecord(raw)) throw new NotationError(`${type}: payload must be a map`);
    const unknown = Object.keys(raw).filter((k) => !ALLOWED[type].includes(k));
    if (unknown.length > 0) throw new NotationError(`${type}: unknown field(s) ${unknown.join(", ")}`);
    const given: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const defaults: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const has = (k: string): boolean => Object.hasOwn(raw, k);
    const wait = (): WaitId => parseWait(raw["wait"], raw["seq"] ?? 1);
    const data = (k: string): void => {
      if (has(k)) given[k] = dataValue(raw[k], refs);
    };
    const copy = (...keys: string[]): void => {
      for (const k of keys) if (has(k)) given[k] = raw[k];
    };

    switch (type) {
      case "RequestStarted": {
        copy("workflow", "version", "readableId", "trigger");
        if (has("by")) given["by"] = parseBy(raw["by"]);
        if (has("input")) {
          const input = raw["input"];
          if (!isRecord(input)) throw new NotationError("RequestStarted: input must be a map");
          given["input"] = { outcome: input["outcome"] ?? "submit", data: dataValue(input["data"] ?? {}, refs) };
        }
        Object.assign(defaults, {
          workflow: options.workflow ?? "case-workflow",
          version: 1,
          readableId: 1,
          input: { outcome: "submit", data: {} },
          trigger: null,
        });
        if (fill && !has("by")) throw new NotationError("RequestStarted: by is needed");
        break;
      }
      case "WaitOpened": {
        if (has("wait")) given["wait"] = wait();
        copy("kind", "role", "outcomes", "connection", "op", "effect");
        if (has("assignees")) given["assignees"] = (raw["assignees"] as Notation[]).map(ref);
        data("args");
        const id = wait();
        const kind = typeof raw["kind"] === "string" ? raw["kind"] : "person";
        const connection = typeof raw["connection"] === "string" ? raw["connection"] : "case-connection";
        if (has("idempotencyKey")) given["idempotencyKey"] = String(raw["idempotencyKey"]).replaceAll("{requestId}", requestId);
        // Defaults by kind: a call has no role and carries its call fields; a person carries assignees.
        if (kind === "call") {
          Object.assign(defaults, { kind, role: null, connection, op: "case@1", effect: "read", args: {}, idempotencyKey: derivedKey(requestId, id) });
        } else {
          Object.assign(defaults, { kind, role: "obligation", assignees: [], outcomes: [] });
        }
        opened.set(waitKey(id), { kind, connection });
        break;
      }
      case "WaitCompleted": {
        if (has("wait")) given["wait"] = wait();
        copy("outcome");
        data("data");
        if (has("by")) given["by"] = parseBy(raw["by"]);
        const was = opened.get(waitKey(wait()));
        const isCall = was?.kind === "call";
        if (has("evidence")) {
          const e = raw["evidence"];
          given["evidence"] = e === null || !fill ? e : { memberOf: [], checks: [], lookups: [], ...(e as object) };
        }
        Object.assign(defaults, { data: {}, evidence: isCall ? null : { memberOf: [], checks: [], lookups: [] } });
        if (isCall) defaults["by"] = { type: "connection", id: was.connection };
        else if (fill && !has("by")) throw new NotationError("WaitCompleted: by is needed for a person wait");
        break;
      }
      case "CallResultLate":
        if (has("wait")) given["wait"] = wait();
        copy("outcome");
        data("data");
        defaults["data"] = {};
        break;
      case "Overridden":
        if (has("by")) given["by"] = parseBy(raw["by"]);
        copy("reason");
        if (has("actions")) given["actions"] = (raw["actions"] as Notation[]).map(adminAction);
        Object.assign(defaults, { reason: "", actions: [] });
        break;
      case "TransitionFired":
        copy("transition", "stage", "activation", "reads");
        defaults["reads"] = [];
        break;
      case "StageEntered":
        copy("activation", "stage", "status", "parentActivation");
        Object.assign(defaults, { status: null, parentActivation: null });
        break;
      case "StageExited":
        copy("activation", "stage", "mode");
        defaults["mode"] = "normal";
        break;
      case "WaitCancelled":
        if (has("wait")) given["wait"] = wait();
        copy("cause");
        defaults["cause"] = "stage-exit";
        break;
      case "WaitSkipped":
        if (has("wait")) given["wait"] = wait();
        break;
      case "DataSet":
        if (has("patch")) given["patch"] = (raw["patch"] as Notation[]).map((op) => patchOp(op, refs));
        copy("source", "element");
        Object.assign(defaults, { source: "transition", element: null });
        break;
      case "Faulted": {
        copy("kind", "element");
        if (has("error")) {
          const e = raw["error"];
          given["error"] = e === null || !fill ? e : { field: null, params: {}, detail: "", ...(e as object) };
        }
        Object.assign(defaults, { element: null, error: null });
        break;
      }
      case "RequestClosed":
        copy("stage");
        defaults["stage"] = null;
        break;
    }
    return fill ? { ...defaults, ...given } : given;
  }

  function entry(item: Notation): { type: EventType; payload: Record<string, unknown> } {
    if (!Array.isArray(item) || item.length < 1 || item.length > 2) throw new NotationError(`entry: expected [Type, payload], got ${JSON.stringify(item)}`);
    const [type, body] = item as [unknown, Notation];
    if (typeof type !== "string" || !(EVENT_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type)) throw new NotationError(`entry: unknown event type ${String(type)}`);
    return { type: type as EventType, payload: payload(type as EventType, body) };
  }

  function envelope(type: EventType, body: Record<string, unknown>, eventTurn: number): AnyEventRecord {
    const at = new Date(startMs + seq * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");
    return { requestId, seq, type, at, turn: eventTurn, v: 1, engineBuild, payload: body } as unknown as AnyEventRecord;
  }

  function isInput(type: EventType, body: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
    if (!INPUTS.includes(type)) return false;
    if (type === "RequestStarted") {
      starter = body["by"] as By;
      startTurnOpen = true;
      return true;
    }
    if (type === "WaitCompleted" && startTurnOpen) {
      startTurnOpen = false;
      const by = body["by"] as By | undefined;
      return !(starter !== null && by !== undefined && by.type === starter.type && by.id === starter.id);
    }
    startTurnOpen = false;
    return true;
  }

  return {
    payload,
    history(entries) {
      return entries.map((item) => {
        const { type, payload: body } = entry(item);
        seq += 1;
        if (isInput(type, body)) turn = seq;
        return envelope(type, body, turn);
      });
    },
    block(entries) {
      const first = seq + 1;
      return entries.map((item) => {
        const { type, payload: body } = entry(item);
        seq += 1;
        isInput(type, body);
        turn = first;
        return envelope(type, body, first);
      });
    },
  };
}
===\nengine/packages/core/test/kernel/cases/workflow-cases.ts\n===
/**
 * The workflow cases' notation (engine/spec/workflows/<workflow>/test-cases.yaml) beyond what the replay cases
 * use: the four inputs, `same-as` turns, the expected events of a turn as a subset match, and `finalState`
 * with the keys the demo cases add (`activeStages` as stage IDs, `eventCount`, `stuck`); `faulted` is read by the
 * replay cases' matcher, so both files read it one way.
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import type { AnyEventRecord, PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import type { MemoryHost } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import type { HostTurn } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import { loadYaml, specPath } from "./load.ts";
import { adminAction, dataValue, isRecord, NotationError, parseBy, parseWait, type Notation } from "./notation.ts";
import { stateMismatches, subsetMismatches } from "./state-match.ts";

export interface WorkflowTurn {
  input?: Record<string, unknown>;
  expect?: Notation[];
  refuse?: { reason: string };
  notify?: string[];
  "same-as"?: string;
}

export interface WorkflowCase {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  turns: WorkflowTurn[];
  finalState?: Record<string, unknown>;
  attemptsLog?: number;
  rebuild?: { tables: string[]; expect: string };
}

export interface WorkflowCaseFile {
  fixtures: Record<string, unknown> & { directory: Record<string, string[]>; people: Record<string, string> };
  cases: WorkflowCase[];
}

export function loadWorkflowCases(workflow: string): WorkflowCaseFile {
  return loadYaml(specPath(`workflows/${workflow}/test-cases.yaml`)) as WorkflowCaseFile;
}

/** engine/design/examples/<name>.definition.json, from this file: cases -> kernel -> test -> core -> packages -> engine. */
export function loadExampleDefinition(name: string): PublishedDefinition {
  const path = fileURLToPath(new URL(`../../../../../design/examples/${name}.definition.json`, import.meta.url));
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8")) as PublishedDefinition;
}

/** `same-as: D1 turns 1 to 5` expands to those turns of that case. */
export function expandTurns(c: WorkflowCase, all: readonly WorkflowCase[]): WorkflowTurn[] {
  return c.turns.flatMap((t) => {
    const ref = t["same-as"];
    if (ref === undefined) return [t];
    const m = /^(\S+) turns (\d+) to (\d+)$/.exec(ref);
    const source = all.find((x) => x.id === m?.[1]);
    if (m === null || source === undefined) throw new NotationError(`same-as: cannot read ${ref}`);
    return expandTurns(source, all).slice(Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]));
  });
}

/** Runs one turn's input through the host. `requestId` is the request the case runs on, once started. */
export function runInput(host: MemoryHost, requestId: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, at: string): HostTurn {
  const [kind, body] = Object.entries(input)[0] ?? [];
  if (!isRecord(body)) throw new NotationError(`input: ${JSON.stringify(input)}`);
  const data = (v: unknown): Record<string, never> => dataValue(v ?? {}, true) as Record<string, never>;
  switch (kind) {
    case "start": {
      const i = body["input"] as Record<string, unknown>;
      return host.start({ by: parseBy(body["by"]), outcome: String(i["outcome"]), data: data(i["data"]) }, at);
    }
    case "act":
      return host.act(requestId, { by: parseBy(body["by"]), wait: parseWait(body["wait"]), outcome: String(body["outcome"]), data: data(body["data"]) }, at);
    case "callResult":
      return host.answerCall(requestId, parseWait(body["wait"]), { outcome: body["outcome"] as "ok" | "failed", data: data(body["data"]) }, at);
    case "admin":
      return host.admin(requestId, { by: parseBy(body["by"]), reason: String(body["reason"] ?? ""), actions: (body["actions"] as Notation[]).map(adminAction) }, at);
    default:
      throw new NotationError(`input: unknown kind ${String(kind)}`);
  }
}

/** The events appended, against the expected ones: same count, type, seq and turn, and each payload a superset. */
export function eventMismatches(actual: readonly AnyEventRecord[], expected: readonly AnyEventRecord[]): string[] {
  if (actual.length !== expected.length) {
    return [`expected ${expected.length} events [${expected.map((e) => e.type).join(", ")}], got ${actual.length} [${actual.map((e) => e.type).join(", ")}]`];
  }
  return actual.flatMap((a, i) => {
    const e = expected[i] as AnyEventRecord;
    const at = `[${i}] ${e.type}`;
    if (a.type !== e.type) return [`${at}: got ${a.type}`];
    const envelope = a.seq === e.seq && a.turn === e.turn ? [] : [`${at}: seq/turn ${a.seq}/${a.turn}, expected ${e.seq}/${e.turn}`];
    return [...envelope, ...subsetMismatches(a.payload, e.payload, at)];
  });
}

export interface FinalStateSource {
  state: ReturnType<MemoryHost["state"]>;
  events: readonly AnyEventRecord[];
  stuck: ReturnType<MemoryHost["stuck"]>;
}

/** `finalState`: the demo's keys here, the rest by the replay cases' matcher (with `user:`/`group:` references). */
export function finalStateMismatches(source: FinalStateSource, expected: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
  const rest: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const [key, x] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    switch (key) {
      case "activeStages": {
        const actual = source.state.activeStages.map((s) => s.stage).sort();
        const want = [...(x as string[])].sort();
        if (JSON.stringify(actual) !== JSON.stringify(want)) out.push(`activeStages: expected ${JSON.stringify(want)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
        break;
      }
      case "eventCount":
        if (source.events.length !== x) out.push(`eventCount: expected ${String(x)}, got ${source.events.length}`);
        break;
      case "stuck":
        out.push(...(x === null ? (source.stuck === null ? [] : [`stuck: expected null, got ${JSON.stringify(source.stuck)}`]) : subsetMismatches(source.stuck, x, "stuck")));
        break;
      default:
        rest[key] = x;
    }
  }
  return [...out, ...stateMismatches(source.state, rest, true)];
}

/**
 * Admin turns (kernel spec section 4): retry and close, what they write, and every refusal.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AdminAction } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { call, definition, Driver, emitted, final, payloadsOf, person, reasons, stage, types, waitId, when } from "./build.ts";

const def = definition({
  stages: [
    stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Work", [{ path: ["owner"], expr: "request.by" }])] }),
    stage("Work", { waits: [person("task", { assignees: "[data.owner]" }), call("job")] }),
    final("Done"),
  ],
  data: { owner: { type: "object", properties: { type: { type: "string" }, id: { type: "string" } } } },
});

function started(): Driver {
  const d = new Driver(def);
  emitted(d.start());
  return d;
}

describe("decide: admin actions", () => {
  it("retry skips the active stage's open waits, exits it forced and enters it afresh", () => {
    const d = started();
    const r = d.admin([{ type: "retry" }]);
    expect(types(r)).toEqual(["Overridden", "WaitSkipped", "WaitSkipped", "StageExited", "StageEntered", "WaitOpened", "WaitOpened"]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "Overridden")).toEqual([{ by: { type: "user", id: "root-admin" }, reason: "test", actions: [{ type: "retry" }] }]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "WaitSkipped").map((w) => w.wait)).toEqual([waitId("Work.task", "a3"), waitId("Work.job", "a3")]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "StageExited")).toEqual([{ activation: "a3", stage: "Work", mode: "forced" }]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "WaitOpened").map((w) => w.wait)).toEqual([waitId("Work.task", "a4"), waitId("Work.job", "a4")]);
  });

  it("retry clears the fault before the re-entry and before decide runs", () => {
    const d = started();
    emitted(d.result(waitId("Work.job", "a3"), "failed", { code: "c", message: "m" }));
    expect(d.state.faults).toHaveLength(1);
    const r = d.admin([{ type: "retry" }]);
    expect(types(r)).toEqual(["Overridden", "WaitSkipped", "StageExited", "StageEntered", "WaitOpened", "WaitOpened"]);
    expect(d.state.faults).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("close cancels every open wait, records RequestClosed with no stage, and ends any fault", () => {
    const d = started();
    emitted(d.result(waitId("Work.job", "a3"), "failed", { code: "c", message: "m" }));
    const r = d.admin([{ type: "close" }]);
    expect(types(r)).toEqual(["Overridden", "WaitCancelled", "RequestClosed"]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "WaitCancelled")).toEqual([{ wait: waitId("Work.task", "a3"), cause: "request-closed" }]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "RequestClosed")).toEqual([{ stage: null }]);
    expect(d.state.faults).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("decide: admin refusals", () => {
  it("not-admin for anyone the caller did not find to be an admin", () => {
    expect(reasons(started().admin([{ type: "close" }], { isAdmin: false }))).toEqual(["not-admin"]);
  });

  it("request-closed once the request is closed", () => {
    const d = started();
    emitted(d.admin([{ type: "close" }]));
    expect(reasons(d.admin([{ type: "retry" }]))).toEqual(["request-closed"]);
  });

  it("invalid-action for no actions, any other action, and anything after a close", () => {
    const d = started();
    const problems = [[], [{ type: "jump" }], [{ type: "close" }, { type: "close" }]] as unknown as AdminAction[][];
    expect(problems.map((actions) => {
      const r = d.admin(actions);
      return r.ok ? null : [r.refusals[0]?.reason, r.refusals[0]?.params["problem"]];
    })).toEqual([["invalid-action", "no-actions"], ["invalid-action", "unknown-action"], ["invalid-action", "after-close"]]);
  });

  it("action-error when an expression fails while an action is applied; nothing is written", () => {
    const d = started();
    d.state = { ...d.state, data: {} };
    const before = d.events.length;

/**
 * Small published definitions for decide's own tests, every field written as publish writes it
 * (definition-format.md section 3), and a driver that runs inputs through decide and folds the events.
 */
import type {
  AdminAction,
  AnyEventRecord,
  By,
  CallWait,
  Check,
  EventType,
  PayloadOf,
  ChildStage,
  Json,
  JsonObject,
  JsonSchema,
  Lookup,
  Outcome,
  PersonWait,
  PublishedDefinition,
  SetEntry,
  Transition,
  Wait,
  WaitId,
} from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { decide, emptyState, evolve, type DecideContext, type DecideInput, type DecideResult, type RequestState } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";

/** Any object: the schema of an outcome whose data a test does not care about. */
export const ANY: JsonSchema = { type: "object" };

export function outcome(id: string, o: { schema?: string; checks?: Check[]; lookups?: Lookup[] } = {}): Outcome {
  return { id, schema: o.schema ?? "any@1", checks: o.checks ?? [], lookups: o.lookups ?? [] };
}

export function person(id: string, o: { assignees?: string; may?: string; role?: "obligation" | "option"; outcomes?: Outcome[] } = {}): PersonWait {
  return { id, kind: "person", role: o.role ?? "obligation", assignees: o.assignees ?? "[request.by]", may: o.may ?? "true", outcomes: o.outcomes ?? [outcome("done")] };
}

export function call(
  id: string,
  o: Partial<Pick<CallWait, "connection" | "op" | "args" | "effect" | "onFailure" | "keyScope" | "idempotencyKey">> = {},
): CallWait {
  const effect = o.effect ?? "read";
  return {
    id,
    kind: "call",
    connection: o.connection ?? "sys",
    op: o.op ?? "doIt@1",
    args: o.args ?? {},
    effect,
    onFailure: o.onFailure ?? "fault",
    keyScope: o.idempotencyKey !== undefined && o.idempotencyKey !== null ? null : (o.keyScope ?? "activation"),
    idempotencyKey: o.idempotencyKey ?? null,
  };
}

export function when(id: string, condition: string, to: string, set: SetEntry[] = []): Transition {
  return { id, otherwise: false, when: condition, set, to };
}

export function otherwise(id: string, to: string, set: SetEntry[] = []): Transition {
  return { id, otherwise: true, when: null, set, to };
}

export function stage(id: string, o: { waits?: Wait[]; transitions?: Transition[]; final?: boolean; status?: string | null } = {}): ChildStage {
  return { id, final: o.final ?? false, status: o.status ?? null, waits: o.waits ?? [], transitions: o.transitions ?? [] };
}

export const final = (id: string): ChildStage => stage(id, { final: true });

export interface DefinitionParts {
  stages: ChildStage[];
  /** Default: the first stage. Its first person wait is the start wait unless `start` says otherwise. */
  initial?: string;
  start?: string;
  schemas?: Record<string, JsonSchema>;
  data?: Record<string, JsonSchema>;
  constants?: Record<string, { type: JsonSchema; value: Json }>;
  results?: Record<string, Record<string, JsonSchema>>;
  statuses?: { id: string; label: string }[];
}

export function definition(p: DefinitionParts): PublishedDefinition {
  const initial = p.initial ?? p.stages[0]?.id ?? "Start";
  const startWait = p.stages.find((s) => s.id === initial)?.waits.find((w) => w.kind === "person");
  const schemas = { "any@1": ANY, ...(p.schemas ?? {}) };
  return {
    format: 1,
    workflow: "test-workflow",
    version: 1,
    compiler: "test",
    runtime: { cel: "cel-1", validator: "jsonschema-1" },
    start: p.start ?? `${initial}.${startWait?.id ?? "form"}`,
    root: { initial, stages: p.stages },
    statuses: (p.statuses ?? []).map((s) => ({ ...s, color: "blue" })),
    notifications: [],
    constants: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p.constants ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.value])),
    types: {
      data: p.data ?? {},
      constants: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p.constants ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.type])),
      results: p.results ?? {},
    },
    schemas: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(schemas).map(([ref, schema]) => [ref, { id: ref.split("@")[0] ?? ref, version: 1, schema }])),
    origins: {},
  };
}

export const rita: By = { type: "user", id: "rita" };
export const alice: By = { type: "user", id: "alice" };
export const admin: By = { type: "user", id: "root-admin" };

export function at(n: number): string {
  return new Date(Date.parse("2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z") + n * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");
}

export function waitId(element: string, activation: string, seq = 1): WaitId {
  return { element, activation, key: "", seq };
}

/** Runs inputs through decide and folds the events, as a host does. */
export class Driver {
  readonly def: PublishedDefinition;
  state: RequestState = emptyState();
  events: AnyEventRecord[] = [];
  private turns = 0;
  constructor(def: PublishedDefinition) {
    this.def = def;
  }

  step(input: DecideInput, context: Partial<DecideContext> = {}): DecideResult {
    const result = decide(this.def, this.state, input, { at: at(this.turns++), ...context });
    if (result.ok) {
      for (const e of result.events) this.state = evolve(this.state, e);
      this.events.push(...result.events);
    }
    return result;
  }

  start(data: JsonObject = {}, o: { by?: By; outcome?: string; context?: Partial<DecideContext> } = {}): DecideResult {
    return this.step({ kind: "start", requestId: "req-1", readableId: 1, by: o.by ?? rita, outcome: o.outcome ?? "done", data, trigger: null }, o.context);
  }

  act(wait: WaitId, data: JsonObject = {}, o: { by?: By; outcome?: string; context?: Partial<DecideContext> } = {}): DecideResult {
    return this.step({ kind: "act", by: o.by ?? rita, wait, outcome: o.outcome ?? "done", data }, o.context);
  }

  result(wait: WaitId, outcome: "ok" | "failed", data: JsonObject = {}): DecideResult {
    return this.step({ kind: "callResult", wait, outcome, data });
  }

  admin(actions: AdminAction[], o: { isAdmin?: boolean } = {}): DecideResult {
    return this.step({ kind: "admin", by: admin, reason: "test", actions }, { isAdmin: o.isAdmin ?? true });
  }
}

/** The events of a result, as `[type, payload]` pairs; throws on a refusal. */
export function emitted(result: DecideResult): AnyEventRecord[] {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(result.refusals)}`);
  return result.events;
}

export function types(result: DecideResult): string[] {
  return emitted(result).map((e) => e.type);
}

export function reasons(result: DecideResult): string[] {
  if (result.ok) throw new Error(`accepted: ${types(result).join(", ")}`);
  return result.refusals.map((r) => r.reason);
}

export function payloadsOf<T extends EventType>(result: DecideResult, type: T): PayloadOf<T>[] {
  return emitted(result)
    .filter((e) => e.type === type)
    .map((e) => e.payload as PayloadOf<T>);
}

    ]);
  });

/**

 * and the publish check type-checks in (E-27): what each scope declares, and that the two agree.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { environmentFor, variablesFor, type Scope } from "../../../src/kernel/decide/environment.ts";
import { environmentsFor } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/environment.ts";
import { definition, outcome, person, stage, when } from "./build.ts";

const def = definition({
  stages: [
    stage("Start", { waits: [person("form", { outcomes: [outcome("done", { schema: "f@1" })] })], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Work")] }),
    stage("Work", { waits: [person("task")] }),
  ],
  schemas: { "f@1": { type: "object", properties: { size: { type: "number" } } } },
  data: { n: { type: "integer" } },
  constants: { limit: { value: 3, type: { type: "integer" } }, data: { value: 1, type: { type: "integer" } } },
});

const scopes: Scope[] = [
  { kind: "stage", stage: "Work" },
  { kind: "actor", stage: "Work" },
  { kind: "check", stage: "Start", schema: "f@1" },
  { kind: "lookup", schema: "f@1" },
];

const checks = (scope: Scope, source: string): boolean => environmentFor(def, scope).check(source).ok;

describe("environmentFor", () => {
  it("declares per scope: data and request everywhere; waits but in lookups; actor in may and checks; input in checks and lookups", () => {
    expect(scopes.map((s) => Object.keys(variablesFor(def, s)).sort())).toEqual([
      ["data", "request", "waits"],
      ["actor", "data", "request", "waits"],
      ["actor", "data", "input", "request", "waits"],
      ["data", "input", "request"],
    ]);
  });

  it("a lookup's inputs read request, typed: the Requester and Started on (spec v2.18)", () => {
    expect(checks({ kind: "lookup", schema: "f@1" }, "request.by.id + request.at + request.id")).toBe(true);
    expect(checks({ kind: "lookup", schema: "f@1" }, "request.by.nope")).toBe(false);
    expect(checks({ kind: "lookup", schema: "f@1" }, "waits.form.outcome")).toBe(false);
    expect(checks({ kind: "lookup", schema: "f@1" }, "input.size * 1.5 + double(data.n) + double(limit)")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("a constant named like a variable is left out, so the environment can still be built", () => {
    expect(checks({ kind: "stage", stage: "Work" }, "data.n + limit")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("the publish check type-checks in the same environment, scope by scope", () => {
    const sources = ["request.by.id", "data.n + 1", "waits.task.outcome == 'done'", "actor.id", "input.size", "input.size + 1", "limit"];
    for (const scope of scopes) {
      const published = environmentsFor(def, scope).typed;
      for (const source of sources) expect([scope.kind, source, published.check(source).ok]).toEqual([scope.kind, source, checks(scope, source)]);
    }
  });

/**
 * Faults (kernel spec section 3; event-payloads.md section 5.12): an expression error in each place an
 * expression can sit, what a fault keeps and rolls back, inputs while faulted, a second fault, the retry that
 * clears it, and nothing that fits, which is worked out and never recorded.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Lookup } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { nothingFits } from "../../../src/kernel/stuck/index.ts";
import { call, definition, Driver, emitted, final, outcome, payloadsOf, person, stage, types, waitId, when } from "./build.ts";

type Place = "when" | "set" | "assignees" | "args" | "idempotencyKey";

function withExpression(place: Place, expr: string) {
  return definition({
    stages: [
      stage("Start", {
        waits: [person("form")],
        transitions: [when("t_go", place === "when" ? expr : "true", "Next", place === "set" ? [{ path: ["x"], expr }] : [])],
      }),
      stage("Next", {
        waits: [
          person("task", { assignees: place === "assignees" ? expr : "[request.by]" }),
          call("job", { effect: "write", args: place === "args" ? { "a/b": expr } : {}, ...(place === "idempotencyKey" ? { idempotencyKey: expr } : { keyScope: "activation" as const }) }),
        ],
      }),
    ],
    data: { x: { type: "integer" } },
  });
}

function faultOf(place: Place, expr: string) {
  const r = new Driver(withExpression(place, expr)).start();
  expect(types(r)).toEqual(["RequestStarted", "StageEntered", "StageEntered", "WaitOpened", "WaitCompleted", "Faulted"]);
  return payloadsOf(r, "Faulted")[0];
}

describe("decide: an expression error in each place faults the turn, naming the element and the field", () => {
  it("a transition's when", () => {
    expect(faultOf("when", "[1][2] == 1")).toEqual({
      kind: "error",
      element: "Start.t_go",
      error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/when", params: { error: "index-out-of-range", index: 2 }, detail: expect.stringMatching(/^index-out-of-bounds: /) as unknown as string },
    });
  });

  it("a when that gives no boolean is an error, never false", () => {
    expect(faultOf("when", "'yes'")).toMatchObject({ element: "Start.t_go", error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/when", params: { error: "wrong-kind" } } });
  });

  it("a Set's expression, with the missing key named", () => {
    expect(faultOf("set", "{'a': 1}['zz']")).toMatchObject({ element: "Start.t_go", error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/set/0/expr", params: { error: "no-such-key", key: "zz" } } });
  });

  it("a value leaving CEL beyond +/-(2^53 - 1) is int-range", () => {
    expect(faultOf("set", "9007199254740993")).toMatchObject({ element: "Start.t_go", error: { code: "int-range", field: "/set/0/expr", params: { error: "overflow" } } });
  });

  it("a Set's value holding a key that starts with $ is reserved-key, at any depth (E-26)", () => {
    for (const expr of ["{'$x': 1}", "{'a': [{'b': {'$x': 1}}]}", "{'$redacted': true}", "{'a': [{'$redacted': true}]}"]) {
      const f = faultOf("set", expr);
      expect(f).toMatchObject({ element: "Start.t_go", error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/set/0/expr", params: { error: "wrong-kind" } } });
      expect(f?.error?.detail).toMatch(/^reserved-key: /);
    }
  });

  it("a Set's value holding null, at the top or inside, is an error: the engine never writes null (E-26)", () => {
    for (const expr of ["null", "{'a': null}", "[1, null]"]) {
      const f = faultOf("set", expr);
      expect(f).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/set/0/expr", params: { error: "wrong-kind" } } });
      expect(f?.error?.detail).toMatch(/^null-value: /);
    }
  });

  it("a days() beyond its limit is cel-error with error overflow, not int-range (E-26)", () => {
    const f = faultOf("set", "int(date('2026-01-01') + days(3650001))");
    expect(f).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "cel-error", params: { error: "overflow" } } });
    expect(f?.error?.detail).toMatch(/^days-out-of-range: /);
  });

  it("a timestamp outside the years 0001 to 9999 leaving a Set is invalid-timestamp (E-26)", () => {
    const f = faultOf("set", "{'at': date('9999-12-31') + days(1)}");
    expect(f).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "cel-error", params: { error: "other" } } });
    expect(f?.error?.detail).toMatch(/^invalid-timestamp: /);
  });

  it("a person wait's assignees", () => {
    expect(faultOf("assignees", "[[request.by][3]]")).toMatchObject({ element: "Next.task", error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/assignees", params: { error: "index-out-of-range" } } });
  });

  it("a call's argument, its name escaped in the pointer", () => {
    expect(faultOf("args", "[1][4]")).toMatchObject({ element: "Next.job", error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/args/a~1b" } });
  });

  it("an explicit idempotency key: an error, and a value that is not a string of 1 to 255 characters", () => {
    expect(faultOf("idempotencyKey", "[1][5] == 1 ? 'a' : 'b'")).toMatchObject({ element: "Next.job", error: { code: "cel-error", field: "/idempotencyKey" } });
    for (const bad of ["''", "'a' == 'a'", `'${"k".repeat(256)}'`]) {
      expect(faultOf("idempotencyKey", bad)).toEqual({ kind: "error", element: "Next.job", error: { code: "key-invalid", field: "/idempotencyKey", params: {}, detail: "" } });
    }
  });

/**
 * Firing transitions (kernel spec section 2, Transition, Set, Values, CEL context; section 3): order,
 * otherwise, once per activation, re-entry, the 50-firing limit, Sets, lexical scope, typed numbers, the trace.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { FIRING_LIMIT } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { call, definition, Driver, emitted, final, otherwise, outcome, payloadsOf, person, stage, types, waitId, when } from "./build.ts";

describe("decide: which transition fires", () => {
  const def = definition({
    stages: [
      stage("Start", {
        waits: [person("form"), person("note", { role: "option" })],
        transitions: [when("t_first", "waits.form.outcome == 'done'", "A"), when("t_second", "true", "B"), otherwise("t_else", "B")],
      }),
      final("A"),
      final("B"),
    ],
  });

  it("the first true transition in declared order fires, and the trace says what was considered", () => {
    const r = new Driver(def).start();
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "TransitionFired")).toEqual([{ transition: "t_first", stage: "Start", activation: "a2", reads: [{ path: ["waits", "form", "outcome"], value: "done" }] }]);
    expect(r.ok ? r.trace : []).toEqual([{ pass: 1, stage: "Start", activation: "a2", transition: "t_first", result: "fired", reads: [{ path: ["waits", "form", "outcome"], value: "done" }] }]);
    expect(types(r).slice(-5)).toEqual(["TransitionFired", "WaitCancelled", "StageExited", "StageEntered", "RequestClosed"]);
  });

  it("an option wait still open does not stop otherwise, and the request closes in the final stage, cancelling it", () => {
    const d = definition({
      stages: [stage("Start", { waits: [person("form"), person("note", { role: "option" })], transitions: [otherwise("t_else", "B")] }), final("B")],
    });
    const r = new Driver(d).start();
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "TransitionFired")[0]).toEqual({ transition: "t_else", stage: "Start", activation: "a2", reads: [] });
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "WaitCancelled")).toEqual([{ wait: waitId("Start.note", "a2"), cause: "stage-exit" }]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "RequestClosed")).toEqual([{ stage: "B" }]);
  });

  it("otherwise waits for every obligation and call; a call failed under onFailure outcome counts as completed", () => {
    const d = definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Work")] }),
        stage("Work", { waits: [call("fetch", { onFailure: "outcome" }), person("task")], transitions: [otherwise("t_done", "Done")] }),
        final("Done"),
      ],
    });
    const drv = new Driver(d);
    emitted(drv.start());
    expect(types(drv.act(waitId("Work.task", "a3")))).toEqual(["WaitCompleted"]);
    expect(types(drv.result(waitId("Work.fetch", "a3"), "failed", { code: "x", message: "m" }))).toEqual(["WaitCompleted", "TransitionFired", "StageExited", "StageEntered", "RequestClosed"]);
  });

  it("a call that failed without onFailure outcome never satisfies otherwise", () => {
    const d = definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Work")] }),
        stage("Work", { waits: [call("job", { effect: "write" }), person("task")], transitions: [otherwise("t_done", "Done")] }),
        final("Done"),
      ],
    });
    const drv = new Driver(d);
    emitted(drv.start());
    expect(payloadsOf(drv.result(waitId("Work.job", "a3"), "failed", { code: "x", message: "m" }), "Faulted")).toHaveLength(1);
    // A state no admin action reaches: the fault gone, the failed call kept.
    drv.state = { ...drv.state, faults: [] };
    expect(types(drv.act(waitId("Work.task", "a3")))).toEqual(["WaitCompleted"]);
  });

  it("a transition fires at most once per activation; a self-target re-enters with a new activation and fresh waits", () => {
    const d = definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Loop")] }),
        stage("Loop", { waits: [person("task"), call("fetch")], transitions: [when("t_again", "waits.task.outcome == 'done'", "Loop")] }),
      ],
    });
    const drv = new Driver(d);
    emitted(drv.start());
    const r = drv.act(waitId("Loop.task", "a3"));
    expect(types(r)).toEqual(["WaitCompleted", "TransitionFired", "WaitCancelled", "StageExited", "StageEntered", "WaitOpened", "WaitOpened"]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "WaitCancelled")).toEqual([{ wait: waitId("Loop.fetch", "a3"), cause: "stage-exit" }]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "StageEntered")).toEqual([{ activation: "a4", stage: "Loop", status: null, parentActivation: "a1" }]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "WaitOpened").map((w) => w.wait)).toEqual([waitId("Loop.task", "a4"), waitId("Loop.fetch", "a4")]);
    // The new activation's task is open, so the transition is not enabled again in the same turn.
    expect(drv.state.waits.filter((w) => w.status === "open").map((w) => w.id.activation)).toEqual(["a4", "a4"]);
  });
});

describe("decide: the 50-firing limit", () => {
  const counting = (limit: number) =>
    definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Loop", [{ path: ["n"], expr: "0" }])] }),
        stage("Loop", {
          transitions: [when("t_again", `data.n < ${limit}`, "Loop", [{ path: ["n"], expr: "data.n + 1" }]), when("t_done", `data.n >= ${limit}`, "Done")],
        }),
        final("Done"),
      ],
      data: { n: { type: "integer" } },
    });

  it(`${FIRING_LIMIT} firings in one turn are allowed`, () => {
    const r = new Driver(counting(48)).start();
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "TransitionFired")).toHaveLength(50);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "RequestClosed")).toEqual([{ stage: "Done" }]);
  });

  it("the 51st faults the turn on that transition and rolls every firing back; the start prefix is kept", () => {
    const drv = new Driver(counting(49));
    const r = drv.start();
    expect(types(r)).toEqual(["RequestStarted", "StageEntered", "StageEntered", "WaitOpened", "WaitCompleted", "Faulted"]);
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "Faulted")).toEqual([{ kind: "error", element: "Loop.t_done", error: { code: "firing-limit", field: null, params: {}, detail: "" } }]);
    expect(drv.state.data).toEqual({});
  });

  it("an endless self-target is stopped the same way", () => {
    const d = definition({ stages: [stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Loop")] }), stage("Loop", { transitions: [when("t_spin", "true", "Loop")] })] });
    expect(payloadsOf(new Driver(d).start(), "Faulted")[0]).toMatchObject({ element: "Loop.t_spin", error: { code: "firing-limit" } });
  });
});

describe("decide: Sets", () => {
  const withSets = (sets: { path: string[]; expr: string }[], data: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
    definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form", { outcomes: [outcome("done", { schema: "form@1" })] })], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Next", sets)] }),
        stage("Next", { waits: [person("task")] }),
      ],
      schemas: { "form@1": { type: "object", properties: { a: { type: "string" }, b: { type: "string" } } } },
      data: { a: { type: "string" }, b: { type: "string" }, form: { type: "object" }, ...(data as Record<string, never>) },
    });

  it("optional.none() on an absent path records nothing: no patch entry, and no DataSet when nothing is left", () => {
    const r = new Driver(withSets([{ path: ["a"], expr: "waits.form.data.?a" }])).start({});
    expect(types(r)).not.toContain("DataSet");
  });

  it("optional.none() on a present path removes it; every Set reads the state before the transition", () => {
    const d = definition({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "true", "Mid", [{ path: ["a"], expr: "'x'" }])] }),
        stage("Mid", { waits: [person("task")], transitions: [when("t_back", "waits.task.outcome == 'done'", "End", [{ path: ["a"], expr: "optional.none()" }, { path: ["b"], expr: "data.?a.orValue('none')" }])] }),
        stage("End", { waits: [person("last")] }),
      ],
      data: { a: { type: "string" }, b: { type: "string" } },
    });
    const drv = new Driver(d);
    emitted(drv.start());
    const r = drv.act(waitId("Mid.task", "a3"));
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "DataSet")).toEqual([{ patch: [{ op: "remove", path: ["a"] }, { op: "set", path: ["b"], value: "x" }], source: "transition", element: "Mid.t_back" }]);
    expect(drv.state.data).toEqual({ b: "x" });
  });

  it("creates missing parents", () => {
    const r = new Driver(withSets([{ path: ["form", "deep", "x"], expr: "'v'" }])).start({});
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "DataSet")[0]?.patch).toEqual([{ op: "set", path: ["form", "deep", "x"], value: "v" }]);
  });

  it("two paths that overlap fault the turn on the transition", () => {
    const r = new Driver(withSets([{ path: ["form"], expr: "{'x': 'y'}" }, { path: ["form", "x"], expr: "'z'" }])).start({});
    expect(payloadsOf(r, "Faulted")).toEqual([{ kind: "error", element: "Start.t_go", error: { code: "set-overlap", field: "/set/1/path", params: {}, detail: "" } }]);
  });
});

describe("decide: scope and typed values", () => {
  it("a number declared `number` is a CEL double even when integral, so it mixes with doubles", () => {

    expect(drv.state.fired.map((f) => [f.transition, f.activation])).toEqual([["t_go", "a2"], ["t_again", "a3"]]);
  });
