/**
 * Refusals of an act and of a start (kernel spec section 2, Person and Start; integrations.md section 11.3):
 * each reason on its own, then the order: wait-not-open, membership-unavailable, not-assignee, may (or
 * rule-error), invalid-data, source-unavailable, choice-unknown, check (or rule-error). A refusal changes
 * nothing; "try again" refusals are not attempts.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { JsonObject, Lookup } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import type { DecideContext } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { alice, call, definition, Driver, emitted, outcome, payloadsOf, person, reasons, rita, stage, waitId, when } from "./build.ts";

const lookup = (property: string): Lookup => ({ property, connection: "cat", source: "services@1", inputs: { status: "'active'", wanted: "input.?size" }, storedField: "id", labelField: "name", answer: "item" });
const ITEM = { type: "object", additionalProperties: false, required: ["stored", "label"], properties: { stored: { type: "string" }, label: { type: "string" } } };

function reviewDefinition(may = "actor.id != 'rita'", checkWhen = "input.size < 10.0") {
  return definition({
    stages: [
      stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "waits.form.outcome == 'done'", "Review")] }),
      stage("Review", {
        waits: [
          person("task", {
            assignees: "[{'type': 'group', 'id': 'grp-a'}, {'type': 'user', 'id': 'dan'}]",
            may,
            outcomes: [
              outcome("approve", {
                schema: "approve@1",
                lookups: [lookup("svc"), lookup("env")],
                checks: [
                  { id: "c_first", when: checkWhen, message: "too big" },
                  { id: "c_second", when: "!has(input.env) || input.env.label != 'Retired'", message: "retired" },
                ],
              }),
            ],
          }),
        ],
      }),
    ],
    schemas: {
      "approve@1": { type: "object", additionalProperties: false, required: ["size"], properties: { size: { type: "number" }, svc: ITEM, env: ITEM } },
    },
  });
}

const TASK = waitId("Review.task", "a3");
const inGroup: Partial<DecideContext> = { memberships: { groups: ["grp-a"] } };
const found = { svc: { found: true, label: "Payments" }, env: { found: true, label: "Prod" } } as const;
const good: JsonObject = { size: 3, svc: { stored: "s1", label: "sent label" }, env: { stored: "e1", label: "x" } };

function started(def = reviewDefinition()): Driver {
  const d = new Driver(def);
  emitted(d.start());
  return d;
}

function act(d: Driver, data: JsonObject, context: Partial<DecideContext>, by = alice) {
  return d.act(TASK, data, { by, outcome: "approve", context });
}

describe("decide: act refusals, each reason", () => {
  it("unknown-wait, not an attempt, for a wait the request never opened; before wait-not-open and any outside lookup", () => {
    const d = started();
    const never = d.act(waitId("Review.task", "a9"), good, { by: alice, outcome: "approve", context: { memberships: "unavailable" } });
    expect(never.ok ? [] : never.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "unknown-wait", attempt: false, params: { element: "Review.task" } }]);
    emitted(d.admin([{ type: "close" }]));
    const closed = d.act(waitId("Review.task", "a9"), good, { by: alice, outcome: "approve", context: inGroup });
    expect(closed.ok ? [] : closed.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "unknown-wait", attempt: false, params: { element: "Review.task" } }]);
  });

  it("wait-not-open on a completed wait says who completed it and with which outcome, also after the request closed", () => {
    const d = started();
    emitted(act(d, good, { ...inGroup, lookups: found }));
    const completed = { reason: "wait-not-open", attempt: true, params: { state: "completed", by: alice, outcome: "approve" } };
    const again = act(d, good, { memberships: "unavailable" }, rita);
    expect(again.ok ? [] : again.refusals).toEqual([completed]);
    emitted(d.admin([{ type: "close" }]));
    const afterClose = act(d, good, { ...inGroup, lookups: found }, rita);
    expect(afterClose.ok ? [] : afterClose.refusals).toEqual([completed]);
  });

  it("wait-not-open requestClosed for a wait the close ended", () => {
    const d = started();
    emitted(d.admin([{ type: "close" }]));
    const r = act(d, good, { ...inGroup, lookups: found });
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "wait-not-open", attempt: true, params: { state: "requestClosed" } }]);
  });

  it("unknown-outcome for an outcome the wait does not have", () => {
    expect(reasons(started().act(TASK, good, { by: alice, outcome: "nope", context: inGroup }))).toEqual(["unknown-outcome"]);
  });

  it("membership-unavailable when the assignees hold a group and the directory gave no answer; not an attempt", () => {
    const d = started();
    for (const context of [{}, { memberships: "unavailable" as const }]) {
      const r = act(d, good, context);
      expect(r.ok ? [] : r.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "membership-unavailable", attempt: false, params: {} }]);
    }
  });

  it("not-assignee for someone neither asked directly nor in a group asked; a user asked directly may act", () => {
    const d = started();
    expect(reasons(act(d, good, { memberships: { groups: ["grp-b"] } }, { type: "user", id: "bob" }))).toEqual(["not-assignee"]);
    const dan = act(d, good, { memberships: { groups: [] }, lookups: found }, { type: "user", id: "dan" });
    expect(payloadsOf(dan, "WaitCompleted")[0]?.evidence?.memberOf).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("may: the requester in the group is refused by may", () => {
    expect(reasons(act(started(), good, inGroup, rita))).toEqual(["may"]);
  });

  it("rule-error at may's place when may errors; never treated as false", () => {
    const r = act(started(reviewDefinition("[1][0 + 1] == 1")), good, inGroup);
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "rule-error", attempt: true, params: { element: "Review.task", field: "/may", error: "index-out-of-range", detail: expect.stringContaining("index-out-of-bounds") as unknown as string } }]);
  });

  it("invalid-data: one refusal per failing property", () => {
    const r = act(started(), { size: "big", extra: 1 }, inGroup);
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.refusals.map((x) => [x.reason, x.params["pointer"], x.params["rule"]])).toEqual([
      ["invalid-data", "/size", "wrong-kind"],
      ["invalid-data", "/extra", "unknown-question"],
    ]);
  });

  it("source-unavailable when a lookup could not be made, before choice-unknown; not an attempt", () => {
    const r = act(started(), good, { ...inGroup, lookups: { svc: { found: false } } });
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "source-unavailable", attempt: false, params: { property: "env" } }]);
  });

  it("choice-unknown when the source has no item with that stored value", () => {
    const r = act(started(), good, { ...inGroup, lookups: { svc: { found: true, label: "P" }, env: { found: false } } });
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.refusals).toEqual([{ reason: "choice-unknown", attempt: true, params: { property: "env" } }]);
  });

/**
 * "evolve(state, event) is the only code replay uses. It never evaluates CEL and never reads the definition"
 * (kernel spec section 3), proved by the imports: the modules evolve loads at run time (type-only imports are
 * erased) include nothing of the CEL environment, of decide, of the host or of the schema validator, and no
 * module of replay names a definition type.
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, relative, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const src = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../src/", import.meta.url));

/** Specifiers loaded at run time: `import ... from` and `export ... from`, except `import type` and `export type`. */
const RUNTIME = /^\s*(?:import|export)\s+(?!type\b)[^;]*?\sfrom\s*["']([^"']+)["']/gm;

function runtimeClosure(entry: string): string[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (file: string): void => {
    if (seen.has(file)) return;
    seen.add(file);
    const text = readFileSync(file, "utf8");
    for (const m of text.matchAll(RUNTIME)) {
      const spec = m[1] ?? "";
      if (!spec.startsWith(".")) {
        seen.add(`lib:${spec}`);
        continue;
      }
      visit(resolve(dirname(file), spec));
    }
  };
  visit(resolve(src, entry));
  return [...seen].map((f) => (f.startsWith(src) ? relative(src, f).replace(/\\/g, "/") : f)).sort();
}

describe("evolve's imports", () => {
  const closure = runtimeClosure("kernel/evolve.ts");

  it("load only the stored formats and replay's own modules", () => {
    expect(closure.filter((f) => !f.startsWith("format/") && !["kernel/evolve.ts", "kernel/errors.ts", "kernel/patch.ts", "kernel/state.ts"].includes(f))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("load no CEL, no decide, no host, no schema validator and no library", () => {
    expect(closure.filter((f) => /^(cel|host|schema)\/|^kernel\/decide\/|^lib:/.test(f))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("the walker sees through re-exports: decide's own closure reaches the CEL environment", () => {
    expect(runtimeClosure("kernel/decide/decide.ts")).toContain("cel/environment.ts");
  });

  it("no module of replay names a definition type", () => {
    const replay = closure.filter((f) => f.startsWith("kernel/"));
    const named = replay.filter((f) => /\b(PublishedDefinition|ChildStage|RootStage|PersonWait|CallWait|Transition)\b/.test(readFileSync(resolve(src, f), "utf8")));
    expect(named).toEqual([]);
  });
});

import { currentWait, emptyState, evolve, EvolveError, fold, hasFired, openWaits, type RequestState } from "../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { createTranslator } from "./cases/translate.ts";

const start = [
  ["RequestStarted", { by: "rita", workflow: "wf-x", version: 3, readableId: 77, input: { outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T" } } }],
  ["StageEntered", { activation: "a1", stage: "root", parentActivation: null }],
  ["StageEntered", { activation: "a2", stage: "Pending", parentActivation: "a1", status: { id: "pending", label: "Pending" } }],
];

function events(...more: unknown[][]): AnyEventRecord[] {
  return createTranslator().history([...start, ...more]);
}

function run(...more: unknown[][]): RequestState {
  return fold(events(...more));
}

function failure(f: () => unknown): string {
  try {
    f();
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof EvolveError) return e.code;
    throw e;
  }
  return "no error";
}

function deepFreeze<T>(v: T): T {
  if (v !== null && typeof v === "object") {
    for (const x of Object.values(v)) deepFreeze(x);
    Object.freeze(v);
  }
  return v;
}

describe("evolve: the start and the envelope", () => {
  it("takes the definition, the request and the start input from RequestStarted", () => {
    const state = run();
    expect(state.definition).toEqual({ workflow: "wf-x", version: 3 });
    expect(state.request).toEqual({ id: "req-1", by: { type: "user", id: "rita" }, at: events()[0]?.at, readableId: 77 });
    expect(state.start).toEqual({ input: { outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T" } }, trigger: null });
    expect([state.requestId, state.lastSeq, state.lastTurn]).toEqual(["req-1", 3, 1]);
  });

  it("takes the definition version from the events, not from anything fixed", () => {
    const a = createTranslator({ workflow: "one" }).history([["RequestStarted", { by: "rita", version: 1 }]]);
    const b = createTranslator({ workflow: "two" }).history([["RequestStarted", { by: "rita", version: 9 }]]);
    expect(fold(a).definition).toEqual({ workflow: "one", version: 1 });
    expect(fold(b).definition).toEqual({ workflow: "two", version: 9 });
  });

  it("refuses a history that does not begin with RequestStarted, or has a second one", () => {
    const [, entered] = events();
    expect(failure(() => evolve(emptyState(), { ...entered!, seq: 1 } as AnyEventRecord))).toBe("not-started");
    const again = createTranslator().history([...start, ["RequestStarted", { by: "rita" }]]);
    expect(failure(() => fold(again))).toBe("already-started");
  });

  it("refuses a gap in seq, another request's event, an unknown type and an unknown version", () => {
    const evs = events();
    const state = fold(evs.slice(0, 2));
    const third = evs[2]!;
    expect(failure(() => evolve(state, { ...third, seq: 4 }))).toBe("seq-gap");
    expect(failure(() => evolve(state, { ...third, requestId: "other" }))).toBe("request-mismatch");
    expect(failure(() => evolve(state, { ...third, type: "Moved" } as unknown as AnyEventRecord))).toBe("unknown-event-type");
    expect(failure(() => evolve(state, { ...third, v: 2 }))).toBe("unknown-event-version");
  });

  it("changes neither the state nor the event it is given", () => {
    const evs = deepFreeze(
      events(
        ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.review@a2" }],
        ["DataSet", { patch: [{ op: "set", path: ["a", "b"], value: 1 }] }],
        ["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.review@a2", outcome: "ok", by: "lee" }],
        ["Faulted", { kind: "error", element: "Pending.t", error: { code: "cel-error" } }],
        ["Overridden", { by: "root-admin", actions: [{ retry: {} }] }],
      ),
    );
    let state = deepFreeze(emptyState());
    for (const e of evs) state = deepFreeze(evolve(state, e));
    expect(state.data).toEqual({ a: { b: 1 } });
  });
});

describe("evolve: stages", () => {
  it("keeps the active stages as a set: a second active child, and a child of a child (parentActivation)", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["StageEntered", { activation: "a3", stage: "Security", parentActivation: "a1" }],
      ["StageEntered", { activation: "a4", stage: "Deep", parentActivation: "a3" }],
      ["StageExited", { activation: "a3", stage: "Security" }],
    );
    expect(state.activeStages.map((s) => [s.activation, s.stage, s.parentActivation])).toEqual([
      ["a1", "root", null],
      ["a2", "Pending", "a1"],
      ["a4", "Deep", "a3"],
    ]);
  });

  it("counts StageEntered events, so decide can name the next activation", () => {
    expect(run().stageEntries).toBe(2);
    expect(run(["StageExited", { activation: "a2", stage: "Pending" }], ["StageEntered", { activation: "a3", stage: "Pending", parentActivation: "a1" }]).stageEntries).toBe(3);
  });

  it("takes the status from the last StageEntered", () => {
    expect(run().status).toEqual({ id: "pending", label: "Pending" });
    expect(run(["StageExited", { activation: "a2", stage: "Pending" }], ["StageEntered", { activation: "a3", stage: "Open", parentActivation: "a1" }]).status).toBeNull();
  });

  it("refuses a second entry of an active activation and the exit of one that is not active", () => {
    expect(failure(() => run(["StageEntered", { activation: "a2", stage: "Pending", parentActivation: "a1" }]))).toBe("duplicate-activation");
    expect(failure(() => run(["StageExited", { activation: "a9", stage: "Pending" }]))).toBe("stage-not-active");
  });

  it("stores StageExited's mode without reading it", () => {
    const forced = run(["StageExited", { activation: "a2", stage: "Pending", mode: "forced" }]);
    const other = run(["StageExited", { activation: "a2", stage: "Pending", mode: "some-later-mode" }]);
    expect(other.activeStages).toEqual(forced.activeStages);
  });
});

describe("evolve: waits", () => {
  it("opens an instance with the WaitOpened payload as recorded, for any kind", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.review@a2", assignees: ["group:grp-a"], outcomes: [{ id: "ok", schema: "s@1" }] }],
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.ticket@a2", kind: "call", connection: "jira", op: "createIssue@1", effect: "write", args: { n: 1 } }],
    );
    expect(state.waits.map((w) => [w.kind, w.role, w.status, w.outcome, w.by, w.data])).toEqual([
      ["person", "obligation", "open", "", null, null],
      ["call", null, "open", "", null, null],
    ]);
    expect(state.waits[0]?.opened).toMatchObject({ assignees: [{ type: "group", id: "grp-a" }] });
    expect(state.waits[1]?.opened).toMatchObject({ connection: "jira", op: "createIssue@1", args: { n: 1 } });
    expect(state.waits[1]?.openedSeq).toBe(5);
  });

  it("stores a wait kind and role it does not know, without reading them", () => {
    const state = run(["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.t@a2", kind: "timer", role: "someRole" }]);
    expect([state.waits[0]?.kind, state.waits[0]?.role, state.waits[0]?.status]).toEqual(["timer", "someRole", "open"]);
  });

  it("refuses a second WaitOpened of the same instance", () => {
    expect(failure(() => run(["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.r@a2" }], ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.r@a2" }]))).toBe("duplicate-wait");
  });

  it("completes the instance named, with outcome, data, by and evidence as recorded", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.r@a2" }],
      ["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.r@a2", outcome: "approve", data: { why: "fine" }, by: "alice", evidence: { memberOf: ["grp-a"] } }],
    );
    const w = state.waits[0];
    expect([w?.status, w?.outcome, w?.data, w?.by, w?.evidence, w?.endedSeq]).toEqual([
      "completed",
      "approve",
      { why: "fine" },
      { type: "user", id: "alice" },
      { memberOf: ["grp-a"], checks: [], lookups: [] },
      5,
    ]);
    expect(state.lastTurn).toBe(5);
  });

  it("records a call's completion with null evidence", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.m@a2", kind: "call", connection: "directory" }],
      ["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.m@a2", outcome: "failed", data: { code: "down", message: "x" } }],
    );
    expect([state.waits[0]?.by, state.waits[0]?.evidence]).toEqual([{ type: "connection", id: "directory" }, null]);
  });

  it("refuses to complete, cancel or skip a wait that was never opened or is no longer open", () => {
    expect(failure(() => run(["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.r@a2", outcome: "x", by: "a" }]))).toBe("unknown-wait");
    const done = [
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.r@a2" }],
      ["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.r@a2", outcome: "x", by: "a" }],
    ];
    expect(failure(() => run(...done, ["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.r@a2", outcome: "y", by: "a" }]))).toBe("wait-not-open");
    expect(failure(() => run(...done, ["WaitCancelled", { wait: "Pending.r@a2" }]))).toBe("wait-not-open");
    expect(failure(() => run(...done, ["WaitSkipped", { wait: "Pending.r@a2" }]))).toBe("wait-not-open");
  });

  it("cancels with the cause as recorded and skips, without reading the cause", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.a@a2" }],
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.b@a2" }],
      ["WaitCancelled", { wait: "Pending.a@a2", cause: "some-later-cause" }],
      ["WaitSkipped", { wait: "Pending.b@a2" }],
    );
    expect(state.waits.map((w) => [w.status, w.cause])).toEqual([
      ["cancelled", "some-later-cause"],
      ["skipped", null],
    ]);
    expect(openWaits(state)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keeps instances apart by seq and key: the current one is the highest seq, whatever came before", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.i[k1]@a2", seq: 1 }],
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.i[k1]@a2", seq: 3 }],
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.i[k2]@a2", seq: 1 }],
      ["WaitCompleted", { wait: "Pending.i[k1]@a2", seq: 3, outcome: "done", by: "cara" }],
    );
    expect(currentWait(state, "Pending.i", "a2", "k1")?.id.seq).toBe(3);
    expect(currentWait(state, "Pending.i", "a2", "k1")?.status).toBe("completed");
    expect(currentWait(state, "Pending.i", "a2", "k2")?.id.seq).toBe(1);
    expect(openWaits(state).map((w) => [w.id.key, w.id.seq])).toEqual([
      ["k1", 1],
      ["k2", 1],
    ]);
  });

  it("keeps a late call result on the ended wait, without changing its status or outcome", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.t@a2", kind: "call", connection: "jira" }],
      ["WaitCancelled", { wait: "Pending.t@a2" }],
      ["CallResultLate", { wait: "Pending.t@a2", outcome: "ok", data: { key: "CHG-1" } }],
    );
    const w = state.waits[0];
    expect([w?.status, w?.outcome, w?.data]).toEqual(["cancelled", "", null]);
    expect(w?.late).toMatchObject({ outcome: "ok", data: { key: "CHG-1" }, seq: 6 });
    expect(state.lastTurn).toBe(6);
  });

  it("refuses a late result for a wait still open", () => {
    expect(failure(() => run(["WaitOpened", { wait: "Pending.t@a2", kind: "call" }], ["CallResultLate", { wait: "Pending.t@a2", outcome: "ok" }]))).toBe("wait-still-open");
  });
});

describe("evolve: data", () => {
  it("applies a patch in order: set creates parents and replaces, remove deletes", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["DataSet", { patch: [{ op: "set", path: ["form", "title"], value: "A" }, { op: "set", path: ["n"], value: 3 }] }],
      ["DataSet", { patch: [{ op: "set", path: ["form"], value: { size: 2 } }, { op: "remove", path: ["n"] }] }],
    );
    expect(state.data).toEqual({ form: { size: 2 } });
  });

  it("changes nothing when removing a path that is not there", () => {
    const state = run(["DataSet", { patch: [{ op: "set", path: ["a"], value: 1 }] }], ["DataSet", { patch: [{ op: "remove", path: ["b", "c"] }, { op: "remove", path: ["a", "x"] }] }]);
    expect(state.data).toEqual({ a: 1 });
  });

  it("does not read DataSet.source", () => {
    const set = (source: string): RequestState => run(["DataSet", { source, patch: [{ op: "set", path: ["a"], value: 1 }] }]);
    expect(set("some-later-source").data).toEqual(set("admin").data);
  });

  it("refuses a patch op it does not know", () => {
    const evs = events(["DataSet", { patch: [{ op: "set", path: ["a"], value: 1 }] }]);
    const last = evs[3]!;
    const bad = { ...last, payload: { ...last.payload, patch: [{ op: "merge", path: ["a"], value: 1 }] } } as unknown as AnyEventRecord;
    expect(failure(() => fold([...evs.slice(0, 3), bad]))).toBe("unknown-patch-op");
  });
});

describe("evolve: transitions, faults and admin turns", () => {
  it("records each firing, so decide can tell a transition has fired in this activation", () => {
    const state = run(["TransitionFired", { transition: "t_ok", stage: "Pending", activation: "a2" }]);
    expect(hasFired(state, "Pending", "a2", "t_ok")).toBe(true);
    expect(hasFired(state, "Pending", "a3", "t_ok")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("keeps every fault not cleared, of any kind, as recorded", () => {
    const state = run(
      ["Faulted", { kind: "error", element: "Pending.t", error: { code: "cel-error", detail: "d" } }],
      ["Faulted", { kind: "some-later-kind", element: "Pending.u", error: { code: "c" } }],
    );
    expect(state.faults.map((f) => [f.kind, f.element, f.error.code, f.error.detail, f.seq])).toEqual([
      ["error", "Pending.t", "cel-error", "d", 4],
      ["some-later-kind", "Pending.u", "c", "", 5],
    ]);
  });

  it("clears every fault on a retry, and only then: no other event ends a fault but RequestClosed", () => {
    const faulted = [["Faulted", { kind: "error", element: "Pending.t", error: { code: "call-failed" } }]];
    expect(run(...faulted, ["TransitionFired", { transition: "t_ok", stage: "Pending", activation: "a2" }]).faults).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(run(...faulted, ["Overridden", { by: "root-admin", actions: [{ close: {} }] }]).faults).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(run(...faulted, ["Faulted", { kind: "error", element: "Pending.u", error: { code: "cel-error" } }], ["Overridden", { by: "root-admin", actions: [{ retry: {} }] }]).faults).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keeps each admin turn as recorded", () => {
    const state = run(["Overridden", { by: "root-admin", reason: "r", actions: [{ close: {} }] }]);
    expect(state.adminTurns).toEqual([{ by: { type: "user", id: "root-admin" }, reason: "r", actions: [{ type: "close" }], seq: 4, at: state.lastAt }]);
  });

  it("closes: keeps the stages it closed in, and ends every fault", () => {
    const state = run(["Faulted", { kind: "error", element: "Pending.t", error: { code: "cel-error" } }], ["RequestClosed", { stage: "Pending" }]);
    expect(state.closed).toMatchObject({ stage: "Pending", seq: 5 });
    expect(state.faults).toEqual([]);
    expect(state.activeStages.map((s) => s.stage)).toEqual(["root", "Pending"]);
  });
  it("stores a trigger kind and by type it does not know", () => {
    const by = { type: "robot", id: "r2" };
    const state = fold(createTranslator().history([["RequestStarted", { by, trigger: { kind: "schedule", id: "yearly", cron: "0 0 1 1 *" } }]]));
    expect(state.request?.by).toEqual(by);
    expect(state.start?.trigger).toEqual({ kind: "schedule", id: "yearly", cron: "0 0 1 1 *" });
  });
});

/** Small definitions for the notify tests, written as publish writes them. */
import type { EventRule, NotificationRule, PublishedDefinition, Recipient } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { call, definition, final, person, stage, when } from "../decide/build.ts";

export const N_TASK: NotificationRule = {
  id: "n_task",
  on: { event: "WaitOpened", element: null },
  when: "event.kind == 'person' && event.role == 'obligation'",
  send: { message: { words: "task.assigned" }, to: [{ type: "expr", expr: "event.assignees" }] },
};

export const N_STOPPED: NotificationRule = {
  id: "n_stopped",
  on: { event: "Stuck", element: null },
  when: "true",
  send: { message: { words: "request.stuck" }, to: [{ type: "workflowAdmins" }] },
};

const STARTER: Recipient[] = [{ type: "expr", expr: "[request.by]" }];

export function rule(id: string, event: string, element: string | null, o: { when?: string; to?: Recipient[]; parts?: NotificationRule["send"]["message"] } = {}): NotificationRule {
  return { id, on: { event, element }, when: o.when ?? "true", send: { message: o.parts ?? { words: id }, to: o.to ?? STARTER } };
}

const INT = { type: "integer" };

/**
 * Start (form) -> Pass -> Work (task) -> End. Pass opens a person wait and leaves at once, so that wait is
 * opened and cancelled in one turn. `x` is 1 on the arrow into Pass and 2 on the arrow out of it.
 */
export function flow(notifications: NotificationRule[]): PublishedDefinition {
  const def = definition({
    stages: [
      stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "waits.form.outcome == 'done'", "Pass", [{ path: ["x"], expr: "1" }])] }),
      stage("Pass", { waits: [person("flash")], transitions: [when("t_pass", "true", "Work", [{ path: ["x"], expr: "2" }])] }),
      stage("Work", {
        waits: [person("task", { assignees: "[{'type': 'user', 'id': 'lee'}, {'type': 'group', 'id': 'grp-a'}]" })],
        transitions: [when("t_done", "waits.task.outcome == 'done'", "End")],
      }),
      final("End"),
    ],
    data: { x: INT, y: INT },
  });
  return { ...def, notifications };
}

/** Start (form) -> Ask, whose obligation asks nobody, beside a read call that faults when it fails. */
export function nobody(notifications: NotificationRule[]): PublishedDefinition {
  const def = definition({
    stages: [
      stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "waits.form.outcome == 'done'", "Ask")] }),
      stage("Ask", {
        status: "asking",
        waits: [call("read"), person("who", { assignees: "[]" })],
        transitions: [when("t_done", "waits.who.outcome == 'done'", "End")],
      }),
      final("End"),
    ],
    results: { sys: { "doIt@1": { type: "object" } } },
    statuses: [{ id: "asking", label: "Asking" }],
  });
  return { ...def, notifications };
}

/**
 * Start (form) -> Review (rev, a write call w) -> Pass -> Done. Review and Pass and Done have statuses;
 * `x` is 5 on the arrow into Pass and 6 on the arrow out of it.
 */
export function statuses(events: EventRule[] = []): PublishedDefinition {
  const def = definition({
    stages: [
      stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [when("t_go", "waits.form.outcome == 'done'", "Review")] }),
      stage("Review", {
        status: "review",
        waits: [call("w", { effect: "write" }), person("rev")],
        transitions: [when("t_ok", "waits.rev.outcome == 'done'", "Pass", [{ path: ["x"], expr: "5" }])],
      }),
      stage("Pass", { status: "passing", transitions: [when("t_p", "true", "Done", [{ path: ["x"], expr: "6" }])] }),
      { ...final("Done"), status: "done" },
    ],
    data: { x: INT, y: INT },
    results: { sys: { "doIt@1": { type: "object" } } },
    statuses: [
      { id: "review", label: "In review" },
      { id: "passing", label: "Passing" },
      { id: "done", label: "Done" },
    ],
  });
  return events.length === 0 ? def : { ...def, events };
}

/**
 * The definition with an origin map as a compiler writes it: each child stage `X` is a step of the authored
 * stage `st_<x>` (part `tasks`), so a reader that reports a stage must map it.
 */
export function withOrigins(def: PublishedDefinition): PublishedDefinition {
  const origins: PublishedDefinition["origins"] = { "stage:root": { item: ["wf_test"], part: null } };
  for (const s of def.root.stages) origins[`stage:${s.id}`] = { item: [`st_${s.id.toLowerCase()}`], part: "tasks" };
  return { ...def, origins };

/**
 * The change-request demo's outbound events, turn by turn, for D1 (the happy path) and D7 (a failed Jira
 * call, cleared by an admin's retry).
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createMemoryHost } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import { emptyState } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { outboundEvents, type OutboundRow } from "../../../src/kernel/notify/index.ts";
import { expandTurns, loadExampleDefinition, loadWorkflowCases, runInput } from "../cases/workflow-cases.ts";

const file = loadWorkflowCases("change-request-demo");
const definition = loadExampleDefinition("change-request-demo");
const START = Date.parse("2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z");
const turnAt = (n: number): string => new Date(START + n * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");

/** Per turn, each row as `type data`; a refused turn is null. */
function published(caseId: string): (string[] | null)[] {
  const c = file.cases.find((x) => x.id === caseId);
  if (c === undefined) throw new Error(caseId);
  const host = createMemoryHost(definition, { directory: file.fixtures.directory, admins: [file.fixtures.people["admin"] ?? ""] });
  return expandTurns(c, file.cases).map((t, i) => {
    const before = i === 0 ? emptyState() : host.state("req-1");
    const r = runInput(host, "req-1", t.input ?? {}, turnAt(i));
    if (!r.ok) return null;
    const { events, errors } = outboundEvents(definition, before, r.events, host.state("req-1"));
    expect(errors).toEqual([]);
    return events.map((row: OutboundRow) => `${row.body.type} ${JSON.stringify(row.body.data)}`);
  });
}

describe("the demo's outbound events", () => {
  it("D1", () => {
    expect(published("D1")).toEqual([
      ['request.started@1 {"startedBy":{"type":"user","id":"rita"},"trigger":null}', 'request.statusChanged@1 {"from":null,"to":{"id":"pendingApproval","label":"Pending approval"}}'],
      [],
      ['request.statusChanged@1 {"from":{"id":"pendingApproval","label":"Pending approval"},"to":{"id":"creatingTicket","label":"Creating ticket"}}'],
      ['request.statusChanged@1 {"from":{"id":"creatingTicket","label":"Creating ticket"},"to":{"id":"inDevelopment","label":"In development"}}'],
      [
        'request.statusChanged@1 {"from":{"id":"inDevelopment","label":"In development"},"to":{"id":"released","label":"Released"}}',
        'request.ended@1 {"status":{"id":"released","label":"Released"},"closedBy":"workflow","by":null,"stage":"Released"}',
      ],
    ]);
  });

  it("D7", () => {
    const turns = published("D7");
    expect(turns.slice(3)).toEqual([
      ['request.stuck@1 {"reason":"action-failed","stage":"CreateTicket"}'],
      null,
      ['request.unstuck@1 {"reason":"action-failed","stage":"CreateTicket","by":{"type":"user","id":"root-admin"}}'],
      ['request.statusChanged@1 {"from":{"id":"creatingTicket","label":"Creating ticket"},"to":{"id":"inDevelopment","label":"In development"}}'],
    ]);
  });
});

/**
 * Runs a small definition through the in-memory host and hands each accepted turn to the notify functions
 * as the notifier and the publisher get it: the state before, the turn's events, the state after.
 */
import type { AnyEventRecord, By, JsonObject, PublishedDefinition, WaitId } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { createMemoryHost, type HostTurn, type MemoryHost } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import { emptyState, type RequestState } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { matchNotifications, outboundEvents, type NotifyResult, type OutboundResult } from "../../../src/kernel/notify/index.ts";
import { admin, at, rita } from "../decide/build.ts";

export const REQUEST = "req-1";

export interface Turn {
  before: RequestState;
  events: AnyEventRecord[];
  after: RequestState;
  notify: NotifyResult;
  outbound: OutboundResult;
}

export class NotifyDriver {
  readonly def: PublishedDefinition;
  readonly host: MemoryHost;
  private n = 0;
  private started = false;

  constructor(def: PublishedDefinition, directory: Record<string, string[]> = {}) {
    this.def = def;
    this.host = createMemoryHost(def, { directory, admins: [admin.id] });
  }

  private run(f: (at: string) => HostTurn): Turn {
    const before = this.started ? this.host.state(REQUEST) : emptyState();
    const r = f(at(this.n++));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(r.refusals)}`);
    this.started = true;
    const after = this.host.state(REQUEST);
    return {
      before,
      events: r.events,
      after,
      notify: matchNotifications(this.def, before, r.events, after),
      outbound: outboundEvents(this.def, before, r.events, after, { deploymentUri: "https://wf.example" }),
    };
  }

  start(data: JsonObject = {}, by: By = rita, outcome = "done"): Turn {
    return this.run((t) => this.host.start({ by, outcome, data }, t));
  }

  act(wait: WaitId, data: JsonObject = {}, by: By = rita, outcome = "done"): Turn {
    return this.run((t) => this.host.act(REQUEST, { by, wait, outcome, data }, t));
  }

  answer(wait: WaitId, outcome: "ok" | "failed", data: JsonObject = {}): Turn {
    return this.run((t) => this.host.answerCall(REQUEST, wait, { outcome, data }, t));
  }

  retry(): Turn {
    return this.run((t) => this.host.admin(REQUEST, { by: admin, reason: "retry", actions: [{ type: "retry" }] }, t));
  }

  close(): Turn {
    return this.run((t) => this.host.admin(REQUEST, { by: admin, reason: "close", actions: [{ type: "close" }] }, t));
  }
}

/**
 * matchNotifications: which rules a turn sets off, to whom, with what message (kernel spec section 7,
 * integrations.md section 12).

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { emptyState } from "../../../src/kernel/index.ts";
import { matchNotifications } from "../../../src/kernel/notify/index.ts";
import { waitId } from "../decide/build.ts";
import { flow, N_STOPPED, N_TASK, nobody, rule, withOrigins } from "./defs.ts";
import { NotifyDriver } from "./drive.ts";

const rules = (t: { notify: { messages: { rule: string }[] } }): string[] => t.notify.messages.map((m) => m.rule);

describe("rules on recorded events", () => {
  const def = flow([
    rule("r_started", "RequestStarted", null),
    rule("r_started_element", "RequestStarted", "Start"),
    rule("r_fired", "TransitionFired", "Start.t_go"),
    rule("r_fired_other", "TransitionFired", "Work.t_go"),
    rule("r_entered", "StageEntered", "Pass", { parts: { parts: [{ text: "x is " }, { value: "data.x", kind: "number" }] } }),
    rule("r_data", "DataSet", "Pass.t_pass"),
    rule("r_work", "StageEntered", "Work", { parts: { parts: [{ value: "data.x", kind: "number" }] } }),
    N_TASK,
    rule("r_completed", "WaitCompleted", "Work.task"),
    rule("r_closed", "RequestClosed", "End"),
    rule("r_admin", "Overridden", null),
  ]);

  it("match each event of the turn of their type and element, in event order then declared order", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(rules(t)).toEqual(["r_started", "r_fired", "r_entered", "r_data", "r_work", "n_task"]);
    expect(t.notify.errors).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("name the matched event by type, seq and payload", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    const fired = t.notify.messages.find((m) => m.rule === "r_fired");
    const event = t.events.find((e) => e.type === "TransitionFired");
    expect(fired?.event).toEqual({ type: "TransitionFired", seq: event?.seq, at: event?.at, payload: event?.payload });
    expect(fired?.requestId).toBe("req-1");
  });

  it("read data as of the matched event, not as of the end of the turn", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(t.notify.messages.find((m) => m.rule === "r_entered")?.message).toEqual({ parts: [{ text: "x is " }, { kind: "number", value: 1 }] });
    expect(t.notify.messages.find((m) => m.rule === "r_work")?.message).toEqual({ parts: [{ kind: "number", value: 2 }] });
  });

  it("on WaitOpened: not for a wait completed in the same turn, nor one cancelled in it", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    const tasks = t.notify.messages.filter((m) => m.rule === "n_task");
    expect(tasks.map((m) => (m.event.payload as { wait: { element: string } }).wait.element)).toEqual(["Work.task"]);
    expect(t.events.filter((e) => e.type === "WaitOpened").length).toBe(3);
  });

  it("send to the recorded assignees, a group as a group reference", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(t.notify.messages.find((m) => m.rule === "n_task")?.to).toEqual([
      { type: "user", id: "lee" },
      { type: "group", id: "grp-a" },
    ]);
  });

  it("match WaitCompleted and RequestClosed by element; RequestClosed by an admin has no stage", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(def);
    d.start();
    expect(rules(d.act(waitId("Work.task", "a4"), {}, { type: "user", id: "lee" }))).toEqual(["r_completed", "r_closed"]);
    const e = new NotifyDriver(def);
    e.start();
    expect(rules(e.close())).toEqual(["r_admin"]);
  });
});

describe("recipients and messages", () => {
  it("drop duplicates and skip references that are not a user or a group", () => {
    const def = flow([
      rule("r", "RequestStarted", null, {
        to: [
          { type: "expr", expr: "[request.by, {'type': 'connection', 'id': 'c'}, request.by, {'type': 'group', 'id': 'g'}]" },
          { type: "workflowAdmins" },
          { type: "workflowAdmins" },
        ],
      }),
    ]);
    const [m] = new NotifyDriver(def).start().notify.messages;
    expect(m?.to).toEqual([{ type: "user", id: "rita" }, { type: "group", id: "g" }, { type: "workflowAdmins" }]);
    expect(m?.skipped).toEqual([{ type: "connection", id: "c" }]);
  });

  it("give a value part that is optional.none() no value", () => {
    const def = flow([rule("r", "RequestStarted", null, { parts: { parts: [{ text: "y: " }, { value: "data.?y", kind: "number" }] } })]);
    expect(new NotifyDriver(def).start().notify.messages[0]?.message).toEqual({ parts: [{ text: "y: " }, { kind: "number" }] });
  });

  it("a rule whose when, recipients or value errors sends nothing; the error is returned and other rules still apply", () => {
    const def = flow([
      rule("r_when", "RequestStarted", null, { when: "event.nothere == 'x'" }),
      rule("r_to", "RequestStarted", null, { to: [{ type: "expr", expr: "request.by" }] }),
      rule("r_value", "RequestStarted", null, { parts: { parts: [{ value: "event.nothere", kind: "text" }] } }),
      rule("r_bool", "RequestStarted", null, { when: "'yes'" }),
      rule("r_ok", "RequestStarted", null),
    ]);
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(rules(t)).toEqual(["r_ok"]);
    expect(t.notify.errors.map((e) => [e.rule, e.seq, e.failure.code])).toEqual([
      ["r_when", 1, "no-such-key"],
      ["r_to", 1, "not-a-list"],
      ["r_value", 1, "no-such-key"],
      ["r_bool", 1, "not-a-bool"],
    ]);
  });

  it("recipients that give nothing, or not a list, are a rule error and nothing is sent (E-28)", () => {
    const def = flow([
      rule("r_nothing", "RequestStarted", null, { to: [{ type: "workflowAdmins" }, { type: "expr", expr: "data.?nothing" }] }),
      rule("r_text", "RequestStarted", null, { to: [{ type: "expr", expr: "'lee'" }] }),
      rule("r_ok", "RequestStarted", null),
    ]);
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(rules(t)).toEqual(["r_ok"]);
    expect(t.notify.errors.map((e) => [e.rule, e.failure.code])).toEqual([
      ["r_nothing", "absent"],
      ["r_text", "not-a-list"],
    ]);
  });

  it("a value that is null is an error", () => {
    const def = flow([rule("r", "StageEntered", "Start", { parts: { parts: [{ value: "event.status", kind: "text" }] } })]);
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(t.notify.messages).toEqual([]);
    expect(t.notify.errors.map((e) => [e.rule, e.failure.code])).toEqual([["r", "null-value"]]);
  });

  it("a when that is false sends nothing and is no error", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(flow([rule("r", "RequestStarted", null, { when: "event.by.id == 'someone-else'" })])).start();
    expect(t.notify).toEqual({ messages: [], errors: [] });
  });
});

describe("Stuck", () => {
  it("matches a turn that leaves the request stuck, at the turn's last event, with {reason, stage}", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(nobody([N_STOPPED])).start();
    const [m] = t.notify.messages;
    expect(m).toMatchObject({ rule: "n_stopped", to: [{ type: "workflowAdmins" }], message: { words: "request.stuck" } });
    expect(m?.event).toEqual({ type: "Stuck", seq: t.events.at(-1)?.seq, at: t.events.at(-1)?.at, payload: { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Ask" } });
  });

    const def = withOrigins(nobody([N_STOPPED, rule("r_ask", "Stuck", null, { when: "event.stage == 'st_ask'" })]));
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(t.notify.messages.map((m) => [m.rule, m.event.payload])).toEqual([
      ["n_stopped", { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_ask" }],
      ["r_ask", { reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_ask" }],
    ]);

  it("does not match a turn that ends in the same stuck state", () => {

    d.start();

  });

  it("does not match when the request stops being stuck", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(nobody([N_STOPPED]));
    d.start();
    expect(rules(d.close())).toEqual([]);
  });

    expect(matchNotifications(def, t.before, t.events, t.after, { stuckAfter: null }).messages).toEqual([]);
  });
});

/**
 * outboundEvents: the CloudEvents a turn publishes (integrations.md section 13.2), without position.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { EventRule } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { outboundEventId, outboundEvents } from "../../../src/kernel/notify/index.ts";
import { admin, rita, waitId } from "../decide/build.ts";
import { nobody, statuses, withOrigins } from "./defs.ts";
import { NotifyDriver, type Turn } from "./drive.ts";

const rows = (t: Turn): [string, string, number][] => t.outbound.events.map((r) => [r.ruleId, r.body.type, r.seq]);
const seqOf = (t: Turn, type: string, stage?: string): number | undefined =>
  t.events.find((e) => e.type === type && (stage === undefined || (e.payload as { stage?: string }).stage === stage))?.seq;

function told(id: string, o: Partial<EventRule> = {}): EventRule {
  return { id, on: { event: "StageEntered", element: "Pass" }, when: "true", told: { id: "tt_passed", words: "Passed" }, values: {}, ...o };
}

describe("the envelope", () => {
  it("is CloudEvents 1.0 with the extensions and no position", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(statuses()).start();
    const started = t.outbound.events[0];
    expect(started?.body).toEqual({
      specversion: "1.0",
      id: outboundEventId("req-1", 1, "$request.started"),
      source: "https://wf.example/workflows/test-workflow",
      type: "request.started@1",
      subject: "req-1",
      time: t.events[0]?.at,
      datacontenttype: "application/json",
      workflow: "test-workflow",
      workflowversion: 1,
      readableid: "1",
      data: { startedBy: rita, trigger: null },
    });
    expect(started?.body).not.toHaveProperty("position");
  });

  it("has the id <request ID>/<seq>/<rule ID>", () => {
    expect(outboundEventId("req-1", 34, "$request.stuck")).toBe("req-1/34/$request.stuck");
  });
});

describe("started, statusChanged and ended", () => {
  it("a start turn publishes started at RequestStarted and the status change at the child stage's StageEntered", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(statuses()).start();
    expect(rows(t)).toEqual([
      ["$request.started", "request.started@1", 1],
      ["$request.statusChanged", "request.statusChanged@1", seqOf(t, "StageEntered", "Review")],
    ]);
    expect(t.outbound.events[1]?.body.data).toEqual({ from: null, to: { id: "review", label: "In review" } });
  });

  it("compares the status once per turn: a stage passed through publishes nothing; a close by the workflow ends it", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(statuses());
    d.start();
    const t = d.act(waitId("Review.rev", "a3"));
    expect(rows(t)).toEqual([
      ["$request.statusChanged", "request.statusChanged@1", seqOf(t, "StageEntered", "Done")],
      ["$request.ended", "request.ended@1", seqOf(t, "RequestClosed")],
    ]);
    expect(t.outbound.events[0]?.body.data).toEqual({ from: { id: "review", label: "In review" }, to: { id: "done", label: "Done" } });
    // The ending the request finished at (E-32); a hand-written definition with no origin map reports its own stage.
    expect(t.outbound.events[1]?.body.data).toEqual({ status: { id: "done", label: "Done" }, closedBy: "workflow", by: null, stage: "Done" });
  });

  it("a re-entry of a stage with the same status publishes no status change", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(statuses());
    d.start();
    expect(rows(d.retry())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a turn whose input is a late call result publishes nothing, even for a rule on CallResultLate", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(statuses([told("act_late", { on: { event: "CallResultLate", element: null } })]));
    d.start();
    d.act(waitId("Review.rev", "a3"));
    const late = d.answer(waitId("Review.w", "a3"), "ok", {});
    expect(late.events.map((e) => e.type)).toEqual(["CallResultLate"]);
    expect(late.outbound).toEqual({ events: [], errors: [] });
  });
});

describe("stuck and unstuck", () => {
  it("publishes stuck at the turn's last event when the request becomes stuck", () => {
    const t = new NotifyDriver(nobody([])).start();
    expect(rows(t).map((r) => r[0])).toEqual(["$request.started", "$request.statusChanged", "$request.stuck"]);
    const stuck = t.outbound.events[2];
    expect(stuck?.seq).toBe(t.events.at(-1)?.seq);
    expect(stuck?.body.data).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Ask" });
  });

  it("a retry that ends stuck in the same state publishes nothing", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(nobody([]));
    d.start();
    expect(rows(d.retry())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a turn that faults publishes stuck in its new state, with no unstuck", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(nobody([]));
    d.start();
    const t = d.answer(waitId("Ask.read", "a3"), "failed", { code: "down", message: "down" });
    expect(rows(t)).toEqual([["$request.stuck", "request.stuck@1", t.events.at(-1)?.seq]]);
    expect(t.outbound.events[0]?.body.data).toEqual({ reason: "action-failed", stage: "Ask" });
  });

  it("an admin close publishes unstuck, then ended, at RequestClosed, both by the admin", () => {
    const d = new NotifyDriver(nobody([]));
    d.start();
    const t = d.close();
    const closed = seqOf(t, "RequestClosed");
    expect(rows(t)).toEqual([
      ["$request.unstuck", "request.unstuck@1", closed],
      ["$request.ended", "request.ended@1", closed],
    ]);
    expect(t.outbound.events[0]?.body.data).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Ask", by: admin });
    expect(t.outbound.events[1]?.body.data).toEqual({ status: { id: "asking", label: "Asking" }, closedBy: "admin", by: admin, stage: null });
  });

  it("stuck, unstuck and a rule on Stuck carry the authored stage, found through the origin map (E-27)", () => {
    const def = { ...withOrigins(nobody([])), events: [told("act_stuck", { on: { event: "Stuck", element: null }, values: { where: "event.stage" } })] };
    const d = new NotifyDriver(def);
    const started = d.start();
    expect(started.outbound.events.find((r) => r.ruleId === "$request.stuck")?.body.data).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_ask" });
    expect(started.outbound.events.find((r) => r.ruleId === "act_stuck")?.body.data).toEqual({ told: { id: "tt_passed", words: "Passed" }, values: { where: "st_ask" } });
    expect(d.close().outbound.events[0]?.body.data).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "st_ask", by: admin });
  });
});

describe("told", () => {
  it("publishes a rule whose when is true, with values as of its event; none leaves a name out", () => {
    const def = statuses([told("act_tell", { values: { x: "data.x", y: "data.?y", by: "request.by" } })]);
    const d = new NotifyDriver(def);
    d.start();
    const t = d.act(waitId("Review.rev", "a3"));
    const row = t.outbound.events.find((r) => r.ruleId === "act_tell");
    expect(row?.seq).toBe(seqOf(t, "StageEntered", "Pass"));
    expect(row?.body.type).toBe("request.told@1");
    expect(row?.body.id).toBe(outboundEventId("req-1", row?.seq ?? 0, "act_tell"));
    expect(row?.body.data).toEqual({ told: { id: "tt_passed", words: "Passed" }, values: { x: 5, by: rita } });
  });

  it("orders rows by source seq, then platform rules, then event rules in declared order", () => {
    const def = statuses([told("act_b", { on: { event: "StageEntered", element: "Done" } }), told("act_a", { on: { event: "StageEntered", element: "Done" } })]);
    const d = new NotifyDriver(def);
    d.start();
    expect(rows(d.act(waitId("Review.rev", "a3"))).map((r) => r[0])).toEqual(["$request.statusChanged", "act_b", "act_a", "$request.ended"]);
  });

  it("a rule whose when is false publishes nothing; one whose expression errors publishes nothing and returns the error", () => {
    const def = statuses([told("act_no", { when: "data.x == 0" }), told("act_err", { values: { v: "event.nothere" } }), told("act_ok")]);
    const d = new NotifyDriver(def);
    d.start();
    const t = d.act(waitId("Review.rev", "a3"));
    expect(t.outbound.events.filter((r) => r.body.type === "request.told@1").map((r) => r.ruleId)).toEqual(["act_ok"]);
    expect(t.outbound.errors.map((e) => [e.rule, e.seq, e.failure.code])).toEqual([["act_err", seqOf(t, "StageEntered", "Pass"), "no-such-key"]]);
  });

  it("a rule on Stuck reads {reason, stage}", () => {
    const def = { ...nobody([]), events: [told("act_stuck", { on: { event: "Stuck", element: null }, values: { why: "event.reason" } })] };
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(t.outbound.events.at(-1)?.body.data).toEqual({ told: { id: "tt_passed", words: "Passed" }, values: { why: "nobody-to-ask" } });
  });
});

describe("near misses", () => {
  it("a turn with no events publishes nothing", () => {
    const def = statuses([told("act_ok")]);
    const t = new NotifyDriver(def).start();
    expect(outboundEvents(def, t.after, [], t.after)).toEqual({ events: [], errors: [] });
  });
});

/**
 * checkDefinition on engine/design/examples/change-request-demo.definition.json: the demo has no problem;
 * for every check, the smallest edit of a copy that fails it, and where it makes sense a near miss that
 * passes.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { ChildStage, PersonWait, PublishedDefinition, Transition, CallWait } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { checkDefinition, PUBLISH_CHECKS, PUBLISH_WARNINGS, type PublishCode, type PublishProblem } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { loadExampleDefinition } from "../cases/workflow-cases.ts";

const demo = loadExampleDefinition("change-request-demo");

function edit(fn: (d: PublishedDefinition) => void): PublishedDefinition {
  const d = structuredClone(demo);
  fn(d);
  return d;
}

function stage(d: PublishedDefinition, id: string): ChildStage {
  const s = d.root.stages.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (s === undefined) throw new Error(`no stage ${id}`);
  return s;
}

function transition(d: PublishedDefinition, stageId: string, id: string): Transition {
  const t = stage(d, stageId).transitions.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (t === undefined) throw new Error(`no transition ${id}`);
  return t;
}

function person(d: PublishedDefinition, stageId: string, id: string): PersonWait {
  const w = stage(d, stageId).waits.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (w === undefined || w.kind !== "person") throw new Error(`no person wait ${id}`);
  return w;
}

function callWait(d: PublishedDefinition, stageId: string, id: string): CallWait {
  const w = stage(d, stageId).waits.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (w === undefined || w.kind !== "call") throw new Error(`no call wait ${id}`);
  return w;
}

/** Adds a transition with its origin, so the edit adds no origin problem of its own. */
function addTransition(d: PublishedDefinition, stageId: string, t: Transition): void {
  stage(d, stageId).transitions.push(t);
  d.origins[`transition:${stageId}.${t.id}`] = { item: [stageId, t.id], part: null };
}

function addStage(d: PublishedDefinition, s: ChildStage): void {
  d.root.stages.push(s);
  d.origins[`stage:${s.id}`] = { item: [s.id], part: null };
  for (const t of s.transitions) d.origins[`transition:${s.id}.${t.id}`] = { item: [s.id, t.id], part: null };
}

/** Every problem's severity follows from its code: a warning only for the codes PUBLISH_WARNINGS lists. */
function severityMismatches(problems: readonly PublishProblem[]): PublishProblem[] {
  return problems.filter((p) => p.severity !== (PUBLISH_WARNINGS.has(p.code) ? "warning" : "error"));
}

const codes = (d: PublishedDefinition): PublishCode[] => {
  const problems = checkDefinition(d);
  expect(severityMismatches(problems)).toEqual([]);
  return problems.map((p) => p.code);
};

/** The problems without their severity, which `severityMismatches` checks apart. */
function only(d: PublishedDefinition): Omit<PublishProblem, "severity">[] {
  const problems = checkDefinition(d);
  expect(severityMismatches(problems)).toEqual([]);
  return problems.map((p) => ({ code: p.code, pointer: p.pointer, params: p.params }));
}

describe("checkDefinition: the demo", () => {
  it("has no problem", () => {
    expect(checkDefinition(demo)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("lists every code once, kebab-case, with a meaning", () => {
    for (const [code, meaning] of Object.entries(PUBLISH_CHECKS)) {
      expect(code).toMatch(/^[a-z]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/);
      expect(meaning.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    }
  });
});

describe("identifiers", () => {
  it("id-invalid: a workflow ID out of its pattern", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (d.workflow = "Change_Request")))).toEqual([
      { code: "id-invalid", pointer: "/workflow", params: { kind: "workflow", id: "Change_Request" } },
    ]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.workflow = "cr-2")))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("id-invalid: a stage named root, an outcome, a check, a constant named like a variable", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (stage(d, "Released").id = "root")))).toContain("id-invalid");
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (person(d, "Request", "form").outcomes[0]!.id = "sub mit")))).toContain("id-invalid");
    const reserved = edit((d) => {
      d.constants["data"] = 1;
      d.types.constants["data"] = { type: "integer" };
    });
    expect(only(reserved)).toEqual([{ code: "id-invalid", pointer: "/constants/data", params: { kind: "constant", id: "data" } }]);
  });

  it("id-invalid: a connection, an op and a schema reference out of their patterns", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (callWait(d, "CreateTicket", "ticket").op = "create_issue@1")))).toContain("id-invalid");
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (callWait(d, "CreateTicket", "ticket").connection = "Jira")))).toContain("id-invalid");
  });

  it("version-out-of-range", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (d.version = 2147483648)))).toEqual([{ code: "version-out-of-range", pointer: "/version", params: { version: 2147483648 } }]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.version = 2147483647)))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("id-duplicate: two statuses with one ID", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => d.statuses.push({ id: "released", label: "Again", color: "green" })))).toEqual([
      { code: "id-duplicate", pointer: "/statuses/6/id", params: { kind: "status", id: "released" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("id-duplicate: a wait and a transition share the stage's one namespace", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (transition(d, "Request", "t_skip").id = "form")))).toContain("id-duplicate");
  });

  it("connection-reserved", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      callWait(x, "CreateTicket", "ticket").connection = "engine";
      x.types.results["engine"] = x.types.results["jira"]!;
      delete x.types.results["jira"];
    });
    expect(checkDefinition(d).map((p) => [p.code, p.pointer])).toEqual([
      ["connection-reserved", "/root/stages/3/waits/0/connection"],
      ["connection-reserved", "/types/results/engine"],
    ]);
  });

  it("wait-id-prefix: a wait ID that is a .-prefix of another in the same scope", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      const w = structuredClone(person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision"));
      w.id = "primary";
      w.role = "option";
      stage(x, "Pending").waits.push(w);
      x.origins["wait:Pending.primary"] = { item: ["Pending"], part: null };
      x.origins["outcome:Pending.primary/approve"] = { item: ["Pending"], part: null };
      x.origins["outcome:Pending.primary/reject"] = { item: ["Pending"], part: null };
    });
    expect(codes(d).filter((c) => c === "wait-id-prefix")).toHaveLength(2);
    // primary.members and primary.decision share a namespace but neither is a prefix of the other.
    expect(codes(demo)).not.toContain("wait-id-prefix");
  });

  it("path-segment-invalid", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (transition(d, "CreateTicket", "t_ticket").set[0]!.path = ["eng-lead"])))).toContainEqual({
      code: "path-segment-invalid",
      pointer: "/root/stages/3/transitions/0/set/0/path/0",
      params: { segment: "eng-lead" },
    });
  });

  it("schema-property-invalid", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      (x.schemas["changeForm@1"]!.schema["properties"] as Record<string, unknown>)["bad-name"] = { type: "string" };
    });
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "schema-property-invalid", pointer: "/schemas/changeForm@1/schema/properties/bad-name", params: { property: "bad-name" } }]);
  });
});

describe("stages, start and targets", () => {
  it("initial-unknown", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.root.initial = "Nope")))).toContain("initial-unknown");
  });

  it("start-not-person-wait-of-initial", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (d.start = "Pending.primary.decision")))).toEqual([
      { code: "start-not-person-wait-of-initial", pointer: "/start", params: { start: "Pending.primary.decision", initial: "Request" } },
    ]);
    // A call wait of root.initial is not a person wait.
    const call = edit((d) => {
      d.root.initial = "AssignLead";
      d.start = "AssignLead.leads";
    });
    expect(codes(call)).toContain("start-not-person-wait-of-initial");
  });

  it("transition-target-unknown", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (transition(d, "Pending", "t_reject").to = "Gone")))).toContain("transition-target-unknown");
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (transition(d, "Pending", "t_reject").to = "root")))).toContain("transition-target-unknown");
  });

  it("status-unknown", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (stage(d, "Pending").status = "nope")))).toEqual([{ code: "status-unknown", pointer: "/root/stages/1/status", params: { status: "nope" } }]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (stage(d, "Pending").status = null)))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("final-stage-not-empty", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => addTransition(x, "Released", { id: "t_again", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Rejected" }));
    expect(codes(d)).toEqual(["final-stage-not-empty"]);
  });

  it("otherwise-twice and otherwise-not-last", () => {
    const twice = edit((d) => {
      addTransition(d, "InDevelopment", { id: "t_o1", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Rejected" });
      addTransition(d, "InDevelopment", { id: "t_o2", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Rejected" });
    });
    expect(codes(twice)).toEqual(["otherwise-twice", "otherwise-not-last"]);
    const notLast = edit((d) => {
      addTransition(d, "InDevelopment", { id: "t_o1", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Rejected" });
      stage(d, "InDevelopment").transitions.unshift(stage(d, "InDevelopment").transitions.pop()!);
    });
    expect(codes(notLast)).toEqual(["otherwise-not-last"]);
    const last = edit((d) => addTransition(d, "InDevelopment", { id: "t_o1", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Rejected" }));
    expect(codes(last)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("set-overlap", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => transition(x, "Pending", "t_accept").set.push({ path: ["engLead", "id"], expr: "waits.primary.decision.data.engLead.id" }));
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([
      { code: "set-overlap", pointer: "/root/stages/1/transitions/1/set/1/path", params: { path: ["engLead", "id"], overlaps: ["engLead"] } },
    ]);
    const disjoint = edit((x) => {
      transition(x, "Pending", "t_accept").set.push({ path: ["ticket"], expr: "'none'" });
    });
    expect(codes(disjoint)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("set-overlap: a later path above an earlier one overlaps too", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => transition(x, "Pending", "t_accept").set.unshift({ path: ["engLead", "id"], expr: "waits.primary.decision.data.engLead.id" }));
    expect(codes(d)).toEqual(["set-overlap"]);
  });

  it("data-path-maybe-absent: a Set that may give optional.none() does not make its path present", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (transition(x, "Pending", "t_accept").set[0]!.expr = "waits.primary.decision.data.?engLead"));
    expect(only(d).map((p) => [p.code, p.pointer])).toEqual([
      ["data-path-maybe-absent", "/root/stages/3/waits/0/args/assignee"],
      ["data-path-maybe-absent", "/root/stages/4/waits/0/assignees"],
    ]);
  });

  it("outcomes-not-covered", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      stage(x, "Pending").transitions.shift();
      delete x.origins["transition:Pending.t_reject"];
    });
    const problems = only(d);
    expect(problems.map((p) => p.code)).toEqual(["outcomes-not-covered"]);
    expect(problems[0]?.params).toEqual({ stage: "Pending", combination: { "primary.members": "ok", "primary.decision": "reject" } });
    // Near miss: a test with `in` covers the same outcome.
    const withIn = edit((x) => (transition(x, "Pending", "t_reject").when = "waits.primary.decision.outcome in ['reject']"));
    expect(codes(withIn)).toEqual([]);
    // Near miss: an otherwise covers what is left (in a stage with no membership read).
    const withOtherwise = edit((x) => {
      transition(x, "Request", "t_approve").otherwise = true;
      transition(x, "Request", "t_approve").when = null;
      transition(x, "Request", "t_approve").set = [];
      transition(x, "Request", "t_skip").to = "Pending";
      transition(x, "Request", "t_approve").to = "Rejected";
    });
    expect(codes(withOtherwise)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("outcomes-not-covered: a condition that also reads data does not cover", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (transition(x, "InDevelopment", "t_release").when = "waits.release.task.outcome == 'released' && data.ticket != ''"));
    expect(codes(d)).toEqual(["outcomes-not-covered"]);
  });

  it("outcomes-not-covered: a stage with no waits and no transitions", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => addStage(x, { id: "Dead", final: false, status: null, waits: [], transitions: [] }));
    expect(codes(d)).toEqual(["stage-cannot-end", "outcomes-not-covered"]);
  });

  it("stage-cannot-end", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (transition(x, "InDevelopment", "t_release").to = "InDevelopment"));
    // Every stage that leads only into InDevelopment cannot end either.
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([
      { code: "stage-cannot-end", pointer: "/root/stages/2", params: { stage: "AssignLead" } },
      { code: "stage-cannot-end", pointer: "/root/stages/3", params: { stage: "CreateTicket" } },
      { code: "stage-cannot-end", pointer: "/root/stages/4", params: { stage: "InDevelopment" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("cycle-without-wait", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      addStage(x, {
        id: "Route",
        final: false,
        status: null,
        waits: [],
        transitions: [
          { id: "t_again", otherwise: false, when: "data.?ticket.orValue('') == 'x'", set: [], to: "Route" },
          { id: "t_done", otherwise: false, when: "true", set: [], to: "Released" },
        ],
      });
    });
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "cycle-without-wait", pointer: "/root/stages/7/transitions/0", params: { stage: "Route", to: "Route" } }]);
    // A self-target whose condition reads the stage's own wait passes: the wait opens again.
    const gated = edit((x) => addTransition(x, "InDevelopment", { id: "t_redo", otherwise: false, when: "waits.release.task.outcome == 'released'", set: [], to: "InDevelopment" }));
    expect(codes(gated)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("cycle-without-wait: an otherwise of a stage with no wait is no condition on a wait", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      addStage(x, { id: "A", final: false, status: null, waits: [], transitions: [{ id: "t_b", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "B" }] });
      addStage(x, {
        id: "B",
        final: false,
        status: null,
        waits: [],
        transitions: [
          { id: "t_end", otherwise: false, when: "data.?ticket.orValue('') == 'x'", set: [], to: "Released" },
          { id: "t_a", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "A" },
        ],
      });
    });
    expect(codes(d)).toEqual(["cycle-without-wait", "cycle-without-wait"]);
  });

  it("read-key-scope", () => {
    const keyed = edit((d) => {
      const w = callWait(d, "AssignLead", "leads");
      w.keyScope = null;
      w.idempotencyKey = "'k.' + request.id";
    });
    expect(only(keyed)).toEqual([{ code: "read-key-scope", pointer: "/root/stages/2/waits/0/keyScope", params: { wait: "leads" } }]);
    // A write may have an explicit key; the demo's ticket does.
    expect(callWait(demo, "CreateTicket", "ticket").idempotencyKey).toBe("'ticket.' + request.id");
  });
});

  it("schema-unknown and schema-unused", () => {

    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.schemas["extra@1"] = { id: "extra", version: 1, schema: { type: "object" } })))).toEqual(["schema-unused"]);

  it("schema-ref-mismatch", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.schemas["changeForm@1"]!.version = 2)))).toEqual(["schema-ref-mismatch"]);
  });

  it("types-data-missing and types-data-unused", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => delete d.types.data["ticket"]))).toEqual(["types-data-missing"]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.types.data["extra"] = { type: "string" })))).toEqual(["types-data-unused"]);
  });

  it("types-constant-missing, types-constant-unused, constant-does-not-fit", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => delete d.types.constants["jiraProject"]))).toEqual(["types-constant-missing"]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.types.constants["extra"] = { type: "string" })))).toEqual(["types-constant-unused"]);
    expect(only(edit((d) => ((d.constants["jiraProject"] as Record<string, unknown>)["A"] = 5)))).toEqual([
      { code: "constant-does-not-fit", pointer: "/constants/jiraProject/A", params: { constant: "jiraProject", rule: "wrong-kind" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("types-result-missing and types-result-unused", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => delete d.types.results["jira"]))).toContain("types-result-missing");
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.types.results["jira"]!["closeIssue@1"] = { type: "object" })))).toEqual(["types-result-unused"]);
  });
});

describe("expressions", () => {
  it("expression-invalid: an unknown name", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (transition(x, "InDevelopment", "t_release").when = "waits.release.task.outcome == releasd"));
    const p = only(d);
    expect(p.map((x) => x.code)).toContain("expression-invalid");
    expect(p.find((x) => x.code === "expression-invalid")?.pointer).toBe("/root/stages/4/transitions/0/when");
  });

  it("expression-invalid: a data key that types.data does not declare, and a type mix", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (person(d, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "data.nope == 'x'")))).toEqual(["expression-invalid"]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (person(d, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "size(data.form.title) == 1.0")))).toEqual(["expression-invalid"]);
  });

  it("expression-invalid: input is only in checks and lookups; actor not in transitions", () => {
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (transition(d, "InDevelopment", "t_release").when = "actor.id != '' && waits.release.task.outcome == 'released'")))).toContain(
      "expression-invalid",
    );
    const check = edit((d) => person(d, "Request", "form").outcomes[0]!.checks.push({ id: "c_title", when: "input.title != '' && actor.id != ''", message: "" }));
    check.origins["check:Request.form/submit/c_title"] = { item: ["Request", "form"], part: null };
    expect(codes(check)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("expression-wrong-type", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (person(d, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "1")))).toEqual([
      { code: "expression-wrong-type", pointer: "/root/stages/1/waits/1/may", params: { expected: "bool", type: "int" } },
    ]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (person(d, "Pending", "primary.decision").assignees = "approverGroup['A']")))).toEqual(["expression-wrong-type"]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (d.notifications[0]!.when = "optional.of(true)")))).toEqual(["expression-wrong-type"]);
  });

  it("set-type-mismatch", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (transition(d, "CreateTicket", "t_ticket").set[0]!.expr = "size(waits.ticket.data.key)")))).toEqual([
      { code: "set-type-mismatch", pointer: "/root/stages/3/transitions/0/set/0/expr", params: { path: ["ticket"], declared: "string", type: "int" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("pattern-unicode-class", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (person(x, "InDevelopment", "release.task").may = "data.ticket.matches('\\\\p{L}')"));
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "pattern-unicode-class", pointer: "/root/stages/4/waits/0/may", params: { start: 20, end: 28 } }]);
    const ok = edit((x) => (person(x, "InDevelopment", "release.task").may = "data.ticket.matches('[A-Z]+')"));
    expect(codes(ok)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("map-key-dollar", () => {
    expect(only(edit((d) => (callWait(d, "CreateTicket", "ticket").args["fields"] = "{'$redacted': true}")))).toEqual([
      { code: "map-key-dollar", pointer: "/root/stages/3/waits/0/args/fields", params: { key: "$redacted" } },
    ]);
    expect(codes(edit((d) => (callWait(d, "CreateTicket", "ticket").args["fields"] = "{'redacted': true}")))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("wait-out-of-scope", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (transition(x, "InDevelopment", "t_release").when = "waits.release.task.outcome == 'released' || waits.form.outcome == 'submit'"));
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "wait-out-of-scope", pointer: "/root/stages/4/transitions/0/when", params: { path: "form.outcome" } }]);
  });

  it("opening-reads-sibling-wait", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").assignees = "waits.primary.members.status == 'completed' ? [approverGroup['A']] : []"));
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "opening-reads-sibling-wait", pointer: "/root/stages/1/waits/1/assignees", params: { wait: "primary.members" } }]);
    // may is evaluated at act time, when every wait of the stage is open: it may read a sibling.
    expect(codes(edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "waits.primary.members.status != 'open'")))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("opening-reads-sibling-wait: call args and keys too", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => {
      callWait(x, "CreateTicket", "ticket").idempotencyKey = "'k.' + waits.ticket.status";
    });
    expect(codes(d)).toEqual(["opening-reads-sibling-wait"]);
  });

  it("wait-data-unguarded", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (transition(x, "Pending", "t_accept").when = "waits.primary.decision.status == 'completed'"));
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "wait-data-unguarded", pointer: "/root/stages/1/transitions/1/set/0/expr", params: { wait: "primary.decision" } }]);
  });

  it("wait-data-unguarded: the guard may be in the expression, under && or in the true branch of ?:", () => {
    const and = edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "waits.primary.members.outcome == 'ok' && size(waits.primary.members.data.groups) > 0"));
    expect(codes(and)).toEqual([]);
    const ternary = edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "waits.primary.members.outcome == 'ok' ? size(waits.primary.members.data.groups) > 0 : true"));
    expect(codes(ternary)).toEqual([]);
    const elseBranch = edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "waits.primary.members.outcome == 'ok' ? true : size(waits.primary.members.data.groups) > 0"));
    expect(codes(elseBranch)).toEqual(["wait-data-unguarded"]);
    const or = edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "waits.primary.members.outcome == 'ok' || size(waits.primary.members.data.groups) > 0"));
    expect(codes(or)).toEqual(["wait-data-unguarded"]);
  });

  it("outcome-unknown", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => (person(x, "Pending", "primary.decision").may = "waits.primary.members.outcome != 'okay'"));
    expect(only(d)).toEqual([{ code: "outcome-unknown", pointer: "/root/stages/1/waits/1/may", params: { wait: "primary.members", outcome: "okay" } }]);
  });

  it("failed-not-handled", () => {
    const d = edit((x) => addTransition(x, "AssignLead", { id: "t_fail", otherwise: false, when: "waits.leads.outcome == 'failed'", set: [], to: "Rejected" }));

/**
 * The publish check makes two faults unreachable (kernel spec section 3, E-26): `set-overlap` and
 * `unknown-stage`. A property test over variants of the demo definition: each variant retargets a
 * transition, adds or drops a Set. For every variant that passes checkDefinition, every input of every demo
 * case (test-cases.yaml) is run through the in-memory host, and no turn may record one of the two faults. The refused variants show the property is not
 * empty: run anyway, some of them do record those faults.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { AnyEventRecord, PublishedDefinition } from "../../../src/format/index.ts";
import { createMemoryHost } from "../../../src/host/index.ts";
import { checkDefinition } from "../../../src/kernel/publish/index.ts";
import { expandTurns, loadExampleDefinition, loadWorkflowCases, runInput } from "../cases/workflow-cases.ts";

const FORBIDDEN = new Set(["set-overlap", "unknown-stage"]);
const file = loadWorkflowCases("change-request-demo");
const demo = loadExampleDefinition("change-request-demo");
const REQUEST_ID = "req-1";
const START = Date.parse("2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z");

function at(n: number): string {
  return new Date(START + n * 1000).toISOString().replace("Z", "000Z");
}

interface Variant {
  name: string;
  definition: PublishedDefinition;
}

function variant(name: string, fn: (d: PublishedDefinition) => void): Variant {
  const d = structuredClone(demo);
  fn(d);
  return { name, definition: d };
}

function variants(): Variant[] {
  const out: Variant[] = [];
  const stages = demo.root.stages;
  const targets = [...stages.map((s) => s.id), "Nowhere"];
  stages.forEach((s, si) => {
    s.transitions.forEach((t, ti) => {
      for (const to of targets) {
        if (to !== t.to) out.push(variant(`${s.id}.${t.id} -> ${to}`, (d) => (d.root.stages[si]!.transitions[ti]!.to = to)));
      }
      t.set.forEach((entry, ei) => {
        out.push(variant(`${s.id}.${t.id} without set ${ei}`, (d) => d.root.stages[si]!.transitions[ti]!.set.splice(ei, 1)));
        out.push(variant(`${s.id}.${t.id} sets ${entry.path.join(".")} twice`, (d) => d.root.stages[si]!.transitions[ti]!.set.push({ ...entry })));
        out.push(
          variant(`${s.id}.${t.id} also sets below ${entry.path.join(".")}`, (d) => d.root.stages[si]!.transitions[ti]!.set.push({ path: [...entry.path, "id"], expr: "'x'" })),
        );
      });
    });
  });
  return out;
}

/** Every fault code the demo cases' inputs record on a definition; inputs that throw are listed too. */
function faultsOf(definition: PublishedDefinition): { codes: string[]; thrown: string[] } {
  const codes: string[] = [];
  const thrown: string[] = [];
  for (const c of file.cases) {
    const host = createMemoryHost(definition, { directory: file.fixtures.directory, admins: [file.fixtures.people["admin"] ?? ""] });
    expandTurns(c, file.cases).forEach((t, i) => {
      try {
        runInput(host, REQUEST_ID, t.input ?? {}, at(i));
      } catch (error) {
        thrown.push(`${c.id} turn ${i + 1}: ${String(error)}`);
      }
    });
    // A start that was refused leaves no request.
    let events: readonly AnyEventRecord[];
    try {
      events = host.events(REQUEST_ID);
    } catch {
      events = [];
    }
    for (const e of events) if (e.type === "Faulted") codes.push(e.payload.error.code);
  }
  return { codes, thrown };
}

describe("faults a publish check makes unreachable", () => {
  const all = variants();
  const passed = all.filter((v) => checkDefinition(v.definition).length === 0);
  const refused = all.filter((v) => !passed.includes(v));

  it("the variants include some that pass and some that are refused", () => {
    expect(passed.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(refused.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });

  it("decide never records set-overlap or unknown-stage on a definition that passed", () => {
    const bad: string[] = [];
    for (const v of [{ name: "the demo", definition: demo }, ...passed]) {
      const { codes, thrown } = faultsOf(v.definition);
      for (const code of codes) if (FORBIDDEN.has(code)) bad.push(`${v.name}: ${code}`);
      for (const t of thrown) bad.push(`${v.name}: threw ${t}`);
    }
    expect(bad).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("some refused variants do record those faults when run anyway", () => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (const v of refused) for (const code of faultsOf(v.definition).codes) if (FORBIDDEN.has(code)) seen.add(code);
    expect([...seen].sort()).toEqual(["set-overlap", "unknown-stage"]);
  });
});
