/**
 * Who is calling (decision E-30): one adapter turns an HTTP request into the `Caller` the API functions take,
 * or null when nobody is signed in (the handler answers `unauthenticated`). The real sign-in belongs to the
 * existing application and is not known yet; the development host reads a development-only header.
 */
import type { Caller } from "@workflow/core";

export interface CallerAdapter {
  /** The signed-in caller, or null when there is none. */
  callerOf(request: Request): Promise<Caller | null>;
}

/** The development host's headers: the user's directory object ID, and "true" for a platform admin. */
export const DEV_USER_HEADER = "x-dev-user";
export const DEV_PLATFORM_ADMIN_HEADER = "x-dev-platform-admin";

/** A directory object ID: 1 to 255 characters, no white space or control character. */
const DIRECTORY_ID = /^[^\s\p{Cc}]{1,255}$/u;

/** Development only: the caller named by the `x-dev-user` header. Never mount it outside the development host. */
export function devHeaderCaller(): CallerAdapter {
  return {
    async callerOf(request) {
      const user = request.headers.get(DEV_USER_HEADER);
      if (user === null || !DIRECTORY_ID.test(user)) return null;
      return { user, platformAdmin: request.headers.get(DEV_PLATFORM_ADMIN_HEADER) === "true" };
    },
  };
}
===\nengine/packages/server/src/api/runtime/admin.ts\n===
/**
 * Retry and close (runtime-api.md 5.1): one admin turn each. Who may is decided before the lock (the
 * caller's groups are an outside lookup); everything else is decided under the lock, in the document's
 * order: not-admin and reason-required (`refuseFirst`), the turn's own stale check, then request-closed and
 * for retry not-stuck and not-retryable (the planner).
 */
import type { Caller, Result } from "@workflow/core";
import type { AdminPlanner, TurnRefusal } from "../../turn/types.ts";
import { BodyProblem, integer, object, shapeOf, string } from "../shared/body.ts";
import { fail, isWorkflowAdmin, loadRequest, ok, publishedOf, userRef, type Ctx } from "./context.ts";
import { toApiError } from "./refusals.ts";
import type { AdminArgs, TurnDone } from "./types.ts";

const REASON_MAX = 2000;
/** The stuck reasons Retry is offered for (E-23). */
const RETRYABLE = new Set(["action-failed", "nobody-to-ask"]);

export function readAdminBody(body: unknown) {
  return shapeOf(() => {
    const o = object(body, "", ["reason", "expectedLastSeq"]);
    const reason = string(o, "reason");
    if (reason.trim().length > REASON_MAX) throw new BodyProblem("/reason", "tooLong");
    return { reason, expectedLastSeq: integer(o, "expectedLastSeq", 0) };
  });
}

const refuse = (reason: string, attempt: boolean, params: TurnRefusal["params"] = {}) => ({ refuse: { reason, attempt, params } });

export async function adminTurn(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: AdminArgs, kind: "retry" | "close"): Promise<Result<TurnDone>> {
  const body = readAdminBody({ reason: args.reason, expectedLastSeq: args.expectedLastSeq });
  if (!body.ok) return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: body.params });
  const loaded = await loadRequest(ctx, args.requestId);
  if (loaded === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
  const admin = await isWorkflowAdmin(ctx, caller, loaded.version.workflow, false);
  if (admin === "unavailable") return fail({ code: "membership-unavailable", params: {} });

  // Before the turn's own stale check: who may, and that a reason is given.
  const refuseFirst = (): TurnRefusal | null => {
    if (!admin) return { reason: "not-admin", attempt: true, params: {} };
    if (args.reason.trim() === "") return { reason: "reason-required", attempt: true, params: {} };
    return null;
  };
  // After it.
  const planner: AdminPlanner = ({ state, stuck }): ReturnType<AdminPlanner> => {
    if (state.closed !== null) return refuse("request-closed", true);
    if (kind === "close") return { actions: [{ type: "close" }] };
    if (stuck === null) return refuse("not-stuck", true);
    if (!RETRYABLE.has(stuck.reason)) return refuse("not-retryable", true, { reason: stuck.reason });
    // The kernel's retry clears any fault and re-enters the active stage.
    return { actions: [{ type: "retry" }] };
  };
  const out = await ctx.turns.admin({
    requestId: args.requestId,
    by: userRef(caller),
    reason: args.reason,
    isAdmin: admin,
    refuseFirst,
    expectedLastSeq: args.expectedLastSeq,
    actions: planner,
  });
  const published = await publishedOf(ctx, loaded.version);
  if (!out.ok) return fail(...out.refusals.map((k) => toApiError(published, k)));
  return ok({ requestId: out.requestId, lastSeq: out.lastSeq, stopped: out.stopped });
}

/**
 * The runtime API as functions (runtime-api.md 1.1): one object with every operation, which the HTTP
 * handlers call and which the existing application could call in process (E-11).
 */
import { adminTurn } from "./admin.ts";
import { listBindings, listPausedDeliveries, listRefusedStarts, retryRefusedStart, setBindingPaused, type InboundRerun } from "./bindings.ts";
import { choices } from "./choices.ts";
import { createCtx, type Ctx, type RuntimeDeps } from "./context.ts";
import { getRequest, listRequests, publishedSource } from "./requests.ts";
import { createSessionApi, type DevSession } from "./session.ts";
import { listStartable, start, startForm } from "./start.ts";
import { act, getTask, myTasks } from "./tasks.ts";
import type { RuntimeApi, SessionApi } from "./types.ts";

export interface RuntimeOptions {
  /** The inbound hook, to run a refused start again; absent: running one again answers `internal`. */
  inbound?: InboundRerun;
  /** The development host's session; absent elsewhere. */
  dev?: DevSession;
}

export interface Runtime extends RuntimeApi {
  session: SessionApi;
  /** The request's last seq, for a cheap `If-None-Match`; null when there is no such request. */
  lastSeqOf(requestId: string): Promise<number | null>;
  /** The request ID a readable ID names; null when none. */
  requestIdOfNumber(readableId: string): Promise<string | null>;
  readonly ctx: Ctx;
}

export function createRuntimeApi(deps: RuntimeDeps, options: RuntimeOptions = {}): Runtime {
  const ctx = createCtx(deps);
  return {
    ctx,
    session: createSessionApi(ctx, options.dev),
    listStartable: () => listStartable(ctx),
    startForm: (caller, args) => startForm(ctx, caller, args),
    start: (caller, args) => start(ctx, caller, args),
    choices: (caller, args) => choices(ctx, caller, args),
    myTasks: (caller, args) => myTasks(ctx, caller, args),
    getTask: (caller, args) => getTask(ctx, caller, args),
    act: (caller, args) => act(ctx, caller, args),
    retry: (caller, args) => adminTurn(ctx, caller, args, "retry"),
    close: (caller, args) => adminTurn(ctx, caller, args, "close"),
    listBindings: (caller, args) => listBindings(ctx, caller, args),
    setBindingPaused: (caller, args) => setBindingPaused(ctx, caller, args),
    listPausedDeliveries: (caller, args) => listPausedDeliveries(ctx, caller, args),
    listRefusedStarts: (caller, args) => listRefusedStarts(ctx, caller, args),
    retryRefusedStart: (caller, args) => retryRefusedStart(ctx, caller, args, options.inbound),
    publishedSource: (caller, args) => publishedSource(ctx, caller, args),
    listRequests: (caller, args) => listRequests(ctx, caller, args),
    getRequest: (caller, args) => getRequest(ctx, caller, args),
    async lastSeqOf(requestId) {
      const rows = await ctx.db.query<{ last_seq: number | string }>("SELECT last_seq FROM requests WHERE id = $1", [requestId]);
      return rows[0] === undefined ? null : Number(rows[0].last_seq);
    },
    async requestIdOfNumber(readableId) {
      if (!/^[0-9]{1,18}$/.test(readableId)) return null;
      const rows = await ctx.db.query<{ id: string }>("SELECT id FROM requests WHERE readable_id = $1::bigint", [readableId]);
      return rows[0]?.id ?? null;
    },
  };
}
===\nengine/packages/server/src/api/runtime/bindings.ts\n===
/**
 * Bindings ("Starts when") and refused starts (runtime-api.md 5.3 and 5.4). A pause is a flag in
 * `workflow_settings.paused_bindings` with one `settings_log` row per pause or resume. A paused binding keeps
 * no events: its paused-deliveries list is empty and a resume runs nothing again. A refused start, one refused
 * by a pause included, is an `inbound_log` row; running it again is the inbound hook's (`InboundRerun`).
 */
import type { Caller, Ref, Result } from "@workflow/core";
import { AT_SQL } from "../../store/events.ts";
import { formatAt } from "../../turn/turns.ts";
import { fail, isWorkflowAdmin, ok, userRef, type Ctx } from "./context.ts";
import { decodeCursor, encodeCursor, limitOf } from "./paging.ts";
import { ms, readSettings } from "./versions.ts";
import type { BindingChanged, BindingState, Page, PageArgs, PausedDelivery, RefusedStart, RetriedStart } from "./types.ts";

const DAYS_30_MS = 30 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;

/** The inbound hook's run again of a refused start for its workflow. */
export interface InboundRerun {
  rerun(id: number, workflow: string, by: Ref): Promise<Result<RetriedStart>>;
}

/** A refused start's ID: its `inbound_log` row and its workflow. */
const refusedId = (id: number | string, workflow: string): string => `${id}.${workflow}`;
function parseId(key: string): { id: number; workflow: string } | undefined {
  const m = /^([1-9][0-9]{0,17})\.(.+)$/.exec(key);
  return m === null ? undefined : { id: Number(m[1]), workflow: m[2] as string };
}

/** The highest version's bindings, in document order, each with its trigger as the catalogue names it. */
async function liveBindings(ctx: Ctx, workflow: string) {
  const highest = await ctx.versions.highest(ctx.db, workflow);
  const rec = highest === null ? null : await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, workflow, highest);
  const triggers = (rec?.definition.triggers ?? []).map((t) => ({ id: t.id, trigger: `${t.connection}.${t.event}` }));
  return { rec, triggers };
}

async function bindingState(ctx: Ctx, workflow: string, binding: string, trigger: string, version: number, paused: boolean): Promise<BindingState> {
  const state: BindingState = { binding: binding as BindingState["binding"], trigger: trigger as BindingState["trigger"], version, paused, held: 0 };
  // The last settings-log row whose paused bindings differ for this binding before and after.
  const last = await ctx.db.query<{ by: { type: string; id: string }; at: string }>(
    `SELECT by, ${AT_SQL("at")} AS at FROM settings_log
     WHERE workflow = $1 AND after ? 'pausedBindings'
       AND (coalesce(before->'pausedBindings', '[]'::jsonb) ? $2) <> (after->'pausedBindings' ? $2)
     ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,
    [workflow, binding],
  );
  const row = last[0];
  if (row !== undefined) {
    state.changedBy = { type: row.by.type === "group" ? "group" : "user", id: row.by.id };
    state.changedAt = ms(row.at);
  }
  return state;
}

export async function listBindings(ctx: Ctx, _caller: Caller, args: { workflow: string }): Promise<Result<BindingState[]>> {
  const settings = await readSettings(ctx.db, args.workflow);
  const { rec, triggers } = await liveBindings(ctx, args.workflow);
  if (settings === null && rec === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "workflow" } });
  if (rec === null) return ok([]);
  const paused = settings?.pausedBindings ?? [];
  const out: BindingState[] = [];
  for (const t of triggers) out.push(await bindingState(ctx, args.workflow, t.id, t.trigger, rec.version, paused.includes(t.id)));
  return ok(out);
}

/** The workflow's live version and the binding, when the caller looks after the workflow; or the error. */
async function adminOfBinding(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, workflow: string, binding: string) {
  const settings = await readSettings(ctx.db, workflow);
  const { rec, triggers } = await liveBindings(ctx, workflow);
  if (settings === null && rec === null) return { error: fail<never>({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "workflow" } }) };
  const trigger = triggers.find((t) => t.id === binding);
  if (rec === null || trigger === undefined) return { error: fail<never>({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "binding" } }) };
  const admin = await isWorkflowAdmin(ctx, caller, workflow, false);
  if (admin === "unavailable") return { error: fail<never>({ code: "membership-unavailable", params: {} }) };
  if (!admin) return { error: fail<never>({ code: "not-admin", params: {} }) };
  return { rec, trigger };
}

export async function setBindingPaused(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: { workflow: string; binding: string; paused: boolean }): Promise<Result<BindingChanged>> {
  const found = await adminOfBinding(ctx, caller, args.workflow, args.binding);
  if ("error" in found) return found.error;
  await ctx.db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const rows = await tx.query<{ paused_bindings: string[] }>("SELECT paused_bindings FROM workflow_settings WHERE workflow = $1 FOR UPDATE", [args.workflow]);
    const before = rows[0]?.paused_bindings ?? [];
    const after = [...before.filter((b) => b !== args.binding), ...(args.paused ? [args.binding] : [])];
    await tx.query("UPDATE workflow_settings SET paused_bindings = $2 WHERE workflow = $1", [args.workflow, after]);
    await tx.query("INSERT INTO settings_log (workflow, by, at, before, after) VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, $3::timestamptz, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb)", [
      args.workflow,
      JSON.stringify(userRef(caller)),
      formatAt(ctx.clock()),
      JSON.stringify({ pausedBindings: before }),
      JSON.stringify({ pausedBindings: after }),
    ]);
  });
  const state = await bindingState(ctx, args.workflow, args.binding, found.trigger.trigger, found.rec.version, args.paused);
  return ok(args.paused ? state : { ...state, rerun: 0, gone: 0 });
}

export async function listPausedDeliveries(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: { workflow: string; binding: string }): Promise<Result<PausedDelivery[]>> {
  const found = await adminOfBinding(ctx, caller, args.workflow, args.binding);
  return "error" in found ? found.error : ok([]);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- refused starts

type RefusedRow = {
  id: number | string;
  workflow: string;
  binding: string;
  at: string;
  problems: { code: string; where: RefusedStart["location"] | null; params: RefusedStart["params"] }[] | null;
};

/** The workflow named, or the error the caller gets for it. */
async function mayListFor(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, workflow: string): Promise<Result<true>> {
  const settings = await readSettings(ctx.db, workflow);
  if (settings === null && (await ctx.versions.highest(ctx.db, workflow)) === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "workflow" } });
  const admin = await isWorkflowAdmin(ctx, caller, workflow, false);
  if (admin === "unavailable") return fail({ code: "membership-unavailable", params: {} });
  return admin ? ok(true) : fail({ code: "not-admin", params: {} });
}

export async function listRefusedStarts(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: { workflow?: string } & PageArgs): Promise<Result<Page<RefusedStart>>> {
  const limit = limitOf(args.limit, 200);
  if (typeof limit !== "number") return fail(limit);
  if (args.workflow !== undefined) {
    const may = await mayListFor(ctx, caller, args.workflow);
    if (!may.ok) return fail(...may.errors);
  }
  const scope = JSON.stringify(["refusedStarts", args.workflow ?? null, caller.user]);
  const after = decodeCursor(args.cursor, scope);
  if (after === "invalid") return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "cursor", problem: "format" } });
  const since = formatAt(new Date(ctx.clock().getTime() - DAYS_30_MS));
  // Refused or paused in the last 30 days, and not run again since.
  // The cursor is the last row shown, as its time and row ID, so it holds when that row leaves the list.
  const [afterAt, afterId] = (after ?? ["", 0]) as [string, number];
  const rows = await ctx.db.query<RefusedRow>(
    `SELECT l.id, l.workflow, l.binding, ${AT_SQL("l.at")} AS at, l.problems FROM inbound_log l
     WHERE l.result IN ('refused', 'paused') AND l.at >= $1::timestamptz AND ($2::text IS NULL OR l.workflow = $2)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbound_log r WHERE r.retry_of = l.id)
       AND ($3 = '' OR (l.at, l.id) < (NULLIF($3, '')::timestamptz, $4))
     ORDER BY l.at DESC, l.id DESC`,
    [since, args.workflow ?? null, afterAt, afterId],
  );
  // Without a workflow: only the workflows the caller looks after (a platform admin: every one).
  const looksAfter = new Map<string, boolean>();
  const items: RefusedStart[] = [];
  const shown: RefusedRow[] = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    const id = refusedId(r.id, r.workflow);
    if (!looksAfter.has(r.workflow)) looksAfter.set(r.workflow, (await isWorkflowAdmin(ctx, caller, r.workflow, false)) === true);
    if (looksAfter.get(r.workflow) !== true) continue;
    const first = r.problems?.[0] ?? { code: "paused", where: { item: r.binding as never }, params: {} };
    const item: RefusedStart = { id, workflow: r.workflow, startsWhen: r.binding as RefusedStart["startsWhen"], at: ms(r.at), code: first.code, params: first.params };
    if (first.where !== null && first.where !== undefined) item.location = first.where;
    items.push(item);
    shown.push(r);
    if (items.length > limit) break;
  }
  const page: Page<RefusedStart> = { items: items.slice(0, limit) };
  const last = shown[limit - 1];
  if (items.length > limit && last !== undefined) page.next = encodeCursor([last.at, Number(last.id)], scope);
  return ok(page);
}

export async function retryRefusedStart(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: { id: string }, inbound?: InboundRerun): Promise<Result<RetriedStart>> {
  const key = parseId(args.id);
  const notFound = fail<RetriedStart>({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "refusedStart" } });
  if (key === undefined) return notFound;
  const rows = await ctx.db.query("SELECT 1 FROM inbound_log WHERE id = $1 AND workflow = $2 AND result IN ('refused', 'paused') AND sent IS NOT NULL", [key.id, key.workflow]);
  if (rows.length === 0) return notFound;
  const may = await mayListFor(ctx, caller, key.workflow);
  if (!may.ok) return fail(...may.errors);
  if (inbound === undefined) return fail({ code: "internal", params: {} });
  return inbound.rerun(key.id, key.workflow, userRef(caller));
}

/**
 * The choices call (runtime-api.md 3.4; integrations.md 11.2): the choices of a question whose choices
 * come from the directory or a data source, on the start form or a task. The server finds the question's
 * lookup in the stored version, works its inputs out with the kernel's `lookupInputs` over the form's answers
 * and the request's data, lists the source through its connector, and keeps the list for the entry's
 * `cacheSeconds`.
 */
import { buttonStates, type ApiError, type Caller, type ChoiceOption, type Json, type Result, type TaskInstanceId } from "@workflow/core";
import { emptyState, lookupInputs, type JsonObject, type Lookup, type RequestState, type WaitId } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { readySource, within } from "../../connectors/lookups.ts";
import { formatAt } from "../../turn/turns.ts";
import { BodyProblem, integer, object, optionalString, shapeOf, string } from "../shared/body.ts";
import { fail, loadRequest, ok, publishedOf, readingOf, userRef, type Ctx } from "./context.ts";
import { answersOf } from "./start.ts";
import { personWaitOf } from "./tasks-common.ts";
import type { ChoicesArgs, ChoicesPage } from "./types.ts";
import type { VersionRecord } from "./versions.ts";

const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 50;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const DEFAULT_CACHE_S = 60;
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S = 10;

export function readChoicesArgs(body: unknown): { ok: true; value: ChoicesArgs } | { ok: false; params: Extract<ApiError, { code: "invalid-body" }>["params"] } {
  return shapeOf(() => {
    const o = object(body, "", ["form", "question", "answers", "search", "cursor", "limit"]);
    if (o["form"] === undefined) throw new BodyProblem("/form", "missing");
    const f = object(o["form"], "/form", ["workflow", "version", "requestId", "task"]);
    const form: ChoicesArgs["form"] =
      "requestId" in f || "task" in f ? { requestId: string(f, "requestId", "/form"), task: string(f, "task", "/form") } : { workflow: string(f, "workflow", "/form"), version: integer(f, "version", 1, "/form") };
    const args: ChoicesArgs = { form, question: string(o, "question") as ChoicesArgs["question"], answers: answersOf(o) };
    const search = optionalString(o, "search");
    const cursor = optionalString(o, "cursor");
    if (search !== undefined) args.search = search;
    if (cursor !== undefined) args.cursor = cursor;
    if (o["limit"] !== undefined) args.limit = Math.min(integer(o, "limit", 1), MAX_LIMIT);
    return args;
  });
}

/** JSON with object keys sorted (JCS for the values a source's inputs hold). */
function jcs(x: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return `[${x.map(jcs).join(",")}]`;
  if (typeof x === "object" && x !== null) {
    const o = x as Record<string, unknown>;
    return `{${Object.keys(o).sort().map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${jcs(o[k])}`).join(",")}}`;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(x);
}

interface Form {
  rec: VersionRecord;
  element: string;
  state: RequestState;
  /** The task's wait, for a task; undefined on the start form. */
  wait?: WaitId;
}

async function formOf(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: ChoicesArgs): Promise<Form | ApiError> {
  if ("workflow" in args.form) {
    const rec = await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, args.form.workflow, args.form.version);
    if (rec === null) return { code: "not-found", params: { what: (await ctx.versions.highest(ctx.db, args.form.workflow)) === null ? "workflow" : "version" } };
    return { rec, element: rec.definition.start, state: emptyState() };
  }
  const loaded = await loadRequest(ctx, args.form.requestId);
  if (loaded === null) return { code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } };
  const w = personWaitOf(loaded.state, args.form.task);
  if (w === undefined) return { code: "not-found", params: { what: "task" } };
  if (w.status !== "open" || loaded.state.closed !== null) {
    // How the task ended, as its buttons report it.
    const of = { form: "task", events: loaded.events, task: args.form.task as TaskInstanceId } as const;
    const refusal = buttonStates(await publishedOf(ctx, loaded.version), of, { as: userRef(caller), isAdmin: false })[0]?.refusals[0];
    return refusal ?? { code: "wait-not-open", params: { state: "cancelled" } };
  }
  return { rec: loaded.version, element: w.id.element, state: loaded.state, wait: w.id };
}

export async function choices(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: ChoicesArgs): Promise<Result<ChoicesPage>> {
  const shape = readChoicesArgs(args);
  if (!shape.ok) return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: shape.params });
  const form = await formOf(ctx, caller, args);
  if ("code" in form) return fail(form);
  const { rec, element, state } = form;
  const reading = readingOf(rec);
  const task = reading.taskOf(element) ?? (element === rec.definition.start ? rec.index.startTask : undefined);
  if (task === undefined || !(rec.index.tasks.get(task)?.questions.has(args.question) ?? false)) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "question" } });

  const wait = reading.waitDef(element);
  const found = wait?.kind === "person" ? wait.outcomes.flatMap((o) => o.lookups.map((l) => ({ outcome: o.id, l }))).find((x) => x.l.property === args.question) : undefined;
  if (found === undefined) return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "/question", problem: "format" } });
  const unavailable = fail<ChoicesPage>({ code: "source-unavailable", params: {}, location: { item: args.question, part: "choices" } });

  // The inputs, worked out by the kernel as it will at act time; on the start form the request is the one
  // the start would record. Inputs whose expression fails give no list.
  const l: Lookup = found.l;
  const data = args.answers as JsonObject;
  const request = form.wait === undefined ? { id: "", by: { type: "user" as const, id: caller.user }, at: formatAt(ctx.clock()) } : undefined;
  const planned = lookupInputs(rec.definition, state, element, found.outcome, args.question, data, request);
  if (planned === undefined || !planned.ok) return ok({ choices: [] });

  const catalogue = ctx.catalogue.current();
  const entry = readySource(catalogue, l.connection, l.source);
  const ds = ctx.connectors.dataSource(l.connection);
  if (entry === undefined || ds === undefined) return unavailable;
  if (entry.input.some((f) => f.required && !(f.id in planned.inputs))) return ok({ choices: [] });

  const limit = args.limit ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT;
  const search = args.search === undefined || args.search === "" ? null : args.search;
  const passSearch = entry.searchable ? search : null;
  const key = jcs([l.connection, l.source, planned.inputs, passSearch, args.cursor ?? null, limit]);
  const now = ctx.clock().getTime();
  const cacheMs = (entry.cacheSeconds ?? DEFAULT_CACHE_S) * 1000;
  const hit = ctx.choicesCache.get(key);
  let listed: { items: JsonObject[]; next: string | null };
  if (hit !== undefined && hit.until > now) {
    listed = hit.value as typeof listed;
  } else {
    try {
      const a = await within(ds.list({ source: l.source, inputs: planned.inputs, search: passSearch, cursor: args.cursor ?? null, limit }), (entry.timeoutSeconds ?? DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S) * 1000);
      if (a.answer === "unavailable") return unavailable;
      listed = { items: a.items, next: a.next };
    } catch {
      return unavailable;
    }
    if (cacheMs > 0) ctx.choicesCache.set(key, { until: now + cacheMs, value: listed });
  }

  const q = search?.toLowerCase();
  const options: ChoiceOption[] = listed.items.flatMap((item) => {
    const stored = item[l.storedField];
    const label = item[l.labelField];
    if ((typeof stored !== "string" && typeof stored !== "number") || typeof label !== "string") return [];
    // A source that is not searchable is filtered here, on the label.
    if (!entry.searchable && q !== undefined && !label.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return [];
    const value: Json = l.answer === "person" ? { type: "user", id: String(stored) } : { stored, label };
    return [{ value, label }];
  });
  return ok(listed.next === null ? { choices: options } : { choices: options, next: listed.next });
}

/**
 * What every runtime operation shares: the store, the turn transaction, the connectors and the catalogue;
 * the published versions; the caller's groups and whether the caller looks after a workflow's stuck
 * requests; and a request's events read and folded.
 */
import type { ApiError, Caller, PublishedVersion, Ref, Result } from "@workflow/core";
import { fold, type AnyEventRecord, type RequestState } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { Connectors } from "../../connectors/types.ts";
import { MEMBERSHIP_TIMEOUT_MS, within } from "../../connectors/lookups.ts";
import type { Db } from "../../store/db.ts";
import { loadEvents } from "../../store/events.ts";
import type { Turns } from "../../turn/types.ts";
import type { CatalogueRegistry } from "../shared/catalogue.ts";
import { admits, lookAfterStuck, readWorkflowPeople } from "../shared/people.ts";
import { VersionReading } from "./reading.ts";
import { createVersions, type VersionRecord, type Versions } from "./versions.ts";

export interface RuntimeDeps {
  db: Db;
  /** The turn transaction, made with `connectorLookups` over the same connectors. */
  turns: Turns;
  connectors: Connectors;
  /** The catalogue now (integrations.md 8.8). */
  catalogue: CatalogueRegistry;
  versions?: Versions;
  /** The clock; default the system clock. */
  clock?: () => Date;
  /** How long the caller's groups are kept for viewer-level fields (runtime-api.md 4.2); default 60 s. */
  groupsCacheMs?: number;
}

export interface Ctx {
  db: Db;
  turns: Turns;
  connectors: Connectors;
  catalogue: CatalogueRegistry;
  versions: Versions;
  clock: () => Date;
  /** The caller's groups: live, or for viewer-level fields from the cache. Undefined: the directory could not be asked. */
  groupsOf(user: string, cached: boolean): Promise<string[] | undefined>;
  /** Choices lists, kept per entry's cacheSeconds (integrations.md 11.2). */
  choicesCache: Map<string, { until: number; value: unknown }>;
}

export function createCtx(deps: RuntimeDeps): Ctx {
  const clock = deps.clock ?? (() => new Date());
  const groupsCacheMs = deps.groupsCacheMs ?? 60_000;
  const groups = new Map<string, { until: number; groups: string[] }>();
  return {
    db: deps.db,
    turns: deps.turns,
    connectors: deps.connectors,
    catalogue: deps.catalogue,
    versions: deps.versions ?? createVersions(),
    clock,
    choicesCache: new Map(),
    async groupsOf(user, cached) {
      const now = clock().getTime();
      const hit = groups.get(user);
      if (cached && hit !== undefined && hit.until > now) return hit.groups;
      try {
        const live = await within(deps.connectors.directory.groupsOf(user), MEMBERSHIP_TIMEOUT_MS);
        groups.set(user, { until: now + groupsCacheMs, groups: live });
        return live;
      } catch {
        return undefined;
      }
    },
  };
}

export const userRef = (caller: Caller): Ref => ({ type: "user", id: caller.user });

/** Errors as a failed result. */
export const fail = <T>(...errors: ApiError[]): Result<T> => ({ ok: false, errors });
export const ok = <T>(value: T): Result<T> => ({ ok: true, value });

/**
 * Whether the caller looks after the workflow's stuck requests: a platform admin, or listed in "Stuck requests
 * go to" (absent: the authors), directly or through a group they are in now. "unavailable" when only a
 * group could admit the caller and the directory could not be asked.
 */
export async function isWorkflowAdmin(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, workflow: string, cached: boolean): Promise<boolean | "unavailable"> {
  if (caller.platformAdmin) return true;
  const people = await readWorkflowPeople(ctx.db, workflow);
  if (people === null) return false;
  const admitted = await admits(lookAfterStuck(people), caller, async () => (await ctx.groupsOf(caller.user, cached)) ?? "unavailable");
  return admitted === "unavailable" ? admitted : admitted === "yes";
}

/** A version as core's readers take it, with the catalogue now. */
export async function publishedOf(ctx: Ctx, rec: VersionRecord): Promise<PublishedVersion> {
  return { definition: rec.definition, source: rec.source, catalogue: ctx.catalogue.current() };
}

export function readingOf(rec: VersionRecord): VersionReading {
  return new VersionReading(rec.definition, rec.index);
}

export interface LoadedRequest {
  events: AnyEventRecord[];
  state: RequestState;
  version: VersionRecord;
}

/** The request's events folded, with its version; null when the request does not exist. */
export async function loadRequest(ctx: Ctx, requestId: string): Promise<LoadedRequest | null> {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(requestId)) return null;
  const events = await loadEvents(ctx.db, requestId);
  if (events.length === 0) return null;
  const state = fold(events);
  if (state.definition === null) return null;
  const version = await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, state.definition.workflow, state.definition.version);
  if (version === null) throw new Error(`request ${requestId} runs on a version that is not stored`);
  return { events, state, version };
}

/** The ETag of a request's reads (runtime-api.md 9.3). */
export function etagOf(lastSeq: number, coreVersion: string): string {
  return `W/"${lastSeq}.${coreVersion}"`;
}

/**
 * The runtime API over HTTP (runtime-api.md): Hono routes, each a function from a Request to a Response
 * (E-30). A handler parses the request, asks the adapter for the caller, calls the function and maps its
 * Result; it adds no rule. `app.fetch(request)` serves a request without a socket. An unknown path or method
 * answers `not-found` (`path`).
 */
import { Hono, type Context } from "hono";
import { coreVersion, type Caller, type Result, type StartsWhenId, type ValueId } from "@workflow/core";
import type { CallerAdapter } from "../caller.ts";
import { boolean, object, refs, shapeOf } from "../shared/body.ts";
import { asCaller, engineHeaders, errorResponse, notFoundPath, readJson, resultResponse } from "../shared/http.ts";
import type { Runtime } from "./api.ts";
import { etagOf } from "./context.ts";
import type { RequestQuery } from "./types.ts";

export const RUNTIME_BASE = "/api/workflow/v1";
/** Request bodies: JSON, at most 256 KiB (runtime-api.md 1.1). */
export const BODY_LIMIT = 262_144;

type Invalid = { field: string; problem: "missing" | "type" | "unknownField" | "empty" | "tooLong" | "format" };
const invalid = (field: string, problem: Invalid["problem"] = "format"): Response => errorResponse([{ code: "invalid-body", params: { field, problem } }]);

/** A query parameter as a positive integer, absent, or "invalid". */
function intParam(value: string | undefined, min: number): number | undefined | "invalid" {
  if (value === undefined || value === "") return undefined;
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,15}$/.test(value)) return "invalid";
  const n = Number(value);
  return n < min ? "invalid" : n;
}

const list = (value: string | undefined): string[] | undefined => (value === undefined || value === "" ? undefined : value.split(","));

/** The request list's query string (runtime-api.md 6.2). */
function requestQuery(url: URL): RequestQuery | Response {
  const q: RequestQuery = {};
  const p = url.searchParams;
  const get = (name: string): string | undefined => p.get(name) ?? undefined;
  const workflow = get("workflow");
  if (workflow !== undefined && workflow !== "") q.workflow = workflow;
  const status = list(get("status"));
  if (status !== undefined) q.status = status as NonNullable<RequestQuery["status"]>;
  const version = intParam(get("version"), 1);
  if (version === "invalid") return invalid("version");
  if (version !== undefined) q.version = version;
  const state = get("state");
  if (state !== undefined && state !== "") {
    if (state !== "open" && state !== "closed") return invalid("state");
    q.state = state;
  }
  const stuck = get("stuck");
  if (stuck !== undefined && stuck !== "") {
    if (stuck !== "true" && stuck !== "false") return invalid("stuck");
    q.stuck = stuck === "true";
  }
  const startedBy = get("startedBy");
  if (startedBy !== undefined && startedBy !== "") q.startedBy = startedBy;
  const include = list(get("include"));
  if (include !== undefined) q.include = include as NonNullable<RequestQuery["include"]>;
  const sort = get("sort");
  if (sort !== undefined && sort !== "") {
    if (sort !== "readableId" && sort !== "startedAt" && sort !== "updatedAt") return invalid("sort");
    q.sort = sort;
  }
  const order = get("order");
  if (order !== undefined && order !== "") {
    if (order !== "asc" && order !== "desc") return invalid("order");
    q.order = order;
  }
  const cursor = get("cursor");
  if (cursor !== undefined && cursor !== "") q.cursor = cursor;
  const limit = intParam(get("limit"), 1);
  if (limit === "invalid") return invalid("limit");
  if (limit !== undefined) q.limit = limit;
  for (const [name, value] of p.entries()) {
    if (!name.startsWith("value.")) continue;
    try {
      const equals = JSON.parse(value) as unknown;
      if (equals === null) return invalid(name);
      (q.valueEquals ??= []).push({ value: name.slice("value.".length) as ValueId, equals: equals as never });
    } catch {
      return invalid(name);
    }
  }
  return q;
}

/** A body read as JSON, then the function; a body that cannot be read answers its error. */
async function withBody(c: Context, fn: (body: unknown) => Promise<Response>): Promise<Response> {
  const body = await readJson(c.req.raw, BODY_LIMIT);
  return body.ok ? fn(body.value) : errorResponse(body.errors);
}

/** A request read with an ETag (runtime-api.md 9.3): 304 when nothing was recorded since. */
async function withEtag<T extends { lastSeq: number }>(c: Context, lastSeq: number | null, read: () => Promise<Result<T>>): Promise<Response> {
  const cache = { "Cache-Control": "private, no-cache" };
  const match = c.req.header("if-none-match");
  // A 304 carries the engine headers too: every response does.
  if (lastSeq !== null && match !== undefined && match === etagOf(lastSeq, coreVersion)) return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers: { ETag: match, ...cache, ...engineHeaders() } });
  return resultResponse(await read(), 200, (v) => ({ ETag: etagOf(v.lastSeq, coreVersion), ...cache }));
}

export function runtimeRoutes(api: Runtime, callers: CallerAdapter, base = RUNTIME_BASE): Hono {
  const app = new Hono().basePath(base);
  const as = (c: Context, fn: (caller: Caller) => Promise<Response>): Promise<Response> => asCaller(callers, c.req.raw, fn);
  const param = (c: Context, name: string): string => c.req.param(name) ?? "";

  // 3. Start
  app.get("/workflows/startable", (c) => as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.listStartable(caller), 200)));
  app.get("/workflows/:workflow/start-form", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const version = intParam(c.req.query("version"), 1);
      if (version === "invalid") return invalid("version");
      return resultResponse(await api.startForm(caller, version === undefined ? { workflow: param(c, "workflow") } : { workflow: param(c, "workflow"), version }), 200);
    }),
  );
  app.post("/requests", (c) =>
    as(c, (caller) =>
      withBody(c, async (body) => {
        const r = await api.start(caller, body as never);
        return resultResponse(r, r.ok && r.value.replayed ? 200 : 201);
      }),
    ),
  );
  app.post("/choices", (c) => as(c, (caller) => withBody(c, async (body) => resultResponse(await api.choices(caller, body as never), 200))));

  // 4. Tasks
  app.get("/my-tasks", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const limit = intParam(c.req.query("limit"), 1);
      if (limit === "invalid") return invalid("limit");
      const cursor = c.req.query("cursor");
      return resultResponse(await api.myTasks(caller, { ...(cursor === undefined || cursor === "" ? {} : { cursor }), ...(limit === undefined ? {} : { limit }) }), 200);
    }),
  );
  app.get("/requests/:requestId/tasks/:task", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => withEtag(c, await api.lastSeqOf(param(c, "requestId")), () => api.getTask(caller, { requestId: param(c, "requestId"), task: param(c, "task") }))),
  );
  app.post("/requests/:requestId/tasks/:task/act", (c) =>
    as(c, (caller) =>
      withBody(c, async (body) => {
        const fields = shapeOf(() => object(body, "", ["button", "answers"]));
        if (!fields.ok) return errorResponse([{ code: "invalid-body", params: fields.params }]);
        const args = { requestId: param(c, "requestId"), task: param(c, "task"), button: fields.value["button"], answers: fields.value["answers"] } as never;
        return resultResponse(await api.act(caller, args), 200);
      }),
    ),
  );

  // 5. Stuck requests, bindings and refused starts
  for (const kind of ["retry", "close"] as const) {
    app.post(`/requests/:requestId/${kind}`, (c) =>
      as(c, (caller) =>
        withBody(c, async (body) => {
          const fields = shapeOf(() => object(body, "", ["reason", "expectedLastSeq"]));
          if (!fields.ok) return errorResponse([{ code: "invalid-body", params: fields.params }]);
          const args = { requestId: param(c, "requestId"), reason: fields.value["reason"], expectedLastSeq: fields.value["expectedLastSeq"] } as never;
          return resultResponse(await api[kind](caller, args), 200);
        }),
      ),
    );
  }
  app.get("/workflows/:workflow/bindings", (c) => as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.listBindings(caller, { workflow: param(c, "workflow") }), 200)));
  app.put("/workflows/:workflow/bindings/:binding", (c) =>
    as(c, (caller) =>
      withBody(c, async (body) => {
        const read = shapeOf(() => boolean(object(body, "", ["paused"]), "paused"));
        if (!read.ok) return errorResponse([{ code: "invalid-body", params: read.params }]);
        return resultResponse(await api.setBindingPaused(caller, { workflow: param(c, "workflow"), binding: param(c, "binding") as StartsWhenId, paused: read.value }), 200);
      }),
    ),
  );
  app.get("/workflows/:workflow/bindings/:binding/paused-deliveries", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.listPausedDeliveries(caller, { workflow: param(c, "workflow"), binding: param(c, "binding") as StartsWhenId }), 200)),
  );
  app.get("/refused-starts", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const limit = intParam(c.req.query("limit"), 1);
      if (limit === "invalid") return invalid("limit");
      const workflow = c.req.query("workflow");
      const cursor = c.req.query("cursor");
      return resultResponse(
        await api.listRefusedStarts(caller, {
          ...(workflow === undefined || workflow === "" ? {} : { workflow }),
          ...(cursor === undefined || cursor === "" ? {} : { cursor }),
          ...(limit === undefined ? {} : { limit }),
        }),
        200,
      );
    }),
  );
  app.post("/refused-starts/:id/retry", (c) => as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.retryRefusedStart(caller, { id: param(c, "id") }), 200)));

  // 6. Reads
  app.get("/workflows/:workflow/versions/:version/source", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const version = intParam(param(c, "version"), 1);
      if (version === "invalid" || version === undefined) return errorResponse([{ code: "not-found", params: { what: "version" } }]);
      return resultResponse(await api.publishedSource(caller, { workflow: param(c, "workflow"), version }), 200, () => ({ "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=31536000, immutable" }));
    }),
  );
  app.get("/requests", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const q = requestQuery(new URL(c.req.url));
      return q instanceof Response ? q : resultResponse(await api.listRequests(caller, q), 200);
    }),
  );
  const debugOf = (c: Context): boolean => c.req.query("debug") === "true";
  app.get("/requests/by-number/:readableId", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const id = await api.requestIdOfNumber(param(c, "readableId"));
      return withEtag(c, id === null ? null : await api.lastSeqOf(id), () => api.getRequest(caller, { readableId: param(c, "readableId"), debug: debugOf(c) }));
    }),
  );
  app.get("/requests/:requestId", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => withEtag(c, await api.lastSeqOf(param(c, "requestId")), () => api.getRequest(caller, { requestId: param(c, "requestId"), debug: debugOf(c) }))),
  );

  // 7. Session and directory
  app.get("/session", (c) => as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.session.whoAmI(caller), 200)));
  app.put("/session", (c) =>
    as(c, (caller) =>
      withBody(c, async (body) => {
        const read = shapeOf(() => refs({ list: [object(body, "", ["person"])["person"]] }, "list")[0]);
        if (!read.ok) return errorResponse([{ code: "invalid-body", params: { ...read.params, field: "/person" } }]);
        if (read.value === undefined) return invalid("/person", "missing");
        return resultResponse(await api.session.signInAs(caller, read.value), 200);
      }),
    ),
  );
  app.get("/session/people", (c) => as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.session.people(caller), 200)));
  app.get("/directory/search", (c) =>
    as(c, async (caller) => {
      const limit = intParam(c.req.query("limit"), 1);
      if (limit === "invalid" || (limit !== undefined && limit > 50)) return invalid("limit");
      const types = list(c.req.query("types")) ?? ["user", "group"];
      if (types.some((t) => t !== "user" && t !== "group")) return invalid("types");
      return resultResponse(await api.session.search(caller, { q: c.req.query("q") ?? "", types: types as ("user" | "group")[], limit: limit ?? 50 }), 200);
    }),
  );
  app.post("/directory/lookup", (c) =>
    as(c, (caller) =>
      withBody(c, async (body) => {
        const read = shapeOf(() => refs(object(body, "", ["refs"]), "refs"));
        if (!read.ok) return errorResponse([{ code: "invalid-body", params: read.params }]);
        return resultResponse(await api.session.lookup(caller, { refs: read.value }), 200);
      }),
    ),
  );
  app.get("/directory/groups/:id/members", (c) => as(c, async (caller) => resultResponse(await api.session.membersOf(caller, { group: param(c, "id") }), 200)));

  app.notFound(() => notFoundPath());

  return app;
}

/**
 * Keyset paging (runtime-api.md 9.2): `next` is opaque, the last row's sort key and ID, bound to the query it
 * came from, so a cursor from another query is `invalid-body`.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { ApiError } from "@workflow/core";

const scopeHash = (scope: string): string => createHash("sha256").update(scope).digest("base64url").slice(0, 16);

export function encodeCursor(values: readonly unknown[], scope: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ q: scopeHash(scope), v: values })).toString("base64url");
}

/** The cursor's values; undefined without a cursor; "invalid" for one that is not this query's. */
export function decodeCursor(cursor: string | undefined, scope: string): unknown[] | undefined | "invalid" {
  if (cursor === undefined || cursor === "") return undefined;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as { q?: unknown; v?: unknown };
    return parsed.q === scopeHash(scope) && Array.isArray(parsed.v) ? parsed.v : "invalid";
  } catch {
    return "invalid";
  }
}

/** A page size: default 50, at most `max`; anything but a positive integer is `invalid-body`. */
export function limitOf(limit: number | undefined, max: number): number | ApiError {
  if (limit === undefined) return 50;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1) return { code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "limit", problem: "format" } };
  return Math.min(limit, max);
}

/**
 * What the runtime API looks up in one version beyond core's readers: the authored task of a person wait,
 * through the origin map, and a wait's definition by its full element ID.
 */
import type { PublishedDefinition, Wait } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { SourceIndex } from "./source-index.ts";

export class VersionReading {
  readonly def: PublishedDefinition;
  readonly ix: SourceIndex;
  constructor(def: PublishedDefinition, ix: SourceIndex) {
    this.def = def;
    this.ix = ix;
  }

  /** The authored task of a person wait. */
  taskOf(element: string): string | undefined {
    const item = this.def.origins[`wait:${element}`]?.item[0];
    return item !== undefined && this.ix.tasks.has(item) ? item : undefined;
  }

  /** A wait by its full element ID; every wait is in a child stage. */
  waitDef(element: string): Wait | undefined {
    const dot = element.indexOf(".");
    if (dot < 0) return undefined;
    return this.def.root.stages.find((x) => x.id === element.slice(0, dot))?.waits.find((w) => w.id === element.slice(dot + 1));
  }
}
===\nengine/packages/server/src/api/runtime/refusals.ts\n===
/**
 * A turn's refusal as the contract reports it (core-api.md 2.6 and 7.2). A kernel refusal is mapped by core's
 * `refusalOf`, the mapping Try it's test host uses too; the reasons the turn transaction and the admin
 * planner add are mapped here.
 */
import { refusalOf, type ApiError, type PublishedVersion, type RefusalContext } from "@workflow/core";
import type { JsonObject, KernelRefusal } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { TurnRefusal } from "../../turn/types.ts";

/** The `not-found` of the turn transaction: its params name the workflow, the version or the request. */
function notFound(p: JsonObject): ApiError {
  const what = "requestId" in p ? "request" : "version" in p ? "version" : "workflow";
  return { code: "not-found", params: { what } };
}

/** One refusal of a turn (the kernel's, the turn transaction's, or an admin planner's) as an `ApiError`. */
export function toApiError(published: PublishedVersion, k: TurnRefusal, ctx: RefusalContext = {}): ApiError {
  const p = k.params;
  switch (k.reason) {
    case "busy":
      return { code: "busy", params: {} };
    case "stale":
      return { code: "stale", params: { lastSeq: Number(p["lastSeq"] ?? 0) } };
    case "not-found":
      return notFound(p);
    case "client-token-reused":
      return { code: "client-token-reused", params: { requestId: String(p["requestId"] ?? "") } };
    case "reason-required":
      return { code: "reason-required", params: {} };
    case "not-stuck":
      return { code: "not-stuck", params: {} };
    case "not-retryable":
      return { code: "not-retryable", params: { reason: p["reason"] as Extract<ApiError, { code: "not-retryable" }>["params"]["reason"] } };
    default:
      // The kernel's reasons. Those the server never lets reach a caller (already-started, action-error,
      // invalid-action) are `internal` there (runtime-api.md 5.1).
      return refusalOf(published, k as KernelRefusal, ctx);
  }
}

/**
 * The reads (runtime-api.md section 6): a published version's source, request lists and the request page.
 * A list is read from the `requests` read table alone, which keeps the authored stage and the stuck state as
 * the request view gives them; it reads no events. The page is built with core's `requestView` (and so its
 * story) from the request's events.
 */
import { requestView, type ApiError, type By, type Caller, type Json, type Location, type OpenAction, type RequestView, type Result, type Status, type Stuck, type Values } from "@workflow/core";
import { listPendingCalls, type PendingCallRow } from "../../store/pending-calls.ts";
import { AT_SQL } from "../../store/events.ts";
import { fail, isWorkflowAdmin, loadRequest, ok, publishedOf, type Ctx, type LoadedRequest } from "./context.ts";
import { decodeCursor, encodeCursor, limitOf } from "./paging.ts";
import { viewerOf } from "./tasks.ts";
import type { GetRequestArgs, Page, PublishedSource, RequestQuery, RequestRow } from "./types.ts";
import { ms, type VersionRecord } from "./versions.ts";

export async function publishedSource(ctx: Ctx, _caller: Caller, args: { workflow: string; version: number }): Promise<Result<PublishedSource>> {
  const rec = await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, args.workflow, args.version);
  if (rec === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: (await ctx.versions.highest(ctx.db, args.workflow)) === null ? "workflow" : "version" } });
  return ok({ workflow: rec.workflow, version: rec.version, authored: rec.source, publishedAt: rec.publishedAt, publishedBy: rec.publishedBy });
}

const SORT_COLUMN = { readableId: "readable_id", startedAt: "started_at", updatedAt: "updated_at" } as const;
const MAX_INCLUDE = 10;

function invalid(field: string, problem: Extract<ApiError, { code: "invalid-body" }>["params"]["problem"]): ApiError {
  return { code: "invalid-body", params: { field, problem } };
}

export async function listRequests(ctx: Ctx, _caller: Caller, q: RequestQuery): Promise<Result<Page<RequestRow>>> {
  const limit = limitOf(q.limit, 200);
  if (typeof limit !== "number") return fail(limit);
  if (q.workflow === undefined) {
    if (q.status !== undefined) return fail(invalid("status", "format"));
    if (q.version !== undefined) return fail(invalid("version", "format"));
    if (q.valueEquals !== undefined && q.valueEquals.length > 0) return fail(invalid(`value.${q.valueEquals[0]?.value ?? ""}`, "format"));
  }
  if ((q.include?.length ?? 0) > MAX_INCLUDE) return fail(invalid("include", "tooLong"));
  const sort = q.sort ?? "readableId";
  const order = q.order ?? "desc";
  if (!(sort in SORT_COLUMN)) return fail(invalid("sort", "format"));
  if (order !== "asc" && order !== "desc") return fail(invalid("order", "format"));

  const where: string[] = [];
  const params: unknown[] = [];
  const param = (v: unknown): string => {
    params.push(v);
    return `$${params.length}`;
  };
  if (q.workflow !== undefined) where.push(`workflow = ${param(q.workflow)}`);
  if (q.status !== undefined) where.push(`status IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(${param(JSON.stringify(q.status))}::jsonb))`);
  if (q.version !== undefined) where.push(`definition_version = ${param(q.version)}`);
  if (q.state === "open") where.push("closed_at IS NULL");
  if (q.state === "closed") where.push("closed_at IS NOT NULL");
  if (q.stuck === true) where.push("stuck IS NOT NULL");
  if (q.stuck === false) where.push("stuck IS NULL");
  if (q.startedBy !== undefined) where.push(`started_by @> ${param(JSON.stringify({ type: "user", id: q.startedBy }))}::jsonb`);
  for (const v of q.valueEquals ?? []) where.push(`data @> ${param(JSON.stringify({ [v.value]: v.equals }))}::jsonb`);

  // The cursor is bound to the query without its paging.
  const scope = JSON.stringify(["requests", Object.entries(q).filter(([k]) => k !== "cursor" && k !== "limit")]);
  const after = decodeCursor(q.cursor, scope);
  if (after === "invalid") return fail(invalid("cursor", "format"));
  const column = SORT_COLUMN[sort];
  const key = sort === "readableId" ? "readable_id" : AT_SQL(column);
  if (after !== undefined) {
    const [k, id] = after;
    const cmp = order === "desc" ? "<" : ">";
    const typed = sort === "readableId" ? `${param(Number(k))}::bigint` : `${param(String(k))}::timestamptz`;
    where.push(`(${column}, id) ${cmp} (${typed}, ${param(String(id))})`);
  }
  const rows = await ctx.db.query<ListRow>(
    `SELECT id, ${key} AS k, readable_id, workflow, definition_version, status, stage, started_by, ${AT_SQL("started_at")} AS started_at,
       ${AT_SQL("updated_at")} AS updated_at, ${AT_SQL("closed_at")} AS closed_at, stuck_view, last_seq, data
     FROM requests ${where.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${where.join(" AND ")}` : ""}
     ORDER BY ${column} ${order}, id ${order} LIMIT ${param(limit + 1)}`,
    params,
  );
  const items: RequestRow[] = [];
  for (const r of rows.slice(0, limit)) {
    const rec = await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, r.workflow, Number(r.definition_version));
    items.push(rowOf(r, rec, q.include));
  }
  const page: Page<RequestRow> = { items };
  const last = rows[limit - 1];
  if (rows.length > limit && last !== undefined) page.next = encodeCursor([sort === "readableId" ? Number(last.k) : last.k, last.id], scope);
  return ok(page);
}

type ListRow = {
  id: string;
  k: string | number;
  readable_id: number | string;
  workflow: string;
  definition_version: number | string;
  status: string | null;
  stage: Location | null;
  started_by: { type: string; id: string };
  started_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  closed_at: string | null;
  stuck_view: Stuck | null;
  last_seq: number | string;
  data: Record<string, Json>;
};

/** A list row from the read table, as the request view would give it. */
function rowOf(r: ListRow, rec: VersionRecord | null, include: readonly string[] | undefined): RequestRow {
  const row: RequestRow = {
    requestId: r.id,
    readableId: String(r.readable_id),
    workflow: r.workflow,
    version: Number(r.definition_version),
    stage: r.stage ?? { item: "" },
    startedBy: { type: r.started_by.type as By["type"], id: r.started_by.id },
    startedAt: ms(r.started_at),
    updatedAt: ms(r.updated_at),
    lastSeq: Number(r.last_seq),
  };
  const status: Status | undefined = r.status === null ? undefined : rec?.source.statuses?.find((s) => s.id === r.status);
  if (status !== undefined) row.status = status;
  if (r.closed_at !== null) row.closedAt = ms(r.closed_at);
  if (r.stuck_view !== null) row.stuck = r.stuck_view;
  if (include !== undefined && include.length > 0) {
    // Only the values of this version, as the request view's `values` holds them.
    const values: Record<string, Json> = {};
    for (const id of include) {
      const v = r.data[id];
      if (v !== undefined && rec?.index.values.has(id) === true) values[id] = v;
    }
    row.values = values as Values;
  }
  return row;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the request page

const DEFAULT_EXPECTED_S = 900;

export async function requestIdOf(ctx: Ctx, args: GetRequestArgs): Promise<string | null> {
  if ("requestId" in args) return args.requestId;
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,18}$/.test(args.readableId)) return null;
  const rows = await ctx.db.query<{ id: string }>("SELECT id FROM requests WHERE readable_id = $1::bigint", [args.readableId]);
  return rows[0]?.id ?? null;
}

export async function getRequest(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: GetRequestArgs): Promise<Result<RequestView>> {
  const id = await requestIdOf(ctx, args);
  const loaded = id === null ? null : await loadRequest(ctx, id);
  if (loaded === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
  const rec = loaded.version;
  const isAdmin = (await isWorkflowAdmin(ctx, caller, rec.workflow, true)) === true;
  const groups = await ctx.groupsOf(caller.user, true);
  const published = await publishedOf(ctx, rec);
  const pending = await listPendingCalls(ctx.db, loaded.state.requestId);
  // How many times a call was sent, known while its row exists: a recorded result deletes the row.
  const attempts = (element: string): number | undefined => {
    const n = pending.filter((p) => p.wait.element === element).reduce((m, p) => Math.max(m, p.attempts), 0);
    return n > 0 ? n : undefined;
  };
  const view = requestView(published, loaded.events, {
    viewer: viewerOf(caller, isAdmin, groups),
    workflow: rec.workflow,
    version: rec.version,
    debug: args.debug === true && caller.platformAdmin,
    attempts,
  });
  if (isAdmin) addActionAdmin(ctx, view, loaded, pending, published.catalogue.entries);
  return ok(view);
}

/** The open actions' admin fields, from `pending_calls` (core-api.md 8, `OpenAction.admin`): `accepted` once the job is known, else `queued`. */
function addActionAdmin(
  ctx: Ctx,
  view: RequestView,
  loaded: LoadedRequest,
  pending: readonly PendingCallRow[],
  entries: readonly { id: string; kind: string; expectedWithinSeconds?: number }[],
): void {
  const now = ctx.clock().getTime();
  for (const action of view.actions) {
    const w = loaded.state.waits.find((x) => x.status === "open" && x.opened.kind === "call" && loaded.version.definition.origins[`wait:${x.id.element}`]?.item[0] === action.location.item);
    if (w === undefined || w.opened.kind !== "call") continue;
    const p = pending.find((x) => x.wait.element === w.id.element && x.wait.activation === w.id.activation && x.wait.key === w.id.key && x.wait.seq === w.id.seq);
    if (p === undefined) continue;
    const call = `${w.opened.connection}.${w.opened.op}`;
    const entry = entries.find((e) => e.id === call);
    const expectedBy = Date.parse(ms(p.openedAt)) + (entry?.expectedWithinSeconds ?? DEFAULT_EXPECTED_S) * 1000;
    const admin: NonNullable<OpenAction["admin"]> = {
      state: p.jobRef === null ? "queued" : "accepted",
      attempts: p.attempts,
      expectedBy: new Date(expectedBy).toISOString(),
      overdue: now > expectedBy,
    };
    if (p.lastAttemptAt !== null) admin.lastAttemptAt = ms(p.lastAttemptAt);
    if (p.lastError !== null) admin.lastError = p.lastError;
    action.admin = admin;
  }
}

/**
 * The session and the directory reads (runtime-api.md section 7). Directory reads are live and recorded
 * nowhere; a directory that cannot be reached answers `membership-unavailable`. Switching person is for the
 * development host only.
 */
import type { Caller, Ref, Result } from "@workflow/core";
import { MEMBERSHIP_TIMEOUT_MS, within } from "../../connectors/lookups.ts";
import { fail, ok, userRef, type Ctx } from "./context.ts";
import type { DirectoryEntry, Person, SessionApi } from "./types.ts";

/** The development host's session: the people it offers, and how it signs one in. */
export interface DevSession {
  people: Ref[];
  /** Platform admins among them. */
  platformAdmins: string[];
  signIn(caller: Caller, person: Ref): Promise<void>;
}

const unavailable = <T>(): Result<T> => fail({ code: "membership-unavailable", params: {} });

async function read<T>(p: Promise<T>): Promise<T | undefined> {
  try {
    return await within(p, MEMBERSHIP_TIMEOUT_MS);
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

const entryOf = (e: { type: "user" | "group"; id: string; label: string; detail?: string }): DirectoryEntry =>
  e.detail === undefined ? { type: e.type, id: e.id, label: e.label } : { type: e.type, id: e.id, label: e.label, detail: e.detail };

export function createSessionApi(ctx: Ctx, dev?: DevSession): SessionApi {
  async function personOf(ref: Ref, platformAdmin: boolean): Promise<Result<Person>> {
    const found = await read(ctx.connectors.directory.lookup([ref]));
    if (found === undefined) return unavailable();
    return ok({ ref, label: found[0]?.label ?? ref.id, platformAdmin });
  }
  return {
    whoAmI: (caller) => personOf(userRef(caller), caller.platformAdmin),
    async signInAs(caller, person) {
      if (dev === undefined) return fail({ code: "forbidden", params: { need: "devHost" } });
      // Only a person the directory knows; a group or an unknown ID is a bad body (section 7 names no code).
      const unknown = fail<Person>({ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "/person", problem: "format" } });
      if (person.type !== "user") return unknown;
      const found = await read(ctx.connectors.directory.lookup([person]));
      if (found === undefined) return unavailable();
      const entry = found.find((e) => e.type === "user" && e.id === person.id);
      if (entry === undefined) return unknown;
      await dev.signIn(caller, person);
      return ok({ ref: person, label: entry.label, platformAdmin: dev.platformAdmins.includes(person.id) });
    },
    async people() {
      if (dev === undefined) return ok([]);
      const found = await read(ctx.connectors.directory.lookup(dev.people));
      if (found === undefined) return unavailable();
      return ok(dev.people.map((ref) => ({ ref, label: found.find((e) => e.type === ref.type && e.id === ref.id)?.label ?? ref.id, platformAdmin: dev.platformAdmins.includes(ref.id) })));
    },
    async search(_caller, args) {
      const found = await read(ctx.connectors.directory.search(args.q, args.types, args.limit));
      return found === undefined ? unavailable() : ok(found.slice(0, args.limit).map(entryOf));
    },
    async lookup(_caller, args) {
      const found = await read(ctx.connectors.directory.lookup(args.refs));
      return found === undefined ? unavailable() : ok(found.map(entryOf));
    },
    async membersOf(_caller, args) {
      const found = await read(ctx.connectors.directory.membersOf(args.group));
      return found === undefined ? unavailable() : ok(found.map(entryOf));
    },
  };
}

/**
 * What the runtime API reads of a version's authored source: the stage each task is in, each task's
 * questions and buttons, and the start task. Read once per version and kept.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Question } from "@workflow/core";

export interface TaskEntry {
  id: string;
  stage: string;
  questions: Map<string, Question>;
  buttons: string[];
}

export interface SourceIndex {
  tasks: Map<string, TaskEntry>;
  /** Question ID to its task. */
  questionTask: Map<string, string>;
  /** Action ID to its stage. */
  actions: Map<string, string>;
  stages: Set<string>;
  values: Set<string>;
  startStage: string;
  /** The start stage's task; "" when the start stage has none. */
  startTask: string;
}

type Loose = Record<string, unknown>;
const list = (x: unknown): Loose[] => (Array.isArray(x) ? (x as Loose[]) : []);

const indexes = new WeakMap<AuthoredWorkflow, SourceIndex>();

export function indexSource(source: AuthoredWorkflow): SourceIndex {
  const known = indexes.get(source);
  if (known !== undefined) return known;
  const ix: SourceIndex = {
    tasks: new Map(),
    questionTask: new Map(),
    actions: new Map(),
    stages: new Set(),
    values: new Set(list(source.values).map((v) => String(v["id"]))),
    startStage: source.start?.stage ?? "",
    startTask: "",
  };
  for (const stage of list(source.stages)) {
    const stageId = String(stage["id"]);
    ix.stages.add(stageId);
    for (const part of ["whenThisStageStarts", "afterTheyRespond"]) for (const a of list(stage[part])) ix.actions.set(String(a["id"]), stageId);
    for (const task of list(stage["tasks"])) {
      const entry: TaskEntry = { id: String(task["id"]), stage: stageId, questions: new Map(), buttons: list(task["buttons"]).map((b) => String(b["id"])) };
      const form = task["form"] as Loose | undefined;
      for (const page of list(form?.["pages"]))
        for (const item of list(page["items"])) {
          if (item["type"] !== "question") continue;
          entry.questions.set(String(item["id"]), item as unknown as Question);
          ix.questionTask.set(String(item["id"]), entry.id);
        }
      ix.tasks.set(entry.id, entry);
      if (stageId === ix.startStage && ix.startTask === "") ix.startTask = entry.id;
    }
  }
  indexes.set(source, ix);
  return ix;
}

/**
 * Starting a request (runtime-api.md section 3): the startable workflows, the start form, and the start
 * turn with its client token. The refusal steps run in the document's order: the shape, the client token
 * (inside the turn transaction's start), then the kernel's reasons and the choice lookups.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { buttonStates, type Answers, type ApiError, type ButtonId, type Caller, type Result } from "@workflow/core";
import type { JsonObject } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { canonicalJson } from "../../config/catalogue.ts";
import { BodyProblem, integer, object, shapeOf, string, type Fields } from "../shared/body.ts";
import { fail, ok, publishedOf, readingOf, userRef, type Ctx } from "./context.ts";
import { formatAt } from "../../turn/turns.ts";
import { toApiError } from "./refusals.ts";
import { readSettings } from "./versions.ts";
import type { StartableWorkflow, StartArgs, StartForm, StartResult } from "./types.ts";

const TOKEN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/;

export async function listStartable(ctx: Ctx): Promise<Result<StartableWorkflow[]>> {
  const rows = await ctx.db.query<{ workflow: string; name: string; v: number | string }>(
    `SELECT d.workflow, coalesce(w.name, d.workflow) AS name, max(d.version) AS v
     FROM definitions d LEFT JOIN workflows w ON w.id = d.workflow GROUP BY d.workflow, w.name ORDER BY 2, 1`,
  );
  return ok(rows.map((r) => ({ workflow: r.workflow, name: r.name, highestVersion: Number(r.v) })));
}

/** The version asked for, or the highest; `not-found` names which is missing. */
async function versionOf(ctx: Ctx, workflow: string, version: number | undefined) {
  const v = version ?? (await ctx.versions.highest(ctx.db, workflow));
  if (v === null) return { error: { code: "not-found", params: { what: "workflow" } } as ApiError };
  const rec = await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, workflow, v);
  if (rec === null) return { error: { code: "not-found", params: { what: (await ctx.versions.highest(ctx.db, workflow)) === null ? "workflow" : "version" } } as ApiError };
  return { rec };
}

export async function startForm(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: { workflow: string; version?: number }): Promise<Result<StartForm>> {
  const found = await versionOf(ctx, args.workflow, args.version);
  if ("error" in found) return fail(found.error);
  const { rec } = found;
  const settings = await readSettings(ctx.db, args.workflow);
  const published = await publishedOf(ctx, rec);
  return ok({
    workflow: rec.workflow,
    version: rec.version,
    name: settings?.name ?? rec.workflow,
    stage: rec.index.startStage as StartForm["stage"],
    task: rec.index.startTask as StartForm["task"],
    buttonStates: buttonStates(published, { form: "start", at: formatAt(ctx.clock()) }, { as: userRef(caller), isAdmin: false }),
  });
}

/** An answers object with no `null` anywhere (runtime-api.md 1.1: no `null` in JSON). */
export function answersOf(o: Fields, pointer = ""): Answers {
  const v = o["answers"];
  if (v === undefined) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/answers`, "missing");
  const answers = object(v, `${pointer}/answers`, Object.keys(v as object));
  const noNull = (x: unknown, at: string): void => {
    if (x === null) throw new BodyProblem(at, "type");
    if (Array.isArray(x)) x.forEach((y, i) => noNull(y, `${at}/${i}`));
    else if (typeof x === "object") for (const [k, y] of Object.entries(x)) noNull(y, `${at}/${k.replaceAll("~", "~0").replaceAll("/", "~1")}`);
  };
  noNull(answers, `${pointer}/answers`);
  return answers as Answers;
}

export function readStartArgs(body: unknown): { ok: true; value: StartArgs } | { ok: false; params: Extract<ApiError, { code: "invalid-body" }>["params"] } {
  return shapeOf(() => {
    const o = object(body, "", ["workflow", "version", "button", "answers", "clientToken"]);
    const args: StartArgs = { workflow: string(o, "workflow"), button: string(o, "button") as ButtonId, answers: answersOf(o), clientToken: string(o, "clientToken") };
    if (o["version"] !== undefined) args.version = integer(o, "version", 1);
    if (!TOKEN.test(args.clientToken)) throw new BodyProblem("/clientToken", "format");
    return args;
  });
}

export async function start(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: StartArgs): Promise<Result<StartResult>> {
  // 1. Shape.
  const shape = readStartArgs(args);
  if (!shape.ok) return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: shape.params });
  const found = await versionOf(ctx, args.workflow, args.version);
  if ("error" in found) return fail(found.error);
  const { rec } = found;
  const reading = readingOf(rec);
  const startTask = rec.index.startTask;
  const startWait = reading.waitDef(rec.definition.start);
  if (startWait?.kind !== "person" || !startWait.outcomes.some((o) => o.id === args.button)) {
    return fail({ code: "unknown-button", params: { button: args.button as ButtonId }, ...(startTask === "" ? {} : { location: { item: startTask } }) });
  }
  // 2 to 6: the client token and the start turn.
  const hashed = { workflow: args.workflow, ...(args.version === undefined ? {} : { version: args.version }), button: args.button, answers: args.answers };
  const argsHash = createHash("sha256").update(canonicalJson(hashed)).digest("hex");
  const out = await ctx.turns.start({
    workflow: rec.workflow,
    version: rec.version,
    by: userRef(caller),
    outcome: args.button,
    data: args.answers as JsonObject,
    clientToken: { token: args.clientToken, argsHash },
  });
  const published = await publishedOf(ctx, rec);
  if (!out.ok) return fail(...out.refusals.map((k) => toApiError(published, k, { element: rec.definition.start, button: args.button, answers: args.answers })));
  return ok({ requestId: out.requestId, readableId: String(out.readableId), version: out.version, lastSeq: out.lastSeq, stopped: out.stopped, replayed: out.replayed });
}

/** A task instance's ID and the wait it names (core-api.md 2.2: `t<seq>`, the seq of its `WaitOpened`). */

/** The person wait a task instance ID names in this request; undefined for any other ID, a call's included. */
export function personWaitOf(state: RequestState, task: string): WaitInstance | undefined {
