type OpenRow = {
  request_id: string;
  element: string;
  opened_at: string;
  assignee_users: string[];
  assignee_groups: string[];
  readable_id: number | string;
  workflow: string;
  definition_version: number | string;
  status: string | null;
  opened_seq: number | string;
}

/** Open obligations asking the caller or a group they are in now; an option shows on the request page only (kernel spec section 7). */
export async function myTasks(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: PageArgs): Promise<Result<MyTasksPage>> {
  const limit = limitOf(args.limit, 200);
  if (typeof limit !== "number") return fail(limit);
  const groups = await ctx.groupsOf(caller.user, false);
  const scope = JSON.stringify(["myTasks", caller.user]);
  const after = decodeCursor(args.cursor, scope);
  if (after === "invalid") return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: { field: "cursor", problem: "format" } });
  const [afterAt, afterRequest, afterSeq] = (after ?? ["", "", 0]) as [string, string, number];

  const rows = await ctx.db.query<OpenRow>(
    `SELECT ow.request_id, ow.element, ${AT_SQL("ow.opened_at")} AS opened_at, ow.assignee_users, ow.assignee_groups,
       r.readable_id, r.workflow, r.definition_version, r.status, e.seq AS opened_seq
     FROM open_waits ow
     JOIN requests r ON r.id = ow.request_id
     JOIN events e ON e.request_id = ow.request_id AND e.type = 'WaitOpened'
       AND e.payload->'wait'->>'element' = ow.element AND e.payload->'wait'->>'activation' = ow.activation
       AND e.payload->'wait'->>'key' = ow.key AND (e.payload->'wait'->>'seq')::int = ow.seq
     WHERE ow.kind = 'person' AND ow.role = 'obligation' AND r.closed_at IS NULL
       AND ($1 = ANY(ow.assignee_users) OR ow.assignee_groups && ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb)))
       AND ($3 = '' OR (ow.opened_at, ow.request_id, e.seq) > (NULLIF($3, '')::timestamptz, $4, $5))
     ORDER BY ow.opened_at, ow.request_id, e.seq
     LIMIT $6`,
    [caller.user, JSON.stringify(groups ?? []), afterAt, afterRequest, afterSeq, limit + 1],
  );
  const page = rows.slice(0, limit);

  // One request view per request, for the caller's button states (mayAnswer).
  const views = new Map<string, { loaded: LoadedRequest; view: RequestView } | null>();
  const items: MyTask[] = [];
  for (const row of page) {
    if (!views.has(row.request_id)) {
      const loaded = await loadRequest(ctx, row.request_id);
      views.set(row.request_id, loaded === null ? null : { loaded, view: requestView(await publishedOf(ctx, loaded.version), loaded.events, { viewer: viewerOf(caller, false, groups) }) });
    }
    const read = views.get(row.request_id);
    // A person who may not answer the task does not see it.
    if (read !== null && read !== undefined && mayNotAnswer(read.loaded.version.definition, read.loaded.state, row.element) === caller.user) continue;
    const view = read?.view;
    const rec = await ctx.versions.get(ctx.db, row.workflow, Number(row.definition_version));
    const task = taskInstanceId(Number(row.opened_seq));
    const open = view?.tasks.find((t) => t.task === task);
    const direct = row.assignee_users.includes(caller.user);
    const via: Ref = direct ? { type: "user", id: caller.user } : { type: "group", id: row.assignee_groups.find((g) => groups?.includes(g)) ?? "" };
    const refusals = open?.buttonStates[0]?.refusals ?? [];
    const item: MyTask = {
      requestId: row.request_id,
      readableId: String(row.readable_id),
      workflow: row.workflow,
      version: Number(row.definition_version),
      task,
      location: open?.location ?? { item: rec === null ? "" : (readingOf(rec).taskOf(row.element) ?? "") },
      openedAt: ms(row.opened_at),
      via,
      mayAnswer: !refusals.some((r) => r.code === "may" || r.code === "rule-error"),
    };
    const status = rec?.source.statuses.find((s) => s.id === row.status);
    if (status !== undefined) item.status = status;
    items.push(item);
  }
  const out: MyTasksPage = { items };
  const last = page[page.length - 1];
  if (rows.length > limit && last !== undefined) out.next = encodeCursor([last.opened_at, last.request_id, Number(last.opened_seq)], scope);
  if (groups === undefined) out.groupsUnavailable = true;
  return ok(out);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- a task

/** The authored task of a person wait; the start task for the start wait. */
function authoredTaskOf(loaded: LoadedRequest, w: WaitInstance): string {
  const r = readingOf(loaded.version);
  return r.taskOf(w.id.element) ?? (w.id.element === loaded.version.definition.start ? loaded.version.index.startTask : "");
}

/**
 * The group members recorded by the directory reads a condition reads (a `members` step, an "is in group"
 * test), each in its own step before the step that uses it: every such read that completed before the task
 * opened, the latest per group. A task's own membership read (`<task>__members`) is not one of them.
 */
function recordedMembers(loaded: LoadedRequest, w: WaitInstance, directory: string): KnownLookups {
  const membersOf: Record<string, Ref[]> = {};
  for (const read of loaded.state.waits) {
    const o = read.opened;
    if (o.kind !== "call" || o.connection !== directory || o.op !== "membersOf@1" || read.id.element.endsWith("__members")) continue;
    if (read.status !== "completed" || read.outcome !== "ok" || (read.endedSeq ?? Infinity) > w.openedSeq) continue;
    const groups = (read.data as JsonObject | null)?.["groups"];
    if (!Array.isArray(groups)) continue;
    for (const g of groups as JsonObject[]) {
      const id = (g["id"] as JsonObject | undefined)?.["id"];
      if (typeof id === "string") membersOf[id] = asRefs(Array.isArray(g["members"]) ? (g["members"] as { type: string; id: string }[]) : []);
    }
  }
  return Object.keys(membersOf).length === 0 ? {} : { membersOf };
}

type Answered = Extract<StoryEntry, { code: "task.answered" }>;
type Started = Extract<StoryEntry, { code: "started" }>;

export async function getTask(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: { requestId: string; task: string }): Promise<Result<TaskView>> {
  const loaded = await loadRequest(ctx, args.requestId);
  if (loaded === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
  const { state, version: rec } = loaded;
  const w = personWaitOf(state, args.task);
  if (w === undefined || state.request === null || w.opened.kind !== "person") return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "task" } });
  const authoredTask = authoredTaskOf(loaded, w);
  const published = await publishedOf(ctx, rec);
  const groups = await ctx.groupsOf(caller.user, true);
  const view = requestView(published, loaded.events, { viewer: viewerOf(caller, false, groups), workflow: rec.workflow, version: rec.version });

  const states: ButtonState[] = buttonStates(published, { form: "task", events: loaded.events, task: args.task as TaskInstanceId }, viewerOf(caller, false, groups));

  const startedOn = state.request.at.slice(0, 10);
  const out: TaskView = {
    requestId: view.requestId,
    readableId: view.readableId,
    workflow: rec.workflow,
    version: rec.version,
    task: args.task,
    authoredTask: authoredTask as TaskView["authoredTask"],
    stage: (rec.index.tasks.get(authoredTask)?.stage ?? "") as TaskView["stage"],
    state: w.status,
    openedAt: ms(w.openedAt),
    askedOf: asRefs(w.opened.assignees),
    values: view.values,
    startedOn,
    lookups: {},
    buttonStates: states,
    lastSeq: view.lastSeq,
  };
  if (view.requester !== undefined) out.requester = view.requester;

  // The form's conditions read the recorded group members only when they use the directory.
  const request = view.requester === undefined ? { startedOn } : { requester: view.requester, startedOn };
  const probe = formState(rec.source, published.catalogue, { item: authoredTask }, {}, view.values, request);
  if (probe.result === "needsLookups") out.lookups = recordedMembers(loaded, w, published.catalogue.directoryConnection);

  // What was answered, this time and the last time the same task was asked, from core's story.
  const answeredOf = (e: StoryEntry): { task: string; answers: Answers; entry: Answered | Started } | undefined => {
    if (e.code === "task.answered" && e.location?.item === authoredTask) return { task: e.params.task, answers: e.params.answers, entry: e };
    if (e.code === "started" && authoredTask === rec.index.startTask) return { task: taskInstanceId(state.waits.find((x) => x.id.element === rec.definition.start)?.openedSeq ?? 0), answers: e.params.answers, entry: e };
    return undefined;
  };
  const answered = view.story.flatMap((e) => answeredOf(e) ?? []);
  const mine = answered.find((a) => a.task === args.task);
  if (mine !== undefined && w.status === "completed") {
    const e = mine.entry;
    out.completed =
      e.code === "task.answered"
        ? { by: e.params.by, at: e.at, button: e.params.button, answers: e.params.answers, asMemberOf: e.params.asMemberOf }
        : { by: e.params.by, at: e.at, button: e.params.button, answers: e.params.answers, asMemberOf: [] };
  }
  const seqOf = (task: string): number => Number(task.slice(1));
  const earlier = answered.filter((a) => seqOf(a.task) < w.openedSeq).at(-1);
  if (earlier !== undefined) out.earlierAnswers = earlier.answers;
  return ok(out);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- act

export function readActBody(body: unknown): { ok: true; value: { button: string; answers: Answers } } | { ok: false; params: Extract<ApiError, { code: "invalid-body" }>["params"] } {
  return shapeOf(() => {
    const o = object(body, "", ["button", "answers"]);
    return { button: string(o, "button"), answers: answersOf(o) };
  });
}

export async function act(ctx: Ctx, caller: Caller, args: ActArgs): Promise<Result<TurnDone>> {
  // 1. Shape.
  const body = readActBody({ button: args.button, answers: args.answers });
  if (!body.ok) return fail({ code: "invalid-body", params: body.params });
  const loaded = await loadRequest(ctx, args.requestId);
  if (loaded === null) return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "request" } });
  const w = personWaitOf(loaded.state, args.task);
  if (w === undefined || w.opened.kind !== "person") return fail({ code: "not-found", params: { what: "task" } });
  if (!w.opened.outcomes.some((o) => o.id === args.button)) {
    const item = authoredTaskOf(loaded, w);
    return fail({ code: "unknown-button", params: { button: args.button as ButtonId }, ...(item === "" ? {} : { location: { item } }) });
  }
  // 2 to 11: the turn transaction.
  const out = await ctx.turns.act({ requestId: args.requestId, by: userRef(caller), wait: w.id, outcome: args.button, data: args.answers as JsonObject });
  const published = await publishedOf(ctx, loaded.version);
  if (!out.ok) return fail(...out.refusals.map((k) => toApiError(published, k, { element: w.id.element, button: args.button, answers: args.answers })));
  return ok({ requestId: out.requestId, lastSeq: out.lastSeq, stopped: out.stopped });
}

===\nengine/packages/server/src/api/runtime/versions.ts\n===
/**
 * Published versions as the runtime API reads them: the definition with its authored source and who
 * published it, kept once read (a version never changes), and the workflow's name and admins, read live
 * (settings change and apply at once, data model `workflow_settings`).
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Ref } from "@workflow/core";
import type { PublishedDefinition } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { Queryable } from "../../store/db.ts";
import { AT_SQL } from "../../store/events.ts";
import { indexSource, type SourceIndex } from "./source-index.ts";

export interface VersionRecord {
  workflow: string;
  version: number;
  definition: PublishedDefinition;
  source: AuthoredWorkflow;
  index: SourceIndex;
  publishedAt: string;
  publishedBy: Ref;
}

/** An event time (six fractional digits) as the contract's Timestamp (milliseconds). */
export function ms(at: string): string {
  const m = /^(.*\.\d{3})\d*Z$/.exec(at);
  return m?.[1] === undefined ? at : `${m[1]}Z`;
}

export interface Versions {
  get(q: Queryable, workflow: string, version: number): Promise<VersionRecord | null>;
  highest(q: Queryable, workflow: string): Promise<number | null>;
}

export function createVersions(): Versions {
  const cache = new Map<string, VersionRecord>();
  return {
    async get(q, workflow, version) {
      const key = JSON.stringify([workflow, version]);
      const hit = cache.get(key);
      if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
      const rows = await q.query<{ document: PublishedDefinition; authored: AuthoredWorkflow; published_by: { type: string; id: string }; published_at: string }>(
        `SELECT document, authored, published_by, ${AT_SQL("published_at")} AS published_at FROM definitions WHERE workflow = $1 AND version = $2`,
        [workflow, version],
      );
      const r = rows[0];
      if (r === undefined) return null;
      const by: Ref = { type: r.published_by.type === "group" ? "group" : "user", id: r.published_by.id };
      const record: VersionRecord = { workflow, version, definition: r.document, source: r.authored, index: indexSource(r.authored), publishedAt: ms(r.published_at), publishedBy: by };
      cache.set(key, record);
      return record;
    },
    async highest(q, workflow) {
      const rows = await q.query<{ v: number | string | null }>("SELECT max(version) AS v FROM definitions WHERE workflow = $1", [workflow]);
      const v = rows[0]?.v;
      return v === null || v === undefined ? null : Number(v);
    },
  };
}

/** What the runtime reads of a workflow's row and settings; who may act is `shared/people.ts`. */
export interface WorkflowSettings {
  name: string;
  pausedBindings: string[];
}

/** The workflow's name and paused bindings, or null when there is no such workflow. */
export async function readSettings(q: Queryable, workflow: string): Promise<WorkflowSettings | null> {
  const rows = await q.query<{ name: string; paused_bindings: string[] | null }>(
    "SELECT w.name, s.paused_bindings FROM workflows w LEFT JOIN workflow_settings s ON s.workflow = w.id WHERE w.id = $1",
    [workflow],
  );
  const r = rows[0];
  return r === undefined ? null : { name: r.name, pausedBindings: r.paused_bindings ?? [] };
}
===\nengine/packages/server/src/api/shared/body.ts\n===
/**
 * Checking a request body's shape (core-api.md section 2.6, `invalid-body`). Each check names the field as a
 * JSON Pointer into the body. No `null` is accepted outside an authored document (authoring-api.md section 1).
 */
import type { ApiErrorParams, Ref } from "@workflow/core";

type Problem = ApiErrorParams["invalid-body"]["problem"];

/** Thrown by the checks below and turned into `invalid-body` by `shapeOf`. */
export class BodyProblem extends Error {
  readonly field: string;
  readonly problem: Problem;
  constructor(field: string, problem: Problem) {
    super(`${field}: ${problem}`);
    this.field = field;
    this.problem = problem;
  }
}

/** Runs `read` over the body; a `BodyProblem` becomes the `invalid-body` params. */
export function shapeOf<T>(read: () => T): { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; params: ApiErrorParams["invalid-body"] } {
  try {
    return { ok: true, value: read() };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof BodyProblem) return { ok: false, params: { field: error.field, problem: error.problem } };
    throw error;
  }
}

export type Fields = Record<string, unknown>;

/** An object with only the given fields (`allowed` also lists fields that are read elsewhere or ignored). */
export function object(value: unknown, pointer: string, allowed: readonly string[]): Fields {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) throw new BodyProblem(pointer, "type");
  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    if (!allowed.includes(key)) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${escape(key)}`, "unknownField");
  }
  return value as Fields;
}

function escape(key: string): string {
  return key.replaceAll("~", "~0").replaceAll("/", "~1");
}

function present(o: Fields, key: string, pointer: string): unknown {
  if (!(key in o) || o[key] === undefined) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "missing");
  return o[key];
}

export function string(o: Fields, key: string, pointer = ""): string {
  const v = present(o, key, pointer);
  if (typeof v !== "string") throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "type");
  return v;
}

/** A string with something in it besides white space. */
export function nonEmptyString(o: Fields, key: string, pointer = ""): string {
  const v = string(o, key, pointer);
  if (v.trim() === "") throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "empty");
  return v;
}

export function optionalString(o: Fields, key: string, pointer = ""): string | undefined {
  return key in o && o[key] !== undefined ? string(o, key, pointer) : undefined;
}

export function boolean(o: Fields, key: string, pointer = ""): boolean {
  const v = present(o, key, pointer);
  if (typeof v !== "boolean") throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "type");
  return v;
}

/** An integer of at least `min`. */
export function integer(o: Fields, key: string, min: number, pointer = ""): number {
  const v = present(o, key, pointer);
  if (typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(v)) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "type");
  if (v < min) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "format");
  return v;
}

/** A directory object ID: 1 to 255 characters, no white space or control character. */
const DIRECTORY_ID = /^[^\s\p{Cc}]{1,255}$/u;

/** A user or group reference `{ type, id }`. */
export function ref(value: unknown, pointer: string): Ref {
  const o = object(value, pointer, ["type", "id"]);
  const type = string(o, "type", pointer);
  if (type !== "user" && type !== "group") throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/type`, "format");
  const id = string(o, "id", pointer);
  if (!DIRECTORY_ID.test(id)) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/id`, "format");
  return { type, id };
}

/** A list of references. Empty is allowed here; the caller decides what an empty list means. */
export function refs(o: Fields, key: string, pointer = ""): Ref[] {
  const v = present(o, key, pointer);
  if (!Array.isArray(v)) throw new BodyProblem(`${pointer}/${key}`, "type");
  return v.map((item, i) => ref(item, `${pointer}/${key}/${i}`));
}

/**
 * What every API handler shares (authoring-api.md section 1, runtime-api.md section 1.1, core-api.md section
 * 2.6): the engine headers, the status of each error code, the failure body, reading a JSON body under a
 * limit, and running a function for a signed-in caller.
 */
import { coreVersion, meta, type ApiError, type ApiErrorParams, type Caller, type Result } from "@workflow/core";
import type { CallerAdapter } from "../caller.ts";

export type ErrorCode = ApiError["code"];


/** The HTTP status of each code (core-api.md section 2.6). `unfinished` is Try it only and never sent. */
export const ERROR_STATUS: { readonly [C in ErrorCode]: number } = {
  unauthenticated: 401,
  forbidden: 403,
  "not-found": 404,
  "invalid-body": 400,
  "too-large": 413,
  busy: 503,
  internal: 500,
  "invalid-document": 422,
  "authored-format-unsupported": 422,
  "stale-revision": 409,
  "core-version-mismatch": 409,
  "has-todo": 422,
  "last-author": 409,
  "client-token-reused": 409,
  "unknown-button": 422,
  "wait-not-open": 409,
  "membership-unavailable": 503,
  "not-assignee": 403,
  may: 403,
  "invalid-data": 422,
  "source-unavailable": 503,
  "choice-unknown": 422,
  check: 422,
  "rule-error": 422,
  "mapping-error": 422,
  unfinished: 422,
  "not-admin": 403,
  "reason-required": 422,
  stale: 409,
  "request-closed": 409,
  "not-stuck": 409,
  "not-retryable": 409,
  "requires-not-met": 422,
};

/** One error with its params. */
export function apiError<C extends ErrorCode>(code: C, params: ApiErrorParams[C]): ApiError {
  return { code, params } as ApiError;
}

/** A failed result of one error. */
export function failure<T>(code: ErrorCode, params: ApiErrorParams[typeof code]): Result<T> {
  return { ok: false, errors: [apiError(code, params as never)] };
}

export function success<T>(value: T): Result<T> {
  return { ok: true, value };
}

/** Every response carries the server core's version and definition format (core-api.md section 13). */
export function engineHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  return { "Engine-Core-Version": coreVersion, "Engine-Definition-Format": String(meta.definitionFormatVersion) };
}

export function jsonResponse(status: number, body: unknown, headers: Record<string, string> = {}): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", ...engineHeaders(), ...headers },
  });
}

/** Failure: the status of the first error's code and `{ errors }`. A 503 may be repeated: `Retry-After: 2`. */
export function errorResponse(errors: readonly ApiError[]): Response {
  const status = ERROR_STATUS[errors[0]?.code ?? "internal"];
  return jsonResponse(status, { errors }, status === 503 ? { "Retry-After": "2" } : {});
}

/** An unknown path, or a method a known path does not take: `not-found` with `what: "path"`, in the usual body and headers. */
export function notFoundPath(): Response {
  return errorResponse([{ code: "not-found", params: { what: "path" } }]);
}

/** Success with the given status and headers, or the failure response. */
export function resultResponse<T>(result: Result<T>, status: number, headers?: (value: T) => Record<string, string>): Response {
  return result.ok ? jsonResponse(status, result.value, headers?.(result.value) ?? {}) : errorResponse(result.errors);
}

/**
 * The body as JSON, read at most `limit` bytes: over it is `too-large`, unreadable JSON is `invalid-body`
 * with field "" and problem `format`.
 */
export async function readJson(request: Request, limit: number): Promise<Result<unknown>> {
  const declared = Number(request.headers.get("content-length") ?? "NaN");
  if (Number.isFinite(declared) && declared > limit) return failure("too-large", { limit });
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  if (request.body !== null) {
    const reader = request.body.getReader();
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > limit) {
        await reader.cancel();
        return failure("too-large", { limit });
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  }
  try {
    const text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(Buffer.concat(chunks));
    return success(JSON.parse(text) as unknown);
  } catch {
    return failure("invalid-body", { field: "", problem: "format" });
  }
}

/**
 * Runs `fn` for the signed-in caller: none is `unauthenticated` before anything runs; an exception is
 * `internal`, with the detail in the server log only.
 */
export async function asCaller(adapter: CallerAdapter, request: Request, fn: (caller: Caller) => Promise<Response>): Promise<Response> {
  const caller = await adapter.callerOf(request);
  if (caller === null) return errorResponse([apiError("unauthenticated", {})]);
  return guarded(() => fn(caller));
}

/** An exception becomes `internal`. */
export async function guarded(fn: () => Promise<Response>): Promise<Response> {
  try {
    return await fn();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("internal error", error);
    return errorResponse([apiError("internal", {})]);
  }
}

/**
 * Who a workflow's settings admit (authoring-api.md section 2, runtime-api.md section 2): its authors, and the
 * people who look after its stuck requests (`stuckRequestsGoTo`; absent or empty: the authors). A person is
 * admitted when listed directly or a member, looked up live, of a listed group. Platform admins are admitted
 * by the caller of these functions.
 */
import type { Caller, Ref } from "@workflow/core";
import type { PublishedDefinition, RequestState } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { Queryable } from "../../store/db.ts";

/**
 * The person who may not answer a person wait (integrations.md 11.5): the Requester (`data.requester`, else the
 * starter when a user) where the wait's nobody-to-ask rule excludes them; else null. Such a person is not told
 * about the task and does not see it in "My tasks".
 */
export function mayNotAnswer(def: PublishedDefinition, state: RequestState, element: string): string | null {
  if (def.nobodyToAsk?.find((r) => r.wait === element)?.excludeRequester !== true) return null;
  const r = state.data["requester"];
  if (r !== undefined) return typeof r === "object" && r !== null && !Array.isArray(r) && r["type"] === "user" && typeof r["id"] === "string" ? r["id"] : null;
  return state.request?.by.type === "user" ? state.request.by.id : null;
}

/** The directory's live group memberships. A lookup that throws counts as unavailable. */
export interface Memberships {
  memberships(userId: string): Promise<{ groups: readonly string[] } | "unavailable">;
}

/** The workflow's people, as stored in `workflow_settings`. */
export interface WorkflowPeople {
  authors: Ref[];
  /** Null when the authors look after stuck requests. */
  stuckRequestsGoTo: Ref[] | null;
}

export async function readWorkflowPeople(q: Queryable, workflow: string): Promise<WorkflowPeople | null> {
  const rows = await q.query<{ authors: Ref[]; stuck_requests_go_to: Ref[] | null }>(
    "SELECT authors, stuck_requests_go_to FROM workflow_settings WHERE workflow = $1",
    [workflow],
  );
  const row = rows[0];
  return row === undefined ? null : { authors: row.authors, stuckRequestsGoTo: row.stuck_requests_go_to };
}

/** The people who look after stuck requests: "Stuck requests go to", or the authors when it is absent or empty. */
export function lookAfterStuck(people: WorkflowPeople): Ref[] {
  return people.stuckRequestsGoTo !== null && people.stuckRequestsGoTo.length > 0 ? people.stuckRequestsGoTo : people.authors;
}

/**
 * The caller's groups, looked up at most once per call to an operation: `groups()` asks the directory the
 * first time it is needed.
 */
export function groupsOnce(memberships: Memberships, caller: Caller): () => Promise<readonly string[] | "unavailable"> {
  let answer: Promise<readonly string[] | "unavailable"> | undefined;
  return () => {
    answer ??= memberships.memberships(caller.user).then(
      (r) => (r === "unavailable" ? r : r.groups),
      () => "unavailable" as const,
    );
    return answer;
  };
}

/**
 * Whether the listed people admit the caller: `yes` when listed directly or through a group, `no`, or
 * `unavailable` when only a group could admit them and the directory could not be asked. The directory is
 * asked only when no direct listing admits the caller and a group is listed. Platform admins are not
 * considered here.
 */
export async function admits(listed: readonly Ref[], caller: Caller, groups: () => Promise<readonly string[] | "unavailable">): Promise<"yes" | "no" | "unavailable"> {
  if (listed.some((r) => r.type === "user" && r.id === caller.user)) return "yes";
  const listedGroups = listed.filter((r) => r.type === "group").map((r) => r.id);
  if (listedGroups.length === 0) return "no";
  const mine = await groups();
  if (mine === "unavailable") return "unavailable";
  return listedGroups.some((g) => mine.includes(g)) ? "yes" : "no";
}
===\nengine/packages/server/src/config/catalogue.ts\n===
/**
 * The catalogue the server serves (integrations.md 8.6 and 8.8): built at start-up from the configured
 * connections and their connectors' entries, with its version, and the shape of an entry that may never
 * change under its ID.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueEntry } from "@workflow/core";

/** RFC 8785 JSON for what a catalogue or a start's arguments hold: object keys sorted, absent keys left out. */
export function canonicalJson(v: unknown): string {
  if (v === null || typeof v !== "object") return JSON.stringify(v);
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return `[${v.map(canonicalJson).join(",")}]`;
  const o = v as Record<string, unknown>;
  const keys = Object.keys(o).filter((k) => o[k] !== undefined).sort();
  return `{${keys.map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJson(o[k])}`).join(",")}}`;
}

/** "cat1." + base64url(SHA-256(JCS({ connections, entries, directoryConnection, notifyConnection }))). */
export function catalogueVersion(c: Omit<Catalogue, "version">): string {
  const { connections, entries, directoryConnection, notifyConnection } = c;
  return `cat1.${createHash("sha256").update(canonicalJson({ connections, entries, directoryConnection, notifyConnection }), "utf8").digest("base64url")}`;
}

/** The parts of an entry its ID fixes, by kind, each `label` and `addressOf` left out at any depth. */
export function entryShape(e: CatalogueEntry): unknown {
  const strip = (x: unknown): unknown => {
    if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(strip);
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) return x;
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(x).filter(([k]) => k !== "label" && k !== "addressOf").map(([k, y]) => [k, strip(y)]));
  };
  switch (e.kind) {
    case "operation":
      return strip({ kind: e.kind, sort: e.sort, input: e.input, result: e.result, failureCodes: e.failureCodes });
    case "dataSource":
      return strip({ kind: e.kind, input: e.input, item: e.item, searchable: e.searchable });
    case "trigger":
      return strip({ kind: e.kind, event: e.event });
    default:
      return { kind: e.kind };
  }
}

/**
 * The server's configuration (engine/design/integrations-shapes.md section 1): read once at start-up into
 * memory. It names the connections with their connector, settings and secrets, the directory and notify
 * connections, and the addresses outbound events are posted to. The catalogue is built from the connectors'
 * entries for these connections. Any failing check stops start-up (integrations.md 8.4).
 */
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Connection } from "@workflow/core";
import type { JsonObject } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { directoryDataSource, directoryOperation, GROUP_MEMBERS, MEMBERS_OF } from "../connectors/directory-source.ts";
import type { Connectors, DataSourceConnector, Directory, Notifier, OperationConnector, TriggerConnector } from "../connectors/types.ts";
import { catalogueVersion } from "./catalogue.ts";

export interface ConnectionConfig {
  /** ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$; engine, system and platform are reserved. */
  id: string;
  /** A name in the connector registry. */
  connector: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  status: Connection["status"];
  config: JsonObject;
  /** The name of an environment variable per secret slot, never a value. */
  secrets: { [slot: string]: string };
}

export interface EngineConfig {
  directoryConnection: string;
  notifyConnection: string;
  /** Names the platform in outbound events: an absolute URI without a trailing slash. */
  deploymentUri: string;
  connections: ConnectionConfig[];
  /** Where outbound events are posted. */
  subscribers: { url: string }[];
}

type WithoutRegistration<T> = T extends unknown ? Omit<T, "id" | "connection" | "status"> : never;
/** An entry as a connector declares it: the catalogue adds its ID, its connection and its status. */
export type EntryDeclaration = WithoutRegistration<CatalogueEntry>;

/** What a connector gives a ready connection at start-up. */
export interface ConnectorParts {
  operation?: OperationConnector;
  dataSource?: DataSourceConnector;
  /** The directory connection's own reads. */
  directory?: Directory;
  /** The notify connection's sending. */
  notifier?: Notifier;
  /** A connection with a trigger entry: the inbound hook's verify and parse. */
  trigger?: TriggerConnector;
}

/** A connector in the registry: code, never configuration. */
export interface ConnectorDefinition {
  name: string;
  /** Its secret slots. */
  secrets: readonly string[];
  entries(config: JsonObject): EntryDeclaration[];
  open(connection: { id: string; config: JsonObject; secret(slot: string): string }): ConnectorParts;
}

export interface Subscriber {
  url: string;
}

/** The configuration as the server runs with it. */
export interface RunConfig {
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  connectors: Connectors;
  subscribers: Subscriber[];
  deploymentUri: string;
}

export class ConfigError extends Error {
  readonly problems: string[];
  constructor(problems: string[]) {
    super(`the configuration has ${problems.length} problem(s): ${problems.join("; ")}`);
    this.problems = problems;
  }
}

const CONNECTION_ID = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$/;
const RESERVED = new Set(["engine", "system", "platform"]);

/** Reads the configuration, opens its ready connections and builds the catalogue; throws `ConfigError` on any failing check. */
export function loadConfig(config: EngineConfig, registry: readonly ConnectorDefinition[], env: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>): RunConfig {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const connections: Connection[] = [];
  const entries: CatalogueEntry[] = [];
  const parts = new Map<string, ConnectorParts>();
  const secret = (name: string, where: string): string => {
    const value = env[name];
    if (value === undefined || value === "") problems.push(`${where}: the environment variable ${name} is not set`);
    return value ?? "";
  };

  for (const c of config.connections) {
    if (!CONNECTION_ID.test(c.id) || RESERVED.has(c.id)) problems.push(`connection ${c.id}: the ID is not allowed`);
    if (connections.some((x) => x.id === c.id)) problems.push(`connection ${c.id}: configured twice`);
    connections.push({ id: c.id, label: c.label, description: c.description ?? null, status: c.status });
    const connector = registry.find((r) => r.name === c.connector);
    if (connector === undefined) {
      problems.push(`connection ${c.id}: no connector ${c.connector}`);
      continue;
    }
    const declared = connector.entries(c.config).map((e) => ({ ...e, id: `${c.id}.${e.name}@${e.version}`, connection: c.id, status: "ready" }) as CatalogueEntry);
    for (const e of declared) if (entries.some((x) => x.id === e.id)) problems.push(`entry ${e.id}: declared twice`);
    entries.push(...declared);
    if (c.status !== "ready") continue;
    const secrets = Object.fromEntries(connector.secrets.map((slot) => [slot, secret(c.secrets[slot] ?? "", `connection ${c.id} secret ${slot}`)]));
    const opened = connector.open({ id: c.id, config: c.config, secret: (slot) => secrets[slot] ?? "" });
    parts.set(c.id, opened);
    for (const e of declared) {
      if (e.kind === "operation" && opened.operation === undefined && !(c.id === config.directoryConnection && opened.directory !== undefined)) problems.push(`entry ${e.id}: the connector cannot call it`);
      if (e.kind === "operation" && e.sort === "await" && opened.operation?.status === undefined) problems.push(`entry ${e.id}: the connector cannot ask its status`);
      if (e.kind === "dataSource" && opened.dataSource === undefined && !(c.id === config.directoryConnection && opened.directory !== undefined)) problems.push(`entry ${e.id}: the connector cannot list it`);
      if (e.kind === "trigger" && opened.trigger === undefined) problems.push(`entry ${e.id}: the connector cannot verify and parse it`);
    }
  }

  const directory = parts.get(config.directoryConnection)?.directory;
  if (directory === undefined) problems.push(`directoryConnection ${config.directoryConnection}: not a ready connection with a directory`);
  for (const name of [MEMBERS_OF, GROUP_MEMBERS]) {
    if (!entries.some((e) => e.id === `${config.directoryConnection}.${name}`)) problems.push(`directoryConnection ${config.directoryConnection}: does not declare ${name}`);
  }
  const notifier = parts.get(config.notifyConnection)?.notifier;
  if (notifier === undefined) problems.push(`notifyConnection ${config.notifyConnection}: not a ready connection that sends messages`);
  const subscribers = config.subscribers.map((s) => ({ url: s.url }));
  if (problems.length > 0 || directory === undefined || notifier === undefined) throw new ConfigError(problems);

  const dirSource = directoryDataSource(directory);
  const dirOperation = directoryOperation(directory);
  const isDirectory = (connection: string): boolean => connection === config.directoryConnection;
  const unversioned = { connections, entries, directoryConnection: config.directoryConnection, notifyConnection: config.notifyConnection };
  return {
    catalogue: { version: catalogueVersion(unversioned), ...unversioned },
    connectors: {
      directory,
      notifier,
      dataSource: (connection) => parts.get(connection)?.dataSource ?? (isDirectory(connection) ? dirSource : undefined),
      operation: (connection) => parts.get(connection)?.operation ?? (isDirectory(connection) ? dirOperation : undefined),
      trigger: (connection) => parts.get(connection)?.trigger,
    },
    subscribers,
    deploymentUri: config.deploymentUri,
  };
}

/**
 * Structured log lines (integrations.md 14): one JSON object per line, `{at, kind, ...ids, code?, detail?}`.
 * Call attempts, rule errors and platform problems are logged here; there is no alert table. A line never holds
 * an argument, a result, a body or a secret.

export interface LogLine {
  kind: string;
  request?: string;
  wait?: string;
  binding?: string;
  connection?: string;
  entry?: string;
  rule?: string;
  code?: string;
  detail?: string;
  [more: string]: string | number | undefined;
}

export type Log = (line: LogLine) => void;

/** The server's log: each line to stdout as JSON. */
export function stdoutLog(clock: () => Date = () => new Date()): Log {
  return (line) => process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ at: clock().toISOString(), ...line })}\n`);
}

/** A log that keeps its lines, for tests. */
export function memoryLog(): { log: Log; lines: LogLine[] } {
  const lines: LogLine[] = [];
  return { lines, log: (line) => lines.push(line) };

===\nengine/packages/server/src/connectors/directory-source.ts\n===
/**
 * The directory connection's two entries (integrations.md 8.7), served from its own reads:
 * - the data source `groupMembers@1`: the users who are members of a group now, items `{ id, name, email? }`,
 *   searchable by name. The choices call and the act-time lookup reach the directory through this.
 * - the read operation `membersOf@1`: for groups `[{type, id}]`, `{ groups: [{ id, name?, members }] }`, the
 *   recorded read behind a members step, an "is in group" test and the nobody-to-ask rule.
 */
import type { JsonObject } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { CallAnswer, DataSourceConnector, Directory, DirectoryEntry, GetAnswer, ListAnswer, OperationConnector } from "./types.ts";

export const GROUP_MEMBERS = "groupMembers@1";
export const MEMBERS_OF = "membersOf@1";

/** `membersOf@1` through the directory's reads. The directory not answering is `unknown`: the call is tried again. */
export function directoryOperation(directory: Directory): OperationConnector {
  return {
    async call(req): Promise<CallAnswer> {
      if (req.op !== MEMBERS_OF) return { answer: "unknown", detail: `no operation ${req.op}` };
      const asked = Array.isArray(req.args["groups"]) ? req.args["groups"] : [];
      const ids = asked.flatMap((g) => (typeof g === "object" && g !== null && !Array.isArray(g) && typeof g["id"] === "string" ? [g["id"]] : []));
      try {
        const named = await directory.lookup(ids.map((id) => ({ type: "group" as const, id })));
        const groups: JsonObject[] = [];
        for (const id of ids) {
          const members = (await directory.membersOf(id)).filter((e) => e.type === "user").map((e) => ({ type: "user", id: e.id }));
          const name = named.find((e) => e.id === id)?.label;
          groups.push(name === undefined ? { id: { type: "group", id }, members } : { id: { type: "group", id }, name, members });
        }
        return { answer: "ok", data: { groups } };
      } catch (error) {
        return { answer: "unknown", detail: String(error) };
      }
    },
  };
}

function groupOf(inputs: JsonObject): string | undefined {
  const g = inputs["group"];
  if (typeof g !== "object" || g === null || Array.isArray(g)) return undefined;
  return g["type"] === "group" && typeof g["id"] === "string" ? g["id"] : undefined;
}

function itemOf(e: DirectoryEntry): JsonObject {
  return e.detail === undefined ? { id: e.id, name: e.label } : { id: e.id, name: e.label, email: e.detail };
}

const unavailable = (detail: string) => ({ answer: "unavailable" as const, detail });

/** The directory's group members as a data source. The cursor is the offset into the members. */
export function directoryDataSource(directory: Directory): DataSourceConnector {
  async function members(inputs: JsonObject): Promise<DirectoryEntry[] | string> {
    const group = groupOf(inputs);
    if (group === undefined) return [];
    try {
      return (await directory.membersOf(group)).filter((e) => e.type === "user");
    } catch (error) {
      return String(error);
    }
  }
  return {
    async list(req): Promise<ListAnswer> {
      if (req.source !== GROUP_MEMBERS) return unavailable(`no source ${req.source}`);
      const all = await members(req.inputs);
      if (typeof all === "string") return unavailable(all);
      const search = req.search?.toLowerCase();
      const hits = search === undefined ? all : all.filter((e) => e.label.toLowerCase().includes(search));
      const offset = Number.parseInt(req.cursor ?? "0", 10) || 0;
      const page = hits.slice(offset, offset + req.limit);
      return { answer: "ok", items: page.map(itemOf), next: offset + req.limit < hits.length ? String(offset + req.limit) : null };
    },
    async get(req): Promise<GetAnswer> {
      if (req.source !== GROUP_MEMBERS) return unavailable(`no source ${req.source}`);
      const all = await members(req.inputs);
      if (typeof all === "string") return unavailable(all);
      const found = all.find((e) => itemOf(e)[req.field] === req.value);
      return found === undefined ? { answer: "notFound" } : { answer: "found", item: itemOf(found) };
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The turn's live lookups through the connectors (integrations.md 11.1 and 11.3): the actor's
 * groups from the directory within 5 s, and each answer looked up by its stored value with the data source's
 * `get` within the entry's `timeoutSeconds`. A connection or entry that is not ready, a timeout, a rejection
 * or an `unavailable` answer is one that could not be made.
 */
import type { Catalogue, DataSource } from "@workflow/core";
import type { LookupAnswer } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { CatalogueRegistry } from "../api/shared/catalogue.ts";
import type { TurnLookups } from "../turn/types.ts";
import type { Connectors } from "./types.ts";

export const MEMBERSHIP_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
const DEFAULT_SOURCE_TIMEOUT_S = 10;

/** Rejects when `p` does not settle within `ms`. */
export function within<T>(p: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
    timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`no answer within ${ms} ms`)), ms);
  });
  return Promise.race([p, timeout]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
}

/** The data source entry `<connection>.<source>` when it and its connection are ready, else undefined. */
export function readySource(catalogue: Catalogue, connection: string, source: string): DataSource | undefined {
  if (catalogue.connections.find((c) => c.id === connection)?.status !== "ready") return undefined;
  const entry = catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === `${connection}.${source}`);
  return entry?.kind === "dataSource" && entry.status === "ready" ? entry : undefined;
}

export function connectorLookups(connectors: Connectors, catalogue: CatalogueRegistry): TurnLookups {
  return {
    async memberships(userId) {
      try {
        return { groups: await within(connectors.directory.groupsOf(userId), MEMBERSHIP_TIMEOUT_MS) };
      } catch {
        return "unavailable";
      }
    },
    async lookup(p): Promise<LookupAnswer> {
      const entry = readySource(catalogue.current(), p.connection, p.source);
      const ds = connectors.dataSource(p.connection);
      if (entry === undefined || ds === undefined) return { unavailable: true };
      try {
        const a = await within(ds.get({ source: p.source, inputs: p.inputs, field: p.storedField, value: p.stored }), (entry.timeoutSeconds ?? DEFAULT_SOURCE_TIMEOUT_S) * 1000);
        if (a.answer === "unavailable") return { unavailable: true };
        if (a.answer === "notFound") return { found: false };
        if (p.answer === "person") return { found: true, label: null };
        const label = a.item[p.labelField];
        return { found: true, label: typeof label === "string" ? label : label === undefined || label === null ? "" : JSON.stringify(label) };
      } catch {
        return { unavailable: true };
      }
    },
  };
}
===\nengine/packages/server/src/connectors/memory.ts\n===
/**
 * In-memory connectors for tests: a directory, data sources, operations and a notify connection held in
 * plain objects. Each can be made to fail, so a test can show what the engine does when the outside cannot
 * be asked, and each keeps what it was asked, so a test can show what was sent and what is never asked.
 */
import type { Json, JsonObject } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { directoryDataSource, directoryOperation } from "./directory-source.ts";
import type {
  CallAnswer,
  CallRequest,
  Connectors,
  DataSourceConnector,
  Directory,
  DirectoryEntry,
  DirectoryRef,
  GetAnswer,
  ListAnswer,
  Notifier,
  OperationConnector,
  OutgoingMessage,
  StatusAnswer,
  StatusRequest,
} from "./types.ts";

export interface MemoryDirectoryData {
  /** User ID to display name. */
  people: Record<string, string>;
  /** Group ID to its user IDs. */
  groups: Record<string, string[]>;
  /** Group ID to display name; default the ID. */
  groupNames?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface MemoryDirectory extends Directory {
  /** False: every read rejects, as a directory that cannot be reached. */
  available: boolean;
  /** Reads that reject while the rest answer. */
  failing: Set<"groupsOf" | "membersOf" | "search" | "lookup">;
  /** How many reads were made, by function name. */
  readonly calls: Record<"groupsOf" | "membersOf" | "search" | "lookup", number>;
}

export function memoryDirectory(data: MemoryDirectoryData): MemoryDirectory {
  const calls = { groupsOf: 0, membersOf: 0, search: 0, lookup: 0 };
  const entry = (r: DirectoryRef): DirectoryEntry | undefined => {
    if (r.type === "user") return r.id in data.people ? { type: "user", id: r.id, label: data.people[r.id] ?? r.id } : undefined;
    return r.id in data.groups ? { type: "group", id: r.id, label: data.groupNames?.[r.id] ?? r.id } : undefined;
  };
  const dir: MemoryDirectory = {
    available: true,
    failing: new Set(),
    calls,
    async groupsOf(user) {
      calls.groupsOf += 1;
      if (!dir.available || dir.failing.has("groupsOf")) throw new Error("directory unavailable");
      return Object.entries(data.groups).filter(([, users]) => users.includes(user)).map(([g]) => g);
    },
    async membersOf(group) {
      calls.membersOf += 1;
      if (!dir.available || dir.failing.has("membersOf")) throw new Error("directory unavailable");
      return (data.groups[group] ?? []).flatMap((u) => entry({ type: "user", id: u }) ?? []);
    },
    async search(query, types, limit) {
      calls.search += 1;
      if (!dir.available || dir.failing.has("search")) throw new Error("directory unavailable");
      const q = query.toLowerCase();
      const all: DirectoryRef[] = [
        ...(types.includes("user") ? Object.keys(data.people).map((id) => ({ type: "user" as const, id })) : []),
        ...(types.includes("group") ? Object.keys(data.groups).map((id) => ({ type: "group" as const, id })) : []),
      ];
      return all.flatMap((r) => entry(r) ?? []).filter((e) => e.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, limit);
    },
    async lookup(refs) {
      calls.lookup += 1;
      if (!dir.available || dir.failing.has("lookup")) throw new Error("directory unavailable");
      return refs.flatMap((r) => entry(r) ?? []);
    },
  };
  return dir;
}

export interface MemoryDataSource extends DataSourceConnector {
  available: boolean;
  /** Every request made, in order. */
  readonly requests: { kind: "list" | "get"; source: string; inputs: JsonObject; search: string | null }[];
}

const same = (a: Json | undefined, b: Json): boolean => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);

/**
 * Data sources by `<name>@<version>`. An input whose field an item also has keeps only the items with that
 * value, as Try it's fakes do; `search` filters on `labelField`.
 */
export function memoryDataSource(sources: Record<string, JsonObject[]>, labelField = "name"): MemoryDataSource {
  const requests: MemoryDataSource["requests"] = [];
  const items = (source: string, inputs: JsonObject): JsonObject[] =>
    (sources[source] ?? []).filter((item) => Object.entries(inputs).every(([f, v]) => !(f in item) || same(item[f], v as Json)));
  const ds: MemoryDataSource = {
    available: true,
    requests,
    async list(req): Promise<ListAnswer> {
      requests.push({ kind: "list", source: req.source, inputs: req.inputs, search: req.search });
      if (!ds.available || !(req.source in sources)) return { answer: "unavailable", detail: "source unavailable" };
      const q = req.search?.toLowerCase();
      const hits = items(req.source, req.inputs).filter((i) => q === undefined || String(i[labelField] ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q));
      const offset = Number.parseInt(req.cursor ?? "0", 10) || 0;
      return { answer: "ok", items: hits.slice(offset, offset + req.limit), next: offset + req.limit < hits.length ? String(offset + req.limit) : null };
    },
    async get(req): Promise<GetAnswer> {
      requests.push({ kind: "get", source: req.source, inputs: req.inputs, search: null });
      if (!ds.available || !(req.source in sources)) return { answer: "unavailable", detail: "source unavailable" };
      const found = items(req.source, req.inputs).find((i) => i[req.field] === req.value);
      return found === undefined ? { answer: "notFound" } : { answer: "found", item: found };
    },
  };
  return ds;
}

/**
 * An operation that answers from a script: each call or status question takes the next answer queued for its
 * op, else `answer(req)`. Every request is kept, in order, so a test can see what was sent with which key.
 */
export interface MemoryOperation extends OperationConnector {
  readonly sent: ({ kind: "call" } & CallRequest | { kind: "status" } & StatusRequest)[];
  /** Answers given to the next calls or status questions of an op, first in first out; a function may throw. */
  queue(op: string, ...answers: (CallAnswer | StatusAnswer | (() => never))[]): void;
}

export function memoryOperation(answer: (req: CallRequest) => CallAnswer | Promise<CallAnswer>, status?: (req: StatusRequest) => StatusAnswer): MemoryOperation {
  const sent: MemoryOperation["sent"] = [];
  const queued = new Map<string, (CallAnswer | StatusAnswer | (() => never))[]>();
  const next = (op: string): CallAnswer | StatusAnswer | undefined => {
    const a = queued.get(op)?.shift();
    return typeof a === "function" ? a() : a;
  };
  const op: MemoryOperation = {
    sent,
    queue(name, ...answers) {
      queued.set(name, [...(queued.get(name) ?? []), ...answers]);
    },
    async call(req) {
      sent.push({ kind: "call", ...req });
      return (next(req.op) as CallAnswer | undefined) ?? (await answer(req));
    },
  };
  if (status !== undefined) {
    op.status = async (req) => {
      sent.push({ kind: "status", ...req });
      return (next(req.op) as StatusAnswer | undefined) ?? status(req);
    };
  }
  return op;
}

/** A notify connection that keeps every message; `failing` makes the next sends reject. */
export interface MemoryNotifier extends Notifier {
  readonly sent: OutgoingMessage[];
  failing: number;
}

export function memoryNotifier(): MemoryNotifier {
  const n: MemoryNotifier = {
    sent: [],
    failing: 0,
    async send(message) {
      if (n.failing > 0) {
        n.failing -= 1;
        throw new Error("notify connection unavailable");
      }
      n.sent.push(message);
    },
  };
  return n;
}

/**
 * Connectors from a directory, data sources and operations by connection. The directory connection serves
 * `groupMembers@1` and `membersOf@1` from the directory unless given others.
 */
export function memoryConnectors(opts: {
  directory: Directory;
  directoryConnection: string;
  notifier?: Notifier;
  sources?: Record<string, DataSourceConnector>;
  operations?: Record<string, OperationConnector>;
}): Connectors {
  const dirSource = directoryDataSource(opts.directory);
  const dirOperation = directoryOperation(opts.directory);
  return {
    directory: opts.directory,
    notifier: opts.notifier ?? memoryNotifier(),
    dataSource: (connection) => opts.sources?.[connection] ?? (connection === opts.directoryConnection ? dirSource : undefined),
    operation: (connection) => opts.operations?.[connection] ?? (connection === opts.directoryConnection ? dirOperation : undefined),
  };
}

/**
 * The outside world as the engine sees it (integrations.md 8.5 and 8.7): the directory, data sources,
 * operations and the notify connection, each behind an interface. A connector that cannot answer rejects or
 * answers `unavailable` or `unknown`; the caller turns either into a "try again".
 */
import type { JsonObject } from "@workflow/core/kernel";

/** A person or group in the directory: `id` is the directory's immutable object ID. */
export interface DirectoryRef {
  type: "user" | "group";
  id: string;
}

export interface DirectoryEntry extends DirectoryRef {
  /** Display name. */
  label: string;
  /** For example an email address or a group description. */
  detail?: string;
}

/** The directory connection's own reads, for the engine's lookups and for pages. Each rejects when the directory cannot be asked. */
export interface Directory {
  /** The IDs of the groups a user belongs to now. */
  groupsOf(user: string): Promise<string[]>;
  /** The users who are members of a group now. */
  membersOf(group: string): Promise<DirectoryEntry[]>;
  search(query: string, types: readonly ("user" | "group")[], limit: number): Promise<DirectoryEntry[]>;
  /** The entries found for these references, in their order; one not found is left out. */
  lookup(refs: readonly DirectoryRef[]): Promise<DirectoryEntry[]>;
}

/** Door 5: a data source's `list`. `source` is `<name>@<version>`. */
export interface ListRequest {
  source: string;
  inputs: JsonObject;
  search: string | null;
  cursor: string | null;
  limit: number;
}
export type ListAnswer = { answer: "ok"; items: JsonObject[]; next: string | null } | { answer: "unavailable"; detail: string };

/** Door 5: a data source's `get` by a stored value. */
export interface GetRequest {
  source: string;
  inputs: JsonObject;
  field: string;
  value: string | number;
}
export type GetAnswer = { answer: "found"; item: JsonObject } | { answer: "notFound" } | { answer: "unavailable"; detail: string };

export interface DataSourceConnector {
  list(req: ListRequest): Promise<ListAnswer>;
  get(req: GetRequest): Promise<GetAnswer>;
}

/** Door 3: an operation's call with its recorded key, and its answers (integrations.md 8.5). */
export interface CallRequest {
  op: string;
  args: JsonObject;
  key: string;
}
export type CallAnswer =
  | { answer: "ok"; data: JsonObject; jobRef?: string }
  | { answer: "failed"; code: string; message: string; jobRef?: string }
  | { answer: "unknown"; detail: string }
  | { answer: "accepted"; jobRef: string };

/** An await operation's status question: about the job `jobRef` only. */
export interface StatusRequest {
  op: string;
  key: string;
  jobRef: string;
}
export type StatusAnswer =
  | { answer: "ok"; data: JsonObject; jobRef: string }
  | { answer: "failed"; code: string; message: string; jobRef: string }
  | { answer: "running"; jobRef: string }
  | { answer: "unknown"; detail: string };

export interface OperationConnector {
  call(req: CallRequest): Promise<CallAnswer>;
  /** Required for an await operation. */
  status?(req: StatusRequest): Promise<StatusAnswer>;
}

/** One message to one person, as the notify connection receives it. How it is worded and sent is the connection's. */
export interface OutgoingMessage {
  /** The person's directory ID. */
  to: string;
  requestId: string;
  readableId: number;
  workflow: string;
  version: number;
  /** The notification rule. */
  rule: string;
  /** The event it matched: its type, seq and time, and its payload ({reason, stage} for Stuck). */
  event: { type: string; seq: number; at: string; payload: unknown };
  message: { words: string } | { parts: ({ text: string } | { kind: string; value?: unknown })[] };
}

/** Door 6: the connection that carries Notify. Rejects when the message could not be sent. */
export interface Notifier {
  send(message: OutgoingMessage): Promise<void>;
}

/** Door 1: an inbound request to the hook as the trigger connector sees it. `headers` names are lower case. */
export interface RawRequest {
  method: string;
  headers: { [name: string]: string };
  body: Uint8Array;
}
export type VerifyAnswer = { answer: "ok" } | { answer: "refused"; code: "bad-signature" | "stale" | "unsigned" };
export type ParseAnswer =
  | { answer: "events"; eventId: string; events: { [nameAtVersion: string]: JsonObject } }
  | { answer: "ignored"; eventId: string | null; detail: string }
  | { answer: "unparsable"; detail: string }
  | { answer: "unavailable"; detail: string };

/** Door 1: a connection with a trigger entry checks the sender's scheme, then maps the body to its events. */
export interface TriggerConnector {
  verify(req: RawRequest): Promise<VerifyAnswer>;
  parse(req: RawRequest): Promise<ParseAnswer>;
}

/** What the server reaches the outside through, by connection ID. */
export interface Connectors {
  /** The directory connection (the catalogue's `directoryConnection`). */
  directory: Directory;
  /** The notify connection (the catalogue's `notifyConnection`). */
  notifier: Notifier;
  /** A connection's data sources; undefined when the connection has none or is not set up. */
  dataSource(connection: string): DataSourceConnector | undefined;
  /** A connection's operations; undefined when it has none. */
  operation(connection: string): OperationConnector | undefined;
  /** A connection's trigger; absent or undefined when it has none. */
  trigger?(connection: string): TriggerConnector | undefined;
}

/**
 * The dev host's control surface for the mocks (engine/DEV-HOST.md, "Controlling the mocks from the
 * browser"), under `/dev`, outside the API base, served by the dev host only: each mock's switches, what each
 * mock received, and making the helpdesk send. JSON in and out; no sign-in. A failure answers
 * `{ "error": "<one line>" }`.
 */
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { HELPDESK_SEND_FIELDS as SEND_FIELDS, MOCK_CATALOGUE, receivedBy, sendHelpdeskEvent, type HelpdeskSendOptions, type Mocks } from "../mock/index.ts";

type Switch = "failNext" | "down";
const SWITCHES: readonly Switch[] = ["failNext", "down"];

type MockOf = Partial<Record<Switch, boolean>>;

const json = (status: number, body: unknown): Response => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" } });
const refuse = (status: number, error: string): Response => json(status, { error });

/** The body as a JSON object, or a one-line reason it is not one. An empty body is `{}`. */
async function objectBody(req: Request): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | string> {
  const text = await req.text();
  if (text.trim() === "") return {};
  try {
    const v: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
    return typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v) ? (v as Record<string, unknown>) : "the body is not a JSON object";
  } catch {
    return "the body is not JSON";
  }
}

/** `/dev/...` over `mocks`. `origin` is the host's own address (known once it listens); `clock` signs the helpdesk's events. */
export function devRoutes(mocks: Mocks, origin: () => string, clock: () => Date): Hono {
  const connections = MOCK_CATALOGUE.connections;
  const mockOf = (connection: string): MockOf | undefined =>
    connections.some((c) => c.id === connection) ? (mocks[connection as keyof Mocks] as MockOf) : undefined;
  const entryOf = (connection: string) => {
    const mock = mockOf(connection) ?? {};
    const switches: MockOf = {};
    for (const s of SWITCHES) if (typeof mock[s] === "boolean") switches[s] = mock[s];
    return { connection, label: connections.find((c) => c.id === connection)?.label ?? connection, switches };
  };
  const app = new Hono();
  app.get("/dev/mocks", () => json(200, { mocks: connections.map((c) => entryOf(c.id)) }));

  app.put("/dev/mocks/:connection", async (c) => {
    const connection = c.req.param("connection");
    const mock = mockOf(connection);
    if (mock === undefined) return refuse(404, `no mock system ${connection}`);
    const body = await objectBody(c.req.raw);
    if (typeof body === "string") return refuse(400, body);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(body)) {
      if (!SWITCHES.includes(k as Switch)) return refuse(400, `unknown key ${k}: the switches are failNext and down`);
      if (typeof mock[k as Switch] !== "boolean") return refuse(400, `${connection} has no switch ${k}`);
      if (typeof v !== "boolean") return refuse(400, `${k} must be true or false`);
    }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(body)) mock[k as Switch] = v as boolean;
    return json(200, entryOf(connection));
  });

  app.get("/dev/mocks/:connection/received", (c) => {
    const connection = c.req.param("connection");
    if (mockOf(connection) === undefined) return refuse(404, `no mock system ${connection}`);
    return json(200, { items: receivedBy(mocks, connection, c.req.query("request")) });
  });

  app.post("/dev/mocks/helpdesk/send", async (c) => {
    const body = await objectBody(c.req.raw);
    if (typeof body === "string") return refuse(400, body);
    const options: HelpdeskSendOptions = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(body)) {
      if (!SEND_FIELDS.includes(k as keyof HelpdeskSendOptions)) return refuse(400, `unknown key ${k}: the fields are ${SEND_FIELDS.join(", ")}`);
      if (typeof v !== "string") return refuse(400, `${k} must be text`);
      options[k as keyof HelpdeskSendOptions] = v;
    }
    return json(200, await sendHelpdeskEvent(origin(), options, clock));
  });
  return app;
}

}

const LOCALHOST = /^https?:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|\[::1\])(:\d+)?$/;

export async function startDevHost(options: DevHostOptions = {}): Promise<DevHost> {
  const clock = options.clock ?? (() => new Date());
  const log = options.log ?? stdoutLog(clock);
  const db = await createPgliteDb(options.dataDir);
  await migrate(db);

  // The mocks name the request a call belongs to by its key, while the call's row is there.
  const requestOf = async (key: string): Promise<string | null> => (await db.query<{ request_id: string }>("SELECT request_id FROM pending_calls WHERE idempotency_key = $1 LIMIT 1", [key]))[0]?.request_id ?? null;
  const mocks = createMocks(clock, log, requestOf);
  const run = loadConfig(mocks.config, mocks.registry, mocks.env);
  const catalogue = fixedCatalogue(run.catalogue);
  const definitions = createDefinitionReader(() => run.catalogue);
  const lookups = connectorLookups(run.connectors, catalogue);
  const turns = createTurns(db, definitions, { lookups, clock });
  const worker = createWorker({ db, turns, definitions, connectors: run.connectors, catalogue, subscribers: run.subscribers, sink: mocks.reporting, deploymentUri: run.deploymentUri, log, clock });
  const hooks = createHooks({ db, turns, definitions, catalogue, connectors: run.connectors, log, clock });

  // The development sign-in: the person signed in on this host, or the one named by the development header.
  // The header must name a person of the directory, as `PUT /session` must: a group or an unknown ID is
  // nobody signed in (`unauthenticated`).
  let signedIn = DEFAULT_PERSON;
  const callers: CallerAdapter = {
    async callerOf(request): Promise<Caller | null> {
      const user = request.headers.get(DEV_USER_HEADER) ?? signedIn;
      if (!PEOPLE.some((p) => p.id === user)) return null;
      const admin = request.headers.get(DEV_PLATFORM_ADMIN_HEADER);
      return { user, platformAdmin: admin === null ? PLATFORM_ADMINS.includes(user) : admin === "true" };
    },
  };
  const dev: DevSession = {
    people: PEOPLE.map((p) => ({ type: "user", id: p.id })),
    platformAdmins: [...PLATFORM_ADMINS],
    async signIn(_caller, person) {
      signedIn = person.id;
    },
  };
  const runtime = createRuntimeApi({ db, turns, connectors: run.connectors, catalogue, clock }, { inbound: hooks, dev });
  const authoring = createAuthoringApi({ db, catalogue, memberships: lookups, clock });

  if (options.seed === true) await seedSamples(db, catalogue, clock);

  const app = new Hono();
  app.use(
    "*",
    cors({
      origin: (origin) => (LOCALHOST.test(origin) ? origin : null),
      allowHeaders: ["content-type", "if-none-match", DEV_USER_HEADER, DEV_PLATFORM_ADMIN_HEADER],
      allowMethods: ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "OPTIONS"],
      exposeHeaders: ["ETag", "Location", "Retry-After", "Engine-Core-Version", "Engine-Definition-Format"],
    }),
  );
  let origin = "";
  app.route("/", devRoutes(mocks, () => origin, clock));
  app.route("/", hookRoutes(hooks));
  app.route("/", authoringRoutes(authoring, callers));
  app.route("/", runtimeRoutes(runtime, callers));
  app.notFound(() => notFoundPath());

  worker.start(options.workerIntervalMs ?? 500);
  const { server, port } = await new Promise<{ server: ServerType; port: number }>((resolve) => {
    const s = serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: options.port ?? DEFAULT_PORT, hostname: "127.0.0.1" }, (info) => resolve({ server: s, port: info.port }));
  });
  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
  return {
    url: origin,
    db,
    mocks,
    worker,
    async close() {
      await worker.stop();
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
      await db.close();
    },
  };
}
