/**
 * The events table: gap-free appends, loads that give back exactly what was appended (the time to the
 * microsecond), and every replay case of engine/spec/kernel/replay-only.yaml stored, loaded and folded to
 * its expected state with core's case helpers.
 */
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { fold, type AnyEventRecord } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { loadReplayCases } from "../../../core/test/kernel/cases/load.ts";
import { stateMismatches } from "../../../core/test/kernel/cases/state-match.ts";
import { createTranslator } from "../../../core/test/kernel/cases/translate.ts";
import { sqlState, type Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { appendEvents, lastSeq, loadEvents, loadState } from "../../src/store/events.ts";
import { freshDb, resetDb } from "../helpers.ts";

let db: Db;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});
beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetDb(db);
});

const replayCases = loadReplayCases();

function history(id: string): AnyEventRecord[] {
  const c = replayCases.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (c === undefined) throw new Error(`no case ${id}`);
  return createTranslator({ requestId: `r-${id}` }).history(c.history);
}

describe("appending and loading events", () => {
  it("loads exactly what was appended, at to the microsecond", async () => {
    const events = history("R1").map((e, i) => ({ ...e, at: `2026-11-15T09:30:0${i % 10}.12345${i % 10}Z` }));
    await db.transaction((tx) => appendEvents(tx, events));
    expect(await loadEvents(db, "r-R1")).toEqual(events);
    expect(await lastSeq(db, "r-R1")).toBe(events.length);
  });

  it("appends a later turn's events after the stored ones", async () => {
    const events = history("R2");
    await appendEvents(db, events.slice(0, 3));
    await appendEvents(db, events.slice(3));
    expect(await loadEvents(db, "r-R2")).toEqual(events);
  });

  it("refuses a gap, a repeat or an event of another request, and writes none of the batch", async () => {
    const events = history("R2");
    await appendEvents(db, events.slice(0, 2));
    await expect(appendEvents(db, events.slice(3, 5))).rejects.toThrow("expected 3");
    await expect(appendEvents(db, events.slice(1, 3))).rejects.toThrow("expected 3");
    const other = { ...(events[2] as AnyEventRecord), requestId: "other" };
    await expect(appendEvents(db, [events[2] as AnyEventRecord, other])).rejects.toThrow("two requests");
    expect(await lastSeq(db, "r-R2")).toBe(2);
  });

  it("is guarded by the primary key (request_id, seq) as well", async () => {
    const [first] = history("R1");
    await appendEvents(db, [first as AnyEventRecord]);
    const error = await db
      .query(`INSERT INTO events (request_id, seq, type, at, turn, v, engine_build, payload) VALUES ($1, 1, 'RequestStarted', now(), 1, 1, 'b', '{}')`, ["r-R1"])
      .then(() => null, (e: unknown) => e);
    expect(sqlState(error)).toBe("23505");
  });

  it("gives a request with no events the empty state", async () => {
    const { events, state } = await loadState(db, "nobody");
    expect(events).toEqual([]);
    expect(state.request).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("replay-only.yaml through the store", () => {
  it("has the cases R1, R2, R4 and R10", () => {
    expect(replayCases.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(["R1", "R2", "R4", "R10"]);
  });

  for (const c of replayCases) {
    it(`${c.id}: ${c.name}`, async () => {
      const events = history(c.id);
      await db.transaction((tx) => appendEvents(tx, events));
      const loaded = await loadEvents(db, `r-${c.id}`);
      expect(loaded).toEqual(events);
      const { state } = await loadState(db, `r-${c.id}`);
      expect(stateMismatches(state, c.expectState)).toEqual([]);
      expect(state).toEqual(fold(events));
    });
  }
});

/** The schema files and their runner (E-30), and the tables of engine/spec/kernel/data-model.md. */
import { mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createPgliteDb, sqlState, type Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { migrate, schemaFiles } from "../../src/store/migrate.ts";
import { freshDb } from "../helpers.ts";

/** The twelve tables of the data model: E-33's list, and the settings log the authoring API reads. */
const TABLES = [
  "events",
  "definitions",
  "workflows",
  "workflow_settings",
  "settings_log",
  "drafts",
  "requests",
  "open_waits",
  "pending_calls",
  "jobs",
  "attempts_log",
  "inbound_log",
];

let db: Db;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});

async function columns(table: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const rows = await db.query<{ column_name: string }>("SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = $1 ORDER BY ordinal_position", [table]);
  return rows.map((r) => r.column_name);
}

async function primaryKey(table: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const rows = await db.query<{ column_name: string }>(
    `SELECT a.attname AS column_name FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = ANY(i.indkey)
     WHERE i.indrelid = $1::regclass AND i.indisprimary ORDER BY array_position(i.indkey, a.attnum)`,
    [table],
  );
  return rows.map((r) => r.column_name);
}

const refused = (sql: string, params: unknown[] = []): Promise<unknown> => db.query(sql, params).then(() => null, (e: unknown) => e);

describe("the schema", () => {
  it("has the data model's twelve tables and no other", async () => {
    const rows = await db.query<{ tablename: string }>("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename <> 'schema_migrations' ORDER BY tablename");
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.tablename)).toEqual([...TABLES].sort());
    expect(TABLES).toHaveLength(12);
  });

  it("gives the tables the data model's columns and keys", async () => {
    expect(await columns("events")).toEqual(["request_id", "seq", "type", "at", "turn", "v", "engine_build", "payload"]);
    expect(await primaryKey("events")).toEqual(["request_id", "seq"]);
    expect(await columns("definitions")).toEqual([
      "workflow", "version", "document", "authored", "from_revision", "core_version", "format_version", "catalogue_version", "schemas", "published_by", "published_at",
    ]);
    expect(await primaryKey("definitions")).toEqual(["workflow", "version"]);
    expect(await columns("requests")).toEqual([
      "id", "readable_id", "workflow", "definition_version", "status", "status_label", "active_stages", "data",
      "started_by", "started_at", "closed_at", "fault", "fault_element", "stuck", "stage", "stuck_view", "client_token", "client_args_hash", "last_seq", "updated_at",
    ]);
    expect(await primaryKey("open_waits")).toEqual(["request_id", "element", "activation", "key", "seq"]);
    expect(await columns("pending_calls")).toEqual([
      "request_id", "element", "activation", "key", "seq", "connection", "op", "args", "effect", "idempotency_key", "wait_closed", "job_ref", "opened_at",
      "attempts", "last_attempt_at", "last_error",
    ]);
    expect(await primaryKey("pending_calls")).toEqual(["request_id", "element", "activation", "key", "seq"]);
    expect(await columns("jobs")).toEqual(["id", "kind", "queue", "payload", "run_at", "attempts", "locked_at", "locked_by", "last_error", "created_at"]);
    expect(await columns("attempts_log")).toEqual(["id", "at", "request_id", "actor", "input", "reason"]);
    expect(await columns("inbound_log")).toEqual([
      "id", "at", "connection", "event_id", "workflow", "version", "binding", "result", "code", "problems", "request_id", "sent", "by", "retry_of",
    ]);
  });

  it("refuses to update or delete events and definitions: they are history", async () => {
    await db.query(`INSERT INTO events VALUES ('r-hist', 1, 'RequestStarted', now(), 1, 1, 'b', '{}')`);
    await db.query(`INSERT INTO definitions VALUES ('w', 1, '{}', '{}', null, null, null, null, '{}', '{}', now())`);
    for (const sql of [
      "UPDATE events SET type = 'X' WHERE request_id = 'r-hist'",
      "DELETE FROM events WHERE request_id = 'r-hist'",
      "UPDATE definitions SET document = '{}' WHERE workflow = 'w'",
      "DELETE FROM definitions WHERE workflow = 'w'",
    ]) {
      expect(sqlState(await refused(sql)), sql).toBe("42501");
    }
    expect(await db.query("SELECT seq FROM events WHERE request_id = 'r-hist'")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("refuses to update or delete the settings log and the inbound log: they are append-only like the events", async () => {
    await db.query(`INSERT INTO settings_log (workflow, by, at, before, after) VALUES ('w-log', '{"type":"user","id":"u"}', now(), null, '{}')`);
    await db.query(`INSERT INTO inbound_log (at, connection, event_id, workflow, result) VALUES (now(), 'c', 'ev-log', 'w-log', 'refused')`);
    for (const sql of [
      "UPDATE settings_log SET after = '{\"x\":1}' WHERE workflow = 'w-log'",
      "DELETE FROM settings_log WHERE workflow = 'w-log'",
      "UPDATE inbound_log SET result = 'started' WHERE workflow = 'w-log'",
      "DELETE FROM inbound_log WHERE workflow = 'w-log'",
    ]) {
      expect(sqlState(await refused(sql)), sql).toBe("42501");
    }
    expect(await db.query("SELECT after FROM settings_log WHERE workflow = 'w-log'")).toEqual([{ after: {} }]);
    expect(await db.query("SELECT result FROM inbound_log WHERE workflow = 'w-log'")).toEqual([{ result: "refused" }]);
  });

  it("lets one event start one request per workflow: a second started row is refused, other results are not", async () => {
    const row = "INSERT INTO inbound_log (at, connection, event_id, workflow, result) VALUES (now(), 'c', 'ev-dup', $1, $2)";
    await db.query(row, ["w-a", "started"]);
    await db.query(row, ["w-a", "duplicate"]);
    await db.query(row, ["w-b", "started"]);
    expect(sqlState(await refused(row, ["w-a", "started"]))).toBe("23505");
  });

  it("lets one client token start one request per person", async () => {
    const insert = `INSERT INTO requests (id, readable_id, workflow, definition_version, active_stages, data, started_by, started_at, last_seq, updated_at, client_token)
      VALUES ($1, $2, 'w', 1, '[]', '{}', $3::jsonb, now(), 1, now(), $4)`;
    await db.query(insert, ["r-tok-1", 901, '{"type":"user","id":"u"}', "tok"]);
    await db.query(insert, ["r-tok-2", 902, '{"type":"user","id":"v"}', "tok"]);
    await db.query(insert, ["r-tok-3", 903, '{"type":"user","id":"u"}', null]);
    expect(sqlState(await refused(insert, ["r-tok-4", 904, '{"type":"user","id":"u"}', "tok"]))).toBe("23505");
    expect(sqlState(await refused(insert, ["r-tok-5", 905, '{"type":"user","id":"u"}', "bad token"]))).toBe("23514");
  });

  it("refuses a request ID that does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$", async () => {
    expect(sqlState(await refused(`INSERT INTO events VALUES ('bad id', 1, 'RequestStarted', now(), 1, 1, 'b', '{}')`))).toBe("23514");
  });

  it("refuses a job of a kind that has no handler", async () => {
    expect(sqlState(await refused(`INSERT INTO jobs (kind, queue, payload) VALUES ('dispatch', 'q', '{}')`))).toBe("23514");
  });
});

describe("the schema runner", () => {
  it("applied every file in number order and recorded each", async () => {
    const files = await schemaFiles();
    expect(files.map((f) => f.name)).toEqual(["001_history.sql", "002_authoring.sql", "003_read_tables.sql", "004_working_state.sql", "005_logs.sql"]);
    const recorded = await db.query<{ name: string }>("SELECT name FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY name");
    expect(recorded.map((r) => r.name)).toEqual(files.map((f) => f.name));
  });

  it("applies nothing a second time", async () => {
    expect(await migrate(db)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("applies only the files not yet recorded, in order", async () => {
    const fresh = await createPgliteDb();
    try {
      const first = [{ name: "001_a.sql", sql: "CREATE TABLE a (x int);" }];

      await writeFile(join(dir, "2_b.sql"), "");
      await expect(schemaFiles(url)).rejects.toThrow("not named");
    } finally {
      await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  });

/**
 * Two turns racing on one request, and a rebuild of a request's read tables racing a turn, on two
 * connections of a real Postgres (E-11: PGlite serves one connection and cannot show it). Skipped unless
 * DATABASE_URL names a Postgres the tests may use; each run works in a schema of its own and drops it after.
 *
 *   $env:DATABASE_URL = "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres"; npx vitest run packages/server/test/turn/concurrency.pg.test.ts
 */
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pg from "pg";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { By, WaitId } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { listAttempts } from "../../src/store/attempts.ts";
import { postgresDb, type Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { createDefinitionReader } from "../../src/store/definitions.ts";
import { loadEvents } from "../../src/store/events.ts";
import { readOpenWaits, readRequestRow, rebuildRequest } from "../../src/store/projections.ts";
import { migrate } from "../../src/store/migrate.ts";
import { createTurns } from "../../src/turn/turns.ts";
import type { TurnOutcome, TurnsOptions } from "../../src/turn/types.ts";
import { definition, fixtureLookups } from "../demo.ts";
import { ENGINE_BUILD, publish, resetDb, testCatalogue, turnAt } from "../helpers.ts";

const url = process.env["DATABASE_URL"];
const schema = `wf_test_${randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "")}`;

const alice: By = { type: "user", id: "alice" };
const decision: WaitId = { element: "Pending.primary.decision", activation: "a3", key: "", seq: 1 };

describe.skipIf(url === undefined)("on a real Postgres (skipped: set DATABASE_URL to a Postgres the tests may use)", () => {
  let pool: pg.Pool;
  let db: Db;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const admin = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: url, max: 1 });
    await admin.query(`CREATE SCHEMA ${schema}`);
    await admin.end();
    pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: url, max: 6, options: `-c search_path=${schema}` });
    db = postgresDb(pool);
    await migrate(db);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (db === undefined) return;
    await pool.query(`DROP SCHEMA ${schema} CASCADE`);
    await db.close();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await resetDb(db);
    await publish(db, definition);
  });

  const turnsWith = (options: Partial<TurnsOptions> = {}) =>
    createTurns(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), { lookups: fixtureLookups(), engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD, newRequestId: (n) => `req-${n}`, ...options });

  async function started(): Promise<string> {
    const r = await turnsWith().start({ workflow: definition.workflow, by: { type: "user", id: "rita" }, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T", primaryDomain: "A" }, at: turnAt(0) });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("start refused");
    return r.requestId;
  }

  /** Waits until some connection waits for a lock: the second turn is blocked on the request's row. */
  async function untilBlocked(): Promise<void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i += 1) {
      const rows = await pool.query("SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted");
      if ((rows.rows[0] as { n: number }).n > 0) return;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
    }
    throw new Error("the second turn never waited for the lock");
  }

  const approve = (requestId: string, at: string) => ({ requestId, by: alice, wait: decision, outcome: "approve", data: { engLead: { type: "user", id: "lee" } }, at });

  it("two acts on the same wait: one wins, the other waits for the lock and is refused wait-not-open, with no gap in seq", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let second: Promise<TurnOutcome> | undefined;
    const first = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(_tx, accepted) {
        if (accepted.events[0]?.type !== "WaitCompleted" || second !== undefined) return;
        // The second turn's unlocked read sees the wait open (this one has not committed), so it goes on to the lock.
        second = turnsWith().act(approve(requestId, turnAt(2)));
        await untilBlocked();
      },
    });
    const won = await first.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)));
    expect(won.ok).toBe(true);
    const lost = await (second as Promise<TurnOutcome>);
    expect(lost).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "wait-not-open", attempt: true, params: { state: "completed", outcome: "approve", by: alice } }] });
    const seqs = (await loadEvents(db, requestId)).map((e) => e.seq);
    expect(seqs).toEqual(seqs.map((_, i) => i + 1));
    expect(await listAttempts(db, requestId)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("a turn that cannot get the lock in time is refused busy and writes nothing", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let second: Promise<TurnOutcome> | undefined;
    const first = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(_tx, accepted) {
        if (accepted.events[0]?.type !== "WaitCompleted" || second !== undefined) return;
        second = turnsWith({ lockTimeoutMs: 200 }).act(approve(requestId, turnAt(2)));
        await second;
      },
    });
    expect((await first.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(await second).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "busy", attempt: false, params: {} }] });
    expect(await listAttempts(db, requestId)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a rebuild while a turn holds the request's lock waits for the turn, then writes the rows the turn left", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let rebuilt: Promise<string> | undefined;
    const first = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(_tx, accepted) {
        if (accepted.events[0]?.type !== "WaitCompleted" || rebuilt !== undefined) return;
        rebuilt = rebuildRequest(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), requestId);
        await untilBlocked();
      },
    });
    expect((await first.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    const row = await readRequestRow(db, requestId);
    const waits = await readOpenWaits(db, requestId);
    expect(await rebuilt).toBe("rebuilt");
    expect(await readRequestRow(db, requestId)).toEqual(row);
    expect(await readOpenWaits(db, requestId)).toEqual(waits);
    expect(row?.lastSeq).toBe((await loadEvents(db, requestId)).length);
  });

  it("a rebuild that cannot get the lock in time is refused busy, as a turn is, and writes nothing", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let rebuilt: Promise<string> | undefined;
    let during: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readRequestRow>> = null;
    const first = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(_tx, accepted) {
        if (accepted.events[0]?.type !== "WaitCompleted" || rebuilt !== undefined) return;
        during = await readRequestRow(db, requestId);
        rebuilt = rebuildRequest(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), requestId, { lockTimeoutMs: 200 });
        await rebuilt;
      },
    });
    expect((await first.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(await rebuilt).toBe("busy");
    expect(during).not.toBeNull();
    expect((await readRequestRow(db, requestId))?.lastSeq).toBe((await loadEvents(db, requestId)).length);
  });
});
===\nengine/packages/server/test/turn/demo-cases.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Every demo case D1 to D12 through the store-backed turn on PGlite, against core's in-memory host on the
 * same inputs at the same times: exactly the same events (every field, envelope included), the same
 * refusals, the same state and stuck state; the case file's own expectations (core's case helpers); the
 * attempts log rows for refusals; the jobs of each turn; and, for every case, D10's rebuild: delete the
 * projection rows, replay the events, the same rows.
 */
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { authoredStageOf, fold, type AnyEventRecord } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { createTranslator } from "../../../core/test/kernel/cases/translate.ts";
import { eventMismatches, expandTurns, finalStateMismatches, runInput, type WorkflowCase } from "../../../core/test/kernel/cases/workflow-cases.ts";
import { listAttempts, type AttemptRow } from "../../src/store/attempts.ts";
import type { Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { createDefinitionReader } from "../../src/store/definitions.ts";
import { loadEvents } from "../../src/store/events.ts";
import { listJobs, type Job } from "../../src/store/jobs.ts";
import { listPendingCalls, type PendingCallRow } from "../../src/store/pending-calls.ts";
import {
  deleteProjections,
  openWaitRowsOf,
  readOpenWaits,
  readRequestRow,
  rebuildRequest,
  requestRowOf,
  type OpenWaitRow,
  type RequestRow,
} from "../../src/store/projections.ts";
import { createTurns } from "../../src/turn/turns.ts";
import { definition, file, fixtureLookups, memoryHost, REQUEST_ID, storeInput } from "../demo.ts";
import { ENGINE_BUILD, freshDb, publish, resetDb, testCatalogue, turnAt } from "../helpers.ts";

let db: Db;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});

interface CaseRun {
  problems: string[];
  events: AnyEventRecord[];
  attempts: AttemptRow[];
  hostAttempts: number;
  jobs: Job[];
  row: RequestRow | null;
  waits: OpenWaitRow[];
  pending: PendingCallRow[];
  hostPending: number;
  finalState: string[];
}

async function runCase(c: WorkflowCase): Promise<CaseRun> {
  await resetDb(db);
  await publish(db, definition);
  const host = memoryHost();
  const turns = createTurns(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), { lookups: fixtureLookups(), engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD, newRequestId: (n) => `req-${n}` });
  const translator = createTranslator({ requestId: REQUEST_ID, workflow: definition.workflow, refs: true, fill: false });
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const turnList = expandTurns(c, file.cases);
  for (const [i, t] of turnList.entries()) {
    const where = `turn ${i + 1}`;
    const at = turnAt(i);
    const mem = runInput(host, REQUEST_ID, t.input ?? {}, at);
    const jobsBefore = (await listJobs(db)).length;
    const out = await storeInput(turns, t.input ?? {}, at);
    const newJobs = (await listJobs(db)).slice(jobsBefore);

    if (mem.ok !== out.ok) {
      problems.push(`${where}: host ok=${mem.ok}, store ok=${out.ok} ${JSON.stringify(out.ok ? out.events.map((e) => e.type) : out.refusals)}`);
      continue;
    }
    if (!mem.ok && !out.ok) {
      if (JSON.stringify(out.refusals) !== JSON.stringify(mem.refusals)) problems.push(`${where}: refusals ${JSON.stringify(out.refusals)}, host ${JSON.stringify(mem.refusals)}`);
      if (newJobs.length > 0) problems.push(`${where}: a refusal enqueued ${newJobs.length} jobs`);
      if (t.refuse !== undefined && out.refusals[0]?.reason !== t.refuse.reason) problems.push(`${where}: expected refusal ${t.refuse.reason}`);
      continue;
    }
    if (!mem.ok || !out.ok) continue;
    try {
      expect(out.events).toEqual(mem.events);
    } catch {
      problems.push(`${where}: events differ from the host's`);
    }
    if (out.dropped !== mem.dropped) problems.push(`${where}: dropped ${out.dropped}, host ${mem.dropped}`);
    const hostStuck = mem.stuck === null ? null : { reason: mem.stuck.reason, stage: authoredStageOf(definition, mem.stuck.stage), at: mem.stuck.at };
    if (JSON.stringify(out.stuck) !== JSON.stringify(hostStuck)) problems.push(`${where}: stuck ${JSON.stringify(out.stuck)}, host ${JSON.stringify(hostStuck)}`);
    if (t.refuse !== undefined) problems.push(`${where}: expected refusal ${t.refuse.reason}, accepted`);
    else problems.push(...eventMismatches(out.events, translator.block(t.expect ?? [])).map((m) => `${where}: ${m}`));

    // The turn's jobs: a call job per call opened, a notify job exactly when its notify line names a rule, one publish.
    const calls = out.events.filter((e) => e.type === "WaitOpened" && e.payload.kind === "call").length;
    const kinds = newJobs.map((j) => j.kind);
    if (out.events.length === 0) {
      if (newJobs.length > 0) problems.push(`${where}: a turn with no events enqueued jobs`);
    } else {
      if (kinds.filter((k) => k === "call").length !== calls) problems.push(`${where}: ${calls} calls opened, jobs ${kinds.join(",")}`);
      if (kinds.filter((k) => k === "publish").length !== 1) problems.push(`${where}: jobs ${kinds.join(",")}, expected one publish`);
      if (t.notify !== undefined && kinds.includes("notify") !== t.notify.length > 0) problems.push(`${where}: notify ${JSON.stringify(t.notify)}, jobs ${kinds.join(",")}`);
    }
  }

  const events = await loadEvents(db, REQUEST_ID);
  const started = turnList.some((t, i) => i === 0 && t.input !== undefined && "start" in t.input);
  try {
    expect(events).toEqual(started ? host.events(REQUEST_ID) : []);
    if (started) expect(fold(events)).toEqual(host.state(REQUEST_ID));
  } catch {
    problems.push("the stored events or their fold differ from the host's");
  }
  const row = await readRequestRow(db, REQUEST_ID);
  const finalState =
    c.finalState === undefined || !started ? [] : finalStateMismatches({ state: fold(events), events, stuck: (row?.stuck ?? null) as Parameters<typeof finalStateMismatches>[0]["stuck"] }, c.finalState);
  return {
    problems,
    events,
    attempts: await listAttempts(db, REQUEST_ID),
    hostAttempts: host.attempts().filter((a) => a.requestId === REQUEST_ID).length,
    jobs: await listJobs(db, REQUEST_ID),
    row,
    waits: await readOpenWaits(db, REQUEST_ID),
    pending: await listPendingCalls(db, REQUEST_ID),
    hostPending: started ? host.pendingCalls(REQUEST_ID).length : 0,
    finalState,
  };
}

describe("the demo cases through the store-backed turn", () => {
  it("has the cases D1 to D12", () => {
    expect(file.cases.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(["D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D5", "D5b", "D6", "D7", "D8", "D8b", "D9", "D10", "D11", "D12"]);
  });

  for (const c of file.cases) {
    describe(`${c.id}: ${c.name}`, () => {
      it("appends exactly the host's events, or the same refusals, at every turn, with the case file's events and jobs", async () => {
        const run = await runCase(c);
        expect(run.problems).toEqual([]);
        expect(run.finalState).toEqual([]);
      });

      it("writes the host's attempts to the attempts log, one row per refused attempt", async () => {
        const run = await runCase(c);
        expect(run.attempts).toHaveLength(run.hostAttempts);
        if (c.attemptsLog !== undefined) expect(run.attempts).toHaveLength(c.attemptsLog);
        for (const a of run.attempts) expect(a.requestId).toBe(REQUEST_ID);
      });

      it("keeps the projections and pending calls in step with the events", async () => {
        const run = await runCase(c);
        const state = fold(run.events);
        // A hand-written definition has no authored source: no authored stage, no stuck state as a list shows it.
        expect(run.row).toEqual(requestRowOf(state, run.row?.stuck ?? null, { stage: null, stuckView: null }));
        const key = (w: OpenWaitRow): string => [w.element, w.activation, w.key, String(w.seq)].join("|");
        const byKey = (a: OpenWaitRow, b: OpenWaitRow): number => (key(a) < key(b) ? -1 : key(a) > key(b) ? 1 : 0);
        expect([...run.waits].sort(byKey)).toEqual(openWaitRowsOf(state).sort(byKey));
        expect(run.pending).toHaveLength(run.hostPending);
      });

      it("rebuilds the same requests and open_waits rows from the events (D10's rebuild)", async () => {
        const run = await runCase(c);
        await deleteProjections(db, REQUEST_ID);
        expect(await readRequestRow(db, REQUEST_ID)).toBeNull();
        expect(await readOpenWaits(db, REQUEST_ID)).toEqual([]);
        await rebuildRequest(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), REQUEST_ID);
        expect(await readRequestRow(db, REQUEST_ID)).toEqual(run.row);
        expect(await readOpenWaits(db, REQUEST_ID)).toEqual(run.waits);
      });
    });
  }

  it("D10: deleting the read tables and replaying the events gives identical rows, the stuck state's time included", async () => {
    const d10 = file.cases.find((c) => c.id === "D10") as WorkflowCase;
    expect(d10.rebuild).toEqual({ tables: ["requests", "open_waits"], expect: "identical" });
    const run = await runCase(d10);
    expect(run.problems).toEqual([]);
    const before = { requests: await db.query("SELECT * FROM requests ORDER BY id"), open_waits: await db.query("SELECT * FROM open_waits ORDER BY element, activation, key, seq") };
    await db.exec("DELETE FROM open_waits; DELETE FROM requests;");
    await rebuildRequest(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), REQUEST_ID);
    const after = { requests: await db.query("SELECT * FROM requests ORDER BY id"), open_waits: await db.query("SELECT * FROM open_waits ORDER BY element, activation, key, seq") };
    expect(after).toEqual(before);
    expect(before.requests).toHaveLength(1);
  });

interface Calls {
  memberships: string[];
  lookups: PlannedLookup[];
  inTransaction: boolean[];
}

function setup(over: { lookups?: Partial<TurnLookups>; options?: Partial<TurnsOptions> } = {}) {
  const tracked = trackTransactions(raw);
  const calls: Calls = { memberships: [], lookups: [], inTransaction: [] };
  const base = fixtureLookups();
  const lookups: TurnLookups = {
    async memberships(userId) {
      calls.memberships.push(userId);
      calls.inTransaction.push(tracked.inTransaction());
      return (over.lookups?.memberships ?? base.memberships)(userId);
    },
    async lookup(p) {
      calls.lookups.push(p);
      calls.inTransaction.push(tracked.inTransaction());
      return (over.lookups?.lookup ?? base.lookup)(p);
    },
  };
  const turns = createTurns(tracked.db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), { lookups, engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD, newRequestId: (n) => `req-${n}`, ...over.options });
  return { turns, calls, db: tracked.db };
}

function accepted(r: TurnOutcome): TurnAccepted {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(r.refusals)}`);
  return r;
}

async function startA(turns: ReturnType<typeof setup>["turns"], at = turnAt(0)): Promise<TurnAccepted> {
  return accepted(await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: startData, at }));
}

    expect(await raw.query("SELECT 1 FROM requests")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a refused start leaves no request, no row and no job, and logs the attempt with no request", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const r = await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "" }, at: turnAt(0) });
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT 1 FROM events")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT 1 FROM requests")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await listJobs(raw)).toEqual([]);
    const attempts = await listAttempts(raw);
    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(attempts[0]).toMatchObject({ requestId: null, actor: rita, reason: "invalid-data", input: { kind: "start", workflow: demo.workflow, version: 1, outcome: "submit" } });
  });

  it("one client token starts one request: the same arguments replay it, other arguments are refused", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const token = { token: "tok-1", argsHash: "h1" };
    const first = accepted(await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: startData, clientToken: token, at: turnAt(0) }));
    expect(first.replayed).toBe(false);
    const again = accepted(await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: startData, clientToken: token, at: turnAt(1) }));
    expect([again.replayed, again.requestId, again.events, again.lastSeq]).toEqual([true, first.requestId, [], first.lastSeq]);
    expect(await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: startData, clientToken: { token: "tok-1", argsHash: "h2" } })).toMatchObject({
      ok: false,
      refusals: [{ reason: "client-token-reused", attempt: false }],
    });
    // Another starter's token of the same text is another token.
    expect(accepted(await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: alice, outcome: "submit", data: startData, clientToken: token, at: turnAt(2) })).replayed).toBe(false);
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT 1 FROM requests")).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT client_token, client_args_hash FROM requests WHERE id = $1", [first.requestId])).toEqual([{ client_token: "tok-1", client_args_hash: "h1" }]);
  });

  it("a refused start keeps no token, so the fixed form can be sent with the same token", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const token = { token: "tok-2", argsHash: "h" };
    expect((await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "" }, clientToken: token })).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT 1 FROM requests WHERE client_token IS NOT NULL")).toEqual([]);
    expect(accepted(await turns.start({ workflow: demo.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: startData, clientToken: token })).replayed).toBe(false);
  });

  it("a start through a binding records its inbound_log row, result started; the same event starts no second request", async () => {
    const def = build({ stages: [stage("Start", { waits: [person("form", { assignees: "[]" })] })] });
    await publish(raw, def);
    const { turns } = setup();
    const helpdesk: By = { type: "connection", id: "helpdesk" };
    const trigger = { kind: "event", id: "b_new", connection: "helpdesk", event: "created@1", eventId: "ev-77" } as const;
    const first = accepted(await turns.start({ workflow: def.workflow, by: helpdesk, outcome: "done", data: {}, trigger, at: turnAt(0) }));
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT connection, event_id, workflow, binding, version, result, request_id FROM inbound_log")).toEqual([
      { connection: "helpdesk", event_id: "ev-77", workflow: def.workflow, binding: "b_new", version: 1, result: "started", request_id: first.requestId },
    ]);
    expect(await turns.start({ workflow: def.workflow, by: helpdesk, outcome: "done", data: {}, trigger, at: turnAt(1) })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      refusals: [{ reason: "already-started", attempt: false, params: { requestId: first.requestId } }],
    });
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT 1 FROM requests")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

describe("lookups before the lock", () => {
  it("asks for the actor's groups outside any transaction, and only when the wait's assignees include a group", async () => {

    expect(calls.memberships).toEqual(["alice"]);
    expect(calls.inTransaction).toEqual([false]);
  });

  it("refuses an act on a wait that is not open from the unlocked read, with no lookup, and logs it", async () => {
    const { turns, calls } = setup();

    expect(again).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "wait-not-open", attempt: true, params: { state: "completed", outcome: "reject", by: alice } }] });

      },
    ]);
  });

  it("a directory that cannot be asked refuses membership-unavailable: try again, nothing written, no attempt", async () => {

      expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "membership-unavailable", attempt: false, params: {} }] });

      expect(await listJobs(raw)).toHaveLength(jobs);
      expect(await listAttempts(raw)).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it("looks up each answer from a data source outside any transaction, and records the source's label", async () => {
    const lookups = [{ property: "svc", connection: "cat", source: "services@1", inputs: {}, storedField: "id", labelField: "name", answer: "item" as const }];
    const def = build({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form", { outcomes: [outcome("done", { lookups })] })], transitions: [{ id: "t_on", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Next" }] }),

    });
    const done = accepted(await turns.act({ requestId: start.requestId, by: rita, wait: pick, outcome: "done", data: { svc: { stored: "s2", label: "x" } }, at: turnAt(2) }));
    expect(done.events[0]?.payload).toMatchObject({ data: { svc: { stored: "s2", label: "Cards" } }, evidence: { lookups: [{ property: "svc", stored: "s2", label: "Cards" }] } });
    expect(calls.lookups.map((p) => p.stored)).toEqual(["s1", "s9", "s2"]);
    expect(calls.inTransaction).toEqual([false, false, false]);
  });

describe("call results", () => {
  it("refuses a result that does not fit its declared shape before the turn: nothing written, the call still pending", async () => {

    expect(await loadEvents(raw, requestId)).toHaveLength(lastSeq);
    expect((await listPendingCalls(raw, requestId)).map((c) => c.wait.element)).toEqual(["Pending.primary.members"]);
  });

  it("marks a pending call whose wait closed, and drops a read's late result: no event, no job, the row deleted", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId } = await startA(turns);
    expect(await listPendingCalls(raw, requestId)).toMatchObject([{ wait: w("Pending.primary.members", "a3"), connection: "directory", op: "membersOf@1", effect: "read", jobRef: null, waitClosed: false, attempts: 0 }]);
    accepted(await turns.act({ requestId, by: alice, wait: w("Pending.primary.decision", "a3"), outcome: "approve", data: { engLead: lee }, at: turnAt(1) }));
    expect((await listPendingCalls(raw, requestId)).map((c) => [c.wait.element, c.waitClosed])).toEqual([
      ["Pending.primary.members", true],
      ["CreateTicket.ticket", false],
    ]);
    const jobs = (await listJobs(raw)).length;
    const r = accepted(await turns.callResult({ requestId, wait: w("Pending.primary.members", "a3"), outcome: "ok", data: membersA, at: turnAt(2) }));
    expect([r.dropped, r.events]).toEqual(["read-closed", []]);
    expect(await listJobs(raw)).toHaveLength(jobs);
    expect((await listPendingCalls(raw, requestId)).map((c) => c.wait.element)).toEqual(["CreateTicket.ticket"]);
    accepted(await turns.callResult({ requestId, wait: w("CreateTicket.ticket", "a4"), outcome: "ok", data: { key: "K-1", url: "u" }, at: turnAt(3) }));
    expect(await listPendingCalls(raw, requestId)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("enqueues a call job for each call a turn opens, on its own queue, and a publish job for every turn", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId } = await startA(turns);
    expect(await listJobs(raw, requestId)).toEqual([
      { kind: "call", requestId, wait: w("Pending.primary.members", "a3") },
      { kind: "notify", requestId, firstSeq: 1, lastSeq: 11 },
      { kind: "publish", requestId, firstSeq: 1, lastSeq: 11 },
    ]);
    expect(await raw.query("SELECT kind, queue FROM jobs ORDER BY id")).toEqual([
      { kind: "call", queue: `call:${requestId}/Pending.primary.members@a3#1` },
      { kind: "notify", queue: `notify:${requestId}` },
      { kind: "publish", queue: `publish:${requestId}` },
    ]);
  });

describe("admin turns", () => {
  const admin = user("root-admin");

  it("refuses someone who is not an admin, and logs the attempt with its actions", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId } = await startA(turns);
    const r = await turns.admin({ requestId, by: alice, isAdmin: false, reason: "r", actions: [{ type: "close" }], at: turnAt(1) });
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "not-admin", attempt: true }] });
    expect(await listAttempts(raw, requestId)).toMatchObject([{ actor: alice, reason: "not-admin", input: { kind: "admin", reason: "r", actions: [{ type: "close" }] } }]);
  });

  it("refuses stale under the lock when the page's last seq is not the request's, not logged", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId, lastSeq } = await startA(turns);
    const r = await turns.admin({ requestId, by: admin, isAdmin: true, reason: "r", actions: [{ type: "close" }], expectedLastSeq: lastSeq - 1, at: turnAt(1) });
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "stale", attempt: false, params: { lastSeq } }] });
    expect(await listAttempts(raw)).toEqual([]);
    const closed = accepted(await turns.admin({ requestId, by: admin, isAdmin: true, reason: "r", actions: [{ type: "close" }], expectedLastSeq: lastSeq, at: turnAt(2) }));
    expect(closed.state.closed).not.toBeNull();
    expect((await readRequestRow(raw, requestId))?.closedAt).toBe(turnAt(2));
    expect(await readOpenWaits(raw, requestId)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await listPendingCalls(raw, requestId)).map((c) => c.waitClosed)).toEqual([true]);
  });

  it("works out the actions under the lock with a planner, which may refuse", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId } = await startA(turns);
    const seen: number[] = [];
    const retry: AdminPlanner = ({ state, stuck }) => {
      seen.push(state.lastSeq);
      return stuck === null ? { refuse: { reason: "not-stuck", attempt: true, params: {} } } : { actions: [] };
    };
    const refused = await turns.admin({ requestId, by: admin, isAdmin: true, reason: "r", actions: retry, at: turnAt(1) });
    expect(refused).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "not-stuck", attempt: true, params: {} }] });
    expect(await listAttempts(raw, requestId)).toMatchObject([{ reason: "not-stuck", actor: admin }]);
    const closed = accepted(await turns.admin({ requestId, by: admin, isAdmin: true, reason: "r", actions: () => ({ actions: [{ type: "close" }] }), at: turnAt(2) }));
    expect(closed.events[0]).toMatchObject({ type: "Overridden", payload: { actions: [{ type: "close" }] } });
    expect(seen).toEqual([11]);
  });

  it("checks stale after the caller's first refusals and before the planner's, so a documented order holds (E-31)", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId, lastSeq } = await startA(turns);
    const order: string[] = [];
    const first = (reason: string | null) => () => {
      order.push("first");
      return reason === null ? null : { reason, attempt: true, params: {} };
    };
    const planner: AdminPlanner = () => {
      order.push("planner");
      return { refuse: { reason: "not-stuck", attempt: true, params: {} } };
    };
    const base = { requestId, by: admin, isAdmin: true, reason: "r", actions: planner, expectedLastSeq: lastSeq - 1, at: turnAt(1) };
    expect(await turns.admin({ ...base, refuseFirst: first("reason-required") })).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "reason-required", attempt: true, params: {} }] });
    expect(order).toEqual(["first"]);
    expect(await turns.admin({ ...base, refuseFirst: first(null) })).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "stale", attempt: false, params: { lastSeq } }] });
    expect(order).toEqual(["first", "first"]);
    expect(await turns.admin({ ...base, expectedLastSeq: lastSeq, refuseFirst: first(null) })).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "not-stuck", attempt: true, params: {} }] });
    expect(order).toEqual(["first", "first", "first", "planner"]);
    expect((await listAttempts(raw, requestId)).map((a) => a.reason)).toEqual(["reason-required", "not-stuck"]);
  });
});

  it("keeps the stuck state's time while a later turn leaves it stuck the same way, and a rebuild gives that time too", async () => {

    const def = build({
      stages: [
        stage("Start", { waits: [person("form")], transitions: [{ id: "t_on", otherwise: true, when: null, set: [], to: "Next" }] }),

      ],
    });
    await publish(raw, def);

    const later = accepted(await turns.act({ requestId: start.requestId, by: rita, wait: note, outcome: "done", data: {}, at: turnAt(5) }));
    expect(later.events.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(later.stuck).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: "Next", at: turnAt(0) });
    const row = await readRequestRow(raw, start.requestId);
    await rebuildRequest(raw, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), start.requestId);
    expect(await readRequestRow(raw, start.requestId)).toEqual(row);
    expect(row?.stuck?.at).toBe(turnAt(0));
  });

  it("returns the state after the turn and whether the request is stuck", async () => {
    const { turns } = setup();
    const { requestId } = await startA(turns);
    const onlyRequester = { groups: [{ id: { type: "group", id: "grp-a" }, members: [user("rita")] }] };
    const r = accepted(await turns.callResult({ requestId, wait: w("Pending.primary.members", "a3"), outcome: "ok", data: onlyRequester, at: turnAt(1) }));
    expect(r.stopped).toBe(true);
    expect(r.stuck).toEqual({ reason: "nobody-to-ask", stage: expect.any(String) as unknown as string, at: turnAt(1) });
    expect((await readRequestRow(raw, requestId))?.stuck).toEqual(r.stuck);
    expect(r.state.lastSeq).toBe(r.lastSeq);
  });
});

===\nengine/packages/server/test/turn/lock.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Two turns on one request cannot interleave (kernel spec section 3), shown on PGlite, which serves one
 * connection: the turn locks the request's row, a second turn started while the first's transaction is open
 * runs only after it commits, and a turn whose unlocked read saw the wait open checks it again under the
 * lock. A rebuild of a request's read tables takes the same lock in one transaction and updates the rows in
 * place. The races on two connections are in concurrency.pg.test.ts (real Postgres).
 */
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { By, WaitId } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { Db, Queryable } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { createDefinitionReader } from "../../src/store/definitions.ts";
import { loadEvents } from "../../src/store/events.ts";
import { readOpenWaits, readRequestRow, rebuildRequest } from "../../src/store/projections.ts";
import { listAttempts } from "../../src/store/attempts.ts";
import { createTurns } from "../../src/turn/turns.ts";
import type { TurnAccepted, TurnOutcome, TurnsOptions } from "../../src/turn/types.ts";
import { definition, fixtureLookups } from "../demo.ts";
import { ENGINE_BUILD, freshDb, publish, recordStatements, resetDb, testCatalogue, turnAt } from "../helpers.ts";

let db: Db;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});
beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetDb(db);
  await publish(db, definition);
});

const alice: By = { type: "user", id: "alice" };
const lee = { type: "user", id: "lee" };
const decision: WaitId = { element: "Pending.primary.decision", activation: "a3", key: "", seq: 1 };

function turnsWith(options: Partial<TurnsOptions> = {}) {
  return createTurns(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), { lookups: fixtureLookups(), engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD, newRequestId: (n) => `req-${n}`, ...options });
}

async function started(): Promise<string> {
  const r = await turnsWith().start({ workflow: definition.workflow, by: { type: "user", id: "rita" }, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T", primaryDomain: "A" }, at: turnAt(0) });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("start refused");
  return r.requestId;
}

const approve = (requestId: string, at: string) => ({ requestId, by: alice, wait: decision, outcome: "approve", data: { engLead: lee }, at });

function gapFree(seqs: number[]): boolean {
  return seqs.every((s, i) => s === i + 1);
}

describe("the request's lock", () => {
  it("is taken on the requests row for the length of the turn", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let locks: string[] = [];
    const turns = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(tx: Queryable) {
        locks = (await tx.query<{ mode: string }>("SELECT mode FROM pg_locks WHERE relation = 'requests'::regclass AND granted")).map((l) => l.mode);
      },
    });
    expect((await turns.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(locks).toContain("RowShareLock");
  });

  it("a second turn started inside the first's transaction runs after its commit and is refused wait-not-open", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    const order: string[] = [];
    let second: Promise<TurnOutcome> | undefined;
    const other = turnsWith();
    const first = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(_tx, accepted: TurnAccepted) {
        if (accepted.events[0]?.type !== "WaitCompleted") return;
        second = other.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(2))).then((r) => {
          order.push("second answered");
          return r;
        });
        // Give the second turn every chance to run; it cannot while this transaction is open.
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
        order.push("first commits");
      },
    });
    const r1 = await first.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)));
    expect(r1.ok).toBe(true);
    const r2 = await (second as Promise<TurnOutcome>);
    expect(order).toEqual(["first commits", "second answered"]);
    expect(r2).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "wait-not-open", attempt: true, params: { state: "completed", outcome: "approve", by: alice } }] });
    const seqs = (await loadEvents(db, requestId)).map((e) => e.seq);
    expect(gapFree(seqs)).toBe(true);
    expect(await listAttempts(db, requestId)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("a turn whose unlocked read saw the wait open checks it again under the lock", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let release: () => void = () => undefined;
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      release = resolve;
    });
    let asked: () => void = () => undefined;
    const lookedUp = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      asked = resolve;
    });
    // The second turn's directory lookup waits until the first turn has committed.
    const slow = turnsWith({
      lookups: {
        async memberships(userId) {
          asked();
          await held;
          return fixtureLookups().memberships(userId);
        },
        lookup: fixtureLookups().lookup,
      },
    });
    const second = slow.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(2)));
    await lookedUp;
    expect((await turnsWith().act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    release();
    expect(await second).toEqual({ ok: false, refusals: [{ reason: "wait-not-open", attempt: true, params: { state: "completed", outcome: "approve", by: alice } }] });
    expect(gapFree((await loadEvents(db, requestId)).map((e) => e.seq))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("a rebuild of a request's read tables (E-31)", () => {
  /** The statements up to and including the first read of the request's events. */
  const upToEvents = (statements: string[]): string[] => statements.slice(0, statements.findIndex((s) => /FROM events/.test(s)) + 1);

  it("takes the lock a turn takes before it reads the events, in one transaction, and updates the requests row in place", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    const asTurn = recordStatements(db);
    expect((await createTurns(asTurn.db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), { lookups: fixtureLookups(), engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD }).act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    const row = await readRequestRow(db, requestId);
    const waits = await readOpenWaits(db, requestId);

    const asRebuild = recordStatements(db);
    let inTransaction = 0;
    const tracked: Db = { ...asRebuild.db, transaction: (fn) => { inTransaction += 1; return asRebuild.db.transaction(fn); } };
    expect(await rebuildRequest(tracked, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), requestId)).toBe("rebuilt");
    expect(inTransaction).toBe(1);
    const lock = ["SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5000ms'", "SELECT id FROM requests WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE"];
    expect(upToEvents(asRebuild.statements).slice(0, 2)).toEqual(lock);
    expect(upToEvents(asTurn.statements.slice(asTurn.statements.indexOf(lock[0] as string))).slice(0, 2)).toEqual(lock);
    expect(asRebuild.statements.filter((s) => /DELETE FROM requests/i.test(s))).toEqual([]);
    expect(asRebuild.statements.some((s) => /INSERT INTO requests[\s\S]*ON CONFLICT \(id\) DO UPDATE/.test(s))).toBe(true);
    expect(await readRequestRow(db, requestId)).toEqual(row);
    expect(await readOpenWaits(db, requestId)).toEqual(waits);
    expect(row?.lastSeq).toBe((await loadEvents(db, requestId)).length);
  });

  it("started inside a turn's transaction, runs after its commit and keeps the turn's rows; a request with no events is none", async () => {
    const requestId = await started();
    let rebuilt: Promise<string> | undefined;
    const first = turnsWith({
      async beforeCommit(_tx, accepted: TurnAccepted) {
        if (accepted.events[0]?.type !== "WaitCompleted") return;
        rebuilt = rebuildRequest(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), requestId);
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
      },
    });
    expect((await first.act(approve(requestId, turnAt(1)))).ok).toBe(true);
    const row = await readRequestRow(db, requestId);
    expect(await rebuilt).toBe("rebuilt");
    expect(await readRequestRow(db, requestId)).toEqual(row);
    expect(row?.lastSeq).toBe((await loadEvents(db, requestId)).length);
    expect(await rebuildRequest(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), "req-none")).toBe("none");
  });
});

/**
 * A failure after decide and before the commit leaves nothing: no event, no job, no change to the read
 * tables, the pending calls, the start's token or the attempts log. The failure is thrown inside the
 * turn's transaction after everything is written, and the turn rethrows it.
 */
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { By, WaitId } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import type { Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { createDefinitionReader } from "../../src/store/definitions.ts";
import { createTurns } from "../../src/turn/turns.ts";
import type { TurnsOptions } from "../../src/turn/types.ts";
import { definition, fixtureLookups } from "../demo.ts";
import { ENGINE_BUILD, freshDb, publish, resetDb, testCatalogue, turnAt } from "../helpers.ts";

let db: Db;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});
beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetDb(db);
  await publish(db, definition);
});

const rita: By = { type: "user", id: "rita" };
const alice: By = { type: "user", id: "alice" };
const decision: WaitId = { element: "Pending.primary.decision", activation: "a3", key: "", seq: 1 };

const TABLES = ["events", "requests", "open_waits", "pending_calls", "jobs", "attempts_log", "inbound_log"];

/** Every row of the tables a turn writes, so that "nothing changed" is checked on all of them. */
async function snapshot(): Promise<Record<string, unknown[]>> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown[]> = {};
  for (const t of TABLES) out[t] = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM ${t} ORDER BY 1, 2`);
  return out;
}

function failing(options: Partial<TurnsOptions> = {}) {
  return createTurns(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), {
    lookups: fixtureLookups(),
    engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD,
    newRequestId: (n) => `req-${n}`,
    async beforeCommit(tx) {
      // Everything of the turn is written by now: the failure comes after decide and before the commit.
      expect((await tx.query("SELECT 1 FROM jobs")).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      throw new Error("crash before commit");
    },
    ...options,
  });
}

const working = () => createTurns(db, createDefinitionReader(testCatalogue), { lookups: fixtureLookups(), engineBuild: ENGINE_BUILD, newRequestId: (n) => `req-${n}` });

describe("a failure after decide and before commit", () => {
  it("leaves nothing of a start", async () => {
    const before = await snapshot();
    await expect(
      failing().start({ workflow: definition.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T", primaryDomain: "A" }, clientToken: { token: "t1", argsHash: "h" }, at: turnAt(0) }),
    ).rejects.toThrow("crash before commit");
    expect(await snapshot()).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("leaves nothing of an act", async () => {
    const start = await working().start({ workflow: definition.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T", primaryDomain: "A" }, at: turnAt(0) });
    if (!start.ok) throw new Error("start refused");
    const before = await snapshot();
    await expect(failing().act({ requestId: start.requestId, by: alice, wait: decision, outcome: "approve", data: { engLead: { type: "user", id: "lee" } }, at: turnAt(1) })).rejects.toThrow(
      "crash before commit",
    );
    expect(await snapshot()).toEqual(before);
    // The same act then succeeds: the failed one held nothing.
    expect((await working().act({ requestId: start.requestId, by: alice, wait: decision, outcome: "approve", data: { engLead: { type: "user", id: "lee" } }, at: turnAt(2) })).ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("leaves nothing of a call result or an admin turn", async () => {
    const start = await working().start({ workflow: definition.workflow, by: rita, outcome: "submit", data: { title: "T", primaryDomain: "A" }, at: turnAt(0) });
    if (!start.ok) throw new Error("start refused");
    const before = await snapshot();
    const members: WaitId = { element: "Pending.primary.members", activation: "a3", key: "", seq: 1 };
    await expect(failing().callResult({ requestId: start.requestId, wait: members, outcome: "ok", data: { groups: [] }, at: turnAt(1) })).rejects.toThrow("crash");
    await expect(failing().admin({ requestId: start.requestId, by: { type: "user", id: "root-admin" }, isAdmin: true, reason: "r", actions: [{ type: "close" }], at: turnAt(1) })).rejects.toThrow("crash");
    expect(await snapshot()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
===\nengine/packages/server/test/workers/http-sink.test.ts\n===
/**
 * The plain HTTP sink through the publish job: a subscriber address that is an http URL is POSTed each event
 * as JSON with `application/cloudevents+json`; an answer that is not 2xx fails the job, which runs again later
 * from the turn's first event. The subscriber is a local HTTP listener that refuses the first post.
 */
import { createServer, type Server } from "node:http";
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { listJobs } from "../../src/store/jobs.ts";
import { freshDb } from "../helpers.ts";
import { bench, createWorkflow, PEOPLE, publishFixture, WORKFLOW } from "../api/runtime/setup.ts";

let db: Db;
let server: Server;
let url = "";
const posts: { status: number; contentType: string | undefined; event: { id: string; type: string } }[] = [];

beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
  server = createServer((req, res) => {
    let body = "";
    req.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => (body += chunk.toString("utf8")));
    req.on("end", () => {
      const status = posts.length === 0 ? 503 : 204;
      posts.push({ status, contentType: req.headers["content-type"], event: JSON.parse(body) as { id: string; type: string } });
      res.writeHead(status).end();
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  url = `http://127.0.0.1:${(server.address() as AddressInfo).port}/events`;
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
  await db.close();
});

it("posts each event to an http subscriber, and after a refused post runs the job again from the turn's first event", async () => {
  await publishFixture(db);
  await createWorkflow(db);
  const b = await bench(db, { httpSubscriber: url });
  const started = await b.call("POST", "/requests", PEOPLE.priya, {
    workflow: WORKFLOW, button: "btn_rf_submit", clientToken: "tok-1",
    answers: { q_title: "Rotate keys", q_primary_domain: "row_payments", q_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", q_risk: "ch_risk_medium" },
  });
  expect(started.status).toBe(201);
  const requestId = started.body.requestId as string;
  await b.settle();

  expect(posts.every((p) => p.contentType === "application/cloudevents+json")).toBe(true);
  // The first post refused, then the turn's events again from its first, each accepted once.
  expect(posts.map((p) => [p.status, p.event.type]).slice(0, 3)).toEqual([[503, "request.started@1"], [204, "request.started@1"], [204, "request.statusChanged@1"]]);
  expect(posts[0]?.event.id).toBe(`${requestId}/1/$request.started`);
  expect(b.log.lines.filter((l) => l.kind === "job-failed").map((l) => [l.code, l.request])).toEqual([["publish", requestId]]);
  const accepted = posts.filter((p) => p.status === 204).map((p) => Number(p.event.id.split("/")[1]));
  expect(accepted).toEqual([...accepted].sort((x, y) => x - y));
  expect(b.sink.received).toEqual([]);
  expect(await listJobs(db)).toEqual([]);
});

/**
 * The worker loop and its three jobs on PGlite, with in-memory connectors: calls sent with their recorded key
 * and tried again until answered, an await polled, a late result after Close, notifications to a person, a
 * group and not to a requester who may not answer, outbound events in order and at least once, and a worker
 * that dies holding a job.
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { compile, parse, type AuthoredWorkflow } from "@workflow/core";
import type { JsonObject } from "@workflow/core/kernel";
import { memoryDataSource, memoryOperation } from "../../src/connectors/memory.ts";
import type { Db } from "../../src/store/db.ts";
import { insertDefinition } from "../../src/store/definitions.ts";
import { loadEvents } from "../../src/store/events.ts";
import { listJobs } from "../../src/store/jobs.ts";
import { listPendingCalls } from "../../src/store/pending-calls.ts";
import { readRequestRow } from "../../src/store/projections.ts";
import { createWorkerLoop } from "../../src/workers/loop.ts";
import { freshDb, resetDb } from "../helpers.ts";
import { authored, bench, catalogue, createWorkflow, PEOPLE, publishFixture, WORKFLOW, type Bench, type BenchOptions } from "../api/runtime/setup.ts";

let db: Db;
let b: Bench;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = await freshDb();
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});

const { priya, marcus, diego, admin } = PEOPLE;
const startAnswers = { q_title: "Rotate keys", q_primary_domain: "row_payments", q_planned_release_date: "2026-12-02", q_risk: "ch_risk_medium" };

async function fresh(options: BenchOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
  await resetDb(db);
  await publishFixture(db);
  await createWorkflow(db);
  b = await bench(db, options);
}

async function start(token = "tok-1"): Promise<string> {
  const r = await b.call("POST", "/requests", priya, { workflow: WORKFLOW, button: "btn_rf_submit", answers: startAnswers, clientToken: token });
  expect(r.status).toBe(201);
  return r.body.requestId as string;
}

/** Started, its group read by the worker, and approved by Marcus: the ticket call is queued. */
async function approved(token = "tok-1"): Promise<string> {
  const requestId = await start(token);
  await b.runWorker();
  const task = (await b.call("GET", "/my-tasks", marcus)).body.items.find((t: { requestId: string }) => t.requestId === requestId).task;
  const r = await b.call("POST", `/requests/${requestId}/tasks/${task}/act`, marcus, { button: "btn_da_approve", answers: { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: diego } } });
  expect(r.status).toBe(200);
  return requestId;
}

const eventTypes = async (requestId: string): Promise<string[]> => (await loadEvents(db, requestId)).map((e) => e.type);
const lastSeq = async (requestId: string): Promise<number> => (await b.call("GET", `/requests/${requestId}`, admin)).body.lastSeq;
const jiraKeys = (): string[] => b.operations.jira.sent.map((s) => s.key);

describe("calls", () => {
  beforeEach(() => fresh());

  it("a write that gets no answer twice and then succeeds is sent three times with one key, and the request moves once", async () => {
    const requestId = await approved();
    b.operations.jira.queue("createIssue@1", { answer: "unknown", detail: "timed out" }, () => {
      throw new Error("connection reset");
    });
    expect(await b.runWorker()).toEqual([]);
    // Not recorded; the row keeps the try and its error, and the job waits 10 s.
    expect(await listPendingCalls(db, requestId)).toMatchObject([{ op: "createIssue@1", attempts: 1, lastError: "timed out" }]);
    const turns = await b.settle();
    expect(turns).toMatchObject([{ ok: true }]);
    expect(jiraKeys()).toEqual([`once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`, `once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`, `once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`]);
    const events = await loadEvents(db, requestId);
    expect(events.filter((e) => e.type === "WaitCompleted" && e.payload.wait.element === "act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(events.filter((e) => e.type === "StageEntered" && e.payload.stage.startsWith("st_development"))).toHaveLength(1);
    expect((await b.call("GET", "/my-tasks", diego)).body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(b.log.lines.filter((l) => l.kind === "call-attempt" && l.entry === "jira.createIssue@1").map((l) => l.code)).toEqual(["unknown", "unknown", "ok"]);
    expect(await listPendingCalls(db, requestId)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await listJobs(db)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a failed write leaves the request stuck, and Retry sends it again with the same key, as 'once' says", async () => {
    const requestId = await approved();
    const failed = await b.runWorker((op) => (op === "createIssue@1" ? { outcome: "failed", data: { code: "server-error", message: "Jira answered 500" } } : { outcome: "ok", data: {} }));
    expect(failed).toMatchObject([{ ok: true, stopped: true }]);
    expect((await b.call("GET", `/requests/${requestId}`, admin)).body.stuck).toMatchObject({ reason: "action-failed" });
    expect(await readRequestRow(db, requestId)).toMatchObject({ fault: "error", faultElement: "act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue", stuck: { reason: "action-failed" } });
    // The stuck message goes to the people who look after the workflow.
    expect(b.notifier.sent.filter((m) => m.rule === "n_stopped").map((m) => m.to)).toEqual([admin]);

    const retried = await b.call("POST", `/requests/${requestId}/retry`, admin, { reason: "Jira is back", expectedLastSeq: await lastSeq(requestId) });
    expect(retried.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await b.runWorker()).toMatchObject([{ ok: true, stopped: false }]);
    expect(jiraKeys()).toEqual([`once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`, `once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`]);
    expect((await b.call("GET", "/my-tasks", diego)).body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await readRequestRow(db, requestId)).toMatchObject({ fault: null, faultElement: null, stuck: null });
  });

  it("a result after Close is recorded late; a read never sent is dropped", async () => {
    const requestId = await approved();
    b.operations.jira.queue("createIssue@1", { answer: "unknown", detail: "timed out" });
    await b.runWorker();
    const other = await start("tok-2");
    for (const id of [requestId, other]) {
      expect((await b.call("POST", `/requests/${id}/close`, admin, { reason: "Not needed", expectedLastSeq: await lastSeq(id) })).status).toBe(200);
    }
    const sentBefore = b.operations.directory.sent.length;
    await b.settle();
    // The ticket, sent before the close, is asked again with the same key and its result recorded late.
    expect(jiraKeys()).toEqual([`once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`, `once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`]);
    expect((await eventTypes(requestId)).at(-1)).toBe("CallResultLate");
    expect(b.log.lines.filter((l) => l.kind === "call-outcome-unknown").map((l) => l.request)).toEqual([requestId]);
    // The other request's group read was never sent: dropped, nothing recorded.
    expect(b.operations.directory.sent).toHaveLength(sentBefore);
    expect((await eventTypes(other)).at(-1)).toBe("RequestClosed");
    expect(await listPendingCalls(db, requestId)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await listPendingCalls(db, other)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await listJobs(db)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("outbound events", () => {
  beforeEach(() => fresh());

  it("arrive at the sink in the request's order, and again from the turn's first event when a post fails", async () => {

    expect(b.log.lines.filter((l) => l.kind === "job-failed").map((l) => l.code)).toEqual(["publish"]);
    // In order: by seq, never back.
    const seqs = b.sink.received.slice(1).map((x) => Number(x.event.id.split("/")[1]));
    expect(seqs).toEqual([...seqs].sort((x, y) => x - y));
    expect(await listJobs(db)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("a turn whose post failed holds back the request's later turns until it is posted", async () => {
    b.sink.failPost(1);
    await approved();
    await b.runWorker();
    // The start turn's job waits 10 s; the later turns' jobs wait behind it on the request's publish queue.
    expect(b.sink.received).toEqual([]);
    await b.settle();
    const types = b.sink.received.map((x) => x.event.type);
    expect(types.slice(0, 2)).toEqual(["request.started@1", "request.statusChanged@1"]);
    const seqs = b.sink.received.map((x) => Number(x.event.id.split("/")[1]));
    expect(seqs).toEqual([...seqs].sort((x, y) => x - y));
    expect(seqs.filter((s) => s > 1).length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
  });
});

describe("a worker that dies", () => {
  beforeEach(() => fresh());

  it("loses nothing: a turn's jobs are committed with it, and a job left locked is taken again once its lock is stale", async () => {
    const requestId = await start();
    expect((await listJobs(db, requestId)).map((j) => j.kind)).toEqual(["call", "notify", "publish"]);
    // One worker takes the first job and never finishes.
    const hangs = () => new Promise<never>(() => undefined);
    const dead = createWorkerLoop({ db, log: b.log.log, clock: () => new Date(b.clock.now), name: "dead", handlers: { call: hangs, notify: hangs, publish: hangs } });
    void dead.runOnce();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await db.query("SELECT locked_by FROM jobs WHERE locked_by IS NOT NULL")).length).toBe(1);
    // Another worker does the rest now, and the dead worker's job once its lock is older than the limit.
    await b.runWorker();
    expect((await db.query<{ locked_by: string }>("SELECT locked_by FROM jobs")).map((j) => j.locked_by)).toEqual(["dead"]);
    b.clock.now += 61_000;
    await b.settle();
    expect(await listJobs(db)).toEqual([]);
    expect(b.operations.directory.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(b.notifier.sent.map((m) => m.to)).toEqual([marcus]);
    expect(b.sink.received.map((x) => x.event.type)).toEqual(["request.started@1", "request.statusChanged@1"]);
  });

  it("after its work and before deleting the job, runs each job twice: a call's result is recorded once, a message and an event may arrive twice", async () => {
    // Every job's first delete fails as if the worker died there; its lock goes stale and the job is taken again.
    const crashed = new Set<unknown>();
    const crashing: Db = {
      ...db,
      query: (sql, params) => {
        if (sql.startsWith("DELETE FROM jobs WHERE id") && !crashed.has(params?.[0])) {
          crashed.add(params?.[0]);
          return Promise.reject(new Error("the worker died"));
        }
        return db.query(sql, params);
      },
      transaction: (fn) => db.transaction(fn),
    };
    await resetDb(db);
    await publishFixture(db);
    await createWorkflow(db);
    b = await bench(crashing);
    const requestId = await start();
    const drain = async (): Promise<void> => {
      for (let round = 0; round < 40 && (await listJobs(db)).length > 0; round += 1) {
        for (;;) {
          try {
            if (!(await b.worker.runOnce())) break;
          } catch {
            // The worker died after the job's work; the next one takes it once its lock is stale.
          }
        }
        b.clock.now += 61_000;
      }
    };
    await drain();
    const task = (await b.call("GET", "/my-tasks", marcus)).body.items[0].task as string;
    expect((await b.call("POST", `/requests/${requestId}/tasks/${task}/act`, marcus, { button: "btn_da_approve", answers: { q_eng_lead: { type: "user", id: diego } } })).status).toBe(200);
    await drain();
    expect(await listJobs(db)).toEqual([]);
    expect(crashed.size).toBeGreaterThan(5);

    const events = await loadEvents(db, requestId);
    expect(events.filter((e) => e.type === "WaitCompleted" && e.payload.wait.element === "act_create_jira_issue__run.act_create_jira_issue")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(events.filter((e) => e.type === "CallResultLate")).toEqual([]);
    expect(jiraKeys()).toEqual([`once.${requestId}.act_create_jira_issue`]);
    expect(b.operations.directory.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect((await b.call("GET", "/my-tasks", diego)).body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    // Each message twice at most, and each event twice at most, with its one ID.
    const messages = b.notifier.sent.map((m) => `${m.rule}>${m.to}`);
    expect([...new Set(messages)].sort()).toEqual(["act_notify_eng_lead>" + diego, "n_task>" + diego, "n_task>" + marcus].sort());
    for (const m of new Set(messages)) expect(messages.filter((x) => x === m).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
    const ids = b.sink.received.map((x) => x.event.id);
    for (const id of new Set(ids)) expect(ids.filter((x) => x === id).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(new Set(ids).size).toBeGreaterThan(2);
  });

  it("start polls until stopped", async () => {
    await start();
    b.worker.start(5);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await listJobs(db)).length, { timeout: 10_000 }).toBe(0);
    await b.worker.stop();
    expect(b.operations.directory.sent).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

===\nengine/scripts/sync-spec.mjs\n===
// Copies the kernel spec package (workflow-platform/engine) into engine/spec with LF line endings,
// deletes what the source no longer has, and rewrites spec/SOURCE.md from the source repo's HEAD
// and the kernel spec's title. Run from engine/: `npm run sync-spec`.
// packages/core/test/spec-copy.test.ts fails when the copy differs from the source.
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, relative } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const engine = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const sourceRepo = join(engine, "..", "..", "workflow-platform");
const source = join(sourceRepo, "engine");
const target = join(engine, "spec");
const KEEP = "SOURCE.md";

if (!existsSync(source)) {
  console.error(`The spec's source is not on disk: ${source}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

/** Every file under a folder, as paths relative to it with forward slashes. */
function filesUnder(root) {
  const out = [];
  const walk = (dir) => {
    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const path = join(dir, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(path);
      else out.push(relative(root, path).split("\\").join("/"));
    }
  };
  walk(root);
  return out.sort();
}

const lf = (text) => text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
const wanted = filesUnder(source);

for (const name of filesUnder(target)) {
  if (name !== KEEP && !wanted.includes(name)) {
    rmSync(join(target, name));
    console.log(`deleted spec/${name}`);
  }
}
// Remove folders the deletions left empty.
const removeEmpty = (dir) => {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
    const path = join(dir, entry.name);
    removeEmpty(path);
    if (readdirSync(path).length === 0) rmSync(path, { recursive: true });
  }
};
removeEmpty(target);

for (const name of wanted) {
  mkdirSync(dirname(join(target, name)), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(target, name), lf(readFileSync(join(source, name), "utf8")), "utf8");
}
console.log(`copied ${wanted.length} files`);

const git = (...args) => execFileSync("git", ["-C", sourceRepo, ...args], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
const commit = git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD");
if (git("status", "--porcelain", "--", "engine") !== "") {
  console.warn(`warning: ${source} has uncommitted changes; SOURCE.md names ${commit}, which does not hold them`);
}
const title = readFileSync(join(source, "kernel", "kernel-spec.md"), "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)[0];
const version = /spec (v\d+(?:\.\d+)*)/.exec(title)?.[1];
if (!version) {
  console.error(`No version in the kernel spec's title: ${title}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const sourceFile = join(target, KEEP);
const sourceText = lf(readFileSync(sourceFile, "utf8"));
const line = /^This folder is a copy of .*$/m;
if (!line.test(sourceText)) {
  console.error(`spec/${KEEP} has no line starting "This folder is a copy of"`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
writeFileSync(
  sourceFile,
  sourceText.replace(
    line,
    `This folder is a copy of \`${relative(join(engine, ".."), source).split("\\").join("/")}\` (relative to this repo's root) at commit \`${commit}\` (kernel spec ${version}), taken on ${today} by \`npm run sync-spec\`.`,
  ),
  "utf8",
);
console.log(`spec/${KEEP}: commit ${commit}, kernel spec ${version}`);
