===\nfrontend/src/app/routeFocus.ts\n===
/**
 * After moving to another page (Submit on the start page, "Edit the form of ...", opening a task
 * from My tasks), the button that was pressed is gone and the keyboard focus would be left on the
 * document's body. Then it goes to the new page's own place for it: an element marked
 * `data-page-focus` (such as a "Your request is started" note), else the page's heading (h1).
 * A page that puts the focus somewhere itself (a revealed item, a name box) is left alone: only lost
 * focus is moved.
 */

/** True when nothing on the page has the focus (it is on the body, or on something no longer there). */
export function focusIsLost(doc: Document = document): boolean {
  const active = doc.activeElement;
  return !active || active === doc.body || active === doc.documentElement || !active.isConnected;
}

/** The new page's place for the focus: a marked element, else its heading; inside the page's main area. */
export function pageFocusTarget(doc: Document = document): HTMLElement | null {
  const mains = Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll('main'));
  // The innermost main is the page's (the editor's frame has one main around its tabs).
  const main = mains[mains.length - 1] ?? doc.body;
  return main.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-page-focus]') ?? main.querySelector<HTMLElement>('h1');
}

/**
 * Puts the focus on the page's place for it while the focus is lost, trying again for a while as the
 * page may still be loading its heading. Returns the function that stops trying.
 */
export function focusPageWhenLost(doc: Document = document, opts: { tries?: number; every?: number } = {}): () => void {
  const { tries = 40, every = 50 } = opts;
  let left = tries;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  // What had the focus when the page changed: often the pressed button, which leaves the page a
  // moment later. While it still has the focus, keep looking; once the new page has put the focus
  // somewhere else, leave it there.
  const from = doc.activeElement;
  const attempt = () => {
    timer = undefined;
    if (!focusIsLost(doc)) {
      if (doc.activeElement === from && left-- > 0) timer = setTimeout(attempt, every);
      return;
    }
    const target = pageFocusTarget(doc);
    if (target) {
      // A heading is not in the Tab order; it takes the focus without being put in it.
      if (!target.hasAttribute('tabindex') && !target.matches('a[href], button, input, select, textarea')) target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
      target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      return;
    }
    if (left-- > 0) timer = setTimeout(attempt, every);
  };
  timer = setTimeout(attempt, 0);
  return () => {
    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
  };
}

/** The part of a router this needs (a data router from react-router-dom). */
export interface RouterLike {
  state: { location: { pathname: string } };
  subscribe(listener: (state: { location: { pathname: string } }) => void): () => void;
}

/** Moves lost focus to the new page after every change of page. Returns the function that stops it. */
export function followRouteFocus(router: RouterLike, doc: Document = document): () => void {
  let last = router.state.location.pathname;
  let stop = () => undefined as void;
  const unsubscribe = router.subscribe((state) => {
    const path = state.location.pathname;
    if (path === last) return;
    last = path;
    stop();
    stop = focusPageWhenLost(doc);
  });
  return () => {
    stop();
    unsubscribe();
  };
}

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { fitTopBar, TOP_BAR_AT_1440, TOP_BAR_LEVELS } from './topBarFit';

/**
 * jsdom has no layout, so the bar's sizes are stubbed: the bar's inner right edge is at 1000 and
 * each level the bar gives up moves its last group `perLevel` pixels left (as tightening the gaps,
 * shortening the version line and tightening the tabs do in the browser).
 */
function bar(needs: number, perLevel: number, opts: { squeezedLeft?: boolean } = {}) {
  const header = document.createElement('header');
  const left = document.createElement('div');
  const center = document.createElement('div');
  const right = document.createElement('div');
  header.append(left, center, right);
  document.body.append(header);
  const rect = (r: Partial<DOMRect>) => ({ left: 0, top: 0, bottom: 56, height: 56, width: 0, x: 0, y: 0, right: 0, toJSON: () => ({}), ...r }) as DOMRect;
  const level = () => Number(header.dataset.fit ?? 0);
  header.getBoundingClientRect = () => rect({ right: 1000, height: level() === TOP_BAR_LEVELS ? 92 : 56 });
  right.getBoundingClientRect = () => rect({ right: needs - perLevel * level() });
  // A group narrower than what it holds: the name and version squeezed under the tabs (the defect).
  Object.defineProperty(left, 'scrollWidth', { get: () => (opts.squeezedLeft && level() < 2 ? 400 : 300) });
  Object.defineProperty(left, 'clientWidth', { get: () => 300 });
  return header;
}

afterEach(() => {
  document.body.innerHTML = '';
  document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--top-h');
});

describe('fitTopBar', () => {
  it('gives up nothing when everything fits', () => {
    const header = bar(990, 50);
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(0);
    expect(header.dataset.fit).toBe('0');
  });

  it('gives up one thing at a time until the last group ends inside the bar', () => {
    // 1120 wide: levels 1 and 2 are not enough (1070, 1020); level 3 is (970).
    const header = bar(1120, 50);
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(3);
    expect(header.dataset.fit).toBe('3');
    // Every level reached is listed, so the CSS for level 1 also holds at 3.
    expect(header.dataset.gave).toBe('1 2 3');
    expect(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--top-h')).toBe('');
  });

  it("gives way in the ruling's order: first the version line, then the tabs' padding", () => {
    // 1080: level 1 (the version line shortened, 1030) is not enough, level 2 (the tabs tighter,
    // 980) is; nothing else gives way, and no level ever hides Glossary's word or the save state.
    const header = bar(1080, 50);
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(TOP_BAR_AT_1440);
    expect(header.dataset.gave).toBe('1 2');
  });

  it('also counts a group that is narrower than its contents (something in it would be covered)', () => {
    const header = bar(990, 50, { squeezedLeft: true });
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(2);
  });

  it('wraps onto two rows as a last resort, and tells fixed things below the bar its new height', () => {
    const header = bar(5000, 10);
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(TOP_BAR_LEVELS);
    expect(header.dataset.fit).toBe(String(TOP_BAR_LEVELS));
    expect(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--top-h')).toBe('92px');
  });

  it('starts again from nothing given up when there is more room', () => {
    let needs = 5000;
    const header = bar(0, 50);
    const right = header.lastElementChild as HTMLElement;
    const level = () => Number(header.dataset.fit ?? 0);
    right.getBoundingClientRect = () => ({ right: needs - 50 * level() }) as DOMRect;
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(TOP_BAR_LEVELS);
    needs = 900;
    expect(fitTopBar(header)).toBe(0);
    expect(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--top-h')).toBe('');
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/app/topBarFit.ts\n===
import { useLayoutEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';

/**
 * How much the editor's top bar gives up to fit its width, in order (the frontend owner's ruling,
 * fix round 2). Each level keeps the ones before it. The workflow's name is cut with "..." after
 * 28 characters at every width (layout.module.css), so a long name never pushes the rest. Never
 * given up: the word "Glossary", the save state in words ("All changes saved", "Saving ...", "Not
 * saved", a conflict), and the To do and Worth knowing counts. Words that go from sight are still
 * read out. The rules for each level are in layout.module.css.
 *
 * 1 the version line shortens: "Version 3 is live" reads "v 3 live";
 * 2 the tabs keep their words but take less padding, and the gaps narrow;
 * 3 the bar's buttons take less padding;
 * 4 the tabs lose their icons;
 * 5 Glossary, Settings, Try it and Publish lose their icons (their words stay);
 * 6 the bar wraps onto two rows.
 * At 1440px the bar stays on one row in every state, the worst being a 37-character name with To do,
 * Worth knowing and "Publish · 2 to do first" all shown (level 5); at 1280 that case wraps
 * (tests/e2e/topbar.spec.ts).
 */
export const TOP_BAR_LEVELS = 6;

/** The level after the ruling's two named steps (version line, then the tabs' padding). */
export const TOP_BAR_AT_1440 = 2;

/**
 * True when the bar's last group ends past the bar's inner right edge, or a group is narrower
 * than what it holds (so something in it would be covered or cut).
 */
export function overflows(bar: HTMLElement): boolean {
  const groups = Array.from(bar.children) as HTMLElement[];
  const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
  if (!last) return false;
  if (groups.some((g) => g.scrollWidth > g.clientWidth + 1)) return true;
  const style = getComputedStyle(bar);
  const inner = bar.getBoundingClientRect().right - parseFloat(style.paddingRight || '0');
  return last.getBoundingClientRect().right > inner + 0.5;
}

function setLevel(bar: HTMLElement, level: number) {
  bar.dataset.fit = String(level);
  bar.dataset.gave = Array.from({ length: level }, (_, i) => i + 1).join(' ');
}

/** Picks the first level at which nothing in the bar overflows, and writes it to data-fit (and data-gave). */
export function fitTopBar(bar: HTMLElement): number {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  root.style.removeProperty('--top-h');
  let level = 0;
  setLevel(bar, 0);
  while (level < TOP_BAR_LEVELS && overflows(bar)) {
    level += 1;
    setLevel(bar, level);
  }
  // Fixed things below the bar (the To do list) start at --top-h; when the bar wraps it is taller.
  if (level === TOP_BAR_LEVELS) root.style.setProperty('--top-h', `${Math.ceil(bar.getBoundingClientRect().height)}px`);
  return level;
}

/**
 * Keeps the top bar fitted: again whenever the bar or any of its groups changes size (a wider
 * window, "To do (2)", "Publish · 2 to do first", a longer version line, a conflict notice).
 */
export function useTopBarFit(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, active: boolean) {
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const bar = ref.current;
    if (!active || !bar) return;
    fitTopBar(bar);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    let frame = 0;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => fitTopBar(bar));
    });
    observer.observe(bar);
    // The groups' children: their size changes with their words, and they never stretch.
    for (const group of Array.from(bar.children)) for (const item of Array.from(group.children)) observer.observe(item);
    // Items that appear later (a conflict notice, the save line's words) change a group's content.
    const mutations = new MutationObserver(() => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => fitTopBar(bar));
    });
    mutations.observe(bar, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      observer.disconnect();
      mutations.disconnect();
      document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--top-h');
    };
  }, [ref, active]);
}
===\nfrontend/src/contract/README.md\n===
# contract

The contract shared with the engine, imported straight from the repo's `contract/` folder through the `@contract` alias (no copies).

- `index.ts`: everything from `@contract/authored-format` and the catalogue types from `@contract/catalogue` (catalogue's `DirectoryRef` is `CatalogueDirectoryRef`; its placeholder `ValueKind` is left out).
- `fixtures.ts`: the four sample workflows and their Settings records, keyed by name.
- No logic and no words a person reads. Imports nothing from the rest of `src`.
- Its types are the ones the engine's core re-exports (core keeps a synced copy of these files); `src/services/types.test.ts` checks they are the same, both ways.
- Elsewhere, import from `@/contract`, not `@contract/...` directly.
===\nfrontend/src/contract/fixtures.test.ts\n===
/** Checks that the contract's fixtures load through the @contract alias and follow the ID rule. */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { ID_PATTERN, ITEM_KINDS, WORDS } from './index';
import { FIXTURE_NAMES, fixtureRecords, fixtures } from './fixtures';

const idPattern = new RegExp(ID_PATTERN);
const prefixes = Object.keys(ITEM_KINDS);

/** Every `id` field in the document, plus every string that starts with an item prefix (references). */
function idsIn(node: unknown, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) node.forEach((n) => idsIn(n, out));
  else if (node && typeof node === 'object') {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(node)) {
      if (key === 'id' && typeof value === 'string') out.push(value);
      idsIn(value, out);
    }
  } else if (typeof node === 'string' && prefixes.some((p) => node.startsWith(`${p}_`))) out.push(node);
  return out;
}

describe('contract fixtures', () => {
  it('has the four named fixtures', () => {
    expect(FIXTURE_NAMES.sort()).toEqual(['blank', 'change-request', 'integrated-sample', 'several-at-once']);
  });

  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s is format version 0', (name) => {
    expect(fixtures[name].formatVersion).toBe(0);
  });

  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s: every ID matches ID_PATTERN and has no double underscore', (name) => {
    const ids = idsIn(fixtures[name]);
    expect(ids.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const id of ids) {
      expect(id, id).toMatch(idPattern);
      expect(id, id).not.toContain('__');
    }
  });

  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s has a Settings record with a name', (name) => {
    expect(fixtureRecords[name].name).not.toBe('');
  });

  it('re-exports the format\'s values', () => {
    expect(WORDS).toBeDefined();
    expect(ITEM_KINDS.st).toBe('stage');
  });
});

/**
 * The contract's sample workflows (contract/fixtures/*.authored.json) and their Settings records
 * (contract/fixtures/records.json), keyed by name, and the mock catalogue of connections
 * (contract/fixtures/catalogue.json). Used by tests, the stand-in engine and the demo.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@contract/authored-format';
import type { Catalogue } from '@contract/catalogue';
import blank from '@contract/fixtures/blank.authored.json';
import catalogue from '@contract/fixtures/catalogue.json';

import integratedSample from '@contract/fixtures/integrated-sample.authored.json';
import records from '@contract/fixtures/records.json';

/**
 * The server's Settings record for a workflow, as the fixtures hold it. Not in the document;
 * its shape follows records.json until authoring-api.md section 3 is committed.
 */
export interface FixtureRecord {

  description: string;

}

/**

 * document is cast once here. contract/check type-checks the TypeScript sources of these files
 * against the format, and fixtures.test.ts checks them at run time.
 */
export const fixtures: Record<FixtureName, AuthoredWorkflow> = {
  'change-request': changeRequest as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow,
  blank: blank as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow,
  'several-at-once': severalAtOnce as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow,
  'integrated-sample': integratedSample as unknown as AuthoredWorkflow,

/** Settings records for the fixtures (cast for the same reason: `type` is read as `string`). */
export const fixtureRecords = records as Record<FixtureName, FixtureRecord>;

export const FIXTURE_NAMES = Object.keys(fixtures) as FixtureName[];

/**

/**

export * from '@contract/authored-format';

/**
 * One action in a stage section, as a card: its name in words (from describe), its details, its
 * "Only when", its findings, and the plain line on what happens if it fails. The name opens and
 * closes the card's editor; the handle moves it (drag, or the arrow keys).
 */
import { forwardRef, Fragment, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type DragEvent, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Action, Expression, Field, Stage, UseConnection, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import {
  actionName,
  describeCondition,
  describeExpression,
  describeFinding,
  describeIfItFails,
  describeTemplate,
  isRefusal,
  Slot,
  type Phrase,
  toText,
  useCatalogue,
  useDescribeEnv,
  useDoc,
  useFindingsFor,
  useRun,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { ConnectionEditor, operationOf, useResultSample, WaitsBox } from './ConnectionEditor';
import { stuckOptionsFor, useKindOf, useStuckPeople, valueName } from './hooks';
import { NotifyEditor } from './NotifyEditor';
import { PhraseView, plainWords } from './PhraseView';
import { SaveValueEditor } from './SaveValueEditor';
import { TellEditor } from './TellEditor';
import s from './actions.module.css';

type Props = {
  action: Action;
  stage: Stage | undefined;
  stageId: string;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange(open: boolean): void;
  /** Focus the first control when the card opens (a newly added action). */
  focusFirst?: boolean;
  flash?: boolean;
  onRemove(): void;
  /** Moves by one place: -1 up, +1 down. */
  onMoveBy(delta: -1 | 1): void;
  onDragStart(e: DragEvent): void;
  onDragEnd(): void;
  onDragOver(e: DragEvent): void;
  /** Where a dragged action would land: a line before or after this card. */
  dropMark: 'before' | 'after' | null;
};

const SORT_ICON: Record<string, IconName> = { read: 'lookup', write: 'bolt', await: 'clock' };

export const ActionCard = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, Props>(function ActionCard(
  { action, stage, stageId, open, onOpenChange, focusFirst, flash, onRemove, onMoveBy, onDragStart, onDragEnd, onDragOver, dropMark },
  ref,
) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const kindOf = useKindOf();
  const run = useRun();
  const bodyId = useId();
  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [onlyWhenRefused, setOnlyWhenRefused] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !focusFirst) return;
    const id = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const root = bodyRef.current;
      const marked = root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-first-control]');
      const target =
        marked?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input, textarea, select, button, [tabindex="0"]') ??
        root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input, textarea, select, button');
      (target ?? nameRef.current)?.focus();
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id);
  }, [open, focusFirst]);

  if (!doc) return null;
  // The short name ("Notify Eng lead", "Wait for Deploy pipeline"); the rest shows in the details and the editor.
  const name = actionName(doc, action, env, true);
  const nameText = toText(name) || t('describe.gap');
  const op = action.type === 'useConnection' ? operationOf(catalogue, action) : undefined;
  const icon: IconName =
    action.type === 'saveValue'
      ? 'save'
      : action.type === 'notify'
        ? 'notify'
        : action.type === 'tellOtherSystems'
          ? 'outbox'
          : (SORT_ICON[op?.operation?.sort ?? 'write'] ?? 'bolt');

  const onHandleKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onMoveBy(e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 1);
    }
  };

  return (
    <li
      ref={ref}
      className={[
        s.card,
        open ? s.cardOpen : undefined,
        flash ? s.flash : undefined,
        dropMark === 'before' ? s.dropBefore : dropMark === 'after' ? s.dropAfter : undefined,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')}
      data-action-id={action.id}
      data-reveal={action.id}
      onDragOver={onDragOver}
    >
      <div className={s.cardHead}>
        <span className={s.cardIcon}>
          <Icon name={icon} size={16} />
        </span>
        <button
          ref={nameRef}
          type="button"
          className={s.cardName}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={bodyId}
          onClick={() => onOpenChange(!open)}
        >
          <PhraseView phrase={name} kindOf={kindOf} />
          {op?.operation?.sort === 'read' && <span className={s.connTag}>{op.connectionLabel}</span>}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={s.handle}
          draggable
          aria-label={t('actions.move', { name: nameText })}
          aria-describedby={`${bodyId}-hint`}
          onKeyDown={onHandleKey}
          onDragStart={onDragStart}
          onDragEnd={onDragEnd}
        >
          <Icon name="drag" size={16} />
        </button>
        <span id={`${bodyId}-hint`} className="visually-hidden">
          {t('actions.moveHint')}
        </span>
      </div>

      <Findings action={action} />

      <div id={bodyId} ref={bodyRef} className={s.cardBody}>
        {open ? (
          <>
            {action.type === 'saveValue' && <SaveValueEditor action={action} autoFocus={focusFirst} />}
            {action.type === 'notify' && <NotifyEditor action={action} autoFocus={focusFirst} />}
            {action.type === 'useConnection' && <ConnectionEditor action={action} stage={stage} autoFocus={focusFirst} />}
            {action.type === 'tellOtherSystems' && <TellEditor action={action} autoFocus={focusFirst} />}
            {/* Named "Only when" for a screen reader, also while empty and only "Only when ..." shows. */}
            <div className={s.labelled} data-only-when="" role="group" aria-label={t('actions.onlyWhen')}>
              {/* Empty, the builder shows only its add control ("Only when ..."): the words once, not twice. */}
              {action.onlyWhen && (
                <span className={s.smallHeading} aria-hidden>
                  {t('actions.onlyWhen')}
                </span>
              )}
              <Slot
                name="WhenBuilder"
                at={{ item: action.id, part: 'onlyWhen' }}
                stageId={stageId}
                addLabel={t('actions.onlyWhenAdd')}
                value={action.onlyWhen}
                onChange={(next) => {
                  const result = run('action.setOnlyWhen', { action: action.id, ...(next ? { onlyWhen: next } : {}) });
                  setOnlyWhenRefused(isRefusal(result));
                }}
              />
              {onlyWhenRefused && (
                <p className={s.noteRed} role="alert">
                  <Icon name="error" size={14} />
                  <span>{t('actions.onlyWhenRefused')}</span>
                </p>
              )}
              {action.type === 'saveValue' && action.onlyWhen && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.save.keepsValue')}</p>}
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Details action={action} stage={stage} />
        )}
        <FailureLine action={action} stage={stage} />
        {open && (
          <div className={s.cardFoot}>
            <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" icon="trash" onClick={onRemove} aria-label={t('actions.removeNamed', { name: nameText })}>
              {t('actions.remove')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                onOpenChange(false);
                nameRef.current?.focus();
              }}
            >
              {t('actions.done')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
});

/** The closed card's details: the message, what is sent and saved, the waiting box, and "Only when". */
function Details({ action, stage }: { action: Action; stage: Stage | undefined }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const kindOf = useKindOf();
  if (!doc) return null;
  return (
    <div className={s.details}>
      {action.type === 'notify' && action.to && 'ifEmptyUse' in action.to && action.to.ifEmptyUse && (
        <p className={s.detailLine}>
          <Icon name="check" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.details.ifEmpty')}</span>{' '}
          <PhraseView phrase={describeExpression(doc, action.to.ifEmptyUse, env)} kindOf={kindOf} />
        </p>
      )}
      {action.type === 'notify' && action.message.length > 0 && (
        <p className={s.messageBox}>
          <PhraseView phrase={describeTemplate(doc, action.message, env)} kindOf={kindOf} />
        </p>
      )}
      {action.type === 'useConnection' && <ConnectionDetails action={action} stage={stage} />}
      {action.type === 'tellOtherSystems' && Object.keys(action.values ?? {}).length > 0 && (
        <p className={s.detailLine}>
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.details.with')}</span>{' '}
          {Object.values(action.values).map((expr, i) => (
            <span key={i} className={s.inlineChip}>
              <PhraseView
                phrase={Array.isArray(expr) ? describeTemplate(doc, expr, env) : describeExpression(doc, expr, env)}
                kindOf={kindOf}
              />
            </span>
          ))}
        </p>
      )}
      {action.onlyWhen && (
        <p className={s.detailLine}>
          <Icon name="filter" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.onlyWhen')}</span>{' '}
          <PhraseView phrase={describeCondition(doc, action.onlyWhen, env)} kindOf={kindOf} />
        </p>
      )}
      {action.type === 'saveValue' && action.onlyWhen && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.save.keepsValue')}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** "Issue key" as "issue key" inside a sentence; a word that starts with two capitals (an acronym) is kept. */
const lowerFirst = (text: string) => (/^[A-Z][a-z]/.test(text) ? text.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + text.slice(1) : text);

/**
 * A catalogue label without a closing "and wait ..." ("Run the pipeline and wait" -> "Run the
 * pipeline"), since the sentence says it. The same rule as describe's withoutTrailingWait, which
 * '@/model' does not export (asked for in the round-1 report).
 */
const withoutTrailingWait = (label: string) => label.replace(/\s+and wait\b.*$/i, '').trim() || label;

/** Words of `key` with `{values}` replaced by `values`: the chips sit inside the sentence. */
function Sentence({ text, values }: { text: string; values: ReactNode }) {
  const [before = '', after = ''] = text.split(VALUES_MARK);
  return (
    <>
      {before}
      {values}
      {after}
    </>
  );
}
const VALUES_MARK = '\u0000';

/** Chips as a list in the shared list words ("[A]", "[A] and [B]", "[A], [B] and [C]"). */
function ChipList({ phrases, kindOf }: { phrases: Phrase[]; kindOf: (id: string | undefined) => ValueKind | undefined }) {
  return (
    <>
      {phrases.map((p, i) => (
        <Fragment key={i}>
          {i > 0 && (i === phrases.length - 1 ? ` ${t('describe.and')} ` : t('describe.comma'))}
          <span className={s.inlineChip}>
            <PhraseView phrase={p} kindOf={kindOf} />
          </span>
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * A closed connection card, as the mockups read it. Does something (07-actions, Create Jira issue):
 * "In Jira", what is sent, one row each ("Project", "Summary", "Assignee"). Look up and Wait for
 * (editor-model.md section 10, 14-connections) read as a sentence: "Find what Service catalog has for
 * [Service]."; "Ask Deploy pipeline to deploy a service and wait until it reports back. Send it [A]
 * and [B]." Then each "If empty, use", "Save the issue key as [Jira issue]" (or, for several results,
 * "Save the results as" with one row each), and for a Wait for its box.
 */
function ConnectionDetails({ action, stage }: { action: UseConnection; stage: Stage | undefined }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const kindOf = useKindOf();
  const { operation, connectionLabel } = operationOf(catalogue, action);
  const sampleOf = useResultSample(doc, operation);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const sampleBeside = (fieldId: string, label: string) => {
    const sample = sampleOf(fieldId);
    return sample ? (
      <span className={s.resultSample} data-result-sample="" title={t('actions.conn.sampleTitle', { label, sample })}>
        <span className="visually-hidden">{t('actions.conn.sampleHidden')}</span>
        {sample}
      </span>
    ) : null;
  };
  const inputs = action.inputs ?? {};
  const fieldIds = operation ? operation.input.map((f) => f.id).filter((id) => inputs[id] !== undefined) : Object.keys(inputs);
  const label = (fields: Field[] | undefined, id: string) => fields?.find((f) => f.id === id)?.label || id;
  const fallbacks = fieldIds
    .map((id) => inputs[id])
    .filter((x): x is Expression => !!x && !Array.isArray(x) && typeof x === 'object' && 'ifEmptyUse' in x && !!x.ifEmptyUse)
    .map((x) => (x as { ifEmptyUse: Expression }).ifEmptyUse);
  const saved = (operation ? operation.result.map((f) => f.id) : Object.keys(action.saveResults ?? {})).filter(
    (id) => action.saveResults?.[id],
  );
  const chip = (valueId: string) => (
    <span className={s.inlineChip}>
      <PhraseView phrase={[{ chip: 'value', label: valueName(doc, valueId), id: valueId }]} kindOf={kindOf} />
    </span>
  );
  const sort = operation?.sort;
  const sentPhrases = fieldIds.map((id) => {
    const input = inputs[id]!;
    return Array.isArray(input) ? describeTemplate(doc, input, env) : describeExpression(doc, input, env, { short: true });
  });
  const ifEmptyLines = fallbacks.map((fallback, i) => (
    <p key={i} className={s.detailLine}>
      <Icon name="check" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
      <span className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.details.ifEmpty')}</span>{' '}
      <PhraseView phrase={describeExpression(doc, fallback, env)} kindOf={kindOf} />
    </p>
  ));
  const chips = <ChipList phrases={sentPhrases} kindOf={kindOf} />;
  return (
    <>
      {sort === 'read' && fieldIds.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.detailGroup} data-sentence="read">
          <p className={s.sentence}>
            <Sentence text={t('actions.details.read', { connection: connectionLabel, values: VALUES_MARK })} values={chips} />
          </p>
          {ifEmptyLines}
        </div>
      )}
      {sort === 'await' && operation && (
        <div className={s.detailGroup} data-sentence="await">
          <p className={s.sentence}>
            {t('actions.details.await', { connection: connectionLabel, what: lowerFirst(withoutTrailingWait(operation.label || '')) })}
            {fieldIds.length > 0 && (
              <>
                {' '}
                <Sentence text={t('actions.details.sendIt', { values: VALUES_MARK })} values={chips} />
              </>
            )}
          </p>
          {ifEmptyLines}
        </div>
      )}
      {sort !== 'read' && sort !== 'await' && fieldIds.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.detailGroup}>
          <p className={s.detailHeading}>{t('actions.conn.in', { connection: connectionLabel })}</p>
          <dl className={s.detailInputs}>
            {fieldIds.map((id) => {
              const input = inputs[id]!;
              return (
                <div key={id} className={s.gridRow}>
                  <dt>{label(operation?.input, id)}</dt>
                  <dd>
                    <PhraseView
                      phrase={Array.isArray(input) ? describeTemplate(doc, input, env) : describeExpression(doc, input, env, { short: true })}
                      kindOf={kindOf}
                    />
                  </dd>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </dl>
          {ifEmptyLines}
        </div>
      )}
      {saved.length === 1 && (
        <p className={s.detailLine}>
          <Icon name="check" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.details.saveOne', { label: lowerFirst(label(operation?.result, saved[0]!)) })}</span>{' '}
          {chip(action.saveResults![saved[0]!]!)} {sampleBeside(saved[0]!, label(operation?.result, saved[0]!))}
        </p>
      )}
      {saved.length > 1 && (
        <div className={s.detailGroup}>
          <p className={s.detailHeading}>{t('actions.details.saveMany')}</p>
          <dl className={s.detailInputs}>
            {saved.map((id) => (
              <div key={id} className={s.gridRow}>
                <dt className={s.resultName} data-result-name="">
                  <span>{label(operation?.result, id)}</span>
                  <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} className={s.arrowIcon} />
                </dt>
                <dd className={s.withSample}>
                  {chip(action.saveResults![id]!)}
                  {sampleBeside(id, label(operation?.result, id))}
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </div>
      )}
      {operation?.sort === 'await' && (
        <WaitsBox doc={doc} stage={stage} connection={connectionLabel} />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The plain lines on what happens if it fails (editor-model.md sections 3, 10 and 11). Save a value
 * never fails. For an action that uses a connection the three sentences are the model's
 * (`describeIfItFails`), the same as In words, open or closed and for every sort (Look up, Does
 * something, Wait for): asked again when it cannot be reached or answers unclearly; who is told when
 * it is slow (the first mention on the card, saying who they are); what happens when it says it
 * failed (the second mention, short).
 */
function FailureLine({ action, stage }: { action: Action; stage: Stage | undefined }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const stuckOptions = stuckOptionsFor(stage, action.id);
  if (!doc || action.type === 'saveValue') return null;
  if (action.type === 'useConnection') {
    const said = describeIfItFails(doc, action, { ...env, stuckPeople }, stuckOptions);
    return (
      <>
        <p className={s.failLine} data-asked-again="">
          <Icon name="info" size={14} />
          <span>
            <PhraseView phrase={plainWords(said.askedAgain)} />
          </span>
        </p>
        {said.slow && (
          <p className={s.failLine} data-slow-line="">
            <Icon name="clock" size={14} />
            <span>
              <PhraseView phrase={plainWords(said.slow)} />
            </span>
          </p>
        )}
        <p className={s.failLine} data-fails-line="">
          <Icon name={said.stops ? 'warning' : 'info'} size={14} />
          <span>
            <PhraseView phrase={plainWords(said.failed)} />
          </span>
        </p>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <p className={s.failLine}>
      <Icon name="info" size={14} />
      <span>{t(action.type === 'notify' ? 'actions.notifyFails' : 'actions.tell.never')}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

/** The action's To do and Worth knowing, in words, on its card. */
function Findings({ action }: { action: Action }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const run = useRun();
  const findings = useFindingsFor(action.id);
  if (!doc || findings.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <ul className={s.findings}>
      {findings.map((f, i) => {
        const words = describeFinding(doc, f, { ...env, stuckPeople });
        const tone = words.tone === 'contradictory' ? s.findingRed : words.tone === 'unfinished' ? s.findingAmber : s.findingGrey;
        return (
          <li key={`${f.code}-${f.location.part ?? ''}-${i}`} className={`${s.finding} ${tone}`}>
            <Icon name={words.tone === 'worthKnowing' ? 'info' : words.tone === 'contradictory' ? 'error' : 'todo'} size={14} />
            <div>
              <strong>{words.short}</strong>
              <span className={s.findingCause}>
                {' '}
                <PhraseView phrase={plainWords(words.causeParts)} />
              </span>
              {words.effect && (
                <span className={s.findingCause}>
                  {' '}
                  <PhraseView phrase={plainWords(words.effectParts ?? [words.effect])} />
                </span>
              )}
              {words.fix?.kind === 'carryOn' && action.type === 'useConnection' && (
                <div>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'useConnection', ifItFails: 'carryOn' })}
                  >
                    {words.fix.label || t('actions.finding.fixCarryOn')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/AddMenu.tsx\n===
/**
 * "+ Add an action or save a value": the grouped menu, built from the catalogue (menu.ts). A menu
 * with a line under each item and a note under a group; Radix gives the keyboard (arrow keys,
 * Enter, Escape) and returns focus to the button unless something new took it.
 * The menu is kept inside the area the button scrolls in (so it never covers the top bar) and,
 * when it is taller than the room on either side, it scrolls instead of running off the window.
 * Could move to ui as a "menu with descriptions" later.
 */
import * as RM from '@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu';
import { Fragment, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useCatalogue } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { buildAddMenu, type AddChoice } from './menu';
import s from './actions.module.css';

const EDGE = 12;

/** The nearest ancestor that scrolls, or null: the menu stays within its top and bottom edges. */
function scrollArea(el: HTMLElement | null): HTMLElement | null {
  for (let p = el?.parentElement ?? null; p && p !== document.body; p = p.parentElement) {
    const { overflowY } = getComputedStyle(p);
    if (overflowY === 'auto' || overflowY === 'scroll') return p;
  }
  return null;
}

type Padding = { top: number; bottom: number; left: number; right: number };

/**
 * `label` is the button's accessible name: the visible words and which section it adds to, so the
 * two buttons of a stage ("When this stage starts", "After they respond") are told apart.
 */
export function AddMenu({ onAdd, disabled, label }: { onAdd(choice: AddChoice): void; disabled?: boolean; label?: string }) {
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const groups = useMemo(() => buildAddMenu(catalogue), [catalogue]);
  const added = useRef(false);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [padding, setPadding] = useState<Padding>({ top: EDGE, bottom: EDGE, left: EDGE, right: EDGE });
  return (
    <RM.Root
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open) return;
        added.current = false;
        const area = scrollArea(trigger.current)?.getBoundingClientRect();
        const top = area ? Math.max(EDGE, area.top + 4) : EDGE;
        const bottom = area ? Math.max(EDGE, window.innerHeight - area.bottom + 4) : EDGE;
        setPadding({ top, bottom, left: EDGE, right: EDGE });
      }}
    >
      <RM.Trigger asChild disabled={disabled}>
        <button ref={trigger} type="button" className={s.add} aria-label={label}>
          <Icon name="plus" />
          {t('word.addActionOrSave')}
        </button>
      </RM.Trigger>
      <RM.Portal>
        <RM.Content
          className={s.menu}
          align="start"
          sideOffset={6}
          collisionPadding={padding}
          onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => {
            // The new action's card takes focus.
            if (added.current) e.preventDefault();
          }}
        >
          {groups.map((group, gi) => (
            <Fragment key={group.key}>
              {gi > 0 && <RM.Separator className={s.menuSep} />}
              <RM.Group aria-label={group.label}>
                <RM.Label className={s.menuGroup}>{group.label}</RM.Label>
                {group.note && <p className={s.menuNote}>{group.note}</p>}
                {group.items.map((item) => (
                  <RM.Item
                    key={item.key}
                    className={s.menuItem}
                    disabled={Boolean(item.unavailable)}
                    onSelect={() => {
                      added.current = true;
                      onAdd(item.choice);
                    }}
                    textValue={item.label}
                  >
                    <span className={s.menuIcon}>
                      <Icon name={item.icon} />
                    </span>
                    <span className={s.menuText}>
                      <span className={s.menuLabel}>{item.label}</span>
                      {(item.sort || item.line) && (
                        <span className={s.menuLine}>
                          {item.sort && <span className={s.menuSort}>{item.sort}</span>}
                          {item.sort && item.line ? t('actions.menu.sep') : ''}
                          {item.line}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {item.unavailable && !group.note && <span className={s.menuLine}>{item.unavailable}</span>}
                    </span>
                  </RM.Item>
                ))}
              </RM.Group>
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </RM.Content>
      </RM.Portal>
    </RM.Root>
  );
}

/**
 * An action that uses a connection (Look up, Does something, Wait for), one editor driven entirely by
 * the catalogue entry (editor-model.md section 10): the inputs under "In <connection>", "Save the
 * results as", the box about waiting for an answer, what happens if the stage starts again (a plain
 * line from the catalogue's default, the choice only when there is none), and "If it fails" (Stop, or
 * Carry on with two optional rows saving whether it failed and what went wrong).
 */
import { useId, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Expression, Field, Operation, Stage, Template, UseConnection, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import { heldValueText, isHeldRef, isRefusal, joinNames, refsInHeld, Slot, useCatalogue, useDoc, useRun } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Callout, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { useRefNames, useStuckWords, valueName } from './hooks';
import { acceptsFor } from './kinds';
import { PhraseView, plainWords, wordsWith } from './PhraseView';
import { ValueNamePicker } from './ValueNamePicker';
import s from './actions.module.css';

/** The operation an action uses, its connection, and the connection's label (its ID's first part when unknown). */
export function operationOf(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, action: UseConnection) {
  const entry = action.operation ? catalogue?.entries.find((e) => e.id === action.operation) : undefined;
  const operation = entry?.kind === 'operation' ? (entry as Operation) : undefined;
  const connectionId = entry?.connection ?? action.operation?.split('.')[0] ?? '';
  const connection = catalogue?.connections.find((c) => c.id === connectionId);
  return { operation, connection, connectionLabel: connection?.label || connectionId };
}

type Props = { action: UseConnection; stage: Stage | undefined; autoFocus?: boolean };

export function ConnectionEditor({ action, stage, autoFocus }: Props) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const { operation, connection, connectionLabel } = operationOf(catalogue, action);
  if (!doc) return null;
  return (
    <div className={s.stack}>
      {catalogue && action.operation && !operation && (
        <Callout tone="danger">{t('actions.conn.missing', { connection: connectionLabel })}</Callout>
      )}
      {connection?.status === 'notSetUp' && <Callout tone="todo">{t('actions.conn.notSetUp', { connection: connectionLabel })}</Callout>}
      {connection?.status === 'disabled' && <Callout tone="todo">{t('actions.conn.turnedOff', { connection: connectionLabel })}</Callout>}
      {connection?.status !== 'disabled' && operation?.status === 'disabled' && (
        <Callout tone="todo">{t('actions.conn.entryOff', { connection: connectionLabel })}</Callout>
      )}
      {operation?.description && <p className={s.quiet}>{operation.description}</p>}
      {operation && <Inputs action={action} operation={operation} connection={connectionLabel} autoFocus={autoFocus} />}
      {operation && <Results doc={doc} action={action} operation={operation} connection={connectionLabel} stage={stage} />}
      {operation?.sort === 'await' && (
        <WaitsBox doc={doc} stage={stage} connection={connectionLabel} />
      )}
      {operation && <Again action={action} operation={operation} />}
      <IfItFails doc={doc} action={action} connection={connectionLabel} />
    </div>
  );
}

function Inputs({
  action,
  operation,
  connection,
  autoFocus,
}: {
  action: UseConnection;
  operation: Operation;
  connection: string;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}) {
  const run = useRun();
  return (
    <section className={s.block} aria-label={t('actions.conn.in', { connection })}>
      <h4 className={s.inHeading}>{t('actions.conn.in', { connection })}</h4>
      {operation.input.length === 0 && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.conn.noInputs')}</p>}
      <div className={s.grid}>
        {operation.input.map((field, i) => {
          const current = action.inputs?.[field.id];
          const label = field.required ? t('actions.conn.needed', { label: field.label || field.id }) : field.label || field.id;
          const name = t('actions.conn.inputLabel', { label, connection });
          const set = (input: Expression | Template | undefined) =>
            run('action.setInput', { action: action.id, field: field.id, ...(input === undefined ? {} : { input }) });
          const asText = Array.isArray(current) || (current === undefined && field.kind === 'longText');
          return (
            <div key={field.id} className={s.gridRow}>
              <span className={s.rowLabel} aria-hidden>
                {label}
              </span>
              <div className={s.rowControl} data-first-control={autoFocus && i === 0 ? '' : undefined}>
                {asText ? (
                  <Slot
                    name="MessageField"
                    at={{ item: action.id, part: `inputs.${field.id}` }}
                    label={name}
                    multiline={field.kind === 'longText'}
                    value={current as Template | undefined}
                    onChange={(next) => set(next && next.length > 0 ? next : undefined)}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Slot
                    name="ValueField"
                    at={{ item: action.id, part: `inputs.${field.id}` }}
                    label={name}
                    accepts={acceptsFor(field.kind)}
                    allowTyped
                    allowIfEmptyUse
                    value={current as Expression | undefined}
                    onChange={(next) => set(next)}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Saves into a new value named `name`: one command when nothing is saved there yet, else the value first. */
function useSaveIntoNew() {
  const run = useRun();
  return (name: string, apply: (value: ValueId | undefined, name: string) => void, hasCurrent: boolean) => {
    if (!hasCurrent) {
      apply(undefined, name);
      return;
    }
    const created = run('value.create', { name });
    if (!isRefusal(created)) apply(created.id, name);
  };
}

function Results({
  doc,
  action,
  operation,
  connection,
  stage,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  action: UseConnection;
  operation: Operation;
  connection: string;
  stage: Stage | undefined;
}) {
  const run = useRun();
  const saveIntoNew = useSaveIntoNew();
  const headingId = useId();
  const sampleOf = useResultSample(doc, operation);
  return (
    <section className={s.block} aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <h4 id={headingId} className={s.blockHeading}>
        {t('actions.conn.saveResults')}
      </h4>
      {operation.result.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.conn.noResults', { connection })}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p className={s.inHeading}>{t('actions.conn.savedIn', { connection })}</p>
          <div className={s.grid}>
            {operation.result.map((field: Field) => {
              const current = action.saveResults?.[field.id];
              const label = field.label || field.id;
              const sample = current ? sampleOf(field.id) : undefined;
              return (
                <div key={field.id} className={s.gridRow}>
                  <span className={`${s.rowLabel} ${s.resultName}`} aria-hidden data-result-name="">
                    <span>{label}</span>
                    <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} className={s.arrowIcon} />
                  </span>
                  <div className={`${s.rowControl} ${s.withSample}`}>
                    <ValueNamePicker
                      label={t('actions.conn.resultLabel', { label })}
                      valueId={current}
                      gives={field.kind}
                      onPick={(value) => run('action.setSavedResult', { action: action.id, field: field.id, value })}
                      onNew={(name) =>
                        saveIntoNew(
                          name,
                          (value, label) =>
                            run('action.setSavedResult', { action: action.id, field: field.id, ...(value ? { value } : { label }) }),
                          Boolean(current),
                        )
                      }
                      onClear={() => run('action.setSavedResult', { action: action.id, field: field.id, value: null })}
                    />
                    {sample && (
                      <span className={s.resultSample} data-result-sample="" title={t('actions.conn.sampleTitle', { label, sample })}>
                        <span className="visually-hidden">{t('actions.conn.sampleHidden')}</span>
                        {sample}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {operation.sort === 'read' && <DoneWhen doc={doc} action={action} stage={stage} />}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * The box on a Wait for: the request stays here until the other system reports back, in minutes or
 * days. Who is told when it is slow is the card's own line, from the model (`describeIfItFails`),
 * the same on every card that uses a connection and in In words.
 */
export function WaitsBox({ doc, stage, connection }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; stage: Stage | undefined; connection: string }) {
  const statusId = stage && 'status' in stage ? stage.status : undefined;
  const status = statusId ? doc.statuses.find((x) => x.id === statusId)?.words?.trim() : undefined;
  return (
    <div className={s.waitsBox} data-waits-box="">
      <Icon name="clock" size={16} />
      <p>{status ? t('actions.conn.waits', { status, connection }) : t('actions.conn.waitsNoStatus', { connection })}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * When a Look up is done, in the stage's own terms (mockup 14-connections, look-up): after the start
 * form, "Done once the requester presses Submit, before the request moves on."
 */
function DoneWhen({ doc, action, stage }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; action: UseConnection; stage: Stage | undefined }) {
  if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending') return null;
  const name = stage.name || t('describe.noName');
  let text: string;
  if ((stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []).some((a) => a.id === action.id)) {
    text = t(stage.kind === 'automatic' ? 'actions.done.automatic' : 'actions.done.stageStarts', { stage: name });
  } else if (doc.start?.stage === stage.id) {
    const buttons = (stage.tasks?.[0]?.buttons ?? []).map((b) => b.label || t('describe.noName'));
    text = buttons.length ? t('actions.done.startForm', { buttons: joinNames(buttons, 'or') }) : t('actions.done.afterRespond', { stage: name });
  } else text = t('actions.done.afterRespond', { stage: name });
  return (
    <p className={s.againLine} data-done-when="">
      <Icon name="info" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
      <span>{text}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

/**
 * The catalogue's sample of a result, in words, when it is something a person reads at a glance
 * ("Mei Tanaka", "Tier 1", "Payments API"); undefined for nothing or for a list of records.
 */
export function useResultSample(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null, operation: Operation | undefined) {
  const sample = operation?.sample?.result;
  const refs = useMemo(() => refsInHeld(Object.values(sample ?? {})), [sample]);
  const { nameOf } = useRefNames(refs);
  return (fieldId: string): string | undefined => {
    const value = (sample as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.[fieldId];
    // A Look up's results are what the author saves to read later (mockup 14, look-up); what other
    // actions give back (a link to a pipeline run, an issue key) is not shown as a sample.
    if (!doc || operation?.sort !== 'read' || !readable(value)) return undefined;
    // A person or group shows once the directory has named them, never as "someone".
    if (refsInHeld(value).some((r) => !nameOf(r))) return undefined;
    return heldValueText(doc, value, { nameOf });
  };
}

const isRecord = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
function readable(value: unknown): boolean {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return false;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length > 0 && value.every((v) => !isRecord(v) || isHeldRef(v));
  if (isRecord(value)) return isHeldRef(value) || typeof value.label === 'string';
  return true;
}

/**
 * What happens when the stage starts again (after a send-back). Frontend owner's ruling: the choice is
 * shown only when the catalogue entry gives no default; otherwise one plain line says what happens,
 * worded from the default. A look-up is always made afresh (contract: a read is made again on every
 * entry, and a choice there "has no effect", core-api.md action.repeatOnRead), so it only says that.
 * A document that already chose otherwise than the default keeps the choice in view, so it can be undone.
 */
function Again({ action, operation }: { action: UseConnection; operation: Operation }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const name = useId();
  if (operation.sort === 'read') {
    return (
      <p className={s.againLine} data-again-line="">
        <Icon name="info" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
        <span>{t('actions.again.read')}</span>
      </p>
    );
  }
  const fallback = operation.onRepeat ?? undefined;
  const authored = action.ifStageEntersAgain;
  if (fallback && (!authored || authored === fallback)) {
    return (
      <p className={s.againLine} data-again-line="">
        <Icon name="info" size={14} className={s.quietIcon} />
        <span>{t(fallback === 'once' ? 'actions.again.lineOnce' : 'actions.again.lineAgain')}</span>
      </p>
    );
  }
  const chosen = authored ?? fallback;
  return (
    <fieldset className={s.choiceSet}>
      <legend className={s.blockHeading}>{t('actions.again.heading')}</legend>
      {(['once', 'again'] as const).map((choice) => (
        <label key={choice} className={[s.choice, chosen === choice ? s.choiceOn : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}>
          <input
            type="radio"
            name={name}
            checked={chosen === choice}
            onChange={() => run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'useConnection', ifStageEntersAgain: choice })}
          />
          <span>{t(choice === 'once' ? 'actions.again.once' : 'actions.again.again')}</span>
        </label>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function IfItFails({ doc, action, connection }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; action: UseConnection; connection: string }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const name = useId();
  // Short form ("Sam Carter is told"): the card's lines below say who that is, with the Settings link.
  const stuck = useStuckWords();
  const saveIntoNew = useSaveIntoNew();
  const carryOn = action.ifItFails === 'carryOn';
  const code = action.saveFailureAs?.code;
  const failed = action.saveFailureAs?.failed;

  // Carrying on, the request goes on to the arrows; "whether it failed" is filled in at once (as Yes/No it is
  // what an arrow most easily tests), and both rows can be cleared: they are optional (frontend owner's ruling).
  const chooseCarryOn = () => {
    if (carryOn) return;
    run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'useConnection', ifItFails: 'carryOn' });
    if (!failed && !code) run('action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: action.id, part: 'failed', name: t('actions.fails.defaultName', { connection }) });
  };
  const saveFailure = (part: 'code' | 'failed', current: ValueId | undefined) => ({
    onPick: (value: ValueId) => run('action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: action.id, part, value }),
    onNew: (newName: string) =>
      saveIntoNew(
        newName,
        (value, n) => run('action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: action.id, part, ...(value ? { value } : { name: n }) }),
        Boolean(current),
      ),
    onClear: () => run('action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: action.id, part, value: null }),
  });
  // The rows, in the format's order: saveFailureAs.failed (Yes/No), then saveFailureAs.code (text).
  const rows = [
    { part: 'failed' as const, current: failed, gives: 'yesNo' as const, words: t('actions.fails.failedRow') },
    { part: 'code' as const, current: code, gives: 'text' as const, words: t('actions.fails.codeRow') },
  ];

  return (
    <fieldset className={s.choiceSet}>
      <legend className={s.blockHeading}>{t('actions.fails.heading')}</legend>
      <label className={[s.choice, !carryOn ? s.choiceOn : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}>
        <input
          type="radio"
          name={name}
          checked={!carryOn}
          onChange={() => run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'useConnection', ifItFails: 'stuck' })}
        />
        <span>
          <PhraseView phrase={plainWords(wordsWith('actions.fails.stop', 'stuck', stuck))} />
        </span>
      </label>
      <div className={[s.choice, carryOn ? s.choiceOn : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}>
        <label className={s.choiceLabel}>
          <input type="radio" name={name} checked={carryOn} onChange={chooseCarryOn} />
          <span>{t('actions.fails.carryOn')}</span>
        </label>
        {carryOn && (
          <div className={s.choiceMore}>
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <div key={row.part} className={s.labelled} data-failure-row={row.part}>
                <span className={s.smallHeading} aria-hidden>
                  {row.words}
                </span>
                <ValueNamePicker label={row.words} valueId={row.current} gives={row.gives} {...saveFailure(row.part, row.current)} />
              </div>
            ))}
            {failed ? (
              <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.fails.carryOnHintFailed', { value: valueName(doc, failed) })}</p>
            ) : code ? (
              <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.fails.carryOnHint', { value: valueName(doc, code) })}</p>
            ) : (
              <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.fails.carryOnNothing')}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/PhraseView.tsx\n===
/**
 * A describe Phrase on screen: plain words as text, chips as chips, unfinished parts quiet, and the
 * "Settings" link part (`isSettingsLink`) as a link that opens Settings.
 * Built here because ui may not know about phrases; could move to a shared place later.
 */
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import type { ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { isChip, isSettingsLink, type Part, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { Chip } from '@/ui';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { chipKind } from './kinds';
import { SettingsLink } from './SettingsLink';
import s from './actions.module.css';

type Props = {
  phrase: Phrase;
  /** The kind of a value chip, for its icon. */
  kindOf?: (valueId: string) => ValueKind | undefined;
};

const MARK = '\u0000';

/**
 * The words of `key` with `{name}` replaced by a whole phrase (chips and links kept): "If Jira has
 * not reported back after 30 minutes, [Platform team], who look after stuck requests, are told".
 */
export function wordsWith(key: WordKey, name: string, inner: Phrase, params: Record<string, string> = {}): Phrase {
  const [before = '', after = ''] = t(key, { ...params, [name]: MARK }).split(MARK);
  return [...(before ? [before] : []), ...inner, ...(after ? [after] : [])] as Part[];
}

/**
 * The phrase with its chips as plain words, the Settings link kept: for the sentences about failing
 * and being slow, which read as plain lines on a card (mockups 07 and 14).
 */
export function plainWords(phrase: Phrase): Phrase {
  return phrase.map((part) => (typeof part !== 'string' && isChip(part) ? part.label : part));
}

export function PhraseView({ phrase, kindOf }: Props) {
  return (
    <>
      {phrase.map((part, i) => {
        if (typeof part === 'string') {
          // Punctuation already shown with a Settings link just before it is not shown twice.
          const before = i > 0 ? phrase[i - 1] : undefined;
          const text = before !== undefined && typeof before !== 'string' && isSettingsLink(before) ? part.replace(/^[)\].,;:]+/, '') : part;
          return <Fragment key={i}>{text}</Fragment>;
        }
        if (isSettingsLink(part)) {
          // The link and the punctuation right after it ("Settings).") stay on one line.
          const next = phrase[i + 1];
          const stuck = typeof next === 'string' ? (/^[)\].,;:]+/.exec(next)?.[0] ?? '') : '';
          return (
            <span key={i} className={s.nowrap}>
              <SettingsLink />
              {stuck}
            </span>
          );
        }
        if (isChip(part)) {
          if (part.missing)
            return (
              <span key={i} className={s.missing}>
                {part.label}
              </span>
            );
          switch (part.chip) {
            case 'value':
              return (
                <Chip key={i} size="sm" kind={chipKind(part.id ? kindOf?.(part.id) : undefined)}>
                  {part.label}
                </Chip>
              );
            case 'person':
            case 'group':
              return (
                <Chip key={i} size="sm" variant={part.chip}>
                  {part.label}
                </Chip>
              );
            case 'button':
              return (
                <Chip key={i} size="sm" variant="button">
                  {part.label}
                </Chip>
              );
            case 'connection':
              return (
                <span key={i} className={s.connTag}>
                  {part.label}
                </span>
              );
            default:
              return (
                <span key={i} className={s.strong}>
                  {part.label}
                </span>
              );
          }
        }
        return (
          <span key={i} className={s.missing}>
            {part.text}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/README.md\n===
# features/actions

The actions and saves of a stage section, done in order (editor-model.md sections 3, 4 and 10; mockups 07-actions and 14-connections).

- No route. Exports `StageActions`, which fills the model slot of the same name (`src/model/slots.ts`, props `StageActionsProps`: `stageId`, `place` = `stageStarts` | `afterRespond` | `automatic`; `automatic` shows the stage's `whenThisStageStarts`). `features/panel` shows it. Also exports `sectionOf(place)` and `buildAddMenu(catalogue)` with its types.
- Files:
  - `index.tsx`: the list (cards, drag and keyboard reorder, remove, "Show me"), then the add menu.
  - `ActionCard.tsx`: one card: the short name from describe (`actionName(..., true)`), its findings in words (`causeParts`/`effectParts`), the closed details or the open editor, "Only when" (the `WhenBuilder` slot), and the lines on what happens if it fails: for a connection the three are the model's `describeIfItFails` (`askedAgain`, `slow`, `failed`), the same sentences as In words, open or closed and for every sort. The first mention of who is told on a card says who they are (the first such card in a stage adds "(change this in Settings)"); the second is short. "Only when" is a group named "Only when".
  - `AddMenu.tsx` + `menu.ts`: the grouped "+ Add" menu built from the catalogue (Built in, then one group per connection; each offering by its label and its sort in the author's words, never the catalogue's description; a connection not set up is shown and says so).
  - `SaveValueEditor.tsx`, `NotifyEditor.tsx`, `ConnectionEditor.tsx` (Look up, Does something, Wait for: all from the catalogue entry; "If it fails" is Stop or Carry on, and Carry on has two optional rows, "Save whether it failed as" and "Save what went wrong as", for `saveFailureAs.failed` and `.code`; "If the stage starts again" is a choice only when the catalogue entry gives no default, otherwise one plain line worded from the default), `TellEditor.tsx`.
  - `ValueNamePicker.tsx`: "saved as [value]": pick a value or type a new name, with the same-name and wrong-kind rules said on the spot. Candidate for ui or values later.
  - `PhraseView.tsx`: a describe Phrase as text and chips, its Settings link part as a link; `plainWords` (chips as plain words, for the failing and slow lines) and `wordsWith` (a word with a phrase inside). Candidate for a shared place.
  - `kinds.ts`, `hooks.ts`: kinds of value; `useStuckPeople` (everyone in "Stuck requests go to", groups marked) for the model's `describeStuckTold`; `stuckOptionsFor` (how the first mention reads on a card) and `useStuckWords` (the short form, for the Stop choice); `useRefNames`. The slow-system line and its time are the model's (`describeIfItFails`, `durationWords`), no longer built here.
  - A Look up's "Save the results as" shows the catalogue's sample beside each saved value (`useResultSample`, through the model's `heldValueText`) and says when it is done (`DoneWhen`).
  - `SettingsLink.tsx`: "Settings" inside a stuck sentence as a link (the model's `isSettingsLink` part, drawn by `PhraseView`), opening the top bar's Settings popover by pressing its button. Interim: it should become a model request (e.g. `openSettings()`, which features/panel's SettingsButton listens to) and move to ui so panel and others can use it.
- Edits only through `useRun()` commands (`action.*`, `value.create`, `told.*`). Words in `src/words/actions.ts`.
- Tests: `menu.test.ts` (with `made-up-catalogue.ts`, a catalogue nothing in the app knows), `StageActions.test.tsx` (every action of the four fixtures, the editors, the list); e2e `tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/SaveValueEditor.tsx\n===
/** Save a value: "Save [what] as [value]" (editor-model.md section 4). */
import type { SaveValue } from '@/contract';
import { Slot, useFacts, useRun } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { kindOfExpression } from './kinds';
import { ValueNamePicker } from './ValueNamePicker';
import s from './actions.module.css';

export function SaveValueEditor({ action, autoFocus }: { action: SaveValue; autoFocus?: boolean }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const gives = kindOfExpression(action.save, facts);
  return (
    <div className={s.saveRow}>
      <span className={s.rowLabel}>{t('actions.save.save')}</span>
      <div className={s.rowControl} data-first-control={autoFocus ? '' : undefined}>
        <Slot
          name="ValueField"
          at={{ item: action.id, part: 'save' }}
          label={t('actions.save.whatLabel')}
          allowTyped
          value={action.save}
          onChange={(next) => run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'saveValue', save: next ?? null })}
        />
      </div>
      <span className={s.rowLabel}>{t('actions.save.as')}</span>
      <div className={s.rowControl}>
        <ValueNamePicker
          label={t('actions.save.asLabel')}
          valueId={action.as}
          gives={gives}
          onPick={(id) => run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'saveValue', as: id })}
          onNew={(name) => run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'saveValue', as: { newValue: name } })}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/SettingsLink.tsx\n===
/**
 * "Settings" inside a sentence about stuck requests, as a link that opens the Settings popover of the
 * top bar (editor-model.md section 9: "Every 'is told' sentence about stuck requests links to
 * Settings"). The popover belongs to features/panel; there is no model request to open it yet, so the
 * link presses the top bar's own "Settings" button. Radix then moves focus into the popover, and back
 * to that button when it closes.
 *
 * Candidate for src/ui (or a model request such as `openSettings()`): see the actions README.
 */
import { t } from '@/words';
import s from './actions.module.css';

/** The top bar's Settings button: a popover trigger whose words are "Settings". */
export function findSettingsButton(root: ParentNode = document): HTMLElement | null {
  const word = t('word.settings');
  const candidates = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:not([data-settings-link])'));
  return candidates.find((b) => b.textContent?.trim() === word) ?? null;
}

export function SettingsLink() {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={s.inlineLink}
      data-settings-link=""
      title={t('actions.settingsLinkTitle')}
      onClick={() => {
        const target = findSettingsButton();
        if (!target) return;
        target.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'nearest' });
        target.click();
      }}
    >
      {t('word.settings')}
    </button>
  );
}

/** ValueField: a select of the workflow's values and the Requester. */
function StubValueField(props: ComponentProps<Slots['ValueField']>) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const current = props.value && 'value' in props.value ? props.value.value : props.value && 'request' in props.value ? 'requester' : '';
  return (
    <select
      aria-label={props.label}
      value={current}
      onChange={(e) => {
        const v = e.target.value;
        const next: Expression | undefined = !v ? undefined : v === 'requester' ? { request: 'requester' } : { value: v as ValueId };
        (props.onChange as (next: Expression | undefined) => void)(next);
      }}
    >
      <option value="">…</option>
      <option value="requester">Requester</option>
      {doc?.values.map((v) => (
        <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
          {v.name}
        </option>
      ))}
    </select>
  );
}

/** MessageField: plain text. */
function StubMessageField(props: ComponentProps<Slots['MessageField']>) {
  const text = (props.value ?? []).filter((p) => typeof p === 'string').join('');
  return (
    <textarea
      aria-label={props.label}
      value={text}
      onChange={(e) => (props.onChange as (next: string[] | undefined) => void)(e.target.value ? [e.target.value] : undefined)}
    />
  );
}

/** WhenBuilder: the add label, which starts an empty sentence. */
function StubWhenBuilder(props: ComponentProps<Slots['WhenBuilder']>) {
  return props.value ? (
    <span>a sentence</span>
  ) : (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => (props.onChange as (c: { allOf: [] }) => void)({ allOf: [] })}>
      {props.addLabel}
    </button>
  );
}

const slots: Partial<Slots> = { ValueField: StubValueField, MessageField: StubMessageField, WhenBuilder: StubWhenBuilder };

// ── set-up ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function open(name: FixtureName, catalogue?: Catalogue) {
  const { services } = createStandinServices();
  const result = await services.catalogue.getCatalogue();
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error('no catalogue');
  const record = fixtureRecords[name];
  act(() => {
    useEditor.getState().load(name, structuredClone(fixtures[name]), 1);
    useSession.setState({
      status: 'ready',
      workflowId: name,
      catalogue: catalogue ?? result.value,
      settings: {
        name: record.name,
        description: record.description,
        authors: [],
        stuckRequestsGoTo: record.stuckRequestsGoTo.map(({ type, id }) => ({ type, id })),
      },
    });
  });
  return { services, catalogue: catalogue ?? result.value };
}

function Wrap({ services, children }: { services: Services; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={slots}>{children}</SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>
  );
}

  return stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage[section] : [];
};

      const { services, catalogue } = await open(name);
      const env = { catalogue };
      const places: [ActionsPlace, 'whenThisStageStarts' | 'afterTheyRespond'][] = [
        ['stageStarts', 'whenThisStageStarts'],
        ['afterRespond', 'afterTheyRespond'],
      ];
      for (const stage of doc().stages) {
        if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
        for (const [place, section] of places) {
          const list = stage[section];
          if (list.length === 0) continue;
          const view = render(
            <Wrap services={services}>
              <StageActions stageId={stage.id} place={place} />
            </Wrap>,
          );
          for (const action of list) {
            const el = card(action.id);
            expect(el, `${action.id} has a card`).not.toBeNull();
            const nameButton = within(el).getAllByRole('button')[0]!;
            expect(nameButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            expect(nameButton.textContent?.startsWith(toText(actionName(doc(), action, env, true)))).toBe(true);
            const text = el.textContent ?? '';
            if (action.type === 'notify') expect(text).toContain("If this can't be sent, the request carries on.");
            if (action.type === 'tellOtherSystems') expect(text).toContain('This never holds a request up. If no system is listening, nothing happens.');
            // The model's three sentences (describeIfItFails), the same as In words: unreachable or unclear is asked again,
            // slow tells the people who look after stuck requests, and neither is stuck; then what a clear failure does.
            if (action.type === 'useConnection') expect(text).toMatch(/If .+ cannot be reached or its answer is unclear, .+ is asked again and the request is not stuck\./);
            if (action.type === 'useConnection') expect(text).toMatch(/If .+ has not (answered|reported back) after \d+ \w+, .+ told( \(change this in Settings\))?; the request is not stuck\./);
            if (action.type === 'useConnection' && action.ifItFails === 'stuck') expect(text).toMatch(/If .+ says it failed, the request is stuck here and/);
            if (action.type === 'useConnection' && action.ifItFails === 'carryOn') expect(text).toMatch(/If .+ says it failed, the request carries on/);
            expect(text).not.toMatch(/alerted|If this fails/);
          }
          view.unmount();
        }
      }
