/**
 * Tell other systems: what happened (typed), with which values, and who is listening now (from the
 * catalogue). It never holds a request up (editor-model.md section 10).
 */
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { Catalogue, Expression, Template, TellOtherSystems, ToldId } from '@/contract';
import { describeExpression, isRefusal, Slot, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useRun } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon, IconButton, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import s from './actions.module.css';

/** The labels of the connections listening now: event sinks that are usable, of connections that are set up. */
export function listeningNow(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (!catalogue) return [];
  const labels = catalogue.entries
    .filter((e) => e.kind === 'eventSink' && e.status !== 'disabled')
    .map((e) => catalogue.connections.find((c) => c.id === e.connection))
    .filter((c) => c && c.status === 'ready')
    .map((c) => c!.label || c!.id);
  return [...new Set(labels)];
}

/** A key for what the other systems receive, made from a value's name ("Pipeline run" -> "pipelineRun"), unique among `taken`. */
export function keyFor(name: string, taken: readonly string[]): string {
  const words = name
    .normalize('NFKD')
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 ]+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  let base = words.map((w, i) => (i === 0 ? w.toLowerCase() : w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase())).join('');
  if (!/^[A-Za-z]/.test(base)) base = `value${base}`;
  let key = base;
  for (let n = 2; taken.includes(key); n++) key = `${base}${n}`;
  return key;
}

export function TellEditor({ action, autoFocus }: { action: TellOtherSystems; autoFocus?: boolean }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const run = useRun();
  const whatId = useId();
  const told = action.tell ? doc?.thingsTold?.find((x) => x.id === action.tell) : undefined;
  // What is being typed; null while not editing (then the document's words show).
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const words = draft ?? told?.words ?? '';

  if (!doc) return null;
  const entries = Object.entries(action.values ?? {});
  const listening = listeningNow(catalogue);

  const commitWords = () => {
    const next = words.trim();
    setDraft(null);
    if (next === (told?.words ?? '').trim()) return;
    const sharedWithOthers =
      told &&
      doc.stages.some((st) =>
        st.kind === 'ending'
          ? false
          : [...st.whenThisStageStarts, ...st.afterTheyRespond].some(
              (a) => a.id !== action.id && a.type === 'tellOtherSystems' && a.tell === told.id,
            ),
      );
    if (told && !sharedWithOthers) {
      // Another entry may already have these words: then this action tells that one.
      const other = doc.thingsTold.find((x) => x.id !== told.id && x.words.trim().toLowerCase() === next.toLowerCase());
      if (!other || !next) {
        run('told.rename', { told: told.id, words: next });
        return;
      }
    }
    const created = run('told.create', { words: next });
    if (isRefusal(created)) return;
    run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'tellOtherSystems', tell: created.id as ToldId });
    if (told) run('told.removeIfUnused', { told: told.id });
  };

  const setValues = (values: Record<string, Expression | Template>) =>
    run('action.update', { action: action.id, type: 'tellOtherSystems', values });
  const nameOf = (expr: Expression | Template) => toText(Array.isArray(expr) ? [] : describeExpression(doc, expr, env));

  return (
    <div className={s.stack}>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.tell.line')}</p>
      <div className={s.labelled}>
        <label htmlFor={whatId} className={s.smallHeading}>
          {t('actions.tell.what')}
        </label>
        <TextInput
          id={whatId}
          value={words}
          placeholder={t('actions.tell.whatPlaceholder')}
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={commitWords}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              e.preventDefault();
              commitWords();
            }
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <section className={s.labelled} aria-label={t('actions.tell.values')}>
        <span className={s.smallHeading} aria-hidden>
          {t('actions.tell.values')}
        </span>
        <ul className={s.plainList}>
          {entries.map(([key, expr], i) => (
            <li key={key} className={s.tellRow}>
              {Array.isArray(expr) ? (
                <>
                  <Slot
                    name="MessageField"
                    at={{ item: action.id, part: `values.${key}` }}
                    label={t('actions.tell.valueLabel', { n: i + 1 })}
                    value={expr}
                    onChange={(next) => {
                      const rest = { ...action.values };
                      if (next && next.length > 0) rest[key] = next;
                      else delete rest[key];
                      setValues(rest);
                    }}
                  />
                  {/* A text has no "empty it" of its own; a value slot does (emptying it stops sending it). */}
                  <IconButton
                    icon="close"
                    size="sm"
                    label={t('actions.tell.removeValue', { name: t('actions.tell.valueLabel', { n: i + 1 }) })}
                    onClick={() => {
                      const rest = { ...action.values };
                      delete rest[key];
                      setValues(rest);
                    }}
                  />
                </>
              ) : (
                <Slot
                  name="ValueField"
                  at={{ item: action.id, part: `values.${key}` }}
                  label={t('actions.tell.valueLabel', { n: i + 1 })}
                  allowIfEmptyUse
                  value={expr}
                  onChange={(next) => {
                    const rest = { ...action.values };
                    if (next) rest[key] = next;
                    else delete rest[key];
                    setValues(rest);
                  }}
                />
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
          {adding && (
            <li className={s.tellRow}>
              <Slot
                name="ValueField"
                at={{ item: action.id, part: 'values' }}
                label={t('actions.tell.newValueLabel')}
                allowIfEmptyUse
                value={undefined}
                onChange={(next) => {
                  if (!next) return;
                  const key = keyFor(nameOf(next) || 'value', Object.keys(action.values ?? {}));
                  setValues({ ...action.values, [key]: next });
                  setAdding(false);
                }}
              />
            </li>
          )}
        </ul>
        {!adding && (
          <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" icon="plus" className={s.addLink} onClick={() => setAdding(true)}>
            {t('actions.tell.addValue')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </section>
      <p className={s.listening}>
        <span>{t('actions.tell.listening')}</span>{' '}
        {listening.length > 0 ? (
          listening.map((label) => (
            <span key={label} className={s.connTag}>
              {label}
            </span>
          ))
        ) : (
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('actions.tell.nobodyListening')}</span>
        )}{' '}
        <a href="#/connections" className={s.link}>
          {t('actions.tell.seeConnections')}
        </a>
      </p>
      <div className={s.toldBox}>
        <Icon name="info" size={14} />
        <p>
          <strong>{t('actions.tell.alwaysTold')}</strong> {t('actions.tell.alwaysToldLine', { builtIn: t('actions.tell.builtIn') })}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/ValueNamePicker.tsx\n===
/**
 * "Save ... as [value]": the value something is saved as, picked from the workflow's values or typed
 * as a new name (editor-model.md section 4). A combobox: type to filter, arrow keys to move, Enter
 * to choose, Escape to put back what was there. Two rules are said on the spot:
 *  - a typed name that another value already has: "There is already a value called ... This one is
 *    separate." with Rename and Use that value instead;
 *  - a value of another kind is refused, with the reason.
 * Could move to ui (or values) later; built here because no shared picker for saving into a value exists.
 */
import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { ValueId, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { locationCrumbs, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFacts } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { chipKind, kindOfValue, kindsFit, kindWords } from './kinds';
import s from './actions.module.css';

type Props = {
  /** The accessible name, e.g. "The value it is saved as". */
  label: string;
  valueId: ValueId | undefined;
  /** The kind of what is saved, when known: a value of another kind is refused. */
  gives?: ValueKind | undefined;
  onPick(valueId: ValueId): void;
  onNew(name: string): void;
  /** Offer "Stop saving it" (a result that need not be saved). */
  onClear?: () => void;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
};

type Option =
  | { kind: 'new'; name: string }
  | { kind: 'value'; id: ValueId; name: string; has: ValueKind | undefined; fits: boolean }
  | { kind: 'clear' };

const norm = (text: string) => text.trim().toLowerCase();

export function ValueNamePicker({ label, valueId, gives, onPick, onNew, onClear, autoFocus }: Props) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const id = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const currentName = (valueId && doc?.values.find((v) => v.id === valueId)?.name) || '';
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null>(null); // null: not being edited, shows the current name
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(-1); // -1: nothing highlighted, Enter takes the typed name
  const [note, setNote] = useState<
    { type: 'sameName'; id: ValueId; name: string; where: string } | { type: 'wrongKind'; message: string } | null
  >(null);

  const shown = text ?? currentName;
  const typed = text ?? '';

  const options = useMemo<Option[]>(() => {
    if (!doc) return [];
    const q = norm(typed);
    const values = doc.values
      .filter((v) => v.id !== valueId && (!q || norm(v.name ?? '').includes(q)))
      .map((v) => {
        const has = kindOfValue(v.id, facts);
        return { kind: 'value' as const, id: v.id, name: v.name ?? '', has, fits: kindsFit(has, gives) };
      });
    const out: Option[] = [];
    if (q && !doc.values.some((v) => norm(v.name ?? '') === q)) out.push({ kind: 'new', name: typed.trim() });
    out.push(...values);
    if (onClear && valueId && !q) out.push({ kind: 'clear' });
    return out;
  }, [doc, typed, valueId, facts, gives, onClear]);

  if (!doc) return null;

  const whereFilled = (vid: ValueId) => {
    const at = facts?.values[vid]?.filledAt[0];
    // The first place on its path: the stage it is filled in ("from Create Jira issue").
    return at ? (locationCrumbs(doc, { item: at.item }, env)[0] ?? '') : '';
  };

  const finish = () => {
    setText(null);
    setOpen(false);
    setActive(-1);
  };

  const pick = (option: Option) => {
    if (option.kind === 'clear') {
      onClear?.();
      setNote(null);
      finish();
      return;
    }
    if (option.kind === 'new') {
      setNote(null);
      onNew(option.name);
      finish();
      return;
    }
    if (!option.fits) {
      setNote({
        type: 'wrongKind',
        message: t('actions.pick.wrongKind', {
          name: option.name || t('describe.noName'),
          has: kindWords(option.has),
          gives: kindWords(gives),
        }),
      });
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    setNote(null);
    onPick(option.id);
    finish();
  };

  /** A typed name, committed with Enter or by leaving the field. */
  const commitTyped = () => {
    const name = typed.trim();
    if (text === null || !name || norm(name) === norm(currentName)) {
      finish();
      return;
    }
    const same = doc.values.find((v) => v.id !== valueId && norm(v.name ?? '') === norm(name));
    if (same) {
      setNote({ type: 'sameName', id: same.id, name: same.name ?? name, where: whereFilled(same.id) });
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    setNote(null);
    onNew(name);
    finish();
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setOpen(true);
      setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, options.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const option = open && active >= 0 ? options[active] : undefined;
      if (option) pick(option);
      else commitTyped();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (open || text !== null) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        setNote(null);
        finish();
      }
    }
  };

  const listId = `${id}-list`;
  const optionId = (i: number) => `${id}-opt-${i}`;
  const useThat = note?.type === 'sameName' ? note : null;

  return (
    <div className={s.picker}>
      <div className={s.pickerBox}>
        {valueId && text === null && <Icon name={chipKind(kindOfValue(valueId, facts))} size={14} className={s.pickerIcon} />}
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          className={s.pickerInput}
          role="combobox"
          aria-label={label}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={listId}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-activedescendant={open && active >= 0 && options[active] ? optionId(active) : undefined}
          placeholder={valueId ? undefined : t('actions.pick.placeholder')}
          value={shown}
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setText(e.target.value);
            setOpen(true);
            setActive(-1);
            setNote(null);
          }}
          onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            if (e.relatedTarget && (e.relatedTarget as HTMLElement).closest(`#${CSS.escape(listId)}`)) return;
            commitTyped();
          }}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          tabIndex={-1}
          className={s.pickerToggle}
          aria-label={label}
          aria-hidden
          onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
          onClick={() => {
            setOpen((o) => !o);
            inputRef.current?.focus();
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <ul id={listId} role="listbox" aria-label={label} className={s.pickerList} hidden={!open}>
        {open && options.length === 0 && <li className={s.pickerEmpty}>{t('actions.pick.noMatch')}</li>}
        {open &&
          options.map((option, i) => (
            <li
              key={option.kind === 'value' ? option.id : option.kind}
              id={optionId(i)}
              role="option"
              aria-selected={i === active}
              aria-disabled={option.kind === 'value' && !option.fits ? true : undefined}
              className={[
                s.pickerOption,
                i === active ? s.pickerActive : undefined,
                option.kind === 'value' && !option.fits ? s.pickerGrey : undefined,
              ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' ')}
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
              onClick={() => pick(option)}
            >
              {option.kind === 'new' && (
                <>
                  <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
                  <span>
                    {gives
                      ? t('actions.pick.newKind', { name: option.name, kind: kindWords(gives) })
                      : t('actions.pick.new', { name: option.name })}
                  </span>
                </>
              )}
              {option.kind === 'value' && (
                <>
                  <Icon name={chipKind(option.has)} size={14} />
                  <span className={s.pickerName}>{option.name || t('describe.noName')}</span>
                  <span className={s.pickerKind}>{kindWords(option.has)}</span>
                </>
              )}
              {option.kind === 'clear' && (
                <>
                  <Icon name="close" size={14} />
                  <span>{t('actions.pick.stopSaving')}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
      </ul>
      {note?.type === 'wrongKind' && (
        <p className={s.noteRed} role="alert">
          <Icon name="error" size={14} />
          <span>{note.message}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {useThat && (
        <div className={s.noteAmber} role="status">
          <p>
            {useThat.where
              ? t('actions.pick.sameName', { name: useThat.name, where: useThat.where })
              : t('actions.pick.sameNameNowhere', { name: useThat.name })}
          </p>
          <div className={s.noteActions}>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                setNote(null);
                inputRef.current?.focus();
                inputRef.current?.select();
              }}
            >
              {t('actions.pick.rename')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="primary"
              onClick={() => {
                const has = kindOfValue(useThat.id, facts);
                setText(null);
                if (!kindsFit(has, gives)) {
                  setNote({
                    type: 'wrongKind',
                    message: t('actions.pick.wrongKind', { name: useThat.name, has: kindWords(has), gives: kindWords(gives) }),
                  });
                  return;
                }
                setNote(null);
                onPick(useThat.id);
                inputRef.current?.focus();
              }}
            >
              {t('actions.pick.useThat')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Small hooks the action cards share. */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Stage, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { describeStuckTold, useFacts, useSettings, type Phrase, type StuckPerson, type StuckToldOptions } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Ref } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { kindOfValue } from './kinds';

/**
 * The kind of a value, from the facts: `kindOf(valueId)`. Describe's request chips ("Requester",
 * "Started on") carry the ids `request.requester` and `request.startedOn` and read as a person and
 * a date, as in features/values (`requestChipKind`).
 */
export function useKindOf(): (valueId: string | undefined) => ValueKind | undefined {
  const facts = useFacts();
  return useCallback((valueId) => {
    if (valueId === 'request.requester') return 'person';
    if (valueId === 'request.startedOn') return 'date';
    return kindOfValue(valueId, facts);
  }, [facts]);
}

const refKey = (r: Ref) => `${r.type}:${r.id}`;
/** Directory names asked for once per page (the directory is the same for every card). */
const knownNames = new Map<string, string>();

/**
 * The directory's names of these people and groups: `nameOf(ref)` is undefined until it is known.
 * Each is asked for once per page; the component renders again when names arrive.
 */
export function useRefNames(refs: readonly Ref[]): { nameOf: (ref: Ref) => string | undefined; learnt: number } {
  const services = useServices();
  const missing = refs.filter((r) => !knownNames.has(refKey(r)));
  const missingKey = [...new Set(missing.map(refKey))].join('|');
  const [learnt, setLearnt] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!missingKey) return;
    let alive = true;
    services.directory
      .lookup(missing)
      .then((found) => {
        for (const e of found) knownNames.set(refKey(e), e.label);
        if (alive) setLearnt((n) => n + 1);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
    // `missingKey` stands for `missing`.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, missingKey]);
  return { nameOf: (ref) => knownNames.get(refKey(ref)), learnt };
}

/**
 * Everyone in "Stuck requests go to" (absent or empty: the authors), by the directory's name, a
 * group marked as one (it reads "are told"). A name not known yet is left out until it is.
 */
export function useStuckPeople(): readonly StuckPerson[] {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const refs: Ref[] = settings?.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : (settings?.authors ?? []);
  const { nameOf, learnt } = useRefNames(refs);
  const key = refs.map(refKey).join('|');
  return useMemo(
    () =>
      refs.flatMap((r) => {
        const name = nameOf(r);
        return name ? [{ name, ...(r.type === 'group' ? { group: true } : {}) }] : [];
      }),
    // `key` and `learnt` stand for the refs and the names learnt.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [key, learnt],
  );
}

/**
 * How the first mention of who is told reads on this action's card (the model's one sentence,
 * `describeStuckTold`, through `describeIfItFails`): every card that uses a connection says who
 * they are ("Sam Carter, who looks after stuck requests, is told"); the first such card in the stage
 * also says where to change it ("(change this in Settings)"). Later mentions on the same card are
 * short; `describeIfItFails` does that.
 */
export function stuckOptionsFor(stage: Stage | undefined, actionId: string): StuckToldOptions {
  return !stage || isFirstStuckMention(stage, actionId) ? { settingsHint: true } : {};
}

/** Who is told when this action gets the request stuck, short ("Sam Carter is told"): for the "If it fails" choice, under the card's lines. */
export function useStuckWords(): Phrase {
  return describeStuckTold(useStuckPeople(), { short: true });
}

/**
 * Whether this action's card is the first in the stage that says who is told: no action before it,
 * in the order a request meets them, uses a connection (each such card says who is told when it is
 * slow, and when it fails).
 */
export function isFirstStuckMention(stage: Stage, actionId: string): boolean {
  if (stage.kind === 'ending') return true;
  const all: Action[] = [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])];
  for (const a of all) {
    if (a.id === actionId) return true;
    if (a.type === 'useConnection' && a.operation) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** The value's name, or the words for a value with no name. */
export function valueName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string | undefined): string {
  if (!valueId) return '';
  return doc.values.find((v) => v.id === valueId)?.name || t('describe.noName');
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/index.tsx\n===
/**
 * features/actions: the actions and saves in a stage section, done in order (editor-model.md
 * sections 3, 4 and 10). No route of its own: StageActions fills the model slot of the same name
 * (src/model/slots.ts), and the stage panel shows it under "When this stage starts", "After they
 * respond", or as "What it does" of an Automatic stage.
 */
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type DragEvent } from 'react';
import type { Action, ActionId, StageId } from '@/contract';
import {
  actionName,
  isRefusal,
  toText,
  useDescribeEnv,
  useDoc,
  useRevealRequest,
  useRun,
  useStage,
  type ActionsPlace,
  type Section,
  type StageActionsProps,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { ActionCard } from './ActionCard';
import { AddMenu } from './AddMenu';
import type { AddChoice } from './menu';
import s from './actions.module.css';

export { buildAddMenu, type AddMenuGroup, type AddMenuItem, type AddChoice } from './menu';

const EMPTY: Action[] = [];

/** Which section of the stage a place shows. An Automatic stage's actions are its "When this stage starts". */
export const sectionOf = (place: ActionsPlace): Section => (place === 'afterRespond' ? 'afterTheyRespond' : 'whenThisStageStarts');

/** The action being dragged, shared by the two lists of a stage (dataTransfer cannot be read while dragging over). */
type Dragged = { id: ActionId; section: Section; stageId: string };
let dragged: Dragged | null = null;
const dragging = (): Dragged | null => dragged;
const setDragging = (next: Dragged | null) => {
  dragged = next;
};
/** "Show me" requests already answered, so a list shown again later does not flash again. */
const handledReveals = new Set<number>();

/** The actions of one stage at one place, then "Add an action or save a value". */
export function StageActions({ stageId, place }: StageActionsProps) {
  const stage = useStage(stageId);
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const run = useRun();
  const reveal = useRevealRequest();
  const section = sectionOf(place);
  const actions = stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? (stage[section] ?? EMPTY) : EMPTY;
  const [openIds, setOpenIds] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [focusNew, setFocusNew] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropAt, setDropAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState('');
  const cards = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLLIElement>());
  const addRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const keepFocusOn = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const setOpen = (id: string, open: boolean) =>
    setOpenIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (open) next.add(id);
      else next.delete(id);
      return next;
    });

  // "Show me": open, scroll to and flash an action of this list (once per request).
  const nonce = reveal?.nonce;
  const revealedItem = reveal?.location.item;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!revealedItem || nonce === undefined || handledReveals.has(nonce) || !actions.some((a) => a.id === revealedItem)) return;
    handledReveals.add(nonce);
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setOpen(revealedItem, true);
      setFlash(revealedItem);
      const el = cards.current.get(revealedItem);
      el?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
      el?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      timer = setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 1600);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    };
    // only when a new reveal arrives
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [nonce]);

  // After a keyboard move, keep focus on the moved card's handle.
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = keepFocusOn.current;
    if (!id) return;
    keepFocusOn.current = null;
    cards.current.get(id)?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.${s.handle}`)?.focus();
  });

  if (!stageId) return <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('actions.noStage')}</p>;
  if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending' || !doc) return null;

  const nameOf = (a: Action) => toText(actionName(doc, a, env, true)) || t('describe.gap');

  const add = (choice: AddChoice) => {
    const result = run('action.add', {
      stage: stageId as StageId,
      section,
      ...(choice.type === 'useConnection' ? { type: 'useConnection', operation: choice.operation } : { type: choice.type }),
    });
    if (isRefusal(result)) return;
    setOpen(result.id, true);
    setFocusNew(result.id);
  };

  const remove = (a: Action, index: number) => {
    const name = nameOf(a);
    run('action.delete', { action: a.id });
    setSaid(t('actions.removed', { name }));
    const next = actions[index + 1] ?? actions[index - 1];
    const target = next
      ? cards.current.get(next.id)?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button')
      : addRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => target?.focus());
  };

  const moveBy = (a: Action, index: number, delta: -1 | 1) => {
    const to = index + delta;
    if (to < 0 || to >= actions.length) return;
    run('action.move', { action: a.id, toIndex: to });
    keepFocusOn.current = a.id;
    setSaid(t('actions.moved', { name: nameOf(a), n: to + 1, count: actions.length }));
  };

  /** The slot a drop over card `index` lands in: before it in its top half, after it in its bottom half. */
  const slotOver = (e: DragEvent, index: number) => {
    const box = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    return e.clientY < box.top + box.height / 2 ? index : index + 1;
  };
  const onDragOver = (e: DragEvent, slot: number) => {
    const d = dragging();
    if (!d || d.stageId !== stageId) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    setDropAt(slot);
  };
  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const d = dragging();
    const slot = dropAt;
    setDropAt(null);
    setDragging(null);
    if (!d || slot === null || d.stageId !== stageId) return;
    const from = d.section === section ? actions.findIndex((a) => a.id === d.id) : -1;
    const toIndex = from >= 0 && slot > from ? slot - 1 : slot;
    if (from === toIndex) return;
    run('action.move', { action: d.id, section, toIndex });
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.list} onDragLeave={(e) => !e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node) && setDropAt(null)}>
      {actions.length > 0 && (
        <ol className={s.cards} aria-label={t('actions.listLabel')} onDrop={onDrop}>
          {actions.map((a, i) => (
            <ActionCard
              key={a.id}
              dropMark={dropAt === i ? 'before' : dropAt === actions.length && i === actions.length - 1 ? 'after' : null}
              onDragOver={(e) => onDragOver(e, slotOver(e, i))}
              ref={(el) => {
                if (el) cards.current.set(a.id, el);
                else cards.current.delete(a.id);
              }}
              action={a}
              stage={stage}
              stageId={stageId}
              open={openIds.has(a.id)}
              onOpenChange={(open) => {
                setOpen(a.id, open);
                if (!open && focusNew === a.id) setFocusNew(null);
              }}
              focusFirst={focusNew === a.id}
              flash={flash === a.id}
              onRemove={() => remove(a, i)}
              onMoveBy={(delta) => moveBy(a, i, delta)}
              onDragStart={(e) => {
                setDragging({ id: a.id, section, stageId });
                e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', nameOf(a));
                const card = cards.current.get(a.id);
                if (card) e.dataTransfer.setDragImage(card, 24, 18);
              }}
              onDragEnd={() => {
                setDragging(null);
                setDropAt(null);
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
      <div
        ref={addRef}
        onDragOver={(e) => onDragOver(e, actions.length)}
        onDrop={onDrop}
        className={actions.length === 0 && dropAt !== null ? s.dropTarget : undefined}
      >
        <AddMenu
          onAdd={add}
          label={t(place === 'afterRespond' ? 'actions.addTo.afterRespond' : place === 'automatic' ? 'actions.addTo.automatic' : 'actions.addTo.stageStarts')}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">
        {said}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/kinds.ts\n===
/**
 * Kinds of value, as this feature needs them: the kind an expression gives where it can be told
 * without the core, the kind a value holds (from the facts), whether two kinds can share a value,
 * and the words and icon for a kind.
 */
import type { Expression, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import type { Facts } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import type { ValueKind as ChipKind } from '@/ui';

/** The kind an expression gives, when it can be told from the expression and the facts alone. */
export function kindOfExpression(expr: Expression | undefined, facts: Facts | null): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (!expr) return undefined;
  if ('value' in expr) return expr.steps?.length ? undefined : kindOfValue(expr.value, facts);
  if ('request' in expr) return expr.steps?.length ? undefined : expr.request === 'requester' ? 'person' : 'date';
  if ('formula' in expr) return undefined;
  if ('allOf' in expr || 'anyOf' in expr) return 'yesNo';
  if ('text' in expr) return 'text';
  if ('number' in expr) return 'number';
  if ('yesNo' in expr) return 'yesNo';
  if ('date' in expr) return 'date';
  if ('choice' in expr || 'button' in expr) return 'choice';
  if ('choices' in expr) return 'multipleChoice';
  if ('person' in expr) return 'person';
  if ('group' in expr) return 'group';
  if ('people' in expr) return 'people';
  if ('row' in expr) return 'choiceFromList';
  if ('connectionChoice' in expr) return 'choiceFromConnection';
  return undefined;
}

/** The kind a value holds, from what fills it; undefined while unknown or when it already has two. */
export function kindOfValue(valueId: string | undefined, facts: Facts | null): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (!valueId) return undefined;
  const kind = facts?.values[valueId as keyof Facts['values']]?.kind;
  return typeof kind === 'string' ? kind : undefined;
}

const FAMILY: Partial<Record<ValueKind, string>> = { text: 'text', longText: 'text' };

/** Whether a value that holds `has` may also be filled with `gives`. Unknown kinds always fit. */
export function kindsFit(has: ValueKind | undefined, gives: ValueKind | undefined): boolean {
  if (!has || !gives || has === gives) return true;
  return FAMILY[has] !== undefined && FAMILY[has] === FAMILY[gives];
}

const KIND_WORD: Record<ValueKind, WordKey> = {
  text: 'actions.kind.text',
  longText: 'actions.kind.longText',
  number: 'actions.kind.number',
  yesNo: 'actions.kind.yesNo',
  date: 'actions.kind.date',
  choice: 'actions.kind.choice',
  multipleChoice: 'actions.kind.multipleChoice',
  person: 'actions.kind.person',
  group: 'actions.kind.group',
  choiceFromList: 'actions.kind.choice',
  choiceFromConnection: 'actions.kind.choice',
  people: 'actions.kind.people',
  list: 'actions.kind.list',
  fieldGroup: 'actions.kind.fieldGroup',
};

/** "a person", "text", "Yes/No": the kind as a value holds it. */
export const kindWords = (kind: ValueKind | undefined): string => (kind ? t(KIND_WORD[kind]) : t('actions.pick.kindUnknown'));

const CHIP_KIND: Partial<Record<ValueKind, ChipKind>> = {
  text: 'text',
  longText: 'longtext',
  number: 'number',
  yesNo: 'yesno',
  date: 'date',
  choice: 'choice',
  choiceFromList: 'choice',
  choiceFromConnection: 'choice',
  multipleChoice: 'multichoice',
  person: 'person',
  group: 'group',
  people: 'group',
};

/** The kind icon a value chip shows. */
export const chipKind = (kind: ValueKind | undefined): ChipKind => (kind && CHIP_KIND[kind]) || 'text';

/**
 * The kinds a slot accepts for a catalogue field's kind. A person field also takes a group's or
 * several people only when the catalogue says so, so it is the field's kind alone.
 */
export function acceptsFor(kind: ValueKind): ValueKind[] {
  if (kind === 'text') return ['text', 'longText', 'choice', 'choiceFromList', 'choiceFromConnection'];
  if (kind === 'longText') return ['longText', 'text'];
  if (kind === 'choice' || kind === 'choiceFromConnection') return ['choice', 'choiceFromConnection', 'choiceFromList', 'text'];
  return [kind];
}

/** Test data: a catalogue no part of the app has heard of, to prove nothing about a connection is hard-coded. */
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Field } from '@/contract';

const field = (id: string, label: string, kind: Field['kind'], required = false): Field => ({ id, label, kind, required });

const op = (id: string, label: string, sort: 'read' | 'write' | 'await', more: Partial<CatalogueEntry> = {}): CatalogueEntry => {
  const [connection = '', rest = ''] = id.split('.');
  return {
    id,
    connection,
    name: rest.split('@')[0] ?? '',
    version: 1,
    kind: 'operation',
    label,
    description: `${label}, said by the catalogue.`,
    supersededBy: null,
    status: 'ready',
    sort,
    input: [field('where', 'Where', 'text', true)],
    result: [field('answer', 'Answer', 'text')],
    failureCodes: [{ code: 'cloudy', label: 'Too cloudy' }],
    onRepeat: sort === 'read' ? null : 'once',
    timeoutSeconds: 30,
    expectedWithinSeconds: 900,
    await: sort === 'await' ? { callback: false, pollSeconds: 60 } : null,
    sample: { input: {}, result: {}, failure: null },
    ...more,
  } as CatalogueEntry;
};

/** A catalogue no part of the app has heard of: made-up connections and entries. */
export const madeUpCatalogue: Catalogue = {

  directoryConnection: 'phonebook',
  notifyConnection: 'phonebook',

    { id: 'gone', label: 'Old printer', description: null, status: 'disabled' },
  ],

    op('weather.launchBalloon@1', 'Launch the balloon and wait', 'await'),
    op('weather.forecast@1', 'Look up the forecast', 'read'),

===\nfrontend/src/features/actions/menu.ts\n===
/**
 * The "+ Add" menu inside a stage section, built from data (editor-model.md section 10): "Built in"
 * (Save a value, Notify, Tell other systems), then one group per connection in the catalogue with
 * what it offers as an action. Nothing about one system is known here: every label, line and
 * whether it can be used comes from the catalogue.
 */
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueRef, Operation } from '@/contract';
import { t } from '@/words';
import type { IconName } from '@/ui';

export type AddChoice = { type: 'saveValue' | 'notify' | 'tellOtherSystems' } | { type: 'useConnection'; operation: CatalogueRef };

export interface AddMenuItem {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** One quiet line under the label. */
  line: string;
  icon: IconName;
  /** The author's words for the sort of thing ("Gives data"); built-in items have none. */
  sort?: string;
  choice: AddChoice;
  /** Why it cannot be added now; absent when it can. */
  unavailable?: string;
}

export interface AddMenuGroup {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Said once under the group's label (a connection not set up). */
  note?: string;
  items: AddMenuItem[];
}

const SORT_ICON: Record<Operation['sort'], IconName> = { read: 'lookup', write: 'bolt', await: 'clock' };
const SORT_ORDER: Record<Operation['sort'], number> = { read: 0, write: 1, await: 2 };

export const sortWords = (sort: Operation['sort']): string => t(`actions.sort.${sort}`);

/** The menu groups for this catalogue (null while it is loading: built-in only). */
export function buildAddMenu(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined): AddMenuGroup[] {
  const groups: AddMenuGroup[] = [
    {
      key: 'builtIn',
      label: t('actions.menu.builtIn'),
      items: [
        { key: 'saveValue', label: t('actions.menu.save'), line: t('actions.menu.save.line'), icon: 'save', choice: { type: 'saveValue' } },
        { key: 'notify', label: t('actions.menu.notify'), line: t('actions.menu.notify.line'), icon: 'notify', choice: { type: 'notify' } },
        {
          key: 'tellOtherSystems',
          label: t('actions.menu.tell'),
          line: t('actions.menu.tell.line'),
          icon: 'outbox',
          choice: { type: 'tellOtherSystems' },
        },
      ],
    },
  ];
  if (!catalogue) return groups;
  const entries = catalogue.entries ?? [];
  for (const connection of catalogue.connections ?? []) {
    const offered = entries
      .filter((e): e is Operation => e.kind === 'operation' && e.connection === connection.id && !e.supersededBy)
      .sort((a, b) => SORT_ORDER[a.sort] - SORT_ORDER[b.sort]);
    if (offered.length === 0) continue;
    const connectionWhy =
      connection.status === 'notSetUp'
        ? t('actions.menu.notSetUp')
        : connection.status === 'disabled'
          ? t('actions.menu.turnedOff')
          : undefined;
    groups.push({
      key: `connection:${connection.id}`,
      label: connection.label || connection.id,
      ...(connectionWhy ? { note: connectionWhy } : {}),
      items: offered.map((entry) => {
        const why = connectionWhy ?? (entry.status === 'disabled' ? t('actions.menu.entryOff') : undefined);
        return {
          key: entry.id,
          label: entry.label || entry.id,
          // The catalogue's description is written for engineers (the Connections page leaves it out too): the label and the sort say enough.
          line: '',
          icon: SORT_ICON[entry.sort],
          sort: sortWords(entry.sort),
          choice: { type: 'useConnection', operation: entry.id as CatalogueRef },
          ...(why ? { unavailable: why } : {}),
        };
      }),
    });
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * "Write a formula" from a "when ...": the formula editor in a dialog over the editor (mockup
 * 05-formula), working on a copy until "Use formula". "Back to word chips" turns a formula that
 * is one plain comparison back into a sentence; otherwise it stays greyed with the reason.
 */
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { Formula, Location } from '@/contract';
import { locationCrumbs, useDescribeEnv, useDoc } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Dialog, DialogClose } from '@/ui';
import { FormulaPanel } from './FormulaEditor';
import type { KindEnv } from './kinds';
import { formulaToSentence, type AnySentence } from './sentence';
import s from './conditions.module.css';

export function FormulaDialog({
  at, sent, initial, kindEnv, onUse, onBack, onClose,
}: {
  at: Location;
  sent?: string;
  initial: Formula;
  kindEnv: KindEnv;
  onUse(next: Formula): void;
  onBack(sentence: AnySentence): void;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Formula | undefined>(initial);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const text = draft?.formula.trim() ?? '';
  const words = draft?.readsAs.trim() ?? '';
  const back = text ? formulaToSentence(doc, text, kindEnv) : undefined;
  const blocked = !text ? t('conditions.formula.needsText') : !words ? t('conditions.formula.needsWords') : undefined;
  const crumbs = at.item ? locationCrumbs(doc, at, env).filter(Boolean) : [];
  return (
    <Dialog
      title={t('conditions.writeFormula')}
      description={crumbs.length ? crumbs.join(t('conditions.crumbJoin')) : undefined}
      open
      onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}
      width={1180}
      footer={
        <div className={s.dialogFoot}>
          {blocked && <span className={s.footNote}>{blocked}</span>}
          <span className={s.grow} />
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabledReason={back ? undefined : t('conditions.formula.backNo')}
            onClick={() => back && onBack(back)}
          >
            {t('conditions.formula.back')}
          </Button>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="secondary">{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button variant="primary" icon="check" disabledReason={blocked} onClick={() => draft && onUse({ formula: text, readsAs: words })}>
            {t('conditions.formula.use')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <FormulaPanel at={at} sent={sent} value={draft} onChange={setDraft} gives="yesNo" />
    </Dialog>
  );
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/conditions/FormulaEditor.tsx\n===
/**
 * The formula editor (editor-model.md section 5; mockup 05-formula), in three parts: the values in
 * scope on the left (click one to put it in as a chip), the formula in the middle (values shown as
 * chips and joining words as words, never typed names or signs; stored as text with `{{v_...}}`
 * chips), and on the right what it gives for the sample request. The plain-language "Reads as"
 * sentence is required: it is shown everywhere instead of the formula.
 * Checking uses core.checkFormula; when the core cannot check formulas yet, it says so in plain
 * words and lets the author go on.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Finding, FormulaResult, SampleResult } from '@/services';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeConstant, describeExpression, describeFinding, find, formatDate, getStage, sessionServices, toText, useCatalogue,
  useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useValuesInScope, type DescribeEnv, type FormulaEditorProps,
} from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Chip, Field, Icon, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { chipRefs, layout, overlaps, parse, PUT_IN, serialize, type Op, type Token } from './formulaTokens';
import { entryOf, kindOfExpression, kindWordKey, sentFields } from './kinds';
import s from './conditions.module.css';

const OP_WORDS: Record<Op, WordKey> = {
  '&&': 'conditions.op.and',
  '||': 'conditions.op.or',
  '!': 'conditions.op.not',
  '==': 'conditions.op.is',
  '!=': 'conditions.op.isNot',
  '<': 'conditions.op.lessThan',
  '>': 'conditions.op.moreThan',
  '<=': 'conditions.op.atMost',
  '>=': 'conditions.op.atLeast',
  '+': 'conditions.op.plus',
  '-': 'conditions.op.minus',
};

const CHECK_QUIET_MS = 250;

/** Slot FormulaEditor. */
export function FormulaEditor(props: FormulaEditorProps) {
  return <FormulaPanel {...props} />;
}

/** A chip's reference as a node to describe: `v_risk`, `request.startedOn`, `sent.category`. */
function nodeOf(ref: string) {
  if (ref.startsWith('request.')) return { request: ref.slice('request.'.length) as 'requester' | 'startedOn' };
  if (ref.startsWith('sent.')) return { sentField: ref.slice('sent.'.length) };
  return { value: ref } as { value: never };
}

const kindName = (kind: ValueKind) => t(`valueKind.${kindWordKey(kind)}`);

/** What a formula must give, in words: "Yes/No", "Text or Number". */
function needsWords(gives: 'yesNo' | ValueKind[]): string {
  const kinds = gives === 'yesNo' ? ['yesNo' as ValueKind] : gives;
  const names = [...new Set(kinds.map(kindName))];
  return names.reduce((a, b) => (a ? t('conditions.fx.or', { a, b }) : b), '');
}

type Check =
  | { status: 'empty' }
  | { status: 'checking' }
  | { status: 'notChecked' }
  | { status: 'ok'; kind: ValueKind; sample?: SampleResult }
  | { status: 'problem'; short: string; cause?: string; start?: number; end?: number };

function useFormulaCheck(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null, at: Location, formula: string, env: DescribeEnv): Check {
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  // The answer for one formula text; a different text is "checking" until its own answer comes.
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState<{ formula: string; check: Check } | null>(null);
  const item = at.item;
  const part = at.part;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!formula.trim()) return;
    let live = true;
    const setCheck = (check: Check) => live && setAnswer({ formula, check });
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const services = sessionServices();
      if (!doc || !catalogue || !services) {
        setCheck({ status: 'notChecked' });
        return;
      }
      const place: Location = part ? { item, part } : { item };
      void services.core
        .checkFormula(doc, catalogue, place, formula, doc.sampleRequest)
        .then(async (result: FormulaResult) => {
          if (!live) return;
          if (result.ok) {
            let sample = result.sample;
            if (!sample && doc.sampleRequest) {
              const evaluated = await services.core.evaluate(doc, catalogue, place, { formula, readsAs: '' }, doc.sampleRequest);
              if (evaluated.result !== 'needsLookups') sample = evaluated;
            }
            if (live) setCheck({ status: 'ok', kind: result.kind, ...(sample ? { sample } : {}) });
            return;
          }
          const error = result.error;
          const said = describeFinding(doc, { ...error, severity: 'todo', location: place } as unknown as Finding, env);
          setCheck({ status: 'problem', short: said.short, ...(said.cause ? { cause: said.cause } : {}), start: error.start, end: error.end });
        })
        .catch(() => setCheck({ status: 'notChecked' }));
    }, CHECK_QUIET_MS);
    return () => {
      live = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [doc, catalogue, item, part, formula, env]);
  if (!formula.trim()) return { status: 'empty' };
  return answer?.formula === formula ? answer.check : { status: 'checking' };
}

/** The formula editor with an optional "Starts when" trigger, whose sent fields are offered instead of values. */
export function FormulaPanel({
  at, sent, value, onChange, gives,
}: FormulaEditorProps & { sent?: string }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const baseEnv = useDescribeEnv();
  const env: DescribeEnv = useMemo(() => (sent ? { ...baseEnv, trigger: sent } : baseEnv), [baseEnv, sent]);
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const hintId = useId();
  const wordsId = useId();

  const [tokens, setTokens] = useState<Token[]>(() => parse(value?.formula ?? ''));
  const [caret, setCaret] = useState(() => tokens.length);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState('');
  // The formula text the pieces stand for; a different text from outside replaces the pieces.
  const incoming = value?.formula ?? '';
  const [known, setKnown] = useState(incoming);
  if (incoming !== known) {
    const next = parse(incoming);
    setKnown(incoming);
    setTokens(next);
    setCaret(next.length);
    setPending('');
  }
  const readsAs = value?.readsAs ?? '';

  const emit = (tk: Token[], c: number, p: string, words = readsAs) => {
    const formula = serialize([...tk.slice(0, c), ...parse(p), ...tk.slice(c)]);
    setKnown(formula);
    onChange(formula || words ? { formula, readsAs: words } : undefined);
  };

  /** The pieces with what is being typed taken in; where the cursor then is. */
  const committed = (): { tk: Token[]; c: number } => {
    if (!pending) return { tk: tokens, c: caret };
    const typed = parse(pending);
    return { tk: [...tokens.slice(0, caret), ...typed, ...tokens.slice(caret)], c: caret + typed.length };
  };
  const commit = () => {
    if (!pending) return;
    const { tk, c } = committed();
    setTokens(tk);
    setCaret(c);
    setPending('');
  };
  const insert = (token: Token) => {
    const { tk, c } = committed();
    const next = [...tk.slice(0, c), token, ...tk.slice(c)];
    setTokens(next);
    setCaret(c + 1);
    setPending('');
    emit(next, c + 1, '');
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };
  const startDays = () => {
    commit();
    setPending('1 days');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      inputRef.current?.focus();
      inputRef.current?.setSelectionRange(0, 1);
    });
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const el = e.currentTarget;
    const atStart = el.selectionStart === 0 && el.selectionEnd === 0;
    const atEnd = el.selectionStart === pending.length && el.selectionEnd === pending.length;
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      commit();
    } else if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !pending && caret > 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const next = tokens.filter((_, i) => i !== caret - 1);
      setTokens(next);
      setCaret(caret - 1);
      emit(next, caret - 1, '');
    } else if (e.key === 'Delete' && !pending && caret < tokens.length) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const next = tokens.filter((_, i) => i !== caret);
      setTokens(next);
      emit(next, caret, '');
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && atStart && caret > 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const { tk, c } = committed();
      setTokens(tk);
      setPending('');
      setCaret(c - 1 - (pending ? parse(pending).length - 1 : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && atEnd && (pending || caret < tokens.length)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const { tk, c } = committed();
      setTokens(tk);
      setPending('');
      setCaret(Math.min(tk.length, pending ? c : c + 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'Home' && !pending) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setCaret(0);
    } else if (e.key === 'End' && !pending) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setCaret(tokens.length);
    }
  };

  const typed = parse(pending);
  const all = [...tokens.slice(0, caret), ...typed, ...tokens.slice(caret)];
  const formula = value?.formula ?? '';
  const check = useFormulaCheck(doc, at, formula, env);
  const { spans } = layout(all);
  const wrong = new Set<number>();
  // The text still being typed is underlined too when the range the engine names falls in it.
  let typingWrong = false;
  if (check.status === 'problem' && check.start !== undefined) {
    const range = { start: check.start, end: check.end ?? check.start };
    spans.forEach((span, i) => {
      if (!overlaps(span, range)) return;
      if (i < caret) wrong.add(i);
      else if (i >= caret + typed.length) wrong.add(i - typed.length);
      else typingWrong = true;
    });
  }

  // The formula box takes the keyboard when the editor opens, so nothing typed at once is lost.
  useEffect(() => {
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  if (!doc) return null;

  const labelOf = (ref: string) => toText(describeExpression(doc, nodeOf(ref), env));
  /** A quoted choice, list row or button ID as its name ("High"), never the ID; other text as typed. */
  const textLabel = (text: string): { label: string; named: boolean } => {
    const inner = /^"(.*)"$/.exec(text)?.[1];
    const entry = inner ? find(doc, inner) : undefined;
    if (entry && (entry.kind === 'choice' || entry.kind === 'row' || entry.kind === 'button')) {
      return { label: toText(describeConstant(doc, { [entry.kind]: inner } as never)), named: true };
    }
    return { label: text, named: false };
  };
  const kindOf = (ref: string) => kindOfExpression(doc, nodeOf(ref), { catalogue, trigger: sent });
  const inWords = (tk: readonly Token[]) =>
    tk
      .map((x) =>
        x.t === 'chip' ? labelOf(x.ref) : x.t === 'op' ? t(OP_WORDS[x.op]) : x.t === 'days' ? t('conditions.fx.daysToken', { n: x.n }) : textLabel(x.text).label.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, ''),
      )
      .join(' ');

  const piece = (token: Token, index: number) => {
    const bad = wrong.has(index);
    const cls = [s.tok, bad ? s.tokBad : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    let inner: ReactNode;
    if (token.t === 'chip') {
      const kind = kindOf(token.ref);
      inner = (
        <Chip size="sm" kind={kind ? kindWordKey(kind) : 'text'}>
          {labelOf(token.ref)}
        </Chip>
      );
    } else if (token.t === 'op') inner = <span className={s.tokOp}>{t(OP_WORDS[token.op])}</span>;
    else if (token.t === 'days') inner = <span className={s.tokConst}>{t('conditions.fx.daysToken', { n: token.n })}</span>;
    else {
      const { label, named } = textLabel(token.text);
      inner = <span className={named ? s.tokConst : s.tokText}>{label}</span>;
    }
    return (
      <span
        key={index}
        className={cls}
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const { tk } = committed();
          setTokens(tk);
          setPending('');
          setCaret(index < caret ? index + 1 : index + 1 + (pending ? typed.length : 0));
          inputRef.current?.focus();
        }}
      >
        {inner}
      </span>
    );
  };

  const used = new Set(chipRefs(all));

  return (
    <div className={s.fxWrap}>
      <div className={s.fx}>
        <ValueTree doc={doc} at={at} sent={sent} env={env} used={used} onInsert={(ref, kind) => insert({ t: 'chip', ref, ...(kind === 'date' ? { date: true } : {}) })} />

        <div className={s.fxMiddle}>
          <section className={`${s.readsAsBox} ${check.status === 'problem' ? s.readsAsBad : ''}`} aria-labelledby={`${wordsId}-head`}>
            <h3 id={`${wordsId}-head`} className={s.kicker}>
              {t('conditions.fx.readsAsHead')}
            </h3>
            <p className={s.readsAsBig}>{readsAs.trim() ? readsAs : <span className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.readsAsEmpty')}</span>}</p>
            <p className={s.statusLine} aria-live="polite">
              <StatusLine check={check} gives={gives} />
            </p>
          </section>

          <section className={s.fxSection}>
            <div className={s.fxHeadRow}>
              <h3 className={s.kicker}>{t('conditions.fx.formulaHead')}</h3>
              <span className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.checkedAsYouType')}</span>
            </div>
            <div className={s.putIn} role="group" aria-label={t('conditions.fx.putInGroup')}>
              <span className={s.quiet} aria-hidden>
                {t('conditions.fx.putIn')}
              </span>
              {PUT_IN.map((op) => (
                <button key={op} type="button" className={s.putChip} onClick={() => insert({ t: 'op', op })}>
                  {t(OP_WORDS[op])}
                </button>
              ))}
              <button type="button" className={s.putChip} onClick={startDays}>
                {t('conditions.fx.days')}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div
              className={`${s.fxBox} ${check.status === 'problem' ? s.fxBoxBad : ''}`}
              role="group"
              aria-label={t('conditions.fx.box')}
              aria-describedby={hintId}
              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  commit();
                  setCaret(tokens.length + (pending ? typed.length : 0));
                  inputRef.current?.focus();
                }
              }}
            >
              {tokens.slice(0, caret).map((tk, i) => piece(tk, i))}
              <input
                ref={inputRef}
                className={[s.fxInput, typingWrong ? s.tokBad : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
                aria-label={t('conditions.writeFormula')}
                aria-invalid={check.status === 'problem' || undefined}
                aria-describedby={hintId}
                value={pending}
                spellCheck={false}
                autoComplete="off"
                style={tokens.length === 0 ? { flex: 1 } : { width: `${Math.max(2, pending.length + 1)}ch` }}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPending(e.target.value);
                  emit(tokens, caret, e.target.value);
                }}
                onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
                onBlur={commit}
              />
              {tokens.slice(caret).map((tk, i) => piece(tk, caret + i))}
            </div>
            <p id={hintId} className={s.hint}>
              {t('conditions.fx.boxHint')}
            </p>
          </section>

          <section className={s.fxSection}>
            <Field
              label={t('conditions.fx.wordsLabel')}
              hint={t('conditions.fx.wordsHint')}
              error={formula.trim() && !readsAs.trim() ? t('conditions.fx.wordsRequired') : undefined}
            >
              <TextInput
                value={readsAs}
                required
                aria-required
                onChange={(e) => onChange(formula || e.target.value ? { formula, readsAs: e.target.value } : undefined)}
              />
            </Field>
            {all.length > 0 && !readsAs.trim() && (
              <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => onChange({ formula, readsAs: inWords(all) })}>
                <Icon name="edit" size={14} />
                {t('conditions.fx.useFormulaWords')}
              </button>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

        <ResultPanel doc={doc} gives={gives} check={check} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatusLine({ check, gives }: { check: Check; gives: 'yesNo' | ValueKind[] }) {
  const needs = needsWords(gives);
  switch (check.status) {
    case 'empty':
      return <span className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.empty')}</span>;
    case 'checking':
      return <span className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.checking')}</span>;
    case 'notChecked':
      return (
        <>
          <Icon name="info" size={14} />
          <span>{t('conditions.fx.notChecked')}</span>
        </>
      );
    case 'problem':
      return (
        <>
          <Icon name="error" size={14} />
          {/* The cause the engine gives, in words (describeFinding), never only "fix the formula". */}
          <span>{check.cause ? t('conditions.fx.problemCause', { cause: check.cause }) : t('conditions.fx.problem', { short: check.short })}</span>
        </>
      );
    default: {
      const fits = gives === 'yesNo' ? check.kind === 'yesNo' : gives.includes(check.kind);
      return (
        <>
          <Icon name={fits ? 'check' : 'error'} size={14} />
          <span>{fits ? t('conditions.fx.fits', { kind: kindName(check.kind) }) : t('conditions.fx.wrongKind', { kind: kindName(check.kind), needs })}</span>
        </>
      );
    }
  }
}

function sampleWords(result: SampleResult | undefined): string {
  if (!result) return t('conditions.fx.sampleUnknown');
  if (result.result === 'absent') return t('conditions.fx.sampleEmpty');
  if (result.result === 'error') return t('conditions.fx.cantRead');
  const v = result.value as unknown;
  if (typeof v === 'boolean') return t(v ? 'conditions.fx.yes' : 'conditions.fx.no');
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v.toLocaleString('en-GB');
  if (typeof v === 'string') return result.kind === 'date' ? formatDate(v) : v;
  if (v && typeof v === 'object' && 'label' in v) return String((v as { label: unknown }).label);
  return result.kind ? kindName(result.kind) : t('describe.gap');
}

function ResultPanel({ doc, gives, check }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; gives: 'yesNo' | ValueKind[]; check: Check }) {
  const needs = needsWords(gives);
  const givesWords =
    check.status === 'ok'
      ? kindName(check.kind)
      : check.status === 'notChecked'
        ? t('conditions.fx.notCheckedShort')
        : check.status === 'problem'
          ? t('conditions.fx.cantRead')
          : t('describe.gap');
  const sample = doc.sampleRequest;
  return (
    <aside className={s.fxRight} aria-label={t('conditions.fx.gives')}>
      <h3 className={s.paneHead}>{t('conditions.fx.gives')}</h3>
      <dl className={s.gives}>
        <dt>{t('conditions.fx.needs')}</dt>
        <dd>
          <span className={s.kindPill}>{needs}</span>
        </dd>
        <dt>{t('conditions.fx.givesRow')}</dt>
        <dd>
          <span className={`${s.kindPill} ${check.status === 'problem' ? s.kindBad : ''}`}>{givesWords}</span>
        </dd>
      </dl>
      {gives === 'yesNo' && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.yesNoLine')}</p>}
      <div className={s.sampleCard}>
        <p className={s.sampleHead}>
          <Icon name="sample" size={14} />
          {t('conditions.fx.sampleHead')}
        </p>
        {sample ? (
          <>
            <p className={s.sampleName}>{sample.name}</p>
            <p className={s.sampleRow}>
              <span>{t('conditions.fx.sampleGives')}</span>
              <b>{check.status === 'ok' ? sampleWords(check.sample) : check.status === 'problem' ? t('conditions.fx.cantRead') : t('conditions.fx.sampleUnknown')}</b>
            </p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.sampleNone')}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

/** The values in scope, by group, each with where it is filled and its sample; click to put it in. */
function ValueTree({
  doc, at, sent, env, used, onInsert,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  at: Location;
  sent?: string;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  used: ReadonlySet<string>;
  onInsert(ref: string, kind: ValueKind | undefined): void;
}) {
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const { values } = useValuesInScope(sent ? null : at);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const sample = doc.sampleRequest;
  const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const fits = (name: string) => !q || name.toLowerCase().includes(q);

  const placeOf = (loc: Location | undefined): string => {
    if (!loc) return '';
    const entry = find(doc, loc.item);
    const stageId = entry?.kind === 'stage' ? entry.id : entry?.parents.stage;
    return getStage(doc, stageId)?.name ?? '';
  };

  type Item = { ref: string; name: string; kind?: ValueKind; lines: string[]; disabled?: boolean };
  const groups: { title: string; items: Item[] }[] = [];

  if (sent) {
    const entry = entryOf(catalogue, sent);
    const thing = toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: '' }, env)).replace(/:\s*$/, '') || entry?.label || '';
    groups.push({
      title: t('conditions.fx.group.sent', { thing }),
      items: sentFields(catalogue, sent).map((f) => ({ ref: `sent.${f.id}`, name: toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: f.id }, env)), kind: f.kind, lines: [] })),
    });
  } else {
    groups.push({
      title: t('conditions.fx.group.values'),
      items: values.map((v) => {
        const state = v.state === 'always' ? 'conditions.fx.filledAlways' : v.state === 'mayBeEmpty' ? 'conditions.fx.filledMaybe' : 'conditions.fx.filledNever';
        const place = placeOf(v.filledAt[0]);
        const answer = sample?.answers[v.id as keyof typeof sample.answers];
        const lines = [place ? t('conditions.fx.from', { place, state: t(state) }) : t(state)];
        if (answer && v.state !== 'never') lines.push(t('conditions.fx.sample', { sample: toText(describeConstant(doc, answer)) }));
        return { ref: v.id, name: v.name || t('describe.noName'), ...(typeof v.kind === 'string' ? { kind: v.kind } : {}), lines, disabled: v.state === 'never' };
      }),
    });
    groups.push({
      title: t('conditions.fx.group.request'),
      items: [
        {
          ref: 'request.requester', name: t('describe.request.requester'), kind: 'person',
          lines: [t('conditions.fx.requesterLine'), ...(sample?.requester ? [t('conditions.fx.sample', { sample: sample.requester.name })] : [])],
        },
        {
          ref: 'request.startedOn', name: t('describe.request.startedOn'), kind: 'date',
          lines: [t('conditions.fx.startedOnLine'), ...(sample?.startedOn ? [t('conditions.fx.sample', { sample: formatDate(sample.startedOn) })] : [])],
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  const shown = groups.map((g) => ({ ...g, items: g.items.filter((i) => fits(i.name)) }));
  const nothing = shown.every((g) => g.items.length === 0);

  return (
    <nav className={s.fxLeft} aria-label={t('conditions.fx.values')}>
      <h3 className={s.paneHead}>{t('conditions.fx.values')}</h3>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.valuesLine')}</p>
      <div className={s.search}>
        <Icon name="search" size={14} />
        <input type="search" aria-label={t('conditions.fx.search')} placeholder={t('conditions.fx.search')} value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
      </div>
      {nothing && q && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('conditions.fx.noMatch', { text: search.trim() })}</p>}
      {shown.map((g) =>
        g.items.length ? (
          <div key={g.title} className={s.treeGroup}>
            <h4 className={g.title === t('conditions.fx.values') ? 'visually-hidden' : s.treeHead}>{g.title}</h4>
            <ul className={s.treeList}>
              {g.items.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.ref}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={[s.treeItem, used.has(item.ref) ? s.treeUsed : '', item.disabled ? s.treeNever : ''].join(' ')}
                    aria-label={
                      item.lines.length
                        ? t('conditions.fx.insertWithLines', { insert: t('conditions.fx.insert', { name: item.name }), lines: item.lines.join(t('conditions.fx.linesJoin')) })
                        : t('conditions.fx.insert', { name: item.name })
                    }
                    onClick={() => onInsert(item.ref, item.kind)}
                  >
                    <span className={s.treeIcon}>
                      <Icon name={item.kind ? kindWordKey(item.kind) : 'text'} size={14} />
                    </span>
                    <span className={s.treeText}>
                      <span className={s.treeName}>
                        {item.name}
                        {used.has(item.ref) && <span className={s.inFormula}> {t('conditions.fx.inFormula')}</span>}
                      </span>
                      {item.lines.map((line, i) => (
                        <span key={i} className={s.treeLine}>
                          {line}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ) : null,
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/conditions/Pickers.tsx\n===
/**
 * The small pickers inside a "when ..." sentence: a chip that opens a short list (the words, one
 * choice, a weekday, a button) and a chip that opens a list of ticks (several choices, for "is one
 * of"). Both are keyboard first: the chip is a button, the list opens with Enter or Space, arrow
 * keys move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and focus goes back to the chip (Radix).
 * Candidates for src/ui: PickChip (a Menu whose trigger is a chip showing the current choice).
 */
import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Checkbox, Icon, Menu, Popover, type MenuItem } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import s from './conditions.module.css';

/** Names as a list in the shared list words: "A", "A or B", "A, B or C" (as describe says lists). */
export function sayList(names: readonly string[], word: 'and' | 'or'): string {
  if (names.length < 2) return names.join('');
  return `${names.slice(0, -1).join(t('describe.comma'))} ${t(word === 'and' ? 'describe.and' : 'describe.or')} ${names[names.length - 1]}`;
}

type ChipButtonProps = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  /** words: joining words of the sentence; constant: a typed choice; button: a task's button. */
  look: 'words' | 'constant' | 'button' | 'empty';
  children: ReactNode;
};

/**
 * A chip that is a button: it opens something to choose from. A small chevron says so, except on
 * the words of the sentence, which read as part of it (mockup 03: [needs no approval]).
 */
export const ChipButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ChipButtonProps>(function ChipButton({ look, children, className, ...rest }, ref) {
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type="button" className={[s.pick, s[`pick_${look}`], className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} {...rest}>
      <span>{children}</span>
      {look !== 'words' && <Icon name="chevron-down" size={12} />}
    </button>
  );
});

export interface PickOption<T> {
  value: T;
  label: string;
}

/** One choice from a short list, shown as a chip with the current choice (or quiet "choose" words). */
export function PickChip<T>({
  label, current, empty, options, heading, onPick, look = 'constant',
}: {
  /** The accessible name of the chip, e.g. "Part 2: words". */
  label: string;
  /** The words of the current choice; absent while nothing is chosen. */
  current?: string;
  empty: string;
  options: readonly PickOption<T>[];
  heading?: string;
  onPick(value: T): void;
  look?: 'words' | 'constant' | 'button';
}) {
  const items: MenuItem[] = [
    ...(heading ? [{ group: heading } as MenuItem] : []),
    ...options.map((o) => ({ label: o.label, onSelect: () => onPick(o.value) })),
  ];
  return (
    <Menu
      items={items}
      trigger={
        <ChipButton look={current ? look : 'empty'} aria-label={t('conditions.chipName', { label, value: current ?? empty })}>
          {current ?? empty}
        </ChipButton>
      }
    />
  );
}

/** Several choices, ticked in a small popover ("is one of"). */
export function MultiPickChip<T>({
  label, title, empty, options, chosen, onChange, joiner,
}: {
  label: string;
  title: string;
  empty: string;
  options: readonly PickOption<T>[];
  /** Which options are ticked, by index. */
  chosen: readonly number[];
  onChange(indexes: number[]): void;
  /** "or" / "and" before the last chosen label. */
  joiner: 'and' | 'or';
}) {
  const names = chosen.map((i) => options[i]?.label).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const shown = names.length ? sayList(names, joiner) : empty;
  return (
    <Popover
      title={title}
      width={280}
      trigger={
        <ChipButton look={names.length ? 'constant' : 'empty'} aria-label={t('conditions.chipName', { label, value: shown })}>
          {shown}
        </ChipButton>
      }
    >
      <div className={s.ticks}>
        {options.map((o, i) => (
          <Checkbox
            key={i}
            label={o.label}
            checked={chosen.includes(i)}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.checked ? [...chosen, i] : chosen.filter((x) => x !== i))}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </Popover>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/conditions/README.md\n===
# features/conditions

The "when ..." sentence builder and the formula editor (editor-model.md section 5; mockups 03-routing and 05-formula).

- No route. Exports `WhenBuilder` and `FormulaEditor`, which fill the model slots of the same names (`src/model/slots.ts`); `src/app/slots.ts` puts them in the slots. Other features show them with `<Slot name="WhenBuilder" ... />` from `@/model`.
- Both are **controlled**: the caller passes the part of the document and stores what `onChange` gives with its own named command. Nothing here writes the document.
  - `WhenBuilderProps`: `at`, `value: Condition | undefined`, `onChange`, `stageId?` (offer "[button] is pressed" for that stage's buttons, named by task when it has several; never in a `showWhen` or `enabledWhen`, which are read before any button of the form is pressed: `pressCanDecide(at)`), `addLabel?`, `autoFocus?`, `sent?` (inside a Starts when: `value`/`onChange` use `SentCondition`).
  - `FormulaEditorProps`: `at`, `value: Formula | undefined`, `onChange`, `gives: 'yesNo' | ValueKind[]`.
- Example: `<Slot name="WhenBuilder" at={{ item: arrow.id, part: 'onlyWhen' }} stageId={stage.id} value={arrow.onlyWhen} onChange={(next) => run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', next ? { arrow: arrow.id, onlyWhen: next } : { arrow: arrow.id })} />`.

## Files

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `WhenBuilder.tsx` | The builder. Empty: the quiet add text, which opens an empty sentence **here only**: `onChange` is first called when the sentence has a part, so a "when ..." opened and left (focus moves on outside it and its pickers, or its own "Remove this "when ..."") is never stored as an empty sentence; removing the last part removes the whole "when ...". A sentence: one row per part, `[ValueField] [words] [right side]`; "and"/"or" between parts is one button that switches the whole sentence; "Add another part" (a menu with the stage's buttons when `stageId` is given); "Write a formula"; the read-back from describe when it says more than the chips (a Yes/No read naturally, a list's choices in brackets); "Kept in the Domains list" with the `ListDialog` slot; the part's To do and Worth knowing. A formula: its "Reads as" sentence with "Edit formula". `wordLabel()` gives the words of a clause as the builder shows them. |
| `preview.ts` | Pure: `choicePreview()`, "What this arrow does for each domain" (each row of the list the arrow's "when ..." reads, and where the stage's arrows, tried from the top, send it); undefined when the editor cannot work it out. `oneRowOf()`: "Domains list" -> "domain". Shown by the WhenBuilder under an arrow's `when.condition`; then the "Reads as" line leaves out the brackets the table already shows. |
| (in `WhenBuilder.tsx`) `ValueSlot` | Each value in the sentence is one chip ([Primary domain]; a Yes/No column read naturally is said by the words, see `chipExpression()`). The ValueField slot lies over the chip unseen, so the chip opens its picker and reads out its name; its "from ..." line, chevron and clear button are not shown. In a narrow panel a long name wraps inside its chip instead of ending in "..." (the ui Chip keeps one line). To be replaced by a chip look of the ValueField slot itself when features/values offers one. |
| `FormulaDialog.tsx` | "Write a formula" from a "when ...": the editor in a dialog on a copy; "Use formula" (refused while the formula or its words are empty), "Back to word chips" (only for one plain comparison; otherwise greyed with the reason), Cancel. |
| `FormulaEditor.tsx` | The slot `FormulaEditor` and `FormulaPanel` (the same, with an optional `sent` trigger). Left: values in scope (and Requester, Started on; or what a trigger sends), click to insert. Middle: "Reads as" box, "Put in" joining words, the formula box (chips and words; typed text in between; Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home, End), the required "Reads as" words. Right: needs and gives, the sample request. Checking with `core.checkFormula` (and `core.evaluate` for the sample); an unknown answer code means "This will be checked when the workflow is published.", never a block. |
| `Pickers.tsx` | `ChipButton`, `PickChip` (one choice from a short list, a Radix menu), `MultiPickChip` (ticks in a popover, for "is one of"; names the choices in the order the "when ..." holds them), `sayList()` (names joined with the shared list words `describe.comma` / `describe.and` / `describe.or`, as describe joins lists). |
| `kinds.ts` | Pure: the kind of an expression (from the core's values in scope, else from what fills the value), the words for a kind (the format's `WORDS_FOR_KIND`), the right side's kinds, a value's choices (typed-in choices, list rows, a task's buttons). |
| `sentence.ts` | Pure: clause edits that keep words and right fitting the left; sentence to formula text; one plain comparison back to a sentence. |
| `formulaTokens.ts` | Pure: formula text as pieces (chips, joining words, days, text) and back; where each piece is in the text. |

## Tests

`npx vitest run src/features/conditions`: every "when ..." of the fixtures renders and round-trips; an opened "when ..." with no part is never stored; building "Risk is High" and "Approve is pressed and Risk is High" from empty by keyboard gives the format's JSON; words per kind; switching, removing; the formula editor's chip insertion, typed days, Backspace, the "Reads as" requirement, the not-checked line; Write a formula, Back to word chips, Use formula. End to end: `tests/e2e/conditions.spec.ts`.

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

  describeCondition, eachExpression, openWorkflow, resetSessionForTests, SlotsProvider, toText, useDoc, useEditor, useSession,
  type ValueFieldProps,
