/** Stands in for features/values' ValueField: a select of the workflow's values, and a text box when typing is allowed. */
function StubValueField(props: ValueFieldProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  if (!doc) return null;
  if (props.sent !== undefined) return <span aria-label={props.label}>{JSON.stringify(props.value)}</span>;
  const { value, label, allowTyped, accepts } = props;
  const plain = value && 'value' in value && !(value.steps ?? []).length ? value.value : '';
  return (
    <span>
      <select aria-label={label} value={plain} onChange={(e) => props.onChange(e.target.value ? { value: e.target.value as ValueId } : undefined)}>
        <option value="">…</option>
        {doc.values.map((v) => (
          <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
            {v.name}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      {allowTyped && (!accepts || accepts.includes('text')) && (
        <input aria-label={`${label}: typed`} value={value && 'text' in value ? value.text : ''} onChange={(e) => props.onChange({ text: e.target.value })} />
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

let services: Services;

async function open(name: string) {
  ({ services } = createStandinServices());
  await act(() => openWorkflow(services, name));
  return useEditor.getState().doc as AuthoredWorkflow;
}

function Harness({
  at, stageId, sent, start, spy,
}: {
  at: Location;
  stageId?: string;
  sent?: string;
  start?: Condition | SentCondition;
  spy: (next: unknown) => void;
}) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<unknown>(start);
  const onChange = (next: unknown) => {
    spy(next);
    setValue(next);
  };
  const props = sent
    ? { at, sent: sent as `${string}.${string}@${number}`, value: value as SentCondition | undefined, onChange }
    : { at, value: value as Condition | undefined, onChange, ...(stageId ? { stageId } : {}) };
  return (
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={{ ValueField: StubValueField, WhenBuilder, FormulaEditor }}>
        <WhenBuilder {...props} />
        <output data-testid="json">{JSON.stringify(value ?? null)}</output>
      </SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>
  );
}

/** Every "when ..." of a fixture, with where it is and the stage it belongs to. */
function whensOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow) {
  const out: { at: Location; condition: Condition | SentCondition; stageId?: string; sent?: string }[] = [];
  eachExpression(doc, (node, slot) => {
    if (slot.sort !== 'condition' && slot.sort !== 'sentCondition') return;
    const stage = doc.stages.find((s) => JSON.stringify(s).includes(`"${slot.owner.id}"`));
    const binding = doc.start.startsWhen.find((b) => b.id === slot.owner.id);
    out.push({
      at: slot.location,
      condition: node as Condition,
      ...(stage && slot.owner.kind !== 'question' && slot.owner.kind !== 'text' && slot.owner.kind !== 'page' ? { stageId: stage.id } : {}),
      ...(binding?.trigger ? { sent: binding.trigger } : {}),
    });
  });
  return out;
}

beforeEach(() => vi.useRealTimers());
afterEach(() => resetSessionForTests());

describe('WhenBuilder: the "when ..." of every fixture', () => {
  const names = FIXTURE_NAMES.filter((n) => n !== 'blank');
  it('the fixtures hold "when ..." sentences to test', () => {
    const total = names.reduce((n, name) => n + whensOf(fixtures[name]).length, 0);
    expect(total).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);
    expect(whensOf(fixtures.blank)).toEqual([]);
  });

  for (const name of names) {
    it(`renders each "when ..." of ${name} as a sentence and gives it back unchanged`, async () => {
      const doc = await open(name);
      for (const when of whensOf(doc)) {
        const spy = vi.fn();
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const view = render(<Harness at={when.at} stageId={when.stageId} sent={when.sent} start={when.condition} spy={spy} />);
        const said = toText(describeCondition(doc, when.condition, when.sent ? { trigger: when.sent, catalogue: useSession.getState().catalogue ?? undefined } : {}));
        const group = view.getByRole('group', { name: new RegExp(`^When ${said.split(' (')[0]!.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}`) });
        expect(group).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

        // Choosing each clause's words again gives exactly the same "when ...".
        const words = within(group).queryAllByRole('button', { name: /^Part \d+: words/ });
        for (const chip of words) {
          chip.focus();
          await user.keyboard('{Enter}');
          const current = chip.getAttribute('aria-label')!.split(': ').slice(2).join(': ');
          const item = await screen.findByRole('menuitem', { name: current });
          await user.click(item);
        }
        // Switching "and"/"or" twice gives it back too.
        const joiner = within(group).queryAllByRole('button', { name: /press to say/ })[0];
        if (joiner) {
          await user.click(joiner);
          await user.click(within(view.container).getAllByRole('button', { name: /press to say/ })[0]!);
        }
        const last = spy.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0];
        if (last !== undefined) expect(last).toEqual(when.condition);
        expect(JSON.parse(view.getByTestId('json').textContent!)).toEqual(when.condition);
        view.unmount();
      }
    });
  }

  it('reads a Yes/No column naturally and says which choices of the list take it', async () => {

    render(<Harness at={{ item: 'ar_rf_no_approval', part: 'when.condition' }} start={when} spy={vi.fn()} />);

    expect(part.querySelector('[data-chip-slot] > [aria-hidden="true"]')?.textContent).toBe('Primary domain');
    // What the arrow does for each domain, this arrow's rows marked in words, not by colour alone.

    expect(wordsFor('choiceFromList')).toEqual(WORDS.choice);
    expect(wordsFor('multipleChoice')).toEqual(WORDS.list);
    expect(wordsFor('group')).toEqual(WORDS.people);

===\nfrontend/src/features/conditions/WhenBuilder.tsx\n===
/**
 * The "when ..." sentence builder (editor-model.md section 5; mockup 03-routing). Empty: the quiet
 * add text. Otherwise the "when" as a sentence of chips, [value] [words] [value or typed choice],
 * joined by "and" or "or" (one joiner for the whole sentence; the word itself switches it), with
 * "[button] is pressed" parts for the stage's buttons when `stageId` is given. Under it, the
 * sentence read back in words when that says more than the chips (a Yes/No read naturally, the
 * list's choices in brackets). "Write a formula" opens the formula editor; a formula shows as its
 * "Reads as" sentence with "Edit formula".
 * Controlled: every edit is handed to `onChange`; nothing in the document is written here.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type {
  Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Condition, Constant, Expression, Formula, Location, SentExpression, ValueKind, Words,
} from '@/contract';
import {
  arrowChoices, describeCondition, describeConstant, describeExpression, describeFinding, describePressed, find,
  findingTone, getWorkingStage, isChip, Slot, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFindingsFor,
  useValuesInScope, yesNoPredicate, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase, type ValueFieldProps, type WhenBuilderProps,
} from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Chip, Icon, IconButton, Menu, type MenuItem } from '@/ui';
import { FormulaDialog } from './FormulaDialog';
import {
  choicesFor, kindOfExpression, kindWordKey, needsAList, needsNothingAfter, rightKinds, sameConstant, wordsFor, wordSetFor,
  type KindEnv, type ScopeKinds,
} from './kinds';
import { MultiPickChip, PickChip, sayList } from './Pickers';
import { choicePreview, oneRowOf, type Preview } from './preview';
import {
  addClause, clausesOf, joinerOf, removeClause, sentenceToFormula, setClause, switchJoiner, withLeft, withRight, withWords,
  type AnyClause, type AnySentence,
} from './sentence';
import s from './conditions.module.css';

type Node = Expression | SentExpression;
type WordsClause = Exclude<AnyClause, { pressed: unknown }>;

/** The sentence shown, and never stored, while a "when ..." just opened has no part yet. */
const OPENED: AnySentence = { allOf: [] };

const WEEKDAYS =['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday'] as const;

/** The words of a clause as the builder shows them: a Yes/No read naturally when its name allows. */
export function wordLabel(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, left: Node | undefined, words: Words, env: DescribeEnv = {}): string {
  if ((words === 'yesNo.isYes' || words === 'yesNo.isNo') && left && typeof left === 'object') {
    const yes = words === 'yesNo.isYes';
    const steps = 'steps' in left ? left.steps ?? [] : [];
    const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
    let name: string | undefined;
    if (last && 'column' in last) {
      const col = find(doc, last.column);
      name = col?.kind === 'column' ? col.item.name : undefined;
    } else if (!steps.length && 'value' in left) {
      name = toText(describeExpression(doc, { value: left.value } as Expression, env));
    }
    const natural = name ? yesNoPredicate(name, yes) : undefined;
    if (natural) return natural;
  }
  return t(`describe.words.${words}` as WordKey);
}

/**
 * The value as its chip shows it. When the words read a Yes/No column naturally ("needs no
 * approval"), the column is said by the words, so the chip names only what it is read from:
 * [Primary domain] [needs no approval] (mockup 03-routing, condition-builder).
 */
export function chipExpression(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, left: Node | undefined, words: Words | undefined): Node | undefined {
  if (!left || typeof left !== 'object' || (words !== 'yesNo.isYes' && words !== 'yesNo.isNo')) return left;
  const steps = 'steps' in left ? left.steps ?? [] : [];
  const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
  if (!last || !('column' in last)) return left;
  const col = find(doc, last.column);
  if (col?.kind !== 'column' || !yesNoPredicate(col.item.name, words === 'yesNo.isYes')) return left;
  const rest = steps.slice(0, -1);
  const { steps: _steps, ...base } = left as Node & { steps?: unknown };
  void _steps;
  return (rest.length ? { ...base, steps: rest } : base) as Node;
}

/** The scope's kinds, as a map from value ID to kind (conflicts left out). */
function useScopeKinds(at: Location | null): ScopeKinds {
  const { values } = useValuesInScope(at);
  return useMemo(() => new Map(values.flatMap((v) => (typeof v.kind === 'string' ? [[v.id, v.kind] as const] : []))), [values]);
}

/** Renders a phrase from describe as text with its chips (used for "Approve is pressed"). */
function PhraseView({ phrase, chip }: { phrase: Phrase; chip?: (label: string) => ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <>
      {phrase.map((p, i) =>
        typeof p === 'string' ? <span key={i}>{p.trim()}</span> : isChip(p) && chip ? <span key={i}>{chip(p.label)}</span> : <span key={i}>{'label' in p ? p.label : p.text}</span>,
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function WhenBuilder(props: WhenBuilderProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const { at, stageId, addLabel, autoFocus, sent } = props;
  const stored = props.value as AnySentence | Formula | undefined;
  const store = props.onChange as (next: AnySentence | Formula | undefined) => void;
  // "+ only when ..." opens an empty sentence here only: the document gets the "when ..." once it
  // has a part, so a "when ..." the author opened and left is never saved as an empty sentence
  // (an empty "when" in a finished draft is a To do for the engine). A sentence whose last part is
  // removed is removed whole (removeClause), so nothing else can store one either.
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const value: AnySentence | Formula | undefined = stored ?? (opened ? OPENED : undefined);
  const onChange = (next: AnySentence | Formula | undefined) => {
    setOpened(false);
    const empty = next !== undefined && !('formula' in next) && clausesOf(next).length === 0;
    if (empty) {
      setOpened(true);
      if (stored !== undefined) store(undefined);
      return;
    }
    if (next === undefined && stored === undefined) return; // closing a sentence that was never stored
    store(next);
  };
  const scope = useScopeKinds(sent ? null : at);
  const kindEnv: KindEnv = useMemo(() => ({ catalogue, trigger: sent, scope }), [catalogue, sent, scope]);
  const sayEnv: DescribeEnv = useMemo(() => (sent ? { ...env, trigger: sent } : env), [env, sent]);
  const [formulaOpen, setFormulaOpen] = useState(false);
  // Where focus goes once the next value is shown (after an add, a removal, or the formula dialog).
  const focusNext = useRef<'first' | 'add' | 'edit' | { part: number } | null>(null);
  const setFocusNext = (where: 'first' | 'add' | 'edit' | { part: number }) => {
    focusNext.current = where;
  };
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const addRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  // Left with no part: once focus moves on to anything outside this "when ..." (and outside the
  // pickers and dialogs it opens over the page), the opened sentence closes again.
  const leftOpen = opened && stored === undefined;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!leftOpen) return;
    const onFocusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => {
      const el = e.target as Element | null;
      if (!el || !el.isConnected || rootRef.current?.contains(el)) return;
      if (el.closest('[role="dialog"], [role="menu"], [role="listbox"], [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]')) return;
      setOpened(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('focusin', onFocusIn);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('focusin', onFocusIn);
  }, [leftOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const where = focusNext.current;
    if (!where) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const root = rootRef.current;
      const pick = (selector: string) => root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector) ?? null;
      const el =
        where === 'add'
          ? addRef.current
          : where === 'edit'
            ? pick('[data-focus="edit"]')
            : where === 'first'
              ? pick('[data-part="0"] :is(button, select, input)')
              : // The part's own first control, never the "and"/"or" in front of it.
                pick(`[data-part="${where.part}"] :is(button, select, input):not([data-joiner])`) ?? pick('[data-focus="add-part"]');
      if (!el) return;
      focusNext.current = null;
      el.focus();
    }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  });

  // "What this arrow does for each domain", for an arrow whose "when ..." depends on a list.
  const preview = useMemo(
    () =>
      doc && !sent && at.part === 'when.condition' && value && !('formula' in value)
        ? choicePreview(doc, at.item, value as unknown as Condition)
        : undefined,
    [doc, sent, at.part, at.item, value],
  );

  if (!doc) return null;

  if (value === undefined) {
    return (
      <div ref={rootRef} className={s.whenRoot} data-at={at.item}>
        <button
          ref={addRef}
          type="button"
          className={s.add}
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          onClick={() => {
            setOpened(true);
            setFocusNext('first');
          }}
        >
          {addLabel ?? t('word.onlyWhen')}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const removeWhole = () => {
    onChange(undefined);
    setFocusNext('add');
  };

  const dialog = formulaOpen && (
    <FormulaDialog
      at={at}
      sent={sent}
      initial={
        'formula' in value
          ? value
          : { formula: sentenceToFormula(value) ?? '', readsAs: clausesOf(value).length ? toText(describeCondition(doc, value as unknown as Condition, sayEnv)) : '' }
      }
      kindEnv={kindEnv}
      onClose={() => setFormulaOpen(false)}
      onUse={(next) => {
        onChange(next);
        setFormulaOpen(false);
        setFocusNext('edit');
      }}
      onBack={(sentence) => {
        onChange(sentence);
        setFormulaOpen(false);
        setFocusNext('first');
      }}
    />
  );

  if ('formula' in value) {
    const words = value.readsAs?.trim();
    return (
      <div ref={rootRef} className={s.whenRoot} data-at={at.item}>
        <div className={s.formulaBox} role="group" aria-label={t('conditions.sentence', { sentence: words || t('describe.formula') })}>
          <Icon name="fx" />
          <p className={s.formulaWords}>
            <b>{t('conditions.formula.readsAsLine')}</b> {words ? words : <span className={s.missing}>{t('conditions.formula.noWords')}</span>}
          </p>
          <div className={s.formulaActions}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="edit" data-focus="edit" onClick={() => setFormulaOpen(true)}>
              {t('conditions.formula.edit')}
            </Button>
            <IconButton size="sm" icon="close" label={t('conditions.removeWhen')} onClick={removeWhole} />
          </div>
        </div>
        {dialog}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={s.whenRoot} data-at={at.item}>
      <SentenceView
        doc={doc}
        at={at}
        stageId={stageId}
        sent={sent}
        sentence={value}
        previewShown={!!preview}
        kindEnv={kindEnv}
        sayEnv={sayEnv}
        onChange={(next, focus) => {
          if (next === undefined) return removeWhole();
          onChange(next);
          if (focus !== undefined) setFocusNext(focus);
        }}
        onWriteFormula={() => setFormulaOpen(true)}
      />
      {preview && <ChoicePreview preview={preview} />}
      {dialog}
    </div>
  );
}

/** "What this arrow does for each domain": each row of the list and where it goes, this arrow's marked. */
function ChoicePreview({ preview }: { preview: Preview }) {
  const headId = useId();
  const row = oneRowOf(preview.list);
  return (
    <section className={s.preview} aria-labelledby={headId}>
      <h4 className={s.previewHead} id={headId}>
        <Icon name="eye" size={14} />
        {row ? t('conditions.preview.head', { row }) : t('conditions.preview.headList', { list: preview.list })}
      </h4>
      <table className={s.previewTable}>
        <tbody>
          {preview.rows.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.label} className={r.here ? s.previewHere : undefined}>
              <th scope="row">{r.label}</th>
              <td>
                <span className={s.previewGo}>
                  {r.here && (
                    <>
                      <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} />
                      <span className="visually-hidden">{t('conditions.preview.thisArrow')}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {r.goTo ?? <span className={s.missing}>{t('conditions.preview.nowhere')}</span>}
                </span>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  );
}

type FocusAfter = 'first' | { part: number };

/**
 * Whether "[button] is pressed" can decide this "when ...". Only a "when ..." read after someone
 * has answered can: an arrow's and an action's. A question's, text's or page's "Show ... only when
 * ..." is read while the form is still being filled, and a button's "Also only when ..." decides
 * whether that button can be pressed at all, so neither can depend on a button of the same form
 * (mockup 06-form: Show when offers answers and values only).
 */
export function pressCanDecide(at: Location): boolean {
  return at.part !== 'showWhen' && at.part !== 'enabledWhen';
}

function SentenceView({
  doc, at, stageId, sent, sentence, previewShown, kindEnv, sayEnv, onChange, onWriteFormula,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  at: Location;
  stageId?: string;
  sent?: string;
  sentence: AnySentence;
  /** "What this arrow does for each ..." is shown under the sentence: it says what the read-back's brackets would. */
  previewShown: boolean;
  kindEnv: KindEnv;
  sayEnv: DescribeEnv;
  onChange(next: AnySentence | undefined, focus?: FocusAfter): void;
  onWriteFormula(): void;
}) {
  const clauses = clausesOf(sentence);
  const joiner = joinerOf(sentence);
  const buttons = useMemo(
    () =>
      stageId && !sent && pressCanDecide(at)
        ? (getWorkingStage(doc, stageId)?.tasks ?? []).flatMap((task) => task.buttons.map((b) => b.id))
        : [],
    [doc, stageId, sent, at],
  );
  const pressedOptions = buttons.map((id) => ({ value: id, label: toText(describePressed(doc, id)) }));
  const findings = useFindingsFor(at.item);
  const readBack = clauses.length ? readBackOf(doc, sentence, sayEnv, sent) : '';
  const chips = clauses.map((c) => chipsText(doc, c, sayEnv)).join(` ${t(`conditions.joiner.${joiner}`)} `);
  const said = clauses.length ? toText(describeCondition(doc, sentence as unknown as Condition, sayEnv)) : '';
  const showReadBack = clauses.length > 0 && norm(previewShown ? said : readBack) !== norm(chips);

  const addPart = (clause: AnyClause) => onChange(addClause(sentence, clause), { part: clauses.length });
  // From the menu, the part is added only once the menu has closed and given focus back to
  // "Add another part"; then focus moves on to the new part instead of staying there.
  const addPartAfterMenu = (clause: AnyClause) => setTimeout(() => addPart(clause), 0);
  const addItems: MenuItem[] = [
    { label: t('conditions.addPart.value'), onSelect: () => addPartAfterMenu({}) },
    ...(buttons.length ? [{ group: t('conditions.addPart.buttons') } as MenuItem] : []),
    ...pressedOptions.map((o) => ({ label: o.label, onSelect: () => addPartAfterMenu({ pressed: o.value as ButtonId }) })),
  ];

  return (
    <div className={s.sentence} role="group" aria-label={t('conditions.sentence', { sentence: readBack || t('describe.gap') })}>
      <ol className={s.parts}>
        {clauses.length === 0 && (
          <li className={s.part} data-part="0">
            <FirstPart
              at={at}
              sent={sent}
              pressedOptions={pressedOptions}
              kindEnv={kindEnv}
              sayEnv={sayEnv}
              onLeft={(left) => onChange(addClause(sentence, { left } as AnyClause), { part: 0 })}
              onPressed={(button) => onChange(addClause(sentence, { pressed: button as ButtonId }), { part: 0 })}
            />
          </li>
        )}
        {clauses.map((clause, i) => (
          <li key={i} className={s.part} data-part={i}>
            {i > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className={s.joiner}
                data-joiner=""
                aria-label={t('conditions.joiner.switch', { word: t(`conditions.joiner.${joiner}`), other: t(`conditions.joiner.${joiner === 'and' ? 'or' : 'and'}`) })}
                onClick={() => onChange(switchJoiner(sentence))}
              >
                {t(`conditions.joiner.${joiner}`)}
              </button>
            )}
            {'pressed' in clause ? (
              <PressedPart
                doc={doc}
                n={i + 1}
                button={clause.pressed}
                options={pressedOptions}
                onPick={(button) => onChange(setClause(sentence, i, { pressed: button as ButtonId }))}
              />
            ) : (
              <WordsPart
                doc={doc}
                at={at}
                sent={sent}
                n={i + 1}
                clause={clause}
                kindEnv={kindEnv}
                sayEnv={sayEnv}
                onChange={(next) => onChange(setClause(sentence, i, next))}
              />
            )}
            <IconButton
              size="sm"
              icon="close"
              className={s.remove}
              label={clauses.length === 1 ? t('conditions.removeWhen') : `${t('conditions.removePart')} (${i + 1})`}
              onClick={() => onChange(removeClause(sentence, i), { part: Math.max(0, i - 1) })}
            />
            <PartNotes doc={doc} clause={clause} at={at} index={i} findings={findings} sayEnv={sayEnv} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {showReadBack && (
        <p className={s.readBack}>
          <b>{t('conditions.readsAs')}</b> {previewShown ? said : readBack}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className={s.foot}>
        {clauses.length > 0 &&
          (addItems.length > 1 ? (
            <Menu
              items={addItems}
              trigger={
                <button type="button" className={s.link} data-focus="add-part">
                  <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
                  {t('conditions.addPart')}
                </button>
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <button type="button" className={s.link} data-focus="add-part" onClick={() => addPart({})}>
              <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
              {t('conditions.addPart')}
            </button>
          ))}
        <span className={s.grow} />
        <button type="button" className={`${s.link} ${s.quiet}`} onClick={onWriteFormula}>
          <Icon name="fx" size={14} />
          {t('conditions.writeFormula')}
        </button>
        {clauses.length !== 1 && (
          <button type="button" className={`${s.link} ${s.quiet}`} onClick={() => onChange(undefined)}>
            <Icon name="trash" size={14} />
            {t('conditions.removeWhen')}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const norm = (text: string) => text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase();

/** The sentence in words, with the list's choices in brackets when the editor can work them out. */
function readBackOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, sentence: AnySentence, env: DescribeEnv, sent?: string): string {
  const said = toText(describeCondition(doc, sentence as unknown as Condition, env));
  if (sent) return said;
  const choices = arrowChoices(doc, { id: 'ar_', when: { type: 'condition', condition: sentence }, goTo: null } as unknown as Arrow);
  return choices && choices.length ? t('describe.label.choices', { label: said, choices: sayList(choices, 'or') }) : said;
}

/** The clause as the chips say it, to tell whether the read-back adds anything. */
function chipsText(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, clause: AnyClause, env: DescribeEnv): string {
  if ('pressed' in clause) return toText(describePressed(doc, clause.pressed));
  const shown = chipExpression(doc, clause.left, clause.words);
  const left = shown ? toText(describeExpression(doc, shown, env)) : t('describe.gap');
  const words = clause.words ? wordLabel(doc, clause.left, clause.words, env) : t('describe.gap');
  if (needsNothingAfter(clause.words)) return `${left} ${words}`;
  const r = clause.right as Node | Node[] | undefined;
  const right = r === undefined ? t('describe.gap') : Array.isArray(r) ? sayList(r.map((x) => toText(describeExpression(doc, x, env))), clause.words === 'list.includesAllOf' ? 'and' : 'or') : toText(describeExpression(doc, r, env));
  return `${left} ${words} ${right}`;
}

const isRef = (x: unknown) => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && ('value' in x || 'request' in x || 'sentField' in x);
const isWhole = (x: unknown) => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && ('formula' in x || 'allOf' in x || 'anyOf' in x);

/**
 * The value slot, with the right value and onChange types for a "Starts when" or not.
 * Inside a sentence the value is one chip on the sentence's row (mockup 03-routing): the chip is
 * drawn here, and the ValueField slot lies over it, unseen, so that the chip opens the slot's own
 * value picker and reads out the slot's own name; the slot's "from ..." line, chevron and clear
 * button are not shown (the part's single × removes the part). A formula or a "when ..." chosen as
 * the value is shown by the slot as it is.
 */
function ValueSlot({
  at, sent, label, value, onChange, accepts, allowTyped, placeholder, shown, kindEnv, sayEnv,
}: {
  at: Location;
  sent?: string;
  label: string;
  value: Node | undefined;
  onChange(next: Node | undefined): void;
  accepts?: ValueKind[];
  allowTyped?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** What the chip names, when it is not the whole value (see chipExpression). */
  shown?: Node;
  kindEnv: KindEnv;
  sayEnv: DescribeEnv;
}) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const props = {
    at, label, value, onChange, allowTyped, placeholder,
    ...(accepts ? { accepts } : {}),
    ...(sent ? { sent } : {}),
  } as unknown as ValueFieldProps;
  const slot = <Slot name="ValueField" {...props} />;
  if (!doc || isWhole(value)) return slot;

  const said = shown ?? value;
  let face: ReactNode;
  if (said === undefined) {
    face = <span className={`${s.pick} ${s.pick_empty}`}>{placeholder ?? t('conditions.left.choose')}</span>;
  } else {
    const phrase = describeExpression(doc, said, sayEnv, { short: true });
    const text = toText(phrase);
    const missing = phrase.some((p) => isChip(p) && p.missing);
    const kind = kindOfExpression(doc, said, kindEnv);
    face = missing ? (
      <span className={`${s.pick} ${s.pick_empty}`}>{text}</span>
    ) : isRef(said) ? (
      <Chip kind={kind ? kindWordKey(kind) : undefined}>{text}</Chip>
    ) : (
      <span className={`${s.pick} ${s.pick_constant}`}>{text}</span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className={s.chipSlot} data-chip-slot="">
      <span className={s.chipFace} aria-hidden="true">
        {face}
      </span>
      <span className={s.chipOver}>{slot}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

function FirstPart({
  at, sent, pressedOptions, onLeft, onPressed, kindEnv, sayEnv,
}: {
  at: Location;
  sent?: string;
  pressedOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
  onLeft(left: Node): void;
  onPressed(button: string): void;
  kindEnv: KindEnv;
  sayEnv: DescribeEnv;
}) {
  return (
    <span className={s.firstPart}>
      <ValueSlot at={at} sent={sent} kindEnv={kindEnv} sayEnv={sayEnv} label={t('conditions.left.part', { n: 1 })} placeholder={t('conditions.firstPart.value')} value={undefined} onChange={(next) => next && onLeft(next)} />
      {pressedOptions.length > 0 && (
        <PickChip label={t('conditions.pressed.button', { n: 1 })} empty={t('conditions.firstPart.button')} heading={t('conditions.pressed.heading')} options={pressedOptions} onPick={onPressed} look="button" />
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

function PressedPart({
  doc, n, button, options, onPick,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  n: number;
  button: string;
  options: { value: string; label: string }[];
  onPick(button: string): void;
}) {
  const phrase = describePressed(doc, button);
  return (
    <span className={s.clause}>
      <PhraseView
        phrase={phrase}
        chip={(label) =>
          options.length ? (
            <PickChip label={t('conditions.pressed.button', { n })} current={label} empty={label} heading={t('conditions.pressed.heading')} options={options} onPick={onPick} look="button" />
          ) : (
            <span className={`${s.pick} ${s.pick_button}`}>{label}</span>
          )
        }
      />
    </span>
  );
}

function WordsPart({
  doc, at, sent, n, clause, kindEnv, sayEnv, onChange,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  at: Location;
  sent?: string;
  n: number;
  clause: WordsClause;
  kindEnv: KindEnv;
  sayEnv: DescribeEnv;
  onChange(next: AnyClause): void;
}) {
  const leftKind = kindOfExpression(doc, clause.left, kindEnv);
  const offered = wordsFor(leftKind);
  const set = wordSetFor(leftKind);
  return (
    <span className={s.clause}>
      <ValueSlot
        at={at}
        sent={sent}
        kindEnv={kindEnv}
        sayEnv={sayEnv}
        shown={chipExpression(doc, clause.left, clause.words)}
        placeholder={t('conditions.left.choose')}
        label={t('conditions.left.part', { n })}
        value={clause.left}
        onChange={(next) => onChange(withLeft(clause, next, kindOfExpression(doc, next, kindEnv), leftKind))}
      />
      {!clause.left && !clause.words ? (
        <span className={s.hint}>{t('conditions.words.first')}</span>
      ) : offered.length === 0 && clause.left && !clause.words ? (
        <span className={s.hint}>{t('conditions.words.none')}</span>
      ) : (
        <PickChip<Words>
          label={t('conditions.words.part', { n })}
          current={clause.words ? wordLabel(doc, clause.left, clause.words, sayEnv) : undefined}
          empty={t('conditions.words.choose')}
          heading={set && leftKind ? t(`conditions.words.heading.${kindWordKey(leftKind)}`) : t('conditions.words.headingAny')}
          options={offered.map((w) => ({ value: w, label: wordLabel(doc, clause.left, w, sayEnv) }))}
          onPick={(w) => onChange(withWords(clause, w))}
          look="words"
        />
      )}
      {clause.words && !needsNothingAfter(clause.words) && (
        <RightPart doc={doc} at={at} sent={sent} n={n} clause={clause} leftKind={leftKind} kindEnv={kindEnv} sayEnv={sayEnv} onChange={(right) => onChange(withRight(clause, right))} />
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

function RightPart({
  doc, at, sent, n, clause, leftKind, kindEnv, sayEnv, onChange,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  at: Location;
  sent?: string;
  n: number;
  clause: WordsClause;
  leftKind: ValueKind | undefined;
  kindEnv: KindEnv;
  sayEnv: DescribeEnv;
  onChange(next: Node | Node[] | undefined): void;
}) {
  const words = clause.words as Words;
  const label = t('conditions.right.part', { n });
  const right = clause.right as Node | Node[] | undefined;
  const say = (c: Constant) => toText(describeConstant(doc, c));

  if (words === 'date.isOnWeekday') {
    const current = right && !Array.isArray(right) && 'weekday' in right ? say(right) : undefined;
    return (
      <PickChip
        label={label}
        current={current}
        empty={t('conditions.weekday.choose')}
        options={WEEKDAYS.map((d) => ({ value: d, label: say({ weekday: d }) }))}
        onPick={(d) => onChange({ weekday: d })}
      />
    );
  }

  const choices = sent ? undefined : choicesFor(doc, clause.left, kindEnv.catalogue);
  const list = needsAList(words);
  if (choices) {
    if (list) {
      const items = Array.isArray(right) ? right : [];
      // In the order the "when ..." holds them, so the chip says them as the read-back does.
      const chosen = items.flatMap((x) => {
        const i = choices.findIndex((c) => sameConstant(x, c.constant));
        return i >= 0 ? [i] : [];
      });
      return (
        <MultiPickChip
          label={label}
          title={label}
          empty={t('conditions.right.chooseSeveral')}
          options={choices.map((c) => ({ value: c.constant, label: c.label }))}
          chosen={chosen}
          joiner={words === 'list.includesAllOf' ? 'and' : 'or'}
          onChange={(indexes) => onChange(indexes.map((i) => choices[i]!.constant as Node))}
        />
      );
    }
    const current = right && !Array.isArray(right) ? toText(describeExpression(doc, right, sayEnv)) : undefined;
    return (
      <PickChip
        label={label}
        current={current}
        empty={t('conditions.right.choose')}
        options={choices.map((c) => ({ value: c.constant, label: c.label }))}
        onPick={(c) => onChange(c as Node)}
      />
    );
  }

  const accepts = rightKinds(words, leftKind);
  if (list) {
    const items = Array.isArray(right) ? right : [];
    return (
      <span className={s.listRight}>
        {[...items, undefined].map((item, i) => (
          <span key={i} className={s.listItem}>
            <ValueSlot
              at={at}
              sent={sent}
              kindEnv={kindEnv}
              sayEnv={sayEnv}
              placeholder={t('conditions.right.chooseValue')}
              label={t('conditions.listItemName', { label, n: i + 1 })}
              accepts={accepts}
              allowTyped
              value={item}
              onChange={(next) => {
                const out = [...items];
                if (next === undefined) out.splice(i, 1);
                else out[i] = next;
                onChange(out);
              }}
            />
            {item !== undefined && (
              <IconButton
                size="sm"
                icon="close"
                label={t('conditions.right.removeItem', { name: toText(describeExpression(doc, item)) })}
                onClick={() => onChange(items.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}
              />
            )}
          </span>
        ))}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ValueSlot at={at} sent={sent} kindEnv={kindEnv} sayEnv={sayEnv} placeholder={t('conditions.right.chooseValue')} label={label} accepts={accepts} allowTyped value={Array.isArray(right) ? right[0] : right} onChange={(next) => onChange(next)} />
  );
}

/** Under a part: "Kept in the Domains list" with its link, and this part's To do and Worth knowing. */
function PartNotes({
  doc, clause, at, index, findings, sayEnv,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  clause: AnyClause;
  at: Location;
  index: number;
  findings: ReturnType<typeof useFindingsFor>;
  sayEnv: DescribeEnv;
}) {
  const [listOpen, setListOpen] = useState(false);
  const left = 'pressed' in clause ? undefined : (clause.left as { steps?: { column?: string }[] } | undefined);
  const column = left?.steps?.find((st) => st.column)?.column;
  const listId = column ? find(doc, column)?.parents.list : undefined;
  const list = listId ? find(doc, listId) : undefined;
  const listName = list?.kind === 'list' ? list.item.name : undefined;
  const prefix = `${at.part ?? ''}.${index}`;
  const mine = findings.filter((f) => f.location.part === prefix || f.location.part?.startsWith(`${prefix}.`));
  if (!listName && mine.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className={s.notes}>
      {listName && listId && (
        <p className={s.keptIn}>
          <Icon name="table" size={14} />
          <span>{t('conditions.keptIn', { list: listName })}</span>
          <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => setListOpen(true)}>
            {t('conditions.editList', { list: listName })}
          </button>
          <Slot name="ListDialog" listId={listId} open={listOpen} onOpenChange={setListOpen} />
        </p>
      )}
      {mine.map((f, i) => {
        const said = describeFinding(doc, f, sayEnv);
        const tone = findingTone(f);
        return (
          <p key={i} className={`${s.finding} ${tone === 'contradictory' ? s.red : tone === 'unfinished' ? s.amber : s.blue}`}>
            <Icon name={tone === 'worthKnowing' ? 'info' : tone === 'contradictory' ? 'error' : 'todo'} size={14} />
            <span>{said.short}</span>
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/conditions/formulaTokens.ts\n===
/**
 * Formula text as a row of pieces the editor shows: value chips (`{{v_...}}`; a date chip is
 * already a point in time, core-api.md 6.4, so it is written bare, and an old `date({{...}})` is
 * read as the chip), joining words ("and", "is less than", "plus" for `&&`, `<`, `+`), an amount
 * of days (`days(3)`, shown "3 days") and anything else as typed. The stored form is always the
 * text (authored-format.ts, Formula); pieces are only how it is shown and edited. Pure.
 */

export type Op = '&&' | '||' | '!' | '==' | '!=' | '<' | '>' | '<=' | '>=' | '+' | '-';

export type Token =
  | { t: 'chip'; ref: string; date?: boolean }
  | { t: 'op'; op: Op }
  | { t: 'days'; n: string }
  | { t: 'text'; text: string };

/** The joining words offered under "Put in", in order, with the sign each stands for. */
export const PUT_IN: readonly Op[] = ['&&', '||', '!', '==', '!=', '<', '>', '+', '-'];

/** Words typed by hand that mean a joining word. */
const TYPED_WORDS: Record<string, Op> = { and: '&&', or: '||', not: '!', plus: '+', minus: '-' };

const PATTERN = new RegExp(
  [
    String.raw`date\(\s*\{\{([^{}]+)\}\}\s*\)`, // 1: a date chip
    String.raw`\{\{([^{}]+)\}\}`, // 2: a chip
    String.raw`days\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)`, // 3: days(n)
    String.raw`(\d+)\s+days?\b`, // 4: "3 days" typed
    String.raw`("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"?|'(?:[^'\\]|\\.)*'?)`, // 5: a text in quotes
    String.raw`(&&|\|\||==|!=|<=|>=|<|>|\+|-|!)`, // 6: a sign
    String.raw`(\s+)`, // 7: space
    String.raw`([^\s{}"'&|=!<>+\-]+|.)`, // 8: anything else
  ].join('|'),
  'gy',
);

/** The pieces of formula text. Spaces are dropped; `serialize` puts single spaces back. */
export function parse(text: string): Token[] {
  const out: Token[] = [];
  PATTERN.lastIndex = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while (PATTERN.lastIndex < text.length && (m = PATTERN.exec(text))) {
    if (m[1] !== undefined) out.push({ t: 'chip', ref: m[1].trim(), date: true });
    else if (m[2] !== undefined) out.push({ t: 'chip', ref: m[2].trim() });
    else if (m[3] !== undefined) out.push({ t: 'days', n: m[3] });
    else if (m[4] !== undefined) out.push({ t: 'days', n: m[4] });
    else if (m[5] !== undefined) out.push({ t: 'text', text: m[5] });
    else if (m[6] !== undefined) out.push({ t: 'op', op: m[6] as Op });
    else if (m[8] !== undefined) {
      const word = TYPED_WORDS[m[8].toLowerCase()];
      out.push(word ? { t: 'op', op: word } : { t: 'text', text: m[8] });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function tokenText(token: Token): string {
  switch (token.t) {
    case 'chip':
      return `{{${token.ref}}}`;
    case 'op':
      return token.op;
    case 'days':
      return `days(${token.n})`;
    default:
      return token.text;
  }
}

/** No space after an opening bracket or a "not", none before a closing bracket, a comma or a dot. */
function joinsTight(prev: Token, next: Token): boolean {
  const p = prev.t === 'text' ? prev.text : prev.t === 'op' && prev.op === '!' ? '!' : '';
  const n = next.t === 'text' ? next.text : '';
  return /[([!.]$/.test(p) || /^[)\],.(]/.test(n);
}

/** The formula text, and where each piece starts and ends in it. */
export function layout(tokens: readonly Token[]): { text: string; spans: { start: number; end: number }[] } {
  let text = '';
  const spans: { start: number; end: number }[] = [];
  tokens.forEach((token, i) => {
    const prev = tokens[i - 1];
    if (prev && !joinsTight(prev, token)) text += ' ';
    const piece = tokenText(token);
    spans.push({ start: text.length, end: text.length + piece.length });
    text += piece;
  });
  return { text, spans };
}

export const serialize = (tokens: readonly Token[]): string => layout(tokens).text;

/** The chips' references in order (`v_risk`, `request.startedOn`, `sent.category`). */
export const chipRefs = (tokens: readonly Token[]): string[] =>
  tokens.flatMap((tk) => (tk.t === 'chip' ? [tk.ref] : []));

/** True when the piece overlaps the range `[start, end)` of the text. */
export const overlaps = (span: { start: number; end: number }, range: { start: number; end: number }): boolean =>
  range.end > range.start ? span.start < range.end && span.end > range.start : span.start <= range.start && range.start <= span.end;

export { WhenBuilder } from './WhenBuilder';

/**
 * What the "when ..." builder needs to know about the left side of a clause: its kind (which
 * words are offered), the kinds the right side may be, and the choices it can be compared with
 * (a question's typed-in choices, a list's rows, a task's buttons). Pure: worked out from the
 * document, the catalogue and the kinds the core reports for the values in scope.
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Constant, Expression, Field, SentExpression, ValueKind, Words, WordSet,
} from '@/contract';
import { WORDS, WORDS_FOR_KIND, WORDS_WITH_A_LIST, WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER } from '@/contract';
import { fillSites, find, getQuestion, valueChoices } from '@/model';

/** The kind of each value as the core reported it at this place (strings only; conflicts are left out). */
export type ScopeKinds = ReadonlyMap<string, ValueKind>;

export interface KindEnv {
  catalogue?: Catalogue | null;
  /** Inside a "Starts when": the trigger whose sent fields are read. */
  trigger?: string;
  scope?: ScopeKinds;
}

type Node = Expression | SentExpression;

const has = (node: unknown, key: string): node is Record<string, unknown> =>
  !!node && typeof node === 'object' && !Array.isArray(node) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(node, key);

export function entryOf(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, ref: string | undefined): CatalogueEntry | undefined {
  if (!catalogue || !ref) return undefined;
  return (catalogue.entries ?? []).find((e) => e.id === ref);
}

/** The fields a trigger sends, or [] when the catalogue does not know it. */
export function sentFields(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, trigger: string | undefined): Field[] {
  const entry = entryOf(catalogue, trigger);
  return entry?.kind === 'trigger' ? entry.event ?? [] : [];
}

function fieldAt(fields: Field[], dotted: string): Field | undefined {
  const [head, ...rest] = dotted.split('.');
  const field = fields.find((f) => f.id === head);
  if (!field || rest.length === 0) return field;
  return fieldAt(field.fields ?? [], rest.join('.'));
}

/** The kind a value is filled with, from what fills it in the document (the first filler that says). */
export function kindOfValue(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string, env: KindEnv = {}): ValueKind | undefined {
  const reported = env.scope?.get(valueId);
  if (reported) return reported;
  for (const site of fillSites(doc, valueId)) {
    const owner = find(doc, site.owner.id);
    switch (site.how) {
      case 'savedAs': {
        const q = getQuestion(doc, site.owner.id);
        if (!q) break;
        if (q.kind === 'choice' && q.choices?.from === 'list') return 'choiceFromList';
        if (q.kind === 'choice' && q.choices?.from === 'source') return 'choiceFromConnection';
        return q.kind;
      }
      case 'savesButtonPressedAs':
        return 'choice';
      case 'savesAnsweredByAs':
        return 'person';
      case 'saveFailureAs':
        // What went wrong is a choice of the operation's failure codes (E-29).
        return site.location.part?.endsWith('.failed') ? 'yesNo' : 'choice';
      case 'saveResults': {
        if (owner?.kind !== 'action' || owner.item.type !== 'useConnection') break;
        const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, owner.item.operation);
        const key = site.location.part?.split('.').slice(1).join('.') ?? '';
        const field = entry?.kind === 'operation' ? fieldAt(entry.result ?? [], key) : undefined;
        if (field) return field.kind;
        break;
      }
      case 'saveAs': {
        if (owner?.kind !== 'action' || owner.item.type !== 'saveValue' || !owner.item.save) break;
        const kind = kindOfExpression(doc, owner.item.save, { ...env, scope: undefined });
        if (kind) return kind;
        break;
      }
      default:
        break;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The kind of a constant, by its key. */
export function kindOfConstant(c: Constant): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (has(c, 'text')) return 'text';
  if (has(c, 'number')) return 'number';
  if (has(c, 'yesNo')) return 'yesNo';
  if (has(c, 'date') || has(c, 'weekday')) return 'date';
  if (has(c, 'choice') || has(c, 'button') || has(c, 'failureCode')) return 'choice';
  if (has(c, 'choices')) return 'multipleChoice';
  if (has(c, 'row')) return 'choiceFromList';
  if (has(c, 'person')) return 'person';
  if (has(c, 'group')) return 'group';
  if (has(c, 'people')) return 'people';
  if (has(c, 'connectionChoice')) return 'choiceFromConnection';
  return undefined;
}

/** The kind an expression gives, or undefined when nothing says (a formula, an unfinished part). */
export function kindOfExpression(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expr: Node | null | undefined, env: KindEnv = {}): ValueKind | undefined {
  if (!expr || typeof expr !== 'object') return undefined;
  if (has(expr, 'allOf') || has(expr, 'anyOf')) return 'yesNo';
  if (has(expr, 'formula')) return undefined;
  if (has(expr, 'sentField')) return fieldAt(sentFields(env.catalogue, env.trigger), String(expr.sentField))?.kind;
  let kind: ValueKind | undefined;
  if (has(expr, 'value')) kind = kindOfValue(doc, String(expr.value), env);
  else if (has(expr, 'request')) kind = expr.request === 'startedOn' ? 'date' : 'person';
  else return kindOfConstant(expr as unknown as Constant);
  const steps = (expr as { steps?: unknown[] }).steps ?? [];
  for (const step of steps) {
    if (has(step, 'column')) {
      const col = find(doc, String(step.column));
      kind = col?.kind === 'column' ? col.item.kind : undefined;
    } else if (has(step, 'directory')) kind = 'people';
  }
  return kind;
}

/** The set of words for a kind, or null when version 0 has none (use a formula). */
export function wordSetFor(kind: ValueKind | undefined): WordSet | null {
  return kind ? WORDS_FOR_KIND[kind] ?? null : null;
}

export function wordsFor(kind: ValueKind | undefined): readonly Words[] {
  const set = wordSetFor(kind);
  return set ? WORDS[set] : [];
}

export const needsNothingAfter = (words: Words | undefined): boolean =>
  !!words && (WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER as readonly Words[]).includes(words);
export const needsAList = (words: Words | undefined): boolean =>
  !!words && (WORDS_WITH_A_LIST as readonly Words[]).includes(words);

/** The kinds the right side of a clause may give, for its words and the left's kind. */
export function rightKinds(words: Words, leftKind: ValueKind | undefined): ValueKind[] {
  const [set, word] = words.split('.') as [WordSet, string];
  switch (set) {
    case 'text':
      return ['text', 'longText'];
    case 'number':
      return ['number'];
    case 'date':
      return ['date'];
    case 'choice':
      return leftKind ? [leftKind] : ['choice'];
    case 'person':
      return word === 'isIn' || word === 'isNotIn' ? ['group', 'people'] : ['person'];
    case 'people':
      return ['person'];
    case 'list':
      return ['choice'];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

export interface ChoiceOption {
  constant: Constant;
  label: string;
}

/**
 * The choices a value can be compared with, when the document says what they are: a question's
 * typed-in choices, the rows of the list it is answered from, the buttons of the task whose "Button
 * pressed" it is, or the failure codes of the operations that save what went wrong in it (labelled
 * by the catalogue). Undefined when the left is anything else (then a value or a typed constant is
 * chosen instead).
 */
export function choicesFor(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, left: Node | null | undefined, catalogue?: Catalogue | null): ChoiceOption[] | undefined {
  if (!has(left, 'value') || ((left as { steps?: unknown[] }).steps ?? []).length > 0) return undefined;
  return valueChoices(doc, catalogue, String((left as unknown as { value: unknown }).value))?.map(({ constant, label }) => ({ constant, label }));
}
/** True when two constants are the same choice (compared by key and ID). */
export function sameConstant(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
  return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
}

/** The kind as the word key under `valueKind.*` (the nine kinds an author meets). */
export function kindWordKey(kind: ValueKind): 'text' | 'longtext' | 'number' | 'yesno' | 'date' | 'choice' | 'multichoice' | 'person' | 'group' {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'longText':
      return 'longtext';
    case 'yesNo':
      return 'yesno';
    case 'multipleChoice':
    case 'list':
      return 'multichoice';
    case 'choiceFromList':
    case 'choiceFromConnection':
      return 'choice';
    case 'people':
      return 'group';
    case 'fieldGroup':
      return 'text';
    default:
      return kind;
  }
}

/**
 * "What this arrow does for each domain" (mockup 03-routing, condition-builder): for an arrow whose
 * "when ..." reads a column of a list's row, where a request goes for each row of that list, with
 * the arrows of the stage tried from the top and the first one that fits used. Worked out from the
 * document with the model's arrowChoices; when any arrow before a row is decided cannot be worked
 * out by the editor (a button, a formula, another list), there is no preview rather than a guess.
 * Pure.
 */
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Condition } from '@/contract';
import { arrowChoices, describeConstant, describeGoTo, find, stageOf, toText } from '@/model';

export interface PreviewRow {
  /** The row's name, e.g. "Internal tools". */
  label: string;
  /** Where a request for this row goes, e.g. "Create Jira issue"; undefined when no arrow fits. */
  goTo: string | undefined;
  /** True when it is this arrow that takes it. */
  here: boolean;
}

export interface Preview {
  /** The list's name, e.g. "Domains list". */
  list: string;
  rows: PreviewRow[];
}

type Clauses = { allOf?: unknown[]; anyOf?: unknown[] };

/** The list whose column the condition's first clause reads, if any. */
function listOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, condition: Condition | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!condition || typeof condition !== 'object' || 'formula' in condition) return undefined;
  const c = condition as Clauses;
  const first = (c.allOf ?? c.anyOf ?? [])[0] as { left?: { steps?: { column?: string }[] } } | undefined;
  const column = first?.left?.steps?.find((st) => st.column)?.column;
  const entry = column ? find(doc, column) : undefined;
  return entry?.kind === 'column' ? entry.parents.list : undefined;
}

/**
 * The preview for arrow `arrowId` with its "when ..." being edited as `condition` (not yet stored).
 * Undefined when the arrow is not a stage's arrow decided by a list, or the editor cannot say.
 */
export function choicePreview(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrowId: string, condition: Condition | undefined): Preview | undefined {
  const stage = stageOf(doc, arrowId) as { arrows?: Arrow[] } | undefined;
  const arrows = stage?.arrows;
  if (!arrows || !arrows.some((a) => a.id === arrowId)) return undefined;
  const listId = listOf(doc, condition);
  const list = listId ? find(doc, listId) : undefined;
  if (list?.kind !== 'list' || list.item.rows.length === 0) return undefined;

  const labels = list.item.rows.map((r) => toText(describeConstant(doc, { row: r.id })));
  const decided = new Map<string, { goTo: string | undefined; here: boolean }>();
  for (const stored of arrows) {
    if (decided.size === labels.length) break;
    const arrow: Arrow = stored.id === arrowId ? { ...stored, when: { type: 'condition', condition } as Arrow['when'] } : stored;
    const goTo = arrow.goTo ? toText(describeGoTo(doc, arrow.goTo)) : undefined;
    const here = arrow.id === arrowId;
    let takes: string[];
    if (arrow.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases') takes = labels;
    else if (arrow.when?.type === 'condition' && !arrow.onlyWhen && listOf(doc, arrow.when.condition) === listId) {
      const choices = arrowChoices(doc, arrow);
      if (!choices) return undefined;
      takes = choices;
    } else return undefined;
    for (const label of takes) if (!decided.has(label)) decided.set(label, { goTo, here });
  }
  return {
    list: list.item.name,
    rows: labels.map((label) => ({ label, goTo: decided.get(label)?.goTo, here: decided.get(label)?.here ?? false })),
  };
}

/** "Domains list" -> "domain": the name of one row, for "for each domain"; undefined when it can't be said. */
export function oneRowOf(listName: string): string | undefined {
  const plural = listName.replace(/\s+list$/i, '').trim();
  if (!plural || plural.toLowerCase() === listName.trim().toLowerCase()) return undefined;
  const one = /ies$/i.test(plural) ? plural.replace(/ies$/i, 'y') : /[^s]s$/i.test(plural) ? plural.slice(0, -1) : undefined;
  return one ? one.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + one.slice(1) : undefined;
}

    const tokens = parse(text);
    expect(tokens).toEqual([
      { t: 'chip', ref: 'v_planned_release_date' },
      { t: 'op', op: '<' },
      { t: 'chip', ref: 'request.startedOn' },
      { t: 'op', op: '+' },
      { t: 'days', n: '3' },
      { t: 'op', op: '&&' },
      { t: 'chip', ref: 'v_risk' },
      { t: 'op', op: '==' },
      { t: 'text', text: '"ch_risk_high"' },
    ]);
    expect(serialize(tokens)).toBe(text);
    // A date chip is already a point in time (core-api.md 6.4): one written inside date(...), which

    expect(serialize(parse('size({{v_list}}) >= 2'))).toBe('size({{v_list}}) >= 2');
  });

  it('knows where each piece is, to underline the part a problem names', () => {
    const { text, spans } = layout(parse('{{v_a}} + 3'));
    expect(text).toBe('{{v_a}} + 3');
    expect(spans.map((s) => overlaps(s, { start: 10, end: 11 }))).toEqual([false, false, true]);
  });

===\nfrontend/src/features/conditions/sentence.ts\n===
/**
 * Pure edits to a "when ..." sentence (authored-format.ts, Sentence and SentCondition): set,
 * add and remove a clause, switch "and" / "or" for the whole sentence, and keep a clause's words
 * and right side fitting its left. Also the two conversions between a sentence and a formula:
 * a sentence the formula language can say is written out as a starting formula, and a formula
 * that is one plain comparison can go back to a sentence. Anything else gives undefined.
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, Clause, Constant, Expression, SentClause, SentExpression, ValueKind, Words,
} from '@/contract';
import { choicesFor, kindOfExpression, needsAList, needsNothingAfter, wordsFor, type KindEnv } from './kinds';

export type AnyClause = Clause | SentClause;
export type AnySentence = { allOf: AnyClause[] } | { anyOf: AnyClause[] };
type Node = Expression | SentExpression;

export const clausesOf = (s: AnySentence): AnyClause[] => ('allOf' in s ? s.allOf : s.anyOf) ?? [];
export const joinerOf = (s: AnySentence): 'and' | 'or' => ('anyOf' in s ? 'or' : 'and');

export function withClauses(s: AnySentence, clauses: AnyClause[]): AnySentence {
  return joinerOf(s) === 'or' ? { anyOf: clauses } : { allOf: clauses };
}

/** "and" becomes "or" and back, for the whole sentence (the format is flat). */
export function switchJoiner(s: AnySentence): AnySentence {
  return joinerOf(s) === 'or' ? { allOf: clausesOf(s) } : { anyOf: clausesOf(s) };
}

export function setClause(s: AnySentence, index: number, clause: AnyClause): AnySentence {
  return withClauses(s, clausesOf(s).map((c, i) => (i === index ? clause : c)));
}

export function addClause(s: AnySentence, clause: AnyClause): AnySentence {
  return withClauses(s, [...clausesOf(s), clause]);
}

/** Removes a clause; removing the last one removes the whole "when ..." (undefined). */
export function removeClause(s: AnySentence, index: number): AnySentence | undefined {
  const rest = clausesOf(s).filter((_, i) => i !== index);
  return rest.length ? withClauses(s, rest) : undefined;
}

const drop = (o: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): Record<string, unknown> => {
  const rest = { ...o };
  delete rest[key];
  return rest;
};

/** A new left side: words and right are kept only while they still fit its kind. */
export function withLeft(clause: AnyClause, left: Node | undefined, newKind: ValueKind | undefined, oldKind: ValueKind | undefined): AnyClause {
  const base = 'pressed' in clause ? {} : { ...clause };
  let next: Record<string, unknown> = left === undefined ? drop(base, 'left') : { ...base, left };
  const words = (next as { words?: Words }).words;
  if (words && !wordsFor(newKind).includes(words)) next = drop(drop(next, 'words'), 'right');
  else if (newKind !== oldKind) next = drop(next, 'right');
  return next as AnyClause;
}

/** New words: the right side is dropped, wrapped in a list or unwrapped as the words need. */
export function withWords(clause: AnyClause, words: Words): AnyClause {
  if ('pressed' in clause) return clause;
  const old = clause.words;
  const right = clause.right as unknown;
  const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...clause, words };
  if (needsNothingAfter(words) || right === undefined) delete next.right;
  else if (needsAList(words) && !Array.isArray(right)) next.right = [right];
  else if (!needsAList(words) && Array.isArray(right)) {
    if (right.length) next.right = right[0];
    else delete next.right;
  } else if (old && old.split('.')[0] === 'person' && (old.endsWith('In') !== words.endsWith('In'))) {
    delete next.right; // "is" a person and "is in" a group take different kinds
  }
  return next as AnyClause;
}

export function withRight(clause: AnyClause, right: Node | Node[] | undefined): AnyClause {
  if ('pressed' in clause) return clause;
  const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...clause };
  if (right === undefined || (Array.isArray(right) && right.length === 0)) delete next.right;
  else next.right = right;
  return next as AnyClause;
}

// ── Sentence to formula and back ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** A chip for the formula text, or undefined when the expression is not a plain reference. */
export function chipOf(node: Node | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return undefined;
  if ('value' in node && typeof node.value === 'string' && !(node.steps ?? []).length && !node.ifEmptyUse) return `{{${node.value}}}`;
  if ('request' in node && !(node.steps ?? []).length && !node.ifEmptyUse) return `{{request.${node.request}}}`;
  if ('sentField' in node) return `{{sent.${node.sentField}}}`;
  return undefined;
}

const quote = (s: string) => JSON.stringify(s);
const num = (n: number) => (Number.isInteger(n) ? `${n}.0` : String(n));

/** A constant as a formula literal (a choice, row or button as its ID text, a failure code as its code), or undefined. */
function literal(node: Node | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return undefined;
  const c = node as Record<string, unknown>;
  if ('text' in c) return quote(String(c.text));
  if ('number' in c && typeof c.number === 'number') return num(c.number);
  if ('date' in c) return `date(${quote(String(c.date))})`;
  if ('choice' in c) return quote(String(c.choice));
  if ('row' in c) return quote(String(c.row));
  if ('button' in c) return quote(String(c.button));
  if ('failureCode' in c) return quote(String(c.failureCode));
  return undefined;
}

const OPS: Partial<Record<Words, string>> = {
  'text.is': '==', 'text.isNot': '!=',
  'number.is': '==', 'number.isNot': '!=', 'number.isMoreThan': '>', 'number.isLessThan': '<', 'number.isAtLeast': '>=', 'number.isAtMost': '<=',
  'date.is': '==', 'date.isBefore': '<', 'date.isAfter': '>', 'date.isOnOrBefore': '<=', 'date.isOnOrAfter': '>=',
  'choice.is': '==', 'choice.isNot': '!=',
};

function clauseFormula(clause: AnyClause): string | undefined {
  if ('pressed' in clause || !clause.words) return undefined;
  const left = chipOf(clause.left);
  if (!left) return undefined;
  const words = clause.words;
  if (words === 'yesNo.isYes') return `${left} == true`;
  if (words === 'yesNo.isNo') return `${left} == false`;
  if (words === 'choice.isOneOf' || words === 'choice.isNotOneOf') {
    const items = (Array.isArray(clause.right) ? clause.right : []).map((r) => literal(r));
    if (!items.length || items.some((x) => x === undefined)) return undefined;
    const list = `${left} in [${items.join(', ')}]`;
    return words === 'choice.isOneOf' ? list : `!(${list})`;
  }
  const right = Array.isArray(clause.right) ? undefined : literal(clause.right);
  if (right === undefined) return undefined;
  if (words === 'text.contains') return `${left}.contains(${right})`;
  if (words === 'text.doesNotContain') return `!${left}.contains(${right})`;
  if (words === 'text.startsWith') return `${left}.startsWith(${right})`;
  const op = OPS[words];
  if (!op) return undefined;
  // A date chip is already a point in time in a formula (core-api.md 6.4, E-26): never `date({{...}})`.
  return `${left} ${op} ${right}`;
}

/** The sentence as formula text, when every clause can be written; undefined otherwise. */
export function sentenceToFormula(s: AnySentence | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!s) return undefined;
  const parts = clausesOf(s).map(clauseFormula);
  if (!parts.length || parts.some((p) => p === undefined)) return undefined;
  return parts.join(joinerOf(s) === 'or' ? ' || ' : ' && ');
}

function leftOf(chip: string): Node {
  if (chip.startsWith('request.')) return { request: chip.slice('request.'.length) as 'requester' | 'startedOn' };
  if (chip.startsWith('sent.')) return { sentField: chip.slice('sent.'.length) };
  return { value: chip } as Expression;
}

const FLIP: Record<string, string> = { '<': '>', '>': '<', '<=': '>=', '>=': '<=', '==': '==', '!=': '!=' };

/**
 * One plain comparison of a value with a typed constant (`{{v_risk}} == "ch_risk_high"`,
 * `{{v_amount}} > 100.0`, `{{v_due}} < date("2026-12-01")`, `{{v_urgent}} == true`) as a
 * sentence of one clause; undefined for anything else, so the formula stays a formula. A date chip
 * written inside `date(...)` (formulas from before the real core, which refuses it) is still read.
 */
export function formulaToSentence(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, formula: string, env: KindEnv = {}): AnySentence | undefined {
  const side = String.raw`(date\(\s*\{\{([^}]+)\}\}\s*\)|\{\{([^}]+)\}\})`;
  const lit = String.raw`(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?|"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"|true|false|date\(\s*"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}"\s*\))`;
  let m = new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*${side}\s*(==|!=|<=|>=|<|>)\s*${lit}\s*$`).exec(formula);
  let chip: string, op: string, raw: string;
  if (m) {
    chip = (m[2] ?? m[3]) as string;
    op = m[4] as string;
    raw = m[5] as string;
  } else {
    m = new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*${lit}\s*(==|!=|<=|>=|<|>)\s*${side}\s*$`).exec(formula);
    if (!m) return undefined;
    raw = m[1] as string;
    op = FLIP[m[2] as string] as string;
    chip = (m[4] ?? m[5]) as string;
  }
  const left = leftOf(chip.trim());
  const kind = kindOfExpression(doc, left, env);
  const one = (words: Words, right?: Node): AnySentence => ({ allOf: [right === undefined ? { left, words } : { left, words, right }] as AnyClause[] });
  const isString = raw.startsWith('"');
  const str = isString ? (JSON.parse(raw) as string) : undefined;

  if (kind === 'number' && /^-?\d/.test(raw)) {
    const words = ({ '==': 'number.is', '!=': 'number.isNot', '>': 'number.isMoreThan', '<': 'number.isLessThan', '>=': 'number.isAtLeast', '<=': 'number.isAtMost' } as const)[op as '=='];
    return words ? one(words, { number: Number(raw) }) : undefined;
  }
  if ((kind === 'text' || kind === 'longText') && str !== undefined && (op === '==' || op === '!=')) {
    return one(op === '==' ? 'text.is' : 'text.isNot', { text: str });
  }
  if (kind === 'yesNo' && (raw === 'true' || raw === 'false') && (op === '==' || op === '!=')) {
    return one((raw === 'true') === (op === '==') ? 'yesNo.isYes' : 'yesNo.isNo');
  }
  if (kind === 'date' && raw.startsWith('date(')) {
    const date = /"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})"/.exec(raw)?.[1] as string;
    const words = ({ '==': 'date.is', '<': 'date.isBefore', '>': 'date.isAfter', '<=': 'date.isOnOrBefore', '>=': 'date.isOnOrAfter' } as const)[op as '=='];
    return words ? one(words, { date }) : undefined;
  }
  if (str !== undefined && (op === '==' || op === '!=')) {
    const choice = (choicesFor(doc, left, env.catalogue) ?? []).find((c) => Object.values(c.constant as Record<string, unknown>)[0] === str);
    if (choice) return one(op === '==' ? 'choice.is' : 'choice.isNot', choice.constant as Constant as Node);
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** Stand-ins for the slots the card shows, so the test sees the props each one gets. */
type Seen = { value: SlotProps['ValueField'][]; when: SlotProps['WhenBuilder'][]; message: SlotProps['MessageField'][] };
function fakeSlots(seen: Seen): Partial<Slots> {
  return {
    ValueField: (p) => {
      seen.value.push(p);
      return <button type="button">{`${p.label}: ${p.value ? JSON.stringify(p.value) : 'Choose a value'}`}</button>;
    },
    WhenBuilder: (p) => {
      seen.when.push(p);
      return <span>{p.value ? 'a when' : p.addLabel}</span>;
    },
    MessageField: (p) => {
      seen.message.push(p);
      return <span>{p.label}</span>;
    },
  };
}

async function open(services: Services, workflow: string, seen: Seen) {
  await act(() => openWorkflow(services, workflow));
  const doc = useEditor.getState().doc!;
  render(
    <SlotsProvider slots={fakeSlots(seen)}>
      <AlsoStartsFrom stageId={doc.start.stage} />
    </SlotsProvider>,
  );
  return doc;
}
