/**
 * The AlsoStartsFrom slot (src/model/slots.ts): on the start stage's panel, under "A person starts
 * it by filling in this form.", "+ Also start it from another system" and the cards it adds
 * (editor-model.md section 10, mockup 14-connections frame "starts-when"). Each card edits one
 * binding of the open draft's `start.startsWhen` with the commands of src/model/commands/start.ts:
 * "Starts when" (what the catalogue's connections offer under "Can start a request"), "+ only when
 * ..." (the WhenBuilder slot over what the other system sends), "Fill in the form from the ticket"
 * (one row per start-form question and one for the Requester, each the ValueField slot over what is
 * sent, the sample beside it, a needed question left unfilled as a To do with its fix), which button
 * it presses, the plain lines on who is told, and for the live version whether it runs.
 *
 * It reaches the services through the editor session (`sessionServices()`), so it needs no provider
 * or router above it.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Catalogue, CatalogueRef, Location, QuestionId, SentCondition, SentExpression, SentTemplate, StartsWhen,
  Trigger,
} from '@/contract';
import {
  describeExpression, describeFinding, describeStartsWhenName, describeStuckTold, findingTone, heldValueText, labelAfterConnection,
  sessionServices, Slot, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFindingsFor, useRevealRequest, useRun,
  useSessionWorkflowId, useSettings, type AlsoStartsFromProps, type DescribeEnv, type StuckPerson,
} from '@/model';
import type { Finding, SampleResult, Services } from '@/services';
import { Button, Icon, Select, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { t, words } from '@/words';
import {
  connectionLabelOf, connectionOf, entryOf, sameChoicesField, sampleName, startQuestions, startTask, triggersOf, triggerThing,
  typedChoiceLabels,
} from './catalogue';
import { LiveState } from './LiveState';
import { useNames } from './names';
import { PretendSent } from './PretendSent';
import { fieldValueText, joinNames, refsIn } from './sample';
import { phraseNodes, wordsWithPhrase } from './SettingsLink';
import { aThing, lowerFirst, upperFirst } from './text';
import s from './connections.module.css';

export function AlsoStartsFrom({ stageId }: AlsoStartsFromProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const run = useRun();
  const addRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [focusId, setFocusId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState('');
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  if (!doc || doc.start?.stage !== stageId) return null;
  const bindings = doc.start.startsWhen ?? [];
  const offered = triggersOf(catalogue);

  const add = () => {
    const made = run('startsWhen.add', {});
    if (made && 'id' in made) setFocusId(made.id);
  };
  const removed = (text: string) => {
    setSaid(t('connections.card.removed', { startsWhen: text }));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => addRef.current?.focus());
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.also}>
      {bindings.map((b) => (
        <StartsWhenCard
          key={b.id}
          doc={doc}
          binding={b}
          catalogue={catalogue}
          env={env}
          autoFocus={focusId === b.id}
          onRemoved={removed}
        />
      ))}
      {offered.length > 0 ? (
        <button ref={addRef} type="button" className={s.addLink} onClick={add}>
          {t('connections.add')}
        </button>
      ) : (
        catalogue && <p className={s.note}>{t('connections.add.none')}</p>
      )}
      <p role="status" className="visually-hidden">
        {said}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

type CardProps = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  binding: StartsWhen;
  catalogue: Catalogue | null;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  autoFocus: boolean;
  onRemoved(said: string): void;
};

function StartsWhenCard({ doc, binding, catalogue, env, autoFocus, onRemoved }: CardProps) {
  const run = useRun();
  const services = sessionServices();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const settings = useSettings();
  const selectId = useId();
  const titleId = useId();
  const selectRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null);
  const findings = useFindingsFor(binding.id, { deep: true });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoFocus) selectRef.current?.focus();
  }, [autoFocus]);

  // "Show me" on this Starts when (from the Connections page, To do ...): bring the card into view.
  const revealed = useRevealRequest();
  const sectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (revealed?.location.item !== binding.id) return;
    sectionRef.current?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'start' });
    selectRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    // Only a new request (its nonce) brings it into view again.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [revealed?.nonce]);

  // "Only when" labels the builder as soon as "+ only when ..." opens it, before anything is chosen
  // (the builder keeps an opened, empty sentence to itself until it has a part).
  const onlyWhenRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const onlyWhenOpen = useBuilderOpen(onlyWhenRef, !!binding.trigger);

  const found = entryOf(catalogue, binding.trigger);
  const trigger: Trigger | undefined = found?.kind === 'trigger' ? found : undefined;
  const isTrigger = !!trigger;
  const connection = binding.trigger ? connectionLabelOf(catalogue, binding.trigger) : '';
  const thing = triggerThing(catalogue, binding.trigger) ?? connection;
  // "Starts when Helpdesk: a ticket is created": the connection named once, for the buttons' names and what is said on removal.
  const said = toText(describeStartsWhenName(binding, env));

  // Who is told: everyone in "Stuck requests go to" (absent or empty: the authors), groups marked, in
  // the model's one sentence (describeStuckTold): "Platform team, who look after stuck requests, are told".
  const goTo = useMemo(
    () => (settings?.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : (settings?.authors ?? [])),
    [settings],
  );
  const nameOf = useNames(services, goTo);
  const stuckPeople: StuckPerson[] = goTo.flatMap((r) => {
    const name = nameOf(r);
    return name ? [{ name, ...(r.type === 'group' ? { group: true } : {}) }] : [];
  });
  const told = describeStuckTold(stuckPeople, { settingsHint: true });
  const findingEnv = { ...env, stuckPeople };

  const notFilled = findings.find((f) => f.code === 'startsWhen.neededNotFilled' && f.location?.item === binding.id);
  const others = findings.filter(
    (f) => f !== notFilled && !(f.location?.part ?? '').startsWith('onlyWhen'),
  );

  const options = [
    ...(binding.trigger ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('connections.startsWhen.choose') }]),
    ...(binding.trigger && !isTrigger ? [{ value: binding.trigger, label: t('connections.startsWhen.unknown') }] : []),
    ...triggersOf(catalogue).map((e) => {
      const conn = connectionOf(catalogue, e.connection);
      const key =
        e.status === 'disabled' || conn?.status === 'disabled'
          ? 'connections.startsWhen.optionOff'
          : conn?.status === 'notSetUp'
            ? 'connections.startsWhen.optionNotSetUp'
            : 'connections.startsWhen.option';
      const label = conn?.label ?? e.connection;
      return { value: e.id, label: t(key, { connection: label, trigger: lowerFirst(labelAfterConnection(catalogue ?? undefined, e.id) || e.label) }) };
    }),
  ];

  const task = startTask(doc);
  const buttons = task?.buttons ?? [];
  const pressed = buttons.find((b) => b.id === binding.button) ?? (buttons.length === 1 ? buttons[0] : undefined);

  const remove = () => {
    run('startsWhen.remove', { binding: binding.id });
    onRemoved(said);
  };

  return (
    <section ref={sectionRef} className={s.swCard} aria-labelledby={titleId} aria-describedby={`${titleId}-said`}>
      <div className={s.swHead}>
        <Icon name="connected" size={15} />
        <h3 id={titleId} className={s.swTitle}>
          {t('connections.card.title')}
        </h3>
        <span id={`${titleId}-said`} className="visually-hidden">
          {said}
        </span>
        <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" aria-label={t('connections.card.removeName', { startsWhen: said })} onClick={remove}>
          {t('connections.card.remove')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className={s.swBody}>
        <div className={s.swRow}>
          <label className={s.swLabel} htmlFor={selectId}>
            {t('connections.startsWhen')}
          </label>
          <Select
            ref={selectRef}
            id={selectId}
            className={s.select}
            options={options}
            value={binding.trigger ?? ''}
            onChange={(e) => run('startsWhen.setTrigger', { binding: binding.id, trigger: (e.target.value || null) as CatalogueRef | null })}
          />
        </div>

        {binding.trigger && (
          <div className={s.swRow}>
            <span className={s.swLabel}>{binding.onlyWhen || onlyWhenOpen ? t('connections.onlyWhen') : ''}</span>
            {/* Named "Only when" for a screen reader, also while empty and only "+ only when ..." shows. */}
            <div className={s.onlyWhen} ref={onlyWhenRef} role="group" aria-label={t('connections.onlyWhen')}>
              <Slot
                name="WhenBuilder"
                at={{ item: binding.id, part: 'onlyWhen' }}
                sent={binding.trigger}
                addLabel={t('word.onlyWhen')}
                value={binding.onlyWhen}
                onChange={(next: SentCondition | undefined) =>
                  run('startsWhen.setOnlyWhen', next ? { binding: binding.id, onlyWhen: next } : { binding: binding.id })
                }
              />
              {binding.onlyWhen && <span className={s.note}>{t('connections.onlyWhen.others')}</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {others.length > 0 && <Findings doc={doc} findings={others} env={findingEnv} />}

        <h4 className={s.fillHead}>
          {thing ? t('connections.fill.heading', { thing: lowerFirst(thing) }) : t('connections.fill.headingNone')}
        </h4>
        {!binding.trigger || !trigger || !catalogue ? (
          <p className={s.note}>{t('connections.fill.needsTrigger')}</p>
        ) : (
          <FillTable
            doc={doc}
            binding={binding}
            trigger={trigger}
            thing={thing}
            connection={connection}
            catalogue={catalogue}
            env={env}
            notFilled={notFilled}
            findingEnv={findingEnv}
            services={services}
          />
        )}

        {buttons.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={s.plain}>{t('connections.button.none')}</p>
        ) : buttons.length === 1 && pressed ? (
          <p className={s.plain}>{t('connections.button.goesOn', { button: pressed.label || t('describe.noName') })}</p>
        ) : (
          <ButtonChoice binding={binding} buttons={buttons} />
        )}

        {binding.trigger && (
          <div className={s.box}>
            <Icon name="info" size={14} />
            <div>
              <p>
                <strong>{t('connections.refusedLine.lead', { aThing: aThing(thing) })}</strong>{' '}
                {wordsWithPhrase('connections.refusedLine.rest', 'told', told, { connection })}
              </p>
              {binding.onlyWhen && <p>{t('connections.notFitLine', { aThing: upperFirst(aThing(thing)) })}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <LiveState services={services} workflowId={workflowId} binding={binding.id} connection={connection} said={said} thing={thing} />

        {trigger && catalogue && <PretendSent services={services} catalogue={catalogue} trigger={trigger} />}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Whether the WhenBuilder slot inside `ref` shows more than its one "+ only when ..." button: it is
 * open (empty or not). Watched, since the slot keeps that state to itself.
 */
function useBuilderOpen(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, active: boolean): boolean {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!active || !el) return;
    const look = () => {
      const root = el.firstElementChild;
      const onlyAdd = !!root && root.children.length === 1 && root.firstElementChild?.tagName === 'BUTTON';
      setOpen(!!root && !onlyAdd);
    };
    look();
    const watch = new MutationObserver(look);
    watch.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    return () => watch.disconnect();
  }, [ref, active]);
  return open;
}

function ButtonChoice({ binding, buttons }: { binding: StartsWhen; buttons: { id: ButtonId; label: string }[] }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const id = useId();
  const options = [
    ...(binding.button ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('connections.button.chooseNone') }]),
    ...buttons.map((b) => ({ value: b.id, label: b.label || t('describe.noName') })),
  ];
  return (
    <div>
      <label className={s.plain} htmlFor={id}>
        {t('connections.button.choose')}
      </label>
      <Select
        id={id}
        options={options}
        value={binding.button ?? ''}
        onChange={(e) =>
          run('startsWhen.setButton', e.target.value ? { binding: binding.id, button: e.target.value as ButtonId } : { binding: binding.id })
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function Findings({ doc, findings, env }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; findings: Finding[]; env: Parameters<typeof describeFinding>[2] }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.findings} role="group" aria-label={t('connections.findings')}>
      {findings.map((f, i) => {
        const said = describeFinding(doc, f, env);
        const tone = findingTone(f);
        const cls = tone === 'worthKnowing' ? s.worth : tone === 'contradictory' ? s.red : s.todo;
        return (
          <p key={`${f.code}-${i}`} className={`${s.finding} ${cls}`}>
            <Icon name={tone === 'worthKnowing' ? 'info' : tone === 'contradictory' ? 'error' : 'todo'} size={14} />
            <span>
              <strong>{t(tone === 'worthKnowing' ? 'connections.worth' : 'connections.todo')}</strong> {phraseNodes(said.causeParts)}
            </span>
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---- "Fill in the form from the ticket" ------------------------------------------------------------

const KIND_ICON: Record<string, IconName> = {
  text: 'text', longText: 'longtext', number: 'number', yesNo: 'yesno', date: 'date', choice: 'choice',
  multipleChoice: 'multichoice', person: 'person', group: 'group',
};

/** A formula (`{ formula, readsAs }`) rather than a sent field, a constant or a text. */
const isFormula = (x: unknown): boolean => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x) && 'formula' in x;

type FillProps = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  binding: StartsWhen;
  trigger: Trigger;
  thing: string;
  connection: string;
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  notFilled: Finding | undefined;
  findingEnv: Parameters<typeof describeFinding>[2];
  services: Services | null;
};

function FillTable({ doc, binding, trigger, thing, connection, catalogue, env, notFilled, findingEnv, services }: FillProps) {
  const run = useRun();
  const questions = startQuestions(doc);
  const lowered = lowerFirst(thing);
  const sampleId = sampleName(trigger);
  const sentEnv = useMemo(() => ({ ...env, trigger: binding.trigger }), [env, binding.trigger]);
  const unfilled = new Set<string>(
    ((notFilled?.params as { questions?: string[] } | undefined)?.questions ?? []),
  );
  const refs = useMemo(() => refsIn(trigger.sample?.event), [trigger]);
  const nameOf = useNames(services, refs);
  const rowRefs = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLElement>());
  const openField = (key: string) => {
    const row = rowRefs.current.get(key);
    row?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-from] button, [data-from] [contenteditable], [data-from] [role="textbox"]')?.click();
  };
  const focusField = (key: string) =>
    requestAnimationFrame(() => rowRefs.current.get(key)?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-from] button, [data-from] [role="textbox"]')?.focus());

  const fromLabel = (question: string) => t('connections.fill.fieldLabel', { question, thing: lowered });
  const sampleHead = sampleId ? t('connections.fill.sample', { thing: lowered, id: sampleId }) : t('connections.fill.sampleAlone');

  return (
    <>
      <table className={s.fill} role="table">
        <thead role="rowgroup">
          <tr role="row">
            <th scope="col" role="columnheader">{t('connections.fill.question')}</th>
            <th scope="col" role="columnheader">{t('connections.fill.from', { thing: lowered })}</th>
            <th scope="col" role="columnheader" className={s.sampleHead}>
              {sampleHead}
            </th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody role="rowgroup">
          <tr role="row" ref={(el) => void (el ? rowRefs.current.set('requester', el) : rowRefs.current.delete('requester'))}>
            <th scope="row" role="rowheader">
              <span className={s.qName}>
                <Icon name="person" size={14} />
                {t('connections.fill.requester')}
              </span>
            </th>
            <td role="cell" data-from="" className={s.from}>
              <Slot
                name="ValueField"
                at={{ item: binding.id, part: 'requester' }}
                label={fromLabel(t('connections.fill.requester'))}
                placeholder={t('connections.fill.choosePerson')}
                accepts={['person']}
                look="chip"
                sent={binding.trigger!}
                value={binding.requester}
                onChange={(next: SentExpression | undefined) =>
                  run('startsWhen.setRequester', next ? { binding: binding.id, requester: next } : { binding: binding.id })
                }
              />
            </td>
            <td role="cell" className={s.sampleCell}>
              <SampleCell
                doc={doc}
                catalogue={catalogue}
                services={services}
                at={{ item: binding.id, part: 'requester' }}
                what={binding.requester}
                trigger={trigger}
                nameOf={nameOf}
                question={t('connections.fill.requester')}
              />
            </td>
          </tr>
          {questions.map((q) => {
            const answer = binding.answers?.[q.id as QuestionId];
            const at: Location = { item: binding.id, part: `answers.${q.id}` };
            const name = q.label || t('describe.noName');
            const todo = unfilled.has(q.id) && answer === undefined;
            const wide = isFormula(answer);
            const setRow = (el: HTMLElement | null) => void (el ? rowRefs.current.set(q.id, el) : rowRefs.current.delete(q.id));
            const head = (
              <th scope="row" role="rowheader" colSpan={wide ? 3 : undefined}>
                <span className={s.qName}>
                  <Icon name={KIND_ICON[q.kind] ?? 'text'} size={14} />
                  {name}
                </span>
              </th>
            );
            const sampleCell = (
              <SampleCell doc={doc} catalogue={catalogue} services={services} at={at} what={answer} trigger={trigger} nameOf={nameOf} question={name} />
            );
            if (wide) {
              // A formula needs the card's full width: the question on one row, the formula under it.
              return [
                <tr role="row" key={q.id} className={s.wideHead}>
                  {head}
                </tr>,
                <tr role="row" key={`${q.id}-formula`} ref={setRow}>
                  <td role="cell" colSpan={3} data-from="" className={s.wideCell}>
                    <Slot
                      name="ValueField"
                      at={at}
                      label={fromLabel(name)}
                      look="chip"
                      allowTyped
                      sent={binding.trigger!}
                      value={answer as SentExpression}
                      onChange={(next: SentExpression | undefined) =>
                        next
                          ? run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId, answer: next })
                          : run('startsWhen.clearAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId })
                      }
                    />
                    {sampleCell}
                  </td>
                </tr>,
              ];
            }
            return [
              <tr role="row" key={q.id} ref={setRow}>
                {head}
                <td role="cell" data-from="" className={Array.isArray(answer) ? s.fromText : s.from}>
                  {Array.isArray(answer) ? (
                    <Slot
                      name="MessageField"
                      at={at}
                      label={fromLabel(name)}
                      sent={binding.trigger!}
                      value={answer as SentTemplate}
                      onChange={(next: SentTemplate | undefined) =>
                        next
                          ? run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId, answer: next })
                          : run('startsWhen.clearAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <Slot
                      name="ValueField"
                      at={at}
                      label={fromLabel(name)}
                      look="chip"
                      allowTyped
                      sent={binding.trigger!}
                      value={answer as SentExpression | undefined}
                      onChange={(next: SentExpression | undefined) =>
                        next
                          ? run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId, answer: next })
                          : run('startsWhen.clearAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId })
                      }
                    />
                  )}
                </td>
                <td role="cell" className={s.sampleCell}>{sampleCell}</td>
              </tr>,
              todo && notFilled && (
                <tr role="row" key={`${q.id}-todo`}>
                  <td role="cell" className={s.todoGap} />
                  <td role="cell" colSpan={2}>
                    <RowTodo
                      doc={doc}
                      finding={notFilled}
                      question={q.id}
                      env={findingEnv}
                      sentEnv={sentEnv}
                      trigger={trigger}
                      onUse={(field) => {
                        run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: binding.id, question: q.id as QuestionId, answer: { sentField: field } });
                        focusField(q.id);
                      }}
                      onChoose={() => openField(q.id)}
                    />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ),
            ];
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      {questions.length === 0 && <p className={s.note}>{t('connections.fill.noQuestions')}</p>}
      <p className={s.note}>
        {binding.requester ? t('connections.fill.recordedBy', { connection }) : t('connections.fill.requesterNone', { connection })}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

/** "To do: Risk is needed to press Submit, but nothing from the ticket fills it." with its fix. */
function RowTodo({
  doc, finding, question, env, sentEnv, trigger, onUse, onChoose,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  finding: Finding;
  question: string;
  env: Parameters<typeof describeFinding>[2];
  sentEnv: DescribeEnv;
  trigger: Trigger;
  onUse(field: string): void;
  onChoose(): void;
}) {
  const one = { ...finding, params: { ...(finding.params as object), questions: [question] } } as Finding;
  const said = describeFinding(doc, one, env);
  const q = startQuestions(doc).find((x) => x.id === question);
  const same = q ? sameChoicesField(q, trigger.event) : undefined;
  const sameName = same ? toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: same.id }, sentEnv)) : '';
  return (
    <div className={s.rowTodo}>
      <p className={s.rowTodoHead}>
        <Icon name="todo" size={14} />
        <span>
          <strong>{t('connections.fill.todo')}</strong> {phraseNodes(said.causeParts)}
        </span>
      </p>
      <div className={s.fix}>
        {same ? (
          <>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onUse(same.id)}>
              {t('connections.fill.use', { sent: sameName })}
            </Button>
            <span>{t('connections.fill.sameChoices', { choices: joinNames(typedChoiceLabels(q!) ?? []) })}</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          said.fix && (
            <Button size="sm" onClick={onChoose}>
              {said.fix.label}
            </Button>
          )
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** What fills the question for the trigger's sample, worked out by the core (`evaluateSent`). */
function SampleCell({
  doc, catalogue, services, at, what, trigger, nameOf, question,
}: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  services: Services | null;
  at: Location;
  what: SentExpression | SentTemplate | undefined;
  trigger: Trigger;
  nameOf: (r: { type: 'user' | 'group'; id: string }) => string | undefined;
  question: string;
}) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<SampleResult | null>(null);
  const key = JSON.stringify(what ?? null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!services || what === undefined) return;
    let alive = true;
    services.core
      .evaluateSent(doc, catalogue, at, what)
      .then((r) => alive && setResult(r))
      .catch(() => alive && setResult({ result: 'absent' }));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
    // `key` stands for `what`; the document matters only through it here.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, catalogue, key, at.item, at.part]);
  const sentField =
    what && !Array.isArray(what) && 'sentField' in what ? trigger.event.find((f) => f.id === what.sentField) : undefined;
  // A value in words, never an ID: a sent choice by the catalogue's label for it; anything else (a
  // typed-in choice or list row, a person, a date ...) through the model's one helper.
  const inWords = (value: unknown, field?: typeof sentField) =>
    field?.choices ? fieldValueText(field, value, nameOf) : heldValueText(doc, value, { nameOf });
  let text: string;
  if (what === undefined) text = '';
  else if (!result) text = words['describe.gap'];
  else if (result.result === 'value' && Array.isArray(what) && Array.isArray(result.value)) {
    // A template: its parts run together as one text.
    // Each part is text, or a value as `{ value, kind }`.
    text = result.value
      .map((part) => {
        if (typeof part === 'string') return part;
        const inner = part && typeof part === 'object' && !Array.isArray(part) && 'value' in part ? part.value : part;
        return inWords(inner);
      })
      .join('');
  } else if (result.result === 'value') text = inWords(result.value, sentField);
  else if (result.result === 'absent') text = t('connections.fill.sampleNone');
  else text = t('connections.fill.sampleProblem');
  if (!text) return null;
  return (
    <span className={s.sample} title={t('connections.fill.sampleLabel', { question, sample: text })}>
      {text}
    </span>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/ConnectionCard.tsx\n===
/**
 * One connection on the Connections page: name, one line on what it is, its status in words ("Set
 * up by an administrator", "Not set up yet", "Turned off by an administrator" and what that means
 * for workflows that use it), what it offers under the four sorts, and "Used by" (the workflows, by
 * name). One with an event sink says "Is told what happened"; the one the catalogue names as carrying
 * Notify (notifyConnection) says "Carries messages: Notify uses it ..." and is used by every workflow
 * that has a Notify (listed, each a link to its first Notify). One that offers nothing to pick says
 * so and has no "Used by". No connection is named here: which one is which comes from the catalogue.
 */
import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Connection, Location } from '@/contract';
import { kindOfId, locationCrumbs, reveal, useEditor } from '@/model';
import type { Services } from '@/services';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { t, words } from '@/words';
import { notifiesIn, offeringsOf, roleOf, toldIn, usesIn, usesOfConnection } from './catalogue';
import { SORT_ICON } from './Explainer';
import { Offering } from './Offering';
import { joinNames } from './sample';
import { firstSentence } from './text';
import s from './connections.module.css';

export type DraftOf = { id: string; name: string; doc: AuthoredWorkflow };
export type Drafts = { status: 'loading' } | { status: 'error' } | { status: 'ready'; workflows: DraftOf[] };

type Props = { services: Services; catalogue: Catalogue; connection: Connection; drafts: Drafts };

export function ConnectionCard({ services, catalogue, connection, drafts }: Props) {
  const role = roleOf(catalogue, connection);
  const isDirectory = connection.id === catalogue.directoryConnection;
  const offered = offeringsOf(catalogue, connection.id);
  // The directory also gives "Who is asked: the members of a group" (mockup 14, the Directory card).
  const groups = isDirectory && !offered.some((g) => g.sort === 'read') ? [{ sort: 'read' as const, entries: [] }, ...offered] : offered;
  const headId = `connection-${connection.id}`;
  const what = firstSentence(connection.description);
  return (
    <article className={s.card} aria-labelledby={headId}>
      <div className={s.cardHead}>
        <span className={s.connIcon} aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name={role === 'listens' ? 'outbox' : role === 'messages' ? 'notify' : 'connected'} size={16} />
        </span>
        <h2 id={headId} className={s.cardName}>
          {connection.label}
        </h2>
        <span className={s.status}>
          <span className={`${s.dot} ${s[connection.status]}`} aria-hidden="true" />
          {t(`connections.status.${connection.status}`)}
        </span>
      </div>
      {what && <p className={s.what}>{what}</p>}
      <p className={`${s.setUp} ${connection.status === 'ready' ? '' : s.warn}`}>
        <Icon name={connection.status === 'ready' ? 'lock' : 'warning'} size={13} />
        <span>{t(`connections.setUp.${connection.status}`)}</span>
      </p>

      <div className={s.offers}>
        {role === 'listens' && <Listens drafts={drafts} />}
        {role === 'messages' && <CarriesMessages headId={headId} />}
        {role === 'none' && <p className={s.note}>{t('connections.offers.nothingToPick')}</p>}
        {role === 'offers' && groups.length === 0 && <p className={s.note}>{t('connections.offers.none')}</p>}
        {groups.map((g) => (
          <section key={g.sort} className={s.offerSort} aria-labelledby={`${headId}-${g.sort}`}>
            <h3 id={`${headId}-${g.sort}`} className={s.sortHead}>
              <Icon name={SORT_ICON[g.sort]} size={14} />
              {t(`connections.sort.${g.sort}`)}
            </h3>
            <ul className={s.offerList}>
              {g.entries.map((e) => (
                <li key={e.id}>
                  <Offering services={services} catalogue={catalogue} entry={e} />
                </li>
              ))}
              {isDirectory && g.sort === 'read' && (
                <li className={s.offerPlain}>
                  <span className={s.prefix}>{t('connections.directory.whoIsAsked')}</span> {t('connections.directory.members')}
                </li>
              )}
            </ul>
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>

      {role !== 'none' && <UsedBy catalogue={catalogue} connection={connection} role={role} drafts={drafts} />}
    </article>
  );
}

/**
 * The connection the catalogue names as carrying Notify (`notifyConnection`), in the same form as
 * what the other cards offer: "Carries messages", then "Notify uses it ...".
 */
function CarriesMessages({ headId }: { headId: string }) {
  return (
    <section className={s.offerSort} aria-labelledby={`${headId}-messages`}>
      <h3 id={`${headId}-messages`} className={s.sortHead}>
        <Icon name={SORT_ICON.messages} size={14} />
        {t('connections.sort.messages')}
      </h3>
      <ul className={s.offerList}>
        <li className={s.offerPlain} data-carries="notify">
          <span className={s.prefix}>{t('connections.messages.notify')}</span> {t('connections.messages.usesIt')}
        </li>
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

function Receiver({ sort, lines }: { sort: 'listens' | 'messages'; lines: ReactNode[] }) {
  return (
    <section className={s.offerSort}>
      <h3 className={s.sortHead}>
        <Icon name={SORT_ICON[sort]} size={14} />
        {t(`connections.sort.${sort}`)}
      </h3>
      {lines.map((line, i) => (
        <p key={i} className={s.plainLine}>
          {line}
        </p>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

/** "Always told: ..." and what "Tell other systems" adds, from the workflows. */
function Listens({ drafts }: { drafts: Drafts }) {
  const told =
    drafts.status === 'ready'
      ? drafts.workflows
          .map((w) => ({ name: w.name, things: toldIn(w.doc).map((x) => x.words).filter(Boolean) }))
          .filter((w) => w.things.length > 0)
          .map((w) => t('connections.listens.told', { workflow: w.name, things: joinNames(w.things) }))
      : [];
  const hears =
    drafts.status !== 'ready'
      ? words['describe.gap']
      : told.length
        ? t('connections.listens.hearsWhat', { list: joinNames(told) })
        : t('connections.listens.hearsNone');
  return (
    <Receiver
      sort="listens"
      lines={[
        <>
          <strong>{t('connections.listens.always')}</strong> {t('connections.listens.alwaysWhat')}
        </>,
        <>
          <strong>{t('connections.listens.hears')}</strong> {hears}
        </>,
        t('connections.listens.never'),
      ]}
    />
  );
}

type Place = { workflow: DraftOf; locations: Location[] };

function UsedBy({ catalogue, connection, role, drafts }: { catalogue: Catalogue; connection: Connection; role: string; drafts: Drafts }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const places = useMemo<Place[]>(() => {
    if (drafts.status !== 'ready') return [];
    return drafts.workflows
      .map((w) => ({
        workflow: w,
        locations:
          role === 'listens'
            ? toldIn(w.doc).map((x) => x.location)
            : role === 'messages'
              ? notifiesIn(w.doc)
              : usesOfConnection(usesIn(w.doc, catalogue), catalogue, connection.id).map((u) => u.location),
      }))
      .filter((p) => p.locations.length > 0);
  }, [drafts, catalogue, connection.id, role]);

  const go = (workflowId: string, location: Location) => {
    const show = () => {
      reveal(location);
      // The panel shows a stage; a Starts when sits on the start stage's panel, which its card then scrolls to.
      const doc = useEditor.getState().doc;
      if (doc && kindOfId(location.item) === 'startsWhen') useEditor.getState().select({ item: doc.start.stage });
    };
    // The editor frame opens the workflow when it mounts (and again under StrictMode, and each load
    // clears the selection), so the place is shown after every load of this workflow that follows,
    // for a short while.
    const stop = useEditor.subscribe((now, before) => {
      // A load (also one of the same workflow over itself) brings a new doc with no history and no selection.
      const loaded =
        now.workflowId === workflowId && !!now.doc && now.doc !== before.doc && now.lastChange === null && now.past.length === 0;
      if (loaded) queueMicrotask(show);
    });
    setTimeout(stop, 3000);
    navigate(`/w/${encodeURIComponent(workflowId)}`);
  };

  let body: ReactNode;
  // Every Notify of every workflow goes through the one that carries messages (contract: notifyConnection):
  // "Used by every workflow that has a Notify: Service change and Change request".
  const every = role === 'messages' ? <>{t('connections.usedBy.everyNotify')} </> : null;
  if (drafts.status === 'loading') body = <span role="status">{t('connections.usedBy.loading')}</span>;
  else if (drafts.status === 'error') body = t('connections.usedBy.error');
  else if (places.length === 0) body = role === 'messages' ? t('connections.usedBy.everyNotifyNone') : t('connections.usedBy.none');
  else
    body = (
      // "Used by Change request, Access request and New starter" (mockup 14): each workflow by name,
      // a link that opens it at the first place it uses this connection.
      <ul>
        {places.map((p, i) => {
          const first = p.locations[0]!;
          const stage = locationCrumbs(p.workflow.doc, first, { catalogue })[0];
          const href = `/w/${encodeURIComponent(p.workflow.id)}`;
          return (
            <li key={p.workflow.id}>
              {i > 0 && (i === places.length - 1 ? ` ${words['describe.and']} ` : words['describe.comma'])}
              <Link
                className={s.link}
                to={href}
                // Which connection is said too: two cards can link to the same stage of the same workflow.
                aria-label={
                  stage
                    ? t('connections.usedBy.openAt', { workflow: p.workflow.name, place: stage, connection: connection.label })
                    : t('connections.usedBy.open', { workflow: p.workflow.name, connection: connection.label })
                }
                onClick={(e) => {
                  if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
                  e.preventDefault();
                  go(p.workflow.id, first);
                }}
              >
                {p.workflow.name}
              </Link>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    );

  return (
    <div className={s.usedBy}>
      {t('connections.usedBy')} {every}
      {body}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Route "/connections" (editor-model.md section 10, mockup 14-connections, frame "connections"):
 * read-only for authors. First "What a connection can offer" (the four sorts in the author's words,
 * the two that only receive, and a small picture of which way things go), then one card per
 * connection of the catalogue (services `catalogue.getCatalogue`): its name, one line on what it is,
 * who set it up and what its status means, what it offers under the four sorts (each opens to what
 * it needs and gives back), and "Used by" (read from the drafts through `services.authoring`, each
 * place a link into the editor with that place revealed). Nothing here names a connection.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { useServices, type Services } from '@/services';
import { Button, Callout, EmptyState, Icon, Page } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { ConnectionCard, type Drafts } from './ConnectionCard';
import { Explainer } from './Explainer';
import s from './connections.module.css';

type Loaded = { status: 'loading' } | { status: 'error' } | { status: 'ready'; catalogue: Catalogue };

/** The drafts of every workflow the signed-in person can see, for "Used by". */
function useDrafts(services: Services): Drafts {
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<Drafts>({ status: 'loading' });
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    (async () => {
      const list = await services.authoring.listWorkflows();
      if (!list.ok) throw new Error('list');
      const docs = await Promise.all(
        list.value.map(async (w) => {
          const d = await services.authoring.getDraft(w.id);
          return d.ok ? { id: w.id, name: w.name, doc: d.value.authored as AuthoredWorkflow } : undefined;
        }),
      );
      if (alive) setDrafts({ status: 'ready', workflows: docs.filter((d) => d !== undefined) });
    })().catch(() => alive && setDrafts({ status: 'error' }));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services]);
  return drafts;
}

export function ConnectionsPage() {
  const services = useServices();
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<Loaded>({ status: 'loading' });
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const drafts = useDrafts(services);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    services.catalogue
      .getCatalogue()
      .then((r) => alive && setLoaded(r.ok ? { status: 'ready', catalogue: r.value } : { status: 'error' }))
      .catch(() => alive && setLoaded({ status: 'error' }));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services, attempt]);

  const retry = useCallback(() => {
    setLoaded({ status: 'loading' });
    setAttempt((n) => n + 1);
  }, []);

  return (
    <Page
      title={t('connections.title')}
      lead={t('connections.lead')}
      actions={
        <p className={s.adminNote}>
          <Icon name="lock" size={14} />
          {t('connections.adminNote')}
        </p>
      }
    >
      <Explainer />
      {loaded.status === 'loading' && (
        <p role="status" className={s.note}>
          {t('connections.loading')}
        </p>
      )}
      {loaded.status === 'error' && (
        <Callout tone="danger" actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={retry}>{t('connections.retry')}</Button>}>
          {t('connections.error')}
        </Callout>
      )}
      {loaded.status === 'ready' &&
        (loaded.catalogue.connections.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon="connected" title={t('connections.none.title')}>
            {t('connections.none.text')}
          </EmptyState>
        ) : (
          <ul className={s.grid} aria-label={t('connections.list')}>
            {loaded.catalogue.connections.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id}>
                <ConnectionCard services={services} catalogue={loaded.catalogue} connection={c} drafts={drafts} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ))}
    </Page>
  );
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/LiveState.tsx\n===
/**
 * On a "Starts when" card: whether that Starts when is running or paused in the live version
 * (services `runtime.listBindings`), Pause and Resume for the people who look after stuck requests
 * (`runtime.setBindingPaused`), what pausing does in the words runtime-api.md 5.3 supports, and a
 * link to the refused starts on the Requests page.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { StartsWhenId } from '@/contract';
import { formatDate, useSettings, useVersions } from '@/model';
import type { BindingState, PausedDelivery, Person, Ref, RequestRow, Services } from '@/services';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { useNames } from './names';
import { noteToggled, sentName, useSends } from './sends';
import s from './connections.module.css';

type Props = {
  services: Services | null;
  workflowId: string | null;
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** The connection's label, e.g. for "what Helpdesk sends". */
  connection: string;
  /** "Starts when Helpdesk: ...", for the buttons' names. */
  said: string;
  /** What the trigger is about ("Ticket"), for naming a kept item. */
  thing?: string;
};

type Live = { status: 'loading' } | { status: 'error' } | { status: 'ready'; state: BindingState | undefined };

/** May the signed-in person pause and resume: a platform admin, or among "Stuck requests go to" (absent: the authors), groups looked up. */
function useMayPause(services: Services | null): boolean {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const [may, setMay] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!services || !settings) return;
    let alive = true;
    const goTo: Ref[] = settings.stuckRequestsGoTo ?? settings.authors ?? [];
    (async () => {
      const me: Person = await services.session.whoAmI();
      if (me.platformAdmin) return true;
      if (goTo.some((r) => r.type === 'user' && r.id === me.ref.id)) return true;
      for (const group of goTo.filter((r) => r.type === 'group')) {
        const members = await services.directory.membersOf(group).catch(() => []);
        if (members.some((m) => m.id === me.ref.id)) return true;
      }
      return false;
    })()
      .then((ok) => alive && setMay(ok))
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services, settings]);
  return may;
}

export function LiveState({ services, workflowId, binding, connection, said, thing }: Props) {
  const { live } = useVersions();
  const [state, setState] = useState<Live>({ status: 'loading' });
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [started, setStarted] = useState<RequestRow[]>([]);
  const may = useMayPause(services);
  // Whether a paused Starts when keeps what is sent (and runs it on Resume), as the runtime says.
  const keeps = services ? services.runtime.whilePaused === 'kept' : undefined;
  const changedBy = state.status === 'ready' ? state.state?.changedBy : undefined;
  const nameOf = useNames(services, changedBy ? [changedBy] : []);
  // Something was sent from the development host: what is kept may have changed.
  const sends = useSends();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!services || !workflowId || !live) return;
    let alive = true;
    services.runtime
      .listBindings({ workflow: workflowId })
      .then((r) => alive && setState(r.ok ? { status: 'ready', state: r.value.find((b) => b.binding === binding) } : { status: 'error' }))
      .catch(() => alive && setState({ status: 'error' }));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services, workflowId, live, binding, sends]);

  if (!live) {
    return (
      <section className={s.live} aria-label={t('connections.live.heading')}>
        <p className={s.liveState}>
          <Icon name="info" size={14} />
          {t('connections.live.notLive')}
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  async function toggle(paused: boolean) {
    if (!services || !workflowId) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage(null);
    setStarted([]);
    try {
      const r = await services.runtime.setBindingPaused({ workflow: workflowId, binding, paused });
      if (!r.ok) {
        setMessage(r.errors[0]?.code === 'not-admin' ? t('connections.live.notAdmin') : t('connections.live.failed'));
        return;
      }
      setState({ status: 'ready', state: r.value });
      noteToggled();
      if (keeps === false) setMessage(t(paused ? 'connections.live.pausedDoneRefused' : 'connections.live.resumedRefused', { connection }));
      else if (paused) setMessage(t('connections.live.pausedDone', { connection }));
      else {
        const rerun = r.value.rerun ?? 0;
        const gone = r.value.gone ?? 0;
        // What was run again and started a request: the requests of this workflow started since the resume.
        const since = r.value.changedAt;
        const rows =
          rerun > 0 && since
            ? await services.runtime
                .listRequests({ workflow: workflowId, sort: 'startedAt', order: 'desc', limit: Math.min(200, rerun) })
                .then((x) => (x.ok ? x.value.items.filter((row) => row.startedAt >= since && row.startedBy.type === 'connection') : []))
                .catch(() => [] as RequestRow[])
            : [];
        const first =
          rerun === 0
            ? t('connections.live.resumedNone')
            : rows.length === 0
              ? t('connections.live.resumedNoneStarted', { n: rerun })
              : t(rows.length === 1 ? 'connections.live.resumedStartedOne' : 'connections.live.resumedStarted', { n: rerun, started: rows.length });
        setMessage(gone > 0 ? `${first} ${t('connections.live.gone', { n: gone })}` : first);
        setStarted(rows.reverse());
      }
    } catch {
      setMessage(t('connections.live.failed'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const refusedHref = workflowId ? `#/requests?workflow=${encodeURIComponent(workflowId)}&show=refused` : undefined;
  let body;
  if (state.status === 'loading') body = <p className={s.liveState} role="status">{t('connections.live.loading')}</p>;
  else if (state.status === 'error') body = <p className={s.liveState}>{t('connections.live.error')}</p>;
  else if (!state.state) {
    body = (
      <p className={s.liveState}>
        <Icon name="info" size={14} />
        {t('connections.live.notInLive', { n: live })}
      </p>
    );
  } else {
    const b = state.state;
    const changed =
      b.changedBy && b.changedAt
        ? t(b.paused ? 'connections.live.changedPaused' : 'connections.live.changedResumed', {
            name: nameOf(b.changedBy) ?? t('connections.live.someone'),
            when: whenSaid(b.changedAt),
          })
        : '';
    body = (
      <>
        <p className={s.liveState}>
          <Icon name={b.paused ? 'clock' : 'play'} size={14} />
          <span>
            <strong>
              {b.paused
                ? t(keeps === false ? 'connections.live.pausedRefused' : 'connections.live.paused', { connection })
                : t('connections.live.running', { n: b.version, connection })}
            </strong>
            {keeps !== false && b.paused && b.held > 0 && <> {t(b.held === 1 ? 'connections.live.held.one' : 'connections.live.held.many', { n: b.held })}</>}
            {changed && <> {changed}</>}
          </span>
        </p>
        {keeps !== false && b.paused && may && <Kept services={services} workflowId={workflowId} binding={binding} connection={connection} held={b.held} thing={thing} />}
        <p className={s.note}>{t(keeps === false ? 'connections.live.pauseWhatRefused' : 'connections.live.pauseWhat', { connection })}</p>
        <div className={s.liveButtons}>
          {may ? (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              icon={b.paused ? 'play' : 'clock'}
              aria-label={t(b.paused ? 'connections.live.resumeName' : 'connections.live.pauseName', { startsWhen: said })}
              disabledReason={busy ? t(b.paused ? 'connections.live.resuming' : 'connections.live.pausing') : undefined}
              onClick={() => void toggle(!b.paused)}
            >
              {t(b.paused ? 'connections.live.resume' : 'connections.live.pause')}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <span className={s.note}>{t('connections.live.notAdmin')}</span>
          )}
          {refusedHref && (
            <a className={s.link} href={refusedHref} aria-label={t('connections.live.refusedStartsName', { connection })}>
              {t('connections.live.refusedStarts')}
            </a>
          )}
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section className={s.live} aria-labelledby={`live-${binding}`}>
      <h4 id={`live-${binding}`} className={s.liveHead}>
        {t('connections.live.heading')}
      </h4>
      {body}
      <div role="status" className={s.note}>
        {message}
        {started.length > 0 && (
          <ul className={s.startedList}>
            {started.map((r) => (
              <li key={r.requestId}>
                <a className={s.link} href={`#/requests/${encodeURIComponent(r.requestId)}`}>
                  {t('connections.live.openRequest', { n: r.readableId })}
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const sameDay = (a: Date, b: Date) => a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();

/** "today at 10:31", "yesterday at 09:14", "on 10 Nov 2026 at 09:14": in the viewer's own time, as the rest of the app. */
export function whenSaid(at: string, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const d = new Date(at);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return at;
  const time = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  if (sameDay(d, now)) return t('connections.when.today', { time });
  const yesterday = new Date(now);
  yesterday.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
  if (sameDay(d, yesterday)) return t('connections.when.yesterday', { time });
  return t('connections.when.date', { date: formatDate(`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`), time });
}

/**
 * While paused: what the other system sent that is kept (`runtime.listPausedDeliveries`, oldest
 * first), each by when it came. Only the people who may resume it can list it.
 */
function Kept({
  services, workflowId, binding, connection, held, thing,
}: { services: Services | null; workflowId: string | null; binding: StartsWhenId; connection: string; held: number; thing?: string | undefined }) {
  const [kept, setKept] = useState<PausedDelivery[] | null>(null);
  const headId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!services || !workflowId) return;
    let alive = true;
    services.runtime
      .listPausedDeliveries({ workflow: workflowId, binding })
      .then((r) => alive && setKept(r.ok ? r.value : []))
      .catch(() => alive && setKept([]));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services, workflowId, binding, held]);
  if (!kept) return null;
  return (
    <div className={s.kept}>
      <p id={headId} className={s.keptHead}>
        {t('connections.live.keptHead', { connection })}
      </p>
      {kept.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.note}>{t('connections.live.keptNone')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className={s.keptList} aria-labelledby={headId}>
          {kept.map((k) => (
            <li key={k.id}>{keptWords(k, thing)}</li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * A kept item in words: "Ticket HD-4001, sent today at 00:33" when what names it is known (it was
 * sent from this page), else "Sent today at 00:33". The runtime lists a kept item by its event ID
 * and time only.
 */
function keptWords(k: PausedDelivery, thing: string | undefined): string {
  const name = sentName(k.eventId);
  const when = whenSaid(k.at);
  return name && thing ? t('connections.live.keptNamed', { thing, name, when }) : t('connections.live.keptAt', { when });
