/**
 * One thing a connection offers, by its catalogue label; opening it shows what it needs and what
 * it gives back (or, for "Can start a request", what it sends), with the catalogue's sample beside
 * each, and how it can fail. On the development host a "Can start a request" entry also offers
 * "Pretend <connection> sent this now".
 */
import { useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Field } from '@/contract';
import { labelAfterConnection } from '@/model';
import { lowerFirst } from './text';
import type { Services } from '@/services';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { t, words, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { useNames } from './names';
import { PretendSent } from './PretendSent';
import { fieldValueText, refsIn, sampleText, type NameOf } from './sample';
import s from './connections.module.css';

export function Offering({ services, catalogue, entry }: { services: Services | null; catalogue: Catalogue; entry: CatalogueEntry }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const panelId = useId();
  const off = entry.status === 'disabled';
  const prefix =
    entry.kind === 'dataSource'
      ? t('connections.offer.source')
      : entry.kind === 'trigger'
        ? t('connections.offer.trigger')
        : entry.kind === 'operation' && entry.sort === 'await'
          ? t('connections.offer.await')
          : undefined;
  // "Starts when: a ticket is created", on the connection's own card: its name is not said again.
  const label = prefix && entry.kind === 'trigger' ? lowerFirst(labelAfterConnection(catalogue, entry.id) || entry.label) : entry.label;
  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={s.offerButton}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={panelId}
        aria-label={t(entry.kind === 'trigger' ? 'connections.details.nameTrigger' : 'connections.details.name', {
          label: [prefix, label, off ? t('connections.offer.turnedOff') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
        })}
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
      >
        <Icon name={open ? 'minus' : 'plus'} size={12} className={s.chev} />
        <span>
          {prefix && <span className={s.prefix}>{prefix} </span>}
          <span className={s.offerLabel}>{label}</span>
          {off && <span className={s.quiet}> {t('connections.offer.turnedOff')}</span>}
        </span>
      </button>
      <div id={panelId} hidden={!open}>
        {open && <Details services={services} catalogue={catalogue} entry={entry} />}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function Details({ services, catalogue, entry }: { services: Services | null; catalogue: Catalogue; entry: CatalogueEntry }) {
  const sample = 'sample' in entry ? (entry.sample as unknown) : undefined;
  const refs = useMemo(() => refsIn(sample), [sample]);
  const nameOf = useNames(services, refs);
  return (
    // The entry's catalogue description is not shown: it is written for engineers (steps, IDs ...).
    <div className={s.details}>
      {entry.kind === 'operation' && (
        <>
          <FieldTable head="connections.details.needs" fields={entry.input} sample={entry.sample.input} nameOf={nameOf} />
          <FieldTable head="connections.details.gives" fields={entry.result} sample={entry.sample.result} nameOf={nameOf} />
          {entry.failureCodes.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <h4 className={s.detailHead}>{t('connections.details.fails')}</h4>
              <ul className={s.failList}>
                {entry.failureCodes.map((f) => (
                  <li key={f.code}>{f.label}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {entry.kind === 'dataSource' && (
        <>
          <FieldTable head="connections.details.needs" fields={entry.input} sample={entry.sample.input} nameOf={nameOf} />
          <FieldTable head="connections.details.item" fields={entry.item} sample={entry.sample.items[0]} nameOf={nameOf} shown={shownBy(entry.item)} />
          {entry.sample.items.length > 0 && (
            <p>
              {t('connections.details.sampleItems', {
                list: entry.sample.items
                  .map((item) => {
                    const named = shownBy(entry.item)?.label ?? entry.item[0]?.id;
                    return named ? sampleText(item[named], nameOf) : '';
                  })
                  .filter(Boolean)
                  .join(words['describe.comma']),
              })}
            </p>
          )}
          {entry.searchable && <p>{t('connections.details.searchable')}</p>}
        </>
      )}
      {entry.kind === 'trigger' && (
        <>
          <FieldTable head="connections.details.sends" fields={entry.event} sample={entry.sample.event} nameOf={nameOf} />
          <PretendSent services={services} catalogue={catalogue} trigger={entry} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const KIND_WORDS = new Set([
  'text', 'longText', 'number', 'yesNo', 'date', 'choice', 'multipleChoice', 'person', 'group', 'people', 'choiceFromList',
  'choiceFromConnection', 'list', 'fieldGroup',
]);

export function kindWords(kind: string): string {
  return KIND_WORDS.has(kind) ? t(`connections.kind.${kind}` as WordKey) : t('connections.kind.other');
}

/**
 * A choice's stored field and the field a person sees for it: a data source's items are stored by a
 * stable identifier (contract: "Store the id; show the name"), its first field, and shown by the next
 * text field. Undefined when the item has no second text field to show.
 */
function shownBy(item: Field[]): { stored: string; label: string } | undefined {
  const stored = item[0];
  const label = item.find((f) => f.kind === 'text' && f.id !== stored?.id);
  return stored && label ? { stored: stored.id, label: label.id } : undefined;
}

function FieldTable({
  head, fields, sample, nameOf, shown,
}: {
  head: WordKey;
  fields: Field[];
  sample: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  nameOf: NameOf;
  /** For a choice: its stored field's sample is said by the label field's ("Sam Carter", not an ID). */
  shown?: { stored: string; label: string } | undefined;
}) {
  const headId = useId();
  return (
    <>
      <h4 id={headId} className={s.detailHead}>
        {t(head)}
      </h4>
      {fields.length === 0 ? (
        <p>{t('connections.details.nothing')}</p>
      ) : (
        <table className={s.fields} aria-labelledby={headId}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">{t('connections.details.what')}</th>
              <th scope="col">{t('connections.details.kind')}</th>
              <th scope="col">{t('connections.details.sample')}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {fields.map((f) => (
              <tr key={f.id}>
                <td>
                  {f.label}
                  <span className={s.quiet}>
                    {t('connections.details.neededAfter', { needed: t(f.required ? 'connections.details.needed' : 'connections.details.optional') })}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>{kindWords(f.kind)}</td>
                <td>{fieldValueText(f, shown && f.id === shown.stored && sample?.[shown.label] !== undefined ? sample[shown.label] : sample?.[f.id], nameOf)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/PretendSent.tsx\n===
/**
 * "Pretend <connection> sent this now" (development host only): a small form built from what a
 * "Can start a request" entry sends, filled from its catalogue sample, sent through
 * `services.dev.sendSample`, and what happened in each workflow said in words, with a link to a
 * request it started. Renders nothing when the services have no `dev`.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, CatalogueRef, Field, Location, Trigger } from '@/contract';
import { find, nameOf } from '@/model';
import type { InboundAnswer, InboundError, InboundProblem, InboundResult, Person, Result, Services } from '@/services';
import { Button, Checkbox, Icon, Select, TextArea, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { connectionLabelOf, sentName } from './catalogue';
import { useNames } from './names';
import { noteSent, useToggles } from './sends';
import { fieldValueText, refsIn, sampleText } from './sample';
import s from './connections.module.css';

type Sent = Record<string, unknown>;

const EDITABLE = new Set(['text', 'longText', 'number', 'date', 'choice', 'yesNo', 'person']);

export function PretendSent({ services, catalogue, trigger }: { services: Services | null; catalogue: Catalogue; trigger: Trigger }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const formId = useId();
  // Whether this engine can pretend this trigger was sent (absent: always; the engine's mock systems: only some, and only when it offers them).
  const [can, setCan] = useState<boolean | null>(() => (services?.dev?.canSendSample ? null : true));
  useEffect(() => {
    const ask = services?.dev?.canSendSample;
    if (!ask) return;
    let alive = true;
    ask(trigger.id as CatalogueRef)
      .then((ok) => alive && setCan(ok))
      .catch(() => alive && setCan(false));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services, trigger]);
  if (!services?.dev) return null;
  const connection = connectionLabelOf(catalogue, trigger.id);
  return (
    <div className={s.dev} role="group" aria-label={t('connections.dev.label')}>
      <div className={s.devTag}>
        <Icon name="sample" size={13} />
        {t('connections.dev.label')}
      </div>
      {can === false ? (
        <p className={s.said}>{t('connections.dev.notOffered', { connection })}</p>
      ) : can === null ? null : (
      <div>
        <Button size="sm" icon="play" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={formId} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
          {t('connections.dev.pretend', { connection })}
        </Button>
      </div>
      )}
      <div id={formId} hidden={!open}>
        {open && <SendForm services={services} catalogue={catalogue} trigger={trigger} connection={connection} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SendForm({ services, catalogue, trigger, connection }: { services: Services; catalogue: Catalogue; trigger: Trigger; connection: string }) {
  const sample = useMemo(() => trigger.sample?.event ?? {}, [trigger]);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Sent>(() => ({ ...sample }));
  const [people, setPeople] = useState<Person[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState<Said | null>(null);
  const refs = useMemo(() => refsIn(sample), [sample]);
  const nameOfRef = useNames(services, refs);
  // A pause or resume makes what happened to an earlier send stale ("that Starts when is paused").
  const toggles = useToggles();
  const [saidAt, setSaidAt] = useState(toggles);
  const shown = saidAt === toggles ? said : null;
  // The fields this engine passes on; the other system fills the rest in itself (absent: all).
  const passed = services.dev?.sampleFields?.(trigger.id as CatalogueRef);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    if (trigger.event.some((f) => f.kind === 'person')) {
      services.session
        .people()
        .then((p) => alive && setPeople(p))
        .catch(() => undefined);
    }
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [services, trigger]);

  const set = (id: string, value: unknown) =>
    setSent((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (value === undefined || value === '') delete next[id];
      else next[id] = value;
      return next;
    });

  async function send() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const answer = await services.dev!.sendSample(trigger.id as CatalogueRef, sent);
      noteSent((answer.ok && answer.value.eventId) || undefined, sentName(trigger, sent));
      setSaid(await sayAnswer(services, catalogue, trigger.id, answer));
      setSaidAt(toggles);
    } catch {
      setSaid({ lines: [{ tone: 'bad', text: t('connections.dev.err.other') }] });
      setSaidAt(toggles);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form
      className={s.devForm}
      aria-label={t('connections.dev.what', { connection })}
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!busy) void send();
      }}
    >
      <p className={s.said}>{t('connections.dev.hint', { connection })}</p>
      {trigger.event.map((field) =>
        passed && !passed.includes(field.id) ? (
          <div key={field.id} className={s.devRow}>
            <span className={s.quiet}>{field.label}</span>
            <span>{t('connections.dev.ownValue', { connection })}</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
        <SentRow
          key={field.id}
          field={field}
          value={sent[field.id]}
          sampleValue={sample[field.id]}
          people={people}
          onChange={(v) => set(field.id, v)}
          nameOf={nameOfRef}
        />
        ),
      )}
      <div className={s.devButtons}>
        <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="primary" icon="play" disabledReason={busy ? t('connections.dev.sending') : undefined}>
          {busy ? t('connections.dev.sending') : t('connections.dev.send')}
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={() => setSent({ ...sample })}>
          {t('connections.dev.reset')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {shown && (
          <>
            <p className={s.detailHead}>{t('connections.dev.result')}</p>
            <ul className={s.results}>
              {shown.lines.map((line, i) => (
                <li key={i}>
                  <Icon name={line.tone === 'good' ? 'check' : line.tone === 'bad' ? 'error' : 'info'} size={14} />
                  <span>
                    {line.text}
                    {line.why && line.why.length > 0 && <> {line.why.join(' ')}</>}
                    {line.request && (
                      <>
                        {' '}
                        <a className={s.link} href={`#/requests/${encodeURIComponent(line.request.id)}`}>
                          {t('connections.dev.out.openRequest', { n: line.request.n })}
                        </a>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/** What "Not one of its choices" sends for a choice from another connection: a stored value no list holds. */
const NOT_LISTED = 'pretend-not-listed';

function SentRow({
  field, value, sampleValue, people, onChange, nameOf: nameOfRef,
}: {
  field: Field;
  value: unknown;
  sampleValue: unknown;
  people: Person[];
  onChange(v: unknown): void;
  nameOf: (r: { type: 'user' | 'group'; id: string }) => string | undefined;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  if (field.kind === 'choiceFromConnection' && sampleValue && typeof sampleValue === 'object') {
    // The sample's choice, or one that is not among the choices (so a start can be refused for it).
    const now = value === undefined ? '' : value && typeof value === 'object' && (value as { stored?: unknown }).stored === NOT_LISTED ? 'other' : 'sample';
    const options = [
      ...(field.required ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('connections.dev.none') }]),
      { value: 'sample', label: sampleText(sampleValue, nameOfRef) },
      { value: 'other', label: t('connections.dev.notListed') },
    ];
    return (
      <div className={s.devRow}>
        <label htmlFor={id}>{field.label}</label>
        <Select
          id={id}
          options={options}
          value={now}
          onChange={(e) =>
            onChange(
              e.target.value === 'sample'
                ? sampleValue
                : e.target.value === 'other'
                  ? { stored: NOT_LISTED, label: t('connections.dev.notListed') }
                  : undefined,
            )
          }
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!EDITABLE.has(field.kind)) {
    return (
      <div className={s.devRow}>
        <span className={s.quiet}>{field.label}</span>
        <span>{t('connections.dev.asInSample', { value: fieldValueText(field, value, nameOfRef) })}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (field.kind === 'yesNo') {
    return <Checkbox label={field.label} checked={value === true} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.checked)} />;
  }
  let control;
  if (field.kind === 'choice') {
    const options = [
      ...(field.required ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('connections.dev.none') }]),
      ...(field.choices ?? []).map((c) => ({ value: c.value, label: c.label })),
    ];
    control = <Select id={id} options={options} value={typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />;
  } else if (field.kind === 'person') {
    const current = value && typeof value === 'object' && 'id' in value ? String((value as { id: string }).id) : '';
    const known = people.map((p) => ({ value: p.ref.id, label: p.label }));
    if (current && !known.some((k) => k.value === current)) known.unshift({ value: current, label: sampleText(value, nameOfRef) });
    const options = [{ value: '', label: t('connections.dev.nobody') }, ...known];
    control = (
      <Select id={id} options={options} value={current} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value ? { type: 'user', id: e.target.value } : undefined)} />
    );
  } else if (field.kind === 'longText') {
    control = <TextArea id={id} rows={2} value={typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />;
  } else if (field.kind === 'number') {
    control = (
      <TextInput
        id={id}
        type="number"
        value={typeof value === 'number' ? String(value) : ''}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.target.value))}
      />
    );
  } else if (field.kind === 'date') {
    control = <TextInput id={id} type="date" value={typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />;
  } else {
    control = <TextInput id={id} value={typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />;
  }
  return (
    <div className={s.devRow}>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{field.label}</label>
      {control}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---- what happened, in words ----------------------------------------------------------------------

type Line = { tone: 'good' | 'bad' | 'plain'; text: string; why?: string[]; request?: { id: string; n: string } };
type Said = { lines: Line[] };

const ERROR_WORDS: Record<string, WordKey> = {
  'unknown-connection': 'connections.dev.err.unknownConnection',
  'connection-unavailable': 'connections.dev.err.unavailable',
  unavailable: 'connections.dev.err.unavailable',
  unparsable: 'connections.dev.err.unreadable',
  'event-invalid': 'connections.dev.err.missing',
};

async function sayAnswer(services: Services, catalogue: Catalogue, entry: string, answer: Result<InboundAnswer, InboundError>): Promise<Said> {
  const connection = connectionLabelOf(catalogue, entry);
  if (!answer.ok) {
    const code = answer.errors[0]?.code ?? '';
    return { lines: [{ tone: 'bad', text: t(ERROR_WORDS[code] ?? 'connections.dev.err.other', { connection }) }] };
  }
  if (answer.value.results.length === 0) return { lines: [{ tone: 'plain', text: t('connections.dev.out.none') }] };
  const names = new Map<string, string>();
  const listed = await services.authoring.listWorkflows().catch(() => undefined);
  if (listed?.ok) for (const w of listed.value) names.set(w.id, w.name);
  const lines: Line[] = [];
  for (const r of answer.value.results) lines.push(await sayResult(services, r, names.get(r.workflow) ?? r.workflow));
  return { lines };
}

async function sayResult(services: Services, r: InboundResult, workflow: string): Promise<Line> {
  switch (r.result) {
    case 'started':
      return { tone: 'good', text: t('connections.dev.out.started', { workflow }), request: { id: r.requestId, n: String(r.readableId) } };
    case 'duplicate':
      return { tone: 'plain', text: t('connections.dev.out.duplicate', { workflow, n: String(r.readableId) }), request: { id: r.requestId, n: String(r.readableId) } };
    case 'notMatched':
      return { tone: 'plain', text: t('connections.dev.out.notMatched', { workflow }) };
    case 'paused':
      return { tone: 'plain', text: t(services.runtime.whilePaused === 'kept' ? 'connections.dev.out.paused' : 'connections.dev.out.pausedRefused', { workflow }) };
    case 'refused': {
      const source = await services.runtime.publishedSource({ workflow: r.workflow, version: r.version }).catch(() => undefined);
      const doc = source?.ok ? source.value.authored : undefined;
      return { tone: 'bad', text: t('connections.dev.out.refused', { workflow }), why: r.problems.map((p) => sayProblem(doc, p)) };
    }
  }
}

function placeName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | undefined, where: Location | null | undefined): string {
  const entry = doc && where ? find(doc, where.item) : undefined;
  return entry ? nameOf(entry) || t('connections.why.somewhere') : t('connections.why.somewhere');
}

/** Why a start was refused, in words, naming the question or button in the version that refused it. */
export function sayProblem(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | undefined, p: Pick<InboundProblem, 'code' | 'params'> & { where?: Location | null; location?: Location }): string {
  const where = p.where ?? p.location ?? null;
  const name = placeName(doc, where);
  switch (p.code) {
    case 'mapping-error':
      return t('connections.why.mappingError', { where: name });
    case 'may':
      return t('connections.why.may');
    case 'invalid-data':
      return (p.params as { rule?: string }).rule === 'required'
        ? t('connections.why.required', { question: name })
        : t('connections.why.invalidData', { question: name });
    case 'choice-unknown':
      return t('connections.why.choiceUnknown', { question: name });
    case 'check':
      return t('connections.why.check', { button: name });
    case 'rule-error':
      return t('connections.why.ruleError', { where: name });
    default:
      return t('connections.why.unknown');
  }
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/README.md\n===
# features/connections

The Connections page and "Starts when" (editor-model.md section 10, mockup 14-connections). The catalogue is data: nothing here names a connection, an entry or a field.

- `ConnectionsPage` (route `/connections`, `ConnectionsPage.tsx`): "What a connection can offer" (`Explainer.tsx`: the four sorts, the two that only receive, the comes-in / goes-out picture and the rule), then one card per connection (`ConnectionCard.tsx`): only the first sentence of its catalogue description (the rest is written for engineers), status in words, what it offers under the four sorts (`Offering.tsx`: each opens to what it needs, gives back or sends, with samples and failures; the entry's own description is not shown), the directory's "Who is asked: the members of a group", and "Used by" from the drafts (`services.authoring`): the workflows by name, each a link that opens the editor and `reveal`s the first place it uses the connection. An entry label's trailing "in <connection>" is left out after the connection's name (the model's `labelAfterConnection`). A data source's choice shows its label field's sample beside its stored field (`Offering.tsx` `shownBy`), never the ID. `Used by` links name the connection too, so two cards' links to one place differ. The one the catalogue names as `notifyConnection` says "Carries messages" and "Used by Every workflow"; "Always told" takes its list of built-in tellings from the same word as the Tell other systems action (`actions.tell.builtIn`).
- `AlsoStartsFrom` (the slot, `AlsoStartsFrom.tsx`): "+ Also start it from another system" and one card per binding, edited only with the `startsWhen.*` commands. "Only when" is the WhenBuilder slot, each row of "Fill in the form from the ticket" the ValueField slot (chip look; MessageField when the answer is text with what was sent in it), all with `sent`. Samples from `core.evaluateSent`. A needed question left unfilled shows `startsWhen.neededNotFilled` in describe's words, per row, with "Use Ticket: X" when a sent field has exactly the same choices, else the finding's fix (opens that row's picker). A formula answer gets a row of the card's full width. `LiveState.tsx`: running or paused (`runtime.listBindings`, looked up again after each development send, `sends.ts`), what is kept while paused (`listPausedDeliveries`), Pause and Resume (`setBindingPaused`; on Resume, links to the requests it started), link to `#/requests?workflow=<id>&show=refused`. Uses `sessionServices()`, so no provider or router is needed above it.
- `PretendSent.tsx`: "Pretend <connection> sent this now" (development host only; nothing when `services.dev` is absent). A choice from another connection can be the sample's or "Something that is not one of its choices", so a start can be refused.
- `catalogue.ts` (pure): sorts, roles, `triggerThing`, where a workflow uses each entry. A connection with no entries, other than the directory and the one that carries messages (`notifyConnection`), is said to offer nothing to pick, and has no "Used by". `sentName`: what names a thing sent ("HD-4001").
- `sample.ts`, `names.ts`, `text.ts`: sample values in words, directory names, small text helpers. A sample in the Fill table goes through the model's `heldValueText` (a typed-in choice or list row by its words). The Fill table has its sample as a third column on a wide card and under what fills the question on a narrow one (a container query; the rows keep their table roles). `SettingsLink.tsx` copies features/actions' link to Settings (candidate for src/ui) and renders a describe phrase with its Settings link part (`phraseNodes`, `wordsWithPhrase`). Who is told uses the model's `describeStuckTold` with everyone in "Stuck requests go to", groups marked.
- `sends.ts`: the sends from the development host (so the live state is looked up again), what names each by its event ID (so a kept item reads "Ticket HD-4001, sent today at 00:33"; the runtime lists a kept item by event ID and time only), and the pauses and resumes (so the development panel drops a result they made stale). Pause and Resume have their own words (`connections.live.*`), not the development-only ones.
- Words: `src/words/connections.ts`. Tests: `catalogue.test.ts`, `AlsoStartsFrom.test.tsx`, `ConnectionsPage.test.tsx`; end to end `tests/e2e/connections.spec.ts`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/SettingsLink.tsx\n===
/**
 * "Settings" inside a sentence about who is told, as a link that opens the Settings popover of the
 * editor's top bar (editor-model.md section 9). The popover belongs to features/panel and there is
 * no model request to open it, so the link presses the top bar's own "Settings" button; Radix then
 * moves focus into the popover and back to that button when it closes. The same as
 * features/actions/SettingsLink.tsx, which this feature may not import (candidate for src/ui or a
 * model `openSettings()`).
 */
import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { isChip, isSettingsLink, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import s from './connections.module.css';

function findSettingsButton(): HTMLElement | null {
  const word = t('word.settings');
  const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:not([data-settings-link])'));
  return candidates.find((b) => b.textContent?.trim() === word) ?? null;
}

function SettingsLink() {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={s.inlineLink}
      data-settings-link=""
      title={t('connections.settingsLinkTitle')}
      onClick={() => {
        const target = findSettingsButton();
        if (!target) return;
        target.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'nearest' });
        target.click();
      }}
    >
      {t('word.settings')}
    </button>
  );
}

/** A describe phrase as plain words, its Settings link part (`isSettingsLink`) a link to Settings. */
export function phraseNodes(phrase: Phrase): ReactNode {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < phrase.length; i += 1) {
    const part = phrase[i]!;
    if (typeof part === 'string') out.push(<Fragment key={i}>{part}</Fragment>);
    else if (isSettingsLink(part)) {
      // The link and the punctuation right after it ("Settings).") stay on one line.
      const next = phrase[i + 1];
      const stuck = typeof next === 'string' ? (/^[)\].,;:]+/.exec(next)?.[0] ?? '') : '';
      out.push(
        <span key={i} className={s.nowrap}>
          <SettingsLink />
          {stuck}
        </span>,
      );
      if (stuck) {
        const rest = (next as string).slice(stuck.length);
        if (rest) out.push(<Fragment key={`${i}-rest`}>{rest}</Fragment>);
        i += 1;
      }
    } else out.push(<Fragment key={i}>{isChip(part) ? part.label : part.text}</Fragment>);
  }
  return out;
}

const MARK = '\u0000';

/** The words of `key` with `{name}` replaced by a phrase (its Settings link kept). */
export function wordsWithPhrase(key: WordKey, name: string, inner: Phrase, params: Record<string, string> = {}): ReactNode {
  const [before = '', after = ''] = t(key, { ...params, [name]: MARK }).split(MARK);
  return phraseNodes([...(before ? [before] : []), ...inner, ...(after ? [after] : [])]);
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Question } from '@/contract';
import { fixtureCatalogue, fixtures } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { offeringsOf, roleOf, sameChoicesField, sampleName, startQuestions, toldIn, triggersOf, triggerThing, usesIn } from './catalogue';
import { joinNames, sampleText } from './sample';

const cat = fixtureCatalogue;

describe('reading the catalogue as data', () => {
  it('groups each connection under the four sorts, and knows the two that only receive', () => {
    const sorts = Object.fromEntries(cat.connections.map((c) => [c.id, offeringsOf(cat, c.id).map((g) => g.sort)]));
    for (const c of cat.connections) {
      const own = cat.entries.filter((e) => e.connection === c.id && e.kind !== 'eventSink');
      expect(sorts[c.id]!.length > 0).toBe(own.length > 0);
    }
    const roles = cat.connections.map((c) => roleOf(cat, c));
    expect(roles.filter((r) => r === 'listens')).toHaveLength(cat.connections.filter((c) => cat.entries.some((e) => e.connection === c.id && e.kind === 'eventSink')).length);
    // The directory offers things; a connection with no entries at all carries messages.
    expect(roleOf(cat, cat.connections.find((c) => c.id === cat.directoryConnection)!)).toBe('offers');
  });

  it('names what a trigger is about from its label, and its sample by the first required text', () => {
    for (const trigger of triggersOf(cat)) {
      const thing = triggerThing(cat, trigger.id)!;
      expect(thing.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(trigger.label.toLowerCase()).toContain(thing.toLowerCase());
      const first = trigger.event.find((f) => f.required && f.kind === 'text');
      expect(sampleName(trigger)).toBe(first ? trigger.sample.event[first.id] : undefined);
    }
  });

  it('offers a sent field only when its choices are exactly the same', () => {
    const risk = startQuestions(fixtures['change-request']).find((q) => q.label === 'Risk') as Question;
    const field = (labels: string[]) => ({ id: 'x', label: 'X', kind: 'choice' as const, required: true, choices: labels.map((l) => ({ value: l, label: l })) });
    expect(sameChoicesField(risk, [field(['high', 'Low', 'Medium'])])?.id).toBe('x');
    expect(sameChoicesField(risk, [field(['Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Critical'])])).toBeUndefined();
    expect(sameChoicesField(risk, [field(['Low', 'Medium', 'High']), { ...field(['Low', 'Medium', 'High']), id: 'y' }])).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('finds where a workflow uses what the catalogue offers', () => {
    const doc = fixtures['integrated-sample'];
    const refs = usesIn(doc, cat).map((u) => u.ref);
    for (const sw of doc.start.startsWhen) expect(refs).toContain(sw.trigger);
    expect(refs).toContain(cat.directoryConnection);
    expect(toldIn(doc).map((x) => x.words)).toEqual(doc.thingsTold.map((x) => x.words));
  });
});

describe('sample values in words', () => {
  it('says people by name, choices by label, dates and Yes/No in words', () => {
    const nameOf = () => 'Priya Raman';
    expect(sampleText({ type: 'user', id: 'x' }, nameOf)).toBe('Priya Raman');
    expect(sampleText({ stored: 'svc', label: 'Payments API' }, nameOf)).toBe('Payments API');
    expect(sampleText('2026-12-02', nameOf)).toBe('2 Dec 2026');
    expect(sampleText(true, nameOf)).toBe('Yes');
    expect(sampleText(undefined, nameOf)).toBe('empty');
    expect(joinNames(['A', 'B', 'C'])).toBe('A, B and C');
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/catalogue.ts\n===
/**
 * Pure helpers over the catalogue of connections (contract/catalogue.ts) for this feature. The
 * catalogue is data: no connection, entry or field is named here. What a connection is for is read
 * from what it offers:
 *   - an entry of kind `trigger` can start a request; a `dataSource` or a `read` operation gives
 *     data; a `write` operation does something; an `await` operation does something and waits;
 *   - a connection with an `eventSink` entry is told what happened (it listens);
 *   - the one the catalogue names as `notifyConnection` carries messages (Notify);
 *   - a connection with no entries at all, other than the directory and the one that carries
 *     messages, offers nothing to pick.
 * Also: where each entry is used in a workflow, and the sent field that could fill a question.
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Connection, Field, Location, Question, Task, Trigger,
} from '@/contract';

/** The four sorts, in the order the page shows them. */
export type OfferSort = 'read' | 'write' | 'await' | 'trigger';
export const OFFER_SORTS: readonly OfferSort[] = ['read', 'write', 'await', 'trigger'];

/** What a connection is, beyond what it offers. */
export type ConnectionRole = 'offers' | 'listens' | 'messages' | 'none';

export function entryOf(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, ref: string | undefined): CatalogueEntry | undefined {
  if (!catalogue || !ref) return undefined;
  return catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === ref);
}

export function connectionOf(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, id: string | undefined): Connection | undefined {
  if (!catalogue || !id) return undefined;
  return catalogue.connections.find((c) => c.id === id);
}

/** The connection's label for an entry; the entry ID's first part when the catalogue lacks it. */
export function connectionLabelOf(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, ref: string): string {
  const entry = entryOf(catalogue, ref);
  const id = entry?.connection ?? ref.split('.')[0] ?? ref;
  return connectionOf(catalogue, id)?.label ?? id;
}

/** Which of the four sorts an entry belongs to; undefined for an event sink. */
export function sortOf(entry: CatalogueEntry): OfferSort | undefined {
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'dataSource':
      return 'read';
    case 'operation':
      return entry.sort;
    case 'trigger':
      return 'trigger';
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

export function entriesOf(catalogue: Catalogue, connection: string): CatalogueEntry[] {
  return catalogue.entries.filter((e) => e.connection === connection);
}

/** A connection's entries grouped under the four sorts, catalogue order, empty sorts left out. */
export function offeringsOf(catalogue: Catalogue, connection: string): { sort: OfferSort; entries: CatalogueEntry[] }[] {
  const own = entriesOf(catalogue, connection);
  return OFFER_SORTS.map((sort) => ({ sort, entries: own.filter((e) => sortOf(e) === sort) })).filter((g) => g.entries.length > 0);
}

/**
 * 'messages' for the connection the catalogue names as carrying Notify (`notifyConnection`);
 * 'listens' when it has an event sink; 'none' when it has no entries at all and is not the
 * directory (nothing to pick from it); else 'offers'.
 */
export function roleOf(catalogue: Catalogue, connection: Connection): ConnectionRole {
  const own = entriesOf(catalogue, connection.id);
  if (connection.id === catalogue.notifyConnection) return 'messages';
  if (own.some((e) => e.kind === 'eventSink')) return 'listens';
  if (own.length === 0 && connection.id !== catalogue.directoryConnection) return 'none';
  return 'offers';
}

/** Every trigger the catalogue offers, catalogue order. */
export function triggersOf(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined): Trigger[] {
  return (catalogue?.entries ?? []).filter((e): e is Trigger => e.kind === 'trigger');
}

/**
 * What a trigger is about, for naming what it sent: the noun after a leading "a", "an" or "the" in
 * its label ("A ticket is created" gives "Ticket"); otherwise the connection's label. The same rule
 * as the model's describe (src/model/describe/catalogue.ts `triggerThing`, not exported).
 */
export function triggerThing(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, ref: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const entry = entryOf(catalogue, ref);
  if (!entry || !ref) return undefined;
  const noun = /^(?:an?|the)\s+([\p{L}\p{N}]+)/iu.exec(entry.label ?? '')?.[1];
  if (noun) return noun.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + noun.slice(1);
  return connectionLabelOf(catalogue, ref);
}

/** The first required text field's sample value ("HD-2291"): what names the sample in a heading. */
export function sampleName(trigger: Trigger | undefined): string | undefined {
  return trigger ? sentName(trigger, trigger.sample?.event) : undefined;
}

/** What names a thing the trigger sent ("HD-4001"): its first required text field's value, by the same rule. */
export function sentName(trigger: Trigger, sent: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | undefined {
  for (const field of trigger.event) {
    const v = sent?.[field.id];
    if (field.required && field.kind === 'text' && typeof v === 'string' && v.trim()) return v.trim();
  }
  return undefined;
}

// ---- the start form ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** The start stage's one task, if it has one. */
export function startTask(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Task | undefined {
  const stage = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === doc.start?.stage);
  if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending') return undefined;
  return stage.tasks?.[0];
}

/** The start form's questions, page order. */
export function startQuestions(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Question[] {
  const task = startTask(doc);
  const out: Question[] = [];
  for (const page of task?.form?.pages ?? []) for (const item of page.items ?? []) if (item.type === 'question') out.push(item);
  return out;
}

const norm = (s: string) => s.trim().toLowerCase();

/** The labels of a question's own typed-in choices, or undefined when its choices come from elsewhere. */
export function typedChoiceLabels(question: Question): string[] | undefined {
  const choices = question.choices;
  if (!choices || choices.from !== 'typedIn') return undefined;
  return (choices.choices ?? []).map((c) => c.label ?? '');
}

/**
 * A sent field that could fill `question`: a choice field with exactly the same choices (by label,
 * ignoring case and order). Undefined when there is none, or more than one.
 */
export function sameChoicesField(question: Question, fields: Field[]): Field | undefined {
  const own = typedChoiceLabels(question);
  if (!own || own.length === 0) return undefined;
  const want = new Set(own.map(norm));
  const fits = fields.filter((f) => {
    if (f.kind !== question.kind || !f.choices?.length) return false;
    const have = new Set(f.choices.map((c) => norm(c.label)));
    return have.size === want.size && [...want].every((l) => have.has(l));
  });
  return fits.length === 1 ? fits[0] : undefined;
}

// ---- where an entry is used ----------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface Use {
  /** The catalogue entry, or the connection for a use that names no entry (the directory). */
  ref: string;
  location: Location;
}

type Json = unknown;

function mentionsGroup(x: Json): boolean {
  if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return false;
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.some(mentionsGroup);
  const o = x as Record<string, unknown>;
  if ('group' in o) return true;
  if (Array.isArray(o.steps) && o.steps.some((s) => !!s && typeof s === 'object' && 'directory' in (s as object))) return true;
  return Object.values(o).some(mentionsGroup);
}

/**
 * Where the workflow uses what the catalogue offers: each "Starts when" (its trigger), each action
 * that uses a connection (its operation), each question whose choices come from a connection (its
 * source) or from the directory (the directory connection), each task that asks a group (the
 * directory connection), and each "Tell other systems" (every listening connection, `ref` = the
 * action's thing told).
 */
export function usesIn(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue): Use[] {
  const out: Use[] = [];
  const dir = catalogue.directoryConnection;
  for (const sw of doc.start?.startsWhen ?? []) if (sw.trigger) out.push({ ref: sw.trigger, location: { item: sw.id } });
  for (const stage of doc.stages) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    const actions = [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])];
    for (const action of actions) {
      if (action.type === 'useConnection' && action.operation) out.push({ ref: action.operation, location: { item: action.id } });
    }
    for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) {
      if (dir && mentionsGroup(task.whoIsAsked)) out.push({ ref: dir, location: { item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' } });
      for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
        for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
          if (item.type !== 'question') continue;
          const choices = item.choices;
          if (choices?.from === 'source' && choices.source) out.push({ ref: choices.source, location: { item: item.id, part: 'choices' } });
          if (choices?.from === 'directory' && dir) out.push({ ref: dir, location: { item: item.id, part: 'choices' } });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The "Tell other systems" actions of a workflow, with the words of what each tells. */
export function toldIn(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): { location: Location; words: string }[] {
  const out: { location: Location; words: string }[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const action of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
      if (action.type !== 'tellOtherSystems') continue;
      const words = (doc.thingsTold ?? []).find((x) => x.id === action.tell)?.words ?? '';
      out.push({ location: { item: action.id }, words });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Every Notify of a workflow, in document order: what the connection that carries messages is used by. */
export function notifiesIn(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Location[] {
  const out: Location[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const action of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
      if (action.type === 'notify') out.push({ item: action.id });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The uses of one connection: of its entries, or of the connection itself (the directory). */
export function usesOfConnection(uses: Use[], catalogue: Catalogue, connection: string): Use[] {
  const own = new Set(entriesOf(catalogue, connection).map((e) => e.id));
  return uses.filter((u) => own.has(u.ref) || u.ref === connection);
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/names.ts\n===
/**
 * Names of people and groups for sample values, from the directory of the services given (so it
 * works inside the editor, through the session's services, and on the Connections page). Asked once
 * per reference per page.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { CatalogueDirectoryRef } from '@/contract';
import type { Services } from '@/services';
import type { NameOf } from './sample';

const key = (r: CatalogueDirectoryRef) => `${r.type}:${r.id}`;
const known = new Map<string, string>();

export function useNames(services: Services | null | undefined, refs: readonly CatalogueDirectoryRef[]): NameOf {
  const wanted = useMemo(() => [...new Map(refs.map((r) => [key(r), r])).values()], [refs]);
  const missingKey = wanted.filter((r) => !known.has(key(r))).map(key).join('|');
  const [, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!services || !missingKey) return;
    let alive = true;
    const ask = wanted.filter((r) => !known.has(key(r)));
    services.directory
      .lookup(ask)
      .then((found) => {
        for (const e of found) known.set(key(e), e.label);
        if (alive) setTick((n) => n + 1);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
    // `missingKey` stands for `wanted` minus what is known.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, missingKey]);
  return (ref) => known.get(key(ref));
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/sample.ts\n===
/**
 * Sample values in words: what another system sends (a catalogue sample), what a "Starts when"
 * fills a question with, what an operation gives back. JSON as core-api.md 2.4 gives it: a person or
 * group is `{ type, id }` (named through `nameOf`), a choice from a connection `{ stored, label }`.
 */
import { formatDate } from '@/model';
import { t, words } from '@/words';
import type { CatalogueDirectoryRef } from '@/contract';

export type NameOf = (ref: CatalogueDirectoryRef) => string | undefined;

/** Names as a list with the shared list words: "A", "A and B", "A, B and C". */
export function joinNames(names: readonly string[]): string {
  if (names.length <= 1) return names[0] ?? '';
  const and = ` ${words['describe.and']} `;
  return names.slice(0, -1).join(words['describe.comma']) + and + names[names.length - 1];
}

const isObject = (x: unknown): x is Record<string, unknown> => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x);

export function isRef(x: unknown): x is CatalogueDirectoryRef {
  return isObject(x) && (x.type === 'user' || x.type === 'group') && typeof x.id === 'string';
}

/** Every person or group a sample value names, for looking up their names once. */
export function refsIn(x: unknown, out: CatalogueDirectoryRef[] = []): CatalogueDirectoryRef[] {
  if (isRef(x)) out.push({ type: x.type, id: x.id });
  else if (Array.isArray(x)) x.forEach((v) => refsIn(v, out));
  else if (isObject(x)) Object.values(x).forEach((v) => refsIn(v, out));
  return out;
}

/** A sample value in words. `undefined` (nothing sent) is "empty". */
export function sampleText(x: unknown, nameOf: NameOf): string {
  if (x === undefined || x === null || x === '') return t('connections.value.empty');
  if (typeof x === 'string') return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(x) ? formatDate(x) : x;
  if (typeof x === 'number') return String(x);
  if (typeof x === 'boolean') return t(x ? 'connections.value.yes' : 'connections.value.no');
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.length ? joinNames(x.map((v) => sampleText(v, nameOf))) : t('connections.value.empty');
  if (isObject(x)) {
    if (x.$redacted === true) return t('connections.value.removed');
    if (isRef(x)) return nameOf(x) ?? words['describe.gap'];
    if ('label' in x && typeof x.label === 'string') return x.label;
    return joinNames(Object.values(x).map((v) => sampleText(v, nameOf)));
  }
  return String(x);
}

/** The label of a choice field's value ("high" gives "High"), or the value in words. */
export function fieldValueText(
  field: { kind: string; choices?: { value: string; label: string }[] } | undefined,
  x: unknown,
  nameOf: NameOf,
): string {
  if (field?.choices && typeof x === 'string') return field.choices.find((c) => c.value === x)?.label ?? x;
  if (field?.choices && Array.isArray(x)) {
    return joinNames(x.map((v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? field.choices?.find((c) => c.value === v)?.label ?? v : sampleText(v, nameOf))));
  }
  return sampleText(x, nameOf);
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/sends.ts\n===
/**
 * What happened on this page that a Starts when card's parts follow:
 *   - a count of the sends made with "Pretend <connection> sent this now", so the card's live state
 *     (what is kept while paused) is looked up again after one;
 *   - what names each thing sent ("HD-4001"), by the event ID the platform gave it, so a kept item
 *     can say which ticket it is (the runtime lists a kept item by its event ID and time only);
 *   - a count of the pauses and resumes, so the development panel drops a result that a pause or
 *     resume has made stale ("that Starts when is paused").
 */
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

let count = 0;
let toggles = 0;
const named = new Map<string, string>();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
const tell = () => listeners.forEach((l) => l());
const subscribe = (l: () => void) => {
  listeners.add(l);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(l);
  };
};

/** Called after a send from the development host; `eventId` and `name` say what was sent, when known. */
export function noteSent(eventId?: string, name?: string): void {
  if (eventId && name) named.set(eventId, name);
  count += 1;
  tell();
}

/** What names the thing sent with this event ID ("HD-4001"), when it was sent from this page. */
export function sentName(eventId: string): string | undefined {
  return named.get(eventId);
}

/** Called after a Starts when is paused or resumed. */
export function noteToggled(): void {
  toggles += 1;
  tell();
}

/** The number of sends so far; changes after each. */
export function useSends(): number {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => count);
}

/** The number of pauses and resumes so far; changes after each. */
export function useToggles(): number {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => toggles);
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/connections/text.ts\n===
/** Small text helpers for this feature's sentences. */
import { t } from '@/words';

/** "Approvers" -> "approvers", leaving names that start with two capitals ("API key") alone. As describe's own. */
export function lowerFirst(text: string): string {
  if (text.length > 1 && text[1] === text[1]?.toUpperCase() && text[1] !== text[1]?.toLowerCase()) return text;
  return text.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + text.slice(1);
}

export function upperFirst(text: string): string {
  return text.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + text.slice(1);
}

/**
 * The first sentence of a catalogue description: the "one line on what it is" a card shows
 * (editor-model.md section 10). The rest of a description is written for engineers.
 */
export function firstSentence(text: string | null | undefined): string {
  const s = (text ?? '').trim();
  const end = /[.!?](?=\s+\S)/.exec(s);
  return end ? s.slice(0, end.index + 1) : s;
}

/** "a ticket", "an issue": the thing a trigger is about, with its article. */
export function aThing(thing: string): string {
  const lower = lowerFirst(thing);
  return t(/^[aeiou]/i.test(lower) ? 'connections.an' : 'connections.a', { thing: lower });
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/diagram/AnchoredPopover.tsx\n===
import * as RP from '@radix-ui/react-popover';
import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { IconButton } from '@/ui';
import s from './AnchoredPopover.module.css';

/**
 * A popover opened at a place rather than under a button: at the "+" of an arrow, at the spot an
 * arrow was dropped on empty space, at a stage box. (The ui Popover needs a trigger element; this
 * one is anchored to a rectangle.) Escape and the close button close it; on closing, focus goes to
 * what `returnFocus` gives (the control that opened it, or the stage just added).
 * Candidate for src/ui.
 */
export function AnchoredPopover({
  open,
  onClose,
  anchor,
  title,
  sub,
  children,
  footer,
  width = 360,
  side = 'bottom',
  returnFocus,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose(): void;
  /** The rectangle on screen it opens beside. */
  anchor: () => DOMRect;
  title: string;
  sub?: ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  width?: number;
  side?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
  returnFocus?: () => HTMLElement | null | undefined;
}) {
  const virtualRef = useMemo(() => ({ current: { getBoundingClientRect: anchor } }), [anchor]);
  return (
    <RP.Root open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <RP.Anchor virtualRef={virtualRef} />
      <RP.Portal>
        <RP.Content
          className={s.popover}
          style={{ width }}
          side={side}
          align="start"
          sideOffset={10}
          collisionPadding={12}
          aria-label={title}
          onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = returnFocus?.();
            if (target?.isConnected) target.focus();
          }}
        >
          <div className={s.head}>
            <div className={s.title}>{title}</div>
            <RP.Close asChild>
              <IconButton icon="close" label={t('common.close')} size="sm" tooltip={false} className={s.close} />
            </RP.Close>
            {sub && <div className={s.sub}>{sub}</div>}
          </div>
          <div className={s.body}>{children}</div>
          {footer && <div className={s.foot}>{footer}</div>}
        </RP.Content>
      </RP.Portal>
    </RP.Root>
  );
}

  it('lays the diagram out again for an edit, but not when the check only sends the same facts again', async () => {
    const { services } = createStandinServices();
    await openWorkflow(services, 'change-request');
    render(
      <ServicesProvider services={services}>
        <div style={{ width: 900, height: 700 }}>
          <DiagramView />
        </div>
      </ServicesProvider>,
    );
    const settled = layoutCalls();
    expect(settled).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // The check comes back with a new facts object saying the same thing: no new layout.
    act(() => useSession.setState({ facts: factsWith({ ar_da_request_changes: true }) }));
    const afterFirstFacts = layoutCalls();
    act(() => useSession.setState({ facts: factsWith({ ar_da_request_changes: true }) }));
    act(() => useSession.setState({ facts: factsWith({ ar_da_request_changes: true }) }));
    expect(layoutCalls()).toBe(afterFirstFacts);

    // One edit: one layout.
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_development', name: 'Build it' } as never));
    expect(layoutCalls()).toBe(afterFirstFacts + 1);
    act(() => useSession.setState({ facts: factsWith({ ar_da_request_changes: true }) }));
    expect(layoutCalls()).toBe(afterFirstFacts + 1);

    // What sends back really changes: the layout follows.
    act(() => useSession.setState({ facts: factsWith({ ar_da_request_changes: false }) }));
    expect(layoutCalls()).toBe(afterFirstFacts + 2);
  });
});

describe('sendsBackKeyOf / sendsBackFrom', () => {
  it('keeps "sends back", "does not" and "not known" apart, whatever order the facts list them in', () => {
    const a = { arrows: { ar_b: { sendsBack: false }, ar_a: { sendsBack: true }, ar_c: {} } } as unknown as Facts;
    const b = { arrows: { ar_a: { sendsBack: true }, ar_c: {}, ar_b: { sendsBack: false } } } as unknown as Facts;
    expect(sendsBackKeyOf(a)).toBe(sendsBackKeyOf(b));
    const ask = sendsBackFrom(sendsBackKeyOf(a));
    expect([ask('ar_a'), ask('ar_b'), ask('ar_c'), ask('ar_x')]).toEqual([true, false, undefined, undefined]);
    expect(sendsBackFrom(sendsBackKeyOf(null))('ar_a')).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

  ReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider, ViewportPortal, useConnection, useReactFlow, useStore,

  AnotherEndingNode, ArrowEdge, ChooseNode, DeletedNode, DiagramContext, StageNode, fill,
  type ArrowEdgeType, type BoxAction, type BoxNode, type DiagramContextValue,
