/** The view is never made smaller than this by itself (editor-model.md section 2). */
export const MIN_AUTO_ZOOM = 0.85;
/**
 * The editor's diagram opens fitted to its whole content when that fits at this zoom or more (the
 * frontend owner's ruling, fix round 2: the demo shows whole, endings and "+ Another ending"
 * included, as mockup 01 does at 88%). When it does not fit even at this zoom, it opens at
 * MIN_AUTO_ZOOM on the start stage, with the "Below: ..." hint, as before.
 */
export const MIN_FIT_ZOOM = 0.6;
const TOOLBAR = 64;
const BOTTOM = 56;
const SIDE = 32;
/** What the author is working on is kept at least this far inside the canvas's left and right edges. */
const EDGE = 16;

/** The pieces xyflow draws, shared with the ReadOnlyDiagram (they draw themselves read only there). */
export const nodeTypes: NodeTypes = { stage: StageNode, ending: StageNode, choose: ChooseNode, deleted: DeletedNode, anotherEnding: AnotherEndingNode };
export const edgeTypes: EdgeTypes = { arrow: ArrowEdge };
/** The smallest zoom, also for "Show the whole workflow" (the author asks for it, so it may go below 85%). */
export const MIN_ZOOM = 0.4;
/**
 * xyflow's own words for screen readers ("Press enter or space to select a node ...") name nodes
 * and edges and describe keys this diagram does not use. Every box and pill names itself instead.
 */
export const ariaLabelConfig: Partial<AriaLabelConfig> = {
  'node.a11yDescription.default': '',
  'node.a11yDescription.keyboardDisabled': '',
  'node.a11yDescription.ariaLiveMessage': () => '',
  'edge.a11yDescription.default': '',
};
/** A blank-start hint's room on the canvas, for fitting the view (diagram.module.css .hint: at most 280 wide). */
const HINT_SIZE: Size = { width: 300, height: 64 };

/** The Diagram tab's left side: every stage as a box, top to bottom, with an arrow for each line under Then go to. */
export function DiagramView() {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <Diagram />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

type Chooser =
  | { mode: 'add'; rect: DOMRect; opener: HTMLElement | null }
  | { mode: 'insert'; arrowId: string; rect: DOMRect; opener: HTMLElement | null }
  | { mode: 'after'; stageId: string; rect: DOMRect; opener: HTMLElement | null }
  | { mode: 'here'; stageId: string; rect: DOMRect; flow: { x: number; y: number }; opener: HTMLElement | null }
  | { mode: 'ending'; rect: DOMRect; opener: HTMLElement | null }
  | { mode: 'connect'; stageId: string; rect: DOMRect; opener: HTMLElement | null };

function Diagram() {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const selection = useSelection();
  const flow = useReactFlow();
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [chooser, setChooser] = useState<Chooser | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<Message | null>(null);
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const settled = useRef(false);

  // ── Layout, from the document every time it changes ─────────────────────────────────────
  // The check's facts come as a new object after every edit; the layout reads only which arrows
  // send a request back, so it depends on that alone (one layout per change, not two).
  const sendsBackKey = useMemo(() => sendsBackKeyOf(facts), [facts]);
  const sendsBack = useMemo(() => sendsBackFrom(sendsBackKey), [sendsBackKey]);
  const { layout, ready, nodes, edges, pillsFrom, boxAt, onNodesChange } = useLaidOut(doc, sendsBack, { editing: true });

  // ── What is selected ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const selectedArrow = doc && selection && find(doc, selection.item)?.kind === 'arrow' ? selection.item : null;
  const selectedStage = doc && selection && !selectedArrow ? (stageOf(doc, selection.item)?.id ?? null) : null;

  // While the chosen stage has a "may be empty" To do (the panel shows it): where that value is
  // filled and used, on the boxes, and the arrow that decides it lit (mockup 04-values).
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stageFindings = useFindingsFor(selectedStage, { deep: true });
  const marks = useMemo(
    () => (doc ? mayBeEmptyMarks(doc, facts, chosenMayBeEmpty(stageFindings, selection), env) : undefined),
    [doc, facts, stageFindings, selection, env],
  );

  const select = useEditor((st) => st.select);
  const run = useEditor((st) => st.run);

  // ── The view: fit when it fits at 60% or more; otherwise 85%, on what matters ────────────
  const width = useStore((st) => st.width);
  const height = useStore((st) => st.height);
  const transform = useStore((st) => st.transform);
  const zoom = transform[2];
  const blank = useBlankStart(doc);
  const startArrow = doc ? getWorking(doc, doc.start?.stage)?.arrows[0]?.id : undefined;
  const hints = useMemo(() => (layout && doc ? hintSpots(layout, doc, blank, startArrow) : []), [layout, doc, blank, startArrow]);
  /** Everything to keep in view: the layout and the blank-start hints beside it. */
  const bounds = useMemo(
    () => (layout ? union([layout.bounds, ...hints.map((h) => ({ x: h.x, y: h.y - HINT_SIZE.height / 2, ...HINT_SIZE }))]) : null),
    [layout, hints],
  );
  /** True once the author has moved or zoomed the view by hand: edits then only keep the selection in view. */
  const moved = useRef(false);
  /** Where a pan or zoom gesture of the author's started. */
  const gestureFrom = useRef<Viewport | null>(null);

  /** The zoom at which everything fits, and the viewport for it. */
  const fitting = useCallback(() => {
    if (!bounds || !width || !height) return null;
    const b = bounds;
    const availW = width - 2 * SIDE;
    const availH = height - TOOLBAR - BOTTOM;
    const fit = Math.min(1, availW / Math.max(b.width, 1), availH / Math.max(b.height, 1));
    const at = (z: number) => ({ x: SIDE + (availW - b.width * z) / 2 - b.x * z, y: TOOLBAR + Math.max(0, (availH - b.height * z) / 2) - b.y * z, zoom: z });
    return { fit, at };
  }, [bounds, width, height]);

  /** "Show the whole workflow": everything, however small that makes it (down to the smallest zoom). */
  const showWhole = useCallback(
    (duration = 200) => {
      const f = fitting();
      if (!f) return;
      moved.current = false;
      void flow.setViewport(f.at(Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, f.fit)), { duration });
    },
    [fitting, flow],
  );

  /** No box left half under the toolbar: the view moves so it shows whole, or out of view, keeping `keep` shown. */
  const clearToolbar = useCallback(
    (vp: Viewport, keep?: Rect): Viewport => {
      if (!layout) return vp;
      const z = vp.zoom;
      let y = vp.y;
      const shows = (r: Rect, dy: number) => r.y * z + y + dy >= TOOLBAR - 1 && (r.y + r.height) * z + y + dy <= height - BOTTOM + 1;
      // A box any of whose lower part shows in the toolbar's band (between its buttons) counts as
      // under it. Moving one box can put another there, so look again, a few times at most.
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
        const box = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.y * z + y < TOOLBAR - 1 && (b.y + b.height) * z + y > 4);
        if (!box) break;
        const top = box.y * z + y;
        const bottom = (box.y + box.height) * z + y;
        const down = TOOLBAR + 8 - top;
        const up = -bottom;
        if (!keep || shows(keep, down)) y += down;
        else if (shows(keep, up)) y += up;
        else break;
      }
      return { ...vp, y };
    },
    [layout, height],
  );

  /**
   * A view that shows `keep` (a box or pill), made tidy: when the whole width fits it is shown
   * whole (nothing cut off at the sides); the view never scrolls past the diagram's edges; and no
   * box is left half under the toolbar (the view moves so it shows whole, or goes out of view).
   */
  const tidy = useCallback(
    (vp: { x: number; y: number; zoom: number }, keep?: Rect): { x: number; y: number; zoom: number } => {
      if (!layout || !bounds || !width || !height) return vp;
      const b = bounds;
      const z = vp.zoom;
      const availW = width - 2 * SIDE;
      const availH = height - TOOLBAR - BOTTOM;
      let { x, y } = vp;
      if (b.width * z <= availW) x = SIDE + (availW - b.width * z) / 2 - b.x * z;
      else x = Math.min(SIDE - b.x * z, Math.max(width - SIDE - (b.x + b.width) * z, x));
      if (b.height * z <= availH) y = TOOLBAR + (availH - b.height * z) / 2 - b.y * z;
      else y = Math.min(TOOLBAR - b.y * z, Math.max(height - BOTTOM - (b.y + b.height) * z, y));
      return clearToolbar({ x, y, zoom: z }, keep);
    },
    [layout, bounds, width, height, clearToolbar],
  );

  /**
   * The view for the whole workflow. On opening: fitted when it fits at 60% (MIN_FIT_ZOOM) or more;
   * otherwise at 85%, centred on `focusId` (the selected stage or arrow) or, with nothing selected,
   * on the top of the workflow. After an edit (`now` is the zoom shown): fitted when it fits at 85%,
   * or at the zoom shown when that is smaller and it still fits; otherwise the zoom stays as it is
   * (never jumping up to 85% under the author's eyes) and the view centres as above.
   */
  const planned = useCallback(
    (focusId: string | null, now?: number): Viewport | null => {
      const f = fitting();
      if (!layout || !bounds || !f) return null;
      const b = bounds;
      const availH = height - TOOLBAR - BOTTOM;
      const availW = width - 2 * SIDE;
      const least = now === undefined ? MIN_FIT_ZOOM : Math.max(MIN_FIT_ZOOM, Math.min(MIN_AUTO_ZOOM, now));
      if (f.fit >= least) return f.at(f.fit);
      const z = now === undefined ? MIN_AUTO_ZOOM : least;
      const focus = focusId ? rectOf(layout, focusId) : undefined;
      if (focus) {
        const centred = { x: width / 2 - (focus.x + focus.width / 2) * z, y: TOOLBAR + availH / 2 - (focus.y + focus.height / 2) * z, zoom: z };
        return tidy(centred, focus);
      }
      const start = layout.boxes.find((x) => x.id === doc?.start?.stage);
      const cx = b.width * z <= availW || !start ? b.x + b.width / 2 : start.x + start.width / 2;
      return tidy({ x: width / 2 - cx * z, y: TOOLBAR - b.y * z, zoom: z }, start);
    },
    [fitting, layout, bounds, width, height, doc?.start?.stage, tidy],
  );

  /**
   * `vp` moved as little as it takes to show what the author is working on whole: the selected
   * stage's box, after an edit with the pills and placeholders of the arrows that leave it (just the
   * box when they do not all fit), or the selected arrow's pill (with where it ends). Inside the
   * canvas (so never under the panel beside it), below the toolbar and above the bottom band.
   */
  const keepInView = useCallback(
    (vp: Viewport, focusId: string, withArrows: boolean): Viewport => {
      if (!layout || !width || !height) return vp;
      const z = vp.zoom;
      const area = { left: EDGE, right: width - EDGE, top: TOOLBAR, bottom: height - BOTTOM };
      const fits = (r: Rect) => r.width * z <= area.right - area.left && r.height * z <= area.bottom - area.top;
      const all = focusRects(layout, focusId);
      const rects = withArrows ? all : all.slice(0, 1);
      const r = [...rects].reverse().find(fits) ?? rects[0];
      if (!r) return vp;
      let { x, y } = vp;
      const sx = r.x * z + x;
      const ex = (r.x + r.width) * z + x;
      if (sx < area.left || ex - sx > area.right - area.left) x += area.left - sx;
      else if (ex > area.right) x += area.right - ex;
      const sy = r.y * z + y;
      const ey = (r.y + r.height) * z + y;
      if (sy < area.top || ey - sy > area.bottom - area.top) y += area.top - sy;
      else if (ey > area.bottom) y += area.bottom - ey;
      return clearToolbar({ x, y, zoom: z }, r);
    },
    [layout, width, height, clearToolbar],
  );

  // The first time a workflow is ready: show it. After that, after every change to the document or
  // to what is selected, the view keeps what the author is working on in view:
  // - when what there is to show changes (a stage or arrow added, the layout wider), it is shown
  //   again the same way (fitted at 60% or more, else centred on the selection), unless the author
  //   has moved or zoomed the view by hand;
  // - then, in any case, the selected (or just added) stage or arrow is brought whole into view.
  const shownFor = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const shownBounds = useRef('');
  const shownFocus = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const boundsKey = bounds ? [bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.width, bounds.height].map(Math.round).join(',') : '';
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !doc || !width || !height) return;
    const focus = selectedStage ?? selectedArrow;
    const first = shownFor.current !== doc.id;
    const boundsChanged = shownBounds.current !== boundsKey;
    const focusChanged = shownFocus.current !== focus;
    shownFor.current = doc.id;
    shownBounds.current = boundsKey;
    shownFocus.current = focus;
    if (first) moved.current = false;
    if (!first && !boundsChanged && !focusChanged) return;
    let vp = first ? planned(focus) : boundsChanged && !moved.current ? planned(focus, flow.getViewport().zoom) : flow.getViewport();
    if (!vp) return;
    // After an edit, also the arrows just made at the selection; after only choosing, the box itself.
    if (focus) vp = keepInView(vp, focus, first || boundsChanged);
    const now = flow.getViewport();
    if (Math.abs(now.x - vp.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(now.y - vp.y) < 0.5 && Math.abs(now.zoom - vp.zoom) < 0.001) return;
    void flow.setViewport(vp, { duration: first || boundsChanged ? 0 : 250 });
  }, [ready, doc, width, height, boundsKey, planned, keepInView, flow, selectedStage, selectedArrow]);

  /** Brings a box (or an arrow's pill) into view if it is not, keeping the zoom. */
  const bringIntoView = useCallback(
    (id: string, always = false) => {
      if (!layout) return;
      const box = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id);
      const arrow = layout.arrows.find((a) => a.id === id);
      const r = box ?? (arrow ? labelRect(arrow.label) : undefined);
      if (!r) return;
      const { x: tx, y: ty, zoom: z } = flow.getViewport();
      const sx = r.x * z + tx;
      const sy = r.y * z + ty;
      const inside = sx >= 0 && sy >= TOOLBAR - 8 && sx + r.width * z <= width && sy + r.height * z <= height - BOTTOM + 8;
      if (inside && !always) return;
      const centred = { x: width / 2 - (r.x + r.width / 2) * z, y: TOOLBAR + (height - TOOLBAR - BOTTOM) / 2 - (r.y + r.height / 2) * z, zoom: z };
      void flow.setViewport(tidy(centred, r), { duration: 300 });
    },
    [layout, flow, width, height, tidy],
  );

  /**
   * The browser scrolls the canvas's inner box to show what gets the keyboard focus (Tab to a box
   * or pill off the edge), which shifts everything drawn off its place. Undo that scroll and move
   * the view instead, so the focused box or pill shows.
   */
  const onScrollCapture = (e: { target: EventTarget }) => {
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (!el.classList?.contains('react-flow') || (!el.scrollTop && !el.scrollLeft)) return;
    el.scrollTop = 0;
    el.scrollLeft = 0;
    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    const id = active?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-arrow-id]')?.dataset.arrowId ?? active?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-stage-id]')?.dataset.stageId;
    if (id) bringIntoView(id);
  };

  // ── "Show me": centre and flash ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const revealRequest = useRevealRequest();
  const handledReveal = useRef<number | null>(null);
  /** The reveal the diagram asked for itself (a stage just added): flash it, but only scroll if it is out of view. */
  const ownReveal = useRef<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!revealRequest || !doc || !ready || handledReveal.current === revealRequest.nonce) return;
    const item = revealRequest.location.item;
    const kind = find(doc, item)?.kind;
    const target = kind === 'arrow' ? item : stageOf(doc, item)?.id;
    if (!target) return;
    handledReveal.current = revealRequest.nonce;
    bringIntoView(target, ownReveal.current !== revealRequest.nonce);
    const on = window.setTimeout(() => setFlash(target), 0);
    const off = window.setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 1600);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(on);
      window.clearTimeout(off);
    };
  }, [revealRequest, doc, ready, bringIntoView]);

  // xyflow wraps each line in an <svg> of its own, which a screen reader lists as an unnamed image.
  // The lines say nothing the pills do not, so they are hidden from it.
  const hasLayout = !!layout;
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = canvas.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const hide = () => {
      for (const svg of root.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edges svg:not([aria-hidden])')) svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    };
    hide();
    const watch = new MutationObserver(hide);
    watch.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    return () => watch.disconnect();
  }, [hasLayout]);

  // ── Messages: a short one goes after a while; "Done: ..." stays until the next edit ──────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!message || message.done) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setMessage(null), 6000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [message]);
  /** The message shown: a "Done: ..." goes as soon as the document changes again. */
  const shownMessage = message?.done && message.done.doc !== doc ? null : message;

  // ── Edits ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /**
   * A stage was added: close the chooser, say so (with Undo), and show it in the panel with its
   * name ready to change (mockup 02-build "approval-added": the name field has the focus).
   */
  const settle = useCallback(
    (id: string, said: string) => {
      settled.current = true;
      setChooser(null);
      setMessage({ text: said, done: { doc: useEditor.getState().doc } });
      revealInPanel({ item: id, part: 'name' });
      ownReveal.current = useSession.getState().reveal?.nonce ?? null;
      // When nothing took the focus (no panel beside the diagram), it goes to the new box.
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        const active = document.activeElement;
        if (active && active !== document.body && document.contains(active)) return;
        canvas.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-select-stage="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }, 50);
    },
    [],
  );

  const addStage = useCallback(
    (kind: StageKindChoice, extra: { name?: string; insertOn?: string; pointArrow?: string; connectFrom?: string } = {}) => {
      const { connectFrom, ...args } = extra;
      const made = run('stage.add', { kind, ...args } as never);
      if (isRefusal(made)) return;
      const id = (made as { id: StageId }).id;
      if (connectFrom) run('arrow.connect', { from: connectFrom as StageId, to: id });
      const now = useEditor.getState().doc;
      const added = now ? getStage(now, id) : undefined;
      const fromId = extra.insertOn ?? extra.pointArrow;
      const from = !now ? undefined : connectFrom ? getStage(now, connectFrom) : fromId ? stageOf(now, fromId) : undefined;
      const what = kind === 'ending' ? t('diagram.added.ending', { name: added?.name || t('diagram.box.noName') }) : t(`stageKind.${kind}` as WordKey);
      const said = from
        ? t('diagram.added.after', { what, from: from.name || t('diagram.box.noName') })
        : t(kind === 'ending' ? 'diagram.added.endingAlone' : 'diagram.added.alone', { what });
      settle(id, said);
    },
    [run, settle],
  );

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    useEditor.getState().undo();
    setMessage(null);
    canvas.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  const deleteStage = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      const name = (doc && getStage(doc, id)?.name) || t('diagram.box.noName');
      const r = run('stage.delete', { stage: id as StageId });
      if (isRefusal(r)) {
        if (r.refused === 'startStage') setMessage({ text: t('diagram.cannotDeleteStart', { name }) });
        return;
      }
      setMessage({ text: t('diagram.deletedStage', { name }) });
      canvas.current?.focus();
    },
    [doc, run],
  );

  const deleteArrow = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      const arrow = doc ? getArrow(doc, id) : undefined;
      const label = layout?.arrows.find((a) => a.id === id)?.label.text ?? '';
      if (!arrow || isRefusal(run('arrow.delete', { arrow: arrow.id }))) return;
      setMessage({ text: t('diagram.deletedArrow', { label }) });
      canvas.current?.focus();
    },
    [doc, layout, run],
  );

  const connect = useCallback(
    (from: string, to: string) => {
      const r = run('arrow.connect', { from: from as StageId, to: to as StageId });
      if (isRefusal(r)) return;
      settled.current = false;
      setChooser(null);
      select({ item: (r as { id: string }).id, part: 'when' });
    },
    [run, select],
  );

  // ── Dragging from the handle under a stage ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const onConnectEnd = useCallback(
    (event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent, state: FinalConnectionState) => {
      const from = state.fromNode?.id;
      if (!from) return;
      const point = 'changedTouches' in event ? event.changedTouches[0] : event;
      if (!point) return;
      const hit = document
        .elementsFromPoint(point.clientX, point.clientY)
        .map((el) => el.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-drop-stage]'))
        .find((el) => !!el);
      const to = hit?.dataset.dropStage;
      if (to) {
        if (to !== from) connect(from, to);
        return;
      }
      const onPane = document.elementsFromPoint(point.clientX, point.clientY).some((el) => el.classList.contains('react-flow__pane'));
      if (!onPane) return;
      const at = flow.screenToFlowPosition({ x: point.clientX, y: point.clientY });
      settled.current = false;
      setChooser({ mode: 'here', stageId: from, flow: at, rect: new DOMRect(point.clientX - 120, point.clientY - 30, 240, 60), opener: null });
    },
    [connect, flow],
  );

  // ── Keys: Delete removes the selected (or focused) stage or arrow ───────────────────────
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Delete' && e.key !== 'Backspace') return;
    if (isTyping(e.target)) return;
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const arrowId = el.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-arrow-id]')?.dataset.arrowId;
    const stageId = el.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-stage-id]')?.dataset.stageId;
    if (arrowId) deleteArrow(arrowId);
    else if (stageId) deleteStage(stageId);
    else if (selectedArrow) deleteArrow(selectedArrow);
    else if (selection && doc && find(doc, selection.item)?.kind === 'stage') deleteStage(selection.item);
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
  };

  // ── What the pieces on the canvas can ask for ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const connecting = useConnection((c) => c.inProgress);

  const ctx = useMemo<DiagramContextValue>(
    () => ({
      selectedStage,
      selectedArrow,
      flash,
      plusShown: blank.hint2 ? (startArrow ?? null) : null,
      connecting,
      pillsFrom,
      boxAt,
      selectStage: (id) => select({ item: id }),
      selectArrow: (id, part) => select(part ? { item: id, part } : { item: id }),
      openInsert: (arrowId, el) => {
        settled.current = false;
        setChooser({ mode: 'insert', arrowId, rect: el.getBoundingClientRect(), opener: el });
      },
      openAnotherEnding: (el) => {
        settled.current = false;
        setChooser({ mode: 'ending', rect: el.getBoundingClientRect(), opener: el });
      },
      boxAction: (action: BoxAction, stageId: string, box: HTMLElement) => {
        if (action === 'delete') return deleteStage(stageId);
        settled.current = false;
        setChooser({ mode: action === 'connect' ? 'connect' : 'after', stageId, rect: box.getBoundingClientRect(), opener: box });
      },
      ...(marks ? { marks } : {}),
    }),
    [selectedStage, selectedArrow, flash, blank.hint2, startArrow, connecting, pillsFrom, boxAt, select, deleteStage, marks],
  );

  /** The zoom buttons: the author's own zoom, so later edits leave the view alone. */
  const zoomBy = (go: () => Promise<boolean>) => {
    moved.current = true;
    void go();
  };

  if (!doc || !layout) return <section className={s.canvas} aria-label={t('diagram.label')} />;
  const sample = doc.sampleRequest?.name?.trim();

  return (
    <DiagramContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <section ref={canvas} className={s.canvas} aria-label={t('diagram.label')} tabIndex={-1} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} onScrollCapture={onScrollCapture}>
        <div className={s.tools}>
          <Button
            icon="plus"
            onClick={(e) => {
              settled.current = false;
              setChooser({ mode: 'add', rect: e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(), opener: e.currentTarget });
            }}
            aria-haspopup="dialog"
          >
            {t('diagram.addStage')}
          </Button>
          {sample ? (
            <div className={s.sample} aria-label={t('diagram.sample.label', { name: sample })} role="note">
              <Icon name="sample" size={14} />
              <span className={s.sampleWord}>{t('diagram.sample')}</span>
              <b>{sample}</b>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className={s.toolsHint}>{t('diagram.addStage.hint')}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* In the band along the bottom, where the view keeps no box or arrow words (not over the
            arrows at the top of the diagram), clear of the zoom control. */}
        <BottomMessage message={shownMessage} onUndo={undo} canvas={canvas} transform={transform} layout={layout} />

        <div className={s.flow} data-ready={ready || undefined}>
          <ReactFlow<BoxNode, ArrowEdgeType>
            nodes={nodes}
            edges={edges}
            nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
            edgeTypes={edgeTypes}
            onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
            onConnectEnd={onConnectEnd}
            // Only the author's own panning and zooming counts as moving the view: not the view set
            // here (no event), and not a click on a box (a gesture that starts and ends in one place).
            onMoveStart={(event, vp) => {
              gestureFrom.current = event ? vp : null;
            }}
            onMoveEnd={(event, vp) => {
              const from = gestureFrom.current;
              gestureFrom.current = null;
              if (event && from && (Math.abs(from.x - vp.x) > 1 || Math.abs(from.y - vp.y) > 1 || Math.abs(from.zoom - vp.zoom) > 0.001)) moved.current = true;
            }}
            ariaLabelConfig={ariaLabelConfig}
            // A click handler keeps the boxes reachable by the pointer (xyflow turns pointer
            // events off on nodes that can be neither selected nor dragged); the box selects itself.
            onNodeClick={noop}
            nodesDraggable={false}
            nodesConnectable
            nodesFocusable={false}
            edgesFocusable={false}
            elementsSelectable={false}
            disableKeyboardA11y
            deleteKeyCode={null}
            selectionKeyCode={null}
            multiSelectionKeyCode={null}
            panOnScroll
            zoomOnScroll={false}
            zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
            minZoom={MIN_ZOOM}
            maxZoom={1.5}
            connectionRadius={0}
            connectionLineStyle={{ stroke: 'var(--accent)', strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: '5 4' }}
            proOptions={{ hideAttribution: true }}
          >
            <ViewportPortal>
              <BlankHints hints={hints} />
              {chooser?.mode === 'here' && (
                <div className={s.dropSpot} style={{ transform: `translate(${chooser.flow.x - 130}px, ${chooser.flow.y - 34}px)` }}>
                  <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
                  {t('diagram.newStageHere')}
                </div>
              )}
              <DropTip />
            </ViewportPortal>
          </ReactFlow>
        </div>

        <OffScreen
          layout={layout}
          transform={transform}
          width={width}
          height={height}
          canvas={canvas}
          onShow={(id) => bringIntoView(id, true)}
          avoid={shownMessage?.text ?? ''}
        />

        <ZoomControl zoom={zoom} onOut={() => zoomBy(() => flow.zoomOut({ duration: 150 }))} onIn={() => zoomBy(() => flow.zoomIn({ duration: 150 }))} onFit={() => showWhole()} />

        {chooser && (
          <ChooserPopover
            chooser={chooser}
            doc={doc}
            layout={layout}
            onClose={() => setChooser(null)}
            returnFocus={() => (settled.current ? null : chooser.opener)}
            addStage={addStage}
            connect={connect}
          />
        )}
      </section>
    </DiagramContext.Provider>
  );
}

// ── The kind chooser and the stage list, in their popover ──────────────────────────────────

function ChooserPopover({
  chooser, doc, layout, onClose, returnFocus, addStage, connect,
}: {
  chooser: Chooser;
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  layout: Layout;
  onClose(): void;
  returnFocus(): HTMLElement | null;
  addStage(kind: StageKindChoice, extra?: { name?: string; insertOn?: string; pointArrow?: string; connectFrom?: string }): void;
  connect(from: string, to: string): void;
}) {
  const rect = chooser.rect;
  const anchor = useCallback(() => rect, [rect]);
  const stageChip = (id: string | null | undefined) => {
    const stage = getStage(doc, id);
    const colour = stage ? doc.statuses.find((x) => x.id === (stage.status ?? (stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.ifSentBackStatus : undefined)))?.colour : undefined;
    return (
      <span className={ps.inline}>
        {colour && <span className={ps.dot} style={{ background: statusColourVar(colour) }} />}
        {stage?.name || t('diagram.box.noName')}
      </span>
    );
  };
  const labelOf = (arrowId: string) => layout.arrows.find((a) => a.id === arrowId)?.label.text ?? '';
  const common = { open: true, onClose, anchor, returnFocus };

  switch (chooser.mode) {
    case 'add':
      return (
        <AnchoredPopover {...common} title={t('diagram.chooser.add.title')} sub={t('diagram.chooser.add.sub')} width={600} footer={<Foot />}>
          <KindChooser onChoose={(kind) => addStage(kind)} />
        </AnchoredPopover>
      );
    case 'insert':
    case 'after': {
      const stage = chooser.mode === 'after' ? getWorking(doc, chooser.stageId) : undefined;
      const arrowId = chooser.mode === 'insert' ? chooser.arrowId : (stage?.arrows.find((a) => a.goTo) ?? stage?.arrows[0])?.id;
      const arrow = arrowId ? getArrow(doc, arrowId) : undefined;
      const from = arrow ? stageOf(doc, arrow.id)?.id : chooser.mode === 'after' ? chooser.stageId : undefined;
      const to = arrow?.goTo && getStage(doc, arrow.goTo) ? arrow.goTo : null;
      const sub = to
        ? fill(t('diagram.chooser.next.between'), { from: stageChip(from), to: stageChip(to) })
        : fill(t('diagram.chooser.next.after'), { from: stageChip(from) });
      const choose = (kind: StageKindChoice) =>
        arrow ? addStage(kind, { insertOn: arrow.id }) : addStage(kind, { connectFrom: chooser.mode === 'after' ? chooser.stageId : undefined });
      return (
        <AnchoredPopover {...common} title={t('diagram.chooser.next.title')} sub={sub} width={600} side="right" footer={<Foot />}>
          <KindChooser onChoose={choose} />
        </AnchoredPopover>
      );
    }
    case 'here': {
      const stage = getWorking(doc, chooser.stageId);
      const open = stage?.arrows.find((a) => a.goTo === null);
      const sub = open
        ? fill(t('diagram.chooser.here.arrow'), { label: <span className={`${ps.inline} ${ps.pill}`}>{labelOf(open.id)}</span> })
        : fill(t('diagram.chooser.here.new'), { from: stageChip(chooser.stageId) });
      const extra = open ? { pointArrow: open.id } : { connectFrom: chooser.stageId };
      return (
        <AnchoredPopover {...common} title={t('diagram.chooser.here.title')} sub={sub} width={340} side="right">
          <KindList
            onChoose={(kind) => addStage(kind, extra)}
            onChooseEnding={(name) => addStage('ending', { ...extra, name })}
            endingName={defaultStageName(doc, 'ending')}
          />
        </AnchoredPopover>
      );
    }
    case 'ending':
      return (
        <AnchoredPopover {...common} title={t('diagram.chooser.ending.title')} sub={t('diagram.chooser.ending.sub')} width={320} side="right">
          <EndingName initial={defaultStageName(doc, 'ending')} why={false} onAdd={(name) => addStage('ending', { name })} />
        </AnchoredPopover>
      );
    case 'connect': {
      const others = layout.boxes.filter((b) => (b.kind === 'stage' || b.kind === 'ending') && b.id !== chooser.stageId);
      return (
        <AnchoredPopover
          {...common}
          title={t('diagram.connect.title', { from: getStage(doc, chooser.stageId)?.name || t('diagram.box.noName') })}
          sub={t('diagram.connect.sub')}
          width={320}
          side="right"
        >
          <ul className={s.stageList}>
            {others.map((b) => (
              <li key={b.id}>
                <button type="button" className={s.stageItem} onClick={() => connect(chooser.stageId, b.id)}>
                  <Icon name={(getStage(doc, b.id)?.kind ?? 'blank') as 'blank'} />
                  {stageChip(b.id)}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </AnchoredPopover>
      );
    }
  }
}

function Foot() {
  return (
    <>
      <Icon name="info" size={14} />
      {t('diagram.chooser.foot')}
    </>
  );
}

// ── Starting from blank: three numbered hints (editor-model.md section 9) ──────────────────

interface Blank {
  hint1: boolean;
  hint2: boolean;
  hint3: boolean;
}

/** Whether the workflow opened as a new one (only the start stage and one ending), and which hints are still to do. */
function useBlankStart(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null): Blank {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState<{ id: string; blank: boolean } | null>(null);
  if (doc && opened?.id !== doc.id) setOpened({ id: doc.id, blank: workingCount(doc) <= 1 && endingCount(doc) <= 1 });
  if (!doc || !opened?.blank) return { hint1: false, hint2: false, hint3: false };
  const start = getWorking(doc, doc.start?.stage);
  const asks = start?.tasks.some((task) => task.form.pages.some((p) => p.items.length > 0)) ?? true;
  return { hint1: !asks, hint2: workingCount(doc) <= 1, hint3: endingCount(doc) <= 1 };
}

const workingCount = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow) => doc.stages.filter((x) => x.kind !== 'ending').length;
const endingCount = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow) => doc.stages.filter((x) => x.kind === 'ending').length;

type HintKey = 'diagram.hint.1' | 'diagram.hint.2' | 'diagram.hint.3';
interface HintSpot {
  n: number;
  key: HintKey;
  /** The hint's left edge and its middle, in the diagram's own coordinates. */
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

/** Where the hints still to do go: beside the start stage, beside the start's arrow, beside "+ Another ending". */
function hintSpots(layout: Layout, doc: AuthoredWorkflow, blank: Blank, startArrow?: string): HintSpot[] {
  const start = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.id === doc.start?.stage);
  const pill = startArrow ? layout.arrows.find((a) => a.id === startArrow) : undefined;
  const another = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.id === ANOTHER_ENDING);
  const hints: HintSpot[] = [];
  if (blank.hint1 && start) hints.push({ n: 1, key: 'diagram.hint.1', x: start.x + start.width + 14, y: start.y + Math.min(start.height / 2, 60) });
  if (blank.hint2 && pill) hints.push({ n: 2, key: 'diagram.hint.2', x: pill.label.x + pill.label.width / 2 + 44, y: pill.label.y });
  if (blank.hint3 && another) hints.push({ n: 3, key: 'diagram.hint.3', x: another.x + another.width + 14, y: another.y + another.height / 2 });
  return hints;
}

function BlankHints({ hints }: { hints: HintSpot[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {hints.map((h) => (
        <p key={h.n} className={s.hint} style={{ transform: `translate(${h.x}px, ${h.y}px) translateY(-50%)` }}>
          <span className={s.hintNumber}>{h.n}</span>
          {t(h.key)}
        </p>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
/** "Drop for a new stage here", beside the pointer while an arrow is dragged over empty space. */
function DropTip() {
  const c = useConnection();
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  const to = c.inProgress ? c.to : null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!c.inProgress) return;
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => setOver(!!(e.target as Element | null)?.closest?.('[data-drop-stage]'));
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
  }, [c.inProgress]);
  if (!to || over) return null;
  return (
    <div className={s.dropTip} style={{ transform: `translate(${to.x + 14}px, ${to.y + 14}px)` }}>
      <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
      {t('diagram.dropHere')}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── "Done: ... Undo" and the other short messages ──────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * The message line, at the bottom of the diagram (the zoom control's band). It never covers a box
 * or arrow words: it stays at the bottom centre when that is clear, else slides along the bottom,
 * then steps up from it (as the "Below: ..." hint does). The live region is always there, so a
 * screen reader hears each message.
 */
function BottomMessage({
  message, onUndo, canvas, transform, layout,
}: {
  message: Message | null;
  onUndo(): void;
  canvas: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  transform: [number, number, number];
  layout: Layout;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  // Held from the bottom edge, so it stays at the bottom when the canvas changes height (the top bar wrapping).
  const [spot, setSpot] = useState<{ left: number; bottom: number } | null>(null);
  const text = message?.text ?? '';
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = () => {
      const el = ref.current;
      const root = canvas.current;
      if (!el || !root || !text) return;
      const at = dodge(root, el, 'below', true);
      const next = at ? { left: at.left, bottom: Math.round(root.clientHeight - at.top - el.offsetHeight) } : null;
      setSpot((was) => (was && next && was.left === next.left && was.bottom === next.bottom ? was : next));
    };
    place();
    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(place);
    return () => window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [canvas, text, transform, layout]);
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={s.message}
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
      style={spot && text ? { left: spot.left, bottom: spot.bottom, transform: 'none' } : undefined}
    >
      {message && (
        <span className={s.messageText} data-done={message.done ? true : undefined}>
          <Icon name={message.done ? 'check' : 'info'} size={14} />
          <span>
            {message.done && <b>{t('diagram.done')} </b>}
            {message.text}
          </span>
          {message.done && (
            <button type="button" className={s.messageUndo} onClick={onUndo}>
              {t('diagram.undo')}
            </button>
          )}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── "Below: Rejected and Released" ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Side = 'above' | 'below' | 'left' | 'right';

function OffScreen({
  layout, transform, width, height, canvas, onShow, avoid,
}: {
  layout: Layout;
  transform: [number, number, number];
  width: number;
  height: number;
  canvas: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onShow(id: string): void;
  /** Changes when the message along the bottom does, so the hints move clear of it. */
  avoid: string;
}) {
  if (!width || !height) return null;
  const [tx, ty, z] = transform;
  const sides: Record<Side, Box[]> = { above: [], below: [], left: [], right: [] };
  for (const b of layout.boxes) {
    if (b.kind !== 'stage' && b.kind !== 'ending') continue;
    const x = b.x * z + tx;
    const y = b.y * z + ty;
    if (y >= height - BOTTOM + 20) sides.below.push(b);
    else if (y + b.height * z <= TOOLBAR - 8) sides.above.push(b);
    else if (x >= width) sides.right.push(b);
    else if (x + b.width * z <= 0) sides.left.push(b);
  }
  return (
    <>
      {(Object.keys(sides) as Side[]).map((side) => {
        const list = sides[side];
        if (list.length === 0) return null;
        const first = list[0] as Box;
        return (
          <OffScreenHint
            key={side}
            side={side}
            ids={list.map((b) => b.id)}
            canvas={canvas}
            transform={transform}
            layout={layout}
            avoid={avoid}
            onShow={() => onShow(first.id)}
          />
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * "Below: Rejected and Released". It never covers a box (mockup kit, WF.dodgeEdgeHint): it stays at
 * its edge when that spot is clear; otherwise it slides along the edge, then steps in from it.
 * Boxes and the zoom controls are avoided, and arrow pills too when a spot clear of them exists.
 */
function OffScreenHint({
  side, ids, canvas, transform, layout, avoid, onShow,
}: {
  side: Side;
  ids: string[];
  canvas: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  transform: [number, number, number];
  layout: Layout;
  avoid: string;
  onShow(): void;
}): ReactNode {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [spot, setSpot] = useState<{ left: number; top: number } | null>(null);
  const names = doc ? joinNames(ids.map((id) => getStage(doc, id)?.name || t('diagram.box.noName'))) : '';

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = () => {
      const el = ref.current;
      const root = canvas.current;
      if (!el || !root) return;
      const next = dodge(root, el, side);
      setSpot((was) => (was && next && was.left === next.left && was.top === next.top ? was : next));
    };
    place();
    // xyflow moves the boxes in a render of its own: look again once they are where they go.
    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(place);
    return () => window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [canvas, side, names, transform, layout, avoid]);

  if (!doc) return null;
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      className={s.offscreen}
      data-side={side}
      style={spot ? { left: spot.left, top: spot.top, right: 'auto', bottom: 'auto', transform: 'none' } : undefined}
      onClick={onShow}
    >
      <Icon name={side === 'below' ? 'arrow-down' : side === 'left' ? 'arrow-left' : side === 'right' ? 'arrow-right' : 'chevron-up'} size={14} />
      {t(`diagram.offscreen.${side}`, { names })}
    </button>
  );
}

/** A spot for an edge hint of el's size inside oot, clear of boxes (and pills when it can be). */
export function dodge(root: HTMLElement, el: HTMLElement, side: Side, pillsHard = false): { left: number; top: number } | null {
  const cr = root.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cw = cr.width;
  const ch = cr.height;
  const hw = el.offsetWidth;
  const hh = el.offsetHeight;
  if (!cw || !ch || !hw || !hh) return null;
  const rel = (r: DOMRect): Rect => ({ x: r.left - cr.left, y: r.top - cr.top, width: r.width, height: r.height });
  const seen = (r: Rect) => r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
  const all = (sel: string) =>
    [...root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(sel)].filter((n) => !el.contains(n)).map((n) => rel(n.getBoundingClientRect())).filter(seen);
  // `pillsHard` (the "Done: ..." message): never over arrow words either.
  const pills = all('[data-arrow-id]');
  const hard = [...all('.react-flow__node'), ...all(`.${s.zoom}`), ...all(`.${s.messageText}`), ...(pillsHard ? pills : [])];
  const soft = pillsHard ? [] : pills;
  const at = (x: number, y: number): Rect => ({ x, y, width: hw, height: hh });
  const clear = (r: Rect, list: Rect[]) => !list.some((b) => overlaps(r, b, 4));
  const home =
    side === 'below' ? { x: (cw - hw) / 2, y: ch - 16 - hh }
    : side === 'above' ? { x: (cw - hw) / 2, y: TOOLBAR - 4 }
    : side === 'left' ? { x: 14, y: (ch - hh) / 2 }
    : { x: cw - 14 - hw, y: (ch - hh) / 2 };
  const tries: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  if (side === 'below' || side === 'above') {
    const xs = [home.x, cw - 14 - hw, 14];
    for (let x = cw - 14 - hw; x > 14; x -= 24) xs.push(x);
    for (let o = 0; o < ch * 0.45; o += 18) for (const x of xs) tries.push({ x, y: side === 'below' ? home.y - o : home.y + o });
  } else {
    for (let o = 0; o < ch * 0.45; o += 18) tries.push({ x: home.x, y: home.y - o }, { x: home.x, y: home.y + o });
  }
  const inside = tries.filter((p) => p.x >= 0 && p.x + hw <= cw && p.y >= 0 && p.y + hh <= ch);
  for (const list of [[...hard, ...soft], hard]) {
    const pick = inside.find((p) => clear(at(p.x, p.y), list));
    if (pick) return { left: Math.round(pick.x), top: Math.round(pick.y) };
  }
  return { left: Math.round(home.x), top: Math.round(home.y) };
}
// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const noop = () => undefined;

/** A line over the diagram. `done`: "Done: ..." with Undo, kept until the document changes again. */
interface Message {
  text: string;
  done?: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null };
}

/** Which arrows the check says send a request back, as a key that stays the same while they do. */
export function sendsBackKeyOf(facts: Facts | null): string {
  if (!facts) return '';
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [id, arrow] of Object.entries(facts.arrows ?? {})) {
    const said = (arrow as { sendsBack?: boolean } | undefined)?.sendsBack;
    if (said !== undefined) parts.push(`${id}:${said ? 1 : 0}`);
  }
  return parts.sort().join(',');
}

/** The layout's `sendsBack` question, answered from a key made by sendsBackKeyOf. */
export function sendsBackFrom(key: string): (arrowId: string) => boolean | undefined {
  const said = new Map<string, boolean>();
  for (const part of key ? key.split(',') : []) {
    const at = part.lastIndexOf(':');
    said.set(part.slice(0, at), part.slice(at + 1) === '1');
  }
  return (id) => said.get(id);
}

/** The smallest rectangle holding all of them. */
function union(rects: Rect[]): Rect {
  const x = Math.min(...rects.map((r) => r.x));
  const y = Math.min(...rects.map((r) => r.y));
  const right = Math.max(...rects.map((r) => r.x + r.width));
  const bottom = Math.max(...rects.map((r) => r.y + r.height));
  return { x, y, width: right - x, height: bottom - y };
}

function getWorking(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | null | undefined) {
  const stage = getStage(doc, id);
  return stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage : undefined;
}

/** A box, or an arrow's pill, by id. */
function rectOf(layout: Layout, id: string): Rect | undefined {
  const box = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id);
  if (box) return box;
  const arrow = layout.arrows.find((a) => a.id === id);
  return arrow ? labelRect(arrow.label) : undefined;
}

/**
 * What to keep in view for a selected stage or arrow, smallest first: the box alone, then the box
 * with the pills of the arrows leaving it and the placeholders they end at ("Choose a stage or
 * ending" just made); for an arrow, its pill, then the pill with where it ends.
 */
export function focusRects(layout: Layout, id: string): Rect[] {
  const box = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id);
  if (box) {
    const own = layout.arrows.filter((a) => a.from === id);
    const places = own.flatMap((a) => layout.boxes.filter((b) => b.id === chooseBoxId(a.id) || b.id === deletedBoxId(a.id)));
    return own.length ? [box, union([box, ...own.map((a) => labelRect(a.label)), ...places])] : [box];
  }
  const arrow = layout.arrows.find((a) => a.id === id);
  if (!arrow) return [];
  const pill = labelRect(arrow.label);
  const place = layout.boxes.find((b) => b.id === chooseBoxId(arrow.id) || b.id === deletedBoxId(arrow.id));
  return place ? [pill, union([pill, place])] : [pill];
}

/** True when the key goes to a text box. */
function isTyping(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  if (target.isContentEditable || target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) return true;
  return target instanceof HTMLInputElement && !['button', 'checkbox', 'radio', 'submit'].includes(target.type);
}

import { useId, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { PRESET_WORDS, type KindChooserProps, type StageKindChoice } from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import s from './KindChooser.module.css';

/** The six kinds of stage, in the order the mockups show them. */
export const KIND_ORDER: readonly StageKindChoice[] = ['form', 'approval', 'work', 'automatic', 'ending', 'blank'];

/** The buttons a kind comes with: the same words the presets put into the document. */
const COMES_WITH: Partial<Record<StageKindChoice, string[]>> = {
  form: [PRESET_WORDS.submit],
  approval: [PRESET_WORDS.approve, PRESET_WORDS.reject],
  work: [PRESET_WORDS.markDone],
};

const kindWord = (kind: StageKindChoice) => t(`stageKind.${kind}` as WordKey);

/**
 * Slot KindChooser: the kinds of stage as cards, each with its icon, word, one line on what it does
 * and the buttons it comes with (mockup 02, "What should happen next?"). Content only: the caller
 * gives the heading and puts it in a popover or dialog.
 */
export function KindChooser({ onChoose, includeEnding = true }: KindChooserProps) {
  return (
    <ul className={s.grid}>
      {KIND_ORDER.filter((k) => includeEnding || k !== 'ending').map((kind) => {
        const buttons = COMES_WITH[kind];
        return (
          <li key={kind}>
            <button type="button" className={s.card} data-kind={kind} onClick={() => onChoose(kind)}>
              <span className={s.icon}>
                <Icon name={kind} size={18} />
              </span>
              <span className={s.text}>
                <span className={s.name}>{kindWord(kind)}</span>
                <span className={s.desc}>{t(`diagram.kind.${kind}` as WordKey)}</span>
                {buttons && (
                  <span className={s.gets}>
                    <span className={s.lbl}>{t('diagram.chooser.comesWith')}</span>
                    {buttons.map((b) => (
                      <span key={b} className={s.button}>
                        {b}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </span>
                )}
                {kind === 'approval' && <span className={s.desc}>{t('diagram.kind.approval.more')}</span>}
              </span>
            </button>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

/**
 * The same kinds as a short list ("New stage here"): one line each. Choosing Ending opens a name
 * field first ("Name of the ending", "Add ending").
 */
export function KindList({
  onChoose,
  onChooseEnding,
  endingName,
}: {
  onChoose(kind: StageKindChoice): void;
  onChooseEnding(name: string): void;
  /** The name the field starts with. */
  endingName: string;
}) {
  const [naming, setNaming] = useState(false);
  const groupId = useId();
  return (
    <div className={s.list}>
      <div className={s.group} id={groupId}>
        {t('diagram.chooser.whichKind')}
      </div>
      <ul className={s.items} aria-labelledby={groupId}>
        {KIND_ORDER.map((kind) => (
          <li key={kind}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={s.item}
              data-active={(kind === 'ending' && naming) || undefined}
              aria-expanded={kind === 'ending' ? naming : undefined}
              onClick={() => (kind === 'ending' ? setNaming((n) => !n) : onChoose(kind))}
            >
              <Icon name={kind} />
              <span className={s.itemName}>{kindWord(kind)}</span>
              <span className={s.itemDesc}>{t(`diagram.kindShort.${kind}` as WordKey)}</span>
            </button>
            {kind === 'ending' && naming && <EndingName initial={endingName} onAdd={onChooseEnding} />}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

/** "Name of the ending" with "Add ending". */
export function EndingName({ initial, onAdd, why = true }: { initial: string; onAdd(name: string): void; why?: boolean }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(initial);
  const id = useId();
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (name.trim()) onAdd(name.trim());
  };
  return (
    <form className={s.naming} onSubmit={submit}>
      {why && <p className={s.why}>{t('diagram.chooser.endingWhy')}</p>}
      <label className={s.label} htmlFor={id}>
        {t('diagram.chooser.endingName')}
      </label>
      <div className={s.row}>
        <input id={id} className={s.input} value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="sm">
          {t('diagram.chooser.addEnding')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/diagram/README.md\n===
# features/diagram

The left side of the Diagram tab (editor-model.md section 2; mockups 01-editor and 02-build), the `KindChooser` slot and the `ReadOnlyDiagram` slot.

- `index.tsx` exports `DiagramView` (route `/w/:workflowId`, beside the stage panel), `KindChooser` (the model slot) and `ReadOnlyDiagram` (the model slot for Try it and the request page).
- `layout.ts`: `layoutDiagram(doc, { sizes, measureLabel, sendsBack, previous })`, pure. dagre places the boxes and makes room for every arrow's pill; endings go in one row at the bottom; an arrow that skips ranks, or goes back up, is routed round the side (back up always on the left, dashed when it sends a request back). "Choose a stage or ending" sits beside its stage (right, else left), reached by one line across, so it never takes the main path's column or pushes the endings down ("Deleted stage" keeps the deleted stage's place in the rows). `previous` (the layout shown before the edit) keeps each row's left-to-right order (dagre order constraints) and makes a new arrow to a stage that was higher up the one that goes back up. Stored `doc.diagram.positions` win. A stage whose arrows all go to endings keeps the ending of its main arrow (the one straight below it before, else its first) right under it, the other endings moved aside, so the main path still runs straight down when a second ending is added. A group of stages the start no longer reaches (after a delete) is lowered to just above where its arrows go. Tested in `layout.test.ts` on all four fixtures.
- `useLaidOut.ts`: the layout as measured xyflow nodes and edges (and each stage's pills), shared by the editing diagram and the read-only one, so both draw the same boxes in the same places.
- `StageCard.tsx`: what a stage box shows (name, status, kind, who is asked with the sample's answer, buttons, actions, what an Automatic stage saves its result as in the panel's words "Save the issue as", "Also starts from Helpdesk and Jira", the first To do). A value shown as it is ("Eng lead", "Jira issue") is the values feature's own chip, through the `ValueChip` slot, so clicking it opens the value card. Words come from `@/model` describe functions (`stageParts.ts`; lists joined with the shared list words by `joinNames`). Which document it shows comes from `boxSource.ts` (the open draft, or the ReadOnlyDiagram's own document, read only: no To do, no sample answer, values as words). Tested in `StageCard.test.tsx`.
- `parts.tsx`: the xyflow node and edge components (stage box with its handles, menu and its own button, "Choose a stage or ending", "Deleted stage" with only the old name struck through, "+ Another ending", the arrow's line). A stage box is a group named "Domain approval, Approval" holding a button of the same name under the card: Enter or Space (or a click anywhere on the box) opens the stage. An arrow's pill and "+" are drawn inside the node of the stage it leaves (not in xyflow's edge-label layer), so with the keyboard each stage's arrows come right after its box. The lines are hidden from screen readers; the pill buttons name the arrows. With `run` in the context the same components draw read only (`RunStageNode`, `RunPill`).
- `marks.ts`: while the chosen stage has a "may be empty" To do, "Filled here", "Used here" and "May be empty here" on the boxes and the deciding arrow lit (mockup 04-values may-be-empty), from the finding's params and the facts. Tested in `marks.test.ts`.
- `DiagramView.tsx`: the canvas, toolbar, zoom (`ZoomControl.tsx`: "Shown at 85%" for screen readers, said once after the author's own zoom), the view, "Below: ..." hints (they slide clear of boxes), the three blank-start hints (kept in view), "Show me" (centre and flash), the kind chooser popovers, the message line ("Done: ... Undo" after a stage is added; focus then goes to the panel's name field through `reveal({ item, part: 'name' })`) at the bottom, sliding clear of boxes, arrow words and the zoom control, Delete, and dragging from a handle. Layout runs once per change: it depends on which arrows send back, not on each new facts object.
  - The view: the first time, fitted to its whole content when that fits at 60% or more (`MIN_FIT_ZOOM`; the frontend owner's ruling, fix round 2: the demo opens whole, endings and "+ Another ending" included), else at 85% on the selection or the top, with the "Below: ..." hint. After every change to the document or the selection: when what there is to show changed it is fitted again when it fits at 85%, or at the zoom shown when that is smaller and it still fits; otherwise the zoom stays as it is (it never jumps up to 85% under the author's eyes) and the view centres on the selection or the top; all this unless the author has panned or zoomed by hand (a click on a box is not that); then the selected or just-added stage (after an edit, with the pills and placeholders of its arrows) or arrow is brought whole into view, inside the canvas (never under the panel), below the toolbar and above the bottom band, and no box is left showing in the toolbar's band. Tab to something off the edge moves the view, never scrolls the canvas out of place.
- `ReadOnlyDiagram.tsx`: the `ReadOnlyDiagram` slot (`ReadOnlyDiagramProps` in `src/model/slots.ts`). The same layout and boxes with no handle, menu, "+" or "Another ending"; `at` stages glow and say "The request is here" (a tag, and in the box's name), `visited` say "Done", `taken` arrows are drawn as travelled ("taken" for screen readers), `stuckAt` says "Stuck"; each box is a button (`aria-current="location"` where the request is) when `onStageClick` is given, else a group. Fitted to its container (at least 360px high) but never below 85% (editor-model.md section 2), centred on where the request is when it does not fit, with no empty canvas past the first or last stage; "Show the whole workflow" may go lower. Zoom control at the bottom. In a page that scrolls (the request page) the mouse wheel scrolls the page and the diagram is dragged; elsewhere (Try it) the wheel moves the diagram. Outside the editor it asks the services for the catalogue once, for action names. Tested in `ReadOnlyDiagram.test.tsx`.
- `KindChooser.tsx`: the six kinds as cards (the slot), as a short list ("New stage here"), and the ending's name field.
- `AnchoredPopover.tsx`: a popover anchored to a rectangle rather than a trigger (candidate for `src/ui`).
- Edits only through `useEditor.getState().run(...)`: `stage.add` (with `insertOn` / `pointArrow`), `stage.delete`, `arrow.connect`, `arrow.delete`; selection with `select`. A new arrow is selected as `{ item: arrowId, part: 'when' }` so the panel can focus its "when".
- e2e: `tests/e2e/diagram.spec.ts`.

import '@xyflow/react/dist/base.css';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { ReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider, useReactFlow, useStore } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import { useCatalogue, useDoc, type ReadOnlyDiagramProps } from '@/model';
import { BoxSourceContext } from './boxSource';
import { MIN_AUTO_ZOOM, MIN_ZOOM, ariaLabelConfig, edgeTypes, nodeTypes } from './DiagramView';
import { DiagramContext, type ArrowEdgeType, type BoxNode, type DiagramContextValue, type RunView } from './parts';
import { useLaidOut } from './useLaidOut';
import { ZoomControl } from './ZoomControl';
import s from './diagram.module.css';

/** Room kept round the workflow when it is fitted; the zoom control's band at the bottom. */
const PAD = 24;
const BAND = 48;

/**
 * The ReadOnlyDiagram slot (src/model/slots.ts): the editing diagram's layout and stage boxes with
 * no editing affordance (no handles, menus, "+" or "Another ending"). The stages where the request
 * is now glow and say "The request is here"; stages it has been through say "Passed" and arrows it
 * took are drawn as travelled ("taken" for screen readers); the stage it is stuck at says "Stuck".
 * Each box is a button when `onStageClick` is given.
 */
export function ReadOnlyDiagram(props: ReadOnlyDiagramProps) {
  const open = useDoc();
  const doc = props.doc ?? open;
  if (!doc) return <section className={s.runCanvas} aria-label={props.label} />;
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <RunDiagram {...props} doc={doc} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

/**
 * True when the diagram sits in a page that scrolls (the request page): there the mouse wheel
 * scrolls the page, and the diagram is moved by dragging. Where nothing round it scrolls (Try it),
 * the wheel moves the diagram.
 */
function useInScrollingPage(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, deps: unknown[]): boolean {
  const [inPage, setInPage] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const check = () => {
      let el = ref.current?.parentElement ?? null;
      let found = false;
      while (el && !found) {
        const oy = getComputedStyle(el).overflowY;
        if ((oy === 'auto' || oy === 'scroll') && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1) found = true;
        el = el.parentElement;
      }
      const root = document.scrollingElement;
      if (!found && root && root.scrollHeight > root.clientHeight + 1) found = true;
      setInPage(found);
    };
    check();
    window.addEventListener('resize', check);
    const ro = typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined' ? null : new ResizeObserver(check);
    ro?.observe(document.body);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', check);
      ro?.disconnect();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, deps);
  return inPage;
}

const noop = () => undefined;
const notKnown = () => undefined;

/**
 * The catalogue for the boxes' words (action names, what is saved): the open workflow's when there
 * is one (Try it), else asked of the services once (the request page, outside the editor).
 */
function useCatalogueForBoxes(): Catalogue | undefined {
  const open = useCatalogue();
  const services = useServices();
  const [fetched, setFetched] = useState<Catalogue | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) return;
    let live = true;
    void services.catalogue
      .getCatalogue()
      .then((r) => {
        if (live && r.ok) setFetched(r.value);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [open, services]);
  return open ?? fetched;
}

function RunDiagram({ doc, at, visited, taken, stuckAt, onStageClick, label }: ReadOnlyDiagramProps & { doc: AuthoredWorkflow }) {
  const flow = useReactFlow();
  const catalogue = useCatalogueForBoxes();
  const source = useMemo(() => ({ doc, readOnly: true, env: catalogue ? { catalogue } : {} }), [doc, catalogue]);
  const { layout, ready, nodes, edges, pillsFrom, boxAt, onNodesChange } = useLaidOut(doc, notKnown, { editing: false });
  const width = useStore((st) => st.width);
  const height = useStore((st) => st.height);
  const zoom = useStore((st) => st.transform[2]);

  // The lists come as new arrays on every render of the page: keep one RunView while they say the same.
  const key = JSON.stringify([at ?? [], visited ?? [], taken ?? [], stuckAt ?? null]);
  const click = useRef(onStageClick);
  useEffect(() => {
    click.current = onStageClick;
  });
  const clickable = !!onStageClick;
  const run = useMemo<RunView>(() => {
    const [a, v, tk, st] = JSON.parse(key) as [string[], string[], string[], string | null];
    return {
      at: new Set(a),
      visited: new Set(v),
      taken: new Set(tk),
      ...(st ? { stuckAt: st } : {}),
      ...(clickable ? { onStageClick: (id: string) => click.current?.(id) } : {}),
    };
  }, [key, clickable]);

  const ctx = useMemo<DiagramContextValue>(
    () => ({
      selectedStage: null,
      selectedArrow: null,
      flash: null,
      plusShown: null,
      connecting: false,
      pillsFrom,
      boxAt,
      selectStage: noop,
      selectArrow: noop,
      openInsert: noop,
      openAnotherEnding: noop,
      boxAction: noop,
      run,
    }),
    [pillsFrom, boxAt, run],
  );

  /**
   * The whole workflow, as large as fits, never above 100% and never below 85% (editor-model.md
   * section 2: "The diagram is never shrunk below 85%"); centred on where the request is when it
   * cannot all be shown. "Show the whole workflow" (the zoom control) may go down to MIN_ZOOM, as
   * in the editor: the person asked for it.
   */
  const fit = (least = MIN_AUTO_ZOOM) => {
    if (!layout || !width || !height) return;
    const b = layout.bounds;
    const availW = width - 2 * PAD;
    const availH = height - PAD - BAND;
    const z = Math.max(least, Math.min(1, availW / Math.max(b.width, 1), availH / Math.max(b.height, 1)));
    let x = PAD + (availW - b.width * z) / 2 - b.x * z;
    let y = PAD + Math.max(0, (availH - b.height * z) / 2) - b.y * z;
    const here = layout.boxes.find((box) => run.at.has(box.id) || box.id === run.stuckAt);
    if (here && (b.width * z > availW || b.height * z > availH)) {
      if (b.width * z > availW) x = width / 2 - (here.x + here.width / 2) * z;
      if (b.height * z > availH) y = PAD + availH / 2 - (here.y + here.height / 2) * z;
    }
    // No empty canvas before the first stage or after the last when the workflow runs off the edge.
    if (b.width * z > availW) x = Math.min(PAD - b.x * z, Math.max(PAD + availW - (b.x + b.width) * z, x));
    if (b.height * z > availH) y = Math.min(PAD - b.y * z, Math.max(PAD + availH - (b.y + b.height) * z, y));
    void flow.setViewport({ x, y, zoom: z }, { duration: 0 });
  };
  const fitRef = useRef(fit);
  useEffect(() => {
    fitRef.current = fit;
  });
  const boundsKey = layout ? [layout.bounds.x, layout.bounds.y, layout.bounds.width, layout.bounds.height].map(Math.round).join(',') : '';
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ready && width && height) fitRef.current();
  }, [ready, width, height, boundsKey, key]);

  /**
   * Tab to a box off the edge makes the browser scroll the canvas's inner box, which shifts
   * everything drawn: undo that and move the view so the focused box shows instead.
   */
  const keepPlace = (el: HTMLElement) => {
    if (!el.classList?.contains('react-flow') || (!el.scrollTop && !el.scrollLeft)) return;
    el.scrollTop = 0;
    el.scrollLeft = 0;
    const id = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-stage-id]')?.dataset.stageId;
    const box = id ? layout?.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id) : undefined;
    if (!box || !width || !height) return;
    const z = flow.getViewport().zoom;
    void flow.setViewport({ x: width / 2 - (box.x + box.width / 2) * z, y: (height - BAND) / 2 - (box.y + box.height / 2) * z, zoom: z }, { duration: 200 });
  };

  const sectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const inPage = useInScrollingPage(sectionRef, [ready, width, height]);

  return (
    <BoxSourceContext.Provider value={source}>
      <DiagramContext.Provider value={ctx}>
        <section ref={sectionRef} className={s.runCanvas} aria-label={label} onScrollCapture={(e) => keepPlace(e.target as HTMLElement)}>
          <div className={s.flow} data-ready={ready || undefined}>
            <ReactFlow<BoxNode, ArrowEdgeType>
              nodes={nodes}
              edges={edges}
              nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
              edgeTypes={edgeTypes}
              onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
              ariaLabelConfig={ariaLabelConfig}
              onNodeClick={noop}
              nodesDraggable={false}
              nodesConnectable={false}
              nodesFocusable={false}
              edgesFocusable={false}
              elementsSelectable={false}
              disableKeyboardA11y
              deleteKeyCode={null}
              selectionKeyCode={null}
              multiSelectionKeyCode={null}
              panOnScroll={!inPage}
              preventScrolling={!inPage}
              zoomOnScroll={false}
              zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
              minZoom={MIN_ZOOM}
              maxZoom={1.5}
              proOptions={{ hideAttribution: true }}
            />
          </div>
          <ZoomControl
            zoom={zoom}
            onOut={() => void flow.zoomOut({ duration: 150 })}
            onIn={() => void flow.zoomIn({ duration: 150 })}
            onFit={() => fit(MIN_ZOOM)}
          />
        </section>
      </DiagramContext.Provider>
    </BoxSourceContext.Provider>
  );
}
