===\nfrontend/src/features/diagram/StageCard.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { Expression, Task } from '@/contract';
import type { Json, Ref } from '@/services';
import {
  describeExpression, describeFinding, findingTone, getStage, sessionServices, Slot, toText, useCatalogue,
  useDirectoryLabel, useDoc, useFacts, useFindingsFor, type FindingTone,
} from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { useBoxSource } from './boxSource';
import {
  actionChips, alsoStartsFrom, comesFromData, joinNames, plainValue, savedResults, savesWords, statusColourVar, statusLine, whoIcon, whoLine,
} from './stageParts';
import s from './StageCard.module.css';

/** At most this many actions are named on a box; the rest are "+1 more". */
export const ACTIONS_SHOWN = 2;

/**
 * What a stage box shows, top to bottom (editor-model.md section 2): its name; the status in words
 * beside its colour dot; the kind's icon and word (the start stage: "Form" with a "Start" tag);
 * who is asked as a chip (with the sample request's answer under it when it depends on the
 * request); the buttons; the actions by name (at most two, then "+1 more"); "Also starts from ..."
 * on a start stage another system can start; and the first To do in words. An ending shows its
 * name, "Ending" and its To do. Content only: DiagramView puts it in a node with its handles.
 */
export function StageCard({ stageId }: { stageId: string }) {
  const { doc, readOnly, env } = useBoxSource();
  const stage = doc ? getStage(doc, stageId) : undefined;
  const openFacts = useFacts();
  const facts = readOnly ? null : openFacts;
  // A read-only box (a published version) shows no To do: the open draft's findings are not about it.
  const findings = useFindingsFor(readOnly ? null : stageId, { deep: true });
  if (!doc || !stage) return null;

  const todos = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo');
  const first = todos[0];
  const todo = first ? { text: describeFinding(doc, first, env).short, tone: findingTone(first), more: todos.length - 1 } : undefined;
  const name = stage.name?.trim() ? stage.name : t('diagram.box.noName');

  if (stage.kind === 'ending') {
    const colour = doc.statuses?.find((x) => x.id === stage.status)?.colour;
    return (
      <div className={s.ending} data-card data-colour={colour ?? 'none'} data-todo={todo?.tone}>
        <div className={s.endingRow}>
          <span className={s.flag} style={{ color: statusColourVar(colour) }}>
            <Icon name="ending" />
          </span>
          <span className={s.endingText}>
            <span className={s.endingKind}>{t('stageKind.ending')}</span>
            <span className={s.endingName}>{name}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        {todo && <TodoLine {...todo} />}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isStart = doc.start?.stage === stage.id;
  const status = statusLine(doc, stage);
  const actions = actionChips(doc, stage, env);
  const starts = alsoStartsFrom(doc, stage, env);
  const saved = stage.kind === 'automatic' ? savedResults(stage) : [];
  return (
    <div className={s.card} data-card data-todo={todo?.tone}>
      <div className={s.head}>
        <span className={s.name}>{name}</span>
        <span className={s.kind}>
          <Icon name={stage.kind} size={14} />
          {t(`stageKind.${stage.kind}` as WordKey)}
        </span>
        {isStart && <span className={s.startTag}>{t('stageKind.start')}</span>}
      </div>
      <div className={s.status} data-missing={status.missing || undefined}>
        <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: statusColourVar(status.colour) }} data-empty={!status.colour || undefined} />
        <span>{status.text}</span>
      </div>

      {(stage.tasks ?? []).map((task) => (
        <TaskPart key={task.id} task={task} icon={whoIcon(doc, task.whoIsAsked, facts)} />
      ))}

      {actions.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={s.chips} aria-label={t('diagram.box.actions')}>
          {actions.slice(0, ACTIONS_SHOWN).map((a) => (
            <li key={a.id} className={s.action}>
              <Icon name="bolt" size={12} />
              <span>{a.text}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
          {actions.length > ACTIONS_SHOWN && <li className={s.more}>{t('diagram.box.more', { n: actions.length - ACTIONS_SHOWN })}</li>}
        </ul>
      )}

      {saved.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.saves}>
          <span className={s.savesWord}>{savesWords(stage, env.catalogue)}</span>
          {saved.map((id) => (
            <ChipSpot key={id} valueId={id} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {starts.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.alsoStarts}>
          <Icon name="connected" size={13} />
          <span>{t('diagram.box.alsoStartsFrom', { connection: joinNames(starts) })}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {todo && <TodoLine {...todo} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function TaskPart({ task, icon }: { task: Task; icon: 'person' | 'group' }) {
  const { doc, readOnly } = useBoxSource();
  const sample = useSampleAnswer(task, readOnly);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const who = whoLine(doc, task);
  const value = plainValue(task.whoIsAsked);
  return (
    <div className={s.task}>
      {who.missing ? (
        <div className={s.nobody}>{who.text}</div>
      ) : (
        <div className={s.who}>
          {value ? (
            <ChipSpot valueId={value} />
          ) : (
            <span className={s.whoChip}>
              <Icon name={icon} size={13} />
              <span>{who.text}</span>
            </span>
          )}
          {sample && <div className={s.sample}>{t('diagram.box.forSample', { answer: sample })}</div>}
        </div>
      )}
      {task.buttons.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={s.chips} aria-label={t('diagram.box.buttons')}>
          {task.buttons.map((b) => (
            <li key={b.id} className={s.button}>
              {b.label?.trim() ? b.label : t('diagram.box.noName')}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * A value's own chip (the values feature's, through its slot): clicking it opens the small value
 * card (editor-model.md section 9) instead of choosing the stage the box stands for.
 */
function ChipSpot({ valueId }: { valueId: string }) {
  const { doc, readOnly, env } = useBoxSource();
  // Read only: the value's name as words (its card belongs to the editor).
  if (readOnly) return doc ? <span className={s.whoChip}>{toText(describeExpression(doc, { value: valueId } as Expression, env))}</span> : null;
  return (
    <span className={s.chipSpot} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} onKeyDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <Slot name="ValueChip" valueId={valueId} />
    </span>
  );
}

function TodoLine({ text, tone, more }: { text: string; tone: FindingTone; more: number }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.todo} data-tone={tone}>
      <Icon name="todo" size={13} />
      <span>
        {text}
        {more > 0 && ` ${t('diagram.box.moreTodo', { n: more })}`}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

const isRef = (v: Json | null | undefined): v is Ref & Json =>
  !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && (v.type === 'user' || v.type === 'group') && typeof v.id === 'string';

/**
 * The sample request's answer for who is asked, when that depends on the request ("Payments
 * approvers", "Diego Santos"); undefined when it does not, or is not known yet.
 */
function useSampleAnswer(task: Task, readOnly: boolean): string | undefined {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const expression = task.whoIsAsked;
  const fromData = !readOnly && comesFromData(expression);
  const key = fromData ? `${task.id}|${JSON.stringify(expression)}` : '';
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ key: string; value: Json | null } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const services = sessionServices();
    const sample = doc?.sampleRequest;
    if (!fromData || !expression || !doc || !sample || !catalogue || !services) return;
    let live = true;
    void services.core
      .evaluate(doc, catalogue, { item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' }, expression, sample)
      .then((r) => {
        if (live) setResult({ key, value: r.result === 'value' ? r.value : null });
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [doc, catalogue, fromData, expression, key, task.id]);

  const current = result && result.key === key ? result.value : null;
  const ref = isRef(current) ? { type: current.type, id: current.id } : null;
  const label = useDirectoryLabel(ref);
  if (!fromData || current === null) return undefined;
  if (ref) return label;
  if (typeof current === 'string' || typeof current === 'number') return String(current);
  return undefined;
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/diagram/ZoomControl.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { IconButton } from '@/ui';
import s from './diagram.module.css';

/**
 * Zoom out, the zoom level, zoom in, "Show the whole workflow". The level is text a screen reader
 * reads in place ("Shown at 85%"); after the author's own zoom it is also said once, through a
 * live region (not after every view the diagram sets by itself, which would chatter).
 */
export function ZoomControl({ zoom, onOut, onIn, onFit }: { zoom: number; onOut(): void; onIn(): void; onFit(): void }) {
  const n = Math.round(zoom * 100);
  const asked = useRef(false);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!asked.current) return;
    // Said when the zoom has settled (it moves for 150-200 ms).
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      asked.current = false;
      setSaid(`${t('diagram.zoomLevel.label')} ${t('diagram.zoomLevel', { n })}`);
    }, 250);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [n, said]);
  const ask = (go: () => void) => () => {
    asked.current = true;
    setSaid('');
    go();
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.zoom}>
      <IconButton icon="minus" label={t('diagram.zoomOut')} size="sm" onClick={ask(onOut)} />
      <span className={s.zoomLevel}>
        <span className="visually-hidden">{t('diagram.zoomLevel.label')} </span>
        {t('diagram.zoomLevel', { n })}
      </span>
      <IconButton icon="plus" label={t('diagram.zoomIn')} size="sm" onClick={ask(onIn)} />
      <IconButton icon="fit" label={t('diagram.fit')} size="sm" onClick={ask(onFit)} />
      <span className="visually-hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {said}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/diagram/boxSource.ts\n===
/**
 * Which document the stage boxes show. The editing diagram shows the open draft (useDoc); the
 * ReadOnlyDiagram slot passes a document of its own (a published version on a request page), and
 * its boxes then show no To do, no sample answers and no value cards: nothing there can be changed.
 */
import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { useDescribeEnv, useDoc, type DescribeEnv } from '@/model';

export interface BoxSource {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null;
  readOnly: boolean;
  /** What the describe functions read besides the document (the catalogue, for action names). */
  env: DescribeEnv;
}

export const BoxSourceContext = createContext<BoxSource | null>(null);

/** The document the boxes show, whether they are read only, and the describe env for them. */
export function useBoxSource(): BoxSource {
  const given = useContext(BoxSourceContext);
  const open = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  return given ?? { doc: open, readOnly: false, env };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { fixtures, FIXTURE_NAMES } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { applyCommand, seededRandom } from '@/model';
import { ANOTHER_ENDING, labelRect, layoutDiagram, overlaps, type Box, type Layout, type Rect } from './layout';

const pills = (l: Layout): (Rect & { id: string })[] => l.arrows.map((a) => ({ id: `pill ${a.label.text}`, ...labelRect(a.label) }));
const boxes = (l: Layout): (Rect & { id: string })[] => l.boxes.map((b) => ({ id: b.id, x: b.x, y: b.y, width: b.width, height: b.height }));

function collisions(l: Layout): string[] {
  const all = [...boxes(l), ...pills(l)];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++)
    for (let j = i + 1; j < all.length; j++) {
      const a = all[i] as Rect & { id: string };
      const b = all[j] as Rect & { id: string };
      if (overlaps(a, b)) out.push(`${a.id} / ${b.id}`);
    }
  return out;
}

function edit(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, steps: [string, unknown][]): AuthoredWorkflow {
  let d = doc;
  const random = seededRandom(7);
  for (const [name, args] of steps) {
    const r = applyCommand(d, name as never, args as never, random);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${name} refused`);
    d = r.doc;
  }
  return d;
}

describe('layoutDiagram', () => {
  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s: no box or pill overlaps another', (name) => {
    expect(collisions(layoutDiagram(fixtures[name]))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s: every stage gets a box, every arrow a line and words', (name) => {
    const doc = fixtures[name];
    const l = layoutDiagram(doc);
    for (const s of doc.stages) expect(l.boxes.some((b) => b.id === s.id)).toBe(true);
    const arrows = doc.stages.flatMap((s) => (s.kind === 'ending' ? [] : s.arrows));
    expect(l.arrows.map((a) => a.id).sort()).toEqual(arrows.map((a) => a.id).sort());
    for (const a of l.arrows) {
      expect(a.label.text).not.toBe('');
      expect(a.points.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    }
    expect(l.boxes.some((b) => b.id === ANOTHER_ENDING)).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s: endings sit in one row below every other stage', (name) => {
    const l = layoutDiagram(fixtures[name]);
    const endings = l.boxes.filter((b) => b.kind === 'ending');
    const others = l.boxes.filter((b) => b.kind === 'stage');
    const row = Math.min(...endings.map((b) => b.y));
    for (const e of endings) expect(e.y).toBe(row);
    for (const s of others) expect(s.y + s.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(row);
  });

  it.each(FIXTURE_NAMES)('%s: lines run only across and down, never on a slant', (name) => {
    for (const a of layoutDiagram(fixtures[name]).arrows) {
      for (let i = 1; i < a.points.length; i++) {
        const p = a.points[i - 1] as { x: number; y: number };
        const q = a.points[i] as { x: number; y: number };
        expect(Math.abs(p.x - q.x) < 0.6 || Math.abs(p.y - q.y) < 0.6, `${a.label.text} piece ${i}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });

  it('the main path of the demo runs down one line, start first', () => {
    const l = layoutDiagram(fixtures['change-request']);
    const at = (id: string) => l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id) as Rect;
    const centre = (id: string) => at(id).x + at(id).width / 2;
    expect(centre('st_domain_approval')).toBeCloseTo(centre('st_request_form'), 0);
    expect(centre('st_create_jira_issue')).toBeCloseTo(centre('st_domain_approval'), 0);
    expect(centre('st_development')).toBeCloseTo(centre('st_create_jira_issue'), 0);
    expect(at('st_request_form').y).toBeLessThan(at('st_domain_approval').y);
    expect(at('st_domain_approval').y).toBeLessThan(at('st_create_jira_issue').y);
    expect(at('st_create_jira_issue').y).toBeLessThan(at('st_development').y);
  });

  it('draws an arrow that sends a request back up the left side, dashed', () => {
    const l = layoutDiagram(fixtures['change-request']);
    const back = l.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_da_request_changes');
    expect(back?.look).toBe('sendsBack');
    const from = l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === 'st_domain_approval') as Rect;
    const to = l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === 'st_request_form') as Rect;
    const xs = (back?.points ?? []).map((p) => p.x);
    expect(Math.min(...xs)).toBeLessThan(Math.min(from.x, to.x));
    expect(back?.points.at(-1)?.x).toBe(to.x);
    expect(l.arrows.filter((a) => a.look === 'sendsBack').map((a) => a.id)).toEqual(['ar_da_request_changes']);
  });

  it('takes "sends back" from the facts when given', () => {
    const l = layoutDiagram(fixtures['change-request'], { sendsBack: (id) => (id === 'ar_da_request_changes' ? false : undefined) });
    expect(l.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_da_request_changes')?.look).toBe('upward');
  });

  it('draws "In all other cases" lighter, an arrow with no stage to "Choose a stage or ending", and one to a deleted stage to "Deleted stage"', () => {
    const doc = edit(fixtures['change-request'], [
      ['arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: 'ar_da_reject', goTo: null }],
      ['stage.delete', { stage: 'st_development' }],

    expect(l.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_rf_other')?.look).toBe('otherCases');
    expect(l.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_da_reject')).toMatchObject({ look: 'choose', to: 'choose:ar_da_reject' });
    expect(l.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_cji_done')).toMatchObject({ look: 'deleted', to: 'deleted:ar_cji_done' });
    expect(l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === 'choose:ar_da_reject')?.kind).toBe('choose');
    expect(l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === 'deleted:ar_cji_done')?.kind).toBe('deleted');
    expect(collisions(l)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('puts a stage nothing leads to any more just above where it goes, not beside the start', () => {
    const doc = edit(fixtures['change-request'], [['stage.delete', { stage: 'st_create_jira_issue' }]]);
    const l = layoutDiagram(doc);
    const at = (id: string) => l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id) as Rect;
    const dev = at('st_development');
    // below Domain approval (no longer in the start's row), right above the endings
    expect(dev.y).toBeGreaterThan(at('st_domain_approval').y + at('st_domain_approval').height);
    const released = at('st_released');
    expect(released.y - (dev.y + dev.height)).toBeLessThan(200);
    // its arrow to Released goes straight down, not round the side
    const mark = l.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_dev_released');
    expect(mark).toBeTruthy();
    const xs = (mark?.points ?? []).map((p) => p.x);
    expect(Math.min(...xs)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(dev.x);
    expect(Math.max(...xs)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(dev.x + dev.width);
    expect(collisions(l)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keeps "+ Another ending" beside the endings', () => {
    const l = layoutDiagram(fixtures['change-request']);
    const another = l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === ANOTHER_ENDING) as Rect;
    const endings = l.boxes.filter((b) => b.kind === 'ending');

  it('stays free of overlaps as stages are added, inserted and given several endings', () => {

  it('uses measured sizes, so a tall box pushes the next one down', () => {

    const y = (l: Layout) => l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === 'st_create_jira_issue')?.y ?? 0;

  it('puts a stage with a stored position there', () => {

    const box = layoutDiagram(doc).boxes.find((b) => b.id === 'st_development');

  });

  it('a stage added on the start arrow of a blank workflow: the main path runs straight down the centre, the unfinished arrow out to the right', () => {
    const doc = edit(fixtures.blank, [['stage.add', { kind: 'approval', insertOn: 'ar_rf_submit' }]]);

    const start = l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === doc.start?.stage) as Box;
    const done = l.boxes.find((b) => b.kind === 'ending') as Box;
    const centre = (b: Box) => b.x + b.width / 2;
    expect(centre(approval)).toBeCloseTo(centre(start), 0);
    expect(centre(done)).toBeCloseTo(centre(approval), 0);
    const out = l.arrows.filter((a) => a.from === approval.id);
    const toDone = out.find((a) => a.to === done.id);
    const open = out.find((a) => a.look === 'choose');
    expect(toDone && open).toBeTruthy();
    // straight down, inside the width of the box: not round the side
    for (const p of toDone?.points ?? []) {
      expect(p.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(approval.x);

    expect(toDone?.points.at(-1)?.y).toBe(done.y);

  it('a second ending under an approval: the main path still runs straight down, the new ending goes beside', () => {

    if (!approval || approval.kind === 'ending') throw new Error('no approval');
    const open = approval.arrows.find((a) => !a.goTo);
    const main = approval.arrows.find((a) => !!a.goTo);
    if (!open || !main) throw new Error('arrows');
    const l1 = layoutDiagram(added);
    const ended = edit(added, [['stage.add', { kind: 'ending', name: 'Rejected', pointArrow: open.id }]]);
    const centre = (l: Layout, id: string) => {
      const b = l.boxes.find((x) => x.id === id) as Box;
      return b.x + b.width / 2;
    };
    const rejected = ended.stages.find((s) => s.kind === 'ending' && s.name === 'Rejected')?.id as string;
    for (const l2 of [layoutDiagram(ended, { previous: l1 }), layoutDiagram(ended)]) {
      expect(centre(l2, approval.id)).toBeCloseTo(centre(l2, added.start?.stage as string), 0);
      expect(centre(l2, main.goTo as string)).toBeCloseTo(centre(l2, approval.id), 0);
      expect(centre(l2, rejected)).not.toBeCloseTo(centre(l2, approval.id), 0);
      // the main arrow goes straight down from the middle of its stage
      const line = l2.arrows.find((a) => a.id === main.id);
      expect(new Set(line?.points.map((p) => Math.round(p.x))).size).toBe(1);
      expect(collisions(l2)).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it('an arrow added with no stage chosen yet moves nothing else', () => {
    const before = edit(fixtures['change-request'], []);
    const after = edit(before, [['arrow.add', { stage: 'st_domain_approval' }]]);
    const l1 = layoutDiagram(before);
    const l2 = layoutDiagram(after, { previous: l1 });
    for (const b of l1.boxes) {
      if (b.kind !== 'stage' && b.kind !== 'ending') continue;
      expect(l2.boxes.find((x) => x.id === b.id), b.id).toMatchObject({ x: b.x, y: b.y });
    }
    expect(collisions(l2)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a new arrow to a stage higher up goes back up to it; the stages stay where they were', () => {
    let random = seededRandom(3);
    const step = (d: AuthoredWorkflow, name: string, args: unknown) => {
      const r = applyCommand(d, name as never, args as never, random);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${name} refused`);
      return r;
    };
    const added = step(fixtures['change-request'], 'stage.add', { kind: 'work', insertOn: 'ar_cji_done' });
    const review = (added.result as { id: string }).id;
    const l1 = layoutDiagram(added.doc);
    random = seededRandom(4);
    const joined = step(added.doc, 'arrow.connect', { from: review, to: 'st_domain_approval' });
    const arrowId = (joined.result as { id: string }).id;
    const l2 = layoutDiagram(joined.doc, { previous: l1 });
    const y = (l: Layout, id: string) => (l.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id) as Box).y;
    for (const id of ['st_request_form', 'st_domain_approval', 'st_create_jira_issue', review]) expect(y(l2, id), id).toBe(y(l1, id));
    expect(y(l2, 'st_domain_approval')).toBeLessThan(y(l2, review));
    expect(['sendsBack', 'upward']).toContain(l2.arrows.find((a) => a.id === arrowId)?.look);

  it('keeps the boxes of each row in the order they had before', () => {
    // Change request with a second stage after Domain approval, beside Create Jira issue.
    const random = seededRandom(5);
    const made = applyCommand(fixtures['change-request'], 'stage.add', { kind: 'work' } as never, random);
    if (!made.ok) throw new Error('stage.add refused');
    const side = (made.result as { id: string }).id;
    const branched = edit(made.doc, [
      ['arrow.connect', { from: 'st_domain_approval', to: side }],
      ['arrow.connect', { from: side, to: 'st_development' }],
    ]);
    const docs: [string, AuthoredWorkflow][] = [...FIXTURE_NAMES.map((n) => [n, fixtures[n]] as [string, AuthoredWorkflow]), ['branched', branched]];
    let checked = 0;
    for (const [name, doc] of docs) {
      const l1 = layoutDiagram(doc);
      // the same boxes, seen before in the opposite order left to right
      const mirrored = { boxes: l1.boxes.map((b) => ({ ...b, x: -b.x - b.width })) };
      const l2 = layoutDiagram(doc, { previous: mirrored });
      const rows = new Map<number, Box[]>();
      for (const b of l1.boxes.filter((x) => x.kind === 'stage')) rows.set(b.y, [...(rows.get(b.y) ?? []), b]);
      for (const row of rows.values()) {
        if (row.length < 2) continue;
        const ids = [...row].sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x).map((b) => b.id);
        const x2 = (id: string) => (l2.boxes.find((b) => b.id === id) as Box).x;
        for (let i = 1; i < ids.length; i++) expect(x2(ids[i] as string), `${name}: ${ids.join(', ')}`).toBeLessThan(x2(ids[i - 1] as string));
        checked++;
      }
      expect(collisions(l2), name).toEqual([]);
    }
    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('is pure: the same document gives the same layout', () => {
    expect(layoutDiagram(fixtures['several-at-once'])).toEqual(layoutDiagram(fixtures['several-at-once']));
  });
});

/**
 * The diagram's layout, worked out from the document every time it changes (editor-model.md
 * section 2): top to bottom, the main path down the centre, endings in one row at the bottom, an
 * arrow that sends a request back drawn up the left side. Pure: the sizes of the boxes come in
 * (measured on screen; estimated when not known yet), and nothing is stored. A stage with a stored
 * position (`doc.diagram.positions`) is put there instead.
 *
 * dagre places the boxes and the arrows' words (each pill is a label dagre makes room for, so no
 * pill sits on a box or on another pill); this file then lines the endings up, routes every arrow
 * as horizontal and vertical lines, and routes the arrows that go back up round the left side.
 */
import { Graph, layout as dagreLayout, type EdgeLabel, type NodeLabel } from '@dagrejs/dagre';
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Stage } from '@/contract';
import { arrowLabel, orderFromStart } from '@/model';

export interface Size {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}
export interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}
export interface Rect extends Point, Size {}

/** stage / ending: a stage of the workflow. choose: "Choose a stage or ending". deleted: "Deleted stage". anotherEnding: "+ Another ending". */
export type BoxKind = 'stage' | 'ending' | 'choose' | 'deleted' | 'anotherEnding';

/** A box on the diagram; x and y are its top-left corner. */
export interface Box extends Rect {
  id: string;
  kind: BoxKind;
  /** For choose and deleted: the arrow that ends there. */
  arrowId?: string;
}

/**
 * normal: an arrow; otherCases: "In all other cases" (drawn lighter); choose: no stage chosen yet
 * (dashed amber); deleted: to a deleted stage (dashed red); sendsBack: back to an earlier stage
 * (dashed, up the left side); upward: any other arrow that goes back up (up the left side).
 */
export type ArrowLook = 'normal' | 'otherCases' | 'choose' | 'deleted' | 'sendsBack' | 'upward';

export interface LaidArrow {
  id: string;
  /** The box it starts at (its stage). */
  from: string;
  /** The box it ends at. */
  to: string;
  look: ArrowLook;
  /** The line, as horizontal and vertical pieces; the last point touches the box it ends at. */
  points: Point[];
  /** The words on its pill, centred at x, y. */
  label: Rect & { text: string };
}

export interface Layout {
  boxes: Box[];
  arrows: LaidArrow[];
  /** Everything drawn, for fitting the view. */
  bounds: Rect;
}

export interface LayoutOptions {
  /** Measured sizes by box id; boxes not in it get an estimate. */
  sizes?: Readonly<Record<string, Size>>;
  /** The size of a pill with these words. Default: an estimate from the number of letters. */
  measureLabel?: (text: string) => Size;
  /** Whether an arrow sends requests back (the check's facts); undefined while not known. */
  sendsBack?: (arrowId: string) => boolean | undefined;
  /**
   * The layout the author saw before this change. Boxes in it keep their order left to right in
   * each row, and an arrow added to a stage that was higher up goes back up to it, so that an edit
   * does not move stages the author did not touch.
   */
  previous?: { boxes: readonly Box[] } | null;
}

export const ANOTHER_ENDING = 'anotherEnding';
export const chooseBoxId = (arrowId: string) => `choose:${arrowId}`;
export const deletedBoxId = (arrowId: string) => `deleted:${arrowId}`;

/** Widths the boxes are drawn at (diagram.module.css uses the same). */
export const STAGE_WIDTH = 264;
export const ENDING_WIDTH = 184;

const ESTIMATE: Record<BoxKind, Size> = {
  stage: { width: STAGE_WIDTH, height: 120 },
  ending: { width: ENDING_WIDTH, height: 50 },
  choose: { width: 200, height: 40 },
  deleted: { width: 184, height: 52 },
  anotherEnding: { width: 148, height: 34 },
};

const GAP = 24;
const ROW_GAP = 40;

/** An estimate of a pill's size from its words: used in tests and until the font is known. */
export function estimateLabel(text: string): Size {
  return { width: Math.ceil(text.length * 6.8) + 26, height: 26 };
}

interface Edge {
  arrow: Arrow;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  look: ArrowLook;
  text: string;
  label: Size;
}

const isWorking = (s: Stage | undefined): s is Exclude<Stage, { kind: 'ending' }> => !!s && s.kind !== 'ending';

/** The layout of the whole diagram. */
export function layoutDiagram(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, options: LayoutOptions = {}): Layout {
  const measure = options.measureLabel ?? estimateLabel;
  const stages = doc.stages ?? [];
  const byId = new Map(stages.map((s) => [s.id as string, s]));
  const order = orderFromStart(doc).filter((id) => byId.has(id));
  const sizeOf = (id: string, kind: BoxKind): Size => {
    const measured = options.sizes?.[id];
    return measured && measured.width > 0 && measured.height > 0 ? measured : ESTIMATE[kind];
  };

  // Where each box was before this change (its middle), when known.
  const was = new Map<string, Point>();
  for (const b of options.previous?.boxes ?? []) was.set(b.id, { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 });

  // ── Which arrows go back up ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const back = backArrows(doc, order, byId, was);

  // ── Boxes and arrows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const boxes = new Map<string, Box>();
  const addBox = (id: string, kind: BoxKind, arrowId?: string) => {
    const size = sizeOf(id, kind);
    boxes.set(id, { id, kind, x: 0, y: 0, ...size, ...(arrowId ? { arrowId } : {}) });
  };
  for (const id of order) addBox(id, byId.get(id)?.kind === 'ending' ? 'ending' : 'stage');

  const edges: Edge[] = [];
  for (const id of order) {
    const stage = byId.get(id);
    if (!isWorking(stage)) continue;
    for (const arrow of stage.arrows ?? []) {
      const text = arrowLabel(doc, arrow);
      const label = measure(text);
      let to: string;
      let look: ArrowLook;
      if (arrow.goTo === null || arrow.goTo === undefined) {
        to = chooseBoxId(arrow.id);
        addBox(to, 'choose', arrow.id);
        look = 'choose';
      } else if (!byId.has(arrow.goTo)) {
        to = deletedBoxId(arrow.id);
        addBox(to, 'deleted', arrow.id);
        look = 'deleted';
      } else {
        to = arrow.goTo;
        const said = options.sendsBack?.(arrow.id);
        if (back.has(arrow.id) || said === true) look = said === false ? 'upward' : 'sendsBack';
        else look = arrow.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases' ? 'otherCases' : 'normal';
      }
      edges.push({ arrow, from: id, to, look, text, label });
    }
  }

  // ── "Choose a stage or ending" goes beside its stage ─────────────────────────────────────
  // It is not part of the path: an arrow to one leaves its stage to the side (mockup 02-build, "approval-added"), so the main path keeps the
  // centre and adding or finishing such an arrow moves nothing else. Only when something is in
  // the way on both sides of the stage does a placeholder go in the rows below it.
  // ("Deleted stage" stays in the rows: it takes the place the deleted stage had.)
  const isEnding = (id: string) => boxes.get(id)?.kind === 'ending';
  const isPlaceholder = (id: string) => boxes.get(id)?.kind === 'choose';
  const down = edges.filter((e) => e.look !== 'sendsBack' && e.look !== 'upward');
  const aside = new Set(down.filter((e) => isPlaceholder(e.to)).map((e) => e.to));
  let short: Edge[];
  let long: Edge[];
  let laid: LaidArrow[];
  let pinned = new Set<string>();

  for (let pass = 0; ; pass++) {
    const inRows = down.filter((e) => !aside.has(e.to));

    // ── Ranks: the longest run of arrows from the start; endings one below the deepest stage ──
    const depth = longestPaths(boxes, inRows);
    const deepestOf = () => {
      let d = 0;
      for (const [id, n] of depth) if (!isEnding(id) && !isPlaceholder(id)) d = Math.max(d, n);
      return d;
    };
    let deepest = deepestOf();
    // Stages nothing leads to (after a delete, say) sit just above where their arrows go, not
    // beside the start with arrows looping round the whole diagram.
    const lowered = lowerUnreached(doc.start?.stage, boxes, inRows, depth, isEnding, deepest);
    if (lowered.length > 0) deepest = deepestOf();
    const rankOf = (id: string) => (isEnding(id) ? deepest + 1 : (depth.get(id) ?? 0));
    // An arrow to the next rank is laid out by dagre, with room for its pill. One that skips ranks
    // goes round the side (as an arrow back up does), so the main path stays one straight line.
    short = inRows.filter((e) => rankOf(e.to) - rankOf(e.from) <= 1);
    long = inRows.filter((e) => rankOf(e.to) - rankOf(e.from) > 1);

    // ── dagre: the order in each rank, positions, and room for every pill ──────────────────
    const g = new Graph<Record<string, unknown>, NodeLabel, EdgeLabel>({ multigraph: true });
    g.setGraph({ rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 48, edgesep: 28, ranksep: 52, marginx: 24, marginy: 24 });
    // An ending that only arrows round the side reach is put in the endings' row afterwards.
    const hasIn = new Set(short.map((e) => e.to));
    const loose = [...boxes.values()].filter((b) => b.kind === 'ending' && !hasIn.has(b.id));
    const inGraph = (b: Box) => !loose.includes(b) && !aside.has(b.id);
    for (const box of boxes.values()) if (inGraph(box)) g.setNode(box.id, { width: box.width, height: box.height });
    for (const e of short) {
      g.setEdge(e.from, e.to, { width: e.label.width, height: e.label.height, labelpos: 'c', minlen: 1, weight: 2 }, e.arrow.id);
    }
    // A lowered stage is held at its rank by an unseen tie to the start (dagre has no fixed ranks).
    const start = doc.start?.stage;
    const tops = lowered.filter((id) => !short.some((e) => e.to === id));
    if (start && g.hasNode(start)) {
      for (const id of tops) {
        const d = depth.get(id) ?? 0;
        if (d > 0 && g.hasNode(id)) g.setEdge(start, id, { width: 0, height: 0, minlen: d, weight: 0 }, `rank:${id}`);
      }
    }
    dagreLayout(g, { constraints: keepOrder(g.nodes(), rankOf, was) });

    for (const box of boxes.values()) {
      if (!inGraph(box)) continue;
      const n = g.node(box.id);
      if (n && typeof n.x === 'number' && typeof n.y === 'number') {
        box.x = n.x - box.width / 2;
        box.y = n.y - box.height / 2;
      }
    }

    // ── Stored positions win ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    pinned = new Set<string>();
    for (const [id, at] of Object.entries(doc.diagram?.positions ?? {})) {
      const box = boxes.get(id);
      if (box && at && Number.isFinite(at.x) && Number.isFinite(at.y)) {
        box.x = at.x;
        box.y = at.y;
        pinned.add(id);
      }
    }

    // ── Placeholders beside their stage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const pills: Rect[] = [];
    for (const e of short) {
      const l = g.edge({ v: e.from, w: e.to, name: e.arrow.id });
      if (l?.x !== undefined && l.y !== undefined) pills.push(labelRect({ x: l.x, y: l.y, ...e.label }));
    }
    const obstacles = [...[...boxes.values()].filter(inGraph).map(asRect), ...pills];
    const besides = placeBeside(down.filter((e) => aside.has(e.to)), boxes, obstacles);
    if (besides.blocked.length > 0 && pass < 2) {
      for (const id of besides.blocked) aside.delete(id);
      continue;
    }

    // ── Endings in one row at the bottom ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const endings = [...boxes.values()].filter((b) => b.kind === 'ending' && !pinned.has(b.id) && !loose.includes(b));
    const looseEndings = loose.filter((b) => !pinned.has(b.id));
    if (endings.length + looseEndings.length > 0) {
      let lowest = -Infinity;
      for (const b of boxes.values()) if (b.kind !== 'ending') lowest = Math.max(lowest, b.y + b.height);
      for (const e of short) {
        if (isEnding(e.to)) continue;
        const l = g.edge({ v: e.from, w: e.to, name: e.arrow.id });
        if (l?.y !== undefined) lowest = Math.max(lowest, l.y + e.label.height / 2);
      }
      const row = Math.max(
        endings.length ? Math.max(...endings.map((b) => b.y)) : -Infinity,
        Number.isFinite(lowest) ? lowest + ROW_GAP : 0,
      );
      endings.sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
      let right = -Infinity;
      for (const b of endings) {
        b.y = row;
        if (b.x < right + GAP) b.x = right + GAP;
        right = b.x + b.width;
      }
      // Endings reached only round the side go at the end of the row nearer the stages that lead there.
      let left = endings.length ? (endings[0] as Box).x : Infinity;
      if (!endings.length) {
        const placed = [...boxes.values()].filter((b) => !loose.includes(b) && !aside.has(b.id));
        const xs = placed.map((b) => b.x + b.width / 2);
        left = right = xs.length ? (Math.min(...xs) + Math.max(...xs)) / 2 : 0;
      }
      const middle = (left + right) / 2;
      for (const b of looseEndings) {
        const sources = long.filter((e) => e.to === b.id).map((e) => boxes.get(e.from) as Box);
        const towards = sources.length ? sources.reduce((s, f) => s + f.x + f.width / 2, 0) / sources.length : Infinity;
        b.y = row;
        if (towards <= middle && Number.isFinite(left)) {
          b.x = left - GAP - b.width;
          left = b.x;
        } else {
          b.x = Number.isFinite(right) ? right + GAP : left;
          right = b.x + b.width;
          if (!Number.isFinite(left)) left = b.x;
        }
      }
    }

    // ── The main path goes straight down into the endings too ──────────────────────────────
    // dagre centres a stage over the endings it leads to, so a stage with two endings below it
    // would sit between them. The ending of its main arrow (the one that was straight below it,
    // else its first) goes right under it instead, and the others move aside.
    const shifted = new Map<string, number>();
    const mainArrows = new Map<string, string>();
    {
      const row = [...boxes.values()].filter((b) => b.kind === 'ending' && !loose.includes(b)).sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
      const outOf = new Map<string, Edge[]>();
      for (const e of short) outOf.set(e.from, [...(outOf.get(e.from) ?? []), e]);
      for (const [from, list] of outOf) {
        const stage = boxes.get(from) as Box;
        if (list.length < 2 || pinned.has(from) || !list.every((e) => isEnding(e.to) && !pinned.has(e.to) && row.some((b) => b.id === e.to))) continue;
        const wasHere = was.get(from);
        const below = wasHere ? list.find((e) => Math.abs((was.get(e.to)?.x ?? Infinity) - wasHere.x) < 2) : undefined;
        const main = below ?? (list[0] as Edge);
        const k = row.findIndex((b) => b.id === main.to);
        const before = new Map(row.map((b) => [b.id, b.x]));
        const target = row[k] as Box;
        target.x = stage.x + stage.width / 2 - target.width / 2;
        for (let i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const b = row[i] as Box;
          const next = row[i + 1] as Box;
          if (b.x + b.width + GAP > next.x) b.x = next.x - GAP - b.width;
        }
        for (let i = k + 1; i < row.length; i++) {
          const b = row[i] as Box;
          const prev = row[i - 1] as Box;
          if (b.x < prev.x + prev.width + GAP) b.x = prev.x + prev.width + GAP;
        }
        for (const b of row) {
          const d = b.x - (before.get(b.id) as number);
          if (Math.abs(d) > 0.5) shifted.set(b.id, (shifted.get(b.id) ?? 0) + d);
        }
        mainArrows.set(from, main.arrow.id);
      }
    }

    // ── Arrows to the next rank: horizontal and vertical lines through dagre's points ──────
    laid = [];
    const outgoing = new Map<string, Edge[]>();
    for (const e of short) outgoing.set(e.from, [...(outgoing.get(e.from) ?? []), e]);
    const startX = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const [from, list] of outgoing) {
      const box = boxes.get(from) as Box;
      const firstX = (e: Edge) => {
        const pts = g.edge({ v: e.from, w: e.to, name: e.arrow.id })?.points ?? [];
        return (pts[1] ?? pts[0] ?? { x: box.x + box.width / 2 }).x;
      };
      const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => firstX(a) - firstX(b));
      const main = mainArrows.get(from);
      if (main) {
        // The main arrow leaves from the middle; the others spread over the half on their side.
        const centre = box.x + box.width / 2;
        const k = sorted.findIndex((e) => e.arrow.id === main);
        const leftOnes = sorted.slice(0, k);
        const rightOnes = sorted.slice(k + 1);
        startX.set(main, centre);
        leftOnes.forEach((e, i) => startX.set(e.arrow.id, box.x + ((box.width / 2) * (i + 1)) / (leftOnes.length + 1)));
        rightOnes.forEach((e, i) => startX.set(e.arrow.id, centre + ((box.width / 2) * (i + 1)) / (rightOnes.length + 1)));
        continue;
      }
      sorted.forEach((e, i) => {
        const x = list.length === 1 ? clamp(firstX(e), box.x + 24, box.x + box.width - 24) : box.x + (box.width * (i + 1)) / (list.length + 1);
        startX.set(e.arrow.id, x);
      });
    }
    for (const e of short) {
      const from = boxes.get(e.from) as Box;
      const to = boxes.get(e.to) as Box;
      const l = g.edge({ v: e.from, w: e.to, name: e.arrow.id });
      const free = pinned.has(e.from) || pinned.has(e.to);
      // An ending moved by the main path above keeps the line's shape; the main arrow runs straight down.
      const d = shifted.get(e.to) ?? 0;
      const straight = mainArrows.get(e.from) === e.arrow.id;
      const inner = free ? [] : (l?.points ?? []).slice(1, -1).map((p) => ({ x: straight ? to.x + to.width / 2 : p.x + d, y: p.y }));
      const sx = startX.get(e.arrow.id) ?? from.x + from.width / 2;
      let label: Point;
      if (!free && l?.x !== undefined && l.y !== undefined) label = { x: straight ? to.x + to.width / 2 : l.x + d, y: l.y };
      else label = { x: (sx + to.x + to.width / 2) / 2, y: (from.y + from.height + to.y) / 2 };
      const through = inner.length > 0 ? inner : [label];
      laid.push({ id: e.arrow.id, from: e.from, to: e.to, look: e.look, points: routeDown(from, to, sx, through), label: { ...label, ...e.label, text: e.text } });
    }
    laid.push(...besides.arrows);
    break;
  }

  // ── Arrows that skip ranks or go back up: round the side ─────────────────────────────────
  // Back up always on the left (editor-model.md section 2); down on the side of the stage it goes to.
  const taken: Rect[] = [...[...boxes.values()].map(asRect), ...laid.map((a) => labelRect(a.label))];
  const lanes: Lane[] = [];
  const ports = new Map<string, number>();
  const around = [...long, ...edges.filter((e) => e.look === 'sendsBack' || e.look === 'upward')];
  around.sort((a, b) => span(boxes, a) - span(boxes, b));
  for (const e of around) {
    const from = boxes.get(e.from) as Box;
    const to = boxes.get(e.to) as Box;
    const up = e.look === 'sendsBack' || e.look === 'upward';
    const centre = (b: Box) => b.x + b.width / 2;
    const side: Side = up || centre(to) < centre(from) - 1 ? 'left' : 'right';
    const routed = routeAround(from, to, side, up, e.label, [...boxes.values()], taken, lanes, ports);
    const label = { ...routed.pill, ...e.label, text: e.text };
    taken.push(labelRect(label));
    laid.push({ id: e.arrow.id, from: e.from, to: e.to, look: e.look, points: routed.points, label });
  }

  // ── "+ Another ending" beside the endings ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const anotherSize = sizeOf(ANOTHER_ENDING, 'anotherEnding');
  const allEndings = [...boxes.values()].filter((b) => b.kind === 'ending');
  const another: Box = { id: ANOTHER_ENDING, kind: 'anotherEnding', x: 0, y: 0, ...anotherSize };
  if (allEndings.length > 0) {
    const last = allEndings.reduce((a, b) => (b.x + b.width > a.x + a.width ? b : a));
    another.x = last.x + last.width + GAP;
    another.y = last.y + (last.height - another.height) / 2;
  } else {
    const all = [...boxes.values()];
    another.x = all.length ? Math.min(...all.map((b) => b.x)) : 0;
    another.y = all.length ? Math.max(...all.map((b) => b.y + b.height)) + ROW_GAP : 0;
  }
  const others = [...[...boxes.values()].map(asRect), ...laid.map((a) => labelRect(a.label))];
  for (let i = 0; i < 50 && others.some((r) => overlaps(r, another, 8)); i++) another.x += GAP;
  boxes.set(ANOTHER_ENDING, another);

  // ── Reading order: stages as met from the start, then placeholders, then "+ Another ending" ──
  const list = [...boxes.values()];
  const rank = (b: Box) => (b.kind === 'stage' || b.kind === 'ending' ? (order as string[]).indexOf(b.id) : b.kind === 'anotherEnding' ? 1e6 : 1e5);
  list.sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b));
  const arrowOrder = new Map<string, number>(edges.map((e, i) => [e.arrow.id, i]));
  laid.sort((a, b) => (arrowOrder.get(a.id) ?? 0) - (arrowOrder.get(b.id) ?? 0));

  return { boxes: list, arrows: laid, bounds: boundsOf(list, laid) };
}

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * The arrows that go back up: walking the arrows from the start (then from any stage not reached),
 * an arrow to a stage still on the walk's path closes a circle. Every arrow that sends a request
 * back is one of these. When the previous layout is known, the walk takes the arrows to stages
 * that were higher up first, so a new arrow to a stage above goes back up to it, rather than
 * pushing that stage (and everything after it) down.
 */
function backArrows(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, order: string[], byId: Map<string, Stage>, was: Map<string, Point>): Set<string> {
  const back = new Set<string>();
  const done = new Set<string>();
  const onPath = new Set<string>();
  const height = (id: string | null | undefined) => (id ? (was.get(id)?.y ?? Infinity) : Infinity);
  const visit = (id: string) => {
    done.add(id);
    onPath.add(id);
    const stage = byId.get(id);
    if (isWorking(stage)) {
      const arrows = [...(stage.arrows ?? [])];
      if (was.size > 0) arrows.sort((a, b) => height(a.goTo) - height(b.goTo));
      for (const arrow of arrows) {
        const to = arrow.goTo;
        if (!to || !byId.has(to)) continue;
        if (onPath.has(to)) back.add(arrow.id);
        else if (!done.has(to)) visit(to);
      }
    }
    onPath.delete(id);
  };
  const start = doc.start?.stage;
  if (start && byId.has(start)) visit(start);
  for (const id of order) if (!done.has(id)) visit(id);
  return back;
}

/** For each box, the longest run of arrows from a box nothing leads to (in the arrows going down). */
function longestPaths(boxes: Map<string, Box>, forward: Edge[]): Map<string, number> {
  const depth = new Map<string, number>();
  const into = new Map<string, Edge[]>();
  for (const e of forward) into.set(e.to, [...(into.get(e.to) ?? []), e]);
  const visiting = new Set<string>();
  const of = (id: string): number => {
    const known = depth.get(id);
    if (known !== undefined) return known;
    if (visiting.has(id)) return 0;
    visiting.add(id);
    let d = 0;
    for (const e of into.get(id) ?? []) d = Math.max(d, of(e.from) + 1);
    visiting.delete(id);
    depth.set(id, d);
    return d;
  };
  for (const id of boxes.keys()) of(id);
  return depth;
}

/**
 * Moves each group of boxes the start does not reach down, as far as its arrows into the rest
 * allow (each such arrow still goes down at least one rank). Endings stay in their own row. Returns
 * the boxes moved.
 */
function lowerUnreached(
  start: string | undefined, boxes: Map<string, Box>, down: Edge[], depth: Map<string, number>,
  isEnding: (id: string) => boolean, deepest: number,
): string[] {
  const reached = new Set<string>();
  const next = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const e of down) next.set(e.from, [...(next.get(e.from) ?? []), e.to]);
  const walk = [start].filter((id): id is string => !!id && boxes.has(id));
  while (walk.length) {
    const id = walk.pop() as string;
    if (reached.has(id)) continue;
    reached.add(id);
    walk.push(...(next.get(id) ?? []));
  }
  const loose = (id: string) => !reached.has(id) && !isEnding(id);
  // Groups of loose boxes joined by arrows (either way).
  const near = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const e of down) {
    if (!loose(e.from) || !loose(e.to)) continue;
    near.set(e.from, [...(near.get(e.from) ?? []), e.to]);
    near.set(e.to, [...(near.get(e.to) ?? []), e.from]);
  }
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const rank = (id: string) => (isEnding(id) ? deepest + 1 : (depth.get(id) ?? 0));
  const moved: string[] = [];
  for (const id of boxes.keys()) {
    if (!loose(id) || seen.has(id)) continue;
    const group: string[] = [];
    const todo = [id];
    while (todo.length) {
      const g = todo.pop() as string;
      if (seen.has(g)) continue;
      seen.add(g);
      group.push(g);
      todo.push(...(near.get(g) ?? []));
    }
    const inGroup = new Set(group);
    let shift = Infinity;
    for (const e of down) if (inGroup.has(e.from) && !inGroup.has(e.to)) shift = Math.min(shift, rank(e.to) - 1 - rank(e.from));
    if (!Number.isFinite(shift) || shift <= 0) continue;
    for (const g of group) depth.set(g, (depth.get(g) ?? 0) + shift);
    moved.push(...group);
  }
  return moved;
}

/**
 * dagre's order constraints that keep the boxes of each rank in the order they had before (by
 * where their middles were), so an edit does not swap stages left and right.
 */
function keepOrder(ids: string[], rankOf: (id: string) => number, was: Map<string, Point>): { left: string; right: string }[] {
  const rows = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (!was.has(id)) continue;
    const r = rankOf(id);
    rows.set(r, [...(rows.get(r) ?? []), id]);
  }
  const out: { left: string; right: string }[] = [];
  for (const row of rows.values()) {
    row.sort((a, b) => (was.get(a) as Point).x - (was.get(b) as Point).x);
    for (let i = 1; i < row.length; i++) out.push({ left: row[i - 1] as string, right: row[i] as string });
  }
  return out;
}

const BESIDE_GAP = 20;
const STACK_GAP = 12;

/**
 * Puts each stage's "Choose a stage or ending" placeholders beside it, on its right (on its left when something is in the
 * way there), one under the other around the stage's middle, each with a straight line across and
 * its pill on that line. Returns the arrows, and the placeholders of the stages where neither side
 * is free (they are placed on the right all the same).
 */
function placeBeside(edges: Edge[], boxes: Map<string, Box>, obstacles: Rect[]): { arrows: LaidArrow[]; blocked: string[] } {
  const arrows: LaidArrow[] = [];
  const blocked: string[] = [];
  const bySource = new Map<string, Edge[]>();
  for (const e of edges) bySource.set(e.from, [...(bySource.get(e.from) ?? []), e]);
  const taken = [...obstacles];
  for (const [from, list] of bySource) {
    const stage = boxes.get(from) as Box;
    const items = list.map((e) => ({ e, box: boxes.get(e.to) as Box }));
    const pillW = Math.max(...items.map((i) => i.e.label.width));
    const boxW = Math.max(...items.map((i) => i.box.width));
    const stackH = items.reduce((h, i) => h + i.box.height, 0) + STACK_GAP * (items.length - 1);
    const top = Math.max(stage.y, stage.y + stage.height / 2 - stackH / 2);
    const reach = BESIDE_GAP + pillW + BESIDE_GAP;
    const region = (side: Side): Rect => ({
      x: side === 'right' ? stage.x + stage.width : stage.x - reach - boxW,
      y: top,
      width: reach + boxW,
      height: stackH,
    });
    const others = taken.filter((r) => !(r.x === stage.x && r.y === stage.y && r.width === stage.width && r.height === stage.height));
    const free = (side: Side) => !others.some((r) => overlaps(r, region(side), 8));
    const side: Side = free('right') ? 'right' : free('left') ? 'left' : 'right';
    if (!free(side)) blocked.push(...items.map((i) => i.box.id));
    taken.push(region(side));
    let y = top;
    for (const { e, box } of items) {
      const x0 = side === 'right' ? stage.x + stage.width : stage.x;
      const edge = side === 'right' ? x0 + reach : x0 - reach;
      box.x = side === 'right' ? edge : edge - box.width;
      box.y = y;
      const line = y + box.height / 2;
      arrows.push({
        id: e.arrow.id,
        from: e.from,
        to: e.to,
        look: e.look,
        points: [{ x: round(x0), y: round(line) }, { x: round(edge), y: round(line) }],
        label: { x: (x0 + edge) / 2, y: line, ...e.label, text: e.text },
      });
      y += box.height + STACK_GAP;
    }
  }
  return { arrows, blocked };
}

type Side = 'left' | 'right';
/** A vertical line already drawn round one side, so the next arrow takes another. */
interface Lane {
  side: Side;
  x: number;
  y1: number;
  y2: number;
}

/**
 * An arrow round the side: out of `from` towards `side`, along a vertical line beyond everything
 * between the two boxes, and into `to` from that side (or from the top when another box is in the
 * way). Its pill goes on the vertical line, where it touches nothing.
 */
function routeAround(
  from: Box, to: Box, side: Side, up: boolean, size: Size, boxes: Box[], taken: Rect[], lanes: Lane[], ports: Map<string, number>,
): { points: Point[]; pill: Point } {
  const dir = side === 'left' ? -1 : 1;
  const edgeX = (b: Box) => (side === 'left' ? b.x : b.x + b.width);
  const top = Math.min(from.y, to.y);
  const bottom = Math.max(from.y + from.height, to.y + to.height);
  const inSpan = taken.filter((r) => r.y < bottom && r.y + r.height > top);
  const extreme =
    side === 'left'
      ? Math.min(from.x, to.x, ...inSpan.map((r) => r.x))
      : Math.max(from.x + from.width, to.x + to.width, ...inSpan.map((r) => r.x + r.width));

  // A box between `box` and the line, at height y.
  const blocked = (box: Box, y: number, lineX: number) =>
    boxes.some((b) => {
      if (b === box || b.kind === 'anotherEnding') return false;
      if (!(b.y - 4 < y && y < b.y + b.height + 4)) return false;
      const lo = Math.min(edgeX(box), lineX);
      const hi = Math.max(edgeX(box), lineX);
      return b.x < hi && b.x + b.width > lo;
    });

  // Arrows leaving (or entering) the same side of a box do so a little apart.
  const port = (key: string) => {
    const n = ports.get(key) ?? 0;
    ports.set(key, n + 1);
    return n * 14;
  };
  const exitY = Math.min(from.y + Math.min(from.height / 2, 40) + port(`${from.id}:${side}:out`), from.y + from.height - 8);
  const entryY = Math.min(to.y + Math.min(to.height / 2, 24) + port(`${to.id}:${side}:in`), to.y + to.height - 8);
  const plan = (x: number) => {
    const out = blocked(from, exitY, x)
      ? [{ x: edgeX(from) - dir * 24, y: from.y + from.height }, { x: edgeX(from) - dir * 24, y: from.y + from.height + 12 }, { x, y: from.y + from.height + 12 }]
      : [{ x: edgeX(from), y: exitY }, { x, y: exitY }];
    const into = blocked(to, entryY, x) || (!up && to.kind === 'ending')
      ? [{ x, y: to.y - 14 }, { x: edgeX(to) - dir * 24, y: to.y - 14 }, { x: edgeX(to) - dir * 24, y: to.y }]
      : [{ x, y: entryY }, { x: edgeX(to), y: entryY }];
    return [...out, ...into];
  };
  const free = (x: number, y1: number, y2: number) =>
    !lanes.some((l) => l.side === side && Math.abs(l.x - x) < 14 && l.y1 < Math.max(y1, y2) + 8 && Math.min(y1, y2) - 8 < l.y2);

  let points: Point[] = [];
  let pill: Point | null = null;
  let x = extreme;
  for (let k = 0; k < 12 && !pill; k++) {
    x = extreme + dir * (28 + 18 * k);
    points = plan(x);
    const ys = points.filter((p) => p.x === x).map((p) => p.y);
    const y1 = Math.min(...ys);
    const y2 = Math.max(...ys);
    if (!free(x, y1, y2)) continue;
    pill = placeOnLine(x, y1, y2, size, taken);
  }
  if (!pill) {
    // No free spot on a line near the boxes: put the line far enough out for the pill to fit beside them.
    const outer = lanes.filter((l) => l.side === side).map((l) => l.x);
    x = (side === 'left' ? Math.min(extreme, ...outer) : Math.max(extreme, ...outer)) + dir * (24 + size.width / 2);
    points = plan(x);
    const ys = points.filter((p) => p.x === x).map((p) => p.y);
    pill = { x, y: (Math.min(...ys) + Math.max(...ys)) / 2 };
  }
  const ys = points.filter((p) => p.x === x).map((p) => p.y);
  lanes.push({ side, x, y1: Math.min(...ys), y2: Math.max(...ys) });
  return { points: points.map((p) => ({ x: round(p.x), y: round(p.y) })), pill };
}

/** Down from `from` (leaving at x `sx`), through `through` (dagre's points), into the top of `to`. */
function routeDown(from: Box, to: Box, sx: number, through: Point[]): Point[] {
  const pts: Point[] = [];
  const push = (p: Point) => {
    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    if (!last || Math.abs(last.x - p.x) > 0.5 || Math.abs(last.y - p.y) > 0.5) pts.push({ x: round(p.x), y: round(p.y) });
  };
  const bottom = from.y + from.height;
  push({ x: sx, y: bottom });
  const first = through[0] as Point;
  if (Math.abs(first.x - sx) > 0.5) {
    const y = Math.min(bottom + 12, (bottom + first.y) / 2);
    push({ x: sx, y });
    push({ x: first.x, y });
  }
  push(first);
  for (let i = 1; i < through.length; i++) {
    const a = through[i - 1] as Point;
    const b = through[i] as Point;
    if (Math.abs(a.x - b.x) > 0.5) {
      const mid = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
      push({ x: a.x, y: mid });
      push({ x: b.x, y: mid });
    }
    push(b);
  }
  const last = through[through.length - 1] as Point;
  const ex = clamp(last.x, to.x + 16, to.x + to.width - 16);
  if (Math.abs(ex - last.x) > 0.5) {
    const y = Math.max(to.y - 12, (last.y + to.y) / 2);
    push({ x: last.x, y });
    push({ x: ex, y });
  }
  push({ x: ex, y: to.y });
  return pts;
}

/** A spot on the vertical line at x between y1 and y2 where the pill touches nothing, or null. */
function placeOnLine(x: number, y1: number, y2: number, size: Size, taken: Rect[]): Point | null {
  const top = Math.min(y1, y2) + size.height;
  const bottom = Math.max(y1, y2) - size.height;
  const mid = (y1 + y2) / 2;
  const tries: number[] = [mid];
  for (let d = 16; mid - d >= top || mid + d <= bottom; d += 16) {
    if (mid - d >= top) tries.push(mid - d);
    if (mid + d <= bottom) tries.push(mid + d);
  }
  for (const y of tries) {
    const rect = { x: x - size.width / 2, y: y - size.height / 2, ...size };
    if (!taken.some((r) => overlaps(r, rect, 6))) return { x, y };
  }
  return null;
}

/** How far up an arrow going back reaches (short ones get the lane nearest the boxes). */
function span(boxes: Map<string, Box>, e: Edge): number {
  const a = boxes.get(e.from);
  const b = boxes.get(e.to);
  return a && b ? Math.abs(a.y - b.y) : 0;
}

export function labelRect(label: Rect): Rect {
  return { x: label.x - label.width / 2, y: label.y - label.height / 2, width: label.width, height: label.height };
}

const asRect = (b: Box): Rect => ({ x: b.x, y: b.y, width: b.width, height: b.height });

/** True when the two rectangles overlap, or come closer than `margin`. */
export function overlaps(a: Rect, b: Rect, margin = 0): boolean {
  return a.x < b.x + b.width + margin && b.x < a.x + a.width + margin && a.y < b.y + b.height + margin && b.y < a.y + a.height + margin;
}

function boundsOf(boxes: Box[], arrows: LaidArrow[]): Rect {
  const xs: number[] = [];
  const ys: number[] = [];
  for (const b of boxes) {
    xs.push(b.x, b.x + b.width);
    ys.push(b.y, b.y + b.height);
  }
  for (const a of arrows) {
    for (const p of a.points) {
      xs.push(p.x);
      ys.push(p.y);
    }
    const r = labelRect(a.label);
    xs.push(r.x, r.x + r.width);
    ys.push(r.y, r.y + r.height);
  }
  if (xs.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
  const x = Math.min(...xs);
  const y = Math.min(...ys);
  return { x, y, width: Math.max(...xs) - x, height: Math.max(...ys) - y };
}

const clamp = (n: number, lo: number, hi: number) => (lo > hi ? (lo + hi) / 2 : Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, n)));
const round = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 10) / 10;

/**
 * The marks of mockup 04-values "may be empty": while the chosen stage has a "may be empty" To do
 * (the panel shows it), the boxes say where that value is filled ("Filled here"), where it is used
 * ("Used here") and where it may be empty ("May be empty here"), and the arrow that decides it (one
 * whose other arrows lead to where the value is filled) is lit. Worked out from the finding's
 * params (the value, the route that skips the filling) and the facts. Pure.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Expression, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { Facts, Finding } from '@/services';
import { describeExpression, find, getStage, stageOf, toText, type DescribeEnv } from '@/model';
import type { MarkKind, StageMarks } from './parts';

type MayBeEmpty = { value?: Location; skippedVia?: Location[] };

/** The "may be empty" finding the marks are for: the one at the selected place, else the stage's first. */
export function chosenMayBeEmpty(findings: readonly Finding[], selection: Location | null): Finding | undefined {
  const list = findings.filter((f) => f.code === 'value.mayBeEmpty');
  const at = selection ? list.find((f) => f.location?.item === selection.item && (!selection.part || f.location?.part === selection.part)) : undefined;
  return at ?? list[0];
}

export function mayBeEmptyMarks(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, facts: Facts | null, finding: Finding | undefined, env: DescribeEnv): StageMarks | undefined {
  if (!finding || finding.code !== 'value.mayBeEmpty') return undefined;
  const params = (finding.params ?? {}) as MayBeEmpty;
  const valueId = params.value?.item;
  if (!valueId) return undefined;
  const value = facts?.values?.[valueId as keyof Facts['values']];
  const stageIdOf = (l: Location): string | undefined => stageOf(doc, l.item)?.id;
  const filled = new Set((value?.filledAt ?? []).map(stageIdOf).filter((s): s is string => !!s));
  const used = new Set((value?.usedAt ?? []).map(stageIdOf).filter((s): s is string => !!s));
  const here = finding.location ? stageIdOf(finding.location) : undefined;

  const byStage = new Map<string, MarkKind[]>();
  const add = (stage: string, kind: MarkKind) => byStage.set(stage, [...(byStage.get(stage) ?? []), kind]);
  for (const s of filled) add(s, 'filled');
  for (const s of used) if (!filled.has(s)) add(s, 'used');
  if (here) add(here, 'mayBeEmpty');

  // The arrows on the route whose other arrows lead to where the value is filled, and that do not.
  const arrows = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of params.skippedVia ?? []) {
    const entry = find(doc, l.item);
    if (entry?.kind !== 'arrow' || !entry.item.goTo) continue;
    const own = reachableFrom(doc, entry.item.goTo);
    const from = getStage(doc, entry.parents.stage);
    const siblings = from && from.kind !== 'ending' ? from.arrows : [];
    const decides = siblings.some(
      (a) => a.id !== entry.item.id && a.goTo && [...reachableFrom(doc, a.goTo)].some((s) => filled.has(s) && !own.has(s)),
    );
    if (decides) arrows.add(entry.item.id);
  }
  return { value: toText(describeExpression(doc, { value: valueId } as Expression, env)), byStage, arrows };
}

/** The stages a request can reach from `start` (itself included). */
function reachableFrom(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, start: string): Set<string> {
  const seen = new Set<string>([start]);
  const queue: string[] = [start];
  while (queue.length) {
    const stage = getStage(doc, queue.shift() as string);
    if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const a of stage.arrows) {
      if (a.goTo && !seen.has(a.goTo)) {
        seen.add(a.goTo);
        queue.push(a.goTo);
      }
    }
  }
  return seen;
}

/**
 * The pieces drawn on the canvas: the stage node (a StageCard with its handles and menu, and the
 * pills of the arrows that leave it), the two placeholders an arrow can end at, "+ Another ending",
 * and the arrow's line. They talk to the canvas through DiagramContext.
 *
 * An arrow's pill and "+" are drawn inside the node of the stage it leaves, not in xyflow's edge
 * label layer, so that with the keyboard each stage's arrows come right after its box (that layer
 * comes before every node in the page).
 */
import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Handle, Position, type Edge, type EdgeProps, type Node, type NodeProps } from '@xyflow/react';
import { getStage, useDoc, useStage } from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Icon, IconButton, Menu, type MenuItem } from '@/ui';
import { useBoxSource } from './boxSource';
import type { LaidArrow, Point } from './layout';
import { StageCard } from './StageCard';
import s from './diagram.module.css';

export type BoxAction = 'connect' | 'after' | 'delete';

export interface DiagramContextValue {
  /** The stage shown in the panel (also when something inside it is selected). */
  selectedStage: string | null;
  selectedArrow: string | null;
  /** A stage or arrow just revealed ("Show me"), drawn with a short flash. */
  flash: string | null;
  /** The arrow whose "+" is shown all the time (hint 2 of a new workflow). */
  plusShown: string | null;
  /** True while an arrow is being dragged from a handle. */
  connecting: boolean;
  /** The arrows leaving each stage, in the panel's order, for their pills. */
  pillsFrom: ReadonlyMap<string, ArrowEdgeType[]>;
  /** Where each box is (its top-left corner), from the same layout as the pills. */
  boxAt: ReadonlyMap<string, { x: number; y: number }>;
  selectStage(id: string): void;
  selectArrow(id: string, part?: string): void;
  openInsert(arrowId: string, from: HTMLElement): void;
  openAnotherEnding(from: HTMLElement): void;
  boxAction(action: BoxAction, stageId: string, box: HTMLElement): void;
  /** While a "may be empty" To do of the chosen stage is shown: the marks on the boxes and the arrows lit. */
  marks?: StageMarks;
  /** Set by the ReadOnlyDiagram: the diagram is drawn without editing, with where a request is and has been. */
  run?: RunView;
}

/** "Filled here", "Used here", "May be empty here" on the boxes, and the arrows that decide it (mockup 04-values). */
export interface StageMarks {
  /** The value's name, for the screen reader's words. */
  value: string;
  byStage: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly MarkKind[]>;
  arrows: ReadonlySet<string>;
}
export type MarkKind = 'filled' | 'used' | 'mayBeEmpty';

/** Where a request is, has been and is stuck (ReadOnlyDiagramProps). */
export interface RunView {
  at: ReadonlySet<string>;
  visited: ReadonlySet<string>;
  taken: ReadonlySet<string>;
  stuckAt?: string;
  onStageClick?: (stageId: string) => void;
}

export const DiagramContext = createContext<DiagramContextValue | null>(null);
const useDiagram = () => useContext(DiagramContext) as DiagramContextValue;

const MARK_WORDS: Record<MarkKind, WordKey> = { filled: 'diagram.mark.filled', used: 'diagram.mark.used', mayBeEmpty: 'diagram.mark.mayBeEmpty' };

/** The marks above a box: words, so they do not rely on colour. */
function Marks({ kinds }: { kinds: readonly MarkKind[] }) {
  return (
    <span className={s.marks}>
      {kinds.map((k) => (
        <span key={k} className={s.mark} data-mark={k}>
          <Icon name={k === 'mayBeEmpty' ? 'warning' : k === 'filled' ? 'form' : 'eye'} size={12} />
          {t(MARK_WORDS[k])}
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

export type BoxNode = Node<Record<string, never>, 'stage' | 'ending' | 'choose' | 'deleted' | 'anotherEnding'>;
export type ArrowEdgeData = {
  laid: LaidArrow;
  /** The arrow's words, split into the main words and the choices in brackets ("Internal tools"). */
  main: string;
  choices?: string;
  fromName: string;
  /** Where it goes, in words; undefined when no stage is chosen. */
  toName?: string;
};
export type ArrowEdgeType = Edge<ArrowEdgeData, 'arrow'>;

// ── Stage boxes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function StageNode(props: NodeProps<BoxNode>) {
  const ctx = useDiagram();
  return ctx.run ? <RunStageNode id={props.id} run={ctx.run} /> : <EditStageNode id={props.id} />;
}

function EditStageNode({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const ctx = useDiagram();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const stage = useStage(id);
  if (!stage || !doc) return null;
  const working = stage.kind !== 'ending';
  const name = stage.name?.trim() ? stage.name : t('diagram.box.noName');
  const kind = t(`stageKind.${stage.kind}` as WordKey);
  const isStart = doc.start?.stage === id;
  const label = t(isStart ? 'diagram.box.labelStart' : 'diagram.box.label', { name, kind });
  const marks = ctx.marks?.byStage.get(id);
  const act = (action: BoxAction) => () => {
    // After the menu has closed and given focus back to its button (Radix does that in a timeout
    // of its own), so the popover that opens next keeps the focus.
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        const box = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-stage-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
        if (box) ctx.boxAction(action, id, box);
      }, 0);
    }, 0);
  };
  const items: MenuItem[] = [
    ...(working
      ? [
          { label: t('diagram.box.addArrow'), icon: 'arrow-right' as const, onSelect: act('connect') },
          { label: t('diagram.box.insertAfter'), icon: 'plus' as const, onSelect: act('after') },
          'separator' as const,
        ]
      : []),
    { label: t('diagram.box.delete'), icon: 'trash' as const, danger: true, onSelect: act('delete') },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className={s.node}
        data-stage-id={id}
        data-drop-stage={id}
        data-selected={ctx.selectedStage === id || undefined}
        data-flash={ctx.flash === id || undefined}
        data-connecting={ctx.connecting || undefined}
        role="group"
        aria-label={label}
        onClick={() => ctx.selectStage(id)}
      >
        <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} isConnectable={false} className={s.targetHandle} />
        {/* The box's own button: Enter or Space opens the stage in the panel. It lies under the card, so
            a click anywhere on the box (bubbling to the group) does the same. */}
        <button
          type="button"
          className={s.select}
          data-select-stage={id}
          aria-label={label}
          aria-current={ctx.selectedStage === id ? 'true' : undefined}
          aria-describedby={marks ? `marks-${id}` : undefined}
        />
        {marks && (
          <span id={`marks-${id}`} className={s.marksSpot}>
            <span className="visually-hidden">{t('diagram.mark.label', { value: ctx.marks?.value ?? '' })} </span>
            <Marks kinds={marks} />
          </span>
        )}
        <StageCard stageId={id} />
        <div className={`${s.menuSpot} nodrag nopan`} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} onKeyDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
          <Menu align="end" items={items} trigger={<IconButton icon="more" size="sm" tooltip={false} label={t('diagram.box.menu', { name })} />} />
        </div>
        {working && (
          <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} className={s.sourceHandle} title={t('diagram.box.handle', { name })} />
        )}
      </div>
      {(ctx.pillsFrom.get(id) ?? []).map((edge) =>
        edge.data ? <ArrowPill key={edge.id} id={edge.id} data={edge.data} origin={ctx.boxAt.get(id) ?? { x: 0, y: 0 }} /> : null,
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * A box of the diagram without editing: the same card, no handle, menu or "+". Where the request is
 * now glows and says "The request is here"; a stage it has been through is drawn as done; the stage
 * it is stuck at says "Stuck". A button when the page can show a stage (onStageClick).
 */
function RunStageNode({ id, run }: { id: string; run: RunView }) {
  const ctx = useDiagram();
  const { doc } = useBoxSource();
  const stage = doc ? getStage(doc, id) : undefined;
  if (!stage || !doc) return null;
  const name = stage.name?.trim() ? stage.name : t('diagram.box.noName');
  const kind = t(`stageKind.${stage.kind}` as WordKey);
  const here = run.at.has(id);
  const stuck = run.stuckAt === id;
  const visited = run.visited.has(id) && !here && !stuck;
  const tag = stuck ? t('word.stuck') : here ? t('diagram.run.here') : visited ? t('diagram.run.visited') : null;
  const label = tag ? t('diagram.run.boxLabelTag', { name, kind, tag }) : t('diagram.run.boxLabel', { name, kind });
  const body = (
    <>
      {tag && (
        <span className={s.marksSpot}>
          <span className={s.mark} data-mark={stuck ? 'stuck' : here ? 'here' : 'visited'}>
            <Icon name={stuck ? 'warning' : here ? 'play' : 'check'} size={12} />
            {tag}
          </span>
        </span>
      )}
      <StageCard stageId={id} />
    </>
  );
  return (
    <>
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} isConnectable={false} className={s.targetHandle} />
      {run.onStageClick ? (
        // A div with the button role: the card inside is block content, which a <button> may not hold.
        <div
          role="button"
          tabIndex={0}
          className={`${s.node} ${s.runBox}`}
          data-stage-id={id}
          data-here={here || undefined}
          data-stuck={stuck || undefined}
          data-visited={visited || undefined}
          aria-label={label}
          aria-current={here ? 'location' : undefined}
          onClick={() => run.onStageClick?.(id)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') return;
            e.preventDefault();
            run.onStageClick?.(id);
          }}
        >
          {body}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={`${s.node} ${s.runBox}`}
          data-stage-id={id}
          data-here={here || undefined}
          data-stuck={stuck || undefined}
          data-visited={visited || undefined}
          role="group"
          aria-label={label}
          aria-current={here ? 'location' : undefined}
        >
          {body}
        </div>
      )}
      <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} isConnectable={false} className={s.targetHandle} />
      {(ctx.pillsFrom.get(id) ?? []).map((edge) =>
        edge.data ? <RunPill key={edge.id} id={edge.id} data={edge.data} origin={ctx.boxAt.get(id) ?? { x: 0, y: 0 }} taken={run.taken.has(edge.id)} /> : null,
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/** An arrow's words without editing; "taken" in words for the arrows the request took. */
function RunPill({ data, origin, taken }: { id: string; data: ArrowEdgeData; origin: { x: number; y: number }; taken: boolean }) {

  return (
    <div
      className={`${s.pillWrap} nodrag nopan`}
      style={{ transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${laid.label.x - origin.x}px, ${laid.label.y - origin.y}px)` }}
    >
      <span className={s.pill} data-look={laid.look} data-taken={taken || undefined} data-static>
        {laid.look === 'sendsBack' && <Icon name="sendback" size={13} />}
        {taken && <Icon name="check" size={13} />}
        <span>{data.main}</span>
        {data.choices && <span className={s.choices}>{t('diagram.arrow.choices', { choices: data.choices })}</span>}
        {taken && <span className="visually-hidden">{t('diagram.run.taken')}</span>}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
