/** An arrow's line and head (hidden from screen readers: its pill, in the box it leaves, names it). */
export function ArrowEdge({ id, data }: EdgeProps<ArrowEdgeType>) {
  const ctx = useDiagram();
  if (!data) return null;
  const { laid } = data;
  const selected = ctx.selectedArrow === id;
  // Lit: the arrow a "may be empty" To do names; taken: the arrow a request took (read only).
  const lit = ctx.marks?.arrows.has(id) || ctx.run?.taken.has(id) || undefined;
  const path = roundedPath(laid.points);
  return (
    <>
      <path d={path} className={s.line} data-look={laid.look} data-selected={selected || undefined} data-lit={lit} fill="none" />
      {!ctx.run && <path d={path} className={s.hit} fill="none" onClick={() => ctx.selectArrow(id)} />}
      <path d={arrowHead(laid.points)} className={s.head} data-look={laid.look} data-selected={selected || undefined} data-lit={lit} />
    </>
  );
}

/** An arrow's words on a pill, and the "+" that adds a stage on it, placed in flow coordinates from origin (the node's corner). */
function ArrowPill({ id, data, origin }: { id: string; data: ArrowEdgeData; origin: { x: number; y: number } }) {
  const ctx = useDiagram();
  const { laid } = data;
  const selected = ctx.selectedArrow === id;
  const label = laid.label.text;
  return (
    <div
      className={`${s.pillWrap} nodrag nopan`}
      style={{ transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${laid.label.x - origin.x}px, ${laid.label.y - origin.y}px)` }}
      data-plus={ctx.plusShown === id || selected || undefined}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className={s.pill}
        data-arrow-id={id}
        data-look={laid.look}
        data-selected={selected || undefined}
        data-lit={ctx.marks?.arrows.has(id) || undefined}
        data-flash={ctx.flash === id || undefined}
        aria-pressed={selected}
        aria-label={t('diagram.arrow.label', { label, from: data.fromName, to: data.toName ?? t('diagram.arrow.nowhere') })}
        onClick={() => ctx.selectArrow(id)}
      >
        {laid.look === 'sendsBack' && <Icon name="sendback" size={13} />}
        <span>{data.main}</span>
        {data.choices && <span className={s.choices}>{t('diagram.arrow.choices', { choices: data.choices })}</span>}
      </button>
      <span className={s.plusSpot}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={s.plus}
          aria-label={t('diagram.arrow.addLabel', { label, from: data.fromName })}
          aria-describedby={`plus-tip-${id}`}
          onClick={(e) => ctx.openInsert(id, e.currentTarget)}
        >
          <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
        </button>
        <span role="tooltip" id={`plus-tip-${id}`} className={s.plusTip}>
          <b>{t('diagram.arrow.add', { label })}</b>
          <span>
            {data.toName
              ? t('diagram.arrow.addBetween', { from: data.fromName, to: data.toName })
              : t('diagram.arrow.addAfter', { from: data.fromName })}
          </span>
        </span>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
/** A line through horizontal and vertical pieces, with rounded corners. */
export function roundedPath(points: Point[], radius = 8): string {
  if (points.length === 0) return '';
  const first = points[0] as Point;
  let d = `M ${first.x} ${first.y}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = points[i - 1] as Point;
    const b = points[i] as Point;
    const c = points[i + 1] as Point;
    const r = Math.min(radius, dist(a, b) / 2, dist(b, c) / 2);
    const p = toward(b, a, r);
    const q = toward(b, c, r);
    d += ` L ${p.x} ${p.y} Q ${b.x} ${b.y} ${q.x} ${q.y}`;
  }
  const last = points[points.length - 1] as Point;
  return `${d} L ${last.x} ${last.y}`;
}

/** A small filled head at the end of the line, pointing the way the last piece goes. */
export function arrowHead(points: Point[], size = 6): string {
  const end = points[points.length - 1];
  const before = points[points.length - 2];
  if (!end || !before) return '';
  const len = dist(before, end) || 1;
  const ux = (end.x - before.x) / len;
  const uy = (end.y - before.y) / len;
  const bx = end.x - ux * size * 1.4;
  const by = end.y - uy * size * 1.4;
  return `M ${end.x} ${end.y} L ${bx - uy * size} ${by + ux * size} L ${bx + uy * size} ${by - ux * size} Z`;
}

const dist = (a: Point, b: Point) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
const toward = (from: Point, to: Point, r: number): Point => {
  const len = dist(from, to) || 1;
  return { x: from.x + ((to.x - from.x) / len) * r, y: from.y + ((to.y - from.y) / len) * r };
};

/** Words with `{name}` placeholders filled with elements (a stage chip inside a sentence). */
export function fill(text: string, parts: Record<string, ReactNode>): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)) {
    out.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
    out.push(<span key={`${m.index}`}>{parts[m[1] as string] ?? m[0]}</span>);
    last = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
  }
  out.push(text.slice(last));
  return out;
}

/**
 * What a stage box shows, worked out from the document with the describe functions (never built
 * by hand): status colour, who is asked and whether that is a person or a group, the actions by
 * name, the connections a start stage also starts from. Pure, so the box and the tests agree.
 */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Expression, Stage, Status, Task } from '@/contract';
import type { Facts } from '@/services';
import {
  actionChip, describeStartsWhen, describeStatus, describeWhoIsAsked, find, getStatus, hasMissing, isChip, toText,
  type DescribeEnv,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';

/** The colour token of a status colour (tokens.css has six; the other two borrow the nearest). */
export function statusColourVar(colour: Status['colour'] | undefined): string {
  switch (colour) {
    case 'amber':
    case 'blue':
    case 'purple':
    case 'green':
    case 'red':
    case 'grey':
      return `var(--st-${colour})`;
    case 'teal':
      return 'var(--action-icon)';
    case 'pink':
      return 'var(--st-red)';
    default:
      return 'transparent';
  }
}

/** The status line ("Waiting for approval", "If sent back: Needs changes") and the colour of its dot. */
export function statusLine(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stage: Stage): { text: string; colour: Status['colour'] | undefined; missing: boolean } {
  const phrase = describeStatus(doc, stage);
  const id = stage.status ?? (stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.ifSentBackStatus : undefined);
  return { text: toText(phrase), colour: getStatus(doc, id)?.colour, missing: hasMissing(phrase) };
}

/** Who is asked, in short words ("Primary domain's approvers"), or the words for nobody yet (missing). */
export function whoLine(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task): { text: string; missing: boolean } {
  const phrase = describeWhoIsAsked(doc, task, { short: true });
  return { text: toText(phrase), missing: hasMissing(phrase) };
}

/** Whether who is asked is one person or a group, for the chip's icon. */
export function whoIcon(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expression: Expression | undefined, facts: Facts | null): 'person' | 'group' {
  if (!expression) return 'person';
  if ('request' in expression) return 'person';
  if ('group' in expression || 'people' in expression) return 'group';
  if ('person' in expression) return 'person';
  if ('value' in expression) {
    const last = expression.steps?.[expression.steps.length - 1];
    if (last && 'directory' in last) return 'group';
    if (last && 'column' in last) {
      const column = find(doc, last.column);
      return column?.kind === 'column' && column.item.kind === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person';
    }
    const kind = facts?.values?.[expression.value]?.kind;
    return kind === 'group' || kind === 'people' ? 'group' : 'person';
  }
  return 'person';
}

/** True when who is asked depends on the request (a value), so the box shows the sample's answer. */
export function comesFromData(expression: Expression | undefined): boolean {
  return !!expression && 'value' in expression;
}

/**
 * The value who is asked is, when it is one value read as it is ("Eng lead", with or without an
 * "If empty, use"), so the box can show that value's own chip. Not when it reads through the value
 * ("Primary domain's approvers"): that is not a value of its own.
 */
export function plainValue(expression: Expression | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!expression || !('value' in expression)) return undefined;
  if (expression.steps?.length) return undefined;
  return expression.value;
}

/** The values an Automatic stage saves what it did as ("Jira issue"), each once, in order. */
export function savedResults(stage: Stage): string[] {
  return savedResultFields(stage).map((r) => r.valueId);
}

/** Each value an Automatic stage saves a result as, with the action and the result field it comes from. */
export function savedResultFields(stage: Stage): { valueId: string; operation?: string; field: string }[] {
  if (stage.kind === 'ending') return [];
  const out: { valueId: string; operation?: string; field: string }[] = [];
  for (const a of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
    if (a.type !== 'useConnection') continue;
    for (const [field, id] of Object.entries(a.saveResults ?? {})) {
      if (!id || out.some((r) => r.valueId === id)) continue;
      out.push({ valueId: id, field, ...(a.operation ? { operation: a.operation } : {}) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The words before the saved value, the same as the panel's connection card says them (actions,
 * "Save the issue key as"): one result names the catalogue's label for its field, several say
 * "Save the results as". Until describe has a function for it (asked of the model area).
 */
export function savesWords(stage: Stage, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): string {
  const saved = savedResultFields(stage);
  const one = saved.length === 1 ? saved[0] : undefined;
  if (!one) return t('diagram.box.savesMany');
  const entry = one.operation ? catalogue?.entries.find((e) => e.id === one.operation) : undefined;
  const label = entry?.kind === 'operation' ? entry.result.find((f) => f.id === one.field)?.label : undefined;
  return label ? t('diagram.box.saves', { label: /^[A-Z][a-z]/.test(label) ? label.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + label.slice(1) : label }) : t('diagram.box.savesMany');
}

/** Names as a list in the shared list words: "Helpdesk", "Helpdesk and Jira", "A, B and C". */
export function joinNames(names: readonly string[]): string {
  if (names.length <= 1) return names[0] ?? '';
  return `${names.slice(0, -1).join(t('describe.comma'))} ${t('describe.and')} ${names[names.length - 1] ?? ''}`;
}

/** Every action of a stage, in the order they are done, as its chip text ("Notify Requester (when Reject)"). */
export function actionChips(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stage: Stage, env: DescribeEnv): { id: string; text: string }[] {
  if (stage.kind === 'ending') return [];
  const all: Action[] = [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])];
  return all.map((a) => ({ id: a.id, text: actionChip(doc, a, env) }));
}

/** The connections a start stage also starts from ("Helpdesk"), by name, each once. */
export function alsoStartsFrom(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stage: Stage, env: DescribeEnv): string[] {
  if (doc.start?.stage !== stage.id) return [];
  const names: string[] = [];
  for (const binding of doc.start.startsWhen ?? []) {
    if (!binding.trigger) continue;
    const first = describeStartsWhen(doc, binding, env).find((part) => isChip(part) && part.chip === 'connection');
    if (first && isChip(first) && !names.includes(first.label)) names.push(first.label);
  }
  return names;
}

/**
 * The layout of a document as xyflow nodes and edges, measured: shared by the editing diagram
 * (DiagramView) and the diagram without editing (ReadOnlyDiagram), so both draw the same boxes in
 * the same places.
 */
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { NodeChange } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { arrowChoices, describeGoTo, getArrow, getStage, toText } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { estimateLabel, layoutDiagram, type Layout, type Size } from './layout';
import type { ArrowEdgeType, BoxNode } from './parts';

export interface LaidOut {
  layout: Layout | null;
  /** True once every box drawn has been measured. */
  ready: boolean;
  nodes: BoxNode[];
  edges: ArrowEdgeType[];
  /** The arrows leaving each stage, for their pills (drawn inside the stage's node). */
  pillsFrom: ReadonlyMap<string, ArrowEdgeType[]>;
  boxAt: ReadonlyMap<string, { x: number; y: number }>;
  onNodesChange(changes: NodeChange<BoxNode>[]): void;
}

export function useLaidOut(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null,
  sendsBack: (arrowId: string) => boolean | undefined,
  options: { editing: boolean },
): LaidOut {
  const [sizes, setSizes] = useState<Record<string, Size>>({});
  // The layout made last, given to the next one so that an edit keeps the stages it did not touch
  // where they were (their order in each row; which arrow of a new circle goes back up).
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<{ id: string; layout: Layout } | null>(null);
  const layout = useMemo<Layout | null>(
    () => (doc ? layoutDiagram(doc, { sizes, measureLabel, sendsBack, previous: shown?.id === doc.id ? shown.layout : null }) : null),
    // Only read: `shown` changes because the layout did, which must not lay it out again.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [doc, sizes, sendsBack],
  );
  if (doc && layout && shown?.layout !== layout) setShown({ id: doc.id, layout });
  const editing = options.editing;
  const drawn = useMemo(() => (layout?.boxes ?? []).filter((b) => editing || b.kind !== 'anotherEnding'), [layout, editing]);
  const ready = !!layout && drawn.every((b) => sizes[b.id]);

  const nodes = useMemo<BoxNode[]>(
    () =>
      drawn.map((b) => ({
        id: b.id,
        type: b.kind,
        position: { x: b.x, y: b.y },
        data: {},
        draggable: false,
        selectable: false,
        focusable: false,
        connectable: editing && b.kind === 'stage',
        ...(sizes[b.id] ? { measured: sizes[b.id] } : {}),
      })),
    [drawn, sizes, editing],
  );
  const edges = useMemo<ArrowEdgeType[]>(() => (doc && layout ? edgesOf(doc, layout) : []), [doc, layout]);
  const pillsFrom = useMemo(() => {
    const by = new Map<string, ArrowEdgeType[]>();
    for (const e of edges) by.set(e.source, [...(by.get(e.source) ?? []), e]);
    return by;
  }, [edges]);
  const boxAt = useMemo(() => new Map((layout?.boxes ?? []).map((b) => [b.id, { x: b.x, y: b.y }])), [layout]);

  const onNodesChange = useCallback((changes: NodeChange<BoxNode>[]) => {
    setSizes((before) => {
      let next = before;
      for (const c of changes) {
        if (c.type !== 'dimensions' || !c.dimensions) continue;
        const { width, height } = c.dimensions;
        const was = next[c.id];
        if (was && Math.abs(was.width - width) < 0.5 && Math.abs(was.height - height) < 0.5) continue;
        if (next === before) next = { ...before };
        next[c.id] = { width, height };
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  return { layout, ready, nodes, edges, pillsFrom, boxAt, onNodesChange };
}

function edgesOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, layout: Layout): ArrowEdgeType[] {
  return layout.arrows.map((laid) => {
    const arrow = getArrow(doc, laid.id);
    const choices = arrow ? arrowChoices(doc, arrow) : undefined;
    const text = laid.label.text;
    const cut = choices?.length ? text.lastIndexOf(' (') : -1;
    const fromName = getStage(doc, laid.from)?.name || t('diagram.box.noName');
    const toName = arrow?.goTo ? toText(describeGoTo(doc, arrow.goTo)) : undefined;
    return {
      id: laid.id,
      source: laid.from,
      target: laid.to,
      type: 'arrow' as const,
      selectable: false,
      focusable: false,
      // The line says nothing to a screen reader (xyflow would say "Edge from st_... to st_...");
      // the arrow's pill, in the box it leaves, names it in words.
      ariaRole: 'presentation',
      domAttributes: { 'aria-hidden': true, 'aria-label': undefined, 'aria-roledescription': undefined },
      data: {
        laid,
        main: cut > 0 ? text.slice(0, cut) : text,
        ...(cut > 0 ? { choices: text.slice(cut + 2, -1) } : {}),
        fromName,
        ...(toName ? { toName } : {}),
      },
    };
  });
}

let measureContext: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null | undefined;
/** A pill's size, from its words in the pill's font (room for the send-back icon included). */
function measureLabel(text: string): Size {
  if (measureContext === undefined) {
    try {
      measureContext = navigator.userAgent.includes('jsdom') ? null : document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
      if (measureContext) {
        const font = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--font') || 'sans-serif';
        measureContext.font = `500 12.5px ${font}`;
      }
    } catch {
      measureContext = null;
    }
  }
  if (!measureContext) return estimateLabel(text);
  return { width: Math.ceil(measureContext.measureText(text).width) + 22 + 18, height: 26 };
}

/**
 * A searchable one-choice picker (ARIA combobox with a listbox): for people, groups and choices
 * read from a connection or a list. Arrow keys move, Enter chooses, Escape closes, typing searches.
 * Built here because src/ui has no combobox yet; a candidate for src/ui once a second feature needs it.

import { Icon, IconButton } from '@/ui';
import type { Json } from '@/services';
import { sameAnswer, type Option } from './logic';
import s from './forms.module.css';

type Props = {
  /** The id of the element that names the picker (the question's label). */
  labelledBy: string;
  describedBy?: string | undefined;
  invalid?: boolean;
  options: Option[];
  value: Json | undefined;
  /** The words of the chosen value, when they are not among the options (a person's name). */
  valueLabel?: string | undefined;
  onChange(next: Json | undefined): void;
  placeholder: string;

  onSearch?: ((text: string) => void) | undefined;
  onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean) => void) | undefined;
  loading?: boolean;
  failed?: boolean;
  /** A line above the options ("Payments engineering · 2 people"). */
  head?: ReactNode;
  /** A line under the options ("Sample choices from Service catalog ..."). */
  foot?: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  clearLabel: string;
  icon?: 'person' | 'group' | 'choice';
};

export function ChoicePicker(props: Props) {
  const { options, value, onChange, onSearch, disabled } = props;
  const listId = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const chosen = options.find((o) => sameAnswer(o.value, value));
  const chosenLabel = value === undefined ? '' : (chosen?.label ?? props.valueLabel ?? '');
  const shown = onSearch || !text ? options : options.filter((o) => o.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));

  const setOpenTo = (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next);
    props.onOpenChange?.(next);
    if (!next) {
      setText('');
      onSearch?.('');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const away = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (wrap.current && !wrap.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpenTo(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', away);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', away);
  });

  const pick = (o: Option) => {
    onChange(o.value);
    setOpenTo(false);
    input.current?.focus();
  };

  const optionId = (i: number) => `${listId}-o${i}`;

  return (
    <div className={s.picker} ref={wrap}>
      <div className={[s.pickerBox, props.invalid ? s.pickerInvalid : ''].join(' ')}>
        {props.icon && <Icon name={props.icon} size={16} />}
        <input
          ref={input}
          role="combobox"
          className={s.pickerInput}
          aria-labelledby={props.labelledBy}
          aria-describedby={props.describedBy}
          aria-invalid={props.invalid || undefined}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={listId}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-activedescendant={open && shown[active] ? optionId(active) : undefined}
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder={chosenLabel ? undefined : props.placeholder}
          value={open ? text : chosenLabel}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setText(e.target.value);
            setActive(0);
            onSearch?.(e.target.value);
            if (!open) setOpenTo(true);
          }}
          onClick={() => !disabled && setOpenTo(!open)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (!open) setOpenTo(true);
              else setActive((a) => Math.min(a + 1, shown.length - 1));
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
              e.preventDefault();
              setActive((a) => Math.max(a - 1, 0));
            } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && open) {
              e.preventDefault();
              const o = shown[active];
              if (o) pick(o);
            } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && open) {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              setOpenTo(false);
            }
          }}
        />
        {value !== undefined && !disabled && (
          <IconButton
            icon="close"
            size="sm"
            label={props.clearLabel}
            onClick={() => {
              onChange(undefined);
              input.current?.focus();
            }}
          />
        )}
        <Icon name={open ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={16} />
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div className={s.pickerPop}>
          {props.head && <div className={s.pickerHead}>{props.head}</div>}
          <ul id={listId} role="listbox" aria-labelledby={props.labelledBy} className={s.pickerList}>
            {shown.map((o, i) => (
              <li
                key={`${i}-${o.label}`}
                id={optionId(i)}
                role="option"
                aria-selected={sameAnswer(o.value, value)}
                className={[s.pickerOption, i === active ? s.pickerActive : ''].join(' ')}
                onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
                onClick={() => pick(o)}
              >
                <span>{o.label}</span>
                {o.detail && <span className={s.quiet}>{o.detail}</span>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {props.loading && <p className={s.pickerNote} role="status">{t('forms.answer.loading')}</p>}
          {props.failed && <p className={s.pickerNote} role="alert">{t('forms.answer.cannotLoad')}</p>}
          {!props.loading && !props.failed && shown.length === 0 && <p className={s.pickerNote}>{t('forms.answer.noMatch')}</p>}
          {props.foot && <div className={s.pickerFoot}>{props.foot}</div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/ChoicesSettings.tsx\n===
/**
 * Where a question's choices come from (editor-model.md sections 6 and 10): Typed in / From a list
 * in this workflow / From a connection / From a formula, and People from the directory on a person
 * question. What the first build cannot run (decision E-23) is not offered; a document that
 * arrives with it says so here and in To do.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, CatalogueRef, Choices, Expression, Question, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { describeExpression, Slot, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useRun, getValue } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Callout, Icon, IconButton, Select } from '@/ui';
import {
  choicesOffered, connectionName, dataSources, kindWords, sampleSourceOptions, sourceEntry, sourceFields, type ChoicesFrom,
} from './logic';
import { CommitInput, focusMoved, useReadOnly } from './parts';
import { useChoices } from './useChoices';
import s from './forms.module.css';

const FROM_WORDS: Record<ChoicesFrom, { title: 'forms.choices.typedIn' | 'forms.choices.list' | 'forms.choices.directory' | 'forms.choices.source' | 'forms.choices.formula' | 'forms.choices.anyone' | 'forms.choices.anyGroup'; line: Parameters<typeof t>[0] }> = {
  typedIn: { title: 'forms.choices.typedIn', line: 'forms.choices.typedIn.line' },
  list: { title: 'forms.choices.list', line: 'forms.choices.list.line' },
  directory: { title: 'forms.choices.directory', line: 'forms.choices.directory.line' },
  source: { title: 'forms.choices.source', line: 'forms.choices.source.line' },
  formula: { title: 'forms.choices.formula', line: 'forms.choices.formula.line' },
  none: { title: 'forms.choices.anyone', line: 'forms.choices.anyone.line' },
};

export function ChoicesSettings({ doc, question }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; question: Question }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const name = useId();
  const offered = choicesOffered(question.kind);
  const current: ChoicesFrom | undefined = question.choices?.from ?? (question.kind === 'person' || question.kind === 'group' ? 'none' : undefined);
  // "People from the directory" needs its group before anything is stored.
  // It is forgotten when another question is chosen or the choices change.
  const key = `|`;
  const [held, setHeld] = useState<{ key: string; from: ChoicesFrom } | null>(null);
  const pending = held?.key === key ? held.from : null;
  const setPending = (from: ChoicesFrom | null) => setHeld(from ? { key, from } : null);
  const chosen = pending ?? current;
  const unsupported = current && !offered.includes(current);

  const choose = (from: ChoicesFrom) => {
    setPending(null);
    switch (from) {
      case 'none':
        run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id });
        return;
      case 'typedIn':
        run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { from: 'typedIn', choices: [] } });
        return;
      case 'list': {
        const list = doc.lists?.[0];
        if (list) run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { from: 'list', list: list.id } });
        else setPending('list');
        return;
      }
      case 'directory':
        setPending('directory');
        return;
      case 'source':
        run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { from: 'source', inputs: {} } });
        return;
      case 'formula':
        run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { from: 'formula', formula: { formula: '', readsAs: '' } } });
        return;
    }
  };

  return (
    <fieldset className={s.choices}>
      <legend className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.choices.title')}</legend>
      {unsupported && (
        <Callout tone="todo">{t('forms.choices.notOffered', { kind: kindWords(question.kind).toLowerCase() })}</Callout>
      )}
      {offered.map((from) => {
        const words = from === 'none' && question.kind === 'group' ? { title: 'forms.choices.anyGroup' as const, line: 'forms.choices.anyGroup.line' as const } : FROM_WORDS[from];
        const on = chosen === from;
        const disabled = from === 'list' && !(doc.lists ?? []).length;
        // Read only: only the source in use is shown, as it is.
        if (readOnly && !on) return null;
        return (
          <div key={from} className={[s.choiceCard, on ? s.choiceCardOn : ''].join(' ')}>
            <label className={s.choiceCardHead}>
              <input type="radio" name={name} checked={on} disabled={disabled || readOnly} onChange={() => choose(from)} />
              <span>
                <span className={s.choiceCardTitle}>{t(words.title)}</span>
                <span className={s.choiceCardLine}>{disabled ? t('forms.choices.noLists') : t(words.line)}</span>
              </span>
            </label>
            {on && from === 'typedIn' && question.choices?.from === 'typedIn' && <TypedIn question={question} />}
            {on && from === 'list' && question.choices?.from === 'list' && <FromList doc={doc} question={question} choices={question.choices} />}
            {on && from === 'directory' && <FromDirectory doc={doc} question={question} />}
            {on && from === 'source' && question.choices?.from === 'source' && <FromSource doc={doc} question={question} choices={question.choices} />}
            {on && from === 'formula' && question.choices?.from === 'formula' && (
              <div className={s.choiceBody}>
                <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.choices.formulaHint')}</p>
                {readOnly ? (
                  <p className={s.readWhen}>{toText(describeExpression(doc, question.choices.formula, env))}</p>
                ) : (
                  <Slot
                    name="FormulaEditor"
                    at={{ item: question.id, part: 'choices.formula' }}
                    value={question.choices.formula}
                    gives={['list']}
                    onChange={(next) => run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { from: 'formula', formula: next ?? { formula: '', readsAs: '' } } })}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function TypedIn({ question }: { question: Question }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const choices = question.choices?.from === 'typedIn' ? (question.choices.choices ?? []) : [];
  const inputs = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLInputElement>());
  const [focusId, setFocusId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusId) inputs.current.get(focusId)?.focus();
  }, [focusId, choices.length]);
  const addChoice = () => {
    const made = run('choice.add', { question: question.id, label: '' });
    if (made && typeof made === 'object' && 'id' in made) setFocusId(made.id);
  };
  // Enter keeps the choice and goes on to the next one, as in a list: a new empty choice after the
  // last one (unless the last is still empty), else the next field.
  const onEnter = (index: number, text: string) => {
    const next = choices[index + 1];
    if (next) {
      inputs.current.get(next.id)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (text.trim()) addChoice();
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.choiceBody}>
      <ol className={s.typedList}>
        {choices.map((c, i) => {
          const label = c.label?.trim() || t('forms.choices.choiceLabel', { n: i + 1 });
          return (
            <li key={c.id} className={s.typedRow}>
              <CommitInput
                ref={(el) => {
                  if (el) inputs.current.set(c.id, el);
                  else inputs.current.delete(c.id);
                }}
                aria-label={t('forms.choices.choiceLabel', { n: i + 1 })}
                value={c.label ?? ''}
                onCommit={(next) => run('choice.rename', { choice: c.id, label: next })}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !readOnly) onEnter(i, e.currentTarget.value);
                }}
              />
              {!readOnly && (
                <>
                  <IconButton
                    icon="chevron-up"
                    size="sm"
                    label={t('forms.choices.moveUp', { choice: label })}
                    data-move={`${c.id}:up`}
                    disabled={i === 0}
                    onClick={() => {
                      run('choice.move', { choice: c.id, toIndex: i - 1 });
                      focusMoved(c.id, 'up');
                    }}
                  />
                  <IconButton
                    icon="chevron-down"
                    size="sm"
                    label={t('forms.choices.moveDown', { choice: label })}
                    data-move={`${c.id}:down`}
                    disabled={i === choices.length - 1}
                    onClick={() => {
                      run('choice.move', { choice: c.id, toIndex: i + 1 });
                      focusMoved(c.id, 'down');
                    }}
                  />
                  <IconButton icon="trash" size="sm" label={t('forms.choices.remove', { choice: label })} onClick={() => run('choice.delete', { choice: c.id })} />
                </>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      {!readOnly && (
        <button type="button" className={s.linkButton} onClick={addChoice}>
          {t('forms.choices.add')}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FromList({ doc, question, choices }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; question: Question; choices: Extract<Choices, { from: 'list' }> }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const lists = doc.lists ?? [];
  const list = lists.find((l) => l.id === choices.list);
  const set = (next: Extract<Choices, { from: 'list' }>) => run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: next });
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const listId = useId();
  const columnId = useId();
  return (
    <div className={s.choiceBody}>
      <div className={s.settingRow}>
        <label htmlFor={listId}>{t('forms.choices.whichList')}</label>
        <Select
          id={listId}
          value={choices.list ?? ''}
          disabled={readOnly}
          options={[...(list ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('forms.choices.chooseList') }]), ...lists.map((l) => ({ value: l.id, label: l.name || t('describe.noName') }))]}
          onChange={(e) => set({ from: 'list', list: e.target.value as typeof choices.list })}
        />
      </div>
      {list && (
        <div className={s.settingRow}>
          <label htmlFor={columnId}>{t('forms.choices.show')}</label>
          <Select
            id={columnId}
            value={choices.shownColumn ?? ''}
            disabled={readOnly}
            options={[{ value: '', label: t('forms.choices.firstColumn') }, ...(list.columns ?? []).map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name || t('describe.noName') }))]}
            onChange={(e) => set({ from: 'list', list: choices.list, ...(e.target.value ? { shownColumn: e.target.value as NonNullable<typeof choices.shownColumn> } : {}) })}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FromDirectory({ doc, question }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; question: Question }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const peopleIn = question.choices?.from === 'directory' ? question.choices.peopleIn : undefined;
  const sample = useChoices(doc, question, null, undefined, '', !!peopleIn);
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  return (
    <div className={s.choiceBody}>
      <p className={s.settingLabel}>{t('forms.choices.membersOf')}</p>
      {readOnly ? (
        <p className={s.readWhen}>{peopleIn ? toText(describeExpression(doc, peopleIn, env)) : t('forms.choices.membersOfNone')}</p>
      ) : (
      <Slot
        name="ValueField"
        at={{ item: question.id, part: 'choices.peopleIn' }}
        label={t('forms.choices.membersOfLabel')}
        accepts={['group']}
        value={peopleIn}
        onChange={(next: Expression | undefined) => {
          if (next) run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { from: 'directory', peopleIn: next } });
          else run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id });
        }}
      />
      )}
      {peopleIn && sample.options.length > 0 && (
        <p className={s.sampleBox}>{t('forms.choices.forSample', { people: sample.options.map((o) => o.label).join(t('describe.comma')) })}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FromSource({ doc, question, choices }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; question: Question; choices: Extract<Choices, { from: 'source' }> }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const groups = dataSources(catalogue);
  const entry = sourceEntry(catalogue, choices.source);
  const connection = entry?.connection ?? '';
  const group = groups.find((g) => g.connection === connection);
  const ids = { connection: useId(), list: useId(), show: useId(), kept: useId() };
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const value = getValue(doc, question.savedAs);
  const set = (next: Partial<Extract<Choices, { from: 'source' }>>) =>
    run('question.setChoices', { question: question.id, choices: { ...choices, ...next, from: 'source' } as Extract<Choices, { from: 'source' }> });
  // A list chosen is stored whole: what people see and what is kept, so the question is finished
  // at once (the check needs both; the author only picks what to show).
  const pickList = (ref: string | undefined) => {
    const next = sourceEntry(catalogue, ref);
    if (!next) return;
    const { label, stored } = sourceFields(next, { from: 'source', inputs: {} } as Extract<Choices, { from: 'source' }>);
    run('question.setChoices', {
      question: question.id,
      choices: { from: 'source', source: next.id as CatalogueRef, inputs: {}, ...(label ? { labelField: label } : {}), ...(stored ? { storedField: stored } : {}) },
    });
  };

  if (groups.length === 0) return <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.choices.noConnections')}</p>;
  const fields = entry ? sourceFields(entry, choices) : undefined;
  const samples = entry ? sampleSourceOptions(entry, choices) : [];
  const shownFields = (entry?.item ?? []).filter((f) => f.kind === 'text' || f.kind === 'number');
  const keptFields = entry?.item ?? [];

  return (
    <div className={s.choiceBody}>
      <div className={s.settingRow}>
        <label htmlFor={ids.connection}>{t('forms.choices.connection')}</label>
        <Select
          id={ids.connection}
            disabled={readOnly}
          value={connection}
          options={[...(entry ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('forms.choices.chooseConnection') }]), ...groups.map((g) => ({ value: g.connection, label: g.label }))]}
          onChange={(e) => pickList(groups.find((g) => g.connection === e.target.value)?.entries[0]?.id)}
        />
      </div>
      {group && (
        <div className={s.settingRow}>
          <label htmlFor={ids.list}>{t('forms.choices.whichOfItsLists')}</label>
          <Select
            id={ids.list}
            disabled={readOnly}
            value={entry?.id ?? ''}
            options={group.entries.map((e) => ({ value: e.id, label: e.label }))}
            onChange={(e) => pickList(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {entry && fields && (
        <div className={s.settingRow}>
          <label htmlFor={ids.show}>{t('forms.choices.whatToShow')}</label>
          <Select
            id={ids.show}
            disabled={readOnly}
            value={choices.labelField ?? ''}
            options={[
              ...(choices.labelField ? [] : [{ value: '', label: t('forms.choices.chooseWhatToShow') }]),
              ...shownFields.map((f) => ({ value: f.id, label: f.label })),
            ]}
            onChange={(e) => e.target.value && set({ labelField: e.target.value, storedField: choices.storedField ?? fields.stored })}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Only a question that arrived without it: what is kept is otherwise set with the list. */}
      {entry && fields && !choices.storedField && (
        <div className={s.settingRow}>
          <label htmlFor={ids.kept}>{t('forms.choices.whatIsKept')}</label>
          <Select
            id={ids.kept}
            disabled={readOnly}
            value=""
            options={[{ value: '', label: t('forms.choices.chooseWhatIsKept') }, ...keptFields.map((f) => ({ value: f.id, label: f.label }))]}
            onChange={(e) => e.target.value && set({ storedField: e.target.value, labelField: choices.labelField ?? fields.label })}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {(entry?.input ?? []).map((field) => (
        <div key={field.id} className={s.inputRow}>
          {readOnly ? (
            <p className={s.readWhen}>
              {t('forms.choices.inputIs', {
                field: field.label,
                value: choices.inputs?.[field.id] ? toText(describeExpression(doc, choices.inputs[field.id] as Expression, env)) : t('forms.choices.inputNone'),
              })}
            </p>
          ) : (
          <Slot
            name="ValueField"
            at={{ item: question.id, part: `choices.inputs.${field.id}` }}
            label={t('forms.choices.input', { field: field.label })}
            accepts={[field.kind as ValueKind]}
            allowTyped
            value={choices.inputs?.[field.id] as Expression | undefined}
            onChange={(next: Expression | undefined) => {
              const inputs = { ...(choices.inputs ?? {}) };
              if (next) inputs[field.id] = next;
              else delete inputs[field.id];
              set({ inputs });
            }}
          />
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      {entry && samples.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.sampleBox}>
          <p>{t('forms.choices.sample', { connection: connectionName(catalogue, entry.connection) })}</p>
          <ul className={s.sampleChips}>
            {samples.slice(0, 4).map((o, i) => (
              <li key={i} className={s.sampleChip}>
                {o.label}
              </li>
            ))}
            {samples.length > 4 && <li className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.choices.more', { n: samples.length - 4 })}</li>}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {entry && (
        <p className={s.keptNote}>
          <Icon name="check" size={14} />
          <span>
            <b>{t('forms.choices.onlyAnswerKept')}</b>{' '}
            {t('forms.choices.onlyAnswerKeptRest', { value: value?.name || question.label || t('describe.noName'), connection: connectionName(catalogue, entry.connection) })}
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The middle of the form editor: the form as people will see it (the one renderer, FormView's own,
 * in preview mode), one page at a time with every item on it, Who is asked at the top and the
 * buttons at the bottom. Clicking a question chooses it; questions move by drag and by keyboard.
 */
import { useRef, useState, type DragEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Button as FormButton, FormItem, Page, Question, QuestionKind, Task } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeCondition, describeGoTo, describeNegatedCondition, describeWhoIsAsked, reveal, Slot, toText,
  useArrowFacts, useDescribeEnv, useFindingsFor, useRun, type Phrase,
} from '@/model';
import type { Answers, FormState, Json, Values } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon, IconButton, Mark, Menu, type MenuItem } from '@/ui';
import { FormRenderer } from './FormView';
import {
  buttonLabel, buttonsNeeding, createdId, distinctFindings, itemName, joinNames, KIND_ICON, KIND_LINE, kindWords, labelOf, neededQuestions,
  pageTitle, QUESTION_KINDS, refOf,
} from './logic';
import { PhraseView, useReadOnly, Words } from './parts';
import { useSampleWho } from './sample';
import { DirectoryName } from './ValueWords';
import s from './forms.module.css';

type Props = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  stageId: string;
  isStart: boolean;
  page: Page;
  selected: string | null;
  onSelect(id: string): void;
  answers: Answers;
  onAnswersChange(next: Answers): void;
  values: Values;
  request: { requester?: { type: 'user' | 'group'; id: string }; startedOn?: string } | undefined;
  flash: string | null;
  /** Says a change in words for screen readers (a move, a removal). */
  announce(text: string): void;
};

export function EditView(props: Props) {
  const { doc, task, page } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const pages = task.form?.pages ?? [];
  const pageIndex = pages.indexOf(page);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropAt, setDropAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const handles = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>());

  const move = (item: FormItem, toPage: Page, toIndex: number, focus = true) => {
    run('item.move', { item: item.id as `q_${string}`, page: toPage.id, toIndex });
    const count = (toPage.items ?? []).length + (toPage.id === page.id ? 0 : 1);
    props.announce(t('forms.item.moved', { item: itemName(doc, task, item), n: Math.min(toIndex, count - 1) + 1, count }));
    if (focus) requestAnimationFrame(() => handles.current.get(item.id)?.focus());
  };

  const remove = (item: FormItem) => {
    const name = itemName(doc, task, item);
    run('item.delete', { item: item.id as `q_${string}` });
    props.announce(t('forms.item.removed', { item: name }));
  };

  const onHandleKey = (item: FormItem, index: number) => (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const count = (page.items ?? []).length;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && index > 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      move(item, page, index - 1);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && index < count - 1) {
      e.preventDefault();
      move(item, page, index + 1);
    }
  };

  const itemTools = (item: FormItem, index: number) => {
    const name = itemName(doc, task, item);
    const count = (page.items ?? []).length;
    const menu: MenuItem[] = [
      ...(index > 0 ? [{ label: t('forms.item.moveUp'), icon: 'chevron-up' as const, onSelect: () => move(item, page, index - 1) }] : []),
      ...(index < count - 1 ? [{ label: t('forms.item.moveDown'), icon: 'chevron-down' as const, onSelect: () => move(item, page, index + 1) }] : []),
      ...pages
        .filter((p) => p.id !== page.id)
        .map((p) => ({ label: t('forms.item.moveToPage', { page: pageTitle(p, pages.indexOf(p)) }), icon: 'arrow-right' as const, onSelect: () => move(item, p, (p.items ?? []).length, false) })),
      'separator',
      { label: t('forms.item.remove', { item: name }), icon: 'trash', danger: true, onSelect: () => remove(item) },
    ];
    return (
      <span className={s.tools}>
        <button
          type="button"
          ref={(el) => {
            if (el) handles.current.set(item.id, el);
            else handles.current.delete(item.id);
          }}
          className={s.handle}
          aria-label={t('forms.item.move', { item: name })}
          aria-describedby={`${page.id}-move-hint`}
          onKeyDown={onHandleKey(item, index)}
          onMouseDown={() => setArmed(item.id)}
          onMouseUp={() => setArmed(null)}
        >
          <Icon name="drag" size={14} />
        </button>
        <Menu trigger={<IconButton icon="more" size="sm" label={t('forms.item.more', { item: name })} />} items={menu} align="end" />
        <IconButton icon="trash" size="sm" label={t('forms.item.remove', { item: name })} onClick={() => remove(item)} />
      </span>
    );
  };

  const itemDrag = (item: FormItem, index: number) => ({
    draggable: armed === item.id || dragging === item.id,
    onDragStart: (e: DragEvent) => {
      setDragging(item.id);
      e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
      e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', item.id);
    },
    onDragOver: (e: DragEvent) => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const box = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
      setDropAt(e.clientY > box.top + box.height / 2 ? index + 1 : index);
    },
    onDrop: (e: DragEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const from = (page.items ?? []).findIndex((i) => i.id === dragging);
      const moved = (page.items ?? [])[from];
      if (moved && dropAt !== null) {
        const to = dropAt > from ? dropAt - 1 : dropAt;
        if (to !== from) move(moved, page, to, false);
      }
      setDragging(null);
      setArmed(null);
      setDropAt(null);
    },
    onDragEnd: () => {
      setDragging(null);
      setArmed(null);
      setDropAt(null);
    },
    'data-drop': dropAt === index ? 'before' : dropAt === index + 1 && index === (page.items ?? []).length - 1 ? 'after' : undefined,
  });

  const addQuestion = (kind: QuestionKind) => {
    const id = createdId(run('question.add', { page: page.id, kind }));
    if (id) props.onSelect(id);
  };
  const addText = () => {
    const id = createdId(run('text.add', { page: page.id }));
    if (id) props.onSelect(id);
  };
  const kinds: MenuItem[] = [
    { group: t('forms.add.kindsTitle') },
    ...QUESTION_KINDS.map((k) => ({ label: `${kindWords(k)}: ${t(KIND_LINE[k])}`, icon: KIND_ICON[k], onSelect: () => addQuestion(k) })),
  ];

  return (
    <FormRenderer
      doc={doc}
      taskId={task.id}
      mode="preview"
      answers={props.answers}
      onAnswersChange={props.onAnswersChange}
      values={props.values}
      {...(props.request ? { request: props.request } : {})}
      editor={{
        pageId: page.id,
        selected: props.selected,
        onSelect: props.onSelect,
        flash: props.flash,
        top: <WhoTop doc={doc} task={task} isStart={props.isStart} />,
        pageHead: <PageHead doc={doc} page={page} index={pageIndex} count={pages.length} />,
        questionHead: (q) => <NeededLine task={task} question={q} />,
        itemFoot: (item, hidden) => <ItemFoot doc={doc} item={item} hiddenForSample={hidden} />,
        readOnly,
        ...(readOnly ? {} : { itemTools, itemDrag }),
        afterItems: readOnly ? null : (
          <div className={s.addRow}>
            <p id={`${page.id}-move-hint`} className="visually-hidden">
              {t('forms.item.moveHint')}
            </p>
            <Menu
              trigger={
                <button type="button" className={s.dashedButton}>
                  {t('forms.add.question')}
                </button>
              }
              items={kinds}
            />
            <button type="button" className={s.dashedButton} onClick={addText}>
              {t('forms.add.text')}
            </button>
            <p className={s.addLine}>
              <b>{t('forms.add.textLead')}</b> {t('forms.add.textLine')}
            </p>
          </div>
        ),
        buttons: (state) => (
          <EditButtons
            doc={doc}
            task={task}
            state={state}
            selected={props.selected === 'buttons'}
            onSelect={() => props.onSelect('buttons')}
            flash={props.flash}
            onSelectQuestion={props.onSelect}
          />
        ),
      }}
    />
  );
}

// ── who is asked, at the top ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function WhoTop({ doc, task, isStart }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; task: Task; isStart: boolean }) {
  const who = useSampleWho(doc, task);
  const ref = refOf(who) ?? (Array.isArray(who) ? refOf(who[0]) : undefined);
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const rule = isStart ? t('forms.who.askedAgain') : ref?.type === 'group' ? t('rule.group') : ref ? t('rule.person') : undefined;
  return (
    <div className={s.who}>
      <div className={s.whoLine}>
        <span className={s.whoLabel}>{t('forms.who.label')}</span>
        <span className={s.whoChip}>
          <PhraseView phrase={describeWhoIsAsked(doc, task)} />
        </span>
        <span className={s.quiet}>
          {isStart ? t('forms.who.requester') : ref && !isRequesterOnly(task) ? <ForSample json={ref} /> : null}
        </span>
        {!readOnly && (
          <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" icon="edit" aria-label={t('forms.who.change')} onClick={() => reveal({ item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' })}>
            {t('forms.who.changeShort')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {rule && (
        <p className={s.whoRule}>
          <Icon name={ref?.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person'} size={14} />
          {rule}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const isRequesterOnly = (task: Task) => !!task.whoIsAsked && 'request' in task.whoIsAsked;

function ForSample({ json }: { json: Json }) {
  return <Words k="forms.who.forSample" fill={{ name: <DirectoryName json={json} /> }} />;
}

function PageHead({ doc, page, index, count }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; page: Page; index: number; count: number }) {
  return (
    <>
      <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.page.ofN', { n: index + 1, count })}</span>
      {page.showWhen && (
        <p className={s.pageShowWhen}>
          <Icon name="filter" size={14} />
          <span>
            <PhraseView phrase={withLead('forms.page.showThisWhen', describeCondition(doc, page.showWhen))} />{' '}
            <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.page.hiddenWhen', { condition: toText(describeNegatedCondition(doc, page.showWhen)) })}</span>
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/** "Show this page when" followed by the chips of the condition. */
function withLead(key: 'forms.page.showThisWhen' | 'forms.question.askedOnlyWhen' | 'forms.text.shownOnlyWhen', condition: Phrase): Phrase {
  return [t(key, { condition: '' }).trimEnd(), ' ', ...condition];
}

function NeededLine({ task, question }: { task: Task; question: Question }) {
  const buttons = buttonsNeeding(task, question);
  if (!buttons.length) return null;
  return <span className={s.neededLine}>{t('forms.question.neededToPress', { buttons: joinNames(buttons.map(buttonLabel)) })}</span>;
}

function ItemFoot({ doc, item, hiddenForSample }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; item: FormItem; hiddenForSample: boolean }) {
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const findings = useFindingsFor(item.id, { deep: true });
  // In the form the cause alone, each said once.
  const lines = distinctFindings(doc, findings, env, false);
  return (
    <div className={s.itemFoot}>
      {item.showWhen && (
        <span className={s.whenTag}>
          <Icon name="filter" size={12} />
          <PhraseView phrase={withLead(item.type === 'question' ? 'forms.question.askedOnlyWhen' : 'forms.text.shownOnlyWhen', describeCondition(doc, item.showWhen))} />
        </span>
      )}
      {hiddenForSample && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.question.hiddenForSample')}</span>}
      {item.type === 'question' && (
        <span className={s.kindSaved}>
          {item.savedAs ? (
            <Words k="forms.question.kindAndSavedAs" fill={{ kind: kindWords(item.kind), value: <Slot name="ValueChip" valueId={item.savedAs} /> }} />
          ) : (
            kindWords(item.kind)
          )}
        </span>
      )}
      {lines.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={s.findings}>
          {lines.map((line) => (
            <li key={line.key}>
              <Mark variant={line.todo ? 'todo' : 'worth'}>{line.text}</Mark>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── the buttons, at the bottom ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function EditButtons(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  state: FormState | null;
  selected: boolean;
  onSelect(): void;
  flash: string | null;
  onSelectQuestion(id: string): void;
}) {
  const { doc, task } = props;
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const buttons = task.buttons ?? [];
  const flashing = !!props.flash && buttons.some((b) => b.id === props.flash);
  return (
    <section
      className={[s.editButtons, props.selected ? s.chosen : '', flashing ? s.flash : ''].join(' ')}
      aria-label={t('forms.buttons.title')}
      data-item-id="buttons"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) props.onSelect();
      }}
    >
      <div className={s.editButtonsHead}>
        <span>
          <b>{t('forms.buttons.title')}</b> <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.sub')}</span>
        </span>
        {!readOnly && (
          <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" icon="edit" aria-pressed={props.selected} onClick={props.onSelect}>
            {t('forms.buttons.edit')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {buttons.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.none')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className={s.editButtonList}>
          {buttons.map((b) => (
            <ButtonCard key={b.id} doc={doc} task={task} button={b} onSelect={() => props.onSelectQuestion(b.id)} onSelectQuestion={props.onSelectQuestion} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function ButtonCard({ doc, task, button, onSelect, onSelectQuestion }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; task: Task; button: FormButton; onSelect(): void; onSelectQuestion(id: string): void }) {
  const needs = neededQuestions(task, button);
  const arrow = buttonArrow(doc, task, button);
  const facts = useArrowFacts(arrow?.id);
  return (
    <li className={s.buttonCard} data-item-id={button.id}>
      <Button
        variant={button.look === 'danger' ? 'danger' : button.look === 'primary' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
        aria-label={t('forms.button.open', { button: buttonLabel(button) })}
        onClick={onSelect}
      >
        {buttonLabel(button)}
      </Button>
      <div className={s.buttonNeeds}>
        {needs.length ? (
          <>
            <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.needs')}</span>
            {needs.map((q) => (
              <button
                key={q.id}
                type="button"
                className={s.needChip}
                aria-label={t('forms.buttons.needChip', { question: labelOf(q), button: buttonLabel(button) })}
                onClick={() => onSelectQuestion(q.id)}
              >
                <Icon name={KIND_ICON[q.kind]} size={12} />
                {labelOf(q)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.needsNothing')}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={s.goesTo}>
        <Icon name="arrow-right" size={12} />
        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.goesTo')}</span>
        {arrow ? (
          <PhraseView phrase={describeGoTo(doc, arrow.goTo)} />
        ) : hasOtherArrows(doc, task) ? (
          <span>{t('forms.buttons.byArrows')}</span>
        ) : (
          <span className={s.missingText}>{t('forms.buttons.goesNowhere')}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {facts?.sendsBack && (
        <div className={s.goesTo}>
          <Icon name="sendback" size={12} />
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.sendsBack')}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

/** True when the task's stage has arrows that do not name a button (they decide for every button). */
export function hasOtherArrows(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task): boolean {
  const stage = (doc.stages ?? []).find((st) => st.kind !== 'ending' && (st.tasks ?? []).some((x) => x.id === task.id));
  return !!stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' && (stage.arrows ?? []).some((a) => a.when?.type !== 'buttonPressed');
}

/** The button's own arrow: its plain one if it has one, else the first that names it. */
export function buttonArrow(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, button: FormButton) {
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending' || !(stage.tasks ?? []).some((x) => x.id === task.id)) continue;
    const own = (stage.arrows ?? []).filter((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === button.id);
    return own.find((a) => !a.onlyWhen) ?? own[0];
  }
  return undefined;
}

  getButton, getQuestion, getTask, openWorkflow, resetSessionForTests, reveal, SlotsProvider, useEditor, type WhenBuilderProps,

/** A stand-in for the conditions feature's builder: one press writes "Risk is High". */
function FakeWhen(props: WhenBuilderProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => props.onChange({ allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] } as never)}
    >
      {props.value ? 'when: set' : props.addLabel}
    </button>
  );
}

async function open(workflow: string, stageId: string, taskId: string, as?: string) {
  const { services } = createStandinServices();
  if (as) await services.session.signInAs({ type: 'user', id: as });
  await act(() => openWorkflow(services, workflow));
  render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={{ WhenBuilder: FakeWhen }}>
        <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[`/w/${workflow}/form/${stageId}/${taskId}`]}>
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/w/:workflowId/form/:stageId/:taskId" element={<FormEditorPage />} />
            <Route path="/w/:workflowId" element={<p>The diagram</p>} />
          </Routes>
        </MemoryRouter>
      </SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>,
  );
  await screen.findAllByText(/Form for|This form does not exist/);
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/FormEditorPage.tsx\n===
/**
 * Route "/w/:workflowId/form/:stageId/:taskId": the form editor (editor-model.md section 6, mockup
 * 06-form). It opens over the editor with the way back (Workflow > Stage > Form), says whose form it
 * is ("Form for: Domain approval") with "Switch form"; pages on the left, the form as people will
 * see it in the middle, the chosen question, text, page or the buttons on the right. "Preview as"
 * shows the form exactly as the person asked will see it, with the sample request.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, FormItem, Page, Task } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeWhoIsAsked, find, getStage, getTask, toText, useDoc, useMay, useRevealRequest, useStage,
} from '@/model';
import type { Answers, Ref } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, EmptyState, Icon, buttonClass } from '@/ui';
import { EditView } from './EditView';
import { FormView } from './FormView';
import { ReadOnlyContext, Words } from './parts';
import { PagesPanel } from './PagesPanel';
import { PreviewBanner, previewPerson, PreviewSide, PreviewToggle, RequestHeader, SentTo, usePreviewPeople } from './Preview';
import { useSampleValues } from './sample';
import { ButtonsSettings, PageSettings, QuestionSettings, TextSettings } from './Settings';
import { SwitchForm } from './SwitchForm';
import s from './forms.module.css';

/** What the right side shows: an item, a page's settings, or the buttons. */
type Chosen = { kind: 'item'; id: string } | { kind: 'page'; id: string } | { kind: 'buttons'; button?: string } | null;

const FLASH_MS = 1600;
const NO_ANSWERS: Answers = {};

export function FormEditorPage() {
  const { workflowId = '', stageId = '', taskId = '' } = useParams();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const stage = useStage(stageId);
  const task = doc ? getTask(doc, taskId) : undefined;
  const inStage = !!task && !!doc && find(doc, taskId)?.parents.stage === stageId;

  if (!doc) return <p className={s.state} role="status">{t('forms.loading')}</p>;
  if (!task || !stage || !inStage) {
    return (
      <div className={s.state}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="search"
          title={t('forms.notFound.title')}
          action={
            <Link to={`/w/${workflowId}`} className={buttonClass('primary')}>
              {t('forms.backToDiagram')}
            </Link>
          }
        >
          {t('forms.notFound.text')}
        </EmptyState>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return <FormEditor key={taskId} doc={doc} workflowId={workflowId} stageId={stageId} task={task} />;
}

function FormEditor({ doc, workflowId, stageId, task }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; workflowId: string; stageId: string; task: Task }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId)!;
  // Read only: the form and its settings are shown, with no control that changes anything (the frame says why above).
  const readOnly = !useMay().edit;
  const isStart = doc.start?.stage === stageId;
  const pages = task.form?.pages ?? [];
  const [pageId, setPageId] = useState<string | null>(pages[0]?.id ?? null);
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Chosen>(null);
  const [autoFocus, setAutoFocus] = useState(false);
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(false);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Answers>(NO_ANSWERS);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState('');
  const [previewAs, setPreviewAs] = useState<Ref | undefined>(undefined);
  const people = usePreviewPeople(doc, task, isStart);
  const person = previewPerson(people, previewAs);
  const sample = useSampleValues(doc);
  const request = useMemo(
    () => ({ ...(sample.requester ? { requester: sample.requester } : {}), ...(sample.startedOn ? { startedOn: sample.startedOn } : {}) }),
    [sample],
  );

  // A page that was removed (or moved to another form) gives way to the first page.
  const page: Page | undefined = pages.find((p) => p.id === pageId) ?? pages[0];

  const select = (id: string, inPage?: string) => {
    if (id === 'buttons' || (task.buttons ?? []).some((b) => b.id === id)) {
      setChosen(id === 'buttons' ? { kind: 'buttons' } : { kind: 'buttons', button: id });
      setPageId(pages[pages.length - 1]?.id ?? null);
      return;
    }
    const entry = find(doc, id);
    const at = entry?.parents.page ?? inPage;
    if (at) setPageId(at);
    setAutoFocus(false);
    setChosen({ kind: 'item', id });
  };

  // "Show me": pages, questions, texts, choices and buttons of this form are chosen, scrolled to and flashed.
  const revealRequest = useRevealRequest();
  const [handled, setHandled] = useState<number | null>(null);
  if (revealRequest && handled !== revealRequest.nonce) {
    const entry = find(doc, revealRequest.location.item);
    if (entry && (entry.parents.task ?? entry.id) === task.id && ['page', 'question', 'text', 'choice', 'button'].includes(entry.kind)) {
      setHandled(revealRequest.nonce);
      setPreview(false);
      if (entry.kind === 'page') {
        setPageId(entry.id);
        setChosen({ kind: 'page', id: entry.id });
        setFlash(entry.id);
      } else if (entry.kind === 'button') {
        select(entry.id);
        setFlash(entry.id);
      } else {
        const target = entry.kind === 'choice' ? (entry.parents.question ?? entry.id) : entry.id;
        select(target);
        setFlash(target);
      }
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!flash) return;
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => document.querySelector(`[data-item-id="${flash}"]`)?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }));
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), FLASH_MS);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [flash]);

  const stageName = stage.name?.trim() || t('describe.noName');
  const who = toText(describeWhoIsAsked(doc, task));
  const base = `/w/${workflowId}`;

  const chosenItem: FormItem | undefined =
    chosen?.kind === 'item' ? (() => {
      const entry = find(doc, chosen.id);
      return entry && (entry.kind === 'question' || entry.kind === 'text') && entry.parents.task === task.id ? entry.item : undefined;
    })() : undefined;
  const chosenPage = chosen?.kind === 'page' ? pages.find((p) => p.id === chosen.id) : undefined;
  const itemPageIndex = chosenItem ? pages.findIndex((p) => (p.items ?? []).includes(chosenItem)) : -1;
  const startStage = !isStart ? getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage) : undefined;
  const startTask = startStage && startStage.kind !== 'ending' ? startStage.tasks?.[0] : undefined;

  return (
    <ReadOnlyContext.Provider value={readOnly}>
    <div className={s.editor}>
      <header className={s.bar}>
        <Link to={base} className={buttonClass('quiet', 'md')}>
          <Icon name="arrow-left" />
          {t('forms.backToDiagram')}
        </Link>
        {/* The editor's top bar above already names the workflow: no trail here, only whose form this is. */}
        <h1 className={s.formFor}>
          <Words k="forms.formFor" fill={{ stage: <b>{stageName}</b> }} />
        </h1>
        <span className={s.quiet}>{isStart ? t('forms.filledInBy.requester') : t('forms.filledInBy', { who })}</span>
        <SwitchForm doc={doc} taskId={task.id} onOpen={(f) => navigate(`${base}/form/${f.stageId}/${f.task.id}`)} />
        <span className={s.barSpacer} />
        <PreviewToggle person={person} preview={preview} onChange={setPreview} />
        <Link to={base} className={buttonClass('primary', 'md')}>
          <Icon name="check" />
          {t('forms.done')}
        </Link>
      </header>
      <p className="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">
        {announcement}
      </p>

      {preview ? (
        <div className={s.previewLayout}>
          <div className={s.middle}>
            <PreviewBanner person={person} />
            <div className={s.formCard}>
              {!isStart && (
                <>
                  <RequestHeader doc={doc} stageId={stageId} task={task} values={sample.values} />
                  <SentTo doc={doc} task={task} />
                </>
              )}
              <FormView
                doc={doc}
                taskId={task.id}
                mode="preview"
                answers={answers}
                onAnswersChange={setAnswers}
                values={sample.values}
                request={request}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <aside className={s.right} aria-label={t('forms.preview.tag')}>
            <PreviewSide
              doc={doc}
              task={task}
              people={people}
              person={person}
              onPerson={setPreviewAs}
              answers={answers}
              values={sample.values}
              request={request}
              onTryIt={() => navigate(`${base}/try`)}
            />
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={s.layout}>
          <PagesPanel
            doc={doc}
            task={task}
            pageId={page?.id ?? null}
            selected={chosen?.kind === 'item' ? chosen.id : chosen?.kind === 'buttons' ? 'buttons' : null}
            onShowPage={(id) => setPageId(id)}
            onSelect={select}
            onPageSettings={(id) => {
              setPageId(id);
              setAutoFocus(true);
              setChosen({ kind: 'page', id });
            }}
            isStart={isStart}
          />
          <div className={s.middle}>
            {startTask && (
              <Callout
                tone="info"
                icon="form"
                actions={
                  <Button size="sm" icon="arrow-right" onClick={() => navigate(`${base}/form/${startStage!.id}/${startTask.id}`)}>
                    {t('forms.startNote.open', { form: startStage!.name })}
                  </Button>
                }
              >
                <b>{t('forms.startNote.titleNamed', { form: startStage!.name })}</b> {t('forms.startNote.text')}
              </Callout>
            )}
            {isStart && (
              <p className={s.hint}>
                <Icon name="eye" size={14} />
                {t(readOnly ? 'forms.startHint.readOnly' : 'forms.startHint')}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className={s.formCard}>
              {page ? (
                <EditView
                  doc={doc}
                  task={task}
                  stageId={stageId}
                  isStart={isStart}
                  page={page}
                  selected={chosen?.kind === 'item' ? chosen.id : chosen?.kind === 'buttons' ? 'buttons' : null}
                  onSelect={(id) => {
                    // A question or text just added is not in this render's document yet: its label gets the focus.
                    const added = id !== 'buttons' && !find(doc, id);
                    select(id);
                    if (added) setAutoFocus(true);
                  }}
                  answers={answers}
                  onAnswersChange={setAnswers}
                  values={sample.values}
                  request={request}
                  flash={flash}
                  announce={setAnnouncement}
                />
              ) : (
                <EmptyState icon="form" title={t('forms.page.empty')} />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <aside className={s.right} aria-label={t('forms.settings.label')}>
            {chosenItem?.type === 'question' ? (
              <QuestionSettings
                key={chosenItem.id}
                doc={doc}
                task={task}
                stageId={stageId}
                question={chosenItem}
                where={{ stageName, pageIndex: itemPageIndex }}
                hiddenForSample={undefined}
                autoFocus={autoFocus}
                onRemoved={() => setChosen(null)}
              />
            ) : chosenItem?.type === 'text' ? (
              <TextSettings key={chosenItem.id} doc={doc} task={task} stageId={stageId} text={chosenItem} where={{ stageName, pageIndex: itemPageIndex }} onRemoved={() => setChosen(null)} />
            ) : chosenPage ? (
              <PageSettings
                key={chosenPage.id}
                doc={doc}
                task={task}
                stageId={stageId}
                page={chosenPage}
                index={pages.indexOf(chosenPage)}
                stageName={stageName}
                autoFocus={autoFocus}
                onRemoved={() => setChosen(null)}
              />
            ) : chosen?.kind === 'buttons' ? (
              <ButtonsSettings doc={doc} task={task} stageId={stageId} stageName={stageName} onSelectQuestion={(id) => select(id)} flash={flash} open={chosen.button} />
            ) : (
              <p className={s.rightEmpty}>{t('forms.settings.nothing')}</p>
            )}
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
    </ReadOnlyContext.Provider>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/FormView.test.tsx\n===
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Question, Task } from '@/contract';
import { fixtures } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { getTask, resetSessionForTests, type FormViewProps } from '@/model';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider, type Answers, type Services, type Values } from '@/services';
import { FormView } from './FormView';

let services: Services;
beforeEach(() => {
  services = createStandinServices().services;
});
afterEach(() => resetSessionForTests());

type HarnessProps = Omit<FormViewProps, 'answers' | 'onAnswersChange' | 'values'> & {
  initial?: Answers;
  values?: Values;
  onChange?: (next: Answers) => void;
};

/** FormView as a page uses it: the page keeps the answers. */
function Harness({ initial, values, onChange, ...rest }: HarnessProps) {
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Answers>(initial ?? {});
  return (
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <FormView
        {...rest}
        values={values ?? {}}
        answers={answers}
        onAnswersChange={(next) => {
          setAnswers(next);
          onChange?.(next);
        }}
      />
    </ServicesProvider>
  );
}

const copy = (name: keyof typeof fixtures): AuthoredWorkflow => structuredClone(fixtures[name]);
const taskOf = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string) => getTask(doc, id) as Task;

async function sampleValues(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Promise<Values> {
  return (await services.core.sampleValues(doc, doc.sampleRequest!)).values;
}
