describe('FormView: every kind of question', () => {
  /** The Development form with one question of every kind and source. */
  function allKinds(): AuthoredWorkflow {
    const doc = copy('change-request');
    const task = taskOf(doc, 'tk_development');
    const q = (id: string, kind: Question['kind'], label: string, more: Partial<Question> = {}): Question =>
      ({ type: 'question', id: `q_${id}`, kind, label, ...more }) as Question;
    task.form.pages = [
      {
        id: 'pg_all',
        items: [
          q('t', 'text', 'Short'),
          q('lt', 'longText', 'Long'),
          q('n', 'number', 'How many'),
          q('yn', 'yesNo', 'Tested'),
          q('d', 'date', 'When'),
          q('c', 'choice', 'Size', { choices: { from: 'typedIn', choices: [{ id: 'ch_s', label: 'Small' }, { id: 'ch_l', label: 'Large' }] } }),
          q('mc', 'multipleChoice', 'Areas', { choices: { from: 'typedIn', choices: [{ id: 'ch_a', label: 'API' }, { id: 'ch_b', label: 'Billing' }, { id: 'ch_c', label: 'Cards' }] } }),
          q('row', 'choice', 'Domain', { choices: { from: 'list', list: 'ls_domains', shownColumn: 'col_domain' } }),
          q('p', 'person', 'Reviewer'),
          q('g', 'group', 'Team'),
          q('dir', 'person', 'Lead', { choices: { from: 'directory', peopleIn: { group: { directoryId: 'dir-group-payments-engineering', name: 'Payments engineering' } } } }),
          q('src', 'choice', 'Service', { choices: { from: 'source', source: 'servicecatalog.services@1', inputs: {} } }),
        ],
      },
    ];
    task.buttons = [{ id: 'btn_done', label: 'Done', look: 'primary', neededToPress: [] }];
    return doc;
  }

  it('sends each answer as core-api.md 2.4 says, and leaves an empty one out', async () => {
    const doc = allKinds();
    const changes = vi.fn<(next: Answers) => void>();
    const loadChoices = vi.fn(async (questionId: string, search: string) => {
      if (questionId === 'q_dir') return [{ stored: 'dir-user-diego-santos', label: 'Diego Santos' }];
      return [{ stored: 'svc-ledger', label: 'Ledger' }].filter((c) => c.label.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
    });
    render(<Harness doc={doc} taskId="tk_development" mode="answer" onChange={changes} loadChoices={loadChoices} />);
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Done' });
    const last = () => changes.mock.calls[changes.mock.calls.length - 1]![0];

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Short' }), { target: { value: 'Hi' } });
    expect(last()).toEqual({ q_t: 'Hi' });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Long' }), { target: { value: 'More words' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'How many' }), { target: { value: '3' } });
    expect(last().q_n).toBe(3);
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Tested' })).getByRole('radio', { name: 'No' }));
    expect(last().q_yn).toBe(false);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('When'), { target: { value: '2026-12-02' } });
    expect(last().q_d).toBe('2026-12-02');
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Size' })).getByRole('radio', { name: 'Large' }));
    expect(last().q_c).toBe('ch_l');
    const areas = within(screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Areas' }));
    fireEvent.click(areas.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Cards' }));
    fireEvent.click(areas.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'API' }));
    expect(last().q_mc).toEqual(['ch_a', 'ch_c']);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Domain' }), { target: { value: '1' } });
    expect(last().q_row).toMatch(/^row_/);

    // A person and a group with no choices: the whole directory, searched.
    const reviewer = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Reviewer' });
    fireEvent.change(reviewer, { target: { value: 'Mar' } });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Marcus Lee/ }));
    expect(last().q_p).toEqual({ type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-marcus-lee' });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Team' }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Payments engineering/ }));
    expect(last().q_g).toEqual({ type: 'group', id: 'dir-group-payments-engineering' });

    // People from the directory and a connection: through loadChoices, with what is typed as the search.
    const lead = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Lead' });
    fireEvent.keyDown(lead, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Diego Santos/ });
    fireEvent.keyDown(lead, { key: 'Enter' });
    expect(last().q_dir).toEqual({ type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-diego-santos' });
    const service = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Service' });
    fireEvent.change(service, { target: { value: 'led' } });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'Ledger' }));
    expect(last().q_src).toEqual({ stored: 'svc-ledger', label: 'Ledger' });
    expect(loadChoices).toHaveBeenCalledWith('q_src', 'led');

    // Emptying an answer leaves its key out.
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Short' }), { target: { value: '' } });
    expect(last()).not.toHaveProperty('q_t');
  });

  it("in the editor's preview, without loadChoices, offers the catalogue's sample choices and says they are samples", async () => {
    const doc = allKinds();
    render(<Harness doc={doc} taskId="tk_development" mode="preview" />);
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('combobox', { name: 'Service' }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'Payments API' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Sample choices from Service catalog/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

      showWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] },
    });
    const onPress = vi.fn();
    let last: Answers = {};
    const initial: Answers = {
      q_title: 'T', q_primary_domain: 'row_payments', q_planned_release_date: '2026-12-02', q_risk: 'ch_risk_high', q_why_high: 'Big change',
    };
    render(<Harness doc={doc} taskId="tk_request_form" mode="answer" initial={initial} onPress={onPress} onChange={(a) => (last = a)} />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('textbox', { name: 'Why so risky' })).toHaveValue('Big change');
    expect(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled');

    // Risk Low hides the question: its answer leaves the answers, and Submit can be pressed.
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Risk' })).getByRole('radio', { name: 'Low' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('textbox', { name: 'Why so risky' })).toBeNull());
    await waitFor(() => expect(last.q_why_high).toBeUndefined());

    expect(submit).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled');
    fireEvent.click(submit);
    expect(onPress).toHaveBeenCalledWith('btn_rf_submit');

    // High again: the typed answer comes back.
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Risk' })).getByRole('radio', { name: 'High' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Why so risky' })).toHaveValue('Big change'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(last.q_why_high).toBe('Big change'));

  it('a kept answer of a hidden question (Try it\'s sample) is dropped at once, so Submit is not grey for it', async () => {

    const task = taskOf(doc, 'tk_request_form');
    task.form.pages[0]!.items.push({
      type: 'question', id: 'q_why_high', label: 'Why so risky', kind: 'text', savedAs: 'v_reason',
      showWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] },
    });
    let last: Answers | undefined;
    const initial: Answers = {
      q_title: 'T', q_primary_domain: 'row_payments', q_planned_release_date: '2026-12-02', q_risk: 'ch_risk_low', q_why_high: 'Kept from before',
    };
    render(<Harness doc={doc} taskId="tk_request_form" mode="answer" initial={initial} onChange={(a) => (last = a)} />);

===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/FormView.tsx\n===
/**
 * The one renderer of a task's form (F6): the form editor (its editing view and its preview), Try it
 * and the live start and task pages all show a form with it, so they cannot disagree.
 *
 * What is shown and which buttons can be pressed come from services `core.formState`
 * (useFormState), never from rules of our own; the engine's `buttonStates` add who may press, and
 * `refusals` say what the last press was refused for, each at its question or button.
 *
 * `FormView` is the slot (FormViewProps in src/model/slots.ts). The form editor uses `FormRenderer`
 * with `editor` extras: one page at a time with every item (hidden ones say when they show), items
 * that can be chosen and moved, and its own button bar.
 */
import { Fragment, useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Button as FormButton, Expression, FormItem, FormText, Page, Question, Task } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeExpression, describeCondition, find, getList, getTask, toText, type FormViewProps,
} from '@/model';
import type { ButtonState, FormButtonState, FormState, Json, Refusal } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { buttonLabel, connectionName, isAnswered, itemName, joinNames, labelOf, pageTitle, rowLabel, sourceEntry, withAnswer } from './logic';
import { QuestionInput } from './QuestionInput';
import { useAnyCatalogue, useFormState } from './useFormState';
import { DirectoryName, ValueWords } from './ValueWords';
import s from './forms.module.css';

export type { FormViewProps };

/** What the form editor adds to the renderer. */
export interface EditorExtras {
  /** The page shown, with every item on it, shown or not. */
  pageId: string;
  /** What is chosen: an item's ID, or 'buttons'. */
  selected: string | null;
  onSelect(id: string): void;
  /** Above the page: who is asked. */
  top?: ReactNode;
  /** Beside the page's title: "Page 1 of 2" and its Show when. */
  pageHead?: ReactNode;
  /** The line under a question's label ("Needed to press: Approve") and the line under its answer. */
  questionHead?(q: Question): ReactNode;
  itemFoot?(item: FormItem, hiddenForSample: boolean): ReactNode;
  /** The handle and menu of an item. */
  itemTools?(item: FormItem, index: number): ReactNode;
  /** Drag and drop on an item. */
  itemDrag?(item: FormItem, index: number): Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Under the items: "+ Add a question", "+ Add text". */
  afterItems?: ReactNode;
  /** The editor's own button bar. */
  buttons(state: FormState | null): ReactNode;
  /** The item to flash (a reveal request). */
  flash: string | null;
  /** The person may not change the workflow: choosing an item shows its settings, nothing more. */
  readOnly?: boolean;
}

export function FormView(props: FormViewProps) {
  return <FormRenderer {...props} />;
}

export function FormRenderer(props: FormViewProps & { editor?: EditorExtras }) {
  const { doc, taskId, mode, answers, onAnswersChange, values, request, lookups, editor } = props;
  const task = getTask(doc, taskId);
  const { state, working, shownAnswers } = useFormState(doc, taskId, answers, values, request, lookups);
  const formId = useId();
  const catalogue = useAnyCatalogue();

  // Answers of questions that are not shown are dropped from the answers (so they are never sent) and
  // kept here: when the question shows again, its answer comes back.
  const answering = !props.readOnly && !editor;
  const dropped = useRef<Partial<Record<string, Json>>>({});
  const hiddenDiffer = answering && !!shownAnswers && Object.keys(shownAnswers).length !== Object.keys(answers).length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!answering || !shownAnswers || !state || !task) return;
    const shownNow = shownAnswers as Partial<Record<string, Json>>;
    let next = answers as Partial<Record<string, Json>>;
    for (const [q, a] of Object.entries(next)) {
      if (shownNow[q] === undefined && a !== undefined) {
        dropped.current[q] = a;
        next = withAnswer(next, q, undefined);
      }
    }
    const on = new Set(state.shown);
    for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
      for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
        const kept = dropped.current[item.id];
        if (item.type !== 'question' || kept === undefined || next[item.id] !== undefined || !on.has(page.id) || !on.has(item.id)) continue;
        delete dropped.current[item.id];
        next = withAnswer(next, item.id, kept);
      }
    }
    if (next !== answers) onAnswersChange(next as typeof answers);
  }, [answering, shownAnswers, state, task, answers, onAnswersChange]);

  // After a send-back the earlier answers are shown: the values the questions are saved as.
  const prefilled = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!task || mode !== 'answer' || props.readOnly || prefilled.current === taskId) return;
    prefilled.current = taskId;
    if (Object.keys(answers).length > 0) return;
    let next = answers;
    for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
      for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
        if (item.type !== 'question' || !item.savedAs) continue;
        const earlier = values[item.savedAs];
        if (isAnswered(earlier)) next = withAnswer(next, item.id, earlier);
      }
    }
    if (next !== answers) onAnswersChange(next);
  }, [task, taskId, mode, props.readOnly, answers, values, onAnswersChange]);

  const shown = useMemo(() => new Set<string>(state?.shown ?? []), [state]);
  const shownPages = useMemo(() => (task?.form?.pages ?? []).filter((p) => shown.has(p.id)), [task, shown]);
  const [pageAt, setPageAt] = useState(0);

  // Refusals of the last press, at their question; a refused question's page is shown.
  const refusedAt = useMemo(() => {
    const at = new Map<string, Refusal>();
    for (const r of props.refusals ?? []) if (r.location?.item && !at.has(r.location.item)) at.set(r.location.item, r);
    return at;
  }, [props.refusals]);
  const [refusalsSeen, setRefusalsSeen] = useState(props.refusals);
  if (refusalsSeen !== props.refusals) {
    setRefusalsSeen(props.refusals);
    const index = shownPages.findIndex((p) => (p.items ?? []).some((i) => refusedAt.has(i.id)) || refusedAt.has(p.id));
    if (!editor && index >= 0) setPageAt(index);
  }

  if (!task) return null;

  const setAnswer = (q: Question, answer: Json | undefined) => onAnswersChange(withAnswer(answers, q.id, answer));
  const lastPage = Math.max(shownPages.length - 1, 0);
  const at = Math.min(pageAt, lastPage);
  const pages: Page[] = editor
    ? (task.form?.pages ?? []).filter((p) => p.id === editor.pageId)
    : props.readOnly
      ? shownPages
      : shownPages.slice(at, at + 1);

  const questionRefusals = (props.refusals ?? []).filter((r) => {
    const kind = r.location?.item ? find(doc, r.location.item)?.kind : undefined;
    return kind === 'question' || kind === 'page' || kind === 'text';
  });
  const otherRefusals = (props.refusals ?? []).filter((r) => !questionRefusals.includes(r) && !isButtonRefusal(doc, r));

  return (
    <section className={s.form} aria-label={editor ? t('forms.form.label') : t('word.form')} aria-busy={props.busy || working || undefined}>
      {editor?.top}
      {questionRefusals.length > 0 && (
        <Callout tone="danger">
          {t('forms.refused.title')}{' '}
          {t(questionRefusals.length === 1 ? 'forms.refused.count.one' : 'forms.refused.count.many', { n: questionRefusals.length })}
        </Callout>
      )}
      {otherRefusals.map((r, i) => (
        <Callout key={i} tone="danger">
          {refusalWords(doc, r, catalogue)}
        </Callout>
      ))}
      {!editor && state === null && <p className={s.quiet} role="status">{t('forms.why.working')}</p>}
      {pages.map((page) => {
        const items = (page.items ?? []).filter((i) => editor || shown.has(i.id));
        // The editor names an untitled page as the pages list does ("Page 1"); people see a title only when it has one.
        const title = page.title?.trim() || (editor ? pageTitle(page, (task.form?.pages ?? []).indexOf(page)) : '');
        const count = !editor && !props.readOnly && shownPages.length > 1;
        return (
          <div key={page.id} className={s.page} data-item-id={page.id}>
            {(title || editor || count) && (
              <div className={s.pageHead}>
                {title ? <h2 className={[s.pageTitle, page.title?.trim() ? '' : s.pageTitleUntitled].join(' ')}>{title}</h2> : <span />}
                {editor ? editor.pageHead : count && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.page.ofN', { n: at + 1, count: shownPages.length })}</span>}
              </div>
            )}
            {items.length === 0 && editor && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.page.noItems')}</p>}
            {items.map((item) => {
              const realIndex = (page.items ?? []).indexOf(item);
              const hiddenForSample = !!editor && state !== null && !shown.has(item.id);
              const body =
                item.type === 'text' ? (
                  <TextItem doc={doc} text={item} values={values} request={request} editing={!!editor} />
                ) : props.readOnly ? (
                  <AnsweredQuestion doc={doc} question={item} answer={answers[item.id]} />
                ) : (
                  <QuestionItem
                    doc={doc}
                    question={item}
                    answer={answers[item.id]}
                    onAnswer={(a) => setAnswer(item, a)}
                    state={state}
                    loadChoices={props.loadChoices}
                    refusal={refusedAt.get(item.id)}
                    catalogue={catalogue}
                    disabled={!!props.busy}
                    formId={formId}
                    head={editor?.questionHead?.(item)}
                  />
                );
              if (!editor) return <Fragment key={item.id}>{body}</Fragment>;
              const chosen = editor.selected === item.id;
              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  data-item-id={item.id}
                  className={[s.editItem, chosen ? s.chosen : '', editor.flash === item.id ? s.flash : '', hiddenForSample ? s.hiddenForSample : ''].join(' ')}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    // Typing into the preview's answer does not choose the item twice; anything else does.
                    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button,[role=option]')) return;
                    editor.onSelect(item.id);
                  }}
                  {...editor.itemDrag?.(item, realIndex)}
                >
                  <div className={s.itemTools}>
                    <button type="button" className={s.selectItem} aria-pressed={chosen} onClick={() => editor.onSelect(item.id)}>
                      {t(editor.readOnly ? 'forms.item.show' : 'forms.item.select', { item: itemName(doc, task, item) })}
                    </button>
                    {editor.itemTools?.(item, realIndex)}
                  </div>
                  {body}
                  {editor.itemFoot?.(item, hiddenForSample)}
                </div>
              );
            })}
            {editor?.afterItems}
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {!editor && !props.readOnly && shownPages.length > 1 && (
        <nav className={s.pageNav} aria-label={t('forms.page.nav')}>
          {at > 0 && (
            <Button variant="quiet" icon="chevron-left" onClick={() => setPageAt(at - 1)}>
              {t('forms.page.back', { n: at })}
            </Button>
          )}
          {at < lastPage && (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setPageAt(at + 1)}>
              {t('forms.page.next')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </nav>
      )}
      {editor
        ? editor.buttons(state)
        : !props.readOnly &&
          state !== null &&
          at === lastPage && (
            <ButtonBar
              doc={doc}
              task={task}
              state={state}
              buttonStates={props.buttonStates}
              refusals={props.refusals}
              busy={!!props.busy}
              onPress={(id) => {
                // Never while a hidden answer is still among the answers: it is being dropped.
                if (mode === 'answer' && !props.busy && !props.readOnly && !hiddenDiffer) props.onPress?.(id);
              }}
            />
          )}
    </section>
  );
}

const isButtonRefusal = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, r: Refusal) =>
  (r.code === 'check' || r.code === 'rule-error') && !!r.location?.item && find(doc, r.location.item)?.kind === 'button';

// ── a question ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function QuestionItem(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  question: Question;
  answer: Json | undefined;
  onAnswer(a: Json | undefined): void;
  state: FormState | null;
  loadChoices: FormViewProps['loadChoices'];
  refusal: Refusal | undefined;
  catalogue: Catalogue | null;
  disabled: boolean;
  formId: string;
  head?: ReactNode;
}) {
  const { question } = props;
  const base = `${props.formId}-${question.id}`;
  const errorId = `${base}-error`;
  const grouped = question.kind === 'yesNo' || question.kind === 'multipleChoice' || isRowOfChoices(question) || isPicker(question);
  const error = props.refusal ? refusalWords(props.doc, props.refusal, props.catalogue) : undefined;
  const Label = grouped ? 'span' : 'label';
  return (
    <div className={s.question}>
      <div className={s.questionHead}>
        <Label id={`${base}-label`} className={s.questionLabel} {...(grouped ? {} : { htmlFor: `${base}-input` })}>
          {labelOf(question)}
        </Label>
        {props.head}
      </div>
      <QuestionInput
        doc={props.doc}
        question={question}
        answer={props.answer}
        onAnswer={props.onAnswer}
        state={props.state}
        loadChoices={props.loadChoices}
        inputId={`${base}-input`}
        labelId={`${base}-label`}
        describedBy={error ? errorId : undefined}
        invalid={!!error}
        disabled={props.disabled}
      />
      {error && (
        <p id={errorId} className={s.error}>
          <Icon name="error" size={14} />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const isRowOfChoices = (q: Question) => q.kind === 'choice' && q.choices?.from === 'typedIn' && (q.choices.choices ?? []).length > 0 && (q.choices.choices ?? []).length <= 6;
const isPicker = (q: Question) => q.kind === 'person' || q.kind === 'group' || q.choices?.from === 'directory' || q.choices?.from === 'source';

/** A question as it was answered (read-only). */
function AnsweredQuestion({ doc, question, answer }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; question: Question; answer: Json | undefined }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.question}>
      <div className={s.questionLabel}>{labelOf(question)}</div>
      <div className={s.answered}>{isAnswered(answer) ? <ValueWords doc={doc} json={answer} /> : <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.answer.nothing')}</span>}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── text people can read ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function TextItem(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  text: FormText;
  values: FormViewProps['values'];
  request: FormViewProps['request'];
  editing: boolean;
}) {
  const { doc, text } = props;
  const content = text.content ?? [];
  if (content.length === 0) return <p className={[s.text, s.quiet].join(' ')}>{t('forms.text.empty')}</p>;
  const blocks = textBlocks(doc, content);
  if (props.editing) {
    // The editor shows which values the text shows: a line that is one value (with or without its
    // "Label:") is that value's chip, side by side as in the mockup; other lines read as written.
    return (
      <div className={s.textBox}>
        <div className={s.textHead}>{t('forms.text.label')}</div>
        {blocks.map((block, n) =>
          block.kind === 'rows' ? (
            <div key={n} className={s.textChips}>
              {block.rows.map((row, i) => (
                <span key={i} className={s.textChip}>
                  {!row.named && <span className={s.textRowLabel}>{t('forms.text.rowLabel', { label: row.label })}</span>}
                  <span className={s.vchip}>{toText(describeExpression(doc, row.expression))}</span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : block.kind === 'line' ? (
            <p key={n} className={s.text}>
              {block.line.map((piece, i) =>
                typeof piece === 'string' ? (
                  <Fragment key={i}>{piece}</Fragment>
                ) : (
                  <span key={i} className={s.vchip}>
                    {toText(describeExpression(doc, piece))}
                  </span>
                ),
              )}
            </p>
          ) : null,
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
  // Line by line: lines that are one value each ("Title", "Risk: [Risk]") make one two-column table
  // (what it is | what the request holds), so the text does not open with lines nobody can place.
  return (
    <div className={s.textLines}>
      {blocks.map((block, n) =>
        block.kind === 'rows' ? (
          <dl key={n} className={s.textTable}>
            {block.rows.map((row, i) => (
              <div key={i} className={s.textRow}>
                <dt className={s.textRowLabel}>{row.label}</dt>
                <dd>
                  <Filled doc={doc} expression={row.expression} values={props.values} request={props.request} />
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        ) : block.kind === 'line' ? (
          <p key={n} className={s.text}>
            {block.line.map((piece, i) =>
              typeof piece === 'string' ? (
                <Fragment key={i}>{piece}</Fragment>
              ) : (
                <Filled key={i} doc={doc} expression={piece} values={props.values} request={props.request} />
              ),
            )}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <br key={n} />
        ),
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type TextRowOf = { label: string; expression: Expression; /** The label is the value's own name (no "Label:" written). */ named: boolean };
type TextBlock = { kind: 'rows'; rows: TextRowOf[] } | { kind: 'line'; line: (string | Expression)[] } | { kind: 'blank' };

/**
 * A text's content as blocks: runs of lines that are one value each (a bare value, or "Label:"
 * followed by the value) become rows of a table, other lines stay lines, empty lines stay breaks.
 */
export function textBlocks(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, content: readonly (string | Expression)[]): TextBlock[] {
  const lines: (string | Expression)[][] = [[]];
  for (const piece of content) {
    if (typeof piece !== 'string') {
      lines[lines.length - 1]!.push(piece);
      continue;
    }
    piece.split('\n').forEach((part, i) => {
      if (i > 0) lines.push([]);
      if (part) lines[lines.length - 1]!.push(part);
    });
  }
  // A trailing newline does not make an empty line at the end.
  while (lines.length > 1 && lines[lines.length - 1]!.length === 0) lines.pop();
  const blocks: TextBlock[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    const row = rowOf(doc, line);
    const last = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
    if (row) {
      if (last?.kind === 'rows') last.rows.push(row);
      else blocks.push({ kind: 'rows', rows: [row] });
    } else if (line.length === 0) blocks.push({ kind: 'blank' });
    else blocks.push({ kind: 'line', line });
  }
  return blocks;
}

function rowOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, line: (string | Expression)[]): TextRowOf | undefined {
  const values = line.filter((p): p is Expression => typeof p !== 'string');
  if (values.length !== 1) return undefined;
  const at = line.indexOf(values[0]!);
  const before = line.slice(0, at).join('');
  const after = line.slice(at + 1).join('');
  if (after.trim()) return undefined;
  const name = toText(describeExpression(doc, values[0]!));
  if (!before.trim()) return { label: name, expression: values[0]!, named: true };
  const label = /^(.*\S)\s*:\s*$/.exec(before)?.[1];
  if (!label) return undefined;
  return { label: label.trim(), expression: values[0]!, named: label.trim().toLowerCase() === name.trim().toLowerCase() };
}

/** A value chip of a text, filled with what the request holds. */
function Filled({ doc, expression, values, request }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; expression: Expression; values: FormViewProps['values']; request: FormViewProps['request'] }) {
  if ('value' in expression && typeof expression.value === 'string') {
    let json: Json | undefined = values[expression.value as keyof typeof values];
    for (const step of expression.steps ?? []) {
      if ('column' in step && typeof json === 'string') {
        const entry = find(doc, json);
        const list = entry?.kind === 'row' ? getList(doc, entry.parents.list) : undefined;
        const cell = list?.rows.find((r) => r.id === json)?.cells?.[step.column];
        json = cell ? cellJson(cell) : undefined;
        if (json === undefined && entry?.kind === 'row') return null;
      } else return <>{toText(describeExpression(doc, expression))}</>;
    }
    if (json === undefined && expression.ifEmptyUse) return <Filled doc={doc} expression={expression.ifEmptyUse} values={values} request={request} />;
    if (typeof json === 'string' && find(doc, json)?.kind === 'row' && !expression.steps?.length) {
      const entry = find(doc, json)!;
      return <>{rowLabel(doc, entry.parents.list ?? '', json, shownColumnFor(doc, expression.value))}</>;
    }
    return <ValueWords doc={doc} json={json} />;
  }
  if ('request' in expression) {
    if (expression.request === 'requester') return request?.requester ? <DirectoryName json={request.requester as unknown as Json} /> : null;
    return request?.startedOn ? <ValueWords doc={doc} json={request.startedOn} /> : null;
  }
  return <>{toText(describeExpression(doc, expression))}</>;
}

/** A list cell as a value (core-api.md 2.4). */
function cellJson(cell: object): Json | undefined {
  const c = cell as Record<string, unknown>;
  if ('text' in c) return c.text as string;
  if ('number' in c) return c.number as number;
  if ('yesNo' in c) return c.yesNo as boolean;
  if ('date' in c) return c.date as string;
  if ('person' in c) return { type: 'user', id: (c.person as { directoryId: string }).directoryId };
  if ('group' in c) return { type: 'group', id: (c.group as { directoryId: string }).directoryId };
  return undefined;
}

/** The column the question that fills a value shows, so a row reads as people saw it. */
function shownColumnFor(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string): string | undefined {
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) {
      for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
        for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
          if (item.type === 'question' && item.savedAs === valueId && item.choices?.from === 'list') return item.choices.shownColumn;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

// ── the buttons ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Why a button cannot be pressed, in words: the engine's refusal for this viewer, else the author's message, else its needs and "when ...". */
export function whyNot(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  _task: Task,
  button: FormButton,
  form: FormButtonState | undefined,
  engine: ButtonState | undefined,
): string | undefined {
  const refusal = engine && !engine.available ? engine.refusals[0] : undefined;
  if (engine && !engine.available) return refusal ? engineWords(refusal) : t('forms.why.engine.unknown');
  if (!form) return t('forms.why.working');
  if (form.available) return undefined;
  if (form.refusal?.code === 'rule-error') return t('forms.why.ruleError');
  // Core's form state also refuses an answer that the act's schema would refuse (core-api.md 7, E-27).
  if (form.refusal?.code === 'invalid-data') {
    const asked = form.refusal.location ? find(doc, form.refusal.location.item) : undefined;
    return asked?.kind === 'question' ? t('forms.why.invalidAt', { question: labelOf(asked.item) }) : t('forms.why.invalid');
  }
  if (button.messageWhileDisabled?.trim()) return button.messageWhileDisabled;
  return defaultWhy(doc, button, form.missing, form.refusal?.code === 'check');
}

/** The message a button shows while it cannot be pressed when the author wrote none: its needs and its "when ..." read back. */
export function defaultWhy(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, button: FormButton, missing: readonly string[], whenFails: boolean): string | undefined {
  const names = missing.map((id) => {
    const entry = find(doc, id);
    return entry?.kind === 'question' ? labelOf(entry.item) : t('describe.noName');
  });
  const condition = whenFails && button.enabledWhen ? toText(describeCondition(doc, button.enabledWhen)) : undefined;
  if (names.length && condition) return tidyStops(t('forms.why.needsAndWhen', { questions: joinNames(names), condition }));
  if (names.length) return tidyStops(t('forms.why.needs', { questions: joinNames(names) }));
  if (condition) return tidyStops(t('forms.why.onlyWhen', { condition }));
  return undefined;
}

/** A sentence's full stop after a name that already ends one ("Why do you need it?.") is dropped. */
export const tidyStops = (text: string): string => text.replace(/([?!.])\./g, '$1');

const ENGINE_WORDS: Partial<Record<string, WordKey>> = {
  'wait-not-open': 'forms.why.engine.waitNotOpen',
  'membership-unavailable': 'forms.why.engine.membershipUnavailable',
  'not-assignee': 'forms.why.engine.notAssignee',
  may: 'forms.why.engine.may',
};

function engineWords(r: Refusal): string {
  return t(ENGINE_WORDS[r.code] ?? 'forms.why.engine.unknown');
}

const RULE_WORDS: Record<string, WordKey> = {
  required: 'forms.refused.required',
  'wrong-kind': 'forms.refused.wrongKind',
  'not-a-choice': 'forms.refused.notAChoice',
  'too-long': 'forms.refused.tooLong',
  'too-short': 'forms.refused.tooShort',
  'out-of-range': 'forms.refused.outOfRange',
  'bad-format': 'forms.refused.badFormat',
  'unknown-question': 'forms.refused.unknownQuestion',
  'hidden-answered': 'forms.refused.hiddenAnswered',
};

/** A refusal of the last press in words, as it is shown at its question or button, or above the form. */
export function refusalWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, r: Refusal, catalogue?: Catalogue | null): string {
  switch (r.code) {
    case 'invalid-data':
      return t(RULE_WORDS[r.params.rule] ?? 'forms.refused.unknown');
    case 'choice-unknown': {
      const q = r.location?.item ? find(doc, r.location.item) : undefined;
      const choices = q?.kind === 'question' ? q.item.choices : undefined;
      const entry = choices?.from === 'source' ? sourceEntry(catalogue, choices.source) : undefined;
      if (entry) return t('forms.refused.choiceUnknown', { connection: connectionName(catalogue, entry.connection) });
      return t('forms.refused.choiceUnknownPlain');
    }
    case 'source-unavailable':
      return t('forms.refused.sourceUnavailable');
    case 'check':
      return r.message?.trim() || t('forms.refused.check');
    case 'rule-error':
      return t('forms.refused.ruleError');
    case 'wait-not-open':
      return t('forms.refused.waitNotOpen');
    case 'busy':
    case 'membership-unavailable':
      return t(r.code === 'busy' ? 'forms.refused.busy' : 'forms.why.engine.membershipUnavailable');
    case 'not-assignee':
    case 'may':
      return engineWords(r);
    default:
      return t('forms.refused.unknown');
  }
}

function ButtonBar(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  state: FormState | null;
  buttonStates: ButtonState[] | undefined;
  refusals: Refusal[] | undefined;
  busy: boolean;
  onPress(id: string): void;
}) {
  const { doc, task, state } = props;
  const rows = (task.buttons ?? []).map((b) => {
    const form = state?.buttons.find((x) => x.button === b.id);
    const engine = props.buttonStates?.find((x) => x.button === b.id);
    const why = props.busy ? t('forms.why.busy') : whyNot(doc, task, b, form, engine);
    return { b, form, engine, why };
  });
  // "Reject and Request changes can be pressed once Reason is filled": buttons that only miss answers.
  const once = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!row.why || props.busy || (row.engine && !row.engine.available) || !row.form || row.form.refusal || !row.form.missing.length) continue;
    const key = row.form.missing.join('|');
    once.set(key, [...(once.get(key) ?? []), buttonLabel(row.b)]);
  }
  // Every other reason a button cannot be pressed is shown under the buttons too, never only in its
  // name: buttons with the same reason share one line ("Approve and Reject: You are not one of ...").
  const covered = new Set([...once.values()].flat());
  const reasons = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!row.why || props.busy || covered.has(buttonLabel(row.b)) || row.why === t('forms.why.working')) continue;
    reasons.set(row.why, [...(reasons.get(row.why) ?? []), buttonLabel(row.b)]);
  }
  const pressRefusals = (props.refusals ?? []).filter((r) => isButtonRefusal(doc, r));
  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className={s.buttonBar}>
      <div role="group" aria-label={t('forms.buttons.title')} className={s.buttonRow}>
        {rows.map(({ b, why }) => (
          <Button
            key={b.id}
            variant={b.look === 'danger' ? 'danger' : b.look === 'primary' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
            // The name says the button and why it cannot be pressed as one sentence ("Submit: Needs: Why ...?").
            {...(why ? { disabledReason: why, 'aria-label': t('forms.button.nameWhy', { button: buttonLabel(b), why }) } : {})}
            onClick={() => props.onPress(b.id)}
          >
            {buttonLabel(b)}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {[...once].map(([key, buttons]) => {
        const questions = key.split('|').map((id) => {
          const entry = find(doc, id);
          return entry?.kind === 'question' ? labelOf(entry.item) : t('describe.noName');
        });
        return (
          <p key={key} className={s.onceLine}>
            <Icon name="lock" size={14} />
            {t(questions.length === 1 ? 'forms.once.one' : 'forms.once.many', { buttons: joinNames(buttons), questions: joinNames(questions) })}
          </p>
        );
      })}
      {[...reasons].map(([why, buttons]) => (
        <p key={why} className={s.onceLine} data-why="">
          <Icon name="lock" size={14} />
          {t('forms.why.line', { buttons: joinNames(buttons), why })}
        </p>
      ))}
      {pressRefusals.map((r, i) => (
        <p key={i} className={s.error} role="alert">
          <Icon name="error" size={14} />
          <span>{refusalWords(doc, r)}</span>
        </p>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The left side of the form editor: the form's pages, each with what is on it, its buttons and its
 * Show when; "+ Add a page"; and the values the form saves.
 */
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Page, Task } from '@/contract';
import { describeCondition, Slot, useRun, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon, IconButton, Menu, type MenuItem } from '@/ui';
import { buttonLabel, itemName, joinNames, KIND_ICON, pageTitle, questionsOf } from './logic';
import { PhraseView, useReadOnly } from './parts';
import { createdId } from './logic';
import s from './forms.module.css';

type Props = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  pageId: string | null;
  selected: string | null;
  onShowPage(pageId: string): void;
  onSelect(id: string, pageId?: string): void;
  onPageSettings(pageId: string): void;
  isStart: boolean;
};

export function PagesPanel({ doc, task, pageId, selected, onShowPage, onSelect, onPageSettings, isStart }: Props) {
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const { workflowId = '' } = useParams();
  const pages = task.form?.pages ?? [];
  const addPage = () => {
    const id = createdId(run('page.add', { task: task.id }));
    if (id) {
      onShowPage(id);
      onPageSettings(id);
    }
  };
  const saves = questionsOf(task).filter((q) => q.savedAs);

  return (
    <div className={s.left}>
      <nav aria-label={t('forms.pages')} className={s.leftNav}>
      <div className={s.leftHead}>
        <h2 className={s.leftTitle}>{t('forms.pages')}</h2>
        {/* A pointer shortcut for "Add a page" below; the keyboard has that one, so this is not a second stop with the same name. */}
        {!readOnly && <IconButton icon="plus" label={t('forms.pages.add')} onClick={addPage} tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true" />}
      </div>
      {pages.length === 0 && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.page.empty')}</p>}
      <ol className={s.pageList}>
        {pages.map((page, index) => (
          <PageCard
            key={page.id}
            doc={doc}
            task={task}
            page={page}
            index={index}
            count={pages.length}
            current={page.id === pageId}
            selected={selected}
            onShow={() => onShowPage(page.id)}
            onSelect={(id) => onSelect(id, page.id)}
            onSettings={() => onPageSettings(page.id)}
            isStart={isStart}
          />
        ))}
      </ol>
      {!readOnly && (
        <button type="button" className={s.dashedButton} onClick={addPage}>
          <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
          {t('forms.pages.add')}
        </button>
      )}
      </nav>

      <section aria-labelledby="forms-saves" className={s.leftNav}>
      <h2 id="forms-saves" className={s.leftTitle}>{t('forms.saves.title')}</h2>
      {saves.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.saves.none')}</p>
      ) : (
        <div className={s.saves}>
          {saves.map((q) => (
            <Slot key={q.id} name="ValueChip" valueId={q.savedAs!} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.saves.text')}</p>
      {saves.length > 0 && (
        <Link to={`/w/${workflowId}/values`} className={s.link}>
          {t('forms.saves.seeAll')}
        </Link>
      )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function PageCard(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  page: Page;
  index: number;
  count: number;
  current: boolean;
  selected: string | null;
  onShow(): void;
  onSelect(id: string): void;
  onSettings(): void;
  isStart: boolean;
}) {
  const { doc, task, page, index, count } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const title = pageTitle(page, index);
  const items = page.items ?? [];
  const questions = items.filter((i) => i.type === 'question').length;
  const lastPage = index === count - 1;
  const menu: MenuItem[] = [
    { label: t('forms.page.rename'), icon: 'edit', onSelect: props.onSettings },
    { label: t('forms.page.editShowWhen'), icon: 'filter', onSelect: props.onSettings },
    ...(index > 0 ? [{ label: t('forms.page.moveUp'), icon: 'chevron-up' as const, onSelect: () => run('page.move', { page: page.id, toIndex: index - 1 }) }] : []),
    ...(index < count - 1 ? [{ label: t('forms.page.moveDown'), icon: 'chevron-down' as const, onSelect: () => run('page.move', { page: page.id, toIndex: index + 1 }) }] : []),
    'separator',
    { label: t('forms.page.remove'), icon: 'trash', danger: true, onSelect: () => run('page.delete', { page: page.id }) },
  ];
  return (
    <li className={[s.pageCard, props.current ? s.pageCurrent : ''].join(' ')} data-item-id={page.id}>
      <div className={s.pageCardHead}>
        <span className={s.pageNumber} aria-hidden="true">
          {index + 1}
        </span>
        <button type="button" className={s.pageName} aria-current={props.current ? 'page' : undefined} onClick={props.onShow}>
          {title}
        </button>
        <span className={s.quiet}>
          {t(questions === 1 ? 'forms.page.questions.one' : questions === 0 ? 'forms.page.questions.none' : 'forms.page.questions.many', { n: questions })}
        </span>
        {!readOnly && <Menu trigger={<IconButton icon="more" size="sm" label={t('forms.page.menu', { page: title })} />} items={menu} align="end" />}
      </div>
      <ul className={s.pageItems}>
        {items.map((item) => (
          <li key={item.id}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={[s.pageItem, props.selected === item.id ? s.pageItemChosen : ''].join(' ')}
              aria-pressed={props.selected === item.id}
              onClick={() => props.onSelect(item.id)}
            >
              {/* Said first, so this entry is not one more control named only "Title" (the form and the value chips name it too). */}
              <span className="visually-hidden">{t('forms.outline.item', { page: title })}</span>
              <Icon name={item.type === 'text' ? 'note' : KIND_ICON[item.kind]} size={14} />
              {/* The name takes the width; its "if ..." goes on its own line under it, not in a narrow column beside it. */}
              <span className={s.pageItemText}>
                {/* A text's summary takes the whole width (two lines at most); "read only" goes on its own line under it. */}
                <span
                  className={[s.pageItemName, item.type === 'text' ? s.pageItemSummary : ''].join(' ')}
                  title={item.type === 'text' ? itemName(doc, task, item) : undefined}
                >
                  {itemName(doc, task, item)}
                </span>
                {item.showWhen && item.type === 'question' && <ShortWhen phrase={describeCondition(doc, item.showWhen)} />}
                {item.type === 'text' && <span className={[s.quiet, s.pageItemTag].join(' ')}>{t('forms.page.readOnly')}</span>}
              </span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {lastPage && (task.buttons ?? []).length > 0 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={[s.pageItem, s.pageButtons, props.selected === 'buttons' ? s.pageItemChosen : ''].join(' ')}
          aria-pressed={props.selected === 'buttons'}
          onClick={() => props.onSelect('buttons')}
        >
          <Icon name="check" size={14} />
          <span className={s.pageItemName}>{joinNames((task.buttons ?? []).map(buttonLabel))}</span>
        </button>
      )}
      <button type="button" className={s.pageWhen} onClick={props.onSettings}>
        {page.showWhen ? (
          <>
            <Icon name="filter" size={14} />
            <span>
              <PhraseView phrase={whenPhrase(doc, page)} />
            </span>
          </>
        ) : (
          t('forms.page.alwaysShown')
        )}
      </button>
    </li>
  );
}

function whenPhrase(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, page: Page): Phrase {
  return [t('forms.page.showWhen', { condition: '' }).trim(), ' ', ...describeCondition(doc, page.showWhen)];
}

function ShortWhen({ phrase }: { phrase: Phrase }) {
  return <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.page.onlyIf', { condition: phrase.map((p) => (typeof p === 'string' ? p : 'label' in p ? p.label : p.text)).join('') })}</span>;
}

/**
 * "Preview as" (mockup 06-form__preview): the form exactly as one person asked will see it, with the
 * sample request. The request's own header (workflow, status, title, who asked and when, what they
 * answered) and the "Sent to ..." line come first, as on the live task page; the right side chooses
 * whom to preview as, says which buttons that person can press right now, and offers Try it.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Task } from '@/contract';
import { getStage, getStatus, getTask, useSettings } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Answers, type Json, type Ref, type Values } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { whyNot } from './FormView';
import { buttonLabel, isAnswered, labelOf, questionsOf, refOf } from './logic';
import { Words } from './parts';
import { useSampleWho } from './sample';
import { useFormState } from './useFormState';
import { DirectoryName, ValueWords } from './ValueWords';
import s from './forms.module.css';

export type PreviewPerson = { ref: Ref; /** The group they are asked as part of, for the line under the name. */ group?: Ref; /** Started the request and may not answer it. */ blocked: boolean };

const asJson = (ref: Ref) => ref as unknown as Json;

/**
 * The people the preview can be "as": the person asked, or the members of the group asked, for the
 * sample request; the requester on the start form. A requester who may not answer is listed, marked.
 */
export function usePreviewPeople(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, isStart: boolean): PreviewPerson[] {
  const services = useServices();
  const who = useSampleWho(doc, task);
  const requesterId = doc.sampleRequest?.requester?.directoryId;
  const requester: Ref | undefined = requesterId ? { type: 'user', id: requesterId } : undefined;
  const refs = (Array.isArray(who) ? who.map(refOf) : [refOf(who)]).filter((r): r is Ref => !!r);
  const group = refs.length === 1 && refs[0]!.type === 'group' ? refs[0] : undefined;
  const groupId = group?.id;
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<{ group: string; people: Ref[] } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!groupId) return;
    let live = true;
    services.directory.membersOf({ type: 'group', id: groupId }).then(
      (people) => live && setMembers({ group: groupId, people: people.map((p) => ({ type: p.type, id: p.id })) }),
      () => undefined,
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, groupId]);
  const blocked = (ref: Ref) => !task.requesterCanAnswer && ref.type === 'user' && ref.id === requesterId;
  if (isStart) return requester ? [{ ref: requester, blocked: false }] : [];
  const asked: PreviewPerson[] = group
    ? (members?.group === group.id ? members.people : []).map((ref) => ({ ref, group, blocked: blocked(ref) }))
    : refs.filter((r) => r.type === 'user').map((ref) => ({ ref, blocked: blocked(ref) }));
  // The requester is listed too, greyed, when they may not answer here (mockup 06-form__preview):
  // the author sees that the person who started the request is not one who answers it.
  if (requester && !task.requesterCanAnswer && !asked.some((p) => p.ref.id === requester.id) && (!group || members?.group === group.id)) {
    asked.push({ ref: requester, blocked: true });
  }
  return asked;
}

/** The person previewed: the one chosen, else the first who may answer. */
export function previewPerson(people: PreviewPerson[], chosen: Ref | undefined): PreviewPerson | undefined {
  return (chosen && people.find((p) => p.ref.id === chosen.id && !p.blocked)) || people.find((p) => !p.blocked);
}

export function PreviewToggle({ person, preview, onChange }: { person: PreviewPerson | undefined; preview: boolean; onChange(next: boolean): void }) {
  if (preview) {
    return (
      <Button icon="close" onClick={() => onChange(false)}>
        {t('forms.exitPreview')}
      </Button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Button icon="eye" onClick={() => onChange(true)}>
      {person ? <Words k="forms.previewAs" fill={{ person: <DirectoryName json={asJson(person.ref)} /> }} /> : t('forms.previewAsSomeone')}
    </Button>
  );
}

export function PreviewBanner({ person }: { person: PreviewPerson | undefined }) {
  return (
    <p className={s.previewBanner}>
      <Icon name="eye" size={16} />
      {person ? (
        <span>
          <Words k="forms.preview.banner" fill={{ person: <b><DirectoryName json={asJson(person.ref)} /></b> }} />
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span>{t('forms.preview.bannerNoOne')}</span>
      )}
    </p>
  );
}

/**
 * The request as the person asked sees it above the form: the workflow and the status the request
 * shows at this stage, its name, who asked and when, and what the requester answered. Not on the
 * start form: there the request does not exist yet.
 */
export function RequestHeader({ doc, stageId, task, values }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; stageId: string; task: Task; values: Values }) {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const sample = doc.sampleRequest;
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
  const status = stage ? getStatus(doc, stage.status) : undefined;
  const startStage = getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage);
  const startTask = startStage && startStage.kind !== 'ending' ? getTask(doc, startStage.tasks?.[0]?.id) : undefined;
  const name = sample?.name?.trim();
  // What the requester answered, in form order; the answer that is the request's name is its title already.
  const rows = (startTask ? questionsOf(startTask) : [])
    .filter((q) => q.savedAs && isAnswered(values[q.savedAs]))
    .filter((q) => !(name && values[q.savedAs!] === name));
  const requester = sample?.requester?.directoryId;
  const inTexts = new Set<string>();
  for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
    for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
      if (item.type !== 'text') continue;
      for (const piece of item.content ?? []) if (typeof piece !== 'string' && 'value' in piece && typeof piece.value === 'string') inTexts.add(piece.value);
    }
  }
  const showsAnswers = rows.some((q) => inTexts.has(q.savedAs!));
  return (
    <header className={s.requestHead}>
      <p className={s.requestMeta}>
        <span>{settings?.name || t('describe.noName')}</span>
        {status?.words?.trim() && (
          <span className={s.statusPill}>
            <span className={s.statusDot} style={{ background: `var(--st-${status.colour})` }} aria-hidden="true" />
            {status.words}
          </span>
        )}
      </p>
      {name && <h2 className={s.requestTitle}>{name}</h2>}
      {(requester || sample?.startedOn) && (
        <p className={s.quiet}>
          <Words
            k="forms.preview.askedOn"
            fill={{
              person: requester ? <DirectoryName json={asJson({ type: 'user', id: requester })} /> : t('forms.preview.someone'),
              date: sample?.startedOn ? <ValueWords doc={doc} json={sample.startedOn} /> : '',
            }}
          />
        </p>
      )}
      {/* What the requester answered, when no text on this form shows it already. */}
      {!showsAnswers && rows.length > 0 && (
        <dl className={s.requestAnswers}>
          {rows.map((q) => (
            <div key={q.id}>
              <dt>{labelOf(q)}</dt>
              <dd>
                <ValueWords doc={doc} json={values[q.savedAs!]} />
              </dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

/** "Sent to Payments approvers. One answer is enough: the first person in the group to answer decides." */
export function SentTo({ doc, task }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; task: Task }) {
  const who = useSampleWho(doc, task);
  const ref = refOf(who) ?? (Array.isArray(who) ? refOf(who[0]) : undefined);
  if (!ref) return null;
  return (
    <p className={s.sentTo}>
      <Icon name={ref.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person'} size={14} />
      <span>
        <Words k="forms.preview.sentTo" fill={{ who: <DirectoryName json={asJson(ref)} /> }} /> {ref.type === 'group' ? t('rule.group') : ''}
      </span>
    </p>
  );
}

export function PreviewSide(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  people: PreviewPerson[];
  person: PreviewPerson | undefined;
  onPerson(ref: Ref): void;
  answers: Answers;
  values: Values;
  request: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string };
  onTryIt(): void;
}) {
  const { doc, task, person } = props;
  const radio = useId();
  const { state } = useFormState(doc, task.id, props.answers, props.values, props.request, undefined);
  const name = person ? <DirectoryName json={asJson(person.ref)} /> : t('forms.preview.someone');
  return (
    <div className={s.rightBody}>
      <header className={s.rightHead}>
        <span className={s.tag}>
          <Icon name="eye" size={14} />
          {t('forms.preview.tag')}
        </span>
        <h2 className={s.rightTitle}>

              return (
                <li key={p.ref.id}>
                  <label className={[s.personCard, on ? s.personCardOn : '', p.blocked ? s.personCardBlocked : ''].join(' ')}>
                    <input type="radio" name={radio} checked={on} disabled={p.blocked} onChange={() => props.onPerson(p.ref)} />

                      <span className={s.personName}>
                        <DirectoryName json={asJson(p.ref)} />
                      </span>
                      <span className={s.quiet}>
                        {p.blocked ? t('forms.preview.startedIt') : p.group ? <DirectoryName json={asJson(p.group)} /> : null}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </label>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      )}
      <section className={s.section}>
        <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>
          {person ? <Words k="forms.preview.buttonsFor" fill={{ person: name }} /> : t('forms.preview.buttonsNow')}
        </h3>
        <ul className={s.buttonsNow}>
          {(task.buttons ?? []).map((b) => {

              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section className={s.section}>
        <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.preview.follow')}</h3>
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.preview.followText')}</p>
        <Button icon="play" onClick={props.onTryIt}>
          {t('forms.preview.tryIt')}
        </Button>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

﻿/**
 * The answer control of one question, by kind (core-api.md 2.4 for the answer each sends): text,
 * long text, number, date, Yes/No, choice, multiple choice, person and group. Choices come from
 * `useChoices`. Every control is named by the question's label and described by its hint and error.
 */
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Question } from '@/contract';
import type { FormState, Json } from '@/services';
import { useDirectoryLabel } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { DateField, Select, TextArea, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { connectionName, isAnswered, refOf, sameAnswer, type Option } from './logic';
import { ChoicePicker } from './ChoicePicker';
import { useChoices, type LoadChoices } from './useChoices';
import { useAnyCatalogue } from './useFormState';
import s from './forms.module.css';

export type InputProps = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  question: Question;
  answer: Json | undefined;
  onAnswer(next: Json | undefined): void;
  state: FormState | null;
  loadChoices?: LoadChoices | undefined;
  /** The control's own id (its label points at it). */
  inputId: string;
  /** The id of the label element (for groups of controls and the picker). */
  labelId: string;
  describedBy?: string | undefined;
  invalid: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
};

const PICK_LIMIT = 6;

export function QuestionInput(props: InputProps) {
  const { question } = props;
  const aria = {
    'aria-describedby': props.describedBy,
    'aria-invalid': props.invalid || undefined,
  };
  switch (question.kind) {
    case 'text':
      return (
        <TextInput
          id={props.inputId}
          value={typeof props.answer === 'string' ? props.answer : ''}
          disabled={props.disabled}
          onChange={(e) => props.onAnswer(e.target.value)}
          {...aria}
        />
      );
    case 'longText':
      return (
        <TextArea
          id={props.inputId}
          value={typeof props.answer === 'string' ? props.answer : ''}
          disabled={props.disabled}
          onChange={(e) => props.onAnswer(e.target.value)}
          {...aria}
        />
      );
    case 'number':
      return <NumberInput {...props} />;
    case 'date':
      // "2 Dec 2026", as the editor writes dates everywhere, never the browser's own format; sent as YYYY-MM-DD.
      return (
        <DateField
          id={props.inputId}
          value={typeof props.answer === 'string' && props.answer ? props.answer : undefined}
          disabled={props.disabled}
          onChange={(next) => props.onAnswer(next)}
          placeholder={t('forms.answer.datePlaceholder')}
          invalidText={t('forms.answer.dateInvalid')}
          calendarLabel={t('forms.answer.dateCalendar', { question: question.label || t('describe.noName') })}
          {...aria}
        />
      );
    case 'yesNo':
      return (
        <div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby={props.labelId} {...aria} className={s.choiceRow}>
          {[true, false].map((v) => (
            <label key={String(v)} className={s.choiceTile}>
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={props.inputId}
                checked={props.answer === v}
                disabled={props.disabled}
                onChange={() => props.onAnswer(v)}
              />
              {t(v ? 'forms.answer.yes' : 'forms.answer.no')}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
    case 'multipleChoice':
      return <MultipleChoice {...props} />;
    default:
      return <OneChoice {...props} />;
  }
}

/** A number as people type it; a number is sent only once what is typed reads as one. */
function NumberInput(props: InputProps) {
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const shown = typed ?? (typeof props.answer === 'number' ? String(props.answer) : '');
  return (
    <TextInput
      id={props.inputId}
      inputMode="decimal"
      value={shown}
      disabled={props.disabled}
      aria-describedby={props.describedBy}
      aria-invalid={props.invalid || undefined}
      onChange={(e) => {
        const text = e.target.value;
        setTyped(text);
        const n = Number(text.replace(',', '.'));
        props.onAnswer(text.trim() === '' || !Number.isFinite(n) ? undefined : n);
      }}
      onBlur={() => setTyped(null)}
    />
  );
}

function MultipleChoice(props: InputProps) {
  const choices = useChoices(props.doc, props.question, props.state, props.loadChoices, '', true);
  const picked = Array.isArray(props.answer) ? props.answer : [];
  if (choices.options.length === 0) return <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.answer.noChoices')}</p>;
  const toggle = (o: Option, on: boolean) => {
    // Kept in the order of the question's choices (core-api.md 2.4).
    const next = choices.options.filter((x) => (sameAnswer(x.value, o.value) ? on : picked.some((p) => sameAnswer(p, x.value)))).map((x) => x.value);
    props.onAnswer(next.length ? next : undefined);
  };
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-labelledby={props.labelId} aria-describedby={props.describedBy} className={s.choiceRow}>
      {choices.options.map((o, i) => (
        <label key={i} className={s.choiceTile}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={picked.some((p) => sameAnswer(p, o.value))}
            disabled={props.disabled}
            onChange={(e) => toggle(o, e.target.checked)}
          />
          {o.label}
        </label>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One choice: a row of options when there are few typed-in ones, else a select or a searchable picker. */
function OneChoice(props: InputProps) {
  const { question, doc } = props;
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const catalogue = useAnyCatalogue();
  const from = question.choices?.from;
  const remote = from === 'directory' || from === 'source' || question.kind === 'person' || question.kind === 'group';
  const choices = useChoices(doc, question, props.state, props.loadChoices, search, remote ? open : true);
  const directoryLabel = useDirectoryLabel(refOf(props.answer));

  if (!remote && from === 'typedIn' && choices.options.length > 0 && choices.options.length <= PICK_LIMIT) {
    return (
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby={props.labelId} aria-describedby={props.describedBy} aria-invalid={props.invalid || undefined} className={s.choiceRow}>
        {choices.options.map((o, i) => (
          <label key={i} className={s.choiceTile}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name={props.inputId}
              checked={sameAnswer(o.value, props.answer)}
              disabled={props.disabled}
              onChange={() => props.onAnswer(o.value)}
            />
            {o.label}
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!remote) {
    const index = choices.options.findIndex((o) => sameAnswer(o.value, props.answer));
    return (
      <Select
        id={props.inputId}
        value={index < 0 ? '' : String(index)}
        disabled={props.disabled}
        aria-describedby={props.describedBy}
        aria-invalid={props.invalid || undefined}
        options={[{ value: '', label: t('forms.answer.chooseOne') }, ...choices.options.map((o, i) => ({ value: String(i), label: o.label }))]}
        onChange={(e) => props.onAnswer(e.target.value === '' ? undefined : choices.options[Number(e.target.value)]?.value)}
      />
    );
  }

  const sample = choices.sample;
  const foot =
    sample?.kind === 'source'
      ? t('forms.answer.samples', { connection: connectionName(catalogue, sample.connection) })
      : sample?.kind === 'directory' && sample.group
        ? t('forms.answer.samplesDirectory', { group: sample.group })
        : from === 'source' && question.choices?.from === 'source'
          ? t('forms.answer.fromConnection', { connection: connectionName(catalogue, catalogue?.entries.find((e) => e.id === (question.choices as { source?: string }).source)?.connection) })
          : undefined;
  const head =
    sample?.kind === 'directory' && sample.group
      ? t(choices.options.length === 1 ? 'forms.answer.peopleCount.one' : 'forms.answer.peopleCount.many', { group: sample.group, n: choices.options.length })
      : undefined;
  const isGroup = question.kind === 'group';
  return (
    <ChoicePicker
      labelledBy={props.labelId}
      describedBy={props.describedBy}
      invalid={props.invalid}
      options={choices.options}
      value={props.answer}
      valueLabel={isAnswered(props.answer) ? (labelOfAnswer(props.answer) ?? directoryLabel) : undefined}
      onChange={props.onAnswer}
      placeholder={t(question.kind === 'person' ? 'forms.answer.choosePerson' : isGroup ? 'forms.answer.chooseGroup' : 'forms.answer.choose')}
      onSearch={choices.searched || !open ? setSearch : undefined}
      onOpenChange={setOpen}
      loading={choices.loading}
      failed={choices.failed}
      head={head}
      foot={foot}
      disabled={props.disabled}
      clearLabel={t('forms.answer.clear', { question: question.label || t('describe.noName') })}
      icon={question.kind === 'person' ? 'person' : isGroup ? 'group' : 'choice'}
    />
  );
}

/** The words of an answer that is not among the loaded options (a connection's choice keeps its label). */
function labelOfAnswer(answer: Json | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (answer && typeof answer === 'object' && !Array.isArray(answer) && typeof answer.label === 'string') return answer.label;
  return undefined;
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/README.md\n===
# features/forms

The form editor and the one form renderer (F6), used by the editor's preview, Try it and the request pages.

- `index.tsx` exports `FormEditorPage` (route `/w/:workflowId/form/:stageId/:taskId`) and `FormView` (the `FormView` model slot; `FormViewProps` in `src/model/slots.ts`). Keep both names.
- `FormView.tsx`: `FormView` and `FormRenderer` (the same renderer with the editor's extras: one page with every item, choosing, moving, its own button bar). What shows and which buttons can be pressed come from `core.formState` (`useFormState.ts`: debounced, last good state kept, `needsLookups` answered from `lookups` then the directory). Also `whyNot`, `defaultWhy` (what a button that cannot be pressed says) and `refusalWords` (a refusal of the last press in words).
- `QuestionInput.tsx` (every kind), `useChoices.ts` (typed in, list, formula, directory and connection through `loadChoices`, or samples in the preview), `ChoicePicker.tsx` (a combobox built here; a candidate for `src/ui`), `ValueWords.tsx` (a request's value in words).
- The editor: `FormEditorPage.tsx` (bar, layout, "Show me"), `SwitchForm.tsx` ("Switch form": each form with who fills it in and what it asks; a menu with two lines per item, built here on the Radix menu and `@/ui/Overlay.module.css`, a candidate for `src/ui`), `Preview.tsx` ("Preview as": the request header, "Sent to ...", whom to preview as, the buttons right now), `PagesPanel.tsx` (left), `EditView.tsx` (middle), `Settings.tsx` (right; the buttons as one card each, "+ only when ..." on each button's arrow) and `ChoicesSettings.tsx`, `sample.ts` (the sample request's values and who it asks), `logic.ts` (pure helpers, the E-23 table of choices offered per kind, `itemName`, `distinctFindings`), `parts.tsx` (`CommitInput`: a box that saves as it is typed, one Undo step per typing through `useTyping`; `ReadOnlyContext`: when `useMay().edit` is false the editor shows everything and offers no control that changes it; `focusMoved` after a move up or down).
- The form editor's own bar sits under the editor's top bar (kept on purpose: Undo, To do, Try it and the save state stay in reach) and does not repeat the trail: Back to diagram, "Form for: <stage>" filled in by <who>, Switch form, Preview, Done.
- Words: `src/words/forms.ts`, keys `forms.*`. Styles: `forms.module.css`.
- Tests: `FormView.test.tsx`, `FormEditorPage.test.tsx`; end to end `tests/e2e/forms.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/forms-fixes.spec.ts` and `tests/e2e/forms-fix2.spec.ts`.
- May import: `@/model`, `@/services`, `@/words`, `@/ui`, `@/contract`, and files in this folder.
