/**
 * The right side of the form editor: the settings of what is chosen. A question (label, kind,
 * Needed to press, choices, Show when, Saved as), a text (its words with value chips, Show when),
 * a page (title, Show when), or the task's buttons (name, look, what it needs, "Also only when ...",
 * the message shown while it cannot be pressed, where it goes).
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import type { Arrow, ArrowId, AuthoredWorkflow, Button as FormButton, Condition, FormText, Page, Question, QuestionKind, StageId, Task } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeArrow, describeCondition, describeGoTo, describeValueCard, getStage, getValue, Slot, useArrowFacts, useCheckIsCurrent, useDescribeEnv, useEditor, useFacts,
  useFindingsFor, useRun,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Checkbox, Icon, IconButton, Mark, Select } from '@/ui';
import { ChoicesSettings } from './ChoicesSettings';
import { buttonArrow, hasOtherArrows } from './EditView';
import { defaultWhy } from './FormView';
import {
  buttonLabel, buttonsNeeding, createdId, distinctFindings, itemName, joinNames, KIND_ICON, kindHasChoices, kindWords, labelOf, neededQuestions, pageTitle,
  QUESTION_KINDS, questionsOf,
} from './logic';
import { CommitInput, focusMoved, PhraseView, TemplateWords, useReadOnly, useTyping } from './parts';
import s from './forms.module.css';

type Where = { stageName: string; pageIndex: number };

/** Focus a field once it is shown, after a menu that opened it has given focus back to its own button. */
function useFocusWhenShown(ref: RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>, on: boolean) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!on) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => ref.current?.focus(), 30);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [ref, on]);
}

function Header(props: { tag: string; icon: Parameters<typeof Icon>[0]['name']; title: string; sub: string; onRemove?: () => void; removeLabel?: string }) {
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  return (
    <header className={s.rightHead}>
      <div className={s.rightTagRow}>
        <span className={s.tag}>
          <Icon name={props.icon} size={14} />
          {props.tag}
        </span>
        {props.onRemove && !readOnly && <IconButton icon="trash" label={props.removeLabel ?? ''} onClick={props.onRemove} />}
      </div>
      <h2 className={s.rightTitle}>{props.title}</h2>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{props.sub}</p>
    </header>
  );
}

function Findings({ doc, itemId, name }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; itemId: string; name: string }) {
  const findings = useFindingsFor(itemId, { deep: true });
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const current = useCheckIsCurrent();
  const lines = distinctFindings(doc, findings, env);
  if (!lines.length) return null;
  return (
    <section
      className={[s.section, current ? '' : s.stale].join(' ')}
      aria-label={t('forms.settings.findings', { item: name })}
      aria-busy={!current || undefined}
    >
      <ul className={s.findings}>
        {lines.map((line) => (
          <li key={line.key}>
            <Mark variant={line.todo ? 'todo' : 'worth'}>{line.text}</Mark>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {!current && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.settings.checking')}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

// ── a question ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function QuestionSettings(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  stageId: string;
  question: Question;
  where: Where;
  hiddenForSample: boolean | undefined;
  autoFocus: boolean;
  onRemoved(): void;
}) {
  const { doc, task, question } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const ids = { label: useId(), kind: useId() };
  const name = labelOf(question);
  const labelRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  useFocusWhenShown(labelRef, props.autoFocus);
  return (
    <div className={s.rightBody}>
      <Header
        tag={t('forms.settings.question')}
        icon={KIND_ICON[question.kind]}
        title={name}
        sub={t('forms.settings.questionSub', { where: t('forms.settings.where', { stage: props.where.stageName, n: props.where.pageIndex + 1 }) })}
        removeLabel={t('forms.settings.remove', { item: name })}
        onRemove={() => {
          run('item.delete', { item: question.id });
          props.onRemoved();
        }}
      />
      <Findings doc={doc} itemId={question.id} name={name} />
      <section className={s.section}>
        <label className={s.sectionTitle} htmlFor={ids.label}>
          {t('forms.settings.labelField')}
        </label>
        <CommitInput
          ref={labelRef}
          id={ids.label}
          value={question.label ?? ''}
          aria-describedby={`${ids.label}-hint`}
          onCommit={(label) => run('question.setLabel', { question: question.id, label })}
        />
        <p id={`${ids.label}-hint`} className={s.quiet}>
          {t('forms.settings.labelHint')}
        </p>
        <label className={s.sectionTitle} htmlFor={ids.kind}>
          {t('forms.settings.kind')}
        </label>
        <Select
          id={ids.kind}
          value={question.kind}
          disabled={readOnly}
          options={QUESTION_KINDS.map((k) => ({ value: k, label: kindWords(k) }))}
          onChange={(e) => run('question.setKind', { question: question.id, kind: e.target.value as QuestionKind })}
        />
      </section>
      <NeededToPress task={task} question={question} />
      {kindHasChoices(question.kind) && (
        <section className={s.section}>
          <ChoicesSettings doc={doc} question={question} />
        </section>
      )}
      <ShowWhen
        doc={doc}
        stageId={props.stageId}
        itemId={question.id}
        title={t('forms.showWhen.title', { item: name })}
        scope={t('forms.showWhen.questionOnly')}
        addLabel={t('forms.showWhen.add', { item: name })}
        value={question.showWhen}
        onChange={(showWhen) => run('question.setShowWhen', { question: question.id, ...(showWhen ? { showWhen } : {}) })}
        cost={[
          t('forms.showWhen.costQuestion', { question: name }),
          ...(buttonsNeeding(task, question).length ? [t('forms.showWhen.costNeeded', { buttons: joinNames(buttonsNeeding(task, question).map(buttonLabel)) })] : []),
        ]}
        sample={props.hiddenForSample === undefined ? undefined : t(props.hiddenForSample ? 'forms.showWhen.sampleHidden' : 'forms.showWhen.sampleShown', { item: name })}
      />
      <SavedAs doc={doc} question={question} />
    </div>
  );
}

function NeededToPress({ task, question }: { task: Task; question: Question }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const buttons = task.buttons ?? [];
  const name = labelOf(question);
  const needing = buttonsNeeding(task, question);
  const set = (button: FormButton, on: boolean) => {
    const others = (button.neededToPress ?? []).filter((q) => q !== question.id);
    run('button.setNeededToPress', { button: button.id, questions: on ? [...others, question.id] : others });
  };
  return (
    <fieldset className={s.section}>
      <legend className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.settings.needed')}</legend>
      {buttons.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.settings.needed.noButtons')}</p>
      ) : (
        <div className={s.ticks}>
          <Checkbox
            label={t('forms.settings.needed.all')}
            checked={!!question.neededForEveryButton}
            disabled={readOnly}
            onChange={(e) => run('question.setNeededForEveryButton', { question: question.id, on: e.target.checked })}
          />
          {buttons.map((b) => (
            <Checkbox
              key={b.id}
              label={buttonLabel(b)}
              checked={!!question.neededForEveryButton || (b.neededToPress ?? []).includes(question.id)}
              disabled={readOnly || !!question.neededForEveryButton}
              onChange={(e) => set(b, e.target.checked)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      <p className={s.quiet}>
        {needing.length
          ? t('forms.settings.needed.cannot', { buttons: joinNames(needing.map(buttonLabel)), question: name })
          : buttons.length
            ? t('forms.settings.needed.none', { question: name })
            : ''}{' '}
        {question.showWhen && needing.length ? t('forms.settings.needed.whileShown') : ''} {buttons.length > 0 && t('forms.settings.needed.allHint')}
      </p>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function ShowWhen(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  stageId: string;
  itemId: string;
  title: string;
  scope: string;
  addLabel: string;
  value: Condition | undefined;
  onChange(next: Condition | undefined): void;
  cost: string[];
  sample?: string | undefined;
  extra?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  return (
    <section className={s.section} aria-label={props.title}>
      <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{props.title}</h3>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{props.scope}</p>
      {!props.value && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.showWhen.always')}</p>}
      {readOnly ? (
        props.value && <ReadWhen doc={props.doc} value={props.value} />
      ) : (
        <Slot name="WhenBuilder" at={{ item: props.itemId, part: 'showWhen' }} stageId={props.stageId} addLabel={props.addLabel} value={props.value} onChange={props.onChange} />
      )}
      {props.value && (
        <div className={s.costBox}>
          <Icon name="eye" size={14} />
          <p>
            {props.cost.join(' ')}
            {props.sample ? ` ${props.sample}` : ''}
            {props.extra ? ` ${props.extra}` : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** A "when ..." read only, in words with its chips (read only: the builder is not offered). */
function ReadWhen({ doc, value }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; value: Condition }) {
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  return (
    <p className={s.readWhen}>
      <PhraseView phrase={describeCondition(doc, value, env)} />
    </p>
  );
}

function SavedAs({ doc, question }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; question: Question }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = useState(false);
  const [refused, setRefused] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const renameId = useId();
  const value = getValue(doc, question.savedAs);
  if (!question.savedAs || !value) {
    return (
      <section className={s.section}>
        <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.savedAs.title')}</h3>
        <p className={s.missingText}>{t('forms.savedAs.missing')}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const card = describeValueCard(doc, value.id, env);
  const used = card.used.length;
  const label = question.label?.trim().toLowerCase();
  // Section 4: a question named like an existing value does not merge with it; the editor says so.
  const twin = label ? (doc.values ?? []).find((v) => v.id !== value.id && v.name.trim().toLowerCase() === label) : undefined;
  const twinCard = twin ? describeValueCard(doc, twin.id, env) : undefined;
  const twinFrom = twinCard?.filled[0];
  const kindOf = (id: string) => {
    const k = facts?.values[id as keyof NonNullable<typeof facts>['values']]?.kind;
    return typeof k === 'string' ? k : undefined;
  };
  const useTwin = () => {
    if (!twin) return;
    const theirs = kindOf(twin.id);
    const mine = kindOf(value.id) ?? question.kind;
    if (theirs && theirs !== mine && !(theirs === 'choiceFromList' && question.kind === 'choice')) {
      setRefused(t('forms.savedAs.wrongKind', { kind: kindLabel(theirs), mine: kindWords(question.kind).toLowerCase() }));
      return;
    }
    run('question.setSavedAs', { question: question.id, value: twin.id });
    setRefused(null);
    setDone(t('forms.savedAs.used', { name: twin.name }));
  };
  return (
    <section className={s.section}>
      <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.savedAs.title')}</h3>
      <div className={s.savedRow}>
        <Slot name="ValueChip" valueId={value.id} />
        <span className={s.quiet}>
          {used === 0 ? t('forms.savedAs.usedIn.none') : used === 1 ? t('forms.savedAs.usedIn.one') : t('forms.savedAs.usedIn.many', { n: used })}
        </span>
      </div>
      {done && (
        <p className={s.quiet} role="status">
          {done}
        </p>
      )}
      {twin && (
        <div className={s.twin}>
          <p>
            {t('forms.savedAs.sameName', {
              name: twin.name,
              from: twinFrom ? t('forms.savedAs.sameNameFrom', { where: twinFrom.stage ? `${twinFrom.stage}, ${twinFrom.what}` : twinFrom.what }) : '',
            })}
          </p>
          {!readOnly && (
            <div className={s.twinActions}>
              <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setRenaming(true)}>
                {t('forms.savedAs.rename')}
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm" onClick={useTwin}>
                {t('forms.savedAs.useThat')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
          {refused && (
            <p className={s.error} role="alert">
              <Icon name="error" size={14} />
              <span>{refused}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {renaming && !readOnly && (
        <div className={s.settingRow}>
          <label htmlFor={renameId}>{t('forms.savedAs.renameLabel')}</label>
          <CommitInput
            id={renameId}
            autoFocus
            value={value.name}
            onCommit={(name) => run('value.rename', { value: value.id, name })}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') setRenaming(false);
            }}
            onBlur={() => setRenaming(false)}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

const kindLabel = (kind: string): string => {
  const known: Record<string, QuestionKind> = { choiceFromList: 'choice', choiceFromConnection: 'choice', people: 'group' };
  const k = (QUESTION_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(kind) ? (kind as QuestionKind) : known[kind];
  return k ? kindWords(k).toLowerCase() : kind;
};

// ── a text ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function TextSettings(props: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; task: Task; stageId: string; text: FormText; where: Where; onRemoved(): void }) {
  const { doc, task, text } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  // The text box saves as it is typed (MessageField calls onChange on each keystroke); the typing
  // is one change for Undo until focus leaves the box.
  const { typed, end } = useTyping();
  const name = itemName(doc, task, text);
  return (
    <div className={s.rightBody}>
      <Header
        tag={t('forms.settings.text')}
        icon="note"
        title={name}
        sub={t('forms.settings.textSub', { where: t('forms.settings.where', { stage: props.where.stageName, n: props.where.pageIndex + 1 }) })}
        removeLabel={t('forms.settings.remove', { item: name })}
        onRemove={() => {
          run('item.delete', { item: text.id });
          props.onRemoved();
        }}
      />
      <Findings doc={doc} itemId={text.id} name={name} />
      <section className={s.section}>
        <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.textSettings.content')}</h3>
        {readOnly ? (
          <div className={s.textBox}>
            {(text.content ?? []).length ? <TemplateWords doc={doc} template={text.content} env={env} /> : <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.text.empty')}</span>}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div
              onBlur={(e) => {
                if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) end();
              }}
            >
              <Slot
                name="MessageField"
                at={{ item: text.id, part: 'content' }}
                label={t('forms.textSettings.content')}
                multiline
                value={text.content}
                onChange={(next) => typed(() => run('text.setContent', { text: text.id, content: next ?? [] }))}
              />
            </div>
            <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.textSettings.contentHint')}</p>
          </>
        )}
      </section>
      <ShowWhen
        doc={doc}
        stageId={props.stageId}
        itemId={text.id}
        title={t('forms.showWhen.title', { item: name })}
        scope={t('forms.showWhen.textOnly')}
        addLabel={t('forms.showWhen.add', { item: name })}
        value={text.showWhen}
        onChange={(showWhen) => run('text.setShowWhen', { text: text.id, ...(showWhen ? { showWhen } : {}) })}
        cost={[]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── a page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function PageSettings(props: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; task: Task; stageId: string; page: Page; index: number; stageName: string; autoFocus: boolean; onRemoved(): void }) {
  const { doc, page } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const titleId = useId();
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  useFocusWhenShown(titleRef, props.autoFocus);
  const title = pageTitle(page, props.index);
  const questions = (page.items ?? []).filter((i): i is Question => i.type === 'question').map(labelOf);
  return (
    <div className={s.rightBody}>
      <Header
        tag={t('forms.settings.page')}
        icon="form"
        title={title}
        sub={t('forms.settings.pageSub', { where: t('forms.settings.where', { stage: props.stageName, n: props.index + 1 }) })}
        removeLabel={t('forms.settings.removePage')}
        onRemove={() => {
          run('page.delete', { page: page.id });
          props.onRemoved();
        }}
      />
      <Findings doc={doc} itemId={page.id} name={title} />
      <section className={s.section}>
        <label className={s.sectionTitle} htmlFor={titleId}>
          {t('forms.pageSettings.title')}
        </label>
        <CommitInput
          ref={titleRef}
          id={titleId}
          value={page.title ?? ''}
          placeholder={t('forms.page.untitled', { n: props.index + 1 })}
          onCommit={(next) => run('page.rename', { page: page.id, ...(next.trim() ? { title: next } : {}) })}
        />
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.pageSettings.titleHint')}</p>
      </section>
      <ShowWhen
        doc={doc}
        stageId={props.stageId}
        itemId={page.id}
        title={t('forms.showWhen.pageTitle')}
        scope={t('forms.showWhen.pageOnly')}
        addLabel={t('forms.showWhen.addPage')}
        value={page.showWhen}
        onChange={(showWhen) => run('page.setShowWhen', { page: page.id, ...(showWhen ? { showWhen } : {}) })}
        cost={[questions.length ? t('forms.showWhen.costPage', { questions: joinNames(questions) }) : t('forms.showWhen.costPageNone')]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── the buttons ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * The task's buttons, one card each (mockup 06-form__buttons): closed, a card says what the button
 * needs, its message and where it goes; the chosen one is open with all its settings.
 */
export function ButtonsSettings(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  stageId: string;
  stageName: string;
  onSelectQuestion(id: string): void;
  flash: string | null;
  /** The button to open: the one clicked in the form or shown by "Show me". */
  open?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const { doc, task } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const buttons = task.buttons ?? [];
  const wanted = props.open ?? (buttons.some((b) => b.id === props.flash) ? (props.flash ?? undefined) : undefined);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | undefined>(wanted ?? buttons[0]?.id);
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(wanted);
  if (seen !== wanted) {
    setSeen(wanted);
    if (wanted) setOpen(wanted);
  }
  const add = () => {
    const id = createdId(run('button.add', { task: task.id }));
    if (id) setOpen(id);
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.rightBody}>
      <Header tag={t('forms.buttons.tag')} icon="check" title={t('forms.buttons.panelTitle', { stage: props.stageName })} sub={t('forms.buttons.panelSub')} />
      <ol className={s.buttonSettingsList}>
        {buttons.map((b, i) => (
          <ButtonSettings
            key={b.id}
            doc={doc}
            task={task}
            stageId={props.stageId}
            button={b}
            index={i}
            count={buttons.length}
            open={open === b.id}
            onOpen={(on) => setOpen(on ? b.id : undefined)}
            onSelectQuestion={props.onSelectQuestion}
            flash={props.flash === b.id}
          />
        ))}
      </ol>
      {!readOnly && (
        <div className={s.buttonAdd}>
          <button type="button" className={s.linkButton} onClick={add}>
            {t('forms.button.add')}
          </button>
          <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.button.addHint')}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ButtonSettings(props: {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  task: Task;
  stageId: string;
  button: FormButton;
  index: number;
  count: number;
  open: boolean;
  onOpen(open: boolean): void;
  onSelectQuestion(id: string): void;
  flash: boolean;
}) {
  const { doc, task, button, index } = props;
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const ids = { name: useId(), look: useId(), message: useId(), body: useId() };
  const name = buttonLabel(button);
  const needs = neededQuestions(task, button);
  const fallback = defaultWhy(doc, button, needs.map((q) => q.id), !!button.enabledWhen);
  const arrow = buttonArrow(doc, task, button);
  const facts = useArrowFacts(arrow?.id);
  const askable = questionsOf(task).length > 0;
  const variant = button.look === 'danger' ? 'danger' : button.look === 'primary' ? 'primary' : 'plain';
  return (
    <li
      className={[s.buttonSettings, props.open ? s.buttonSettingsOpen : '', props.flash ? s.flash : ''].join(' ')}
      data-item-id={button.id}
      onClick={(e) => {
        // A closed card opens on a click anywhere on it; its own controls do their own thing.
        if (!props.open && !(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button,a,input,select')) props.onOpen(true);
      }}
    >
      <div className={s.buttonHead}>
        {props.open ? (
          <div className={s.buttonNameRow}>
            <CommitInput id={ids.name} aria-label={t('forms.button.nameFor', { button: name })} value={button.label ?? ''} onCommit={(label) => run('button.rename', { button: button.id, label })} />
            {!readOnly && (
              <>
                <IconButton
                  icon="chevron-up"
                  size="sm"
                  label={t('forms.button.moveUp', { button: name })}
                  data-move={`${button.id}:up`}
                  disabled={index === 0}
                  onClick={() => {
                    run('button.move', { button: button.id, toIndex: index - 1 });
                    focusMoved(button.id, 'up');
                  }}
                />
                <IconButton
                  icon="chevron-down"
                  size="sm"
                  label={t('forms.button.moveDown', { button: name })}
                  data-move={`${button.id}:down`}
                  disabled={index === props.count - 1}
                  onClick={() => {
                    run('button.move', { button: button.id, toIndex: index + 1 });
                    focusMoved(button.id, 'down');
                  }}
                />
                <IconButton icon="trash" size="sm" label={t('forms.button.remove', { button: name })} onClick={() => run('button.delete', { button: button.id })} />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <span className={[s.buttonChip, s[`buttonChip_${variant}`]].join(' ')}>{name}</span>
        )}
        <IconButton
          icon={props.open ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'}
          size="sm"
          label={t(props.open ? 'forms.button.collapse' : 'forms.button.expand', { button: name })}
          aria-expanded={props.open}
          aria-controls={ids.body}
          onClick={() => props.onOpen(!props.open)}
        />
      </div>
      {!props.open ? (
        <div id={ids.body} className={s.buttonSummary}>
          <p>
            {needs.length ? (
              <>
                <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.needs')}</span>{' '}
                {needs.map((q) => (
                  <span key={q.id} className={s.needChip}>
                    <Icon name={KIND_ICON[q.kind]} size={12} />
                    {labelOf(q)}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </>
            ) : (
              <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.needsNothing')}</span>
            )}
          </p>
          {button.messageWhileDisabled?.trim() && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.button.messageSummary', { message: button.messageWhileDisabled.trim() })}</p>}
          <p className={s.goesTo}>
            <Icon name="arrow-right" size={12} />
            <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.goesTo')}</span>
            {arrow ? (
              <PhraseView phrase={describeGoTo(doc, arrow.goTo)} />
            ) : hasOtherArrows(doc, task) ? (
              <span>{t('forms.buttons.byArrows')}</span>
            ) : (
              <span className={s.missingText}>{t('forms.buttons.goesNowhere')}</span>
            )}
            {facts?.sendsBack && (
              <span className={s.quiet}>
                <Icon name="sendback" size={12} /> {t('forms.buttons.sendsBack')}
              </span>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div id={ids.body} className={s.buttonBody}>
          <div className={s.settingRow}>
            <label htmlFor={ids.look}>{t('forms.button.lookFor', { button: name })}</label>
            <Select
              id={ids.look}
              value={button.look}
              disabled={readOnly}
              options={(['primary', 'secondary', 'danger'] as const).map((l) => ({ value: l, label: t(`forms.button.look.${l}`) }))}
              onChange={(e) => run('button.setLook', { button: button.id, look: e.target.value as FormButton['look'] })}
            />
          </div>
          <div className={s.settingGroup}>
            <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.button.needsTitle')}</h3>
            {needs.length === 0 ? (
              <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.buttons.needsNothing')}</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className={s.needsList}>
                {needs.map((q) => (
                  <li key={q.id}>
                    <span className={s.needChip}>
                      <Icon name={KIND_ICON[q.kind]} size={12} />
                      {labelOf(q)}
                    </span>
                    <button type="button" className={s.linkButton} onClick={() => props.onSelectQuestion(q.id)}>
                      <Icon name="edit" size={12} />
                      {t('forms.button.changeOn', { question: labelOf(q) })}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            {!needs.length && askable && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.settings.needed.allHint')}</p>}
            <div className={s.alsoWhen} role="group" aria-label={t('forms.button.alsoOnlyWhenFor', { button: name })}>
              {button.enabledWhen && <p className={s.settingLabel}>{t('forms.button.alsoOnlyWhenTitle')}</p>}
              {readOnly ? (
                button.enabledWhen && (
                  <p className={s.readWhen}>
                    <PhraseView phrase={describeCondition(doc, button.enabledWhen, env)} />
                  </p>
                )
              ) : (
                <Slot
                  name="WhenBuilder"
                  at={{ item: button.id, part: 'enabledWhen' }}
                  stageId={props.stageId}
                  addLabel={t('forms.button.alsoOnlyWhen')}
                  value={button.enabledWhen}
                  onChange={(next) => run('button.setEnabledWhen', { button: button.id, ...(next ? { enabledWhen: next } : {}) })}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className={s.settingRow}>
            <label htmlFor={ids.message}>{t('forms.button.messageFor', { button: name })}</label>
            <CommitInput
              id={ids.message}
              value={button.messageWhileDisabled ?? ''}
              placeholder={fallback ?? ''}
              aria-describedby={`${ids.message}-hint`}
              onCommit={(message) => run('button.setMessageWhileDisabled', { button: button.id, ...(message.trim() ? { message } : {}) })}
            />
            <p id={`${ids.message}-hint`} className={s.quiet}>
              {fallback ? t('forms.button.messageHint', { default: fallback }) : t('forms.button.messageHintNone')}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className={s.settingGroup}>
            <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>{t('forms.button.thenGoTo')}</h3>
            <ButtonArrows doc={doc} task={task} stageId={props.stageId} button={button} />
            <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.button.otherCases')}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * Where a button goes, as the stage panel says it: "When Reject is pressed [+ only when ...] go to
 * Rejected", one line per arrow of the button (editor-model.md section 3). "+ only when ..." on the
 * plain arrow keeps it for every other request and adds a new arrow above it, as on the stage.
 */
function ButtonArrows({ doc, task, stageId, button }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; task: Task; stageId: string; button: FormButton }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
  const arrows = stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? (stage.arrows ?? []).filter((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === button.id) : [];
  const name = buttonLabel(button);
  if (!arrows.length) {
    return hasOtherArrows(doc, task) ? <p className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.button.byArrows')}</p> : <p className={s.missingText}>{t('forms.buttons.goesNowhere')}</p>;
  }
  const narrow = (plain: Arrow, onlyWhen: Condition) => {
    const made = createdId(run('arrow.add', { stage: stageId as StageId, when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: button.id } }));
    if (!made) return;
    run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', { arrow: made as ArrowId, onlyWhen });
    const now = getStage(useEditor.getState().doc ?? doc, stageId);
    const at = now && now.kind !== 'ending' ? (now.arrows ?? []).findIndex((a) => a.id === plain.id) : -1;
    if (at >= 0) run('arrow.move', { arrow: made as ArrowId, toIndex: at });
  };
  return (
    <ul className={s.arrowList}>
      {arrows.map((arrow, i) => {
        const words = describeArrow(doc, arrow);
        return (
          <li key={arrow.id} className={s.arrowLine}>
            <PhraseView phrase={words.when} />
            {arrow.onlyWhen && <span>{t('forms.button.and')}</span>}
            {readOnly ? (
              arrow.onlyWhen && (
                <span>
                  <PhraseView phrase={describeCondition(doc, arrow.onlyWhen)} />
                </span>
              )
            ) : (
            <div
              role="group"
              aria-label={arrows.length > 1 ? t('forms.button.onlyWhenForN', { button: name, n: i + 1 }) : t('forms.button.onlyWhenFor', { button: name })}
              className={s.slotGroup}
            >
              <Slot
                name="WhenBuilder"
                at={{ item: arrow.id, part: 'onlyWhen' }}
                stageId={stageId}
                addLabel={t('word.onlyWhen')}
                value={arrow.onlyWhen}
                onChange={(next) => {
                  if (next !== undefined && !arrow.onlyWhen) narrow(arrow, next);
                  else run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', { arrow: arrow.id, ...(next === undefined ? {} : { onlyWhen: next }) });
                }}
              />
            </div>
            )}
            <span>{t('forms.button.goTo')}</span>
            <PhraseView phrase={words.goTo} />
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/SwitchForm.tsx\n===
/**
 * "Switch form" (mockup 06-form__switch-form): every form of the workflow, in diagram order, each
 * with who fills it in and what it asks, so the author can see where a question belongs. The
 * shared Menu has one line per item, so this one is built here on the same menu parts.
 */
import * as RM from '@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Task } from '@/contract';
import { describeWhoIsAsked, toText } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import overlay from '@/ui/Overlay.module.css';
import { joinNames, labelOf, questionsOf } from './logic';
import s from './forms.module.css';

/** At most this many question names are said; more are "and more". */
const NAMED = 5;

export type FormEntry = { stageId: string; task: Task; label: string };

/** Every form of the workflow, in diagram order: "Request form", "Domain approval", "Several at once · Security team". */
export function formsOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): FormEntry[] {
  const out: FormEntry[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    const tasks = stage.tasks ?? [];
    for (const task of tasks) {
      const name = stage.name?.trim() || t('describe.noName');
      out.push({
        stageId: stage.id,
        task,
        label: tasks.length > 1 ? t('forms.switchForm.taskOfStage', { stage: name, who: toText(describeWhoIsAsked(doc, task)) }) : name,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** "Filled in by the requester when they start a request. Asks Title, Description and more." */
export function formDetail(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, entry: FormEntry): string {
  const who = doc.start?.stage === entry.stageId
    ? t('forms.switchForm.byRequester')
    : t('forms.switchForm.by', { who: toText(describeWhoIsAsked(doc, entry.task)) });
  const names = questionsOf(entry.task).map(labelOf);
  const asks = names.length === 0
    ? t('forms.switchForm.asksNothing')
    : names.length > NAMED
      ? t('forms.switchForm.asksMore', { questions: names.slice(0, NAMED).join(t('describe.comma')) })
      : t('forms.switchForm.asks', { questions: joinNames(names) });
  return `${who} ${asks}`;
}

export function SwitchForm({ doc, taskId, onOpen }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; taskId: string; onOpen(entry: FormEntry): void }) {
  const forms = formsOf(doc);
  return (
    <RM.Root>
      <RM.Trigger asChild>
        <Button size="sm" icon="form" after={<Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} />}>
          {t('forms.switchForm')}
        </Button>
      </RM.Trigger>
      <RM.Portal>
        <RM.Content className={`${overlay.popover} ${overlay.menu} ${s.switchMenu}`} align="start" sideOffset={6} collisionPadding={12}>
          <RM.Label className={overlay.menuGroup}>{t('forms.switchForm.group')}</RM.Label>
          {forms.map((f) => {
            const current = f.task.id === taskId;
            return (
              <RM.Item key={f.task.id} className={[overlay.menuItem, s.switchItem].join(' ')} onSelect={() => onOpen(f)}>
                <Icon name="form" />
                <span className={s.switchText}>
                  <span className={s.switchName}>
                    {f.label}
                    {current && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('forms.switchForm.editingNow')}</span>}
                  </span>
                  <span className={s.switchDetail}>{formDetail(doc, f)}</span>
                </span>
              </RM.Item>
            );
          })}
          <RM.Separator className={overlay.menuSep} />
          <p className={s.switchFoot}>{t('forms.switchForm.foot')}</p>
        </RM.Content>
      </RM.Portal>
    </RM.Root>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/ValueWords.tsx\n===
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { useDirectoryLabel } from '@/model';
import type { Json } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { plainText, refOf } from './logic';

/** A person's or group's name from the directory; "…" until it is known. */
export function DirectoryName({ json }: { json: Json }) {
  const ref = refOf(json);
  const label = useDirectoryLabel(ref);
  return <>{label ?? t('describe.gap')}</>;
}

/** A request's value in words: names for choices, rows, buttons and people, dates as the editor writes them. */
export function ValueWords({ doc, json }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; json: Json | undefined }) {
  const plain = plainText(doc, json);
  if (plain !== undefined) return <>{plain}</>;
  if (Array.isArray(json)) {
    return (
      <>
        {json.map((j, i) => (
          <Fragment key={i}>
            {i > 0 && (i === json.length - 1 ? ` ${t('describe.and')} ` : t('describe.comma'))}
            <ValueWords doc={doc} json={j} />
          </Fragment>
        ))}
      </>
    );
  }
  return json === undefined ? null : <DirectoryName json={json} />;
}

/**

/**
 * Pure helpers of the form editor and the form view: questions and their needs, which sources of
 * choices a kind may take (decision E-23), the answer JSON of each kind (core-api.md 2.4), choices
 * from the document, and the words that join a list of names. Nothing here decides what is shown or
 * which button can be pressed: that is `core.formState`.
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, Button, CatalogueEntry, Catalogue, Choices, FormItem, Page, Question, QuestionKind, Task,
} from '@/contract';
import { describeConstant, describeExpression, describeFinding, find, getList, toText, type FindingEnv } from '@/model';
import type { Finding, Json } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';

export const QUESTION_KINDS: readonly QuestionKind[] = [
  'text', 'longText', 'number', 'yesNo', 'date', 'choice', 'multipleChoice', 'person', 'group',
];

/** The icon and the words of each kind (the shared kind words in src/words/core.ts). */
export const KIND_ICON = {
  text: 'text',
  longText: 'longtext',
  number: 'number',
  yesNo: 'yesno',
  date: 'date',
  choice: 'choice',
  multipleChoice: 'multichoice',
  person: 'person',
  group: 'group',
} as const satisfies Record<QuestionKind, string>;

export const kindWords = (kind: QuestionKind): string => t(`valueKind.${KIND_ICON[kind]}` as WordKey);

export const KIND_LINE: Record<QuestionKind, WordKey> = {
  text: 'forms.kind.line.text',
  longText: 'forms.kind.line.longText',
  number: 'forms.kind.line.number',
  yesNo: 'forms.kind.line.yesNo',
  date: 'forms.kind.line.date',
  choice: 'forms.kind.line.choice',
  multipleChoice: 'forms.kind.line.multipleChoice',
  person: 'forms.kind.line.person',
  group: 'forms.kind.line.group',
};

/** Where a question's choices may come from. `none` on a person or group: anyone in the directory. */
export type ChoicesFrom = Choices['from'] | 'none';

/**
 * The sources of choices offered for each kind, in the order shown. Decision E-23: the first build
 * cannot run choices from a connection or the directory on a multiple-choice or group question, nor
 * typed-in or list choices on a person question, so those are not offered.
 */
export function choicesOffered(kind: QuestionKind): ChoicesFrom[] {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'choice':
      return ['typedIn', 'list', 'source', 'formula'];
    case 'multipleChoice':
      return ['typedIn', 'list', 'formula'];
    case 'person':
      return ['none', 'directory', 'source', 'formula'];
    case 'group':
      return ['none', 'typedIn', 'list', 'formula'];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

export const kindHasChoices = (kind: QuestionKind): boolean => choicesOffered(kind).length > 0;

/** A form's questions, every page, in order. */
export function questionsOf(task: Task): Question[] {
  return (task.form?.pages ?? []).flatMap((p) => p.items ?? []).filter((i): i is Question => i.type === 'question');
}

/**
 * The answers of questions that are not shown with these answers (the question, or its page, is not in
 * the form state's `shown`). The engine refuses such an answer (`hidden-answered`), so the form drops it.
 */
export function hiddenAnswers(task: Task, shown: readonly string[], answers: Partial<Record<string, Json>>): string[] {
  const on = new Set(shown);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
    for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
      if (item.type !== 'question' || answers[item.id] === undefined) continue;
      if (!on.has(page.id) || !on.has(item.id)) out.push(item.id);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The questions a button needs: its "Needed to press" plus every question ticked "All", in form order. */
export function neededQuestions(task: Task, button: Button): Question[] {
  const ids = new Set<string>(button.neededToPress ?? []);
  return questionsOf(task).filter((q) => q.neededForEveryButton || ids.has(q.id));
}

/** The buttons a question is needed to press. */
export function buttonsNeeding(task: Task, question: Question): Button[] {
  return (task.buttons ?? []).filter((b) => question.neededForEveryButton || (b.neededToPress ?? []).includes(question.id));
}

export const labelOf = (q: Question): string => q.label?.trim() || t('describe.noName');
export const buttonLabel = (b: Button): string => b.label?.trim() || t('describe.noName');
export const pageTitle = (page: Page, index: number): string => page.title?.trim() || t('forms.page.untitled', { n: index + 1 });

/** A text's name is at most this long; longer is cut with "...". */
const TEXT_NAME_LENGTH = 40;

/**
 * What a form item is called in the pages list and in a control's name: a question by its label; a
 * text by what it says (its first line, when that line has words of its own: "The deploy of Service
 * failed"), else by the values it shows ("Shows Title, Description and 3 more"), else "Text 2" by its
 * place among the texts.
 */
export function itemName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, item: FormItem): string {
  if (item.type === 'question') return labelOf(item);
  const lines: { text: string; words: boolean }[] = [{ text: '', words: false }];
  const values: string[] = [];
  for (const piece of item.content ?? []) {
    if (typeof piece === 'string') {
      piece.split('\n').forEach((part, i) => {
        if (i > 0) lines.push({ text: '', words: false });
        const line = lines[lines.length - 1]!;
        line.text += part;
        if (/\p{L}/u.test(part)) line.words = true;
      });
    } else {
      const name = toText(describeExpression(doc, piece));
      values.push(name);
      lines[lines.length - 1]!.text += name;
    }
  }
  const first = lines.find((l) => l.text.trim());
  if (first?.words) {
    const text = first.text.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/[:,]$/, '');
    return text.length > TEXT_NAME_LENGTH ? `${text.slice(0, TEXT_NAME_LENGTH - 3).trimEnd()}...` : text;
  }
  if (values.length > 2) return t('forms.text.showsMore', { values: values.slice(0, 2).join(t('describe.comma')), n: values.length - 2 });
  if (values.length) return t('forms.text.shows', { values: joinNames(values) });
  const texts = (task.form?.pages ?? []).flatMap((p) => p.items ?? []).filter((i) => i.type === 'text');
  return t('forms.text.name', { n: texts.findIndex((x) => x.id === item.id) + 1 });
}

/** "A", "A and B", "A, B and C", with the shared list words (src/words/describe.ts). */
export function joinNames(names: readonly string[]): string {
  if (names.length <= 1) return names[0] ?? '';
  return `${names.slice(0, -1).join(t('describe.comma'))} ${t('describe.and')} ${names[names.length - 1] ?? ''}`;
}

// ── answers (core-api.md 2.4) ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Option {
  /** Exactly what is sent as the answer (or one item of a multiple-choice answer). */
  value: Json;
  label: string;
  /** Quiet words after the label (a group's name, a service's team). */
  detail?: string;
}

/** True when an answer counts as given: never `""`, `[]` or null (an empty answer is a missing key). */
export function isAnswered(answer: Json | undefined): boolean {
  if (answer === undefined || answer === null) return false;
  if (typeof answer === 'string') return answer !== '';
  if (Array.isArray(answer)) return answer.length > 0;
  return true;
}

/** The answers with one changed; an empty answer leaves the key out. */
export function withAnswer<A extends Partial<Record<string, Json>>>(answers: A, questionId: string, answer: Json | undefined): A {
  const next = { ...answers } as Partial<Record<string, Json>>;
  if (isAnswered(answer)) next[questionId] = answer as Json;
  else delete next[questionId];
  return next as A;
}

/** Two answers are the same (a person by type and id, a connection's choice by what is kept). */
export function sameAnswer(a: Json | undefined, b: Json | undefined): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (!a || !b || typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object' || Array.isArray(a) || Array.isArray(b)) return false;
  if ('id' in a && 'id' in b) return a.id === b.id && a.type === b.type;
  if ('stored' in a && 'stored' in b) return a.stored === b.stored;
  return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
}

/** A directory reference in an answer (`{ type, id }`), or undefined. */
export function refOf(answer: Json | undefined): { type: 'user' | 'group'; id: string } | undefined {
  if (!answer || typeof answer !== 'object' || Array.isArray(answer)) return undefined;
  const { type, id } = answer as { type?: unknown; id?: unknown };
  return (type === 'user' || type === 'group') && typeof id === 'string' ? { type, id } : undefined;
}

/** A list row's words: the shown column's cell, else the first column's. */
export function rowLabel(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, listId: string, rowId: string, shownColumn?: string): string {
  const list = getList(doc, listId);
  const row = list?.rows?.find((r) => r.id === rowId);
  if (!list || !row) return t('describe.noName');
  const column = shownColumn ?? list.columns?.[0]?.id;
  const cell = column ? row.cells?.[column as keyof typeof row.cells] : undefined;
  return cell ? toText(describeConstant(doc, cell)) : t('describe.noName');
}

/** The choices kept in the document: typed in, or a list's rows. Others come from elsewhere. */
export function documentOptions(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, question: Question): Option[] | undefined {
  const choices = question.choices;
  if (choices?.from === 'typedIn') return (choices.choices ?? []).map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: c.label?.trim() || t('describe.noName') }));
  if (choices?.from === 'list') {
    const list = getList(doc, choices.list);
    return (list?.rows ?? []).map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: rowLabel(doc, choices.list, r.id, choices.shownColumn) }));
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * A value as plain words, without the directory: a choice, row or button by its name, a date as
 * the editor writes dates, Yes/No, a connection's choice by its label. A person or group gives
 * undefined (its name comes from the directory).
 */
export function plainText(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, json: Json | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (json === undefined || json === null) return '';
  if (typeof json === 'boolean') return t(json ? 'describe.yes' : 'describe.no');
  if (typeof json === 'number') return String(json);
  if (typeof json === 'string') {
    const entry = find(doc, json);
    if (entry?.kind === 'choice' || entry?.kind === 'button') return entry.item.label || t('describe.noName');
    if (entry?.kind === 'row') return rowLabel(doc, entry.parents.list ?? '', entry.id);
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(json)) return toText(describeConstant(doc, { date: json }));
    return json;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(json)) {
    const parts = json.map((j) => plainText(doc, j));
    return parts.some((p) => p === undefined) ? undefined : joinNames(parts as string[]);
  }
  if ('label' in json && typeof json.label === 'string') return json.label;
  if (refOf(json)) return undefined;
  return '';
}

// ── the catalogue ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** The data sources of ready connections, by connection, for "From a connection". The directory is offered as "People from the directory". */
export function dataSources(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined): { connection: string; label: string; entries: Extract<CatalogueEntry, { kind: 'dataSource' }>[] }[] {
  if (!catalogue) return [];
  return (catalogue.connections ?? [])
    .filter((c) => c.id !== catalogue.directoryConnection && c.status !== 'disabled')
    .map((c) => ({
      connection: c.id,
      label: c.label,
      entries: catalogue.entries.filter((e): e is Extract<CatalogueEntry, { kind: 'dataSource' }> => e.kind === 'dataSource' && e.connection === c.id),
    }))
    .filter((c) => c.entries.length > 0);
}

export function sourceEntry(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, ref: string | undefined) {
  const entry = ref ? catalogue?.entries.find((e) => e.id === ref) : undefined;
  return entry?.kind === 'dataSource' ? entry : undefined;
}

/** The item field people see and the one kept: the question's own, else "name" and "id", else the first fields. */
export function sourceFields(entry: Extract<CatalogueEntry, { kind: 'dataSource' }>, choices: Extract<Choices, { from: 'source' }>) {
  const ids = (entry.item ?? []).map((f) => f.id);
  const label = choices.labelField ?? (ids.includes('name') ? 'name' : ids[1] ?? ids[0] ?? '');
  const stored = choices.storedField ?? (ids.includes('id') ? 'id' : ids[0] ?? '');
  return { label, stored };
}

/** The catalogue's sample items of a data source as choices (the editor's preview, marked as samples). */
export function sampleSourceOptions(entry: Extract<CatalogueEntry, { kind: 'dataSource' }>, choices: Extract<Choices, { from: 'source' }>): Option[] {
  const { label, stored } = sourceFields(entry, choices);
  return (entry.sample?.items ?? []).map((item) => {
    const shown = item[label];
    const kept = item[stored];
    const words = typeof shown === 'string' || typeof shown === 'number' ? String(shown) : t('describe.noName');
    return { value: { stored: typeof kept === 'number' ? kept : String(kept ?? words), label: words }, label: words };
  });
}

/** The connection's name of a catalogue entry. */
export function connectionName(catalogue: Catalogue | null | undefined, connection: string | undefined): string {
  return catalogue?.connections.find((c) => c.id === connection)?.label ?? connection ?? '';
}

/**
 * Findings as lines people read, each said once: several parts of one question can be unfinished
 * for the same reason ("has no choices yet" at the connection, what to show and what is kept), and
 * the same sentence three times says nothing more.
 */
export function distinctFindings(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  findings: readonly Finding[],
  env: FindingEnv,
  withEffect = true,
): { key: string; todo: boolean; text: string }[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: { key: string; todo: boolean; text: string }[] = [];
  for (const f of findings) {
    const words = describeFinding(doc, f, env);
    const text = withEffect && words.effect ? `${words.cause} ${words.effect}` : words.cause;
    const key = `${f.severity}|${text}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push({ key, todo: f.severity === 'todo', text });
  }
  return out;
}

/** The ID a command made (page.add, question.add ...), or undefined when it was refused. */
export function createdId(result: unknown): string | undefined {
  return result && typeof result === 'object' && 'id' in result && typeof result.id === 'string' ? result.id : undefined;
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/parts.tsx\n===
/** Small pieces the form editor uses in many places. */
import {
  createContext, forwardRef, Fragment, useCallback, useContext, useRef, useState, type InputHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Template } from '@/contract';
import { describeExpression, isChip, isMissing, toText, useEditor, type DescribeEnv, type HistoryEntry, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import s from './forms.module.css';

/**
 * True when the person may not change the workflow (`useMay().edit` false): the form editor then
 * shows the form and its settings but no control that changes anything. Set by FormEditorPage.
 */
export const ReadOnlyContext = createContext(false);
export const useReadOnly = () => useContext(ReadOnlyContext);

/**
 * Typing in a box saves as it is typed, through the box's own named command, and the whole typing
 * is one change for Undo: each command run while one typing goes on is folded into the history
 * entry the first one made, as long as nothing else changed the document in between. `end()` closes
 * the typing (the box lost focus, Enter): the next keystroke starts a new change.
 * Only the history is touched here; the document itself is changed by the commands alone.
 */
export function useTyping() {
  const open = useRef<HistoryEntry | null>(null);
  const typed = useCallback((apply: () => unknown) => {
    const pastBefore = useEditor.getState().past;
    apply();
    const now = useEditor.getState();
    if (now.past === pastBefore || now.past.length === 0) return;
    const added = now.past[now.past.length - 1]!;
    const prev = now.past[now.past.length - 2];
    if (open.current && prev === open.current && prev.name === added.name) {
      const merged: HistoryEntry = { name: added.name, before: prev.before, after: added.after };
      useEditor.setState({ past: [...now.past.slice(0, -2), merged] });
      open.current = merged;
    } else {
      open.current = added;
    }
  }, []);
  const end = useCallback(() => {
    open.current = null;
  }, []);
  return { typed, end };
}

/** A describe phrase on screen: words as text, chips as small tinted chips, unfinished parts in amber with their words. */
export function PhraseView({ phrase }: { phrase: Phrase }) {
  return (
    <>
      {phrase.map((part, i) => {
        if (typeof part === 'string') return <Fragment key={i}>{part}</Fragment>;
        if (isChip(part)) {
          const cls = [s.pchip, s[`pchip_${part.chip}`], part.missing ? s.pchipMissing : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
          return (
            <span key={i} className={cls}>
              {part.label}
            </span>
          );
        }
        return (
          <span key={i} className={isMissing(part) ? s.missingText : undefined}>
            {part.text}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

type CommitProps = Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'value' | 'onChange'> & {
  value: string;
  /**
   * Called with the text as it is typed (each keystroke), so the document, its To do and the page
   * around the box follow while the author is still in it; the typing is one change for Undo.
   * Escape puts back the text the box had when it got focus. Never called when read only.
   */
  onCommit(next: string): void;
};

/** A text field that saves as it is typed, through its own named command (one undo step per typing). */
export const CommitInput = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CommitProps>(function CommitInput({ value, onCommit, onBlur, onFocus, onKeyDown, readOnly: ownReadOnly, ...rest }, ref) {
  const readOnly = useReadOnly() || !!ownReadOnly;
  const { typed, end } = useTyping();
  const [text, setText] = useState(value);
  // What the box held when it got focus: Escape goes back to it.
  const atFocus = useRef(value);
  // The document changed underneath (undo, another control): show what it holds now.
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(value);
  if (seen !== value) {
    setSeen(value);
    setText(value);
  }
  const save = (next: string) => {
    setText(next);
    if (next !== value) typed(() => onCommit(next));
  };
  return (
    <TextInput
      ref={ref}
      value={text}
      readOnly={readOnly}
      onChange={(e) => {
        if (!readOnly) save(e.target.value);
      }}
      onFocus={(e) => {
        atFocus.current = value;
        end();
        onFocus?.(e);
      }}
      onBlur={(e) => {
        end();
        onBlur?.(e);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          end();
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && text !== atFocus.current && !readOnly) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          save(atFocus.current);
        }
        onKeyDown?.(e);
      }}
      {...rest}
    />
  );
});

/**
 * After "Move ... up" or "Move ... down": focus stays on the moved thing's move button in the same
 * direction, or on the other one once it reaches the end (the first is then disabled), so focus never
 * falls to the page. The buttons carry `data-move="<id>:up"` and `data-move="<id>:down"`.
 */
export function focusMoved(id: string, direction: 'up' | 'down') {
  const pick = (dir: 'up' | 'down') => document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-move="${id}:${dir}"]`);
  const go = () => {
    const first = pick(direction);
    const other = pick(direction === 'up' ? 'down' : 'up');
    const target = first && !first.disabled ? first : other && !other.disabled ? other : first;
    target?.focus();
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(go);
}

/** A text with value chips (a form's text, a message), read only: words as text, each value as a chip. */
export function TemplateWords({ doc, template, env }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; template: Template | undefined; env?: DescribeEnv }) {
  return (
    <span className={s.text}>
      {(template ?? []).map((piece, i) =>
        typeof piece === 'string' ? (
          <Fragment key={i}>{piece}</Fragment>
        ) : (
          <span key={i} className={s.vchip}>
            {toText(describeExpression(doc, piece, env))}
          </span>
        ),
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Words with parts of the page in them: each {name} in the words is replaced by `fill[name]` (a name from the directory, a chip). */
export function Words({ k, fill }: { k: WordKey; fill: Record<string, ReactNode> }) {
  const text = t(k);
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)) {
    const name = m[1] ?? '';
    if (!(name in fill)) continue;
    out.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
    out.push(<Fragment key={out.length}>{fill[name]}</Fragment>);
    last = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
  }
  out.push(text.slice(last));
  return <>{out}</>;
}===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/sample.ts\n===
/**
 * The sample request, as the form editor uses it: its values as JSON (core.sampleValues), and who
 * is asked for it ("for the sample: Payments approvers", core.evaluate).
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Task } from '@/contract';
import { useCatalogue } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Json, type SampleValues } from '@/services';

const EMPTY: SampleValues = { values: {} };

export function useSampleValues(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null): SampleValues {
  const services = useServices();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const [sample, setSample] = useState<SampleValues>(EMPTY);
  const request = doc?.sampleRequest;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!doc || !request) return;
    let live = true;
    // With the catalogue, a value saved from a connection's result has its kind (core-api.md 2.4).
    services.core.sampleValues(doc, request, catalogue ?? undefined).then(
      (got) => live && setSample(got),
      () => undefined,
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
    // Only the sample request changes the sample values.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, request, catalogue]);
  return sample;
}

/** Who a task asks for the sample request: a person, a group or several people; undefined while unknown. */
export function useSampleWho(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null, task: Task | undefined): Json | undefined {
  const services = useServices();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const [who, setWho] = useState<{ for: unknown; value: Json } | null>(null);
  const expression = task?.whoIsAsked;
  const sample = doc?.sampleRequest;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!doc || !task || !expression || !sample || !catalogue) return;
    let live = true;
    services.core.evaluate(doc, catalogue, { item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' }, expression, sample).then(
      (got) => live && got.result === 'value' && setWho({ for: expression, value: got.value }),
      () => undefined,
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
    // The task's who is asked and the sample decide it.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, catalogue, task?.id, expression, sample]);
  return who && who.for === expression ? who.value : undefined;
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/useChoices.ts\n===
/**
 * The choices offered for one question, wherever they come from (core-api.md 7.1):
 *  - typed in and list choices: the document;
 *  - a formula: `FormState.choices`;
 *  - the directory and a connection: `loadChoices` (the runtime's or Try it's choices call), with
 *    what the person types as the search. In the editor's preview there is no `loadChoices`: a
 *    connection shows the catalogue's sample items and the directory the people of the sample
 *    request's group, each marked as a sample;
 *  - a person or group question with no choices: the whole directory, searched.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Question } from '@/contract';
import type { FormState, Json, Services } from '@/services';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import { documentOptions, plainText, sampleSourceOptions, sourceEntry, type Option } from './logic';
import { useAnyCatalogue } from './useFormState';

/** A choice handed out by the choices call: a source item's stored value (text or a number, as the source has it) or a person's directory ID. */
export type LoadChoices = (questionId: string, search: string) => Promise<{ stored: string | number; label: string }[]>;

export interface ChoicesNow {
  options: Option[];
  loading: boolean;
  failed: boolean;
  /** The options are samples, not what people will see: say so. */
  sample?: { kind: 'source'; connection: string } | { kind: 'directory'; group: string };
  /** The list is searched as the person types (else it is filtered here). */
  searched: boolean;
}

const SEARCH_QUIET_MS = 200;

/** Options from the choices call: a directory person as `{ type: 'user', id }`, a connection's choice as `{ stored, label }`. */
function fromLoaded(question: Question, loaded: { stored: string | number; label: string }[]): Option[] {
  // A person's directory ID is text; a source item's stored value stays as the source has it.
  if (question.choices?.from === 'directory') return loaded.map((c) => ({ value: { type: 'user', id: String(c.stored) }, label: c.label }));
  return loaded.map((c) => ({ value: { stored: c.stored, label: c.label }, label: c.label }));
}

async function directorySample(services: Services, doc: AuthoredWorkflow, question: Question): Promise<{ options: Option[]; group: string }> {
  const choices = question.choices;
  if (choices?.from !== 'directory' || !doc.sampleRequest) return { options: [], group: '' };
  const catalogue = await services.catalogue.getCatalogue();
  if (!catalogue.ok) return { options: [], group: '' };
  const got = await services.core.evaluate(doc, catalogue.value, { item: question.id, part: 'choices.peopleIn' }, choices.peopleIn, doc.sampleRequest);
  if (got.result !== 'value' || !got.value || typeof got.value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(got.value)) return { options: [], group: '' };
  const ref = got.value as { type?: string; id?: string };
  if (ref.type !== 'group' || !ref.id) return { options: [], group: '' };
  const [members, named] = await Promise.all([
    services.directory.membersOf({ type: 'group', id: ref.id }),
    services.directory.lookup([{ type: 'group', id: ref.id }]),
  ]);
  const group = named[0]?.label ?? '';
  return { options: members.map((m) => ({ value: { type: m.type, id: m.id }, label: m.label, detail: group })), group };
}

export function useChoices(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  question: Question,
  state: FormState | null,
  loadChoices: LoadChoices | undefined,
  search: string,
  open: boolean,
): ChoicesNow {
  const services = useServices();
  const catalogue = useAnyCatalogue();
  const from = question.choices?.from;
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<{ now: ChoicesNow; for: string } | null>(null);

  const fromDoc = documentOptions(doc, question);
  const formula: Json[] | undefined = from === 'formula' ? state?.choices?.[question.id] : undefined;
  const remote = from === 'directory' || from === 'source' || ((question.kind === 'person' || question.kind === 'group') && !from);
  const choicesKey = JSON.stringify(question.choices ?? null);
  const asking = `|||`;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!remote || !open) return;
    let live = true;
    const run = async (): Promise<ChoicesNow> => {
      if (!from) {
        const found = await services.directory.search(search, [question.kind === 'group' ? 'group' : 'user']);
        return { options: found.map((e) => ({ value: { type: e.type, id: e.id }, label: e.label, ...(e.detail ? { detail: e.detail } : {}) })), loading: false, failed: false, searched: true };
      }
      if (loadChoices) {
        const got = await loadChoices(question.id, search);
        return { options: fromLoaded(question, got), loading: false, failed: false, searched: true };
      }
      if (from === 'source' && question.choices?.from === 'source') {
        const entry = sourceEntry(catalogue, question.choices.source);
        const options = entry ? sampleSourceOptions(entry, question.choices) : [];
        return { options, loading: false, failed: false, searched: false, sample: { kind: 'source', connection: entry?.connection ?? '' } };
      }
      const { options, group } = await directorySample(services, doc, question);
      return { options, loading: false, failed: false, searched: false, sample: { kind: 'directory', group } };
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(
      () => {
        run().then(
          (next) => live && setLoaded({ now: next, for: asking }),
          () => live && setLoaded({ now: { options: [], loading: false, failed: true, searched: false }, for: asking }),
        );
      },
      search ? SEARCH_QUIET_MS : 0,
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
    // choicesKey stands for question.choices.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [remote, open, from, search, loadChoices, services, catalogue, doc, question.id, question.kind, choicesKey, asking]);

  if (fromDoc) return { options: fromDoc, loading: false, failed: false, searched: false };
  if (from === 'formula') {
    const options = (formula ?? []).map((j) => ({ value: j, label: plainText(doc, j) ?? '' }));
    return { options, loading: state === null, failed: false, searched: false };
  }
  if (remote) {
    if (!loaded) return { options: [], loading: open, failed: false, searched: !!loadChoices || !from };
    return loaded.for === asking ? loaded.now : { ...loaded.now, loading: true };
  }
  return { options: [], loading: false, failed: false, searched: false };
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/forms/useFormState.ts\n===
/**
 * What a form shows and which buttons can be pressed, from services `core.formState` (core-api.md 7),
 * never from rules of our own. Called through the services, debounced while people type, and the
 * last good state is kept while a new one is worked out, so the form does not flicker.
 *
 * Where the form's conditions read a group's people (`needsLookups`), the people come from
 * `lookups` (a task page passes `TaskView.lookups`), and what is still missing is read from the
 * directory (the form editor, Try it), once, before asking again.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { getTask, useCatalogue } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Answers, type FormState, type KnownLookups, type Ref, type Services, type Values } from '@/services';
import { hiddenAnswers } from './logic';

/** The quiet period after a change before the form is worked out again. */
export const FORM_STATE_QUIET_MS = 150;

let fetched: { services: Services; catalogue: Promise<Catalogue | null> } | null = null;

/** The catalogue: the open workflow's, or fetched once from the services outside the editor. */
export function useAnyCatalogue(): Catalogue | null {
  const services = useServices();
  const session = useCatalogue();
  const [own, setOwn] = useState<Catalogue | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (session) return;
    let live = true;
    if (!fetched || fetched.services !== services) {
      fetched = {
        services,
        catalogue: services.catalogue.getCatalogue().then(
          (r) => (r.ok ? r.value : null),
          () => null,
        ),
      };
    }
    void fetched.catalogue.then((c) => {
      if (live) setOwn(c);
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, session]);
  return session ?? own;
}

export interface FormStateNow {
  /** The last good state; null until the first one is known. */
  state: FormState | null;
  /** True while a newer state is being worked out. */
  working: boolean;
  /**
   * The answers the state is for: the answers given, less those of questions that are not shown.
   * Undefined while working. When it differs from the answers given, the form drops the hidden ones.
   */
  shownAnswers?: Answers;
}

export function useFormState(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  taskId: string,
  answers: Answers,
  values: Values,
  request: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string } | undefined,
  lookups: KnownLookups | undefined,
): FormStateNow {
  const services = useServices();
  const catalogue = useAnyCatalogue();
  // The state, and the inputs it was worked out for: while they are not the current inputs, a new one is coming.
  const [now, setNow] = useState<{ state: FormState | null; for: unknown; answers?: Answers }>({ state: null, for: null });
  const requesterType = request?.requester?.type;
  const requesterId = request?.requester?.id;
  const startedOn = request?.startedOn;
  const facts = useMemo(
    () => ({
      ...(requesterType && requesterId ? { requester: { type: requesterType, id: requesterId } } : {}),
      ...(startedOn ? { startedOn } : {}),
    }),
    [requesterType, requesterId, startedOn],
  );
  const asked = useRef(0);
  const inputs = useMemo(() => ({ catalogue, doc, taskId, answers, values, facts, lookups }), [catalogue, doc, taskId, answers, values, facts, lookups]);
  const first = useRef(true);
  const lastTask = useRef(taskId);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!catalogue) return;
    const n = ++asked.current;
    if (lastTask.current !== taskId) {
      lastTask.current = taskId;
      first.current = true;
    }
    const work = async () => {
      let given: Answers = answers;
      const ask = (known?: KnownLookups) => services.core.formState(doc, catalogue, { item: taskId }, given, values, facts, known);
      let known: KnownLookups | undefined = lookups;
      let result = await ask(known);
      if (result.result === 'needsLookups') {
        const membersOf: Record<string, Ref[]> = { ...(lookups?.membersOf ?? {}) } as Record<string, Ref[]>;
        await Promise.all(
          result.lookups.map(async ({ membersOf: group }) => {
            if (membersOf[group.id]) return;
            try {
              const people = await services.directory.membersOf(group);
              membersOf[group.id] = people.map(({ type, id }) => ({ type, id }));
            } catch {
              membersOf[group.id] = [];
            }
          }),
        );
        known = { membersOf };
        result = await ask(known);
      }
      // Answers of questions that are not shown are dropped and the form asked again, until none is
      // left: a hidden answer is never sent (the engine refuses it), and a dropped answer may hide more.
      const task = getTask(doc, taskId);
      for (let round = 0; task && result.result === 'state' && round < 10; round++) {
        const hidden = hiddenAnswers(task, result.state.shown, given);
        if (!hidden.length) break;
        given = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(given).filter(([q]) => !hidden.includes(q))) as Answers;
        result = await ask(known);
      }
      if (n !== asked.current) return;
      if (result.result === 'state') setNow({ state: result.state, for: inputs, answers: given });
      else setNow((before) => ({ ...before, for: inputs }));
    };
    const delay = first.current ? 0 : FORM_STATE_QUIET_MS;
    first.current = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      work().catch(() => {
        if (n === asked.current) setNow((before) => ({ ...before, for: inputs }));
      });
    }, delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [services, catalogue, doc, taskId, answers, values, facts, lookups, inputs]);

  const working = now.for !== inputs;
  return { state: now.state, working, shownAnswers: !working ? now.answers : undefined };
}

    expect(rows.map((r) => r.textContent)).toEqual([

      'Domain approvalApproval',
      'Create Jira issueAutomatic',
      'DevelopmentWork',
      'ReleasedEnding',
      'RejectedEnding',
    ]);
    fireEvent.click(rows[3] as HTMLElement);
    expect(useEditor.getState().selection).toEqual({ item: 'st_development' });
  });

    const writeText = vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve());

    await setup();

    await setup();

    const print = vi.spyOn(window, 'print').mockImplementation(() => {});
    await setup();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Print' }));
    expect(print).toHaveBeenCalled();
    print.mockRestore();
  });

  it('writes a To do where it belongs, with "Fix this" that goes to its spot', async () => {
    await setup();
    await waitFor(() => expect(paragraphs()).toHaveLength(6));
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: 'ar_da_reject', goTo: null } as never));
    await waitFor(() => expect(useSession.getState().checkedDoc).toBe(useEditor.getState().doc));
    expect(await screen.findByText('This draft has 1 thing to do before publishing.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    const third = paragraphs()[2] as HTMLElement;
    expect(words(third)).toContain('Reject tells the requester and does not go anywhere yet. To do: the arrow "Reject pressed" does not go anywhere yet.');
    fireEvent.click(within(third).getByRole('button', { name: /^Fix this: To do: the arrow "Reject pressed"/ }));
    expect(useEditor.getState().selection).toEqual({ item: 'ar_da_reject', part: 'goTo' });
    const side = screen.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'About these words' });
    expect(within(side).getByRole('heading', { name: 'To do (1)' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The side column's To do ends with its paragraph and its fix, as mockup 13-in-words__to-do.
    expect(within(side).getByText('Paragraph 3. Choose a stage or ending.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
