/**
 * In words (editor-model.md section 9, mockup 13): the whole workflow as numbered plain
 * paragraphs, read-only. The sentences come from `describeInWords` in '@/model'; this screen only
 * draws them. Every bold stage name and every sentence opens its place on the Diagram tab (the
 * session's "Show me"); "Sam Carter is told" opens Settings; To do items sit in amber where they
 * belong, each with "Fix this". Copy puts the numbered sentences on the clipboard as plain text;
 * Print prints only the words.
 */
import { Fragment, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Location } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeFinding,
  describeInWords,
  inWordsOrder,
  inWordsText,
  openSettings,
  reveal,
  sentenceText,
  useDescribeEnv,
  useDirectoryLabel,
  useDoc,
  useFacts,
  useFindings,
  useSessionWorkflowId,
  useSettings,
  useVersions,
  type InWordsParagraph,
  type InWordsSentence,
} from '@/model';
import { Button, Callout, Card, EmptyState, Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import s from './inwords.module.css';
import { SentenceCard } from './SentenceCard';
import { useSameAsLive } from './useSameAsLive';
import { useStuckPeople } from './useStuckPeople';

/** How long the card beside a sentence stays after the pointer leaves, so the pointer can reach it. */
const CARD_LINGER_MS = 250;


const show = (at: Location) => reveal(at);

export function InWordsPage() {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const settings = useSettings();
  const { live } = useVersions();
  const findings = useFindings();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const describeEnv = useDescribeEnv();
  const author = useDirectoryLabel(settings?.authors?.[0]);
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const href = workflowId ? `#/w/${workflowId}` : '#';
  const sameAsLive = useSameAsLive();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<'ok' | 'failed' | null>(null);
  const [hot, setHotNow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const linger = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  /** A sentence pointed at or focused shows at once; leaving it hides it after a moment, so the pointer can reach its card. */
  const setHot = useCallback((key: string | null) => {
    clearTimeout(linger.current);
    if (key) setHotNow(key);
    else linger.current = setTimeout(() => setHotNow(null), CARD_LINGER_MS);
  }, []);
  const keepCard = useCallback((inside: boolean) => {
    clearTimeout(linger.current);
    if (!inside) linger.current = setTimeout(() => setHotNow(null), CARD_LINGER_MS);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(linger.current), []);
  // The card that appears on its own when a sentence is pointed at goes away with Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hot) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        clearTimeout(linger.current);
        setHotNow(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [hot]);

  const env = useMemo(() => ({ ...describeEnv, stuckPeople }), [describeEnv, stuckPeople]);
  const paragraphs = useMemo(() => (doc ? describeInWords(doc, { ...env, findings, facts }) : []), [doc, env, findings, facts]);
  const order = useMemo(() => (doc ? inWordsOrder(doc) : []), [doc]);
  const todos = useMemo(
    () =>
      paragraphs.flatMap((p, i) =>
        p.sentences
          .filter((x) => x.todo)
          .map((x) => ({
            sentence: x,
            paragraph: i + 1,
            stageId: p.stageId,
            // The To do's fix, as the To do list says it ("Choose who is asked").
            fix: doc && x.todo ? describeFinding(doc, x.todo.finding, env).fix?.label : undefined,
          })),
      ),
    [paragraphs, doc, env],
  );

  if (!doc) return null;
  const title = settings?.name ?? '';

  const copy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(inWordsText(paragraphs, title || undefined));
      setCopied('ok');
    } catch {
      setCopied('failed');
    }
  };

  const stageName = (id: string | undefined) => (id ? (doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === id)?.name ?? '') : '');

  return (
    <div className={s.layout}>
      <article className={`${s.main} ${s.printArea}`} aria-labelledby="inwords-title">
        <h1 id="inwords-title" className={s.title}>
          {title}
        </h1>
        <p className={s.meta}>
          {/* The same badge as the top bar's: Published while the draft is the version that is live (section 7). */}
          {sameAsLive && live !== null ? (
            <>
              <span className={s.published}>
                <Icon name="check" size={13} />
                {t('inwords.published')}
              </span>{' '}
              <strong>{t('inwords.publishedLine', { n: live })}</strong>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <span className={s.draft}>{t('version.draft')}</span>{' '}
              <strong>
                {t('inwords.draftLine')} {live ? t('inwords.liveLine', { n: live }) : t('inwords.notLiveLine')}
              </strong>
            </>
          )}
          {author && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('inwords.metaSep')}{t('inwords.byLine', { name: author })}</span>}
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('inwords.metaSep')}{t('inwords.writtenOut')}</span>
        </p>

        {todos.length > 0 && (
          <div className={s.noPrint}>
            <Callout tone="todo">
              <strong>{todos.length === 1 ? t('inwords.todoBanner.one') : t('inwords.todoBanner.many', { n: todos.length })}</strong>{' '}
              {t('inwords.todoBanner.text')}
            </Callout>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className={s.intro}>
          <Callout
            icon="book"
            actions={
              <span className={s.noPrint}>
                <Button size="sm" icon="copy" onClick={() => void copy()}>
                  {t('inwords.copy')}
                </Button>{' '}
                <Button size="sm" icon="print" onClick={() => window.print()}>
                  {t('inwords.print')}
                </Button>
              </span>
            }
          >
            {t('inwords.intro')}
          </Callout>
          <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className={copied === 'failed' ? s.copyFailed : s.copied}>
            {copied === 'ok' ? t('inwords.copied') : copied === 'failed' ? t('inwords.copyFailed') : ''}
          </p>
        </div>

        {paragraphs.length === 0 ? (
          <Card>
            <EmptyState icon="book" title={t('inwords.empty.title')}>
              {t('inwords.empty.text')}
            </EmptyState>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <ol className={s.paragraphs} aria-label={t('inwords.paragraphs')}>
            {paragraphs.map((p, i) => (
              <ParagraphItem
                key={p.key}
                n={i + 1}
                paragraph={p}
                hot={hot}
                setHot={setHot}
                keepCard={keepCard}
                stageName={stageName(p.stageId)}
                href={href}
              />
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
      </article>

      <aside className={`${s.side} ${s.noPrint}`} aria-label={t('inwords.side.label')}>
        {todos.length > 0 && (
          <section className={s.sideSection} aria-labelledby="inwords-side-todo">
            <h2 id="inwords-side-todo" className={s.sideHead}>
              {t('inwords.side.todo', { n: todos.length })}
            </h2>
            <ul className={s.todoList}>
              {todos.map(({ sentence, paragraph, stageId, fix }, i) => (
                <li key={i}>
                  <button type="button" className={s.todoCard} onClick={() => show(sentence.todo?.finding.location ?? sentence.at)}>
                    {stageId && <strong>{t('inwords.side.todoStage', { stage: stageName(stageId) })}</strong>}
                    {sentenceText({ ...sentence, runs: sentence.runs.filter((r) => !r.todoLead) }).trim()}
                    <span className={s.todoWhere}>
                      {fix ? t('inwords.side.todoWhereFix', { n: paragraph, fix }) : t('inwords.side.todoWhere', { n: paragraph })}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        )}

        <section className={s.sideSection} aria-labelledby="inwords-side-stages">
          <h2 id="inwords-side-stages" className={s.sideHead}>
            {t('inwords.side.stages')}
          </h2>
          <p className={s.sideLine}>{t('inwords.side.stagesLine')}</p>
          <ul className={s.stageList}>
            {order.map((id) => {
              const stage = doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === id);
              if (!stage) return null;
              const colour = doc.statuses.find((x) => x.id === stage.status)?.colour ?? 'grey';
              const stageTodos = todos.filter((x) => x.stageId === id).length;
              return (
                <li key={id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={s.stageRow}
                    onClick={() => show({ item: id })}
                    aria-label={t('inwords.openStage', { stage: stage.name || t('describe.noName') })}
                  >
                    <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: `var(--st-${colour})` }} aria-hidden />
                    <span className={s.stageName}>{stage.name || t('describe.noName')}</span>
                    <span className={stageTodos ? s.stageTodo : s.stageKind}>
                      {stageTodos ? t('inwords.side.todoCount', { n: stageTodos }) : t(`stageKind.${stage.kind}` as WordKey)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </section>

        <section className={s.sideSection} aria-labelledby="inwords-side-others">
          <h2 id="inwords-side-others" className={s.sideHead}>
            {t('inwords.side.forOthers')}
          </h2>
          <SideNote icon="copy" lead={t('inwords.copy')} text={t('inwords.side.copyNote')} />
          <SideNote icon="print" lead={t('inwords.print')} text={t('inwords.side.printNote')} />
          <SideNote icon="edit" text={t('inwords.side.readOnlyNote')} />
        </section>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

function SideNote({ icon, lead, text }: { icon: IconName; lead?: string; text: string }) {
  return (
    <p className={s.note}>
      <Icon name={icon} size={14} />
      <span>
        {lead && <strong>{lead} </strong>}
        {text}
      </span>
    </p>
  );
}

type ParagraphProps = {
  n: number;
  paragraph: InWordsParagraph;
  hot: string | null;
  setHot: (key: string | null) => void;
  keepCard: (inside: boolean) => void;
  stageName: string;
  href: string;
};

/** The card's width in pixels (inwords.module.css .card), to keep it inside its paragraph. */
const CARD_WIDTH = 330;

/**
 * The stage names of a paragraph that are links: the first time each stage is named. A stage named
 * again in the same paragraph is bold words, so no two controls in a paragraph share a name.
 */
function linkedStageRuns(paragraph: InWordsParagraph): Set<string> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const linked = new Set<string>();
  paragraph.sentences.forEach((sentence, i) =>
    sentence.runs.forEach((run, j) => {
      if (!run.stage || !run.text.trim() || seen.has(run.stage)) return;
      seen.add(run.stage);
      linked.add(`${i}:${j}`);
    }),
  );
  return linked;
}

function ParagraphItem({ n, paragraph, hot, setHot, keepCard, stageName, href }: ParagraphProps) {
  const li = useRef<HTMLLIElement>(null);
  const hotIndex = hot?.startsWith(`${paragraph.key}:`) ? Number(hot.slice(paragraph.key.length + 1)) : -1;
  const hotSentence = hotIndex >= 0 ? paragraph.sentences[hotIndex] : undefined;
  const cardId = `inwords-card-${paragraph.key}`;
  const [place, setPlace] = useState<{ top: number; left: number } | null>(null);
  const linked = useMemo(() => linkedStageRuns(paragraph), [paragraph]);

  // The card stands under the end of the sentence (mockup 13-in-words__linked), inside the paragraph.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!hotSentence || !li.current) {
      setPlace(null);
      return;
    }
    const box = li.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const el = li.current.querySelector(`[data-sentence="${hot}"]`);
    const rects = el ? Array.from(el.getClientRects()) : [];
    const last = rects[rects.length - 1];
    if (!last) {
      setPlace({ top: box.height, left: 40 });
      return;
    }
    const left = Math.max(40, Math.min(last.right - box.left - CARD_WIDTH / 2, box.width - CARD_WIDTH));
    setPlace({ top: last.bottom - box.top + 6, left });
  }, [hot, hotSentence]);

  // Each paragraph's button has a name of its own: a stage's arrows are not the stage's own paragraph.
  const changeLabel =
    paragraph.kind === 'endings'
      ? t('inwords.changeEndings')
      : stageName
        ? t(paragraph.kind === 'arrows' ? 'inwords.changeArrows' : 'inwords.changeStage', { stage: stageName })
        : t('inwords.change');
  return (
    <li ref={li} className={s.paragraph} data-paragraph={paragraph.key}>
      <span className={s.number} aria-hidden>
        {n}
      </span>
      <p className={s.text}>
        {paragraph.sentences.map((sentence, i) => {
          const key = `${paragraph.key}:${i}`;
          return (
            <span key={key}>
              {i > 0 && t('inwords.space')}
              <Sentence
                sentence={sentence}
                dataKey={key}
                href={href}
                hot={hot === key}
                isLinked={(j) => linked.has(`${i}:${j}`)}
                onHot={(on) => setHot(on ? key : null)}
              />
            </span>
          );
        })}
        {t('inwords.space')}
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`${s.change} ${s.noPrint}`}
          aria-label={changeLabel}
          onClick={() => show(paragraph.stageId && paragraph.kind !== 'arrows' ? { item: paragraph.stageId } : paragraph.at)}
        >
          <Icon name="edit" size={13} />
          {t('inwords.change')}
        </button>
      </p>
      {hotSentence && place && (
        <SentenceCard
          id={cardId}
          at={hotSentence.at}
          sentence={sentenceText(hotSentence)}
          top={place.top}
          left={place.left}
          onOpen={() => show(hotSentence.at)}
          onPointer={keepCard}
        />
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

/** A link's words without the spaces at its edges, which go outside it: " goes to " -> " ", "goes to", " ". */
function edges(text: string): [string, string, string] {
  const m = /^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/.exec(text);
  return [m?.[1] ?? '', m?.[2] ?? text, m?.[3] ?? ''];
}

/** Opens a place on the Diagram tab ("Show me"); the link's address is the Diagram tab, for a new tab. */
function placeClick(at: Location) {
  return (e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    show(at);
  };
}

/**
 * One sentence, as plain text (editor-model.md section 11: "a sentence is plain text; only stage
 * names are links"). A stage name is a link named for what it opens ("Open Request form on the
 * diagram"), the first time the paragraph names it. Pointing at the sentence shows the card beside
 * it with "Open on the diagram"; for the keyboard, the paragraph's "Change this on the diagram" and
 * the stage links go to the same places.
 */
function Sentence({
  sentence,
  dataKey,
  hot,
  isLinked,
  onHot,
  href,
}: {
  sentence: InWordsSentence;
  dataKey: string;
  hot: boolean;
  isLinked: (run: number) => boolean;
  onHot: (on: boolean) => void;
  href: string;
}) {
  const todo = sentence.todo;
  const fullText = sentenceText(sentence);
  const pieces = sentence.runs.map((run, i) => {
    const [before, text, after] = edges(run.text);
    let piece: ReactNode;
    if (run.stage && isLinked(i)) {
      piece = (
        <a href={href} className={s.stageLink} aria-label={t('inwords.openStage', { stage: text })} onClick={placeClick({ item: run.stage })}>
          {text}
        </a>
      );
    } else if (run.stage) {
      piece = <strong className={s.stageBold}>{text}</strong>;
    } else if (run.settings) {
      piece = (
        <button type="button" className={s.settingsLink} aria-label={t('inwords.settingsLink', { settings: text })} onClick={() => openSettings()}>
          {text}
        </button>
      );
    } else {
      const cls = [run.todoLead ? s.todoLead : '', run.missing ? s.missing : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
      piece = cls ? <span className={cls}>{text}</span> : text;
    }
    return (
      <Fragment key={i}>
        {before}
        {text ? piece : null}
        {after}
      </Fragment>
    );
  });
  return (
    <span
      data-sentence={dataKey}
      className={[s.sentence, hot ? s.hot : '', todo ? (todo.tone === 'contradictory' ? s.todoRed : s.todoAmber) : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
      onMouseEnter={() => onHot(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => onHot(false)}
    >
      {pieces}
      {todo && (
        <>
          {t('inwords.space')}
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`${s.fix} ${s.noPrint}`}
            aria-label={t('inwords.fixThisAbout', { what: fullText })}
            onClick={() => show(todo.finding.location ?? sentence.at)}
          >
            {t('inwords.fixThis')}
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}===\nfrontend/src/features/inwords/README.md\n===
# features/inwords

In words (editor-model.md section 9, mockup 13): the whole workflow as numbered plain paragraphs, read-only, with Copy and Print.

- Exports `InWordsPage` (route `/w/:workflowId/words`), from `InWordsPage.tsx`.
- The sentences are not built here: `describeInWords(doc, env)` in `src/model/describe/in-words.ts` gives paragraphs of sentences of runs, each knowing its place (`at`), the stages it names (`run.stage`), the "is told" words that open Settings (`run.settings`) and the To do items from the check (`sentence.todo`). `inWordsText` is the plain text for Copy; `inWordsOrder` is the order of the stages ("Stages, in order").
- The page: the workflow's name and the draft line; the To do line when anything is to do; "The whole workflow in plain words ..." with Copy and Print; the numbered paragraphs; beside them To do, "Stages, in order" and the notes for people who will not open the editor.
- Links (editor-model.md section 11: "a sentence is plain text; only stage names are links"): a sentence's words are plain text. A stage name is a link named "Open Request form on the diagram" that calls the session's `reveal`; a stage named again in the same paragraph is bold words, so no two controls in a paragraph share a name. A `run.settings` part (only a real `SettingsLink`) calls the model's `openSettings()`. Each paragraph ends with "Change this on the diagram", named for its stage ("Change Request form on the diagram"; a stage's arrows paragraph: "Change where Request form goes on the diagram"); each To do has "Fix this". Who is told about stuck requests comes from every ref in "Stuck requests go to" (`useStuckPeople.ts`), groups marked.
- The badge: "Published" and "These words describe version n, which is live now ..." while the draft is the very document that is live (`useSameAsLive.ts`, the same comparison as features/todo's top bar), otherwise "Draft (not live)".
- The card (`SentenceCard.tsx`, mockup 13-in-words__linked): pointing at a sentence shows what it is about ("An arrow"), where it is (`locationCrumbs`), an arrow's label, and "Open on the diagram". It lingers a moment so the pointer can reach it; Escape hides it. Its button is not a tab stop: for the keyboard, the paragraph's "Change ... on the diagram" and the stage links go to the same places.
- The side column's To do items end with their paragraph and their fix ("Paragraph 3. Choose a stage or ending."), from `describeFinding`, and go to the finding's own place.
- Print: `inwords.module.css` has a print stylesheet that hides everything but the words.
- Words: `src/words/inwords.ts`, keys starting with `inwords.` (the page's words and the sentences' words).
- Tests: `InWordsPage.test.tsx` (rendered, the demo), `src/model/describe/in-words.test.ts` (the wording), `tests/e2e/inwords.spec.ts`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/inwords/SentenceCard.tsx\n===
/**
 * The small card beside a sentence that is pointed at or focused (mockup 13-in-words__linked): what
 * kind of thing the sentence is about ("An arrow"), where it is on the diagram (the To do path from
 * `locationCrumbs`), an arrow's label as it is drawn, and "Open on the diagram". The words about the
 * document come from describe; this file only lays them out.
 *
 * For the keyboard the sentence's own link does what "Open on the diagram" does (Enter opens it), so
 * the card's button is not a second tab stop; the card's words describe the link (aria-describedby).
 */
import type { Location } from '@/contract';
import { arrowLabel, find, locationCrumbs, useDescribeEnv, useDoc } from '@/model';
import { Button, Chip } from '@/ui';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import s from './inwords.module.css';

type Props = {
  id: string;
  at: Location;
  /** The sentence's words, for the button's name. */
  sentence: string;
  /** Where the card stands inside its paragraph, in pixels. */
  top: number;
  left: number;
  onOpen(): void;
  onPointer(inside: boolean): void;
};

export function SentenceCard({ id, at, sentence, top, left, onOpen, onPointer }: Props) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  if (!doc) return null;
  const entry = find(doc, at.item);
  const kind: string = entry?.kind === 'stage' && entry.item.kind === 'ending' ? 'ending' : (entry?.kind ?? 'workflow');
  const arrow = entry?.kind === 'arrow' && !at.part ? entry.item : undefined;
  const crumbs = locationCrumbs(doc, at, env);
  // An arrow's label is shown as it is drawn, so the path stops before it.
  const label = arrow ? arrowLabel(doc, arrow) : '';
  const where = (arrow && crumbs[crumbs.length - 1] === label ? crumbs.slice(0, -1) : crumbs).join(t('describe.where.separator'));
  return (
    <span
      id={id}
      className={`${s.card} ${s.noPrint}`}
      style={{ top, left }}
      onMouseEnter={() => onPointer(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => onPointer(false)}
    >
      <span id={`${id}-words`} className={s.cardWords}>
        <span className={s.cardKind}>{t(`inwords.card.kind.${kind}` as WordKey)}</span>
        {where && <span className={s.cardLine}>{t('inwords.card.where', { where })}</span>}
        {arrow && label && (
          <span className={s.cardLine}>
            {t('inwords.card.labelled')}{' '}
            <Chip variant="button" size="sm">
              {label}
            </Chip>
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
      <span className={s.cardActions}>
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" icon="arrow-right" tabIndex={-1} aria-label={t('inwords.card.openAbout', { what: sentence })} onClick={onOpen}>
          {t('inwords.card.open')}
        </Button>
        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('inwords.card.orClick')}</span>
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}
