===\nfrontend/src/features/inwords/useSameAsLive.ts\n===
/**
 * Whether the draft on screen is the very document that is live, so the page's badge agrees with the
 * top bar's (editor-model.md section 7: "When the draft is the same as the live version the badge
 * reads Published"). True, false, or null while not known (nothing live, or the live version still
 * loading). The live version's document is fetched once per workflow and version; published
 * versions never change.
 *
 * features/todo has the same comparison for the top bar; a feature may not import another, so this
 * is a copy until the model offers one hook for both (asked for in the report).
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { useDoc, useSessionWorkflowId, useVersions } from '@/model';
import { useServices } from '@/services';

/** The same JSON, whatever the order of the keys (as the server compares a draft with what is live). */
export function sameDocument(a: AuthoredWorkflow, b: AuthoredWorkflow): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  const stable = (v: unknown): string => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return `[${v.map(stable).join(',')}]`;
    if (v && typeof v === 'object') {
      return `{${Object.keys(v)
        .filter((k) => (v as Record<string, unknown>)[k] !== undefined)
        .sort()
        .map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${stable((v as Record<string, unknown>)[k])}`)
        .join(',')}}`;
    }
    return JSON.stringify(v) ?? 'null';
  };
  return stable(a) === stable(b);
}

const liveDocs = new Map<string, AuthoredWorkflow>();

export function useSameAsLive(): boolean | null {
  const services = useServices();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const { live } = useVersions();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const key = workflowId && live !== null ? `${workflowId}@${live}` : null;
  // Bumped when a fetch lands, so the page reads the cache again.
  const [, setLoaded] = useState(0);
  const liveDoc = key ? liveDocs.get(key) : undefined;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!key || !workflowId || live === null || liveDocs.has(key)) return;
    let stale = false;
    services.authoring
      .getVersion(workflowId, live)
      .then((found) => {
        if (!found.ok) return;
        liveDocs.set(key, found.value.authored);
        if (!stale) setLoaded((n) => n + 1);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      stale = true;
    };
  }, [key, workflowId, live, services]);

  return useMemo(() => (doc && liveDoc ? sameDocument(doc, liveDoc) : null), [doc, liveDoc]);
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/inwords/useStuckPeople.ts\n===
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useSettings, type StuckPerson } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Ref } from '@/services';

const refKey = (r: Ref) => `${r.type}:${r.id}`;
/** Directory names asked for once per page (the directory is the same everywhere on the page). */
const known = new Map<string, string>();

/**
 * Everyone in "Stuck requests go to" (the authors when it is not set), by the directory's name, a
 * group marked as one, for "Platform team, who look after stuck requests, are told". A name not
 * known yet is left out until the directory answers (describe then says "the people who look after
 * stuck requests").
 */
export function useStuckPeople(): readonly StuckPerson[] {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const services = useServices();
  const refs: Ref[] = settings?.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : (settings?.authors ?? []);
  const key = refs.map(refKey).join('|');
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const missing = refs.filter((r) => !known.has(refKey(r)));
    if (!missing.length) return;
    let alive = true;
    services.directory
      .lookup(missing)
      .then((found) => {
        for (const e of found) known.set(refKey(e), e.label);
        if (alive) setTick((n) => n + 1);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
    // `key` stands for `refs`.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, key]);
  return useMemo(
    () => refs.flatMap((r) => {
      const name = known.get(refKey(r));
      return name ? [{ name, ...(r.type === 'group' ? { group: true } : {}) }] : [];
    }),
    // `key` and `tick` stand for the refs and the names learnt.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [key, tick],
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/ArrowsSection.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type DragEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { Arrow, ArrowId, AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Condition, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import {
  arrowLabel, describeArrowWhen, describeFinding, getStatus, getWorkingStage, planFindingFix, Slot, useArrowFacts, useCheckedDoc,
  useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useEditor, useFacts, useFindingsFor, useRun, useSelection, whenDoneIsOtherCases,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon, IconButton, Select } from '@/ui';
import {
  arrowName, colourVar, everyButtonHasArrow, earlierOf, holdNeverUsed, isPlainButtonArrow, orderMatters, suggestGoTo,
} from './logic';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { StageChooser } from './StageChooser';
import { useStuckPeople } from './useStuckName';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/** "Words on the arrow": the words drawn on it, worked out until the author rewords them. */
function ArrowWords({ arrow, name, sendsBack }: { arrow: Arrow; name: string; sendsBack: boolean }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const editRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const wasEditing = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wasEditing.current && !editing) editRef.current?.focus();
    wasEditing.current = editing;
  }, [editing]);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const label = arrowLabel(doc, arrow);
  const workedOut = arrowLabel(doc, { ...arrow, words: undefined });
  const commit = () => {
    const next = inputRef.current?.value.trim() ?? '';
    const words = next && next !== workedOut ? next : undefined;
    if ((words ?? '') !== (arrow.words ?? '')) run('arrow.setWords', { arrow: arrow.id, ...(words ? { words } : {}) });
    setEditing(false);
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      commit();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setEditing(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.wordsRow}>
      <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.arrow.words')}</span>
      {editing ? (
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          className={s.inlineInput}
          aria-label={t('panel.arrow.wordsLabel', { arrow: name })}
          defaultValue={arrow.words ?? workedOut}
          placeholder={workedOut}
          autoFocus
          onBlur={commit}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <span className={s.pill}>
            {sendsBack && <Icon name="sendback" size={13} />}
            {label}
          </span>
          <IconButton ref={editRef} icon="edit" size="sm" label={t('panel.arrow.reword', { arrow: name })} onClick={() => setEditing(true)} />
          {arrow.words && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={s.link}
              aria-label={t('panel.arrow.useWorkedOutFor', { arrow: name })}
              onClick={() => run('arrow.setWords', { arrow: arrow.id })}
            >
              {t('panel.arrow.useWorkedOut')}
            </button>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The "When ..." part of an arrow, by its kind. */
function ArrowWhen({ stage, arrow, name, focusWhen, onNarrow }: {
  stage: WorkingStage; arrow: Arrow; name: string; focusWhen: boolean; onNarrow(arrow: Arrow, onlyWhen: Condition): void;
}) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  if (!doc) return null;
  const when = arrow.when;
  if (when?.type === 'buttonPressed') {
    const buttons = (stage.tasks ?? []).flatMap((task) => task.buttons ?? []);
    const known = when.button && buttons.some((b) => b.id === when.button);
    return (
      <div className={s.arrowLine}>
        {known ? (
          <span className={s.sentence}>
            <PhraseView phrase={describeArrowWhen(doc, arrow)} />
          </span>
        ) : (
          <>
            <span className={s.kw}>{t('panel.arrow.when')}</span>
            <Select
              aria-label={t('panel.arrow.button')}
              value=""
              options={[{ value: '', label: t('panel.arrow.chooseButton') }, ...buttons.map((b) => ({ value: b.id, label: b.label || t('describe.noName') }))]}
              onChange={(e) => e.target.value && run('arrow.setWhen', { arrow: arrow.id, when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: e.target.value as ButtonId } })}
            />
            <span>{t('panel.arrow.isPressed')}</span>
          </>
        )}
        {arrow.onlyWhen && <span className={s.kw}>{t('panel.arrow.and')}</span>}
        {/* Named by its arrow, so each "+ only when ..." on the stage says whose it is. */}
        <div role="group" aria-label={t('panel.arrow.onlyWhenGroup', { arrow: name })} className={s.slotGroup}>
          <Slot
            name="WhenBuilder"
            at={{ item: arrow.id, part: 'onlyWhen' }}
            stageId={stage.id}
            addLabel={t('word.onlyWhen')}
            value={arrow.onlyWhen}
            onChange={(next) => {
              // "+ only when ..." on a plain button arrow adds a new arrow above it and keeps the plain
              // one, for every other request (editor-model.md section 3; 03-routing note 3).
              if (next !== undefined && isPlainButtonArrow(arrow)) onNarrow(arrow, next);
              else run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', { arrow: arrow.id, ...(next === undefined ? {} : { onlyWhen: next }) });
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (when?.type === 'condition') {
    return (
      <div className={s.arrowLine}>
        <span className={s.kw}>{t('panel.arrow.when')}</span>
        <div role="group" aria-label={t('panel.arrow.whenGroup', { arrow: name })} className={s.slotGroup}>
          <Slot
            name="WhenBuilder"
            at={{ item: arrow.id, part: 'when.condition' }}
            stageId={stage.id}
            addLabel={t('panel.arrow.whenPart')}
            autoFocus={focusWhen}
            value={when.condition}
            onChange={(next: Condition | undefined) =>
              run('arrow.setWhen', { arrow: arrow.id, when: next === undefined ? { type: 'condition' } : { type: 'condition', condition: next } })
            }
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * "This arrow can never be used.", from the findings, with the cause and the fix where it is one
 * command. Held back while it cannot be known yet (`holdNeverUsed`): the arrow's own "when" is not
 * written, or the arrow above said to fit first is still being written ("+ only when ..." just
 * pressed), when "Move it above" would undo what the author is in the middle of doing.
 */
function NeverUsed({ arrow, onFixed }: { arrow: Arrow; onFixed(): void }) {
  const findings = useFindingsFor(arrow.id);
  const facts = useArrowFacts(arrow.id);
  const checked = useCheckedDoc();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const finding = findings.find((f) => f.code === 'arrow.neverUsed');
  if (!doc || (!finding && facts?.usable !== false)) return null;
  if (holdNeverUsed(doc, arrow.id, earlierOf(finding?.params) ?? earlierOf(facts))) return null;
  const words = finding && (checked ?? doc) ? describeFinding((checked ?? doc)!, finding, { ...env, stuckPeople }) : undefined;
  const plan = doc && words ? planFindingFix(doc, words.fix, env) : null;
  const fix = plan ? () => void useEditor.getState().run(plan.command.name, plan.command.args as never) : undefined;
  return (
    <div className={s.neverUsed}>
      <Icon name="error" size={15} />
      <div>
        {/* The cause already says the arrow can never be used; the plain line only when there is no cause. */}
        <p>{words?.cause ? <PhraseView phrase={words.causeParts} /> : <b>{t('arrow.neverUsed')}</b>}</p>
        {fix && words?.fix && (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            icon="chevron-up"
            onClick={() => {
              fix();
              onFixed();
            }}
          >
            {words.fix.label}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** "Suggested: Rejected, like Reject on Domain approval" with "Go to Rejected", for a button's arrow that goes nowhere yet. */
function Suggest({ stage, arrow }: { stage: WorkingStage; arrow: Arrow }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  if (!doc) return null;
  const suggestion = suggestGoTo(doc, stage, arrow);
  if (!suggestion) return null;
  const target = doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === suggestion.goTo);
  const from = doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === suggestion.from);
  if (!target || !from) return null;
  const name = target.name || t('describe.noName');
  return (
    <div className={s.suggest}>
      <div className={s.suggestLine}>
        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.arrow.suggested')}</span>
        <span className={s.pill}>
          <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: colourVar(getStatus(doc, target.status)?.colour) }} aria-hidden />
          {name}
        </span>
        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.arrow.suggestedLike', { button: suggestion.button, stage: from.name || t('describe.noName') })}</span>
      </div>
      <Button
        size="sm"
        icon="check"
        onClick={() => {
          run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: arrow.id, goTo: suggestion.goTo });
          // This button goes once the arrow goes somewhere: focus moves to where it now goes.
          requestAnimationFrame(() => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-chooser="${arrow.id}"]`)?.focus());
        }}
      >
        {t('panel.arrow.goThere', { stage: name })}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * What happens when the arrow sends a request back, true for the stage it goes to: where someone is
 * asked, they are asked again and see what was entered before; where nobody is (Automatic), the
 * stage happens again.
 */
function sendsBackLine(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): string {
  const target = arrow.goTo ? getWorkingStage(doc, arrow.goTo) : undefined;
  if (target && (target.tasks ?? []).length === 0) return t('panel.arrow.happensAgain', { stage: target.name || t('describe.noName') });
  return t('panel.arrow.sendsBackLine');
}

type RowProps = {
  stage: WorkingStage;
  arrow: Arrow;
  index: number;
  ordered: boolean;
  movable: boolean;
  lastMovable: number;
  several: boolean;
  focusWhen: boolean;
  /** The plain arrow's button, when this arrow was just made by "+ only when ..." above it. */
  placedAbove: string | null;
  onMove(arrow: Arrow, to: number, from: 'up' | 'down' | 'drag'): void;
  onNarrow(arrow: Arrow, onlyWhen: Condition): void;
  onFixed(arrow: Arrow): void;
  onRemoved(): void;
};

function ArrowRow({
  stage, arrow, index, ordered, movable, lastMovable, several, focusWhen, placedAbove, onMove, onNarrow, onFixed, onRemoved,
}: RowProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const selection = useSelection();
  const facts = useArrowFacts(arrow.id);
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const label = arrowName(doc, arrow, index);
  const sendsBack = facts?.sendsBack === true;
  const kind = arrow.when?.type;
  const highlighted = selection?.item === arrow.id;
  const single = kind === 'inAllOtherCases' || kind === 'whenDone';

  const onDragStart = (e: DragEvent<HTMLLIElement>) => {
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', arrow.id);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
  };
  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent<HTMLLIElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setOver(false);
    const id = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') as ArrowId;
    const moving = stage.arrows.find((a) => a.id === id);
    if (moving && moving.id !== arrow.id) onMove(moving, Math.min(index, lastMovable), 'drag');
  };

  const cls = [
    s.arrow,
    highlighted ? s.highlighted : undefined,
    over ? s.dropOver : undefined,
    !arrow.goTo ? s.arrowTodo : undefined,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  return (
    <li
      className={cls}
      data-reveal={arrow.id}
      draggable={ordered && movable}
      onDragStart={ordered && movable ? onDragStart : undefined}
      onDragOver={ordered ? (e) => { e.preventDefault(); setOver(true); } : undefined}
      onDragLeave={ordered ? () => setOver(false) : undefined}
      onDrop={ordered ? onDrop : undefined}
      aria-current={highlighted || undefined}
    >
      {ordered && (
        <div className={s.arrowSide}>
          {movable ? (
            <span className={s.dragHandle} title={t('panel.arrow.drag', { arrow: label })} aria-hidden>
              <Icon name="drag" size={14} />
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className={s.dragHandle} aria-hidden />
          )}
          <span className={s.num} aria-label={t('panel.arrow.number', { n: index + 1 })}>
            {index + 1}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={s.arrowBody}>
        <ArrowWhen stage={stage} arrow={arrow} name={label} focusWhen={focusWhen} onNarrow={onNarrow} />
        <div className={s.arrowLine}>
          <span className={s.kw}>
            {single
              ? t(kind === 'inAllOtherCases' || whenDoneIsOtherCases(doc, arrow) ? 'panel.arrow.inAllOtherCasesGoTo' : 'panel.arrow.whenDoneGoTo')
              : t('panel.arrow.goTo')}
          </span>
          <StageChooser arrow={arrow} ownStage={stage.id} />
          {sendsBack && (
            <span className={s.backTag}>
              <Icon name="sendback" size={13} />
              {t('panel.arrow.sendsBack')}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {sendsBack && <p className={s.ruleLine}>{sendsBackLine(doc, arrow)}</p>}
        {placedAbove && (
          <p className={s.placedAbove}>
            <Icon name="chevron-up" size={14} />
            <span>{t('panel.arrow.placedAbove', { button: placedAbove })}</span>
          </p>
        )}
        <NeverUsed arrow={arrow} onFixed={() => onFixed(arrow)} />
        <Suggest stage={stage} arrow={arrow} />
        {several && kind !== 'inAllOtherCases' && (
          <div className={s.dontWait}>
            <button
              type="button"
              role="switch"
              aria-checked={arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue === true}
              className={s.switch}
              onClick={() => run('arrow.setGoAsSoonAsTrue', { arrow: arrow.id, on: !arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue })}
            >
              <span className={s.switchTrack} aria-hidden />
              <span>{t('panel.arrow.dontWait')}</span>
            </button>
            {arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue && <p className={s.ruleLine}>{t('panel.arrow.dontWaitLine')}</p>}
          </div>
        )}
        <ArrowWords arrow={arrow} name={label} sendsBack={sendsBack} />
      </div>
      <div className={s.arrowTools}>
        {ordered && movable && (
          <>
            <IconButton
              icon="chevron-up"
              size="sm"
              label={t('panel.arrow.moveUp', { arrow: label })}
              data-move={`${arrow.id}:up`}
              aria-disabled={index === 0 || undefined}
              onClick={() => index > 0 && onMove(arrow, index - 1, 'up')}
            />
            <IconButton
              icon="chevron-down"
              size="sm"
              label={t('panel.arrow.moveDown', { arrow: label })}
              data-move={`${arrow.id}:down`}
              aria-disabled={index >= lastMovable || undefined}
              onClick={() => index < lastMovable && onMove(arrow, index + 1, 'down')}
            />
          </>
        )}
        <IconButton
          icon="trash"
          size="sm"
          label={t('panel.arrow.remove', { arrow: label })}
          onClick={() => {
            run('arrow.delete', { arrow: arrow.id });
            onRemoved();
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * "Then go to": the arrows, each "When [...] go to [stage]". Where order matters they are numbered,
 * with "Checked from the top. The first one that fits is used.", and move by drag or by the Move up /
 * Move down buttons; "In all other cases" stays last. "+ Add an arrow" adds one with its "when" focused.
 */
export function ArrowsSection({ stage, connected }: { stage: WorkingStage; connected: ArrowId | null }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const [focusArrow, setFocusArrow] = useState<ArrowId | null>(null);
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState('');
  const [refocus, setRefocus] = useState<{ key: string; n: number } | null>(null);
  const [placed, setPlaced] = useState<{ arrow: ArrowId; button: string } | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement & HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const addRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const doc = useDoc();

  // Focus stays with an arrow that moved: on its own Move button ("id:up"), or on the arrow itself
  // ("id"): its Move up button, else where it goes. "id:when" is the first part of its "when".
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!refocus) return;
    const list = listRef.current;
    if (!list) return;
    const [id, part] = refocus.key.split(':');
    const pick = (): HTMLElement | null =>
      part === 'when'
        ? list.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-reveal="${id}"] [data-part="0"] :is(button, select, input)`)
        : part
          ? list.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-move="${refocus.key}"]`)
          : list.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-move="${id}:up"]`) ?? list.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-chooser="${id}"]`);
    // Placed now and once more a moment later (a menu or popover that just closed may take focus
    // back), then forgotten, so a later change to the arrows does not pull focus here again.
    // A key pressed after the first placement (Tab to the next control, say) is the person moving
    // on: focus is then left where they put it.
    let placed = false;
    let acted = false;
    const onKey = () => {
      if (!placed) return;
      acted = true;
      setRefocus(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    const timers = [0, 40].map((ms, i) =>
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (!acted) {
          const el = pick();
          if (el && document.activeElement !== el) el.focus();
        }
        placed = true;
        if (i === 1) setRefocus(null);
      }, ms),
    );
    return () => {
      timers.forEach((x) => window.clearTimeout(x));
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    };
  }, [refocus, stage.arrows]);

  if (!doc) return null;
  const arrows = stage.arrows ?? [];
  const ordered = orderMatters(stage, facts);
  const several = (stage.tasks ?? []).length > 1;
  const catchAll = arrows.findIndex((a) => a.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases');
  const lastMovable = (catchAll >= 0 ? arrows.length - 2 : arrows.length - 1);
  const caption = ordered
    ? several ? t('panel.arrows.severalTasks') : t('arrow.order')
    : everyButtonHasArrow(stage) && arrows.length > 0 ? t('arrow.everyButton') : '';
  // "Only for some requests?": said while the stage has button arrows and none is kept to some
  // requests yet (in testing, authors did not find "+ only when ..." without it).
  const offerOnlySome = arrows.some(isPlainButtonArrow) && !arrows.some((a) => a.onlyWhen);
  const wantsOtherCases =catchAll < 0 && stage.kind !== 'automatic' && (several || arrows.some((a) => a.when?.type === 'condition' || a.onlyWhen));

  const onMove = (arrow: Arrow, to: number, from: 'up' | 'down' | 'drag') => {
    run('arrow.move', { arrow: arrow.id, toIndex: to });
    setAnnounce(t('panel.arrow.moved', { arrow: arrowName(doc, arrow, to), n: to + 1 }));
    setRefocus(from === 'drag' ? null : { key: `${arrow.id}:${from}`, n: Date.now() });
  };

  // "+ only when ..." on a plain button arrow: a new arrow for the same button, kept to some
  // requests, placed just above the plain one, which stays for every other request.
  const onNarrow = (plain: Arrow, onlyWhen: Condition) => {
    if (plain.when?.type !== 'buttonPressed' || !plain.when.button) return;
    const button = plain.when.button;
    const made = run('arrow.add', { stage: stage.id, when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button } });
    if (!made || !('id' in made)) return;
    run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', { arrow: made.id, onlyWhen });
    const now = useEditor.getState().doc?.stages.find((x) => x.id === stage.id);
    const at = now && now.kind !== 'ending' ? now.arrows.findIndex((a) => a.id === plain.id) : -1;
    if (at >= 0) run('arrow.move', { arrow: made.id, toIndex: at });
    const buttonName = (stage.tasks ?? []).flatMap((x) => x.buttons ?? []).find((b) => b.id === button)?.label || t('describe.noName');
    setPlaced({ arrow: made.id, button: buttonName });
    setRefocus({ key: `${made.id}:when`, n: Date.now() });
  };

  const onFixed = (arrow: Arrow) => setRefocus({ key: arrow.id, n: Date.now() });

  const add = () => {
    const needsDone = stage.kind === 'automatic' && !arrows.some((a) => a.when?.type === 'whenDone');
    const made = run('arrow.add', { stage: stage.id, ...(needsDone ? { when: { type: 'whenDone' as const } } : {}) });
    if (made && 'id' in made) setFocusArrow(made.id);
  };

  const List = ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul';
  return (
    <div className={s.arrows}>
      {caption && (
        <p className={s.caption}>
          <Icon name="info" size={14} />
          <span>{caption}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {offerOnlySome && (
        <p className={s.onlySome}>
          <Icon name="filter" size={14} />
          <span>
            <b>{t('panel.arrow.onlySome')}</b> {t('panel.arrow.onlySomeHint')}
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
      <List ref={listRef} className={s.arrowList} aria-label={t('panel.arrows.label', { stage: stage.name || t('describe.noName') })}>
        {arrows.map((arrow, i) => (
          <ArrowRow
            key={arrow.id}
            stage={stage}
            arrow={arrow}
            index={i}
            ordered={ordered}
            movable={arrow.when?.type !== 'inAllOtherCases'}
            lastMovable={lastMovable}
            several={several}
            focusWhen={arrow.id === focusArrow || arrow.id === connected}
            placedAbove={placed?.arrow === arrow.id ? placed.button : null}
            onMove={onMove}
            onNarrow={onNarrow}
            onFixed={onFixed}
            onRemoved={() => addRef.current?.focus()}
          />
        ))}
      </List>
      <p className="visually-hidden" role="status">
        {announce}
      </p>
      <div className={s.addRow}>
        <button ref={addRef} type="button" className={s.addLine} onClick={add}>
          <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
          {t('panel.arrow.add')}
        </button>
        {wantsOtherCases && (
          <button type="button" className={s.addLine} onClick={() => run('arrow.add', { stage: stage.id, when: { type: 'inAllOtherCases' } })}>
            <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
            {t('panel.arrow.addOtherCases')}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/DirectorySearch.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useId, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { DirectoryEntry } from '@/contract';
import { useServices, type Ref } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/**
 * A small search of the directory's people and groups (services.directory.search), as a combobox:
 * type, move with the arrow keys, Enter or click to add. Entries already chosen are left out.
 * Built here for the Settings popover; a candidate for src/ui once a second screen needs it.
 */
export function DirectorySearch({ label, exclude, onPick }: { label: string; exclude: readonly Ref[]; onPick(ref: Ref): void }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const id = useId();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [found, setFound] = useState<{ query: string; entries: DirectoryEntry[] } | null>(null);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);

  const words = query.trim();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!words) return;
    let live = true;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void services.directory.search(words, ['user', 'group']).then((entries) => {
        if (live) setFound({ query: words, entries });
      });
    }, 120);
    return () => {
      live = false;
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [services, words]);

  const taken = new Set(exclude.map((r) => `${r.type}:${r.id}`));
  const entries = words && found?.query === words ? found.entries.filter((e) => !taken.has(`${e.type}:${e.id}`)) : [];
  const searching = !!words && found?.query !== words;
  const open = !!words;

  const pick = (entry: DirectoryEntry | undefined) => {
    if (!entry) return;
    onPick({ type: entry.type, id: entry.id });
    setQuery('');
    setActive(0);
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, Math.max(entries.length - 1, 0)));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      pick(entries[active]);
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && query) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      setQuery('');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.dirSearch}>
      <div className={s.dirInput}>
        <Icon name="search" size={14} />
        <input
          role="combobox"
          aria-label={label}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={`${id}-list`}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-activedescendant={open && entries[active] ? `${id}-${active}` : undefined}
          placeholder={t('panel.directory.placeholder')}
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setQuery(e.target.value);
            setActive(0);
          }}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
        />
      </div>
      {open && (
        <ul id={`${id}-list`} role="listbox" aria-label={t('panel.directory.results')} className={s.dirList}>
          {searching && <li className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.directory.searching')}</li>}
          {!searching && entries.length === 0 && <li className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.directory.noMatch', { query: words })}</li>}
          {entries.map((entry, i) => (
            <li
              key={`${entry.type}:${entry.id}`}
              id={`${id}-${i}`}
              role="option"
              aria-selected={i === active}
              className={`${s.dirOption} ${i === active ? s.dirActive : ''}`}
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              onClick={() => pick(entry)}
            >
              <Icon name={entry.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person'} size={14} />
              <span>
                <span className={s.dirName}>{entry.label}</span>
                <span className={s.quiet}>
                  {' '}
                  {t(entry.type === 'group' ? 'panel.directory.group' : 'panel.directory.person')}
                  {entry.detail ? t('panel.directory.detail', { detail: entry.detail }) : ''}
                </span>
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/FindingsStrip.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { StageId } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeFinding, findingTone, planFindingFix, reveal, useCheckedDoc, useCheckIsCurrent, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useEditor, useFindingsFor,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { earlierOf, fixPlace, holdNeverUsed } from './logic';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { useStuckPeople } from './useStuckName';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/**
 * Under the header: this stage's To do and Worth knowing items in full (cause, then what would
 * happen). A fix that is one command is a button that does it ("Add an arrow for Approve"), with
 * "Show me" beside it; a fix that needs the author's choice is said in its own words ("Choose who is
 * asked", "Choose a stage or ending") and takes the panel to that control; an item with no fix has
 * "Show me". A fix is confirmed in place ("Done: ..."), and focus goes to that line.
 */
export function FindingsStrip({ stageId }: { stageId: StageId }) {
  const all = useFindingsFor(stageId, { deep: true });
  const checked = useCheckedDoc();
  const current = useDoc();
  const doc = checked ?? current;
  const fresh = useCheckIsCurrent();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const [done, setDone] = useState<{ what: string; n: number } | null>(null);
  const doneRef = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (done) doneRef.current?.focus();
  }, [done]);
  if (!doc) return null;
  // "Can never be used" is held back while it cannot be known yet (as on the arrow's row under Then
  // go to): its own "when" is not written, or the arrow above said to fit first is still being written.
  const findings = all.filter((f) => f.code !== 'arrow.neverUsed' || !holdNeverUsed(current ?? doc, f.location.item, earlierOf(f.params)));

  return (
    <div className={s.strip} aria-label={t('panel.strip.label')} role="region" aria-busy={!fresh || undefined}>
      {findings.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.stripClear}>
          <Icon name="check" size={14} />
          <span>{t('panel.strip.clear')}</span>
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className={s.stripList}>
          {findings.map((finding, i) => {
            const words = describeFinding(doc, finding, { ...env, stuckPeople });
            const tone = findingTone(finding);
            // The one obvious fix as one named command, the same one the To do drawer runs.
            const plan = current ? planFindingFix(current, words.fix, env) : null;
            const runFix = plan ? () => void useEditor.getState().run(plan.command.name, plan.command.args as never) : undefined;
            const worth = finding.severity !== 'todo';
            const choiceFix = !runFix && words.fix ? words.fix : undefined;
            return (
              <li key={`${finding.code}-${finding.location.item}-${finding.location.part ?? ''}-${i}`} className={`${s.stripItem} ${s[`tone_${tone}`]}`}>
                <Icon name={worth ? 'info' : tone === 'contradictory' ? 'error' : 'todo'} size={15} />
                <div className={s.stripText}>
                  <p>
                    <b>{t('panel.strip.markLead', { mark: t(worth ? 'mark.worth' : 'mark.todo') })}</b>
                    <PhraseView
                      phrase={words.effectParts ? [...words.causeParts, t('panel.strip.between'), ...words.effectParts] : words.causeParts}
                    />
                  </p>
                  <div className={s.stripActions}>
                    {runFix && words.fix && (
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => {
                          runFix();
                          setDone((d) => ({ what: plan ? plan.done.replace(/\.\s*$/, '') : '', n: (d?.n ?? 0) + 1 }));
                        }}
                      >
                        {words.fix.label}
                      </Button>
                    )}
                    {choiceFix ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className={s.link}
                        data-fix={choiceFix.kind}
                        aria-label={t('panel.strip.fixLabel', { fix: choiceFix.label, what: words.where })}
                        onClick={() => reveal(fixPlace(choiceFix, finding.location))}
                      >
                        {choiceFix.label}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      // Drawn like the fixes said in words beside it ("Choose a stage or ending").
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className={s.link}
                        aria-label={t('panel.strip.showMeLabel', { what: words.short })}
                        onClick={() => reveal(finding.location)}
                      >
                        {t('panel.strip.showMe')}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      <p role="status" ref={doneRef} tabIndex={-1} className={done ? s.doneLine : 'visually-hidden'}>
        {done && (
          <>
            <Icon name="check" size={14} /> {t('panel.strip.done', { what: done.what })}
          </>
        )}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/PanelHeader.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Stage, StageId } from '@/contract';
import { defaultStageName, isStartStage, useDoc, useEditor, useFindingsFor, useRun } from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Dialog, DialogClose, Icon, IconButton, Menu } from '@/ui';
import { deleteConsequences, joinNames, kindOf } from './logic';
import { StatusPicker } from './StatusPicker';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/** The stage's name, edited in place: saved on Enter or when leaving the field; Escape puts it back. */
function NameField({ stageId, name, hintId }: { stageId: StageId; name: string; hintId?: string }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  // The field stays the same element while the name changes (so focus stays in it after Enter);
  // a name changed elsewhere (undo, the diagram) is shown unless the author is typing in it.
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (el && el !== document.activeElement && el.value !== name) el.value = name;
  }, [name]);
  const commit = () => {
    const next = ref.current?.value ?? name;
    if (next !== name) run('stage.rename', { stage: stageId, name: next });
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      commit();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && ref.current) {
      ref.current.value = name;
      ref.current.blur();
    }
  };
  return (
    <input
      key={stageId}
      ref={ref}
      className={s.nameInput}
      data-reveal={`${stageId}:name`}
      aria-label={t('panel.name')}
      aria-describedby={hintId}
      placeholder={t('panel.name.placeholder')}
      defaultValue={name}
      onBlur={commit}
      onKeyDown={onKey}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * Puts focus on `target()` once a dialog or menu that closed has let go of it. The delete dialog has
 * no trigger and the menu item that opened it is gone, so on its own focus would fall to the page.
 * Tried now and twice more a moment later (the dialog gives focus back after it closes), each time
 * only while nothing else has focus, so a person who has already moved on is left alone.
 */
function focusSoon(target: () => HTMLElement | null | undefined) {
  for (const ms of [0, 40, 120, 250]) {
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const active = document.activeElement;
      const lost = !active || active === document.body || !active.isConnected || !!active.closest('[role="dialog"], [role="menu"]');
      if (!lost) return;
      const el = target();
      if (el?.isConnected) el.focus();
    }, ms);
  }
}

/** The diagram, where focus goes once the stage shown here is deleted; the panel itself when there is none. */
function diagramOr(fallback: HTMLElement | null): () => HTMLElement | null {
  return () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`section[aria-label="${CSS.escape(t('diagram.label'))}"]`) ?? (fallback?.isConnected ? fallback : null);
}

/**
 * True while a stage still has the name it was given when added ("New approval", or "New approval 2"
 * beside another): the panel then says how to name it and what its status is for, until renamed
 * (02-build__approval-added).
 */
function stillNamedAsNew(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stage: Stage): boolean {
  const kind = stage.kind ?? 'blank';
  const others = { ...doc, stages: doc.stages.filter((x) => x.id !== stage.id) };
  return !!stage.name && stage.name === defaultStageName(others, kind);
}

/**
 * The fixed header: the kind badge with its one line, the editable name, and the status (for the
 * start stage, "If sent back:" and, when it needs one, its own status). The menu holds Delete.
 */
export function PanelHeader({ stage, onClosed }: { stage: Stage; onClosed(): void }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<{ values: string[]; arrows: string[] } | null>(null);
  const moreRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const findings = useFindingsFor(stage.id);
  if (!doc) return null;

  const kind = kindOf(stage);
  const isStart = isStartStage(doc, stage.id);
  const line = t(`stageKind.${kind}.line` as WordKey);
  const needsOwnStatus = isStart && (!!stage.status || findings.some((f) => f.code === 'start.needsStatus'));
  const fresh = !isStart && stillNamedAsNew(doc, stage);
  const nameHint = `panel-name-hint-${stage.id}`;

  const remove = () => {
    // Found before the delete: the panel's own aside stays, the header does not.
    const aside = moreRef.current?.closest('aside') ?? null;
    run('stage.delete', { stage: stage.id });
    setConfirm(null);
    focusSoon(diagramOr(aside));
  };
  const askDelete = () => {
    const what = deleteConsequences(doc, stage.id);
    if (what.values.length === 0 && what.arrows.length === 0) remove();
    else setConfirm(what);
  };

  return (
    <header className={s.head}>
      <div className={s.headTop}>
        <span className={s.kindBadge}>
          <Icon name={kind} size={14} />
          {t(`stageKind.${kind}` as WordKey)}
        </span>
        {isStart && (
          <span className={s.startBadge}>
            <Icon name="start" size={14} />
            {t('stageKind.start')}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className={s.grow} />
        <Menu
          align="end"
          trigger={<IconButton ref={moreRef} icon="more" label={t('panel.more')} size="sm" />}
          items={[
            isStart
              ? { label: t('panel.delete.start'), icon: 'trash', disabled: true, onSelect: () => {} }
              : { label: t('panel.delete'), icon: 'trash', danger: true, onSelect: askDelete },
          ]}
        />
        <IconButton
          icon="close"
          label={t('panel.close')}
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => {
            useEditor.getState().select(null);
            onClosed();
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className={s.kindLine}>{isStart ? t('panel.kindLine.start', { line }) : line}</p>
      <NameField stageId={stage.id} name={stage.name ?? ''} hintId={fresh ? nameHint : undefined} />
      {fresh && (
        <p className={s.hint} id={nameHint}>
          {t('panel.name.hint')}
        </p>
      )}
      {(!isStart || needsOwnStatus) && (
        <div className={s.statusRow} data-reveal={`${stage.id}:status`}>
          <span className={s.statusLabel}>{t('panel.status')}</span>
          <StatusPicker stageId={stage.id} field="status" label={t('panel.status')} statusId={stage.status} />
        </div>
      )}
      {stage.kind !== 'ending' && (isStart || stage.ifSentBackStatus) && (
        <div className={s.statusRow} data-reveal={`${stage.id}:ifSentBackStatus`}>
          {/* The start stage alone: its only status is the one shown when sent back, so it is simply
              "Status people see", with the line "A request only sits here when it was sent back." */}
          <span className={s.statusLabel}>{t(isStart && !needsOwnStatus ? 'panel.status' : 'panel.status.ifSentBack')}</span>
          <StatusPicker
            stageId={stage.id}
            field="ifSentBackStatus"
            label={t(isStart && !needsOwnStatus ? 'panel.status' : 'panel.status.ifSentBack')}
            statusId={stage.ifSentBackStatus}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {isStart && !needsOwnStatus && <p className={s.hint}>{t('panel.status.startHint')}</p>}
      {fresh && stage.kind !== 'ending' && <p className={s.hint}>{t('panel.status.hint')}</p>}

      <Dialog
        title={t('panel.delete.title', { stage: stage.name || t('describe.noName') })}
        open={confirm !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (open) return;
          // Cancel, Escape, the close button: back to "More for this stage", which opened it.
          setConfirm(null);
          focusSoon(() => moreRef.current);
        }}
        footer={
          <>
            <DialogClose asChild>
              <Button>{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
            </DialogClose>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={remove}>
              {t('panel.delete.confirm')}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {confirm && (
          <div className={s.deleteBody}>
            {confirm.values.length > 0 && <p>{t('panel.delete.values', { values: joinNames(confirm.values) })}</p>}
            {confirm.arrows.length === 1 && <p>{t('panel.delete.arrowOne', { arrows: confirm.arrows[0] ?? '' })}</p>}
            {confirm.arrows.length > 1 && (
              <p>{t('panel.delete.arrowsMany', { n: confirm.arrows.length, arrows: joinNames(confirm.arrows.map((a) => t('panel.list.quoted', { name: a }))) })}</p>
            )}
            <p className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.delete.undo')}</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </header>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/PhraseView.tsx\n===
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import { canOpenSettings, isChip, isMissing, isSettingsLink, openSettings, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/**
 * A describe phrase on screen: plain words as text, chips as small chips (a button as a button chip,
 * a value tinted, a stage with its name), unfinished parts marked in amber with their words, and
 * "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)" as a link that opens Settings.
 */
export function PhraseView({ phrase }: { phrase: Phrase }) {
  return (
    <>
      {phrase.map((part, i) => {
        if (typeof part === 'string') return <Fragment key={i}>{part}</Fragment>;
        if (isSettingsLink(part)) {
          if (!canOpenSettings()) return <Fragment key={i}>{part.text}</Fragment>;
          return (
            <button key={i} type="button" className={s.link} aria-label={t('panel.settingsLink', { settings: part.text })} onClick={() => openSettings()}>
              {part.text}
            </button>
          );
        }
        if (isChip(part)) {
          const cls = [s.pchip, s[`pchip_${part.chip}`], part.missing ? s.pchipMissing : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
          return (
            <span key={i} className={cls}>
              {part.label}
            </span>
          );
        }
        return (
          <span key={i} className={isMissing(part) ? s.missingText : undefined}>
            {part.text}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/README.md\n===
# features/panel

The Diagram tab's right side (editor-model.md section 3) and the top-bar Settings popover.

- `StagePanel` (index.tsx, from `StagePanel.tsx`): nothing chosen gives a quiet line; a chosen stage, or anything inside one (an arrow chosen on the diagram, a button, a task ...), shows that stage: the fixed header (`PanelHeader.tsx`: kind badge and its line, name, status pickers, the menu with Delete), the strip of To do and Worth knowing (`FindingsStrip.tsx`), then the spine: Reached from (`ReachedFrom.tsx`), When this stage starts / What it does, Task (`TaskSection.tsx`, `WhoIsAsked.tsx`), After they respond, Then go to (`ArrowsSection.tsx`, `StageChooser.tsx`). An Ending shows its header and strip only.
- `SettingsButton` (`SettingsButton.tsx`, `DirectorySearch.tsx`): "Stuck requests go to" and who can edit, saved with `saveSettings`.
- Other features' parts come through model slots: `StageActions` (three places), `ValueField` (Who is asked), `ValueChip`, `ListDialog`, `WhenBuilder` (arrows, "+ only when ...", "Also only when ..."), `KindChooser` ("+ New stage..." asks "Which kind?"), `AlsoStartsFrom`.
- The start stage's "+ Also start it from another system" and its "Starts when" cards are the `AlsoStartsFrom` slot (features/connections), rendered in the bounded place under "A person starts it by filling in this form." (`ReachedFrom.tsx`, `data-place="starts-when"`) as `<Slot name="AlsoStartsFrom" stageId={stage.id} />`.
- The strip: a one-command fix is a button that does it, the same command and "Done: ..." words as the To do drawer (`planFindingFix` from the model; then focus goes to the "Done: ..." line); a fix that needs a choice is said in its own words ("Choose who is asked", "Choose a stage or ending") and takes focus to that control (`fixPlace` in `logic.ts`); an item with no fix of its own has "Show me", drawn like those words. A reveal of `<arrow>:goTo` for an arrow to a deleted stage ("Choose another stage") opens the stage chooser by itself, asking with the arrow's whole "when".
- Then go to: "+ only when ..." on a plain button arrow adds a new arrow for that button above it (the plain one stays); "Only for some requests?" says so. "+ New stage..." asks Which kind?, Who is asked? and the name before "Add stage"; the new stage's arrow for the same button carries on where that button's plain arrow went (`carryOnFor`), and its other button arrows suggest a stage ("like Reject on Domain approval", `suggestGoTo`). An arrow whose own "when" is not written yet is never called "can never be used". An arrow that sends a request back says what is true for the stage it goes to (asked again, or "<Stage> happens again." where nobody is asked). Every "+ only when ...", "+ when ..." and "+ Also only when ..." sits in a group named by its arrow or button (the WhenBuilder slot takes no accessible name of its own yet).
- A stage that still has the name it was added with (`defaultStageName`) shows the hints under its name and status until renamed. A single task has no name: its "Edit form" is named by the stage.
- Primitives built here that could move to ui: the kind radio list of the new-stage form (`NewStageForm` in `StageChooser.tsx`) and the chip-like table cell button (`.whoCell`).
- "Show me" and selection: `StagePanel` scrolls to and flashes what is chosen or revealed (elements carry `data-reveal="<id>"` or `"<id>:<part>"`, sections `data-section`), and focuses it after a reveal.
- Every edit is a named command through `useRun()`; `logic.ts` holds the pure helpers (when order matters, the per-answer table, form summary, what a stage's deletion takes with it, where a fix that needs a choice is made).
- Words: `src/words/panel.ts`, keys `panel.*`. Tests: `StagePanel.test.tsx` (rendered), `tests/e2e/panel.spec.ts`.
- Who is told about a stuck request: `useStuckPeople()` (`useStuckName.ts`) gives every ref of "Stuck requests go to" (or the authors) by its directory name, groups marked, for `describeFinding`'s `stuckPeople`. `PhraseView` draws "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)" as a link that calls the model's `openSettings()`.
- Tests: `StagePanel.test.tsx` types with `userEvent.setup({ delay: null })` and pastes words (`typeIn`), so no case depends on how busy the machine is.
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/ReachedFrom.tsx\n===
import type { Stage } from '@/contract';
import { arrowLabel, arrowsInto, getStatus, isStartStage, Slot, useDoc, useFacts } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { colourVar } from './logic';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/**
 * "Reached from": read-only, one line per arrow that leads here, naming its stage and the words on
 * the arrow, as the diagram says them ("Domain approval by the arrow Request changes pressed").
 * On the start stage, the bounded place under "A person starts it by filling in this form." holds
 * "+ Also start it from another system" and its cards (editor-model.md section 10), shown through
 * the AlsoStartsFrom model slot (features/connections).
 */
export function ReachedFrom({ stage }: { stage: Stage }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const facts = useFacts();
  if (!doc) return null;
  const into = arrowsInto(doc, stage.id);
  const isStart = isStartStage(doc, stage.id);
  return (
    <div className={s.reached}>
      {isStart && (
        <>
          <p className={s.startLine}>
            <Icon name="person" size={14} />
            <span>{t('panel.reachedFrom.start')}</span>
          </p>
          <div className={s.startsFromOthers} data-place="starts-when">
            <Slot name="AlsoStartsFrom" stageId={stage.id} />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {into.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={s.plainList}>
          {into.map(({ from, arrow }) => {
            const sendsBack = facts?.arrows[arrow.id]?.sendsBack;
            const status = getStatus(doc, from.status);
            return (
              <li key={arrow.id} className={s.reachedRow}>
                <span className={s.stageChip}>
                  <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: colourVar(status?.colour) }} aria-hidden />
                  {from.name || t('describe.noName')}
                </span>
                <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.reachedFrom.byTheArrow')}</span>
                <span className={s.pill}>
                  {sendsBack && <Icon name="sendback" size={13} />}
                  {arrowLabel(doc, arrow)}
                </span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {!isStart && into.length === 0 && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.reachedFrom.none')}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/SettingsButton.tsx\n===
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { Settings, Ref } from '@/services';
import { saveSettings, takesPlural, useDirectoryLabel, useMay, useSettings } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Icon, IconButton, Popover } from '@/ui';
import { DirectorySearch } from './DirectorySearch';
import { joinNames } from './logic';
import s from './panel.module.css';

const same = (a: Ref, b: Ref) => a.type === b.type && a.id === b.id;

/** One person or group as a chip, with Remove unless it is the last one. */
function RefChip({ entry, canRemove, onRemove }: { entry: Ref; canRemove: boolean; onRemove(): void }) {
  const name = useDirectoryLabel(entry) ?? '...';
  return (
    <li className={s.refChip}>
      <Icon name={entry.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person'} size={14} />
      <span>{name}</span>
      {canRemove && <IconButton icon="close" size="sm" label={t('panel.settings.remove', { name })} onClick={onRemove} />}
    </li>
  );
}

/** "Sam Carter, who looks after stuck requests, is" for the first mention (names come from the directory). */
function StuckWho({ refs }: { refs: Ref[] }) {
  const a = useDirectoryLabel(refs[0]);
  const b = useDirectoryLabel(refs[1]);
  const c = useDirectoryLabel(refs[2]);
  const names = [a, b, c].slice(0, refs.length).map((n) => n ?? '...');
  if (refs.length > 3) names.push(t('panel.settings.more', { n: refs.length - 3 }));
  // A group takes the plural verb, as several people do (the model's one rule, `takesPlural`).
  const many = takesPlural(refs.map((r) => ({ kind: r.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person' })));
  const who = many ? t('panel.settings.whoMany', { names: joinNames(names) }) : t('panel.settings.whoOne', { names: names[0] ?? '' });
  return <p className={s.hint}>{t('panel.settings.stuckHint', { who })}</p>;
}

/** A list of people or groups that is never empty: chips, Remove on each while more than one, and a directory search to add. */
function RefList({ refs, label, addLabel, editable, onChange }: { refs: Ref[]; label: string; addLabel: string; editable: boolean; onChange(next: Ref[]): void }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.refList}>
      <ul className={s.refChips} aria-label={label}>
        {refs.map((r) => (
          <RefChip key={`${r.type}:${r.id}`} entry={r} canRemove={editable && refs.length > 1} onRemove={() => onChange(refs.filter((x) => !same(x, r)))} />
        ))}
      </ul>
      {editable && refs.length === 1 && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.settings.lastOne')}</p>}
      {editable && <DirectorySearch label={addLabel} exclude={refs} onPick={(ref) => onChange([...refs, ref])} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Top-bar slot: the gear labelled "Settings", opening a small popover for the whole workflow:
 * "Stuck requests go to" (people or a group from the directory; starts as the authors; never empty)
 * and who can edit. Saved with the session's saveSettings at once.
 */
export function SettingsButton() {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const may = useMay();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ tone: 'info' | 'danger'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const save = async (next: Settings) => {
    setMessage(null);
    const result = await saveSettings(next);
    if (result.ok) setMessage({ tone: 'info', text: t('panel.settings.saved') });
    else {
      const code = result.errors[0]?.code;
      setMessage({
        tone: 'danger',
        text: code === 'last-author' ? t('panel.settings.lastAuthor') : code === 'forbidden' ? t('panel.settings.forbidden') : t('panel.settings.failed'),
      });
    }
  };

  const stuck = settings ? (settings.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : settings.authors) : [];
  const isDefault = !!settings && (!settings.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ||
    (settings.stuckRequestsGoTo.length === settings.authors.length && settings.stuckRequestsGoTo.every((r) => settings.authors.some((a) => same(a, r)))));

  return (
    <Popover
      trigger={
        <Button variant="quiet" icon="gear" title={t('panel.settingsTitle')}>
          {t('panel.settings')}
        </Button>
      }
      title={t('panel.settings')}
      sub={t('panel.settings.sub')}
      width={420}
      align="end"
      onOpenChange={() => setMessage(null)}
    >
      {settings && (
        <div className={s.settings}>
          {!may.settings && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.settings.readOnly')}</p>}
          <div className={s.sub}>
            <div className={s.subLabel}>
              {t('word.stuckRequestsGoTo')} <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.settings.stuckSub')}</span>
            </div>
            <RefList
              refs={stuck}
              label={t('word.stuckRequestsGoTo')}
              addLabel={t('panel.settings.addStuck')}
              editable={may.settings}
              onChange={(next) => void save({ ...settings, stuckRequestsGoTo: next })}
            />
            <StuckWho refs={stuck} />
            {isDefault && (
              <p className={s.noteBox}>
                <Icon name="info" size={14} />
                <span>{t('panel.settings.default')}</span>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={s.sub}>
            <div className={s.subLabel}>
              {t('panel.settings.authors')} <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.settings.authorsSub')}</span>
            </div>
            <RefList
              refs={settings.authors}
              label={t('panel.settings.authors')}
              addLabel={t('panel.settings.addAuthor')}
              editable={may.settings}
              onChange={(next) => void save({ ...settings, authors: next })}
            />
          </div>
          <p className={s.elsewhere}>
            <Icon name="task" size={14} />
            <span>{t('panel.settings.elsewhere')}</span>
          </p>
          <div role="status">{message && <Callout tone={message.tone}>{message.text}</Callout>}</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Popover>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/StageChooser.tsx\n===
import { forwardRef, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { Arrow, Clause, Expression, StageId } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeArrowWhen, describeGoTo, find, getStatus, orderFromStart, Slot, toText, useDoc, useEditor, useRevealRequest, useRun, type StageKindChoice,
} from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon, Popover, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { carryOnFor, colourVar } from './logic';
import s from './panel.module.css';

type TriggerProps = { label: string; state: 'chosen' | 'none' | 'deleted'; colour: string; text: string };

const Trigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, TriggerProps & ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>(function Trigger(
  { label, state, colour, text, ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type="button" className={`${s.chooser} ${s[`chooser_${state}`]}`} aria-label={label} {...rest}>
      {state === 'chosen' && <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: colour }} aria-hidden />}
      {state === 'none' && <Icon name="todo" size={14} />}
      {state === 'deleted' && <Icon name="error" size={14} />}
      <span>{text}</span>
      <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} />
    </button>
  );
});

/** The kinds "+ New stage..." offers, in the mockup's order. */
const KINDS: StageKindChoice[] = ['approval', 'form', 'work', 'automatic', 'ending'];
/** The kinds that ask someone, so "Who is asked?" is asked too. */
const ASKS: ReadonlySet<StageKindChoice> = new Set(['approval', 'form', 'work']);

/**
 * "+ New stage...": in the same place, "Which kind?", then "Who is asked?" (for a kind that asks
 * someone) and the name, then Cancel or "Add stage". Nothing is made until "Add stage".
 * (A small form of its own: the diagram's KindChooser slot chooses on click, with no chosen state.)
 */
function NewStageForm({ arrow, initialName, onCancel, onAdd }: {
  arrow: Arrow; initialName: string; onCancel(): void; onAdd(kind: StageKindChoice, name: string, who: Expression | undefined): void;
}) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<StageKindChoice>('approval');
  const [name, setName] = useState(initialName);
  const [who, setWho] = useState<Expression | undefined>(undefined);
  const group = useId();
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onAdd(kind, name.trim(), ASKS.has(kind) ? who : undefined);
  };
  return (
    <form className={s.newStageForm} onSubmit={submit}>
      <fieldset className={s.kindList}>
        <legend>{t('panel.chooser.whichKind')}</legend>
        {KINDS.map((k, i) => (
          <label key={k} className={s.kindOption}>
            <input type="radio" name={group} value={k} checked={kind === k} onChange={() => setKind(k)} autoFocus={i === 0} />
            <Icon name={k} size={15} />
            <span className={s.kindDesc}>
              <span className={s.kindName}>{t(`stageKind.${k}` as WordKey)}</span>
              {' '}
              {t(`stageKind.${k}.line` as WordKey).replace(/^[^:]*:\s*/, '')}
            </span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      {ASKS.has(kind) && (
        <div>
          <div className={s.fieldLabel}>{t('panel.chooser.whoIsAsked')}</div>
          <Slot
            name="ValueField"
            at={{ item: arrow.id }}
            label={t('word.whoIsAsked')}
            accepts={['person', 'group', 'people']}
            allowTyped
            value={who}
            onChange={setWho}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      <TextInput
        aria-label={t('panel.chooser.stageName')}
        placeholder={t('panel.name.placeholder')}
        value={name}
        onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
      />
      <div className={s.newStageFoot}>
        <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onCancel}>
          {t('common.cancel')}
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
          {t(kind === 'ending' ? 'panel.chooser.addEnding' : 'panel.chooser.addStage')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * The arrow with its whole "when" in one, for the question asked when it goes to a deleted stage:
 * "When Approve is pressed and Risk is High", not only "When Approve is pressed". Joined only where
 * the words stay flat (an "and" list); otherwise the arrow as it is.
 */
function wholeWhen(arrow: Arrow): Arrow {
  const only = arrow.onlyWhen;
  if (!only || 'formula' in only) return arrow;
  const extra: Clause[] | undefined = 'allOf' in only ? only.allOf : only.anyOf.length <= 1 ? only.anyOf : undefined;
  if (!extra || extra.length === 0) return arrow;
  const when = arrow.when;
  let own: Clause[] | undefined;
  if (when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && when.button) own = [{ pressed: when.button }];
  else if (when?.type === 'condition' && when.condition && !('formula' in when.condition)) {
    const c = when.condition;
    own = 'allOf' in c ? c.allOf : c.anyOf.length <= 1 ? c.anyOf : undefined;
  }
  if (!own) return arrow;
  return { ...arrow, when: { type: 'condition', condition: { allOf: [...own, ...extra] } }, onlyWhen: undefined };
}

/**
 * Where an arrow goes: the stages and endings in diagram order, a search box, and "+ New stage...",
 * which asks, in the same place, "Which kind?" and "Who is asked?" before the stage is made. The
 * arrow's own stage is not offered. An arrow to a deleted stage first says what was deleted and asks
 * where requests should go now.
 */
export function StageChooser({ arrow, ownStage }: { arrow: Arrow; ownStage: StageId }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [askKind, setAskKind] = useState(false);
  const request = useRevealRequest();
  const handled = useRef<number | undefined>(request?.nonce);
  const goesToDeleted = !!doc && !!arrow.goTo && find(doc, arrow.goTo)?.kind !== 'stage';
  // "Choose another stage" (the To do drawer, the strip) for an arrow to a deleted stage opens the
  // chooser by itself, with its question, once the panel has put focus on it (09-publish__fix-deleted).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!request || handled.current === request.nonce) return;
    handled.current = request.nonce;
    const { item, part } = request.location;
    if (item !== arrow.id || part !== 'goTo' || !goesToDeleted) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setQuery('');
      setAskKind(false);
      setOpen(true);
    }, 150);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [request, arrow.id, goesToDeleted]);
  if (!doc) return null;

  const target = arrow.goTo ? find(doc, arrow.goTo) : undefined;
  const state: TriggerProps['state'] = !arrow.goTo ? 'none' : target?.kind === 'stage' ? 'chosen' : 'deleted';
  const text = state === 'none' ? t('arrow.chooseStage') : toText(describeGoTo(doc, arrow.goTo));
  const colour = target?.kind === 'stage' ? colourVar(getStatus(doc, target.item.status)?.colour) : colourVar(undefined);

  const words = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const order = orderFromStart(doc)
    .filter((id) => id !== ownStage)
    .map((id) => doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === id))
    .filter((x): x is NonNullable<typeof x> => !!x && (!words || (x.name ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(words)));
  const working = order.filter((x) => x.kind !== 'ending');
  const endings = order.filter((x) => x.kind === 'ending');

  const choose = (id: StageId) => {
    run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: arrow.id, goTo: id });
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const create = (kind: StageKindChoice, name: string, who: Expression | undefined) => {
    const made = run('stage.add', { kind, pointArrow: arrow.id, ...(name ? { name } : {}) });
    setOpen(false);
    if (!made || !('id' in made)) return;
    const id = made.id as StageId;
    const after = useEditor.getState().doc;
    const stage = after?.stages.find((x) => x.id === id);
    const task = stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.tasks?.[0] : undefined;
    if (who && task) run('task.setWhoIsAsked', { task: task.id, whoIsAsked: who });
    // The new stage's arrow for the same button goes on to where that button's plain arrow goes.
    const carry = after ? carryOnFor(after, arrow, id) : undefined;
    if (carry) run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: carry.arrow, goTo: carry.goTo });
    // The new stage opens in the panel, with its name ready to change.
    useEditor.getState().select({ item: id });
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const name = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`input[data-reveal="${id}:name"]`);
      name?.focus();
      name?.select(); // ready to replace, not to add to (02-build approval-added)
    }, 60);
  };

  const option = (x: (typeof order)[number]) => (
    <li key={x.id}>
      <button type="button" className={s.optionRow} aria-pressed={x.id === arrow.goTo} onClick={() => choose(x.id)}>
        <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: colourVar(getStatus(doc, x.status)?.colour) }} aria-hidden />
        <span>{x.name || t('describe.noName')}</span>
        {x.id === arrow.goTo && <Icon name="check" size={14} />}
      </button>
    </li>
  );

  const when = toText(describeArrowWhen(doc, wholeWhen(arrow)));
  const deletedLine =
    state === 'deleted'
      ? when.trim() && arrow.when?.type !== 'inAllOtherCases'
        ? t('panel.chooser.deleted', { stage: text, when: when.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + when.slice(1) })
        : t('panel.chooser.deletedPlain', { stage: text })
      : '';

  return (
    <Popover
      trigger={
        <Trigger
          label={t('panel.chooser.label', { current: text })}
          state={state}
          colour={colour}
          text={text}
          data-chooser={arrow.id}
          data-reveal={`${arrow.id}:goTo`}
        />
      }
      title={askKind ? t('panel.chooser.newTitle') : t('panel.chooser.title')}
      width={askKind ? 400 : 340}
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        if (next) {
          setQuery('');
          setAskKind(false);
        }
      }}
    >
      {askKind ? (
        <div className={s.chooserBody}>
          <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => setAskKind(false)}>
            <Icon name="chevron-left" size={14} />
            {t('panel.chooser.back')}
          </button>
          <NewStageForm arrow={arrow} initialName={query.trim()} onCancel={() => setOpen(false)} onAdd={create} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={s.chooserBody}>
          {deletedLine && (
            <p className={s.deletedHead}>
              <Icon name="error" size={14} />
              <span>{deletedLine}</span>
            </p>
          )}
          <TextInput aria-label={t('panel.chooser.search')} placeholder={t('panel.chooser.search')} value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
          {working.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <div className={s.groupLabel}>{t('panel.chooser.stages')}</div>
              <ul className={s.plainList}>{working.map(option)}</ul>
            </div>
          )}
          {endings.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <div className={s.groupLabel}>{t('panel.chooser.endings')}</div>
              <ul className={s.plainList}>{endings.map(option)}</ul>
            </div>
          )}
          {words && order.length === 0 && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.chooser.noMatch', { name: query.trim() })}</p>}
          <button type="button" className={`${s.optionRow} ${s.newStage}`} onClick={() => setAskKind(true)}>
            <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
            <span>
              {state === 'deleted'
                ? t('panel.chooser.newHere')
                : query.trim()
                  ? t('panel.chooser.newNamed', { name: query.trim() })
                  : t('panel.chooser.new')}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </Popover>
  );
}

/** Small stand-ins for the slots other features fill, so this test needs no other feature. */
const testSlots: Partial<Slots> = {
  StageActions: ({ place }) => <span>{`actions: ${place}`}</span>,
  ValueField: ({ label, value }) => <span aria-label={label}>{value ? JSON.stringify(value) : ''}</span>,
  ValueChip: function Chip({ valueId }) {
    const doc = useDoc();
    return <span>{doc?.values.find((v) => v.id === valueId)?.name}</span>;
  },
  WhenBuilder: ({ addLabel, value, onChange }) =>
    value ? <span>a "when ..."</span> : <button type="button" onClick={() => onChange({ allOf: [] } as never)}>{addLabel}</button>,
  ListDialog: ({ open }) => (open ? <div role="dialog" aria-label="Domains list" /> : null),
  KindChooser: ({ onChoose }) => (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onChoose('approval')}>
      Approval kind
    </button>
  ),
};

async function openAt(workflow: string, item: string) {
  const { services } = createStandinServices();
  await openWorkflow(services, workflow);
  const view = render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={testSlots}>
        <MemoryRouter>
          <SettingsButton />
          <StagePanel />
        </MemoryRouter>
      </SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>,
  );
  act(() => useEditor.getState().select({ item }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(useSession.getState().facts).not.toBeNull());
  return view;
}

/**
 * No pause between events (`delay: null`), and words go in as one paste rather than a key at a
 * time: typing "waiting for approval" one key at a time re-rendered the panel twenty times with a
 * timer between each, which made single cases take close to a second and time out on a busy
 * machine. Nothing here depends on how fast the machine is.
 */
const setupUser = () => userEvent.setup({ delay: null });
type User = ReturnType<typeof setupUser>;
async function typeIn(user: User, box: HTMLElement, text: string, enter = false) {
  await user.click(box);
  await user.paste(text);
  if (enter) await user.keyboard('{Enter}');
}

  it('names each arrow\'s reword button after its arrow, so no two controls share a name', async () => {

    expect(rewords.length).toBe(2);

    expect(new Set(names).size).toBe(2);
    expect(names.some((n) => n?.includes('In all other cases'))).toBe(true);
    // Every control in the panel has a name of its own.
    const all = within(panel()).getAllByRole('button').map((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? b.textContent ?? '');
    const repeated = all.filter((n, i) => n && all.indexOf(n) !== i && /arrow/i.test(n));

  it('gives a stage just added its name selected, so typing replaces it', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');

  it('keeps focus in the name field after renaming with Enter', async () => {

  it('"+ only when ..." on a plain button arrow adds a new arrow above it and keeps the plain one', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
    const p = within(panel());
    expect(p.getByText('Only for some requests?')).toBeInTheDocument();
    const arrows = p.getByRole('list', { name: 'The arrows of Domain approval' });
    const approveRow = within(arrows).getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Create Jira issue' }).closest('li')!;
    fireEvent.click(within(approveRow as HTMLElement).getByRole('button', { name: '+ only when ...' }));
    const stage = getStage(doc(), 'st_domain_approval') as { arrows: { id: string; goTo: string | null; when: { type: string; button?: string }; onlyWhen?: unknown }[] };
    const approve = stage.arrows.filter((a) => a.when.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === 'btn_da_approve');
    expect(approve).toHaveLength(2);
    // The new one, kept to some requests, is above the plain one, which still goes to Create Jira issue.
    expect(approve[0]!.onlyWhen).toBeDefined();
    expect(approve[0]!.goTo).toBeNull();
    expect(approve[1]!.id).toBe('ar_da_approve');
    expect(approve[1]!.onlyWhen).toBeUndefined();
    expect(approve[1]!.goTo).toBe('st_create_jira_issue');
    expect(stage.arrows.findIndex((a) => a.id === approve[0]!.id)).toBeLessThan(stage.arrows.findIndex((a) => a.id === 'ar_da_approve'));
    expect(panel()).toHaveTextContent('Placed above the plain Approve arrow, so it is checked first.');
    // Its "only when" is not chosen yet, so it is not said to hide the plain arrow, and nothing
    // offers to move the plain one above it (03-routing, the new row).
    // Core's facts: an arrow whose "only when" is not chosen yet never makes a later one unusable (E-25).
    await waitFor(() => expect(useSession.getState().facts?.arrows).toHaveProperty(approve[0]!.id));
    expect(useSession.getState().facts?.arrows.ar_da_approve).toMatchObject({ usable: true });
    expect(panel()).not.toHaveTextContent(/can never be used/);
    expect(within(panel()).queryByRole('button', { name: /Move it above/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('does not call a new arrow whose "when" is not written "never used", and names it by its number', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
    const p = within(panel());
    fireEvent.click(p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add an arrow' }));

  });

  it('suggests where a new stage\'s button goes, from the stage that leads to it', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
    const user = setupUser();

    const approveRow = within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Create Jira issue' }).closest('li')!;
    fireEvent.click(within(approveRow as HTMLElement).getByRole('button', { name: '+ only when ...' }));

    await typeIn(user, within(pop).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Find a stage or ending' }), 'Security review');

    const form = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'New stage' });
    expect(within(form).getByRole('radio', { name: /^Approval/ })).toBeChecked();
    expect(within(form).getByText('Who is asked?')).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(within(form).getByRole('button', { name: 'Add stage' }));
    const made = doc().stages.find((x) => x.name === 'Security review') as { id: string; arrows: { goTo: string | null; when: { type: string; button?: string } }[] } | undefined;
    expect(made).toBeDefined();
    expect(made!.arrows[0]!.goTo).toBe('st_create_jira_issue');
    expect(made!.arrows[1]!.goTo).toBeNull();
    // The new stage is shown, and its Reject arrow suggests Rejected, like Reject on Domain approval.
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(panel()).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stage name' })).toHaveValue('Security review'));
    expect(panel()).toHaveTextContent('like Reject on Domain approval');
    fireEvent.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Go to Rejected' }));
    expect((getStage(doc(), made!.id as StageId) as { arrows: { goTo: string | null }[] }).arrows[1]!.goTo).toBe('st_rejected');
  });
