    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Delete Development?' });
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent('These values go with it, because only this stage fills them: Release notes.');
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent('The arrow "When done" leads here. It will need another stage.');
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete stage' }));
    expect(getStage(doc(), 'st_development' as StageId)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(within(panel()).getByText('Choose a stage on the diagram to see it here.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Focus does not fall to the page: with no diagram here, it goes to the panel.

  it('gives focus back to "More for this stage" when the delete question is cancelled or closed', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_development');
    const user = setupUser();
    const more = within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'More for this stage' });
    for (const close of ['Cancel', 'Escape'] as const) {
      await user.click(more);
      await user.click(await screen.findByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Delete this stage' }));
      const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Delete Development?' });

      else await user.keyboard('{Escape}');
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument());
      await waitFor(() => expect(document.activeElement).toBe(more));
    }
    expect(getStage(doc(), 'st_development' as StageId)).toBeDefined();
  });

describe('the stage panel says what is true (fix round 3)', () => {
  it('an arrow that sends a request back to an Automatic stage says the stage happens again, not that people are asked', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_development');
    act(() => {
      const made = useEditor.getState().run('arrow.add', { stage: 'st_development' as StageId, when: { type: 'condition' } });
      if (made && 'id' in made) useEditor.getState().run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: made.id as ArrowId, goTo: 'st_create_jira_issue' as StageId });
    });
    const row = await waitFor(() => {
      const r = within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Create Jira issue' }).closest('li') as HTMLElement;
      expect(r).toHaveTextContent('sends it back');
      return r;
    });
    expect(row).toHaveTextContent('Create Jira issue happens again.');
    expect(row).not.toHaveTextContent('asked again');
  });

  it('a "when done" arrow after an arrow that depends on answers reads "In all other cases go to", as on the arrow', async () => {
    await openAt('integrated-sample', 'st_find_owner');
    const arrows = within(panel()).getByRole('list', { name: /^The arrows of / });
    expect(arrows).toHaveTextContent('In all other cases go to');
    expect(arrows).not.toHaveTextContent('When done go to');
  });

  it('says both cases under Who is asked when "If empty, use" names a group for a person', async () => {
    await openAt('integrated-sample', 'st_fix_deployment');
    const p = within(panel());
    await waitFor(() => expect(p.getByText(/^This one person answers\. If Service owner is empty, Platform team are asked instead/)).toBeInTheDocument());
    expect(p.getByText(/the first person in the group to answer decides\.$/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(p.queryByText('This one person answers.')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('a new stage is described by two hints until it is renamed', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
    let id = '';
    act(() => {
      const made = useEditor.getState().run('stage.add', { kind: 'approval' });
      if (made && 'id' in made) id = made.id;
      useEditor.getState().select({ item: id });
    });
    const p = within(panel());
    const name = p.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stage name' });
    expect(name).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Give it a name people will recognise, like "Domain approval".');
    expect(p.getByText('Requesters see this while their request is here. You can reword it.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.change(name, { target: { value: 'Security review' } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(name, { key: 'Enter' });
    expect(p.queryByText(/Give it a name people will recognise/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(p.queryByText(/Requesters see this while their request is here/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('the "If empty, use" fix in the strip is one command, the same as the To do drawer\'s', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_development');
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('task.setWhoIsAsked', { task: 'tk_development', whoIsAsked: { value: 'v_eng_lead' } } as never));
    const strip = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'To do and Worth knowing on this stage' });
    const fix = await within(strip).findByRole('button', { name: /^If empty, \w+ Primary domain's default lead$/ });
    fireEvent.click(fix);
    expect(getTask(doc(), 'tk_development')?.whoIsAsked).toMatchObject({ value: 'v_eng_lead', ifEmptyUse: { value: 'v_primary_domain' } });
    expect(within(strip).getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent(/^Done: If Eng lead is empty, Primary domain's default lead is used\.$/);
  });

  it('"Show me" in the strip is drawn like the fixes said in words', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
    let id = '';
    act(() => {
      const made = useEditor.getState().run('stage.add', { kind: 'work' });
      if (made && 'id' in made) id = made.id;
      useEditor.getState().select({ item: id });
    });
    const strip = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'To do and Worth knowing on this stage' });
    const show = (await within(strip).findAllByRole('button', { name: /^Show me/ }))[0]!;
    const choose = within(strip).getAllByRole('button', { name: /^Choose / })[0]!;
    expect(show.className).toBe(choose.className);
  });

  it('asks where an arrow to a deleted stage should go with its whole "when"', async () => {
    await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
    act(() => {
      useEditor.getState().run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', {
        arrow: 'ar_da_reject' as ArrowId,
        onlyWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] } as never,
      });
      useEditor.getState().run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_rejected' as StageId });
    });
    act(() => reveal({ item: 'ar_da_reject', part: 'goTo' }));
    const pop = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Where it goes' });
    expect(pop).toHaveTextContent(/Where should requests go when Reject is pressed and Risk is High\?/);
  });
});

describe('who is told about a stuck request, in the strip', () => {
  it('says a group "are told" and makes "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)" a link that opens Settings', async () => {
    const opened = vi.fn();
    const stop = setSettingsOpener(opened);
    try {
      await openAt('change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
      const settings = useSession.getState().settings!;
      act(() => useSession.setState({ settings: { ...settings, stuckRequestsGoTo: [{ type: 'group', id: 'dir-group-platform-team' }] } }));
      let id = '';
      act(() => {
        const made = useEditor.getState().run('stage.add', { kind: 'approval' });
        if (made && 'id' in made) id = made.id;
        useEditor.getState().select({ item: id });
      });
      const strip = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'To do and Worth knowing on this stage' });
      await waitFor(() => expect(strip).toHaveTextContent('Platform team, who look after stuck requests, are told (change this in Settings)'));
      fireEvent.click(within(strip).getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Settings' }));
      expect(opened).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    } finally {
      stop();
    }

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { ArrowId, AuthoredWorkflow, Location, Stage } from '@/contract';
import { find, Slot, stageOf, useDoc, useEditor, useRevealRequest, useSelection, type ActionsPlace } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon, Tooltip, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { ArrowsSection } from './ArrowsSection';
import { FindingsStrip } from './FindingsStrip';
import { PanelHeader } from './PanelHeader';
import { ReachedFrom } from './ReachedFrom';
import { TaskSection } from './TaskSection';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/** One section of the spine: its node on the line, its title (and quiet hint), and its body. */
function Section({ id, icon, title, hint, glossary, children }: {
  id: string; icon: IconName; title: string; hint?: string; glossary?: string; children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section className={s.section} data-section={id} aria-labelledby={`panel-section-${id}`}>
      <span className={s.node} aria-hidden>
        <Icon name={icon} size={14} />
      </span>
      <div className={s.sectionBody}>
        <h3 className={s.sectionTitle} id={`panel-section-${id}`}>
          {glossary ? (
            <Tooltip content={glossary}>
              <button type="button" className={s.wordmark} aria-label={t('panel.glossary', { term: title })}>
                {title}
              </button>
            </Tooltip>
          ) : (
            title
          )}
          {hint && <span className={s.sectionHint}>{hint}</span>}
        </h3>
        {children}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Actions({ stageId, place }: { stageId: string; place: ActionsPlace }) {
  return <Slot name="StageActions" stageId={stageId} place={place} />;
}

/** The element in the panel that shows `location`, or null when the panel does not show it. */
function targetOf(root: HTMLElement, doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location): HTMLElement | null {
  const q = (sel: string) => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(sel);
  const { item, part } = location;
  const head = part?.split('.')[0];
  const direct = (part && (q(`[data-reveal="${item}:${part}"]`) ?? q(`[data-reveal="${item}:${head}"]`))) || q(`[data-reveal="${item}"]`);
  if (direct) return direct;
  const entry = find(doc, item);
  if (!entry) return null;
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'stage':
      return head ? q(`[data-section="${head}"]`) : null;
    case 'action':
      return entry.parents.section ? q(`[data-section="${entry.parents.section}"]`) : null;
    case 'page':
    case 'question':
    case 'text':
    case 'choice':
      return entry.parents.task ? q(`[data-reveal="${entry.parents.task}:form"]`) : null;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

const FLASH = s.flash ?? '';
const FOCUSABLE = 'input, select, textarea, button, [href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

/** The chosen stage: fixed header, the strip, then the fixed anatomy as a spine. */
function StageView({ stage }: { stage: Stage }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const selection = useSelection();
  const request = useRevealRequest();
  const lastChange = useEditor((st) => st.lastChange);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // A stage chosen opens at its top (its header, its To do strip), not where the last stage was
  // scrolled to. Runs before the effect below, which scrolls to anything inside the stage chosen.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const scroller = rootRef.current?.closest('aside');
    if (scroller) scroller.scrollTop = 0;
  }, []);

  // An arrow chosen on the diagram (or anything revealed by "Show me"): scroll to it and flash it.
  const selected = selection?.item;
  const selectedPart = selection?.part;
  const nonce = request?.nonce;
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    const current = useEditor.getState().doc;
    if (!root || !current || !selected || selected === stage.id && !selectedPart) return;
    const el = targetOf(root, current, { item: selected, ...(selectedPart ? { part: selectedPart } : {}) });
    if (!el) return;
    el.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
    el.classList.remove(FLASH);
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add(FLASH);
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove(FLASH), 1600);
    const revealed = request && request.location.item === selected;
    if (revealed) {
      const focusable = el.matches(FOCUSABLE) ? el : el.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE);
      focusable?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      // A name revealed (a stage just added, a workflow just made, "Show me" on a name) is ready to
      // replace: typing the real name replaces "Approval", it does not add to it (02-build approval-added).
      if (selectedPart === 'name' && focusable instanceof HTMLInputElement) focusable.select();
    }
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    // `request` is read for the focus only; its nonce is the trigger.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [selected, selectedPart, nonce, stage.id]);

  if (!doc) return null;
  const connected =
    lastChange?.name === 'arrow.connect' && lastChange.via === 'run' && find(doc, selected)?.kind === 'arrow' ? (selected as ArrowId) : null;

  return (
    <div className={s.stage} ref={rootRef}>
      <PanelHeader stage={stage} onClosed={() => rootRef.current?.closest('aside')?.focus()} />
      <FindingsStrip stageId={stage.id} />
      {stage.kind !== 'ending' && (
        <div className={s.spine}>
          <Section id="reachedFrom" icon="enter" title={t('panel.reachedFrom')}>
            <ReachedFrom stage={stage} />
          </Section>
          {stage.kind === 'automatic' ? (
            <Section id="whenThisStageStarts" icon="automatic" title={t('panel.whatItDoes')} hint={t('panel.whatItDoesSub')}>
              <Actions stageId={stage.id} place="automatic" />
            </Section>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Section id="whenThisStageStarts" icon="start" title={t('panel.whenStarts')} hint={t('panel.whenStartsSub')}>
                <Actions stageId={stage.id} place="stageStarts" />
              </Section>
              <Section id="tasks" icon="task" title={t('word.task')} glossary={t('glossary.task.line')}>
                <TaskSection stage={stage} />
              </Section>
              <Section id="afterTheyRespond" icon="reply" title={t('panel.afterRespond')} hint={t('panel.afterRespondSub')}>
                <Actions stageId={stage.id} place="afterRespond" />
              </Section>
            </>
          )}
          <Section id="arrows" icon="branch" title={t('word.thenGoTo')}>
            <ArrowsSection stage={stage} connected={connected} />
          </Section>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The Diagram tab's right side. Nothing chosen: a quiet line. A stage, or anything inside one
 * (an arrow chosen on the diagram, a button, a task ...): that stage, scrolled to the thing chosen.
 */
export function StagePanel() {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const selection = useSelection();
  const stage = doc && selection ? stageOf(doc, selection.item) : undefined;
  return (
    <aside className={s.panel} aria-label={t('panel.label')} tabIndex={-1}>
      {stage ? <StageView key={stage.id} stage={stage} /> : <p className={s.empty}>{t('panel.empty')}</p>}
    </aside>
  );
}

import { useId, useMemo, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { StageId, Status, StatusId } from '@/contract';
import { useDoc, useRun } from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Icon, Popover, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { colourVar } from './logic';
import s from './panel.module.css';

const COLOURS: readonly Status['colour'][] = ['grey', 'red', 'amber', 'green', 'blue', 'purple', 'teal', 'pink'];

type Field = 'status' | 'ifSentBackStatus';

/**
 * "Status people see" (or "If sent back:"): the status as words beside its colour. The popover lists
 * the statuses already in the workflow (picking one reuses it), takes new words (a new status), and
 * sets the colour of the status shown, for every stage that shows it.
 */
export function StatusPicker({ stageId, field, label, statusId }: { stageId: StageId; field: Field; label: string; statusId: StatusId | undefined }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const listId = useId();
  const statuses = useMemo(() => doc?.statuses ?? [], [doc]);
  const current = statuses.find((x) => x.id === statusId);
  const command = field === 'status' ? 'stage.setStatus' : 'stage.setIfSentBackStatus';

  const words = query.trim();
  const shown = words ? statuses.filter((x) => (x.words ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(words.toLowerCase())) : statuses;
  const exact = statuses.find((x) => (x.words ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === words.toLowerCase());

  const pick = (status: StatusId | null) => {
    run(command, { stage: stageId, status });
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const create = () => {
    if (!words) return;
    if (exact) pick(exact.id);
    else {
      run(command, { stage: stageId, words });
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      create();
    }
  };

  const trigger = (
    <button type="button" className={s.statusTrigger} aria-label={t('panel.status.trigger', { label, words: current?.words || t('panel.status.none') })}>
      <span className={s.swatch} style={{ background: colourVar(current?.colour) }} aria-hidden />
      <span className={current ? undefined : s.quiet}>{current?.words || t('panel.status.none')}</span>
      <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} />
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <Popover
      trigger={trigger}
      title={label}
      width={320}
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        if (next) setQuery('');
      }}
    >
      <div className={s.statusPop}>
        <TextInput
          aria-label={t('panel.status.words')}
          placeholder={t('panel.status.placeholder')}
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
          aria-describedby={`${listId}-hint`}
          autoFocus
        />
        <div className={s.statusGroup} id={listId}>
          <div className={s.groupLabel}>{t('panel.status.inUse')}</div>
          <ul className={s.plainList}>
            {shown.map((x) => (
              <li key={x.id}>
                <button type="button" className={s.optionRow} aria-pressed={x.id === statusId} onClick={() => pick(x.id)}>
                  <span className={s.swatch} style={{ background: colourVar(x.colour) }} aria-hidden />
                  <span>{x.words || t('describe.noName')}</span>
                  {x.id === statusId && <Icon name="check" size={14} />}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
            {words && !exact && (
              <li>
                <button type="button" className={s.optionRow} onClick={create}>
                  <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
                  <span>{t('panel.status.new', { words })}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            )}
            {statusId && (
              <li>
                <button type="button" className={`${s.optionRow} ${s.quiet}`} onClick={() => pick(null)}>
                  <Icon name="close" size={14} />
                  <span>{t('panel.status.clear')}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            )}
          </ul>
        </div>
        {current && (
          <fieldset className={s.colours}>
            <legend className={s.groupLabel}>{t('panel.status.colour')}</legend>
            <div className={s.colourRow}>
              {COLOURS.map((colour) => (
                <label key={colour} className={s.colourOption}>
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name={`${listId}-colour`}
                    checked={current.colour === colour}
                    onChange={() => run('status.setColour', { status: current.id, colour })}
                  />
                  <span className={s.swatch} style={{ background: colourVar(colour) }} aria-hidden />
                  <span>{t(`panel.colour.${colour}` as WordKey)}</span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
        )}
        <p className={s.hint} id={`${listId}-hint`}>
          {t('panel.status.shared')}
        </p>
      </div>
    </Popover>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { Button as ButtonItem, ButtonId, Task, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeArrowWhen, describeChoicesSource, describeCondition, describeExpression, isStartStage, Slot, taskNameOf, toText, useDescribeEnv, useDoc,
  useEditor, useRun, useSessionWorkflowId,
} from '@/model';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, buttonClass, Callout, Icon, IconButton, Menu } from '@/ui';
import { buttonsNeeding, formSummary, joinNames, neededLabels, questionKindKey, textShows } from './logic';
import { WhoIsAsked } from './WhoIsAsked';
import s from './panel.module.css';

/** A one-line text box that saves on Enter or when left; Escape gives up. */
function InlineName({ label, value, onCommit, onDone }: { label: string; value: string; onCommit(next: string): void; onDone(): void }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const finish = (save: boolean) => {
    if (save && ref.current && ref.current.value !== value) onCommit(ref.current.value);
    onDone();
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      finish(true);
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      finish(false);
    }
  };
  return <input ref={ref} className={s.inlineInput} aria-label={label} defaultValue={value} autoFocus onBlur={() => finish(true)} onKeyDown={onKey} />;
}

/** The form's summary card: questions, pages, the values it saves, and "Edit form". */
function FormSummary({ stage, task, taskName }: { stage: WorkingStage; task: Task; taskName: string | null }) {
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const summary = formSummary(task);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const questions =
    summary.questions === 0 ? t('panel.form.noQuestions') : summary.questions === 1 ? t('panel.form.question') : t('panel.form.questions', { n: summary.questions });
  const pages = summary.pages === 1 ? t('panel.form.page') : t('panel.form.pages', { n: summary.pages });
  return (
    <div className={s.sub} data-reveal={`${task.id}:form`}>
      <div className={s.subLabel}>{t('word.form')}</div>
      <div className={s.formCard}>
        <div className={s.formHead}>
          <span className={s.formIcon}>
            <Icon name="form" size={16} />
          </span>
          <div className={s.grow}>
            <div className={s.formTitle}>{questions}</div>
            <div className={s.quiet}>{pages}</div>
          </div>
          {workflowId && (
            <Link
              className={buttonClass('secondary', 'sm')}
              to={`/w/${workflowId}/form/${stage.id}/${task.id}`}
              aria-label={taskName ? t('panel.form.editLabel', { task: taskName }) : t('panel.form.editLabelStage', { stage: stage.name?.trim() || t('describe.noName') })}
            >
              <Icon name="edit" size={14} />
              {t('panel.form.edit')}
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
        {summary.items.length > 0 && (
          <ul className={s.formTexts}>
            {summary.items.map((item) => {
              if (item.type === 'text') {
                const shows = textShows(item);
                return (
                  <li key={item.id} className={s.formText} data-reveal={item.id}>
                    <Icon name="note" size={14} />
                    <div>
                      <div className={s.formTextKind}>{t('panel.form.text')}</div>
                      {item.showWhen && (
                        <div className={s.quiet}>
                          {t('panel.form.shownOnlyWhen')} <PhraseView phrase={describeCondition(doc, item.showWhen)} />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {shows.length > 0 && (
                        <div className={s.formLine}>
                          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.form.shows')}</span>{' '}
                          {shows.map((piece, i) => (
                            <span key={i}>
                              <PhraseView phrase={describeExpression(doc, piece, env)} />
                              {i < shows.length - 2 ? t('panel.list.comma') : i === shows.length - 2 ? ` ${t('panel.form.and')} ` : ''}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              }
              const kindKey = questionKindKey(item.kind);
              const needs = buttonsNeeding(task, item);
              return (
                <li key={item.id} className={s.formText} data-reveal={item.id}>
                  <Icon name={kindKey} size={14} />
                  <div>
                    <div className={s.formTextKind}>{item.label?.trim() || t('describe.noName')}</div>
                    <div className={s.quiet}>
                      {t(`valueKind.${kindKey}`)}
                      {item.choices && (
                        <>
                          {t('panel.form.kindSep')}
                          <PhraseView phrase={describeChoicesSource(doc, item.choices, env)} />
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {item.showWhen && (
                      <div className={s.quiet}>
                        {t('panel.form.shownOnlyWhen')} <PhraseView phrase={describeCondition(doc, item.showWhen, env)} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {item.savedAs && (
                      <div className={s.formLine}>
                        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.form.savedAs')}</span> <Slot name="ValueChip" valueId={item.savedAs} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {needs.length > 0 && (
                      <div className={s.formLine}>
                        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.form.neededToPress')}</span> <b>{joinNames(needs)}</b>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
        {summary.alsoSaves.length > 0 && (
          <div className={s.formSaves}>
            <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.form.alsoSaves')}</span>
            {summary.alsoSaves.map((v) => (
              <Slot key={v} name="ValueChip" valueId={v} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** One button: its chip, what it needs, its "Also only when ...", and a menu to rename, move or remove it. */
function ButtonRow({ stage, task, button, index, count, editing, setEditing }: {
  stage: WorkingStage; task: Task; button: ButtonItem; index: number; count: number; editing: boolean; setEditing(id: ButtonId | null): void;
}) {
  const run = useRun();
  const chipRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const wasEditing = useRef(editing);
  useEffect(() => {
    // After naming the button, focus goes back to its chip.
    if (wasEditing.current && !editing) chipRef.current?.focus();
    wasEditing.current = editing;
  }, [editing]);
  const needs = neededLabels(task, button);
  const name = button.label?.trim() ? button.label : t('describe.noName');
  return (
    <li className={s.buttonRow} data-reveal={button.id}>
      <div className={s.buttonLine}>
        {editing ? (
          <InlineName
            label={t('panel.button.name')}
            value={button.label ?? ''}
            onCommit={(label) => run('button.rename', { button: button.id, label })}
            onDone={() => setEditing(null)}
          />
        ) : (
          <button ref={chipRef} type="button" className={`${s.buttonChip} ${button.label?.trim() ? '' : s.pchipMissing}`} onClick={() => setEditing(button.id)} aria-label={t('panel.button.renameLabel', { button: name })}>
            {name}
          </button>
        )}
        {needs.length > 0 && (
          <span className={s.needs}>
            <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.button.needs')}</span> {joinNames(needs)}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className={s.grow} />
        <Menu
          align="end"
          trigger={<IconButton icon="more" size="sm" label={t('panel.button.menu', { button: name })} />}
          items={[
            { label: t('panel.button.rename'), icon: 'edit', onSelect: () => setEditing(button.id) },
            { label: t('panel.button.moveUp'), icon: 'chevron-up', disabled: index === 0, onSelect: () => run('button.move', { button: button.id, toIndex: index - 1 }) },
            { label: t('panel.button.moveDown'), icon: 'chevron-down', disabled: index === count - 1, onSelect: () => run('button.move', { button: button.id, toIndex: index + 1 }) },
            'separator',
            { label: t('panel.button.remove'), icon: 'trash', danger: true, onSelect: () => run('button.delete', { button: button.id }) },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      {/* Named by its button, so each "+ Also only when ..." on the stage says whose it is. */}
      <div className={s.alsoWhen} role="group" aria-label={t('panel.button.alsoOnlyWhenGroup', { button: name })}>
        <Slot
          name="WhenBuilder"
          at={{ item: button.id, part: 'enabledWhen' }}
          stageId={stage.id}
          addLabel={t('panel.button.alsoOnlyWhen')}
          value={button.enabledWhen}
          onChange={(next) => run('button.setEnabledWhen', { button: button.id, ...(next === undefined ? {} : { enabledWhen: next }) })}
        />
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

function Buttons({ stage, task }: { stage: WorkingStage; task: Task }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<ButtonId | null>(null);
  const buttons = task.buttons ?? [];
  return (
    <div className={s.sub} data-reveal={`${task.id}:buttons`}>
      <div className={s.subLabel}>{t('panel.buttons')}</div>
      {buttons.length === 0 && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.buttons.none')}</p>}
      <ul className={s.plainList}>
        {buttons.map((button, i) => (
          <ButtonRow
            key={button.id}
            stage={stage}
            task={task}
            button={button}
            index={i}
            count={buttons.length}
            editing={editing === button.id}
            setEditing={setEditing}
          />
        ))}
      </ul>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={s.addLine}
        onClick={() => {
          const made = run('button.add', { task: task.id });
          if (made && 'id' in made) setEditing(made.id);
        }}
      >
        <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
        {t('panel.button.add')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/** One task: Who is asked, Form, Buttons. With several tasks each is a card named after who is asked. */
function TaskBody({ stage, task, several, isStart }: { stage: WorkingStage; task: Task; several: boolean; isStart: boolean }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = useState(false);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const name = taskNameOf(doc, task);
  const body = (
    <>
      <WhoIsAsked stageId={stage.id} task={task} isStart={isStart} showOwnRequest={!isStart && (stage.kind === 'approval' || task.requesterCanAnswer === false)} />
      {/* A single task has no name of its own (never "Task 1"): its form is the stage's. */}
      <FormSummary stage={stage} task={task} taskName={several ? name : null} />
      <Buttons stage={stage} task={task} />
    </>
  );
  if (!several) return <div data-reveal={task.id}>{body}</div>;
  return (
    <section className={s.taskCard} data-reveal={task.id} aria-label={name}>
      <div className={s.taskHead}>
        {renaming ? (
          <InlineName
            label={t('panel.task.nameLabel')}
            value={task.name ?? name}
            onCommit={(next) => run('task.rename', { task: task.id, ...(next.trim() ? { name: next } : {}) })}
            onDone={() => setRenaming(false)}
          />
        ) : (
          <h4 className={s.taskName}>{name}</h4>
        )}
        <span className={s.grow} />
        <Menu
          align="end"
          trigger={<IconButton icon="more" size="sm" label={t('panel.task.menu', { task: name })} />}
          items={[
            { label: t('panel.task.rename'), icon: 'edit', onSelect: () => setRenaming(true) },
            ...(task.name ? [{ label: t('panel.task.useWho'), icon: 'person' as const, onSelect: () => run('task.rename', { task: task.id }) }] : []),
            'separator' as const,
            { label: t('panel.task.remove'), icon: 'trash', danger: true, onSelect: () => run('task.delete', { task: task.id }) },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      {body}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * The Task section: each task, then "+ Ask someone else at the same time" (or "+ Add a task" on a
 * stage with none). Adding a second task names the tasks in the arrows; the editor says so.
 */
export function TaskSection({ stage }: { stage: WorkingStage }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const run = useRun();
  const [rewritten, setRewritten] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const noteRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (rewritten !== null) noteRef.current?.focus();
  }, [rewritten]);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const tasks = stage.tasks ?? [];
  const isStart = isStartStage(doc, stage.id);

  const addTask = () => {
    const before = tasks.length;
    const made = run('task.add', { stage: stage.id });
    if (!made || !('id' in made) || before !== 1) return;
    const after = useEditor.getState().doc;
    const next = after?.stages.find((x) => x.id === stage.id);
    const arrow = next && next.kind !== 'ending' ? next.arrows.find((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button) : undefined;
    setRewritten(after && arrow ? toText(describeArrowWhen(after, arrow)) : '');
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.tasks}>
      {tasks.map((task) => (
        <TaskBody key={task.id} stage={stage} task={task} several={tasks.length > 1} isStart={isStart} />
      ))}
      {rewritten !== null && tasks.length > 1 && (
        <div ref={noteRef} tabIndex={-1} className={s.noteWrap}>
          <Callout
            tone="info"
            icon="check"
            actions={
              <>
                <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={() => { useEditor.getState().undo(); setRewritten(null); }}>
                  {t('panel.task.undo')}
                </Button>
                <IconButton icon="close" size="sm" label={t('panel.task.dismiss')} onClick={() => setRewritten(null)} />
              </>
            }
          >
            <b>{t('panel.task.rewritten.title')}</b>{' '}
            {rewritten ? t('panel.task.rewritten', { example: rewritten }) : t('panel.task.rewrittenPlain')}
          </Callout>
        </div>
      )}
      {!isStart && (
        <button type="button" className={s.addLine} onClick={addTask}>
          <Icon name="plus" size={14} />
          {tasks.length === 0 ? t('panel.task.add') : t('panel.task.addAnother')}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Expression, StageId, Task } from '@/contract';

/** The switch "The requester can't answer their own request" (on: the requester may not answer). */
function OwnRequestSwitch({ task }: { task: Task }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const on = task.requesterCanAnswer === false;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="switch"
      aria-checked={on}
      className={s.switch}
      onClick={() => run('task.setRequesterCanAnswer', { task: task.id, value: on })}
    >
      <span className={s.switchTrack} aria-hidden />
      <span>{t('panel.who.ownRequest')}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * "Depends on the answer to [Primary domain]": each answer and who is asked for it. Every "who" is a
 * chip that opens the list where it is kept (the Domains list), so it is changed in place; a row with
 * nobody reads "Not asked: these skip this stage", unless the check says such a request does reach
 * this stage, when it says nobody is given (the To do strip explains). "Edit the Domains list" below.
 */
function DependsTable({ stageId, task, expr }: { stageId: StageId; task: Task; expr: Expression }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const findings = useFindingsFor(task.id);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const link = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const depends = doc ? dependsOnList(doc, expr, stageId) : undefined;
  if (!doc || !depends) return null;
  const reachesEmpty = findings.some((f) => f.code === 'task.askedMayBeEmpty');
  const openList = (from: HTMLElement) => {
    opener.current = from;
    setOpen(true);
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.depends}>
      <div className={s.dependsHead}>
        <span>{t('panel.who.dependsOn')}</span>
        <Slot name="ValueChip" valueId={depends.valueId} />
      </div>
      <table className={s.dependsTable}>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">{t('panel.who.answer')}</th>
            <th scope="col">{t('word.whoIsAsked')}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {depends.rows.map((row) => {
            // A row whose requests never come here skips the stage, whoever the list names for it.
            const who = row.who && !row.skips ? toText(describeConstant(doc, row.who)) : '';
            return (
              <tr key={row.id}>
                <th scope="row">{row.answer}</th>
                <td>
                  {who ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={s.whoCell}
                      aria-label={t('panel.who.cellLabel', { answer: row.answer, who, list: depends.listName })}
                      onClick={(e) => openList(e.currentTarget)}
                    >
                      <Icon name="group" size={13} />
                      <span>{who}</span>
                      <Icon name="chevron-down" size={13} />
                    </button>
                  ) : reachesEmpty && !row.skips ? (
                    <span className={s.missingText}>{t('panel.who.nobody', { list: depends.listName })}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.who.skips')}</span>
                  )}
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div className={s.dependsFoot}>
        <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.who.keptIn', { list: depends.listName })}</span>
        <button ref={link} type="button" className={s.link} onClick={(e) => openList(e.currentTarget)}>
          <Icon name="table" size={14} />
          {t('panel.who.editList', { list: depends.listName })}
        </button>
      </div>
      <Slot
        name="ListDialog"
        listId={depends.listId}
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(next) => {
          setOpen(next);
          if (!next) requestAnimationFrame(() => (opener.current?.isConnected ? opener.current : link.current)?.focus());
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The plain line on how answering works. When "If empty, use" names the other kind of answerer (a
 * person whose fallback is a group, or the other way round) both cases are said, so the line is true
 * for every request.
 */
function askedRule(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expr: Expression | undefined, kind: 'person' | 'group', facts: Facts | null): string {
  const fallback = ifEmptyUseOf(expr);
  const other = fallback ? askedKind(doc, fallback, facts) : undefined;
  if (!expr || !fallback || !other || other === kind) return t(kind === 'group' ? 'rule.group' : 'rule.person');
  const own = { ...(expr as object) } as Record<string, unknown>;
  delete own.ifEmptyUse;
  const value = toText(describeExpression(doc, own as Expression, {}, { short: true }));
  const instead = toText(describeExpression(doc, fallback, {}, { short: true }));
  return t(kind === 'person' ? 'panel.who.personElseGroup' : 'panel.who.groupElsePerson', { value, fallback: instead });
}

/**
 * "Who is asked": the value slot (a person or group, with "If empty, use"), always the one plain line
 * on how answering works, the per-answer table when it depends on a list, and the Approval switch.
 * On the start stage: the Requester, asked again only when a request is sent back (locked until an
 * arrow leads back here).
 */
export function WhoIsAsked({ stageId, task, isStart, showOwnRequest }: { stageId: StageId; task: Task; isStart: boolean; showOwnRequest: boolean }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const run = useRun();
  if (!doc) return null;
  const at = { item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' };
  const kind = askedKind(doc, task.whoIsAsked, facts);
  const field = (
    <Slot
      name="ValueField"
      at={at}
      label={t('word.whoIsAsked')}
      accepts={['person', 'group', 'people']}
      allowTyped
      allowIfEmptyUse
      value={task.whoIsAsked}
      onChange={(next) => run('task.setWhoIsAsked', { task: task.id, ...(next === undefined ? {} : { whoIsAsked: next }) })}
    />
  );

  if (isStart) {
    const locked = arrowsInto(doc, stageId).length === 0;
    return (
      <div className={s.sub} data-reveal={`${task.id}:whoIsAsked`}>
        <div className={s.subLabel}>{t('word.whoIsAsked')}</div>
        {locked ? (
          <div className={s.lockedSlot}>
            <Chip variant="person">{t('describe.request.requester')}</Chip>
            <span className={s.quiet}>{t('panel.who.requester')}</span>
            <Icon name="lock" size={14} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          field
        )}
        <p className={s.ruleLine}>
          <Icon name="sendback" size={14} />
          <span>{t('panel.who.askedAgain')}</span>
        </p>
        {locked && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('panel.who.locked')}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={s.sub} data-reveal={`${task.id}:whoIsAsked`}>
      <div className={s.subLabel}>{t('word.whoIsAsked')}</div>
      {field}
      {kind && (
        <p className={s.ruleLine}>
          <Icon name={kind} size={14} />
          <span>{askedRule(doc, task.whoIsAsked, kind, facts)}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {task.whoIsAsked && <DependsTable stageId={stageId} task={task} expr={task.whoIsAsked} />}
      {showOwnRequest && <OwnRequestSwitch task={task} />}
    </div>
  );
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/logic.ts\n===
/**
 * Pure helpers for the stage panel: when order matters under "Then go to", what kind of answerer a
 * "Who is asked" gives, the per-answer table when it depends on a list, the form summary, what a
 * button needs, what goes with a deleted stage, and where a fix that needs a choice is made.
 * Nothing here writes the document: commands are run by the caller.
 */
import type {
  Arrow, ArrowId, AuthoredWorkflow, Button, Condition, Constant, Expression, FormItem, FormText, ListId, Location, Question, Stage, StageId, Status, Task, ValueId, WorkingStage,
} from '@/contract';
import type { Facts } from '@/services';
import {
  applyCommand, arrowChoices, arrowLabel, arrowsInto, describeCondition, describeConstant, find, getList, hasMissing, toText, type FindingFix,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';

/** The kinds of stage an icon and a word exist for. */
export type KindKey = 'form' | 'approval' | 'work' | 'automatic' | 'ending' | 'blank';

export const kindOf = (stage: Stage): KindKey => (stage.kind ?? 'blank') as KindKey;

/**
 * Order matters (editor-model.md sections 2 and 3) on a stage with more than one arrow when an arrow
 * is kept to some requests ("+ only when ..."), when arrows depend on answers (a "when ..." or "In all
 * other cases"), when several tasks are asked, or when the facts say an earlier arrow hides a later one.
 */
export function orderMatters(stage: WorkingStage, facts: Facts | null): boolean {
  const arrows = stage.arrows ?? [];
  if (arrows.length < 2) return false;
  if ((stage.tasks ?? []).length > 1) return true;
  if (arrows.some((a) => a.onlyWhen)) return true;
  if (arrows.some((a) => a.when?.type === 'condition' || a.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases')) return true;
  return arrows.some((a) => {
    const f = facts?.arrows[a.id];
    return f?.usable === false && f.reason === 'earlierArrowAlwaysFits';
  });
}

/** Every button of the stage has an arrow of its own ("Every button has an arrow."). */
export function everyButtonHasArrow(stage: WorkingStage): boolean {
  const buttons = (stage.tasks ?? []).flatMap((task) => task.buttons ?? []);
  if (buttons.length === 0) return false;
  return buttons.every((b) => (stage.arrows ?? []).some((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === b.id));
}

const has = <K extends string>(node: unknown, key: K): node is Record<K, unknown> =>
  !!node && typeof node === 'object' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(node, key);

/** Whether "Who is asked" gives one person or a group (several people): for the plain line under it. */
export function askedKind(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expr: Expression | undefined, facts: Facts | null): 'person' | 'group' | undefined {
  if (!expr || typeof expr !== 'object') return undefined;
  if (has(expr, 'person')) return 'person';
  if (has(expr, 'group')) return 'group';
  const steps = has(expr, 'steps') && Array.isArray(expr.steps) ? (expr.steps as object[]) : [];
  const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
  if (last && has(last, 'directory')) return 'group';
  if (last && has(last, 'column')) {
    const column = find(doc, String(last.column));
    if (column?.kind === 'column') return column.item.kind === 'person' ? 'person' : column.item.kind === 'group' ? 'group' : undefined;
    return undefined;
  }
  if (has(expr, 'request')) return expr.request === 'requester' ? 'person' : undefined;
  if (has(expr, 'value') && typeof expr.value === 'string') {
    const kind = facts?.values[expr.value as ValueId]?.kind;
    if (kind === 'person') return 'person';
    if (kind === 'group' || kind === 'people') return 'group';
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The "If empty, use" of a value or request reference, when it has one. */
export function ifEmptyUseOf(expr: Expression | undefined): Expression | undefined {
  if (!expr || typeof expr !== 'object' || !has(expr, 'ifEmptyUse')) return undefined;
  const use = expr.ifEmptyUse;
  return use && typeof use === 'object' ? (use as Expression) : undefined;
}

export interface DependsRow {
  id: string;
  /** What the person answered (the row's shown column), e.g. "Payments". */
  answer: string;
  /** Who is asked for that answer, or undefined when the list gives nobody. */
  who: Constant | undefined;
  /**
   * True when the arrows say a request with this answer never comes to the stage (an earlier arrow
   * that depends on the same answer takes it elsewhere, as "Domain needs no approval (Identity or
   * Internal tools)"), so whoever the list names is not asked here.
   */
  skips: boolean;
}

/** True when every clause of `condition` reads (a column of) value `valueId`. */
function onlyAbout(condition: Condition | undefined, valueId: string): boolean {
  if (!condition || typeof condition !== 'object' || 'formula' in condition) return false;
  const clauses = ('allOf' in condition ? condition.allOf : 'anyOf' in condition ? condition.anyOf : undefined) ?? [];
  return (
    clauses.length > 0 &&
    clauses.every((c) => {
      if (!c || typeof c !== 'object' || 'pressed' in c) return false;
      const left = (c as { left?: unknown }).left;
      return !!left && typeof left === 'object' && (left as { value?: unknown }).value === valueId;
    })
  );
}

/**
 * The row labels (first column, as the arrows' brackets say them) an arrow takes, when its choice
 * rests only on answer `valueId`; null when it takes every row; undefined when the editor cannot say.
 */
function rowsTaken(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow, valueId: string): Set<string> | null | undefined {
  const when = arrow.when?.type;
  if (when === 'condition') {
    if (!onlyAbout(arrow.when?.type === 'condition' ? arrow.when.condition : undefined, valueId)) return undefined;
    const labels = arrowChoices(doc, arrow);
    return labels ? new Set(labels) : undefined;
  }
  if (arrow.onlyWhen) {
    if (!onlyAbout(arrow.onlyWhen, valueId)) return undefined;
    const labels = arrowChoices(doc, arrow);
    return labels ? new Set(labels) : undefined;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The labels of the list's rows whose requests never reach `stageId`: for every arrow into it, an
 * earlier arrow of the same stage (checked first) that depends only on this answer takes the row
 * somewhere else, or the arrow's own "when ..." leaves the row out. Anything the editor cannot work
 * out counts as reaching the stage, so the table never hides who may be asked.
 */
function rowsThatSkip(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: string, valueId: string, labels: string[]): Set<string> {
  const into = arrowsInto(doc, stageId);
  if (into.length === 0) return new Set();
  const skip = new Set<string>();
  for (const label of labels) {
    const reaches = into.some(({ from, arrow }) => {
      const own = rowsTaken(doc, arrow, valueId);
      if (own && !own.has(label)) return false;
      const arrows = from.kind === 'ending' ? [] : from.arrows ?? [];
      for (const earlier of arrows.slice(0, arrows.indexOf(arrow))) {
        if (earlier.when?.type !== 'condition' || earlier.goTo === stageId) continue;
        const taken = rowsTaken(doc, earlier, valueId);
        if (taken === undefined) return true; // cannot say: it may reach
        if (taken?.has(label)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
    if (!reaches) skip.add(label);
  }
  return skip;
}

export interface Depends {
  /** The answer it depends on, e.g. Primary domain. */
  valueId: ValueId;
  listId: ListId;
  listName: string;
  rows: DependsRow[];
}

/**
 * "It depends on Primary domain": who is asked is a column of the row a list question was answered
 * with. The table pairs each row (by the question's shown column, else the list's first column) with
 * that row's cell. Undefined for anything else.
 */
export function dependsOnList(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expr: Expression | undefined, stageId?: string): Depends | undefined {
  if (!expr || !has(expr, 'value') || typeof expr.value !== 'string' || !has(expr, 'steps') || !Array.isArray(expr.steps)) return undefined;
  const steps = expr.steps as object[];
  const step = steps[0];
  if (steps.length !== 1 || !step || !has(step, 'column')) return undefined;
  const column = find(doc, String(step.column));
  if (column?.kind !== 'column' || !column.parents.list) return undefined;
  const list = getList(doc, column.parents.list);
  if (!list) return undefined;
  const question = [...doc.stages]
    .flatMap((s) => (s.kind === 'ending' ? [] : s.tasks ?? []))
    .flatMap((task) => task.form?.pages ?? [])
    .flatMap((page) => page.items ?? [])
    .find((item) => item.type === 'question' && item.savedAs === expr.value && item.choices?.from === 'list' && item.choices.list === list.id);
  const shown =
    (question?.type === 'question' && question.choices?.from === 'list' ? question.choices.shownColumn : undefined) ??
    list.columns.find((c) => c.kind === 'text')?.id ??
    list.columns[0]?.id;
  // The arrows' brackets name rows by the list's first column.
  const first = list.columns[0]?.id;
  const bracketLabel = (row: (typeof list.rows)[number]) => {
    const cell = first ? row.cells?.[first as keyof typeof row.cells] : undefined;
    return cell ? toText(describeConstant(doc, cell)) : '';
  };
  const skipping = stageId ? rowsThatSkip(doc, stageId, expr.value, (list.rows ?? []).map(bracketLabel).filter(Boolean)) : new Set<string>();
  const rows = (list.rows ?? []).map((row) => {
    const label = shown ? row.cells?.[shown] : undefined;
    const bracket = bracketLabel(row);
    return {
      id: row.id,
      answer: label ? toText(describeConstant(doc, label)) : t('panel.who.notGiven'),
      who: row.cells?.[column.id as keyof typeof row.cells],
      skips: !!bracket && skipping.has(bracket),
    };
  });
  return { valueId: expr.value as ValueId, listId: list.id, listName: list.name, rows };
}

/**
 * The form card: pages and questions counted, every item in order, and the task's two extra
 * answers (Button pressed, Answered by) when saved. Those are not questions, so they are kept apart.
 */
export function formSummary(task: Task): { pages: number; questions: number; items: FormItem[]; alsoSaves: ValueId[] } {
  const pages = task.form?.pages ?? [];
  const items = pages.flatMap((p) => p.items ?? []);
  const alsoSaves = [task.savesButtonPressedAs, task.savesAnsweredByAs].filter((v): v is ValueId => !!v);
  return { pages: pages.length, questions: items.filter((item) => item.type === 'question').length, items, alsoSaves: [...new Set(alsoSaves)] };
}

/** The word key of a question's kind under `valueKind.*` ("Person", "Long text" ...), and its icon. */
export function questionKindKey(kind: Question['kind'] | undefined): 'text' | 'longtext' | 'number' | 'yesno' | 'date' | 'choice' | 'multichoice' | 'person' | 'group' {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'longText':
      return 'longtext';
    case 'yesNo':
      return 'yesno';
    case 'multipleChoice':
      return 'multichoice';
    case 'number':
    case 'date':
    case 'choice':
    case 'person':
    case 'group':
      return kind;
    default:
      return 'text';
  }
}

/** "Needed to press": the names of the task's buttons that need this question, in button order. */
export function buttonsNeeding(task: Task, question: Question): string[] {
  return (task.buttons ?? [])
    .filter((b) => question.neededForEveryButton || (b.neededToPress ?? []).includes(question.id))
    .map((b) => b.label?.trim() || t('describe.noName'));
}

/** The chips in a text people can read ("Shows Title, Description ..."): its expressions, in order. */
export function textShows(text: FormText): Expression[] {
  return (text.content ?? []).filter((piece): piece is Expression => typeof piece !== 'string');
}

/** The labels of the questions a button needs: its "Needed to press" plus every question needed for all buttons. */
export function neededLabels(task: Task, button: Button): string[] {
  const all = (task.form?.pages ?? []).flatMap((p) => p.items ?? []);
  const ids = new Set<string>(button.neededToPress ?? []);
  for (const item of all) if (item.type === 'question' && item.neededForEveryButton) ids.add(item.id);
  return all
    .filter((item) => item.type === 'question' && ids.has(item.id))
    .map((item) => (item.type === 'question' ? item.label || t('describe.noName') : ''));
}

/**
 * "A", "A and B", "A, B and C", every piece of punctuation and the "and" from the words.
 * (Meant to move to model/describe as the one list-joining function; see the panel's report.)
 */
export function joinNames(names: readonly string[]): string {
  if (names.length <= 1) return names[0] ?? '';
  return t('panel.list.last', { rest: names.slice(0, -1).join(t('panel.list.comma')), last: names[names.length - 1] ?? '' });
}

/**
 * What the panel calls an arrow in its controls' names: its words, or "Arrow 3" while its "when" is
 * not written yet (the worked-out words are then only a gap, "Ã¢â‚¬Â¦").
 */
export function arrowName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow, index: number): string {
  const label = arrowLabel(doc, arrow);
  return label.trim() && label !== t('describe.gap') ? label : t('panel.arrow.unnamed', { n: index + 1 });
}

/** True while an arrow's own "when" is not written yet: a "when ..." with nothing in it, or no button chosen. */
export function whenUnwritten(arrow: Arrow): boolean {
  const when = arrow.when;
  if (!when) return true;
  if (when.type === 'buttonPressed') return !when.button;
  if (when.type !== 'condition') return false;
  const c = when.condition as unknown;
  if (!c) return true;
  if (has(c, 'allOf') && Array.isArray(c.allOf)) return c.allOf.length === 0;
  if (has(c, 'anyOf') && Array.isArray(c.anyOf)) return c.anyOf.length === 0;
  return false;
}

/** True while a "when ..." is empty or has a part still to choose (a gap in its words). */
function conditionUnfinished(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, condition: Condition): boolean {
  const c = condition as unknown;
  if (has(c, 'allOf') && Array.isArray(c.allOf) && c.allOf.length === 0) return true;
  if (has(c, 'anyOf') && Array.isArray(c.anyOf) && c.anyOf.length === 0) return true;
  return hasMissing(describeCondition(doc, condition));
}

/**
 * True while an arrow is still being written: its own "when" not written yet, or its "+ only
 * when ..." added but not chosen (or with a part still to choose).
 */
export function stillBeingWritten(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): boolean {
  if (whenUnwritten(arrow)) return true;
  if (arrow.when?.type === 'condition' && arrow.when.condition && conditionUnfinished(doc, arrow.when.condition)) return true;
  return !!arrow.onlyWhen && conditionUnfinished(doc, arrow.onlyWhen);
}

/**
 * "Can never be used" is held back while it cannot be known yet: the arrow's own "when" is not
 * written, or the arrow said to fit first above it (`earlier`) is still being written (just made by
 * "+ only when ...", its "only when" not chosen). Said then, its "Move it above" would undo what the
 * author is in the middle of doing.
 */
export function holdNeverUsed(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrowId: string, earlier: string | undefined): boolean {
  const own = find(doc, arrowId);
  if (own?.kind === 'arrow' && whenUnwritten(own.item)) return true;
  const above = earlier ? find(doc, earlier) : undefined;
  return above?.kind === 'arrow' && stillBeingWritten(doc, above.item);
}

/** The arrow a "can never be used" finding or fact says always fits first. */
export function earlierOf(params: unknown): string | undefined {
  const earlier = has(params, 'earlier') ? params.earlier : undefined;
  return has(earlier, 'item') && typeof earlier.item === 'string' ? earlier.item : undefined;
}

/** A plain button arrow: "When [button] is pressed", without "+ only when ...". */
export const isPlainButtonArrow = (arrow: Arrow): boolean => arrow.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && !!arrow.when.button && !arrow.onlyWhen;

/** The label of a stage's button, by id. */
function buttonLabelIn(stage: WorkingStage, buttonId: string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!buttonId) return undefined;
  for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) for (const b of task.buttons ?? []) if (b.id === buttonId) return b.label?.trim() || undefined;
  return undefined;
}

/** Where `stage`'s plain arrow for the button labelled `label` goes, if it has one and it goes somewhere. */
function plainGoToFor(stage: WorkingStage, label: string, except?: StageId): StageId | undefined {
  for (const a of stage.arrows ?? []) {
    if (!isPlainButtonArrow(a) || !a.goTo || a.goTo === except) continue;
    if (a.when.type === 'buttonPressed' && buttonLabelIn(stage, a.when.button)?.toLowerCase() === label.toLowerCase()) return a.goTo as StageId;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export interface Suggestion {
  goTo: StageId;
  /** The button and the stage it is copied from: "like Reject on Domain approval". */
  button: string;
  from: StageId;
}

/**
 * For an arrow that goes nowhere yet, "Suggested: Rejected, like Reject on Domain approval": a stage
 * that leads here has a button with the same name whose plain arrow goes somewhere (not back here).
 */
export function suggestGoTo(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stage: WorkingStage, arrow: Arrow): Suggestion | undefined {
  if (arrow.goTo || arrow.when?.type !== 'buttonPressed') return undefined;
  const label = buttonLabelIn(stage, arrow.when.button);
  if (!label) return undefined;
  for (const { from } of arrowsInto(doc, stage.id)) {
    if (from.id === stage.id || from.kind === 'ending') continue;
    const goTo = plainGoToFor(from as WorkingStage, label, stage.id as StageId);
    if (goTo) return { goTo, button: label, from: from.id as StageId };
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * "+ New stage..." on an arrow that a button takes ("Approve pressed and Risk is High"): the new
 * stage's arrow for the button of the same name goes on to where the plain arrow of that button goes
 * (in the mockup: the new Security review's Approve goes on to Create Jira issue). Returns that pair,
 * or undefined when there is nothing to carry on to.
 */
export function carryOnFor(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, pointed: Arrow, newStageId: StageId): { arrow: ArrowId; goTo: StageId } | undefined {
  if (pointed.when?.type !== 'buttonPressed') return undefined;
  const fromId = find(doc, pointed.id)?.parents.stage;
  const from = fromId ? doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === fromId) : undefined;
  const made = doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === newStageId);
  if (!from || from.kind === 'ending' || !made || made.kind === 'ending') return undefined;
  const label = buttonLabelIn(from, pointed.when.button);
  if (!label) return undefined;
  const goTo = plainGoToFor(from, label, newStageId);
  if (!goTo) return undefined;
  const own = made.arrows.find((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && !a.goTo && buttonLabelIn(made, a.when.button)?.toLowerCase() === label.toLowerCase());
  return own ? { arrow: own.id as ArrowId, goTo } : undefined;
}

/**
 * What goes with a deleted stage, worked out by trying the command on a copy (nothing is written):
 * the values only it filled, and the arrows that lead to it (they will need another stage).
 */
export function deleteConsequences(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: StageId): { values: string[]; arrows: string[] } {
  const tried = applyCommand(doc, 'stage.delete', { stage: stageId });
  const left = tried.ok ? new Set(tried.doc.values.map((v) => v.id)) : new Set(doc.values.map((v) => v.id));
  const values = doc.values.filter((v) => !left.has(v.id)).map((v) => v.name || t('describe.noName'));
  const arrows = arrowsInto(doc, stageId)
    .filter(({ from }) => from.id !== stageId)
    .map(({ arrow }) => arrowLabel(doc, arrow));
  return { values, arrows };
}

/**
 * Where a fix that needs the author's choice is made, for the strip's fix words ("Choose who is
 * asked" goes to Who is asked, "Choose a stage or ending" to the arrow's Where it goes ...).
 */
export function fixPlace(fix: FindingFix | undefined, fallback: Location): Location {
  switch (fix?.kind) {
    case 'chooseWhoIsAsked':
      return { item: fix.task, part: 'whoIsAsked' };
    case 'chooseStage':
      return { item: fix.arrow, part: 'goTo' };
    case 'setIfEmptyUse':
      return { item: fix.item, part: fix.part };
    case 'chooseStatus':
      return { item: fix.stage, part: 'status' };
    case 'show':
      return fix.location;
    default:
      return fallback;
  }
}

/** The status's colour as a CSS variable from the tokens (teal and pink fall back until the tokens have them). */
export function colourVar(colour: Status['colour'] | undefined): string {
  switch (colour) {
    case 'teal':
      return 'var(--st-teal, var(--action-icon))';
    case 'pink':
      return 'var(--st-pink, var(--st-red))';
    case undefined:
      return 'var(--g-300)';
    default:
      return `var(--st-${colour})`;
  }
}
