===\nfrontend/src/features/panel/useStuckName.ts\n===
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useSettings, type StuckPerson } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Ref } from '@/services';

const refKey = (r: Ref) => `${r.type}:${r.id}`;
/** Directory names asked for once per page (the directory is the same for every stage). */
const known = new Map<string, string>();

/**
 * Everyone in "Stuck requests go to" (the authors when it is not set), by the directory's name, a
 * group marked as one, for "Platform team, who look after stuck requests, are told". A name not
 * known yet is left out until the directory answers (describe then says "the people who look after
 * stuck requests").
 */
export function useStuckPeople(): readonly StuckPerson[] {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const services = useServices();
  const refs: Ref[] = settings?.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : (settings?.authors ?? []);
  const key = refs.map(refKey).join('|');
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const missing = refs.filter((r) => !known.has(refKey(r)));
    if (!missing.length) return;
    let alive = true;
    services.directory
      .lookup(missing)
      .then((found) => {
        for (const e of found) known.set(refKey(e), e.label);
        if (alive) setTick((n) => n + 1);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
    // `key` stands for `refs`.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, key]);
  return useMemo(
    () => refs.flatMap((r) => {
      const name = known.get(refKey(r));
      return name ? [{ name, ...(r.type === 'group' ? { group: true } : {}) }] : [];
    }),
    // `key` and `tick` stand for the refs and the names learnt.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [key, tick],
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/AdminDialog.tsx\n===
/**
 * Retry or Close, confirmed in a dialog that asks for a reason (recorded in the request's story;
 * runtime-api.md 5.1 needs one for both). Each refusal is said in words inside the dialog.
 */
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactElement, type RefObject } from 'react';
import type { RequestView } from '@/services';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Dialog, DialogClose, Field, TextArea } from '@/ui';
import { adminRefusal } from './refusals';
import s from './requests.module.css';

export type AdminKind = 'retry' | 'close';

type Props = {
  kind: AdminKind;
  view: RequestView;
  /** What it will do, in words (shown under the title). */
  what: string;
  trigger: ReactElement;
  /** After it was done; `stale` after the request moved since the page was read (the page reloads). */
  onDone: (kind: AdminKind, outcome: 'done' | 'stale') => void;
};

const MAX = 2000;

export function AdminDialog({ kind, view, what, trigger, onDone }: Props) {
  const services = useServices();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const reasonRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const confirm = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      setError(t('requests.admin.refusal.reasonRequired'));
      reasonRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (reason.trim().length > MAX) {
      setError(t('requests.admin.refusal.tooLong'));
      reasonRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const args = { requestId: view.requestId, reason: reason.trim(), expectedLastSeq: view.lastSeq };
      const r = kind === 'retry' ? await services.runtime.retry(args) : await services.runtime.close(args);
      if (r.ok) {
        setOpen(false);
        setReason('');
        onDone(kind, 'done');
        return;
      }
      const first = r.errors[0];
      setError(first ? adminRefusal(first) : t('requests.refusal.other'));
      if (first?.code === 'stale' || first?.code === 'request-closed') onDone(kind, 'stale');
    } catch {
      setError(t('requests.admin.sendFailed'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const title = kind === 'retry' ? t('requests.admin.retry.title') : t('requests.admin.close.title');
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        if (!next) setError(null);
      }}
      trigger={trigger}
      title={title}
      description={what}
      footer={
        <>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="quiet">{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button variant={kind === 'close' ? 'danger' : 'primary'} icon={kind === 'retry' ? 'undo' : 'close'} onClick={() => void confirm()} aria-busy={busy || undefined}>
            {kind === 'retry' ? t('requests.admin.retry.confirm') : t('requests.admin.close.confirm')}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Field
        label={kind === 'retry' ? t('requests.admin.retry.reason') : t('requests.admin.close.reason')}
        hint={t('requests.admin.reasonHint')}
        {...(error ? { error } : {})}
      >
        <TextArea ref={reasonRef} value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} rows={3} maxLength={MAX + 200} />
      </Field>
      <FocusOnOpen target={reasonRef} />
      {kind === 'close' && (
        <div className={s.gapTop}>
          <Callout tone="todo">{t('requests.admin.close.cannotUndo')}</Callout>
        </div>
      )}
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/**
 * Puts the focus in the reason when the dialog opens, so typing goes there and not to its Close
 * button. Its effect runs before the dialog's own focus trap looks for something to focus, and the
 * trap leaves a focus that is already inside the dialog where it is.
 */
function FocusOnOpen({ target }: { target: RefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement | null> }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    target.current?.focus();
  }, [target]);
  return null;
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/MyTasksPage.tsx\n===
/**
 * Route "/tasks": what the signed-in person is asked to do (runtime-api.md 4.1), directly and
 * through groups ("via Payments approvers"), newest first, each with the request's name, its
 * workflow, its stage and since when. Opening one shows the task on the request's page. When the
 * directory cannot be reached, one page-level line and Try again.
 */
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { requestTitle, stageOf } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type MyTask, type RequestView, type Services } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Card, EmptyState, Icon, Page } from '@/ui';
import { sourceOf, useLoad, useNames, valueOf, workflowsOf } from './data';
import { formatAge, formatWhen, refPhrase, whenInSentence } from './format';
import { LoadFailed, StartRequestMenu, StatusPill } from './parts';
import { PhraseView, say } from './say';
import s from './requests.module.css';

interface Row {
  task: MyTask;
  name: string;
  workflow: string;
  stage: string;
}

interface Loaded {
  rows: Row[];
  groupsUnavailable: boolean;
}

async function loadTasks(services: Services): Promise<Loaded> {
  const page = valueOf(await services.runtime.myTasks({ limit: 200 }));
  const workflows = await workflowsOf(services).catch(() => []);
  const rows = await Promise.all(
    page.items.map(async (task): Promise<Row> => {
      const [doc, view] = await Promise.all([
        sourceOf(services, task.workflow, task.version).catch(() => undefined as AuthoredWorkflow | undefined),
        services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: task.requestId }).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.value : undefined), () => undefined as RequestView | undefined),
      ]);
      const stage = doc ? stageOf(doc, task.location.item) : undefined;
      return {
        task,
        name: requestTitle(doc, view?.values, t('requests.numbered', { n: task.readableId })),
        workflow: workflows.find((w) => w.id === task.workflow)?.name ?? t('word.workflow'),
        stage: stage?.name || t('describe.noName'),
      };
    }),
  );
  rows.sort((a, b) => b.task.openedAt.localeCompare(a.task.openedAt));
  return { rows, groupsUnavailable: !!page.groupsUnavailable };
}

export function MyTasksPage() {
  const services = useServices();
  const loaded = useLoad(() => loadTasks(services), 'tasks');
  const names = useNames(services, loaded.state === 'done' ? loaded.value.rows.map((r) => r.task.via) : []);

  return (
    <Page title={t('requests.tasks.title')} lead={t('requests.tasks.lead')} actions={<StartRequestMenu />}>
      {loaded.state === 'loading' && (
        <p className={s.quiet} role="status">
          {t('requests.load.loading')}
        </p>
      )}
      {loaded.state === 'failed' && <LoadFailed what={t('requests.tasks.failed')} onRetry={() => void loaded.reload()} />}
      {loaded.state === 'done' && (
        <>
          {loaded.value.groupsUnavailable && (
            <Callout
              tone="todo"
              actions={
                <Button size="sm" icon="undo" onClick={() => void loaded.reload()}>
                  {t('requests.load.tryAgain')}
                </Button>
              }
            >
              {t('requests.tasks.groupsUnavailable')}
            </Callout>
          )}
          {loaded.value.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <Card>
              <EmptyState icon="task" title={t('requests.tasks.empty.title')}>
                {t('requests.tasks.empty.text')}
              </EmptyState>
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <Card flush title={t('requests.tasks.count', { n: loaded.value.rows.length })}>
              <ul className={s.taskList}>
                {loaded.value.rows.map(({ task, name, workflow, stage }) => (
                  <li key={task.task}>
                    <Link to={`/requests/${task.readableId}?task=${encodeURIComponent(task.task)}`} className={s.taskRow}>
                      <span className={s.taskMain}>
                        <span className={s.taskName}>{name}</span>
                        <span className={s.quiet}>
                          {t('requests.tasks.where', { workflow, n: task.readableId, stage })}
                        </span>
                        {task.via.type === 'group' && (
                          <span className={s.quiet}>
                            <PhraseView phrase={say('requests.tasks.via', { group: refPhrase(task.via, names) })} />
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {!task.mayAnswer && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('requests.tasks.mayNot')}</span>}
                      </span>
                      <span className={s.taskSide}>
                        <StatusPill status={task.status} size="sm" />
                        <span className={s.quiet} title={formatWhen(task.openedAt)}>
                          {t('requests.tasks.since', { when: whenInSentence(task.openedAt), age: formatAge(task.openedAt) })}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                      <Icon name="chevron-right" />
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </Card>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </Page>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/PathStrip.tsx\n===
/**
 * The request's path, left to right (mockup 12 "Where it is"): each stage with a mark and a word
 * for where the request is on it (done, now, stuck, ahead), never colour alone; then the other ways
 * from the stage it is at. The whole workflow's diagram is one click away under it.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { describeWhoIsAsked, getStage, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import type { RequestView } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { refsPhrase, type Names } from './format';
import { pathOf, type PathState } from './path';
import { PhraseView, say } from './say';
import { stageAt } from './stuck';
import { buttonGoes } from './TaskPanel';
import s from './requests.module.css';

const MARK: Record<PathState, IconName> = {
  done: 'check',
  now: 'clock',
  stuck: 'error',
  ahead: 'chevron-right',
  ended: 'ending',
  closed: 'close',
};

export function PathStrip({ doc, view, names, visited }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; view: RequestView; names: Names; visited: ReadonlySet<string> }) {
  const path = pathOf(doc, view);

  const under = (stageId: string, state: PathState): Phrase => {
    const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
    if (state === 'done') return [t('requests.path.done')];
    if (state === 'stuck') return [t('requests.path.stuck')];
    if (state === 'ended') return [t('requests.path.ended')];
    if (state === 'closed') return [t('requests.path.closed')];
    if (state === 'now') {
      const asked = view.tasks.filter((x) => stageAt(doc, x.location)?.id === stageId).flatMap((x) => x.askedOf);
      return asked.length ? say('requests.path.nowAsked', { who: refsPhrase(asked, names) }) : [t('requests.path.now')];
    }
    if (!stage) return [];
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') return [t('requests.path.ending')];
    const task = stage.tasks[0];
    return task ? say('requests.path.asks', { who: describeWhoIsAsked(doc, task, { short: true }) }) : [t('requests.path.byItself')];
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.path}>
      <ol className={s.pathList} aria-label={t('requests.path.label', { n: view.readableId })}>
        {path.stops.map((stop, i) => (
          <li key={`${stop.stage}-${i}`} className={`${s.pathStop} ${s[`path_${stop.state}`] ?? ''}`} {...(stop.state === 'now' || stop.state === 'stuck' ? { 'aria-current': 'step' as const } : {})}>
            <span className={s.pathMark} aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon name={MARK[stop.state]} size={14} />
            </span>
            <span className={s.pathName}>{getStage(doc, stop.stage)?.name || t('describe.noName')}</span>
            <span className={s.pathUnder}>
              <PhraseView phrase={under(stop.stage, stop.state)} />
            </span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {path.from && path.via && path.stops.some((x) => x.state === 'ahead') && (
        <p className={s.quiet}>
          <PhraseView phrase={say('requests.path.via', { button: [{ chip: 'button', label: path.via.label || t('describe.noName'), id: path.via.id }] })} />
        </p>
      )}
      {path.from && path.others.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.pathOthers}>
          <span className={s.quiet}>
            <PhraseView phrase={say('requests.path.otherWays', { stage: [{ chip: 'stage', label: getStage(doc, path.from)?.name || t('describe.noName'), id: path.from }] })} />
          </span>
          <ul className={s.pathOtherList}>
            {path.others.map((b) => (
              <li key={b.id}>
                <strong>{b.label || t('describe.noName')}</strong>
                {t('requests.path.otherSep')}
                <PhraseView phrase={buttonGoes(doc, b.id, visited)} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/README.md\n===
# features/requests

The pages people use (mockup 12; editor-model.md sections 1, 3 and 10; runtime-api.md): start a request, My tasks, the requests list, and one request's page with its task and, when stuck, Retry and Close.

- Exports (route table in `src/app/routes.tsx`): `StartRequestPage` (`/start/:workflowId`), `MyTasksPage` (`/tasks`), `RequestsPage` (`/requests`, `?workflow=` filters), `RequestPage` (`/requests/:requestId`, the number or the ID; `?task=<task>` opens that task, open or not).
- Files:
  - `StartRequestPage.tsx`: the live version's start form through `<Slot name="FormView">` with the published document; a client token made when the form opens (`makeClientToken`); refusals at their question (FormView) and on the page; a workflow with nothing live says so (`StartableList`).
  - `MyTasksPage.tsx`: `runtime.myTasks`, newest first, "via" a group; `groupsUnavailable` is one page-level line with Try again.
  - `RequestsPage.tsx`: `runtime.listRequests` with the title values included; for the people who look after stuck requests (asked the server's way: `listRefusedStarts({ workflow })` answers `not-admin` otherwise) their stuck requests first, "Starts that were refused" with Run again, and deliveries held by a paused "Starts when".
  - `RequestPage.tsx`: header, `<Slot name="ReadOnlyDiagram">` with where it is/was/stuck, where it is in words (`where.ts`), `StuckCard.tsx`, `TaskPanel.tsx` per task this person is concerned with, a Close card for an open request that is not stuck, the values, the story (`story.ts`).
  - `stuck.ts`: the rules (`mayRetry`: only `action-failed` and `nobody-to-ask`; `mayClose`: any open request; both only when `viewer.isAdmin`), the stuck reason in words, why nobody can answer (`whyNobody`), what Close does (`closeWhat`).
  - `AdminDialog.tsx`: Retry or Close, confirmed, with a reason (the runtime records one for both); refusals in words (`refusals.ts`).
  - `choices.ts`: choices from the directory or a connection through `runtime.choices`, handed to FormView as `{ stored, label }` and turned back into the runtime's own value before sending.
  - `data.ts` (loading, caches of the catalogue and published documents, names), `format.ts` (times, names, what the model's sentences need from the page), `say.tsx` (words with describe phrases filled in), `parts.tsx` (status pill, stuck pill, Start a request menu).
- A request's name is the model's `requestTitle` (the list pages ask for every value of `requestTitleValues`), else "Request 1042". A value it holds is said by the model's `describeHeldValue` (`format.ts` `heldEnv` gives it the names and the catalogue), so a saved failure code reads in its catalogue words, never as the code.
- `path.ts` / `PathStrip.tsx`: "Where it is" as a path of stages (done, now or stuck, the usual way ahead) and the other ways from the stage it is at; the whole diagram (ReadOnlyDiagram slot) is under "See the whole of ...".
- `keepFocus.ts`: `useKeepButtonFocus` puts the focus back on a form button that the ui Button draws again as a new element when it becomes pressable (a stopgap until `src/ui/Button.tsx` keeps one element).
- Who was told about a stuck request is the model's `describeStuckTold` in the past, on the stuck card and on the history's stuck line (`format.ts` `stuckPeopleOf`). Why nobody can answer is read from the directory's people of the groups asked. Close on a request waiting on another system says that system is not stopped and its answer is then only recorded. A retry that is stuck again at once says so, and why.
- A page with nothing for this person to answer or look after has no empty column. After Start, the focus is on the new request's heading. A task someone else answered tells a person who was not asked only what happened (no "already", no Back to My tasks).
- Words: `src/words/requests.ts`. `requests.refusedBecause.*` are the words of `contract/words/notifications.json` (`refusedBecause`); keep them in step.
- Tests: `requests.test.tsx` (rendered, against the seeded requests; FormView and ReadOnlyDiagram are stubs there) and `tests/e2e/requests.spec.ts`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/RequestPage.tsx\n===
/**
 * Route "/requests/:requestId" (the request's number, or its ID): one request's page, open to
 * every signed-in person (runtime-api.md 2, 6.3; mockup 12). Its name and status; where it is now on
 * the small read-only diagram and in words; who is asked now and since when; the task for the
 * person signed in; a stuck request's card; its story, newest last, and the version it runs on; the
 * values it holds (those the runtime gives this viewer). `?task=<task>` opens one task, open or not.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation, useParams, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { describeHeldValue, getStage, refsInHeld, requestTitle, Slot } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Ref, type RequestView, type Services } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Card, EmptyState, Icon, Page } from '@/ui';
import { AdminDialog, type AdminKind } from './AdminDialog';
import { catalogueOf, sourceOf, useLoad, useMe, useNames, workflowsOf, type WorkflowInfo } from './data';
import { byPhrase, formatDay, formatWhen, heldEnv, stuckPeopleOf, userRef, type Names } from './format';
import { ClosedPill, LoadFailed, StatusPill, StuckPill } from './parts';
import { PathStrip } from './PathStrip';
import { PhraseView, say } from './say';
import { closeWhat, mayClose, stageAt, stuckShort } from './stuck';
import { StuckCard } from './StuckCard';
import { refsInStory, storyLines } from './story';
import { cannotAnswer, TaskPanel } from './TaskPanel';
import { marksOf, whereNow } from './where';
import s from './requests.module.css';

interface PageData {
  view: RequestView;
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  catalogue: Catalogue | undefined;
  workflow: WorkflowInfo | undefined;
  /** "Stuck requests go to", when this person may read the workflow's settings. */
  toldTo: Ref[] | undefined;
}

type Got = { found: false } | ({ found: true } & PageData);

async function getView(services: Services, requestId: string): Promise<RequestView | undefined> {
  const args = /^\d+$/.test(requestId) ? { readableId: requestId } : { requestId };
  const r = await services.runtime.getRequest(args);
  if (r.ok) return r.value;
  if (r.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'not-found')) return undefined;
  throw new Error('request');
}

async function loadRequest(services: Services, requestId: string): Promise<Got> {
  const view = await getView(services, requestId);
  if (!view || !view.workflow || !view.version) return { found: false };
  const [doc, catalogue, workflows, settings] = await Promise.all([
    sourceOf(services, view.workflow, view.version),
    catalogueOf(services),
    workflowsOf(services).catch(() => [] as WorkflowInfo[]),
    services.authoring.getSettings(view.workflow).catch(() => undefined),
  ]);
  const toldTo = settings?.ok ? (settings.value.stuckRequestsGoTo ?? settings.value.authors) : undefined;
  return { found: true, view, doc, catalogue, workflow: workflows.find((w) => w.id === view.workflow), toldTo };
}

export function RequestPage() {
  const { requestId = '' } = useParams();
  const services = useServices();
  const me = useMe(services);
  const loaded = useLoad(() => loadRequest(services, requestId), requestId);

  if (loaded.state === 'loading')
    return (
      <Page title={t('requests.numbered', { n: requestId })}>
        <p className={s.quiet} role="status">
          {t('requests.load.loading')}
        </p>
      </Page>
    );
  if (loaded.state === 'failed')
    return (
      <Page title={t('requests.numbered', { n: requestId })}>
        <LoadFailed what={t('requests.page.failed')} onRetry={() => void loaded.reload()} />
      </Page>
    );
  if (!loaded.value.found)
    return (
      <Page title={t('requests.numbered', { n: requestId })}>
        <Card>
          <EmptyState icon="history" title={t('requests.page.notFound.title')} action={<Link to="/requests">{t('requests.page.allRequests')}</Link>}>
            {t('requests.page.notFound.text')}
          </EmptyState>
        </Card>
      </Page>
    );
  return <RequestBody key={loaded.value.view.requestId} data={loaded.value} me={me} />;
}

function RequestBody({ data, me }: { data: PageData; me: ReturnType<typeof useMe> }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const taskParam = search.get('task');
  const [view, setView] = useState(data.view);
  const [keep, setKeep] = useState<string[]>(() => (taskParam ? [taskParam] : []));
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>((location.state as { started?: boolean } | null)?.started ? t('requests.page.started') : null);
  const noticeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const justStarted = !!(location.state as { started?: boolean } | null)?.started;
  // Landed here from Start: the focus goes to the new request's name, the page heading.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (justStarted) headingRef.current?.focus();
  }, [justStarted]);
  const { doc, catalogue, workflow, toldTo } = data;

  const refs = useMemo(
    () => [
      ...userRef(view.startedBy),
      ...(view.requester ? [view.requester] : []),
      ...view.tasks.flatMap((x) => x.askedOf),
      ...refsInStory(view.story),
      ...Object.values(view.values).flatMap((v) => refsInHeld(v)),
      ...(toldTo ?? []),
    ],
    [view, toldTo],
  );
  const names = useNames(services, refs);

  const refresh = useCallback(async (): Promise<RequestView | undefined> => {
    const next = await getView(services, view.requestId).catch(() => undefined);
    if (next) setView(next);
    return next;
  }, [services, view.requestId]);

  const acted = useCallback(
    (task: string) => async () => {
      setKeep((k) => (k.includes(task) ? k : [...k, task]));
      return refresh();
    },
    [refresh],
  );

  const adminDone = (kind: AdminKind, outcome: 'done' | 'stale') => {
    if (outcome === 'done' && kind === 'close') setNotice(t('requests.admin.closed'));
    void refresh().then((next) => {
      // A retry that is stuck again at once says so, and why.
      if (outcome === 'done' && kind === 'retry') {
        const again = next?.stuck && !next.closed ? next.stuck : undefined;
        setNotice(again ? t('requests.admin.retriedStuck', { why: stuckShort(again.reason) }) : t('requests.admin.retried'));
      }
      // The button pressed goes with the stuck card: the confirmation takes the focus, once the
      // dialog has handed it back.
      if (outcome === 'done') setTimeout(() => noticeRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    });
  };

  const name = requestTitle(doc, view.values, t('requests.numbered', { n: view.readableId }));
  const stuckPeople = stuckPeopleOf(toldTo, names);
  const stuckStage = view.stuck ? getStage(doc, stageAt(doc, view.stuck.location)?.id ?? stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id)?.name : undefined;
  const marks = marksOf(doc, view);
  const where = whereNow(doc, view, names, catalogue);
  const lines = storyLines(doc, view.story, { names, catalogue, ...(stuckPeople ? { stuckPeople } : {}) });
  const workflowName = workflow?.name ?? t('word.workflow');
  // The stages it has left at least once: a button that goes to one of them sends it back.
  const visited = new Set(view.story.flatMap((e) => (e.code === 'moved' ? [e.params.from] : [])));
  const newer = workflow?.liveVersion && view.version && workflow.liveVersion > view.version ? workflow.liveVersion : undefined;
  // Tasks shown here: the open ones this person is concerned with (asked, even if they may not
  // answer), the one opened from My tasks, and any this person just answered.
  const concerned = view.tasks.filter((x) => cannotAnswer(x.buttonStates) !== 'not-assignee').map((x) => x.task);
  const shown = [...new Set([...concerned, ...keep])];
  const closeText = closeWhat(doc, view, catalogue);
  const showStuck = !!view.stuck && !view.closed;
  const showClose = !view.stuck && mayClose(view);
  // Nothing for this person to do or look after here: no empty column beside the request.
  const hasMain = showStuck || shown.length > 0 || showClose;

  return (
    <Page
      title={
        <span ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1} className={s.headingFocus}>
          {name}
        </span>
      }
      lead={
        <>
          <nav aria-label={t('requests.page.crumbs')} className={s.crumbs}>
            <Link to={`/requests?workflow=${encodeURIComponent(view.workflow ?? '')}`}>{workflowName}</Link>
            <Icon name="chevron-right" size={12} />
            <span aria-current="page">{t('requests.numbered', { n: view.readableId })}</span>
          </nav>
          <span className={s.byline}>
            <PhraseView
              phrase={say('requests.page.startedBy', {
                who: byPhrase(view.startedBy, names, catalogue),
                when: formatDay(view.startedAt),
                workflow: workflowName,
                version: view.version ?? 0,
              })}
            />
          </span>
        </>
      }
      actions={
        <div className={s.pills}>
          {view.closed ? !view.closed.ending && <ClosedPill /> : view.stuck ? <StuckPill at={stuckStage || t('describe.noName')} /> : null}
          <StatusPill status={view.status} />
        </div>
      }
    >
      {notice && (
        <div ref={noticeRef} tabIndex={-1} role="status" className={s.noticeWrap}>
          <Callout tone="info" icon="check">
            {notice}
          </Callout>
        </div>
      )}

      <Card title={t('requests.page.whereItIs')} sub={t(view.closed ? 'requests.path.subWent' : 'requests.path.sub')}>
        <PathStrip doc={doc} view={view} names={names} visited={visited} />
        <ul className={s.whereList}>
          {where.map((line, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <PhraseView phrase={line.phrase} />
              {line.note && <span className={line.tone === 'overdue' ? s.overdue : s.quiet}> {line.note}</span>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <details className={s.wholeDiagram}>
          <summary>{t('requests.path.whole', { workflow: workflowName })}</summary>
          <div className={s.diagram}>
            <Slot
              name="ReadOnlyDiagram"
              doc={doc}
              at={marks.at}
              visited={marks.visited}
              taken={marks.taken}
              {...(marks.stuckAt ? { stuckAt: marks.stuckAt } : {})}
              label={t('requests.page.diagramLabel', { n: view.readableId })}
            />
          </div>
        </details>
      </Card>

      <div className={hasMain ? s.columns : s.oneColumn}>
        {hasMain && (
        <div className={s.mainCol}>
          {showStuck && view.stuck && (
            <StuckCard
              doc={doc}
              view={{ ...view, stuck: view.stuck }}
              catalogue={catalogue}
              names={names}
              stuckPeople={stuckPeople}
              onDone={adminDone}
              {...(workflow?.mayEdit ? { editor: `/w/${workflow.id}` } : {})}
            />
          )}

          {shown.map((task) => (
            <TaskPanel key={task} doc={doc} view={view} task={task} catalogue={catalogue} names={names} me={me} onActed={acted(task)} />
          ))}

          {showClose && (
            <Card title={t('requests.admin.lookAfter.title')} sub={t('requests.admin.lookAfter.sub')}>
              <div className={s.adminChoice}>
                <AdminDialog
                  kind="close"
                  view={view}
                  what={closeText}
                  onDone={adminDone}
                  trigger={<Button icon="close">{t('requests.stuck.close')}</Button>}
                />
                <p className={s.quiet}>{closeText}</p>
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
        )}

        <div className={s.sideCol}>
          <ValuesCard doc={doc} view={view} names={names} catalogue={catalogue} />
          <Card title={t('requests.story.title')} sub={t('requests.story.count', { n: lines.length })}>
            <p className={s.quiet}>
              {newer ? t('requests.story.versionNewer', { version: view.version ?? 0, live: newer }) : t('requests.story.version', { version: view.version ?? 0 })}
            </p>
            <ol className={s.story}>
              {lines.map((line) => (
                <li key={line.key} className={line.stuck ? s.storyStuck : undefined}>
                  <span className={s.storyIcon} aria-hidden="true">
                    <Icon name={line.icon} size={14} />
                  </span>
                  <span>
                    <PhraseView phrase={line.phrase} />
                    <span className={s.storyWhen}>{formatWhen(line.at)}</span>
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Page>
  );
}

/** The values the request holds (as the runtime gives them to this viewer), in the document's order. */
function ValuesCard({ doc, view, names, catalogue }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; view: RequestView; names: Names; catalogue: Catalogue | undefined }) {
  const shown = doc.values.filter((v) => view.values[v.id] !== undefined);
  return (
    <Card title={t('requests.values.title')}>
      {shown.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('requests.values.none')}</p>
      ) : (
        <dl className={s.facts}>
          {shown.map((v) => (
            <div key={v.id} className={s.factRow}>
              <dt>{v.name || t('describe.noName')}</dt>
              <dd>
                <PhraseView phrase={describeHeldValue(doc, view.values[v.id], heldEnv(names, catalogue, view.values), v.id)} />
              </dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/RequestsPage.tsx\n===
/**
 * Route "/requests": the requests a person may see (runtime-api.md 6.2), with status in words and
 * colour, stage, started by and when, and filters by workflow and "Stuck". For the people who look
 * after stuck requests: their stuck requests first, then "Starts that were refused" (5.4) with "Run
 * again", and deliveries held by a paused "Starts when" (5.3) if there are any.
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Location, StartsWhen } from '@/contract';
import { describeStartsWhen, getQuestion, locationCrumbs, requestTitle, requestTitleValues, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import {
  useServices, type BindingState, type PausedDelivery, type RefusedStart, type RequestRow, type RetriedStart, type Services, type WhilePaused,
} from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Card, Checkbox, EmptyState, Field, Page, Select } from '@/ui';
import { catalogueOf, looksAfter, sourceOf, useLoad, useNames, valueOf, workflowsOf, type WorkflowInfo } from './data';
import { byPhrase, formatWhen, userRef, whenInSentence } from './format';
import { ClosedPill, LoadFailed, StartRequestMenu, StatusPill, StuckPill } from './parts';
import { list, PhraseView, say, text } from './say';
import { stageAt, stuckShort } from './stuck';
import s from './requests.module.css';

interface Listed {
  row: RequestRow;
  name: string;
  stage: string;
  stuckAt?: string;
  /** Closed without reaching an ending: closed by someone who looks after it. */
  closedEarly: boolean;
}

interface Held {
  workflow: WorkflowInfo;
  binding: BindingState;
  said: Phrase;
  deliveries: PausedDelivery[];
}

interface Loaded {
  rows: Listed[];
  workflows: WorkflowInfo[];
  /** The workflows whose stuck requests this person looks after. */
  mine: string[];
  refused: RefusedStart[];
  held: Held[];
  docs: Record<string, AuthoredWorkflow>;
  catalogue: Catalogue | undefined;
}

const docKey = (workflow: string, version: number) => `${workflow}@${version}`;

async function loadRequests(services: Services): Promise<Loaded> {
  const [workflows, catalogue] = await Promise.all([workflowsOf(services).catch(() => [] as WorkflowInfo[]), catalogueOf(services)]);
  const docs: Record<string, AuthoredWorkflow> = {};
  const fetchDocs = (keys: Iterable<string>) =>
    Promise.all(
      [...keys].filter((key) => !docs[key]).map(async (key) => {
        const [workflow = '', version = '0'] = key.split('@');
        const doc = await sourceOf(services, workflow, Number(version)).catch(() => undefined);
        if (doc) docs[key] = doc;
      }),
    );
  await fetchDocs(workflows.filter((w) => w.liveVersion).map((w) => docKey(w.id, w.liveVersion as number)));
  // Each request is named by the model's title rule: ask for every value that may name one with the rows.
  const include = [...new Set(Object.values(docs).flatMap(requestTitleValues))].slice(0, 10);
  const items = valueOf(await services.runtime.listRequests({ limit: 200, ...(include.length ? { include } : {}) })).items;
  await fetchDocs(new Set(items.map((r) => docKey(r.workflow, r.version))));
  const rows = items.map((row): Listed => {
    const doc = docs[docKey(row.workflow, row.version)];
    const stage = doc ? stageAt(doc, row.stage) : undefined;
    const stuckStage = doc && row.stuck ? stageAt(doc, row.stuck.location) : undefined;
    return {
      row,
      name: requestTitle(doc, row.values, t('requests.numbered', { n: row.readableId })),
      stage: stage?.name || t('describe.noName'),
      ...(row.stuck ? { stuckAt: stuckStage?.name || stage?.name || t('describe.noName') } : {}),
      closedEarly: !!row.closedAt && stage?.kind !== 'ending',
    };
  });

  const live = workflows.filter((w) => w.liveVersion);
  const mine = (await Promise.all(live.map(async (w) => ((await looksAfter(services, w.id)) ? w.id : undefined)))).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
  const refusedPage = mine.length ? await services.runtime.listRefusedStarts({ limit: 200 }).catch(() => undefined) : undefined;
  const refused = refusedPage?.ok ? refusedPage.value.items : [];

  const held: Held[] = [];
  for (const id of mine) {
    const workflow = workflows.find((w) => w.id === id) as WorkflowInfo;
    const bindings = await services.runtime.listBindings({ workflow: id }).catch(() => undefined);
    if (!bindings?.ok) continue;
    for (const binding of bindings.value.filter((b) => b.paused)) {
      const deliveries = await services.runtime.listPausedDeliveries({ workflow: id, binding: binding.binding }).catch(() => undefined);
      if (!deliveries?.ok || deliveries.value.length === 0) continue;
      const doc = docs[docKey(id, binding.version)];
      held.push({ workflow, binding, deliveries: deliveries.value, said: doc ? bindingWords(doc, binding.binding, catalogue) : [t('requests.refused.someStart')] });
    }
  }
  return { rows, workflows, mine, refused, held, docs, catalogue };
}

function bindingWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): Phrase {
  const binding: StartsWhen | undefined = doc.start?.startsWhen?.find((b) => b.id === id);
  if (!binding) return [t('requests.refused.someStart')];
  // What started it, without its "only when" and Requester: those did not refuse it.
  const plain: StartsWhen = { ...binding };
  delete plain.onlyWhen;
  delete plain.requester;
  return describeStartsWhen(doc, plain, catalogue ? { catalogue } : {});
}

const REFUSED_BECAUSE: Record<string, WordKey> = {
  'mapping-error': 'requests.refusedBecause.mapping-error',
  may: 'requests.refusedBecause.may',
  'invalid-data': 'requests.refusedBecause.invalid-data',
  'choice-unknown': 'requests.refusedBecause.choice-unknown',
  check: 'requests.refusedBecause.check',
  'rule-error': 'requests.refusedBecause.rule-error',
  paused: 'requests.refusedBecause.paused',
};

/** Why a start was refused, in the words other messages use (contract/words/notifications.json, refusedBecause). */
export function refusedBecause(code: string): string {
  const key = REFUSED_BECAUSE[code];
  return key ? t(key) : t('requests.refusedBecause.other');
}

const REFUSED_BECAUSE_AT: Partial<Record<string, WordKey>> = {
  'invalid-data': 'requests.refusedBecauseAt.invalid-data',
  'choice-unknown': 'requests.refusedBecauseAt.choice-unknown',
};

/** Why a start was refused, naming the start form's question it was refused at: "the answer to Service is not one of its choices". */
export function refusedBecauseAt(code: string, question: string): string {
  const key = REFUSED_BECAUSE_AT[code];
  return key ? t(key, { question }) : refusedBecause(code);
}

/** The workflows the filter offers: those with a live version or with requests, and the one chosen. */
function filterable(workflows: WorkflowInfo[], rows: Listed[], chosen: string): WorkflowInfo[] {
  const withRequests = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.row.workflow));
  return workflows.filter((w) => w.liveVersion || withRequests.has(w.id) || w.id === chosen);
}

export function RequestsPage() {
  const services = useServices();
  const loaded = useLoad(() => loadRequests(services), 'requests');
  const [search, setSearch] = useSearchParams();
  const workflowFilter = search.get('workflow') ?? '';
  // The workflows list links here with `stuck=true` (the name RequestQuery uses); '1' is kept too.
  const [stuckOnly, setStuckOnly] = useState(['true', '1'].includes(search.get('stuck') ?? ''));
  const people = useMemo(() => (loaded.state === 'done' ? loaded.value.rows.flatMap((r) => userRef(r.row.startedBy)) : []), [loaded]);
  const names = useNames(services, people);

  return (
    <Page title={t('requests.list.title')} lead={t('requests.list.lead')} actions={<StartRequestMenu variant="secondary" />}>
      {loaded.state === 'loading' && (
        <p className={s.quiet} role="status">
          {t('requests.load.loading')}
        </p>
      )}
      {loaded.state === 'failed' && <LoadFailed what={t('requests.list.failed')} onRetry={() => void loaded.reload()} />}
      {loaded.state === 'done' &&
        (() => {
          const v = loaded.value;
          const wfName = (id: string) => v.workflows.find((w) => w.id === id)?.name ?? t('word.workflow');
          const mineStuck = v.rows.filter((r) => r.row.stuck && !r.row.closedAt && v.mine.includes(r.row.workflow));
          const shown = v.rows.filter((r) => (!workflowFilter || r.row.workflow === workflowFilter) && (!stuckOnly || r.row.stuck));
          const lookAfterNames = v.mine.map(wfName);
          return (
            <>
              {v.mine.length > 0 && (
                <Card
                  title={t('requests.list.stuckTitle')}
                  sub={t('requests.list.stuckSub', { workflows: text(list(lookAfterNames.map((n) => [n]))) })}
                  flush
                >
                  {mineStuck.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className={s.cardText}>{t('requests.list.stuckNone')}</p>
                  ) : (
                    <RequestTable rows={mineStuck} names={names} catalogue={v.catalogue} wfName={wfName} label={t('requests.list.stuckTitle')} />
                  )}
                </Card>
              )}

              {v.mine.length > 0 && <RefusedStarts refused={v.refused} docs={v.docs} workflows={v.workflows} catalogue={v.catalogue} onRan={() => void loaded.reload()} />}

              {v.held.length > 0 && (
                <Card title={t('requests.held.title')} sub={t('requests.held.sub')}>
                  <ul className={s.plainList}>
                    {v.held.map((h) => (
                      <li key={`${h.workflow.id}/${h.binding.binding}`}>
                        <PhraseView
                          phrase={say('requests.held.line', { workflow: h.workflow.name, startsWhen: h.said, n: h.deliveries.length })}
                        />
                        <span className={s.quiet}> {t('requests.held.oldest', { when: whenInSentence(h.deliveries[0]?.at ?? '') })}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </Card>
              )}

              <Card title={t('requests.list.allTitle')} flush>
                <div className={s.filters} role="group" aria-label={t('requests.list.filters')}>
                  <Field label={t('requests.list.filterWorkflow')}>
                    <Select
                      value={workflowFilter}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const next = new URLSearchParams(search);
                        if (e.target.value) next.set('workflow', e.target.value);
                        else next.delete('workflow');
                        setSearch(next, { replace: true });
                      }}
                      options={[{ value: '', label: t('requests.list.allWorkflows') }, ...filterable(v.workflows, v.rows, workflowFilter).map((w) => ({ value: w.id, label: w.name }))]}
                    />
                  </Field>
                  <Checkbox label={t('requests.list.filterStuck')} checked={stuckOnly} onChange={(e) => setStuckOnly(e.target.checked)} />
                </div>
                {shown.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyState icon="history" title={t('requests.list.empty.title')}>
                    {t('requests.list.empty.text')}
                  </EmptyState>
                ) : (
                  <RequestTable rows={shown} names={names} catalogue={v.catalogue} wfName={wfName} label={t('requests.list.allTitle')} />
                )}
              </Card>
            </>
          );
        })()}
    </Page>
  );
}

function RequestTable({
  rows, names, catalogue, wfName, label,
}: { rows: Listed[]; names: Record<string, string>; catalogue: Catalogue | undefined; wfName: (id: string) => string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <table className={s.table} aria-label={label}>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">{t('word.request')}</th>
          <th scope="col">{t('word.status')}</th>
          <th scope="col">{t('requests.list.col.stage')}</th>
          <th scope="col">{t('requests.list.col.startedBy')}</th>
          <th scope="col">{t('requests.list.col.started')}</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {rows.map(({ row, name, stage, stuckAt, closedEarly }) => (
          <tr key={row.requestId} className={row.stuck ? s.rowStuck : undefined}>
            <td>
              <Link to={`/requests/${row.readableId}`} className={s.tableLink}>
                {name}
              </Link>
              <span className={s.quiet}>
                {t('requests.list.inWorkflow', { workflow: wfName(row.workflow), n: row.readableId })}
              </span>
            </td>
            <td>
              <span className={s.pills}>
                {closedEarly ? <ClosedPill size="sm" /> : row.stuck && !row.closedAt ? <StuckPill size="sm" /> : null}
                <StatusPill status={row.status} size="sm" />
              </span>
              {row.stuck && !row.closedAt && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('requests.list.stuckWhy', { stage: stuckAt ?? stage, why: stuckShort(row.stuck.reason) })}</span>}
            </td>
            <td>{row.closedAt ? t('requests.list.closedOn', { when: whenInSentence(row.closedAt) }) : stage}</td>
            <td>
              <PhraseView phrase={byPhrase(row.startedBy, names, catalogue)} />
            </td>
            <td>{formatWhen(row.startedAt)}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function RefusedStarts({
  refused, docs, workflows, catalogue, onRan,
}: { refused: RefusedStart[]; docs: Record<string, AuthoredWorkflow>; workflows: WorkflowInfo[]; catalogue: Catalogue | undefined; onRan: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Card title={t('requests.refused.title')} sub={t('requests.refused.sub')} flush>
      {refused.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.cardText}>{t('requests.refused.none')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className={s.refusedList}>
          {refused.map((r) => {
            const workflow = workflows.find((w) => w.id === r.workflow);
            const doc = workflow?.liveVersion ? docs[docKey(r.workflow, workflow.liveVersion)] : undefined;
            return <RefusedRow key={r.id} refused={r} workflowName={workflow?.name ?? t('word.workflow')} doc={doc} catalogue={catalogue} onRan={onRan} />;
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

function whereWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | undefined, location: Location | undefined, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!doc || !location) return undefined;
  const crumbs = locationCrumbs(doc, location, catalogue ? { catalogue } : {});
  return crumbs.length ? crumbs.join(t('describe.where.separator')) : undefined;
}

function RefusedRow({
  refused, workflowName, doc, catalogue, onRan,
}: { refused: RefusedStart; workflowName: string; doc: AuthoredWorkflow | undefined; catalogue: Catalogue | undefined; onRan: () => void }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ words: Phrase; link?: string } | null>(null);
  const tried = doc ? bindingWords(doc, refused.startsWhen, catalogue) : [t('requests.refused.someStart')];
  // A start refused because of a pause is at the Starts when itself, which "What tried to start it" already names.
  const where = refused.code === 'paused' ? undefined : whereWords(doc, refused.location, catalogue);
  const code = refused.code;
  const asked = doc && refused.location ? getQuestion(doc, refused.location.item) : undefined;
  const question = asked ? asked.label.trim() || t('describe.noName') : undefined;

  const run = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await services.runtime.retryRefusedStart({ id: refused.id });
      setResult(r.ok ? retriedWords(r.value, services.runtime.whilePaused) : { words: [refusedRunAgain(r.errors[0]?.code)] });
      // The list is read again at once: a new request, or this row brought up to date when refused again.
      if (r.ok) onRan();
    } catch {
      setResult({ words: [t('requests.refused.sendFailed')] });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <li className={s.refusedRow}>
      <div className={s.refusedMain}>
        <span>
          <span className={s.taskName}>{workflowName}</span>
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('requests.refused.whenSep')}{formatWhen(refused.at)}</span>
        </span>
        <span>
          <PhraseView phrase={say('requests.refused.tried', { startsWhen: tried })} />
        </span>
        <span>
          {question ? t('requests.refused.because', { why: refusedBecauseAt(code, question) }) : t('requests.refused.because', { why: refusedBecause(code) })}
          {where && !question && <span className={s.quiet}> {t('requests.refused.at', { where })}</span>}
        </span>
        {result && (
          <span role="status" className={s.result}>
            <PhraseView phrase={result.words} />
            {result.link && (
              <>
                {' '}
                <Link to={result.link}>{t('requests.refused.open')}</Link>
              </>
            )}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <Button icon="undo" onClick={() => void run()} aria-busy={busy || undefined} aria-label={t('requests.refused.runAgainFor', { workflow: workflowName, when: whenInSentence(refused.at) })}>
        {t('requests.refused.runAgain')}
      </Button>
    </li>
  );
}

function retriedWords(r: RetriedStart, whilePaused: WhilePaused): { words: Phrase; link?: string } {
  switch (r.result) {
    case 'started':
      return { words: [t('requests.refused.result.started', { n: r.readableId })], link: `/requests/${r.readableId}` };
    case 'duplicate':
      return { words: [t('requests.refused.result.duplicate', { n: r.readableId })], link: `/requests/${r.readableId}` };
    case 'notMatched':
      return { words: [t('requests.refused.result.notMatched')] };
    case 'paused':
      // Held for Resume where a pause keeps what is sent; otherwise refused again, and still listed.
      return { words: [t(whilePaused === 'kept' ? 'requests.refused.result.paused' : 'requests.refused.result.stillPaused')] };
    case 'refused': {
      const first = r.refusals[0];
      return { words: [t('requests.refused.result.refused', { why: refusedBecause(first ? first.code : '') })] };
    }
    default:
      return { words: [t('requests.refusal.other')] };
  }
}

function refusedRunAgain(code: string | undefined): string {
  switch (code) {
    case 'not-found':
      return t('requests.refused.error.gone');
    case 'not-admin':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.notAdmin');
    case 'membership-unavailable':
      return t('requests.refusal.membershipUnavailable');
    case 'source-unavailable':
    case 'busy':
      return t('requests.refusal.busy');
    default:
      return t('requests.refusal.other');
  }
}

/**
 * Route "/start/:workflowId": the live version's start form, through the FormView slot with the
 * published document (runtime-api.md 3.2, 3.3). Started with a client token made when the form
 * opens, so a double press starts one request; refusals are said at their question and on the page;
 * then on to the request's page. A workflow with nothing live says so, with the ones that can be started.
 */
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { ButtonId } from '@/contract';
import { Slot } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Answers, type Refusal, type Services, type StartForm } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Callout, Card, EmptyState, Icon, Page } from '@/ui';
import { liveChoices } from './choices';
import { sourceOf, useLoad, useMe, useNames, valueOf, workflowsOf } from './data';
import { LoadFailed } from './parts';
import { useKeepButtonFocus } from './keepFocus';
import { formRefusal, isAtQuestion } from './refusals';
import { PhraseView } from './say';
import s from './requests.module.css';

/** 1 to 64 of [A-Za-z0-9_-] (runtime-api.md 3.3). */
export function makeClientToken(): string {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  return `start-${Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
}

/** The start form has no values yet: one object, so the form is not worked out again on every render. */
const NO_VALUES = {};

type Loaded =
  | { live: true; form: StartForm; doc: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof sourceOf>> }
  | { live: false; name?: string; startable: { workflow: string; name: string }[] };

async function loadStart(services: Services, workflow: string): Promise<Loaded> {
  const form = await services.runtime.startForm({ workflow });
  if (!form.ok) {
    if (!form.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'not-found')) throw new Error('start form');
    const [startable, all] = await Promise.all([services.runtime.listStartable(), workflowsOf(services).catch(() => [])]);
    const name = all.find((w) => w.id === workflow)?.name;
    return { live: false, ...(name ? { name } : {}), startable: valueOf(startable) };
  }
  const doc = await sourceOf(services, workflow, form.value.version);
  return { live: true, form: form.value, doc };
}

export function StartRequestPage() {
  const { workflowId = '' } = useParams();
  const services = useServices();
  const loaded = useLoad(() => loadStart(services, workflowId), workflowId);

  if (loaded.state === 'loading')
    return (
      <Page title={t('requests.start.title')} width="narrow">
        <p className={s.quiet} role="status">
          {t('requests.load.loading')}
        </p>
      </Page>
    );
  if (loaded.state === 'failed')
    return (
      <Page title={t('requests.start.title')} width="narrow">
        <LoadFailed what={t('requests.start.failed')} onRetry={() => void loaded.reload()} />
      </Page>
    );
  const v = loaded.value;
  if (!v.live) return <NothingLive name={v.name} startable={v.startable} />;
  return <StartFormBody key={`${v.form.workflow}@${v.form.version}`} form={v.form} doc={v.doc} />;
}

function NothingLive({ name, startable }: { name?: string; startable: { workflow: string; name: string }[] }) {
  return (
    <Page title={t('requests.start.title')} width="narrow">
      <Card>
        <EmptyState icon="workflow" title={name ? t('requests.start.notLive.title', { name }) : t('requests.start.unknown.title')}>
          {name ? t('requests.start.notLive.text') : t('requests.start.unknown.text')}
        </EmptyState>
      </Card>
      <StartableList startable={startable} />
    </Page>
  );
}

/** The workflows that can be started, as links. */
export function StartableList({ startable }: { startable: { workflow: string; name: string }[] }) {
  return (
    <Card title={t('requests.start.listTitle')} sub={t('requests.start.listSub')} flush>
      {startable.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.cardText}>{t('requests.start.noneLive')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className={s.linkList}>
          {startable.map((w) => (
            <li key={w.workflow}>
              <Link to={`/start/${w.workflow}`} className={s.rowLink}>
                <Icon name="workflow" />
                <span className={s.rowLinkText}>{w.name}</span>
                <Icon name="chevron-right" />
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

function StartFormBody({ form, doc }: { form: StartForm; doc: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof sourceOf>> }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const me = useMe(services);
  const names = useNames(services, []);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Answers>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [refusals, setRefusals] = useState<Refusal[]>([]);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  // Made once when the form opens: pressing twice, or again after a refusal, starts one request.
  const [clientToken] = useState(makeClientToken);
  const [choices] = useState(() => liveChoices(services, { workflow: form.workflow, version: form.version }));
  const pressing = useRef(false);
  const formBox = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useKeepButtonFocus(formBox);

  const press = async (button: string) => {
    if (pressing.current) return;
    pressing.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setFailed(false);
    try {
      const r = await services.runtime.start({
        workflow: form.workflow, version: form.version, button: button as ButtonId, answers: choices.restore(answers), clientToken,
      });
      if (r.ok) {
        navigate(`/requests/${r.value.readableId}`, { state: { started: true } });
        return;
      }
      setRefusals(r.errors);
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    } finally {
      pressing.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const onPage = refusals.filter((r) => !isAtQuestion(doc, r));
  return (
    <Page title={form.name} lead={t('requests.start.lead', { version: form.version })} width="narrow">
      {(onPage.length > 0 || failed) && (
        <div className={s.stack} role="alert">
          {failed && <Callout tone="danger">{t('requests.start.sendFailed')}</Callout>}
          {onPage.map((r, i) => (
            <Callout key={i} tone="danger">
              <PhraseView phrase={formRefusal(doc, r, names)} />
            </Callout>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {refusals.length > 0 && onPage.length === 0 && (
        <p className={s.srOnly} role="alert">
          {t('requests.start.seeQuestions')}
        </p>
      )}
      <div ref={formBox}>
      <Slot
        name="FormView"
        doc={doc}
        taskId={form.task}
        mode="answer"
        answers={answers}
        onAnswersChange={(next) => {
          choices.setAnswers(next);
          setAnswers(next);
          if (refusals.length) setRefusals([]);
        }}
        values={NO_VALUES}
        {...(me ? { request: { requester: me.ref } } : {})}
        loadChoices={choices.load}
        buttonStates={form.buttonStates}
        refusals={refusals}
        onPress={(b) => void press(b)}
        busy={busy}
      />
      </div>
    </Page>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/StuckCard.tsx\n===
/**
 * "This request is stuck at <stage>" (editor-model.md sections 1 and 3, runtime-api.md 5.1): the
 * reason in words and what it means, who was told; for the people who look after stuck requests,
 * Retry (only for a failed action or nobody to ask, saying what it will do) and Close, each
 * confirmed, and the technical detail behind "Technical detail".
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { describeStuckTold, getStage, getWorkingStage, type Phrase, type StuckPerson } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type RequestView, type Stuck } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { AdminDialog, type AdminKind } from './AdminDialog';
import { formatWhen, type Names } from './format';
import { capital, PhraseView, say, text } from './say';
import { closeWhat, isRetryable, mayClose, mayRetry, stageAt, stagePhrase, stuckAction, stuckWhy, whyNobody, type Named } from './stuck';
import s from './requests.module.css';

const meansKey: Record<Stuck['reason'], WordKey> = {
  'action-failed': 'requests.stuck.means.actionFailed',
  'nobody-to-ask': 'requests.stuck.means.nobodyToAsk',
  'nothing-fits': 'requests.stuck.means.nothingFits',
  error: 'requests.stuck.means.error',
  unfinished: 'requests.stuck.means.unfinished',
};

type Props = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  view: RequestView & { stuck: Stuck };
  catalogue: Catalogue | undefined;
  names: Names;
  /** Who looks after stuck requests in this workflow, by name, when the page could read it. */
  stuckPeople: readonly StuckPerson[] | undefined;
  onDone: (kind: AdminKind, outcome: 'done' | 'stale') => void;
  /** The editor's address of this workflow, when the person may open it there. */
  editor?: string;
};

export function StuckCard({ doc, view, catalogue, names, stuckPeople, onDone, editor }: Props) {
  const stuck = view.stuck;
  const stageId = stageAt(doc, stuck.location)?.id ?? stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id;
  const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageId);
  const action = stuckAction(doc, stuck, catalogue);
  // The model's sentence, the same as in the editor and Try it: "Platform team, who look after stuck requests, were told."
  const told = [...capital(describeStuckTold(stuckPeople, { tense: 'past' })), t('requests.story.end')];
  const nobody = useWhyNobody(doc, view, names);
  const retryWhat = text(
    stuck.reason === 'action-failed'
      ? say('requests.stuck.retry.actionFailed', { action: action ?? [t('requests.stuck.anAction')] })
      : say('requests.stuck.retry.nobodyToAsk', { stage }),
  );
  const closeText = closeWhat(doc, view, catalogue);
  const inEditor = view.viewer.isAdmin ? editorPlace(doc, stuck.location?.item, action) : undefined;
  const detail = stuck.admin;
  const headingId = `stuck-${view.requestId}`;

  return (
    <section className={s.stuckCard} aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <div className={s.stuckHead}>
        <span className={s.stuckIcon}>
          <Icon name="error" size={18} />
        </span>
        <div>
          <h2 id={headingId} className={s.stuckTitle}>
            <PhraseView phrase={say('requests.stuck.title', { stage })} />
          </h2>
          <p>
            <PhraseView phrase={stuckWhy(doc, stuck, catalogue)} />
            {nobody && (
              <>
                {' '}
                <PhraseView phrase={nobody} />
              </>
            )}{' '}
            {t(meansKey[stuck.reason] ?? 'requests.stuck.means.error')}
          </p>
          <p>
            <PhraseView phrase={told} />
            {editor && (
              <>
                {' '}
                {t('requests.stuck.changeIn.before')}
                <Link to={editor} className={s.inlineLink}>
                  {t('requests.stuck.changeIn.settings')}
                </Link>
                {t('requests.stuck.changeIn.after')}
              </>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {inEditor && (
        <p className={s.stuckWhere}>
          <span>{t('requests.stuck.where')}</span>
          <span>
            <PhraseView phrase={inEditor} />
          </span>
        </p>
      )}

      <dl className={s.facts}>
        <dt>{t('requests.stuck.since')}</dt>
        <dd>{formatWhen(stuck.at)}</dd>
      </dl>

      {view.viewer.isAdmin && detail && (
        <details className={s.detail}>
          <summary>{t('requests.stuck.detail')}</summary>
          <dl className={s.facts}>
            {stuck.reason === 'action-failed' && (
              <>
                <dt>{t('requests.stuck.detail.said')}</dt>
                <dd>{detail.outsideText ? <q>{detail.outsideText}</q> : t('requests.stuck.detail.noText')}</dd>
                <dt>{t('requests.stuck.detail.attempts')}</dt>
                <dd>{detail.attempts ?? 1}</dd>
              </>
            )}
            {stuck.reason !== 'action-failed' && (
              <>
                <dt>{t('requests.stuck.detail.engine')}</dt>
                <dd>{detail.text ? <q>{detail.text}</q> : t('requests.stuck.detail.noText')}</dd>
              </>
            )}
          </dl>
        </details>
      )}

      {view.viewer.isAdmin ? (
        <div className={s.adminRow}>
          {mayRetry(view) ? (
            <div className={s.adminChoice}>
              <AdminDialog
                kind="retry"
                view={view}
                what={retryWhat}
                onDone={onDone}
                trigger={
                  <Button variant="primary" icon="undo">
                    {t('requests.stuck.retry')}
                  </Button>
                }
              />
              <p className={s.quiet}>{retryWhat}</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            !isRetryable(stuck.reason) && (
              <div className={s.adminChoice}>
                <p className={s.quiet}>{t('requests.stuck.noRetry')}</p>
              </div>
            )
          )}
          {mayClose(view) && (
            <div className={s.adminChoice}>
              <AdminDialog
                kind="close"
                view={view}
                what={closeText}
                onDone={onDone}
                trigger={<Button icon="close">{t('requests.stuck.close')}</Button>}
              />
              <p className={s.quiet}>{closeText}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {view.viewer.isAdmin && editor && (
        <div className={s.editorLine}>
          <span className={s.editorText}>
            <Icon name="info" size={14} />
            <span>
              <PhraseView
                phrase={
                  stuck.reason === 'action-failed' && action
                    ? say('requests.stuck.fixFirst.action', { action })
                    : say('requests.stuck.fixFirst.stage', { stage })
                }
              />
            </span>
          </span>
          <Link to={editor} className={s.editorLink}>
            <Icon name="external" size={14} />
            {t('requests.stuck.openEditor')}
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
      {view.viewer.isAdmin ? null : (
        <p className={`${s.quiet} ${s.lockLine}`}>
          <Icon name="lock" size={14} /> {t('requests.stuck.onlyThem')}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Where the stuck part is in the editor: "In the editor, it is the action Create Jira issue under
 * What it does on the stage Create Jira issue". Undefined when the stuck state names no action.
 */
function editorPlace(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, itemId: string | undefined, action: Phrase | undefined): Phrase | undefined {
  if (!itemId || !action) return undefined;
  for (const stage of doc.stages) {
    const working = getWorkingStage(doc, stage.id);
    if (!working) continue;
    const starts = working.whenThisStageStarts.some((a) => a.id === itemId);
    const after = working.afterTheyRespond.some((a) => a.id === itemId);
    if (!starts && !after) continue;
    const section = starts
      ? t(working.tasks.length === 0 ? 'requests.stuck.section.whatItDoes' : 'requests.stuck.section.whenStarts')
      : t('requests.stuck.section.afterRespond');
    return say('requests.stuck.inEditor', { action, section, stage: stagePhrase(doc, getStage(doc, stage.id)?.id) });
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Why nobody can answer, once the asked groups' people are read from the directory (`whyNobody`).
 * Undefined while they are being read, when they cannot be, or when the reason is another.
 */
function useWhyNobody(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: RequestView & { stuck: Stuck }, names: Names): Phrase | undefined {
  const services = useServices();
  const open = view.stuck.reason === 'nobody-to-ask' ? view.tasks.find((x) => x.location.item === view.stuck.location?.item) : undefined;
  const groups = (open?.askedOf ?? []).filter((r) => r.type === 'group').map((r) => r.id);
  const wanted = groups.join('|');
  const hasOpen = !!open;
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<{ key: string; got: Record<string, Named[] | undefined> } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasOpen) return;
    let live = true;
    const ids = wanted ? wanted.split('|') : [];
    void Promise.all(
      ids.map((id) =>
        services.directory.membersOf({ type: 'group', id }).then(
          (got) => [id, got.map((m) => ({ type: m.type, id: m.id, label: m.label }))] as const,
          () => [id, undefined] as const,
        ),
      ),
    ).then((pairs) => {
      if (live) setMembers({ key: wanted, got: Object.fromEntries(pairs) });
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, wanted, hasOpen]);
  if (!open || !members || members.key !== wanted) return undefined;
  return whyNobody(doc, view, members.got, names);
