/**
 * A task on the request's page (runtime-api.md 4.2, 4.3; mockup 12, "request" and "answered"): who
 * is asked and the one-answer rule, the form through the FormView slot with the request's values
 * and recorded lists, the buttons with why one cannot be pressed for this person, what each button
 * does, and after pressing the request's new place in one line. A task answered by someone else
 * meanwhile says so plainly.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Catalogue, Condition, Expression } from '@/contract';
import { describeExpression, getButton, getStage, getTask, getWorkingStage, refsInHeld, Slot, stageOf, subjectsOf, takesPlural, toText, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Answers, type ButtonState, type Person, type Ref, type Refusal, type RequestView, type Services, type TaskView } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { liveChoices } from './choices';
import { useLoad, valueOf } from './data';
import { byPhrase, refsPhrase, whenInSentence, type Names } from './format';
import { useKeepButtonFocus } from './keepFocus';
import { LoadFailed } from './parts';
import { formRefusal, isAtQuestion } from './refusals';
import { chipOf, list, PhraseView, say } from './say';
import { stagePhrase } from './stuck';
import { whereNow } from './where';
import s from './requests.module.css';

type Props = {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  view: RequestView;
  task: string;
  catalogue: Catalogue | undefined;
  names: Names;
  me: Person | null;
  /** The request changed (after a press): read it again. Resolves with the new view. */
  onActed: () => Promise<RequestView | undefined>;
};

/** Why this person cannot press any button, from the engine's button states; undefined when one can be pressed. */
export function cannotAnswer(states: readonly ButtonState[]): Refusal['code'] | undefined {
  if (states.length === 0 || states.some((b) => b.available)) return undefined;
  const order: Refusal['code'][] = ['wait-not-open', 'membership-unavailable', 'not-assignee', 'may'];
  const codes = new Set(states.flatMap((b) => b.refusals.map((r) => r.code)));
  return order.find((c) => codes.has(c));
}

/** What a button does: "Goes to Create Jira issue.", "Sends it back to Request form.", "Goes to Rejected, an ending." */
export function buttonGoes(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, buttonId: string, visited: ReadonlySet<string>): Phrase {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, stageOf(doc, buttonId)?.id);
  const arrows = (stage?.arrows ?? []).filter((a) => a.when.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === buttonId && a.goTo);
  const targets = [...new Set(arrows.map((a) => a.goTo as string))];
  if (targets.length === 0) return [t('requests.task.goes.depends')];
  if (targets.length > 1) return say('requests.task.goes.oneOf', { stages: list(targets.map((id) => stagePhrase(doc, id)), 'or') });
  const to = targets[0] as string;
  const target = getStage(doc, to);
  if (target?.kind === 'ending') return say('requests.task.goes.ending', { stage: stagePhrase(doc, to) });
  if (visited.has(to) || to === doc.start?.stage) return say('requests.task.goes.back', { stage: stagePhrase(doc, to) });
  return say('requests.task.goes.to', { stage: stagePhrase(doc, to) });
}

/** Whether a "when ..." is only "<button> is pressed" (one or several buttons), and holds for `buttonId`. */
function onlyWhenPressed(condition: Condition | undefined, buttonId: string): boolean {
  if (!condition) return true;
  if (!('allOf' in condition) && !('anyOf' in condition)) return false;
  const clauses = 'allOf' in condition ? condition.allOf : condition.anyOf;
  if (clauses.length === 0 || !clauses.every((c) => 'pressed' in c)) return false;
  const pressed = clauses.map((c) => (c as { pressed: string }).pressed);
  return 'allOf' in condition ? pressed.every((p) => p === buttonId) : pressed.includes(buttonId);
}

/** Who a notification goes to, as this request has it: "Priya Raman"; else the author's words for it. */
function toldWho(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, to: Expression, view: RequestView, names: Names, answeredHere: ReadonlySet<string>): { phrase: Phrase; many: boolean } {
  // The model's one plural rule (`takesPlural`): a group or several names take "are", one person "is".
  const ofRefs = (refs: readonly Ref[]) => ({ phrase: refsPhrase(refs, names), many: takesPlural(refs.map((r) => ({ kind: r.type === 'group' ? ('group' as const) : ('person' as const) }))) });
  const ofExpression = (e: Expression) => {
    const phrase = describeExpression(doc, e);
    return { phrase, many: takesPlural(subjectsOf(doc, e, toText(phrase))) };
  };
  const fallback = (e: Expression | undefined) => (e ? toldWho(doc, e, view, names, answeredHere) : ofExpression(to));
  if ('request' in to && to.request === 'requester' && !to.steps?.length) {
    return view.requester ? ofRefs([view.requester]) : fallback(to.ifEmptyUse);
  }
  if ('value' in to && !to.steps?.length) {
    const refs = refsInHeld(view.values[to.value]);
    if (refs.length) return ofRefs(refs);
    // Filled by this very form: the person chosen here ("Eng lead"), not what it falls back to while empty.
    if (answeredHere.has(to.value)) return ofExpression({ value: to.value });
    if (to.ifEmptyUse) return fallback(to.ifEmptyUse);
  }
  return ofExpression(to);
}

/** Who is told when `buttonId` is pressed: the notifications after they respond that it sets off, and those where it goes. */
export function buttonTells(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, buttonId: string, view: RequestView, names: Names): Phrase | undefined {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, stageOf(doc, buttonId)?.id);
  if (!stage) return undefined;
  const notifies = (actions: readonly Action[], when: (a: Action) => boolean) => actions.filter((a) => a.type === 'notify' && a.to && when(a));
  const found = notifies(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [], (a) => onlyWhenPressed(a.onlyWhen, buttonId));
  const targets = [...new Set((stage.arrows ?? []).filter((a) => a.when.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === buttonId && a.goTo).map((a) => a.goTo as string))];
  const next = targets.length === 1 ? getWorkingStage(doc, targets[0]) : undefined;
  if (next) found.push(...notifies(next.whenThisStageStarts ?? [], (a) => !a.onlyWhen));
  if (found.length === 0) return undefined;
  const answeredHere = new Set(
    stage.tasks
      .filter((task) => task.buttons.some((b) => b.id === buttonId))
      .flatMap((task) => task.form.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items))
      .flatMap((i) => (i.type === 'question' && i.savedAs ? [i.savedAs as string] : [])),
  );
  const who = found.map((a) => toldWho(doc, (a as { to: Expression }).to, view, names, answeredHere));
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const unique = who.filter((w) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(w.phrase);
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });
  const many = unique.length > 1 || unique.some((w) => w.many);
  return say(many ? 'requests.task.toldMany' : 'requests.task.toldOne', { who: list(unique.map((w) => w.phrase)) });
}

export function TaskPanel({ doc, view, task, catalogue, names, me, onActed }: Props) {
  const services = useServices();
  const loaded = useLoad(async () => valueOf(await services.runtime.getTask({ requestId: view.requestId, task })), `${view.requestId}/${task}`);
  if (loaded.state === 'loading') return <p className={s.quiet}>{t('requests.load.loading')}</p>;
  if (loaded.state === 'failed') return <LoadFailed what={t('requests.task.failed')} onRetry={() => void loaded.reload()} />;
  return (
    <TaskBody key={loaded.value.task} doc={doc} view={view} tv={loaded.value} catalogue={catalogue} names={names} me={me} onActed={onActed} reloadTask={loaded.reload} />
  );
}

type BodyProps = Omit<Props, 'task'> & { tv: TaskView; reloadTask: () => Promise<void> };

function TaskBody({ doc, view, tv, catalogue, names, me, onActed, reloadTask }: BodyProps) {
  const services = useServices();
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Answers>(tv.earlierAnswers ?? {});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [refusals, setRefusals] = useState<Refusal[]>([]);
  const [sendFailed, setSendFailed] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<{ button: string; after?: RequestView } | null>(null);
  const [overtaken, setOvertaken] = useState(false);
  const [choices] = useState(() => liveChoices(services, { requestId: tv.requestId, task: tv.task }, tv.earlierAnswers ?? {}));
  const pressing = useRef(false);
  const formBox = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const doneRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useKeepButtonFocus(formBox);
  // After pressing, the focus goes to what it did ("Done: you pressed Reject"), not to the page body.
  const isDone = !!done;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDone) doneRef.current?.focus();
  }, [isDone]);
  const task = getTask(doc, tv.authoredTask);
  const stageId = tv.stage;
  const visited = useMemo(() => {
    const v = new Set<string>();
    for (const e of view.story) if (e.code === 'moved') v.add(e.params.from);
    return v;
  }, [view.story]);
  const group = tv.askedOf.some((r) => r.type === 'group');
  const why = cannotAnswer(tv.buttonStates);
  const request = { ...(tv.requester ? { requester: tv.requester } : {}), startedOn: tv.startedOn };
  // Whether this person was among who is asked: only they are sent back to My tasks, and told "already".
  const wasAsked = useWasAsked(services, tv.state === 'open' ? [] : tv.askedOf, me);

  const press = async (button: string) => {
    if (pressing.current) return;
    pressing.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setSendFailed(false);
    try {
      const r = await services.runtime.act({ requestId: tv.requestId, task: tv.task, button: button as ButtonId, answers: choices.restore(answers) });
      if (r.ok) {
        const after = await onActed();
        setDone({ button, ...(after ? { after } : {}) });
        setRefusals([]);
        return;
      }
      setRefusals(r.errors);
      if (r.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'wait-not-open')) {
        setOvertaken(true);
        await reloadTask();
        await onActed();
      }
    } catch {
      setSendFailed(true);
    } finally {
      pressing.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const heading = <PhraseView phrase={stagePhrase(doc, stageId)} />;

  // Pressed here: the button, and where the request is now.
  if (done) {
    const after = done.after;
    const where = after ? whereNow(doc, after, names, catalogue)[0]?.phrase : undefined;
    return (
      <section className={s.taskCard} aria-labelledby={`task-${tv.task}`}>
        <div ref={doneRef} tabIndex={-1} className={`${s.taskBanner} ${s.bannerDone} ${s.bannerFocus}`} role="status">
          <Icon name="check" size={18} />
          <div>
            <h2 id={`task-${tv.task}`} className={s.bannerTitle}>
              <PhraseView phrase={say('requests.task.done', { button: [chipOf('button', getButton(doc, done.button)?.label ?? '', done.button)] })} />
            </h2>
            {where && (
              <p>
                <PhraseView phrase={where} />
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={s.taskFoot}>
          <Link to="/tasks" className={s.backLink}>
            <Icon name="arrow-left" size={14} />
            {t('requests.task.backToTasks')}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  // No longer open: answered (by someone else, or by me), or no longer needed.
  if (tv.state !== 'open') {
    const c = tv.completed;
    const mine = c && me && c.by.type === 'user' && c.by.id === me.ref.id;
    const where = whereNow(doc, view, names, catalogue)[0]?.phrase;
    let title: Phrase;
    let body: Phrase | undefined;
    if (c && !mine) {
      // Someone else answered. To one of who was asked: "already", and the one-answer rule; to anyone else, only what happened.
      title = say(wasAsked ? 'requests.task.answeredBy' : 'requests.task.answeredByOther', { who: byPhrase(c.by, names, catalogue) });
      body = say(group && wasAsked ? 'requests.task.answeredBy.group' : 'requests.task.answeredBy.text', {
        button: [chipOf('button', getButton(doc, c.button)?.label ?? '', c.button)],
        when: whenInSentence(c.at),
      });
    } else if (c) {
      title = [t('requests.task.answeredByYou')];
      body = say('requests.task.answeredByYou.text', { button: [chipOf('button', getButton(doc, c.button)?.label ?? '', c.button)], when: whenInSentence(c.at) });
    } else {
      title = [t('requests.task.noLongerNeeded')];
    }
    return (
      <section className={s.taskCard} aria-labelledby={`task-${tv.task}`}>
        <div className={`${s.taskBanner} ${s.bannerInfo}`}>
          <Icon name="check" size={18} />
          <div>
            <h2 id={`task-${tv.task}`} className={s.bannerTitle}>
              <PhraseView phrase={title} />
            </h2>
            {body && (
              <p>
                <PhraseView phrase={body} />
              </p>
            )}
            {overtaken && <p>{t('requests.task.notSaved')}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
        {where && (
          <p className={s.taskWhere}>
            <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} />
            <span>
              <PhraseView phrase={where} />
            </span>
          </p>
        )}
        {c && task && (
          <div className={s.taskForm}>
            <Slot name="FormView" doc={doc} taskId={tv.authoredTask} mode="answer" answers={c.answers} onAnswersChange={() => undefined} values={tv.values} request={request} lookups={tv.lookups} readOnly />
          </div>
        )}
        {(mine || wasAsked) && (
          <div className={s.taskFoot}>
            <Link to="/tasks" className={s.backLink}>
              <Icon name="arrow-left" size={14} />
              {t('requests.task.backToTasks')}
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    );
  }

  const onPage = refusals.filter((r) => !isAtQuestion(doc, r));
  const canAnswer = !why;
  return (
    <section className={s.taskCard} aria-labelledby={`task-${tv.task}`}>
      <div className={`${s.taskBanner} ${canAnswer ? s.bannerTurn : s.bannerInfo}`}>
        <Icon name={group ? 'group' : 'person'} size={18} />
        <div>
          <h2 id={`task-${tv.task}`} className={s.bannerTitle}>
            {canAnswer ? t('requests.task.yourTurn') : t('requests.task.title')} {heading}
          </h2>
          <p>
            <PhraseView
              phrase={
                tv.askedOf.length
                  ? say(tv.askedOf.length > 1 || group ? 'requests.task.askedMany' : 'requests.task.askedOne', { askedOf: refsPhrase(tv.askedOf, names), when: whenInSentence(tv.openedAt) })
                  : [t('requests.task.nobodyAsked')]
              }
            />
          </p>
          <p>{group ? t('rule.group') : t('rule.person')}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {why && (
        <div className={s.taskWhy}>
          <Callout
            tone={why === 'membership-unavailable' ? 'todo' : 'neutral'}
            icon="lock"
            {...(why === 'membership-unavailable'
              ? { actions: <Button size="sm" icon="undo" onClick={() => void reloadTask()}>{t('requests.load.tryAgain')}</Button> }
              : {})}
          >
            {t(
              why === 'may'
                ? 'requests.task.cannot.may'
                : why === 'not-assignee'
                  ? 'requests.task.cannot.notAssignee'
                  : why === 'membership-unavailable'
                    ? 'requests.task.cannot.membership'
                    : 'requests.task.cannot.notOpen',
            )}
          </Callout>
        </div>
      )}

      {(onPage.length > 0 || sendFailed) && (
        <div className={s.taskWhy} role="alert">
          {sendFailed && <Callout tone="danger">{t('requests.task.sendFailed')}</Callout>}
          {onPage.map((r, i) => (
            <Callout key={i} tone="danger">
              <PhraseView phrase={formRefusal(doc, r, names)} />
            </Callout>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={s.taskForm} ref={formBox}>
        <Slot
          name="FormView"
          doc={doc}
          taskId={tv.authoredTask}
          mode="answer"
          answers={answers}
          onAnswersChange={(next) => {
            choices.setAnswers(next);
            setAnswers(next);
            if (refusals.length) setRefusals([]);
          }}
          values={tv.values}
          request={request}
          lookups={tv.lookups}
          loadChoices={choices.load}
          buttonStates={tv.buttonStates}
          refusals={refusals}
          onPress={(b) => void press(b)}
          busy={busy}
          readOnly={!canAnswer}
        />
      </div>

      {task && task.buttons.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.buttonsDo}>
          <h3 className={s.smallHead}>{t('requests.task.whatButtonsDo')}</h3>
          <dl className={s.facts}>

                        {' '}
                        <PhraseView phrase={told} />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </dl>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Whether the signed-in person is among `askedOf`: by name, or as one of a group's people (read from
 * the directory). False while it is not known, so nobody is told "already" or sent back to My tasks
 * on a guess.
 */
function useWasAsked(services: Services, askedOf: readonly Ref[], me: Person | null): boolean {
  const meId = me?.ref.id;
  const direct = !!meId && askedOf.some((r) => r.type === 'user' && r.id === meId);
  const groups = askedOf.filter((r) => r.type === 'group').map((r) => r.id).join('|');
  const [inGroup, setInGroup] = useState<{ key: string; yes: boolean } | null>(null);
  const key = `${meId ?? ''}/${groups}`;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!meId || !groups || direct) return;
    let live = true;
    void Promise.all(groups.split('|').map((id) => services.directory.membersOf({ type: 'group', id }).catch(() => [])))
      .then((lists) => {
        if (live) setInGroup({ key, yes: lists.some((l) => l.some((m) => m.type === 'user' && m.id === meId)) });
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, meId, groups, direct, key]);
  return direct || (inGroup?.key === key && inGroup.yes);

/** Live choices hand out a source item's stored value as the source has it, a number included, and put the runtime's value back. */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { ChoicesArgs, Services } from '@/services';
import { liveChoices } from './choices';

function servicesGiving(choices: { value: unknown; label: string }[]): Services {
  return { runtime: { choices: async (_args: ChoicesArgs) => ({ ok: true, value: { choices } }) } } as unknown as Services;
}

describe('liveChoices', () => {
  it('keeps a number stored value a number, apart from the same digits as text, and restores both', async () => {
    const live = liveChoices(servicesGiving([
      { value: { stored: 7, label: 'Rack 7' }, label: 'Rack 7' },
      { value: { stored: '7', label: 'Room 7' }, label: 'Room 7' },
      { value: { type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-sam-carter' }, label: 'Sam Carter' },
    ]), { workflow: 'w1', version: 1 });
    const handed = await live.load('q_rack', '');
    expect(handed).toEqual([{ stored: 7, label: 'Rack 7' }, { stored: '7', label: 'Room 7' }, { stored: 'dir-user-sam-carter', label: 'Sam Carter' }]);
    expect(live.restore({ q_rack: { stored: 7, label: 'Rack 7' }, q_room: { stored: '7', label: 'x' }, q_who: { type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-sam-carter' } })).toEqual({
      q_rack: { stored: 7, label: 'Rack 7' }, q_room: { stored: '7', label: 'Room 7' }, q_who: { type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-sam-carter' },
    });
  });
});

/**
 * Choices from the directory or a connection on a live form (runtime-api.md 3.4). The runtime gives
 * each choice as the exact value to send back; the FormView slot's `loadChoices` hands out
 * `{ stored, label }`, `stored` being a person's or group's ID or a source item's stored value as
 * the source has it (text or a number, never turned into text). This keeps the runtime's value for
 * each `stored` it handed out, and puts it back in the answers before they are sent.
 */
import type { QuestionId } from '@/contract';
import type { Answers, ChoicesArgs, Json, Services } from '@/services';

export interface LiveChoices {
  load: (questionId: string, search: string) => Promise<{ stored: string | number; label: string }[]>;
  /** The answers with each choice handed out by `load` turned back into the runtime's own value. */
  restore: (answers: Answers) => Answers;
  /** Keeps the form's answers so far: the choices of a question may depend on them. */
  setAnswers: (answers: Answers) => void;
}

/** What a choice is handed out as: a person's or group's ID, a source item's stored value, else the value as text. */
function storedOf(value: Json): string | number {
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') return value;
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (typeof value.id === 'string' && (value.type === 'user' || value.type === 'group')) return value.id;
    if (typeof value.stored === 'string' || typeof value.stored === 'number') return value.stored;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

/** One key per stored value, so the text "7" and the number 7 stay apart. */
const keyOf = (stored: string | number): string => `${typeof stored}:${stored}`;

export function liveChoices(services: Services, form: ChoicesArgs['form'], first: Answers = {}): LiveChoices {
  const given = new Map<string, Json>();
  let now = first;
  const answersNow = () => restoreWith(now);
  const back = (value: Json | undefined): Json | undefined => {
    if (value === undefined) return value;
    if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') return given.get(keyOf(value)) ?? value;
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v) => back(v) ?? v);
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
      const stored = typeof value.id === 'string' ? value.id : typeof value.stored === 'string' || typeof value.stored === 'number' ? value.stored : undefined;
      if (stored !== undefined && given.has(keyOf(stored))) return given.get(keyOf(stored));
    }
    return value;
  };
  function restoreWith(answers: Answers): Answers {
    const out: Answers = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(answers)) {
      const r = back(v);
      if (r !== undefined) out[k as QuestionId] = r;
    }
    return out;
  }
  return {
    async load(question, search) {
      const r = await services.runtime.choices({ form, question: question as QuestionId, answers: answersNow(), ...(search ? { search } : {}) });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.errors.map((e) => e.code).join(', '));
      return r.value.choices.map((c) => {
        const stored = storedOf(c.value);
        given.set(keyOf(stored), c.value);
        return { stored, label: c.label };
      });
    },
    restore: restoreWith,
    setAnswers(answers) {
      now = answers;
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Loading what the request pages show: a small hook for one async load, and caches for what never
 * changes while a page is open (the catalogue, a published version's document, workflow names).
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import type { Person, Ref, Result, Services, ServerWorkflowId, VersionNumber } from '@/services';

export type Loaded<T> =
  | { state: 'loading' }
  | { state: 'failed' }
  | { state: 'done'; value: T };

/**
 * Runs `load` when `key` changes and keeps its answer. A rejected promise is `failed` (the call
 * could not be made); `reload` runs it again, keeping the old value on screen while it runs.
 */
export function useLoad<T>(load: () => Promise<T>, key: string): Loaded<T> & { reload: () => Promise<void> } {
  const [got, setGot] = useState<{ key: string; loaded: Loaded<T> } | null>(null);
  const loadRef = useRef(load);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRef.current = load;
  });
  const run = useRef(0);

  const start = useCallback(async (forKey: string) => {
    const mine = ++run.current;
    try {
      const value = await loadRef.current();
      if (mine === run.current) setGot({ key: forKey, loaded: { state: 'done', value } });
    } catch {
      if (mine === run.current) setGot({ key: forKey, loaded: { state: 'failed' } });
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void start(key);
  }, [key, start]);

  const reload = useCallback(() => start(key), [key, start]);
  const loaded: Loaded<T> = got && got.key === key ? got.loaded : { state: 'loading' };
  return { ...loaded, reload };
}

/** The value of a result, or throws so `useLoad` reports `failed`. */
export function valueOf<T>(result: Result<T>): T {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.errors.map((e) => e.code).join(', '));
  return result.value;
}

const catalogues = new WeakMap<Services, Promise<Catalogue | undefined>>();

/** The catalogue of connections, fetched once per set of services. Undefined when it cannot be had. */
export function catalogueOf(services: Services): Promise<Catalogue | undefined> {
  let found = catalogues.get(services);
  if (!found) {
    found = services.catalogue.getCatalogue().then((r) => (r.ok ? r.value : undefined), () => undefined);
    catalogues.set(services, found);
  }
  return found;
}

const sources = new WeakMap<Services, Map<string, Promise<AuthoredWorkflow>>>();

/** A published version's document. Published versions never change, so each is fetched once. */
export function sourceOf(services: Services, workflow: ServerWorkflowId, version: VersionNumber): Promise<AuthoredWorkflow> {
  let map = sources.get(services);
  if (!map) {
    map = new Map();
    sources.set(services, map);
  }
  const key = `${workflow}@${version}`;
  let found = map.get(key);
  if (!found) {
    found = services.runtime.publishedSource({ workflow, version }).then((r) => valueOf(r).authored);
    found.catch(() => map?.delete(key));
    map.set(key, found);
  }
  return found;
}

export interface WorkflowInfo {
  id: ServerWorkflowId;
  name: string;
  /** The highest published version; absent when nothing is live. */
  liveVersion?: VersionNumber;
  /** Whether the signed-in person may open it in the editor (known only from the workflows list). */
  mayEdit?: boolean;
}

/** Every workflow's name and live version: the workflows list, else the startable ones. */
export async function workflowsOf(services: Services): Promise<WorkflowInfo[]> {
  const listed = await services.authoring.listWorkflows().catch(() => undefined);
  if (listed?.ok) return listed.value.map((w) => ({ id: w.id, name: w.name, mayEdit: !!w.may?.edit, ...(w.liveVersion ? { liveVersion: w.liveVersion } : {}) }));
  const startable = valueOf(await services.runtime.listStartable());
  return startable.map((w) => ({ id: w.workflow, name: w.name, liveVersion: w.highestVersion }));
}

/** The key of a person or group in a names map. */
export const refKey = (ref: { type: string; id: string }) => `${ref.type}:${ref.id}`;

/**
 * Display names of people and groups, looked up in the directory. Returns the names found so far,
 * by `refKey`; a reference the directory does not know keeps no name (the caller says "someone").
 */
export function useNames(services: Services, refs: readonly Ref[]): Record<string, string> {
  const [names, setNames] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const wanted = [...new Set(refs.map(refKey))].sort().join('|');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!wanted) return;
    let live = true;
    const list = wanted.split('|').map((k) => {
      const [type, ...id] = k.split(':');
      return { type: type as Ref['type'], id: id.join(':') };
    });
    services.directory.lookup(list).then(
      (entries) => {
        if (!live) return;
        setNames((old) => {
          const next = { ...old };
          for (const e of entries) next[refKey(e)] = e.label;
          return next;
        });
      },
      () => undefined,
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, wanted]);
  return names;
}

/** Who is signed in, or null while it is being found out. */
export function useMe(services: Services): Person | null {
  const [me, setMe] = useState<Person | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    services.session.whoAmI().then(
      (p) => live && setMe(p),
      () => undefined,
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services]);
  return me;
}

/**
 * Whether the signed-in person looks after the stuck requests of a workflow: asked the server's
 * own way, by listing its refused starts (refused `not-admin` when not).
 */
export async function looksAfter(services: Services, workflow: ServerWorkflowId): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = await services.runtime.listRefusedStarts({ workflow, limit: 1 }).catch(() => undefined);
  return !!r?.ok;
}

/**
 * Small things said the same way on every request page: when something happened, who did it, and
 * what the model's sentences need from the page (names for a held value, the people told about a
 * stuck request). A request's title and a value in words are the model's (`requestTitle`,
 * `describeHeldValue`).
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { formatDate, getQuestion, getStage, type HeldValueEnv, type Phrase, type StuckPerson } from '@/model';
import type { By, Ref, Timestamp } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { chipOf, list } from './say';
import { refKey } from './data';

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const sameDay = (a: Date, b: Date) => a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();

/** `formatWhen` inside a sentence: "today, 10:31". */
export function whenInSentence(at: Timestamp, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const said = formatWhen(at, now);
  return /^\d/.test(said) ? said : said.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + said.slice(1);
}

/** "Today, 10:31", "Yesterday, 09:14", "10 Nov, 09:14", or "10 Nov 2025, 09:14" in another year. */
export function formatWhen(at: Timestamp, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const d = new Date(at);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return at;
  const time = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  if (sameDay(d, now)) return t('requests.when.today', { time });
  const yesterday = new Date(now);
  yesterday.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
  if (sameDay(d, yesterday)) return t('requests.when.yesterday', { time });
  const months = t('describe.months').split(' ');
  const date = `${d.getDate()} ${months[d.getMonth()] ?? ''}${d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() ? '' : ` ${d.getFullYear()}`}`;
  return t('requests.when.date', { date, time });
}

/** "10 Nov 2026": the day only. */
export function formatDay(at: Timestamp): string {
  const d = new Date(at);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return at;
  return formatDate(`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`);
}

/** How long ago, roughly: "just now", "5 minutes", "3 hours", "2 days". */
export function formatAge(at: Timestamp, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.round((now.getTime() - new Date(at).getTime()) / 60000));
  if (minutes < 1) return t('requests.age.justNow');
  if (minutes < 60) return t(minutes === 1 ? 'requests.age.minute' : 'requests.age.minutes', { n: minutes });
  const hours = Math.round(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return t(hours === 1 ? 'requests.age.hour' : 'requests.age.hours', { n: hours });
  const days = Math.round(hours / 24);
  return t(days === 1 ? 'requests.age.day' : 'requests.age.days', { n: days });
}

export type Names = Record<string, string>;

/** A person or group as a chip, by its directory name ("someone" until it is known). */
export function refPhrase(ref: Ref, names: Names): Phrase {
  return [chipOf(ref.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person', names[refKey(ref)] ?? t('requests.someone'), ref.id)];
}

/** People and groups as a list: "Marcus Lee and Hannah Okafor". */
export function refsPhrase(refs: readonly Ref[], names: Names): Phrase {
  return list(refs.map((r) => refPhrase(r, names)));
}

/** Who did something: a person, another system (by its connection's name), or the platform. */
export function byPhrase(by: By, names: Names, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): Phrase {
  if (by.type === 'user') return refPhrase({ type: 'user', id: by.id }, names);
  if (by.type === 'connection') {
    const label = catalogue?.connections.find((c) => c.id === by.id)?.label;
    return [chipOf('connection', label ?? t('requests.anotherSystem'), by.id)];
  }
  return [t('requests.thePlatform')];
}

export const userRef = (by: By | undefined): Ref[] => (by?.type === 'user' ? [{ type: 'user', id: by.id }] : []);

export function firstTaskOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): string | undefined {

}

export function heldEnv(names: Names, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined, links?: HeldValueEnv['links']): HeldValueEnv {

/** "Platform team" and "Sam Carter" as the model's `describeStuckTold` takes them; undefined until every name is known. */

  return people.every((p) => p.name) ? people : undefined;
}

/**
 * Keeps the keyboard focus on a button that is drawn again as a new element. A form's button that
 * changes from "cannot be pressed yet" to "can be pressed" is replaced in the page (the ui Button
 * wraps a blocked button in its tooltip), and the browser then drops the focus to the page body:
 * a person who had just tabbed to Submit would press Enter on nothing. This puts the focus back on
 * the button that took its place (the same label, at the same place among the buttons).
 */
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';

/** The words of a button without its hidden "why it cannot be pressed" (the ui Button adds them in a visually hidden span). */
export function buttonLabel(el: Element): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const node of Array.from(el.childNodes)) {
    if (node instanceof Element && node.classList.contains('visually-hidden')) continue;
    out += node.textContent ?? '';
  }
  return out.trim();
}

export function useKeepButtonFocus(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    const box = ref.current;
    if (!box) return;
    let held: { el: HTMLButtonElement; label: string; index: number } | null = null;

    const onFocusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => {
      const el = e.target;
      if (!(el instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) {
        held = null;
        return;
      }
      held = { el, label: buttonLabel(el), index: Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('button')).indexOf(el) };
    };
    const onFocusOut = (e: FocusEvent) => {
      // Moved on by the person (to anything else): forget it. A button taken out of the page moves
      // the focus to nothing (relatedTarget null) and is handled when the page changes.
      if (e.relatedTarget) held = null;
    };
    const restore = () => {
      if (!held || held.el.isConnected) return;
      const active = document.activeElement;
      if (active && active !== document.body && box.contains(active)) {
        held = null;
        return;
      }
      if (active && active !== document.body) return;
      const buttons = Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('button'));
      const same = buttons.filter((b) => buttonLabel(b) === held?.label);
      const next = same.length === 1 ? same[0] : (same.find((b) => buttons.indexOf(b) === held?.index) ?? same[0]);
      if (next) next.focus();
    };
    const observer = new MutationObserver(restore);
    observer.observe(box, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    box.addEventListener('focusin', onFocusIn);
    box.addEventListener('focusout', onFocusOut);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      box.removeEventListener('focusin', onFocusIn);
      box.removeEventListener('focusout', onFocusOut);
    };
  }, [ref]);
}

/**
 * "Where it is" as a path (mockup 12, request and stopped): the stages the request went through,
 * the one it is at now, and the way it usually goes on from there (each stage's main button, or an
 * automatic stage's "In all other cases" or "When done" arrow, never its failure branch), to an ending. The other buttons of the stage it is at are "Other
 * ways from" that stage.
 */
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Button } from '@/contract';
import { getStage, getWorkingStage } from '@/model';
import type { RequestView } from '@/services';
import { stageAt } from './stuck';

export type PathState = 'done' | 'now' | 'stuck' | 'ahead' | 'ended' | 'closed';

export interface PathStop {
  stage: string;
  state: PathState;
}

export interface RequestPath {
  stops: PathStop[];
  /** The button whose way the path follows from the stage it is at now. */
  via?: Button;
  /** The stage it is at now, when it can still move on; its other buttons are the other ways. */
  from?: string;
  others: Button[];
}

const MAX_AHEAD = 12;

/** The main button of a stage's (first) task: its primary button, else its first. */
function mainButton(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: string): Button | undefined {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, stageId);
  const buttons = stage?.tasks[0]?.buttons ?? [];
  return buttons.find((b) => b.look === 'primary') ?? buttons[0];
}

/** The values actions save "whether it failed" and "what went wrong" in. */
function failureValues(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const action of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
      if (action.type !== 'useConnection') continue;
      if (action.saveFailureAs?.failed) out.add(action.saveFailureAs.failed);
      if (action.saveFailureAs?.code) out.add(action.saveFailureAs.code);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** True when an arrow's "when" or "only when" reads a value an action saves a failure in: the way taken when something failed. */
function readsAFailure(arrow: Arrow, failures: Set<string>): boolean {
  const text = JSON.stringify([arrow.when, arrow.onlyWhen ?? null]);
  return [...failures].some((v) => text.includes(`"value":${JSON.stringify(v)}`) || text.includes(`{{${v}}}`));
}

/**
 * Where the usual way goes from a stage: by its main button's own arrow; when the main button has
 * none, the "In all other cases" arrow (where pressing it goes when no other arrow is about it).
 * From an automatic stage: its "In all other cases" or "When done" arrow; else the first arrow whose
 * "when" does not read a failure (never the way taken when something failed); else the first arrow.
 */
function nextOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: string): string | undefined {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, stageId);
  if (!stage) return undefined;
  const arrows = (stage.arrows ?? []).filter((a) => a.goTo);
  if (stage.tasks.length > 0) {
    const main = mainButton(doc, stageId);
    const byButton = arrows.find((a) => a.when.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === main?.id);
    if (byButton?.goTo) return byButton.goTo;
    const otherwise = arrows.find((a) => a.when.type === 'inAllOtherCases');
    if (otherwise?.goTo) return otherwise.goTo;
    return arrows[0]?.goTo ?? undefined;
  }
  const usual = arrows.find((a) => a.when.type === 'inAllOtherCases' || a.when.type === 'whenDone');
  if (usual?.goTo) return usual.goTo;
  const failures = failureValues(doc);
  const notAFailure = arrows.find((a) => !readsAFailure(a, failures));
  return (notAFailure ?? arrows[0])?.goTo ?? undefined;
}

export function pathOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: RequestView): RequestPath {
  // The stages in the order the request first came to them.
  const order: string[] = [];
  const add = (id: string | undefined) => {
    if (id && getStage(doc, id) && !order.includes(id)) order.push(id);
  };
  add(doc.start?.stage);
  for (const e of view.story) if (e.code === 'moved') add(e.params.to);

  const closedEarly = !!view.closed && !view.closed.ending;
  const now = view.closed?.ending ?? (view.stuck ? stageAt(doc, view.stuck.location)?.id : undefined) ?? stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id;
  if (!now) return { stops: order.map((stage) => ({ stage, state: 'done' })), others: [] };

  // Sent back to a stage it passed before: the path goes on from there again.
  const at = order.indexOf(now);
  const before = at >= 0 ? order.slice(0, at) : order;
  const nowState: PathState = view.closed ? (closedEarly ? 'closed' : 'ended') : view.stuck ? 'stuck' : 'now';
  const stops: PathStop[] = [...before.map((stage): PathStop => ({ stage, state: 'done' })), { stage: now, state: nowState }];
  if (view.closed) return { stops, others: [] };

  const seen = new Set(stops.map((s) => s.stage));
  let next = nextOf(doc, now);
  while (next && !seen.has(next) && stops.length < MAX_AHEAD) {
    stops.push({ stage: next, state: 'ahead' });
    seen.add(next);
    next = nextOf(doc, next);
  }
  const via = mainButton(doc, now);
  // With several tasks, buttons of the same name (each task's Reject) are one other way, said once.
  const others = (getWorkingStage(doc, now)?.tasks ?? []).flatMap((task) => task.buttons)
    .filter((b) => b.id !== via?.id && b.label !== via?.label)
    .filter((b, i, all) => all.findIndex((x) => x.label === b.label) === i);
  return { stops, ...(via ? { via } : {}), from: now, others };
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/refusals.ts\n===
/**
 * Refusals of a start, an answer, a retry or a close, in words (runtime-api.md 3.3, 4.3, 5.1).
 * Those that name a question are shown at that question by the FormView slot; the page says the
 * others in one line each.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { getButton, getQuestion, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import type { Refusal } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { byPhrase, type Names } from './format';
import { chipOf, say } from './say';

/** A refusal the form shows at its question (or button) rather than the page. */
export function isAtQuestion(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, r: Refusal): boolean {
  if (!['invalid-data', 'choice-unknown', 'source-unavailable', 'check', 'rule-error'].includes(r.code)) return false;
  return !!getQuestion(doc, r.location?.item) || !!getButton(doc, r.location?.item) || r.code === 'check';
}

/** The words for a refusal of starting or answering, on the page. */
export function formRefusal(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, r: Refusal, names: Names): Phrase {
  const question = getQuestion(doc, r.location?.item);
  const q = question ? [chipOf('value', question.label || t('describe.noName'), question.id)] : undefined;
  switch (r.code) {
    case 'may':
      return [t('requests.refusal.may')];
    case 'not-assignee':
      return [t('requests.refusal.notAssignee')];
    case 'membership-unavailable':
      return [t('requests.refusal.membershipUnavailable')];
    case 'busy':
      return [t('requests.refusal.busy')];
    case 'source-unavailable':
      return q ? say('requests.refusal.sourceUnavailableAt', { question: q }) : [t('requests.refusal.sourceUnavailable')];
    case 'choice-unknown':
      return q ? say('requests.refusal.choiceUnknownAt', { question: q }) : [t('requests.refusal.choiceUnknown')];
    case 'invalid-data':
      return q ? say('requests.refusal.invalidDataAt', { question: q }) : [t('requests.refusal.invalidData')];
    case 'check':
      return r.message ? [r.message] : [t('requests.refusal.check')];
    case 'rule-error':
      return [t('requests.refusal.ruleError')];
    case 'client-token-reused':
      return [t('requests.refusal.tokenReused')];
    case 'unknown-button':
    case 'not-found':
      return [t('requests.refusal.changed')];
    case 'wait-not-open': {
      const { by, state } = r.params;
      if (by && state === 'completed') return say('requests.refusal.answeredBy', { who: byPhrase(by, names, undefined) });
      if (state === 'requestClosed') return [t('requests.refusal.requestClosed')];
      return [t('requests.refusal.noLongerOpen')];
    }
    default:
      return [t('requests.refusal.other')];
  }
}

/** The words for a refusal of Retry or Close. */
export function adminRefusal(r: Refusal): string {
  switch (r.code) {
    case 'not-admin':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.notAdmin');
    case 'reason-required':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.reasonRequired');
    case 'invalid-body':
      return r.params.problem === 'tooLong' ? t('requests.admin.refusal.tooLong') : t('requests.admin.refusal.reasonRequired');
    case 'stale':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.stale');
    case 'request-closed':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.closed');
    case 'not-stuck':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.notStuck');
    case 'not-retryable':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.notRetryable');
    case 'requires-not-met':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.requiresNotMet');
    case 'membership-unavailable':
      return t('requests.refusal.membershipUnavailable');
    case 'busy':
      return t('requests.refusal.busy');
    case 'not-found':
      return t('requests.admin.refusal.notFound');
    default:
      return t('requests.refusal.other');
  }
}

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getTask, requestTitle, requestTitleValues, SlotsProvider, type FormViewProps, type ReadOnlyDiagramProps } from '@/model';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider, type Answers, type RequestView, type Services, type StuckReason } from '@/services';
import { MyTasksPage, RequestPage, RequestsPage, StartRequestPage } from './index';
import { closeWhat, mayClose, mayRetry, whyNobody } from './stuck';
import { StuckCard } from './StuckCard';
import { sourceOf } from './data';
import { cannotAnswer } from './TaskPanel';

/*
 * Rendered tests of the pages people use, against the stand-in's seeded requests: 1001 (waiting
 * for the Payments approvers), 1003 (stuck: nobody to ask), 1004 (held until the deploy pipeline
 * answers), 1005 (stuck: an action failed) and one refused start. The form and the diagram are
 * other features' slots, stood in for here by small stubs.
 */

let fillWith: Answers = {};

/** Matches the smallest element whose whole text (names in bold included) fits `re`. */
const sentence = (re: RegExp) => (_: string, el: Element | null) =>
  !!el && re.test(el.textContent ?? '') && ![...el.children].some((c) => re.test(c.textContent ?? ''));

function StubForm(p: FormViewProps) {
  const task = getTask(p.doc, p.taskId);
  return (
    <div data-testid="form">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => p.onAnswersChange(fillWith)}>
        Fill in
      </button>
      {task?.buttons.map((b) => {
        const state = p.buttonStates?.find((x) => x.button === b.id);
        const can = !p.readOnly && !p.busy && (state?.available ?? true);
        return (
          <button key={b.id} type="button" disabled={!can} onClick={() => p.onPress?.(b.id)}>
            {b.label}
          </button>
        );
      })}
      {p.refusals?.map((r, i) => <p key={i}>refused at the form: {r.code}</p>)}
    </div>
  );
}

function StubDiagram(p: ReadOnlyDiagramProps) {
  return (
    <p data-testid="diagram">
      {p.label}; at {(p.at ?? []).join(',')}; stuck {p.stuckAt ?? 'none'}; taken {(p.taken ?? []).length}
    </p>
  );
}

function seeded(): Services {
  return createStandinServices({ sampleRequests: true }).services;
}

/** The engine's ID of the open task of a seeded request (the engine names a task by when it opened). */
async function openTaskOf(services: Services, readableId: string): Promise<string> {
  const got = await services.runtime.getRequest({ readableId });
  const task = got.ok ? got.value.tasks[0] : undefined;
  if (!task) throw new Error(`no open task on request ${readableId}`);
  return task.task;
}

async function as(services: Services, slug: string) {
  const r = await services.session.signInAs({ type: 'user', id: `dir-user-${slug}` });
  expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
}

function renderAt(services: Services, path: string) {
  return render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={{ FormView: StubForm, ReadOnlyDiagram: StubDiagram }}>
        <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[path]}>
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/start/:workflowId" element={<StartRequestPage />} />
            <Route path="/tasks" element={<MyTasksPage />} />
            <Route path="/requests" element={<RequestsPage />} />
            <Route path="/requests/:requestId" element={<RequestPage />} />
          </Routes>
        </MemoryRouter>
      </SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>,
  );
}

describe('the Retry and Close rules', () => {
  const reasons: StuckReason[] = ['action-failed', 'nobody-to-ask', 'nothing-fits', 'error', 'unfinished'];
  const view = (reason: StuckReason | undefined, isAdmin: boolean, closed = false) =>
    ({
      viewer: { isAdmin },
      ...(reason ? { stuck: { reason, at: '2026-11-14T11:23:00.000Z' } } : {}),
      ...(closed ? { closed: { at: '2026-11-14T12:00:00.000Z', byAdmin: true } } : {}),
    }) as Pick<RequestView, 'stuck' | 'closed' | 'viewer'>;

  it('offers Retry only for a failed action or nobody to ask, and only to the people who look after stuck requests', () => {
    const offered = reasons.filter((r) => mayRetry(view(r, true)));
    expect(offered).toEqual(['action-failed', 'nobody-to-ask']);
    expect(reasons.filter((r) => mayRetry(view(r, false)))).toEqual([]);
    expect(mayRetry(view(undefined, true))).toBe(false);
    expect(mayRetry(view('action-failed', true, true))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('offers Close for any open request, stuck or not, and only to them', () => {
    for (const r of [...reasons, undefined]) {
      expect(mayClose(view(r, true))).toBe(true);
      expect(mayClose(view(r, false))).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(mayClose(view('error', true, true))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says why a person cannot answer, in the engine order', () => {
    const state = (code: 'may' | 'not-assignee' | 'membership-unavailable' | 'wait-not-open') => ({
      button: 'btn_x' as never, available: false, refusals: [{ code, params: {} } as never],
    });
    expect(cannotAnswer([state('may'), state('not-assignee')])).toBe('not-assignee');
    expect(cannotAnswer([state('may')])).toBe('may');
    expect(cannotAnswer([{ button: 'btn_x' as never, available: true, refusals: [] }])).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("words a refused start's reason as notifications.json does", () => {
    expect(refusedBecause('choice-unknown')).toBe('an answer is not one of the choices its question offers');
    expect(refusedBecause('something-new')).toBe('something about it did not fit the workflow');
  });
});

describe('the stuck card, per reason', () => {
  it.each([
    ['nothing-fits', 'None of the arrows out of Fix deployment fits this request'],
    ['error', 'Something went wrong at Fix deployment'],
  ] as const)('for %s: only Close, and says why there is no Retry', async (reason, words) => {
    const services = seeded();
    const got = await services.runtime.getRequest({ readableId: '1005' });
    if (!got.ok) throw new Error('no 1005');
    const v = got.value;
    const doc = await sourceOf(services, v.workflow as string, v.version as number);
    const stuck = { ...v.stuck!, reason };
    render(
      <ServicesProvider services={services}>
        <StuckCard doc={doc} view={{ ...v, stuck }} catalogue={undefined} names={{}} stuckPeople={undefined} onDone={() => undefined} />
      </ServicesProvider>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(sentence(new RegExp(words)))).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close request' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Retry is not offered/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('round 1 fixes', () => {
  it('names a request by the first text question every request is asked, not one with a Show when', async () => {
    const services = seeded();
    const doc = structuredClone(await sourceOf(services, 'change-request', 3));
    const first = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === doc.start?.stage);
    if (!first || first.kind === 'ending') throw new Error('no start stage');
    const page = first.tasks[0]!.form.pages[0]!;
    const title = page.items.find((i) => i.type === 'question' && i.kind === 'text');
    page.items.unshift({
      type: 'question', id: 'q_model' as never, label: 'Which model exactly?', kind: 'text', savedAs: 'v_model' as never,
      showWhen: { allOf: [] },
    });
    const titleValue = title?.type === 'question' ? (title.savedAs as string) : '';
    expect(requestTitleValues(doc)[0]).toBe(titleValue);
    expect(requestTitle(doc, { v_model: 'Framework 13', [titleValue]: 'New laptop' }, 'Request 1006')).toBe('New laptop');
    expect(requestTitle(doc, { v_model: 'Framework 13' }, 'Request 1006')).toBe('Request 1006');
  });

  it('says a task opened moments ago was opened "just now", not "0 minutes" ago', () => {
    const now = new Date('2026-11-15T23:18:20Z');
    expect(formatAge('2026-11-15T23:18:00Z', now)).toBe('just now');
    expect(formatAge('2026-11-15T23:16:00Z', now)).toBe('2 minutes');
  });

  it('puts the focus back on a button that is drawn again as a new element with the same label', async () => {
    function Swap() {
      const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
      useKeepButtonFocus(box);
      return (
        <div ref={box}>
          <input aria-label="Why" onChange={() => setTimeout(() => setReady(true), 20)} />
          {ready ? (
            <button type="button">Submit</button>
          ) : (
            <span>
              <button type="button" aria-disabled="true">
                Submit<span className="visually-hidden">: Needs: Why.</span>
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<Swap />);
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Why'), 'x');
    await user.tab();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Submit/ })).toHaveFocus();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })).toHaveFocus());
  });

  it('Retry opens with the focus in the reason, and a refusal puts it back there', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const services = seeded();
    renderAt(services, '/requests/1005');
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Retry this request?' });
    const reason = within(dialog).getByLabelText('Why are you retrying it?');
    await waitFor(() => expect(reason).toHaveFocus());
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    expect(reason).toHaveFocus();
  });

  it('after pressing a button, the focus is on what it did', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

/**
 * Sentences of the request pages: the words of src/words/requests.ts with their {name} places
 * filled by phrases from describe (stage, action, value and people chips), and a component that
 * shows a phrase with its names in bold. Lists of names are joined with the shared list words.
 */
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import { isChip, isMissing, isSettingsLink, isWebLink, toText, type Chip, type ChipKind, type Part, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { ExternalLink } from '@/ui';
import { t, words, type WordKey } from '@/words';

export type Fill = Phrase | Part | number;

/** The words for `key` with each `{name}` filled by a phrase, a part or a number. */
export function say(key: WordKey, fill: Record<string, Fill> = {}): Phrase {
  const text: string = words[key];
  const out: Phrase = [];
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)) {
    const name = m[1] as string;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fill, name)) continue;
    push(out, text.slice(last, m.index));
    const value = fill[name] as Fill;
    if (typeof value === 'number') push(out, String(value));
    else for (const part of Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]) push(out, part);
    last = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
  }
  push(out, text.slice(last));
  return out;
}

function push(out: Phrase, part: Part) {
  if (typeof part === 'string') {
    if (!part) return;
    const prev = out[out.length - 1];
    if (typeof prev === 'string') out[out.length - 1] = prev + part;
    else out.push(part);
  } else out.push(part);
}

/** "A", "A and B", "A, B and C" (or "or"), with the shared list words. */
export function list(items: readonly Phrase[], word: 'and' | 'or' = 'and'): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  const joiner = ` ${t(word === 'and' ? 'describe.and' : 'describe.or')} `;
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (i > 0) push(out, i === items.length - 1 ? joiner : t('describe.comma'));
    for (const part of item) push(out, part);
  });
  return out;
}

export const chipOf = (kind: ChipKind, label: string, id?: string): Chip => ({ chip: kind, label, ...(id ? { id } : {}) });

/** A plain string of a phrase. */
export const text = (phrase: Phrase): string => toText(phrase);

/** The first letter in capitals (a sentence that starts with a lower-case phrase). */
export function capital(phrase: Phrase): Phrase {
  const [first, ...rest] = phrase;
  if (typeof first !== 'string' || !first) return phrase;
  return [first.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + first.slice(1), ...rest];
}

/** A phrase on screen: names (chips) in bold, unfinished parts in italics. */
export function PhraseView({ phrase }: { phrase: Phrase }) {
  return (
    <>
      {phrase.map((part, i) => (
        <Fragment key={i}>
          {typeof part === 'string' ? (
            part
          ) : isChip(part) ? (
            <strong>{part.label}</strong>
          ) : isMissing(part) ? (
            <em>{toText([part])}</em>
          ) : isSettingsLink(part) ? (
            part.text
          ) : isWebLink(part) ? (
            <ExternalLink href={part.href}>{part.text}</ExternalLink>
          ) : null}
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/story.ts\n===
/**
 * A request's story (core-api.md section 9) as plain lines, oldest first, in the words Try it uses
 * (editor-model.md section 7): "Marcus Lee pressed Approve, so it went to Create Jira issue.",
 * "Create Jira issue happened by itself and went on to Development." A press and the move it caused
 * (one turn) are one line; status changes are not lines of their own.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { actionName, arrowLabel, describeStuckTold, getAction, getArrow, getButton, getStage, getTask, getValue, stageOf, toText, type Phrase, type StuckPerson } from '@/model';
import type { Ref, StoryEntry, Timestamp } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import type { IconName } from '@/ui';
import { byPhrase, refsPhrase, type Names } from './format';
import { capital, chipOf, say } from './say';
import { stageAt, stagePhrase, stuckShort } from './stuck';

export interface StoryLine {
  key: string;
  phrase: Phrase;
  at: Timestamp;
  icon: IconName;
  stuck?: boolean;
}

export interface StoryContext {
  names: Names;
  catalogue: Catalogue | undefined;
  /** The people in "Stuck requests go to", by name, when the page could read them. */
  stuckPeople?: readonly StuckPerson[];
}

/** Every person and group a story names, for the names lookup. */
export function refsInStory(story: readonly StoryEntry[]): Ref[] {
  const out: Ref[] = [];
  for (const e of story) {
    const p = e.params as Record<string, unknown>;
    const by = p.by as { type: string; id: string } | undefined;
    if (by?.type === 'user') out.push({ type: 'user', id: by.id });
    for (const key of ['askedOf', 'asMemberOf'] as const) {
      const refs = p[key];
      if (Array.isArray(refs)) out.push(...(refs as Ref[]));
    }
    const requester = p.requester as Ref | undefined;
    if (requester) out.push(requester);
  }
  return out;
}

function buttonPhrase(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Phrase {
  return [chipOf('button', getButton(doc, id)?.label || t('describe.noName'), id)];
}

function actionPhrase(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): Phrase {
  const action = getAction(doc, id);
  if (!action) return [t('requests.stuck.anAction')];
  return [chipOf('connection', toText(actionName(doc, action, catalogue ? { catalogue } : {}, true)), action.id)];
}

/** The story as lines, oldest first. */
export function storyLines(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, story: readonly StoryEntry[], ctx: StoryContext): StoryLine[] {
  const lines: StoryLine[] = [];
  /** The last line a move of the same turn may finish: a press ("..., so it went to X") or an action done by itself. */
  let open: { line: StoryLine; turn: number; how: 'pressed' | 'byItself' | 'carriedOn'; action?: Phrase } | undefined;
  const add = (e: StoryEntry, phrase: Phrase, icon: IconName, extra: Partial<StoryLine> = {}) => {
    const line: StoryLine = { key: `${lines.length}`, phrase, at: e.at, icon, ...extra };
    lines.push(line);
    return line;
  };

  for (const e of story) {
    switch (e.code) {
      case 'started': {
        const who = byPhrase(e.params.by, ctx.names, ctx.catalogue);
        const startTask = getTask(doc, e.location?.item);
        const stage = startTask ? stagePhrase(doc, stageOf(doc, startTask.id)?.id) : stagePhrase(doc, doc.start?.stage);
        const phrase =
          e.params.by.type === 'connection'
            ? say(e.params.requester ? 'requests.story.startedBySystemFor' : 'requests.story.startedBySystem', {
                who,
                ...(e.params.requester ? { requester: refsPhrase([e.params.requester], ctx.names) } : {}),
              })
            : say('requests.story.started', { who, button: buttonPhrase(doc, e.params.button), stage });
        open = { line: add(e, phrase, 'form'), turn: e.turn, how: 'pressed' };
        break;
      }
      case 'task.answered': {
        const who = byPhrase(e.params.by, ctx.names, ctx.catalogue);
        const phrase = e.params.asMemberOf.length
          ? say('requests.story.answeredFor', { who, button: buttonPhrase(doc, e.params.button), groups: refsPhrase(e.params.asMemberOf, ctx.names) })
          : say('requests.story.answered', { who, button: buttonPhrase(doc, e.params.button) });
        open = { line: add(e, phrase, 'check'), turn: e.turn, how: 'pressed' };
        break;
      }
      case 'moved': {
        const to = stagePhrase(doc, e.params.to);
        const from = getStage(doc, e.params.from);
        if (open && open.turn === e.turn && open.how === 'pressed') {
          open.line.phrase = say(e.params.sentBack ? 'requests.story.soSentBack' : 'requests.story.soWent', { line: open.line.phrase, to });
          open = undefined;
          break;
        }
        if (open && open.turn === e.turn && open.how === 'carriedOn' && open.action) {
          open.line.phrase = say(e.params.sentBack ? 'requests.story.carriedOnBack' : 'requests.story.carriedOnTo', { action: open.action, to });
          open = undefined;
          break;
        }
        if (from?.kind === 'automatic' && open && open.turn === e.turn && open.how === 'byItself') {
          open.line.phrase = say('requests.story.byItself', { stage: stagePhrase(doc, from.id), to });
          open.line.icon = 'automatic';
          open = undefined;
          break;
        }
        const arrow = getArrow(doc, e.params.arrow);
        if (arrow?.when.type === 'condition') {
          add(e, say(e.params.sentBack ? 'requests.story.becauseSentBack' : 'requests.story.because', { label: [arrowLabel(doc, arrow)], to }), 'arrow-right');
        } else if (from?.kind === 'automatic') {
          add(e, say('requests.story.byItself', { stage: stagePhrase(doc, from.id), to }), 'automatic');
        } else {
          add(e, say(e.params.sentBack ? 'requests.story.sentBack' : 'requests.story.went', { to }), e.params.sentBack ? 'sendback' : 'arrow-right');
        }
        open = undefined;
        break;
      }
      case 'status.changed':
        break;
      case 'task.opened': {
        const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageOf(doc, e.location?.item ?? '')?.id);
        const phrase = e.params.askedOf.length
          ? say('requests.story.asked', { askedOf: refsPhrase(e.params.askedOf, ctx.names), stage })
          : say('requests.story.nobodyAsked', { stage });
        add(e, phrase, 'person');
        open = undefined;
        break;
      }
      case 'task.noLongerNeeded': {
        const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageOf(doc, e.location?.item ?? '')?.id);
        add(e, say(NO_LONGER_NEEDED[e.params.because], { stage }), 'minus');
        break;
      }
      case 'action.waiting': {
        const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageAt(doc, e.location)?.id);
        add(e, say('requests.story.actionWaiting', { action: actionPhrase(doc, e.location?.item, ctx.catalogue), stage }), 'clock');
        open = undefined;
        break;
      }
      case 'action.done': {
        const action = actionPhrase(doc, e.location?.item, ctx.catalogue);
        const line = add(e, say(e.params.late ? 'requests.story.actionDoneLate' : 'requests.story.actionDone', { action }), 'bolt');
        open = e.params.late ? undefined : { line, turn: e.turn, how: 'byItself' };
        break;
      }
      case 'action.failed': {
        const action = actionPhrase(doc, e.location?.item, ctx.catalogue);
        const key = e.params.late ? 'requests.story.actionFailedLate' : e.params.carriedOn ? 'requests.story.actionFailedCarriedOn' : 'requests.story.actionFailed';
        const line = add(e, say(key, { action }), 'warning');
        open = e.params.carriedOn && !e.params.late ? { line, turn: e.turn, how: 'carriedOn', action } : undefined;
        break;
      }
      case 'value.saved': {
        const value = [chipOf('value', getValue(doc, e.params.value)?.name || t('describe.noName'), e.params.value)];
        add(e, say(e.params.to === undefined ? 'requests.story.valueEmptied' : 'requests.story.valueSaved', { value }), 'save');
        break;
      }
      case 'stuck': {
        const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageAt(doc, e.params.location)?.id);
        const told = capital(describeStuckTold(ctx.stuckPeople, { tense: 'past' }));
        add(e, say('requests.story.stuck', { stage, why: stuckShort(e.params.reason), told }), 'error', { stuck: true });
        open = undefined;
        break;
      }
      case 'retried':
        add(e, say('requests.story.retried', { who: byPhrase(e.params.by, ctx.names, ctx.catalogue), reason: e.params.reason }), 'undo');
        open = undefined;
        break;
      case 'closed':
        add(e, say('requests.story.closed', { who: byPhrase(e.params.by, ctx.names, ctx.catalogue), reason: e.params.reason }), 'close');
        open = undefined;
        break;
      case 'ended':
        add(e, say('requests.story.ended', { ending: stagePhrase(doc, e.params.ending) }), 'ending');
        open = undefined;
        break;
      default: {
        // A story entry core adds later fails to compile here, so it cannot vanish from the history.
        const unknown: never = e;
        return unknown;
      }
    }
  }
  return lines.map((l) => ({ ...l, phrase: sentence(l.phrase) }));
}

/** Why a task is no longer needed, keyed by core's own reasons: a reason core adds later fails to compile here. */
const NO_LONGER_NEEDED: Record<Extract<StoryEntry, { code: 'task.noLongerNeeded' }>['params']['because'], WordKey> = {
  movedOn: 'requests.story.noLongerNeeded.movedOn',
  closed: 'requests.story.noLongerNeeded.closed',
  retried: 'requests.story.noLongerNeeded.retried',
};

/** A capital at the start and a full stop at the end (the words of a line have neither, so lines can be joined). */
function sentence(phrase: Phrase): Phrase {
  const out = capital(phrase);
  const last = out[out.length - 1];
  if (typeof last === 'string' && /[.!?”"]$/.test(last)) return out;
  return [...out, t('requests.story.end')];
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/requests/stuck.ts\n===
/**
 * The rules of a stuck request as the pages show them (runtime-api.md 5.1, E-23, editor-model.md
 * section 1 "Stuck"): Retry only for a failed action or nobody to ask; Close for any open request,
 * stuck or not; both only for the people who look after stuck requests and platform admins (the
 * request view's `viewer.isAdmin`). The stage a stuck state names, and its reason in words.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Location } from '@/contract';
import { actionName, getAction, getStage, getTask, stageOf, toText, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import type { RequestView, RetryableStuckReason, Stuck, StuckReason } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { chipOf, list, say } from './say';

const RETRYABLE: readonly StuckReason[] = ['action-failed', 'nobody-to-ask'];

export const isRetryable = (reason: StuckReason): reason is RetryableStuckReason => RETRYABLE.includes(reason);

/** Whether Retry is offered on this request to this viewer. */
export const mayRetry = (view: Pick<RequestView, 'stuck' | 'closed' | 'viewer'>): boolean =>
  !!view.viewer.isAdmin && !view.closed && !!view.stuck && isRetryable(view.stuck.reason);

/** Whether Close is offered on this request to this viewer: any open request, stuck or not. */
export const mayClose = (view: Pick<RequestView, 'closed' | 'viewer'>): boolean => !!view.viewer.isAdmin && !view.closed;

/** The stage a location is in (the stage itself, or the stage of its task, action, arrow ...). */
export function stageAt(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location | undefined) {
  if (!location) return undefined;
  return getStage(doc, location.item) ?? stageOf(doc, location.item);
}

/** The stage as a chip, by name. */
export function stagePhrase(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: string | undefined): Phrase {
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
  return [chipOf('stage', stage?.name || t('describe.noName'), stageId)];
}

/** The action a stuck state names, as a chip of its name; undefined when it names no action. */
export function stuckAction(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stuck: Stuck, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): Phrase | undefined {
  const action = getAction(doc, stuck.location?.item);
  if (!action) return undefined;
  return [chipOf('connection', toText(actionName(doc, action, catalogue ? { catalogue } : {}, true)), action.id)];
}

/** The connection an action uses, by name ("Jira"), when it uses one. */
export function connectionOfAction(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, actionId: string | undefined, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): string | undefined {
  const action = getAction(doc, actionId);
  if (action?.type !== 'useConnection') return undefined;
  const operation = action.operation;
  const op = catalogue?.entries.find((e) => e.id === operation);
  return op ? catalogue?.connections.find((c) => c.id === op.connection)?.label : undefined;
}

/**
 * What Close does, in words. A request waiting on another system to do something (a "Wait for" or
 * an action that changes something there, not a look-up) is told plainly that the other system is
 * not stopped and may still finish, and that its answer is then only recorded (05-integrations.md,
 * "Retry and Close": outside jobs are not stopped; their results are recorded late).
 */
export function closeWhat(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: Pick<RequestView, 'actions'>, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): string {
  const outside = view.actions.filter((a) => a.sort !== 'read');
  if (outside.length === 0) return t('requests.stuck.close.what');
  const names = [...new Set(outside.map((a) => connectionOfAction(doc, a.location.item, catalogue) ?? t('requests.anotherSystem')))];
  return t(names.length > 1 ? 'requests.stuck.close.whatOutsideMany' : 'requests.stuck.close.whatOutsideOne', {
    connections: toText(list(names.map((n) => [n]))),
  });
}

const reasonKey: Record<StuckReason, WordKey> = {
  'action-failed': 'requests.stuck.why.actionFailed',
  'nobody-to-ask': 'requests.stuck.why.nobodyToAsk',
  'nothing-fits': 'requests.stuck.why.nothingFits',
  error: 'requests.stuck.why.error',
  unfinished: 'requests.stuck.why.unfinished',
};

/** The reason in one sentence everyone may read: "Create Jira issue did not work, so nothing after it has happened yet." */
export function stuckWhy(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stuck: Stuck, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): Phrase {
  const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageAt(doc, stuck.location)?.id);
  const action = stuckAction(doc, stuck, catalogue) ?? [t('requests.stuck.anAction')];
  return say(reasonKey[stuck.reason] ?? 'requests.stuck.why.error', { stage, action });
}

/** A person or group as the directory gives it, with its name. */
export interface Named {
  type: 'user' | 'group';
  id: string;
  label: string;
}

/**
 * Why nobody can answer, when the page can know it (stuck `nobody-to-ask`): the only person who
 * could answer is the one who started the request (or its Requester), who can't answer their own;
 * or the groups asked have nobody in them. `members`: each asked group's people, by group ID, as
 * the directory gives them now. Undefined when it cannot be said (nobody is asked at all, a group
 * could not be read, or someone could answer now).
 */
export function whyNobody(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  view: Pick<RequestView, 'stuck' | 'tasks' | 'requester' | 'startedBy'>,
  members: Readonly<Record<string, readonly Named[] | undefined>>,
  names: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): Phrase | undefined {
  if (view.stuck?.reason !== 'nobody-to-ask') return undefined;
  const open = view.tasks.find((x) => x.location.item === view.stuck?.location?.item);
  const askedOf = open?.askedOf ?? [];
  if (askedOf.length === 0) return undefined;
  const groups = askedOf.filter((r) => r.type === 'group');
  if (groups.some((g) => members[g.id] === undefined)) return undefined;
  const people = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const r of askedOf) if (r.type === 'user') people.set(r.id, names[`user:${r.id}`] ?? t('requests.someone'));
  for (const g of groups) for (const m of members[g.id] ?? []) if (m.type === 'user') people.set(m.id, m.label);
  if (people.size === 0) {
    const said = list(groups.map((g) => [chipOf('group', names[`group:${g.id}`] ?? t('requests.someone'), g.id)]));
    return say(groups.length > 1 ? 'requests.stuck.nobody.emptyMany' : 'requests.stuck.nobody.emptyOne', { groups: said });
  }
  const task = getTask(doc, open?.location.item);
  const requester = view.requester?.type === 'user' ? view.requester : undefined;
  if (task?.requesterCanAnswer !== false || !requester || people.size !== 1 || !people.has(requester.id)) return undefined;
  const person = [chipOf('person', people.get(requester.id) ?? t('requests.someone'), requester.id)];
  const started = view.startedBy.type === 'user' && view.startedBy.id === requester.id;
  return say(started ? 'requests.stuck.nobody.onlyStarter' : 'requests.stuck.nobody.onlyRequester', { person });
}

/** A short form for lists: "an action did not work". */
export function stuckShort(reason: StuckReason): string {
  switch (reason) {
    case 'action-failed':
      return t('requests.stuck.short.actionFailed');
    case 'nobody-to-ask':
      return t('requests.stuck.short.nobodyToAsk');
    case 'nothing-fits':
      return t('requests.stuck.short.nothingFits');
    case 'unfinished':
      return t('requests.stuck.short.unfinished');
    default:
      return t('requests.stuck.short.error');
  }
}
