/**
 * Where a request is, in words and for the read-only diagram: the stage it is at, the stages it
 * has been through and the arrows it took (from its story), who is asked now and since when, and
 * an action that keeps it at its stage until another system answers.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import { getAction, getStage, stageOf, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import type { RequestView } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { refsPhrase, whenInSentence, type Names } from './format';
import { say } from './say';
import { connectionOfAction, stageAt, stagePhrase } from './stuck';

export interface Marks {
  at: string[];
  visited: string[];
  taken: string[];
  stuckAt?: string;
}

/** What the read-only diagram marks for this request. */
export function marksOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: RequestView): Marks {
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const taken: string[] = [];
  if (doc.start?.stage) visited.add(doc.start.stage);
  for (const e of view.story) {
    if (e.code === 'moved') {
      visited.add(e.params.from);
      visited.add(e.params.to);
      taken.push(e.params.arrow);
    }
  }
  const now = view.closed?.ending ?? stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id;
  const stuckAt = view.stuck ? stageAt(doc, view.stuck.location)?.id ?? now : undefined;
  if (now) visited.delete(now);
  return { at: now && !(view.closed && !view.closed.ending) ? [now] : [], visited: [...visited], taken, ...(stuckAt ? { stuckAt } : {}) };
}

export interface WhereLine {
  phrase: Phrase;
  /** A quieter second line (the group rule, the overdue note). */
  note?: string;
  tone?: 'overdue';
}

/** Where the request is now, in one or a few lines everyone may read. */
export function whereNow(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: RequestView, names: Names, catalogue: Catalogue | undefined): WhereLine[] {
  if (view.closed) {
    if (view.closed.ending) return [{ phrase: say('requests.where.ended', { ending: stagePhrase(doc, view.closed.ending), when: whenInSentence(view.closed.at) }) }];
    return [{ phrase: say('requests.where.closed', { when: whenInSentence(view.closed.at) }) }];
  }
  const stage = stagePhrase(doc, stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id);
  if (view.stuck) return [{ phrase: say('requests.where.stuck', { stage: stagePhrase(doc, stageAt(doc, view.stuck.location)?.id ?? stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id) }) }];
  const lines: WhereLine[] = [];
  for (const task of view.tasks) {
    const at = stagePhrase(doc, stageOf(doc, task.location.item)?.id);
    const group = task.askedOf.some((r) => r.type === 'group');
    const several = task.askedOf.length > 1 || group;
    lines.push({
      phrase: say(several ? 'requests.where.askedMany' : 'requests.where.askedOne', {
        stage: at,
        askedOf: refsPhrase(task.askedOf, names),
        when: whenInSentence(task.openedAt),
      }),
      ...(group ? { note: t('rule.group') } : {}),
    });
  }
  for (const action of view.actions) {
    if (action.sort !== 'await') continue;
    const connection = connectionOfAction(doc, action.location.item, catalogue) ?? t('requests.anotherSystem');
    const at = stagePhrase(doc, stageOf(doc, action.location.item)?.id ?? stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id);
    const overdue = action.admin?.overdue;
    lines.push({
      phrase: say('requests.where.untilAnswers', { stage: at, connection, when: whenInSentence(action.openedAt) }),
      ...(overdue && action.admin ? { note: t('requests.where.overdue', { connection, when: whenInSentence(action.admin.expectedBy) }), tone: 'overdue' as const } : {}),
    });
  }
  if (lines.length === 0) {
    const doing = view.actions.find((a) => a.sort !== 'await');
    const action = doing ? getAction(doc, doing.location.item) : undefined;
    lines.push({ phrase: say(action ? 'requests.where.doing' : 'requests.where.at', { stage }) });
  }
  return lines;
}

/** "Domain approval" as plain text: the stage a request is at now. */
export function stageNameOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: Pick<RequestView, 'stage'>): string {
  return getStage(doc, stageAt(doc, view.stage)?.id)?.name || t('describe.noName');
}

import { useId } from 'react';
import { Button, Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import type { Location } from '@/contract';
import type { FindingTone } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import type { TodoItem } from './items';
import { LinkedPhrase } from './LinkedPhrase';
import s from './todo.module.css';

const TONE_ICON: Record<FindingTone, IconName> = { contradictory: 'error', unfinished: 'todo', worthKnowing: 'info' };

type Props = {
  item: TodoItem;
  /** Its fix: one command carried out here, or a choice the button takes the author to. */
  fix?: { label: string; run(): void };
  /** Why the fix just tried could not be done. */
  error?: string;
  onShowMe(): void;
  /** "Show me" for another place the item names (the arrows that take the request first). */
  onShow?(location: Location): void;
};

/**
 * One To do or Worth knowing item (mockup 09): its cause, what will happen, where it is, its fix
 * where one exists, and "Show me". Red or amber is only the icon's colour: the group heading
 * (To do, Worth knowing) and the cause sentence say what kind of problem it is.
 */
export function FindingItem({ item, fix, error, onShowMe, onShow }: Props) {
  const { words } = item;
  const causeId = useId();
  return (
    <li className={`${s.item} ${s[words.tone]}`}>
      <span className={s.toneIcon}>
        <Icon name={TONE_ICON[words.tone]} size={16} />
      </span>
      <div className={s.itemText}>
        <p className={s.cause} id={causeId}>
          <LinkedPhrase phrase={words.causeParts ?? [words.cause]} />
        </p>
        {words.effect && (
          <p className={s.effect}>
            <LinkedPhrase phrase={words.effectParts ?? [words.effect]} />
          </p>
        )}
        <div className={s.itemFoot}>
          <p className={s.where}>{words.where}</p>
          <div className={s.itemButtons}>
            {fix && (
              <Button size="sm" onClick={fix.run} aria-describedby={causeId}>
                {fix.label}
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="eye" onClick={onShowMe} aria-describedby={causeId}>
              {t('todo.showMe')}
            </Button>
            {onShow &&
              words.alsoShow?.map((also) => (
                <Button key={also.location.item} size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="eye" onClick={() => onShow(also.location)}>
                  {also.label}
                </Button>
              ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        {error && (
          <p className={s.fixError} role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

import { useId, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { buttonClass, Icon, Tooltip } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { usePublishState } from './hooks';
import { useTodoUi } from './state';
import s from './todo.module.css';

/**
 * Publish, as it is shown in the top bar and at the foot of the To do drawer:
 * - while anything is to do: "Publish · 2 to do first"; pressing it opens the To do drawer;
 * - for someone who may not publish: "Publish · authors only";
 * - while the draft is the same as the live version (right after publishing, and after a reload
 *   with no edit since): a plain greyed "Publish" (mockup 09, published), its reason ("Nothing has
 *   changed since version 3") in its tooltip and accessible description, not on the label;
 * - the same while the draft is in a save conflict or its latest change could not be saved (the
 *   top bar's save line beside it already says so in full): the reason in the tooltip and description;
 * - otherwise: opens the publish dialog.
 * A greyed Publish keeps the name "Publish" and stays focusable; its reason is its description.
 */
export function PublishControl({ id }: { id?: string }) {
  const state = usePublishState();
  const openList = useTodoUi((st) => st.openList);
  const close = useTodoUi((st) => st.close);
  const setPublishOpen = useTodoUi((st) => st.setPublishOpen);
  const whyId = useId();

  switch (state.kind) {
    case 'notYours':
      return <Greyed id={id} why={t('todo.publishNotYours')} after={t('todo.publishNotYoursShort')} />;
    case 'conflict':
      return <Greyed id={id} why={t('todo.publishConflict')} />;
    case 'notSaved':
      return <Greyed id={id} why={t('todo.publishNotSaved')} />;
    case 'nothingNew':
      return <Greyed id={id} why={t('todo.publishNothingNew', { n: state.version })} />;
    case 'blocked':
      return (
        <>
          <button
            id={id}
            type="button"
            className={buttonClass('secondary', 'md', s.blocked)}
            aria-describedby={whyId}
            onClick={() => openList('todo', id)}
          >
            <Icon name="publish" size={16} />
            {t('todo.publish')}{' '}
            <span className={s.after}>{t('todo.publishBlocked', { n: state.todo })}</span>
          </button>
          <span id={whyId} className="visually-hidden">
            {t('todo.publishBlockedOpens')}
          </span>
        </>
      );
    default:
      return (
        <button
          id={id}
          type="button"
          className={buttonClass('primary', 'md')}
          onClick={() => {
            close();
            setPublishOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="publish" size={16} />
          {t('todo.publish')}
        </button>
      );
  }
}

/**
 * Publish greyed for a reason: named "Publish" (with the short reason after it when given), the
 * whole reason as its tooltip and its accessible description. Focusable, pressing does nothing.
 */
function Greyed({ id, why, after }: { id?: string; why: string; after?: ReactNode }) {
  const whyId = useId();
  return (
    <>
      <Tooltip content={why}>
        <button
          id={id}
          type="button"
          className={buttonClass('secondary', 'md', `${s.greyed} ${s.quietWhy}`)}
          aria-disabled="true"
          aria-describedby={whyId}
          onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          <Icon name="publish" size={16} />
          {t('todo.publish')}
          {after && <span>{after}</span>}
        </button>
      </Tooltip>
      <span id={whyId} className="visually-hidden">
        {why}
      </span>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * "Publish version n?" (editor-model.md section 7, mockup 09 "ready"): says nothing is left to do,
 * what changed since the live version (services core.diff, said by the model's describeChanges),
 * what it means for requests in progress, then publishes (session `publish`).
 *
 * It describes and publishes the same revision: the draft as it was when the dialog opened. If the
 * document changes while it is open, the dialog closes and a line says the workflow changed (the
 * author presses Publish again to see what it would publish now). While the draft is in a save
 * conflict, or its latest change could not be saved, it says so and does not publish.
 * A refusal from the server is said in words: To do found by the server (shown like the drawer's
 * items), the workflow was changed in another window or by someone else (load the latest), or the
 * editor is out of date (reload the page).
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ItemKind } from '@/contract';
import type { ApiError, Finding } from '@/services';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import {
  describeChanges, isChip, isMissing, publish, reloadDraft, reveal, toText, useEditor, useSessionWorkflowId, useTodoCount, useVersions,

import { useFindingEnv, usePublishState, useTodoList } from './hooks';

import { loadWhereInProgress, type WhereInProgress } from './inProgress';
import { LinkedPhrase } from './LinkedPhrase';
import { focusById, PUBLISH_BUTTON_ID, useTodoUi } from './state';
import s from './todo.module.css';

type ChangesState =
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'first' }
  | { status: 'failed' }
  | { status: 'ready'; words: ChangesInWords };

/** Refusals after which pressing Publish again cannot work: it stays greyed with the reason. */
const FINAL_REFUSALS = new Set(['stale-revision', 'core-version-mismatch', 'forbidden']);

export function PublishDialog() {
  const open = useTodoUi((st) => st.publishOpen);
  return open ? <PublishDialogOpen /> : null;
}

/** A mark for each sort of change, so the list can be scanned (the words say it all). */
function iconOf(line: ChangeLine): IconName {
  if (line.sort === 'removed') return 'trash';
  if (line.sort === 'moved' || line.sort === 'order') return 'drag';
  const byKind: Partial<Record<ItemKind, IconName>> = {
    stage: 'workflow', arrow: 'branch', task: 'person', question: 'form', page: 'form', text: 'form', choice: 'form', action: 'bolt', button: 'check',
  };
  return line.sort === 'added' ? (byKind[line.itemKind] ?? 'plus') : (byKind[line.itemKind] ?? 'edit');
}

/** A sentence from describe: names (chips) in bold, a part not filled in yet marked in words and colour. */
function Said({ words }: { words: Phrase }) {
  return (
    <span>
      {words.map((part, i) =>
        typeof part === 'string' ? (
          part
        ) : isChip(part) ? (
          <strong key={i} className={part.missing ? s.changeMissing : undefined}>
            {part.label}
          </strong>
        ) : (
          <em key={i} className={isMissing(part) ? s.changeMissing : undefined}>
            {part.text}
          </em>
        ),
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

function PublishDialogOpen() {
  const services = useServices();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const { versions, live } = useVersions();
  const env = useFindingEnv();
  const list = useTodoList();
  const todoCount = useTodoCount();
  const state = usePublishState();
  const ui = useTodoUi();
  /** The draft this dialog describes and publishes: as it was when the dialog opened. */
  const [described] = useState<AuthoredWorkflow | null>(() => useEditor.getState().doc);
  const [changes, setChanges] = useState<ChangesState>({ status: live === null ? 'first' : 'loading' });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [refusal, setRefusal] = useState<ApiError | null>(null);
  const [loadFailed, setLoadFailed] = useState(false);
  const leaving = useRef(false);
  const publishing = useRef(false);
  const next = (live ?? 0) + 1;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (live === null || !workflowId || !described) return;
    let gone = false;
    (async () => {
      const version = await services.authoring.getVersion(workflowId, live);
      if (!version.ok) throw new Error('version');
      const found = await services.core.diff(version.value.authored, described);
      if (!gone) setChanges({ status: 'ready', words: describeChanges(version.value.authored, described, found, env) });
    })().catch(() => {
      if (!gone) setChanges({ status: 'failed' });
    });
    return () => {
      gone = true;
    };
    // Worked out once, for the draft this dialog publishes.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  /**
   * The document changed while the dialog was open (an undo key, a change in another part of the
   * screen): what it says is no longer what would be published, so it closes and says why.
   */
  useEffect(
    () =>
      useEditor.subscribe((st) => {
        if (st.doc === described || leaving.current || publishing.current) return;
        leaving.current = true;
        ui.setPublishOpen(false);
        if (workflowId) ui.setChangedWhileOpen(workflowId);
        focusById(PUBLISH_BUTTON_ID);
      }),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [described, workflowId],
  );

  const inProgress = versions.reduce((n, v) => n + v.openRequests, 0);
  /** Where the requests in progress are ("2 at Domain approval"), when the services can say. */
  const [where, setWhere] = useState<WhereInProgress[] | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!workflowId || inProgress === 0) return;
    let gone = false;
    void loadWhereInProgress(services, workflowId, live).then((found) => {
      if (!gone) setWhere(found);
    });
    return () => {
      gone = true;
    };
    // Asked once, when the dialog opens.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
  const versionsWithOpen = versions.filter((v) => v.openRequests > 0);
  const worthItems = list?.worth.flatMap((g) => g.items) ?? [];

  /** The To do items that stop publishing: the server's, after a has-todo refusal; else the editor's own. */
  const blocking: TodoItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (refusal?.code === 'has-todo' && described) {
      return todoList(described, (refusal.params as { findings: Finding[] }).findings ?? [], env).todoItems;
    }
    return list?.todoItems ?? [];
  }, [refusal, list, env, described]);
  const blocked = blocking.length > 0 && (refusal?.code === 'has-todo' || todoCount > 0);

  /** Why Publish cannot be pressed now, or null. */
  const cannot: string | null = busy
    ? t('todo.dialog.publishing')
    : state.kind === 'conflict'
      ? t('todo.publishConflict')
      : state.kind === 'notSaved'
        ? t('todo.publishNotSaved')
        : blocked
          ? t('todo.publishBlockedWhy')
          : refusal && FINAL_REFUSALS.has(refusal.code)
            ? refusalWords(refusal, blocking.length)
            : null;

  /**
   * Closed by Escape, the close button, Cancel or publishing: focus goes back to Publish in the top
   * bar. (The dialog is opened from code, not from a Radix trigger, so Radix has no button to return to.)
   */
  const closeBack = () => {
    leaving.current = true;
    ui.setPublishOpen(false);
    focusById(PUBLISH_BUTTON_ID);
  };

  const showMe = (item: TodoItem) => {
    leaving.current = true;
    ui.setPublishOpen(false);
    reveal(item.finding.location);
    ui.follow(item.key);
  };

  const onPublish = async () => {
    // Only the draft described here is published: anything else closes the dialog (see above).
    if (!described || useEditor.getState().doc !== described || cannot) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setRefusal(null);
    publishing.current = true;
    const result = await publish();
    publishing.current = false;
    setBusy(false);
    if (result.ok) {
      if (workflowId) ui.setPublished({ workflowId, version: result.value.version, doc: described, inProgress, previous: live });
      closeBack();
      return;
    }
    setRefusal(result.errors[0] ?? { code: 'internal', params: {} });
    // A change made while publishing: what is on screen is no longer what this dialog says.
    if (useEditor.getState().doc !== described) {
      leaving.current = true;
      ui.setPublishOpen(false);
      if (workflowId) ui.setChangedWhileOpen(workflowId);
      focusById(PUBLISH_BUTTON_ID);
    }
  };

  const onLoadLatest = async () => {
    setLoadFailed(false);
    leaving.current = true;
    const result = await reloadDraft();
    if (result.ok) closeBack();
    else {
      leaving.current = false;
      setLoadFailed(true);
    }
  };

  const whatTheyMiss =
    changes.status === 'ready' && changes.words.newStageNames.length > 0
      ? t('todo.dialog.what.newStage', { stages: toText(changes.words.newStages) })
      : t('todo.dialog.what.changes');

  const inProgressLine = () => {
    if (inProgress === 0) return t('todo.dialog.inProgress.none', { next });
    if (versionsWithOpen.length > 1 || versionsWithOpen[0]?.version !== live) {
      return t('todo.dialog.inProgress.versions', { n: inProgress, what: whatTheyMiss, next });
    }
    return inProgress === 1
      ? t('todo.dialog.inProgress.one', { live: live ?? 0, what: whatTheyMiss, next })
      : t('todo.dialog.inProgress.many', { n: inProgress, live: live ?? 0, what: whatTheyMiss, next });
  };

  const loadLatest = (
    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => void onLoadLatest()}>
      {t('todo.refused.loadLatest')}
    </Button>
  );

  const footer = (
    <div className={s.dialogFoot}>
      {workflowId && (
        <Link to={`/w/${workflowId}/try`} className={buttonClass('quiet', 'md', s.tryFirst)}
          onClick={() => {
            leaving.current = true;
            ui.setPublishOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="play" size={16} />
          {t('todo.dialog.tryFirst')}
        </Link>
      )}
      <Button onClick={closeBack}>{t('todo.dialog.cancel')}</Button>
      <Button variant="primary" icon="publish" onClick={() => void onPublish()} {...(cannot ? { disabledReason: cannot } : {})}>
        {busy ? t('todo.dialog.publishing') : t('todo.dialog.publish', { n: next })}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Dialog title={t('todo.dialog.title', { n: next })} open onOpenChange={(o) => (o ? ui.setPublishOpen(true) : closeBack())} width={600} footer={footer}>
      <div className={s.dialogBody}>
        {state.kind === 'conflict' && !refusal && (
          <Callout tone="danger" actions={loadLatest}>
            {t('todo.dialog.conflict')}
            {loadFailed && <> {t('todo.refused.loadFailed')}</>}
          </Callout>
        )}
        {state.kind === 'notSaved' && !refusal && <Callout tone="danger">{t('todo.dialog.notSaved')}</Callout>}
        {refusal && (
          <Callout
            tone={refusal.code === 'has-todo' ? 'todo' : 'danger'}
            actions={
              refusal.code === 'stale-revision' ? (
                loadLatest
              ) : refusal.code === 'core-version-mismatch' ? (
                <Button size="sm" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
                  {t('todo.refused.reload')}
                </Button>
              ) : undefined
            }
          >
            {refusalWords(refusal, blocking.length)}
            {loadFailed && <> {t('todo.refused.loadFailed')}</>}
          </Callout>
        )}

        {blocked ? (
          <ul className={s.items} aria-label={t('todo.group.todo')}>
            {blocking.map((item) => (
              <FindingItem key={item.key} item={item} onShowMe={() => showMe(item)} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className={s.nothingLeft}>
              <Icon name="check" size={16} />
              <strong>{t('todo.dialog.nothingLeft')}</strong>
              {worthItems.length > 0 && (
                <span>{worthItems.length === 1 ? t('todo.dialog.worth.one') : t('todo.dialog.worth.many', { n: worthItems.length })}</span>
              )}
            </p>

            <section className={s.dialogSection} aria-labelledby="todo-changed-head">
              <h3 id="todo-changed-head" className={s.dialogHead}>
                {live === null ? t('todo.dialog.firstTitle') : t('todo.dialog.changedSince', { n: live })}
              </h3>
              {changes.status === 'first' && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('todo.dialog.first')}</p>}
              {changes.status === 'loading' && (
                <p className={s.quietLine} role="status">
                  {t('todo.dialog.loadingChanges')}
                </p>
              )}
              {changes.status === 'failed' && <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('todo.dialog.changesFailed')}</p>}
              {changes.status === 'ready' && changes.words.groups.length === 0 && (
                <p className={s.quietLine}>{t('todo.dialog.noChanges', { n: live ?? 0, next })}</p>
              )}
              {changes.status === 'ready' && changes.words.groups.length > 0 && (
                // One list in the order a request meets the stages; each sentence names its stage (mockup 09).
                <ul className={s.changes} aria-labelledby="todo-changed-head">
                  {changes.words.groups.flatMap((g) =>
                    g.lines.map((l) => (
                      <li key={l.key} className={s.changeLine} data-stage={g.stageId ?? ''}>
                        <span className={s.changeIcon}>
                          <Icon name={iconOf(l)} size={16} />
                        </span>
                        <Said words={l.words} />
                      </li>
                    )),
                  )}
                </ul>
              )}
            </section>

            {live !== null && (
              <section className={s.dialogSection} aria-labelledby="todo-progress-head">
                <h3 id="todo-progress-head" className={s.dialogHead}>
                  {t('todo.dialog.inProgress')}
                </h3>
                <div className={s.inProgress}>
                  <Icon name="clock" size={16} />
                  <div>
                    <p>{inProgressLine()}</p>
                    {inProgress > 0 && where && where.length > 0 && (
                      <ul className={s.whereList} aria-label={t('todo.dialog.inProgress.where')}>
                        {where.map((w) => (
                          <li key={w.stageId} className={s.whereChip}>
                            <span className={s.whereDot} style={{ background: statusDot(w.colour) }} aria-hidden="true" />
                            {t('todo.dialog.inProgress.at', { n: w.n, stage: w.name })}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>
            )}

            {worthItems.map((item) => (
              <Callout key={item.key} tone="info">
                <strong>{t('todo.dialog.worthLabel')}</strong> <LinkedPhrase phrase={item.words.causeParts ?? [item.words.cause]} />{' '}
                {t('todo.dialog.worthLine')}
              </Callout>
            ))}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/** The colour token of a status's dot (tokens.css has six status colours; the other two borrow the nearest). */
function statusDot(colour: WhereInProgress['colour']): string {
  switch (colour) {
    case 'amber':
    case 'blue':
    case 'purple':
    case 'green':
    case 'red':
    case 'grey':
      return `var(--st-${colour})`;
    case 'teal':
      return 'var(--action-icon)';
    case 'pink':
      return 'var(--st-red)';
    default:
      return 'var(--g-300)';
  }
}

function refusalWords(refusal: ApiError, blocking: number): string {
  switch (refusal.code) {
    case 'has-todo':
      return blocking === 1 ? t('todo.refused.hasTodo.one') : t('todo.refused.hasTodo.many', { n: blocking });
    case 'stale-revision':
      return t('todo.refused.stale');
    case 'core-version-mismatch':
      return t('todo.refused.outOfStep');
    case 'forbidden':
      return t('todo.refused.notYours');
    default:
      return t('todo.refused.other');
  }
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/todo/README.md\n===
# features/todo

To do and Worth knowing, the "To do before publishing" drawer, Publish, versions and what changed.

- Exports the top-bar slots `VersionState` (after the name: "Draft (not live)", or "Published" while the draft is the same as the live version; then "Version n is live" or "Not published yet"), `TodoButton` ("To do (n)", then "Worth knowing (n)" only when n is above zero; when it goes away while focused, focus goes to To do) and `PublishButton`. Also `TODO_BAR_PLACE_ID`, the element the editor keeps above the stage panel for the "To do · n left" bar.
- Publish (`PublishControl.tsx`, `usePublishState` in `hooks.ts`): "Publish · n to do first" while anything is to do (it opens the drawer); greyed with its reason in the tooltip and accessible description (not on the label) while nothing changed since the live version, in a save conflict, or while the latest change could not be saved; "Publish · authors only" for someone who may not publish.
- The publish dialog (`PublishDialog.tsx`) describes and publishes the same revision: the draft as it was when it opened. If the document changes while it is open, it closes and a line says so (`todo.changedWhileOpen`). "What changed since version n" comes from the model's `describeChanges` (src/model/describe/change.ts) over services `core.diff`. "Requests already in progress" also says where they are ("2 at Domain approval", "1 at Development", each with its status's dot) when the services give it (`inProgress.ts`: `runtime.listRequests` of the open requests, named from the version each runs on).
- Finding sentences are drawn with `LinkedPhrase.tsx` from `causeParts` / `effectParts`: the "Settings" of "(change this in Settings)" is a link that opens Settings (`openSettings()` from `@/model`; plain words where nothing can open it). Who is told comes from `useStuckPeople()` (everyone in "Stuck requests go to", groups marked), through `useFindingEnv`.
- The version line has a short form for a top bar short of room ("v 3 live", `data-topbar-short`), the whole words staying in the page (see `src/app/topBarFit.ts`).
- Fixes in the drawer run through the model's `planFindingFix`, the same as the stage panel's strip; a fix that needs a choice leads to the spot (`choiceLocation` in `items.ts`).
- May import: `@/model`, `@/services`, `@/words`, `@/ui`, `@/contract`, and files in this folder. Never another feature or `@/app` (lint enforces it).
- Words: `src/words/todo.ts`, keys starting with `todo.`. The change sentences (`todo.change.*`) are used by src/model/describe/change.ts. The `version.*` words are shared vocabulary in `core.ts`.
- Styles: CSS modules in this folder, using the variables from `src/ui/tokens.css`.
- Tests: `todo.test.tsx` next to the code; end-to-end in `tests/e2e/todo.spec.ts`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/todo/TodoDrawer.tsx\n===
/**
 * The "To do before publishing" drawer (editor-model.md section 7, mockup 09): a side drawer that
 * does not block the editor. "Show me" folds it into a small bar ("To do · 3 left", Next to do,
 * All To do items) so the author can work on the spot and go on through what is left.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { isRefusal, reveal, useEditor, useMay, useCheckIsCurrent, useVersions } from '@/model';
import { Button, EmptyState, Icon, IconButton } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { FindingItem } from './FindingItem';
import { useFindingEnv, usePublishState, useTodoList } from './hooks';
import { choiceLocation, planFix, type TodoGroup, type TodoItem } from './items';
import { PublishControl } from './PublishControl';
import { focusById, TODO_BAR_PLACE_ID, useTodoUi } from './state';
import s from './todo.module.css';

/** A fix carried out here, said in place ("Done: ...") until the drawer closes. */
interface DoneEntry {
  key: string;
  text: string;
  severity: 'todo' | 'worth';
  stageId: string | null;
  title: string;
  groupIndex: number;
  index: number;
}

type Row = { done: false; item: TodoItem } | { done: true; entry: DoneEntry };
type RowGroup = { stageId: string | null; title: string; rows: Row[] };

/** The groups with the fixed items replaced by their "Done: ..." line, in the same place. */
function withDone(groups: TodoGroup[], done: DoneEntry[], severity: 'todo' | 'worth'): RowGroup[] {
  const doneKeys = new Set(done.map((d) => d.key));
  const out: RowGroup[] = groups.map((g) => ({
    stageId: g.stageId,
    title: g.title,
    rows: g.items.filter((i) => !doneKeys.has(i.key)).map((item): Row => ({ done: false, item })),
  }));
  for (const entry of done.filter((d) => d.severity === severity)) {
    let group = out.find((g) => g.stageId === entry.stageId);
    if (!group) {
      group = { stageId: entry.stageId, title: entry.title, rows: [] };
      out.splice(Math.min(entry.groupIndex, out.length), 0, group);
    }
    group.rows.splice(Math.min(entry.index, group.rows.length), 0, { done: true, entry });
  }
  return out.filter((g) => g.rows.length > 0);
}

export function TodoDrawer() {
  const mode = useTodoUi((st) => st.mode);
  const place = useBarPlace(mode === 'following');
  if (mode === 'closed') return null;
  const following = mode === 'following';
  return createPortal(<DrawerContent following={following} inPlace={following && place !== null} />, (following && place) || document.body);
}

/**
 * The editor's place for the bar at the top of the stage panel's column, while following; null when
 * the screen has none (the bar then floats). Watched, as the place may come and go with the tab shown.
 */
function useBarPlace(following: boolean): HTMLElement | null {
  const subscribe = useCallback(
    (changed: () => void) => {
      if (!following) return () => undefined;
      const watch = new MutationObserver(changed);
      watch.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      return () => watch.disconnect();
    },
    [following],
  );
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => (following ? document.getElementById(TODO_BAR_PLACE_ID) : null));
}

function DrawerContent({ following, inPlace = false }: { following: boolean; inPlace?: boolean }) {
  const list = useTodoList();
  const may = useMay();
  const { live } = useVersions();
  const current = useCheckIsCurrent();
  const publish = usePublishState();
  const env = useFindingEnv();
  const ui = useTodoUi();
  const [done, setDone] = useState<DoneEntry[]>([]);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const nextRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  const todoHeadId = useId();
  const worthHeadId = useId();

  const close = () => {
    const back = ui.returnTo;
    ui.close();
    focusById(back);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (following) {
      // The screen that shows the revealed place may take focus there; otherwise it comes to the bar.
      const id = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const at = document.activeElement;
        if (!at || at === document.body) nextRef.current?.focus();
      });
      return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id);
    }
    if (ui.focusGroup === 'worth') {
      const head = document.getElementById(worthHeadId);
      head?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'start' });
    }
    titleRef.current?.focus();
    // Only when the drawer opens, comes back from following, or is asked for the other group.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [following, ui.focusGroup]);

  if (!list) return null;
  const todoItems = list.todoItems;
  const todoCount = todoItems.length;
  const worthCount = list.worth.reduce((n, g) => n + g.items.length, 0);
  const next = (live ?? 0) + 1;
  // With nothing to do, say what Publish itself says: it may still be greyed (nothing new, or not this person's to publish).
  const nothingTitle =
    publish.kind === 'nothingNew' ? t('todo.nothingNothingNew') : publish.kind === 'ready' ? t('todo.nothingCanPublish') : t('todo.nothing');
  const footText =
    todoCount === 1
      ? t('todo.foot.one')
      : todoCount > 1
        ? t('todo.foot.many', { n: todoCount })
        : publish.kind === 'nothingNew'
          ? t('todo.foot.nothingNew')
          : nothingTitle;

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.stopPropagation();
      close();
    }
  };

  const showMe = (item: TodoItem) => {
    reveal(item.finding.location);
    ui.follow(item.key);
  };

  const fixOf = (item: TodoItem, severity: 'todo' | 'worth', groupIndex: number, index: number, title: string) => {
    if (!may.edit || !item.words.fix) return undefined;
    const doc = useEditor.getState().doc;
    const plan = doc ? planFix(doc, item.words.fix, env) : null;
    if (!plan) {
      // A fix that needs a choice ("Choose who is asked"): it takes the author to the spot to choose.
      const at = choiceLocation(item.words.fix, item.finding.location);
      if (!at) return undefined;
      return {
        label: item.words.fix.label,
        run: () => {
          reveal(at);
          ui.follow(item.key);
        },
      };
    }
    return {
      label: item.words.fix.label,
      run: () => {
        const result = useEditor.getState().run(plan.command.name, plan.command.args as never);
        if (isRefusal(result)) {
          setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, [item.key]: t('todo.fixFailed') }));
          return;
        }
        setDone((d) => [...d, { key: item.key, text: plan.done, severity, stageId: item.stageId, title, groupIndex, index }]);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => document.getElementById(`done-${item.key}`)?.focus());
      },
    };
  };

  const undo = (entry: DoneEntry) => {
    useEditor.getState().undo();
    setDone((d) => d.filter((x) => x.key !== entry.key));
    titleRef.current?.focus();
  };

  if (following) {
    const index = todoItems.findIndex((i) => i.key === ui.current);
    const go = (step: 1 | -1) => {
      if (todoCount === 0) return;
      const at = index < 0 ? (step === 1 ? 0 : todoCount - 1) : (index + step + todoCount) % todoCount;
      const item = todoItems[at];
      if (item) showMe(item);
    };
    return (
      <section className={inPlace ? s.followBarInPlace : s.followBar} aria-label={t('todo.follow.region')} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
        <p className={s.followCount} aria-live="polite">
          <Icon name={todoCount ? 'todo' : 'check'} size={16} />
          <strong>{t('todo.follow.label')}</strong>
          <span>{t('todo.follow.count', { count: todoCount ? t('todo.follow.left', { n: todoCount }) : t('todo.follow.none') })}</span>
        </p>
        {todoCount > 0 && (
          <>
            <IconButton icon="chevron-left" label={t('todo.follow.previous')} size="sm" onClick={() => go(-1)} />
            <Button size="sm" ref={nextRef} onClick={() => go(1)}>
              {t('todo.follow.next')}
              {/* "Next to do >" (mockup 09, show me): the chevron says it moves on, like the "<" beside it. */}
              <Icon name="chevron-right" size={14} />
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
        <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" ref={todoCount ? undefined : nextRef} onClick={() => ui.openList('todo', ui.returnTo)}>
          {t('todo.follow.all')}
        </Button>
        {/* Above the panel (mockup 09) the bar has no close of its own beside the panel's; Escape and To do (n) close it. */}
        {!inPlace && <IconButton icon="close" label={t('common.close')} size="sm" onClick={close} />}
      </section>
    );
  }

  const renderGroups = (groups: RowGroup[], severity: 'todo' | 'worth') =>
    groups.map((g, gi) => (
      <div key={g.stageId ?? 'elsewhere'} className={s.stageGroup}>
        <h4 className={s.stageHead}>{g.title}</h4>
        <ul className={s.items}>
          {g.rows.map((row, ri) =>
            row.done ? (
              <li key={`done-${row.entry.key}`} id={`done-${row.entry.key}`} tabIndex={-1} className={s.doneRow} role="status">
                <Icon name="check" size={16} />
                <p>
                  <strong>{t('todo.done')}</strong> {row.entry.text}
                </p>
                <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={() => undo(row.entry)}>
                  {t('todo.undo')}
                </Button>
              </li>
            ) : (
              <FindingItem
                key={row.item.key}
                item={row.item}
                fix={fixOf(row.item, severity, gi, ri, g.title)}
                error={errors[row.item.key]}
                onShowMe={() => showMe(row.item)}
                onShow={(location) => {
                  reveal(location);
                  ui.follow(row.item.key);
                }}
              />
            ),
          )}
        </ul>
      </div>
    ));

  const todoGroups = withDone(list.todo, done, 'todo');
  const worthGroups = withDone(list.worth, done, 'worth');

  return (
    <section role="dialog" aria-modal="false" aria-labelledby={titleId} className={s.drawer} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
      <header className={s.drawerHead}>
        <h2 id={titleId} ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1} className={s.drawerTitle}>
          {t('todo.drawerTitle')}
        </h2>
        <IconButton icon="close" label={t('common.close')} onClick={close} tooltip={false} />
      </header>
      <div className={s.drawerBody} aria-busy={!current}>
        {todoCount > 0 ? (
          <div className={s.intro}>
            <Icon name="publish" size={16} />
            <div>
              <p className={s.introCount}>
                {todoCount === 1 ? t('todo.intro.one', { v: next }) : t('todo.intro.many', { n: todoCount, v: next })}
              </p>
              <p>
                {t('mark.intro')} {t('todo.intro.spot')}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState icon="check" title={nothingTitle}>
            {t('mark.intro')}
          </EmptyState>
        )}
        {!current && <p className={s.checking}>{t('todo.checking')}</p>}

        {todoGroups.length > 0 && (
          <section aria-labelledby={todoHeadId} className={s.group}>
            <h3 id={todoHeadId} className={s.groupHead}>
              <span>{t('todo.group.todo')}</span>
              <span className={s.count}>{todoCount}</span>
              <span className={s.groupNote}>{t('todo.group.todoNote')}</span>
            </h3>
            {renderGroups(todoGroups, 'todo')}
          </section>
        )}

        {worthGroups.length > 0 && (
          <section aria-labelledby={worthHeadId} className={s.group}>
            <h3 id={worthHeadId} className={s.groupHead}>
              <span>{t('todo.group.worth')}</span>
              <span className={s.count}>{worthCount}</span>
              <span className={s.groupNote}>{t('todo.group.worthNote')}</span>
            </h3>
            {renderGroups(worthGroups, 'worth')}
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
      <footer className={s.drawerFoot}>
        <p>{footText}</p>
        <PublishControl />
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
}

/** The session's findings as this feature lists them, with the describe env findings need. */
import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import {
  useCheckedDoc, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFindings, useMay, useSaveFailure, useSaveState, useSessionWorkflowId,
  useStuckPeople, useTodoCount, useVersions,
  type FindingEnv,
} from '@/model';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import { todoList, type TodoList } from './items';
import { liveKey, useTodoUi } from './state';

/** The same JSON, whatever the order of the keys (as the server compares a draft with what is live). */
export function sameDocument(a: AuthoredWorkflow, b: AuthoredWorkflow): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  const stable = (v: unknown): string => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return `[${v.map(stable).join(',')}]`;
    if (v && typeof v === 'object') {
      return `{${Object.keys(v)
        .filter((k) => (v as Record<string, unknown>)[k] !== undefined)
        .sort()
        .map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${stable((v as Record<string, unknown>)[k])}`)
        .join(',')}}`;
    }
    return JSON.stringify(v) ?? 'null';
  };
  return stable(a) === stable(b);
}

const fetching = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Whether the draft on screen is the very document that is live: true, false, or null while that
 * is not known yet (nothing live, or the live version still loading). Survives a reload, unlike
 * "just published": the live version is fetched once and kept.
 */
export function useSameAsLive(): boolean | null {
  const services = useServices();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const { live } = useVersions();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const key = workflowId && live !== null ? liveKey(workflowId, live) : null;
  const liveDoc = useTodoUi((st) => (key ? st.liveDocs[key] : undefined));
  const remember = useTodoUi((st) => st.rememberLive);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!key || liveDoc || !workflowId || live === null || fetching.has(key)) return;
    fetching.add(key);
    services.authoring
      .getVersion(workflowId, live)
      .then((found) => {
        if (found.ok) remember(key, found.value.authored);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined)
      .finally(() => fetching.delete(key));
  }, [key, liveDoc, workflowId, live, services, remember]);

  return useMemo(() => (doc && liveDoc ? sameDocument(doc, liveDoc) : null), [doc, liveDoc]);
}

/**
 * Where Publish stands, so the top bar, the drawer's foot and the drawer's words agree:
 * - notYours: this person may not publish;
 * - conflict: the draft was saved from another window or by someone else since this editor last saved;
 * - notSaved: the latest change could not be saved (publishing would publish something else);
 * - blocked: something is to do;
 * - nothingNew: the draft is the version that is live (right after publishing, or opened again with no edit since);
 * - ready: the publish dialog can open.
 */
export type PublishState =
  | { kind: 'notYours' }
  | { kind: 'conflict' }
  | { kind: 'notSaved' }
  | { kind: 'nothingNew'; version: number }
  | { kind: 'blocked'; todo: number }
  | { kind: 'ready' };

export function usePublishState(): PublishState {
  const may = useMay();
  const todo = useTodoCount();
  const doc = useDoc();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const published = useTodoUi((st) => st.published);
  const sameAsLive = useSameAsLive();
  const { live } = useVersions();
  const saveState = useSaveState();
  const saveFailed = useSaveFailure() !== null;
  const justPublished = published !== null && published.workflowId === workflowId && published.doc === doc;
  if (!may.publish) return { kind: 'notYours' };
  if (saveState === 'conflict') return { kind: 'conflict' };
  if (saveState === 'unsaved' && saveFailed) return { kind: 'notSaved' };
  // While something is to do, that is what Publish says, also when nothing changed since the live version.
  if (todo > 0) return { kind: 'blocked', todo };
  if (justPublished) return { kind: 'nothingNew', version: published.version };
  if (sameAsLive && live !== null) return { kind: 'nothingNew', version: live };
  return { kind: 'ready' };
}

/**
 * The describe env plus everyone in "Stuck requests go to" (the authors when none is set), groups
 * marked, so the words can say "Sam Carter, who looks after stuck requests, is told" or "Platform
 * team, who look after stuck requests, are told".
 */
export function useFindingEnv(): FindingEnv {
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  return useMemo(() => (stuckPeople.length ? { ...env, stuckPeople } : env), [env, stuckPeople]);
}

/** Every finding in words, grouped by stage; null before a document is open. */
export function useTodoList(): TodoList | null {
  const findings = useFindings();
  const checked = useCheckedDoc();
  const current = useDoc();
  const doc = checked ?? current;
  const env = useFindingEnv();
  return useMemo(() => (doc ? todoList(doc, findings, env) : null), [doc, findings, env]);
}

/**
 * Where the requests already in progress are, for the Publish dialog (mockup 09 "ready": "2 at
 * Domain approval", "1 at Development"), when the services give it: the open requests of the
 * workflow (runtime.listRequests), counted by the stage each is at, named from the version it runs on.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Status } from '@/contract';
import type { RequestRow, Services } from '@/services';
import { getStatus, stageOf } from '@/model';
import { diagramOrder } from './items';

export interface WhereInProgress {
  stageId: string;
  name: string;
  n: number;
  colour: Status['colour'] | undefined;
}

/**
 * The open requests counted by the stage they are at (a stuck one where it is stuck), in the order
 * the diagram draws the stages. `docs` holds the version each request runs on; `order` is the
 * document whose diagram order is used (the live version). A stage no version names is left out.
 */
export function countWhere(rows: readonly RequestRow[], docs: ReadonlyMap<number, AuthoredWorkflow | undefined>, order?: AuthoredWorkflow): WhereInProgress[] {
  const byStage = new Map<string, WhereInProgress>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.closedAt) continue;
    const stageId = (row.stuck?.location ?? row.stage)?.item;
    const doc = docs.get(row.version);
    // A stuck request may be stuck at a task or an action: it counts at that one's stage.
    const stage = doc && stageId ? stageOf(doc, stageId) : undefined;
    if (!doc || !stage) continue;
    const had = byStage.get(stage.id);
    if (had) had.n += 1;
    else byStage.set(stage.id, { stageId: stage.id, name: stage.name, n: 1, colour: getStatus(doc, stage.status)?.colour });
  }
  const ranks = order ? diagramOrder(order) : [];
  const rank = (id: string) => {
    const at = ranks.indexOf(id);
    return at < 0 ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : at;
  };
  return [...byStage.values()].sort((a, b) => rank(a.stageId) - rank(b.stageId) || b.n - a.n);
}

/** Loads where the open requests of `workflow` are; null when the services cannot say. */
export async function loadWhereInProgress(services: Services, workflow: string, live: number | null): Promise<WhereInProgress[] | null> {
  try {
    const listed = await services.runtime.listRequests({ workflow, state: 'open', limit: 200 });
    if (!listed.ok) return null;
    const rows = listed.value.items.filter((r) => !r.closedAt);
    const docs = new Map<number, AuthoredWorkflow | undefined>();
    for (const version of new Set(rows.map((r) => r.version))) {
      const found = await services.authoring.getVersion(workflow, version).catch(() => undefined);
      docs.set(version, found?.ok ? found.value.authored : undefined);
    }
    const order = live !== null ? docs.get(live) ?? [...docs.values()].find(Boolean) : [...docs.values()].find(Boolean);
    return countWhere(rows, docs, order);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * The To do drawer's list, worked out from the session's findings: each finding in words
 * (describeFinding only), grouped by the stage it belongs to in the order a request meets the
 * stages, To do and Worth knowing apart; and where a fix that needs the author's choice is made.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { Finding } from '@/services';
import {
  arrowsOutOf, describeFinding, describeLocation, find, getStage, orderFromStart, planFindingFix, toText,
  type FindingEnv, type FindingFix, type FindingWords, type FixPlan,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';

export interface TodoItem {
  /** Stable while the finding stays: code, place and how many such came before it. */
  key: string;
  finding: Finding;
  words: FindingWords;
  /** The stage it is in, or null for things outside any stage (values, lists, the whole workflow). */
  stageId: string | null;
}

export interface TodoGroup {
  stageId: string | null;
  /** The stage's name, or "Elsewhere in the workflow". */
  title: string;
  items: TodoItem[];
}

export interface TodoList {
  todo: TodoGroup[];
  worth: TodoGroup[];
  /** Every To do item in the order shown (for "Next to do"). */
  todoItems: TodoItem[];
}

/** The stage a location is in: the item itself when it is a stage, its stage otherwise. */
export function stageOfLocation(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location | undefined): string | null {
  if (!location) return null;
  const entry = find(doc, location.item);
  if (!entry) return null;
  if (entry.kind === 'stage') return entry.id;
  if (entry.kind === 'startsWhen') return doc.start?.stage ?? null;
  return entry.parents.stage ?? null;
}

/**
 * Stage IDs top to bottom as the diagram draws them: by the longest way from the start stage, not
 * counting arrows that send a request back; endings last; ties in the order a request meets them.
 * (A candidate for model/graph.ts.)
 */
export function diagramOrder(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): string[] {
  const met = orderFromStart(doc) as string[];
  const onPath = new Set<string>();
  const done = new Set<string>();
  const forward = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const postorder: string[] = [];
  const visit = (id: string) => {
    onPath.add(id);
    const next: string[] = [];
    for (const arrow of arrowsOutOf(doc, id)) {
      const to = arrow.goTo;
      if (!to || !getStage(doc, to) || onPath.has(to)) continue;
      next.push(to);
      if (!done.has(to)) visit(to);
    }
    forward.set(id, next);
    onPath.delete(id);
    done.add(id);
    postorder.push(id);
  };
  for (const id of [doc.start?.stage, ...met]) if (id && !done.has(id)) visit(id);
  const depth = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const id of [...postorder].reverse()) {
    const d = depth.get(id) ?? 0;
    for (const to of forward.get(id) ?? []) depth.set(to, Math.max(depth.get(to) ?? 0, d + 1));
  }
  const ending = (id: string) => (getStage(doc, id)?.kind === 'ending' ? 1 : 0);
  return [...met].sort((a, b) => ending(a) - ending(b) || (depth.get(a) ?? 0) - (depth.get(b) ?? 0) || met.indexOf(a) - met.indexOf(b));
}

function group(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, items: TodoItem[], env: FindingEnv): TodoGroup[] {
  const order = diagramOrder(doc);
  const rank = (id: string | null) => (id === null ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : (order.indexOf(id) + 1 || order.length + 1));
  const byStage = new Map<string | null, TodoItem[]>();
  for (const item of items) byStage.set(item.stageId, [...(byStage.get(item.stageId) ?? []), item]);
  return [...byStage.entries()]
    .sort(([a], [b]) => rank(a) - rank(b))
    .map(([stageId, list]) => ({
      stageId,
      title: stageId ? toText(describeLocation(doc, { item: stageId }, env)) : t('todo.group.elsewhere'),
      items: list,
    }));
}

/** The findings in words, grouped by stage in the order a request meets them. */
export function todoList(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, findings: readonly Finding[], env: FindingEnv): TodoList {
  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
  const items = findings.map((finding): TodoItem => {
    const base = `${finding.severity}|${finding.code}|${finding.location?.item ?? ''}|${finding.location?.part ?? ''}`;
    const n = seen.get(base) ?? 0;
    seen.set(base, n + 1);
    return { key: `${base}|${n}`, finding, words: describeFinding(doc, finding, env), stageId: stageOfLocation(doc, finding.location) };
  });
  const todo = group(doc, items.filter((i) => i.finding.severity === 'todo'), env);
  const worth = group(doc, items.filter((i) => i.finding.severity !== 'todo'), env);
  return { todo, worth, todoItems: todo.flatMap((g) => g.items) };
}

// ── Fixes carried out here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Where a fix that needs a choice by the author is made ("Choose who is asked" goes to Who is
 * asked, "Choose another stage" to where the arrow goes ...), so its button can take the author
 * there. Null for fixes carried out here with one command (see planFix).
 */
export function choiceLocation(fix: FindingFix | undefined, fallback: Location | undefined): Location | null {
  if (!fix) return null;
  switch (fix.kind) {
    case 'chooseWhoIsAsked':
      return { item: fix.task, part: 'whoIsAsked' };
    case 'chooseStage':
      return { item: fix.arrow, part: 'goTo' };
    case 'chooseStatus':
      return { item: fix.stage, part: 'status' };
    case 'setIfEmptyUse':
      return { item: fix.item, part: fix.part };
    case 'fillAnswer':
      return fallback ?? { item: fix.binding };
    case 'carryOn':
      return { item: fix.action };
    case 'show':
      return fix.location;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** The fix of a finding as one named command (the model's planFindingFix, the same as the stage panel's), or null when it needs a choice. */
export const planFix = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, fix: FindingFix | undefined, env: FindingEnv = {}): FixPlan | null => planFindingFix(doc, fix, env);

/**
 * What the three top-bar parts of this feature share: whether the To do drawer is open (as a list,
 * or folded into a small bar while the author goes through the items with "Show me"), whether the
 * publish dialog is open, and what was just published. Screen state only: the document and the

import { create } from 'zustand';

export const TODO_BUTTON_ID = 'todo-button';
export const PUBLISH_BUTTON_ID = 'publish-button';
export const WORTH_BUTTON_ID = 'worth-button';
/**

 * panel (mockup 09-publish, "Show me"): the "To do · n left" bar is shown in it, so it covers
 * nothing on the diagram. Without it the bar floats over the diagram.
 */
export const TODO_BAR_PLACE_ID = 'todo-follow-bar-place';

export type DrawerMode = 'closed' | 'list' | 'following';

export interface JustPublished {
  workflowId: string;
  version: number;
  /** The document as it was published: the badge says "Published" until it changes. */
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  /** Requests still in progress on earlier versions, and the version that was live before. */
  inProgress: number;
  previous: number | null;
}

interface TodoUi {
  mode: DrawerMode;
  /** The To do item being shown while following ("To do Â· 3 left"). */
  current: string | null;
  /** Which group to bring into view when the drawer opens. */
  focusGroup: 'todo' | 'worth';
  /** The id of the control focus goes back to when the drawer closes. */
  returnTo: string;
  publishOpen: boolean;
  published: JustPublished | null;
  /** The "Version n is live" card after publishing. */
  toast: JustPublished | null;
  /** The workflow whose Publish dialog closed because the document changed while it was open (a line says so). */
  changedWhileOpen: string | null;
  /** Published documents already fetched, by `workflowId@version`, to tell whether the draft differs from what is live. */
  liveDocs: Record<string, AuthoredWorkflow>;
  openList(group?: 'todo' | 'worth', returnTo?: string): void;
  follow(key: string): void;
  close(): void;
  setPublishOpen(open: boolean): void;
  setPublished(published: JustPublished): void;
  closeToast(): void;
  setChangedWhileOpen(workflowId: string | null): void;
  rememberLive(key: string, doc: AuthoredWorkflow): void;
}

export const useTodoUi = create<TodoUi>()((set) => ({
  mode: 'closed',
  current: null,
  focusGroup: 'todo',
  returnTo: TODO_BUTTON_ID,
  publishOpen: false,
  published: null,
  toast: null,
  changedWhileOpen: null,
  liveDocs: {},
  openList: (group = 'todo', returnTo = TODO_BUTTON_ID) => set({ mode: 'list', focusGroup: group, returnTo }),
  follow: (key) => set({ mode: 'following', current: key }),
  close: () => set({ mode: 'closed', current: null }),
  setPublishOpen: (publishOpen) => set(publishOpen ? { publishOpen, changedWhileOpen: null } : { publishOpen }),
  setPublished: (published) =>
    set((st) => ({ published, toast: published, liveDocs: { ...st.liveDocs, [liveKey(published.workflowId, published.version)]: published.doc } })),
  closeToast: () => set({ toast: null }),
  setChangedWhileOpen: (changedWhileOpen) => set({ changedWhileOpen }),
  rememberLive: (key, doc) => set((st) => ({ liveDocs: { ...st.liveDocs, [key]: doc } })),
}));

export const liveKey = (workflowId: string, version: number) => `${workflowId}@${version}`;

/** For tests: back to nothing open, nothing published. */
export function resetTodoUi(): void {
  useTodoUi.setState({ mode: 'closed', current: null, focusGroup: 'todo', returnTo: TODO_BUTTON_ID, publishOpen: false, published: null, toast: null, changedWhileOpen: null, liveDocs: {} });
}

/** Focus goes to id on the next frame; to To do (n) when that control is gone (Worth knowing (n) hides at 0). */
export function focusById(id: string): void {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => (document.getElementById(id) ?? document.getElementById(TODO_BUTTON_ID))?.focus());
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/todo/todo.test.tsx\n===
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { applyCommand, describeFinding, flushSave, openWorkflow, planFindingFix, resetSessionForTests, setSettingsOpener, useEditor, useSession, type CommandName } from '@/model';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider, type Finding, type Services } from '@/services';
import { PublishButton, TodoButton, VersionState } from './index';
import { resetTodoUi, TODO_BAR_PLACE_ID } from './state';

const DEMO = 'change-request';

async function setup(change?: (services: Services) => Services, options: { sampleRequests?: boolean } = {}) {
  const standin = createStandinServices(options).services;
  const services = change ? change(standin) : standin;
  render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <MemoryRouter>
        <VersionState />
        <TodoButton />
        <PublishButton />
      </MemoryRouter>
    </ServicesProvider>,
  );
  await act(() => openWorkflow(services, DEMO));
  await checked();
  return services;
}

/** Waits until the findings are for the document on screen. */
const checked = () =>
  waitFor(() => {
    const doc = useEditor.getState().doc;
    expect(doc).not.toBeNull();
    expect(useSession.getState().checkedDoc).toBe(doc);
  });

async function run(name: CommandName, args: unknown) {
  act(() => void useEditor.getState().run(name, args as never));
  await checked();
}

/** The broken copy: an arrow with no stage, a deleted stage's arrow, a button with only a narrowed arrow. */
async function breakTheDemo() {
  await run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: 'ar_da_request_changes', goTo: null });
  await run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_rejected' });
  // Approve's only arrow is gone, so pressing Approve fits no arrow (core judges buttons only: an
  // arrow kept to some requests by "+ only when" on a value counts as one that may fit).
  await run('arrow.delete', { arrow: 'ar_da_approve' });
}

const drawer = () => screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'To do before publishing' });

afterEach(() => {
  resetSessionForTests();
  resetTodoUi();
});

/** An edit that changes nothing a finding cares about, so the draft differs from what is live. */
const edit = () => run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'Shipped' });

describe('the demo, with nothing to do', () => {
  it('opened with no change since version 3: "Published", "Version 3 is live", and a plain greyed Publish whose reason is its description (mockup 09)', async () => {
    await setup();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Published')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Version 3 is live')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Draft (not live)')).toBeNull();
    const publish = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' });
    expect(publish).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    // The reason is not on the label (it reads only "Publish"): it is the tooltip and the accessible description.
    expect(publish).toHaveTextContent(/^Publish$/);
    expect(publish).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Nothing has changed since version 3');
  });

  it('shows "To do (0)" alone: Worth knowing is in the top bar only when something is worth knowing (mockup 01)', async () => {
    await setup();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Worth knowing/ })).toBeNull();
  });
  it('after an edit, says the draft is not live, version 3 is, To do (0), and Publish is ready', async () => {
    await setup();
    await edit();
    expect(screen.getByText('Draft (not live)')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Version 3 is live')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Worth knowing/ })).toBeNull();
    const publish = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' });
    expect(publish).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled');
  });

  it('opens an empty drawer that says so, and closes with Escape back to the To do button', async () => {
    await setup();
    await edit();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)' }));
    expect(within(drawer()).getAllByText('Nothing to do. You can publish.').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(within(drawer()).getByText('To do: must be done before publishing. Worth knowing: will not stop you.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.keyDown(drawer(), { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'To do before publishing' })).toBeNull();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)' })).toHaveFocus());
  });
  it('with nothing changed since the live version, the empty drawer does not say "You can publish" beside a greyed Publish', async () => {
    await setup();
    await screen.findByText('Published');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)' }));
    expect(within(drawer()).queryByText(/You can publish/)).toBeNull();
    expect(within(drawer()).getByText('Nothing to do, and nothing new to publish.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(drawer()).getByText('Change something to publish a new version.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    const footPublish = within(drawer()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' });
    expect(footPublish).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    expect(footPublish).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Nothing has changed since version 3');
  });
});

describe('a broken copy of the demo', () => {
  it('counts the To do items, greys Publish with the count on it, and the greyed Publish opens the drawer', async () => {
    await setup();
    await breakTheDemo();
    const todo = useSession.getState().findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo').length;
    expect(todo).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: `To do (${todo})` })).toBeInTheDocument();
    const publish = screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Publish · ${todo} to do first` });
    expect(publish).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Opens the To do list. Publishing is possible once nothing is left to do.');
    fireEvent.click(publish);
    expect(within(drawer()).getByText(`${todo} things to do before version 4 can be published.`)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(drawer()).getByText(`Do the ${todo} things above to publish.`)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("words each item with the mockup's sentences, with its tone in words, grouped by stage", async () => {
    await setup();
    await breakTheDemo();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do \(/ }));
    const d = within(drawer());
    expect(d.getByText('The arrow "Request changes pressed" does not go anywhere yet.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(d.getByText('When Request changes is pressed, the request would be stuck in Domain approval.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(d.getByText('The arrow "Reject pressed" goes to Rejected (deleted), a stage that is no longer in the workflow.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(d.getByText('When Approve is pressed, the request goes nowhere.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // No tone tag on the items (mockup 09): the cause sentence says what is wrong.
    expect(d.queryByText('Not finished yet')).toBeNull();
    expect(d.queryByText('Contradicts itself')).toBeNull();
    expect(d.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: 'Domain approval' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Every item has Show me.
    const items = d.getAllByRole('listitem');
    for (const item of items) expect(within(item).getByRole('button', { name: 'Show me' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('offers the fix of every item that has one, also when the fix is a choice made in place (section 7)', async () => {
    await setup();
    await breakTheDemo();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do \(/ }));
    const d = within(drawer());
    const deleted = d.getByText('The arrow "Reject pressed" goes to Rejected (deleted), a stage that is no longer in the workflow.').closest('li')!;
    const nowhere = d.getByText('The arrow "Request changes pressed" does not go anywhere yet.').closest('li')!;
    expect(within(nowhere as HTMLElement).getByRole('button', { name: 'Choose a stage or ending' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(within(deleted as HTMLElement).getByRole('button', { name: 'Choose another stage' }));
    // It takes the author to where the arrow goes, and the drawer folds into the bar.
    expect(useSession.getState().reveal?.location).toEqual({ item: 'ar_da_reject', part: 'goTo' });
    expect(screen.getByRole('region', { name: 'Going through what is left to do' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('counts Worth knowing in the top bar, apart from To do, and that button opens the drawer at Worth knowing', async () => {
    await setup();
    // With Create Jira issue deleted, nothing reaches Development any more: Worth knowing, not To do.
    await run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_create_jira_issue' });
    const worth = useSession.getState().findings.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'todo').length;
    const todo = useSession.getState().findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo').length;
    expect(worth).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: `To do (${todo})` })).toBeInTheDocument();
    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Worth knowing (${worth})` });
    fireEvent.click(button);
    expect(button).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    expect(within(drawer()).getByRole('heading', { level: 3, name: new RegExp(`^Worth knowing\\s*${worth}`) })).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.keyDown(drawer(), { key: 'Escape' });
    await waitFor(() => expect(button).toHaveFocus());
  });

  it('when Worth knowing goes away while it has focus, focus goes to To do', async () => {
    await setup();
    await run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_create_jira_issue' });
    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Worth knowing \(\d+\)$/ });
    button.focus();
    act(() => useEditor.getState().undo());
    await checked();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Worth knowing/ })).toBeNull();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)' })).toHaveFocus());
  });

  it('carries out a one-command fix and says it is done, in place, with Undo', async () => {
    await setup();
    await breakTheDemo();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do \(/ }));
    fireEvent.click(within(drawer()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Add an arrow for it' }));
    const done = within(drawer()).getByRole('status');
    expect(done).toHaveTextContent('Done: Domain approval now has an arrow for Approve. Choose where it goes.');
    const arrows = () => useEditor.getState().doc!.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval')!;
    expect(JSON.stringify(arrows())).toContain('"button":"btn_da_approve"');
    await checked();
    expect(within(drawer()).getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Done:');
    expect(within(drawer()).queryByText('When Approve is pressed, the request goes nowhere.')).toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(within(drawer()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }));
    await checked();
    expect(within(drawer()).getByText('When Approve is pressed, the request goes nowhere.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('Show me selects the place and folds the drawer into a bar to go through what is left', async () => {
    await setup();
    await breakTheDemo();
    const todo = useSession.getState().findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo').length;
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do \(/ }));
    const item = within(drawer()).getByText('The arrow "Request changes pressed" does not go anywhere yet.').closest('li')!;
    fireEvent.click(within(item as HTMLElement).getByRole('button', { name: 'Show me' }));
    expect(useSession.getState().reveal?.location).toEqual({ item: 'ar_da_request_changes', part: 'goTo' });
    const bar = screen.getByRole('region', { name: 'Going through what is left to do' });
    expect(bar).toHaveTextContent(`${todo} left`);
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(bar).getByRole('button', { name: 'Next to do' })).toHaveFocus());
    // "Next to do >" (mockup 09, show me): a chevron after the words, hidden from the accessible name.
    const nextButton = within(bar).getByRole('button', { name: 'Next to do' });
    const chevron = nextButton.lastElementChild;
    expect(chevron?.tagName.toLowerCase()).toBe('svg');
    expect(chevron).toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    expect(chevron?.innerHTML).toContain('M6 4l4 4-4 4');
    const before = useSession.getState().reveal?.nonce;
    fireEvent.click(within(bar).getByRole('button', { name: 'Next to do' }));
    expect(useSession.getState().reveal?.nonce).not.toBe(before);
    fireEvent.click(within(bar).getByRole('button', { name: 'All To do items' }));
    expect(drawer()).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('Show me puts the bar in the place the editor keeps for it above the stage panel, covering nothing on the diagram', async () => {
    const place = document.createElement('div');
    place.id = TODO_BAR_PLACE_ID;
    document.body.appendChild(place);
    try {
      await setup();
      await breakTheDemo();
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do \(/ }));
      fireEvent.click(within(drawer()).getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Show me' })[0]!);
      const bar = await screen.findByRole('region', { name: 'Going through what is left to do' });
      expect(place).toContainElement(bar);
      expect(within(bar).getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous to do' })).toBeInTheDocument();
      // Escape closes it (it has no close button beside the panel's own) and focus goes back to To do (n).
      fireEvent.keyDown(bar, { key: 'Escape' });
      expect(screen.queryByRole('region', { name: 'Going through what is left to do' })).toBeNull();
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do \(/ })).toHaveFocus());
    } finally {
      place.remove();
    }
  });
});

  /** Saves a rename of Released from "another window": the same author, through the services directly. */
  async function saveFromAnotherWindow(services: Services, name: string) {
    const draft = await services.authoring.getDraft(DEMO);
    if (!draft.ok) throw new Error('no draft');
    const other = applyCommand(draft.value.authored, 'stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released' as never, name });
    if (!other.ok) throw new Error('refused');
    await services.authoring.saveDraft(DEMO, { baseRevision: draft.value.revision, authored: other.doc });
  }

  it('when the workflow was changed elsewhere after the last save, says so in words true for the same author, and Publish stays greyed', async () => {
    const services = await setup();
    await edit();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' });
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish version 4' }));
    expect(
      await within(dialog).findByText(/^This workflow was changed in another window or by someone else, so this draft cannot be published\./),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(dialog).queryByText(/Someone else changed/)).toBeNull();
    // Pressing again cannot work: it stays greyed with the reason.
    expect(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: /^Publish version 4/ })).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Load the latest' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' })).toBeNull());
    expect(useEditor.getState().doc!.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_released')?.name).toBe('Done');
  });

  it('in a save conflict (saved from another window, then changed here), Publish is not offered and says why', async () => {
    const services = await setup();
    await edit();
    await act(() => flushSave());
    await saveFromAnotherWindow(services, 'Done');
    // A change here is now refused on save: the conflict.
    await run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_development', name: 'Build A2' });
    await act(() => flushSave());
    expect(useEditor.getState().saveState).toBe('conflict');
    const publish = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' });
    expect(publish).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    expect(publish).toHaveAccessibleDescription(/^This workflow was changed in another window or by someone else\./);
    fireEvent.click(publish);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('when the dialog is open and a save conflict arrives, it says so and does not publish', async () => {
    const services = await setup();
    await edit();
    await act(() => flushSave());
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' });
    let published = false;
    const original = services.authoring.publish;
    services.authoring.publish = async (...args) => {
      published = true;
      return original(...args);
    };
    act(() => useEditor.getState().setSaveState('conflict'));
    expect(within(dialog).getByText(/^This workflow was changed in another window or by someone else/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    const button = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: /^Publish version 4/ });
    expect(button).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    fireEvent.click(button);
    expect(published).toBe(false);
  });

  it('while the latest change could not be saved, Publish says so and is not offered', async () => {

  it('describes and publishes the same revision: a change while it is open closes it with a line saying so', async () => {

      ...s,

          publishedCalls += 1;

        },
      },

    await edit();
    const publish = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' });
    publish.focus();
    fireEvent.click(publish);
    await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' });
    // An undo key reaching the editor while the dialog is open changes the document.
    await run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_development', name: 'Build' });
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' })).toBeNull());
    expect(
      screen.getByText('The workflow changed while Publish was open, so nothing was published. Press Publish again to see what it would publish now.'),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(publishedCalls).toBe(0);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' })).toHaveFocus());
    // Opened again, it describes the draft as it is now.
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish' }));

    expect(items.map((li) => li.textContent)).toContain('Stage Development is now called Build.');
    expect(screen.queryByText(/The workflow changed while Publish was open/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('when the editor is out of date, says to reload the page', async () => {
    await setup((s) => ({
      ...s,

        ...s.authoring,

    expect(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Reload the page' })).toBeInTheDocument();

  });
