import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { OutboxEntry } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Callout, Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { outboxEntryId, outboxGroups, peoplePhrase, type DoneItem, type OutboxCtx, type Row } from './outbox';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { joinNames, sayText } from './say';
import s from './tryit.module.css';

function Group({ id, title, stamp, count, note, children }: { id: string; title: string; stamp: string; count: number; note?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className={s.outGroup} aria-labelledby={id}>
      <header className={s.outHead}>
        <h3 id={id} className={s.outTitle}>
          {title} <span className={s.count}>{count}</span>
        </h3>
        <span className={s.stamp}>
          <Icon name="close" size={12} />
          {stamp}
        </span>
      </header>
      {note && <p className={s.outEmpty}>{note}</p>}
      {count === 0 ? <p className={s.outEmpty}>{t('tryit.outbox.empty')}</p> : <ul className={s.outList}>{children}</ul>}
    </section>
  );
}

function Rows({ rows }: { rows: Row[] }) {
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  return (
    <dl className={s.rows}>
      {rows.map((r, i) => (
        <div key={i} className={s.row}>
          <dt>{r.label}</dt>
          <dd>{r.value.length ? <PhraseView phrase={r.value} /> : t('tryit.outbox.nothingSent')}</dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

/** One entry; the story's "Read it in the Test outbox" puts focus on it by its ID. */
function Item({ icon, entry, children }: { icon: IconName; entry: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <li className={s.outItem} id={outboxEntryId(entry)} tabIndex={-1}>
      <Icon name={icon} size={16} />
      <div className={s.outBody}>{children}</div>
    </li>
  );
}

function CallItem({ d }: { d: DoneItem }) {
  return (
    <Item entry={d.entry} icon={d.state === 'failed' ? 'error' : d.state === 'pending' ? 'clock' : 'connected'}>
      <p className={s.outSubject}>{d.title}</p>
      <Rows rows={d.sent} />
      <p className={s.outState} data-state={d.state}>
        {d.stateWords}
      </p>
      {d.state !== 'pending' && <Rows rows={d.result} />}
      <p className={s.quiet}>{d.from}</p>
    </Item>
  );
}

/** The Test outbox: Messages, Done in other systems, Other systems told, each stamped as not real. */
export function OutboxView({ ctx, entries }: { ctx: OutboxCtx; entries: readonly OutboxEntry[] }) {
  const g = outboxGroups(ctx, entries);
  return (
    <div className={s.outbox}>
      <Callout tone="info">{t('tryit.outbox.lead')}</Callout>
      <Group id="tryit-out-messages" title={t('tryit.outbox.messages')} stamp={t('tryit.outbox.notSent')} count={g.messages.length}>
        {g.messages.map((m) => (
          <Item key={m.key} entry={m.entry} icon="notify">
            <p className={s.outLine}>
              <strong>{t('tryit.outbox.toLabel')}</strong> <PhraseView phrase={peoplePhrase(ctx.names, m.to)} />
            </p>
            {m.subject && <p className={s.outSubject}>{m.subject}</p>}
            <p className={s.outText}>
              <PhraseView phrase={m.text} />
            </p>
            <p className={s.quiet}>{m.from}</p>
          </Item>
        ))}
      </Group>
      <Group id="tryit-out-done" title={t('tryit.outbox.done')} stamp={t('tryit.outbox.notDone')} count={g.done.length}>
        {g.done.map((d) => (
          <CallItem key={d.key} d={d} />
        ))}
      </Group>
      {g.lookedUp.length > 0 && (
        <Group id="tryit-out-looked-up" title={t('tryit.outbox.lookedUp')} stamp={t('tryit.outbox.notAsked')} count={g.lookedUp.length} note={t('tryit.outbox.lookUpNote')}>
          {g.lookedUp.map((d) => (
            <CallItem key={d.key} d={d} />
          ))}
        </Group>
      )}
      <Group id="tryit-out-told" title={t('tryit.outbox.told')} stamp={t('tryit.outbox.notTold')} count={g.told.length}>
        {g.told.map((x) => (
          <Item key={x.key} entry={x.entry} icon="link">
            <p className={s.outSubject}>{x.title}</p>
            <Rows rows={x.values} />
            <p className={s.quiet}>{x.from}</p>
          </Item>
        ))}
      </Group>
      <p className={s.quiet}>
        {g.listening.length ? sayText('tryit.outbox.listening', { systems: joinNames(g.listening) }) : t('tryit.outbox.noListeners')}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Fragment } from 'react';
import type { Phrase } from '@/model';
import { isChip, isSettingsLink, isWebLink } from '@/model';
import { ExternalLink } from '@/ui';
import s from './tryit.module.css';

/** A Try it sentence: names (stages, buttons, people, values, answers) in bold, the rest as text. One inline element, so it flows as one run of text anywhere. */
export function PhraseView({ phrase }: { phrase: Phrase }) {
  return (
    <span className={s.phrase}>
      {phrase.map((part, i) =>
        typeof part === 'string' ? (
          <Fragment key={i}>{part}</Fragment>
        ) : isChip(part) ? (
          <strong key={i} className={part.chip === 'value' ? s.valueName : undefined}>
            {part.label}
          </strong>
        ) : isSettingsLink(part) ? (
          <Fragment key={i}>{part.text}</Fragment>
        ) : isWebLink(part) ? (
          <ExternalLink key={i} href={part.href}>
            {part.text}
          </ExternalLink>
        ) : (
          <span key={i} className={s.missing}>
            {part.text}
          </span>
        ),
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/tryit/Pretend.tsx\n===
/**
 * Pretended connections: how each operation the draft uses answers in this test (its sample, an
 * answer the author types, or a failure with one of the entry's reasons), and the card for an
 * action the request is held on, where the author answers Succeeded or Failed for the other system.
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, CatalogueRef, Field as CatalogueField, Operation, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { actionName, getAction, getStage, getValue, stageOf, toText, type DescribeEnv } from '@/model';
import type { CallFake, Json, OpenAction, OutboxEntry } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Field, Icon, Select, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import type { TryItController } from './controller';
import { usedOperations } from './controller';
import type { Forecast } from './forecast';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { joinNames, quoted, say, sayText } from './say';
import { connectionLabel } from './story';
import { sayValue, type Names } from './values';
import s from './tryit.module.css';

export interface PretendCtx {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  names: Names;
  calls: Record<string, CallFake>;
  controller: TryItController;
  busy: boolean;
  /** The request's last story entry: a forecast is worked out again when it moves. */
  seq?: number;
}

const upperFirst = (s: string) => (s ? s[0]!.toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : s);

/** "On to Deployed; "Change deployed" is told." / "Saved as Deploy failed; on to Fix deployment." Empty when nothing is known. */
export function forecastWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, f: Forecast): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const stage = (id: string) => getStage(doc, id)?.name || t('describe.noName');
  if (f.saved.length) parts.push(sayText('tryit.forecast.saved', { values: joinNames(f.saved.map((v) => getValue(doc, v)?.name || t('describe.noName'))) }));
  const next = f.next;
  if (next.kind !== 'unknown') {
    const key: WordKey = next.kind === 'to' ? (next.back ? 'tryit.forecast.back' : 'tryit.forecast.to') : next.kind === 'stuck' ? 'tryit.forecast.stuck' : 'tryit.forecast.stays';
    parts.push(sayText(key, { stage: stage(next.stage) }));
  }
  for (const id of f.told) {
    const thing = doc.thingsTold?.find((x) => x.id === id)?.words?.trim();
    if (thing) parts.push(sayText('tryit.forecast.told', { thing: toText(quoted(thing)) }));
  }
  if (next.kind === 'unknown' && !f.saved.length) return '';
  return upperFirst(parts.join(t('tryit.forecast.join'))) + t('tryit.forecast.end');
}

/** The actions that use an operation, by name: "Create a Jira issue". */
function actionsUsing(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, env: DescribeEnv, op: string): string {
  const names: string[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const a of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
      if (a.type === 'useConnection' && a.operation === op) names.push(toText(actionName(doc, a, env)));
    }
  }
  return joinNames([...new Set(names)]);
}

const modeOf = (fake: CallFake | undefined): string => {
  if (!fake || fake.mode === 'sample') return 'sample';
  if (fake.mode === 'fail') return `fail:${fake.error.code}`;
  return fake.mode;
};

/** The sample result, as text the author can change, per result field. */
function editable(op: Operation, data: Record<string, Json> | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  const from = data ?? (op.sample.result as Record<string, Json>);
  for (const f of op.result) {
    const v = from[f.id];
    if (typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'number') out[f.id] = String(v);
  }
  return out;
}

const typable = (f: CatalogueField) => ['text', 'longText', 'number'].includes(f.kind);

/** Typed answers merged over the sample result. */
function resultFrom(op: Operation, typed: Record<string, string>): Record<string, Json> {
  const out: Record<string, Json> = { ...(op.sample.result as Record<string, Json>) };
  for (const f of op.result) {
    if (!typable(f) || !(f.id in typed)) continue;
    const text = typed[f.id] ?? '';
    if (text === '') delete out[f.id];
    else out[f.id] = f.kind === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(Number(text)) ? Number(text) : text;
  }
  return out;
}

/** One operation's answer: a choice and, for "Succeeds, answering with ...", its fields. */
export function CallAnswerChoice({ ctx, op, label }: { ctx: PretendCtx; op: Operation; label: string }) {
  const fake = ctx.calls[op.id];
  const mode = modeOf(fake);
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => editable(op, fake?.mode === 'result' ? fake.data : undefined));
  const set = (next: CallFake) => void ctx.controller.setCallFake(op.id as CatalogueRef, next);
  const choose = (value: string) => {
    if (value === 'sample') set({ mode: 'sample' });
    else if (value === 'hold') set({ mode: 'hold' });
    else if (value === 'result') set({ mode: 'result', data: resultFrom(op, typed) });
    else if (value.startsWith('fail:')) set({ mode: 'fail', error: { code: value.slice(5) } });
  };
  const type = (id: string, text: string) => {
    const next = { ...typed, [id]: text };
    setTyped(next);
    set({ mode: 'result', data: resultFrom(op, next) });
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.callChoice}>
      <Field label={label}>
        <Select
          value={mode}
          onChange={(e) => choose(e.target.value)}
          options={[
            ...(op.sort === 'await' ? [{ value: 'hold', label: t('tryit.pretend.hold') }] : []),
            { value: 'sample', label: t('tryit.pretend.sample') },
            ...(op.result.some(typable) ? [{ value: 'result', label: t('tryit.pretend.answerWith') }] : []),
            ...op.failureCodes.map((f) => ({ value: `fail:${f.code}`, label: sayText('tryit.pretend.fail', { reason: f.label }) })),
          ]}
        />
      </Field>
      {mode === 'result' && (
        <fieldset className={s.answerWith}>
          <legend>{t('tryit.pretend.answerWithTitle')}</legend>
          {op.result.filter(typable).map((f) => (
            <Field key={f.id} label={f.label}>
              <TextInput value={typed[f.id] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => type(f.id, e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** "How other systems answer in this test": one choice per operation the draft uses. */
export function CallSettings({ ctx }: { ctx: PretendCtx }) {
  const ops = usedOperations(ctx.doc, ctx.catalogue);
  return (
    <section className={s.section} aria-labelledby="tryit-pretend">
      <h3 id="tryit-pretend" className={s.sectionTitle}>
        <Icon name="connected" size={14} /> {t('tryit.pretend.title')}
      </h3>
      {ops.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.pretend.none')}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.pretend.hint')}</p>
          {ops.map((op) => (
            <CallAnswerChoice
              key={op.id}
              ctx={ctx}
              op={op}
              label={sayText('tryit.pretend.label', { action: `${connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, op.connection)} (${actionsUsing(ctx.doc, ctx.env, op.id) || op.label})` })}
            />
          ))}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The operation an action uses. */
export function operationOf(catalogue: Catalogue, action: Action | undefined): Operation | undefined {
  if (action?.type !== 'useConnection') return undefined;
  const e = catalogue.entries.find((x) => x.id === action.operation);
  return e?.kind === 'operation' ? e : undefined;
}

/** An action the request is held on: what it was sent, and the author's answer for the other system. */
export function WaitingCall({ ctx, open, outbox }: { ctx: PretendCtx; open: OpenAction; outbox: readonly OutboxEntry[] }) {
  const action = getAction(ctx.doc, open.location.item);
  const op = operationOf(ctx.catalogue, action);
  const connection = connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, op?.connection);
  const call = outbox.find((e) => e.kind === 'call' && e.call === open.call);
  const sent = call?.kind === 'call' ? call.inputs : {};
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState(op?.failureCodes[0]?.code ?? '');
  const failId = useId();
  const fake = op ? ctx.calls[op.id] : undefined;
  const data = fake?.mode === 'result' ? fake.data : ((op?.sample.result ?? {}) as Record<string, Json>);
  const dataKey = JSON.stringify(data);
  const actionId = open.location.item;
  // Where each answer would take the request, worked out before the author chooses (mockup 14).
  const [whereOk, setWhereOk] = useState<Forecast | null>(null);
  const [whereFailed, setWhereFailed] = useState<Forecast | null>(null);
  const { controller } = ctx;
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void controller.forecast(actionId, { outcome: 'ok', data: JSON.parse(dataKey) as Record<string, Json> }).then((f) => live && setWhereOk(f));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [controller, actionId, dataKey, ctx.seq]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (failure) void controller.forecast(actionId, { outcome: 'failed', error: { code: failure } }).then((f) => live && setWhereFailed(f));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [controller, actionId, failure, ctx.seq]);
  if (!open.call) return null;
  const callRef = open.call;
  const name = action ? toText(actionName(ctx.doc, action, ctx.env)) : t('tryit.anAction');
  const failLabel = op?.failureCodes.find((f) => f.code === failure)?.label ?? t('tryit.theFailure');
  const succeededHint = (whereOk && forecastWords(ctx.doc, whereOk)) || t('tryit.waiting.succeededHint');
  const failedHint = (failure && whereFailed && forecastWords(ctx.doc, whereFailed)) || failLabel;
  return (
    <section className={s.waiting} aria-label={sayText('tryit.waiting.answerFor', { action: name })}>
      <header className={s.waitingHead}>
        <Icon name="clock" size={16} />
        <h3 className={s.waitingTitle}>{name}</h3>
        <span className={s.stamp}>{t('tryit.pretended')}</span>
      </header>
      <p>{sayText('tryit.waiting.text', { connection })}</p>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{sayText('tryit.waiting.stays', { stage: stageOf(ctx.doc, actionId)?.name || t('describe.noName'), connection })}</p>
      <dl className={s.rows}>
        <dt>{t('tryit.waiting.sent')}</dt>
        <dd>
          {Object.entries(sent).map(([k, v]) => {
            const field = op?.input.find((f) => f.id === k);
            return (
              <div key={k}>
                <PhraseView phrase={say('tryit.waiting.sentRow', { field: field?.label || t('tryit.anotherDetail'), value: sayValue(ctx.doc, v, ctx.names, field?.kind as ValueKind | undefined) })} />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </dd>
      </dl>
      <h4 className={s.subTitle}>{t('tryit.waiting.choose')}</h4>
      <div className={s.answerTiles}>
        <Button
          className={s.answerTile}
          icon="check"
          aria-busy={ctx.busy || undefined}
          onClick={() => void ctx.controller.answerCall(callRef, { outcome: 'ok', data })}
          after={succeededHint}
        >
          {t('tryit.waiting.succeeded')}
        </Button>
        {failure && (
          <Button
            className={s.answerTile}
            icon="error"
            aria-busy={ctx.busy || undefined}
            onClick={() => void ctx.controller.answerCall(callRef, { outcome: 'failed', error: { code: failure } })}
            after={failedHint}
          >
            {t('tryit.waiting.failed')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {op && op.failureCodes.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.inlineField}>
          <label htmlFor={failId}>{t('tryit.waiting.failReason')}</label>
          <Select
            id={failId}
            value={failure}
            onChange={(e) => setFailure(e.target.value)}
            options={op.failureCodes.map((f) => ({ value: f.code, label: f.label }))}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/tryit/README.md\n===
# features/tryit

Try it: a test request on the draft as it is now (editor-model.md section 7, section 9 "What happens to other people", section 10 "In Try it every connection is pretended"; mockups 08-try-it, 14-connections try-it, 10-several-at-once).

- `index.tsx` exports the top-bar slot `TryItButton` (a link to `/w/:workflowId/try`, shown as current while there) and `TryItPage` (route `/w/:workflowId/try`). Keep these names: `src/app` points at them.
- `controller.ts`: `TryItController`, one Try it session. It makes a test host from the draft (`services.core.createTestHost`, which is core's own test host: with the directory's groups, "Stuck requests go to" from Settings, and every "Wait for" held so the author answers for it), keeps the start form's answers (from the sample request), runs every move (`start`, `startFrom`, `act`, `answerCall`, `admin`), reads the request back as the person acted as (`request` answers the view, or core's `not-found` refusal), and then switches to whoever the request needs (the first person who can answer an open task; the person who looks after stuck requests when it is stuck). It keeps every move said to the host, so a forecast can play them again on a second host. `startAgain` makes a new host from the draft as it is now. The answers used become the sample request through the `sample.replaceWith` command (at the start and at Start again). `usedOperations`, `startTask`.
- Nothing here works out what the engine would do. The request view, the story, the refusals and the outbox are core's; this folder only puts them into words.
- `useTryIt.ts`: the page's controller, read with `useSyncExternalStore`.
- `TryItPage.tsx`: the banner (every connection is pretended; Start again; a note when the draft changed), the `ReadOnlyDiagram` slot (where it is, has been, the arrows taken, stuck), "What just happened" / "Now you are" over the diagram, Acting as with Switch, and the tabs Task, So far, Test outbox.
- `TaskTab.tsx`: the start form through the `FormView` slot with "Fill in from the sample request"; "Start it as <connection> would" for each "Starts when", with the trigger's sample, editable; the task exactly as the person acted as sees it (`FormView`, mode `answer`, with the host's button states and refusals), or who is asked and "Act as <them>"; the stuck box (why, where with Show me, what can be done; Retry only for a failed action or nobody to ask, Close otherwise; as the person who looks after stuck requests, or "Act as" them).
- `Pretend.tsx`: how each operation the draft uses answers (its sample, "Succeeds, answering with ..." from the entry's result fields, or a failure with one of its reasons; "You choose each time it is asked" for a "Wait for"), and the card for an action the request is held on (what it was sent, Succeeded / Failed with the reason).
- `SoFar.tsx`: the story as lines and the values filled so far (kind, where each came from, New / Changed since the last move).
- `OutboxView.tsx` + `outbox.ts`: the Test outbox's groups (Messages, Done in other systems, Looked up in other systems for a read, which only reads, and Other systems told), each stamped as not real. Exactly what core says would go out, in full: a message is the parts core rendered (never the draft's message rendered again, so a failure code in it shows as it goes out), every field sent and answered (by the catalogue's labels, nested lists too), every field other systems are told (the request's number, the status by its label, the stage, the reason, who; never answers). Built-in messages worded from contract/words/notifications.json with their params filled. `storyNotes` / `outboxByLine` say what each line of the story sent ("Priya Raman was told: ..."), matched by the turn's time; `NotesView` (SoFar.tsx) puts "Read it in the Test outbox" after each, which opens the outbox with focus on that entry.
- Titles: the request's name is the model's `requestTitle` / `requestTitleAnswer` (never a question with a Show when); values are said with the model's `describeHeldValue` through `sayValue`, with the value ID so a failure code reads in words.
- `story.ts`: core's story entries put into words. `entryWords` has a sentence for every entry kind core gives (a new kind fails to compile; `tryit.test.ts` checks each). `storyLines` leads each line with what the person did, folds a stage that happens by itself into the same line, ends it with who is asked now and the status, and says why an arrow was taken when it depended on answers (what core says it read; a button's own read is not said again). A "Wait for" reads "the request stays at <stage> until <connection> answers". `valueSources`, `reasonClause`, `reasonWhatYouCanDo`.
- `forecast.ts`: where an answer for another system would take the request, shown on the Succeeded / Failed tiles before the author chooses: the controller plays the moves again on a second host made from the same draft and fakes and gives it the answer; this file compares the request before and after.
- The stuck box: the reason in words, where (with Show me), and for an unfinished part each To do there by name (so a "when" that is not decided is named); for the people who look after stuck requests, the engine's own text behind "Technical detail".
- `refusals.ts`: refusals in words; `unfinishedAt` names what is unfinished at an item from the test host's findings (the stuck box, a refused start). `values.ts`: values said by name, and turned back into constants for the sample request. `say.ts`: sentences as describe Phrases; `quoted` leaves out a quoted text's own final full stop. `PhraseView.tsx`: a Phrase with names in bold.
- Words: `src/words/tryit.ts` (keys `tryit.`). The built-in message, stuck reason and refused-start words are copied from contract/words/notifications.json (features cannot import it); `tryit.test.ts` checks they still match.
- Tests: `tryit.test.ts` (words, every story kind, the outbox as core gives it, refusals, values), `TryItPage.test.tsx` (rendered, with small stand-ins for the FormView and ReadOnlyDiagram slots), `tests/e2e/tryit.spec.ts` (the demo to Released as three people, and the outbox).
- May import: `@/model`, `@/services`, `@/words`, `@/ui`, `@/contract`, and files in this folder. Never another feature or `@/app`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/tryit/SoFar.tsx\n===
import type { ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { getValue, useFacts } from '@/model';
import type { RequestView, Values } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { noteLinkLabel, type StoryNote } from './outbox';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { joinNames, sayText } from './say';
import { stageChip, valueSources, type StoryCtx, type StoryLine } from './story';
import { kindWords, sayValue } from './values';
import s from './tryit.module.css';

/** What the outbox says a line's move sent, by line: its notes, and how to open the Test outbox at one. */
export interface LineNotes {
  of(line: StoryLine): StoryNote[];
  open(entry: number): void;
}

/** The sentences about what a move sent, each followed by "Read it in the Test outbox". */
export function NotesView({ notes, open }: { notes: StoryNote[]; open(entry: number): void }) {
  if (!notes.length) return null;
  return (
    <>
      {notes.map((note) => (
        <span key={note.entry} className={s.note}>
          {' '}
          <PhraseView phrase={note.text} />{' '}
          <button type="button" className={s.noteLink} onClick={() => open(note.entry)} aria-label={noteLinkLabel(note)}>
            <Icon name="outbox" size={12} />
            {t('tryit.note.read')}
          </button>
        </span>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

/** One line of the story, with what it sent and why each arrow was taken when it depended on answers. */
export function LineView({ line, notes }: { line: StoryLine; notes?: LineNotes | undefined }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.line} data-tone={line.tone}>
      <p className={s.lineText}>
        <Icon name={line.tone === 'stuck' ? 'warning' : line.tone === 'ended' ? 'ending' : 'branch'} size={14} />
        <span>
          <PhraseView phrase={line.text} />
          {notes && <NotesView notes={notes.of(line)} open={notes.open} />}
        </span>
      </p>
      {line.why.map((w, i) => (
        <div key={i} className={s.why}>
          <span className={s.byArrow}>{sayText('tryit.byTheArrow', { arrow: w.arrow })}</span>
          {w.reads && (
            <p className={s.reads}>
              <PhraseView phrase={w.reads} />
            </p>
          )}
          {w.notFitting.length > 0 && <p className={s.quiet}>{sayText('tryit.notFitting', { arrows: joinNames(w.notFitting) })}</p>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** "So far": the story, newest last, and the values filled so far. */
export function SoFar({ ctx, lines, view, valuesBefore, notes }: { ctx: StoryCtx; lines: StoryLine[]; view: RequestView | null; valuesBefore: Values; notes?: LineNotes }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.soFar}>
      {lines.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.storyEmpty')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className={s.story}>
          {lines.map((line) => (
            <li key={line.turn}>
              {line.stage && (
                <p className={s.storyAt}>
                  <PhraseView phrase={[stageChip(ctx.doc, line.stage)]} />
                </p>
              )}
              <LineView line={line} notes={notes} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
      <ValuesNow ctx={ctx} view={view} valuesBefore={valuesBefore} />
    </div>
  );
}

/** Every value filled so far: its kind, where it came from, and whether the last move changed it. */
export function ValuesNow({ ctx, view, valuesBefore }: { ctx: StoryCtx; view: RequestView | null; valuesBefore: Values }) {
  const facts = useFacts();
  const values = view?.values ?? {};
  const sources = view ? valueSources(ctx, view.story) : {};
  const ids = (ctx.doc.values ?? []).map((v) => v.id as string).filter((id) => values[id as keyof Values] !== undefined);
  for (const id of Object.keys(values)) if (!ids.includes(id)) ids.push(id);
  return (
    <section className={s.section} aria-labelledby="tryit-values">
      <h3 id="tryit-values" className={s.sectionTitle}>
        {t('tryit.valuesNow')}
      </h3>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.valuesHint')}</p>
      {ids.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.valuesEmpty')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className={s.values}>
          {ids.map((id) => {
            const value = values[id as keyof Values];
            const before = valuesBefore[id as keyof Values];
            const kindFact = facts?.values[id as keyof Values]?.kind;
            const kind = typeof kindFact === 'string' ? (kindFact as ValueKind) : undefined;
            const mark = before === undefined ? t('tryit.valueNew') : JSON.stringify(before) !== JSON.stringify(value) ? t('tryit.valueChanged') : '';
            return (
              <li key={id} className={s.valueRow} data-changed={mark ? 'true' : undefined}>
                <div className={s.valueHead}>
                  <strong>{getValue(ctx.doc, id)?.name || t('describe.noName')}</strong>
                  <span className={s.quiet}>{sayText('tryit.valueKind', { kind: kindWords(kind) })}</span>
                  {mark && <span className={s.changed}>{mark}</span>}
                </div>
                <div className={s.valueBody}>
                  <PhraseView phrase={sayValue(ctx.doc, value, ctx.names, kind, { valueId: id, catalogue: ctx.catalogue, links: values })} />
                </div>
                <div className={s.quiet}>
                  <PhraseView phrase={sources[id] ?? [t('tryit.from.unknown')]} />
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * The Task tab: the task exactly as the person acted as sees it (the FormView slot), or who is
 * asked and a one-click "Act as <them>"; the start form before the request starts, and "Start it
 * as <connection> would"; the card for another system the request is held on; and, when it is
 * stuck, why and what can be done.
 */
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Field as CatalogueField, Location, StartsWhen } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeLocation, describeStartsWhen, getAction, getStage, getTask, reveal, Slot, stageOf, toText, type DescribeEnv,
} from '@/model';
import type { Json, KnownLookups, OpenTask, Ref, Refusal, StuckDetail, StuckReason } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Callout, Field, Icon, Select, TextArea, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { startTask, type TryItController, type TryItState } from './controller';
import { CallAnswerChoice, CallSettings, operationOf, WaitingCall, type PretendCtx } from './Pretend';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { refusalWords, refusedBecause, unfinishedAt } from './refusals';
import { joinList, joinNames, named, say, sayText } from './say';
import { connectionLabel, reasonClause, reasonWhatYouCanDo, stageChip } from './story';
import { nameOfRef, refKey, type Names } from './values';
import s from './tryit.module.css';

export interface TaskCtx {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  state: TryItState;
  controller: TryItController;
}

const lookupsOf = (groups: Record<string, string[]>): KnownLookups => ({
  membersOf: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(groups).map(([g, ids]) => [g, ids.map((id): Ref => ({ type: 'user', id }))])),
});

/** Refusals in words, under the form. */
function RefusalList({ ctx, list, button }: { ctx: TaskCtx; list: Refusal[]; button?: string }) {
  const { state, doc, env } = ctx;
  if (!list.length) return null;
  const words = [...new Set(list.map((r) => refusalWords({ doc, env, names: state.names, as: state.actingAs, ...(button ? { button: button as `btn_${string}` } : {}) }, r)))];
  return (
    <Callout tone="danger">
      <strong>{t('tryit.notDone')}</strong>{' '}
      {words.map((w, i) => (
        <span key={i}>{w} </span>
      ))}
    </Callout>
  );
}

export function TaskTab({ ctx }: { ctx: TaskCtx }) {
  const { state, doc, catalogue, controller } = ctx;
  const pretend: PretendCtx = { doc, env: ctx.env, catalogue, names: state.names, calls: state.calls, controller, busy: state.busy, seq: state.view?.lastSeq ?? 0 };
  return (
    <div className={s.taskTab}>
      {state.requestId && state.view ? <OnTheRequest ctx={ctx} pretend={pretend} /> : <BeforeStart ctx={ctx} />}
      <CallSettings ctx={pretend} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Before it starts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function BeforeStart({ ctx }: { ctx: TaskCtx }) {
  const { state, doc, controller } = ctx;
  const task = startTask(doc);
  const name = state.starter ? nameOfRef(state.names, state.starter) : t('tryit.someone');
  const firstButton = task?.buttons[0];
  const refusals = state.refusals?.place === 'start' ? state.refusals.list : [];
  return (
    <>
      {task && (
        <section className={s.taskCard} aria-label={sayText('tryit.taskOf', { task: getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage)?.name || t('describe.noName') })}>
          <header className={s.taskHead}>
            <p className={s.exactly}>
              <Icon name="eye" size={14} /> {sayText('tryit.exactlyStart', { name })}
            </p>
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="sample" onClick={() => void controller.fillFromSample()}>
              {t('tryit.fillFromSample')}
            </Button>
          </header>
          <Slot
            name="FormView"
            doc={doc}
            taskId={task.id}
            mode="answer"
            answers={state.startAnswers}
            onAnswersChange={(next) => controller.setStartAnswers(next)}
            values={{}}
            request={{ ...(state.starter ? { requester: state.starter } : {}), ...(doc.sampleRequest?.startedOn ? { startedOn: doc.sampleRequest.startedOn } : {}) }}
            lookups={lookupsOf(state.groups)}
            refusals={refusals}
            onPress={(button) => void controller.start(button as `btn_${string}`)}
            busy={state.busy}
          />
          {firstButton && <p className={s.quiet}>{sayText('tryit.startHint', { button: firstButton.label || t('describe.noName') })}</p>}
        </section>
      )}
      {(doc.start?.startsWhen ?? []).map((b) => (
        <StartFromSystem key={b.id} ctx={ctx} binding={b} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function StartRefused({ ctx, binding, refusals }: { ctx: TaskCtx; binding: string; refusals: Refusal[] }) {
  const b = ctx.doc.start?.startsWhen?.find((x) => x.id === binding);
  const entry = ctx.catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === b?.trigger);
  const connection = connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, entry?.connection);
  const codes = [...new Set(refusals.map((r) => r.code))];
  // An unfinished "Starts when" says which part is not finished, each with Show me.
  const parts = refusals.some((r) => r.code === 'unfinished')
    ? unfinishedAt(ctx.doc, ctx.env, ctx.state.hostFindings, refusals.find((r) => r.code === 'unfinished')?.location?.item ?? binding)
    : [];
  const others = refusals.filter((r) => r.code !== 'unfinished' || !parts.length);
  return (
    <Callout tone="danger">
      <p className={s.calloutPara}>
        {sayText('tryit.sentRefused', { why: joinNames(codes.map(refusedBecause)), connection })}{' '}
        {[...new Set(others.map((r) => refusalWords({ doc: ctx.doc, env: ctx.env, names: ctx.state.names, connection }, r)))].map((w) => (
          <span key={w}>{w} </span>
        ))}
      </p>
      {parts.length > 0 && <UnfinishedParts title={t('tryit.sentRefusedParts')} parts={parts} />}
    </Callout>
  );
}

/** "What is not finished:" each To do's cause, with Show me. */
function UnfinishedParts({ title, parts }: { title: string; parts: { cause: string; location: Location }[] }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.unfinished}>
      <p className={s.calloutPara}>
        <strong>{title}</strong>
      </p>
      <ul className={s.unfinishedList}>
        {parts.map((p) => (
          <li key={p.cause}>
            <span>{p.cause}</span>{' '}
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="arrow-right" onClick={() => reveal(p.location)} aria-label={sayText('tryit.showMeWhat', { what: p.cause })}>
              {t('tryit.showMe')}
            </Button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

/** "Start it as Helpdesk would": what the other system sends, from its sample, editable. */
function StartFromSystem({ ctx, binding }: { ctx: TaskCtx; binding: StartsWhen }) {
  const { catalogue, state, controller, doc } = ctx;
  const entry = catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === binding.trigger);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'trigger') return null;
  const connection = connectionLabel(catalogue, entry.connection);
  const sent = state.sent[binding.id] ?? {};
  const change = (id: string, v: Json | undefined) => {
    const next = { ...sent };
    if (v === undefined) delete next[id];
    else next[id] = v;
    controller.setSent(binding.id, next);
  };
  return (
    <section className={s.taskCard} aria-label={sayText('tryit.startAsSystem', { connection })}>
      <p className={s.orLine}>{t('tryit.or')}</p>
      <h3 className={s.sectionTitle}>
        <Icon name="connected" size={14} /> <PhraseView phrase={describeStartsWhen(doc, binding, ctx.env)} />
      </h3>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{sayText('tryit.startAsSystemHint', { connection })}</p>
      <div className={s.sentFields}>
        {entry.event.map((f) => (
          <SentField key={f.id} field={f} value={sent[f.id]} names={state.names} onChange={(v) => change(f.id, v)} thing={connection} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <Button variant="secondary" icon="play" onClick={() => void controller.startFrom(binding.id)}>
        {sayText('tryit.startAsSystem', { connection })}
      </Button>
      {/* What came of it, right under the button that was pressed, and read out. */}
      <div role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {state.notice?.kind === 'notMatched' && state.notice.binding === binding.id && <Callout tone="neutral">{t('tryit.sentNotFit')}</Callout>}
        {state.notice?.kind === 'startRefused' && state.notice.binding === binding.id && (
          <StartRefused ctx={ctx} binding={binding.id} refusals={state.notice.refusals} />
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function SentField({ field, value, names, onChange, thing }: { field: CatalogueField; value: Json | undefined; names: Names; onChange(v: Json | undefined): void; thing: string }) {
  const label = sayText('tryit.sentField', { thing, field: field.label });
  if (field.kind === 'yesNo') {
    return (
      <Field label={label}>
        <Select
          value={value === true ? 'yes' : value === false ? 'no' : ''}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value === '' ? undefined : e.target.value === 'yes')}
          options={[{ value: '', label: '' }, { value: 'yes', label: t('tryit.yes') }, { value: 'no', label: t('tryit.no') }]}
        />
      </Field>
    );
  }
  if (field.kind === 'choice' && field.choices) {
    return (
      <Field label={label}>
        <Select
          value={typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value || undefined)}
          options={[{ value: '', label: '' }, ...field.choices]}
        />
      </Field>
    );
  }
  if (field.kind === 'person') {
    const people = Object.entries(names).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('user:')).sort((a, b) => a[1].localeCompare(b[1]));
    const current = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) && typeof value.id === 'string' ? `user:${value.id}` : '';
    return (
      <Field label={label}>
        <Select
          value={current}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value ? { type: 'user', id: e.target.value.slice(5) } : undefined)}
          options={[{ value: '', label: t('tryit.nobody') }, ...people.map(([k, n]) => ({ value: k, label: n }))]}
        />
      </Field>
    );
  }
  if (field.kind === 'text' || field.kind === 'longText' || field.kind === 'number') {
    const text = typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' ? String(value) : '';
    const set = (v: string) => onChange(v === '' ? undefined : field.kind === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(Number(v)) ? Number(v) : v);
    return (
      <Field label={label}>
        {field.kind === 'longText' ? (
          <TextArea rows={2} value={text} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)} />
        ) : (
          <TextInput value={text} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)} />
        )}
      </Field>
    );
  }
  // A connection's choice, a list or a group of fields: shown as sent.
  const shown = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) && 'label' in value ? String(value.label) : value === undefined ? '' : JSON.stringify(value);
  return (
    <div className={s.sentRead}>
      <span className={s.quiet}>{label}</span> <strong>{shown}</strong>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── On the request ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Whether the person acted as may answer this task at all (not "not asked here"). */
const isMine = (task: OpenTask) => task.buttonStates.length > 0 && task.buttonStates.some((b) => b.available || b.refusals.every((r) => r.code !== 'not-assignee'));

function OnTheRequest({ ctx, pretend }: { ctx: TaskCtx; pretend: PretendCtx }) {
  const { state, doc } = ctx;
  const view = state.view!;
  const name = state.actingAs ? nameOfRef(state.names, state.actingAs) : t('tryit.someone');
  const mine = view.tasks.filter(isMine);
  const others = view.tasks.filter((x) => !isMine(x));
  const waiting = view.actions.filter((a) => a.call);
  const ending = view.closed?.ending ? getStage(doc, view.closed.ending)?.name || t('describe.noName') : undefined;
  return (
    <>
      <p className={s.exactly}>
        <Icon name="eye" size={14} /> {sayText('tryit.exactly', { name })}
      </p>
      {state.refusals?.place === 'call' && <RefusalList ctx={ctx} list={state.refusals.list} />}
      {view.stuck && <StuckBox ctx={ctx} pretend={pretend} />}
      {waiting.map((a) => (
        <WaitingCall key={a.call} ctx={pretend} open={a} outbox={state.outbox} />
      ))}
      {mine.map((task) => (
        <TaskCard key={task.task} ctx={ctx} task={task} />
      ))}
      {others.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.notAsked}>
          {!mine.length && <p>{sayText('tryit.notAskedHere', { name })}</p>}
          {others.map((task) => (
            <OtherTask key={task.task} ctx={ctx} task={task} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {view.closed && (
        <Callout tone="neutral" icon="ending">
          {ending ? sayText('tryit.endedText', { ending }) : t('tryit.closedText')}
        </Callout>
      )}
      {!view.closed && !view.stuck && !view.tasks.length && !waiting.length && <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.nothingOpen')}</p>}
    </>
  );
}

/** Who a task asks, in words: "Payments approvers (Marcus Lee and Hannah Okafor)". */
function askedWords(ctx: TaskCtx, askedOf: readonly Ref[]) {
  const { state, controller } = ctx;
  return joinList(askedOf.map((r) => {
    if (r.type === 'user') return [named('person', nameOfRef(state.names, r), r.id)];
    const members = controller.people([r]).map((p) => nameOfRef(state.names, p));
    return [named('group', nameOfRef(state.names, r), r.id), ...(members.length ? [` (${joinNames(members)})`] : [])];
  }));
}

function TaskCard({ ctx, task }: { ctx: TaskCtx; task: OpenTask }) {
  const { state, doc, controller } = ctx;
  const view = state.view!;
  const authored = getTask(doc, task.location.item);
  const stage = getStage(doc, view.stage.item);
  const refusals = state.refusals?.place === `task:${task.task}` ? state.refusals.list : [];
  const status = view.status;
  const group = task.askedOf.some((r) => r.type === 'group');
  if (!authored) return null;
  return (
    <section className={s.taskCard} aria-label={sayText('tryit.taskOf', { task: authored.name || stage?.name || t('describe.noName') })}>
      <header className={s.taskHeadStack}>
        <h3 className={s.taskTitle}>
          {status && <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: `var(--st-${status.colour})` }} aria-hidden="true" />}
          {stage?.name || t('describe.noName')}
          {authored.name && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.separator')}{authored.name}</span>}
        </h3>
        <p className={s.quiet}>
          <PhraseView phrase={askedWordsSentence(ctx, task.askedOf)} />
          {group && ` ${t('tryit.oneAnswer')}`}
        </p>
      </header>
      <Slot
        name="FormView"
        doc={doc}
        taskId={authored.id}
        mode="answer"
        answers={controller.answersFor(task.task, authored.id)}
        onAnswersChange={(next) => controller.setAnswers(task.task, next)}
        values={view.values}
        request={{ ...(view.requester ? { requester: view.requester } : {}), startedOn: view.startedAt.slice(0, 10) }}
        lookups={lookupsOf(state.groups)}
        buttonStates={task.buttonStates}
        refusals={refusals}
        onPress={(button) => void controller.act(task.task, button as `btn_${string}`)}
        busy={state.busy}
      />
      <ButtonRefusals ctx={ctx} task={task} />
    </section>
  );
}

const askedWordsSentence = (ctx: TaskCtx, askedOf: readonly Ref[]) => say('tryit.askedOf', { who: askedWords(ctx, askedOf) });

/** Why this person cannot press any button (asked through a group, but it is their own request ...). */
function ButtonRefusals({ ctx, task }: { ctx: TaskCtx; task: OpenTask }) {
  const blocked = task.buttonStates.length > 0 && task.buttonStates.every((b) => !b.available);
  if (!blocked) return null;
  const first = task.buttonStates[0]?.refusals ?? [];
  const words = [...new Set(first.map((r) => refusalWords({ doc: ctx.doc, env: ctx.env, names: ctx.state.names, as: ctx.state.actingAs }, r)))];
  return (
    <>
      <Callout tone="todo">{words.join(' ') || sayText('tryit.cannotAnswer', { name: ctx.state.actingAs ? nameOfRef(ctx.state.names, ctx.state.actingAs) : '' })}</Callout>
      <ActAsSomeone ctx={ctx} task={task} />
    </>
  );
}

/** Someone the test host knows who can answer a task: the first person asked, not the requester when they may not answer. */
function whoCanAnswer(ctx: TaskCtx, task: OpenTask): Ref | undefined {
  const { state, doc, controller } = ctx;
  const authored = getTask(doc, task.location.item);
  const requester = state.view?.requester;
  return controller.people(task.askedOf).find((p) => {
    if (state.actingAs && refKey(p) === refKey(state.actingAs)) return false;
    return authored?.requesterCanAnswer !== false || !requester || refKey(requester) !== refKey(p);
  });
}

function ActAsSomeone({ ctx, task }: { ctx: TaskCtx; task: OpenTask }) {
  const who = whoCanAnswer(ctx, task);
  if (!who) return null;
  return (
    <Button icon="person" onClick={() => void ctx.controller.switchTo(who)}>
      {sayText('tryit.actAs', { name: nameOfRef(ctx.state.names, who) })}
    </Button>
  );
}

/** A task this person is not asked: who is, and "Act as <them>". */
function OtherTask({ ctx, task }: { ctx: TaskCtx; task: OpenTask }) {
  const { doc } = ctx;
  const stage = stageOf(doc, task.location.item);
  return (
    <div className={s.otherTask}>
      <p>
        <PhraseView phrase={say('tryit.whoIsAskedNow', { stage: [stageChip(doc, stage?.id)], who: askedWords(ctx, task.askedOf) })} />
      </p>
      <ActAsSomeone ctx={ctx} task={task} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Stuck ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const RETRYABLE: readonly StuckReason[] = ['action-failed', 'nobody-to-ask'];

/**
 * The engine's own detail of a stuck request, only for the people who look after stuck requests
 * and behind a disclosure: what the other system said, and the platform's technical text as it
 * recorded it (E-27). Never the explanation itself; the box above says that in words.
 */
function TechnicalDetail({ detail }: { detail: StuckDetail | undefined }) {
  if (!detail || (detail.text === undefined && detail.outsideText === undefined)) return null;
  return (
    <details className={s.detail}>
      <summary>{t('tryit.stuck.detail')}</summary>
      <dl className={s.rows}>
        {detail.outsideText !== undefined && (
          <>
            <dt>{t('tryit.stuck.detail.said')}</dt>
            <dd>{detail.outsideText ? <q>{detail.outsideText}</q> : t('tryit.stuck.detail.noText')}</dd>
          </>
        )}
        {detail.text !== undefined && (
          <>
            <dt>{t('tryit.stuck.detail.engine')}</dt>
            <dd>
              <code>{detail.text}</code>
            </dd>
          </>
        )}
      </dl>
    </details>
  );
}

function StuckBox({ ctx, pretend }: { ctx: TaskCtx; pretend: PretendCtx }) {
  const { state, doc, env, controller } = ctx;
  const view = state.view!;
  const stuck = view.stuck!;
  const [reason, setReason] = useState(t('tryit.stuck.reasonDefault'));
  const reasonId = useId();
  const stageId = view.stage.item;
  const where = stuck.location ? toText(describeLocation(doc, stuck.location, env)) : '';
  const admins = controller.people(state.stuckPeople);
  const action = stuck.reason === 'action-failed' ? getAction(doc, stuck.location?.item) : undefined;
  const op = operationOf(ctx.catalogue, action);
  const refusals = state.refusals?.place === 'admin' ? state.refusals.list : [];
  // Stuck at an unfinished part: which one, by name (the draft's To do), each with Show me.
  const parts = stuck.reason === 'unfinished' ? unfinishedAt(doc, env, state.hostFindings, stuck.location?.item) : [];
  return (
    <section className={s.stuck} aria-labelledby="tryit-stuck">
      <h3 id="tryit-stuck" className={s.stuckTitle}>
        <Icon name="warning" size={16} />
        <PhraseView phrase={[`${t('word.stuck')}: `, stageChip(doc, stageId)]} />
      </h3>
      <p>{sayText('tryit.stuck.why', { reason: reasonClause(stuck.reason) })}</p>
      {parts.length > 0 ? (
        <UnfinishedParts title={t('tryit.stuck.unfinishedParts')} parts={parts} />
      ) : where && (
        <p className={s.stuckWhere}>
          {sayText('tryit.stuck.where', { where })}{' '}
          {stuck.location && (
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="arrow-right" onClick={() => reveal(stuck.location!)}>
              {t('tryit.showMe')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className={s.quiet}>{reasonWhatYouCanDo(stuck.reason)}</p>
      {view.viewer.isAdmin && <TechnicalDetail detail={stuck.admin} />}
      {view.viewer.isAdmin ? (
        <div className={s.adminBox}>
          {op && RETRYABLE.includes(stuck.reason) && (
            <>
              <p className={s.quiet}>{sayText('tryit.stuck.changeAnswer', { action: op.label })}</p>
              <CallAnswerChoice ctx={pretend} op={op} label={sayText('tryit.pretend.label', { action: op.label })} />
            </>
          )}
          <div className={s.inlineField}>
            <label htmlFor={reasonId}>{t('tryit.stuck.reasonLabel')}</label>
            <TextInput id={reasonId} value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div className={s.answerPair}>
            {RETRYABLE.includes(stuck.reason) && (
              <Button variant="primary" icon="redo" onClick={() => void controller.admin('retry', reason)}>
                {t('tryit.stuck.retry')}
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button variant={RETRYABLE.includes(stuck.reason) ? 'secondary' : 'primary'} icon="close" onClick={() => void controller.admin('close', reason)}>
              {t('tryit.stuck.close')}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <RefusalList ctx={ctx} list={refusals} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={s.adminBox}>
          <p>{sayText('tryit.stuck.onlyAdmins', { who: joinNames(admins.map((a) => nameOfRef(state.names, a))) || t('tryit.someone') })}</p>
          {admins[0] && (
            <Button icon="person" onClick={() => void controller.switchTo(admins[0]!)}>
              {sayText('tryit.actAs', { name: nameOfRef(state.names, admins[0]) })}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Try it, rendered on the stand-in's own workflows: the demo's happy path, Reject with and without
 * a Reason, the send-back, several people asked at once (the "no longer needed" case), a failed Jira
 * action then Retry, and the integrated sample's "Wait for" answered both ways. The FormView and
 * ReadOnlyDiagram slots are filled with small stand-ins here (their owners test the real ones), so
 * these tests see exactly what Try it hands them.
 */
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { act, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  getTask, openWorkflow, resetSessionForTests, SlotsProvider, useEditor, type FormViewProps, type ReadOnlyDiagramProps,
} from '@/model';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider } from '@/services';
import { TryItPage } from './TryItPage';
import { questionsOf } from './values';

/** The form, as plainly as possible: a box per text question, a button per button, the refusals by code. */
function TestForm(props: FormViewProps) {
  const task = getTask(props.doc, props.taskId);
  if (!task) return null;
  return (
    <form aria-label={`form ${props.taskId}`} onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      {questionsOf(task)
        .filter((q) => ['text', 'longText', 'number'].includes(q.kind))
        .map((q) => (
          <label key={q.id}>
            {q.label}
            <input
              value={typeof props.answers[q.id] === 'string' ? (props.answers[q.id] as string) : ''}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const next = { ...props.answers };
                if (e.target.value) next[q.id] = e.target.value;
                else delete next[q.id];
                props.onAnswersChange(next);
              }}
            />
          </label>
        ))}
      {task.buttons.map((b) => {
        const engine = props.buttonStates?.find((x) => x.button === b.id);
        return (
          <button key={b.id} type="button" aria-disabled={engine && !engine.available ? true : undefined} onClick={() => props.onPress?.(b.id)}>
            {b.label}
          </button>
        );
      })}
      {(props.refusals ?? []).map((r, i) => (
        <p key={i} role="alert">{`refused ${r.code} ${r.location?.item ?? ''}`}</p>
      ))}
    </form>
  );
}

function TestDiagram(props: ReadOnlyDiagramProps) {
  return (
    <div
      data-testid="diagram"
      aria-label={props.label}
      data-at={(props.at ?? []).join(',')}
      data-visited={(props.visited ?? []).join(',')}
      data-taken={(props.taken ?? []).join(',')}
      data-stuck={props.stuckAt ?? ''}
    />
  );
}

async function setup(workflow = 'change-request') {
  const services = createStandinServices().services;
  render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={{ FormView: TestForm, ReadOnlyDiagram: TestDiagram }}>
        <MemoryRouter>
          <TryItPage />
        </MemoryRouter>
      </SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>,
  );
  await act(() => openWorkflow(services, workflow));
  await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Acting as' });
  return { user: userEvent.setup(), services };
}

const panel = () => screen.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'The test request' });
const actingAs = () => within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'Acting as' });
const happened = () => document.querySelector('[aria-live="polite"]') as HTMLElement;
const diagram = () => screen.getByTestId('diagram');
const press = async (user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>, name: string) => {
  await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name }));
};
const expectActingAs = (name: string) => waitFor(() => expect(within(actingAs()).getByText(name)).toBeInTheDocument());
const expectHappened = (text: string | RegExp) => waitFor(() => expect(happened()).toHaveTextContent(text));

async function tab(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>, name: RegExp) {
  await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('tab', { name }));
}

// Each test plays a whole request through the stand-in: under a full parallel `npm run test` that
// can take longer than vitest's default 5 s (it did: 5363 ms), so each gets 30 s.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 30_000 });

afterEach(() => resetSessionForTests());

describe('Try it on the demo', () => {
  it('runs the happy path as three people: the start form from the sample, approval, Jira by itself, development, Released', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    // The start form, filled in from the sample request, as Priya Raman, the requester.
    expect(within(actingAs()).getByText('Priya Raman')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(actingAs()).getByText('Requester · fills in Request form')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Title')).toHaveValue('Rotate payment gateway API keys');
    expect(screen.getByRole('note')).toHaveTextContent('Every connection is pretended: nothing leaves the platform.');
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_request_form');
    // The head names the request by its title, once; the test's own name is the chip beside it.
    expect(within(panel()).getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveTextContent('Rotate payment gateway API keys');
    expect(within(panel()).getAllByText('Test request 1')).toHaveLength(1);
    // Above the diagram: what its marks mean, in words, and which sample it shows (mockup 08).
    const legend = screen.getByRole('list', { name: 'What the diagram shows' });
    expect(legend).toHaveTextContent('Now here');
    expect(legend).toHaveTextContent('Arrow taken');
    expect(legend).toHaveTextContent('Not reached yet');
    expect(screen.getByText('Sample: Rotate payment gateway API keys (Test request 1)')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(screen.getByRole('note')).getByRole('link', { name: /Stop testing/ })).toBeInTheDocument();

    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectHappened('Priya Raman pressed Submit, so it went to Domain approval.');
    expect(happened()).toHaveTextContent('By the arrow In all other cases');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    expect(within(actingAs()).getByText('One of Payments approvers')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(panel()).getByText(/Asked of/)).toHaveTextContent('Asked of Payments approvers (Marcus Lee and Hannah Okafor).');
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_domain_approval');
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-taken', 'ar_rf_other');

    await press(user, 'Approve');
    await expectHappened('Marcus Lee pressed Approve, so it went to Create Jira issue. Create Jira issue happened by itself and went on to Development.');
    await expectActingAs('Diego Santos');
    expect(diagram().getAttribute('data-visited')?.split(',')).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['st_request_form', 'st_domain_approval', 'st_create_jira_issue']));
    // "Now you are" says why: who the stage asks, who that is here, and who picked them (mockup 08 why).
    await expectHappened("Diego Santos: Development asks Eng lead, which here is Diego Santos (Marcus Lee's answer at Domain approval).");

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Release notes'), 'Rotated.');
    await press(user, 'Mark released');
    await expectHappened('Diego Santos pressed Mark released, so it went to Released.');
    expect(within(panel()).getByText(/has finished at Released/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_released');

    // So far: why the first arrow was taken, with what it read; the values with where they came from.
    await tab(user, /So far/);
    // What core says the arrows read (tryit.test.ts says a Yes/No column as a statement when core reports one).
    expect(within(panel()).getAllByText(/It read:/)[0]).toHaveTextContent('It read: Primary domain is Payments');
    // An arrow taken by a button: the button pressed is already said ("pressed Approve"), not read again.
    const reads = within(panel()).getAllByText(/It read:/).map((p) => p.textContent ?? '');
    expect(reads.join(' ')).not.toMatch(/button pressed at/);
    // Every entry of the engine's story is said: who is asked now and the status, in words.
    expect(within(panel()).getByRole('tabpanel')).toHaveTextContent('Domain approval asks Payments approvers.');
    expect(within(panel()).getByRole('tabpanel')).toHaveTextContent('Its status is now Waiting for approval.');
    const values = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'Values now' });
    expect(values).toHaveTextContent("Priya Raman's answer at Request form");
    expect(values).toHaveTextContent('Kind: text');

    // The Test outbox: three groups, each stamped, the messages to the people they really reach.
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    const messages = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Messages/ });
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('Not really sent');
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('To Marcus Lee and Hannah Okafor');
    // Messages name the request by its title, as they would for real, not by the test's label.
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('You have something to do on Rotate payment gateway API keys');
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('the request Rotate payment gateway API keys in');
    expect(messages).not.toHaveTextContent('Sent by the platform by itself');
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent("The platform always sends this one (not one of this workflow's actions)");
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('To Diego Santos');
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('Your Jira issue for this change is ready: CHG-101');
    const done = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Done in other systems/ });
    expect(done).toHaveTextContent('Jira: Create a Jira issue');
    expect(done).toHaveTextContent('Not really done');
    const told = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Other systems told/ });
    expect(told).toHaveTextContent('It started');
    // request.ended@1 carries the ending it finished at (E-32), the status and who closed it.
    const ended = within(told).getAllByRole('listitem').find((li) => li.textContent?.includes('It finished at Released'))!;
    expect(ended).toHaveTextContent('StatusReleased');
    expect(ended).toHaveTextContent('Closed byThe workflow, at an ending');

    // The test request became the sample request.
    expect(useEditor.getState().doc?.sampleRequest?.answers.v_title).toEqual({ text: 'Rotate payment gateway API keys' });
  });

  it('Reject without a Reason is refused and the request stays; with one it is Rejected and the requester is told', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    await user.clear(screen.getByLabelText('Reason'));
    await press(user, 'Reject');
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(panel()).getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('refused invalid-data q_reason'));
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_domain_approval');

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Reason'), 'Too risky before the freeze.');
    await press(user, 'Reject');
    await expectHappened('Marcus Lee pressed Reject, so it went to Rejected.');
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    const messages = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Messages/ });
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('To Priya Raman');
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('Your change request was rejected');
  });

  it('Request changes sends it back to the requester, who submits again', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    await press(user, 'Request changes');
    await expectHappened('Marcus Lee pressed Request changes, so it went back to Request form.');
    await expectActingAs('Priya Raman');
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_request_form');
    expect(within(panel()).getByText(/Status people see/).parentElement).toHaveTextContent('Needs changes');
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectHappened('Priya Raman pressed Submit, so it went to Domain approval.');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
  });

  it('a failed Jira action leaves it stuck; the person who looks after stuck requests changes the answer and retries', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    await user.selectOptions(within(panel()).getByLabelText('What Jira (Create a Jira issue) answers'), 'fail:project-not-found');
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    await press(user, 'Approve');
    await expectHappened('It is stuck at Create Jira issue: one of its actions did not work.');
    await expectActingAs('Sam Carter');
    const stuck = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /Stuck/ });
    expect(stuck).toHaveTextContent('It cannot go on: one of its actions did not work.');
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-stuck', 'st_create_jira_issue');
    // Retry is offered for a failed action, and Close.
    expect(within(stuck).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close the request' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The engine's own detail only behind "Technical detail", for the person who looks after stuck requests.
    const detail = stuck.querySelector('details')!;
    expect(detail).not.toHaveAttribute('open');
    expect(within(detail).getByText('Technical detail')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(detail).toHaveTextContent("What the other system saidProject 'CHX' does not exist.");
    await user.selectOptions(within(stuck).getByLabelText('What Create a Jira issue answers'), 'sample');
    await user.click(within(stuck).getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    await expectHappened(/Sam Carter retried it/);
    await expectHappened('went on to Development.');
    await expectActingAs('Diego Santos');
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    const messages = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Messages/ });
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('Rotate payment gateway API keys is stuck at Create Jira issue');
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('one of its actions did not work. Once you have put right what made it fail');
  });

  it('switching shows that person\'s view: someone not asked sees who is, and "Act as" them', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    await user.click(within(actingAs()).getByRole('button', { name: /Switch who you are acting as/ }));
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('menuitem', { name: /^Priya Raman/ }));
    await expectActingAs('Priya Raman');
    expect(within(panel()).getByText('Priya Raman is not asked anything on this request now.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Act as Marcus Lee' }));
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
  });
});

describe('Try it on an unfinished draft', () => {
  it('a changed draft is noticed; Start again runs it, and the request is stuck at the unfinished part, with Close only', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    // An arrow with nowhere to go stops a request (core's compile; nobody asked no longer does, E-28).
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: 'ar_dev_released', goTo: null }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('note')).toHaveTextContent('The draft has changed since this test request started.'));
    await user.click(within(screen.getByRole('note')).getByRole('button', { name: /Start again/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('note')).not.toHaveTextContent('The draft has changed'));
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    await press(user, 'Approve');
    // The request runs on until it meets the unfinished arrow: when Development is answered (core-api.md 10.2).
    await expectActingAs('Diego Santos');
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Release notes'), 'Rotated.');
    await press(user, 'Mark released');
    await expectHappened('It is stuck at Development: it reached a part of the workflow that is not finished yet');
    await expectActingAs('Sam Carter');
    const stuck = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /Stuck/ });
    // It names the unfinished part (the draft's To do), not only the general reason, each with Show me.
    expect(stuck).toHaveTextContent('What is not finished:');
    expect(within(stuck).getByRole('button', { name: /^Show me: / })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(stuck).queryByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' })).toBeNull();
    await user.click(within(stuck).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close the request' }));
    await expectHappened('Sam Carter closed it: "Tried in Try it".');
    // Core sends no stuck message for Try it's unfinished (core-api.md 10.3): the outbox has none.
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    expect(within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Messages/ })).not.toHaveTextContent('is stuck at');
  });
});

describe('Try it on a "when" that is not decided', () => {
  it('stops there, and says which "when" is not decided, with Show me (editor-model.md section 11)', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('arrow.setWhen', { arrow: 'ar_rf_no_approval', when: { type: 'condition' } }));
    await user.click(within(await screen.findByRole('note')).getByRole('button', { name: /Start again/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('note')).not.toHaveTextContent('The draft has changed'));
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectHappened(/It is stuck at Request form: it reached a part of the workflow that is not finished yet/);
    await expectActingAs('Sam Carter');
    const stuck = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /Stuck/ });
    expect(stuck).toHaveTextContent('What is not finished:');
    // Which "when": the draft's To do at the part core names (item.partMissing at when.condition).
    expect(stuck).toHaveTextContent('The "when" of the arrow "Domain needs no approval" is not decided yet.');
    expect(within(stuck).getByRole('button', { name: /^Show me: / })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-stuck', 'st_request_form');
  });
});

describe('Try it with several people asked at once', () => {
  it('the Security team rejects first: the domain approvers no longer need to answer, and are told', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('several-at-once');
    await press(user, 'Submit');
    await expectActingAs('Marcus Lee');
    // Marcus answers the domain approval; the Security team's task is someone else's.
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: /^Act as Tom Becker/ }));
    await expectActingAs('Tom Becker');
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Security notes'), 'Keys are logged.');
    await press(user, 'Reject');
    await expectHappened(/Tom Becker pressed Reject for/);
    await expectHappened('Payments approvers no longer need to answer at Domain approval. They are told they no longer need to answer.');
    await expectHappened('Rejected');
  });
});

describe('Try it on the integrated sample', () => {
  it('another system starts it; the deploy is held and the author answers Succeeded', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('integrated-sample');
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Start it as Helpdesk would' }));
    const card = await within(panel()).findByRole('region', { name: /^Answer for Wait for Deploy pipeline/ });
    expect(card).toHaveTextContent('In real use Deploy pipeline answers by itself. Here, you answer for it.');
    expect(card).toHaveTextContent('It was sent');
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_deploy');
    await expectHappened(/Helpdesk started it, so it went to Find service owner/);
    // Each answer says where it takes the request before it is chosen (mockup 14 try-it).
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: /^Succeeded/ })).toHaveTextContent('On to Deployed; "Change deployed" is told.'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: /^Failed/ })).toHaveTextContent('Saved as Deploy failed and Deploy failure code; on to Fix deployment.'));
    expect(card).not.toHaveTextContent(/service: |summary: /);
    await user.click(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: /^Succeeded/ }));
    await expectHappened(/You answered for Deploy pipeline: Succeeded/);
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    const told = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Other systems told/ });
    expect(told).toHaveTextContent('"Change deployed"');
    // What was told is labelled by what fills it, as the author knows it, never by the key sent.
    expect(told).toHaveTextContent('Service');
    expect(told).toHaveTextContent('Pipeline run');
    expect(told).not.toHaveTextContent(/runLink|\bservice\b|\bsummary\b/);
  });

  it('an unfinished "Starts when" refuses to start and says which part is not finished; the outbox message says why too', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('integrated-sample');
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: 'sw_helpdesk_ticket', question: 'q_service', answer: { formula: '', readsAs: '' } }));
    await user.click(within(await screen.findByRole('note')).getByRole('button', { name: /Start again/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('note')).not.toHaveTextContent('The draft has changed'));
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Start it as Helpdesk would' }));
    await within(panel()).findByText(/No request was started/);
    const box = within(panel()).getByRole('tabpanel');
    expect(box).toHaveTextContent('No request was started: its "Starts when" is not finished yet in this draft.');
    expect(box).toHaveTextContent('In real use Helpdesk gets this reason in its answer');
    expect(box).toHaveTextContent('What is not finished:');
    expect(box).toHaveTextContent('Service');
    expect(within(box).getByRole('button', { name: /^Show me: / })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(box).not.toHaveTextContent('it could not be started');
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    const messages = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Messages/ });
    expect(messages).toHaveTextContent('the request could not be started: its "Starts when" is not finished yet in this draft.');
  });

  it('the author answers Failed: the problem is saved and the other arrow is taken', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('integrated-sample');
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Start it as Helpdesk would' }));
    const card = await within(panel()).findByRole('region', { name: /^Answer for Wait for Deploy pipeline/ });
    await user.selectOptions(within(card).getByLabelText('Why it failed'), 'deploy-failed');
    await user.click(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: /^Failed/ }));
    await expectHappened(/You answered for Deploy pipeline: Failed \(The deployment failed\), so it went to Fix deployment/);
    expect(diagram()).toHaveAttribute('data-at', 'st_fix_deployment');
    // A value holding the failure code is said in words, as the request page says it (fix2 n6).
    await tab(user, /So far/);
    const values = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'Values now' });
    expect(values).toHaveTextContent('The deployment failed');
    expect(values).not.toHaveTextContent('deploy-failed');
    // The message the author wrote holds the failure as the engine renders it: the catalogue's label (E-29),
    // shown as it would go out.
    expect(within(panel()).getByRole('tabpanel')).toHaveTextContent('failed with code The deployment failed. Fix issue: CHG-101".');
    expect(within(panel()).getByRole('tabpanel')).not.toHaveTextContent('deploy-failed');
  });

  it('"Wait for" in the story: the stage asked the connection, and the request stays there until it answers (fix2 n4)', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('integrated-sample');
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Start it as Helpdesk would' }));
    const card = await within(panel()).findByRole('region', { name: /^Answer for Wait for Deploy pipeline/ });
    await expectHappened('Deploy asked Deploy pipeline to deploy a service. The request stays at Deploy until Deploy pipeline answers.');
    expect(card).toHaveTextContent('The request stays at Deploy until Deploy pipeline answers.');
    expect(happened()).not.toHaveTextContent(/waiting/i);
    expect(card).not.toHaveTextContent(/waiting/i);
  });

  it('a value typed on the "Starts when" card is set by the workflow, not "what Helpdesk sent" (fix2 n5)', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('integrated-sample');
    act(() => void useEditor.getState().run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: 'sw_helpdesk_ticket', question: 'q_helpdesk_ticket', answer: { text: 'Typed by the author' } }));
    await user.click(within(await screen.findByRole('note')).getByRole('button', { name: /Start again/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('note')).not.toHaveTextContent('The draft has changed'));
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Start it as Helpdesk would' }));
    await within(panel()).findByRole('region', { name: /^Answer for Wait for Deploy pipeline/ });
    await tab(user, /So far/);
    const rows = within(within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: 'Values now' })).getAllByRole('listitem');
    const row = (name: string) => rows.find((r) => r.querySelector('strong')?.textContent === name)!;
    expect(row('Helpdesk ticket')).toHaveTextContent('set by the workflow itself whenever Helpdesk starts a request');
    expect(row('Helpdesk ticket')).not.toHaveTextContent('what Helpdesk sent');
    expect(row('Summary')).toHaveTextContent('what Helpdesk sent');
  });

  it('the outbox: a Look up under its own heading; what is always told carries the request, never answers (fix2 n9)', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup('integrated-sample');
    await user.click(within(panel()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Start it as Helpdesk would' }));
    await within(panel()).findByRole('region', { name: /^Answer for Wait for Deploy pipeline/ });
    await tab(user, /Test outbox/);
    const lookedUp = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Looked up in other systems/ });
    expect(lookedUp).toHaveTextContent('Service catalog: Look up a service');
    expect(lookedUp).toHaveTextContent('only reads');
    const done = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Done in other systems/ });
    expect(done).not.toHaveTextContent('Look up a service');
    expect(done).toHaveTextContent('Deploy pipeline: Deploy a service');
    const told = within(panel()).getByRole('region', { name: /^Other systems told/ });
    const started = within(told).getAllByRole('listitem').find((li) => li.textContent?.includes('It started'))!;
    // The request by its number, as it is told: its title is an answer, and answers are never told.
