/**
 * Route "/w/:workflowId/try": a test request on the draft as it is now (editor-model.md section 7,
 * section 9 "What happens to other people", section 10 "In Try it every connection is pretended";
 * mockups 08-try-it, 14-connections try-it, 10-several-at-once). Left: the read-only diagram with
 * where the request is, has been and is stuck, and what just happened. Right: who you are acting as,
 * then Task (exactly what that person sees), So far (the story and the values) and the Test outbox.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeFinding, describeWhoIsAsked, getStage, getTask, requestTitle, requestTitleAnswer, reveal, Slot, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv,
  useDoc, useSettings,
} from '@/model';
import type { Ref, RequestView } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, buttonClass, Callout, Card, EmptyState, Icon, Menu, Tabs, type MenuItem } from '@/ui';
import { startTask, type TryItController, type TryItState } from './controller';
import { outboxByLine, outboxEntryId, storyNotes, type OutboxCtx } from './outbox';
import { OutboxView } from './OutboxView';
import { PhraseView } from './PhraseView';
import { joinNames, sayText } from './say';
import { NotesView, SoFar, type LineNotes } from './SoFar';
import { storyLines, valueSources, type StoryCtx, type StoryLine } from './story';
import { TaskTab } from './TaskTab';
import { useTryIt } from './useTryIt';
import { nameOfRef, refKey } from './values';
import s from './tryit.module.css';

/** The draft without what Try it itself changes (the sample request) or what does not run (the layout). */
const runKey = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null) => {
  if (!doc) return '';
  const rest: Partial<AuthoredWorkflow> = { ...doc };
  delete rest.sampleRequest;
  delete rest.diagram;
  return JSON.stringify(rest);
};

export function TryItPage() {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const { controller, state } = useTryIt();
  if (!doc || !catalogue || !controller || state.status === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className={s.state} role="status">
        {t('tryit.loading')}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (state.status === 'failed') {
    return (
      <div className={s.state}>
        <Callout tone="danger">{t('tryit.failed')}</Callout>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return <TryIt controller={controller} state={state} current={doc} />;
}

function TryIt({ controller, state, current }: { controller: TryItController; state: TryItState; current: AuthoredWorkflow }) {
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const settings = useSettings();
  const doc = state.doc ?? current;
  const catalogue = env.catalogue ?? null;
  const changed = useMemo(() => runKey(current) !== runKey(state.doc), [current, state.doc]);
  const storyCtx: StoryCtx = { doc, env, catalogue, names: state.names };
  const lines = useMemo(() => (state.view ? storyLines(storyCtx, state.view) : []),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [state.view, state.names, doc, catalogue]);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('task');
  const testName = sayText('tryit.testRequest', { n: state.testNo });
  // What the request is called, by the model's one rule (the same as the request pages): its
  // title answer, else "Test request 1". Before it starts, the start form's answers as filled in.
  const held = state.view ? state.view.values : state.startAnswers;
  const by = state.view ? 'value' : 'question';
  const title = requestTitle(doc, held, testName, by);
  const titleAnswer = requestTitleAnswer(doc, held, by);
  const outboxCtx: OutboxCtx = {
    doc, env, catalogue, names: state.names, requestName: title, workflowName: settings?.name ?? '',
    ...(state.view ? { readableId: state.view.readableId } : {}),
  };
  // The Test outbox, opened at one entry: the tab, then focus on the entry once it is drawn.
  const [openAt, setOpenAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (openAt === null || tab !== 'outbox') return;
    // The tab's content may be drawn a frame after the tab is chosen: look for the entry until it is there.
    let tries = 0;
    let frame = 0;
    const go = () => {
      const el = document.getElementById(outboxEntryId(openAt));
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'nearest' });
        el.focus();
        setOpenAt(null);
      } else if (tries++ < 20) frame = requestAnimationFrame(go);
      else setOpenAt(null);
    };
    go();
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [openAt, tab]);
  const byLine = useMemo(
    () => (state.view ? outboxByLine(lines, state.view.story, state.outbox, state.view.requestId): new Map<number, number[]>()),
    [lines, state.view, state.outbox],
  );
  const notes: LineNotes = {
    of: (line) => storyNotes(outboxCtx, state.outbox, byLine.get(line.turn) ?? []),
    open: (entry) => {
      setTab('outbox');
      setOpenAt(entry);
    },
  };

  if (state.status === 'blocked') {
    return (
      <div className={s.page}>
        <Banner state={state} controller={controller} changed={false} />
        <div className={s.blocked}>
          <Card>
            <EmptyState icon="todo" title={t('tryit.blocked.title')}>
              <p>{t('tryit.blocked.text')}</p>
              <ul className={s.findings}>
                {state.findings.map((f, i) => {
                  const words = describeFinding(doc, f, env);
                  return (
                    <li key={i}>
                      <span>{words.cause}</span>{' '}
                      <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="arrow-right" onClick={() => reveal(f.location)}>
                        {t('tryit.showMe')}
                      </Button>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            </EmptyState>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={s.page}>
      <Banner state={state} controller={controller} changed={changed} />
      <div className={s.workspace}>
        <div className={s.left}>
          <Legend sample={doc.sampleRequest?.name || titleAnswer} testName={testName} />
          <div className={s.diagram}>
            <Slot name="ReadOnlyDiagram" doc={doc} label={t('tryit.diagramLabel')} {...diagramMarks(doc, state.view)} />
          </div>
          <Happened state={state} controller={controller} lines={lines} doc={doc} storyCtx={storyCtx} notes={notes} />
        </div>
        <aside className={s.panel} aria-label={t('tryit.panelLabel')}>
          <header className={s.head}>
            <div className={s.titleRow}>
              <h1 className={s.title}>{title}</h1>
              {title !== testName && (
                <span className={s.testPill}>
                  <Icon name="play" size={12} />
                  {testName}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <StatusLine view={state.view} doc={doc} />
          </header>
          <ActingAs state={state} controller={controller} doc={doc} />
          <div className={s.tabs}>
            <Tabs
              look="line"
              label={t('tryit.tabs')}
              value={tab}
              onValueChange={setTab}
              tabs={[
                { value: 'task', label: t('tryit.tab.task'), icon: 'task', content: <TaskTab ctx={{ doc, env, catalogue: catalogue!, state, controller }} /> },
                { value: 'soFar', label: t('tryit.tab.soFar'), icon: 'history', content: <SoFar ctx={storyCtx} lines={lines} view={state.view} valuesBefore={state.valuesBefore} notes={notes} /> },
                {
                  value: 'outbox',
                  label: sayText('tryit.tab.outbox', { n: state.outbox.length }),
                  icon: 'outbox',
                  content: <OutboxView ctx={outboxCtx} entries={state.outbox} />,
                },
              ]}
            />
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Where the request is, has been and is stuck, for the diagram. */
function diagramMarks(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, view: RequestView | null) {
  if (!view) {
    const start = doc.start?.stage;
    return start ? { at: [start] } : {};
  }
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const taken: string[] = [];
  for (const e of view.story) {
    if (e.code === 'moved') {
      visited.add(e.params.from);
      visited.add(e.params.to);
      taken.push(e.params.arrow);
    }
  }
  if (doc.start?.stage) visited.add(doc.start.stage);
  const here = view.stage.item;
  visited.delete(here);
  return {
    at: view.closed && !view.closed.ending ? [] : [here],
    visited: [...visited],
    taken,
    ...(view.stuck ? { stuckAt: here } : {}),
  };
}

/**
 * Above the diagram: what its marks mean (in words, not only colour) and which sample it shows
 * (mockup 08): "Sample: Rotate payment gateway API keys (Test request 1)", or only "Sample: Test
 * request 1" while the sample has no name of its own, never the test's name twice.
 */
function Legend({ sample, testName }: { sample: string | undefined; testName: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={s.legendRow}>
      <ul className={s.legend} aria-label={t('tryit.legend')}>
        <li>
          <span className={s.swatchNow} aria-hidden="true" />
          {t('tryit.legend.now')}
        </li>
        <li>
          <span className={s.swatchTaken} aria-hidden="true" />
          {t('tryit.legend.taken')}
        </li>
        <li>
          <span className={s.swatchNotReached} aria-hidden="true" />
          {t('tryit.legend.notReached')}
        </li>
      </ul>
      <p className={s.sampleLine}>
        <Icon name="sample" size={14} />
        <span>{sample && sample !== testName ? sayText('tryit.sampleLine', { sample, test: testName }) : sayText('tryit.sampleLineTest', { test: testName })}</span>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function Banner({ state, controller, changed }: { state: TryItState; controller: TryItController; changed: boolean }) {
  const { workflowId = '' } = useParams();
  return (
    <div className={s.banner} role="note">
      <Icon name="play" size={16} />
      <p className={s.bannerText}>{t('tryit.banner')}</p>
      <span className={s.bannerTest}>{sayText('tryit.usesThisDraft', { n: state.testNo })}</span>
      {changed && <span className={s.changedNote}>{t('tryit.draftChanged')}</span>}
      <Button size="sm" icon="undo" onClick={() => void controller.startAgain()} title={t('tryit.startAgainHint')}>
        {t('tryit.startAgain')}
      </Button>
      <Link to={`/w/${workflowId}`} className={buttonClass('secondary', 'sm')} title={t('tryit.stopTestingHint')}>
        <Icon name="close" size={14} />
        {t('tryit.stopTesting')}
      </Link>
    </div>
  );

function StatusLine({ view, doc }: { view: RequestView | null; doc: AuthoredWorkflow }) {
  const status = view?.status;
  const ending = view?.closed?.ending ? getStage(doc, view.closed.ending)?.name : undefined;
  return (
    <p className={s.statusLine}>
      <span className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.statusPeopleSee')}</span>{' '}
      {status ? (
        <span className={s.status}>
          <span className={s.dot} style={{ background: `var(--st-${status.colour})` }} aria-hidden="true" />
          {status.words || t('tryit.noStatus')}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span className={s.status}>{view ? t('tryit.noStatus') : t('tryit.notStarted')}</span>
      )}
      {ending && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.separator')}{sayText('tryit.ended', { ending })}</span>}
      {view?.closed?.byAdmin && <span className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.separator')}{t('tryit.closedByAdmin')}</span>}
    </p>
  );
}

// ── Acting as ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** What a person is to this request: "Requester", "One of Payments approvers", "Looks after stuck requests". */
export function rolesOf(state: TryItState, controller: TryItController, doc: AuthoredWorkflow, person: Ref): string {
  const view = state.view;
  const roles: string[] = [];
  const key = refKey(person);
  const requester = view ? view.requester : state.starter;
  if (requester && refKey(requester) === key) {
    const start = getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage)?.name || t('describe.noName');
    roles.push(view ? t('tryit.role.requester') : sayText('tryit.role.startsIt', { stage: start }));
  }
  for (const task of view?.tasks ?? []) {
    const stage = getStage(doc, view?.stage.item)?.name || t('describe.noName');
    if (task.askedOf.some((r) => refKey(r) === key)) roles.push(sayText('tryit.role.asked', { stage }));
    for (const g of task.askedOf.filter((r) => r.type === 'group')) {
      if (controller.people([g]).some((p) => refKey(p) === key)) roles.push(sayText('tryit.role.inGroup', { group: nameOfRef(state.names, g) }));
    }
  }
  if (controller.people(state.stuckPeople).some((p) => refKey(p) === key)) roles.push(t('tryit.role.looksAfterStuck'));
  if (!roles.length && view?.story.some((e) => e.code === 'task.answered' && e.params.by.type === 'user' && e.params.by.id === person.id)) roles.push(t('tryit.role.acted'));
  return [...new Set(roles)].join(t('tryit.roleJoin')) || t('tryit.role.none');
}

/** The people the test host knows: before it starts, anyone who could start it; then the requester, the people asked, who looks after stuck requests, who answered. */
function knownPeople(state: TryItState, controller: TryItController): Ref[] {
  const view = state.view;
  if (!view) {
    return Object.keys(state.names)
      .filter((k) => k.startsWith('user:'))
      .map((k): Ref => ({ type: 'user', id: k.slice(5) }))
      .sort((a, b) => nameOfRef(state.names, a).localeCompare(nameOfRef(state.names, b)));
  }
  const out: Ref[] = [];
  const add = (refs: Ref[]) => {
    for (const r of refs) if (!out.some((o) => refKey(o) === refKey(r))) out.push(r);
  };
  if (view.requester) add([view.requester]);
  for (const task of view.tasks) add(controller.people(task.askedOf));
  add(controller.people(state.stuckPeople));
  for (const e of view.story) if (e.code === 'task.answered' && e.params.by.type === 'user') add([{ type: 'user', id: e.params.by.id }]);
  if (state.actingAs) add([state.actingAs]);
  return out;
}

const initials = (name: string) => name.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).map((w) => w[0]?.toUpperCase()).join('');

function ActingAs({ state, controller, doc }: { state: TryItState; controller: TryItController; doc: AuthoredWorkflow }) {
  const me = state.actingAs;
  const name = me ? nameOfRef(state.names, me) : t('tryit.someone');
  const items: MenuItem[] = knownPeople(state, controller)
    .filter((p) => !me || refKey(p) !== refKey(me))
    .map((p) => ({
      label: `${nameOfRef(state.names, p)}${t('tryit.separator')}${rolesOf(state, controller, doc, p)}`,
      icon: 'person',
      onSelect: () => void controller.switchTo(p),
    }));
  return (
    <section className={s.actingAs} aria-labelledby="tryit-acting-as">
      <h2 id="tryit-acting-as" className={s.eyebrow}>
        {t('tryit.actingAs')}
      </h2>
      <div className={s.person}>
        <span className={s.avatar} aria-hidden="true">
          {initials(name)}
        </span>
        <div className={s.personText}>
          <strong className={s.personName}>{name}</strong>
          <span className={s.quiet}>{me ? rolesOf(state, controller, doc, me) : ''}</span>
        </div>
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <Menu
            align="end"
            items={items}
            trigger={
              <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" aria-label={sayText('tryit.switchLabel', { name })}>
                {t('tryit.switch')}
                <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} />
              </Button>
            }
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

// ── What just happened ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * "Now you are": why this person is the one asked, as mockup 08 says it ("Development asks the Eng
 * lead, and Marcus Lee picked him"): who the stage asks, who that is here, and where that came from.
 * Someone not asked now gets their roles ("Requester", "Looks after stuck requests").
 */
export function nowYouAre(state: TryItState, controller: TryItController, doc: AuthoredWorkflow, storyCtx: StoryCtx, me: Ref): string {
  const view = state.view;
  const name = nameOfRef(state.names, me);
  const key = refKey(me);
  const task = view?.tasks.find((x) => controller.people(x.askedOf).some((p) => refKey(p) === key));
  const authored = task ? getTask(doc, task.location.item) : undefined;
  if (!view || !task || !authored) return sayText('tryit.nowYouAreText', { name, role: rolesOf(state, controller, doc, me) });
  const stage = getStage(doc, view.stage.item)?.name || t('describe.noName');
  const who = toText(describeWhoIsAsked(doc, authored, { short: true }));
  const actual = joinNames(task.askedOf.map((r) => nameOfRef(state.names, r)));
  if (!who || who === actual) return sayText('tryit.nowAsked', { name, stage, who: actual });
  const asked = authored.whoIsAsked;
  const valueId = asked && typeof asked === 'object' && !Array.isArray(asked) && 'value' in asked && !(asked.steps ?? []).length ? asked.value : undefined;
  const source = valueId ? valueSources(storyCtx, view.story)[valueId] : undefined;
  return source
    ? sayText('tryit.nowAskedFrom', { name, stage, who, actual, source: toText(source) })
    : sayText('tryit.nowAskedHere', { name, stage, who, actual });
}

function Happened({ state, controller, lines, doc, storyCtx, notes }: {
  state: TryItState; controller: TryItController; lines: StoryLine[]; doc: AuthoredWorkflow; storyCtx: StoryCtx; notes: LineNotes;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const moves = state.moves;
  useEffect(() => {
    // After a move the form that was pressed is gone: put focus on what happened.
    if (moves > 0) ref.current?.focus();
  }, [moves]);
  const recent = lines.filter((l) => l.lastTurn > state.turnBefore);
  const me = state.actingAs;
  const name = me ? nameOfRef(state.names, me) : t('tryit.someone');
  const start = startTask(doc);
  return (
    <div className={s.happened} ref={ref} tabIndex={-1} aria-live="polite">
      {!state.view ? (
        <>
          <h2 className={s.eyebrow}>{t('tryit.readyToStart')}</h2>
          <p className={s.happenedText}>
            <Icon name="person" size={14} />
            <span>
              {sayText('tryit.readyText', {
                name, stage: getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage)?.name || t('describe.noName'),
                button: start?.buttons[0]?.label || t('describe.noName'),
              })}
            </span>
          </p>
          <p className={s.quiet}>{t('tryit.readyNote')}</p>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <h2 className={s.eyebrow}>{t('tryit.whatJustHappened')}</h2>
          {(recent.length ? recent : lines.slice(-1)).map((line) => (
            <div key={line.turn} className={s.happenedLine}>
              <p className={s.happenedText}>
                <Icon name="branch" size={14} />
                <span>
                  <PhraseView phrase={line.text} />
                  <NotesView notes={notes.of(line)} open={notes.open} />
                </span>
              </p>
              {line.why.map((w, i) => (
                <span key={i} className={s.byArrow}>
                  {sayText('tryit.byTheArrow', { arrow: w.arrow })}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
          {me && !state.view.closed && (
            <>
              <h2 className={s.eyebrow}>{t('tryit.nowYouAre')}</h2>
              <p className={s.happenedText}>
                <Icon name="person" size={14} />
                <span>{nowYouAre(state, controller, doc, storyCtx, me)}</span>
              </p>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {state.view?.closed && (
        <Button variant="primary" icon="play" onClick={() => void controller.startAgain()}>
          {t('tryit.startAgain')}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * One Try it session: a test host made from the draft as it is now (core-api.md 10), the test
 * request on it, who the author is acting as, the answers being filled in, how each other system
 * is pretended, and the request and Test outbox as last read. Plain TypeScript with a subscribe
 * function, so the page reads it with useSyncExternalStore and tests can drive it without React.
 *
 * Every move (start, a button, an answer for another system, retry, close) reads the request back
 * as the person acted as and then switches to whoever the request now needs (the first person who
 * can answer an open task; the person who looks after stuck requests when it is stuck).
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Catalogue, CatalogueRef, Location, SampleRequest, StartsWhenId, ValueKind,
} from '@/contract';
import type {
  Answers, CallAnswer, CallFake, Fakes, Finding, Json, OutboxEntry, Ref, Refusal, RequestView, Services, Settings,
  TestHost, Values,
} from '@/services';
import { getAction, getStage, getTask } from '@/model';
import { forecastFrom, type Forecast } from './forecast';
import { answersFrom, isRef, refKey, refsIn, sampleFrom, type Names } from './values';

export type Notice =
  | { kind: 'notMatched'; binding: StartsWhenId }
  | { kind: 'startRefused'; binding: StartsWhenId; refusals: Refusal[] };

/** Where the last refusal came from: the start form, a task, a binding, the stuck box, an answer for a call. */
export type RefusalPlace = 'start' | 'admin' | 'call' | `task:${string}` | `binding:${string}`;

export interface TryItState {
  status: 'loading' | 'blocked' | 'ready' | 'failed';
  /** Why the draft cannot be tried at all (status 'blocked'). */
  findings: Finding[];
  /** Stages a test request stops at (unfinished). */
  unfinished: Location[];
  /** The draft's check, as the test host read it: what is unfinished, by name (the stuck box, a refused start). */
  hostFindings: Finding[];
  /** The draft the host runs. */
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null;
  /** 1 for the first test request on this page, 2 for the next ... */
  testNo: number;
  requestId: string | null;
  /** The test request as the person acted as sees it. */
  view: RequestView | null;
  outbox: OutboxEntry[];
  actingAs: Ref | null;
  /** Who starts it (the Requester): the sample's Requester, else the signed-in person. */
  starter: Ref | null;
  startAnswers: Answers;
  /** Answers being filled in, per task instance. */
  answers: Record<string, Answers>;
  /** What each "Starts when" sends, per binding. */
  sent: Record<string, Record<string, Json>>;
  refusals: { place: RefusalPlace; list: Refusal[]; button?: ButtonId } | null;
  notice: Notice | null;
  /** How each operation is pretended, by catalogue entry. */
  calls: Record<string, CallFake>;
  names: Names;
  /** Group ID to the IDs of its people, as the test host is told. */
  groups: Record<string, string[]>;
  /** Who looks after stuck requests in the test. */
  stuckPeople: Ref[];
  /** The request's values before the last move, to mark what changed. */
  valuesBefore: Values;
  /** The story's last turn before the last move: entries after it are "what just happened". */
  turnBefore: number;
  /** A move is being made. */
  busy: boolean;
  /** Counts moves, so the page can put focus on the newest line. */
  moves: number;
}

export interface TryItDeps {
  services: Services;
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  settings: Settings | null;
  /** The draft as it is now. */
  getDoc(): AuthoredWorkflow | null;
  /** Puts a new sample request into the draft (the `sample.replaceWith` command). */
  replaceSample(sample: SampleRequest): void;
  /** Each value's kind, from the facts, for the sample request. */
  kinds(): Partial<Record<string, ValueKind>>;
}

const initial: TryItState = {
  status: 'loading', findings: [], unfinished: [], hostFindings: [], doc: null, testNo: 1, requestId: null, view: null, outbox: [],
  actingAs: null, starter: null, startAnswers: {}, answers: {}, sent: {}, refusals: null, notice: null, calls: {},
  names: {}, groups: {}, stuckPeople: [], valuesBefore: {}, turnBefore: 0, busy: false, moves: 0,
};

const START_AT = '2026-11-15T09:00:00.000Z';
const same = (a: Ref | null | undefined, b: Ref | null | undefined) => !!a && !!b && a.type === b.type && a.id === b.id;

/** Everything said to the test host that can change it, in order, so it can be played again (a forecast). */
type Move =
  | { kind: 'start'; as: Ref; button: ButtonId; answers: Answers }
  | { kind: 'startFrom'; binding: StartsWhenId; sent: Record<string, Json> }
  | { kind: 'act'; as: Ref; requestId: string; task: string; button: ButtonId; answers: Answers }
  | { kind: 'answerCall'; call: string; answer: CallAnswer }
  | { kind: 'admin'; as: Ref; requestId: string; action: 'retry' | 'close'; reason: string }
  | { kind: 'setCallFake'; operation: CatalogueRef; fake: CallFake };

async function play(host: TestHost, m: Move): Promise<void> {
  switch (m.kind) {
    case 'start':
      await host.start(m.as, m.button, m.answers);
      break;
    case 'startFrom':
      await host.startFrom(m.binding, m.sent);
      break;
    case 'act':
      await host.act(m.as, m.requestId, m.task, m.button, m.answers);
      break;
    case 'answerCall':
      await host.answerCall(m.call, m.answer);
      break;
    case 'admin':
      await host.admin(m.as, m.requestId, m.action, m.reason);
      break;
    case 'setCallFake':
      await host.setCallFake(m.operation, m.fake);
      break;
  }
}

export class TryItController {
  private state: TryItState = initial;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private host: TestHost | null = null;
  /** The fakes the host was made with, and every move said to it since: a forecast plays them again. */
  private fakes: Fakes | null = null;
  private played: Move[] = [];
  private disposed = false;

  constructor(private readonly deps: TryItDeps) {}

  // ── store ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  readonly subscribe = (listener: () => void) => {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  readonly getState = () => this.state;

  private set(patch: Partial<TryItState>) {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.state = { ...this.state, ...patch };
    for (const l of this.listeners) l();
  }

  dispose() {
    this.disposed = true;
    this.listeners.clear();
  }

  // ── setting up ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /** Reads the directory, makes the host and fills the start form from the sample request. */
  async init(): Promise<void> {
    const { directory, session } = this.deps.services;
    try {
      const [people, groupEntries] = await Promise.all([directory.search('', ['user']), directory.search('', ['group'])]);
      const names: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const e of [...people, ...groupEntries]) names[refKey(e)] = e.label;
      const groups: Record<string, string[]> = {};
      await Promise.all(groupEntries.map(async (g) => {
        groups[g.id] = (await directory.membersOf({ type: 'group', id: g.id })).map((m) => m.id);
      }));
      const settings = this.deps.settings;
      const stuckPeople = settings?.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : (settings?.authors ?? []);
      let starter: Ref | null = null;
      const doc = this.deps.getDoc();
      const sampleRequester = doc?.sampleRequest?.requester;
      if (sampleRequester?.directoryId) starter = { type: 'user', id: sampleRequester.directoryId };
      else starter = (await session.whoAmI()).ref;
      this.set({ names, groups, stuckPeople, starter, actingAs: starter });
      await this.newHost();
    } catch {
      this.set({ status: 'failed' });
    }
  }

  /** The calls a new host starts with: each "Wait for" holds, so the author answers for it. */
  private defaultCalls(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Record<string, CallFake> {
    const out: Record<string, CallFake> = {};
    for (const op of usedOperations(doc, this.deps.catalogue)) if (op.sort === 'await') out[op.id] = { mode: 'hold' };
    return out;
  }

  private async newHost(): Promise<void> {
    const doc = this.deps.getDoc();
    if (!doc) return;
    const calls = { ...this.defaultCalls(doc), ...this.keptCalls(doc) };
    const fakes: Fakes = {
      groups: this.state.groups,
      stuckRequestsGoTo: this.state.stuckPeople,
      calls: calls as Fakes['calls'],
      startAt: START_AT,
    };
    const made = await this.deps.services.core.createTestHost(doc, this.deps.catalogue, fakes);
    if (!made.ok) {
      this.host = null;
      this.fakes = null;
      this.set({ status: 'blocked', findings: made.findings, doc });
      return;
    }
    this.host = made.host;
    this.fakes = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fakes)) as Fakes;
    this.played = [];
    const startAnswers = await this.sampleAnswers(doc);
    this.set({
      status: 'ready', findings: [], unfinished: made.unfinished, hostFindings: made.findings, doc, requestId: null, view: null, outbox: [],
      startAnswers, answers: {}, sent: this.sampleSent(doc), refusals: null, notice: null, calls,
      valuesBefore: {}, turnBefore: 0, actingAs: this.state.starter, busy: false,
    });
  }

  /** Fakes chosen earlier for operations the draft still uses. */
  private keptCalls(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Record<string, CallFake> {
    const used = new Set(usedOperations(doc, this.deps.catalogue).map((o) => o.id));
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(this.state.calls).filter(([op]) => used.has(op)));
  }

  /** The start form's answers from the sample request. */
  private async sampleAnswers(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Promise<Answers> {
    const task = startTask(doc);
    if (!task || !doc.sampleRequest) return {};
    const sample = await this.deps.services.core.sampleValues(doc, doc.sampleRequest, this.deps.catalogue);
    return answersFrom(task, sample.values);
  }

  /** Each binding's trigger sample: what the other system sends. */
  private sampleSent(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Record<string, Record<string, Json>> {
    const out: Record<string, Record<string, Json>> = {};
    for (const b of doc.start?.startsWhen ?? []) {
      const entry = this.deps.catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === b.trigger);
      if (entry?.kind === 'trigger') out[b.id] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(entry.sample.event ?? {})) as Record<string, Json>;
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ── before it starts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  setStartAnswers(answers: Answers) {
    this.set({ startAnswers: answers });
  }

  async fillFromSample() {
    const doc = this.state.doc;
    if (doc) this.set({ startAnswers: await this.sampleAnswers(this.deps.getDoc() ?? doc), refusals: null });
  }

  setSent(binding: string, sent: Record<string, Json>) {
    this.set({ sent: { ...this.state.sent, [binding]: sent } });
  }

  /** Who starts it, before it has started. */
  setStarter(ref: Ref) {
    if (this.state.requestId) return;
    this.set({ starter: ref, actingAs: ref, refusals: null });
  }

  /** The start form's button: the starter presses it. */
  async start(button: ButtonId): Promise<void> {
    const host = this.host;
    const doc = this.state.doc;
    const as = this.state.starter;
    if (!host || !doc || !as || this.state.busy) return;
    this.set({ busy: true, refusals: null, notice: null });
    const answers = await this.shownOnly(doc, startTask(doc)?.id, this.state.startAnswers, {}, as);
    this.played.push({ kind: 'start', as, button, answers });
    const r = await host.start(as, button, answers);
    if (!r.ok) {
      this.set({ busy: false, refusals: { place: 'start', list: r.refusals, button } });
      return;
    }
    await this.afterMove(r.requestId, {}, 0);
    this.keepAsSample();
  }

  /** "Start it as <connection> would". */
  async startFrom(binding: StartsWhenId): Promise<void> {
    const host = this.host;
    if (!host || this.state.busy) return;
    this.set({ busy: true, refusals: null, notice: null });
    const sent = this.state.sent[binding] ?? {};
    this.played.push({ kind: 'startFrom', binding, sent });
    const r = await host.startFrom(binding, sent);
    if (!r.ok) {
      this.set({ busy: false, outbox: await host.outbox(), notice: { kind: 'startRefused', binding, refusals: r.refusals } });
      return;
    }
    if (!r.started) {
      this.set({ busy: false, notice: { kind: 'notMatched', binding } });
      return;
    }
    await this.afterMove(r.requestId, {}, 0);
    this.keepAsSample();
  }

  // ── on the request ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  setAnswers(task: string, answers: Answers) {
    this.set({ answers: { ...this.state.answers, [task]: answers } });
  }

  /** The answers shown for a task: what the author typed, else the request's and the sample's values. */
  answersFor(task: string, taskId: string): Answers {
    const typed = this.state.answers[task];
    if (typed) return typed;
    const doc = this.state.doc;
    const authored = doc ? getTask(doc, taskId) : undefined;
    if (!authored) return {};
    return { ...this.sampleTaskAnswers.get(taskId), ...answersFrom(authored, this.state.view?.values ?? {}) };
  }

  /** The sample's answers per authored task, read once per host. */
  private sampleTaskAnswers = new Map<string, Answers>();

  private async loadSampleTaskAnswers() {
    const doc = this.state.doc;
    if (!doc?.sampleRequest) return;
    const sample = await this.deps.services.core.sampleValues(doc, doc.sampleRequest, this.deps.catalogue);
    for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
      if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
      for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) this.sampleTaskAnswers.set(task.id, answersFrom(task, sample.values));
    }
  }

  /** The person acted as presses a button on an open task. */
  async act(task: string, button: ButtonId): Promise<void> {
    const host = this.host;
    const { requestId, actingAs, view, doc } = this.state;
    if (!host || !requestId || !actingAs || !view || !doc || this.state.busy) return;
    const open = view.tasks.find((x) => x.task === task);
    if (!open) return;
    this.set({ busy: true, refusals: null });
    const answers = await this.shownOnly(doc, open.location.item, this.answersFor(task, open.location.item), view.values, view.requester);
    this.played.push({ kind: 'act', as: actingAs, requestId, task, button, answers });
    const r = await host.act(actingAs, requestId, task, button, answers);
    if (!r.ok) {
      this.set({ busy: false, refusals: { place: `task:${task}`, list: r.refusals, button } });
      return;
    }
    await this.afterMove(requestId, view.values, lastTurn(view));
  }

  /** The author answers for another system the request is held on. */
  async answerCall(call: string, answer: CallAnswer): Promise<void> {
    const host = this.host;
    const { requestId, view } = this.state;
    if (!host || !requestId || !view || this.state.busy) return;
    this.set({ busy: true, refusals: null });
    this.played.push({ kind: 'answerCall', call, answer });
    const r = await host.answerCall(call, answer);
    if (!r.ok) {
      this.set({ busy: false, refusals: { place: 'call', list: r.refusals } });
      return;
    }
    await this.afterMove(requestId, view.values, lastTurn(view));
  }

  /** Retry or close, as the person acted as. */
  async admin(action: 'retry' | 'close', reason: string): Promise<void> {
    const host = this.host;
    const { requestId, actingAs, view } = this.state;
    if (!host || !requestId || !actingAs || !view || this.state.busy) return;
    this.set({ busy: true, refusals: null });
    this.played.push({ kind: 'admin', as: actingAs, requestId, action, reason });
    const r = await host.admin(actingAs, requestId, action, reason);
    if (!r.ok) {
      this.set({ busy: false, refusals: { place: 'admin', list: r.refusals } });
      return;
    }
    await this.afterMove(requestId, view.values, lastTurn(view));
  }

  /** How an operation is pretended from now on. */
  async setCallFake(operation: CatalogueRef, fake: CallFake): Promise<void> {
    this.set({ calls: { ...this.state.calls, [operation]: fake } });
    if (!this.host) return;
    this.played.push({ kind: 'setCallFake', operation, fake });
    await this.host.setCallFake(operation, fake);
  }

  /**
   * Where an answer for an action the request is held on would take it, by the engine itself: a
   * second test host from the same draft and fakes plays every move again, is given the answer, and
   * forecast.ts compares the request before and after. Null while not known.
   */
  async forecast(actionId: string, answer: CallAnswer): Promise<Forecast | null> {
    const { doc, view } = this.state;
    const fakes = this.fakes;
    if (!doc || !view || !fakes) return null;
    const action = getAction(doc, actionId);
    const open = view.actions.find((a) => a.location.item === actionId && a.call);
    if (action?.type !== 'useConnection' || !open?.call) return null;
    try {
      const made = await this.deps.services.core.createTestHost(doc, this.deps.catalogue, fakes);
      if (!made.ok) return null;
      const twin = made.host;
      for (const m of [...this.played]) await play(twin, m);
      const before = await twin.request(view.requestId);
      const sentBefore = (await twin.outbox()).length;
      const r = await twin.answerCall(open.call, answer);
      if (!r.ok) return null;
      const after = await twin.request(view.requestId);
      if (!('requestId' in before) || !('requestId' in after)) return null;
      return forecastFrom(action, answer, before, after, (await twin.outbox()).slice(sentBefore));
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /** Switch who the author is acting as: shows that person's view. */
  async switchTo(ref: Ref): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.state.requestId) {
      this.setStarter(ref);
      return;
    }
    this.set({ actingAs: ref, refusals: null });
    await this.refresh();
  }

  /** A new test request on the draft as it is now; the answers used last time are the sample request. */
  async startAgain(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.state.busy) return;
    this.set({ busy: true });
    if (this.state.view) this.keepAsSample(this.state.view.values);
    this.sampleTaskAnswers.clear();
    const testNo = this.state.requestId ? this.state.testNo + 1 : this.state.testNo;
    this.set({ testNo, actingAs: this.state.starter });
    await this.newHost();
  }

  // ── reading back ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  private async afterMove(requestId: string, valuesBefore: Values, turnBefore: number) {
    if (!this.sampleTaskAnswers.size) await this.loadSampleTaskAnswers();
    this.set({ requestId, valuesBefore, turnBefore, answers: {} });
    await this.refresh();
    await this.switchToWhoIsNeeded();
    this.set({ busy: false, moves: this.state.moves + 1 });
  }

  private async refresh() {
    const host = this.host;
    const { requestId, actingAs } = this.state;
    if (!host || !requestId) return;
    const [read, outbox] = await Promise.all([host.request(requestId, actingAs ?? undefined), host.outbox()]);
    // The host holds every request it started; a not-found here means the host was replaced meanwhile.
    if (!('requestId' in read)) return;
    const view = read;
    this.set({ view, outbox });
    await this.learnNames([view, outbox]);
  }

  /** Looks up the names of people and groups not seen yet. */
  private async learnNames(things: unknown) {
    const missing = new Map<string, Ref>();
    for (const r of refsIn(things)) if (!(refKey(r) in this.state.names)) missing.set(refKey(r), { type: r.type, id: r.id });
    for (const by of bysIn(things)) if (!(refKey(by) in this.state.names)) missing.set(refKey(by), by);
    if (!missing.size) return;
    const found = await this.deps.services.directory.lookup([...missing.values()]);
    const names = { ...this.state.names };
    for (const e of found) names[refKey(e)] = e.label;
    this.set({ names });
  }

  /** After a move: act as whoever the request needs now. */
  private async switchToWhoIsNeeded() {
    const host = this.host;
    const { view, requestId, actingAs } = this.state;
    if (!host || !view || !requestId || view.closed) return;
    if (view.tasks.length) {
      const candidates = [...(actingAs ? [actingAs] : []), ...view.tasks.flatMap((x) => this.people(x.askedOf))];
      for (const c of candidates) {
        const tasks = await host.openTasks({ requestId, as: c });
        if (tasks.some((x) => x.buttonStates.some((b) => b.available))) {
          if (!same(c, actingAs)) await this.switchTo(c);
          return;
        }
      }
    }
    if (view.stuck) {
      const admin = this.people(this.state.stuckPeople)[0];
      if (admin && !same(admin, actingAs)) await this.switchTo(admin);
    }
  }

  /** People: groups opened up into the people the test host is told are in them. */
  people(refs: readonly Ref[]): Ref[] {
    const out: Ref[] = [];
    for (const r of refs) {
      const add = r.type === 'user' ? [r] : (this.state.groups[r.id] ?? []).map((id): Ref => ({ type: 'user', id }));
      for (const p of add) if (!out.some((o) => same(o, p))) out.push(p);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Answers for the questions shown with these answers only (a hidden question's answer is refused). */
  private async shownOnly(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, taskId: string | undefined, answers: Answers, values: Values, requester?: Ref): Promise<Answers> {
    if (!taskId) return answers;
    const lookups = { membersOf: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(this.state.groups).map(([g, ids]) => [g, ids.map((id): Ref => ({ type: 'user', id }))])) };
    const r = await this.deps.services.core.formState(doc, this.deps.catalogue, { item: taskId }, answers, values, requester ? { requester } : {}, lookups);
    if (r.result !== 'state') return answers;
    const shown = new Set(r.state.shown);
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(answers).filter(([q]) => shown.has(q)));
  }

  /** The values of the request (or the start form's answers) become the sample request. */
  private keepAsSample(values?: Values) {
    const doc = this.deps.getDoc();
    const ran = this.state.doc;
    const view = this.state.view;
    if (!doc || !ran) return;
    const kept = values ?? view?.values ?? {};
    const requester = view?.requester ?? this.state.starter ?? undefined;
    const next = sampleFrom(doc, doc.sampleRequest, kept, this.state.names, this.deps.kinds(), requester);
    if (JSON.stringify(next) !== JSON.stringify(doc.sampleRequest)) this.deps.replaceSample(next);
  }
}

// ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** The start stage's task. */
export function startTask(doc: AuthoredWorkflow) {
  const stage = getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage);
  return stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.tasks?.[0] : undefined;
}

/** The catalogue operations the draft's actions use, each once, in document order. */
export function usedOperations(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue) {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: Extract<Catalogue['entries'][number], { kind: 'operation' }>[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const a of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
      if (a.type !== 'useConnection' || !a.operation || seen.has(a.operation)) continue;
      const entry = catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === a.operation);
      if (entry?.kind !== 'operation') continue;
      seen.add(a.operation);
      out.push(entry);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const lastTurn = (view: RequestView) => view.story.reduce((n, e) => Math.max(n, e.turn), 0);

/** Every `{ type: 'user', id }` a story names as who did something. */
function bysIn(value: unknown, out: Ref[] = []): Ref[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) for (const v of value) bysIn(v, out);
  else if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
    const o = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (o.type === 'user' && typeof o.id === 'string' && !isRef(o)) out.push({ type: 'user', id: o.id });
    for (const v of Object.values(o)) bysIn(v, out);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Where an answer for another system would take the test request, shown before the author chooses
 * it (mockup 14 try-it: "On to Released; "Change released" is told." / "Saved as Deploy problem;
 * back to Development."). Nothing here works out what the engine would do: the controller plays the
 * same moves again on a second test host made from the same draft and fakes, gives that host the
 * answer, and this file only compares the request before and after it, and reads what it told.
 */
import type { StageId, UseConnection, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import type { CallAnswer, OutboxEntry, RequestView } from '@/services';

export type Next =
  | { kind: 'to'; stage: StageId; back: boolean }
  | { kind: 'stuck'; stage: StageId }
  | { kind: 'stays'; stage: StageId }
  | { kind: 'unknown' };

export interface Forecast {
  /** Values a failure saves that the author reads ("Saved as Deploy failed"): the action's "Save what went wrong as". */
  saved: ValueId[];
  /** Each thing told after it, by its ID, in the order told. */
  told: string[];
  next: Next;
}

/**
 * The forecast from the engine's own run: `before` and `after` are the request just before and
 * just after the answer, `sent` what the answer sent (the outbox entries it added).
 */
export function forecastFrom(action: UseConnection, answer: CallAnswer, before: RequestView, after: RequestView, sent: readonly OutboxEntry[]): Forecast {
  const changed = (id: string) => JSON.stringify(before.values[id as ValueId]) !== JSON.stringify(after.values[id as ValueId]);
  const saved = answer.outcome === 'failed'
    ? [action.saveFailureAs?.failed, action.saveFailureAs?.code].filter((v): v is ValueId => !!v && changed(v))
    : [];
  const told = sent.flatMap((e) => (e.kind === 'told' && 'tell' in e.what ? [e.what.tell as string] : []));
  return { saved, told, next: nextOf(before, after) };
}

function nextOf(before: RequestView, after: RequestView): Next {
  const here = after.stage.item as StageId;
  if (after.stuck && JSON.stringify(after.stuck) !== JSON.stringify(before.stuck)) return { kind: 'stuck', stage: here };
  const newMoves = after.story.slice(before.story.length).filter((e) => e.code === 'moved');
  const lastMove = newMoves[newMoves.length - 1];
  if (after.closed?.ending) return { kind: 'to', stage: after.closed.ending as StageId, back: false };
  if (lastMove?.code === 'moved') return { kind: 'to', stage: lastMove.params.to, back: lastMove.params.sentBack };
  if (after.tasks.length) return { kind: 'stays', stage: here };
  return { kind: 'unknown' };
}

/**
 * The Test outbox (core's `TestHost.outbox`, services types-testhost.ts) in words, in its groups:
 * Messages (each to the people it would really reach, the platform's own ones worded from
 * contract/words/notifications.json with their params filled), Done in other systems, Looked up in
 * other systems (a read only reads, so it is not "done" there), and Other systems told.
 *
 * Exactly what the engine says would go out, in full: a message is its parts as the engine
 * rendered them (never the draft's message rendered again), what was sent and answered is every
 * field the engine gives, and what other systems are told is every field they would get. Only
 * the labels are the frontend's: a field by its catalogue label, a person or group by name.
 *
 * `storyNotes` says the same entries as sentences for the story ("Priya Raman was told: ..."), so
 * "What just happened" and So far name everything a move caused, each with a way to read it here.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Field, Location, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import {
  actionName, describeExpression, describeLocation, describeStartsWhenName, describeTemplate, getAction, stageOf, takesPlural, toText, type DescribeEnv,
  type Phrase,
} from '@/model';
import type { BuiltInTold, By, Json, MessagePart, OutboxEntry, Ref, StoryEntry } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { refusedBecause } from './refusals';
import { concat, joinList, joinNames, named, quoted, say, sayText } from './say';
import { connectionLabel, failureWords, isStuckReason, reasonClause, reasonWhatYouCanDo, whatItDoes, whoDid, type StoryLine } from './story';
import { isRef, nameOfRef, sayValue, type Names } from './values';

export interface OutboxCtx {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  catalogue: Catalogue | null;
  names: Names;
  /** What the request is called, as its messages name it: its title, else "Test request 1". */
  requestName: string;
  /** The request's number, as what other systems are told carries it. */
  readableId?: string;
  workflowName: string;
}

export interface Row {
  label: string;
  value: Phrase;
}

interface Item {
  key: string;
  /** The entry's place in the outbox, for "Read it in the Test outbox". */
  entry: number;
}

export interface MessageItem extends Item {
  /** The people it reaches. */
  to: Ref[];
  /** Who it was addressed to, as written, when that differs (a group). */
  addressed: string;
  subject?: string;
  text: Phrase;
  from: string;
}

export interface DoneItem extends Item {
  call: string;
  title: string;
  sent: Row[];
  state: 'pending' | 'ok' | 'failed' | 'late';
  stateWords: string;
  result: Row[];
  from: string;
}

export interface ToldItem extends Item {
  title: string;
  values: Row[];
  from: string;
}

export interface OutboxGroups {
  messages: MessageItem[];
  /** Done in other systems: what changes something there (an action, a "Wait for"). */
  done: DoneItem[];
  /** A read only reads, so it is not "done" in the other system: its own group. */
  lookedUp: DoneItem[];
  told: ToldItem[];
  /** The systems that listen now ("Reporting"). */
  listening: string[];
}

/** The element ID of an outbox entry, so the story can open the Test outbox at it. */
export const outboxEntryId = (entry: number) => `tryit-out-${entry}`;

const stageName = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined) => {
  const stage = id ? stageOf(doc, id) : undefined;
  return stage?.name || t('describe.noName');
};

/**
 * "Create Jira issue · Notify Eng lead": where it came from, and its name. A read the platform
 * makes for a part that is not an action (who is asked at a task) is named by that part.
 */
function fromWhere(ctx: OutboxCtx, location: Location): string {
  const action = getAction(ctx.doc, location.item);
  const name = action ? toText(actionName(ctx.doc, action, ctx.env)) : toText(describeLocation(ctx.doc, location, ctx.env));
  if (!action) return sayText('tryit.outbox.from', { where: name });
  return sayText('tryit.outbox.from', { where: sayText('tryit.outbox.fromWhere', { stage: stageName(ctx.doc, location.item), action: name }) });
}

const people = (ctx: OutboxCtx, refs: readonly Ref[]) => joinNames(refs.map((r) => nameOfRef(ctx.names, r)));

/** A value in words by the model's one rule: people and groups by name, nothing else changed. */
const said = (ctx: OutboxCtx, value: Json | undefined, kind?: ValueKind): Phrase =>
  sayValue(ctx.doc, value, ctx.names, kind, { catalogue: ctx.catalogue });

/**
 * A message as the engine rendered it: its text parts as they are, each value as it was then
 * (people by name). An empty value is nothing. Never the draft's message rendered again, so a
 * value is shown as it would go out (a failure code comes as the catalogue's label, E-29).
 */
function messageText(ctx: OutboxCtx, parts: MessagePart[] | undefined): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  for (const p of parts ?? []) {
    if (typeof p === 'string') out.push(p);
    else if (p.value !== undefined) out.push(...said(ctx, p.value, p.kind as ValueKind | undefined));
  }
  return concat(out);
}

/** A field's label in the catalogue, never its ID: "Another detail" when the catalogue has none. */
const fieldOf = (fields: readonly Field[] | undefined, id: string) => fields?.find((f) => f.id === id);

/** A value of a catalogue field: a list of items or a group of fields with each field by its label. */
function fieldValue(ctx: OutboxCtx, value: Json, field: Field | undefined): Phrase {
  const sub = field && 'fields' in field ? (field as { fields?: Field[] }).fields : undefined;
  const asFields = (v: Json): Phrase | null => {
    if (!sub || !v || typeof v !== 'object' || Array.isArray(v) || isRef(v)) return null;
    const parts = Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]): Phrase => [`${fieldOf(sub, k)?.label || t('tryit.anotherDetail')}: `, ...fieldValue(ctx, x, fieldOf(sub, k))]);
    return parts.reduce<Phrase>((acc, p, i) => concat(acc, i ? [t('tryit.outbox.fieldJoin')] : [], p), []);
  };
  if (Array.isArray(value) && sub) {
    if (!value.length) return [t('tryit.outbox.nothingSent')];
    const items = value.map((v) => asFields(v) ?? said(ctx, v));
    return items.reduce<Phrase>((acc, p, i) => concat(acc, i ? [t('tryit.outbox.itemJoin')] : [], p), []);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) && !value.length) return [t('tryit.outbox.nothingSent')];
  return asFields(value) ?? said(ctx, value, field?.kind as ValueKind | undefined);
}

function rows(ctx: OutboxCtx, data: Record<string, Json> | undefined, fields?: readonly Field[]): Row[] {
  return Object.entries(data ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => {
    const field = fieldOf(fields, k);
    return { label: field?.label || t('tryit.anotherDetail'), value: fieldValue(ctx, v, field) };
  });
}

/**
 * What a "Tell other systems" sent, each labelled as the author knows it: by what fills it (the
 * value's name, "Service"), as the action's card shows it, never by the key the other system reads.
 * The value is the engine's, as it goes out.
 */
function toldRows(ctx: OutboxCtx, actionId: string, data: Record<string, Json> | undefined): Row[] {
  const action = getAction(ctx.doc, actionId);
  const filled = action?.type === 'tellOtherSystems' ? action.values ?? {} : {};
  return Object.entries(data ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => {
    const expr = filled[k];
    const label = expr === undefined ? ''
      : toText(Array.isArray(expr) ? describeTemplate(ctx.doc, expr, ctx.env) : describeExpression(ctx.doc, expr, ctx.env, { short: true }));
    return { label: label || t('tryit.anotherDetail'), value: said(ctx, v) };
  });
}

function builtInMessage(ctx: OutboxCtx, e: Extract<OutboxEntry, { kind: 'notification' }>): { subject: string; text: Phrase } {
  const from = e.from;
  if (!('builtIn' in from)) return { subject: '', text: [] };
  const b = from.builtIn;
  const base = { request: ctx.requestName, workflow: ctx.workflowName };
  switch (b.code) {
    case 'task.assigned': {
      const fill = { ...base, stage: stageName(ctx.doc, b.params.stage), askedOf: people(ctx, b.params.askedOf) };
      return { subject: sayText('tryit.builtIn.taskAssigned.subject', fill), text: say('tryit.builtIn.taskAssigned.body', fill) };
    }
    case 'request.stuck': {
      const fill = {
        ...base, stage: stageName(ctx.doc, b.params.stage), reason: reasonClause(b.params.reason),
        whatYouCanDo: reasonWhatYouCanDo(b.params.reason),
      };
      return { subject: sayText('tryit.builtIn.requestStuck.subject', fill), text: say('tryit.builtIn.requestStuck.body', fill) };
    }
    case 'start.refused': {
      const binding = ctx.doc.start?.startsWhen?.find((s) => s.id === b.params.binding);
      const startsWhen = binding ? toText(describeStartsWhenName(binding, ctx.env)) : t('tryit.aConnection');
      // {code}: the first refusal's code, worded by refusedBecause (core-api.md 10.3).
      const first = b.params.refusals[0];
      const fill = { ...base, startsWhen, code: first ? refusedBecause(first.code) : t('tryit.refusedBecause.other') };
      return { subject: sayText('tryit.builtIn.startRefused.subject', fill), text: say('tryit.builtIn.startRefused.body', fill) };
    }
    default: {
      const never: never = b;
      return never;
    }
  }
}

const isRead = (e: Extract<OutboxEntry, { kind: 'call' }>) => e.sort === 'read';

export function outboxGroups(ctx: OutboxCtx, entries: readonly OutboxEntry[]): OutboxGroups {
  const groups: OutboxGroups = { messages: [], done: [], lookedUp: [], told: [], listening: listening(ctx.catalogue) };
  entries.forEach((e, i) => {
    const key = `${e.kind}-${i}`;
    if (e.kind === 'notification') {
      const addressed = people(ctx, e.to);
      if ('action' in e.from) {
        groups.messages.push({ key, entry: i, to: e.recipients, addressed, text: messageText(ctx, e.message), from: fromWhere(ctx, e.from.action) });
      } else {
        const { subject, text } = builtInMessage(ctx, e);
        groups.messages.push({ key, entry: i, to: e.recipients, addressed, subject, text, from: t('tryit.outbox.fromBuiltIn') });
      }
    } else if (e.kind === 'call') {
      const entry = ctx.catalogue?.entries.find((x) => x.id === e.operation);
      const op = entry?.kind === 'operation' ? entry : undefined;
      const title = sayText('tryit.outbox.callTitle', { connection: connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, entry?.connection), action: entry?.label || t('tryit.anAction') });
      const reason = failureWords(ctx, e.action, e.failure?.code);
      const stateWords =
        e.state === 'pending' ? t('tryit.outbox.pending')
        : e.state === 'ok' ? t('tryit.outbox.ok')
        : e.state === 'late' ? t('tryit.outbox.late')
        : sayText('tryit.outbox.failed', { reason: e.failure?.message ? sayText('tryit.outbox.failedWithText', { reason, text: toText(quoted(e.failure.message)) }) : reason });
      (isRead(e) ? groups.lookedUp : groups.done).push({
        key, entry: i, call: e.call, title, sent: rows(ctx, e.inputs, op?.input), state: e.state, stateWords,
        result: rows(ctx, e.result, op?.result), from: fromWhere(ctx, e.action),
      });
    } else if ('builtIn' in e.what) {
      groups.told.push({
        key, entry: i, title: toldTitle(ctx, e.what.builtIn, e.values), values: builtInRows(ctx, e.what.builtIn, e.values), from: t('tryit.outbox.withoutSetup'),
      });
    } else {
      const tell = e.what.tell;
      const thing = ctx.doc.thingsTold?.find((x) => x.id === tell);
      groups.told.push({
        key, entry: i, title: sayText('tryit.outbox.told.thing', { thing: toText(quoted(thing?.words || t('describe.noName'))) }),
        values: toldRows(ctx, e.what.action.item, e.values), from: fromWhere(ctx, e.what.action),
      });
    }
  });
  return groups;
}

/** A status as what other systems are told carries it: `{ id, label }`, said by its label. */
function toldStatus(ctx: OutboxCtx, v: Json | undefined): string {
  if (v === undefined) return t('tryit.noStatus');
  if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && typeof v.label === 'string') return v.label || t('describe.noName');
  return toText(said(ctx, v));
}

function toldTitle(ctx: OutboxCtx, what: BuiltInTold, values: Record<string, Json>): string {
  switch (what) {
    case 'requestStarted':
      return t('tryit.outbox.told.requestStarted');
    case 'unstuck':
      return t('tryit.outbox.told.unstuck');
    case 'statusChanged':
      return values.to === undefined ? t('tryit.outbox.told.statusEmptied') : sayText('tryit.outbox.told.statusChanged', { status: toldStatus(ctx, values.to) });
    case 'stuck':
      return sayText('tryit.outbox.told.stuck', { stage: stageName(ctx.doc, typeof values.stage === 'string' ? values.stage : undefined) });
    case 'ended':
      // The ending it finished at (E-32); none when it was closed by the people who look after stuck requests.
      return typeof values.stage === 'string' ? sayText('tryit.outbox.told.endedAt', { stage: stageName(ctx.doc, values.stage) }) : t('tryit.outbox.told.closed');
    default: {
      const never: never = what;
      return never;
    }
  }
}

const isBy = (v: unknown): v is By =>
  !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && typeof (v as { type?: unknown }).type === 'string' && typeof (v as { id?: unknown }).id === 'string';

/**
 * Everything a built-in told carries, in words, field by field (docs/05-integrations.md, "What
 * other systems are told"): who started it and through which "Starts when", the status before and
 * now, the stage and why it is stuck, who put it right, how it ended. They carry IDs, status and
 * reason only, never answers (E-22). The envelope's request number and workflow come first. A
 * field this page does not know is still shown, as "Another detail".
 */
function builtInRows(ctx: OutboxCtx, what: BuiltInTold, values: Record<string, Json>): Row[] {
  const row = (label: string, value: Phrase | string): Row => ({ label, value: typeof value === 'string' ? [named('constant', value)] : value });
  const out: Row[] = [
    ...(ctx.readableId ? [row(t('tryit.outbox.row.request'), sayText('tryit.outbox.requestNumber', { n: ctx.readableId }))] : []),
    ...(ctx.workflowName ? [row(t('tryit.outbox.row.workflow'), ctx.workflowName)] : []),
  ];
  for (const [key, v] of Object.entries(values)) {
    switch (key) {
      case 'startedBy':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.startedBy'), isBy(v) ? whoDid(ctx, v) : said(ctx, v)));
        break;
      case 'trigger': {
        const trig = v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : {};
        const binding = ctx.doc.start?.startsWhen?.find((b) => b.id === trig.id);
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.startedThrough'), binding ? toText(describeStartsWhenName(binding, ctx.env)) : t('tryit.aConnection')));
        if (trig.eventId !== undefined) {
          out.push(row(sayText('tryit.outbox.row.reference', { connection: connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, typeof trig.connection === 'string' ? trig.connection : undefined) }), said(ctx, trig.eventId)));
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'from':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.statusBefore'), toldStatus(ctx, v)));
        break;
      case 'to':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.statusNow'), toldStatus(ctx, v)));
        break;
      case 'status':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.status'), toldStatus(ctx, v)));
        break;
      case 'stage':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.stage'), stageName(ctx.doc, typeof v === 'string' ? v : undefined)));
        break;
      case 'reason':
        out.push(row(t(what === 'unstuck' ? 'tryit.outbox.row.wasStuckBecause' : 'tryit.outbox.row.why'), isStuckReason(v) ? reasonClause(v) : said(ctx, v)));
        break;
      case 'closedBy':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.closedBy'), t(v === 'admin' ? 'tryit.outbox.closedByAdmin' : 'tryit.outbox.closedByWorkflow')));
        break;
      case 'by':
        out.push(row(t('tryit.outbox.row.by'), isBy(v) ? whoDid(ctx, v) : said(ctx, v)));
        break;
      default:
        out.push(row(t('tryit.anotherDetail'), said(ctx, v)));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The connections that listen to what the platform tells. */
function listening(catalogue: Catalogue | null): string[] {
  if (!catalogue) return [];
  const ids = [...new Set(catalogue.entries.filter((e) => e.kind === 'eventSink').map((e) => e.connection))];
  return ids.map((id) => connectionLabel(catalogue, id));
}

/** "Diego Santos and Mei Tanaka" as chips. */
export const peoplePhrase = (names: Names, refs: readonly Ref[]): Phrase =>
  refs.length ? joinList(refs.map((r) => [named(r.type === 'user' ? 'person' : 'group', nameOfRef(names, r), r.id)])) : [t('tryit.outbox.nobody')];

// ── The same entries, said in the story ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** One sentence of the story about what a move sent, with the outbox entry it opens. */
export interface StoryNote {
  entry: number;
  text: Phrase;
}

const lowerFirst = (s: string) => (s ? s[0]!.toLowerCase() + s.slice(1) : s);

/**
 * For each line of the story, the outbox entries its turns caused, by the time of the turn (a turn's
 * story entries and what it sent share one time). Lines whose turns sent nothing are left out.
 */
export function outboxByLine(lines: readonly StoryLine[], story: readonly StoryEntry[], entries: readonly OutboxEntry[], requestId?: string): Map<number, number[]> {
  const turnAt = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const e of story) if (!turnAt.has(e.at)) turnAt.set(e.at, e.turn);
  const out = new Map<number, number[]>();
  entries.forEach((e, i) => {
    if (requestId && e.requestId !== requestId) return;
    const turn = turnAt.get(e.at);
    if (turn === undefined) return;
    const line = lines.find((l) => turn >= l.turn && turn <= l.lastTurn);
    if (!line) return;
    out.set(line.turn, [...(out.get(line.turn) ?? []), i]);
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * What the outbox entries of one line say in the story: each message and to whom ("Priya Raman was
 * told: "Your change request was rejected""), each thing done in or asked of another system, each
 * thing told ("Other systems were told "Change deployed"."), and what is always told, in one sentence.
 * A "Wait for" is left out (the story already says the stage asked it), and so is a read (it only
 * reads; the Test outbox lists it under its own heading).
 */
export function storyNotes(ctx: OutboxCtx, entries: readonly OutboxEntry[], indexes: readonly number[]): StoryNote[] {
  const notes: StoryNote[] = [];
  const builtIns: { entry: number; what: string; status: boolean }[] = [];
  for (const i of indexes) {
    const e = entries[i];
    if (!e) continue;
    if (e.kind === 'notification') {
      const message = 'action' in e.from ? messageText(ctx, e.message) : (() => {
        const b = builtInMessage(ctx, e);
        return b.subject ? [b.subject] : b.text;
      })();
      const many = takesPlural(e.to.map((r) => ({ kind: r.type === 'group' ? ('group' as const) : ('person' as const) })));
      notes.push({ entry: i, text: say(many ? 'tryit.note.toldMany' : 'tryit.note.toldOne', { who: peoplePhrase(ctx.names, e.to), text: quoted(message) }) });
    } else if (e.kind === 'call') {
      // A "Wait for" is already in the story; a read only reads, so nothing was done or told there.
      if (e.sort === 'await' || e.sort === 'read') continue;
      const entry = ctx.catalogue?.entries.find((x) => x.id === e.operation);
      const connection = [named('connection', connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, entry?.connection))];
      const what = whatItDoes(ctx.catalogue, e.operation);
      notes.push({ entry: i, text: what ? say('tryit.note.asked', { connection, what }) : say('tryit.note.askedPlain', { connection }) });
    } else if ('builtIn' in e.what) {
      // Several status changes in one move read as one: "its status changed to Preparing, then to Deploying".
      const prev = builtIns[builtIns.length - 1];
      if (e.what.builtIn === 'statusChanged' && e.values.to !== undefined && prev?.status) {
        prev.what += sayText('tryit.note.statusThen', { status: toldStatus(ctx, e.values.to) });
      } else {
        builtIns.push({ entry: i, what: lowerFirst(toldTitle(ctx, e.what.builtIn, e.values)), status: e.what.builtIn === 'statusChanged' && e.values.to !== undefined });
      }
    } else {
      const tell = e.what.tell;
      const thing = ctx.doc.thingsTold?.find((x) => x.id === tell);
      notes.push({ entry: i, text: say('tryit.note.thing', { thing: quoted(thing?.words || t('describe.noName')) }) });
    }
  }
  if (builtIns.length) {
    notes.push({ entry: builtIns[0]!.entry, text: say('tryit.note.builtIn', { what: joinList(builtIns.map((b) => [b.what])) }) });
  }
  return notes;
}

/** The accessible name of a note's link: which entry it opens. */
export const noteLinkLabel = (note: StoryNote): string => sayText('tryit.note.readLabel', { what: toText(concat(note.text)) });

/**
 * A refused turn (services types-errors.ts) said in words, naming the question, button or person
 * by name. A code this build does not know gets plain fallback words, never its code.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ButtonId, Location } from '@/contract';
import { describeFinding, describeLocation, getButton, getQuestion, getStage, stageOf, toText, type DescribeEnv, type FindingEnv } from '@/model';
import type { Finding, Ref, Refusal } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { sayText } from './say';
import { reasonClause } from './story';
import { nameOfRef, type Names } from './values';

export interface RefusalCtx {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  names: Names;
  /** The person who acted. */
  as?: Ref | null;
  /** The button that was pressed. */
  button?: ButtonId;
  /** The connection that sent it, for a start by another system. */
  connection?: string;
}

const RULES: Record<string, WordKey> = {
  'wrong-kind': 'tryit.refusal.wrongKind',
  'not-a-choice': 'tryit.refusal.notAChoice',
  'too-long': 'tryit.refusal.tooLong',
  'too-short': 'tryit.refusal.tooShort',
  'out-of-range': 'tryit.refusal.outOfRange',
  'bad-format': 'tryit.refusal.badFormat',
  'unknown-question': 'tryit.refusal.unknownQuestion',
  'hidden-answered': 'tryit.refusal.hiddenAnswered',
};

export function refusalWords(ctx: RefusalCtx, r: Refusal): string {
  const { doc } = ctx;
  const question = getQuestion(doc, r.location?.item)?.label || t('describe.noName');
  const buttonId = (r.code === 'check' ? r.params.button : undefined) ?? ctx.button;
  const button = getButton(doc, buttonId)?.label || t('describe.noName');
  const name = ctx.as ? nameOfRef(ctx.names, ctx.as) : t('tryit.someone');
  const where = r.location ? toText(describeLocation(doc, r.location, ctx.env)) : '';
  switch (r.code) {
    case 'invalid-data': {
      if (r.params.rule === 'required') return ctx.button ? sayText('tryit.refusal.required', { question, button }) : sayText('tryit.refusal.requiredPlain', { question });
      return sayText(RULES[r.params.rule] ?? 'tryit.refusal.wrongKind', { question });
    }
    case 'choice-unknown':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.choiceUnknown', { question });
    case 'check':
      return r.message || sayText('tryit.refusal.check', { button });
    case 'rule-error':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.ruleError', { where });
    case 'may':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.may', { name });
    case 'not-assignee':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.notAssignee', { name });
    case 'wait-not-open':
    case 'unknown-button':
    case 'not-found':
      return t('tryit.refusal.closedTask');
    case 'unfinished':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.unfinished', { where });
    case 'mapping-error':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.mapping', { connection: ctx.connection ?? t('tryit.aConnection'), where });
    case 'not-admin':
      return t('tryit.refusal.notAdmin');
    case 'reason-required':
      return t('tryit.refusal.reasonRequired');
    case 'not-stuck':
      return t('tryit.refusal.notStuck');
    case 'not-retryable':
      return sayText('tryit.refusal.notRetryable', { reason: reasonClause(r.params.reason) });
    case 'request-closed':
      return t('tryit.refusal.requestClosed');
    case 'busy':
    case 'membership-unavailable':
    case 'source-unavailable':
      return t('tryit.refusal.tryAgain');
    default:
      return t('tryit.refusal.other');
  }
}

/** Why a start by another system was refused, in the words of contract/words/notifications.json (and `unfinished`, Try it's own). */
export function refusedBecause(code: string): string {
  const known = ['mapping-error', 'may', 'invalid-data', 'choice-unknown', 'check', 'rule-error', 'unfinished'];
  return known.includes(code) ? t(`tryit.refusedBecause.${code}` as WordKey) : t('tryit.refusedBecause.other');
}

/**
 * What is not finished at an item (an arrow, an action, a "Starts when" card), from the draft's
 * check as the test host read it: each To do's cause in words, with where it is for Show me. A To
 * do inside another one's part ("answers.x.readsAs" under "answers.x") is said once, by the outer one.
 */
export function unfinishedAt(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, env: FindingEnv, findings: readonly Finding[], item: string | undefined): { cause: string; location: Location }[] {
  if (!item) return [];
  const todos = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo' && !!f.location);
  let here = todos.filter((f) => f.location.item === item);
  // Stuck at a stage: what is unfinished in it (its tasks, actions, arrows).
  if (!here.length && getStage(doc, item)) here = todos.filter((f) => stageOf(doc, f.location.item)?.id === item);
  const parts = here.map((f) => f.location.part ?? '');
  const outer = here.filter((f) => {
    const part = f.location.part ?? '';
    return !parts.some((p) => p !== part && (p === '' || part.startsWith(`${p}.`)));
  });
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: { cause: string; location: Location }[] = [];
  for (const f of outer) {
    const cause = describeFinding(doc, f, env).cause;
    if (seen.has(cause)) continue;
    seen.add(cause);
    out.push({ cause, location: f.location });
  }
  return out;
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/tryit/say.ts\n===
/**
 * Small helpers that build Try it's sentences as describe Phrases (text and chips), from the words
 * in src/words/tryit.ts, so names can be shown bold and read as one sentence. Lists of names are
 * joined with the shared list words (describe.comma, describe.and).
 */
import { toText, type Chip, type ChipKind, type Part, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { t, words, type WordKey } from '@/words';

export type Fill = Phrase | Part | string | number;

/** The words for `key` with each `{name}` replaced by `fill[name]` (a phrase, a chip or plain text). */
export function say(key: WordKey, fill: Record<string, Fill> = {}): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  const text: string = words[key];
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)) {
    const name = m[1] as string;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fill, name)) continue;
    push(out, text.slice(last, m.index));
    const value = fill[name] as Fill;
    if (typeof value === 'number') push(out, String(value));
    else for (const part of Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]) push(out, part);
    last = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
  }
  push(out, text.slice(last));
  return out;
}

function push(out: Phrase, part: Part) {
  if (typeof part === 'string') {
    if (!part) return;
    const prev = out[out.length - 1];
    if (typeof prev === 'string') out[out.length - 1] = prev + part;
    else out.push(part);
  } else out.push(part);
}

/** Phrases one after another, as one phrase. */
export function concat(...phrases: Phrase[]): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  for (const p of phrases) for (const part of p) push(out, part);
  return out;
}

export const named = (kind: ChipKind, label: string, id?: string): Chip => (id ? { chip: kind, label, id } : { chip: kind, label });

/** "A", "A and B", "A, B and C", with the shared list words. */
export function joinList(items: Phrase[]): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  const and = ` ${t('describe.and')} `;
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (i > 0) push(out, i === items.length - 1 ? and : t('describe.comma'));
    for (const part of item) push(out, part);
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * A text to be quoted inside a sentence that ends with its own full stop ('was told: "{text}".'):
 * the text's one final full stop is left out, whether it ends in plain words or in a name, so the
 * sentence never ends with two.
 */
export function quoted(text: Phrase | string): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = typeof text === 'string' ? [text] : [...text];
  // One full stop at the end, not an ellipsis ("Wait for it...").
  const cut = (s: string) => s.replace(/\s+$/, '').replace(/(?<!\.)\.$/, '');
  for (let i = out.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const part = out[i]!;
    if (typeof part === 'string') {
      const rest = cut(part);
      if (rest) out[i] = rest;
      else out.splice(i, 1);
      // A text that was only a full stop or blank: the part before it ends the quote.
      if (!rest) continue;
    } else if ('label' in part) {
      out[i] = { ...part, label: cut(part.label) };
    } else {
      out[i] = { ...part, text: cut(part.text) };
    }
    break;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Plain names joined the same way. */
export const joinNames = (names: string[]): string => toText(joinList(names.map((n) => [n])));

/** A plain sentence. */
export const sayText = (key: WordKey, fill: Record<string, Fill> = {}): string => toText(say(key, fill));
