/**
 * The test request's story, as the engine gives it (core's `story`, services types-story.ts), put
 * into words: codes, locations and params in, sentences out. One line per move, leading with what
 * the person did: "Marcus Lee pressed Approve, so it went to Create Jira issue." A stage that
 * happens by itself is folded into the same line when it follows directly ("Create Jira issue
 * happened by itself and went on to Development."), and so is an action answered in a turn of its
 * own. A line says why an arrow was taken when it depended on answers (what the engine says it read).
 *
 * `entryWords` has a sentence for every entry kind the engine can give (tryit.test.ts checks each);
 * the lines use it for every entry they do not fold into the person's sentence.
 */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Location, SentExpression, SentTemplate } from '@/contract';
import {
  actionName, arrowLabel, describeConstant, describeLocation, failureCodeWords, find, getAction, getArrow, getButton, getQuestion, getStage,
  getTask, getValue, labelAfterConnection, nameOf, stageOf, toText, yesNoPredicate, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase,
} from '@/model';
import type { By, Json, ReadOf, RequestView, StoryEntry, StuckReason, WhyRead } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { concat, joinList, named, quoted, say } from './say';
import { nameOfRef, sayValue, type Names } from './values';

export interface WhyWords {
  arrow: string;
  /** What the arrow read, when it depended on answers. */
  reads: Phrase | null;
  /** The arrows checked before it that did not fit (Try it only). */
  notFitting: string[];
}

export interface StoryLine {
  /** The first turn of the line (unique). */
  turn: number;
  /** The last turn folded into it. */
  lastTurn: number;
  /** Where it happened: the stage the line starts at. */
  stage?: string;
  text: Phrase;
  why: WhyWords[];
  /** For the mark beside the line. */
  tone: 'move' | 'stuck' | 'ended' | 'info';
}

export interface StoryCtx {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  catalogue: Catalogue | null;
  names: Names;
}

/** Words for each stuck reason (contract/words/notifications.json, reasons). Every reason core gives has its own. */
const REASONS: Record<StuckReason, { clause: WordKey; whatYouCanDo: WordKey }> = {
  'action-failed': { clause: 'tryit.reason.action-failed.clause', whatYouCanDo: 'tryit.reason.action-failed.whatYouCanDo' },
  'nobody-to-ask': { clause: 'tryit.reason.nobody-to-ask.clause', whatYouCanDo: 'tryit.reason.nobody-to-ask.whatYouCanDo' },
  'nothing-fits': { clause: 'tryit.reason.nothing-fits.clause', whatYouCanDo: 'tryit.reason.nothing-fits.whatYouCanDo' },
  error: { clause: 'tryit.reason.error.clause', whatYouCanDo: 'tryit.reason.error.whatYouCanDo' },
  unfinished: { clause: 'tryit.reason.unfinished.clause', whatYouCanDo: 'tryit.reason.unfinished.whatYouCanDo' },
};

export const reasonClause = (reason: StuckReason): string => t(REASONS[reason].clause);
export const reasonWhatYouCanDo = (reason: StuckReason): string => t(REASONS[reason].whatYouCanDo);
/** For a stuck reason read from what other systems are told (plain JSON there). */
export const isStuckReason = (x: unknown): x is StuckReason => typeof x === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(REASONS, x);

/** The describe functions write a column inside a sentence with a small first letter ("Primary domain's approvers"). */
const lowerFirst = (s: string) => (s ? s[0]!.toLowerCase() + s.slice(1) : s);

export const stageChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined) => {
  const stage = getStage(doc, id);
  return named('stage', stage?.name || (stage ? t('describe.noName') : t('tryit.aStage')), id);
};

export const buttonChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined) => {
  const b = getButton(doc, id);
  return named('button', b?.label || (b ? t('describe.noName') : t('tryit.aButton')), id);
};

/** A status by its words, as the draft names it. */
export const statusChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined) =>
  named('status', doc.statuses?.find((s) => s.id === id)?.words || t('describe.noName'), id);

/** A person, a connection or the platform, by name. */
export function whoDid(ctx: StoryCtx, by: By | undefined): Phrase {
  if (!by) return [named('person', t('tryit.someone'))];
  if (by.type === 'user') return [named('person', nameOfRef(ctx.names, { type: 'user', id: by.id }), by.id)];
  if (by.type === 'connection') return [named('connection', connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, by.id))];
  return [t('tryit.thePlatform')];
}

export const connectionLabel = (catalogue: Catalogue | null, id: string | undefined): string =>
  catalogue?.connections.find((c) => c.id === id)?.label ?? t('tryit.aConnection');

/** The connection an action uses, by name. */
export function connectionOfAction(ctx: Pick<StoryCtx, 'catalogue'>, action: Action | undefined): string {
  if (action?.type !== 'useConnection') return t('tryit.aConnection');
  const entry = ctx.catalogue?.entries.find((e) => e.id === action.operation);
  return connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, entry?.connection);
}

export function actionWords(ctx: StoryCtx, location: Location | undefined): Phrase {
  const action = getAction(ctx.doc, location?.item);
  return action ? actionName(ctx.doc, action, ctx.env) : [t('tryit.anAction')];
}

/** The words the catalogue gives an operation's failure code ("The project does not exist"); never the code itself. */
export function failureWords(ctx: Pick<StoryCtx, 'catalogue' | 'doc'>, location: Location | undefined, code: string | undefined): string {
  if (!code) return t('tryit.theFailure');
  const action = getAction(ctx.doc, location?.item);
  const operation = action?.type === 'useConnection' ? action.operation : undefined;
  return failureCodeWords(ctx.catalogue ?? undefined, operation, code) ?? t('tryit.unnamedFailure');
}

/** "deploy a service": what an operation does, as said after "asked Deploy pipeline to". */
export function whatItDoes(catalogue: Catalogue | null, operation: string | undefined): string {
  return lowerFirst(labelAfterConnection(catalogue ?? undefined, operation) ?? '');
}

/** A value in words, with the value it is held in (so a failure code reads as words). */
export const sayHeld = (ctx: StoryCtx, value: Json, valueId?: string): Phrase =>
  sayValue(ctx.doc, value, ctx.names, undefined, { ...(valueId ? { valueId } : {}), catalogue: ctx.catalogue });

/** One thing a condition read, in words: "Primary domain is Payments". */
export function sayRead(ctx: StoryCtx, read: WhyRead): Phrase {
  const of = read.of as ReadOf;
  const value = read.value === undefined ? null : sayHeld(ctx, read.value, 'value' in of && !(of.path ?? []).length ? of.value : undefined);
  let what: Phrase;
  if ('value' in of) {
    const v = getValue(ctx.doc, of.value);
    what = [named('value', v?.name || t('describe.noName'), of.value)];
  } else if ('request' in of) {
    what = [named('value', t(of.request === 'startedOn' ? 'describe.request.startedOn' : 'describe.request.requester'))];
  } else if ('pressed' in of) {
    const task = getTask(ctx.doc, of.pressed);
    const stage = task ? stageOf(ctx.doc, task.id) : undefined;
    const taskName = [named('stage', task?.name || stage?.name || t('describe.noName'))];
    return value ? say('tryit.readPressed', { task: taskName, value }) : say('tryit.readPressedEmpty', { task: taskName });
  } else {
    const row = describeConstant(ctx.doc, { row: of.row });
    const column = find(ctx.doc, of.column);
    const columnName = column ? nameOf(column) : '';
    // A Yes/No column named verb-first reads as a statement, as describe says it: "Payments needs
    // approval" / "Payments needs no approval", never "Payments's Needs approval is Yes" (section 5).
    const predicate = typeof read.value === 'boolean' && column?.kind === 'column' ? yesNoPredicate(columnName, read.value) : undefined;
    if (predicate) return say('tryit.readCellYesNo', { row, predicate });
    const said = lowerFirst(columnName);
    return value ? say('tryit.readCell', { row, column: said, value }) : say('tryit.readCellEmpty', { row, column: said });
  }
  return value ? say('tryit.read', { what, value }) : say('tryit.readEmpty', { what });
}

/** Whether an arrow is taken by a button: what it read of the button pressed is already said by "pressed X". */
const byButton = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrowId: string) => getArrow(doc, arrowId)?.when.type === 'buttonPressed';

/** Why an arrow was taken. Null reads: the arrow did not depend on answers. */
function whyWords(ctx: StoryCtx, entry: Extract<StoryEntry, { code: 'moved' }>): WhyWords {
  const arrow = getArrow(ctx.doc, entry.params.arrow);
  const label = arrow ? arrowLabel(ctx.doc, arrow) : t('describe.noName');
  const why = entry.params.why;
  const checked = [...(why ? [why.taken] : []), ...(why?.notFitting ?? [])];
  const reads = checked.flatMap((c) => c.reads.filter((r) => !('pressed' in r.of) || !byButton(ctx.doc, c.arrow)));
  // The same thing read twice (by two arrows) is said once.
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const unique = reads.filter((r) => {
    const k = JSON.stringify(r);
    if (seen.has(k)) return false;
    seen.add(k);
    return true;
  });
  const notFitting = (why?.notFitting ?? []).map((n) => {
    const a = getArrow(ctx.doc, n.arrow);
    return a ? arrowLabel(ctx.doc, a) : t('describe.noName');
  });
  return { arrow: label, reads: unique.length ? say('tryit.because', { reads: joinList(unique.map((r) => sayRead(ctx, r))) }) : null, notFitting };
}

/** Whether a stage asks nobody: it happens by itself. */
function happensByItself(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: string): boolean {
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
  return !!stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' && !(stage.tasks ?? []).length;
}

/** The turns that start a new line: a person (or another system) did something, or the author answered for a system. */
function startsLine(entry: StoryEntry): boolean {
  switch (entry.code) {
    case 'started':
    case 'task.answered':
    case 'retried':
    case 'closed':
      return true;
    case 'action.done':
    case 'action.failed':
      return entry.params.sort === 'await' && !entry.params.late;
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

/** The story as lines, oldest first. */
export function storyLines(ctx: StoryCtx, view: Pick<RequestView, 'story'>): StoryLine[] {
  const turns: StoryEntry[][] = [];
  for (const e of view.story) {
    const last = turns[turns.length - 1];
    if (last && last[0]!.turn === e.turn) last.push(e);
    else turns.push([e]);
  }
  const lines: StoryLine[] = [];
  /** Per line, the status it ends with: said once, at the end of the line. */
  const statuses: (Phrase | null)[] = [];
  for (const turn of turns) {
    const first = turn[0]!;
    const prev = lines[lines.length - 1];
    const { status, ...words } = turnWords(ctx, turn, view.story);
    if (prev && !startsLine(first)) {
      prev.text = concat(prev.text, prev.text.length && words.text.length ? [' '] : [], words.text);
      prev.why.push(...words.why);
      prev.lastTurn = first.turn;
      if (words.tone !== 'move') prev.tone = words.tone;
      if (status) statuses[statuses.length - 1] = status;
    } else {
      lines.push({ turn: first.turn, lastTurn: first.turn, ...(words.stage ? { stage: words.stage } : {}), ...words });
      statuses.push(status);
    }
  }
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    const status = statuses[i];
    if (status && line.tone !== 'ended') line.text = concat(line.text, line.text.length ? [' '] : [], status);
  });
  return lines;
}

function locationStage(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location | undefined): string | undefined {
  return location ? stageOf(doc, location.item)?.id : undefined;
}

/** Who a task asks, by name: "Payments approvers", "Diego Santos and Mei Tanaka". */
function askedPhrase(ctx: StoryCtx, askedOf: readonly { type: 'user' | 'group'; id: string }[]): Phrase {
  return askedOf.length
    ? joinList(askedOf.map((r) => [named(r.type === 'user' ? 'person' : 'group', nameOfRef(ctx.names, r), r.id)]))
    : [t('tryit.nobodyLower')];
}

/**
 * One story entry as a sentence of its own, for every kind the engine gives. The lines use it for
 * every entry they do not fold into the sentence of the person who acted.
 */
export function entryWords(ctx: StoryCtx, e: StoryEntry, story: readonly StoryEntry[] = []): Phrase {
  const { doc } = ctx;
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'started':
      return e.params.by.type === 'connection'
        ? say('tryit.entry.startedBySystem', { connection: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by) })
        : say('tryit.entry.started', { who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), button: [buttonChip(doc, e.params.button)] });
    case 'task.opened':
      return say('tryit.line.taskOpened', { stage: [stageChip(doc, locationStage(doc, e.location))], who: askedPhrase(ctx, e.params.askedOf) });
    case 'task.answered':
      return say('tryit.entry.answered', {
        who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), button: [buttonChip(doc, e.params.button)], stage: [stageChip(doc, locationStage(doc, e.location))],
      });
    case 'task.noLongerNeeded': {
      const opened = story.find((x) => x.code === 'task.opened' && x.params.task === e.params.task);
      const who = opened?.code === 'task.opened' && opened.params.askedOf.length ? askedPhrase(ctx, opened.params.askedOf) : [t('tryit.someone')];
      const stage = [stageChip(doc, locationStage(doc, e.location))];
      const key: WordKey = e.params.because === 'movedOn' ? 'tryit.line.noLongerNeeded'
        : e.params.because === 'closed' ? 'tryit.line.noLongerNeededClosed' : 'tryit.line.noLongerNeededRetried';
      return say(key, { who, stage });
    }
    case 'action.waiting': {
      // The stage is the subject, never the action's label (mockup 14-connections try-it):
      // "Deploy asked Deploy pipeline to deploy a service. The request stays at Deploy until Deploy pipeline answers."
      const action = getAction(doc, e.location?.item);
      const what = whatItDoes(ctx.catalogue, action?.type === 'useConnection' ? action.operation : undefined);
      const fill = { stage: [stageChip(doc, locationStage(doc, e.location))], connection: [named('connection', connectionOfAction(ctx, action))] };
      return what ? say('tryit.line.actionSent', { ...fill, what }) : say('tryit.line.actionSentPlain', fill);
    }
    case 'action.done':
      if (e.params.late) return say('tryit.line.actionDoneLate', { action: actionWords(ctx, e.location) });
      return say(e.params.sort === 'read' ? 'tryit.line.actionLookedUp' : 'tryit.line.actionDone', { action: actionWords(ctx, e.location) });
    case 'action.failed': {
      const failure = failureWords(ctx, e.location, e.params.failureCode);
      if (e.params.late) return say('tryit.line.actionFailedLate', { action: actionWords(ctx, e.location), failure });
      return say(e.params.carriedOn ? 'tryit.line.actionFailedCarriedOn' : 'tryit.line.actionFailed', { action: actionWords(ctx, e.location), failure });
    }
    case 'value.saved': {
      const v = getValue(doc, e.params.value);
      const value = [named('value', v?.name || t('describe.noName'), e.params.value)];
      return e.params.to === undefined ? say('tryit.line.emptied', { value }) : say('tryit.line.saved', { value, to: sayHeld(ctx, e.params.to, e.params.value) });
    }
    case 'moved': {
      const key: WordKey = e.params.sentBack ? 'tryit.line.movedBack' : 'tryit.line.movedOn';
      return say(happensByItself(doc, e.params.from) ? (e.params.sentBack ? 'tryit.line.byItselfBack' : 'tryit.line.byItself') : key, {
        stage: [stageChip(doc, e.params.from)], next: [stageChip(doc, e.params.to)],
      });
    }
    case 'status.changed':
      return e.params.to === undefined ? say('tryit.line.statusNone') : say('tryit.line.status', { status: [statusChip(doc, e.params.to)] });
    case 'stuck': {
      const at = locationStage(doc, e.params.location) ?? locationStage(doc, e.location);
      const fill = { stage: [stageChip(doc, at)], reason: reasonClause(e.params.reason) };
      // Unfinished: which part of the draft it reached (the stuck box lists its To dos, each with Show me).
      const where = e.params.reason === 'unfinished' && e.params.location ? toText(describeLocation(doc, e.params.location, ctx.env)) : '';
      return where ? say('tryit.line.stuckAt', { ...fill, where }) : say('tryit.line.stuck', fill);
    }
    case 'retried':
      return say('tryit.line.retried', { who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), reason: quoted(e.params.reason) });
    case 'closed':
      return say('tryit.line.closed', { who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), reason: quoted(e.params.reason) });
    case 'ended':
      return say('tryit.line.ended', { ending: [stageChip(doc, e.params.ending)] });
    default: {
      // Every code core gives has words above: a new one fails to compile here.
      const never: never = e;
      return never;
    }
  }
}
/** The words of one turn: one or more sentences. */
function turnWords(ctx: StoryCtx, turn: StoryEntry[], story: StoryEntry[]): Omit<StoryLine, 'turn' | 'lastTurn'> & { status: Phrase | null } {
  const { doc } = ctx;
  const sentences: Phrase[] = [];
  /** Said after the moves: who is no longer needed, who is asked now, the status now. */
  const later: Phrase[] = [];
  let status: Phrase | null = null;
  const why: WhyWords[] = [];
  let tone: StoryLine['tone'] = 'move';
  /** A subject waiting for its "so it went to ...". */
  let open: Phrase | null = null;
  let stage: string | undefined;
  let lastTo: string | undefined;
  let moves = 0;
  const close = (rest: Phrase) => {
    if (open) sentences.push(concat(open, rest));
    open = null;
  };
  const alone = (e: StoryEntry) => {
    close(say('tryit.line.period'));
    sentences.push(entryWords(ctx, e, story));
  };

  for (const e of turn) {
    stage ??= locationStage(doc, e.location);
    switch (e.code) {
      case 'started': {
        stage = doc.start?.stage ?? stage;
        open = e.params.by.type === 'connection'
          ? say('tryit.line.startedBySystem', { connection: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by) })
          : say('tryit.line.startedBy', { who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), button: [buttonChip(doc, e.params.button)] });
        break;
      }
      case 'task.answered': {
        const taskId = e.location?.item;
        const task = getTask(doc, taskId);
        const st = taskId ? stageOf(doc, taskId) : undefined;
        const several = st && st.kind !== 'ending' && (st.tasks ?? []).length > 1;
        const fill = { who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), button: [buttonChip(doc, e.params.button)] };
        open = several
          ? say('tryit.line.answeredFor', { ...fill, task: [named('stage', task?.name || taskAskedWords(ctx, story, e.params.task))] })
          : say('tryit.line.answered', fill);
        break;
      }
      case 'task.noLongerNeeded':
      case 'task.opened':
        // Said after the move it came with: "... so it went to Rejected. Payments approvers no longer need to answer ..."
        later.push(entryWords(ctx, e, story));
        break;
      case 'status.changed':
        // The status the line ends with; Other systems told says each change.
        status = entryWords(ctx, e, story);
        break;
      case 'action.waiting':
        alone(e);
        break;
      case 'action.done': {
        if (e.params.late) alone(e);
        else if (e.params.sort === 'await') {
          const action = getAction(doc, e.location?.item);
          open = say('tryit.line.answeredFor.call', { connection: connectionOfAction(ctx, action), answer: t('tryit.line.succeeded') });
        }
        // A look-up or a "does something" answered in its own turn says nothing more here: the
        // stage "happened by itself" and the Test outbox shows what was done.
        break;
      }
      case 'action.failed': {
        if (e.params.sort === 'await' && !e.params.late) {
          const action = getAction(doc, e.location?.item);
          const failure = failureWords(ctx, e.location, e.params.failureCode);
          open = say('tryit.line.answeredFor.call', { connection: connectionOfAction(ctx, action), answer: say('tryit.line.failedBecause', { failure }) });
        } else alone(e);
        break;
      }
      case 'value.saved':
        alone(e);
        break;
      case 'moved': {
        moves += 1;
        const to = [stageChip(doc, e.params.to)];
        const w = whyWords(ctx, e);
        if (w.reads) why.push(w);
        if (open) close(say(e.params.sentBack ? 'tryit.line.wentBackTo' : 'tryit.line.wentTo', { stage: to }));
        else sentences.push(entryWords(ctx, e, story));
        lastTo = e.params.to;
        break;
      }
      case 'stuck':
        tone = 'stuck';
        alone(e);
        break;
      case 'retried':
      case 'closed':
        open = null;
        if (e.code === 'closed') tone = 'ended';
        sentences.push(entryWords(ctx, e, story));
        break;
      case 'ended':
        close(say('tryit.line.period'));
        tone = 'ended';
        if (e.params.ending !== lastTo) sentences.push(entryWords(ctx, e, story));
        break;
      default: {
        const never: never = e;
        void never;
      }
    }
  }
  if (open) {
    // A person answered but the request did not move: the others asked at this stage still have to answer.
    const answered = turn[0]?.code === 'task.answered' && !moves && tone === 'move';
    close(answered ? say('tryit.line.stays', { stage: [stageChip(doc, stage)] }) : say('tryit.line.period'));
  }
  const text = [...sentences, ...later].reduce<Phrase>((acc, s, i) => concat(acc, i ? [' '] : [], s), []);
  return { ...(stage ? { stage } : {}), text, why, tone, status };
}

/**
 * Where each value came from, by the last story entry that filled it: a person's answer at a
 * stage, the button pressed, an action's result, a saved value, what another system sent.
 */
export function valueSources(ctx: StoryCtx, story: readonly StoryEntry[]): Record<string, Phrase> {
  const { doc } = ctx;
  const out: Record<string, Phrase> = {};
  const answered = (answers: Record<string, unknown>, from: Phrase) => {
    for (const q of Object.keys(answers)) {
      const question = getQuestion(doc, q);
      if (question?.savedAs) out[question.savedAs] = from;
    }
  };
  for (const e of story) {
    switch (e.code) {
      case 'started': {
        const stage = [stageChip(doc, doc.start?.stage)];
        if (e.params.by.type !== 'connection') {
          answered(e.params.answers, say('tryit.from.answer', { who: whoDid(ctx, e.params.by), stage }));
          break;
        }
        // Started by another system: an answer read from what it sent is "what Helpdesk sent"; one the
        // author typed on the "Starts when" card is set by the workflow, whatever was sent.
        const connection = connectionLabel(ctx.catalogue, e.params.by.id);
        const binding = doc.start?.startsWhen?.find((b) => b.id === e.params.startsWhen);
        const sent = say('tryit.from.sent', { connection });
        const set = say('tryit.from.setOnStart', { connection });
        for (const q of Object.keys(e.params.answers)) {
          const question = getQuestion(doc, q);
          if (!question?.savedAs) continue;
          const expr = binding?.answers[q as keyof typeof binding.answers];
          out[question.savedAs] = expr === undefined || readsSent(expr) ? sent : set;
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'task.answered': {
        const task = getTask(doc, e.location?.item);
        const stage = [stageChip(doc, locationStage(doc, e.location))];
        const who = whoDid(ctx, e.params.by);
        answered(e.params.answers, say('tryit.from.answer', { who, stage }));
        if (task?.savesButtonPressedAs) out[task.savesButtonPressedAs] = say('tryit.from.pressed', { who, stage });
        if (task?.savesAnsweredByAs) out[task.savesAnsweredByAs] = say('tryit.from.answeredBy', { stage });
        break;
      }
      case 'action.done':
      case 'action.failed': {
        if (e.params.late) break;
        const action = getAction(doc, e.location?.item);
        if (action?.type !== 'useConnection') break;
        const name = actionWords(ctx, e.location);
        if (e.code === 'action.done') {
          for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(action.saveResults ?? {})) if (e.params.result && field in e.params.result) out[value] = say('tryit.from.action', { action: name });
          if (action.saveFailureAs?.failed) out[action.saveFailureAs.failed] = say('tryit.from.action', { action: name });
        } else if (e.params.carriedOn) {
          for (const v of [action.saveFailureAs?.failed, action.saveFailureAs?.code]) if (v) out[v] = say('tryit.from.actionFailed', { action: name });
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'value.saved':
        out[e.params.value] = say('tryit.from.saved', { action: actionWords(ctx, e.location) });
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Whether a "Starts when" answer reads anything the other system sent (a sent field, or a formula or text with one in it). */
export function readsSent(expr: SentExpression | SentTemplate): boolean {
  if (Array.isArray(expr)) return expr.some((part) => typeof part !== 'string' && readsSent(part));
  if (!expr || typeof expr !== 'object') return false;
  if ('sentField' in expr) return true;
  if ('formula' in expr) return /\{\{\s*sent\./.test(expr.formula);
  return false;
}

/** A task's name from who was asked when it opened ("Security team"). */
function taskAskedWords(ctx: StoryCtx, story: StoryEntry[], instance: string): string {
  const opened = story.find((x) => x.code === 'task.opened' && x.params.task === instance);
  const askedOf = opened?.code === 'task.opened' ? opened.params.askedOf : [];
  return toText(joinList(askedOf.map((r) => [nameOfRef(ctx.names, r)]))) || t('tryit.taskPlain');
}

/** For tests: the words key of a stuck reason's clause. */
export const reasonKey = (reason: StuckReason): WordKey => REASONS[reason].clause;

 * Try it's words: the built-in message and reason words still match contract/words/notifications.json,
 * a story entry or refusal this build does not know gets plain fallback words (never its code), and

    expect(t('tryit.builtIn.taskAssigned.body')).toBe(msg('task.assigned').body);

===\nfrontend/src/features/tryit/useTryIt.ts\n===
/**
 * The page's Try it session: one TryItController per visit, made from the open draft, its
 * catalogue and Settings, read with useSyncExternalStore.
 */
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import type { ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { useCatalogue, useEditor, useFacts, useSettings } from '@/model';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import { TryItController, type TryItState } from './controller';

const EMPTY = new TryItController({
  services: null as never, catalogue: null as never, settings: null, getDoc: () => null, replaceSample: () => undefined, kinds: () => ({}),
});

export function useTryIt(): { controller: TryItController | null; state: TryItState } {
  const services = useServices();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const settings = useSettings();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const kindsRef = useRef<Partial<Record<string, ValueKind>>>({});
  useEffect(() => {
    const kinds: Partial<Record<string, ValueKind>> = {};
    for (const [id, f] of Object.entries(facts?.values ?? {})) if (typeof f?.kind === 'string') kinds[id] = f.kind;
    kindsRef.current = kinds;
  }, [facts]);

  const [controller, setController] = useState<TryItController | null>(null);
  const ready = !!catalogue && !!settings;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !catalogue) return;
    const c = new TryItController({
      services,
      catalogue,
      settings,
      getDoc: () => useEditor.getState().doc,
      replaceSample: (sample) => void useEditor.getState().run('sample.replaceWith', { sample }),
      kinds: () => kindsRef.current,
    });
    setController(c);
    void c.init();
    return () => {
      c.dispose();
      setController(null);
    };
    // Settings are read once per visit; Start again picks up a new draft, not new Settings.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, catalogue, ready]);

  const active = controller ?? EMPTY;
  const state = useSyncExternalStore(active.subscribe, active.getState);
  return { controller, state };
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/tryit/values.ts\n===
/**
 * Values in Try it: a value as the engine holds it (core-api.md 2.4 JSON) said in words, turned
 * back into the authored format's constants (for the sample request), and the sample request's
 * answers for a form.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Constant, DirectoryRef, SampleRequest, Task, ValueId, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { describeHeldValue, find, getValue, toText, type HeldValueEnv, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import type { Answers, Json, Ref, Values } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { joinList, named } from './say';

/** Display names of people and groups, by `type:id`. */
export type Names = Readonly<Record<string, string>>;

export const refKey = (r: { type: string; id: string }): string => `${r.type}:${r.id}`;

export function isRef(j: unknown): j is Ref {
  return !!j && typeof j === 'object' && !Array.isArray(j) && ((j as Ref).type === 'user' || (j as Ref).type === 'group') &&
    typeof (j as Ref).id === 'string' && Object.keys(j).length === 2;
}

const isChoiceOf = (j: unknown): j is { stored: string | number; label: string } =>
  !!j && typeof j === 'object' && !Array.isArray(j) && 'stored' in j && 'label' in j;

const isRedacted = (j: unknown): boolean => !!j && typeof j === 'object' && (j as { $redacted?: unknown }).$redacted === true;

const DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

/** A person's or group's name, or "Someone" while it is not known. */
export const nameOfRef = (names: Names, ref: Ref): string => names[refKey(ref)] ?? t('tryit.someone');

export interface SayValueOptions {
  /** The value it is held in: a failure code saved by "Save what went wrong as" reads in words ("The tests failed"). */
  valueId?: string;
  /** For the words of a failure code. */
  catalogue?: Catalogue | null;
  /** The request's values: given, a web address is said as a link (the model's `WebLink`, see `HeldValueEnv.links`). */
  links?: HeldValueEnv['links'];
}

/**
 * A value said in words, as a phrase, by the model's one rule (`describeHeldValue`, as the request
 * page says it): rows, choices and buttons by their names, people by name, dates as "2 Dec 2026",
 * Yes/No, a connection's choice by its label, a failure code by its words, never a code or an ID.
 * Names are bold (constant chips). A field group or a list of items: each field with its value.
 */
export function sayValue(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, value: Json | undefined, names: Names, kind?: ValueKind, options: SayValueOptions = {}): Phrase {
  if (value === undefined) return [];
  if (isRedacted(value)) return [t('tryit.removed')];
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return joinList(value.map((v) => sayValue(doc, v, names, undefined, { ...(options.catalogue ? { catalogue: options.catalogue } : {}) })));
  // Text that only looks like a date stays as typed.
  if (typeof value === 'string' && DATE.test(value) && kind !== undefined && kind !== 'date') return [named('constant', value)];
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !isRef(value) && !isChoiceOf(value)) {
    return joinList(Object.entries(value).map(([k, v]) => [`${k}: `, ...sayValue(doc, v, names, undefined, { ...(options.catalogue ? { catalogue: options.catalogue } : {}) })]));
  }
  const env: HeldValueEnv = { nameOf: (r) => names[refKey(r)], ...(options.catalogue ? { catalogue: options.catalogue } : {}), ...(options.links ? { links: options.links } : {}) };
  return describeHeldValue(doc, value, env, options.valueId).map((part) => (typeof part === 'string' ? named('constant', part) : part));
}

export const sayValueText = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, value: Json | undefined, names: Names, kind?: ValueKind, options?: SayValueOptions): string =>
  toText(sayValue(doc, value, names, kind, options));

const dirRef = (ref: Ref, names: Names): DirectoryRef => ({ directoryId: ref.id, name: names[refKey(ref)] ?? '' });

/**
 * A value as the authored format's constant, for the sample request. The kind decides between a
 * date and text; rows, choices and buttons are known by their IDs. Undefined when it cannot be kept.
 */
export function constantOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, value: Json | undefined, names: Names, kind?: ValueKind): Constant | undefined {
  if (value === undefined || isRedacted(value)) return undefined;
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return { yesNo: value };
  if (typeof value === 'number') return { number: value };
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const entry = find(doc, value);
    if (entry?.kind === 'row') return { row: entry.item.id };
    if (entry?.kind === 'choice') return { choice: entry.item.id };
    if (entry?.kind === 'button') return { button: entry.item.id };
    if (kind === 'date' || (kind === undefined && DATE.test(value))) return { date: value };
    return { text: value };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    const refs = (value as unknown[]).filter(isRef);
    if (refs.length === value.length) return { people: refs.filter((r) => r.type === 'user').map((r) => dirRef(r, names)) };
    const choices = value.map((v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? find(doc, v) : undefined));
    if (choices.length && choices.every((e) => e?.kind === 'choice')) return { choices: choices.map((e) => (e!.item as { id: `ch_${string}` }).id) };
    return undefined;
  }
  if (isRef(value)) return value.type === 'user' ? { person: dirRef(value, names) } : { group: dirRef(value, names) };
  if (isChoiceOf(value)) return { connectionChoice: { stored: value.stored, label: value.label } };
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * A new sample request: the old one with every value the test request held put in its place, the
 * Requester the person who started it. Values that cannot be kept are left as they were.
 */
export function sampleFrom(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow, old: SampleRequest | undefined, values: Values, names: Names, kinds: Partial<Record<string, ValueKind>>,
  requester?: Ref,
): SampleRequest {
  const answers: SampleRequest['answers'] = { ...(old?.answers ?? {}) };
  for (const [id, v] of Object.entries(values)) {
    if (!getValue(doc, id)) continue;
    const c = constantOf(doc, v, names, kinds[id]);
    if (c) answers[id as ValueId] = c;
  }
  const next: SampleRequest = { name: old?.name ?? '', answers };
  if (old?.startedOn) next.startedOn = old.startedOn;
  if (requester?.type === 'user') next.requester = dirRef(requester, names);
  else if (old?.requester) next.requester = old.requester;
  return next;
}

/** A task's questions, in form order. */
export function questionsOf(task: Task) {
  return task.form.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items).flatMap((i) => (i.type === 'question' ? [i] : []));
}

/** Answers for a task's questions from values (the sample's, or the request's): each question's saved value. */
export function answersFrom(task: Task, values: Values): Answers {
  const out: Answers = {};
  for (const q of questionsOf(task)) {
    const v = q.savedAs ? values[q.savedAs] : undefined;
    if (v !== undefined) out[q.id] = v;
  }
  return out;
}

/** The words of a value's kind. */
export function kindWords(kind: ValueKind | undefined): string {
  const key = `tryit.kind.${kind ?? 'unknown'}` as WordKey;
  return t(kind && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(KIND_KEYS, kind) ? key : 'tryit.kind.unknown');
}

const KIND_KEYS: Record<ValueKind, true> = {
  text: true, longText: true, number: true, yesNo: true, date: true, choice: true, multipleChoice: true, person: true,
  group: true, choiceFromList: true, choiceFromConnection: true, people: true, list: true, fieldGroup: true,
};

/** Every person or group reference inside a JSON value. */
export function refsIn(value: unknown, out: Ref[] = []): Ref[] {
  if (isRef(value)) out.push(value);
  else if (Array.isArray(value)) for (const v of value) refsIn(v, out);
  else if (value && typeof value === 'object') for (const v of Object.values(value)) refsIn(v, out);
  return out;
}

/**
 * A date typed as people write it ("2 Dec 2026", "2/12/2026", "2026-12-02") in one text box with one
 * accessible name. The browser's own date box is not used: it adds unnamed parts ("Month", "Day",
 * "Year", "Show date picker") that read the same for every date on a page. Shows the date as the
 * editor writes it everywhere ("2 Dec 2026"); stores YYYY-MM-DD.
 */
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { formatDate } from '@/model';
import { TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { parseDate } from './options';
import s from './values.module.css';

export function DateInput({
  value, onCommit, label, commitOnBlur = true, onDraft, className,
}: {
  /** YYYY-MM-DD, or '' for none. */
  value: string;
  /** The date read from the box (YYYY-MM-DD), or '' when the box was emptied. */
  onCommit(next: string): void;
  /** The accessible name: says which date this is ("Sample answer for Planned release date"). */
  label: string;
  /** Store on leaving the box, not only on Enter. */
  commitOnBlur?: boolean;
  /** Each time the box reads as a date (or stops reading as one): for a "Use this date" button beside it. */
  onDraft?(next: string | undefined): void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const shown = value ? formatDate(value) : '';
  const [text, setText] = useState(shown);
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(value);
  const [bad, setBad] = useState(false);
  const hintId = useId();
  if (seen !== value) {
    // The stored date changed elsewhere (undo, another tab): show it.
    setSeen(value);
    setText(shown);
    setBad(false);
  }
  const commit = () => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setBad(false);
      if (value) onCommit('');
      return;
    }
    const date = parseDate(trimmed);
    if (!date) {
      setBad(true);
      return;
    }
    setBad(false);
    setText(formatDate(date));
    if (date !== value) onCommit(date);
  };
  return (
    <span className={s.dateBox}>
      <TextInput
        type="text"
        inputMode="text"
        aria-label={label}
        aria-invalid={bad || undefined}
        aria-describedby={bad ? hintId : undefined}
        placeholder={t('values.date.placeholder')}
        value={text}
        className={className}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setText(e.target.value);
          onDraft?.(parseDate(e.target.value));
        }}
        onBlur={() => {
          if (commitOnBlur) commit();
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            commit();
          }
        }}
      />
      {bad && (
        <span id={hintId} className={s.dateBad}>
          {t('values.date.invalid')}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Choosing one person or one group from the Directory, with search (mockup 01-editor,
 * domains-list): a button showing who is chosen now, or "(not given)", that opens a small popover
 * with a search box and the matches. Used by the list dialog's person and group cells and by the
 * sample request's Requester. A local primitive: `@/ui` has no Directory picker.
 */
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { DirectoryRef } from '@/contract';
import { Icon, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { useDirectorySearch } from './directory';
import { InlinePopover } from './InlinePopover';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

type DirectoryPickProps = {
  /** People or groups. */
  type: 'user' | 'group';
  /** What is being chosen, for the accessible names: "Approvers for Payments", "Requester". */
  label: string;
  value: DirectoryRef | undefined;
  /** Absent: "(not given)". */
  onChange(next: DirectoryRef | undefined): void;
  /** Words shown when nothing is chosen. */
  emptyWords: string;
};

export function DirectoryPick({ type, label, value, onChange, emptyWords }: DirectoryPickProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const listId = useId();
  // Before anything is typed, offer what is near the current choice (its first word: "Payments").
  const near = value?.name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? '';
  const answer = useDirectorySearch(open ? query || near : '', [type]);
  const current = value?.name ?? emptyWords;
  const choose = (next: DirectoryRef | undefined) => {
    onChange(next);
    setOpen(false);
  };
  return (
    <InlinePopover
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        if (next) setQuery('');
      }}
      width={360}
      title={t('values.dirpick.title', { label })}
      trigger={
        <button type="button" className={value ? s.dirChip : s.dirEmpty} aria-label={t('values.field.name', { label, current })} aria-haspopup="dialog">
          {value && <Icon name={type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person'} size={13} />}
          <span className={s.dirName}>{current}</span>
          <Icon name="chevron-down" size={13} />
        </button>
      }
    >
      <div className={s.dirBody}>
        <TextInput
          autoFocus
          type="search"
          aria-label={t('values.dirpick.search')}
          aria-controls={listId}
          placeholder={value?.name ?? t('values.dirpick.search')}
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        />
        <div className={s.dirHead}>{t(type === 'group' ? 'values.dirpick.groups' : 'values.dirpick.people')}</div>
        <ul id={listId} className={s.dirList} aria-label={t(type === 'group' ? 'values.dirpick.groups' : 'values.dirpick.people')}>
          {answer === 'looking' && <li className={s.quiet}>{t('values.option.directoryLooking')}</li>}
          {answer === 'failed' && <li className={s.quiet}>{t('values.option.directoryFailed')}</li>}
          {answer === undefined && <li className={s.quiet}>{t('values.option.directoryHint')}</li>}
          {Array.isArray(answer) && answer.length === 0 && (
            <li className={s.quiet}>{t('values.option.directoryNone', { query: query || near })}</li>
          )}
          {Array.isArray(answer) &&
            answer.map((e) => {
              const now = value?.directoryId === e.id;
              return (
                <li key={e.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={s.dirOption}
                    aria-current={now ? 'true' : undefined}
                    onClick={() => choose({ directoryId: e.id, name: e.label })}
                  >
                    <Icon name={e.type === 'group' ? 'group' : 'person'} size={14} />
                    <span>
                      <span className={s.dirOptionName}>
                        {e.label}
                        {now && <span className={s.quiet}> {t('values.dirpick.now')}</span>}
                      </span>
                      {e.detail && <span className={s.dirOptionDetail}>{e.detail}</span>}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
        </ul>
        {value && (
          <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => choose(undefined)}>
            {t('values.dirpick.clear', { name: value.name })}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </InlinePopover>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/InlinePopover.tsx\n===
/**
 * A popover that renders where it is used instead of at the end of the page, so it shows above a
 * dialog it sits in (the ui Popover is portalled with a z-index under the dialog's: inside the list
 * dialog it would open behind it). Same anatomy as the ui Popover: a title that names it, a close
 * button, a body and an optional footer. Focus goes in on open and back to the trigger on close
 * (Radix). A local primitive until `@/ui` offers this.
 */
import * as RP from '@radix-ui/react-popover';
import type { ReactElement, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { IconButton } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

type InlinePopoverProps = {
  trigger: ReactElement;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  width?: number;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange(open: boolean): void;
};

export function InlinePopover({ trigger, title, children, footer, width = 340, open, onOpenChange }: InlinePopoverProps) {
  return (
    <RP.Root open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <RP.Trigger asChild>{trigger}</RP.Trigger>
      {/* Not portalled: it stays inside the dialog, so it shows above it. */}
      <RP.Content className={s.pop} style={{ width }} align="start" sideOffset={6} collisionPadding={12} aria-label={title}>
        <div className={s.popHead}>
          <div className={s.popTitle}>{title}</div>
          <RP.Close asChild>
            <IconButton icon="close" label={t('common.close')} size="sm" tooltip={false} />
          </RP.Close>
        </div>
        <div className={s.popBody}>{children}</div>
        {footer && <div className={s.popFoot}>{footer}</div>}
      </RP.Content>
    </RP.Root>
  );
}

/** What a cell shows: a text box's or select's value, or a button's text. */
function shown(td: HTMLElement): string {
  const input = td.querySelector('input, select') as HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement | null;
  if (input instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return input.options[input.selectedIndex]?.text ?? '';
  if (input) return input.value;
  return td.querySelector('button')?.textContent?.trim() ?? '';
}

/**
 * Slot ListDialog: a list kept with the workflow (the Domains list) as a small table, edited in
 * place (editor-model.md section 8; mockup 01-editor, domains-list). Rows and columns are added,
 * renamed, reordered (rows) and removed; each cell has the small editor its column's kind needs
 * (text, number, date, Yes/No, a person or a group from the Directory with search; "(not given)"
 * when empty). It says where the list is used, which choice question takes its choices from it, and
 * what removing a row that a running request may hold means. Every change is a named command
 * (src/model/commands/lists.ts) and is kept in the draft at once.
 */
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Column, ColumnId, Constant, List, Row, RowId } from '@/contract';
import { getList, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useRun, useVersions, type ListDialogProps } from '@/model';
import { Button, Dialog, DialogClose, Field, Icon, IconButton, Select, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { DirectoryPick } from './DirectoryPick';
import { InlinePopover } from './InlinePopover';
import { andList, kindIcon, kindTitle } from './kinds';
import { choiceQuestionsOf, COLUMN_KINDS, listPlaces, listPlacesByStage, rowName, rowNamedIn, sampleHoldsRow } from './lists';
import { CommitInput } from './SampleRequest';
import { DateInput } from './DateInput';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

export function ListDialog({ listId, open, onOpenChange }: ListDialogProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const run = useRun();
  const list = doc ? getList(doc, listId) : undefined;
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [openColumn, setOpenColumn] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const addRowRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  useReturnFocus(open);

  if (!doc || !list) {
    return (
      <Dialog title={t('describe.noName')} open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange} width={520}>
        <p>{t('values.list.gone')}</p>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }

  const places = listPlaces(doc, list, env);
  const usedBy = places.length ? t('values.list.usedBy', { places: andList(listPlacesByStage(places)) }) : t('values.list.notUsed');
  const uses = choiceQuestionsOf(doc, list);
  const removingRow = removing ? list.rows.find((r) => r.id === removing) : undefined;

  const addColumn = () => {
    const r = run('column.add', { list: list.id, name: t('values.list.newColumn') });
    if (r && typeof r === 'object' && 'id' in r) setOpenColumn(String(r.id));
  };
  const addRow = () => {
    run('row.add', { list: list.id });
    setStatus('');
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      title={list.name || t('describe.noName')}
      description={listLead(list)}
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
      width={1000}

            <Icon name="info" size={16} />
            <span>
              <strong>{t('values.list.footStrong')}</strong> {t('values.list.foot')}
            </span>

            <Button variant="primary">{t('values.list.done')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
        </>

          <Icon name="link" size={14} />
          <span>{usedBy}</span>

          <p key={u.question.id} className={s.useLine}>
            <Icon name="choice" size={14} />
            <span>
            {u.shown
              ? t('values.list.choicesFrom', { question: u.question.label, stage: u.stage, column: u.shown.name })
              : t('values.list.choicesFromNoColumn', { question: u.question.label, stage: u.stage })}
            </span>
          </p>
        ))}

        {list.columns.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={s.emptyLine}>{t('values.list.noColumns')}</p>
        ) : (
          <div className={s.gridWrap}>
            <table className={s.grid} aria-label={list.name || t('describe.noName')}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {list.columns.map((c) => (
                    <th key={c.id} scope="col">
                      <ColumnHead
                        column={c}
                        open={openColumn === c.id}
                        onOpenChange={(next) => setOpenColumn(next ? c.id : null)}
                      />
                    </th>
                  ))}
                  <th scope="col">
                    <span className={s.srOnly}>{t('values.list.rowHead')}</span>
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {list.rows.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={list.columns.length + 1} className={s.quiet}>
                      {t('values.list.noRows')}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {list.rows.map((row, i) => {
                  const name = rowName(doc, list, row);
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.id} className={removing === row.id ? s.removingRow : undefined}>
                      {list.columns.map((c) => (
                        <td key={c.id}>
                          <Cell row={row} column={c} rowName={name} />
                        </td>
                      ))}
                      <td className={s.rowMenu}>
                        <span className={s.rowButtons} role="group" aria-label={t('values.list.rowMenu', { row: name })}>
                          <IconButton
                            icon="chevron-up"
                            size="sm"
                            label={t('values.list.moveRowUp', { row: name })}
                            aria-disabled={i === 0 || undefined}
                            onClick={() => i > 0 && run('row.move', { row: row.id as RowId, toIndex: i - 1 })}
                          />
                          <IconButton
                            icon="chevron-down"
                            size="sm"
                            label={t('values.list.moveRowDown', { row: name })}
                            aria-disabled={i === list.rows.length - 1 || undefined}
                            onClick={() => i < list.rows.length - 1 && run('row.move', { row: row.id as RowId, toIndex: i + 1 })}
                          />
                          <IconButton icon="trash" size="sm" label={t('values.list.removeRowLabel', { row: name })} onClick={() => setRemoving(row.id)} />
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {removingRow && (
          <RemoveRow
            list={list}
            row={removingRow}
            onKeep={() => {
              setRemoving(null);
              requestAnimationFrame(() => addRowRef.current?.focus());
            }}
            onRemove={(name) => {
              run('row.delete', { row: removingRow.id as RowId });
              setRemoving(null);
              setStatus(t('values.list.removed', { row: name, list: list.name }));
              requestAnimationFrame(() => addRowRef.current?.focus());
            }}
          />
        )}

        <div className={s.listTools}>
          {list.columns.length > 0 && (
            <Button ref={addRowRef} size="sm" icon="plus" onClick={addRow}>
              {t('values.list.addRow')}
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button size="sm" icon="plus" onClick={addColumn}>
            {t('values.list.addColumn')}
          </Button>
          {places.length === 0 && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="quiet"
              icon="trash"
              onClick={() => {
                run('list.delete', { list: list.id });
                onOpenChange(false);
              }}
            >
              {t('values.list.removeList')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('values.list.removeNote')}</p>
        <p role="status" className={s.status}>
          {status}
        </p>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/** The line under the title: what one row is and what each column holds, from the columns themselves. */
export function listLead(list: List): string {
  const [first, ...others] = list.columns.map((c) => c.name || t('describe.noName'));
  if (!first) return t('values.list.lead');
  return others.length ? t('values.list.leadColumns', { first, others: andList(others) }) : t('values.list.leadOne', { first });
}

/**
 * The dialog is opened by its `open` prop, not by a Radix trigger, so on close Radix has nothing
 * to give focus back to and it fell to the page. Whatever had focus when the dialog opened (the
 * "Edit the Domains list" button, wherever it is) gets it back after Done, Close or Escape, unless
 * the opener already moved focus somewhere on purpose.
 */
function useReturnFocus(open: boolean) {
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const wasOpen = useRef(false);
  // A layout effect runs before Radix moves focus into the dialog (a passive effect).
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (open && !wasOpen.current) {
      const active = document.activeElement;
      opener.current = active instanceof HTMLElement && active !== document.body ? active : null;
    }
    if (!open && wasOpen.current) {
      const back = opener.current;
      opener.current = null;
      const give = () => {
        const now = document.activeElement;
        const lost = !now || now === document.body || !now.isConnected;
        if (back?.isConnected && lost) back.focus();
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        give();
        // Radix may still hold focus for its closing frame; try once more after it lets go.
        setTimeout(give, 0);
      });
    }
    wasOpen.current = open;
  }, [open]);
}

/** One cell, with the small editor its column's kind needs. */
function Cell({ row, column, rowName: name }: { row: Row; column: Column; rowName: string }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const cell = row.cells?.[column.id];
  const label = t('values.list.cell', { column: column.name || t('describe.noName'), row: name });
  const set = (value: Constant | undefined) =>
    run('cell.set', value ? { row: row.id as RowId, column: column.id as ColumnId, value } : { row: row.id as RowId, column: column.id as ColumnId });

  switch (column.kind) {
    case 'text':
      return (
        <CommitInput
          className={s.cellInput}
          label={label}
          value={cell && 'text' in cell ? cell.text : ''}
          onCommit={(v) => set(v.trim() ? { text: v } : undefined)}
        />
      );
    case 'number':
      return (
        <CommitInput
          className={s.cellInput}
          type="number"
          label={label}
          value={cell && 'number' in cell ? String(cell.number) : ''}
          onCommit={(v) => set(v.trim() && Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? { number: Number(v) } : undefined)}
        />
      );
    case 'date':
      return (
        <DateInput className={s.cellInput} label={label} value={cell && 'date' in cell ? cell.date : ''} onCommit={(v) => set(v ? { date: v } : undefined)} />
      );
    case 'yesNo':
      return (
        <Select
          className={s.cellSelect}
          aria-label={label}
          value={cell && 'yesNo' in cell ? (cell.yesNo ? 'yes' : 'no') : ''}
          onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value ? { yesNo: e.target.value === 'yes' } : undefined)}
          options={[
            { value: '', label: t('values.list.notGiven') },
            { value: 'yes', label: t('values.list.yes') },
            { value: 'no', label: t('values.list.no') },
          ]}
        />
      );
    case 'person':
      return (
        <DirectoryPick
          type="user"
          label={label}
          value={cell && 'person' in cell ? cell.person : undefined}
          emptyWords={t('values.list.notGiven')}
          onChange={(next) => set(next ? { person: next } : undefined)}
        />
      );
    case 'group':
      return (
        <DirectoryPick
          type="group"
          label={label}
          value={cell && 'group' in cell ? cell.group : undefined}
          emptyWords={t('values.list.notGiven')}
          onChange={(next) => set(next ? { group: next } : undefined)}
        />
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** A column's heading: its name and kind; opens a small popover to rename it, change its kind or remove it. */
function ColumnHead({ column, open, onOpenChange }: { column: Column; open: boolean; onOpenChange(open: boolean): void }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const [name, setName] = useState(column.name);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<Column['kind']>(column.kind);
  const shown = column.name || t('describe.noName');
  const save = () => {
    const next = name.trim();
    if (next && next !== column.name) run('column.rename', { column: column.id as ColumnId, name: next });
    if (kind !== column.kind) run('column.setKind', { column: column.id as ColumnId, kind });
    onOpenChange(false);
  };
  return (
    <InlinePopover
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        if (next) {
          setName(column.name);
          setKind(column.kind);
        }
        onOpenChange(next);
      }}
      width={320}
      title={t('values.list.column', { name: shown })}
      trigger={
        <button type="button" className={s.colHead} aria-label={t('values.list.columnLabel', { name: shown })} aria-haspopup="dialog">
          <Icon name={kindIcon(column.kind)} size={13} />
          <span>{shown}</span>
          <Icon name="chevron-down" size={13} />
        </button>
      }
      footer={
        <div className={s.colFoot}>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="danger"
            icon="trash"
            onClick={() => {
              run('column.delete', { column: column.id as ColumnId });
              onOpenChange(false);
            }}
          >
            {t('values.list.removeColumn')}
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={save}>
            {t('values.list.apply')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <form
        className={s.colForm}
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          save();
        }}
      >
        <Field label={t('values.list.columnName')}>
          <TextInput autoFocus value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t('values.list.columnKind')} hint={t('values.list.kindHint')}>
          <Select
            value={kind}
            onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value as Column['kind'])}
            options={COLUMN_KINDS.map((k) => ({ value: k, label: kindTitle(k) }))}
          />
        </Field>
        <p className={s.quiet}>{t('values.list.removeColumnWhy', { name: shown })}</p>
        <button type="submit" hidden />
      </form>
    </InlinePopover>
  );
}

/** "Remove Identity from the Domains list?" with what it means for running requests and this draft. */
function RemoveRow({ list, row, onKeep, onRemove }: { list: List; row: Row; onKeep(): void; onRemove(name: string): void }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const { live } = useVersions();
  if (!doc) return null;
  const name = rowName(doc, list, row);
  const named = rowNamedIn(doc, list, row);
  const uses = choiceQuestionsOf(doc, list);
  const titleId = `remove-${row.id}`;
  return (
    <div className={s.removeBox} role="group" aria-labelledby={titleId}>
      <p id={titleId} className={s.removeTitle}>
        <Icon name="warning" size={16} />
        {t('values.list.removeRow.title', { row: name, list: list.name })}
      </p>
      <ul className={s.removeWhy}>
        <li>{live ? t('values.list.removeRow.live', { n: live, row: name }) : t('values.list.removeRow.notLive', { row: name })}</li>
        {uses.map((u) => (
          <li key={u.question.id}>{t('values.list.removeRow.choice', { question: u.question.label, row: name })}</li>
        ))}
        {named > 0 && (
          <li>{named === 1 ? t('values.list.removeRow.namedOne', { row: name }) : t('values.list.removeRow.named', { n: named, row: name })}</li>
        )}
        {sampleHoldsRow(doc, row) && <li>{t('values.list.removeRow.sample', { row: name })}</li>}
      </ul>
      <div className={s.removeButtons}>
        <Button size="sm" autoFocus onClick={onKeep}>
          {t('values.list.removeRow.keep')}
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={() => onRemove(name)}>
          {t('values.list.removeRow.confirm', { row: name })}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, SentTemplate, Template } from '@/contract';

/** Every Template (and SentTemplate) in a document, with where it is. */
function templatesOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow) {
  const found: { where: string; template: Template; sent: boolean }[] = [];
  eachExpression(doc, (node, at) => {
    if (at.sort === 'template' || at.sort === 'sentTemplate') {
      found.push({ where: `${at.location.item} ${at.location.part ?? ''}`, template: node as Template, sent: at.sort === 'sentTemplate' });
    }
  });
  return found;
}

const all = FIXTURE_NAMES.flatMap((name) => templatesOf(fixtures[name]).map((x) => ({ name, ...x })));

function caretAt(node: Node, offset: number) {
  const range = document.createRange();
  range.setStart(node, offset);
  range.collapse(true);
  const sel = document.getSelection()!;
  sel.removeAllRanges();
  sel.addRange(range);
}

describe('MessageField', () => {

    expect(all.some((x) => x.sent)).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each(all.map((x) => [`${x.name}: ${x.where}`, x] as const))('round-trips %s unchanged, and an edit exactly', (_, x) => {
    const doc = fixtures[x.name];
    act(() => useEditor.getState().load(x.name, doc, 1));
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    const sent = doc.start.startsWhen[0]?.trigger;
    render(
      x.sent && sent ? (
        <MessageField at={{ item: doc.id }} label="Message" multiline sent={sent} value={x.template as SentTemplate} onChange={onChange} />
      ) : (
        <MessageField at={{ item: doc.id }} label="Message" multiline value={x.template} onChange={onChange} />
      ),
    );
    const box = screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' });
    expect(box.textContent).toBe(toText(describeTemplate(doc, x.template, sent && x.sent ? { trigger: sent } : {})));

    // Nothing typed: what the box holds is the template, piece for piece.
    fireEvent.input(box);
    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    // One letter typed at the end: the same template with it added.
    const tail = box.querySelector('br[data-tail]');
    box.insertBefore(document.createTextNode('!'), tail);
    fireEvent.input(box);
    const last = x.template[x.template.length - 1];
    const expected = typeof last === 'string' ? [...x.template.slice(0, -1), `${last}!`] : [...x.template, '!'];
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(expected);

    const box = screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Text' });
    const text = box.childNodes[1]!;
    expect(text.nodeValue).toBe(' asked for changes: ');

    caretAt(text, 0);
    fireEvent.keyDown(box, { key: 'Backspace' });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith([' asked for changes: ', { value: 'v_reason' }]);

    caretAt(text, text.nodeValue!.length);
    fireEvent.keyDown(box, { key: 'Delete' });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith([' asked for changes: ']);

    const single = screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Summary' });

    await waitFor(() => expect(box).toHaveFocus());
    expect(box).toHaveTextContent('Ready: Jira issue now');
  });
