===\nfrontend/src/features/values/MessageField.tsx\n===
/**
 * Slot MessageField: text with value chips in it (a notification message, form text, a Jira
 * summary). A text box on one line or several; "+ Insert a value" opens the same value picker and
 * puts the chip where the caret was; a chip is deleted whole with Backspace or Delete. What it gives
 * is exactly the format's Template (or SentTemplate inside a "Starts when").
 */
import * as RP from '@radix-ui/react-popover';
import { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ClipboardEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { ValueId } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeExpression, isChip, toText, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFacts, useValuesInScope, type MessageFieldProps,
} from '@/model';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { chipLook } from './chips';
import { ALL_KINDS, kindIcon, type ScopeKind } from './kinds';
import { kindOfExpression } from './options';
import { ValuePicker } from './Picker';
import { chipNextToCaret, drawTemplate, fixTail, readTemplate, type Piece } from './template-dom';
import s from './values.module.css';

type ChipPiece = Exclude<Piece, string>;

/** Every icon a chip may carry, drawn once out of sight and copied into chips. */
const BANK = [...new Set([...ALL_KINDS.map((k) => kindIcon(k)), 'connected', 'person', 'group'] as const)];

export function MessageField(props: MessageFieldProps) {
  const { at, label, multiline, sent } = props;
  const value = props.value as Piece[] | undefined;
  const emit = props.onChange as (next: Piece[] | undefined) => void;
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const { values: scope } = useValuesInScope(sent ? null : at);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const editorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const bankRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const chips = useRef(new WeakMap<Element, ChipPiece>());
  const shown = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const saved = useRef<Range | null>(null);
  const inserted = useRef(false);

  const sayEnv = useMemo(() => (sent ? { ...env, trigger: sent } : env), [env, sent]);
  const kindOfValue = useCallback(
    (id: string): ScopeKind => scope.find((v) => v.id === id)?.kind ?? facts?.values[id as ValueId]?.kind,
    [scope, facts],
  );

  /** Gives a chip element its look and words for the current document. */
  const dress = useCallback(
    (el: HTMLElement, piece: ChipPiece) => {
      if (!doc) return;
      const phrase = describeExpression(doc, piece, sayEnv);
      const first = phrase.find(isChip);
      const look = chipLook(first ?? { chip: 'value' }, kindOfExpression(doc, piece, sayEnv, kindOfValue));
      el.className = look.className;
      el.replaceChildren();
      const icon = look.icon ? bankRef.current?.querySelector(`[data-icon="${look.icon}"] svg`) : null;
      if (icon) el.append(icon.cloneNode(true));
      const words = document.createElement('span');
      words.className = s.chipLabel ?? '';
      words.textContent = toText(phrase);
      el.append(words);
    },
    [doc, sayEnv, kindOfValue],
  );

  const makeChip = useCallback(
    (piece: ChipPiece) => {
      const el = document.createElement('span');
      el.contentEditable = 'false';
      el.setAttribute('data-chip', '');
      chips.current.set(el, piece);
      dress(el, piece);
      return el;
    },
    [dress],
  );

  // Draw the text when it is not what the box shows (first time, undo, a change made elsewhere);
  // otherwise only refresh the chips' words (a value renamed).
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = editorRef.current;
    if (!el || !doc) return;
    const json = JSON.stringify(value ?? []);
    if (shown.current !== json) {
      drawTemplate(el, value ?? [], makeChip);
      shown.current = json;
      return;
    }
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-chip]').forEach((c) => {
      const piece = chips.current.get(c);
      if (piece) dress(c as HTMLElement, piece);
    });
  }, [value, doc, makeChip, dress]);

  const sync = () => {
    const el = editorRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    fixTail(el);
    const next = readTemplate(el, (c) => chips.current.get(c));
    const json = JSON.stringify(next);
    shown.current = json;
    if (json !== JSON.stringify(value ?? [])) emit(next.length ? next : undefined);
  };

  const remember = () => {
    const el = editorRef.current;
    const sel = document.getSelection();
    if (el && sel && sel.rangeCount && el.contains(sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer)) saved.current = sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
  };

  /** Where to put something: the caret (or, coming back from the picker, where it was), else the end of the text. */
  const caretRange = (preferSaved = false): Range => {
    const el = editorRef.current as HTMLDivElement;
    const sel = document.getSelection();
    const savedHere = saved.current && el.contains(saved.current.startContainer) ? saved.current : null;
    if (preferSaved && savedHere) return savedHere;
    if (sel && sel.rangeCount && el.contains(sel.getRangeAt(0).startContainer)) return sel.getRangeAt(0);
    if (savedHere) return savedHere;
    const range = document.createRange();
    const tail = el.querySelector('br[data-tail]');
    if (tail) range.setStartBefore(tail);
    else {
      range.selectNodeContents(el);
      range.collapse(false);
    }
    return range;
  };

  const placeAfter = (node: Node) => {
    const sel = document.getSelection();
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.setStartAfter(node);
    range.collapse(true);
    sel?.removeAllRanges();
    sel?.addRange(range);
    saved.current = range.cloneRange();
  };

  const insertNode = (node: Node, preferSaved = false) => {
    const range = caretRange(preferSaved);
    range.deleteContents();
    range.insertNode(node);
    placeAfter(node);
    sync();
  };

  const insertChip = (piece: ChipPiece) => {
    const el = editorRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.focus();
    insertNode(makeChip(piece), true);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = editorRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (multiline) insertNode(document.createTextNode('\n'));
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' || e.key === 'Delete') {
      const chip = chipNextToCaret(el, e.key === 'Backspace' ? 'back' : 'forward', (c) => chips.current.has(c));
      if (!chip || !chip.parentNode) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const parent = chip.parentNode;
      const index = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(parent.childNodes, chip) as number;
      chip.remove();
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.setStart(parent, index);
      range.collapse(true);
      const sel = document.getSelection();
      sel?.removeAllRanges();
      sel?.addRange(range);
      sync();
    }
  };

  const onPaste = (e: ClipboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let text = e.clipboardData.getData('text/plain');
    if (!multiline) text = text.replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ');
    if (text) insertNode(document.createTextNode(text));
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.message}>
      <div
        ref={editorRef}
        className={[s.editor, multiline ? s.multi : s.single].join(' ')}
        role="textbox"
        aria-label={label}
        aria-multiline={multiline ? true : undefined}
        contentEditable
        tabIndex={0}
        spellCheck
        onInput={sync}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
        onKeyUp={remember}
        onMouseUp={remember}
        onBlur={remember}
        onPaste={onPaste}
        onDrop={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      />
      <div className={s.tools}>
        <RP.Root open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <RP.Trigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" icon="plus" aria-label={t('values.message.insertInto', { label })}>
              {t('values.message.insert')}
            </Button>
          </RP.Trigger>
          <RP.Portal>
            <RP.Content
              className={s.pop}
              align="start"
              sideOffset={6}
              collisionPadding={12}
              aria-label={t('values.picker.title', { label })}
              onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => {
                if (!inserted.current) return;
                inserted.current = false;
                e.preventDefault();
                editorRef.current?.focus();
              }}
            >
              <ValuePicker
                at={at}
                label={label}
                sent={sent}
                onPick={(piece) => {
                  inserted.current = true;
                  setOpen(false);
                  insertChip(piece as ChipPiece);
                }}
              />
            </RP.Content>
          </RP.Portal>
        </RP.Root>
      </div>
      <span ref={bankRef} className={s.bank} aria-hidden="true">
        {BANK.map((name) => (
          <span key={name} data-icon={name}>
            <Icon name={name} size={13} />
          </span>
        ))}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/Picker.tsx\n===
/**
 * The value picker (editor-model.md section 4): one list used in every slot. A search box that is
 * also the list's combobox (type to search, arrows to move, Enter to pick; Escape is the popover's
 * and puts focus back on the field), the groups with each item's kind icon, name, where it comes
 * from, whether it is filled here and a sample from the sample request, the wrong kinds counted and
 * shown greyed on request, typed-in constants, and the footer links Add "when ..." and Write a formula.
 *
 * Add "when ..." is in every slot's footer (editor-model.md section 4 and ruling 8). Where a Yes/No
 * is accepted it puts a "when ..." sentence in the slot (`onWhen`). Anywhere else a sentence cannot
 * stand there, so it lets the slot depend on an answer instead: the picker shows the answers chosen
 * from a list, and what each list's columns give ("Primary domain's approvers"). That is how Who is
 * asked comes to depend on the request (section 3: "It depends on Primary domain").
 */
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { CatalogueRef, Expression, Location, SentExpression, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useValuesInScope } from '@/model';
import { Button, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { DateInput } from './DateInput';
import { useDirectoryName, useDirectorySearch } from './directory';
import { kindIcon, kindsWithArticle, singleKind } from './kinds';
import { mayBeEmptyWords, useStuckPeople } from './notes';
import { buildOptions, type PickOption, type PickResult, type Sample } from './options';
import s from './values.module.css';

export type PickerProps = {
  at: Location;
  label: string;
  accepts?: readonly ValueKind[] | undefined;
  allowTyped?: boolean | undefined;
  sent?: CatalogueRef | undefined;
  onPick(expression: Expression | SentExpression): void;
  /**
   * Put a "when ..." sentence in the slot (a Yes/No is accepted here). Without it, Add "when ..."
   * shows the answers the slot can depend on (not offered for what another system sends).
   */
  onWhen?: (() => void) | undefined;
  /** Offer Write a formula. */
  onFormula?: (() => void) | undefined;
  /** Offer Clear: empty the slot (a chip in a sentence or a table has no Clear button of its own). */
  onClear?: (() => void) | undefined;
};

const EMPTY: PickResult = { groups: [], hidden: 0, offerDate: false, flat: [] };

type ShownGroup = { id: string; title: string; sub?: string | undefined; options: PickOption[] };

/**
 * The answers a slot can depend on: each answer chosen from a list, with the steps into that list's
 * columns that fit the slot, under "Depends on the answer to Primary domain".
 */
export function dependsGroups(result: PickResult, nameOf: (valueId: string) => string | undefined): ShownGroup[] {
  const groups = new Map<string, ShownGroup>();
  for (const o of result.groups.find((g) => g.id === 'lists')?.options ?? []) {
    if (!o.valueId || o.wrongKind) continue;
    let g = groups.get(o.valueId);
    if (!g) {
      g = { id: `dep-${o.valueId}`, title: t('values.depends.on', { answer: nameOf(o.valueId) ?? '' }), sub: o.from, options: [] };
      groups.set(o.valueId, g);
    }
    g.options.push(o);
  }
  return [...groups.values()];
}

export function ValuePicker({ at, label, accepts, allowTyped, sent, onPick, onWhen, onFormula, onClear }: PickerProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const { values: scope } = useValuesInScope(sent ? null : at);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [showWrong, setShowWrong] = useState(false);
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [date, setDate] = useState('');
  /** Add "when ..." in a slot that does not take Yes/No: the answers it can depend on. */
  const [depends, setDepends] = useState(false);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const listId = useId();

  const directoryTypes = useMemo(
    () => (allowTyped && !sent ? (accepts ?? []).flatMap((k) => (k === 'person' ? ['user' as const] : k === 'group' ? ['group' as const] : [])) : []),
    [allowTyped, sent, accepts],
  );
  const directory = useDirectorySearch(query, directoryTypes);

  const result = useMemo(
    () =>
      doc
        ? buildOptions({ doc, env, at, scope, label, accepts, allowTyped, sent, query, directory, showWrongKind: showWrong })
        : EMPTY,
    [doc, env, at, scope, label, accepts, allowTyped, sent, query, directory, showWrong],
  );
  const shownGroups: ShownGroup[] = useMemo(
    () => (depends ? dependsGroups(result, (id) => scope.find((v) => v.id === id)?.name) : result.groups),
    [depends, result, scope],
  );
  const flat = useMemo(() => (depends ? shownGroups.flatMap((g) => g.options) : result.flat), [depends, shownGroups, result]);
  const offerDepends = !onWhen && !sent;
  const switchView = (to: boolean) => {
    setDepends(to);
    setActiveId(null);
    setQuery('');
    searchRef.current?.focus();
  };
  const active = flat.find((o) => o.id === activeId) ?? flat.find((o) => !o.disabled) ?? flat[0];
  const domId = (o: PickOption) => `${listId}-${o.id}`;

  const activeDom = active ? domId(active) : undefined;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeDom) return;
    const el = document.getElementById(activeDom);
    el?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'nearest' });
  }, [activeDom]);

  const findingEnv = useMemo(() => ({ ...env, stuckPeople }), [env, stuckPeople]);

  const choose = (o: PickOption | undefined) => {
    if (o && !o.disabled) onPick(o.expression);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!flat.length) return;
    const i = active ? flat.indexOf(active) : -1;
    const go = (to: number) => {
      const next = flat[Math.max(0, Math.min(flat.length - 1, to))];
      if (next) setActiveId(next.id);
    };
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      go(i + 1);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      go(i - 1);
    } else if (e.key === 'PageDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      go(i + 6);
    } else if (e.key === 'PageUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      go(i - 6);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      choose(active);
    }
  };

  const peopleToo = directoryTypes.length > 0;
  const count = flat.filter((o) => !o.disabled).length;

  return (
    <>
      <div className={s.searchRow}>
        <div className={s.searchBox}>
          <Icon name="search" size={15} />
          <input
            className={s.search}
            type="text"
            role="combobox"
            ref={searchRef}
            aria-label={t(peopleToo && !depends ? 'values.picker.searchPeople' : 'values.picker.search')}
            placeholder={t(peopleToo && !depends ? 'values.picker.searchPeople' : 'values.picker.search')}
            aria-expanded="true"
            aria-controls={listId}
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-activedescendant={activeDom}
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setQuery(e.target.value);
              setActiveId(null);
            }}
            onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">
        {count === 1 ? t('values.picker.countOne') : t('values.picker.count', { n: count })}
      </div>
      {depends && (
        <div className={s.dependsHead}>
          <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => switchView(false)}>
            <Icon name="arrow-left" size={14} />
            {t('values.depends.back')}
          </button>
          <span>{t('values.depends.intro', { label })}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {!depends && result.hiddenWords && (
        <div className={s.hidden}>
          <Icon name="info" size={14} />
          <span>{result.hiddenWords}</span>
          <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => setShowWrong((v) => !v)} aria-pressed={showWrong}>
            {t(showWrong ? 'values.picker.hide' : 'values.picker.show')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={s.scroll}>
        <ul
          className={s.list}
          role="listbox"
          id={listId}
          aria-label={depends ? t('values.depends.list', { label }) : t('values.picker.list')}
        >
          {shownGroups.map((g) => (
            <li key={g.id} role="presentation">
              <div className={s.groupHead} id={`${listId}-g-${g.id}`}>
                {g.title}
                {g.sub && <span className={s.groupSub}>{t('values.sep')}{g.sub}</span>}
              </div>
              <ul className={s.list} role="group" aria-labelledby={`${listId}-g-${g.id}`}>
                {g.options.map((o) => (
                  <OptionRow
                    key={o.id}
                    option={o}
                    id={domId(o)}
                    active={o === active}
                    onHover={() => setActiveId(o.id)}
                    onChoose={() => choose(o)}
                    may={
                      // Said in full for the item the author is on, so the list stays readable.
                      doc && o === active && o.state === 'mayBeEmpty' && o.valueId && !o.disabled
                        ? mayBeEmptyWords(doc, findingEnv, at, o.valueId, o.skippedVia, false)
                        : undefined
                    }
                  />
                ))}
              </ul>
              {!depends && g.id === 'lists' && result.directoryNote && <div className={s.dirNote}>{result.directoryNote}</div>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {!depends && !result.groups.some((g) => g.id === 'lists') && result.directoryNote && (
          <div className={s.dirNote}>{result.directoryNote}</div>
        )}
        {flat.length === 0 && !(result.offerDate && !depends && !query.trim()) && (
          <p className={s.empty}>
            {query.trim()
              ? t('values.picker.none', { query: query.trim() })
              : depends
                ? accepts?.length
                  ? t('values.depends.none', { kinds: kindsWithArticle(accepts) })
                  : t('values.depends.noneAny')
                : t('values.picker.empty')}
          </p>
        )}
        {!depends && result.offerDate && (
          <div className={s.dateRow}>
            <span aria-hidden="true">{t('values.date.label')}</span>
            <DateInput
              label={t('values.date.labelFor', { label })}
              value=""
              commitOnBlur={false}
              onDraft={(next) => setDate(next ?? '')}
              onCommit={(next) => next && onPick({ date: next })}
            />
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => date && onPick({ date })}>
              {t('values.date.use')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {(onWhen || offerDepends || onFormula || onClear) && (
        <div className={s.foot}>
          {(onWhen || offerDepends) && !depends ? (
            <button type="button" className={s.footLink} onClick={onWhen ?? (() => switchView(true))}>
              <Icon name="branch" size={14} />
              {t('values.footer.when')}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <span />
          )}
          <span className={s.footEnd}>
            {onClear && (
              <button type="button" className={s.footLink} onClick={onClear} aria-label={t('values.field.clear', { label })}>
                <Icon name="close" size={14} />
                {t('values.footer.clear')}
              </button>
            )}
            {onFormula && (
              <button type="button" className={s.footLink} onClick={onFormula}>
                <Icon name="fx" size={14} />
                {t('values.footer.formula')}
              </button>
            )}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function SampleText({ sample }: { sample: Sample }) {
  const name = useDirectoryName(typeof sample === 'string' ? undefined : sample.ref);
  return <>{typeof sample === 'string' ? sample : (name ?? '')}</>;
}

type RowProps = {
  option: PickOption;
  id: string;
  active: boolean;
  may: string | undefined;
  onHover(): void;
  onChoose(): void;
};

function OptionRow({ option: o, id, active, may, onHover, onChoose }: RowProps) {
  const neverFilled = o.state === 'never' && !o.wrongKind;
  const detail = [o.from, !o.disabled && o.state === 'always' ? o.stateWords : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(t('values.sep'));
  return (
    <li
      id={id}
      role="option"
      aria-selected={active}
      aria-disabled={o.disabled ? true : undefined}
      className={s.option}
      title={o.disabled ?? o.why}
      onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      onMouseMove={active ? undefined : onHover}
      onClick={onChoose}
    >
      <span className={[s.optIcon, o.group === 'sent' ? s.optSent : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} aria-hidden="true">
        <Icon name={o.group === 'sent' ? 'connected' : kindIcon(singleKind(o.kind))} size={14} />
      </span>
      <span className={s.optMain}>
        <span className={s.optName}>{o.name}</span>
        {(detail || (o.state === 'mayBeEmpty' && !o.disabled)) && (
          <span className={s.optDetail}>
            {detail}
            {o.state === 'mayBeEmpty' && !o.disabled && (
              <span className={s.optMay}>
                {detail ? t('values.sep') : ''}
                <span className={s.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
                {o.stateWords}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
        )}
        {may && <span className={s.optMay}>{may}</span>}
        {o.disabled && <span className={s.optWhy}>{neverFilled ? o.stateWords : o.disabled}</span>}
        {o.why && !o.disabled && <span className="visually-hidden">{o.why}</span>}
      </span>
      {o.sample !== undefined && (
        <span className={s.optSample}>
          <SampleText sample={o.sample} />
        </span>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

# features/values

The value picker, the value chip and its card, the message field, the Values tab and the list dialog.

- Exports `ValuesPage` (route `/w/:workflowId/values`, `ValuesPage.tsx`) and four slot components, which `src/app/slots.ts` puts in the model slots of the same names (`src/model/slots.ts`). Other features show them with `<Slot name="..." ... />` from `@/model`, never by importing them:
  - `ValueField` (`ValueFieldProps`): the one value slot. Shows the slot's expression in words (describe) as chips, with where it is filled and the sample ("from Domain approval · for the sample: Diego Santos"); opens the value picker. Under it: a red note when the value is the wrong kind or never filled here, an amber note when it may be empty here (the To do drawer's own words, from `describeFinding`), and, with `allowIfEmptyUse`, "If empty, use [suggestion]", "Choose another value" and the "If Eng lead is empty, use" field (itself a ValueField taking what the slot takes; its sentences name the slot it stands in for). In a Who is asked whose value may be empty: the card "Who Development asks, for each kind of request" (through the stage that fills it; the arrow that skips it, with the fallback or "nobody is asked"). An empty slot that takes only people reads "Choose who is asked" ("Choose " + the label). A "when ..." or a formula in the slot is edited with the WhenBuilder and FormulaEditor slots, with "Choose a value instead". In Who is asked the fallback is someone asked, so the words say "If empty, ask [suggestion]", "If Eng lead is empty, ask" and "Done: if Eng lead is empty, Development now asks ..." (mockup 04-values); the chosen value carries an amber dot while it may be empty here. An optional look?: 'field' | 'chip' (proposed for ValueFieldProps; until slots.ts has it, ValueFieldWithLookProps): 'chip' shows only the value as a chip (or a dashed "Choose ...") to stand in a sentence, opens the same picker, has no notes under it and says its state in its accessible name and tooltip, with an amber or red dot.
  - `ValueChip` (`ValueChipProps`): `{ valueId }`, the value's name with its kind's icon; a click opens the value card. Every line comes from the model's `describeValueCard`: kind, Filled at, "If empty, use" with its chips, sample, Used in N places (with "Needed to press Approve" and the connection's own names, "In Jira this is called Assignee"), each place a "Show" link through `reveal` beside its stage's status dot; Rename with `value.rename`; See all values.
  - `MessageField` (`MessageFieldProps`): text with value chips in it, one line or several; "+ Insert a value" opens the same picker; Backspace/Delete remove a chip whole; gives exactly the format's `Template` (`SentTemplate` with `sent`).
  - `ListDialog` (`ListDialogProps`, `ListDialog.tsx`): the list as a table edited in place (cells, rows moved and removed with a plain-words question, columns added with their settings), where it is used, and "Not live until you publish." with Done.
- The Values tab (`ValuesPage.tsx`): every value with its kind, Filled at, Used in and the sample, searchable and groupable by the stage that fills it; rename in place; "Lists and directory"; the sample request card (`SampleRequest.tsx`). Choosing a value (its name, or a click on its row) shows it beside the table (`ValueDetail.tsx`, mockup 04-values values-tab): kind, where it is filled, the sample, Rename, a small map of the stages marked Filled here / Used here / May be empty here / Never filled here, and At each stage with the reason (the To do drawer's words, `describeMayBeEmpty`) and each use with its "If empty". Under Used in, the amber line "may be empty in 2 stages, each with an "if empty"". Every Show link names the value it belongs to. Pure helpers: `values-tab.ts` (rows, search, grouping), `values-detail.ts` (the value at each stage, from core.valuesInScope at each stage and each use) and `lists.ts` (where a list is used, row names). Dates are typed in `DateInput.tsx` (one named text box: "2 Dec 2026", "2/12/2026"), never the browser's date box. Local primitives: `DirectoryPick.tsx` (one person or group from the Directory) and `InlinePopover.tsx` (a popover that stays inside a dialog, since the ui Popover opens behind the ui Dialog). Also `places.tsx` (place links) and `values-tab.module.css`.
- The editing slots are **controlled**: the caller passes the part of the document and stores what `onChange` gives with its own named command. Example: `<Slot name="ValueField" at={{ item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' }} label={t('word.whoIsAsked')} accepts={['person', 'group']} allowTyped allowIfEmptyUse value={task.whoIsAsked} onChange={(next) => run(...)} />`.
- The picker (`Picker.tsx`) renders what `buildOptions` (`options.ts`, pure) offers: groups "This stage's answers", "Values", "Lists and directory" (a list's columns as steps, "Primary domain's approvers"; people and groups from the Directory when `allowTyped` takes a person or group), "Request" (Requester, Started on), "Type it in" (constants of the accepted kinds); with `sent`, only "From the ticket" (what the trigger sends, as dashed sent chips); in a "Fill in the form from the ticket" row (`answers.<question>` of a binding) the question says what fits when the slot does not, and what can be typed is its own choices or list rows, a date or a number. Search puts names that start with the text first (`matchRank`); a typed date gives "Use the date 2 Dec 2026" (`parseDate`). A chip (look 'chip') is emptied with Delete or Backspace, or Clear in its picker's footer. The wrong kinds are counted in one line with "Show"; shown, they are greyed with the reason. Never filled here is greyed with why. Keyboard: the search box is a combobox; type, arrows (PageUp/PageDown), Enter; Escape closes and focus goes back to the field.
- The picker's footer always offers Add "when ..." (except for what another system sends) and Write a formula. Where a Yes/No fits, Add "when ..." puts a sentence in the slot; elsewhere it shows the answers chosen from a list that the slot can depend on (`dependsGroups` in `Picker.tsx`), which is how Who is asked comes to depend on the request. The picker opens below its field and stays inside the area the field scrolls in (`collisionBoundary`), scrolling that area to make room, so it never covers the top bar.
- Files: `ValueField.tsx`, `Picker.tsx`, `options.ts`, `kinds.ts`, `notes.ts`, `directory.ts` (Directory search and names through `sessionServices()`, no provider needed), `chips.tsx` (phrases as chips), `ValueChip.tsx`, `MessageField.tsx`, `template-dom.ts` (drawing and reading a Template in the text box), `values.module.css`.
- Separators and list words come from src/words (`values.sep`, `values.comma`, `values.and`; `andList` in `kinds.ts`). `words.test.ts` fails if a component here writes one itself.
- Tests: `options.test.ts`, `words.test.ts`, `ValueField.test.tsx` (also the ValueChip card and the chip look), `MessageField.test.tsx` (every Template in the four fixtures round-trips), `values-tab.test.ts`, `ValuesPage.test.tsx`, `ListDialog.test.tsx`; end-to-end in `tests/e2e/values.spec.ts` (through the panel's Who is asked; fails when the panel does not show it) and `tests/e2e/values-tab.spec.ts`.
- May import: `@/model`, `@/services`, `@/words`, `@/ui`, `@/contract`, and files in this folder. Never another feature or `@/app` (lint enforces it). Words: `src/words/values.ts`, keys starting with `values.`.

/**
 * The sample request on the Values tab (editor-model.md section 1, "Sample request"): the request
 * the editor uses for every sample it shows. Its name, Requester, Started on, and one answer per
 * value, each with the small editor its kind needs. Changed only with the sample commands
 * (src/model/commands/sample.ts).
 */
import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Constant, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import { describeConstant, failureChoices, fillSites, getQuestion, getTask, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFacts, useRun } from '@/model';
import { Card, Field, Select, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { DateInput } from './DateInput';
import { DirectoryPick } from './DirectoryPick';
import { singleKind } from './kinds';
import { rowName } from './lists';
import { listOfValue } from './options';
import { valueRows, type ValueRow } from './values-tab';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

/** A text box that keeps what is typed until it loses focus or Enter is pressed, then stores it. */
export function CommitInput({
  value, onCommit, label, type = 'text', className,
}: { value: string; onCommit(next: string): void; label: string; type?: 'text' | 'number'; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <TextInput
      key={value}
      type={type}
      aria-label={label}
      defaultValue={value}
      className={className}
      onBlur={(e) => {
        if (e.currentTarget.value !== value) onCommit(e.currentTarget.value);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (e.currentTarget.value !== value) onCommit(e.currentTarget.value);
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}

const NONE = '';

export function SampleRequestCard() {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const run = useRun();
  const rows = useMemo(() => (doc ? valueRows(doc, facts, env) : []), [doc, facts, env]);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const sample = doc.sampleRequest;
  return (
    <Card title={t('word.sampleRequest')} sub={t('values.sample.sub')}>
      <div className={s.sampleTop}>
        <Field label={t('values.sample.name')} hint={t('values.sample.nameHint')}>
          <TextInput
            key={sample?.name ?? ''}
            defaultValue={sample?.name ?? ''}
            onBlur={(e) => {
              if (e.currentTarget.value !== (sample?.name ?? '')) run('sample.setName', { name: e.currentTarget.value });
            }}
          />
        </Field>
        <div className={s.sampleField}>
          <span className={s.fieldLabel}>{t('values.sample.requester')}</span>
          <DirectoryPick
            type="user"
            label={t('values.sample.requester')}
            value={sample?.requester}
            emptyWords={t('values.list.notGiven')}
            onChange={(next) => run('sample.setRequester', next ? { requester: next } : {})}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={s.sampleField}>
          <span className={s.fieldLabel}>{t('values.sample.startedOn')}</span>
          <DateInput
            label={t('values.sample.startedOn')}
            value={sample?.startedOn ?? ''}
            onCommit={(next) => run('sample.setStartedOn', next ? { startedOn: next } : {})}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <h3 className={s.subHead}>{t('values.sample.answers')}</h3>
      <p className={s.quiet}>{t('values.sample.answersSub')}</p>
      <ul className={s.sampleAnswers}>
        {rows.map((row) => (
          <li key={row.id} className={s.sampleAnswer}>
            <span className={s.sampleName}>{row.name || t('describe.noName')}</span>
            <AnswerEditor doc={doc} row={row} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** The small editor for one value's sample answer, by its kind. */
function AnswerEditor({ doc, row }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; row: ValueRow }): ReactNode {
  const run = useRun();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const id = row.id as ValueId;
  const answer = doc.sampleRequest?.answers?.[id];
  const label = t('values.sample.answerLabel', { name: row.name || t('describe.noName') });
  const set = (next: Constant | undefined) => (next ? run('sample.setAnswer', { value: id, answer: next }) : run('sample.clearAnswer', { value: id }));
  const select = (options: { value: string; label: string }[], current: string, onPick: (v: string) => void) => (
    <Select aria-label={label} value={current} onChange={(e) => onPick(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: NONE, label: t('values.sample.none') }, ...options]} />
  );

  // A task's "Button pressed": one of the task's buttons.
  const pressed = fillSites(doc, id).find((r) => r.how === 'savesButtonPressedAs');
  if (pressed) {
    const task = getTask(doc, pressed.owner.id);
    const current = answer && 'button' in answer ? answer.button : NONE;
    return select(
      (task?.buttons ?? []).map((b) => ({ value: b.id, label: b.label || t('describe.noName') })),
      current,
      (v) => set(v ? { button: v as never } : undefined),
    );
  }

  // What went wrong in an action: one of its operation's failure codes, by the catalogue's label (E-29).
  const failures = failureChoices(doc, catalogue, id);
  if (failures) {
    const current = answer && 'failureCode' in answer ? answer.failureCode : NONE;
    return select(failures.map((c) => ({ value: c.value, label: c.label })), current, (v) => set(v ? { failureCode: v } : undefined));
  }

  const kind = singleKind(row.kind);
  switch (kind) {
    case 'text':
    case 'longText':
      return <CommitInput label={label} value={answer && 'text' in answer ? answer.text : ''} onCommit={(v) => set(v ? { text: v } : undefined)} />;
    case 'number':
      return (
        <CommitInput
          type="number"
          label={label}
          value={answer && 'number' in answer ? String(answer.number) : ''}
          onCommit={(v) => set(v.trim() && Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? { number: Number(v) } : undefined)}
        />
      );
    case 'date':
      return <DateInput label={label} value={answer && 'date' in answer ? answer.date : ''} onCommit={(v) => set(v ? { date: v } : undefined)} />;
    case 'yesNo':
      return select(
        [
          { value: 'yes', label: t('values.list.yes') },
          { value: 'no', label: t('values.list.no') },
        ],
        answer && 'yesNo' in answer ? (answer.yesNo ? 'yes' : 'no') : NONE,
        (v) => set(v ? { yesNo: v === 'yes' } : undefined),
      );
    case 'person':
    case 'group': {
      const ref = answer && kind in answer ? (answer as Record<string, { directoryId: string; name: string }>)[kind] : undefined;
      return (
        <DirectoryPick
          type={kind === 'group' ? 'group' : 'user'}
          label={label}
          value={ref}
          emptyWords={t('values.sample.none')}
          onChange={(next) => set(next ? (kind === 'group' ? { group: next } : { person: next }) : undefined)}
        />
      );
    }
    case 'choice': {
      const question = fillSites(doc, id).map((r) => getQuestion(doc, r.owner.id)).find((q) => q?.choices?.from === 'typedIn');
      const choices = question?.choices?.from === 'typedIn' ? question.choices.choices : [];
      if (choices.length) {
        return select(
          choices.map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: c.label })),
          answer && 'choice' in answer ? answer.choice : NONE,
          (v) => set(v ? { choice: v as never } : undefined),
        );
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'choiceFromList': {
      const of = listOfValue(doc, id);
      const list = of ? doc.lists.find((l) => l.id === of.listId) : undefined;
      if (list) {
        return select(
          list.rows.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: rowName(doc, list, r) })),
          answer && 'row' in answer ? answer.row : NONE,
          (v) => set(v ? { row: v as never } : undefined),
        );
      }
      break;
    }
    default:
      break;
  }
  // Kinds without a small editor here (a choice from a connection, several people ...): said, not edited.
  return (
    <span className={s.plain}>
      {answer ? toText(describeConstant(doc, answer)) : t('values.sample.none')}
      <span className={s.quiet}> {t('values.sample.fromTryIt')}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Slot ValueChip: a value's name with its kind's icon. Clicking it opens the small value card
 * (editor-model.md section 9, "Getting into things from where you see them"; mockup 01-editor,
 * value-card): its kind, where it is filled, the "If empty, use" its uses fall back to, the sample,
 * "Used in N places", Rename and See all values (the Values tab). Every line of the card is the
 * model's describeValueCard; each place is a link that shows it, beside its stage's status dot.
 */
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Status, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeExpression, describeValueCard, find, getStage, isChip, reveal, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFacts, useRun,
  type ValueCardLine,
} from '@/model';
import { Button, Icon, Popover, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { chipLook, PhraseView, requestChipKind } from './chips';
import { kindTitle } from './kinds';
import { sampleOf, stageIdOf } from './options';
import s from './values.module.css';

export function ValueChip({ valueId }: ValueChipProps) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const phrase = doc ? describeExpression(doc, { value: valueId as ValueId }, env) : [];
  const first = phrase.find(isChip);
  const label = first?.label ?? valueId;
  const kind = facts?.values[valueId as ValueId]?.kind;
  const look = chipLook({ chip: 'value', ...(first?.missing ? { missing: true } : {}) }, kind);
  return (
    <Popover
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={setOpen}
      width={400}
      title={label}
      sub={t('values.card.sub', { kind: kindTitle(kind) })}
      trigger={
        <button type="button" className={look.className} aria-haspopup="dialog">
          {look.icon && <Icon name={look.icon} size={13} />}
          <span className={s.chipLabel}>{label}</span>
        </button>
      }
      footer={<CardFooter valueId={valueId} name={label} gone={!!first?.missing} onDone={() => setOpen(false)} />}
    >
      <CardBody valueId={valueId} onShow={() => setOpen(false)} />
    </Popover>
  );
}

type ValueChipProps = { valueId: string };

function CardBody({ valueId, onShow }: { valueId: string; onShow(): void }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  if (!doc) return null;
  if (find(doc, valueId)?.kind !== 'value') return <p className={s.cardLine}>{t('values.card.gone')}</p>;

  const card = describeValueCard(doc, valueId, env);
  const sample = sampleOf(doc, { value: valueId as ValueId });
  const kindOfChip = (id: string | undefined) => (id ? facts?.values[id as ValueId]?.kind : undefined);
  const show = (line: ValueCardLine) => {
    onShow();
    reveal(line.location);
  };

  return (
    <div className={s.card}>
      <section aria-labelledby={`${valueId}-filled`}>
        <h3 className={s.cardHead} id={`${valueId}-filled`}>
          {t('values.card.filledAt')}
        </h3>
        {card.filled.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={s.cardLine}>{t('values.card.filledNowhere')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className={s.places}>
            {card.filled.map((line, i) => (
              <PlaceLine key={i} doc={doc} line={line} onShow={() => show(line)} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {card.ifEmptyUse.length > 0 && (
          <ul className={s.places}>
            {card.ifEmptyUse.map((fallback, i) => (
              <li key={i} className={s.cardIfEmpty}>
                <Icon name="check" size={14} className={s.cardIfEmptyIcon} />
                <span>{t('describe.card.ifEmptyUse')}</span>
                <PhraseView phrase={fallback} kindOf={(c) => kindOfChip(c.id) ?? requestChipKind(c)} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {card.filled.length > 1 && <p className={s.cardLine}>{t('values.card.later', { n: card.filled.length })}</p>}
        {sample && <p className={s.cardLine}>{t('values.card.sample', { sample })}</p>}
        {card.choices && <p className={s.cardLine}>{card.choices}</p>}
      </section>
      <section aria-labelledby={`${valueId}-used`} className={s.cardSection}>
        <h3 className={s.cardHead} id={`${valueId}-used`}>
          {card.used.length === 1 ? t('values.card.usedInOne') : t('values.card.usedIn', { n: card.used.length })}
        </h3>
        {card.used.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={s.cardLine}>{t('values.card.usedNowhere')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className={s.places}>
            {card.used.map((line, i) => (
              <PlaceLine key={i} doc={doc} line={line} onShow={() => show(line)} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

/** One place on the card: the stage (a link that shows the place, beside its status dot) and what it is there. */
function PlaceLine({ doc, line, onShow }: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; line: ValueCardLine; onShow(): void }) {
  const stageId = stageIdOf(doc, line.location.item);
  const stage = stageId ? getStage(doc, stageId) : undefined;
  const statusId = stage ? (stage.status ?? (stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.ifSentBackStatus : undefined)) : undefined;
  const colour = statusId ? doc.statuses?.find((x) => x.id === statusId)?.colour : undefined;
  const place = line.stage && line.what ? t('values.card.place', { stage: line.stage, what: line.what }) : line.stage || line.what;
  return (
    <li className={s.place}>
      <span className={s.placeWhere}>
        <span className={s.stageDot} style={{ background: statusColour(colour) }} aria-hidden="true" />
        <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={onShow} aria-label={t('values.card.show', { place })}>
          {line.stage || line.what}
        </button>
      </span>
      <span className={s.placeWhat}>{line.stage ? line.what : ''}</span>
    </li>
  );
}

/** The colour token of a stage's status (tokens.css has six; the other two borrow the nearest). */
function statusColour(colour: Status['colour'] | undefined): string {
  switch (colour) {
    case 'amber':
    case 'blue':
    case 'purple':
    case 'green':
    case 'red':
    case 'grey':
      return `var(--st-${colour})`;
    case 'teal':
      return 'var(--action-icon)';
    case 'pink':
      return 'var(--st-red)';
    default:
      return 'transparent';
  }
}

function CardFooter({ valueId, name, gone, onDone }: { valueId: string; name: string; gone: boolean; onDone(): void }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(name);
  const renameRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const backToRename = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (renaming || !backToRename.current) return;
    backToRename.current = false;
    renameRef.current?.focus();
  }, [renaming]);
  const stop = () => {
    backToRename.current = true;
    setRenaming(false);
  };
  if (renaming) {
    const save = (e: FormEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const next = text.trim();
      if (next && next !== name) run('value.rename', { value: valueId as ValueId, name: next });
      stop();
    };
    return (
      <form className={s.renameForm} onSubmit={save}>
        <TextInput
          aria-label={t('values.card.renameLabel', { name })}
          value={text}
          autoFocus
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
        />
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" type="submit">
          {t('values.card.renameSave')}
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={stop}>
          {t('values.card.renameCancel')}
        </Button>
      </form>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={s.cardFoot}>
      {!gone && (
        <Button
          ref={renameRef}
          size="sm"
          icon="edit"
          onClick={() => {
            setText(name);
            setRenaming(true);
          }}
        >
          {t('values.card.rename')}
        </Button>
      )}
      <Button
        size="sm"
        variant="quiet"
        icon="grid"
        onClick={() => {
          onDone();
          reveal({ item: valueId });
        }}
      >
        {t('values.card.seeAll')}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/ValueDetail.tsx\n===
/**
 * The Values tab's detail panel (mockup 04-values, values-tab): the chosen value's kind, where it is
 * filled and its sample, Rename, a small map of the stages marking where it is filled, used, may be
 * empty and never filled, and "At each stage", one plain sentence per stage with its reason and each
 * use there with its "If empty". The may-be-empty reason is the To do drawer's own sentence
 * (describeMayBeEmpty), so one fact is never worded two ways.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import type { ValueInScope } from '@/services';
import {
  describeExpression, describeMayBeEmpty, getStage, reveal, sessionServices, toText, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useRun,
  type DescribeEnv,
} from '@/model';
import { Button, Icon, TextInput, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { andList, kindIcon, kindTitle, singleKind } from './kinds';
import { placeWords, statusColour } from './places';
import { scopeKey, stagesFor, type ScopeAt, type StageAt, type StageState } from './values-detail';
import type { ValueRow } from './values-tab';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

/**
 * What core.valuesInScope says at each of `locations`, for any value; null until the first answer.
 * The last answers stay while the next ones are worked out, so nothing flickers on an edit.
 */
export function useScopeAt(locations: readonly Location[]): ScopeAt | null {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const [got, setGot] = useState<Map<string, ValueInScope[]> | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const services = sessionServices();
    if (!doc || !catalogue || !services) return;
    let live = true;
    const asked = locations;
    void Promise.all(
      asked.map((l) =>
        services.core.valuesInScope(doc, catalogue, l).then(
          (values) => [scopeKey(l), values] as const,
          () => [scopeKey(l), [] as ValueInScope[]] as const,
        ),
      ),
    ).then((entries) => {
      if (live) setGot(new Map(entries));
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [doc, catalogue, locations]);
  return useMemo(() => (got ? (l: Location, valueId: string) => got.get(scopeKey(l))?.find((v) => v.id === valueId) : null), [got]);
}

const MARKS: { state: 'filled' | 'used' | 'mayBeEmpty' | 'never'; icon: IconName; word: Parameters<typeof t>[0]; cls: string }[] = [
  { state: 'filled', icon: 'save', word: 'values.detail.mark.filled', cls: s.markFilled! },
  { state: 'used', icon: 'eye', word: 'values.detail.mark.used', cls: s.markUsed! },
  { state: 'mayBeEmpty', icon: 'warning', word: 'values.detail.mark.may', cls: s.markMay! },
  { state: 'never', icon: 'minus', word: 'values.detail.mark.never', cls: s.markNever! },
];

function Mark({ state }: { state: (typeof MARKS)[number]['state'] }) {
  const m = MARKS.find((x) => x.state === state)!;
  return (
    <span className={`${s.mark} ${m.cls}`}>
      <Icon name={m.icon} size={12} />
      {t(m.word)}
    </span>
  );
}

const marksOf = (st: StageAt): (typeof MARKS)[number]['state'][] => {
  const out: (typeof MARKS)[number]['state'][] = [];
  if (st.state === 'filled') out.push('filled');
  if (st.uses.length) out.push('used');
  if (st.state === 'mayBeEmpty') out.push('mayBeEmpty');
  if (st.state === 'never') out.push('never');
  return out;
};

function stageDot(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stageId: string): string {
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
  const statusId = stage ? (stage.status ?? (stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.ifSentBackStatus : undefined)) : undefined;
  return statusColour(statusId ? doc.statuses?.find((x) => x.id === statusId)?.colour : undefined);
}

export function ValueDetail({ row, scopeAt, onRenamed }: { row: ValueRow; scopeAt: ScopeAt | null; onRenamed?: () => void }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const stages = useMemo(
    () => (doc && scopeAt ? stagesFor(doc, row.id, { filled: row.filled, used: row.used, ifEmptyUse: [] }, scopeAt) : []),
    [doc, row, scopeAt],
  );
  if (!doc) return null;
  const name = row.name || t('describe.noName');
  const kind = singleKind(row.kind);
  const fillPlaces = [...new Set(row.filled.map((l) => l.stage).filter(Boolean))];
  const meta = [
    kindTitle(row.kind),
    fillPlaces.length ? t('values.detail.filledAt', { place: andList(fillPlaces) }) : t('values.detail.filledNowhere'),
    row.sample ? t('values.from.sample', { sample: row.sample }) : undefined,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(t('values.sep'));
  const working = stages.filter((st) => !st.ending);
  const endings = stages.filter((st) => st.ending);
  const listed = stages.filter((st) => !st.ending || st.uses.length || st.fills.length);

  return (
    <div className={s.detail}>
      <DetailHead row={row} name={name} meta={meta} icon={kindIcon(kind)} onRenamed={onRenamed} />

      <section className={s.detailSec} aria-label={t('values.detail.mapLabel', { name })}>
        <div className={s.legend} aria-hidden="true">
          {MARKS.map((m) => (
            <Mark key={m.state} state={m.state} />
          ))}
          <span className={s.quiet}>{t('values.detail.noMark')}</span>
        </div>
        {!scopeAt ? (
          <p className={s.quiet}>{t('values.detail.working')}</p>
        ) : (
          <div className={s.mini}>
            <ol className={s.miniList}>
              {working.map((st, i) => (
                <li key={st.stageId} className={s.miniRow}>
                  <span className={s.miniStage}>
                    <span className={s.stageDot} style={{ background: stageDot(doc, st.stageId) }} aria-hidden="true" />
                    {st.name || t('describe.noName')}
                  </span>
                  <span className={s.miniMarks}>
                    {marksOf(st).length ? (
                      marksOf(st).map((m) => <Mark key={m} state={m} />)
                    ) : (
                      <span className="visually-hidden">{t('values.detail.always')}</span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  {i < working.length - 1 && <Icon name="arrow-down" size={12} className={s.miniArrow} />}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
            {endings.length > 0 && (
              <ul className={s.miniEndings} aria-label={t('values.detail.endings')}>
                {endings.map((st) => (
                  <li key={st.stageId} className={s.miniEnding}>
                    <Icon name="ending" size={12} />
                    {st.name || t('describe.noName')}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className={s.detailSec}>
        <h3 className={s.detailLabel}>{t('values.detail.atEach')}</h3>
        {scopeAt && (
          <ul className={s.ats}>
            {listed.map((st, i) => (
              <li key={st.stageId} className={s.atsRow} data-state={st.state}>
                <div className={s.atsStage}>
                  <span className={s.stageDot} style={{ background: stageDot(doc, st.stageId) }} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {st.name || t('describe.noName')}
                </div>
                <div className={s.atsText}>
                  <StageSentence doc={doc} env={env} row={row} name={name} st={st} before={listed.slice(0, i)} />
                  {st.uses.map((u, j) => (
                    <div key={j} className={s.atsUse}>
                      <Icon name="eye" size={13} />
                      <span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className={s.link}
                          aria-label={t('values.tab.showUses', { place: placeWords(u.line), name })}
                          onClick={() => reveal(u.line.location)}
                        >
                          {u.line.what || u.line.stage}
                        </button>
                        {u.ifEmpty ? (
                          <>
                            {t('values.detail.ifEmptyLead')}
                            {t('values.detail.ifEmpty', { fallback: toText(describeExpression(doc, u.ifEmpty, env, { short: true })) })}
                          </>
                        ) : u.ifEmpty === null && u.mayBeEmpty ? (
                          <span className={s.atsWarn}>
                            {t('values.detail.ifEmptyLead')}
                            {t('values.detail.noIfEmpty')}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Why the value may be empty at a stage, in the To do drawer's words, without their opening "Eng
 * lead may be empty here:" (the bold "May be empty here." before it says that already).
 */
function reason(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, env: DescribeEnv, valueId: string, st: StageAt): string {
  const said = describeMayBeEmpty(doc, { item: st.stageId }, valueId, st.skippedVia ?? [], env);
  if (!said.cause.startsWith(said.short)) return said.cause;
  const rest = said.cause.slice(said.short.length).replace(/^[\s:.,]+/, '');
  return rest ? rest.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + rest.slice(1) : said.cause;
}

/** The one sentence for a stage: "Filled here by the question Eng lead.", "May be empty here. Requests ...". */
function StageSentence({
  doc, env, row, name, st, before,
}: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; env: DescribeEnv; row: ValueRow; name: string; st: StageAt; before: readonly StageAt[] }) {
  const head = (state: StageState): ReactNode => {
    switch (state) {
      case 'filled':
        return <strong>{t('values.detail.filledHere')}</strong>;
      case 'mayBeEmpty':
        return <strong className={s.atsWarn}>{t('values.detail.mayHere')}</strong>;
      case 'never':
        return <strong>{t('values.detail.neverHere')}</strong>;
      default:
        return <strong>{t('values.detail.alwaysHere')}</strong>;
    }
  };
  if (st.state === 'filled') {
    const what = andList(st.fills.map((f) => f.what).filter(Boolean));
    return (
      <p>
        {head('filled')}
        {what ? t('values.detail.filledBy', { what }) : t('values.detail.stop')}
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (st.state === 'never') {
    const places = [...new Set(row.filled.map((l) => l.stage).filter(Boolean))];
    return (
      <p>
        {head('never')}
        {t('values.detail.space')}
        {places.length ? t('values.detail.neverLater', { name, place: andList(places) }) : t('values.detail.neverNothing', { name })}
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (st.state === 'mayBeEmpty') {
    const cause = reason(doc, env, row.id, st);
    const same = before.some((b) => b.state === 'mayBeEmpty' && reason(doc, env, row.id, b) === cause);
    return (
      <p>
        {head('mayBeEmpty')}
        {same ? t('values.detail.sameReason') : <>{t('values.detail.space')}{cause}</>}
      </p>
    );
  }
  return (
    <p>
      {head('always')}
      {t('values.detail.stop')}
    </p>
  );
}

function DetailHead({
  row, name, meta, icon, onRenamed,
}: { row: ValueRow; name: string; meta: string; icon: IconName; onRenamed?: (() => void) | undefined }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(row.name);
  const renameRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const back = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing || !back.current) return;
    back.current = false;
    renameRef.current?.focus();
  }, [editing]);
  const stop = () => {
    back.current = true;
    setEditing(false);
  };
  const save = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = text.trim();
    if (next && next !== row.name) {
      run('value.rename', { value: row.id as ValueId, name: next });
      onRenamed?.();
    }
    stop();
  };
  return (
    <div className={s.detailHead}>
      <span className={s.detailIcon} aria-hidden="true">
        <Icon name={icon} size={18} />
      </span>
      <div className={s.detailTitle}>
        {editing ? (
          <form className={s.renameForm} onSubmit={save}>
            <TextInput
              aria-label={t('values.card.renameLabel', { name })}
              value={text}
              autoFocus
              onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  stop();
                }
              }}
            />
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" type="submit">
              {t('values.card.renameSave')}
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={stop}>
              {t('values.card.renameCancel')}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <h2 className={s.detailName} id={`detail-${row.id}`}>
            {name}
          </h2>
        )}
        <p className={s.detailMeta}>{meta}</p>
      </div>
      {!editing && (
        <Button
          ref={renameRef}
          size="sm"
          icon="edit"
          aria-label={t('values.detail.rename', { name })}
          onClick={() => {
            setText(row.name);
            setEditing(true);
          }}
        >
          {t('values.card.rename')}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Expression, Location, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import { describeValueCard, openWorkflow, resetSessionForTests, SlotsProvider, useEditor } from '@/model';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider, type Services } from '@/services';
import { Icon } from '@/ui';
import { ValueChip } from './ValueChip';
import { ValueField } from './ValueField';

afterEach(() => resetSessionForTests());

async function open(): Promise<Services> {
  const { services } = createStandinServices();
  await act(() => openWorkflow(services, 'change-request'));
  return services;
}

function wrap(services: Services, node: ReactNode) {
  return render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <SlotsProvider slots={{}}>{node}</SlotsProvider>
    </ServicesProvider>,
  );
}

type FieldArgs = { at: Location; value?: Expression; accepts?: ValueKind[]; allowTyped?: boolean; allowIfEmptyUse?: boolean };

async function field(args: FieldArgs) {
  const services = await open();
  const onChange = vi.fn<(next: Expression | undefined) => void>();
  const view = wrap(
    services,
    <ValueField label="Who is asked" at={args.at} value={args.value} onChange={(next) => onChange(next)}
      {...(args.accepts ? { accepts: args.accepts } : {})} {...(args.allowTyped ? { allowTyped: true } : {})}
      {...(args.allowIfEmptyUse ? { allowIfEmptyUse: true } : {})} />,
  );
  return { services, onChange, view };
}

describe('ValueChip', () => {

    await waitFor(() => expect(card).toHaveTextContent('A value · Kind: Person'));
    expect(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: 'Show Domain approval: by the question Eng lead' })).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(card).toHaveTextContent("If empty, usePrimary domain's default lead");
  });

  it('every line of the card is the model\'s describeValueCard: 4 places, each in words, not crumbs (mockup 01-editor, value-card)', async () => {

    // The same places, in the same order, as the model's card (its words for a connection's part need the catalogue).
    expect(words.used.map((l) => l.stage)).toEqual(['Domain approval', 'Create Jira issue', 'Create Jira issue', 'Development']);
    expect(lines).toEqual([
      'Domain approvalNeeded to press Approve',
      'Create Jira issueIn Jira this is called Assignee',
      'Create Jira issueNotify Eng lead',
      'DevelopmentWho is asked',
    ]);
    expect(card.textContent).not.toMatch(/›/);
    expect(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: 'Show Create Jira issue: In Jira this is called Assignee' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('rename from the card', async () => {
    const services = await open();
    wrap(services, <ValueChip valueId="v_eng_lead" />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Eng lead' }));
    const card = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Eng lead' });

    fireEvent.click(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: 'Rename' }));
    const box = within(card).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'New name for Eng lead' });
    fireEvent.change(box, { target: { value: 'Engineering lead' } });
    fireEvent.click(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    expect(useEditor.getState().doc!.values.find((v) => v.id === 'v_eng_lead')?.name).toBe('Engineering lead');
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(card).getByRole('button', { name: 'Rename' })).toHaveFocus());
  });
});
