/**
 * Slot ValueField: one value slot. Shows what the slot holds as a chip in words (describe), with
 * where it comes from and the sample, and opens the value picker. Under it, what is worth knowing
 * about the choice at this place: the wrong kind or never filled here (red), may be empty here
 * (amber, with "If empty, use ..." offered right there when the slot allows it). A "when ..." or a
 * formula in the slot is edited with the other features' slots WhenBuilder and FormulaEditor.
 */
import * as RP from '@radix-ui/react-popover';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Expression, Location, SentExpression, ValueId, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import {
  arrowLabel, describeExpression, find, getList, getStage, Slot, toText, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFacts, useValuesInScope,
  type ValueFieldProps,
} from '@/model';
import { Button, Icon, IconButton } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { NoteWords, PhraseView } from './chips';
import { ALL_KINDS, andList, fits, kindsWithArticle, kindWithArticle, singleKind, type ScopeKind } from './kinds';
import { mayBeEmptyPhrase, useStuckPeople } from './notes';
import {
  buildOptions, fillStages, kindOfExpression, listOfValue, sameBase, sentQuestionOf, stageIdOf, type PickOption,
} from './options';
import { ValuePicker } from './Picker';
import s from './values.module.css';

type AnyExpression = Expression | SentExpression;

type InnerProps = ValueFieldProps & {
  look?: ValueFieldLook;
  /** Open the picker when it appears ("Choose another value"). */
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  /** Put focus on the field when it appears (after "If empty, use ..." was applied). */
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  /** Set on the "If <value> is empty, use" field: the slot it stands in for, for its sentences. */
  fallbackOf?: { label: string; value: string };
};

/**
 * The look of the slot (proposed for ValueFieldProps in src/model/slots.ts):
 * - 'field' (the default): a full-width field with "from ..." and the sample, the chevron, Clear,
 *   and the notes under it (the stage panel, an action's details).
 * - 'chip': only the value as a chip (or a dashed "Choose ..." when empty), to stand in a sentence
 *   ("When [Risk] is High"). It opens the same picker. There are no notes under it, so the chip
 *   names its state in its accessible name and tooltip, with a dot beside it (amber: may be empty
 *   here; red: wrong kind or never filled here).
 */
export type ValueFieldLook = 'field' | 'chip';
export type ValueFieldWithLookProps = ValueFieldProps & { look?: ValueFieldLook };

const PEOPLE_KINDS: readonly ValueKind[] = ['person', 'group', 'people'];
const lowerFirst = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + s.slice(1);

export function ValueField(props: ValueFieldWithLookProps) {
  return <ValueFieldInner {...props} />;
}

const isRecord = (x: unknown): x is Record<string, unknown> => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x);
const isFormula = (x: unknown) => isRecord(x) && typeof x.formula === 'string';
const isSentence = (x: unknown) => isRecord(x) && (Array.isArray(x.allOf) || Array.isArray(x.anyOf));
const isReference = (x: unknown): x is { value: string; ifEmptyUse?: Expression } | { request: string; ifEmptyUse?: Expression } =>
  isRecord(x) && (typeof x.value === 'string' || typeof x.request === 'string');

const partOf = (at: Location, sub: string): Location => ({ item: at.item, part: at.part ? `${at.part}.${sub}` : sub });

function ValueFieldInner(props: InnerProps) {
  const { at, label, allowTyped, allowIfEmptyUse, placeholder, sent, autoOpen, autoFocus, fallbackOf } = props;
  const look: ValueFieldLook = props.look ?? 'field';
  const docForKinds = useDoc();
  // "Fill in the form from the ticket": when the caller does not say what fits, the question does.
  const sentQuestionKind = sent && docForKinds && !props.accepts?.length ? sentQuestionOf(docForKinds, at)?.kind : undefined;
  const accepts = useMemo<ValueKind[] | undefined>(
    () => (props.accepts?.length ? [...props.accepts] : sentQuestionKind ? [sentQuestionKind] : props.accepts ? [...props.accepts] : undefined),
    [props.accepts, sentQuestionKind],
  );
  /** Who is asked (and its own "If empty, ..."): the fallback is someone asked, so the words say "ask". */
  const asks = at.part?.split('.')[0] === 'whoIsAsked';
  /** The slot named in sentences ("Who is asked needs ..."): the fallback speaks for the slot it stands in for. */
  const sayLabel = fallbackOf?.label ?? label;
  const value = props.value as AnyExpression | undefined;
  const emit = props.onChange as (next: AnyExpression | undefined) => void;
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const stuckPeople = useStuckPeople();
  const { values: scope } = useValuesInScope(sent ? null : at);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(autoOpen ?? false);
  const [choosingFallback, setChoosingFallback] = useState(false);
  const [focusFallback, setFocusFallback] = useState(false);
  /** "Done: ..." after the offered "If empty, use" was applied, confirmed in place (editor-model.md section 7). */
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const focusInside = useRef(false);
  /** Set when the "If empty, use" value was cleared: focus goes to the offer that comes back, or to the field. */
  const focusAfterClear = useRef(false);
  const offerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const fallbackLabelId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusAfterClear.current) return;
    focusAfterClear.current = false;
    const target = offerRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button') ?? triggerRef.current;
    target?.focus();
  });

  const sayEnv = useMemo(() => (sent ? { ...env, trigger: sent } : env), [env, sent]);
  const findingEnv = useMemo(() => ({ ...env, stuckPeople }), [env, stuckPeople]);
  const kindOfValue = useCallback(
    (id: string): ScopeKind => scope.find((v) => v.id === id)?.kind ?? facts?.values[id as ValueId]?.kind,
    [scope, facts],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoFocus) triggerRef.current?.focus();
  }, [autoFocus]);

  // The picker opens below the field and stays inside the area the field scrolls in, so it never
  // covers the top bar: on opening, that area is scrolled to make room below when it can.
  const [boundary, setBoundary] = useState<Element | null>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !triggerRef.current) return;
    const scroller = scrollArea(triggerRef.current);
    // A narrow column (the form editor's Settings) cannot hold the picker side to side: keep it
    // inside the nearest area wide enough for it, else the window, so it is never cut off.
    setBoundary(scroller ? wideEnough(scroller) : null);
    if (!scroller) return;
    const trigger = triggerRef.current;
    makeRoomBelow(scroller, trigger);
    // What is above the field can still grow while the picker is open (a To do line arriving after
    // an edit, say), pushing the field down: make the room again so the picker stays below it.
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const watch = new ResizeObserver(() => makeRoomBelow(scroller, trigger));
    for (const child of Array.from(scroller.children)) watch.observe(child);
    return () => watch.disconnect();
  }, [open]);

  // After switching to a "when ..." or a formula, focus goes into it.
  const mode = isFormula(value) ? 'formula' : isSentence(value) && !sent ? 'when' : 'value';
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusInside.current) return;
    focusInside.current = false;
    wrapRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('textarea, input, button, [tabindex="0"]')?.focus();
  }, [mode]);

  // Everything the picker would offer here, to say where the chosen value comes from and whether it is filled.
  const all = useMemo(
    () => (doc ? buildOptions({ doc, env, at, scope, label, accepts: undefined, sent, query: '', showWrongKind: true }) : undefined),
    [doc, env, at, scope, label, sent],
  );
  const mine: PickOption | undefined = value ? all?.flat.find((o) => sameBase(o.expression, value)) : undefined;

  const offerWhen = !sent && (!accepts || accepts.includes('yesNo'));
  const pick = (next: AnyExpression) => {
    // Picking the same value again keeps its "If empty, use ...".
    const keep = value && isReference(value) && value.ifEmptyUse && sameBase(next, value) ? { ifEmptyUse: value.ifEmptyUse } : {};
    emit({ ...(next as object), ...keep } as AnyExpression);
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const switchTo = (next: AnyExpression) => {
    focusInside.current = true;
    emit(next);
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const backToValue = () => {
    emit(undefined);
    setOpen(true);
  };
  const clear = () => {
    emit(undefined);
    setOpen(false);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => triggerRef.current?.focus());
  };

  if (mode === 'formula') {
    return (
      <div className={s.inline} ref={wrapRef}>
        <Slot name="FormulaEditor" at={at} value={value as never} onChange={(next) => emit(next)} gives={accepts?.length ? accepts : ALL_KINDS} />
        <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={backToValue}>
          {t('values.field.formulaBack')}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (mode === 'when') {
    return (
      <div className={s.inline} ref={wrapRef}>
        <Slot name="WhenBuilder" at={at} value={value as never} onChange={(next) => emit(next)} autoFocus />
        <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={backToValue}>
          {t('values.field.whenBack')}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const phrase = doc && value ? describeExpression(doc, value, sayEnv, { short: true }) : null;
  const takesPeople = !!accepts?.length && accepts.every((k) => PEOPLE_KINDS.includes(k));
  const emptyWords = placeholder ?? (takesPeople ? t('values.field.emptyWho', { label: lowerFirst(label) }) : t('values.field.empty'));
  const current = phrase ? toText(phrase) : emptyWords;
  const kind = doc && value ? kindOfExpression(doc, value, sayEnv, kindOfValue) : undefined;
  const detail = doc && value ? detailOf(doc, value, mine, scope) : '';
  const name = current;

  const wrongKind = !!value && !!accepts?.length && !!kind && !fits(kind, accepts);
  const fallback = isReference(value) ? value.ifEmptyUse : undefined;
  const state = mine?.state;
  const showMay = !wrongKind && state === 'mayBeEmpty' && !fallback && !!mine?.valueId;
  // "If empty, use" takes what the slot takes (Who is asked: a person, a group or several people),
  // whatever kind the first value is. Only a slot that takes anything keeps to the first value's kind.
  const fallbackKinds: ValueKind[] | undefined = accepts?.length ? accepts : singleKind(kind) ? [singleKind(kind) as ValueKind] : undefined;
  const suggestion =
    showMay && allowIfEmptyUse && all
      ? suggest(all.flat, value, fallbackKinds, singleKind(kind))
      : undefined;

  const setFallback = (next: AnyExpression | undefined) => {
    if (!value || !isReference(value)) return;
    const { ifEmptyUse: _old, ...rest } = value as unknown as { ifEmptyUse?: Expression } & Record<string, unknown>;
    void _old;
    if (!next) {
      focusAfterClear.current = true;
      setFocusFallback(false);
    }
    emit((next ? { ...rest, ifEmptyUse: next } : rest) as AnyExpression);
  };

  const neverHere = !wrongKind && state === 'never' && !!mine;
  const hereId = doc ? stageIdOf(doc, at.item) : undefined;
  const hereStage = (doc && hereId ? getStage(doc, hereId)?.name : undefined) ?? '';
  const chipKindOf = (c: { id?: string }) => (c.id && c.id === (value as { value?: string }).value ? kind : c.id ? kindOfValue(c.id) : undefined);
  const faceWords = phrase ? <PhraseView phrase={phrase} kindOf={chipKindOf} /> : <span className={s.placeholder}>{current}</span>;
  // The amber dot on the chosen value when it may be empty here (mockup 04-values); the note under the field says it in words.
  const mayDot = showMay ? <span className={s.mayDot} aria-hidden="true" /> : null;

  const picker = (
    <RP.Portal>
      <RP.Content
        className={s.pop}
        side="bottom"
        align="start"
        sideOffset={6}
        collisionPadding={8}
        collisionBoundary={boundary}
        aria-label={t('values.picker.title', { label })}
        onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => {
          // A switch to a "when ..." or a formula puts focus in it instead.
          if (focusInside.current) e.preventDefault();
        }}
      >
        <ValuePicker
          at={at}
          // The picker's sentences name the slot ("Who is asked needs ..."), also for "If empty, use".
          label={sayLabel}
          accepts={accepts}
          allowTyped={allowTyped}
          sent={sent}
          onPick={pick}
          onWhen={offerWhen ? () => switchTo({ allOf: [] }) : undefined}
          onFormula={() => switchTo({ formula: '', readsAs: '' })}
          // The chip has no Clear button beside it, so its picker offers one.
          onClear={look === 'chip' && value !== undefined ? clear : undefined}
        />
      </RP.Content>
    </RP.Portal>
  );

  if (look === 'chip') {
    // In a sentence: no notes under it, so the chip says its state itself, in words and with a dot.
    const stateWords = wrongKind
      ? t('values.state.wrongKind', { kinds: kindsWithArticle(accepts ?? []), name, kind: kindWithArticle(kind) })
      : neverHere
        ? mine?.stateWords
        : state === 'mayBeEmpty' && !fallback && mine?.valueId
          ? t('values.state.mayBeEmpty')
          : undefined;
    const tone = wrongKind || neverHere ? 'red' : stateWords ? 'amber' : undefined;
    return (
      <span className={s.chipField}>
        <RP.Root open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <RP.Trigger asChild>
            <button
              ref={triggerRef}
              type="button"
              className={phrase ? s.chipTrigger : `${s.chipTrigger} ${s.chipEmpty}`}
              aria-label={stateWords ? t('values.field.nameState', { label, current, state: stateWords }) : t('values.field.name', { label, current })}
              aria-haspopup="dialog"
              aria-keyshortcuts={value !== undefined ? 'Delete Backspace' : undefined}
              title={stateWords}
              data-mark={tone}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                // Delete or Backspace on a chosen chip empties the slot, as in a message field.
                if ((e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && value !== undefined) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  emit(undefined);
                }
              }}
            >
              {phrase ? <PhraseView phrase={phrase} kindOf={chipKindOf} /> : current}
              {tone && <span className={tone === 'red' ? `${s.mayDot} ${s.redDot}` : s.mayDot} aria-hidden="true" />}
            </button>
          </RP.Trigger>
          {picker}
        </RP.Root>
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={s.fieldWrap} ref={wrapRef}>
      <RP.Root open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <div className={s.fieldRow}>
          <RP.Trigger asChild>
            <button
              ref={triggerRef}
              type="button"
              className={s.field}
              aria-label={t('values.field.name', { label, current })}
              aria-haspopup="dialog"
            >
              <span className={s.fieldMain}>
                <span className={s.faceRow}>
                  {faceWords}
                  {mayDot}
                </span>
                {detail && <span className={s.fieldDetail}>{detail}</span>}
              </span>
              <Icon name="chevron-down" className={s.chevron} />
            </button>
          </RP.Trigger>
          {value !== undefined && (
            <IconButton
              icon="close"
              size="sm"
              className={s.clear}
              label={t('values.field.clear', { label })}
              onClick={() => {
                emit(undefined);
                triggerRef.current?.focus();
              }}
            />
          )}
        </div>
        {picker}
      </RP.Root>

      {wrongKind && (
        <div className={`${s.note} ${s.red}`}>
          <Icon name="error" size={15} />
          <div className={s.noteBody}>
            {fallbackOf
              ? t('values.note.wrongKindFallback', {
                  name, value: fallbackOf.value, label: fallbackOf.label, kinds: kindsWithArticle(accepts ?? []), kind: kindWithArticle(kind),
                })
              : t('values.note.wrongKind', { label, kinds: kindsWithArticle(accepts ?? []), name, kind: kindWithArticle(kind) })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {neverHere && mine && (
        <div className={`${s.note} ${s.red}`}>
          <Icon name="error" size={15} />
          <div className={s.noteBody}>
            <span className={s.noteTitle}>{t('values.note.never', { name })}</span>
            <span>{mine.stateWords}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {showMay && doc && mine?.valueId && (
        <div className={`${s.note} ${s.amber}`}>
          <Icon name="warning" size={15} />
          <div className={s.noteBody}>
            <NoteWords phrase={mayBeEmptyPhrase(doc, findingEnv, at, mine.valueId, mine.skippedVia)} />
            <div className={s.offer} ref={offerRef}>
            {allowIfEmptyUse && suggestion && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                icon="plus"
                onClick={() => {
                  setFocusFallback(true);
                  setDone(
                    asks
                      ? t('values.ifEmpty.doneAsk', { name, stage: hereStage, fallback: suggestion.name })
                      : t('values.ifEmpty.done', { name, fallback: suggestion.name }),
                  );
                  setFallback(suggestion.expression);
                }}
              >
                {t(asks ? 'values.ifEmpty.suggestAsk' : 'values.ifEmpty.suggest', { name: suggestion.name })}
              </Button>
            )}
            {allowIfEmptyUse && !choosingFallback && (
              <button type="button" className={s.link} onClick={() => setChoosingFallback(true)}>
                {t('values.ifEmpty.choose')}
              </button>
            )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div role="status" className={done && fallback !== undefined ? `${s.note} ${s.green}` : undefined}>
        {done && fallback !== undefined && (
          <>
            <Icon name="check" size={15} />
            <span>{done}</span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {allowIfEmptyUse && isReference(value) && (fallback !== undefined || (choosingFallback && showMay)) && (
        <div className={s.fallback} role="group" aria-labelledby={fallbackLabelId}>
          <span className={s.fallbackLabel} id={fallbackLabelId}>
            {t(asks ? 'values.ifEmpty.labelAsk' : 'values.ifEmpty.label', { name: currentName(doc, value, sayEnv) })}
          </span>
          <ValueFieldInner
            at={partOf(at, 'ifEmptyUse')}
            label={t(asks ? 'values.ifEmpty.labelAsk' : 'values.ifEmpty.label', { name: currentName(doc, value, sayEnv) })}
            {...(fallbackKinds ? { accepts: fallbackKinds } : {})}
            {...(allowTyped ? { allowTyped } : {})}
            allowIfEmptyUse
            placeholder={t('values.ifEmpty.placeholder')}
            value={fallback as Expression | undefined}
            onChange={(next) => setFallback(next)}
            autoOpen={fallback === undefined && choosingFallback}
            autoFocus={focusFallback}
            fallbackOf={{ label: sayLabel, value: currentName(doc, value, sayEnv) }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {at.part === 'whoIsAsked' && doc && mine?.valueId && state === 'mayBeEmpty' && !wrongKind && isReference(value) && (
        <AskedPerRoute
          doc={doc}
          at={at}
          valueName={currentName(doc, value, sayEnv)}
          sample={typeof mine.sample === 'string' ? mine.sample : undefined}
          filledAt={scope.find((v) => v.id === mine.valueId)?.filledAt ?? []}
          skippedVia={mine.skippedVia ?? []}
          // No sample for the fallback: the sample request is not one that skips.
          fallback={fallback !== undefined ? { name: toText(describeExpression(doc, fallback, sayEnv, { short: true })), sample: undefined } : undefined}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * "Who Development asks, for each kind of request": the requests that pass where the value is
 * filled get it; the ones that skip it get the "If empty, use" value, or nobody (stuck).
 */
function AskedPerRoute({
  doc, at, valueName, sample, filledAt, skippedVia, fallback,
}: {
  doc: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useDoc>>;
  at: Location;
  valueName: string;
  sample: string | undefined;
  filledAt: readonly Location[];
  skippedVia: readonly Location[];
  fallback: { name: string; sample: string | undefined } | undefined;
}) {
  const here = stageIdOf(doc, at.item);
  const stage = here ? getStage(doc, here) : undefined;
  const fillIds = new Set(filledAt.map((l) => stageIdOf(doc, l.item)).filter((x): x is string => !!x));
  const fillNames = fillStages(doc, filledAt);
  if (!stage || !fillNames.length) return null;
  const place = andList(fillNames);
  const skipping = skippingArrow(doc, skippedVia, fillIds);
  const leftEmptyAt = !skipping ? skippedVia.map((l) => l.item).find((id) => fillIds.has(id)) : undefined;
  const otherTitle = skipping
    ? arrowLabel(doc, skipping)
    : leftEmptyAt
      ? t('values.paths.leftEmpty', { value: valueName, place: getStage(doc, leftEmptyAt)?.name ?? place })
      : t('values.paths.other', { place });
  const gets = (name: string, s: string | undefined) => (s ? t('values.paths.getsSample', { name, sample: s }) : t('values.paths.gets', { name }));
  return (
    <section className={s.paths} aria-label={t('values.paths.head', { stage: stage.name })}>
      <div className={s.pathsHead} aria-hidden>{t('values.paths.head', { stage: stage.name })}</div>
      <ul className={s.pathsList}>
        <li className={s.pathsRow}>
          <Icon name="check" size={15} className={s.pathsOk} />
          <div>
            <div className={s.pathsTitle}>{t('values.paths.through', { place })}</div>
            <div>{gets(valueName, sample)}</div>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li className={s.pathsRow}>
          <Icon name={fallback ? 'check' : 'warning'} size={15} className={fallback ? s.pathsOk : s.pathsWarn} />
          <div>
            <div className={s.pathsTitle}>{otherTitle}</div>
            <div>{fallback ? gets(fallback.name, fallback.sample) : t('values.paths.stuck', { value: valueName })}</div>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

/** The arrow on a route that goes around where the value is filled: it leaves a stage that has another arrow into a stage that fills it. */
function skippingArrow(doc: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useDoc>>, route: readonly Location[], fillIds: ReadonlySet<string>) {
  for (const l of route) {
    const entry = find(doc, l.item);
    if (entry?.kind !== 'arrow') continue;
    const from = entry.parents.stage ? getStage(doc, entry.parents.stage) : undefined;
    if (!from || from.kind === 'ending') continue;
    if (fillIds.has(String(entry.item.goTo))) continue;
    if ((from.arrows ?? []).some((a) => a.id !== entry.id && fillIds.has(String(a.goTo)))) return entry.item;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The nearest area that scrolls (the stage panel's body, say); undefined on the page itself. */
function scrollArea(el: Element): Element | null {
  for (let p = el.parentElement; p && p !== document.body && p !== document.documentElement; p = p.parentElement) {
    const { overflowY } = getComputedStyle(p);
    if (overflowY === 'auto' || overflowY === 'scroll') return p;
  }
  return null;
}

/** The picker's width (values.module.css .pop) and the collision padding on both sides. */
const PICKER_WIDTH = 420 + 2 * 8;

/** The area itself when the picker fits in it side to side, else the nearest one around it that is wide enough; null: the window. */
function wideEnough(area: Element): Element | null {
  for (let p: Element | null = area; p && p !== document.body && p !== document.documentElement; p = p.parentElement) {
    if (p.getBoundingClientRect().width >= Math.min(PICKER_WIDTH, window.innerWidth)) return p;
  }
  return null;
}

/** Room the picker wants below its field before it would rather flip above. */
const PICKER_ROOM = 480;

/** Scroll the area up so the picker fits below the field, keeping the field's label in sight. */
function makeRoomBelow(scroller: Element, trigger: Element) {
  const area = scroller.getBoundingClientRect();
  const field = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
  const below = Math.min(area.bottom, window.innerHeight) - field.bottom;
  if (below >= PICKER_ROOM) return;
  const up = Math.min(PICKER_ROOM - below, field.top - area.top - 48, scroller.scrollHeight - scroller.clientHeight - scroller.scrollTop);
  if (up > 0) scroller.scrollTop += up;
}

/** The chosen value's own name, without "(if empty, use ...)". */
function currentName(doc: ReturnType<typeof useDoc>, value: AnyExpression, env: ReturnType<typeof useDescribeEnv>): string {
  return doc ? toText(describeExpression(doc, value, env, { short: true })) : '';
}

/** "from Domain approval · for the sample: Diego Santos", "from the Domains list". */
function detailOf(
  doc: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useDoc>>,
  value: AnyExpression,
  mine: PickOption | undefined,
  scope: readonly { id: string; filledAt: Location[] }[],
): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const v = value as { value?: string; steps?: unknown[] };
  if (typeof v.value === 'string') {
    if (v.steps?.length) {
      const list = listOfValue(doc, v.value);
      const name = list ? getList(doc, list.listId)?.name : undefined;
      if (name) parts.push(t('values.field.fromList', { list: name }));
    } else {
      const filledAt = scope.find((x) => x.id === v.value)?.filledAt ?? [];
      const stages = fillStages(doc, filledAt);
      if (stages.length) parts.push(t('values.field.from', { place: andList(stages) }));
    }
  }
  if (typeof mine?.sample === 'string') parts.push(t('values.field.sample', { sample: mine.sample }));
  return parts.join(t('values.sep'));
}

/**
 * A sensible "If empty, use ...": a value that is always filled here and fits the slot, of the same
 * kind as the value first (an Eng lead stands in for an Eng lead), a list's column first.
 */
function suggest(
  options: readonly PickOption[], value: AnyExpression | undefined, kinds: readonly ValueKind[] | undefined, same: ValueKind | undefined,
): PickOption | undefined {
  const order = ['lists', 'values', 'answers', 'request'];
  const fitting = options.filter(
    (o) => o.state === 'always' && !o.disabled && fits(o.kind, kinds) && !!o.kind && !sameBase(o.expression, value) && order.includes(o.group),
  );
  const rank = (o: PickOption) => (same && singleKind(o.kind) !== same ? order.length : 0) + order.indexOf(o.group);
  return [...fitting].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b))[0];
}

/**
 * Route "/w/:workflowId/values": the Values tab (editor-model.md sections 4 and 8; mockup
 * 04-values, values-tab). Every value with its kind, where it is filled and used (each place a link
 * that shows it), the sample, rename in place, a kind clash as the red To do it is, search and
 * grouping by the stage that fills it. Below: "Lists and directory" (each list kept with the
 * workflow, opened in the list dialog; the Directory as a connection) and the sample request.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { ValueId } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeFinding, find, isRefusal, useCatalogue, useDescribeEnv, useDoc, useFacts, useFindingsFor, useRevealRequest, useRun,
} from '@/model';
import { Button, Card, Icon, IconButton, Page, Select, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { andList, kindIcon, kindTitle, singleKind } from './kinds';
import { ListDialog } from './ListDialog';
import { listPlaces } from './lists';
import { PlaceLink, placeLabels, placeWords } from './places';
import { SampleRequestCard } from './SampleRequest';
import { ValueDetail, useScopeAt } from './ValueDetail';
import { mayBeEmptyUses, scopeLocations, stagesFor } from './values-detail';
import { groupByStage, rowMatches, valueRows, type ValueRow } from './values-tab';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

/** The reveal request last handled, so coming back to the tab does not show it again. */
let handledReveal = 0;

export function ValuesPage() {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const facts = useFacts();
  const request = useRevealRequest();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [grouped, setGrouped] = useState(false);
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openList, setOpenList] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const listOpener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  const rows = useMemo(() => (doc ? valueRows(doc, facts, env) : []), [doc, facts, env]);
  const shown = rows.filter((r) => rowMatches(r, query));
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const chosenRow = rows.find((r) => r.id === chosen);
  // Where each value may be empty: asked once at each stage and at each place that uses a value.
  const locations = useMemo(() => (doc ? scopeLocations(doc, rows.map((r) => ({ filled: r.filled, used: r.used, ifEmptyUse: [] }))) : []), [doc, rows]);
  const scopeAt = useScopeAt(locations);
  const mayNotes = useMemo(() => {
    const out = new Map<string, string>();
    if (!doc || !scopeAt) return out;
    for (const r of rows) {
      const { stages, withoutIfEmpty: m } = mayBeEmptyUses(stagesFor(doc, r.id, { filled: r.filled, used: r.used, ifEmptyUse: [] }, scopeAt));
      if (!stages) continue;
      const one = stages === 1;
      out.set(
        r.id,
        m === 0
          ? t(one ? 'values.tab.mayAllOne' : 'values.tab.mayAll', { n: stages })
          : m === 1
            ? t(one ? 'values.tab.maySomeUseOne' : 'values.tab.maySomeUse', { n: stages })
            : t(one ? 'values.tab.maySomeOne' : 'values.tab.maySome', { n: stages, m }),
      );
    }
    return out;
  }, [doc, rows, scopeAt]);

  // "Show me" on a value, a list, a column or a row brings the author here: show it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!doc || !request || request.nonce === handledReveal) return;
    const nonce = request.nonce;
    const entry = find(doc, request.location.item);
    if (!entry) return;
    const listId = entry.kind === 'list' ? entry.id : entry.kind === 'column' || entry.kind === 'row' ? entry.parents.list : undefined;
    // After this render: clear the search so the row is there, then scroll to it and flash it.
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      handledReveal = nonce;
      if (entry.kind === 'value') {
        setQuery('');
        setFlash(entry.id);
        setChosen(entry.id);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const el = document.getElementById(`value-${entry.id}`);
          el?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'center' });
          el?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        });
      } else if (listId) setOpenList(listId);
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [doc, request]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!flash) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 1600);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [flash]);

  if (!doc) return null;
  const groups = grouped ? groupByStage(doc, shown) : [{ stageId: 'all', title: t('values.tab.allHead'), rows: shown }];

  return (
    // The table and the chosen value's details side by side take the page's whole width (mockup
    // 04-values, values-tab), so "Choice from a list" and the longer names fit.
    <div className={s.fullWidth}>
    <Page title={t('word.values')} lead={<strong>{t('values.intro')}</strong>}>
      <div className={s.top}>
        <p className={s.explain}>{t('values.tab.explain')}</p>
        <div className={s.tools}>
          <label className={s.searchBox}>
            <Icon name="search" size={16} />
            <TextInput
              type="search"
              aria-label={t('values.tab.search')}
              placeholder={t('values.tab.search')}
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className={s.showLabel}>
            <span>{t('values.tab.showLabel')}</span>
            <Select
              value={grouped ? 'stage' : 'all'}
              onChange={(e) => setGrouped(e.target.value === 'stage')}
              options={[
                { value: 'all', label: t('values.tab.showAll') },
                { value: 'stage', label: t('values.tab.showByStage') },
              ]}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className={s.srOnly} role="status">
        {query ? (shown.length === 1 ? t('values.tab.countOne') : t('values.tab.count', { n: shown.length })) : ''}
      </p>

      <div className={s.split}>
      <Card flush>
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={s.emptyLine}>{t('values.tab.none')}</p>
        ) : shown.length === 0 ? (
          <p className={s.emptyLine}>{t('values.tab.noMatch', { query })}</p>
        ) : (
          <table className={s.table} aria-label={t('values.tab.tableLabel')}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">{t('values.tab.col.value')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('values.tab.col.kind')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('values.tab.col.filled')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('values.tab.col.used')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('values.tab.col.sample')}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            {groups.map((g) => (
              <tbody key={g.stageId}>
                <tr className={s.groupRow}>
                  <th scope="colgroup" colSpan={5}>
                    {g.title}
                    {!grouped && <span className={s.quiet}> {t('values.tab.allSub')}</span>}
                  </th>
                </tr>
                {g.rows.map((row) => (
                  <ValueRowView
                    key={row.id}
                    row={row}
                    flash={flash === row.id}
                    chosen={chosen === row.id}
                    mayNote={mayNotes.get(row.id)}
                    onChoose={() => setChosen(row.id)}
                  />
                ))}
              </tbody>
            ))}
          </table>
        )}
      </Card>
      <span id="values-detail-hint" hidden>
        {t('values.tab.detailsHint')}
      </span>
      <aside id="values-detail" className={s.side} aria-label={chosenRow ? t('values.tab.details', { name: chosenRow.name || t('describe.noName') }) : t('values.detail.label')}>
        {chosenRow ? (
          <ValueDetail key={chosenRow.id} row={chosenRow} scopeAt={scopeAt} />
        ) : (
          <p className={s.sideNone}>
            <Icon name="info" size={16} />
            {t('values.detail.none')}
          </p>
        )}
      </aside>
      </div>

      <ListsCard
        onOpen={(listId, opener) => {
          listOpener.current = opener;
          setOpenList(listId);
        }}
      />
      <SampleRequestCard />

      {openList && (
        <ListDialog
          listId={openList}
          open
          onOpenChange={(next) => {
            if (next) return;
            setOpenList(null);
            requestAnimationFrame(() => listOpener.current?.focus());
          }}
        />
      )}
    </Page>
    </div>
  );
}

/** How many places a cell lists before "Show N more". */
const FEW = 3;

function ValueRowView({
  row, flash, chosen, mayNote, onChoose,
}: { row: ValueRow; flash: boolean; chosen: boolean; mayNote: string | undefined; onChoose(): void }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const [allUsed, setAllUsed] = useState(false);
  if (!doc) return null;
  const kind = singleKind(row.kind);
  const used = allUsed ? row.used : row.used.slice(0, FEW);
  const name = row.name || t('describe.noName');
  const filledLabels = placeLabels(row.filled, name, 'fills');
  const usedLabels = placeLabels(row.used, name, 'uses');
  return (
    <>
      <tr
        id={`value-${row.id}`}
        tabIndex={-1}
        className={[s.row, flash ? s.flash : '', row.conflict ? s.conflicted : '', chosen ? s.chosen : ''].join(' ')}
        // A click anywhere on the row that is not on one of its own controls shows the value beside the table.
        onClick={(e) => {
          if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button, a, input, select, textarea, form')) return;
          onChoose();
        }}
      >
        <th scope="row" className={s.nameCell}>
          <NameCell row={row} chosen={chosen} onChoose={onChoose} />
        </th>
        <td>
          {row.conflict ? (
            <span className={s.redTodo}>
              <Icon name="error" size={14} />
              <strong>{t('mark.todo')}</strong> {kindTitle(row.kind)}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className={s.kind}>
              <Icon name={kindIcon(kind)} size={14} />
              {kindTitle(row.kind)}
            </span>
          )}
          {row.choices && <span className={s.plain}> {row.choices}</span>}
        </td>
        <td>
          {row.filled.length === 0 ? (
            <span className={s.plain}>{t('values.card.filledNowhere')}</span>
          ) : (
            <ul className={s.placeList}>
              {row.filled.map((line, i) => (
                <li key={i}>
                  <PlaceLink doc={doc} line={line} label={filledLabels[i]} />
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          {row.laterWins.map((words, i) => (
            <p key={i} className={s.note}>
              {words}
            </p>
          ))}
        </td>
        <td>
          {row.used.length === 0 ? (
            <span className={s.plain}>{t('values.card.usedNowhere')}</span>
          ) : (
            <>
              <strong className={s.count}>
                {row.used.length === 1 ? t('values.tab.usedInOne') : t('values.tab.usedIn', { n: row.used.length })}
              </strong>
              <ul className={s.placeList}>
                {used.map((line, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>
                    <PlaceLink doc={doc} line={line} label={usedLabels[i]} />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>

              {row.used.length > FEW && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={s.link}
                  aria-expanded={allUsed}
                  aria-label={allUsed ? undefined : t('values.tab.morePlaces', { n: row.used.length - FEW, name: row.name })}
                  onClick={() => setAllUsed(!allUsed)}
                >
                  {allUsed ? t('values.tab.fewerPlaces') : t('values.tab.morePlacesShort', { n: row.used.length - FEW })}
                </button>
              )}
              {mayNote && (
                <p className={s.mayNote}>
                  <span className={s.mayDot} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {mayNote}
                </p>
              )}            </>
          )}
        </td>
        <td>{row.sample ? <span className={s.sample}>{row.sample}</span> : <span className={s.quiet}>{t('values.tab.noSample')}</span>}</td>
      </tr>
      {row.conflict && <ConflictRow row={row} />}
    </>
  );
}

/** A value filled with two kinds: the red To do it is, with the places each kind comes from. */
function ConflictRow({ row }: { row: ValueRow }) {
  const doc = useDoc();
  const env = useDescribeEnv();
  const findings = useFindingsFor(row.id);
  if (!doc || !row.conflict) return null;
  const finding = findings.find((f) => f.code === 'value.kindConflict');
  const words = finding ? describeFinding(doc, finding, env) : undefined;
  return (
    <tr className={s.conflictRow}>
      <td colSpan={5}>
        <div className={s.conflictBox}>
          <Icon name="error" size={16} />
          <div>
            <p>
              <strong>{t('values.tab.markLead', { mark: t('mark.todo') })}</strong>
              {words
                ? words.effect
                  ? t('values.tab.causeEffect', { cause: words.cause, effect: words.effect })
                  : words.cause
                : kindTitle(row.kind)}
            </p>
            <p className={s.conflictHead}>{t('values.tab.conflictPlaces')}</p>
            <ul className={s.placeList}>
              {row.conflict.map((c, i) => {
                const line = row.filled.find((l) => l.location.item === c.at.item) ?? { location: c.at, stage: '', what: '' };
                return (
                  <li key={i} className={s.conflictPlace}>
                    <span className={s.kind}>
                      <Icon name={kindIcon(c.kind)} size={14} />
                      {kindTitle(c.kind)}
                    </span>
                    <PlaceLink
                      doc={doc}
                      line={line.stage || line.what ? line : { ...line, stage: kindTitle(c.kind) }}
                      label={t('values.tab.showFills', { place: placeWords(line.stage || line.what ? line : { ...line, stage: kindTitle(c.kind) }), name: row.name })}
                    />
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}

function NameCell({ row, chosen, onChoose }: { row: ValueRow; chosen: boolean; onChoose(): void }) {
  const run = useRun();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(row.name);
  const renameRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const back = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing || !back.current) return;
    back.current = false;
    renameRef.current?.focus();
  }, [editing]);
  const stop = () => {
    back.current = true;
    setEditing(false);
  };
  const kind = singleKind(row.kind);
  const name = row.name || t('describe.noName');

  if (editing) {
    const save = (e: FormEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const next = text.trim();
      if (next && next !== row.name) run('value.rename', { value: row.id as ValueId, name: next });
      stop();
    };
    return (
      <form className={s.renameForm} onSubmit={save}>
        <TextInput
          aria-label={t('values.card.renameLabel', { name })}
          value={text}
          autoFocus
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
              e.preventDefault();
              stop();
            }
          }}
        />
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" type="submit">
          {t('values.card.renameSave')}
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="quiet" onClick={stop}>
          {t('values.card.renameCancel')}
        </Button>
      </form>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={s.name}>
      <span className={row.conflict ? `${s.nameIcon} ${s.nameIconRed}` : s.nameIcon} aria-hidden="true">
        <Icon name={row.conflict ? 'error' : kindIcon(kind)} size={14} />
      </span>
      <span className={s.nameText}>
        <span className={s.nameLine}>
          {/* The name opens the value's details beside the table (by keyboard too). */}
          <button
            type="button"
            className={s.nameButton}
            aria-pressed={chosen}
            aria-controls="values-detail"
            aria-describedby="values-detail-hint"
            onClick={onChoose}
          >
            {name}
          </button>
          <IconButton
            ref={renameRef}
            icon="edit"
            size="sm"
            label={t('values.tab.rename', { name })}
            onClick={() => {
              setText(row.name);
              setEditing(true);
            }}
          />
        </span>
        {row.sameName.map((o) => (
          <span key={o.id} className={s.note}>
            {o.filledAt ? t('values.tab.sameName', { name, place: o.filledAt }) : t('values.tab.sameNameNowhere', { name })}
          </span>
        ))}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Drawing describe's phrases (src/model/describe): text and chips. A value chip carries its kind's
 * icon; what another system sent is dashed, in its own tint, with the connection mark ("Ticket:
 * Title"); a person or group is round; something unfinished or removed is amber and dashed, never
 * marked by colour alone (its words say "(deleted)" or "…").
 */
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { canOpenSettings, isChip, isSettingsLink, openSettings, toText, type Chip, type Phrase } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui';
import { kindIcon, singleKind, type ScopeKind } from './kinds';
import s from './values.module.css';

/** The class names and icon of a chip, also used by the message field's hand-made chips. */
export function chipLook(chip: Pick<Chip, 'chip' | 'missing'>, kind?: ScopeKind): { className: string; icon?: IconName } {
  const classes = [s.chip];
  let icon: IconName | undefined;
  switch (chip.chip) {
    case 'value':
      icon = kindIcon(singleKind(kind));
      break;
    case 'sent':
      classes.push(s.sent);
      icon = 'connected';
      break;
    case 'person':
      classes.push(s.person);
      icon = 'person';
      break;
    case 'group':
      classes.push(s.group);
      icon = 'group';
      break;
    default:
      classes.push(s.constant);
      if (kind) icon = kindIcon(singleKind(kind));
  }
  if (chip.missing) classes.push(s.missing);
  return { className: classes.filter(Boolean).join(' '), ...(icon ? { icon } : {}) };
}

export function ChipView({ chip, kind }: { chip: Chip; kind?: ScopeKind }) {
  const look = chipLook(chip, kind);
  return (
    <span className={look.className}>
      {look.icon && <Icon name={look.icon} size={13} />}
      <span className={s.chipLabel}>{chip.label}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

/** The kind of a chip that names something every request has ("Requester", "Started on"); describe gives them the ids `request.*`. */
export function requestChipKind(chip: Pick<Chip, 'id'>): ScopeKind {
  if (chip.id === 'request.requester') return 'person';
  if (chip.id === 'request.startedOn') return 'date';
  return undefined;
}

/** A phrase as text and chips. `kindOf` gives a value chip's kind (by the chip's id). */
export function PhraseView({ phrase, kindOf }: { phrase: Phrase; kindOf?: (chip: Chip) => ScopeKind }): ReactNode {
  return (
    <span className={s.phrase}>
      {phrase.map((part, i) => {
        if (typeof part === 'string') return <span key={i}>{part}</span>;
        if (isSettingsLink(part)) return <SettingsWord key={i} text={part.text} />;
        if (isChip(part)) return <ChipView key={i} chip={part} kind={kindOf?.(part) ?? requestChipKind(part)} />;
        return <span key={i}>{part.text}</span>;
      })}
    </span>
  );
}

/** "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)": a link that opens Settings, or the word where none can open. */
function SettingsWord({ text }: { text: string }) {
  if (!canOpenSettings()) return <span>{text}</span>;
  return (
    <button type="button" className={s.inlineLink} aria-label={t('values.settingsLink', { settings: text })} onClick={() => openSettings()}>
      {text}
    </button>
  );
}

/** A sentence in a note: plain words, names as words (no chips), and the Settings link. */
export function NoteWords({ phrase }: { phrase: Phrase }): ReactNode {
  return (
    <span>
      {phrase.map((part, i) => (isSettingsLink(part) ? <SettingsWord key={i} text={part.text} /> : <span key={i}>{toText([part])}</span>))}
    </span>
  );

/**
 * The Directory, as the picker uses it: searching people and groups while the author types, and a
 * person's name for a sample. Through the open workflow's services (`sessionServices()`), so a slot
 * works without a ServicesProvider above it.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import type { CatalogueDirectoryRef, DirectoryEntry } from '@/contract';
import { sessionServices } from '@/model';
import type { DirectoryAnswer } from './options';

/** How long the author may pause between letters before the Directory is asked. */
export const SEARCH_QUIET_MS = 150;

type Found = { key: string; answer: DirectoryEntry[] | 'failed' };

/**
 * People and groups matching `query`, of the given types. `undefined` while not asked (no types or
 * no text), 'looking' until the answer for this very text is in.
 */
export function useDirectorySearch(query: string, types: readonly ('user' | 'group')[]): DirectoryAnswer {
  const text = query.trim();
  const typeList = types.join(',');
  const key = typeList && text ? `${typeList}:${text}` : '';
  const [found, setFound] = useState<Found | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!key) return;
    let live = true;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const directory = sessionServices()?.directory;
      if (!directory) {
        if (live) setFound({ key, answer: 'failed' });
        return;
      }
      directory.search(text, typeList.split(',') as ('user' | 'group')[]).then(
        (answer) => {
          if (live) setFound({ key, answer });
        },
        () => {
          if (live) setFound({ key, answer: 'failed' });
        },
      );
    }, SEARCH_QUIET_MS);
    return () => {
      live = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [key, text, typeList]);
  if (!key) return undefined;
  return found?.key === key ? found.answer : 'looking';
}

// ── Names of people and groups, asked once per page ───────────────────────────────────────────

const names = new Map<string, string | null>();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
const subscribe = (fn: () => void) => {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => listeners.delete(fn);
};
const keyOf = (ref: CatalogueDirectoryRef) => `${ref.type}:${ref.id}`;

function ask(ref: CatalogueDirectoryRef) {
  const key = keyOf(ref);
  if (names.has(key)) return;
  const directory = sessionServices()?.directory;
  if (!directory) return;
  names.set(key, null);
  directory.lookup([ref]).then(
    (found) => {
      names.set(key, found[0]?.label ?? null);
      listeners.forEach((fn) => fn());
    },
    () => undefined,
  );
}

/** The display name of a person or group from the Directory; undefined until known. */
export function useDirectoryName(ref: CatalogueDirectoryRef | undefined): string | undefined {
  const key = ref ? keyOf(ref) : '';
  const name = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => (key ? names.get(key) ?? undefined : undefined));
  const type = ref?.type;
  const id = ref?.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (type && id) ask({ type, id });
  }, [type, id]);
  return name;
}

/** The display names of several people or groups, in order; an entry is undefined until known. */
export function useDirectoryNames(refs: readonly CatalogueDirectoryRef[]): (string | undefined)[] {
  const keys = refs.map(keyOf).join('|');
  // A string snapshot, so the store's answer is stable between renders.
  const said = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => refs.map((r) => names.get(keyOf(r)) ?? '').join('\u0000'));
  useEffect(() => {
    for (const r of refs) ask({ type: r.type, id: r.id });
    // `keys` stands for `refs`.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [keys]);
  return useMemo(() => (keys ? said.split('\u0000').map((n) => n || undefined) : []), [keys, said]);
}===\nfrontend/src/features/values/index.tsx\n===

/**
 * Kinds of value, as the picker and the chips need them: the icon for a kind, its words, and
 * whether a value of one kind can stand in a slot that accepts others.
 */
import type { ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import type { IconName } from '@/ui';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';

/** What `ValueInScope.kind` or `ValueFacts.kind` may hold. */
export type ScopeKind = ValueKind | { conflict: readonly (ValueKind | { kind: ValueKind })[] } | undefined;

export const ALL_KINDS: ValueKind[] = [
  'text', 'longText', 'number', 'yesNo', 'date', 'choice', 'multipleChoice', 'person', 'group',
  'choiceFromList', 'choiceFromConnection', 'people', 'list', 'fieldGroup',
];

const ICON: Record<ValueKind, IconName> = {
  text: 'text',
  longText: 'longtext',
  number: 'number',
  yesNo: 'yesno',
  date: 'date',
  choice: 'choice',
  multipleChoice: 'multichoice',
  person: 'person',
  group: 'group',
  choiceFromList: 'choice',
  choiceFromConnection: 'choice',
  people: 'group',
  list: 'longtext',
  fieldGroup: 'form',
};

export const isKind = (k: unknown): k is ValueKind => typeof k === 'string' && (ALL_KINDS as string[]).includes(k);

/** The kinds a scope kind stands for: one, the conflicting ones, or none when not known yet. */
export function kindsOf(kind: ScopeKind): ValueKind[] {
  if (!kind) return [];
  if (typeof kind === 'string') return [kind];
  return kind.conflict.map((k) => (typeof k === 'string' ? k : k.kind));
}

/** The single kind, or undefined when it is not known or conflicting. */
export const singleKind = (kind: ScopeKind): ValueKind | undefined => (typeof kind === 'string' ? kind : undefined);

export const kindIcon = (kind: ValueKind | undefined): IconName => (kind ? ICON[kind] : 'text');

const word = (prefix: 'values.kind' | 'values.kindA' | 'values.kindPlural', kind: string) => t(`${prefix}.${kind}` as WordKey);

/** "Person", "Choice from a list". */
export function kindTitle(kind: ScopeKind): string {
  if (!kind) return t('values.kind.unknown');
  if (typeof kind !== 'string') return t('values.kind.conflict');
  return word('values.kind', kind);
}

/** "a person", "text", "filled with two kinds". */
export function kindWithArticle(kind: ScopeKind): string {
  if (!kind) return t('values.kindA.unknown');
  if (typeof kind !== 'string') return t('values.kindA.conflict');
  return word('values.kindA', kind);
}

function orList(items: string[]): string {
  if (items.length <= 1) return items[0] ?? '';
  return t('values.or', { a: items.slice(0, -1).join(t('values.comma')), b: items[items.length - 1] ?? '' });
}

/** Names said as a list: "Domain approval", "Domain approval and Development", "A, B and C". */
export function andList(items: readonly string[]): string {
  if (items.length <= 1) return items[0] ?? '';
  return t('values.and', { a: items.slice(0, -1).join(t('values.comma')), b: items[items.length - 1] ?? '' });
}

/** "a person or a group". */
export const kindsWithArticle = (kinds: readonly ValueKind[]) => orList(kinds.map((k) => word('values.kindA', k)));
/** "people or groups". */
export const kindsPlural = (kinds: readonly ValueKind[]) => orList([...new Set(kinds.map((k) => word('values.kindPlural', k)))]);

/** Kinds that read the same where a slot asks for another: text and long text, a choice and a choice from a list or connection. */
const STANDS_IN: Partial<Record<ValueKind, ValueKind[]>> = {
  text: ['longText'],
  longText: ['text'],
  choice: ['choiceFromList', 'choiceFromConnection'],
};

/** True when a value of `kind` fits a slot that accepts `accepts` (absent: any). An unknown kind fits: the check decides later. */
export function fits(kind: ScopeKind, accepts: readonly ValueKind[] | undefined): boolean {
  if (!accepts || accepts.length === 0) return true;
  const kinds = kindsOf(kind);
  if (kinds.length === 0) return true;
  return kinds.some((k) => accepts.includes(k) || accepts.some((a) => STANDS_IN[a]?.includes(k)));
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/lists.ts\n===
/**
 * Lists kept with the workflow (the Domains list), as the Values tab and the list dialog say them:
 * where a list is used, which choice questions take their choices from it, a row's name, and what
 * removing a row means. Pure.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Column, List, Location, Question, Row } from '@/contract';
import {
  allReferences, describeConstant, find, getStage, locationCrumbs, toText, type DescribeEnv, type ValueCardLine,
} from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { andList } from './kinds';
import { stageIdOf } from './options';

/** A place that refers to the list, its columns or its rows from outside the list (as the model's `listUsedIn`). */
function placesUsing(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, list: List): Location[] {
  const own = new Set<string>([list.id, ...list.columns.map((c) => c.id), ...list.rows.map((r) => r.id)]);
  const ownRows = new Set<string>(list.rows.map((r) => r.id));
  const seen = new Map<string, Location>();
  for (const ref of allReferences(doc)) {
    if (!own.has(ref.target) || ownRows.has(ref.owner.id) || ref.how === 'sampleAnswer') continue;
    // The sample request's answers are not a use of the list.
    if (ref.location.part?.startsWith('sampleRequest')) continue;
    const key = `${ref.location.item}|${ref.location.part ?? ''}`;
    if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, ref.location);
  }
  return [...seen.values()];
}

/** One line per place, like the value card: the stage, and what it is there. One line per item. */
export function listPlaces(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, list: List, env: DescribeEnv = {}): ValueCardLine[] {
  const byItem = new Map<string, ValueCardLine>();
  for (const location of placesUsing(doc, list)) {
    if (byItem.has(location.item)) continue;
    const stageId = stageIdOf(doc, location.item);
    const stage = stageId ? getStage(doc, stageId)?.name ?? '' : '';
    const crumbs = locationCrumbs(doc, location, env);
    const rest = crumbs[0] === stage ? crumbs.slice(1) : crumbs;
    byItem.set(location.item, { location, stage, what: rest.join(t('describe.where.separator')) });
  }
  return [...byItem.values()];
}

/** The places said briefly, one entry per stage: "Request form (the arrow "Domain needs no approval" and Primary domain)". */
export function listPlacesByStage(lines: readonly ValueCardLine[]): string[] {
  const byStage = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const line of lines) {
    const crumbs = line.what.split(t('describe.where.separator'));
    // "Then go to" is a heading of the panel, not a thing: an arrow is named by its own name.
    const first = crumbs[0] === t('describe.part.arrows')
      ? crumbs[1] ? t('values.list.placeArrow', { arrow: crumbs[1] }) : ''
      : crumbs[0] ?? '';
    const whats = byStage.get(line.stage) ?? [];
    if (first && !whats.includes(first)) whats.push(first);
    byStage.set(line.stage, whats);
  }
  return [...byStage].map(([stage, whats]) =>
    stage && whats.length ? t('values.list.place', { stage, what: andList(whats) }) : stage || andList(whats),
  );
}

export interface ChoiceUse {
  question: Question;
  stage: string;
  /** The column people see, if one is chosen. */
  shown?: Column;
}

/** The choice questions whose choices are the rows of this list. */
export function choiceQuestionsOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, list: List): ChoiceUse[] {
  const out: ChoiceUse[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) {
      for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
        for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
          const q = item as Question;
          if (find(doc, q.id)?.kind !== 'question') continue;
          const c = q.choices;
          if (c?.from !== 'list' || c.list !== list.id) continue;
          const shown = c.shownColumn ? list.columns.find((col) => col.id === c.shownColumn) : undefined;
          out.push({ question: q, stage: stage.name, ...(shown ? { shown } : {}) });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** What a row is called: its first column's cell ("Payments"), else "Row 2". */
export function rowName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, list: List, row: Row): string {
  const first = list.columns[0];
  const cell = first ? row.cells?.[first.id] : undefined;
  const said = cell ? toText(describeConstant(doc, cell)).trim() : '';
  return said || t('values.list.rowN', { n: list.rows.indexOf(row) + 1 });
}

/** The places in this draft that name the row itself (a "when ..." comparing to it), not its sample answer. */
export function rowNamedIn(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, list: List, row: Row): number {
  const ownRows = new Set<string>(list.rows.map((r) => r.id));
  const items = new Set<string>();
  for (const ref of allReferences(doc)) {
    if (ref.target !== row.id || ref.how === 'sampleAnswer' || ownRows.has(ref.owner.id)) continue;
    if (ref.location.part?.startsWith('sampleRequest')) continue;
    items.add(ref.location.item);
  }
  return items.size;
}

/** True when the sample request's answer for some value is this row. */
export function sampleHoldsRow(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, row: Row): boolean {
  return Object.values(doc.sampleRequest?.answers ?? {}).some((a) => !!a && 'row' in a && a.row === row.id);
}

export const COLUMN_KINDS: Column['kind'][] = ['text', 'number', 'yesNo', 'date', 'person', 'group'];

/**
 * The sentences under a chosen value and in the picker's amber notes. "May be empty here" is said
 * by describeFinding (src/model/describe), the same words the To do drawer uses, so the picker and
 * the drawer never word one fact two ways.
 */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import { describeFinding, useSettings, type FindingEnv, type Phrase, type StuckPerson } from '@/model';
import type { Finding } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { useDirectoryNames } from './directory';

function said(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, env: FindingEnv, at: Location, valueId: string, skippedVia: readonly Location[] | undefined) {
  const finding = {
    code: 'value.mayBeEmpty',
    severity: 'worthKnowing',
    location: at,
    params: { value: { item: valueId }, skippedVia: [...(skippedVia ?? [])] },
  } as Finding;
  return describeFinding(doc, finding, env);
}

/** "Eng lead may be empty here: requests that take the arrow ... skip ..." and, with `effect`, what that causes there. */
export function mayBeEmptyWords(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  env: FindingEnv,
  at: Location,
  valueId: string,
  skippedVia: readonly Location[] | undefined,
  effect: boolean,
): string {
  const words = said(doc, env, at, valueId, skippedVia);
  return effect && words.effect ? t('values.sentences', { first: words.cause, then: words.effect }) : words.cause;
}

/**
 * The same with what it causes, as a phrase: "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)" is the
 * link part, so the note can draw it as a link.
 */
export function mayBeEmptyPhrase(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  env: FindingEnv,
  at: Location,
  valueId: string,
  skippedVia: readonly Location[] | undefined,
): Phrase {
  const words = said(doc, env, at, valueId, skippedVia);
  return words.effectParts ? [...words.causeParts, t('values.sentenceGap'), ...words.effectParts] : words.causeParts;
}

/**
 * Everyone stuck requests go to (the authors when it is not set), a group marked as one, for
 * "Platform team, who look after stuck requests, are told". Names not known yet are left out.
 */
export function useStuckPeople(): readonly StuckPerson[] {
  const settings = useSettings();
  const refs = settings?.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : (settings?.authors ?? []);
  const names = useDirectoryNames(refs);
  const key = refs.map((r, i) => `${r.type}:${names[i] ?? ''}`).join('|');
  return useMemo(
    () => refs.flatMap((r, i) => {
      const name = names[i];
      return name ? [{ name, ...(r.type === 'group' ? { group: true } : {}) }] : [];
    }),
    // `key` stands for the refs and their names.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [key],
  );
}
