===\nfrontend/src/features/values/options.ts\n===
/**
 * What the value picker offers at one place (editor-model.md section 4), as plain data: the groups
 * "This stage's answers", "Values", "Lists and directory" (steps into a list's columns, and people
 * and groups from the Directory), "Request" (Requester, Started on), typed-in constants, and, inside
 * a "Starts when", what the other system sends. Each option knows its kind, where it comes from, its
 * sample, whether it is filled here (always / may be empty / never), and why it cannot be picked.
 * Pure: the picker renders it, the tests read it.
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, CatalogueDirectoryRef, CatalogueRef, Constant, DirectoryEntry, Expression, Field,
  Location, Question, SentExpression, Step, ValueId, ValueKind,
} from '@/contract';
import {
  describeConstant, describeExpression, fillSites, find, formatDate, getList, getQuestion, getStage, laterAnswersAt, PRESET_WORDS, toText,
  type DescribeEnv,
} from '@/model';
import type { Json, ValueInScope } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { andList, fits, kindsOf, kindsWithArticle, kindWithArticle, singleKind, type ScopeKind } from './kinds';

export type GroupId = 'answers' | 'values' | 'lists' | 'request' | 'sent' | 'typed';
export type FillState = 'always' | 'mayBeEmpty' | 'never';

/** A sample: words, or a person in the Directory whose name must be looked up. */
export type Sample = string | { ref: CatalogueDirectoryRef };

export interface PickOption {
  /** Unique within one picker; safe in a DOM id. */
  id: string;
  group: GroupId;
  /** What is stored when it is picked. */
  expression: Expression | SentExpression;
  /** As the chip reads ("Primary domain's approvers", "Ticket: Title", "Diego Santos"). */
  name: string;
  kind: ScopeKind;
  /** Where it comes from: the stage, the list, "Directory". */
  from?: string;
  sample?: Sample;
  state: FillState;
  /** The words for the state in the detail line ("always filled here", "Never filled here: ..."). */
  stateWords?: string;
  /** Why it is always filled, shown on hover. */
  why?: string;
  /** Set when it cannot be picked here: the reason, in words. */
  disabled?: string;
  wrongKind: boolean;
  /** The value it reads, for the may-be-empty words. */
  valueId?: string;
  skippedVia?: Location[];
}

export interface PickGroup {
  id: GroupId;
  title: string;
  sub?: string;
  options: PickOption[];
}

/** The Directory's answer for the search text: entries, still looking, or could not be reached. */
export type DirectoryAnswer = DirectoryEntry[] | 'looking' | 'failed' | undefined;

export interface PickInput {
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  env: DescribeEnv;
  at: Location;
  /** `useValuesInScope(at).values`. */
  scope: readonly ValueInScope[];
  /** The slot's accessible name, for "Who is asked needs a person or a group ...". */
  label: string;
  accepts?: readonly ValueKind[] | undefined;
  allowTyped?: boolean | undefined;
  sent?: CatalogueRef | undefined;
  query: string;
  directory?: DirectoryAnswer;
  /** Show the values of the wrong kind (greyed) instead of only counting them. */
  showWrongKind?: boolean;
}

export interface PickResult {
  groups: PickGroup[];
  /** The options of the wrong kind left out (they are shown when `showWrongKind`). */
  hidden: number;
  /** The words for the hidden ones, when there are any. */
  hiddenWords?: string;
  /** A line under the Directory: a hint, "Looking ...", nobody found, or not reachable. */
  directoryNote?: string;
  /** Offer the small date editor (a typed date is accepted here). */
  offerDate: boolean;
  /** Every option in the order shown, for the arrow keys. */
  flat: PickOption[];
}

const has = <K extends string>(o: object, k: K): o is Record<K, unknown> => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, k);

/** The stage a located item sits in (a stage is its own; a "Starts when" is in the start stage). */
export function stageIdOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return undefined;
  if (entry.kind === 'stage') return entry.id;
  if (entry.kind === 'startsWhen') return doc.start?.stage ?? undefined;
  return entry.parents.stage;
}

const stageName = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined) => (id ? getStage(doc, id)?.name || undefined : undefined);

/** The names of the stages where a value is filled, in order, without repeats. */
export function fillStages(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, filledAt: readonly Location[]): string[] {
  const ids = [...new Set(filledAt.map((l) => stageIdOf(doc, l.item)).filter((s): s is string => !!s))];
  return ids.map((id) => stageName(doc, id)).filter((n): n is string => !!n);
}

/** The list a value's choices come from, and the column its choices show (a choice question answered from a list). */
export function listOfValue(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string): { listId: string; shown?: string } | undefined {
  for (const site of fillSites(doc, valueId)) {
    const q = getQuestion(doc, site.owner.id);
    if (q?.choices?.from === 'list' && q.choices.list) {
      return { listId: q.choices.list, ...(q.choices.shownColumn ? { shown: q.choices.shownColumn } : {}) };
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The sample request's value for an expression, in words; undefined when it has none. */
export function sampleOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expression: Expression | SentExpression | undefined): string | undefined {
  const sample = doc.sampleRequest;
  if (!sample || !expression || typeof expression !== 'object' || Array.isArray(expression)) return undefined;
  if (has(expression, 'request')) {
    if (expression.request === 'requester') return sample.requester?.name || undefined;
    if (expression.request === 'startedOn') return sample.startedOn ? formatDate(sample.startedOn) : undefined;
    return undefined;
  }
  if (has(expression, 'value') && typeof expression.value === 'string') {
    let c: Constant | undefined = sample.answers?.[expression.value as ValueId];
    for (const step of ((expression as { steps?: Step[] }).steps ?? [])) {
      if (!c) return undefined;
      if (has(step, 'column') && has(c, 'row')) {
        const row = find(doc, String(c.row));
        c = row?.kind === 'row' ? row.item.cells?.[step.column] : undefined;
      } else return undefined;
    }
    return c ? toText(describeConstant(doc, c)) || undefined : undefined;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * The start-form question a "Starts when" slot fills (`answers.<question>` of a binding), with the
 * kind of value it takes; undefined anywhere else.
 */
export function sentQuestionOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, at: Location): { question: Question; kind: ValueKind } | undefined {
  if (find(doc, at.item)?.kind !== 'startsWhen') return undefined;
  const m = /^answers\.([^.]+)$/.exec(at.part ?? '');
  const question = m?.[1] ? getQuestion(doc, m[1]) : undefined;
  if (!question) return undefined;
  const kind: ValueKind =
    question.kind === 'choice' && question.choices?.from === 'list'
      ? 'choiceFromList'
      : question.kind === 'choice' && question.choices?.from === 'source'
        ? 'choiceFromConnection'
        : question.kind;
  return { question, kind };
}

/** A sent field's sample, from the catalogue's sample event; a choice by its label ("High", not "high"). */
function sentSample(value: Json | undefined, field?: Field): Sample | undefined {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return undefined;
  if (typeof value === 'string' && field?.choices) {
    const choice = field.choices.find((c) => c.value === value);
    if (choice) return choice.label;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? formatDate(value) : value;
  if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return String(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return undefined;
  if (typeof value.label === 'string') return value.label;
  if ((value.type === 'user' || value.type === 'group') && typeof value.id === 'string') return { ref: { type: value.type, id: value.id } };
  return undefined;
}

/** The fields a trigger sends, nested fields as dotted ids. */
function sentFields(fields: readonly Field[] | undefined, prefix = ''): { id: string; field: Field }[] {
  return (fields ?? []).flatMap((f) => {
    const id = prefix ? `${prefix}.${f.id}` : f.id;
    if (f.kind === 'fieldGroup' && f.fields?.length) return sentFields(f.fields, id);
    return [{ id, field: f }];
  });
}

const pick = (obj: Json | undefined, dotted: string): Json | undefined =>
  dotted.split('.').reduce<Json | undefined>((o, k) => (o && typeof o === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o) ? o[k] : undefined), obj);

const safeId = (s: string) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '-');

const matches = (o: PickOption, q: string) => {
  if (!q) return true;
  const sample = typeof o.sample === 'string' ? o.sample : '';
  return `${o.name} ${o.from ?? ''} ${sample}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
};

/**
 * How well an option's name matches the search text, best first: the name starts with it, a word of
 * the name starts with it, the name has it somewhere, only where it comes from or its sample has it.
 * Typing "Platform" puts "Platform team" before "Data platform approvers".
 */
export function matchRank(name: string, q: string): number {
  if (!q) return 0;
  const n = name.toLowerCase();
  if (n.startsWith(q)) return 0;
  if (n.split(/[\s'’(),.:/-]+/).some((word) => word.startsWith(q))) return 1;
  if (n.includes(q)) return 2;
  return 3;
}

/** "2 Dec 2026", "2 December 2026", "Dec 2 2026", "2026-12-02" or "2/12/2026" as YYYY-MM-DD; undefined when it is not a date. */
export function parseDate(text: string): string | undefined {
  const s = text.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/,/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  if (!s) return undefined;
  const months = t('values.date.monthNames').toLowerCase().split(' ');
  const monthOf = (word: string) => {
    if (word.length < 3) return 0;
    return months.findIndex((month) => month.startsWith(word)) + 1;
  };
  let y: number;
  let m: number;
  let d: number;
  let parts: RegExpExecArray | null;
  if ((parts = /^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/.exec(s))) [y, m, d] = [Number(parts[1]), Number(parts[2]), Number(parts[3])];
  else if ((parts = /^(\d{1,2})[/.](\d{1,2})[/.](\d{4})$/.exec(s))) [d, m, y] = [Number(parts[1]), Number(parts[2]), Number(parts[3])];
  else if ((parts = /^(\d{1,2}) ([a-z]+)\.? (\d{4})$/.exec(s))) [d, m, y] = [Number(parts[1]), monthOf(parts[2]!), Number(parts[3])];
  else if ((parts = /^([a-z]+)\.? (\d{1,2}) (\d{4})$/.exec(s))) [m, d, y] = [monthOf(parts[1]!), Number(parts[2]), Number(parts[3])];
  else return undefined;
  if (!m || m > 12 || !d || y < 1000) return undefined;
  const days = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, 0)).getUTCDate();
  if (d > days) return undefined;
  return `${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/** The thing a trigger is about ("Ticket"), lower-cased for "From the ticket". */
function sentThing(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, env: DescribeEnv, sent: CatalogueRef): string {
  const label = toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: '\u0000' }, { ...env, trigger: sent }));
  const thing = label.split(':')[0]?.trim() || label;
  return thing.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + thing.slice(1);
}

export function buildOptions(input: PickInput): PickResult {
  const { doc, env, at, scope, allowTyped, sent, label } = input;
  const q = input.query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const here = stageIdOf(doc, at.item);
  // In "Fill in the form from the ticket" the question says what fits, when the slot does not.
  const question = sent ? sentQuestionOf(doc, at) : undefined;
  const accepts = input.accepts?.length ? input.accepts : question ? [question.kind] : undefined;
  const acceptsList = accepts && accepts.length ? accepts : undefined;
  const wrongWords = (name: string, kind: ScopeKind) =>
    t('values.state.wrongKind', { kinds: kindsWithArticle(acceptsList ?? []), name, kind: kindWithArticle(kind) });

  const groups: PickGroup[] = [];
  const addGroup = (g: PickGroup) => groups.push(g);

  if (sent) {
    const sentEnv = { ...env, trigger: sent };
    const entry = (env.catalogue as Catalogue | undefined)?.entries?.find((e) => e.id === sent);
    const thing = sentThing(doc, env, sent);
    const connection = (env.catalogue as Catalogue | undefined)?.connections?.find((c) => c.id === entry?.connection)?.label ?? thing;
    const fields = entry?.kind === 'trigger' ? sentFields(entry.event) : [];
    const options = fields.map(({ id, field }): PickOption => {
      const expression: SentExpression = { sentField: id };
      const name = toText(describeExpression(doc, expression, sentEnv));
      const wrong = !fits(field.kind, acceptsList);
      const sample = entry?.kind === 'trigger' ? sentSample(pick(entry.sample?.event as Json, id), field) : undefined;
      return {
        id: `sent-${safeId(id)}`,
        group: 'sent',
        expression,
        name,
        kind: field.kind,
        ...(sample !== undefined ? { sample } : {}),
        state: field.required ? 'always' : 'mayBeEmpty',
        stateWords: field.required ? t('values.state.always') : t('values.state.mayBeEmptySent', { thing }),
        ...(field.required ? { why: t('values.state.alwaysSent', { thing }) } : {}),
        wrongKind: wrong,
        ...(wrong ? { disabled: wrongWords(name, field.kind) } : {}),
      };
    });
    addGroup({ id: 'sent', title: t('values.group.sent', { thing }), sub: t('values.group.sent.sub', { connection }), options });
  } else {
    const answers: PickOption[] = [];
    const others: PickOption[] = [];
    const lists: PickOption[] = [];
    // A form's "Show when" reads only the answers above it: core's valuesInScope also lists the
    // question's own answer and the later ones (reported to the engine owner), so they are left out here.
    const later = laterAnswersAt(doc, at);
    for (const v of scope) {
      if (later.has(v.id)) continue;
      const stages = fillStages(doc, v.filledAt);
      const from = andList(stages) || undefined;
      const own = v.filledAt.some((l) => {
        const e = find(doc, l.item);
        return (e?.kind === 'question' || e?.kind === 'task') && stageIdOf(doc, l.item) === here;
      });
      const expression: Expression = { value: v.id };
      const name = v.name || t('values.ifEmpty.placeholder');
      const option = valueOption({
        id: `v-${safeId(v.id)}`, group: own ? 'answers' : 'values', expression, name, kind: v.kind, from, v, own,
        sample: sampleOf(doc, expression), acceptsList, wrongWords,
      });
      (own ? answers : others).push(option);

      // Steps into a list's columns: "Primary domain's approvers".
      if (singleKind(v.kind) === 'choiceFromList' || (!v.kind && listOfValue(doc, v.id))) {
        const source = listOfValue(doc, v.id);
        const list = source ? getList(doc, source.listId) : undefined;
        for (const column of list?.columns ?? []) {
          if (column.id === source?.shown) continue;
          const steps: Step[] = [{ column: column.id }];
          const stepped: Expression = { value: v.id, steps };
          lists.push(valueOption({
            id: `v-${safeId(v.id)}-${safeId(column.id)}`, group: 'lists', expression: stepped,
            name: toText(describeExpression(doc, stepped, env)), kind: column.kind, from: list?.name, filledFrom: from, v, own,
            sample: sampleOf(doc, stepped), acceptsList, wrongWords,
          }));
          if (column.kind === 'group' && acceptsList?.includes('people')) {
            const members: Expression = { value: v.id, steps: [...steps, { directory: 'members' }] };
            lists.push(valueOption({
              id: `v-${safeId(v.id)}-${safeId(column.id)}-members`, group: 'lists', expression: members,
              name: toText(describeExpression(doc, members, env)), kind: 'people', from: list?.name, filledFrom: from, v, own,
              acceptsList, wrongWords,
            }));
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Each task here also gives "Answered by" (section 4). Not saved yet and asked for before anyone
    // answers, it is never filled here: shown greyed with why, like the stage's other answers.
    const entry = find(doc, at.item);
    const beforeAnswers = entry?.kind === 'task' || (entry?.kind === 'action' && entry.parents.section === 'whenThisStageStarts');
    const stage = here ? getStage(doc, here) : undefined;
    if (beforeAnswers && stage && stage.kind !== 'ending') {
      for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) {
        if (task.savesAnsweredByAs) continue;
        const name = PRESET_WORDS.answeredBy.replace('{name}', task.name || stage.name || '');
        const wrong = !fits('person', acceptsList);
        answers.push({
          id: `answered-${safeId(task.id)}`,
          group: 'answers',
          // Never picked (it is greyed); an expression only so the option has one.
          expression: { value: `v_answered_by_${task.id}` as ValueId },
          name,
          kind: 'person',
          ...(stage.name ? { from: stage.name } : {}),
          state: 'never',
          stateWords: t('values.state.neverOwn'),
          disabled: wrong ? wrongWords(name, 'person') : t('values.state.neverOwn'),
          wrongKind: wrong,
        });
      }
    }

    // People and groups typed in from the Directory.
    const directoryKinds = (['person', 'group'] as const).filter((k) => acceptsList?.includes(k));
    if (allowTyped && directoryKinds.length && Array.isArray(input.directory)) {
      for (const e of input.directory) {
        const kind = e.type === 'user' ? 'person' : 'group';
        if (!directoryKinds.includes(kind)) continue;
        const ref = { directoryId: e.id, name: e.label };
        lists.push({
          id: `dir-${safeId(e.type)}-${safeId(e.id)}`,
          group: 'lists',
          expression: kind === 'person' ? { person: ref } : { group: ref },
          name: e.label,
          kind,
          from: t(kind === 'person' ? 'values.option.directoryPerson' : 'values.option.directoryGroup'),
          state: 'always',
          wrongKind: false,
        });
      }
    }

    const request: PickOption[] = (['requester', 'startedOn'] as const).map((r) => {
      const expression: Expression = { request: r };
      const kind: ValueKind = r === 'requester' ? 'person' : 'date';
      const name = toText(describeExpression(doc, expression, env));
      const wrong = !fits(kind, acceptsList);
      const sample = sampleOf(doc, expression);
      return {
        id: `request-${r}`,
        group: 'request',
        expression,
        name,
        kind,
        from: t('values.from.request'),
        ...(sample ? { sample } : {}),
        state: 'always',
        stateWords: t('values.state.always'),
        why: t('values.state.alwaysRequest'),
        wrongKind: wrong,
        ...(wrong ? { disabled: wrongWords(name, kind) } : {}),
      };
    });

    addGroup({ id: 'answers', title: t('values.group.answers'), sub: t('values.group.answers.sub'), options: answers });
    addGroup({ id: 'values', title: t('values.group.values'), sub: t('values.group.values.sub'), options: others });
    addGroup({ id: 'lists', title: t('values.group.lists'), sub: t('values.group.lists.sub'), options: lists });
    addGroup({ id: 'request', title: t('values.group.request'), sub: t('values.group.request.sub'), options: request });
  }

  // Typed-in constants of an accepted kind.
  let offerDate = false;
  if (allowTyped) {
    const typed = typedOptions(doc, acceptsList, input.query.trim(), question?.question);
    offerDate = typed.offerDate;
    groups.push({ id: 'typed', title: t('values.group.typed'), options: typed.options });
  }

  // Search, the best matches first, then leave out the wrong kinds unless asked to show them.
  let hidden = 0;
  for (const g of groups) {
    g.options = g.options.filter((o) => g.id === 'typed' || matches(o, q));
    if (q && g.id !== 'typed') {
      const ranked = g.options.map((o, i) => ({ o, i, r: matchRank(o.name, q) }));
      g.options = ranked.sort((a, b) => a.r - b.r || a.i - b.i).map((x) => x.o);
    }
    if (acceptsList && !input.showWrongKind) {
      const before = g.options.length;
      g.options = g.options.filter((o) => !o.wrongKind);
      hidden += before - g.options.length;
    }
    // Within a group, what can be picked comes first.
    g.options = [...g.options.filter((o) => !o.disabled), ...g.options.filter((o) => o.disabled)];
  }
  const shown = groups.filter((g) => g.options.length > 0);

  let directoryNote: string | undefined;
  const directoryKinds = (['person', 'group'] as const).filter((k) => acceptsList?.includes(k));
  if (!sent && allowTyped && directoryKinds.length) {
    if (!q) directoryNote = t('values.option.directoryHint');
    else if (input.directory === 'looking') directoryNote = t('values.option.directoryLooking');
    else if (input.directory === 'failed') directoryNote = t('values.option.directoryFailed');
    else if (Array.isArray(input.directory) && !input.directory.some((e) => directoryKinds.includes(e.type === 'user' ? 'person' : 'group'))) {
      directoryNote = t('values.option.directoryNone', { query: input.query.trim() });
    }
  }

  const hiddenWords =
    hidden > 0 && acceptsList
      ? t(hidden === 1 ? 'values.picker.hiddenOne' : 'values.picker.hidden', {
          label, kinds: kindsWithArticle(acceptsList), n: hidden, plural: pluralOf(acceptsList),
        })
      : undefined;

  return {
    groups: shown,
    hidden,
    ...(hiddenWords ? { hiddenWords } : {}),
    ...(directoryNote ? { directoryNote } : {}),
    offerDate,
    flat: shown.flatMap((g) => g.options),
  };
}

function pluralOf(kinds: readonly ValueKind[]): string {
  const words = [...new Set(kinds.map((k) => t(`values.kindPlural.${k}` as Parameters<typeof t>[0])))];
  if (words.length <= 1) return words[0] ?? '';
  return t('values.or', { a: words.slice(0, -1).join(t('values.comma')), b: words[words.length - 1] ?? '' });
}

interface ValueOptionArgs {
  id: string;
  group: GroupId;
  expression: Expression;
  name: string;
  kind: ScopeKind;
  from: string | undefined;
  /** For a step into a list: the stages that fill the value the step starts from. */
  filledFrom?: string | undefined;
  v: ValueInScope;
  own: boolean;
  sample?: string | undefined;
  acceptsList: readonly ValueKind[] | undefined;
  wrongWords(name: string, kind: ScopeKind): string;
}

function valueOption(a: ValueOptionArgs): PickOption {
  const { v } = a;
  const wrong = !fits(a.kind, a.acceptsList);
  let stateWords: string;
  let why: string | undefined;
  let never: string | undefined;
  if (v.state === 'always') {
    stateWords = t('values.state.always');
    // A list is not a stage a request passes: say what the step reads from instead.
    if (a.group === 'lists' && a.from) why = t('values.state.alwaysWhyList', { value: v.name, list: a.from });
    else if (a.from) why = t('values.state.alwaysWhy', { place: a.from });
  } else if (v.state === 'mayBeEmpty') {
    stateWords = t('values.state.mayBeEmpty');
  } else {
    never = a.own
      ? t('values.state.neverOwn')
      : (a.filledFrom ?? a.from)
        ? t('values.state.neverLater', { place: (a.filledFrom ?? a.from) as string })
        : t('values.state.neverNothing');
    stateWords = never;
  }
  // When it is both the wrong kind and never filled, the kind reason is given (section 4).
  const disabled = wrong ? a.wrongWords(a.name, a.kind) : never;
  return {
    id: a.id,
    group: a.group,
    expression: a.expression,
    name: a.name,
    kind: a.kind,
    ...(a.from ? { from: a.from } : {}),
    ...(a.sample ? { sample: a.sample } : {}),
    state: v.state,
    stateWords,
    ...(why ? { why } : {}),
    ...(disabled ? { disabled } : {}),
    wrongKind: wrong,
    valueId: v.id,
    ...(v.skippedVia ? { skippedVia: v.skippedVia } : {}),
  };
}

/**
 * Typed-in constants: the search text as text, a number or a date, Yes and No, a question's choices,
 * a list's rows. `only`: the question the slot fills, whose own choices or list are the ones offered.
 */
function typedOptions(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow, accepts: readonly ValueKind[] | undefined, query: string, only?: Question,
): { options: PickOption[]; offerDate: boolean } {
  const wants = (k: ValueKind) => !accepts || accepts.includes(k);
  const strictly = (k: ValueKind) => !!accepts && accepts.includes(k);
  const options: PickOption[] = [];
  const base = { group: 'typed' as const, state: 'always' as const, wrongKind: false };
  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  const date = query && strictly('date') ? parseDate(query) : undefined;
  if (date) {
    options.push({ ...base, id: 'typed-date', expression: { date }, name: t('values.option.date', { date: formatDate(date) }), kind: 'date' });
  }
  if (only && (strictly('choice') || strictly('multipleChoice') || strictly('choiceFromList'))) {
    // The question's own choices, or the rows of its list: nothing else is an answer to it.
    if (only.choices?.from === 'typedIn') {
      for (const choice of only.choices.choices ?? []) {
        const o: PickOption = {
          ...base, id: `typed-${safeId(choice.id)}`, expression: { choice: choice.id }, name: choice.label,
          kind: 'choice', from: t('values.option.choiceOf', { question: only.label }),
        };
        if (matches(o, q)) options.push(o);
      }
    } else if (only.choices?.from === 'list') {
      const list = getList(doc, only.choices.list);
      for (const row of list?.rows ?? []) {
        const name = toText(describeConstant(doc, { row: row.id }));
        const o: PickOption = { ...base, id: `typed-${safeId(row.id)}`, expression: { row: row.id }, name, kind: 'choiceFromList', from: t('values.option.rowOf', { list: list?.name ?? '' }) };
        if (matches(o, q)) options.push(o);
      }
    }
    return { options, offerDate: false };
  }
  if (query && (wants('text') || strictly('longText'))) {
    options.push({ ...base, id: 'typed-text', expression: { text: query }, name: t('values.option.text', { text: query }), kind: 'text' });
  }
  const n = Number(query.replace(/,/g, ''));
  if (query && strictly('number') && Number.isFinite(n)) {
    options.push({ ...base, id: 'typed-number', expression: { number: n }, name: t('values.option.number', { number: n.toLocaleString('en-GB') }), kind: 'number' });
  }
  if (strictly('yesNo')) {
    for (const yes of [true, false]) {
      const name = t(yes ? 'values.option.yes' : 'values.option.no');
      if (!q || name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) options.push({ ...base, id: `typed-${yes ? 'yes' : 'no'}`, expression: { yesNo: yes }, name, kind: 'yesNo' });
    }
  }
  if (strictly('choice') || strictly('multipleChoice')) {
    for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
      if (stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
      for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) {
        for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
          for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
            if (item.type !== 'question' || item.choices?.from !== 'typedIn') continue;
            for (const choice of item.choices.choices ?? []) {
              const o: PickOption = {
                ...base, id: `typed-${safeId(choice.id)}`, expression: { choice: choice.id }, name: choice.label,
                kind: 'choice', from: t('values.option.choiceOf', { question: item.label }),
              };
              if (matches(o, q)) options.push(o);
            }
          }
        }
        for (const button of task.buttons ?? []) {
          const o: PickOption = {
            ...base, id: `typed-${safeId(button.id)}`, expression: { button: button.id }, name: button.label,
            kind: 'choice', from: t('values.option.buttonOf', { stage: stage.name }),
          };
          if (matches(o, q)) options.push(o);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (strictly('choiceFromList')) {
    for (const list of doc.lists ?? []) {
      for (const row of list.rows ?? []) {
        const name = toText(describeConstant(doc, { row: row.id }));
        const o: PickOption = { ...base, id: `typed-${safeId(row.id)}`, expression: { row: row.id }, name, kind: 'choiceFromList', from: t('values.option.rowOf', { list: list.name }) };
        if (matches(o, q)) options.push(o);
      }
    }
  }
  return { options, offerDate: strictly('date') };
}

/** The kind an expression gives, as far as the document and the catalogue say; undefined when not known. */
export function kindOfExpression(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  expression: Expression | SentExpression | undefined,
  env: DescribeEnv,
  kindOfValue: (id: string) => ScopeKind,
): ScopeKind {
  if (!expression || typeof expression !== 'object' || Array.isArray(expression)) return undefined;
  const e = expression as Record<string, unknown>;
  const steps = (e.steps as Step[] | undefined) ?? [];
  const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
  if (last) {
    if (has(last, 'directory')) return 'people';
    const column = find(doc, String(last.column));
    return column?.kind === 'column' ? column.item.kind : undefined;
  }
  if (typeof e.value === 'string') return kindOfValue(e.value);
  if (e.request === 'requester') return 'person';
  if (e.request === 'startedOn') return 'date';
  if (typeof e.sentField === 'string') {
    const entry = (env.catalogue as Catalogue | undefined)?.entries?.find((x) => x.id === env.trigger);
    return entry?.kind === 'trigger' ? sentFields(entry.event).find((f) => f.id === e.sentField)?.field.kind : undefined;
  }
  if (has(e, 'allOf') || has(e, 'anyOf')) return 'yesNo';
  const constants: [string, ValueKind][] = [
    ['text', 'text'], ['number', 'number'], ['yesNo', 'yesNo'], ['date', 'date'], ['choice', 'choice'],
    ['choices', 'multipleChoice'], ['row', 'choiceFromList'], ['button', 'choice'], ['person', 'person'],
    ['group', 'group'], ['people', 'people'], ['connectionChoice', 'choiceFromConnection'],
  ];
  return constants.find(([k]) => has(e, k))?.[1];
}

/** True when two expressions are the same apart from their "If empty, use ...". */
export function sameBase(a: Expression | SentExpression | undefined, b: Expression | SentExpression | undefined): boolean {
  const strip = (x: unknown) => {
    if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return x;
    const { ifEmptyUse: _drop, ...rest } = x as Record<string, unknown>;
    void _drop;
    return rest;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(strip(a)) === JSON.stringify(strip(b));
}

/**
 * One place in the workflow as the Values tab and the list dialog show it: the stage's status dot,
 * the stage's name as a link that shows the place ("Show me", through `reveal`), and what it is
 * there ("by the question Title", "Who is asked").
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Status } from '@/contract';
import { getStage, reveal, type ValueCardLine } from '@/model';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { stageIdOf } from './options';
import s from './values-tab.module.css';

/** The colour token of a stage's status. */
export function statusColour(colour: Status['colour'] | undefined): string {
  switch (colour) {
    case 'amber':
    case 'blue':
    case 'purple':
    case 'green':
    case 'red':
    case 'grey':
    case 'teal':
    case 'pink':
      return `var(--st-${colour})`;
    default:
      return 'transparent';
  }
}

function dotColour(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, item: string): string {
  const stageId = stageIdOf(doc, item);
  const stage = stageId ? getStage(doc, stageId) : undefined;
  const statusId = stage ? (stage.status ?? (stage.kind !== 'ending' ? stage.ifSentBackStatus : undefined)) : undefined;
  return statusColour(statusId ? doc.statuses?.find((x) => x.id === statusId)?.colour : undefined);
}

/** The place in words, for its "Show ..." link: "Create Jira issue: In Jira this is called Assignee". */
export const placeWords = (line: ValueCardLine) =>
  line.stage && line.what ? t('values.card.place', { stage: line.stage, what: line.what }) : line.stage || line.what;

/**
 * The "Show ..." names for a list of places, each saying what it belongs to ("Show Domain approval:
 * Who is asked (uses Eng lead)"), and numbered when two lines of one list read the same.
 */
export function placeLabels(lines: readonly ValueCardLine[], name: string, role: 'fills' | 'uses'): string[] {
  const words = lines.map((line) => placeWords(line));
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const w of words) counts.set(w, (counts.get(w) ?? 0) + 1);
  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
  return words.map((w) => {
    const n = (seen.get(w) ?? 0) + 1;
    seen.set(w, n);
    const place = (counts.get(w) ?? 0) > 1 ? t('values.tab.placeNth', { place: w, n }) : w;
    return t(role === 'fills' ? 'values.tab.showFills' : 'values.tab.showUses', { place, name });
  });
}

export function PlaceLink({
  doc, line, onShow, label,
}: { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; line: ValueCardLine; onShow?: () => void; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={s.place}>
      <span className={s.stageDot} style={{ background: dotColour(doc, line.location.item) }} aria-hidden="true" />
      <button
        type="button"
        className={s.link}
        aria-label={label ?? t('values.card.show', { place: placeWords(line) })}
        onClick={() => {
          onShow?.();
          reveal(line.location);
        }}
      >
        {line.stage || line.what}
      </button>
      {line.stage && line.what && (
        <span className={s.placeWhat}>
          {t('values.sep')}
          {line.what}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/template-dom.ts\n===
/**
 * The message field's text box is an editable element holding text and chips. These helpers draw a
 * Template into it and read it back, so that what is read is exactly the format's Template: strings
 * as written (line breaks as "\n"), each chip as the expression it stands for, neighbouring strings
 * joined, nothing empty. A chip is one element that cannot be edited inside, so it is deleted whole.
 */
import type { Expression, SentExpression } from '@/contract';

export type Piece = string | Expression | SentExpression;

/** Marks the <br> that only lets a last empty line show; it is not part of the text. */
const TAIL = 'data-tail';

/** Draws `template` into `root`, making each chip with `makeChip` (which also remembers its expression). */
export function drawTemplate(root: HTMLElement, template: readonly Piece[], makeChip: (piece: Exclude<Piece, string>) => HTMLElement) {
  root.replaceChildren();
  for (const piece of template) {
    if (typeof piece === 'string') {
      if (piece) root.append(document.createTextNode(piece));
    } else root.append(makeChip(piece));
  }
  fixTail(root);
}

/** Reads the Template back. `chipOf` gives the expression of a chip element (undefined for anything else). */
export function readTemplate(root: HTMLElement, chipOf: (el: Element) => Exclude<Piece, string> | undefined): Piece[] {
  const out: Piece[] = [];
  const text = (s: string) => {
    if (!s) return;
    const last = out[out.length - 1];
    if (typeof last === 'string') out[out.length - 1] = last + s;
    else out.push(s);
  };
  const endsWithBreak = () => {
    const last = out[out.length - 1];
    return out.length === 0 || (typeof last === 'string' && last.endsWith('\n'));
  };
  const walk = (node: Node) => {
    node.childNodes.forEach((child) => {
      if (child.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
        text((child.nodeValue ?? '').replace(/\u200b/g, ''));
        return;
      }
      if (child.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return;
      const el = child as HTMLElement;
      const chip = chipOf(el);
      if (chip) {
        out.push(chip);
        return;
      }
      if (el.tagName === 'BR') {
        if (!el.hasAttribute(TAIL)) text('\n');
        return;
      }
      // A block a browser made for a new line ("<div>more</div>").
      const block = el.tagName === 'DIV' || el.tagName === 'P';
      if (block && !endsWithBreak()) text('\n');
      walk(el);
    });
  };
  walk(root);
  return out;
}

/** A text ending in a line break needs a <br> after it, or the empty last line cannot be seen or reached. */
export function fixTail(root: HTMLElement) {
  const tails = root.querySelectorAll(`br[${TAIL}]`);
  tails.forEach((br) => br.remove());
  let last = root.lastChild;
  while (last && last.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && !last.nodeValue) last = last.previousSibling;
  if (last && last.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && (last.nodeValue ?? '').endsWith('\n')) {
    const br = document.createElement('br');
    br.setAttribute(TAIL, '');
    root.append(br);
  }
}

/** The chip right before (`'back'`) or right after (`'forward'`) a collapsed caret inside `root`, if there is one. */
export function chipNextToCaret(root: HTMLElement, direction: 'back' | 'forward', isChip: (el: Element) => boolean): Element | undefined {
  const sel = root.ownerDocument.getSelection();
  if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0 || !sel.isCollapsed) return undefined;
  const { startContainer: node, startOffset: offset } = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  if (!root.contains(node)) return undefined;
  let candidate: Node | null = null;
  if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
    const len = (node.nodeValue ?? '').length;
    if (direction === 'back' && offset === 0) candidate = node.previousSibling;
    if (direction === 'forward' && offset === len) candidate = node.nextSibling;
  } else {
    candidate = direction === 'back' ? (node.childNodes[offset - 1] ?? null) : (node.childNodes[offset] ?? null);
  }
  return candidate && candidate.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && isChip(candidate as Element) ? (candidate as Element) : undefined;
}

/** True when two templates are the same piece for piece. */
export const sameTemplate = (a: readonly Piece[] | undefined, b: readonly Piece[] | undefined) =>
  JSON.stringify(a ?? []) === JSON.stringify(b ?? []);
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/values-detail.ts\n===
/**
 * One value at each stage, as the Values tab's detail panel shows it (mockup 04-values, values-tab;
 * editor-model.md section 4): for every stage whether the value is filled there, used there, may be
 * empty there or never filled there, the places it is filled and used in that stage, and for each
 * use its "If empty, use ...". Also the amber line under "Used in": "may be empty in 2 stages, each
 * with an "if empty"". Pure: it takes what core.valuesInScope says at each stage and at each use.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Expression, Location } from '@/contract';
import { find, type ValueCardLine, type ValueCardWords } from '@/model';
import type { ValueInScope } from '@/services';
import { stageIdOf } from './options';

export type StageState = 'filled' | 'always' | 'mayBeEmpty' | 'never';

export interface UseAtStage {
  line: ValueCardLine;
  /** Read where the value may be empty (said by core.valuesInScope at the use itself). */
  mayBeEmpty: boolean;
  /** The "If empty, use ..." the use has; null when it has none; undefined when it cannot have one (a button's "Needed to press"). */
  ifEmpty: Expression | null | undefined;
}

export interface StageAt {
  stageId: string;
  name: string;
  ending: boolean;
  state: StageState;
  /** Set with mayBeEmpty: one route that reaches the stage without filling the value. */
  skippedVia?: Location[];
  fills: ValueCardLine[];
  uses: UseAtStage[];
}

/** What core.valuesInScope says at a place about one value. */
export type ScopeAt = (location: Location, valueId: string) => ValueInScope | undefined;

/** The locations to ask core.valuesInScope about: each stage, and each place that uses one of the values. */
export function scopeLocations(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, cards: readonly ValueCardWords[]): Location[] {
  const out = new Map<string, Location>();
  const add = (l: Location) => out.set(scopeKey(l), l);
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) add({ item: stage.id });
  for (const card of cards) for (const line of card.used) add(readAt(line.location));
  return [...out.values()];
}

export const scopeKey = (l: Location) => (l.part ? `${l.item}#${l.part}` : l.item);

/** Where a use reads the value: the slot (its first part), which is what the To do drawer checks. */
export function readAt(l: Location): Location {
  const head = l.part?.split('.')[0];
  return head ? { item: l.item, part: head } : { item: l.item };
}

const isRecord = (x: unknown): x is Record<string, unknown> => !!x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x);

/** The part of an item a location points at ("inputs.assignee"), or the whole item when the path does not lead anywhere. */
function nodeAt(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, l: Location): unknown {
  const entry = find(doc, l.item);
  const item: unknown = entry?.item;
  let node: unknown = item;
  for (const key of (l.part ?? '').split('.').filter(Boolean)) {
    if (Array.isArray(node)) node = node[Number(key)] ?? node.find((x) => isRecord(x) && x.id === key);
    else if (isRecord(node)) node = node[key];
    else return item;
    if (node === undefined) return item;
  }
  return node;
}

/** The "If empty, use" of the references to the value at a place: null when one of them has none. */
export function ifEmptyAt(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, l: Location, valueId: string): Expression | null | undefined {
  if (l.part === 'neededToPress') return undefined;
  let found: Expression | null | undefined;
  const visit = (node: unknown) => {
    if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.forEach(visit);
    if (!isRecord(node)) return;
    if (node.value === valueId && !(Array.isArray(node.steps) && node.steps.length)) {
      const fallback = node.ifEmptyUse as Expression | undefined;
      if (!fallback) found = null;
      else if (found === undefined) found = fallback;
    }
    for (const child of Object.values(node)) if (child && typeof child === 'object') visit(child);
  };
  visit(nodeAt(doc, l));
  return found === undefined ? null : found;
}

/** The value at each stage, in the document's order. */
export function stagesFor(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string, card: ValueCardWords, scopeAt: ScopeAt): StageAt[] {
  return (doc.stages ?? []).map((stage) => {
    const inStage = (line: ValueCardLine) => stageIdOf(doc, line.location.item) === stage.id;
    const fills = card.filled.filter(inStage);
    const uses = card.used.filter(inStage).map((line): UseAtStage => {
      const here = scopeAt(readAt(line.location), valueId);
      return { line, mayBeEmpty: here?.state === 'mayBeEmpty', ifEmpty: ifEmptyAt(doc, line.location, valueId) };
    });
    const at = scopeAt({ item: stage.id }, valueId);
    const state: StageState = fills.length ? 'filled' : at?.state ?? 'never';
    return {
      stageId: stage.id,
      name: stage.name,
      ending: stage.kind === 'ending',
      state,
      ...(state === 'mayBeEmpty' && at?.skippedVia ? { skippedVia: at.skippedVia } : {}),
      fills,
      uses,
    };
  });
}

/** For the amber line under "Used in": the stages where a use may find it empty, and how many of those uses have no "if empty". */
export function mayBeEmptyUses(stages: readonly StageAt[]): { stages: number; withoutIfEmpty: number } {
  let n = 0;
  let without = 0;
  for (const s of stages) {
    const risky = s.uses.filter((u) => u.mayBeEmpty && u.ifEmpty !== undefined);
    if (!risky.length) continue;
    n += 1;
    without += risky.filter((u) => u.ifEmpty === null).length;
  }
  return { stages: n, withoutIfEmpty: without };
}

/* The Values tab uses the whole width of the page, like the mockup; the page frame's reading width

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import { fixtureCatalogue } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { fixture } from '@/model/testkit';
import type { Facts } from '@/services';
import { choiceQuestionsOf, listPlaces, listPlacesByStage, rowName, rowNamedIn } from './lists';
import { groupByStage, rowMatches, valueRows } from './values-tab';

const env = { catalogue: fixtureCatalogue };
const row = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string, facts: Facts | null = null) => valueRows(doc, facts, env).find((r) => r.id === id);

describe('valueRows (the Values tab of the demo)', () => {
  it('lists every value in document order, with where it is filled, where it is used and the sample', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    const rows = valueRows(doc, null, env);
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.name)).toEqual([
      'Title', 'Description', 'Primary domain', 'Planned release date', 'Risk', 'Eng lead', 'Reason',
      'Domain approval: button pressed', 'Domain approval: answered by', 'Jira issue', 'Release notes',
    ]);
    const title = row(doc, 'v_title')!;
    expect(title.filled.map((l) => [l.stage, l.what])).toEqual([['Request form', 'by the question Title']]);
    expect(title.used).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(title.sample).toBe('Rotate payment gateway API keys');
    expect(title.laterWins).toEqual([]);
    expect(row(doc, 'v_eng_lead')!.sample).toBe('Diego Santos');
    expect(row(doc, 'v_release_notes')!.sample).toBeUndefined();
    expect(row(doc, 'v_release_notes')!.used.map((l) => l.what)).toEqual(['Needed to press Mark released']);
  });

  it('a value filled in two places says the later one replaces the earlier', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    // Release notes' question at Development now saves into Title too.
    const dev = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_development');
    if (!dev || dev.kind === 'ending') throw new Error('no Development');
    const q = dev.tasks[0]!.form!.pages[0]!.items.find((i) => i.id === 'q_release_notes') as { savedAs?: string };
    q.savedAs = 'v_title';
    const title = row(doc, 'v_title')!;
    expect(title.filled.map((l) => l.stage)).toEqual(['Request form', 'Development']);
    expect(title.laterWins).toEqual(['Filled in 2 places: the later one replaces the earlier.']);
  });

  it('within one stage, the task later in the stage wins', () => {
    const doc = fixture('several-at-once');
    const stage = doc.stages.find((s) => s.kind !== 'ending' && (s.tasks ?? []).length > 1);
    if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending') throw new Error('several-at-once has a stage with two tasks');
    const [first, second] = stage.tasks;
    // Both tasks save who answered into one value.
    first!.savesAnsweredByAs = 'v_da_answered_by' as ValueId;
    second!.savesAnsweredByAs = 'v_da_answered_by' as ValueId;
    const r = row(doc, 'v_da_answered_by')!;
    expect(r.laterWins[0]).toMatch(/^Filled in \d places: the later one replaces the earlier\.$/);
    expect(r.laterWins.some((w) => w.startsWith(`In ${stage.name}, `) && w.endsWith('comes later in the stage, so its answer is kept.'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("a task's button pressed or answered by value is listed only when something uses it", () => {
    expect(row(fixture('change-request'), 'v_da_answered_by')).toBeDefined();
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    // The only reader of "answered by" is the Request form's text shown when sent back: drop it.
    const stage = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_request_form');
    if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending') throw new Error('no start stage');
    for (const page of stage.tasks[0]!.form?.pages ?? []) page.items = page.items.filter((i) => !JSON.stringify(i).includes('v_da_answered_by'));
    expect(row(doc, 'v_da_answered_by')).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('a value filled with two kinds carries the places of each kind', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    const facts: Facts = {
      stages: {},
      arrows: {},
      values: {
        v_jira_issue: {
          kind: { conflict: [{ kind: 'text', at: { item: 'ac_create_jira' } }, { kind: 'number', at: { item: 'q_title' } }] },
          filledAt: [],
          usedAt: [],
        },
      },
    } as unknown as Facts;
    expect(row(doc, 'v_jira_issue', facts)!.conflict?.map((c) => c.kind)).toEqual(['text', 'number']);
  });

  it('two values with the same name each say so', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    doc.values.find((v) => v.id === 'v_release_notes')!.name = 'Jira issue';
    expect(row(doc, 'v_release_notes')!.sameName).toEqual([{ id: 'v_jira_issue', filledAt: 'Create Jira issue' }]);
    expect(row(doc, 'v_jira_issue')!.sameName.map((o) => o.id)).toEqual(['v_release_notes']);
  });

  it('search matches the name, the kind or a stage; grouping follows the stages', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    const rows = valueRows(doc, null, env);
    expect(rows.filter((r) => rowMatches(r, 'eng')).map((r) => r.name)).toEqual(['Eng lead']);
    expect(rows.filter((r) => rowMatches(r, 'development')).map((r) => r.name)).toEqual(['Release notes']);
    expect(rows.filter((r) => rowMatches(r, 'person')).map((r) => r.name)).toEqual([]); // kinds come from the check
    expect(rows.filter((r) => rowMatches(r, 'jira')).map((r) => r.name)).toEqual(['Jira issue']);
    const groups = groupByStage(doc, rows);
    expect(groups.map((g) => g.title)).toEqual([
      'Filled at Request form', 'Filled at Domain approval', 'Filled at Create Jira issue', 'Filled at Development',
    ]);
    expect(groups[0]!.rows.map((r) => r.name)).toEqual(['Title', 'Description', 'Primary domain', 'Planned release date', 'Risk']);
  });
});

describe('lists', () => {
  it('the Domains list: where it is used, its choice question and its rows by name', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    const list = doc.lists[0]!;
    const places = listPlaces(doc, list, env);
    expect(places.map((p) => p.stage)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['Request form', 'Domain approval', 'Create Jira issue', 'Development']));
    expect(places.some((p) => p.stage === '' || p.what.includes('Sample'))).toBe(false);
    expect(listPlacesByStage(places)).toContain('Development (Who is asked)');
    expect(choiceQuestionsOf(doc, list).map((u) => [u.question.label, u.stage, u.shown?.name])).toEqual([['Primary domain', 'Request form', 'Domain']]);
    expect(list.rows.map((r) => rowName(doc, list, r))).toEqual(['Payments', 'Identity', 'Data platform', 'Internal tools']);
    expect(rowNamedIn(doc, list, list.rows[0]!)).toBe(0);
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/features/values/values-tab.ts\n===
/**
 * The Values tab as plain data (editor-model.md section 4; mockup 04-values, values-tab): one row
 * per value with its kind, where it is filled and used (the model's describeValueCard), the sample,
 * a kind clash, other values of the same name, and the stage that fills it (for grouping). Pure: the
 * page renders it, the tests read it.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location, ValueId, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import {
  describeValueCard, fillSites, find, getTask, referencesTo, taskNameOf, type DescribeEnv, type ValueCardLine,
} from '@/model';
import type { Facts } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { andList, kindTitle, type ScopeKind } from './kinds';
import { sampleOf, stageIdOf } from './options';

export interface ValueRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  kind: ScopeKind;
  /** Set when the value is filled with more than one kind: each kind and where. */
  conflict?: { kind: ValueKind; at: Location }[];
  filled: ValueCardLine[];
  used: ValueCardLine[];
  /** "Filled in 2 places: the later one replaces the earlier." and, within one stage, which task wins. */
  laterWins: string[];
  sample?: string;
  /** "A choice of: ...": the failure codes a value holding what went wrong can be (E-29). */
  choices?: string;
  /** Other values with the same name (they are separate values). */
  sameName: { id: string; filledAt: string }[];
  /** The stage that fills it first (for grouping); undefined when nothing in a stage fills it. */
  stageId?: string;
}

const EXTRA_HOWS = new Set(['savesButtonPressedAs', 'savesAnsweredByAs']);

/** A task's "Button pressed" or "Answered by" value that nothing reads: not listed (editor-model section 4). */
function isUnusedExtra(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string): boolean {
  const fills = fillSites(doc, valueId);
  if (fills.length === 0 || !fills.every((r) => EXTRA_HOWS.has(r.how))) return false;
  return referencesTo(doc, valueId).every((r) => EXTRA_HOWS.has(r.how) || r.how === 'sampleAnswer');
}

/** Within one stage, when two tasks fill the value, the task later in the stage wins. */
function sameStageWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, valueId: string): string[] {
  const byStage = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const r of fillSites(doc, valueId)) {
    const entry = find(doc, r.owner.id);
    const taskId = entry?.kind === 'task' ? entry.id : entry?.parents.task;
    const stageId = stageIdOf(doc, r.owner.id);
    if (!taskId || !stageId) continue;
    const tasks = byStage.get(stageId) ?? [];
    if (!tasks.includes(taskId)) tasks.push(taskId);
    byStage.set(stageId, tasks);
  }
  const words: string[] = [];
  for (const [stageId, taskIds] of byStage) {
    if (taskIds.length < 2) continue;
    const stage = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === stageId);
    if (!stage || stage.kind === 'ending') continue;
    // Document order of the stage's tasks decides, not the order the places were found in.
    const ordered = (stage.tasks ?? []).filter((tk) => taskIds.includes(tk.id));
    const last = ordered[ordered.length - 1];
    if (!last) continue;
    words.push(
      t('values.tab.laterTask', {
        stage: stage.name,
        tasks: andList(ordered.map((tk) => taskNameOf(doc, tk))),
        later: taskNameOf(doc, getTask(doc, last.id) ?? last),
      }),
    );
  }
  return words;
}

const norm = (name: string) => name.trim().toLowerCase();

/** Every value the tab lists, in the document's order. */
export function valueRows(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, facts: Facts | null, env: DescribeEnv = {}): ValueRow[] {
  const values = (doc.values ?? []).filter((v) => !isUnusedExtra(doc, v.id));
  const cards = new Map(values.map((v) => [v.id, describeValueCard(doc, v.id, env)]));
  const stageOfFirstFill = (id: string) => {
    const first = fillSites(doc, id)[0];
    return first ? stageIdOf(doc, first.owner.id) : undefined;
  };
  return values.map((v) => {
    const card = cards.get(v.id)!;
    const factKind = facts?.values[v.id as ValueId]?.kind;
    const conflict = factKind && typeof factKind !== 'string' ? factKind.conflict : undefined;
    const laterWins = card.filled.length > 1 ? [t('values.card.later', { n: card.filled.length }), ...sameStageWords(doc, v.id)] : [];
    const sample = sampleOf(doc, { value: v.id as ValueId });
    const sameName = values
      .filter((o) => o.id !== v.id && norm(o.name) !== '' && norm(o.name) === norm(v.name))
      .map((o) => ({ id: o.id, filledAt: andList([...new Set(cards.get(o.id)!.filled.map((l) => l.stage || l.what))]) }));
    const stageId = stageOfFirstFill(v.id);
    return {
      id: v.id,
      name: v.name,
      kind: factKind,
      ...(conflict ? { conflict } : {}),
      filled: card.filled,
      used: card.used,
      laterWins,
      ...(sample ? { sample } : {}),
      ...(card.choices ? { choices: card.choices } : {}),
      sameName,
      ...(stageId ? { stageId } : {}),
    };
  });
}

/** True when the row matches the search text: its name, its kind or a stage it is filled at. */
export function rowMatches(row: ValueRow, query: string): boolean {
  const q = norm(query);
  if (!q) return true;
  const hay = [row.name, kindTitle(row.kind), ...row.filled.map((l) => l.stage)];
  return hay.some((h) => norm(h).includes(q));
}

export interface ValueGroup {
  /** The stage's ID, or '' for values nothing in a stage fills. */
  stageId: string;
  title: string;
  rows: ValueRow[];
}

/** The rows grouped by the stage that fills them, in the order of the stages; values filled nowhere last. */
export function groupByStage(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, rows: readonly ValueRow[]): ValueGroup[] {
  const groups: ValueGroup[] = [];
  for (const stage of doc.stages ?? []) {
    const inStage = rows.filter((r) => r.stageId === stage.id);
    if (inStage.length) groups.push({ stageId: stage.id, title: t('values.tab.groupStage', { stage: stage.name || t('describe.noName') }), rows: inStage });
  }
  const rest = rows.filter((r) => !r.stageId || !doc.stages.some((s) => s.id === r.stageId));
  if (rest.length) groups.push({ stageId: '', title: t('values.tab.groupNowhere'), rows: rest });
  return groups;
}

===\nfrontend/src/features/values/words.test.ts\n===
/**
 * Every word a person reads comes from src/words (F5), separators and list words too: none is
 * written into the components of this folder ("Domains list · always filled here" takes its " · "
 * from values.sep, a list of names its comma and "and" from values.comma and values.and).
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { andList } from './kinds';

const here = join(process.cwd(), 'src', 'features', 'values');
const sources = readdirSync(here).filter((f) => /\.tsx?$/.test(f) && !/\.test\.tsx?$/.test(f));

describe('values: no words outside src/words', () => {
  it.each(sources)('%s has no hard-coded separator', (file) => {
    const code = readFileSync(join(here, file), 'utf8')
      // Comments may quote what is on screen.
      .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '')
      .replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm, '$1');
    expect(code).not.toMatch(/['"`][^'"`\n]*[·›][^'"`\n]*['"`]/);
    // In JSX text: "<span> · {g.sub}</span>".
    expect(code).not.toMatch(/>[^<{}\n]*[·›]/);
    // A list said to a person (a key such as "user,group" is not said).
    expect(code).not.toMatch(/\.join\(\s*['"`], /);
  });

  it('lists of names are joined with the words', () => {
    expect(andList(['Domain approval'])).toBe('Domain approval');
    expect(andList(['Domain approval', 'Development'])).toBe('Domain approval and Development');
    expect(andList(['A', 'B', 'C'])).toBe('A, B and C');
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/NewWorkflowDialog.tsx\n===
import { useId, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useServices } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Dialog, DialogClose, Field, TextInput } from '@/ui';
import { markJustCreated } from './justCreated';

/**
 * "New workflow": asks only for a name, creates the workflow (authoring.createWorkflow, a blank
 * draft) and opens the editor on it. Give it a new `key` on each opening, so each opening starts empty.
 */
export function NewWorkflowDialog({ open, onOpenChange }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange(open: boolean): void }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const formId = useId();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<WordKey | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function create(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    const chosen = name.trim();
    if (!chosen) {
      setError('workflows.create.nameNeeded');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    let result;
    try {
      result = await services.authoring.createWorkflow({ name: chosen });
    } catch {
      result = null;
    }
    setBusy(false);
    if (result?.ok) {
      markJustCreated(result.value.workflow);
      onOpenChange(false);
      navigate(`/w/${encodeURIComponent(result.value.workflow)}`);
      return;
    }
    setError(result?.errors.some((x) => x.code === 'forbidden') ? 'workflows.create.forbidden' : 'workflows.create.failed');
  }

  return (
    <Dialog
      title={t('workflows.create.title')}
      description={t('workflows.create.lead')}
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
      width={460}
      footer={
        <>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="secondary">{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button variant="primary" type="submit" form={formId} aria-busy={busy || undefined}>
            {busy ? t('workflows.create.busy') : t('workflows.create.submit')}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form id={formId} onSubmit={(e) => void create(e)} noValidate>
        <Field label={t('workflows.create.name')} error={error ? t(error) : undefined}>
          <TextInput
            value={name}
            autoFocus
            autoComplete="off"
            maxLength={200}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setName(e.target.value);
              if (error) setError(null);
            }}
          />
        </Field>
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/OpenRequestsCard.tsx\n===
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { Status } from '@/contract';
import { useServices, type WorkflowSummary } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Card, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { howLong, useOpenRequests, type OpenRequest } from './openRequests';
import s from './workflows.module.css';

/** How many requests the card lists before "See all n requests". */
export const CARD_ROWS = 5;

/**
 * "Open requests in <workflow>", beside the list (mockup 12, workflows): the selected workflow's
 * open requests, stuck first, then the longest waiting; each opens the request's page.
 */
export function OpenRequestsCard({ summary, id }: { summary: WorkflowSummary; id: string }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const [state, retry] = useOpenRequests(services, summary.id, summary.liveVersion);
  const { name } = summary;
  const total = state.status === 'ready' ? state.requests.length : summary.openRequests;
  const allLink = `/requests?workflow=${encodeURIComponent(summary.id)}`;

  let body;
  if (state.status === 'loading') {
    body = (
      <p className={s.rcardNote} role="status">
        {t('workflows.requests.loading')}
      </p>
    );
  } else if (state.status === 'failed') {
    body = (
      <div className={s.rcardNote}>
        <p>{t('workflows.requests.failed')}</p>
        <Button size="sm" icon="undo" onClick={retry}>
          {t('workflows.retry')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  } else if (state.requests.length === 0) {
    body = <p className={s.rcardNote}>{t('workflows.requests.none')}</p>;
  } else {
    body = (
      <ul className={s.rlist}>
        {state.requests.slice(0, CARD_ROWS).map((r) => (
          <RequestLine key={r.row.requestId} request={r} workflowName={name} looksAfter={state.looksAfter} />
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card
      id={id}
      className={s.rcard}
      flush
      aria-label={t('workflows.requests.title', { name })}
      title={t('workflows.requests.title', { name })}
      sub={t('workflows.requests.sub', { n: total })}
    >
      {body}
      {state.status === 'ready' && state.requests.length > 0 && (
        <div className={s.rcardFoot}>
          <Link to={allLink} className={s.seeAll} aria-label={total === 1 ? t('workflows.requests.seeAllLabel.one', { name }) : t('workflows.requests.seeAllLabel', { n: total, name })}>
            {total === 1 ? t('workflows.requests.seeAll.one') : t('workflows.requests.seeAll', { n: total })}
            <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} />
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

function StatusPill({ status }: { status: Status | undefined }) {
  if (!status?.words) return null;
  return (
    <span className={`${s.pill} ${s[`st_${status.colour}`] ?? s.st_grey}`}>
      <span className={s.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
      {status.words}
    </span>
  );
}

function RequestLine({ request, workflowName, looksAfter }: { request: OpenRequest; workflowName: string; looksAfter: boolean }) {
  const { row, name, stage } = request;
  const stuck = row.stuck;
  return (
    <li className={stuck ? `${s.rline} ${s.rlineStuck}` : s.rline}>
      <Link to={`/requests/${encodeURIComponent(row.readableId)}`} className={s.rlink}>
        <span className={s.rname}>
          {name}
          <Icon name="chevron-right" size={15} />
        </span>
        <span className={s.rmeta}>
          {stuck ? (
            <>
              <span className={`${s.pill} ${s.stuckPill}`}>
                <Icon name="error" size={13} />
                {t('workflows.requests.stuck')}
              </span>
              <span>{t('workflows.requests.stuckAt', { stage, age: howLong(stuck.at) })}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <StatusPill status={row.status} />
              <span>{t('workflows.requests.at', { stage, age: howLong(row.updatedAt) })}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </span>
        {stuck && looksAfter && <span className={s.rwhy}>{t('workflows.requests.why', { name: workflowName })}</span>}
      </Link>
    </li>
  );
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/README.md\n===
# features/workflows

The workflows list, creating a workflow, its name, and saving the draft.

- `WorkflowsPage` (route `/`, `WorkflowsPage.tsx`): every workflow from `authoring.listWorkflows`, one table row each: name, description, "Also starts from <connection>" (the summary's `triggers`: the live version's, or the draft's before the first publish; labels from the catalogue), "Changed <when>, by <who>", the version ("Version n is live", "Draft (not live)", "changed since version n", "n to do before publishing", "n worth knowing"), the open count (a pressed/not pressed button that shows the workflow's open requests in the card beside the list), which versions they run on ("all on version 3", "on versions 2 and 3", from `listVersions`, asked only for a workflow with open requests), the stuck count linking to `/requests?workflow=<id>&stuck=true` (the `RequestQuery` name), who built it (Settings authors, by directory name) and Open (View, with a read-only line, for people without `may.edit`). Loading, failure (with Try again) and empty states. Data: `useWorkflowList.ts`. Drafts are not loaded; only `getSettings` is asked per row, for the authors.
- `OpenRequestsCard.tsx` (beside the list, mockup 12): "Open requests in <workflow>" for the selected row (`selectedRow`: the one whose open count was pressed, else most stuck, then most open), "n open · stuck first, then the longest waiting", up to `CARD_ROWS` requests (each named by its start form's first text question, its status in words and colour or "Stuck", "Stuck at <stage> · <how long>" or "At <stage> · <how long>", linking to `/requests/<number>`), "You see this because stuck requests in <workflow> go to you." on a stuck one when `listRefusedStarts({ workflow })` is not refused, and "See all n requests" (`/requests?workflow=<id>`). Data: `openRequests.ts` (`listRequests` with `state: 'open'`, `publishedSource` per version).
- `NewWorkflowDialog.tsx`: asks only for a name, `authoring.createWorkflow`, marks the workflow as just made (`justCreated.ts`) and opens `/w/<id>`. Once the editor has loaded it, `WorkflowName` reveals its start stage with part `name`, so the panel shows the start stage and its name field has the focus (mockup 02-build "empty").
- `WorkflowName` (top-bar slot, left): the name; click to rename in place with `renameWorkflow` (Enter saves, Escape cancels, leaving the box saves); refusals in words under the box. Name only for people without `may.settings`.
- `SaveStatus` (top-bar slot, before Settings): always in words: "All changes saved", "Saving ...", "Not saved yet", "Not saved. Trying again." (tries again every `SAVE_RETRY_MS` with `flushSave`). On a conflict: "Not saved." (read out with "A newer draft was saved.") and a short "Load the latest" button on one line; its dialog says who saved (you in another window, someone by name, or not known) and warns before it calls `reloadDraft`. A polite live region; it never takes focus by itself.
- `changed.ts`: `whenSaid` ("today, 09:40", "yesterday", "3 Nov") and `joinNames` (with the `workflows.join.*` words).
- Words: `src/words/workflows.ts`. Tests: `WorkflowsPage.test.tsx`, `TopBar.test.tsx`, and `tests/e2e/workflows.spec.ts`.
===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/SaveStatus.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { reloadDraft, useDirectoryLabel, useSaveFailure, useSaveState, useSessionWorkflowId } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Ref } from '@/services';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Button, Dialog, DialogClose, Icon } from '@/ui';
import { whenSaid } from './changed';
import s from './workflows.module.css';

/**
 * Top-bar slot, right before Settings: the autosave line (F9). "All changes saved", "Saving ...",
 * "Not saved yet"; after a failed save "Not saved. Trying again." (the session tries again on its
 * own every SAVE_RETRY_MS, see '@/model'); after a newer draft was saved elsewhere (by someone
 * else, or by the same person in another window), "Not saved." (read out with "A newer draft was
 * saved.") and a short "Load the latest" button, on one line that keeps the top bar to one row at
 * 1440px; its dialog says who saved, warns that unsaved changes
 * will be lost, and loads the latest draft. The words are always in sight and sit in a polite live
 * region; nothing here takes focus by itself.
 */
export function SaveStatus() {
  const state = useSaveState();
  const failure = useSaveFailure();
  const failed = failure !== null && state === 'unsaved';
  const conflict = state === 'conflict';
  const statusRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [reloadError, setReloadError] = useState(false);
  const focusStatus = useRef(false);
  const wasOpen = useRef(false);
  const conflictRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const statusId = useId();

  // When the dialog closes, focus goes back to the button that opened it; after the latest draft
  // is loaded that button is gone, so it goes to the save line instead of the page.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      wasOpen.current = true;
      return;
    }
    if (!wasOpen.current) return;
    wasOpen.current = false;
    const toStatus = focusStatus.current;
    focusStatus.current = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const target = toStatus || !conflictRef.current ? statusRef.current : conflictRef.current;
      target?.focus();
    }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [open]);

  // Who saved the newer draft is looked up when the conflict appears and again when the dialog
  // opens. The top bar's words are true whoever it was (someone else, or this person in another
  // window); the dialog says who, and never "someone else" when it was this person.
  const latest = useLatestSave(conflict, open);
  const who: 'me' | 'other' | 'unknown' = !latest ? 'unknown' : latest.byMe ? 'me' : 'other';
  const dialogText: Record<typeof who, WordKey> = {
    me: 'workflows.conflict.textYou',
    other: 'workflows.conflict.text',
    unknown: 'workflows.conflict.textUnknown',
  };

  let words: WordKey;
  if (conflict) words = 'workflows.conflict.said';
  else if (failed) words = 'workflows.saveFailed';
  else if (state === 'saving') words = 'workflows.saving';
  else if (state === 'unsaved') words = 'workflows.unsaved';
  else words = 'workflows.saved';

  const loadLatest = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setReloadError(false);
    let result;
    try {
      result = await reloadDraft();
    } catch {
      result = null;
    }
    setBusy(false);
    if (result?.ok) {
      focusStatus.current = true;
      setOpen(false);
    } else {
      setReloadError(true);
    }
  };


  return (
    <div className={s.save}>
      <span
        ref={statusRef}
        tabIndex={-1}
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        id={statusId}
        className={conflict ? s.saveConflict : failed ? `${s.saved} ${s.saveFailed}` : s.saved}
        title={conflict ? `${t(words)} ${t('workflows.conflict.why')}` : undefined}
      >
        {(failed || conflict) && <Icon name="warning" size={14} />}
        {t(words)}
        {conflict && ' '}
        {conflict && <span className="visually-hidden">{t('workflows.conflict.why')}</span>}
      </span>
      {conflict && (
        <button
          ref={conflictRef}
          type="button"
          className={s.conflict}
          aria-label={t('workflows.conflict.buttonLabel')}
          aria-describedby={statusId}
          aria-haspopup="dialog"
          onClick={() => {
            setReloadError(false);
            setOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          {t('workflows.conflict.button')}
        </button>
      )}
      <Dialog
        title={t('workflows.conflict.title')}
        description={t(dialogText[who])}
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(next) => {
          if (!busy) setOpen(next);
        }}
        width={460}
        footer={
          <>
            <DialogClose asChild>
              <Button variant="secondary">{t('workflows.conflict.keep')}</Button>
            </DialogClose>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => void loadLatest()} aria-busy={busy || undefined}>
              {busy ? t('workflows.conflict.busy') : t('workflows.conflict.confirm')}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {latest && <LatestSaveLine latest={latest} />}
        <p className={s.dialogNote}>{t('workflows.conflict.notNow')}</p>
        {reloadError && (
          <p className={s.dialogError} role="alert">
            <Icon name="error" size={14} />
            {t('workflows.conflict.failed')}
          </p>
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

interface LatestSave {
  savedBy: Ref;
  savedAt: string;
  byMe: boolean;
}

/**
 * Who saved the server's draft, and when: looked up when the conflict appears and again each time
 * the dialog opens (the draft may have been saved again since). Null until known.
 */
function useLatestSave(active: boolean, open: boolean): LatestSave | null {
  const services = useServices();
  const workflowId = useSessionWorkflowId();
  const [latest, setLatest] = useState<LatestSave | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if ((!active && !open) || !workflowId) return;
    let live = true;
    void Promise.all([
      services.authoring.getDraft(workflowId).catch(() => null),
      services.session.whoAmI().catch(() => null),
    ]).then(([draft, me]) => {
      if (!live || !draft?.ok) return;
      const { savedBy, savedAt } = draft.value;
      const ref = me?.ref;
      setLatest({ savedBy, savedAt, byMe: !!ref && ref.type === savedBy.type && ref.id === savedBy.id });
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [active, open, workflowId, services]);
  return active || open ? latest : null;
}

/** "Hannah Okafor saved it today, 10:12." */
function LatestSaveLine({ latest }: { latest: LatestSave }) {
  const label = useDirectoryLabel(latest.savedBy);
  const said = whenSaid(latest.savedAt);
  // "today, 09:40" and "yesterday" read as they are; a date reads "on 9 Nov".
  const when = /^\d/.test(said) ? t('workflows.conflict.on', { date: said }) : said;
  let words;
  if (latest.byMe) words = t('workflows.conflict.byYou', { when });
  else if (label) words = t('workflows.conflict.by', { who: label, when });
  else words = t('workflows.conflict.byNoName', { when });
  return <p className={s.dialogWho}>{words}</p>;
}
