===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/WorkflowName.tsx\n===
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { renameWorkflow, useMay, useSettings } from '@/model';
import { t, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { Icon, Tooltip } from '@/ui';
import { useShowStartWhenJustCreated } from './justCreated';
import s from './workflows.module.css';

/**
 * Top-bar slot, left: the workflow's name. Click it to rename in place (the Settings record, with
 * renameWorkflow; not undoable): Enter saves, Escape cancels, leaving the box saves. A refusal is
 * said in words under the box, which stays open. People who may not change Settings see the name only.
 * It also opens a workflow just made with "New workflow" on its start stage (see justCreated.ts).
 */
/** How many characters of the name the top bar shows before it is cut with "…" (review fix2-app n1). */
const NAME_SHOWN = 28;

export function WorkflowName() {
  const name = useSettings()?.name ?? '';
  const mayRename = useMay().settings;
  const shown = name || t('workflows.untitled');

  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(name);
  const [error, setError] = useState<WordKey | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  /** Put focus back on the name when the box closes from the keyboard (not when the person clicked away). */
  const refocus = useRef(false);
  const errorId = useId();
  const keysId = useId();
  useShowStartWhenJustCreated();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing && refocus.current) {
      refocus.current = false;
      buttonRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing) inputRef.current?.select();
  }, [editing]);

  if (!mayRename) return <div className={s.name}>{shown}</div>;

  const start = () => {
    setText(name);
    setError(null);
    setEditing(true);
  };

  const close = (returnFocus: boolean) => {
    refocus.current = returnFocus;
    setError(null);
    setEditing(false);
  };

  const commit = async (returnFocus: boolean) => {
    if (busy) return;
    const next = text.trim();
    if (!next) {
      setError('workflows.rename.nameNeeded');
      return;
    }
    if (next === name) {
      close(returnFocus);
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    let result;
    try {
      result = await renameWorkflow(next);
    } catch {
      result = null;
    }
    setBusy(false);
    if (result?.ok) {
      close(returnFocus);
      return;
    }
    setError(result?.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'forbidden') ? 'workflows.rename.forbidden' : 'workflows.rename.failed');
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      void commit(true);
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      close(true);
    }
  };

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <div className={s.nameEdit}>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          className={s.nameInput}
          value={text}
          aria-label={t('workflows.rename.input')}
          aria-describedby={[keysId, error ? errorId : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          aria-busy={busy || undefined}
          maxLength={200}
          size={Math.max(12, Math.min(40, text.length + 2))}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setText(e.target.value);
            if (error) setError(null);
          }}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          onBlur={() => {
            // Leaving the box keeps what was typed; an unchanged name just closes.
            if (!busy && !error) void commit(false);
          }}
          autoFocus
        />
        <span id={keysId} className="visually-hidden">
          {t('workflows.rename.keys')}
        </span>
        {(error || busy) && (
          <div className={error ? s.nameError : s.nameBusy} id={error ? errorId : undefined} role={error ? 'alert' : 'status'}>
            {error && <Icon name="error" size={14} />}
            {t(error ?? 'workflows.rename.busy')}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // The top bar shows at most 28 characters of the name; the whole name is in the tooltip and the accessible name.
  const cut = shown.length > NAME_SHOWN ? t('workflows.name.cut', { name: shown.slice(0, NAME_SHOWN).trimEnd() }) : shown;
  return (
    <Tooltip
      content={
        cut === shown ? (
          t('workflows.rename.tip')
        ) : (
          <>
            {shown}
            <br />
            {t('workflows.rename.tip')}
          </>
        )
      }
    >
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        className={s.nameButton}
        aria-label={t('workflows.rename.button', { name: shown })}
        onClick={start}
      >
        <span className={s.nameText}>{cut}</span>
        <Icon name="edit" size={14} />
      </button>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider, type RequestRow, type Services, type VersionSummary } from '@/services';

function renderList(services: Services) {
  return render(
    <ServicesProvider services={services}>
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/']}>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/" element={<WorkflowsPage />} />
          <Route path="/w/:workflowId" element={<EditorStandIn />} />

const rowOf = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('link', { name }).closest('tr') as HTMLElement;

describe('the workflows list', () => {
  it('shows the three seeded workflows, newest first, with their version, To do and builders', async () => {
    const { services } = createStandinServices();
    const listed = await services.authoring.listWorkflows();
    if (!listed.ok) throw new Error('the stand-in should list its workflows');
    const getDraft = vi.spyOn(services.authoring, 'getDraft');
    renderList(services);

    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Loading the workflows ...');
    const table = await screen.findByRole('table', { name: 'Your workflows' });
    for (const col of ['Workflow', 'Version', 'Open requests', 'Built by']) {
      expect(within(table).getByRole('columnheader', { name: col })).toBeInTheDocument();
    }
    const names = within(table)
      .getAllByRole('row')
      .slice(1)
      .map((tr) => within(tr).getAllByRole('link')[0]?.textContent);
    expect(names).toEqual(listed.value.map((w) => w.name));
    expect(names).toHaveLength(3);

    // Change request: version 3 is live and the draft is the same as it.
    const demo = rowOf('Change request');
    expect(within(demo).getByText('Version 3 is live')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(demo).queryByText('Draft (not live)')).toBeNull();
    const demoSummary = listed.value.find((w) => w.id === 'change-request')!;
    expect(within(demo).getByText(demoSummary.description || 'No description yet.')).toBeInTheDocument();

    // The integrated sample is published as version 1 (the stand-in seed since Draft 3), and Helpdesk can also start its requests.
    const integrated = rowOf('Service change');
    expect(within(integrated).getByText('Version 1 is live')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(integrated).getByText('Also starts from Helpdesk')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Live, with no sample requests in this store: "None open" (never "None yet", which is for a workflow never published).
    expect(within(integrated).getByText('None open')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(demo).queryByText(/Also starts from/)).toBeNull();

    // To do counts in words, only when above zero.
    for (const w of listed.value) {
      const row = rowOf(w.name);
      if (w.draft.todo > 0) expect(within(row).getByText(`${w.draft.todo} to do before publishing`)).toBeInTheDocument();
      else expect(within(row).queryByText(/to do before publishing/)).toBeNull();
    }

    // Last saved, by whom ("you": Sam Carter is signed in), and who built it, by name.
    expect(within(demo).getByText(/^Changed .+, by you$/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(demo).getByText('Sam Carter')).toBeInTheDocument());

    expect(within(demo).getByRole('link', { name: 'Open Change request' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/w/change-request');
    // Everything comes from the Draft 3 summary: no draft is loaded to draw the list.
    expect(getDraft).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

    expect(whenSaid(new Date(2026, 10, 14, 18, 0).toISOString(), now)).toBe('yesterday');
    expect(whenSaid(new Date(2026, 10, 3, 8, 0).toISOString(), now)).toBe('3 Nov');
    expect(whenSaid(new Date(2025, 10, 3, 8, 0).toISOString(), now)).toBe('3 Nov 2025');
  });

  it('says which versions the open requests run on', () => {
    expect(onVersionsWords([3])).toBe('all on version 3');
    expect(onVersionsWords([2, 3])).toBe('on versions 2 and 3');
    expect(onVersionsWords(undefined)).toBe('');
    expect(versionsWithOpen([
      { version: 3, openRequests: 4 },
      { version: 2, openRequests: 0 },
      { version: 1, openRequests: 1 },
    ] as VersionSummary[])).toEqual([1, 3]);
  });

  it('orders open requests stuck first (longest stuck first), then the longest waiting', () => {
    const row = (id: string, updatedAt: string, stuckAt?: string) =>
      ({ requestId: id, updatedAt, ...(stuckAt ? { stuck: { reason: 'action-failed', at: stuckAt } } : {}) }) as RequestRow;
    const rows = [
      row('new', '2026-11-14T10:00:00Z'),
      row('stuck-late', '2026-11-01T10:00:00Z', '2026-11-14T09:00:00Z'),
      row('old', '2026-11-02T10:00:00Z'),
      row('stuck-early', '2026-11-13T10:00:00Z', '2026-11-10T09:00:00Z'),
    ];
    expect([...rows].sort(byStuckThenWaiting).map((r) => r.requestId)).toEqual(['stuck-early', 'stuck-late', 'old', 'new']);
  });

  it('picks the workflow for the card: the one pressed, else most stuck, then most open, then first', () => {
    const r = (id: string, open: number, stuck: number) => ({ summary: { id, openRequests: open, stuckRequests: stuck }, startsFrom: [] }) as unknown as WorkflowRow;
    const rows = [r('a', 0, 0), r('b', 5, 0), r('c', 2, 1), r('d', 3, 1)];
    expect(selectedRow(rows, null)?.summary.id).toBe('d');
    expect(selectedRow(rows, 'b')?.summary.id).toBe('b');
    // A workflow with nothing open cannot be picked.
    expect(selectedRow(rows, 'a')?.summary.id).toBe('d');
    expect(selectedRow([r('a', 0, 0), r('b', 2, 0), r('c', 2, 0)], null)?.summary.id).toBe('b');
    expect(selectedRow([r('a', 0, 0)], null)).toBeUndefined();
  });

    expect(joinNames(['Helpdesk', 'Jira', 'Deploy'])).toBe('Helpdesk, Jira and Deploy');

  it('names each connection once, from the catalogue, and skips what it does not know', async () => {

      'Helpdesk',
    ]);
    expect(startsFromLabels(['helpdesk.ticketCreated@1'], null)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

import { useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useDirectoryLabel } from '@/model';
import { useServices, type Ref, type WorkflowSummary } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { Button, Card, EmptyState, Icon, Page, TextInput, buttonClass } from '@/ui';
import { joinNames, whenSaid } from './changed';
import { NewWorkflowDialog } from './NewWorkflowDialog';
import { OpenRequestsCard } from './OpenRequestsCard';
import { matchesSearch, useWorkflowList, type WorkflowRow } from './useWorkflowList';
import s from './workflows.module.css';

/** Route "/": every workflow the signed-in person built or helps build, one line each (mockup 12). */
export function WorkflowsPage() {
  const services = useServices();
  const [state, retry] = useWorkflowList(services);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [openings, setOpenings] = useState(0);
  /** The button that opened New workflow: focus goes back to it when the dialog closes. */
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const countId = useId();
  const cardId = useId();
  /** The workflow whose open requests the card beside the list shows, when the person picked one. */
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const onDialogOpenChange = (open: boolean) => {
    setCreating(open);
    if (!open) setTimeout(() => opener.current?.isConnected && opener.current.focus(), 0);
  };

  const newButton = (
    <Button
      variant="primary"
      icon="plus"
      onClick={(e) => {
        opener.current = e.currentTarget;
        setOpenings((n) => n + 1);
        setCreating(true);
      }}
    >
      {t('workflows.new')}
    </Button>
  );

  const shown = state.status === 'ready' ? state.rows.filter((row) => matchesSearch(row, search)) : [];
  const searching = search.trim() !== '';
  const hasRows = state.status === 'ready' && state.rows.length > 0;
  const searchBox = hasRows && (
    <div className={s.search} role="search">
      <Icon name="search" size={15} />
      <TextInput
        ref={searchRef}
        type="search"
        className={s.searchInput}
        aria-label={t('workflows.search.label')}
        aria-describedby={searching ? countId : undefined}
        placeholder={t('workflows.search.label')}
        value={search}
        onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && search) {
            e.preventDefault();
            setSearch('');
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );

  let body;
  if (state.status === 'loading') {
    body = (
      <Card>
        <p className={s.loading} role="status">
          {t('workflows.loading')}
        </p>
      </Card>
    );
  } else if (state.status === 'failed') {
    body = (
      <Card>
        <EmptyState
          icon="warning"
          title={t('workflows.failed.title')}
          action={
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={retry}>
              {t('workflows.retry')}
            </Button>
          }
        >
          {t('workflows.failed.text')}
        </EmptyState>
      </Card>
    );
  } else if (state.rows.length === 0) {
    body = (
      <Card>
        <EmptyState icon="workflow" title={t('workflows.empty.title')} action={newButton}>
          {t('workflows.empty.text')}
        </EmptyState>
      </Card>
    );
  } else if (shown.length === 0) {
    body = (
      <Card>
        <EmptyState
          icon="search"
          title={t('workflows.search.none', { text: search.trim() })}
          action={
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearch('');
                searchRef.current?.focus();
              }}
            >
              {t('workflows.search.clear')}
            </Button>
          }
        >
          {t('workflows.search.noneText')}
        </EmptyState>
      </Card>
    );
  } else {
    const selected = selectedRow(shown, chosen);
    body = (
      <div className={selected ? s.lgrid : undefined}>
        <Card flush>
          <table className={s.table} aria-label={t('workflows.listLabel')}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">{t('workflows.col.workflow')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('workflows.col.version')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('workflows.col.requests')}</th>
                <th scope="col">{t('workflows.col.builtBy')}</th>
                <th scope="col">
                  <span className="visually-hidden">{t('workflows.col.open')}</span>
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {shown.map((row) => (
                <Row key={row.summary.id} row={row} me={state.me} selected={row === selected} onSelect={setChosen} cardId={cardId} />
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </Card>
        {/* The selected workflow's open requests, beside the list (mockup 12). */}
        {selected && <OpenRequestsCard key={selected.summary.id} summary={selected.summary} id={cardId} />}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Page
      title={t('workflows.title')}
      lead={t('workflows.lead')}
      actions={
        <>
          {searchBox}
          {newButton}
        </>
      }
    >
      {/* How many rows the search leaves, said politely to screen readers as it changes. */}
      <p id={countId} className="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">
        {searching && state.status === 'ready'
          ? shown.length === 1
            ? t('workflows.search.count.one')
            : t('workflows.search.count.many', { n: shown.length })
          : ''}
      </p>
      {body}
      {/* A new key on each opening starts the dialog empty; it stays mounted so focus returns to the button. */}
      <NewWorkflowDialog key={openings} open={creating} onOpenChange={onDialogOpenChange} />
    </Page>
  );
}

/**
 * The row whose open requests the card shows: the one the person picked, if it is shown and has
 * open requests; else the one that most needs looking at (most stuck, then most open, then the
 * first in the list); none when no shown workflow has open requests.
 */
export function selectedRow(rows: readonly WorkflowRow[], chosen: string | null): WorkflowRow | undefined {
  const withOpen = rows.filter((r) => r.summary.openRequests > 0);
  const picked = chosen === null ? undefined : withOpen.find((r) => r.summary.id === chosen);
  if (picked) return picked;
  let best: WorkflowRow | undefined;
  for (const r of withOpen) {
    const b = best?.summary;
    if (!b || r.summary.stuckRequests > b.stuckRequests || (r.summary.stuckRequests === b.stuckRequests && r.summary.openRequests > b.openRequests)) best = r;
  }
  return best;
}

interface RowProps {
  row: WorkflowRow;
  me: Ref | null;
  /** Its open requests are in the card beside the list. */
  selected: boolean;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  cardId: string;
}

function Row({ row, me, selected, onSelect, cardId }: RowProps) {
  const w = row.summary;
  const path = `/w/${encodeURIComponent(w.id)}`;
  const mayEdit = w.may.edit;
  return (
    <tr className={selected ? s.selected : undefined}>
      <td className={s.wfCell}>
        <div className={s.wf}>
          <span className={s.wfIcon} aria-hidden="true">
            <Icon name="workflow" size={16} />
          </span>
          <div className={s.wfText}>
            <Link to={path} className={s.wfName}>
              {w.name}
            </Link>
            <p className={s.wfDesc}>{w.description || t('workflows.noDescription')}</p>
            {row.startsFrom.length > 0 && (
              <p className={s.wfStarts}>
                <Icon name="connected" size={14} />
                {t('workflows.alsoStarts', { connections: joinNames(row.startsFrom) })}
              </p>
            )}
            <Changed summary={w} me={me} />
            {!mayEdit && (
              <p className={s.readOnly}>
                <Icon name="lock" size={14} />
                {t('workflows.readOnly')}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td>
        <VersionCell summary={w} />
      </td>
      <td>
        <RequestsCell row={row} selected={selected} onSelect={onSelect} cardId={cardId} />
      </td>
      <td>
        <ul className={s.people}>
          {(row.authors ?? []).map((ref) => (
            <li key={`${ref.type}:${ref.id}`}>
              <PersonName personRef={ref} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </td>
      <td className={s.openCell}>
        <Link
          to={path}
          className={buttonClass('secondary', 'sm')}
          aria-label={t(mayEdit ? 'workflows.openLabel' : 'workflows.viewLabel', { name: w.name })}
        >
          {t(mayEdit ? 'workflows.open' : 'workflows.view')}
        </Link>
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}

/** "Changed today, 09:40, by you" */
function Changed({ summary, me }: { summary: WorkflowSummary; me: Ref | null }) {
  const by = summary.draft.savedBy;
  const label = useDirectoryLabel(by);
  const isMe = me !== null && me.type === by.type && me.id === by.id;
  const who = isMe ? t('workflows.you') : label;
  const when = whenSaid(summary.draft.savedAt);
  return (
    <p className={s.changed}>{who ? t('workflows.changed', { when, who }) : t('workflows.changedNoWho', { when })}</p>
  );
}

function VersionCell({ summary }: { summary: WorkflowSummary }) {
  const live = summary.liveVersion;
  const showDraft = live === undefined || summary.draft.changedSinceLive;
  const { todo, worthKnowing } = summary.draft;
  return (
    <div className={s.version}>
      {live !== undefined && (
        <span className={`${s.badge} ${s.live}`}>
          <Icon name="check" size={13} />
          {t('version.live', { n: live })}
        </span>
      )}
      {showDraft && (
        <span className={`${s.badge} ${s.draft}`}>
          <Icon name="edit" size={13} />
          {t('version.draft')}
        </span>
      )}
      {live !== undefined && summary.draft.changedSinceLive && (
        <span className={s.small}>{t('workflows.changedSince', { n: live })}</span>
      )}
      {todo > 0 && (
        <span className={s.todo}>
          <Icon name="todo" size={13} />
          {t('workflows.todo', { n: todo })}
        </span>
      )}
      {worthKnowing > 0 && (
        <span className={s.worth}>
          <Icon name="info" size={13} />
          {t('workflows.worthKnowing', { n: worthKnowing })}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** "all on version 3", "on versions 2 and 3"; nothing when the versions are not known. */
export function onVersionsWords(openOn: readonly number[] | undefined): string {
  if (!openOn || openOn.length === 0) return '';
  if (openOn.length === 1) return t('workflows.onVersion', { n: openOn[0] ?? '' });
  return t('workflows.onVersions', { list: joinNames(openOn.map(String)) });
}

function RequestsCell({ row, selected, onSelect, cardId }: { row: WorkflowRow; selected: boolean; onSelect: (id: string) => void; cardId: string }) {
  const { summary } = row;
  const { openRequests: open, stuckRequests: stuck, name, id } = summary;
  if (open === 0 && stuck === 0) {
    return <span className={s.none}>{t(summary.liveVersion === undefined ? 'workflows.noneYet' : 'workflows.noneOpen')}</span>;
  }
  const query = `workflow=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
  const versions = onVersionsWords(row.openOn);
  const label = open === 1 ? t('workflows.show.label.one', { name }) : t('workflows.show.label.many', { n: open, name });
  return (
    <div className={s.counts}>
      {open > 0 ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={s.openButton}
          aria-pressed={selected}
          aria-controls={selected ? cardId : undefined}
          aria-label={label}
          title={label}
          onClick={() => onSelect(id)}
        >
          {t('workflows.openCount', { n: open })}
        </button>
      ) : (
        <span>{t('workflows.openCount', { n: open })}</span>
      )}
      {versions && <span className={s.small}>{versions}</span>}
      {stuck > 0 && (
        <Link
          to={`/requests?${query}&stuck=true`}
          className={s.stuckLink}
          aria-label={stuck === 1 ? t('workflows.stuckCount.label.one', { name }) : t('workflows.stuckCount.label.many', { n: stuck, name })}
        >
          <Icon name="error" size={13} />
          {t('workflows.stuckCount', { n: stuck })}
        </Link>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const initials = (label: string) =>
  label
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/** A person or group from the directory, by name, with a small initials badge (decoration only). */
function PersonName({ personRef }: { personRef: Ref }) {
  const label = useDirectoryLabel(personRef);
  if (!label) return null;
  return (
    <span className={s.person}>
      <span className={s.avatar} aria-hidden="true">
        {personRef.type === 'group' ? <Icon name="group" size={12} /> : initials(label)}
      </span>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Words for the workflows list that are worked out, not looked up: when a draft was last saved
 * ("today, 09:40", "yesterday", "3 Nov", "3 Nov 2025") and a list of names joined with "and".
 */
import { t } from '@/words';

const sameDay = (a: Date, b: Date) =>
  a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();

/** When `savedAt` was, said from `now` (local time): "today, 09:40", "yesterday", "3 Nov", or "3 Nov 2025" in another year. */
export function whenSaid(savedAt: string, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const at = new Date(savedAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(at.getTime())) return '';
  if (sameDay(at, now)) {
    const time = at.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    return t('workflows.when.today', { time });
  }
  const yesterday = new Date(now);
  yesterday.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
  if (sameDay(at, yesterday)) return t('workflows.when.yesterday');
  const options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions =
    at.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() ? { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' } : { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' };
  return at.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', options);
}

/** "Helpdesk", "Helpdesk and Jira", "Helpdesk, Jira and Deploy". */
export function joinNames(names: readonly string[]): string {
  if (names.length === 0) return '';
  if (names.length === 1) return names[0] ?? '';
  if (names.length === 2) return t('workflows.join.two', { a: names[0] ?? '', b: names[1] ?? '' });
  return t('workflows.join.last', { list: names.slice(0, -1).join(t('workflows.join.comma')), last: names[names.length - 1] ?? '' });
}

/**
 * A workflow just made with "New workflow": the editor opens on it with its start stage chosen and
 * the stage's name ready to change (mockup 02-build "empty"), so a keyboard user does not start
 * again from the top of the page. NewWorkflowDialog marks the workflow before it navigates; the
 * editor's top-bar name (always mounted in the editor) takes the mark once the draft is loaded.
 */
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { reveal, useEditor } from '@/model';

let pending: string | null = null;

/** Marks `workflowId` as just made: the next time the editor loads it, its start stage is shown. */
export function markJustCreated(workflowId: string): void {
  pending = workflowId;
}

/** For tests. */
export function pendingJustCreated(): string | null {
  return pending;
}

/** Once the workflow marked as just made is loaded in the editor, chooses its start stage (once). */
export function useShowStartWhenJustCreated(): void {
  const loadedId = useEditor((s) => (s.doc ? s.workflowId : null));
  const start = useEditor((s) => s.doc?.start.stage ?? null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pending || !loadedId || !start || loadedId !== pending) return;
    pending = null;
    // The name of the start stage takes the focus in the panel (as for a stage just added).
    reveal({ item: start, part: 'name' });
  }, [loadedId, start]);
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/openRequests.ts\n===
/**
 * What the "Open requests in <workflow>" card beside the list shows (mockup 12, workflows): the
 * workflow's open requests, stuck first (longest stuck first), then the longest waiting (oldest
 * last change first); each named by its start form's first text question, at its stage, with how
 * long; and whether the signed-in person looks after the workflow's stuck requests (asked the
 * server's own way: `listRefusedStarts({ workflow })` is refused `not-admin` otherwise).
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import { getStage, requestTitle, requestTitleValues, stageOf } from '@/model';
import type { RequestRow, Services, ServerWorkflowId, Timestamp } from '@/services';
import { t } from '@/words';

export interface OpenRequest {
  row: RequestRow;
  /** The request's title by the model's rule (`requestTitle`), else "Request 1042". */
  name: string;
  /** The stage it is at now, or the stage it is stuck at. */
  stage: string;
}

export type OpenRequestsState =
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'failed' }
  | { status: 'ready'; requests: OpenRequest[]; looksAfter: boolean };

function stageName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | undefined, location: Location | undefined): string {
  const stage = doc && location ? (getStage(doc, location.item) ?? stageOf(doc, location.item)) : undefined;
  return stage?.name || t('describe.noName');
}

const time = (at: Timestamp | undefined) => (at ? new Date(at).getTime() : 0);

/** Stuck first (longest stuck first), then the longest waiting (oldest last change first). */
export function byStuckThenWaiting(a: RequestRow, b: RequestRow): number {
  if (!!a.stuck !== !!b.stuck) return a.stuck ? -1 : 1;
  if (a.stuck && b.stuck) return time(a.stuck.at) - time(b.stuck.at);
  return time(a.updatedAt) - time(b.updatedAt);
}

async function sourceOf(services: Services, workflow: ServerWorkflowId, version: number): Promise<AuthoredWorkflow | undefined> {
  const r = await services.runtime.publishedSource({ workflow, version }).catch(() => undefined);
  return r?.ok ? r.value.authored : undefined;
}

export async function loadOpenRequests(services: Services, workflow: ServerWorkflowId, liveVersion: number | undefined): Promise<OpenRequestsState> {
  try {
    const docs = new Map<number, AuthoredWorkflow | undefined>();
    if (liveVersion !== undefined) docs.set(liveVersion, await sourceOf(services, workflow, liveVersion));
    const live = liveVersion !== undefined ? docs.get(liveVersion) : undefined;
    const include = live ? requestTitleValues(live).slice(0, 10) : [];
    const [listed, refused] = await Promise.all([
      services.runtime.listRequests({ workflow, state: 'open', limit: 200, ...(include.length ? { include } : {}) }),
      services.runtime.listRefusedStarts({ workflow, limit: 1 }).catch(() => undefined),
    ]);
    if (!listed.ok) return { status: 'failed' };
    const rows = listed.value.items.filter((r) => !r.closedAt);
    for (const version of new Set(rows.map((r) => r.version))) {
      if (!docs.has(version)) docs.set(version, await sourceOf(services, workflow, version));
    }
    const requests = [...rows].sort(byStuckThenWaiting).map((row): OpenRequest => {
      const doc = docs.get(row.version);
      return {
        row,
        name: requestTitle(doc, row.values, t('workflows.requests.numbered', { n: row.readableId })),
        stage: stageName(doc, row.stuck?.location ?? row.stage),
      };
    });
    return { status: 'ready', requests, looksAfter: !!refused?.ok };
  } catch {
    return { status: 'failed' };
  }
}

/** The card's state for one workflow, and a function that loads it again. */
export function useOpenRequests(
  services: Services,
  workflow: ServerWorkflowId,
  liveVersion: number | undefined,
): [OpenRequestsState, () => void] {
  const [got, setGot] = useState<{ key: string; state: OpenRequestsState } | null>(null);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const key = `${workflow}@${liveVersion ?? ''}#${attempt}`;
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void loadOpenRequests(services, workflow, liveVersion).then((state) => {
      if (live) setGot({ key, state });
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, workflow, liveVersion, key]);
  const retry = useCallback(() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1), []);
  return [got && got.key === key ? got.state : { status: 'loading' }, retry];
}

/** How long, roughly: "5 minutes", "2 hours", "3 days". */
export function howLong(at: Timestamp, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.round((now.getTime() - new Date(at).getTime()) / 60000));
  if (minutes < 60) return t(minutes === 1 ? 'workflows.age.minute' : 'workflows.age.minutes', { n: minutes });
  const hours = Math.round(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return t(hours === 1 ? 'workflows.age.hour' : 'workflows.age.hours', { n: hours });
  const days = Math.round(hours / 24);
  return t(days === 1 ? 'workflows.age.day' : 'workflows.age.days', { n: days });
}
===\nfrontend/src/features/workflows/useWorkflowList.ts\n===
/**
 * Loads what the workflows list shows: the rows (authoring.listWorkflows, Draft 3 WorkflowSummary:
 * versions, To do and Worth knowing counts, open and stuck request counts, the triggers of its
 * "Starts when" bindings, may), who is signed in (for "by you"), and the catalogue (which names the
 * connections the triggers belong to; it is data). Drafts are not loaded. Who built each workflow
 * is not in the summary, so its Settings are asked per workflow; nor are the versions its open
 * requests run on, so `listVersions` is asked for a workflow with open requests. A row whose
 * Settings or versions cannot be loaded is still shown, without them.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { Catalogue } from '@/contract';
import type { Ref, Services, VersionSummary, WorkflowSummary } from '@/services';

export interface WorkflowRow {
  summary: WorkflowSummary;
  /** The people and groups who built it (Settings authors), or undefined when not known. */
  authors?: Ref[];
  /** The labels of the connections that can also start its requests, each once, in document order. */
  startsFrom: string[];
  /** The versions its open requests run on, lowest first; undefined when not known (or none are open). */
  openOn?: number[];
}

export type ListState =
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'failed' }
  | { status: 'ready'; rows: WorkflowRow[]; me: Ref | null };

/** The connection labels of a draft's Starts when entries (unknown connections are left out). */
export function startsFromLabels(triggers: readonly (string | undefined)[], catalogue: Catalogue | null): string[] {
  if (!catalogue) return [];
  const labels: string[] = [];
  for (const ref of triggers) {
    if (!ref) continue;
    const entry = catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === ref);
    const label = entry && catalogue.connections.find((c) => c.id === entry.connection)?.label;
    if (label && !labels.includes(label)) labels.push(label);
  }
  return labels;
}

/**
 * Whether a row is kept by what the person typed in the search box: every word must appear,
 * in any case, in the name, the description or a connection it also starts from. Empty: all rows.
 */
export function matchesSearch(row: WorkflowRow, search: string): boolean {
  const words = search.toLocaleLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return true;
  const text = [row.summary.name, row.summary.description, ...row.startsFrom].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase();
  return words.every((w) => text.includes(w));
}

/**
 * The triggers that start this workflow's requests: the live version's when there is one (what
 * really starts requests today), else the draft's (what will, once published).
 */
export function startingTriggers(summary: WorkflowSummary): readonly string[] {
  return summary.liveVersion !== undefined ? summary.triggers.live : summary.triggers.draft;
}

async function details(services: Services, summary: WorkflowSummary, catalogue: Catalogue | null): Promise<WorkflowRow> {
  const [settings, versions] = await Promise.all([
    services.authoring.getSettings(summary.id).catch(() => undefined),
    summary.openRequests > 0 ? services.authoring.listVersions(summary.id).catch(() => undefined) : undefined,
  ]);
  const authors = settings?.ok ? settings.value.authors : undefined;
  const openOn = versions?.ok ? versionsWithOpen(versions.value) : undefined;
  return {
    summary,
    ...(authors ? { authors } : {}),
    startsFrom: startsFromLabels(startingTriggers(summary), catalogue),
    ...(openOn && openOn.length > 0 ? { openOn } : {}),
  };
}

/** The versions that have open requests, lowest first. */
export function versionsWithOpen(versions: readonly VersionSummary[]): number[] {
  return versions
    .filter((v) => v.openRequests > 0)
    .map((v) => v.version)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

export async function loadWorkflowList(services: Services): Promise<ListState> {
  try {
    const [list, me, catalogue] = await Promise.all([
      services.authoring.listWorkflows(),
      services.session.whoAmI().catch(() => null),
      services.catalogue.getCatalogue().catch(() => null),
    ]);
    if (!list.ok) return { status: 'failed' };
    const cat = catalogue?.ok ? catalogue.value : null;
    const rows = await Promise.all(list.value.map((summary) => details(services, summary, cat)));
    return { status: 'ready', rows, me: me?.ref ?? null };
  } catch {
    return { status: 'failed' };
  }
}

/** The list's state, and a function that loads it again (for "Try again"). */
export function useWorkflowList(services: Services): [ListState, () => void] {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ListState>({ status: 'loading' });
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void loadWorkflowList(services).then((next) => {
      if (live) setState(next);
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [services, attempt]);
  const retry = useCallback(() => {
    setState({ status: 'loading' });
    setAttempt((n) => n + 1);
  }, []);
  return [state, retry];
}

===\nfrontend/src/model/README.md\n===
# model

The one document and everything derived from it (docs/08-frontend-design.md, F2 and F3), and the slots through which features show each other's parts.

- `store.ts`: one zustand store (`useEditor`) holding the draft (authored workflow format), its revision and save state, the selection, and undo/redo. Edit only with `run(name, args)`; autosave is wired by the app through `onDocChange` and reported back with `setSaveState`.
- `commands/`: named, pure edits on an immer draft. `registry.ts` merges the groups and has `applyCommand`; `types.ts` says how a group is declared. Groups: `stages`, `arrows`, `tasks`, `buttons` (here), and `forms`, `values`, `lists`, `sample`, `actions`, `start`, `statuses`, `told`, `diagram` (filled in by the builders of those features). `removal.ts` is the shared tidy-up after a delete.
- Derivations, never stored: `lookup.ts` (items by ID, parents, typed getters), `walk.ts` (every expression slot, every reference, fill sites, "Used in N places"), `graph.ts` (Reached from, order from the start), `presets.ts` (what each kind of stage starts with), `ids.ts` (new IDs), `invariants.ts` (structural rules, for tests), `form-order.ts` (`laterAnswersAt`: the answers a form's "Show when" may not read, its own and later ones, which core's `valuesInScope` lists).
- `testkit.ts`: `fixture`, `step` (apply a command and check the structural rules) for tests.
- `describe/`: the sentences about the document (arrows, actions, who is asked, locations, findings), from `src/words/describe.ts` and `src/words/findings.ts`. Shared by several screens so they never word one thing two ways: `joinNames` (a list of names in the shared list words), `describeSaves` (the "Save the new issue as [Jira issue]" line of a stage box and the panel), `describeSendsBack` and `sendsBackTag` (the line under "sends it back", by the stage the arrow goes to), `describeMayBeEmpty` (the may-be-empty sentence, the same as the To do's), `describeStuckTold` / `stuckToldText` (who is told about a stuck request, in number and tense, with an optional "(change this in Settings)" whose "Settings" is a `SettingsLink` part; `settingsLinked(text)` finds that link in plain words; every finding also gives `causeParts` / `effectParts`), `describeIfItFails` (the three sentences on another system: asked again when unreachable or unclear, who is told when it is slow after the catalogue's time, what a clear failure does; the same in In words and on the action card; `durationWords` says the time), `verbNumber` / `takesPlural` / `subjectsOf` (the one rule for "is" or "are": a group or several names take the plural verb, "Platform team are asked"), `describeStartsWhenName` (the name of a "Starts when", naming the connection once via `labelAfterConnection`), `requestTitle` and friends (what a request is called), `describeHeldValue` / `heldValueText` (a value a request holds, in words: never an ID or a code; given `links` (the request's values) a web address is a `WebLink` part (`isWebLink`), and the other of an action's two saved results, an issue's key, is the words of a link to it: `heldLinkOf`, `pairedResult`), `describeChanges` (Publish's "What changed", from core's `diff`: what is inside an added or removed item is folded into its one sentence).
- A new ending's status is named after the ending, in the neutral colour (an existing status with those words is reused); renaming the ending renames its status while the two are the same words (`presets.ts`, `stage.rename`).
- `session/`: the open workflow (Settings, what you may do, catalogue, versions, To do and Worth knowing, facts, values in scope, the describe `env`, autosave, publish, "Show me"); `session/README.md` lists every name with an example.
- `slots.ts`: a feature that must show another feature's part renders `<Slot name="..." {...props} />`. Slots now: `StageActions` (actions), `WhenBuilder` and `FormulaEditor` (conditions), `ValueField`, `ValueChip`, `MessageField` and `ListDialog` (values), `KindChooser` (diagram).
- May import: `contract`, `services`, `words`. Never `ui`, `features` or `app`.
===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/actions.test.ts\n===
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, UseConnection, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { applyCommand } from './registry';
import { getAction, getStage, getValue } from '../lookup';
import { fillSites } from '../walk';
import { createdId, fixture, step } from '../testkit';

const refused = (r: ReturnType<typeof applyCommand>) => (r.ok ? undefined : r.refusal.refused);
const stageOf = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string) => getStage(doc, id) as WorkingStage;
const ids = (list: { id: string }[]) => list.map((a) => a.id);
const connection = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string) => getAction(doc, id) as UseConnection;

describe('action.add', () => {
  it('adds each type empty, last in the section by default', () => {
    let doc = fixture('blank');
    const made: string[] = [];
    for (const type of ['saveValue', 'notify', 'tellOtherSystems'] as const) {
      const r = step(doc, 'action.add', { stage: 'st_request_form', section: 'afterTheyRespond', type });
      doc = r.doc;
      made.push(createdId(r.result));
    }
    const after = stageOf(doc, 'st_request_form').afterTheyRespond;
    expect(ids(after)).toEqual(made);
    expect(after).toEqual([
      { id: made[0], type: 'saveValue' },
      { id: made[1], type: 'notify', message: [] },
      { id: made[2], type: 'tellOtherSystems', values: {} },
    ]);
  });

  it('a connection action starts with the operation, nothing filled in, and stuck if it fails', () => {
    const { doc, result } = step(fixture('integrated-sample'), 'action.add', {
      stage: 'st_find_owner',
      section: 'whenThisStageStarts',
      type: 'useConnection',
      operation: 'jira.createIssue@1',
      at: 0,
    });
    const id = createdId(result);
    expect(stageOf(doc, 'st_find_owner').whenThisStageStarts[0]).toEqual({
      id,
      type: 'useConnection',
      operation: 'jira.createIssue@1',
      inputs: {},
      saveResults: {},
      ifItFails: 'stuck',
    });
  });

  it('a connection action without an operation yet is a legal draft', () => {
    const { doc, result } = step(fixture('blank'), 'action.add', { stage: 'st_request_form', section: 'whenThisStageStarts', type: 'useConnection' });
    expect(getAction(doc, createdId(result))).not.toHaveProperty('operation');
  });

  it('refuses an ending, an unknown stage and an unknown section', () => {
    const doc = fixture('blank');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.add', { stage: 'st_done', section: 'afterTheyRespond', type: 'notify' }))).toBe('ending');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.add', { stage: 'st_gone', section: 'afterTheyRespond', type: 'notify' }))).toBe('notFound');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.add', { stage: 'st_request_form', section: 'nowhere' as 'afterTheyRespond', type: 'notify' }))).toBe('notFound');
  });
});

describe('action.update', () => {
  it('Save a value: what and as; a new value by name; the old value goes when nothing fills it', () => {
    let doc = fixture('change-request');
    const add = step(doc, 'action.add', { stage: 'st_domain_approval', section: 'afterTheyRespond', type: 'saveValue' });
    const act = createdId(add.result) as 'act_x';
    const made = step(add.doc, 'action.update', { action: act, type: 'saveValue', save: { text: 'x' }, as: { newValue: 'Outcome note' } });
    doc = made.doc;
    const v = createdId(made.result);
    expect(getValue(doc, v)?.name).toBe('Outcome note');
    expect(getAction(doc, act)).toMatchObject({ save: { text: 'x' }, as: v });
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: act, type: 'saveValue', as: 'v_title' }).doc;
    expect(getValue(doc, v)).toBeUndefined();
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: act, type: 'saveValue', save: null, as: null }).doc;
    expect(getAction(doc, act)).toEqual({ id: act, type: 'saveValue' });
    expect(getValue(doc, 'v_title')).toBeDefined(); // still filled by its question
  });

  it('Notify: who and the message', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('change-request'), 'action.update', {
      action: 'act_notify_eng_lead',
      type: 'notify',
      to: { request: 'requester' },
      message: ['Hello'],
    }).doc;
    expect(getAction(doc, 'act_notify_eng_lead')).toMatchObject({ to: { request: 'requester' }, message: ['Hello'] });
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_notify_eng_lead', type: 'notify', to: null }).doc;
    expect(getAction(doc, 'act_notify_eng_lead')).not.toHaveProperty('to');
  });

  it('Tell other systems: which thing told and the values', () => {
    let doc = fixture('integrated-sample');
    const told = step(doc, 'told.create', { words: 'Deploy finished' });
    doc = step(told.doc, 'action.update', {
      action: 'act_send_change_deployed',
      type: 'tellOtherSystems',
      tell: createdId(told.result) as 'told_x',
      values: { summary: { value: 'v_summary' } },
    }).doc;
    expect(getAction(doc, 'act_send_change_deployed')).toMatchObject({ tell: createdId(told.result), values: { summary: { value: 'v_summary' } } });
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_send_change_deployed', type: 'tellOtherSystems', tell: null }).doc;
    expect(getAction(doc, 'act_send_change_deployed')).not.toHaveProperty('tell');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_send_change_deployed', type: 'tellOtherSystems', tell: 'told_gone' }))).toBe('notFound');
  });

  it('a new version of the same operation keeps what was filled in; another operation clears it', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('change-request'), 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'useConnection', operation: 'jira.createIssue@2' }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue')).toMatchObject({ saveResults: { key: 'v_jira_issue' }, ifStageEntersAgain: 'once' });
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'useConnection', operation: 'servicenow.createTicket@1' }).doc;
    const a = connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue');
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ operation: 'servicenow.createTicket@1', inputs: {}, saveResults: {} });
    expect(a).not.toHaveProperty('ifStageEntersAgain');
    // The Jira issue value was only filled here, but the notify message still reads it: it stays, filled nowhere.
    expect(getValue(doc, 'v_jira_issue')?.name).toBe('Jira issue');
    expect(fillSites(doc, 'v_jira_issue')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(doc.removedNames?.v_jira_issue).toBeUndefined();
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'useConnection', operation: null }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue')).not.toHaveProperty('operation');
  });

  it('If it fails: carry on with the failure saved; back to stuck stops saving it', () => {
    let doc = fixture('integrated-sample');
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_run_pipeline').saveFailureAs).toBeDefined();
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_run_pipeline', type: 'useConnection', ifItFails: 'stuck' }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_run_pipeline')).not.toHaveProperty('saveFailureAs');
    // Deploy failed is still read by an arrow: it stays, filled nowhere.
    expect(getValue(doc, 'v_deploy_failed')?.name).toBe('Deploy failed');
    expect(fillSites(doc, 'v_deploy_failed')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(fillSites(doc, 'v_deploy_failure_code')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(doc.removedNames?.v_deploy_failed).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('replaces inputs and saved results, sets and clears When the stage is entered again', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('integrated-sample'), 'action.update', {
      action: 'act_look_up_service',
      type: 'useConnection',
      inputs: { serviceId: { value: 'v_summary' } },
      saveResults: { owner: 'v_service_owner' },
      ifStageEntersAgain: 'again',
    }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_look_up_service')).toMatchObject({
      inputs: { serviceId: { value: 'v_summary' } },
      saveResults: { owner: 'v_service_owner' },
      ifStageEntersAgain: 'again',
    });
    // Service tier is no longer filled, but it is still read: it stays.
    expect(fillSites(doc, 'v_service_tier')).toHaveLength(0);
    doc = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_look_up_service', type: 'useConnection', ifStageEntersAgain: null, saveFailureAs: null }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_look_up_service')).not.toHaveProperty('ifStageEntersAgain');
  });

  it('refuses a wrong type, an unknown action and unknown values', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'notify', message: [] }))).toBe('notFound');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_gone', type: 'notify' }))).toBe('notFound');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'useConnection', saveResults: { key: 'v_gone' } }))).toBe('notFound');
  });

  it('an update that changes nothing makes no change', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    const r = applyCommand(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'useConnection' });
    expect(r.ok && r.patches.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('inputs, saved results and the saved failure', () => {
  it('sets and empties one input', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('change-request'), 'action.setInput', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'description', input: ['See ', { value: 'v_title' }] }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue').inputs.description).toEqual(['See ', { value: 'v_title' }]);
    doc = step(doc, 'action.setInput', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'project' }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue').inputs).not.toHaveProperty('project');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.setInput', { action: 'act_notify_eng_lead', field: 'x' }))).toBe('notFound');
  });

  it('creates the value on first use, named after the field label, then reuses it', () => {
    const first = step(fixture('change-request'), 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'url', label: 'Issue link' });
    const v = createdId(first.result);
    expect(getValue(first.doc, v)?.name).toBe('Issue link');
    const again = step(first.doc, 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'url', label: 'Issue link' });
    expect(createdId(again.result)).toBe(v);
    expect(again.doc).toBe(first.doc);
    const unnamed = step(first.doc, 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'id' });
    expect(getValue(unnamed.doc, createdId(unnamed.result))?.name).toBe('id');
  });

  it('switches to another value and stops saving', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('change-request'), 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'key', value: 'v_title' }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue').saveResults.key).toBe('v_title');
    expect(fillSites(doc, 'v_jira_issue')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(getValue(doc, 'v_jira_issue')).toBeDefined();
    doc = step(doc, 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'key', value: null }).doc;
    expect(connection(doc, 'act_create_jira_issue').saveResults).toEqual({});
    expect(fillSites(doc, 'v_title')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(applyCommand(doc, 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'key', value: null }).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', field: 'key', value: 'v_gone' }))).toBe('notFound');
  });

  it('saves the failure only when carrying on', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', part: 'failed' }))).toBe('notFound');
    let next = step(doc, 'action.update', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', type: 'useConnection', ifItFails: 'carryOn' }).doc;
    const made = step(next, 'action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', part: 'failed', name: 'Jira failed' });
    next = made.doc;
    const v = createdId(made.result);
    expect(connection(next, 'act_create_jira_issue').saveFailureAs).toEqual({ failed: v });
    expect(getValue(next, v)?.name).toBe('Jira failed');
    expect(createdId(step(next, 'action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', part: 'failed' }).result)).toBe(v);
    next = step(next, 'action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: 'act_create_jira_issue', part: 'failed', value: null }).doc;
    expect(connection(next, 'act_create_jira_issue')).not.toHaveProperty('saveFailureAs');
    expect(getValue(next, v)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('switches the failure code to an existing value', () => {
    const { doc } = step(fixture('integrated-sample'), 'action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: 'act_run_pipeline', part: 'code', value: 'v_summary' });

    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.delete', { action: 'act_gone' }))).toBe('notFound');
    expect(refused(applyCommand(doc, 'action.setSavedResult', { action: 'act_gone', field: 'x' }))).toBe('notFound');

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/actions.ts\n===
﻿/**
 * Commands for the actions in a stage's two sections, "When this stage starts" and "After they
 * respond": add (Save a value, Notify, a connection's operation, Tell other systems), change their
 * fields, "Only when", move (within a section and between the two), delete.
 * A value exists because something fills it: a save's "as", an operation's saved results and its
 * saved failure. Values an action stops filling go when nothing else fills them (removal.ts), and
 * saved results create their value on first use.
 */
import type {
  Action,
  ActionId,
  CatalogueRef,
  Condition,
  Expression,
  StageId,
  Template,
  ToldId,
  UseConnection,
  Value,
  ValueId,
  WorkingStage,
} from '@/contract';
import { find, getWorkingStage, type Section } from '../lookup';
import { uniqueName } from '../presets';
import { emptyRemoved, tidyAfterRemoval } from './removal';
import { pressesElsewhere, stageOf } from './pressed';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

const SECTIONS: readonly Section[] = ['whenThisStageStarts', 'afterTheyRespond'];

interface ActionPlace {
  action: Action;
  stage: WorkingStage;
  section: Section;
}

function actionPlace(doc: Doc, id: string): ActionPlace | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'action' || !entry.parents.section) return undefined;
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, entry.parents.stage);
  return stage ? { action: entry.item, stage, section: entry.parents.section } : undefined;
}

const isValue = (doc: Doc, id: string) => find(doc, id)?.kind === 'value';

/** A new value named `base` (made unique), added to the registry. */
function createValue(doc: Doc, ctx: CommandContext, base: string): ValueId {
  const value: Value = { id: ctx.newId('v'), name: uniqueName(base, doc.values.map((v) => v.name ?? '')) };
  doc.values.push(value);
  return value.id;
}

/** Removes the values in `dropped` that nothing fills any more. */
function tidyValues(doc: Doc, dropped: Iterable<ValueId | undefined>): void {
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  for (const id of dropped) if (id) removed.filledValues.add(id);
  if (removed.filledValues.size > 0) tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

/** The values an action fills. */
function filledBy(action: Action): ValueId[] {
  if (action.type === 'saveValue') return action.as ? [action.as] : [];
  if (action.type !== 'useConnection') return [];
  const out = Object.values(action.saveResults ?? {});
  if (action.saveFailureAs?.failed) out.push(action.saveFailureAs.failed);
  if (action.saveFailureAs?.code) out.push(action.saveFailureAs.code);
  return out;
}

const clampIndex = (index: number | undefined, length: number) =>
  index === undefined || !Number.isFinite(index) ? length : Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.trunc(index), length));

// ── add ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ActionAddArgs = {
  stage: StageId;
  section: Section;
  /** Where in the section, counted from 0. Default: last. */
  at?: number;
} & (
  | { type: 'saveValue' | 'notify' | 'tellOtherSystems' }
  /** The catalogue operation, e.g. `jira.createIssue@1`. (Optional in a draft.) */
  | { type: 'useConnection'; operation?: CatalogueRef }
);

/** Adds an empty action of the type. A connection action starts with nothing filled in and "If it fails": stuck. */
export function actionAdd(doc: Doc, args: ActionAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ActionId> | Refusal {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, args.stage);
  if (!stage) return refuse(find(doc, args.stage) ? 'ending' : 'notFound');
  if (!SECTIONS.includes(args.section)) return refuse('notFound');
  const id = ctx.newId('act');
  let action: Action;
  switch (args.type) {
    case 'saveValue':
      action = { id, type: 'saveValue' };
      break;
    case 'notify':
      action = { id, type: 'notify', message: [] };
      break;
    case 'tellOtherSystems':
      action = { id, type: 'tellOtherSystems', values: {} };
      break;
    case 'useConnection':
      action = { id, type: 'useConnection', inputs: {}, saveResults: {}, ifItFails: 'stuck' };
      if (args.operation) action.operation = args.operation;
      break;
    default:
      return refuse('notFound');
  }
  const list = (stage[args.section] ??= []);
  list.splice(clampIndex(args.at, list.length), 0, action);
  return { id };
}

// ── update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Changes an action's own fields. `type` must be the action's type (otherwise: notFound). A field
 * left out is unchanged; `null` clears an optional field.
 */
export type ActionUpdateArgs = { action: ActionId } & (
  | {
      type: 'saveValue';
      save?: Expression | null;
      /** A value ID, `null` to clear, or `{ newValue: name }` to save into a new value (returned). */
      as?: ValueId | null | { newValue: string };
    }
  | { type: 'notify'; to?: Expression | null; message?: Template }
  | {
      type: 'useConnection';
      /** Changing to another operation (not just another version of it) clears the inputs, saved results and "When the stage is entered again". */
      operation?: CatalogueRef | null;
      /** Replaces all inputs. */
      inputs?: Record<string, Expression | Template>;
      /** Replaces all saved results; every value must exist. */
      saveResults?: Record<string, ValueId>;
      /** Back to "stuck" also stops saving the failure. */
      ifItFails?: UseConnection['ifItFails'];
      saveFailureAs?: { failed?: ValueId; code?: ValueId } | null;
      ifStageEntersAgain?: 'once' | 'again' | null;
    }
  | { type: 'tellOtherSystems'; tell?: ToldId | null; values?: Record<string, Expression | Template> }
);

/** `jira.createIssue@1` → `jira.createIssue`. */
const withoutVersion = (ref: string | undefined) => (ref ?? '').replace(/@\d+$/, '');

export function actionUpdate(doc: Doc, args: ActionUpdateArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ValueId> | Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place || place.action.type !== args.type) return refuse('notFound');
  const action = place.action;

  if (args.type === 'saveValue' && action.type === 'saveValue') {
    if (args.as !== undefined && typeof args.as === 'string' && !isValue(doc, args.as)) return refuse('notFound');
    if (args.save === null) delete action.save;
    else if (args.save !== undefined) action.save = args.save;
    if (args.as === undefined) return;
    const old = action.as;
    let created: ValueId | undefined;
    if (args.as === null) delete action.as;
    else if (typeof args.as === 'string') action.as = args.as;
    else action.as = created = createValue(doc, ctx, args.as.newValue);
    if (old !== action.as) tidyValues(doc, [old]);
    return created ? { id: created } : undefined;
  }

  if (args.type === 'notify' && action.type === 'notify') {
    if (args.to === null) delete action.to;
    else if (args.to !== undefined) action.to = args.to;
    if (args.message !== undefined) action.message = args.message;
    return;
  }

  if (args.type === 'tellOtherSystems' && action.type === 'tellOtherSystems') {
    if (args.tell && find(doc, args.tell)?.kind !== 'thingTold') return refuse('notFound');
    if (args.tell === null) delete action.tell;
    else if (args.tell !== undefined) action.tell = args.tell;
    if (args.values !== undefined) action.values = args.values;
    return;
  }

  if (args.type === 'useConnection' && action.type === 'useConnection') {
    const wanted = [...Object.values(args.saveResults ?? {}), args.saveFailureAs?.failed, args.saveFailureAs?.code];
    if (wanted.some((v) => v !== undefined && !isValue(doc, v))) return refuse('notFound');
    const before = filledBy(action);
    if (args.operation !== undefined) {
      if (args.operation !== null && withoutVersion(args.operation) !== withoutVersion(action.operation)) {
        action.inputs = {};
        action.saveResults = {};
        delete action.ifStageEntersAgain;
      }
      if (args.operation === null) delete action.operation;
      else action.operation = args.operation;
    }
    if (args.inputs !== undefined) action.inputs = args.inputs;
    if (args.saveResults !== undefined) action.saveResults = args.saveResults;
    if (args.ifItFails !== undefined) action.ifItFails = args.ifItFails;
    if (args.saveFailureAs === null) delete action.saveFailureAs;
    else if (args.saveFailureAs !== undefined) action.saveFailureAs = args.saveFailureAs;
    if (action.ifItFails === 'stuck') delete action.saveFailureAs;
    if (args.ifStageEntersAgain === null) delete action.ifStageEntersAgain;
    else if (args.ifStageEntersAgain !== undefined) action.ifStageEntersAgain = args.ifStageEntersAgain;
    const after = new Set(filledBy(action));
    tidyValues(doc, before.filter((v) => !after.has(v)));
  }
}

// ── one input, one saved result, the saved failure ──────────────────────────

export interface ActionSetInputArgs {
  action: ActionId;
  /** The operation's catalogue input field id. */
  field: string;
  /** Absent: the field is not filled in. */
  input?: Expression | Template;
}
/** Fills in (or empties) one input of a connection action. */
export function actionSetInput(doc: Doc, args: ActionSetInputArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place || place.action.type !== 'useConnection' || !args.field) return refuse('notFound');
  const inputs = (place.action.inputs ??= {});
  if (args.input === undefined) delete inputs[args.field];
  else inputs[args.field] = args.input;
}

export interface ActionSetSavedResultArgs {
  action: ActionId;
  /** The operation's catalogue result field id, e.g. `key`. */
  field: string;
  /**
   * Which value keeps it. Absent: the one already used, or a new value named `label` (the
   * catalogue field's label; the field id when not given). null: stop saving it.
   */
  value?: ValueId | null;
  label?: string;
}
/** "Save the results as": one result field into a value, created on first use. Returns the value. */
export function actionSetSavedResult(doc: Doc, args: ActionSetSavedResultArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ValueId> | Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place || place.action.type !== 'useConnection' || !args.field) return refuse('notFound');
  const results = (place.action.saveResults ??= {});
  const current = results[args.field];
  if (args.value === null) {
    if (!current) return;
    delete results[args.field];
    tidyValues(doc, [current]);
    return;
  }
  if (args.value !== undefined) {
    if (!isValue(doc, args.value)) return refuse('notFound');
    results[args.field] = args.value;
    if (current !== args.value) tidyValues(doc, [current]);
    return { id: args.value };
  }
  if (current && isValue(doc, current)) return { id: current };
  const id = createValue(doc, ctx, args.label || args.field);
  results[args.field] = id;
  return { id };
}

export interface ActionSetFailureSavedAsArgs {
  action: ActionId;
  /** `failed`: Yes/No, Yes when it failed. `code`: the failure code. */
  part: 'failed' | 'code';
  /** As for saved results: absent reuses or creates a value named `name`; null stops saving. */
  value?: ValueId | null;
  name?: string;
}
/**
 * Carry on's two optional rows: "Save whether it failed as [value]" (`failed`) and "Save what
 * went wrong as [value]" (`code`). Only with "If it fails": carry on (refused as
 * notFound on a stuck one). Returns the value.
 */
export function actionSetFailureSavedAs(doc: Doc, args: ActionSetFailureSavedAsArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ValueId> | Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place || place.action.type !== 'useConnection' || place.action.ifItFails !== 'carryOn') return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.part !== 'failed' && args.part !== 'code') return refuse('notFound');
  const action = place.action;
  const current = action.saveFailureAs?.[args.part];
  if (args.value === null) {
    if (!current || !action.saveFailureAs) return;
    delete action.saveFailureAs[args.part];
    if (!action.saveFailureAs.failed && !action.saveFailureAs.code) delete action.saveFailureAs;
    tidyValues(doc, [current]);
    return;
  }
  if (args.value !== undefined && !isValue(doc, args.value)) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.value === undefined && current && isValue(doc, current)) return { id: current };
  const id = args.value ?? createValue(doc, ctx, args.name || args.part);
  (action.saveFailureAs ??= {})[args.part] = id;
  if (current !== id) tidyValues(doc, [current]);
  return { id };
}

// ── Only when, move, delete ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ActionSetOnlyWhenArgs {
  action: ActionId;
  /** Absent: remove "Only when". */
  onlyWhen?: Condition;
}
export function actionSetOnlyWhen(doc: Doc, args: ActionSetOnlyWhenArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (pressesElsewhere(doc, stageOf(doc, args.action), args.onlyWhen)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.onlyWhen === undefined) delete place.action.onlyWhen;
  else place.action.onlyWhen = args.onlyWhen;
}

export interface ActionMoveArgs {
  action: ActionId;
  /** Default: the section it is in. */
  section?: Section;
  /** The position it should end up at in that section, counted from 0 (clamped). */
  toIndex: number;
}
/** Reorders an action within its section or moves it to the stage's other section. */
export function actionMove(doc: Doc, args: ActionMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const section = args.section ?? place.section;
  if (!SECTIONS.includes(section)) return refuse('notFound');
  const from = place.stage[place.section];
  from.splice(from.indexOf(place.action), 1);
  const to = (place.stage[section] ??= []);
  to.splice(clampIndex(args.toIndex, to.length), 0, place.action);
}

export interface ActionDeleteArgs {
  action: ActionId;
}
/** Deletes the action and the values only it filled. */
export function actionDelete(doc: Doc, args: ActionDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = actionPlace(doc, args.action);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const list = place.stage[place.section];
  list.splice(list.indexOf(place.action), 1);
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  removed.items.set(place.action.id, '');
  for (const v of filledBy(place.action)) removed.filledValues.add(v);
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export const actionsCommands = {
  'action.add': actionAdd,
  'action.update': actionUpdate,
  'action.setInput': actionSetInput,
  'action.setSavedResult': actionSetSavedResult,
  'action.setFailureSavedAs': actionSetFailureSavedAs,
  'action.setOnlyWhen': actionSetOnlyWhen,
  'action.move': actionMove,
  'action.delete': actionDelete,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/arrows.ts\n===
/**
 * Arrow commands ("Then go to"): add, change the "when", "+ only when ...", where it goes, its
 * words, reorder, delete, "Don't wait for the others", and connect (drag from one stage to
 * another). "In all other cases" is always the last arrow and a stage has at most one.
 */
import type { Arrow, ArrowId, ArrowWhen, Condition, StageId, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { find, getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { pressesElsewhere } from './pressed';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

const fitsAll = (a: Arrow) => a.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases' || a.when?.type === 'whenDone';

/**
 * Puts `arrow` before the arrow that always fits, "In all other cases" or "When done" (an arrow
 * after it would never be used; "When done" then reads "In all other cases"), or last when it is
 * such an arrow itself or there is none.
 */
export function insertArrow(stage: WorkingStage, arrow: Arrow): void {
  const catchAll = stage.arrows.findIndex(fitsAll);
  if (catchAll < 0 || fitsAll(arrow)) stage.arrows.push(arrow);
  else stage.arrows.splice(catchAll, 0, arrow);
}

/** The arrow and the working stage it belongs to. */
export function arrowAndStage(doc: Doc, arrowId: string): { arrow: Arrow; stage: WorkingStage } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, arrowId);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'arrow') return undefined;
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, entry.parents.stage);
  return stage ? { arrow: entry.item, stage } : undefined;
}

const hasCatchAll = (stage: WorkingStage, except?: Arrow) =>
  stage.arrows.some((a) => a !== except && a.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases');

export interface ArrowAddArgs {
  stage: StageId;
  /** Default: a "when ..." that depends on answers, not written yet. */
  when?: ArrowWhen;
  goTo?: StageId | null;
}
export function arrowAdd(doc: Doc, args: ArrowAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ArrowId> | Refusal {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, args.stage);
  if (!stage) return refuse(find(doc, args.stage) ? 'ending' : 'notFound');
  const when: ArrowWhen = args.when ?? { type: 'condition' };
  if (when.type === 'inAllOtherCases' && hasCatchAll(stage)) return refuse('catchAllExists');
  const arrow: Arrow = { id: ctx.newId('ar'), when, goTo: args.goTo ?? null };
  insertArrow(stage, arrow);
  return { id: arrow.id };
}

export interface ArrowSetWhenArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
  when: ArrowWhen;
}
export function arrowSetWhen(doc: Doc, args: ArrowSetWhenArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  const { arrow, stage } = found;
  if (args.when.type === 'buttonPressed' && args.when.button !== null) {
    const button = find(doc, args.when.button);
    if (button?.kind !== 'button') return refuse('notFound');
    if (button.parents.stage !== stage.id) return refuse('notThisStage');
  }
  if (args.when.type === 'condition' && pressesElsewhere(doc, stage.id, args.when.condition)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.when.type === 'inAllOtherCases') {
    if (hasCatchAll(stage, arrow)) return refuse('catchAllExists');
    stage.arrows.splice(stage.arrows.indexOf(arrow), 1);
    arrow.when = args.when;
    stage.arrows.push(arrow);
    return;
  }
  arrow.when = args.when;
}

export interface ArrowSetOnlyWhenArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
  /** Absent: remove "+ only when ...". */
  onlyWhen?: Condition;
}
export function arrowSetOnlyWhen(doc: Doc, args: ArrowSetOnlyWhenArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  if (pressesElsewhere(doc, found.stage.id, args.onlyWhen)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.onlyWhen === undefined) delete found.arrow.onlyWhen;
  else found.arrow.onlyWhen = args.onlyWhen;
}

export interface ArrowSetGoToArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
  /** null: not chosen yet. */
  goTo: StageId | null;
}
export function arrowSetGoTo(doc: Doc, args: ArrowSetGoToArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.goTo !== null && find(doc, args.goTo)?.kind !== 'stage') return refuse('notFound');
  found.arrow.goTo = args.goTo;
}

export interface ArrowSetWordsArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
  /** Absent or empty: the arrow's own sentence is shown. */
  words?: string;
}
export function arrowSetWords(doc: Doc, args: ArrowSetWordsArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  if (!args.words) delete found.arrow.words;
  else found.arrow.words = args.words;
}

export interface ArrowMoveArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
  /** The position it should end up at, counted from 0. Kept above "In all other cases". */
  toIndex: number;
}
export function arrowMove(doc: Doc, args: ArrowMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  const { arrow, stage } = found;
  if (arrow.when?.type === 'inAllOtherCases') return refuse('catchAllStaysLast');
  stage.arrows.splice(stage.arrows.indexOf(arrow), 1);
  const lastAllowed = stage.arrows.length - (hasCatchAll(stage) ? 1 : 0);
  const to = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.trunc(args.toIndex), lastAllowed));
  stage.arrows.splice(to, 0, arrow);
}

export interface ArrowDeleteArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
}
export function arrowDelete(doc: Doc, args: ArrowDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  found.stage.arrows.splice(found.stage.arrows.indexOf(found.arrow), 1);
}

export interface ArrowSetGoAsSoonAsTrueArgs {
  arrow: ArrowId;
  on: boolean;
}
/** "Don't wait for the others". The check says when it does not apply (a stage with one task). */
export function arrowSetGoAsSoonAsTrue(doc: Doc, args: ArrowSetGoAsSoonAsTrueArgs): Refusal | void {
  const found = arrowAndStage(doc, args.arrow);
  if (!found) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.on) found.arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue = true;
  else delete found.arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue;
}

export interface ArrowConnectArgs {
  from: StageId;
  to: StageId;
}
/**
 * Drag from stage A to stage B: the first arrow of A that goes nowhere yet now goes to B; if there
 * is none, a new arrow (a "when ..." not written yet; "When done" on an Automatic stage that has
 * none) is added before "In all other cases". Returns the arrow used.
 */
export function arrowConnect(doc: Doc, args: ArrowConnectArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ArrowId> | Refusal {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, args.from);
  if (!stage) return refuse(find(doc, args.from) ? 'ending' : 'notFound');
  if (find(doc, args.to)?.kind !== 'stage') return refuse('notFound');
  const unfinished = stage.arrows.find((a) => a.goTo === null);
  if (unfinished) {
    unfinished.goTo = args.to;
    return { id: unfinished.id };
  }
  const whenDone = stage.kind === 'automatic' && !stage.arrows.some((a) => a.when?.type === 'whenDone');
  const arrow: Arrow = { id: ctx.newId('ar'), when: whenDone ? { type: 'whenDone' } : { type: 'condition' }, goTo: args.to };
  insertArrow(stage, arrow);
  return { id: arrow.id };
}

export const arrowsCommands = {
  'arrow.add': arrowAdd,
  'arrow.setWhen': arrowSetWhen,
  'arrow.setOnlyWhen': arrowSetOnlyWhen,
  'arrow.setGoTo': arrowSetGoTo,
  'arrow.setWords': arrowSetWords,
  'arrow.move': arrowMove,
  'arrow.delete': arrowDelete,
  'arrow.setGoAsSoonAsTrue': arrowSetGoAsSoonAsTrue,
  'arrow.connect': arrowConnect,
} satisfies CommandGroup;
