===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/buttons.ts\n===
/**
 * Button commands. A new button arrives with its own arrow, going nowhere yet, placed before
 * "In all other cases" ("Every button has an arrow"). Deleting a button deletes its arrows; any
 * other reference to it stays and becomes a To do (its label goes into removedNames).
 */
import type { Button, ButtonId, Condition, QuestionId, TaskId, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { find, getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { buttonArrow } from '../presets';
import { insertArrow } from './arrows';
import { emptyRemoved, tidyAfterRemoval } from './removal';
import { pressesElsewhere, stageOf } from './pressed';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

/** The button, its task's buttons and its stage. */
function buttonPlace(doc: Doc, buttonId: string): { button: Button; buttons: Button[]; task: string; stage: WorkingStage } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, buttonId);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'button') return undefined;
  const task = find(doc, entry.parents.task);
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, entry.parents.stage);
  if (!task || task.kind !== 'task' || !stage) return undefined;
  return { button: entry.item, buttons: task.item.buttons, task: task.id, stage };
}

export interface ButtonAddArgs {
  task: TaskId;
  /** Default: empty (a To do until named). */
  label?: string;
  /** Default: primary for the task's first button, secondary after. */
  look?: Button['look'];
}
export function buttonAdd(doc: Doc, args: ButtonAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ButtonId> | Refusal {
  const entry = find(doc, args.task);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'task') return refuse('notFound');
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, entry.parents.stage);
  if (!stage) return refuse('notFound');
  const task = entry.item;
  const button: Button = {
    id: ctx.newId('btn'),
    label: args.label ?? '',
    look: args.look ?? (task.buttons.length === 0 ? 'primary' : 'secondary'),
    neededToPress: [],
  };
  task.buttons.push(button);
  insertArrow(stage, buttonArrow(ctx, button.id));
  return { id: button.id };
}

export interface ButtonRenameArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
  label: string;
}
export function buttonRename(doc: Doc, args: ButtonRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.button.label = args.label;
}

export interface ButtonSetLookArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
  look: Button['look'];
}
export function buttonSetLook(doc: Doc, args: ButtonSetLookArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.button.look = args.look;
}

export interface ButtonMoveArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
  /** Display position among the task's buttons, counted from 0. */
  toIndex: number;
}
export function buttonMove(doc: Doc, args: ButtonMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { buttons, button } = place;
  buttons.splice(buttons.indexOf(button), 1);
  buttons.splice(Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.trunc(args.toIndex), buttons.length)), 0, button);
}

export interface ButtonDeleteArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
}
export function buttonDelete(doc: Doc, args: ButtonDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { button, buttons, stage } = place;
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  removed.items.set(button.id, button.label ?? '');
  buttons.splice(buttons.indexOf(button), 1);
  stage.arrows = stage.arrows.filter((a) => {
    const own = a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === button.id;
    if (own) removed.items.set(a.id, a.words ?? '');
    return !own;
  });
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export interface ButtonSetNeededToPressArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
  questions: QuestionId[];
}
/** "Needed to press": questions of the button's own task that must be answered first; others are left out. */
export function buttonSetNeededToPress(doc: Doc, args: ButtonSetNeededToPressArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.button.neededToPress = [...new Set(args.questions)].filter((q) => {
    const entry = find(doc, q);
    return entry?.kind === 'question' && entry.parents.task === place.task;
  });
}

export interface ButtonSetEnabledWhenArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
  /** Absent: remove "Also only when ...". */
  enabledWhen?: Condition;
}
export function buttonSetEnabledWhen(doc: Doc, args: ButtonSetEnabledWhenArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (pressesElsewhere(doc, stageOf(doc, args.button), args.enabledWhen)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.enabledWhen === undefined) delete place.button.enabledWhen;
  else place.button.enabledWhen = args.enabledWhen;
}

export interface ButtonSetMessageWhileDisabledArgs {
  button: ButtonId;
  /** Absent or empty: the editor reads back the needs and the "when ...". */
  message?: string;
}
export function buttonSetMessageWhileDisabled(doc: Doc, args: ButtonSetMessageWhileDisabledArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = buttonPlace(doc, args.button);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (!args.message) delete place.button.messageWhileDisabled;
  else place.button.messageWhileDisabled = args.message;
}

export const buttonsCommands = {
  'button.add': buttonAdd,
  'button.rename': buttonRename,
  'button.setLook': buttonSetLook,
  'button.move': buttonMove,
  'button.delete': buttonDelete,
  'button.setNeededToPress': buttonSetNeededToPress,
  'button.setEnabledWhen': buttonSetEnabledWhen,
  'button.setMessageWhileDisabled': buttonSetMessageWhileDisabled,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { applyCommand } from './registry';
import { fixture, step } from '../testkit';

describe('diagram positions', () => {
  it('pins a stage, rounded, and moves it again', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('blank'), 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_done', x: 10.4, y: -20.6 }).doc;
    expect(doc.diagram).toEqual({ positions: { st_done: { x: 10, y: -21 } } });
    doc = step(doc, 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_done', x: 5, y: 5 }).doc;
    expect(doc.diagram?.positions.st_done).toEqual({ x: 5, y: 5 });
  });

  it('clearing the last position removes the diagram (automatic layout)', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('blank'), 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_done', x: 1, y: 2 }).doc;
    doc = step(doc, 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_request_form', x: 3, y: 4 }).doc;
    doc = step(doc, 'diagram.clearPosition', { stage: 'st_done' }).doc;
    expect(doc.diagram).toEqual({ positions: { st_request_form: { x: 3, y: 4 } } });
    doc = step(doc, 'diagram.clearPosition', { stage: 'st_request_form' }).doc;
    expect(doc).toEqual(fixture('blank'));
  });

  it('clears all', () => {
    let doc = step(fixture('blank'), 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_done', x: 1, y: 2 }).doc;
    doc = step(doc, 'diagram.clearAll', {}).doc;
    expect(doc).toEqual(fixture('blank'));
    const none = applyCommand(doc, 'diagram.clearAll', {});
    expect(none.ok && none.patches).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('refuses unknown stages; ignores positions that are not numbers', () => {
    const doc = fixture('blank');
    const r = applyCommand(doc, 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_gone', x: 0, y: 0 });
    expect(r.ok ? undefined : r.refusal.refused).toBe('notFound');
    const nan = applyCommand(doc, 'diagram.setPosition', { stage: 'st_done', x: Number.NaN, y: 0 });
    expect(nan.ok && nan.patches).toEqual([]);
    const gone = applyCommand(doc, 'diagram.clearPosition', { stage: 'st_gone' });
    expect(gone.ok && gone.patches).toEqual([]);
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/diagram.ts\n===
﻿/**
 * Commands for diagram positions. A stage without a position is placed automatically; with none at
 * all the document has no `diagram` (the normal case). Positions are rounded to whole pixels.
 */
import type { StageId } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { refuse, type CommandGroup, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

export interface DiagramSetPositionArgs {
  stage: StageId;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}
/** Pins the stage where the author dropped it. Positions that are not finite numbers change nothing. */
export function diagramSetPosition(doc: Doc, args: DiagramSetPositionArgs): Refusal | void {
  if (find(doc, args.stage)?.kind !== 'stage') return refuse('notFound');
  if (!Number.isFinite(args.x) || !Number.isFinite(args.y)) return;
  doc.diagram ??= { positions: {} };
  doc.diagram.positions ??= {};
  doc.diagram.positions[args.stage] = { x: Math.round(args.x), y: Math.round(args.y) };
}

export interface DiagramClearPositionArgs {
  /** May name a stage that no longer exists. */
  stage: StageId;
}
/** The stage is placed automatically again. */
export function diagramClearPosition(doc: Doc, args: DiagramClearPositionArgs): void {
  const positions = doc.diagram?.positions;
  if (!positions || !(args.stage in positions)) return;
  delete positions[args.stage];
  if (Object.keys(positions).length === 0) delete doc.diagram;
}

/** Every stage is placed automatically again ("Tidy up"). */
// The empty arguments object keeps `run('diagram.clearAll', {})` in the same shape as every command.
export function diagramClearAll(doc: Doc, _args?: Record<string, never>): void {
  if (doc.diagram) delete doc.diagram;
}

export const diagramCommands = {
  'diagram.setPosition': diagramSetPosition,
  'diagram.clearPosition': diagramClearPosition,
  'diagram.clearAll': diagramClearAll,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

const refused = (r: ReturnType<typeof applyCommand>) => (r.ok ? undefined : r.refusal.refused);
const pageIds = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: string) => getTask(doc, task)!.form.pages.map((p) => p.id);
const itemIds = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, page: string) => getPage(doc, page)!.items.map((i) => i.id);

    const added = createdId(r.result) as 'pg_x';
    expect(pageIds(r.doc, 'tk_request_form')).toEqual(['pg_request_form_1', added]);
    expect(getPage(r.doc, added)).toEqual({ id: added, title: 'Details', items: [] });
    let doc = step(r.doc, 'page.move', { page: added, toIndex: 0 }).doc;

    expect(find(doc, 'q_eng_lead')).toBeUndefined();
    // Eng lead is used by Create Jira issue; Reason by the sent-back note: both stay.

    expect(getValue(doc, 'v_reason')).toBeDefined();

    doc = step(doc, 'question.setChoices', {
      question: 'q_risk',
      choices: { from: 'typedIn', choices: [{ id: 'ch_risk_high', label: 'Very high' }, { label: 'None' }, { id: 'ch_risk_high', label: 'Twice' }] },
    }).doc;
    const choices = getQuestion(doc, 'q_risk')!.choices;
    expect(choices?.from).toBe('typedIn');
    const list = choices?.from === 'typedIn' ? choices.choices : [];
    expect(list.map((c) => c.label)).toEqual(['Very high', 'None', 'Twice']);
    expect(list[0]?.id).toBe('ch_risk_high');
    expect(new Set(list.map((c) => c.id)).size).toBe(3);
    // The sample answer named Medium: it stays (same source), as a To do.
    expect(doc.removedNames).toEqual({ ch_risk_low: 'Low', ch_risk_medium: 'Medium' });
    expect(doc.sampleRequest?.answers.v_risk).toEqual({ choice: 'ch_risk_medium' });
  });

  it('takes every other source and clears the sample answer when the source changes', () => {
    const sources = [
      { from: 'list', list: 'ls_domains', shownColumn: 'col_domain' },
      { from: 'directory', peopleIn: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_engineering_group' }] } },
      { from: 'source', source: 'servicecatalog.services@1', inputs: {}, labelField: 'name', storedField: 'id' },
      { from: 'formula', formula: { formula: '["a"]', readsAs: 'A' } },
    ] as const;
    for (const choices of sources) {
      const { doc } = step(fixture('change-request'), 'question.setChoices', { question: 'q_risk', choices: structuredClone(choices) as never });
      expect(getQuestion(doc, 'q_risk')?.choices).toEqual(choices);
      expect(doc.sampleRequest?.answers).not.toHaveProperty('v_risk');
    }
    const { doc } = step(fixture('change-request'), 'question.setChoices', { question: 'q_risk' });
    expect(getQuestion(doc, 'q_risk')).not.toHaveProperty('choices');
  });

  it('refuses an unknown question', () => {
    expect(refused(applyCommand(fixture('blank'), 'question.setChoices', { question: 'q_gone' }))).toBe('notFound');
  });

    expect(labels(r.doc)[1]).toBe('Second');

﻿/**
 * Commands for the form editor: pages, questions, form text, typed-in choices, Show when, and
 * "Needed to press" from the question side (the "All" tick and one tick per button).
 *
 * Saved as: adding a question creates its value, named after the label (made unique, "Title 2").
 * The value's name FOLLOWS the label while (a) this question is the only thing that fills the
 * value and (b) the value's name is still the old label, or the old label with a number added to
 * keep it unique (compared ignoring case and outer spaces). Nothing is stored for this: once the
 * author renames the value itself, or another place fills it, the name no longer matches or the
 * value is shared, and it stops following. So the rule survives saving and reloading.
 *
 * Deleting: a question's value stays if anything else fills or uses it, else it goes with its
 * sample answer (./values.ts). The question leaves its task's buttons' "Needed to press". Any other
 * reference to a removed question, text, page or choice stays and becomes a To do (its name goes
 * into removedNames).
 */
import type {
  Button,
  ButtonId,
  ChoiceId,
  Choices,
  Condition,
  FormItem,
  FormText,
  Page,
  PageId,
  Question,
  QuestionId,
  QuestionKind,
  Task,
  Template,
  TextId,
  Value,
  ValueId,
} from '@/contract';
import { find, getPage, getQuestion, getTask } from '../lookup';
import { uniqueName } from '../presets';
import { fillSites } from '../walk';
import { emptyRemoved, tidyAfterRemoval, type Removed } from './removal';
import { removeValueIfUnused } from './values';
import { pressesElsewhere, stageOf } from './pressed';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

// ── places ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const clamp = (index: number | undefined, length: number) =>
  index === undefined || !Number.isFinite(index) ? length : Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.trunc(index), length));

function insertAt<T>(list: T[], item: T, toIndex?: number): void {
  list.splice(clamp(toIndex, list.length), 0, item);
}

function moveTo<T>(list: T[], item: T, toIndex: number): void {
  list.splice(list.indexOf(item), 1);
  insertAt(list, item, toIndex);
}

function pagePlace(doc: Doc, pageId: string): { page: Page; task: Task } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, pageId);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'page') return undefined;
  const task = getTask(doc, entry.parents.task);
  return task ? { page: entry.item, task } : undefined;
}

function itemPlace(doc: Doc, itemId: string): { item: FormItem; page: Page; task: Task } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, itemId);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'question' && entry?.kind !== 'text') return undefined;
  const page = getPage(doc, entry.parents.page);
  const task = getTask(doc, entry.parents.task);
  return page && task ? { item: entry.item, page, task } : undefined;
}

function questionPlace(doc: Doc, id: string): { question: Question; page: Page; task: Task } | undefined {
  const place = itemPlace(doc, id);
  return place?.item.type === 'question' ? { ...place, question: place.item } : undefined;
}

function textOf(doc: Doc, id: string): FormText | undefined {
  const place = itemPlace(doc, id);
  return place?.item.type === 'text' ? place.item : undefined;
}

// ── value names that follow the label ───────────────────────────────────────

/** True when `name` is `label`, or `label` with a number added ("Title 2"). */
export function isNameFromLabel(name: string, label: string): boolean {
  const n = name.trim().toLowerCase();
  const l = label.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (n === l) return true;
  return l !== '' && n.startsWith(`${l} `) && /^\d+$/.test(n.slice(l.length + 1));
}

/** The name a question's value gets from its label: the label made unique among other values; '' for no label. */
function nameForLabel(doc: Doc, label: string, except?: string): string {
  const base = label.trim();
  if (!base) return '';
  return uniqueName(base, doc.values.filter((v) => v.id !== except).map((v) => v.name ?? ''));
}

/** True while the question's value still follows its label (see the file comment). */
export function valueFollowsLabel(doc: Doc, question: Question): boolean {
  const entry = find(doc, question.savedAs);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'value') return false;
  const fills = fillSites(doc, entry.id);
  if (fills.length !== 1 || fills[0]?.owner.id !== question.id) return false;
  return isNameFromLabel(entry.item.name ?? '', question.label ?? '');
}

// ── removal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * After form items have left the document: takes removed questions out of the task's "Needed to
 * press", removes values nothing fills or uses any more, and names still-referenced items.
 */
function tidyAfterItems(doc: Doc, task: Task | undefined, items: FormItem[], removed: Removed = emptyRemoved()): void {
  const questions = new Set<string>();
  const values: ValueId[] = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.type === 'text') {
      removed.items.set(item.id, '');
      continue;
    }
    removed.items.set(item.id, item.label ?? '');
    questions.add(item.id);
    if (item.savedAs) values.push(item.savedAs);
    collectChoices(item.choices, removed);
  }
  for (const button of task?.buttons ?? []) {
    if ((button.neededToPress ?? []).some((q) => questions.has(q))) {
      button.neededToPress = button.neededToPress.filter((q) => !questions.has(q));
    }
  }
  for (const value of values) removeValueIfUnused(doc, value);
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

function collectChoices(choices: Choices | undefined, removed: Removed, keep?: Set<string>): void {
  if (choices?.from !== 'typedIn') return;
  for (const c of choices.choices ?? []) if (!keep?.has(c.id)) removed.items.set(c.id, c.label ?? '');
}

/** The sample answer of a value no longer fits when its question changes kind or source. */
function clearSampleAnswer(doc: Doc, valueId: ValueId | undefined): void {
  if (valueId && doc.sampleRequest?.answers && valueId in doc.sampleRequest.answers) delete doc.sampleRequest.answers[valueId];
}

// ── pages ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface PageAddArgs {
  task: string;
  title?: string;
  /** Position among the form's pages, from 0. Default: last. */
  toIndex?: number;
}
export function pageAdd(doc: Doc, args: PageAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<PageId> | Refusal {
  const task = getTask(doc, args.task);
  if (!task) return refuse('notFound');
  const page: Page = { id: ctx.newId('pg'), items: [] };
  if (args.title) page.title = args.title;
  insertAt(task.form.pages, page, args.toIndex);
  return { id: page.id };
}

export interface PageRenameArgs {
  page: PageId;
  /** Absent or empty: no title. */
  title?: string;
}
export function pageRename(doc: Doc, args: PageRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (!args.title) delete place.page.title;
  else place.page.title = args.title;
}

export interface PageDeleteArgs {
  page: PageId;
}
/** Deletes the page and everything on it. The form may be left with no page. */
export function pageDelete(doc: Doc, args: PageDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { page, task } = place;
  task.form.pages.splice(task.form.pages.indexOf(page), 1);
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  removed.items.set(page.id, page.title ?? '');
  tidyAfterItems(doc, task, page.items ?? [], removed);
}

export interface PageMoveArgs {
  page: PageId;
  toIndex: number;
}
export function pageMove(doc: Doc, args: PageMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  moveTo(place.task.form.pages, place.page, args.toIndex);
}

export interface ShowWhenArgs {
  /** Absent: always shown. */
  showWhen?: Condition;
}
export function pageSetShowWhen(doc: Doc, args: ShowWhenArgs & { page: PageId }): Refusal | void {
  const place = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (pressesElsewhere(doc, stageOf(doc, args.page), args.showWhen)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.showWhen === undefined) delete place.page.showWhen;
  else place.page.showWhen = args.showWhen;
}

// ── questions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Question kinds that have choices; person and group may also take "People from the directory". */
const KINDS_WITH_CHOICES: readonly QuestionKind[] = ['choice', 'multipleChoice', 'person', 'group'];
const KINDS_WITH_DIRECTORY: readonly QuestionKind[] = ['person', 'group'];
const KINDS_TYPED_IN_BY_DEFAULT: readonly QuestionKind[] = ['choice', 'multipleChoice'];

export interface QuestionAddArgs {
  page: PageId;
  kind: QuestionKind;
  /** Default: empty (a To do until written). */
  label?: string;
  /** Position on the page, from 0. Default: last. */
  toIndex?: number;
}
/**
 * Adds a question and the value it is saved as, named after the label. A choice or multiple-choice
 * question starts with an empty typed-in list.
 */
export function questionAdd(doc: Doc, args: QuestionAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<QuestionId> | Refusal {
  const place = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const label = args.label ?? '';
  const value: Value = { id: ctx.newId('v'), name: nameForLabel(doc, label) };
  const question: Question = { type: 'question', id: ctx.newId('q'), label, kind: args.kind, savedAs: value.id };
  if (KINDS_TYPED_IN_BY_DEFAULT.includes(args.kind)) question.choices = { from: 'typedIn', choices: [] };
  doc.values.push(value);
  insertAt(place.page.items, question, args.toIndex);
  return { id: question.id };
}

export interface QuestionSetLabelArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  label: string;
}
/** Sets the label; the value's name follows while it still matches the old label (file comment). */
export function questionSetLabel(doc: Doc, args: QuestionSetLabelArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { question } = place;
  if (question.label === args.label) return;
  const follows = valueFollowsLabel(doc, question);
  question.label = args.label;
  if (!follows) return;
  const value = doc.values.find((v) => v.id === question.savedAs);
  if (value) value.name = nameForLabel(doc, args.label, value.id);
}

export interface QuestionSetKindArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  kind: QuestionKind;
}
/**
 * Changes the kind. Choices the new kind cannot have are dropped (all for text, number ...;
 * "People from the directory" unless person or group), and the value's sample answer is cleared.
 */
export function questionSetKind(doc: Doc, args: QuestionSetKindArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { question } = place;
  if (question.kind === args.kind) return;
  question.kind = args.kind;
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  const choices = question.choices;
  if (choices && (!KINDS_WITH_CHOICES.includes(args.kind) || (choices.from === 'directory' && !KINDS_WITH_DIRECTORY.includes(args.kind)))) {
    collectChoices(choices, removed);
    delete question.choices;
  }
  if (!question.choices && KINDS_TYPED_IN_BY_DEFAULT.includes(args.kind)) question.choices = { from: 'typedIn', choices: [] };
  clearSampleAnswer(doc, question.savedAs);
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

/** Choices as a caller gives them: typed-in choices may come without IDs (new ones get one). */
export type ChoicesInput =
  | Exclude<Choices, { from: 'typedIn' }>
  | { from: 'typedIn'; choices: { id?: ChoiceId; label: string }[] };

export interface QuestionSetChoicesArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  /** Absent: no choices (a To do for a choice question). */
  choices?: ChoicesInput;
}
/**
 * Sets where the choices come from (all five sources). Typed-in choices keep their ID when they
 * are already this question's; others get a new one. Changing the source clears the sample answer.
 */
export function questionSetChoices(doc: Doc, args: QuestionSetChoicesArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { question } = place;
  const old = question.choices;
  const oldIds = new Set(old?.from === 'typedIn' ? (old.choices ?? []).map((c) => c.id) : []);
  const kept = new Set<string>();
  let next: Choices | undefined;
  if (args.choices?.from === 'typedIn') {
    next = {
      from: 'typedIn',
      choices: args.choices.choices.map((c) => {
        const id = c.id && oldIds.has(c.id) && !kept.has(c.id) ? c.id : ctx.newId('ch');
        kept.add(id);
        return { id, label: c.label };
      }),
    };
  } else {
    next = args.choices ? structuredClone(args.choices) : undefined;
  }
  const sourceChanged = old?.from !== next?.from || (old?.from === 'list' && next?.from === 'list' && old.list !== next.list);
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  collectChoices(old, removed, kept);
  if (next) question.choices = next;
  else delete question.choices;
  if (sourceChanged) clearSampleAnswer(doc, question.savedAs);
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export function questionSetShowWhen(doc: Doc, args: ShowWhenArgs & { question: QuestionId }): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (pressesElsewhere(doc, stageOf(doc, args.question), args.showWhen)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.showWhen === undefined) delete place.question.showWhen;
  else place.question.showWhen = args.showWhen;
}

export interface QuestionSetNeededForEveryButtonArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  /** The "All" tick under "Needed to press". */
  on: boolean;
}
export function questionSetNeededForEveryButton(doc: Doc, args: QuestionSetNeededForEveryButtonArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.on) place.question.neededForEveryButton = true;
  else delete place.question.neededForEveryButton;
}

export interface QuestionSetNeededToPressArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  /** A button of the question's own task. */
  button: ButtonId;
  /** The tick for that button under "Needed to press". */
  on: boolean;
}
/**
 * "Needed to press" from the question's side: one tick per button (editor-model.md section 6).
 * Ticking adds the question to the button's "Needed to press", in the order of the form; unticking
 * removes it. Unticking one button while "All" is on turns "All" off and leaves every other button
 * of the task ticked, so the question is still needed for them.
 */
export function questionSetNeededToPress(doc: Doc, args: QuestionSetNeededToPressArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { question, task } = place;
  const button = (task.buttons ?? []).find((b) => b.id === args.button);
  if (!button) return refuse('notFound');
  const order = task.form.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items ?? []).map((i) => i.id);
  const add = (b: Button) => {
    if ((b.neededToPress ?? []).includes(question.id)) return;
    b.neededToPress = [...(b.neededToPress ?? []), question.id].sort((x, y) => order.indexOf(x) - order.indexOf(y));
  };
  if (args.on) {
    if (!question.neededForEveryButton) add(button);
    return;
  }
  if (question.neededForEveryButton) {
    delete question.neededForEveryButton;
    for (const other of task.buttons ?? []) if (other.id !== button.id) add(other);
  }
  if ((button.neededToPress ?? []).includes(question.id)) button.neededToPress = button.neededToPress.filter((q) => q !== question.id);
}

export interface QuestionSetSavedAsArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  /** An existing value ("Use that value instead"). */
  value: ValueId;
}
/** Points "Saved as" at another value; the old one goes if nothing else fills or uses it. */
export function questionSetSavedAs(doc: Doc, args: QuestionSetSavedAsArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place || find(doc, args.value)?.kind !== 'value') return refuse('notFound');
  const old = place.question.savedAs;
  if (old === args.value) return;
  place.question.savedAs = args.value;
  removeValueIfUnused(doc, old);
}

// ── typed-in choices ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ChoiceAddArgs {
  question: QuestionId;
  label: string;
  toIndex?: number;
}
/** Adds a typed-in choice. A question with no choices yet gets typed-in ones; another source is refused. */
export function choiceAdd(doc: Doc, args: ChoiceAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ChoiceId> | Refusal {
  const place = questionPlace(doc, args.question);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { question } = place;
  question.choices ??= { from: 'typedIn', choices: [] };
  if (question.choices.from !== 'typedIn') return refuse('choicesNotTypedIn');
  const choice = { id: ctx.newId('ch'), label: args.label };
  insertAt(question.choices.choices, choice, args.toIndex);
  return { id: choice.id };
}

function choicePlace(doc: Doc, id: string) {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'choice') return undefined;
  const question = getQuestion(doc, entry.parents.question);
  if (question?.choices?.from !== 'typedIn') return undefined;
  return { choice: entry.item, list: question.choices.choices };
}

export interface ChoiceRenameArgs {
  choice: ChoiceId;
  label: string;
}
export function choiceRename(doc: Doc, args: ChoiceRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = choicePlace(doc, args.choice);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.choice.label = args.label;
}

export interface ChoiceDeleteArgs {
  choice: ChoiceId;
}
/** Deletes a typed-in choice; a "when ..." or sample answer naming it becomes a To do. */
export function choiceDelete(doc: Doc, args: ChoiceDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = choicePlace(doc, args.choice);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.list.splice(place.list.indexOf(place.choice), 1);
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  removed.items.set(place.choice.id, place.choice.label ?? '');
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export interface ChoiceMoveArgs {
  choice: ChoiceId;
  toIndex: number;
}
export function choiceMove(doc: Doc, args: ChoiceMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = choicePlace(doc, args.choice);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  moveTo(place.list, place.choice, args.toIndex);
}

// ── questions and text together ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ItemMoveArgs {
  item: QuestionId | TextId;
  /** The page it goes to: the same page, another page of the form, or a page of another task. */
  page: PageId;
  /** Position on that page, from 0 (counted without the item itself). Default: last. */
  toIndex?: number;
}
/**
 * Moves a question or text. A question moved to another task's form leaves its old task's
 * "Needed to press" (those buttons are not on its new form) and, moved off the start form, the
 * answers of every "Starts when".
 */
export function itemMove(doc: Doc, args: ItemMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const from = itemPlace(doc, args.item);
  const to = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!from || !to) return refuse('notFound');
  from.page.items.splice(from.page.items.indexOf(from.item), 1);
  insertAt(to.page.items, from.item, args.toIndex);
  if (from.task.id === to.task.id || from.item.type !== 'question') return;
  const id = from.item.id;
  for (const button of from.task.buttons ?? []) {
    if ((button.neededToPress ?? []).includes(id)) button.neededToPress = button.neededToPress.filter((q) => q !== id);
  }
  // Nor does a "Starts when" fill it any more: those answer only the start form.
  for (const sw of doc.start?.startsWhen ?? []) {
    if (sw.answers && id in sw.answers) delete sw.answers[id];
  }
}

export interface ItemDeleteArgs {
  item: QuestionId | TextId;
}
export function itemDelete(doc: Doc, args: ItemDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = itemPlace(doc, args.item);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.page.items.splice(place.page.items.indexOf(place.item), 1);
  tidyAfterItems(doc, place.task, [place.item]);
}

// ── text ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TextAddArgs {
  page: PageId;
  /** Default: empty. */
  content?: Template;
  toIndex?: number;
}
export function textAdd(doc: Doc, args: TextAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<TextId> | Refusal {
  const place = pagePlace(doc, args.page);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const text: FormText = { type: 'text', id: ctx.newId('tx'), content: structuredClone(args.content ?? []) };
  insertAt(place.page.items, text, args.toIndex);
  return { id: text.id };
}

export interface TextSetContentArgs {
  text: TextId;
  content: Template;
}
export function textSetContent(doc: Doc, args: TextSetContentArgs): Refusal | void {
  const text = textOf(doc, args.text);
  if (!text) return refuse('notFound');
  text.content = structuredClone(args.content);
}

export function textSetShowWhen(doc: Doc, args: ShowWhenArgs & { text: TextId }): Refusal | void {
  const text = textOf(doc, args.text);
  if (!text) return refuse('notFound');
  if (pressesElsewhere(doc, stageOf(doc, args.text), args.showWhen)) return refuse('notThisStage');
  if (args.showWhen === undefined) delete text.showWhen;
  else text.showWhen = args.showWhen;
}

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/lists.ts\n===
﻿/**
 * Commands for lists kept with the workflow (the Domains list): the list, its columns, rows and
 * cells. Names are given by the caller (a person reads them, so the words come from src/words).
 *
 * Deleting a list is refused while anything outside it refers to the list, its columns or its rows
 * (a question's choices, a column step, a row in a "when ..." or a sample answer); the refusal says
 * where. Deleting a column or a row is allowed: references to it stay and become a To do (its name
 * goes into removedNames). A cell must hold a constant of its column's kind; changing a column's
 * kind empties the cells that no longer fit.
 */
import type { Column, ColumnId, Constant, List, ListId, Location, Row, RowId } from '@/contract';
import { find, getList } from '../lookup';
import { allReferences } from '../walk';
import { emptyRemoved, tidyAfterRemoval } from './removal';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

/** The list is still used: `usedIn` says where (RefusalCode 'inUse'). */
export interface ListInUse extends Refusal {
  refused: 'inUse';
  usedIn: Location[];
}
const refuseInUse = (usedIn: Location[]): ListInUse => ({ refused: 'inUse', usedIn });
const refuseWrongKind = (): Refusal => refuse('wrongKind');

const clamp = (index: number | undefined, length: number) =>
  index === undefined || !Number.isFinite(index) ? length : Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.trunc(index), length));

function columnPlace(doc: Doc, id: string): { column: Column; list: List } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'column') return undefined;
  const list = getList(doc, entry.parents.list);
  return list ? { column: entry.item, list } : undefined;
}

function rowPlace(doc: Doc, id: string): { row: Row; list: List } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'row') return undefined;
  const list = getList(doc, entry.parents.list);
  return list ? { row: entry.item, list } : undefined;
}

/** True when the constant is of the column's kind (`{ text }` for a text column ...). */
export function fitsColumn(column: Pick<Column, 'kind'>, value: Constant): boolean {
  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  return keys.length === 1 && keys[0] === column.kind;
}

/** Where the list, its columns or its rows are referred to from outside the list (one entry per place). */
export function listUsedIn(doc: Doc, list: List): Location[] {
  const own = new Set<string>([list.id, ...(list.columns ?? []).map((c) => c.id), ...(list.rows ?? []).map((r) => r.id)]);
  const ownRows = new Set<string>((list.rows ?? []).map((r) => r.id));
  const seen = new Map<string, Location>();
  for (const ref of allReferences(doc)) {
    if (!own.has(ref.target) || ownRows.has(ref.owner.id)) continue;
    const key = `${ref.location.item}|${ref.location.part ?? ''}`;
    if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, ref.location);
  }
  return [...seen.values()];
}

// ── lists ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ListAddArgs {
  name: string;
}
/** A new list with no columns and no rows. */
export function listAdd(doc: Doc, args: ListAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ListId> {
  const list: List = { id: ctx.newId('ls'), name: args.name, columns: [], rows: [] };
  doc.lists.push(list);
  return { id: list.id };
}

export interface ListRenameArgs {
  list: ListId;
  name: string;
}
export function listRename(doc: Doc, args: ListRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const list = getList(doc, args.list);
  if (!list) return refuse('notFound');
  list.name = args.name;
}

export interface ListDeleteArgs {
  list: ListId;
}
export function listDelete(doc: Doc, args: ListDeleteArgs): ListInUse | Refusal | void {
  const list = getList(doc, args.list);
  if (!list) return refuse('notFound');
  const usedIn = listUsedIn(doc, list);
  if (usedIn.length > 0) return refuseInUse(usedIn);
  doc.lists.splice(doc.lists.indexOf(list), 1);
}

// ── columns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ColumnAddArgs {
  list: ListId;
  name: string;
  /** Default: text. */
  kind?: Column['kind'];
  toIndex?: number;
}
export function columnAdd(doc: Doc, args: ColumnAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ColumnId> | Refusal {
  const list = getList(doc, args.list);
  if (!list) return refuse('notFound');
  const column: Column = { id: ctx.newId('col'), name: args.name, kind: args.kind ?? 'text' };
  list.columns.splice(clamp(args.toIndex, list.columns.length), 0, column);
  return { id: column.id };
}

export interface ColumnRenameArgs {
  column: ColumnId;
  name: string;
}
export function columnRename(doc: Doc, args: ColumnRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = columnPlace(doc, args.column);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.column.name = args.name;
}

export interface ColumnSetKindArgs {
  column: ColumnId;
  kind: Column['kind'];
}
/** Changes the column's kind; cells that no longer fit are emptied ("(not given)"). */
export function columnSetKind(doc: Doc, args: ColumnSetKindArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = columnPlace(doc, args.column);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { column, list } = place;
  if (column.kind === args.kind) return;
  column.kind = args.kind;
  for (const row of list.rows ?? []) {
    const cell = row.cells?.[column.id];
    if (cell && !fitsColumn(column, cell)) delete row.cells[column.id];
  }
}

export interface ColumnDeleteArgs {
  column: ColumnId;
}
/** Deletes the column and its cells; a step or "shown column" naming it becomes a To do. */
export function columnDelete(doc: Doc, args: ColumnDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = columnPlace(doc, args.column);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { column, list } = place;
  list.columns.splice(list.columns.indexOf(column), 1);
  for (const row of list.rows ?? []) if (row.cells && column.id in row.cells) delete row.cells[column.id];
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  removed.items.set(column.id, column.name ?? '');
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

// ── rows and cells ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RowAddArgs {
  list: ListId;
  /** Cells by column ID; each must be of its column's kind. Default: none. */
  cells?: Partial<Record<ColumnId, Constant>>;
  toIndex?: number;
}
export function rowAdd(doc: Doc, args: RowAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<RowId> | Refusal {
  const list = getList(doc, args.list);
  if (!list) return refuse('notFound');
  const row: Row = { id: ctx.newId('row'), cells: {} };
  for (const [columnId, value] of Object.entries(args.cells ?? {})) {
    if (!value) continue;
    const column = list.columns.find((c) => c.id === columnId);
    if (!column) return refuse('notFound');
    if (!fitsColumn(column, value)) return refuseWrongKind();
    row.cells[column.id] = structuredClone(value);
  }
  list.rows.splice(clamp(args.toIndex, list.rows.length), 0, row);
  return { id: row.id };
}

export interface RowDeleteArgs {
  row: RowId;
}
/** Deletes the row; a "when ..." or sample answer naming it becomes a To do. */
export function rowDelete(doc: Doc, args: RowDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = rowPlace(doc, args.row);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { row, list } = place;
  list.rows.splice(list.rows.indexOf(row), 1);
  const removed = emptyRemoved();
  const first = list.columns[0];
  const shown = first ? row.cells?.[first.id] : undefined;
  removed.items.set(row.id, shown && 'text' in shown ? shown.text : '');
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export interface RowMoveArgs {
  row: RowId;
  toIndex: number;
}
export function rowMove(doc: Doc, args: RowMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = rowPlace(doc, args.row);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { row, list } = place;
  list.rows.splice(list.rows.indexOf(row), 1);
  list.rows.splice(clamp(args.toIndex, list.rows.length), 0, row);
}

export interface CellSetArgs {
  row: RowId;
  column: ColumnId;
  /** Absent: "(not given)". */
  value?: Constant;
}
export function cellSet(doc: Doc, args: CellSetArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = rowPlace(doc, args.row);
  const column = place?.list.columns.find((c) => c.id === args.column);
  if (!place || !column) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.value === undefined) {
    if (place.row.cells && column.id in place.row.cells) delete place.row.cells[column.id];
    return;
  }
  if (!fitsColumn(column, args.value)) return refuseWrongKind();
  place.row.cells ??= {};
  place.row.cells[column.id] = structuredClone(args.value);
}

export const listsCommands = {
  'list.add': listAdd,
  'list.rename': listRename,
  'list.delete': listDelete,
  'column.add': columnAdd,
  'column.rename': columnRename,
  'column.setKind': columnSetKind,
  'column.delete': columnDelete,
  'row.add': rowAdd,
  'row.delete': rowDelete,
  'row.move': rowMove,
  'cell.set': cellSet,
} satisfies CommandGroup;
===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/pressed.ts\n===
/**
 * The rule behind the `notThisStage` refusal: a "when" set by a command may say "[button] is
 * pressed" only for a button of the stage it sits in (an arrow's "when" and "+ only when ...", an
 * action's "Only when", a button's "Also only when", a page's, question's or text's "Show when").
 */
import { find } from '../lookup';
import type { Doc } from './types';

/** Every button a "pressed" anywhere inside `node` names. */
function pressedIn(node: unknown, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    for (const child of node) pressedIn(child, out);
    return out;
  }
  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return out;
  const o = node as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof o.pressed === 'string') out.push(o.pressed);
  for (const child of Object.values(o)) if (child && typeof child === 'object') pressedIn(child, out);
  return out;
}

/**
 * True when `when` says a button of another stage than `stage` is pressed. A button that is not in
 * the document is left to the `notFound` check.
 */
export function pressesElsewhere(doc: Doc, stage: string | undefined, when: unknown): boolean {
  if (!stage) return false;
  return pressedIn(when).some((id) => {
    const button = find(doc, id);
    return button?.kind === 'button' && button.parents.stage !== stage;
  });
}

/** The stage an item sits in (undefined for items outside stages). */
export const stageOf = (doc: Doc, id: string): string | undefined => find(doc, id)?.parents.stage;

/**
 * Applies 200 random commands of the action, Starts when, status, thing-told and diagram groups to
 * the integrated-sample fixture (seeded, so a failure repeats), checks the structural rules after
 * each, then undoes all of them through the store and expects the fixture back.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, ItemKind } from '@/contract';
import { seededRandom, type Random } from '../ids';
import { indexDoc } from '../lookup';
import { createEditorStore } from '../store';
import { assertWellFormed, fixture } from '../testkit';
import type { ArgsOf, CommandName } from './registry';

type Chosen = { [K in CommandName]: [K, ArgsOf<K>] }[CommandName];

function ids(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, kind: ItemKind): string[] {
  return [...indexDoc(doc).byId.values()].filter((e) => e.kind === kind).map((e) => e.id);
}

function randomCommand(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, random: Random): Chosen {
  const one = <T,>(items: readonly T[]): T | undefined => items[Math.floor(random() * items.length)];
  const pick = (kind: ItemKind, ghost: string) => (random() < 0.05 ? ghost : (one(ids(doc, kind)) ?? ghost));
  const stage = () => pick('stage', 'st_ghost') as 'st_x';
  const action = () => pick('action', 'act_ghost') as 'act_x';
  const value = () => pick('value', 'v_ghost') as 'v_x';
  const status = () => pick('status', 'stat_ghost') as 'stat_x';
  const told = () => pick('thingTold', 'told_ghost') as 'told_x';
  const sw = () => pick('startsWhen', 'sw_ghost') as 'sw_x';
  const question = () => pick('question', 'q_ghost') as 'q_x';
  const button = () => pick('button', 'btn_ghost') as 'btn_x';
  const maybe = <T,>(x: T) => (random() < 0.5 ? undefined : x);
  const section = () => one(['whenThisStageStarts', 'afterTheyRespond'] as const)!;
  const ops = ['jira.createIssue@1', 'jira.createIssue@2', 'deploy.runPipeline@1'] as const;
  const field = () => one(['key', 'url', 'owner', 'tier'])!;

  const choices: (() => Chosen)[] = [
    () => ['action.add', { stage: stage(), section: section(), type: one(['saveValue', 'notify', 'tellOtherSystems'] as const)! }],
    () => ['action.add', { stage: stage(), section: section(), type: 'useConnection', operation: one(ops)!, at: Math.floor(random() * 4) }],
    () => ['action.update', { action: action(), type: 'saveValue', save: maybe({ text: 'x' }), as: one([value(), null, { newValue: 'Saved' }]) }],
    () => ['action.update', { action: action(), type: 'notify', to: one([{ request: 'requester' as const }, null]), message: ['Hi ', { value: value() }] }],
    () => ['action.update', { action: action(), type: 'tellOtherSystems', tell: one([told(), null]), values: { a: { value: value() } } }],
    () => ['action.update', {
      action: action(),
      type: 'useConnection',
      operation: maybe(one([...ops, null])!),
      ifItFails: one(['stuck', 'carryOn'] as const)!,
      saveResults: maybe({ [field()]: value() }),
      ifStageEntersAgain: one(['once', 'again', null] as const),
    }],
    () => ['action.setInput', { action: action(), field: field(), input: maybe({ value: value() }) }],
    () => ['action.setSavedResult', { action: action(), field: field(), value: one([undefined, null, value()]), label: 'Result' }],
    () => ['action.setFailureSavedAs', { action: action(), part: one(['failed', 'code'] as const)!, value: one([undefined, null, value()]) }],
    () => ['action.setOnlyWhen', { action: action(), onlyWhen: maybe({ allOf: [] }) }],
    () => ['action.move', { action: action(), section: maybe(section()), toIndex: Math.floor(random() * 5) - 1 }],
    () => ['action.delete', { action: action() }],
    () => ['startsWhen.add', { trigger: maybe('helpdesk.ticketCreated@1' as const) }],
    () => ['startsWhen.setTrigger', { binding: sw(), trigger: one(['helpdesk.ticketCreated@2' as const, null])! }],
    () => ['startsWhen.setOnlyWhen', { binding: sw(), onlyWhen: maybe({ anyOf: [] }) }],
    () => ['startsWhen.setRequester', { binding: sw(), requester: maybe({ sentField: 'reporter' }) }],

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/registry.ts\n===
/**
 * Every command by name, merged from the groups, and `applyCommand`: runs one command on a
 * document with immer and returns the new document with its patches (for undo) or the refusal.
 * The command types live in ./types.ts (re-exported here) so the groups can use them without a cycle.
 */
import { enablePatches, produceWithPatches, type Patch } from 'immer';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { newId, type IdPrefix, type Random } from '../ids';
import { actionsCommands } from './actions';
import { arrowsCommands } from './arrows';
import { buttonsCommands } from './buttons';
import { diagramCommands } from './diagram';
import { formsCommands } from './forms';
import { listsCommands } from './lists';
import { sampleCommands } from './sample';
import { stagesCommands } from './stages';
import { startCommands } from './start';
import { statusesCommands } from './statuses';
import { tasksCommands } from './tasks';
import { toldCommands } from './told';
import { valuesCommands } from './values';
import { indexDoc } from '../lookup';
import { allReferences } from '../walk';
import { isRefusal, refuse, type Command, type CommandContext, type CommandResult, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

export * from './types';

enablePatches();

export const registry = {
  ...stagesCommands,
  ...arrowsCommands,
  ...tasksCommands,
  ...buttonsCommands,
  ...formsCommands,
  ...valuesCommands,
  ...listsCommands,
  ...sampleCommands,
  ...actionsCommands,
  ...startCommands,
  ...statusesCommands,
  ...toldCommands,
  ...diagramCommands,
};

export type Registry = typeof registry;
export type CommandName = keyof Registry;
export type ArgsOf<K extends CommandName> = Parameters<Registry[K]>[1];
export type ResultOf<K extends CommandName> = ReturnType<Registry[K]>;

/** A context whose newId never repeats an ID, also among those handed out in the same command. */
export function makeContext(doc: Doc, random: Random = Math.random): CommandContext {
  const issued = new Set<string>();
  return { newId: <P extends IdPrefix>(prefix: P) => newId(doc, prefix, random, issued) };
}

export type Applied<K extends CommandName> =
  | { ok: true; doc: AuthoredWorkflow; result: ResultOf<K>; patches: Patch[]; inversePatches: Patch[] }
  | { ok: false; refusal: Refusal };

/** How many references each target that is not in the document has (unknown or deleted). */
function missingTargets(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): Map<string, number> {
  const { byId } = indexDoc(doc);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const ref of allReferences(doc)) if (!byId.has(ref.target)) counts.set(ref.target, (counts.get(ref.target) ?? 0) + 1);
  return counts;
}

/**
 * True when `after` has a new reference to something not in it: an unknown ID, or one deleted
 * before this command (named in removedNames counts too, so a deleted thing cannot be picked
 * again). References that were there before stay, and so do references to things this command
 * deletes (they become red To dos).
 */
function addsUnknownReference(before: AuthoredWorkflow, after: AuthoredWorkflow): boolean {
  const now = missingTargets(after);
  if (now.size === 0) return false;
  const existedBefore = indexDoc(before).byId;
  const earlier = missingTargets(before);
  for (const [id, count] of now) {
    if (existedBefore.has(id)) continue;
    if (count > (earlier.get(id) ?? 0)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Runs command `name` on `doc` without changing `doc`. A refusal leaves nothing changed. When the
 * command changes nothing, `patches` is empty and `doc` is the same object. A command whose
 * arguments name something not in the document (e.g. a condition naming a deleted choice) is
 * refused with `notFound`, whichever command it is, so no command can leave a dangling reference
 * or add one more reference to a deleted thing.
 */
export function applyCommand<K extends CommandName>(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  name: K,
  args: ArgsOf<K>,
  random: Random = Math.random,
): Applied<K> {
  const command = registry[name] as unknown as Command<ArgsOf<K>>;
  if (!command) throw new Error(`Unknown command: ${String(name)}`);
  const out: { result?: CommandResult } = {};
  const [next, patches, inversePatches] = produceWithPatches(doc, (draft) => {
    out.result = command(draft, args, makeContext(draft, random));
  });
  const result = out.result;
  if (isRefusal(result)) return { ok: false, refusal: result };
  if (patches.length === 0) return { ok: true, doc, result: result as ResultOf<K>, patches, inversePatches };
  if (addsUnknownReference(doc, next)) return { ok: false, refusal: refuse('notFound') };
  return { ok: true, doc: next, result: result as ResultOf<K>, patches, inversePatches };
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/removal.ts\n===
/**
 * Shared by the delete commands: what a removed part of the document contained, and the tidy-up
 * after it is gone. References to removed things stay (a draft may point at a deleted thing; it is
 * a red To do) and the removed thing's name goes into removedNames so To do can name it. A value
 * whose fillers were removed goes too, but only when nothing else uses it either.
 */
import type { Stage, Task, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { allReferences } from '../walk';
import type { Doc } from './types';
import { removeValueIfUnused } from './values';

export interface Removed {
  /** IDs of every item inside, with the name a person knew it by ('' when it has none). */
  items: Map<string, string>;
  /** Values filled inside: removed too if nothing else fills them. */
  filledValues: Set<ValueId>;
}

export function emptyRemoved(): Removed {
  return { items: new Map(), filledValues: new Set() };
}

/** Everything inside a task: pages, questions, text, choices, buttons, and the values it fills. */
export function collectTask(task: Task, removed: Removed = emptyRemoved()): Removed {
  removed.items.set(task.id, task.name ?? '');
  if (task.savesButtonPressedAs) removed.filledValues.add(task.savesButtonPressedAs);
  if (task.savesAnsweredByAs) removed.filledValues.add(task.savesAnsweredByAs);
  for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
    removed.items.set(page.id, page.title ?? '');
    for (const item of page.items ?? []) {
      if (item.type !== 'question') {
        removed.items.set(item.id, '');
        continue;
      }
      removed.items.set(item.id, item.label ?? '');
      if (item.savedAs) removed.filledValues.add(item.savedAs);
      if (item.choices?.from === 'typedIn') for (const c of item.choices.choices ?? []) removed.items.set(c.id, c.label ?? '');
    }
  }
  for (const button of task.buttons ?? []) removed.items.set(button.id, button.label ?? '');
  return removed;
}

/** Everything inside a stage: tasks, actions, arrows, and the values they fill. */
export function collectStage(stage: Stage, removed: Removed = emptyRemoved()): Removed {
  removed.items.set(stage.id, stage.name ?? '');
  if (stage.kind === 'ending') return removed;
  for (const task of stage.tasks ?? []) collectTask(task, removed);
  for (const action of [...(stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [])]) {
    removed.items.set(action.id, '');
    if (action.type === 'saveValue' && action.as) removed.filledValues.add(action.as);
    if (action.type === 'useConnection') {
      for (const v of Object.values(action.saveResults ?? {})) removed.filledValues.add(v);
      if (action.saveFailureAs?.failed) removed.filledValues.add(action.saveFailureAs.failed);
      if (action.saveFailureAs?.code) removed.filledValues.add(action.saveFailureAs.code);
    }
  }
  for (const arrow of stage.arrows ?? []) removed.items.set(arrow.id, arrow.words ?? '');
  return removed;
}

/**
 * After the items are gone from `doc`: removes the values they filled that nothing else fills or
 * uses any more (and their sample answers), by the same rule as removing a question
 * (removeValueIfUnused). A value still read somewhere stays with its name, and the reader's To do
 * says it is never filled. Then names in removedNames every removed thing still referenced.
 */
export function tidyAfterRemoval(doc: Doc, removed: Removed): void {
  for (const valueId of removed.filledValues) removeValueIfUnused(doc, valueId);
  const referenced = new Set(allReferences(doc).map((r) => r.target));
  for (const [id, name] of removed.items) {
    if (!referenced.has(id) || find(doc, id)) continue;
    doc.removedNames ??= {};
    doc.removedNames[id] = name;
  }
}

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/sample.ts\n===
﻿/**
 * Commands for the sample request (the request the editor uses for every sample it shows): its
 * name, Requester, Started on, one answer per value, or the whole sample at once (e.g. from a test
 * request in Try it). The sample is created on first use with an empty name.
 *
 * Every answer must be for a value in the document, and the choices, rows and buttons inside it
 * must exist; `sample.replaceWith` quietly leaves out answers that do not fit (a test request run
 * on an older draft), the single-answer command refuses them.
 */
import type { Constant, DirectoryRef, SampleRequest, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { refuse, type CommandGroup, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

function sampleOf(doc: Doc): SampleRequest {
  doc.sampleRequest ??= { name: '', answers: {} };
  doc.sampleRequest.answers ??= {};
  return doc.sampleRequest;
}

/** The IDs a constant points at (choices, rows, buttons). */
function idsIn(constant: Constant): string[] {
  if ('choice' in constant) return [constant.choice];
  if ('choices' in constant) return [...constant.choices];
  if ('row' in constant) return [constant.row];
  if ('button' in constant) return [constant.button];
  return [];
}

/** True when the answer can be kept: its value exists and everything it points at exists. */
export function answerFits(doc: Doc, valueId: string, answer: Constant | undefined): answer is Constant {
  if (!answer || find(doc, valueId)?.kind !== 'value') return false;
  return idsIn(answer).every((id) => find(doc, id) !== undefined);
}

export interface SampleSetNameArgs {
  name: string;
}
export function sampleSetName(doc: Doc, args: SampleSetNameArgs): void {
  sampleOf(doc).name = args.name;
}

export interface SampleSetAnswerArgs {
  value: ValueId;
  answer: Constant;
}
export function sampleSetAnswer(doc: Doc, args: SampleSetAnswerArgs): Refusal | void {
  if (!answerFits(doc, args.value, args.answer)) return refuse('notFound');
  sampleOf(doc).answers[args.value] = structuredClone(args.answer);
}

export interface SampleClearAnswerArgs {
  value: ValueId;
}
/** "No sample" for this value. */
export function sampleClearAnswer(doc: Doc, args: SampleClearAnswerArgs): void {
  const answers = doc.sampleRequest?.answers;
  if (answers && args.value in answers) delete answers[args.value];
}

export interface SampleSetRequesterArgs {
  /** Absent: no Requester. */
  requester?: DirectoryRef;
}
export function sampleSetRequester(doc: Doc, args: SampleSetRequesterArgs): void {
  if (args.requester) sampleOf(doc).requester = structuredClone(args.requester);
  else if (doc.sampleRequest?.requester) delete doc.sampleRequest.requester;
}

export interface SampleSetStartedOnArgs {
  /** `YYYY-MM-DD`. Absent: not given. */
  startedOn?: string;
}
export function sampleSetStartedOn(doc: Doc, args: SampleSetStartedOnArgs): void {
  if (args.startedOn) sampleOf(doc).startedOn = args.startedOn;
  else if (doc.sampleRequest?.startedOn) delete doc.sampleRequest.startedOn;
}

export interface SampleReplaceWithArgs {
  sample: SampleRequest;
}
/** Replaces the whole sample, leaving out answers that do not fit this document. */
export function sampleReplaceWith(doc: Doc, args: SampleReplaceWithArgs): void {
  const { name, requester, startedOn, answers } = structuredClone(args.sample);
  const next: SampleRequest = { name: name ?? '', answers: {} };
  if (requester) next.requester = requester;
  if (startedOn) next.startedOn = startedOn;
  for (const [valueId, answer] of Object.entries(answers ?? {})) {
    if (answerFits(doc, valueId, answer)) next.answers[valueId as ValueId] = answer;
  }
  doc.sampleRequest = next;
}

export const sampleCommands = {
  'sample.setName': sampleSetName,
  'sample.setAnswer': sampleSetAnswer,
  'sample.clearAnswer': sampleClearAnswer,
  'sample.setRequester': sampleSetRequester,
  'sample.setStartedOn': sampleSetStartedOn,
  'sample.replaceWith': sampleReplaceWith,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/stages.ts\n===
/**
 * Stage commands: add a stage of a kind (optionally pointing a chosen arrow at it, or inserting it
 * on an existing arrow, already wired), rename, delete, and change the kind's label.
 * New working stages go before the endings; endings go last (the start stage stays first).
 * Deleting a stage keeps the arrows that pointed at it (their goTo now dangles, a red To do) and
 * puts its name in removedNames. The start stage cannot be deleted.
 */
import type { ArrowId, StageId, StatusId, WorkingStageKind } from '@/contract';
import { find, getStage } from '../lookup';
import { isStartStage } from '../graph';
import { ENDING_STATUS_COLOUR, presetStage, type NewStageKind } from '../presets';
import { arrowAndStage } from './arrows';
import { collectStage, tidyAfterRemoval } from './removal';
import { dropIfUnused, sameWords } from './statuses';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

export interface StageAddArgs {
  kind: NewStageKind;
  /** Default: the kind's word, made unique ("Approval 2"). */
  name?: string;
  /** "+ New stage..." on an arrow: that arrow now goes to the new stage. */
  pointArrow?: ArrowId;
  /**
   * "+" on an arrow: the arrow now goes to the new stage, and the new stage's first arrow goes to
   * where the arrow went (a Blank stage gets an "In all other cases" arrow for it).
   */
  insertOn?: ArrowId;
}
export function stageAdd(doc: Doc, args: StageAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<StageId> | Refusal {
  const pointed = args.pointArrow ? arrowAndStage(doc, args.pointArrow) : undefined;
  const inserted = args.insertOn ? arrowAndStage(doc, args.insertOn) : undefined;
  if ((args.pointArrow && !pointed) || (args.insertOn && !inserted)) return refuse('notFound');

  const { stage, values, statuses } = presetStage(doc, args.kind, ctx, args.name);
  doc.statuses.push(...statuses);
  doc.values.push(...values);
  const firstEnding = doc.stages.findIndex((s) => s.kind === 'ending');
  if (stage.kind === 'ending' || firstEnding < 0) doc.stages.push(stage);
  else doc.stages.splice(firstEnding, 0, stage);

  if (pointed) pointed.arrow.goTo = stage.id;
  if (inserted) {
    const oldTarget = inserted.arrow.goTo;
    inserted.arrow.goTo = stage.id;
    if (stage.kind !== 'ending' && oldTarget !== null) {
      const added = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === stage.id);
      if (added && added.kind !== 'ending') {
        const first = added.arrows[0];
        if (first) first.goTo = oldTarget;
        else added.arrows.push({ id: ctx.newId('ar'), when: { type: 'inAllOtherCases' }, goTo: oldTarget });
      }
    }
  }
  return { id: stage.id };
}

export interface StageRenameArgs {
  stage: StageId;
  name: string;
}
/**
 * Renames the stage. An ending whose status still has the ending's words keeps them the same: the
 * status follows the new name: its own status is renamed (colour kept); when another status already
 * has the new words, the ending moves to it; when other stages share its status, it gets a new one
 * with the new words in the neutral colour, so no other stage changes. Once the author has given the
 * status other words, they stay.
 */
export function stageRename(doc: Doc, args: StageRenameArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Refusal | void {
  const stage = getStage(doc, args.stage);
  if (!stage) return refuse('notFound');
  const oldName = stage.name ?? '';
  stage.name = args.name;
  if (stage.kind === 'ending') followName(doc, stage, oldName, args.name ?? '', ctx);
}

/** How many stages show the status (as their status or their "If sent back" status). */
const showing = (doc: Doc, id: StatusId): number =>
  doc.stages.filter((s) => s.status === id || ('ifSentBackStatus' in s && s.ifSentBackStatus === id)).length;

/** An ending's status follows its name while the two are the same words. */
function followName(doc: Doc, stage: { id: StageId; status?: StatusId }, oldName: string, newName: string, ctx: CommandContext): void {
  const status = stage.status ? doc.statuses.find((s) => s.id === stage.status) : undefined;
  if (!status || !oldName.trim() || !newName.trim() || !sameWords(status.words ?? '', oldName)) return;
  if (sameWords(oldName, newName)) {
    if (showing(doc, status.id) === 1) status.words = newName.trim();
    return;
  }
  const other = doc.statuses.find((s) => s.id !== status.id && sameWords(s.words ?? '', newName));
  if (other) {
    stage.status = other.id;
    dropIfUnused(doc, status.id);
  } else if (showing(doc, status.id) === 1) {
    status.words = newName.trim();
  } else {
    const made = { id: ctx.newId('stat'), words: newName.trim(), colour: ENDING_STATUS_COLOUR };
    doc.statuses.push(made);
    stage.status = made.id;
  }
}

export interface StageDeleteArgs {
  stage: StageId;
}
export function stageDelete(doc: Doc, args: StageDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const stage = getStage(doc, args.stage);
  if (!stage) return refuse('notFound');
  if (isStartStage(doc, stage.id)) return refuse('startStage');
  const removed = collectStage(stage);
  doc.stages.splice(doc.stages.indexOf(stage), 1);
  if (doc.diagram?.positions) delete doc.diagram.positions[stage.id];
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export interface StageSetKindArgs {
  stage: StageId;
  kind: WorkingStageKind;
}
/** Changes the kind's label only; nothing in the stage changes. An ending stays an ending. */
export function stageSetKind(doc: Doc, args: StageSetKindArgs): Refusal | void {
  const entry = find(doc, args.stage);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'stage') return refuse('notFound');
  if (entry.item.kind === 'ending' || (args.kind as string) === 'ending') return refuse('kindChange');
  entry.item.kind = args.kind;
}

export const stagesCommands = {
  'stage.add': stageAdd,
  'stage.rename': stageRename,
  'stage.delete': stageDelete,
  'stage.setKind': stageSetKind,
} satisfies CommandGroup;
===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/start.test.ts\n===
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { applyCommand } from './registry';
import { createdId, fixture, step } from '../testkit';

const refused = (r: ReturnType<typeof applyCommand>) => (r.ok ? undefined : r.refusal.refused);

﻿/**
 * Commands for "Starts when" on the start stage: another system starting a request by filling in
 * the start form from what it sent. Add a binding (a catalogue trigger), change its trigger, its
 * "Only when", who it names as Requester, the answer it gives each start-form question, which
 * start-form button it presses, move it (the first binding that fits decides), and remove it.
 * Answers and the button must belong to the start stage's one task. Changing the trigger keeps
 * everything else: the check reports fields the new trigger does not send.
 */
import type {
  ButtonId,
  CatalogueRef,
  QuestionId,
  SentCondition,
  SentExpression,
  SentTemplate,
  StartsWhen,
  StartsWhenId,
  Task,
} from '@/contract';
import { find, getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

function binding(doc: Doc, id: string): StartsWhen | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  return entry?.kind === 'startsWhen' ? entry.item : undefined;
}

/** The start stage's task (the start form). */
function startTask(doc: Doc): Task | undefined {
  return getWorkingStage(doc, doc.start?.stage)?.tasks?.[0];
}

/** True when `id` is an item of `kind` inside the start form. */
function inStartForm(doc: Doc, id: string, kind: 'question' | 'button'): boolean {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  const task = startTask(doc);
  return !!task && entry?.kind === kind && entry.parents.task === task.id;
}

export interface StartsWhenAddArgs {
  /** The catalogue trigger, e.g. `helpdesk.ticketCreated@1`. (Optional in a draft.) */
  trigger?: CatalogueRef;
}
/** Adds a binding with no answers yet. Returns its ID. */
export function startsWhenAdd(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<StartsWhenId> {
  const sw: StartsWhen = { id: ctx.newId('sw'), answers: {} };
  if (args.trigger) sw.trigger = args.trigger;
  doc.start.startsWhen ??= [];
  doc.start.startsWhen.push(sw);
  return { id: sw.id };
}

export interface StartsWhenSetTriggerArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** null: not chosen yet. */
  trigger: CatalogueRef | null;
}
export function startsWhenSetTrigger(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenSetTriggerArgs): Refusal | void {
  const sw = binding(doc, args.binding);
  if (!sw) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.trigger === null) delete sw.trigger;
  else sw.trigger = args.trigger;
}

export interface StartsWhenSetOnlyWhenArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** Absent: every one sent starts a request. */
  onlyWhen?: SentCondition;
}
export function startsWhenSetOnlyWhen(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenSetOnlyWhenArgs): Refusal | void {
  const sw = binding(doc, args.binding);
  if (!sw) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.onlyWhen === undefined) delete sw.onlyWhen;
  else sw.onlyWhen = args.onlyWhen;
}

export interface StartsWhenSetRequesterArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** A sent field of kind person. Absent: the request has no person as Requester. */
  requester?: SentExpression;
}
export function startsWhenSetRequester(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenSetRequesterArgs): Refusal | void {
  const sw = binding(doc, args.binding);
  if (!sw) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.requester === undefined) delete sw.requester;
  else sw.requester = args.requester;
}

export interface StartsWhenSetAnswerArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** A question of the start form. */
  question: QuestionId;
  answer: SentExpression | SentTemplate;
}
export function startsWhenSetAnswer(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenSetAnswerArgs): Refusal | void {
  const sw = binding(doc, args.binding);
  if (!sw || !inStartForm(doc, args.question, 'question')) return refuse('notFound');
  sw.answers ??= {};
  sw.answers[args.question] = args.answer;
}

export interface StartsWhenClearAnswerArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** May name a question that no longer exists. */
  question: QuestionId;
}
/** The question stays empty when this binding starts a request. */
export function startsWhenClearAnswer(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenClearAnswerArgs): Refusal | void {
  const sw = binding(doc, args.binding);
  if (!sw) return refuse('notFound');
  if (sw.answers) delete sw.answers[args.question];
}

export interface StartsWhenSetButtonArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** A button of the start form. Absent: not chosen (fine while the form has one button). */
  button?: ButtonId;
}
export function startsWhenSetButton(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenSetButtonArgs): Refusal | void {
  const sw = binding(doc, args.binding);
  if (!sw) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.button === undefined) {
    delete sw.button;
    return;
  }
  if (!inStartForm(doc, args.button, 'button')) return refuse('notFound');
  sw.button = args.button;
}

export interface StartsWhenRemoveArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
}
export function startsWhenRemove(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenRemoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const at = (doc.start.startsWhen ?? []).findIndex((sw) => sw.id === args.binding);
  if (at < 0) return refuse('notFound');
  doc.start.startsWhen.splice(at, 1);
}

export interface StartsWhenMoveArgs {
  binding: StartsWhenId;
  /** The new position among the bindings, from 0 (clamped). */
  toIndex: number;
}
/**
 * Moves a binding up or down. The order matters: for one thing sent, the bindings are checked from
 * the top and the first whose "Only when" fits decides (runtime-api.md, inbound events).
 */
export function startsWhenMove(doc: Doc, args: StartsWhenMoveArgs): Refusal | void {
  const list = doc.start.startsWhen ?? [];
  const at = list.findIndex((sw) => sw.id === args.binding);
  if (at < 0) return refuse('notFound');
  const [sw] = list.splice(at, 1);
  const to = Number.isFinite(args.toIndex) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.trunc(args.toIndex), list.length)) : list.length;
  list.splice(to, 0, sw as StartsWhen);
}

export const startCommands = {
  'startsWhen.add': startsWhenAdd,
  'startsWhen.setTrigger': startsWhenSetTrigger,
  'startsWhen.setOnlyWhen': startsWhenSetOnlyWhen,
  'startsWhen.setRequester': startsWhenSetRequester,
  'startsWhen.setAnswer': startsWhenSetAnswer,
  'startsWhen.clearAnswer': startsWhenClearAnswer,
  'startsWhen.setButton': startsWhenSetButton,
  'startsWhen.remove': startsWhenRemove,
  'startsWhen.move': startsWhenMove,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

﻿/**
 * Status commands. A status is words and a colour; stages showing the same words share one status
 * (so creating or choosing by words reuses a status with the same words, ignoring case), and
 * renaming or recolouring a status changes it for every stage that shows it.
 * A status exists because stages show it: when a stage stops showing one that no other stage
 * shows, it is removed (status.removeIfUnused does the same on request).
 */
import type { StageId, Status, StatusId } from '@/contract';
import { find, getStage, getStatus } from '../lookup';
import { referencesTo } from '../walk';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

export type Colour = Status['colour'];
export const COLOURS: readonly Colour[] = ['grey', 'red', 'amber', 'green', 'blue', 'purple', 'teal', 'pink'];
const DEFAULT_COLOUR: Colour = 'grey';

export const sameWords = (a: string, b: string) => a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();

/** The status with these words, or a new one (colour: as given, else grey). */
function findOrCreate(doc: Doc, words: string, colour: Colour | undefined, ctx: CommandContext): StatusId {
  const same = doc.statuses.find((s) => sameWords(s.words ?? '', words));
  if (same) return same.id;
  const status: Status = { id: ctx.newId('stat'), words: words.trim(), colour: colour ?? DEFAULT_COLOUR };
  doc.statuses.push(status);
  return status.id;
}

/** Removes the status when no stage shows it. */
export function dropIfUnused(doc: Doc, id: string | undefined): void {
  if (!id || referencesTo(doc, id).length > 0) return;
  const at = doc.statuses.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
  if (at >= 0) doc.statuses.splice(at, 1);
}

export interface StatusCreateArgs {
  words: string;
  colour?: Colour;
}
/** A status with these words: the existing one if there is one (its colour unchanged), else a new one. */
export function statusCreate(doc: Doc, args: StatusCreateArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<StatusId> {
  return { id: findOrCreate(doc, args.words ?? '', args.colour, ctx) };
}

export interface StatusRenameArgs {
  status: StatusId;
  words: string;
}
/** Changes the words for every stage that shows the status. Does not merge with a status that has the same words. */
export function statusRename(doc: Doc, args: StatusRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const status = getStatus(doc, args.status);
  if (!status) return refuse('notFound');
  status.words = args.words ?? '';
}

export interface StatusSetColourArgs {
  status: StatusId;
  colour: Colour;
}
export function statusSetColour(doc: Doc, args: StatusSetColourArgs): Refusal | void {
  const status = getStatus(doc, args.status);
  if (!status || !COLOURS.includes(args.colour)) return refuse('notFound');
  status.colour = args.colour;
}

/**
 * Which status a stage shows: an existing status by ID, words (reusing a status with the same
 * words, or creating one), or none (`status: null`, or empty words). Returns the status used.
 */
export type StageStatusArgs = { stage: StageId } & ({ status: StatusId | null } | { words: string; colour?: Colour });

type StatusField = 'status' | 'ifSentBackStatus';

function setStageStatus(field: StatusField) {
  return (doc: Doc, args: StageStatusArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<StatusId> | Refusal | void => {
    const stage = getStage(doc, args.stage);
    if (!stage) return refuse('notFound');
    if (stage.kind === 'ending' && field === 'ifSentBackStatus') return refuse('ending');
    let next: StatusId | undefined;
    if ('words' in args) {
      if (args.words.trim()) next = findOrCreate(doc, args.words, args.colour, ctx);
    } else if (args.status !== null) {
      if (!getStatus(doc, args.status)) return refuse('notFound');
      next = args.status;
    }
    const target = stage as { status?: StatusId; ifSentBackStatus?: StatusId };
    const old = target[field];
    if (next) target[field] = next;
    else delete target[field];
    if (old !== next) dropIfUnused(doc, old);
    return next ? { id: next } : undefined;
  };
}

/** The status people see while a request is at the stage. */
export const stageSetStatus = setStageStatus('status');
/** "If sent back": the status shown when the request was sent back to the stage (working stages only). */
export const stageSetIfSentBackStatus = setStageStatus('ifSentBackStatus');

export interface StatusRemoveIfUnusedArgs {
  status: StatusId;
}
/** Removes the status if no stage shows it; otherwise changes nothing. */
export function statusRemoveIfUnused(doc: Doc, args: StatusRemoveIfUnusedArgs): Refusal | void {
  if (find(doc, args.status)?.kind !== 'status') return refuse('notFound');
  dropIfUnused(doc, args.status);
}

export const statusesCommands = {
  'status.create': statusCreate,
  'status.rename': statusRename,
  'status.setColour': statusSetColour,
  'stage.setStatus': stageSetStatus,
  'stage.setIfSentBackStatus': stageSetIfSentBackStatus,
  'status.removeIfUnused': statusRemoveIfUnused,
} satisfies CommandGroup;
