===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/tasks.ts\n===
/**
 * Task commands: add a second (third ...) task to a stage, delete, rename, who is asked, "The
 * requester can't answer their own request", and saving the task's two extra answers ("Button
 * pressed", "Answered by"), whose values are created the first time they are used.
 * Naming (authored-format.ts, Task.name): a task's name is absent while its stage has one task;
 * with several the editor shows each after who is asked, and `name` is stored only when the
 * author renames one. So adding a task stores no names, and deleting down to one task clears it.
 * The start stage keeps exactly one task.
 */
import type { Expression, StageId, Task, TaskId, Value, ValueId, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { find, getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { buttonArrow, PRESET_WORDS, presetTask, uniqueName } from '../presets';
import { isStartStage } from '../graph';
import { insertArrow } from './arrows';
import { collectTask, emptyRemoved, tidyAfterRemoval } from './removal';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

function taskPlace(doc: Doc, taskId: string): { task: Task; stage: WorkingStage } | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, taskId);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'task') return undefined;
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, entry.parents.stage);
  return stage ? { task: entry.item, stage } : undefined;
}

export interface TaskAddArgs {
  stage: StageId;
}
/**
 * Adds a task asked at the same time as the others, pre-filled like the stage's kind (Approval:
 * Approve / Reject and Reason; Form: Submit; Work: Mark done; otherwise an empty form and no
 * button). Each new button gets its arrow.
 */
export function taskAdd(doc: Doc, args: TaskAddArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<TaskId> | Refusal {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, args.stage);
  if (!stage) return refuse(find(doc, args.stage) ? 'ending' : 'notFound');
  if (isStartStage(doc, stage.id)) return refuse('startStage');
  const { task, values } = presetTask(doc, stage.kind, ctx);
  stage.tasks.push(task);
  doc.values.push(...values);
  for (const button of task.buttons) insertArrow(stage, buttonArrow(ctx, button.id));
  return { id: task.id };
}

export interface TaskDeleteArgs {
  task: TaskId;
}
/** Deletes the task, its buttons' arrows, and values only it filled. */
export function taskDelete(doc: Doc, args: TaskDeleteArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = taskPlace(doc, args.task);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  const { task, stage } = place;
  if (isStartStage(doc, stage.id)) return refuse('startStage');
  const removed = collectTask(task, emptyRemoved());
  stage.tasks.splice(stage.tasks.indexOf(task), 1);
  stage.arrows = stage.arrows.filter((a) => {
    const own = a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button !== null && removed.items.has(a.when.button);
    if (own) removed.items.set(a.id, a.words ?? '');
    return !own;
  });
  if (stage.tasks.length === 1 && stage.tasks[0]) delete stage.tasks[0].name;
  tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
}

export interface TaskRenameArgs {
  task: TaskId;
  /** Absent or empty: named after who is asked again. */
  name?: string;
}
export function taskRename(doc: Doc, args: TaskRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = taskPlace(doc, args.task);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (!args.name) delete place.task.name;
  else place.task.name = args.name;
}

export interface TaskSetWhoIsAskedArgs {
  task: TaskId;
  /** Absent: nobody is asked (a To do). */
  whoIsAsked?: Expression;
}
export function taskSetWhoIsAsked(doc: Doc, args: TaskSetWhoIsAskedArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = taskPlace(doc, args.task);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  if (args.whoIsAsked === undefined) delete place.task.whoIsAsked;
  else place.task.whoIsAsked = args.whoIsAsked;
}

export interface TaskSetRequesterCanAnswerArgs {
  task: TaskId;
  value: boolean;
}
export function taskSetRequesterCanAnswer(doc: Doc, args: TaskSetRequesterCanAnswerArgs): Refusal | void {
  const place = taskPlace(doc, args.task);
  if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
  place.task.requesterCanAnswer = args.value;
}

export interface TaskSaveExtraAnswerArgs {
  task: TaskId;
  /**
   * Which value keeps it. Absent: the one already used, or a new value named "<stage>: button
   * pressed" / "<stage>: answered by" (the task's own name instead when it has one). null: stop
   * saving it (the value goes if nothing else fills it).
   */
  value?: ValueId | null;
}

type ExtraAnswer = 'savesButtonPressedAs' | 'savesAnsweredByAs';

function saveExtraAnswer(
  field: ExtraAnswer,
  words: string,
): (doc: Doc, args: TaskSaveExtraAnswerArgs, ctx: CommandContext) => Created<ValueId> | Refusal | void {
  return (doc, args, ctx) => {
    const place = taskPlace(doc, args.task);
    if (!place) return refuse('notFound');
    const { task, stage } = place;
    const current = task[field];
    if (args.value === null) {
      if (!current) return;
      delete task[field];
      const removed = emptyRemoved();
      removed.filledValues.add(current);
      tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
      return;
    }
    if (args.value !== undefined) {
      if (find(doc, args.value)?.kind !== 'value') return refuse('notFound');
      task[field] = args.value;
      if (current && current !== args.value) {
        const removed = emptyRemoved();
        removed.filledValues.add(current);
        tidyAfterRemoval(doc, removed);
      }
      return { id: args.value };
    }
    if (current && find(doc, current)?.kind === 'value') return { id: current };
    const base = words.replace('{name}', task.name || stage.name || '');
    const value: Value = { id: ctx.newId('v'), name: uniqueName(base, doc.values.map((v) => v.name ?? '')) };
    doc.values.push(value);
    task[field] = value.id;
    return { id: value.id };
  };
}

/** "Button pressed": keep which button was pressed in a value. */
export const taskSaveButtonPressedAs = saveExtraAnswer('savesButtonPressedAs', PRESET_WORDS.buttonPressed);
/** "Answered by": keep who answered in a value. */
export const taskSaveAnsweredByAs = saveExtraAnswer('savesAnsweredByAs', PRESET_WORDS.answeredBy);

export const tasksCommands = {
  'task.add': taskAdd,
  'task.delete': taskDelete,
  'task.rename': taskRename,
  'task.setWhoIsAsked': taskSetWhoIsAsked,
  'task.setRequesterCanAnswer': taskSetRequesterCanAnswer,
  'task.saveButtonPressedAs': taskSaveButtonPressedAs,
  'task.saveAnsweredByAs': taskSaveAnsweredByAs,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/told.ts\n===
﻿/**
 * Commands for the things the workflow tells other systems happened ("Change deployed"): a registry
 * like statuses, so several "Tell other systems" actions can tell the same thing. Creating by words
 * reuses an entry with the same words (ignoring case). Outside systems key on the ID, so renaming
 * keeps it. An action points at an entry with action.update (`tell`).
 */
import type { ThingTold, ToldId } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { referencesTo } from '../walk';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

const sameWords = (a: string, b: string) => a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();

function getTold(doc: Doc, id: string): ThingTold | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  return entry?.kind === 'thingTold' ? entry.item : undefined;
}

export interface ToldCreateArgs {
  words: string;
}
/** The thing told with these words: the existing one, or a new one. Empty words always make a new one. */
export function toldCreate(doc: Doc, args: ToldCreateArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ToldId> {
  const words = (args.words ?? '').trim();
  doc.thingsTold ??= [];
  const same = words ? doc.thingsTold.find((t) => sameWords(t.words ?? '', words)) : undefined;
  if (same) return { id: same.id };
  const told: ThingTold = { id: ctx.newId('told'), words };
  doc.thingsTold.push(told);
  return { id: told.id };
}

export interface ToldRenameArgs {
  told: ToldId;
  words: string;
}
export function toldRename(doc: Doc, args: ToldRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const told = getTold(doc, args.told);
  if (!told) return refuse('notFound');
  told.words = args.words ?? '';
}

export interface ToldRemoveIfUnusedArgs {
  told: ToldId;
}
/** Removes the entry if no action tells it; otherwise changes nothing. */
export function toldRemoveIfUnused(doc: Doc, args: ToldRemoveIfUnusedArgs): Refusal | void {
  if (!getTold(doc, args.told)) return refuse('notFound');
  if (referencesTo(doc, args.told).length > 0) return;
  doc.thingsTold = doc.thingsTold.filter((t) => t.id !== args.told);
}

export const toldCommands = {
  'told.create': toldCreate,
  'told.rename': toldRename,
  'told.removeIfUnused': toldRemoveIfUnused,
} satisfies CommandGroup;
===\nfrontend/src/model/commands/types.ts\n===
/**
 * The shape of a command (docs/08, F2): a named edit that changes the draft document in place
 * (immer) and may refuse or report what it created. Declare a group like this, so the registry
 * keeps each command's own argument type:
 *
 *   export const formsCommands = {
 *     'question.add': questionAdd,   // a Command<QuestionAddArgs>
 *   } satisfies CommandGroup;
 *
 * Kept apart from registry.ts so the groups can import it without a cycle.
 */
import type { Draft } from 'immer';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { IdPrefix } from '../ids';

/** The document as a command sees it: a draft to change in place. */
export type Doc = Draft<AuthoredWorkflow>;

export interface CommandContext {
  /** A fresh, unused ID with this prefix (unique also among IDs handed out earlier in the same command). */
  newId<P extends IdPrefix>(prefix: P): `${P}_${string}`;
}

/**
 * Why a command did nothing. Codes, not words: the screen that offers the command says it.
 *  - notFound: an ID in the arguments is not in the document.
 *  - startStage: the start stage cannot be deleted, or must keep exactly one task.
 *  - ending: an ending has no tasks, buttons or arrows.
 *  - catchAllExists: the stage already has an "In all other cases" arrow.
 *  - catchAllStaysLast: "In all other cases" cannot be moved.
 *  - kindChange: a working stage cannot become an ending or the other way round.
 *  - choicesNotTypedIn: a typed-in choice cannot be added to a question whose choices come from elsewhere.
 *  - notThisStage: a "when" set by a command (an arrow's "when" or "+ only when ...", an action's
 *    "Only when", a button's "Also only when", a "Show when") says a button of another stage is
 *    pressed, or an arrow's button is another stage's: only the stage's own buttons can be pressed there.
 *  - notFound also covers a command that would add a new reference to something already deleted
 *    (references that were there before stay).
 *  - inUse: a list is still used; the refusal carries `usedIn` (where).
 *  - wrongKind: a cell's constant is not of its column's kind.
 */
export type RefusalCode =
  | 'notFound' | 'startStage' | 'ending' | 'catchAllExists' | 'catchAllStaysLast' | 'kindChange'
  | 'choicesNotTypedIn' | 'notThisStage' | 'inUse' | 'wrongKind';

export interface Refusal {
  refused: RefusalCode;
  /** Only with `inUse`: the places that still use the thing. */
  usedIn?: Location[];
}

/** What a command that adds something returns: the new item's ID. */
export interface Created<I extends string = string> {
  id: I;
}

export type CommandResult = void | Refusal | Created;

export type Command<A> = (doc: Doc, args: A, ctx: CommandContext) => CommandResult;

/** A group of commands by name. `never` accepts every argument type (parameters are contravariant). */
export type CommandGroup = Record<string, Command<never>>;

export const refuse = (code: RefusalCode): Refusal => ({ refused: code });

export function isRefusal(result: unknown): result is Refusal {
  return typeof result === 'object' && result !== null && 'refused' in result;
}

﻿/**
 * Value commands (the Values tab and the value picker): rename, description, "+ New value" (a
 * value typed as a new name in a Save action, which the Save action then fills), and removing a
 * value that nothing fills or uses.
 *
 * Also exports the rule the form commands use when a question goes or stops saving into a value:
 * the value stays while anything else fills it or uses it (a chip, a formula, a step), and is
 * removed, with its sample answer, only when nothing does. Its sample answer alone does not keep it.
 */
import type { Value, ValueId } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { referencesTo } from '../walk';
import { refuse, type CommandContext, type CommandGroup, type Created, type Doc, type Refusal } from './types';

/** True when nothing refers to the value except its own sample answer. */
export function isValueUnused(doc: Doc, valueId: string): boolean {
  return referencesTo(doc, valueId).every((r) => r.how === 'sampleAnswer');
}

/** Removes the value and its sample answer when nothing fills or uses it. True when it was removed. */
export function removeValueIfUnused(doc: Doc, valueId: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (!valueId || !isValueUnused(doc, valueId)) return false;
  const at = doc.values.findIndex((v) => v.id === valueId);
  if (at < 0) return false;
  doc.values.splice(at, 1);
  if (doc.sampleRequest?.answers && valueId in doc.sampleRequest.answers) delete doc.sampleRequest.answers[valueId as ValueId];
  return true;
}

function valueOf(doc: Doc, id: string): Value | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  return entry?.kind === 'value' ? entry.item : undefined;
}

export interface ValueRenameArgs {
  value: ValueId;
  /** May be empty in a draft (a To do). Two values may share a name; the editor says so. */
  name: string;
}
export function valueRename(doc: Doc, args: ValueRenameArgs): Refusal | void {
  const value = valueOf(doc, args.value);
  if (!value) return refuse('notFound');
  value.name = args.name;
}

export interface ValueSetDescriptionArgs {
  value: ValueId;
  /** Absent or empty: no description. */
  description?: string;
}
export function valueSetDescription(doc: Doc, args: ValueSetDescriptionArgs): Refusal | void {
  const value = valueOf(doc, args.value);
  if (!value) return refuse('notFound');
  if (!args.description) delete value.description;
  else value.description = args.description;
}

export interface ValueCreateArgs {
  /** As typed. Not made unique: naming a value like another does not merge them. */
  name: string;
  description?: string;
}
/**
 * "+ New value": adds a value nothing fills yet; the caller then points a filler at it (e.g.
 * `action.update` with a new `as`). Until then it is unused, and `value.removeIfUnused` tidies it away.
 */
export function valueCreate(doc: Doc, args: ValueCreateArgs, ctx: CommandContext): Created<ValueId> {
  const value: Value = { id: ctx.newId('v'), name: args.name };
  if (args.description) value.description = args.description;
  doc.values.push(value);
  return { id: value.id };
}

export interface ValueRemoveIfUnusedArgs {
  value: ValueId;
}
/** Removes the value when nothing fills or uses it; otherwise changes nothing. */
export function valueRemoveIfUnused(doc: Doc, args: ValueRemoveIfUnusedArgs): Refusal | void {
  if (!valueOf(doc, args.value)) return refuse('notFound');
  removeValueIfUnused(doc, args.value);
}

export const valuesCommands = {
  'value.rename': valueRename,
  'value.setDescription': valueSetDescription,
  'value.create': valueCreate,
  'value.removeIfUnused': valueRemoveIfUnused,
} satisfies CommandGroup;

/**
 * Two rules every command keeps: a "when" may press only its own stage's buttons (notThisStage),
 * and no command adds a new reference to something already deleted (notFound).

import type { Condition } from '@/contract';

const orPressed = (button: string): Condition => ({
  anyOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }, { pressed: button as 'btn_x' }],

    ['text.setShowWhen', () => applyCommand(doc, 'text.setShowWhen', { text: 'tx_sent_back_note', showWhen: pressed('btn_da_reject') })],

===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/action.ts\n===
/**
 * Actions in words: "Notify Requester", "Save High as Risk level", "Tell other systems: Change
 * released", and an action that uses a connection, named from its catalogue entry ("Create Jira
 * issue", "Look up a service", "Wait for Deploy pipeline: run the pipeline"); each with its
 * "only when ..." suffix. `actionChip` is the short text on diagram cards ("Notify Requester (when
 * Reject)").
 */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Condition, UseConnection } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { connectionLabel, entryOf } from './catalogue';
import { describeCondition } from './condition';
import { describeExpression } from './expression';
import { buttonChip, deletedName, valueChip } from './names';
import { chip, gap, joinPhrases, lowerFirst, missing, phrase, toText, w, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';

const ARTICLES = new Set(['a', 'an', 'the']);
/** Looked for in a catalogue label, never shown (so not in src/words): see withoutTrailingWait. */
const AWAIT_TAIL = 'and wait';

/** The action's name: what it does, without its "only when". `short` drops "(if empty, use ...)" and an operation's detail. */
export function actionName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, action: Action, env: DescribeEnv = {}, short = false): Phrase {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'saveValue':
      return phrase('describe.action.save', {
        what: action.save ? describeExpression(doc, action.save, env, { short }) : gap(),
        value: action.as ? valueChip(doc, action.as) : gap(),
      });
    case 'notify':
      return phrase('describe.action.notify', { to: action.to ? describeExpression(doc, action.to, env, { short }) : gap() });
    case 'useConnection':
      return operationName(action, env, short);
    case 'tellOtherSystems':
      return phrase('describe.action.tell', { thing: toldWords(doc, action.tell) });
    default:
      return [gap()];
  }
}

function toldWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined): Phrase {
  if (!id) return [gap()];
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'thingTold') return [missing(deletedName(doc, id))];
  return entry.item.words?.trim() ? [entry.item.words] : [missing(w('describe.noName'))];
}

/**
 * An operation's name from the catalogue: a read is its label ("Look up a service"); a write puts
 * the connection after the verb ("Create issue" in Jira: "Create Jira issue"); an await reads
 * "Wait for Deploy pipeline: run the pipeline" ("Wait for Deploy pipeline" when short). Without the
 * catalogue entry: the operation's ID.
 */
function operationName(action: UseConnection, env: DescribeEnv, short: boolean): Phrase {
  const ref = action.operation;
  if (!ref) return phrase('describe.action.noOperation', { gap: gap() });
  const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, ref);
  if (!entry || entry.kind !== 'operation') return [chip('connection', ref, ref)];
  const connection = connectionLabel(env.catalogue, entry, ref);
  const label = entry.label ?? '';
  if (entry.sort === 'await') {
    const c = chip('connection', connection, entry.connection);
    if (short) return phrase('describe.action.awaitChip', { connection: c });
    return phrase('describe.action.await', { connection: c, label: lowerFirst(withoutTrailingWait(label)) });
  }
  if (entry.sort === 'read' || label.toLowerCase().includes(connection.toLowerCase())) return [label];
  const [verb = '', ...rest] = label.trim().split(/\s+/);
  while (rest.length > 1 && ARTICLES.has((rest[0] ?? '').toLowerCase())) rest.shift();
  if (rest.length === 0) return phrase('describe.action.writeOneWord', { label, connection });
  return phrase('describe.action.write', { verb, connection, rest: rest.join(' ') });
}

/**
 * A catalogue label without its closing "and wait ..." ("Run the pipeline and wait (until it
 * reports back)" -> "Run the pipeline"), since "Wait for" already says it. A label that starts
 * with it, or does not have it, stays.
 */
export function withoutTrailingWait(label: string): string {
  const at = ` ${label.toLowerCase()} `.indexOf(` ${AWAIT_TAIL} `);
  if (at <= 0) return label;
  return label.slice(0, at).trim();
}

/** The action in words, with ", only when ..." when it has one. */
export function describeAction(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, action: Action, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  const name = actionName(doc, action, env);
  if (!action.onlyWhen) return name;
  return phrase('describe.action.onlyWhen', { action: name, condition: describeCondition(doc, action.onlyWhen, env) });
}

/** The short text on a diagram card: "Notify Requester", "Notify Requester (when Reject)". */
export function actionChip(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, action: Action, env: DescribeEnv = {}): string {
  const name = actionName(doc, action, env, true);
  if (!action.onlyWhen) return toText(name);
  return toText(phrase('describe.action.chipWhen', { action: name, condition: shortWhen(doc, action.onlyWhen, env) }));
}

/** "Reject" for "Reject is pressed" (also when several tasks press a button with that label); else the condition. */
function shortWhen(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, condition: Condition, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase {
  if ('allOf' in condition || 'anyOf' in condition) {
    const clauses = 'allOf' in condition ? condition.allOf : condition.anyOf;
    if (clauses.length > 0 && clauses.every((c) => 'pressed' in c)) {
      const labels = [...new Set(clauses.map((c) => toText([buttonChip(doc, (c as { pressed: string }).pressed)])))];
      return joinPhrases(labels.map((l) => [l]), 'allOf' in condition ? 'and' : 'or');
    }
  }
  return describeCondition(doc, condition, env);
}

/** arrowChoices and the bracket in arrow labels: "Domain needs no approval (Internal tools)". */
import { describe as group, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Clause, Expression, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { fixture } from '../testkit';
import { arrowChoices, arrowLabel } from './index';

const doc = fixture('change-request');
const column = (col: string, ifEmptyUse?: Expression): Expression =>
  ({ value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: col }], ...(ifEmptyUse ? { ifEmptyUse } : {}) }) as Expression;
const arrowWhen = (clauses: Clause[], any = false): Arrow =>
  ({ id: 'ar_x', when: { type: 'condition', condition: any ? { anyOf: clauses } : { allOf: clauses } }, goTo: null }) as Arrow;
const arrow = (d: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string) =>
  d.stages.flatMap((s) => (s.kind === 'ending' ? [] : (s as WorkingStage).arrows)).find((a) => a.id === id)!;

group('arrowChoices', () => {
  it('works out the demo bracket', () => {
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrow(doc, 'ar_rf_no_approval'))).toEqual(['Internal tools']);
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, arrow(doc, 'ar_rf_no_approval'))).toBe('Domain needs no approval (Internal tools)');
  });

  it('lists several choices in the list order, joined with "or"', () => {
    const a = arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_needs_approval'), words: 'yesNo.isYes' }]);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, a)).toEqual(['Payments', 'Identity', 'Data platform']);
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, a)).toBe('Primary domain needs approval (Payments, Identity or Data platform)');
  });

  it('compares text, filled and empty cells', () => {
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.startsWith', right: { text: 'pay' } }]))).toEqual(['Payments']);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.isNot', right: { text: 'Payments' } }]))).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_default_lead'), words: 'person.isFilled' }]))).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_approvers'), words: 'people.areEmpty' }]))).toEqual(['Internal tools']);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_approvers'), words: 'people.include', right: { text: 'x' } }]))).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('joins clauses with and / or', () => {
    const yes: Clause = { left: column('col_needs_approval'), words: 'yesNo.isYes' };
    const id: Clause = { left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.is', right: { text: 'Identity' } };
    const internal: Clause = { left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.is', right: { text: 'Internal tools' } };
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([yes, id]))).toEqual(['Identity']);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([id, internal], true))).toEqual(['Identity', 'Internal tools']);
  });

  it('uses a typed "If empty, use ..."', () => {
    const x = { directoryId: 'dir-group-x', name: 'X' };
    const approvers = column('col_approvers', { group: x });
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: approvers, words: 'person.is', right: { group: x } }]))).toEqual(['Internal tools']);
    const byValue = column('col_approvers', { value: 'v_title' });
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, arrowWhen([{ left: byValue, words: 'person.isFilled' }]))).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('gives [] when no choice fits, and no bracket then', () => {
    const a = arrowWhen([{ left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.is', right: { text: 'Nothing' } }]);
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, a)).toEqual([]);
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, a)).toBe('Primary domain\'s domain is Nothing');
  });

  it('works on "+ only when ..." of a pressed arrow', () => {
    const a = { id: 'ar_x', when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: 'btn_da_approve' }, goTo: null,
      onlyWhen: { allOf: [{ left: column('col_needs_approval'), words: 'yesNo.isNo' }] } } as Arrow;
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, a)).toEqual(['Internal tools']);
  });

  it('gives nothing for what the editor cannot work out', () => {
    const cases: (Arrow | Clause[])[] = [
      [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }],
      [{ left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.is', right: { value: 'v_title' } }],
      [{ left: column('col_needs_approval'), words: 'yesNo.isYes' }, { left: { value: 'v_title', steps: [{ column: 'col_domain' }] }, words: 'text.isFilled' }],
      [{ pressed: 'btn_da_approve' }],
      [{ left: column('col_needs_approval') }],
      [{ left: column('col_gone'), words: 'yesNo.isYes' }],
      [{ left: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }, { directory: 'members' }] }, words: 'people.areFilled' }],
      [{ left: column('col_domain'), words: 'text.is' }],
      [],
    ];
    for (const c of cases) expect(arrowChoices(doc, Array.isArray(c) ? arrowWhen(c) : c)).toBeUndefined();

    expect(arrowChoices(doc, { id: 'ar_x', when: { type: 'condition' }, goTo: null } as Arrow)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(arrowChoices(doc, { id: 'ar_x', when: { type: 'inAllOtherCases' }, goTo: null } as Arrow)).toBeUndefined();
  });

    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    delete d.lists[0]!.rows.find((r) => r.id === 'row_internal_tools')!.cells.col_domain;
    expect(arrowChoices(d, arrow(d, 'ar_rf_no_approval'))).toEqual(['(no name yet)']);
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/arrow-choices.ts\n===
/**
 * Which choices of a list take an arrow, worked out by the editor and never typed: the bracket in
 * "Domain needs no approval (Internal tools)" (editor-model.md section 2, Labels). Applies when
 * every clause of the arrow's condition reads a column of the same list-choice value and compares
 * it with a typed constant; each row of the list is then tried against the clauses. Anything the
 * editor cannot work out on its own (a value on the right, a formula, a directory step) gives no
 * bracket rather than a guess.
 */
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Clause, Condition, Constant, Row, ValueReference, Words } from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { rowChip } from './expression';

/** A cell or typed constant as something to compare; undefined when empty or not comparable. */
type Scalar = string | number | boolean;

function scalar(c: Constant | undefined): Scalar | undefined {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return undefined;
  if ('text' in c) return c.text === '' ? undefined : c.text;
  if ('number' in c) return c.number;
  if ('yesNo' in c) return c.yesNo;
  if ('date' in c) return c.date;
  if ('person' in c) return c.person?.directoryId;
  if ('group' in c) return c.group?.directoryId;
  return undefined;
}

const isConstant = (x: unknown): x is Constant =>
  !!x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x) &&
  !['value', 'request', 'formula', 'allOf', 'anyOf', 'sentField'].some((k) => k in (x as object));

/** One clause on one cell: true, false, or undefined when the editor cannot say. */
function test(words: Words, cell: Scalar | undefined, right: unknown): boolean | undefined {
  const [, word = ''] = words.split('.');
  if (word === 'isFilled' || word === 'areFilled') return cell !== undefined;
  if (word === 'isEmpty' || word === 'areEmpty') return cell === undefined;
  if (words === 'yesNo.isYes') return cell === true;
  if (words === 'yesNo.isNo') return cell === false;
  if (!isConstant(right)) return undefined;
  const r = scalar(right);
  if (r === undefined) return undefined;
  if (cell === undefined) return false; // an empty cell compared with something never takes the arrow
  switch (words) {
    case 'text.is': case 'number.is': case 'date.is': case 'person.is': return cell === r;
    case 'text.isNot': case 'number.isNot': case 'person.isNot': return cell !== r;
    case 'text.contains': return String(cell).toLowerCase().includes(String(r).toLowerCase());
    case 'text.doesNotContain': return !String(cell).toLowerCase().includes(String(r).toLowerCase());
    case 'text.startsWith': return String(cell).toLowerCase().startsWith(String(r).toLowerCase());
    case 'number.isMoreThan': case 'date.isAfter': return cell > r;
    case 'number.isLessThan': case 'date.isBefore': return cell < r;
    case 'number.isAtLeast': case 'date.isOnOrAfter': return cell >= r;
    case 'number.isAtMost': case 'date.isOnOrBefore': return cell <= r;
    default: return undefined;
  }
}

interface ColumnClause {
  value: string;
  column: string;
  words: Words;
  right: unknown;
  ifEmptyUse?: unknown;
}

/** The clause as "a column of a value", or undefined when it is anything else. */
function columnClause(clause: Clause): ColumnClause | undefined {
  if (!clause || typeof clause !== 'object' || 'pressed' in clause || !clause.words) return undefined;
  const left = clause.left as ValueReference | undefined;
  if (!left || typeof left !== 'object' || typeof left.value !== 'string') return undefined;
  const steps = left.steps ?? [];
  const step = steps[0];
  if (steps.length !== 1 || !step || !('column' in step)) return undefined;
  return { value: left.value, column: step.column, words: clause.words, right: clause.right, ifEmptyUse: left.ifEmptyUse };
}

function cellOf(row: Row, c: ColumnClause): Scalar | undefined | null {
  const cell = scalar(row.cells?.[c.column as keyof Row['cells']]);
  if (cell !== undefined || c.ifEmptyUse === undefined) return cell;
  return isConstant(c.ifEmptyUse) ? scalar(c.ifEmptyUse) : null; // null: cannot say
}

/** The condition the arrow's label is about: its "when ..." when it depends on answers, else its "+ only when ...". */
function conditionOf(arrow: Arrow): Condition | undefined {
  if (arrow.when?.type === 'condition' && arrow.when.condition) return arrow.when.condition;
  return arrow.onlyWhen;
}

/**
 * The labels of the list's rows that take this arrow ("Internal tools"), in the list's order.
 * Undefined when the condition is not one the editor can work out for a list; [] when no row fits.
 */
export function arrowChoices(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): string[] | undefined {
  const condition = conditionOf(arrow);
  if (!condition || typeof condition !== 'object' || 'formula' in condition) return undefined;
  const all = 'allOf' in condition;
  const clauses = ((all ? condition.allOf : condition.anyOf) ?? []).map(columnClause);
  if (clauses.length === 0 || clauses.some((c) => !c)) return undefined;
  const parts = clauses as ColumnClause[];
  if (new Set(parts.map((c) => c.value)).size !== 1) return undefined;
  const lists = new Set(parts.map((c) => find(doc, c.column)).map((e) => (e?.kind === 'column' ? e.parents.list : undefined)));
  const [listId] = [...lists];
  if (lists.size !== 1 || !listId) return undefined;
  const list = find(doc, listId);
  if (list?.kind !== 'list') return undefined;

  const labels: string[] = [];
  for (const row of list.item.rows ?? []) {
    const results = parts.map((c) => {
      const cell = cellOf(row, c);
      return cell === null ? undefined : test(c.words, cell, c.right);
    });
    if (results.some((r) => r === undefined)) return undefined;
    if (all ? results.every(Boolean) : results.some(Boolean)) labels.push(rowChip(doc, row.id).label);
  }
  return labels;
}

/**
 * Arrows in words: the "When ... go to ..." line of the panel and In words, in its parts, and the
 * short words drawn on the diagram's pill ("Approve pressed", "In all other cases", "When done").
 */
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Clause, Condition } from '@/contract';
import { find, getTask, getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { describeClause, describeCondition, describePressed, isOrGroup, joinGroups, type Group } from './condition';
import { buttonChip, stageChip, stageHasSeveralTasks } from './names';
import { arrowChoices } from './arrow-choices';
import { gap, joinEach, joinPhrases, missing, phrase, toText, w, type Phrase } from './phrase';

export interface ArrowWords {
  /** "When Approve is pressed", "When Risk is High", "In all other cases", "When done". */
  when: Phrase;
  /** The "+ only when ..." part ("Risk is High"); absent when the arrow has none. */
  onlyWhen?: Phrase;
  /** The stage chip, "(choose a stage)" (missing), or "<old name> (deleted)" (missing). */
  goTo: Phrase;
  /** The whole line: "When Approve is pressed and Risk is High go to Security review". */
  sentence: Phrase;
}

/**
 * True for a "When done" arrow that comes after an arrow depending on answers: it is then the
 * catch-all of a numbered list and reads "In all other cases" (editor-model.md section 3: "When
 * arrows depend on answers rather than buttons, the last arrow is In all other cases go to ...").
 * "When done" stays for an Automatic stage's only arrow (section 2).
 */
export function whenDoneIsOtherCases(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): boolean {
  if (arrow.when?.type !== 'whenDone') return false;
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, find(doc, arrow.id)?.parents.stage);
  if (!stage) return false;
  const at = stage.arrows.findIndex((a) => a.id === arrow.id);
  return stage.arrows.slice(0, Math.max(at, 0)).some((a) => a.when?.type === 'condition' || a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed');
}

/** The "When ..." part of an arrow. */
export function describeArrowWhen(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): Phrase {
  const when = arrow.when;
  switch (when?.type) {
    case 'buttonPressed':
      return phrase('describe.arrow.when', { condition: describePressed(doc, when.button) });
    case 'condition':
      return phrase('describe.arrow.when', { condition: describeCondition(doc, when.condition) });
    case 'inAllOtherCases':
      return [w('describe.arrow.inAllOtherCases')];
    case 'whenDone':
      return [w(whenDoneIsOtherCases(doc, arrow) ? 'describe.arrow.inAllOtherCases' : 'describe.arrow.whenDone')];
    default:
      return phrase('describe.arrow.when', { condition: gap() });
  }
}

/** Where an arrow goes, as a stage chip or "(choose a stage)". */
export function describeGoTo(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, goTo: string | null | undefined): Phrase {
  return goTo ? [stageChip(doc, goTo)] : [missing(w('describe.arrow.nowhere'))];
}

/** The arrow's line in its parts. */
export function describeArrow(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): ArrowWords {
  const when = describeArrowWhen(doc, arrow);
  const goTo = describeGoTo(doc, arrow.goTo);
  if (!arrow.onlyWhen) return { when, goTo, sentence: phrase('describe.arrow.sentence', { when, goTo }) };
  const onlyWhen = describeCondition(doc, arrow.onlyWhen);
  const first = whenGroup(doc, arrow);
  if (!first) return { when, onlyWhen, goTo, sentence: phrase('describe.arrow.sentenceOnlyWhen', { when, onlyWhen, goTo }) };
  const joined = joinGroups([first, { phrase: onlyWhen, or: isOrGroup(arrow.onlyWhen) }]);
  return { when, onlyWhen, goTo, sentence: phrase('describe.arrow.sentence', { when: phrase('describe.arrow.when', { condition: joined }), goTo }) };
}

/** The arrow's own "when" as a group to join its "+ only when ..." to; undefined for "In all other cases" / "When done". */
function whenGroup(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): Group | undefined {
  const when = arrow.when;
  if (when?.type === 'buttonPressed') return { phrase: describePressed(doc, when.button), or: false };
  if (when?.type === 'condition') return { phrase: describeCondition(doc, when.condition), or: isOrGroup(when.condition) };
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * The short words on the diagram: the author's "Words on the arrow", else worked out from the
 * arrow; then, when the arrow depends on a list choice, the choices that take it in brackets,
 * never typed: "Domain needs no approval (Internal tools)".
 */
export function arrowLabel(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): string {
  const label = wordsOrWorkedOut(doc, arrow);
  const choices = arrowChoices(doc, arrow);
  if (!choices?.length) return label;
  return toText(phrase('describe.label.choices', { label, choices: joinPhrases(choices.map((c) => [c]), 'or') }));
}

function wordsOrWorkedOut(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): string {
  if (arrow.words?.trim()) return arrow.words;
  const base = baseLabel(doc, arrow);
  if (!arrow.onlyWhen) return base;
  const baseIsOr = arrow.when?.type === 'condition' && isOrGroup(arrow.when.condition);
  const joined = toText(
    joinGroups([
      { phrase: [base], or: baseIsOr },
      { phrase: describeCondition(doc, arrow.onlyWhen), or: isOrGroup(arrow.onlyWhen) },
    ]),
  );
  return joined.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + joined.slice(1);
}

/**
 * A "when ..." as the pill says it: a pressed part reads "Approve pressed" like the plain button
 * arrow beside it ("Approve pressed and Risk is High", editor-model.md section 3), or names the task
 * when the stage asks several ("Security team presses Reject"); every other part as in the sentence.
 */
function labelCondition(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, condition: Condition | undefined): Phrase {
  if (!condition || 'formula' in condition) return describeCondition(doc, condition);
  const all = 'allOf' in condition;
  const clauses: Clause[] = (all ? condition.allOf : condition.anyOf) ?? [];
  if (clauses.length === 0) return describeCondition(doc, condition);
  return joinEach(
    clauses.map((c) => (c && typeof c === 'object' && 'pressed' in c ? pressedLabel(doc, c.pressed) : describeClause(doc, c))),
    all ? 'and' : 'or',
  );
}

/** "Approve pressed", or "Security team presses Reject" when the stage asks several tasks. */
function pressedLabel(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, buttonId: string | null | undefined): Phrase {
  const task = getTask(doc, buttonId ? find(doc, buttonId)?.parents.task : undefined);
  if (task && stageHasSeveralTasks(doc, task.id)) return describePressed(doc, buttonId);
  return phrase('describe.label.pressed', { button: buttonId ? buttonChip(doc, buttonId) : gap() });
}

function baseLabel(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, arrow: Arrow): string {
  const when = arrow.when;
  switch (when?.type) {
    case 'buttonPressed':
      // With several tasks the pill says who presses, as the sentence does (editor-model.md
      // section 3): "Domain approvers press Request changes", "Security team presses Reject".
      return toText(pressedLabel(doc, when.button));
    case 'condition':
      return toText(labelCondition(doc, when.condition));
    case 'inAllOtherCases':
      return w('describe.arrow.inAllOtherCases');
    case 'whenDone':
      return w(whenDoneIsOtherCases(doc, arrow) ? 'describe.arrow.inAllOtherCases' : 'describe.arrow.whenDone');
    default:
      return w('describe.gap');
  }
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/catalogue.ts\n===
/**
 * Reading names out of the catalogue of connections (contract/catalogue.ts) for describe: an
 * entry and its connection's label, a sent field's label, and the thing a trigger is about
 * ("Ticket" for "A ticket is created"). The catalogue is data: no system is named here.
 */
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueEntry, Field } from '@/contract';

/** The catalogue entry with this ID, if the catalogue is given and has it. */
export function entryOf(catalogue: Catalogue | undefined, ref: string | undefined): CatalogueEntry | undefined {
  if (!catalogue || !ref) return undefined;
  return (catalogue.entries ?? []).find((e) => e.id === ref);
}

/** The label of the connection an entry belongs to; its ID's first part when the catalogue lacks it. */
export function connectionLabel(catalogue: Catalogue | undefined, entry: CatalogueEntry | undefined, ref: string): string {
  const id = entry?.connection ?? ref.split('.')[0] ?? ref;
  return (catalogue?.connections ?? []).find((c) => c.id === id)?.label ?? id;
}

/**
 * An entry's label as said after its connection's name ("Helpdesk: a ticket is created"): a
 * trailing "in <connection>" or "in the <connection>" is left out, only when the label really ends
 * with the label the catalogue gives that connection. Undefined when the catalogue lacks the entry.
 */
export function labelAfterConnection(catalogue: Catalogue | undefined, ref: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const entry = entryOf(catalogue, ref);
  if (!entry || !ref) return undefined;
  const label = (entry.label ?? '').trim();
  const connection = (catalogue?.connections ?? []).find((c) => c.id === entry.connection)?.label?.trim();
  if (!connection) return label;
  const lower = label.toLowerCase();
  for (const tail of [` in the ${connection.toLowerCase()}`, ` in ${connection.toLowerCase()}`]) {
    if (lower.endsWith(tail) && lower.length > tail.length) return label.slice(0, label.length - tail.length).trimEnd();
  }
  return label;
}

/** The label of a field, following dotted names into nested fields; undefined when not found. */
export function fieldLabel(fields: Field[] | undefined, dotted: string): string | undefined {
  const [head, ...rest] = dotted.split('.');
  const field = (fields ?? []).find((f) => f.id === head);
  if (!field) return undefined;
  if (rest.length === 0) return field.label;
  const inner = fieldLabel(field.fields, rest.join('.'));
  return inner === undefined ? undefined : `${field.label} ${inner.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${inner.slice(1)}`;
}

/**
 * What a trigger is about, for naming what it sent: the noun after a leading "a", "an" or "the" in
 * its label ("A ticket is created" gives "Ticket"); otherwise the connection's label.
 */
export function triggerThing(catalogue: Catalogue | undefined, ref: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const entry = entryOf(catalogue, ref);
  if (!entry || !ref) return undefined;
  const noun = /^(?:an?|the)\s+([\p{L}\p{N}]+)/iu.exec(entry.label ?? '')?.[1];
  if (noun) return noun.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + noun.slice(1);
  return connectionLabel(catalogue, entry, ref);
}

 * what changed and to what, grouped by stage in the order a request meets them.

/** The sentences for `before` -> `after`, where `after` is `before` changed by `edit`. */
async function changes(name: Name, edit: (doc: AuthoredWorkflow) => void) {
  const before = fixture(name);
  const after = structuredClone(before) as AuthoredWorkflow;
  edit(after);

  return { said: describeChanges(before, after, found, env), found };
}

}

===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/change.ts\n===
/**
 * What changed between two versions of a workflow, in plain sentences: "At Domain approval, the
 * requester can now answer their own request." Pure: it takes the two documents and the changes
 * services `core.diff` reports between them (`Change[]`, items matched by ID), and says each one,
 * grouped by stage in the order a request meets the stages. Used by Publish ("What changed since
 * version 3"), and meant for In words and a version history page.
 *
 * Every change `core.diff` reports is covered: an item added, removed or moved, and a part changed,
 * for every kind of item. Changes inside an item that is itself new or deleted are folded into that
 * item's one sentence; a value coming or going is said by what fills it (a value "is never declared
 * by the author", authored-format.ts `Value`), and a status or thing told coming or going by the
 * stage or action that uses it. A change this file has no sentence for reads "Changed: <the place
 * in words>". The words are in src/words/todo.ts ("todo.change.*").
 */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Condition, Expression, ItemKind, Location, Stage, Task, Template } from '@/contract';
import type { Change } from '@/services';
import { words, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { find, getStage, nameOf, type Entry } from '../lookup';
import { arrowsOutOf, orderFromStart } from '../graph';
import { actionName, describeAction } from './action';
import { arrowLabel, describeArrow, describeGoTo } from './arrow';
import { describeCondition, taskNameOf } from './condition';
import { describeConstant, describeExpression, describeTemplate, rowChip } from './expression';
import { connectionField, describeLocation } from './location';
import { buttonChip, deletedName, itemName, stageHasSeveralTasks, statusChip, valueChip } from './names';
import { chip, joinPhrases, phrase, toText, w, type DescribeEnv, type Part, type Phrase } from './phrase';
import { describeChoicesSource, describeStartsWhen, describeWhoIsAsked } from './stage';
import { subjectsOf, takesPlural } from './verb';

/** What sort of change a sentence says, so a screen can mark it (an icon) without reading the words. */
export type ChangeSort = 'added' | 'removed' | 'changed' | 'moved' | 'order';

export interface ChangeLine {
  /** Stable for one change between the same two documents. */
  key: string;
  sort: ChangeSort;
  /** The kind of item changed. */
  itemKind: ItemKind;
  /** The sentence, with chips for names. */
  words: Phrase;
  /** The same sentence as plain text. */
  text: string;
}

export interface ChangeGroup {
  /** The stage the changes are in; null for changes outside any stage (values, lists, statuses ...). */
  stageId: string | null;
  /** The stage's name (its old name when it was deleted), or "Elsewhere in the workflow". */
  title: string;
  lines: ChangeLine[];
}

export interface ChangesInWords {
  groups: ChangeGroup[];
  /** The names of the stages that are new in `after`, in the order a request meets them. */
  newStageNames: string[];
  /** The same, joined with the shared list words ("Security review and Legal review"). */
  newStages: Phrase;
}

type Fill = Record<string, Phrase | Part>;


/** The item's name in that document, or its kept deleted name. */
const nameIn = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): string => itemName(doc, id);

/** The stage an item belongs to: itself for a stage, the start stage for a "Starts when", else its parent stage; null outside stages. */
function stageOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): string | null {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return null;
  if (entry.kind === 'stage') return entry.id;
  if (entry.kind === 'startsWhen') return doc.start?.stage ?? null;
  return entry.parents.stage ?? null;
}

/** "Domain approval", or "Domain approval, for Security team" when the stage asks several tasks. */
function placeOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, entry: Entry, withTask = true): string {
  const stage = entry.parents.stage ? nameIn(doc, entry.parents.stage) : '';
  const taskId = !withTask ? undefined : entry.kind === 'task' ? entry.id : entry.parents.task;
  const task = taskId ? find(doc, taskId) : undefined;
  if (task?.kind === 'task' && stageHasSeveralTasks(doc, task.id)) {
    return toText(phrase('todo.change.placeTask', { stage, task: taskNameOf(doc, task.item) }));
  }
  return stage;
}

/** The sentence for key; the place (t, stage) is said as a stage chip, so screens can show it as a name. */
const said = (key: WordKey, fill: Fill = {}): Phrase => {
  const named: Fill = { ...fill };
  for (const k of ['at', 'stage'] as const) if (typeof named[k] === 'string') named[k] = chip('stage', named[k] as string);
  return phrase(key, named);
};

/** Before/after of a part, from the documents (the change's own params only carry small values). */
function partOf(item: unknown, part: string): unknown {
  let at: unknown = item;
  for (const segment of part.split('.')) {
    if (!at || typeof at !== 'object') return undefined;
    at = (at as Record<string, unknown>)[segment];
  }
  return at;
}

const quoted = (text: string): string => toText(phrase('todo.change.quoted', { text }));

/** A kind of value in words ("a number"); the plain "something else" when the kind is not known. */
function kindWords(kind: unknown): string {
  const key = `findings.kind.${String(kind)}`;
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(words, key) ? words[key as WordKey] : w('todo.change.otherKind');
}

/** A kind of stage in words ("Approval"). */
function stageKindWords(kind: unknown): string {
  const key = `stageKind.${String(kind)}`;
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(words, key) ? words[key as WordKey] : w('todo.change.otherKind');
}

/** One change in words, or null when it says nothing an author needs (the format's version, a value coming or going). */
export function describeChange(before: AuthoredWorkflow, after: AuthoredWorkflow, change: Change, env: DescribeEnv = {}): ChangeLine | null {
  const id = change.location.item;
  const part = change.location.part;
  const itemKind = (change.params as { itemKind: ItemKind }).itemKind;
  const make = (sort: ChangeSort, words: Phrase): ChangeLine => ({
    key: `${change.code}:${id}:${part ?? ''}`,
    sort,
    itemKind,
    words,
    text: toText(words),
  });
  const fallback = () => make('changed', said('todo.change.changed', { where: describeLocation(change.code === 'item.removed' ? before : after, change.location, env) }));

  let words: Phrase | null | undefined;
  let sort: ChangeSort = 'changed';
  switch (change.code) {
    case 'item.added':
      sort = 'added';
      words = added(after, id, itemKind, env);
      break;
    case 'item.removed':
      sort = 'removed';
      words = removed(before, id, itemKind, env);
      break;
    case 'item.moved':
      sort = 'moved';
      words = moved(after, id, change.params.to, env);
      break;
    case 'part.changed': {
      if (!part) break;
      const b = find(before, id);
      const a = find(after, id);
      if (!a || !b) break;
      if (LIST_PARTS.has(part.split('.').pop() ?? '')) {
        sort = 'order';
        words = order(after, a, part);
        break;
      }
      words = partChanged(before, after, b, a, part, env);
      break;
    }
    default: {
      // Every change code core's `diff` has is said above: a new code in core fails to compile here.
      const unknownCode: never = change;
      void unknownCode;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (words === null) return null;
  return words ? make(sort, words) : fallback();
}

/** Ordered child lists: a change of one of these parts is a new order (an added or removed child is said on its own). */
const LIST_PARTS = new Set(['arrows', 'tasks', 'buttons', 'pages', 'items', 'choices', 'columns', 'rows', 'whenThisStageStarts', 'afterTheyRespond']);

function order(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, entry: Entry, part: string): Phrase | undefined {
  const at = placeOf(doc, entry);
  const last = part.split('.').pop();
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'stage':
      if (last === 'arrows') return said('todo.change.order.arrows', { stage: entry.item.name });
      if (last === 'tasks') return said('todo.change.order.tasks', { stage: entry.item.name });
      if (last === 'whenThisStageStarts' || last === 'afterTheyRespond') {
        return said('todo.change.order.actions', { stage: entry.item.name, section: w(`describe.part.${last}`) });
      }
      return undefined;
    case 'task':
      if (last === 'buttons') return said('todo.change.order.buttons', { at });
      if (last === 'pages') return said('todo.change.order.pages', { at });
      return undefined;
    case 'page':
      return said('todo.change.order.questions', { at });
    case 'question':
      return said('todo.change.order.choices', { at, question: nameOf(entry) || w('describe.noName') });
    case 'list':
      return said(last === 'rows' ? 'todo.change.order.rows' : 'todo.change.order.columns', { list: nameOf(entry) });
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

function pageName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, entry: Entry): string {
  const crumbs = toText(describeLocation(doc, { item: entry.id })).split(w('describe.where.separator'));
  return crumbs[crumbs.length - 1] ?? '';
}

function whoOfStage(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, stage: Stage): Phrase | null {
  if (stage.kind === 'ending') return null;
  const asked = (stage.tasks ?? []).filter((t) => t.whoIsAsked).map((t) => describeWhoIsAsked(doc, t, { short: true }));
  return asked.length ? joinPhrases(asked, 'and') : null;
}

/** "At Development, Requester is now asked too", "..., Platform team are now asked too": the verb by who it is (verb.ts). */
function askedSaid(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, key: 'todo.change.added.task' | 'todo.change.removed.task', task: Task, at: string): Phrase {
  const who = describeWhoIsAsked(doc, task, { short: true });
  const many = takesPlural(subjectsOf(doc, task.whoIsAsked as Expression | undefined, toText(who)));
  return said(many ? `${key}.many` : key, { at, who });
}

function added(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string, kind: ItemKind, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase | null | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return undefined;
  const at = placeOf(doc, entry);
  const name = nameOf(entry) || w('describe.noName');
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'stage': {
      if (entry.item.kind === 'ending') return said('todo.change.added.ending', { name: chip('stage', name, id) });
      const who = whoOfStage(doc, entry.item);
      return who ? said('todo.change.added.stageAsks', { name: chip('stage', name, id), who }) : said('todo.change.added.stage', { name: chip('stage', name, id) });
    }
    case 'task':
      return askedSaid(doc, 'todo.change.added.task', entry.item, placeOf(doc, entry, false));
    case 'page':
      return said('todo.change.added.page', { at, name: pageName(doc, entry) });
    case 'question':
      return said('todo.change.added.question', { at, name: chip('value', name, id) });
    case 'text':
      return said('todo.change.added.text', { at, content: describeTemplate(doc, entry.item.content ?? [], env) });
    case 'choice':
      return said('todo.change.added.choice', { at, name, question: nameIn(doc, entry.parents.question ?? '') });
    case 'button':
      return said('todo.change.added.button', { at, name: buttonChip(doc, id) });
    case 'action':
      return said('todo.change.added.action', { at, action: describeAction(doc, entry.item, env), section: w(`describe.part.${entry.parents.section ?? 'whenThisStageStarts'}`) });
    case 'arrow':
      return said('todo.change.added.arrow', { at, sentence: describeArrow(doc, entry.item).sentence });
    case 'startsWhen':
      return said('todo.change.added.startsWhen', { binding: describeStartsWhen(doc, entry.item, env) });
    case 'list':
      return said('todo.change.added.list', { name });
    case 'column':
      return said('todo.change.added.column', { name, list: nameIn(doc, entry.parents.list ?? '') });
    case 'row':
      return said('todo.change.added.row', { row: rowChip(doc, id), list: nameIn(doc, entry.parents.list ?? '') });
    case 'value':
    case 'status':
    case 'thingTold':
      // Said by what fills or uses it (a new question, a stage's status, a "Tell other systems").
      return null;
    default:
      return kind === 'workflow' ? null : undefined;
  }
}

function removed(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string, kind: ItemKind, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase | null | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return undefined;
  const at = placeOf(doc, entry);
  const name = nameOf(entry) || w('describe.noName');
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'stage':
      return said(entry.item.kind === 'ending' ? 'todo.change.removed.ending' : 'todo.change.removed.stage', { name: chip('stage', name, id) });
    case 'task':
      return askedSaid(doc, 'todo.change.removed.task', entry.item, placeOf(doc, entry, false));
    case 'page':
      return said('todo.change.removed.page', { at, name: pageName(doc, entry) });
    case 'question':
      return said('todo.change.removed.question', { at, name: chip('value', name, id) });
    case 'text':
      return said('todo.change.removed.text', { at });
    case 'choice':
      return said('todo.change.removed.choice', { at, name, question: nameIn(doc, entry.parents.question ?? '') });
    case 'button':
      return said('todo.change.removed.button', { at, name: buttonChip(doc, id) });
    case 'action':
      return said('todo.change.removed.action', { at, action: actionName(doc, entry.item, env) });
    case 'arrow':
      return said('todo.change.removed.arrow', { at, label: arrowLabel(doc, entry.item) });
    case 'startsWhen':
      return said('todo.change.removed.startsWhen', { binding: describeStartsWhen(doc, entry.item, env) });
    case 'list':
      return said('todo.change.removed.list', { name });
    case 'column':
      return said('todo.change.removed.column', { name, list: nameIn(doc, entry.parents.list ?? '') });
    case 'row':
      return said('todo.change.removed.row', { row: rowChip(doc, id), list: nameIn(doc, entry.parents.list ?? '') });
    case 'value':
    case 'status':
    case 'thingTold':
      return null;
    default:
      return kind === 'workflow' ? null : undefined;
  }
}

function moved(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string, to: Location, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase | undefined {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return undefined;
  if (entry.kind === 'action' && (to.part === 'whenThisStageStarts' || to.part === 'afterTheyRespond')) {
    return said('todo.change.movedAction', { at: placeOf(doc, entry), action: actionName(doc, entry.item, env), section: w(`describe.part.${to.part}`) });
  }
  const thing: Phrase = entry.kind === 'action' ? actionName(doc, entry.item, env) : [nameOf(entry) || w('describe.noName')];
  return said('todo.change.moved', { thing, where: describeLocation(doc, to, env) });
}

/** A value reference or template in words; "nothing" when absent. */
function sayValue(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, x: unknown, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase {
  if (x === undefined || x === null) return [w('todo.change.nothing')];
  return describeExpression(doc, x as Expression | Template, env);
}

function partChanged(before: AuthoredWorkflow, after: AuthoredWorkflow, b: Entry, a: Entry, part: string, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase | null | undefined {
  const was = partOf(b.item, part);
  const now = partOf(a.item, part);
  const at = placeOf(after, a);
  const [head = '', ...rest] = part.split('.');
  const key = rest.join('.');
  switch (a.kind) {
    case 'workflow':
      if (part === 'formatVersion') return null;
      if (part === 'start.stage') return said('todo.change.workflow.startStage', { stage: nameIn(after, String(now ?? '')) });
      return undefined;

    case 'stage': {
      const stage = a.item;
      if (part === 'name') return said('todo.change.stage.name', { before: chip('stage', String(was ?? '') || w('describe.noName')), after: chip('stage', stage.name || w('describe.noName'), stage.id) });
      if (part === 'status') {
        return now ? said('todo.change.stage.status', { stage: stage.name, status: statusChip(after, String(now)) }) : said('todo.change.stage.statusNone', { stage: stage.name });
      }
      if (part === 'ifSentBackStatus') {
        return now ? said('todo.change.stage.ifSentBack', { stage: stage.name, status: statusChip(after, String(now)) }) : said('todo.change.stage.ifSentBackNone', { stage: stage.name });
      }
      if (part === 'kind') return said('todo.change.stage.kind', { stage: stage.name, kind: stageKindWords(now) });
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'status':
      if (part === 'words') return said('todo.change.status.words', { before: quoted(String(was ?? '')), after: quoted(String(now ?? '')) });
      if (part === 'colour') return said('todo.change.status.colour', { name: a.item.words || w('describe.noName') });
      return undefined;

    case 'thingTold':
      if (part === 'words') return said('todo.change.told.words', { before: quoted(String(was ?? '')), after: quoted(String(now ?? '')) });
      return undefined;

    case 'task': {
      const task = a.item;
      if (head === 'whoIsAsked') return said('todo.change.task.whoIsAsked', { at: placeOf(after, a, false), who: describeWhoIsAsked(after, task) });
      if (part === 'requesterCanAnswer') return said(now ? 'todo.change.task.requesterCan' : 'todo.change.task.requesterCannot', { at });
      if (part === 'name') return said('todo.change.task.name', { at, before: quoted(String(was ?? '')), after: quoted(task.name ?? '') });
      if (part === 'savesButtonPressedAs' || part === 'savesAnsweredByAs') {
        const which = part === 'savesButtonPressedAs' ? 'Pressed' : 'AnsweredBy';
        return now
          ? said(`todo.change.task.saves${which}` as WordKey, { at, value: valueChip(after, String(now)) })
          : said(`todo.change.task.saves${which}None` as WordKey, { at });
      }
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'page': {
      const name = pageName(after, a);
      if (part === 'title') return said('todo.change.page.title', { at, before: quoted(String(was ?? '') || pageName(before, b)), after: quoted(name) });
      if (head === 'showWhen') return shownWhen(after, at, [name], a.item.showWhen, env);
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'question': {
      const q = a.item;
      const name: Part = chip('value', q.label || w('describe.noName'), q.id);
      if (part === 'label') return said('todo.change.question.label', { at, before: quoted(String(was ?? '') || w('describe.noName')), after: quoted(q.label || w('describe.noName')) });
      if (part === 'savedAs') return now ? said('todo.change.question.savedAs', { at, name, value: valueChip(after, String(now)) }) : undefined;
      if (part === 'kind') return said('todo.change.question.kind', { at, name, kind: kindWords(now) });
      if (head === 'showWhen') return shownWhen(after, at, [name], q.showWhen, env);
      if (part === 'neededForEveryButton') return said(now ? 'todo.change.question.neededAll' : 'todo.change.question.neededAllNot', { at, name });
      if (head === 'choices') return said('todo.change.question.choices', { at, name, source: describeChoicesSource(after, q.choices, env) });
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'text':
      if (head === 'content') return said('todo.change.text.content', { at, content: describeTemplate(after, a.item.content ?? [], env) });
      if (head === 'showWhen') return shownWhen(after, at, [w('describe.where.text')], a.item.showWhen, env);
      return undefined;

    case 'choice':
      if (part === 'label') return said('todo.change.choice.label', { at, question: nameIn(after, a.parents.question ?? ''), before: quoted(String(was ?? '')), after: quoted(a.item.label) });
      return undefined;

    case 'button': {
      const btn = a.item;
      const name = buttonChip(after, btn.id);
      if (part === 'label') return said('todo.change.button.label', { at, before: quoted(String(was ?? '') || w('describe.noName')), after: quoted(btn.label || w('describe.noName')) });
      if (head === 'neededToPress') {
        // Only what changed: the questions it now also needs, and those it no longer needs that are still
        // there (a removed question is said by its own removal line). Nothing new to say: no line.
        const had = new Set<string>(Array.isArray(was) ? (was as string[]) : []);
        const now = btn.neededToPress ?? [];
        const names = (ids: readonly string[]) => joinPhrases(ids.map((q) => [chip('value', nameIn(after, q), q)] as Phrase), 'and');
        const added = now.filter((q) => !had.has(q));
        const dropped = [...had].filter((q) => !now.includes(q as never) && find(after, q));
        if (!now.length && dropped.length) return said('todo.change.button.neededNone', { at, name });
        if (added.length && dropped.length) return said('todo.change.button.neededChanged', { at, name, added: names(added), dropped: names(dropped) });
        if (added.length) return said('todo.change.button.neededMore', { at, name, questions: names(added) });
        if (dropped.length) return said('todo.change.button.neededLess', { at, name, questions: names(dropped) });
        return null;
      }
      if (head === 'enabledWhen') {
        return btn.enabledWhen
          ? said('todo.change.button.enabledWhen', { at, name, condition: describeCondition(after, btn.enabledWhen, env) })
          : said('todo.change.button.enabledWhenNone', { at, name });
      }
      if (part === 'look') return said('todo.change.button.look', { at, name });
      if (part === 'messageWhileDisabled') {
        return btn.messageWhileDisabled
          ? said('todo.change.button.message', { at, name, message: quoted(btn.messageWhileDisabled) })
          : said('todo.change.button.messageNone', { at, name });
      }
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'action':
      return actionChanged(before, after, b.item as Action, a.item, at, head, key, env);

    case 'arrow': {
      const arrow = a.item;
      const label = b.kind === 'arrow' ? arrowLabel(before, b.item) : arrowLabel(after, arrow);
      if (part === 'goTo') return said('todo.change.arrow.goTo', { at, label, goTo: describeGoTo(after, arrow.goTo) });
      if (part === 'words') return said('todo.change.arrow.words', { at, before: label, after: arrowLabel(after, arrow) });
      if (part === 'goAsSoonAsTrue') return said(now ? 'todo.change.arrow.soon' : 'todo.change.arrow.soonNot', { at, label });
      if (head === 'when' || head === 'onlyWhen') return said('todo.change.arrow.when', { at, label, sentence: describeArrow(after, arrow).sentence });
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'startsWhen':
      return said('todo.change.startsWhen', { binding: describeStartsWhen(after, a.item, env) });

    case 'value':
      if (part === 'name') return said('todo.change.value.name', { before: String(was ?? ''), after: valueChip(after, a.id) });
      if (part === 'description') return said('todo.change.value.description', { name: valueChip(after, a.id) });
      return undefined;

    case 'list':
      if (part === 'name') return said('todo.change.list.name', { before: String(was ?? ''), after: a.item.name });
      return undefined;

    case 'column': {
      const list = nameIn(after, a.parents.list ?? '');
      if (part === 'name') return said('todo.change.column.name', { list, before: String(was ?? ''), after: a.item.name });
      if (part === 'kind') return said('todo.change.column.kind', { list, name: a.item.name, kind: kindWords(now) });
      return undefined;
    }

    case 'row':
      if (head === 'cells' && key) {
        const cell = a.item.cells?.[key as keyof typeof a.item.cells];
        return said('todo.change.row.cell', {
          list: nameIn(after, a.parents.list ?? ''),
          column: nameIn(after, key),
          row: rowChip(after, a.id),
          value: cell === undefined ? [w('todo.change.notGiven')] : describeConstant(after, cell),
        });
      }
      return undefined;

    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

function shownWhen(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, at: string, thing: Phrase, condition: Condition | undefined, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase {
  return condition
    ? said('todo.change.showWhen', { at, thing, condition: describeCondition(doc, condition, env) })
    : said('todo.change.showWhenAlways', { at, thing });
}

function actionChanged(
  before: AuthoredWorkflow, after: AuthoredWorkflow, was: Action, action: Action, at: string, head: string, key: string, env: DescribeEnv,
): Phrase | undefined {
  const name = actionName(after, action, env);
  const entry = find(after, action.id);
  if (head === 'onlyWhen') {
    return action.onlyWhen
      ? said('todo.change.action.onlyWhen', { at, action: name, condition: describeCondition(after, action.onlyWhen, env) })
      : said('todo.change.action.always', { at, action: name });
  }
  // What the action is (what is saved and where, who is notified, which operation, what is told): its name says it.
  if (['save', 'as', 'to', 'operation', 'tell'].includes(head)) {
    return said('todo.change.action.now', { at, before: actionName(before, was, env), after: name });
  }
  if (head === 'message' && action.type === 'notify') {
    return said('todo.change.action.message', { at, action: name, message: describeTemplate(after, action.message ?? [], env) });
  }
  if ((head === 'inputs' || head === 'values') && key) {
    const field = connectionField(entry, 'inputs', key, env).label;
    const now = action.type === 'useConnection' ? action.inputs?.[key] : action.type === 'tellOtherSystems' ? action.values?.[key] : undefined;
    return now === undefined
      ? said('todo.change.action.sendsNone', { at, action: name, field })
      : said('todo.change.action.sends', { at, action: name, field, value: sayValue(after, now, env) });
  }
  if (head === 'saveResults' && key && action.type === 'useConnection') {
    const field = connectionField(entry, 'saveResults', key, env).label;
    const value = action.saveResults?.[key];
    return value
      ? said('todo.change.action.savesResult', { at, action: name, field, value: valueChip(after, value) })
      : said('todo.change.action.savesResultNone', { at, action: name, field });
  }
  if (head === 'ifItFails' && action.type === 'useConnection') {
    return said(action.ifItFails === 'carryOn' ? 'todo.change.action.failsCarryOn' : 'todo.change.action.failsStuck', { at, action: name });
  }
  // Core reports `saveFailureAs.failed` or `.code`, or the whole `saveFailureAs` when it was added or
  // removed (core-api.md 11): then the one of the two that differs is said, `failed` first.
  const failureKey = (): 'failed' | 'code' | undefined => {
    if (key === 'failed' || key === 'code') return key;
    if (key || action.type !== 'useConnection') return undefined;
    const old = was.type === 'useConnection' ? was.saveFailureAs : undefined;
    return (['failed', 'code'] as const).find((k) => old?.[k] !== action.saveFailureAs?.[k]);
  };
  const fk = head === 'saveFailureAs' ? failureKey() : undefined;
  if (fk && action.type === 'useConnection') {
    const value = action.saveFailureAs?.[fk];
    const which = fk === 'failed' ? 'Failed' : 'Code';
    return value
      ? said(`todo.change.action.saves${which}` as WordKey, { at, action: name, value: valueChip(after, value) })
      : said(`todo.change.action.saves${which}None` as WordKey, { at, action: name });
  }
  if (head === 'ifStageEntersAgain' && action.type === 'useConnection' && action.ifStageEntersAgain) {
    return said(action.ifStageEntersAgain === 'once' ? 'todo.change.action.againOnce' : 'todo.change.action.againAgain', { at, action: name });
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Stage IDs top to bottom as the diagram draws them: by the longest way from the start stage, not
 * counting arrows that send a request back; endings last; ties in the order a request meets them.
 * (The same order as the To do list's groups; a candidate for model/graph.ts.)
 */
function diagramOrder(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): string[] {
  const met = orderFromStart(doc) as string[];
  const onPath = new Set<string>();
  const done = new Set<string>();
  const forward = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const postorder: string[] = [];
  const visit = (id: string) => {
    onPath.add(id);
    const next: string[] = [];
    for (const arrow of arrowsOutOf(doc, id)) {
      const to = arrow.goTo;
      if (!to || !getStage(doc, to) || onPath.has(to)) continue;
      next.push(to);
      if (!done.has(to)) visit(to);
    }
    forward.set(id, next);
    onPath.delete(id);
    done.add(id);
    postorder.push(id);
  };
  for (const id of [doc.start?.stage, ...met]) if (id && !done.has(id)) visit(id);
  const depth = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const id of [...postorder].reverse()) {
    const d = depth.get(id) ?? 0;
    for (const to of forward.get(id) ?? []) depth.set(to, Math.max(depth.get(to) ?? 0, d + 1));
  }
  const ending = (id: string) => (getStage(doc, id)?.kind === 'ending' ? 1 : 0);
  return [...met].sort((a, b) => ending(a) - ending(b) || (depth.get(a) ?? 0) - (depth.get(b) ?? 0) || met.indexOf(a) - met.indexOf(b));
}

/** True when an item is inside (or is) one of `ids` in `doc`. */
function within(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string, ids: Set<string>): boolean {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return false;
  return Object.values(entry.parents).some((p) => typeof p === 'string' && ids.has(p));
}

/**
 * The changes from `before` (say, the live version) to `after` (the draft) in words, grouped by
 * stage in the order a request meets the stages (endings, then deleted stages, then everything
 * outside a stage last). `changes` is what services `core.diff(before, after)` gives.
 */
export function describeChanges(before: AuthoredWorkflow, after: AuthoredWorkflow, changes: readonly Change[], env: DescribeEnv = {}): ChangesInWords {
  const addedIds = new Set(changes.filter((c) => c.code === 'item.added').map((c) => c.location.item));
  const removedIds = new Set(changes.filter((c) => c.code === 'item.removed').map((c) => c.location.item));
  // A status or thing told that is new and used by a stage or action said elsewhere is folded; one used nowhere is folded too.
  // A question whose choices now come from elsewhere: core reports `choices` (where they come from)
  // and each of their parts beside it (core-api.md 11); the one sentence about `choices` says it all.
  const newSource = new Set(changes.filter((c) => c.code === 'part.changed' && c.location.part === 'choices').map((c) => c.location.item));
  const groups = new Map<string | null, ChangeLine[]>();
  for (const change of changes) {
    const doc = change.code === 'item.removed' ? before : after;
    const id = change.location.item;
    if (change.code === 'part.changed' && newSource.has(id) && change.location.part?.startsWith('choices.')) continue;
    if (change.code === 'item.added' && within(after, id, addedIds)) continue;
    if (change.code === 'item.removed' && within(before, id, removedIds)) continue;
    const line = describeChange(before, after, change, env);
    if (!line) continue;
    const stageId = stageOf(doc, id);
    const list = groups.get(stageId) ?? [];
    if (!list.some((l) => l.key === line.key)) list.push(line);
    groups.set(stageId, list);
  }
  const met = diagramOrder(after);
  const order = [
    ...met,
    ...(after.stages ?? []).map((s) => s.id as string).filter((sid) => !met.includes(sid)),
    ...(before.stages ?? []).map((s) => s.id as string).filter((sid) => removedIds.has(sid)),
  ];
  const rank = (sid: string | null) => (sid === null ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : (order.indexOf(sid) + 1 || order.length + 1));
  const title = (sid: string | null) => {
    if (sid === null) return w('todo.group.elsewhere');
    const now = find(after, sid);
    if (now) return nameOf(now) || w('describe.noName');
    const old = find(before, sid);
    return old ? nameOf(old) : deletedName(after, sid);
  };
  const newStageIds = order.filter((sid) => addedIds.has(sid) && getStage(after, sid));
  const newStageNames = newStageIds.map((sid) => nameIn(after, sid));
  return {
    groups: [...groups.entries()].sort(([x], [y]) => rank(x) - rank(y)).map(([stageId, lines]) => ({ stageId, title: title(stageId), lines })),
    newStageNames,
    newStages: joinPhrases(newStageIds.map((sid) => [chip('stage', nameIn(after, sid), sid)]), 'and'),
  };
}
