/** describeCondition and describeClause: every operator, natural Yes/No, pressed clauses, unfinished clauses. */
import { describe as group, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Clause, Expression, Words } from '@/contract';
import { WORDS, WORDS_WITH_A_LIST, WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER } from '@/contract';
import { t } from '@/words';
import { fixture } from '../testkit';
import {
  describeClause, describeCondition, describeExpression, describePressed, hasMissing, toText, yesNoColumnSubject, yesNoPredicate,
} from './index';
import { startsNegative } from './condition';
import { describeNegatedCondition } from './negate';

const doc = fixture('change-request');
const clause = (c: Clause) => toText(describeClause(doc, c));

group('every operator has words', () => {
  // A Yes/No value used directly reads as its name, not "is Yes": see "Yes/No reads naturally".
  const all = (Object.values(WORDS).flat() as Words[]).filter((x) => x !== 'yesNo.isYes' && x !== 'yesNo.isNo');

  it.each(all)('%s', (words) => {
    const nothingAfter = (WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER as readonly Words[]).includes(words);
    const withList = (WORDS_WITH_A_LIST as readonly Words[]).includes(words);
    const right: Expression | Expression[] | undefined = nothingAfter ? undefined : withList ? [{ text: 'A' }, { text: 'B' }] : { text: 'A' };
    const said = clause({ left: { value: 'v_title' }, words, ...(right ? { right } : {}) });
    const phrase = t(`describe.words.${words}`);
    expect(phrase).not.toMatch(/describe\./);
    const tail = nothingAfter ? '' : withList ? ` A ${words === 'list.includesAllOf' ? 'and' : 'or'} B` : ' A';
    expect(said).toBe(`Title ${phrase}${tail}`);
  });

  it('uses the plain phrases from the brief', () => {
    expect(t('describe.words.text.is')).toBe('is');
    expect(t('describe.words.choice.isOneOf')).toBe('is one of');
    expect(t('describe.words.number.isAtLeast')).toBe('is at least');
    expect(t('describe.words.text.isFilled')).toBe('is filled');
    expect(t('describe.words.date.isOnWeekday')).toBe('is on a');
  });
});

group('Yes/No reads naturally', () => {
  const needsApproval = { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_needs_approval' }] } as Expression;

  it('never as a double negative', () => {
    expect(clause({ left: needsApproval, words: 'yesNo.isNo' })).toBe('Primary domain needs no approval');
    expect(clause({ left: needsApproval, words: 'yesNo.isYes' })).toBe('Primary domain needs approval');
    expect(clause({ left: needsApproval, words: 'yesNo.isFilled' })).toBe('Primary domain needs approval is filled');
  });

  it('names a verb-first Yes/No column as a statement, never with a possessive (the value chip)', () => {
    // Was "Primary domain's needs approval" on the Request form's first arrow.
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, needsApproval))).toBe('Primary domain needs approval');
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }] } as Expression))).toBe(
      "Primary domain's approvers",
    );
    const split = yesNoColumnSubject(doc, { ...needsApproval, ifEmptyUse: { yesNo: true } } as Expression);
    expect(split && toText(split.subject)).toBe('Primary domain');
    expect(split?.column).toBe('Needs approval');
    expect(yesNoColumnSubject(doc, { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }] } as Expression)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(yesNoColumnSubject(doc, { value: 'v_risk' } as Expression)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('falls back to "is Yes / is No" for a list column whose name does not start with a verb', () => {
    expect(clause({ left: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }] }, words: 'yesNo.isYes' })).toBe(
      "Primary domain's approvers is Yes",
    );
  });

  group('a Yes/No value used directly', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    const names = {
      v_urgent: 'Urgent',
      v_needs_approval: 'Needs approval',
      v_not_urgent: 'Not urgent',
      v_cannot_deploy: 'Cannot deploy',
      v_needs_no_approval: 'Needs no approval',
      v_vip_customer: 'VIP customer',
    } as const;
    for (const [id, name] of Object.entries(names)) d.values.push({ id: id as `v_${string}`, name });
    const say = (id: keyof typeof names, words: Words, extra: object = {}) =>
      toText(describeClause(d, { left: { value: id, ...extra } as Expression, words }));

    it('"is Yes" reads as the name alone', () => {
      expect(say('v_urgent', 'yesNo.isYes')).toBe('Urgent');
      expect(say('v_needs_approval', 'yesNo.isYes')).toBe('Needs approval');
      expect(say('v_not_urgent', 'yesNo.isYes')).toBe('Not urgent');
      expect(say('v_needs_no_approval', 'yesNo.isYes')).toBe('Needs no approval');
    });

    it('"is No" reads as a plain negative, never a double one', () => {
      expect(say('v_urgent', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('not urgent');
      // "not" only in front of one word: a longer name keeps its name ("not deploy failed" read as nonsense)
      expect(say('v_vip_customer', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('VIP customer is No');
      expect(say('v_needs_approval', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('Needs no approval');
      expect(say('v_not_urgent', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('Not urgent: No');
      expect(say('v_cannot_deploy', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('Cannot deploy: No');
      expect(say('v_needs_no_approval', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('Needs no approval: No');
    });

    it('keeps the value a chip, and "If empty, use" after it', () => {
      const parts = describeClause(d, { left: { value: 'v_urgent' }, words: 'yesNo.isNo' });
      expect(parts).toEqual(['not ', { chip: 'value', label: 'urgent', id: 'v_urgent' }]);
      expect(say('v_urgent', 'yesNo.isNo', { ifEmptyUse: { yesNo: false } })).toBe('not urgent (if empty, use No)');
    });

    it('in a sentence and in its opposite', () => {
      const urgent = { left: { value: 'v_urgent' }, words: 'yesNo.isYes' } as Clause;
      const high: Clause = { left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } };
      expect(toText(describeCondition(d, { allOf: [high, urgent] }))).toBe('Risk is High and Urgent');
      expect(toText(describeNegatedCondition(d, { allOf: [high, urgent] }))).toBe('Risk is not High or not urgent');
    });
  });

  it('startsNegative', () => {
    expect(startsNegative('Not urgent')).toBe(true);
    expect(startsNegative('Cannot deploy')).toBe(true);
    expect(startsNegative('Needs no approval')).toBe(true);
    expect(startsNegative("Don't ship")).toBe(true);
    expect(startsNegative('Needs approval')).toBe(false);
    expect(startsNegative('Notable')).toBe(false);
    expect(startsNegative('')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('keeps the natural reading with "If empty, use ...", the fallback after it', () => {
    expect(clause({ left: { ...needsApproval, ifEmptyUse: { yesNo: true } } as Expression, words: 'yesNo.isNo' })).toBe(
      'Primary domain needs no approval (if empty, use Yes)',
    );
    expect(clause({ left: { ...needsApproval, ifEmptyUse: { yesNo: false } } as Expression, words: 'yesNo.isYes' })).toBe(
      'Primary domain needs approval (if empty, use No)',
    );
  });

  it('never says "no no" for a name already in the negative', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    d.lists[0]!.columns.push({ id: 'col_needs_no_review', name: 'Needs no review', kind: 'yesNo' }, { id: 'col_cannot_ship', name: 'Cannot ship', kind: 'yesNo' });
    const say = (col: string, words: Words) =>
      toText(describeClause(d, { left: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: col as `col_${string}` }] }, words }));
    expect(say('col_needs_no_review', 'yesNo.isYes')).toBe('Primary domain needs no review');
    expect(say('col_needs_no_review', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('Primary domain needs review');
    expect(say('col_cannot_ship', 'yesNo.isYes')).toBe('Primary domain cannot ship');
    expect(say('col_cannot_ship', 'yesNo.isNo')).toBe('Primary domain can ship');
  });

  it('yesNoPredicate', () => {
    expect(yesNoPredicate('Needs approval', true)).toBe('needs approval');
    expect(yesNoPredicate('Needs approval', false)).toBe('needs no approval');
    expect(yesNoPredicate('Is not urgent', false)).toBe('is urgent');
    expect(yesNoPredicate('Approvers', true)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(yesNoPredicate('Needs', true)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(yesNoPredicate('Needs no', false)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(yesNoPredicate('', true)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('knows the other verbs', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    d.lists[0]!.columns.push({ id: 'col_is_critical', name: 'Is critical', kind: 'yesNo' }, { id: 'col_can_ship', name: 'Can ship', kind: 'yesNo' });
    const say = (col: string) => toText(describeClause(d, { left: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: col as `col_${string}` }] }, words: 'yesNo.isNo' }));
    expect(say('col_is_critical')).toBe('Primary domain is not critical');
    expect(say('col_can_ship')).toBe('Primary domain cannot ship');
  });
});

group('sentences', () => {

===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/condition.ts\n===
/**
 * "When ..." sentences in words: clauses read "[left] [words] [right]" with the words from
 * src/words/describe.ts, joined by "and" (allOf) or "or" (anyOf). Yes/No reads naturally, never as
 * a double negative ("Primary domain needs no approval"). A pressed clause reads "Approve is
 * pressed", or "Security team presses Reject" when the stage asks several tasks. Unfinished parts
 * read "…", flagged missing.
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow,
  Clause,
  Condition,
  Expression,
  RequestReference,
  SentClause,
  SentCondition,
  Task,
  ValueReference,
  Words,
  WordsClause,
} from '@/contract';
import { WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER } from '@/contract';
import { find, getTask } from '../lookup';
import { describeExpression, formulaWords } from './expression';
import { buttonChip, soundsPlural, stageHasSeveralTasks, taskName } from './names';
import { gap, isChip, joinEach, joinPhrases, lowerFirst, phrase, toText, w, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';

type AnyClause = Clause | SentClause;
type WordsLike = WordsClause | SentClause;

/** A condition (sentence or formula), or a sent condition, in words. Absent or empty reads "…". */
export function describeCondition(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  condition: Condition | SentCondition | null | undefined,
  env: DescribeEnv = {},
): Phrase {
  if (!condition || typeof condition !== 'object') return [gap()];
  if ('formula' in condition) return formulaWords(condition.readsAs);
  const all = 'allOf' in condition;
  const clauses: AnyClause[] = (all ? condition.allOf : (condition as { anyOf: AnyClause[] }).anyOf) ?? [];
  if (clauses.length === 0) return [gap()];
  return joinEach(clauses.map((c) => describeClause(doc, c, env)), all ? 'and' : 'or');
}

/** True for an "or" sentence of two clauses or more: it needs "either" when joined to more by "and". */
export function isOrGroup(condition: Condition | SentCondition | null | undefined): boolean {
  return !!condition && typeof condition === 'object' && 'anyOf' in condition && (condition.anyOf ?? []).length > 1;
}

/** A part of a longer "and" sentence; `or` marks an "or" group. */
export interface Group {
  phrase: Phrase;
  or: boolean;
}

/**
 * Parts joined by "and" so the grouping cannot be misread: an "or" group reads "either A or B",
 * with a comma after it when more follows. "When Approve is pressed and either Risk is High or
 * Risk is Medium"; "When either A presses Reject or B presses Reject, and Risk is High".
 */
export function joinGroups(groups: Group[]): Phrase {
  const parts = groups.map((g, i) => {
    if (!g.or) return g.phrase;
    const either = phrase('describe.either', { condition: g.phrase });
    return i < groups.length - 1 ? [...either, w('describe.groupEnd')] : either;
  });
  return joinEach(parts, 'and');
}

/** One clause in words. */
export function describeClause(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, clause: AnyClause, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  if (!clause || typeof clause !== 'object') return [gap()];
  if ('pressed' in clause) return describePressed(doc, clause.pressed);
  const natural = naturalYesNo(doc, clause, env);
  if (natural) return natural;
  return clauseWithWords(doc, clause, clause.words ? [w(`describe.words.${clause.words}`)] : [gap()], env);
}

/** "[left] [words] [right]" with the given words in place of the clause's own (negation uses it). */
export function clauseWithWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, clause: WordsLike, words: Phrase, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  const left = clause.left ? describeExpression(doc, clause.left, env) : [gap()];
  if (clause.words && (WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER as readonly Words[]).includes(clause.words)) {
    return phrase('describe.clause.nothingAfter', { left, words });
  }
  return phrase('describe.clause', { left, words, right: right(doc, clause, env) });
}

function right(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, clause: WordsLike, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase {
  const r = clause.right as Expression | Expression[] | undefined;
  if (r === undefined || r === null) return [gap()];
  if (!Array.isArray(r)) return describeExpression(doc, r, env);
  if (r.length === 0) return [gap()];
  const word = clause.words === 'list.includesAllOf' ? 'and' : 'or';
  return joinPhrases(r.map((e) => describeExpression(doc, e, env)), word);
}

/**
 * "Approve is pressed", or "Security team presses Reject" / "Domain approvers press Reject".
 * With `not`: "Approve is not pressed", "Security team does not press Reject".
 */
export function describePressed(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, buttonId: string | null | undefined, not = false): Phrase {
  const keys = not
    ? { one: 'describe.not.pressed', byTask: 'describe.not.pressed.byTask', byTasks: 'describe.not.pressed.byTasks' } as const
    : { one: 'describe.pressed', byTask: 'describe.pressed.byTask', byTasks: 'describe.pressed.byTasks' } as const;
  if (!buttonId) return phrase(keys.one, { button: gap() });
  const button = buttonChip(doc, buttonId);
  const taskId = find(doc, buttonId)?.parents.task;
  const task = getTask(doc, taskId);
  if (!task || !stageHasSeveralTasks(doc, task.id)) return phrase(keys.one, { button });
  const name = taskNameOf(doc, task);
  return phrase(!asksOnePersonByName(task) && soundsPlural(name) ? keys.byTasks : keys.byTask, { task: name, button });
}

/** True when the task is called by the one person it asks ("Diego Santos presses Reject", never "press"). */
function asksOnePersonByName(task: Task): boolean {
  if (task.name?.trim()) return false;
  const who = task.whoIsAsked;
  return !!who && typeof who === 'object' && 'person' in who;
}

/** A task's display name ("Domain approvers"), from its name or who is asked. */
export function taskNameOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task): string {
  return taskName(doc, task, (t) => toText(describeExpression(doc, t.whoIsAsked, {}, { short: true })));
}

/** The table of "first word=its negative" pairs from the words file. */
function negatives(): Map<string, string> {
  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const pair of w('describe.yesNo.negatives').split('|')) {
    const [word, negative] = pair.split('=');
    if (word && negative) map.set(word.toLowerCase(), negative);
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * A verb-first Yes/No name read for Yes or for No: "Needs approval" gives "needs approval" /
 * "needs no approval"; a name already in the negative ("Needs no review") gives "needs no review"
 * / "needs review", never "needs no no review". Undefined when the name does not start with a
 * word from the table.
 */
export function yesNoPredicate(name: string, yes: boolean): string | undefined {
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const lower = words.map((x) => x.toLowerCase());
  for (const [positive, negative] of negatives()) {
    const neg = negative.toLowerCase().split(' ');
    if (neg.every((x, i) => lower[i] === x)) {
      if (words.length <= neg.length) return undefined;
      const rest = lowerFirst(words.slice(neg.length).join(' '));
      return `${yes ? negative : positive} ${rest}`;
    }
  }
  const [first = '', ...rest] = words;
  const negative = negatives().get(first.toLowerCase());
  if (!negative || rest.length === 0) return undefined;
  return `${yes ? first.toLowerCase() : negative} ${lowerFirst(rest.join(' '))}`;
}

/**
 * "Primary domain needs approval" / "Primary domain needs no approval": a Yes/No clause whose left
 * reads a column (of a list row) named with a verb first, with its "(if empty, use ...)" after the
 * whole reading. A value used directly reads as its name (yesNoValue). Anything else reads
 * "... is Yes / is No".
 */
function naturalYesNo(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, clause: WordsLike, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase | undefined {
  if (clause.words !== 'yesNo.isYes' && clause.words !== 'yesNo.isNo') return undefined;
  const left = clause.left as ValueReference | RequestReference | undefined;
  if (!left || typeof left !== 'object') return undefined;
  if ('value' in left && typeof left.value === 'string' && !(left.steps ?? []).length) {
    return yesNoValue(doc, left, clause.words === 'yesNo.isYes', env);
  }
  const split = yesNoColumnSubject(doc, left, env);
  if (!split) return undefined;
  const predicate = yesNoPredicate(split.column, clause.words === 'yesNo.isYes');
  if (!predicate) return undefined;
  const natural = phrase('describe.yesNo.natural', { subject: split.subject, predicate });
  const { ifEmptyUse } = left;
  if (!ifEmptyUse) return natural;
  return phrase('describe.ifEmptyUse', { main: natural, fallback: describeExpression(doc, ifEmptyUse, env) });
}

/**
 * For a value that ends on a list's column named verb-first ("Needs approval"): what comes before
 * that column, in words ("Primary domain", without "If empty, use"), and the column's name. A
 * sentence builder shows the subject as the chip and the column as the words: [Primary domain]
 * [needs no approval] (mockup 03-routing). Undefined for anything else.
 */
export function yesNoColumnSubject(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  left: Expression | null | undefined,
  env: DescribeEnv = {},
): { subject: Phrase; column: string } | undefined {
  if (!left || typeof left !== 'object' || Array.isArray(left) || !('steps' in left)) return undefined;
  const ref = left as ValueReference | RequestReference;
  const steps = ref.steps ?? [];
  const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
  if (!last || !('column' in last)) return undefined;
  const entry = find(doc, last.column);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'column' || !entry.item.name || !yesNoPredicate(entry.item.name, true)) return undefined;
  const plain = { ...ref };
  delete plain.ifEmptyUse;
  const subject = describeExpression(doc, { ...plain, steps: steps.slice(0, -1) } as Expression, env);
  return { subject, column: entry.item.name };
}

/** True when a name already says the negative ("Not urgent", "Cannot deploy", "Needs no approval"). */
export function startsNegative(name: string): boolean {
  const lower = name.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (lower.length === 0) return false;
  const starts = (words: string) => {
    const want = words.toLowerCase().split(' ');
    return want.every((x, i) => lower[i] === x);
  };
  if (w('describe.yesNo.negativeStarts').split('|').some(starts)) return true;
  return [...negatives().values()].some(starts);
}

/**
 * A Yes/No value used directly: "is Yes" reads as its name ("Urgent", "Needs approval"); "is No"
 * as a plain negative, never a double one: "not urgent", "Needs no approval" for a verb-first name,
 * and "<name>: No" for a name already in the negative ("Cannot deploy: No").
 */
function yesNoValue(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, left: ValueReference, yes: boolean, env: DescribeEnv): Phrase {
  const { ifEmptyUse, ...plain } = left;
  const said = describeExpression(doc, plain as Expression, env);
  const name = said.length === 1 ? said[0] : undefined;
  let main: Phrase;
  if (yes || !name || !isChip(name)) {
    main = yes ? said : phrase('describe.yesNo.nameNo', { name: said });
  } else if (startsNegative(name.label)) {
    main = phrase('describe.yesNo.nameNo', { name });
  } else {
    const predicate = yesNoPredicate(name.label, false);
    // "not" only goes in front of one word ("not urgent"); in front of a longer name it can read
    // as nonsense ("not deploy failed"), so that keeps its name and says "is No".
    const oneWord = name.label.trim().split(/\s+/).length === 1;
    main = predicate
      ? [{ ...name, label: name.label.charAt(0) + predicate.slice(1) }]
      : oneWord
        ? phrase('describe.yesNo.not', { name: { ...name, label: lowerFirst(name.label) } })
        : phrase('describe.yesNo.nameIsNo', { name });
  }
  if (!ifEmptyUse) return main;
  return phrase('describe.ifEmptyUse', { main, fallback: describeExpression(doc, ifEmptyUse, env) });
}

}

/** Arrows, actions, statuses, choices and Starts when on unfinished drafts: missing fields everywhere. */
import { describe as group, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Action, Arrow, Stage, StartsWhen, Task } from '@/contract';
import { fixture } from '../testkit';
import {
  actionChip,
  arrowLabel,
  describeAction,
  describeArrow,
  describeChoicesSource,
  describeStartsWhen,
  describeStatus,
  describeWhoIsAsked,
  hasMissing,
  toText,
} from './index';
import { testCatalogue } from './__tests__/test-catalogue';

const doc = fixture('change-request');
const env = { catalogue: testCatalogue };
const arrow = (a: Partial<Arrow>): Arrow => ({ id: 'ar_x', when: { type: 'inAllOtherCases' }, goTo: null, ...a });
const sentence = (a: Partial<Arrow>, d = doc) => toText(describeArrow(d, arrow(a)).sentence);
const action = (a: object) => a as Action;

group('arrows', () => {
  it('goes to "(choose a stage)" until a stage is chosen', () => {
    const words = describeArrow(doc, arrow({ when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: 'btn_da_approve' } }));
    expect(toText(words.sentence)).toBe('When Approve is pressed go to (choose a stage)');
    expect(hasMissing(words.goTo)).toBe(true);
    expect(words.onlyWhen).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('says a deleted stage by its old name', () => {
    const d = { ...doc, removedNames: { st_domain_review: 'Domain review' } };
    const words = describeArrow(d, arrow({ goTo: 'st_domain_review' }));
    expect(toText(words.sentence)).toBe('In all other cases go to Domain review (deleted)');
    expect(words.goTo[0]).toMatchObject({ chip: 'stage', id: 'st_domain_review', missing: true });
  });

  it('adds "+ only when" as "and ..."', () => {
    const a = arrow({
      when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: 'btn_da_approve' },
      onlyWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] },
      goTo: 'st_development',
    });
    const words = describeArrow(doc, a);
    expect(toText(words.sentence)).toBe('When Approve is pressed and Risk is High go to Development');
    expect(toText(words.onlyWhen ?? [])).toBe('Risk is High');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, a)).toBe('Approve pressed and Risk is High');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, { ...a, words: '  ' })).toBe('Approve pressed and Risk is High');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, { ...a, words: 'High risk' })).toBe('High risk');
  });

  it('says a pressed part of a "when ..." as "Approve pressed" on the pill (built with "Add an arrow")', () => {
    // Was "Approve is pressed and Risk is High" on the diagram (editor-model.md section 3).
    const a = arrow({
      when: {
        type: 'condition',
        condition: { allOf: [{ pressed: 'btn_da_approve' }, { left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] },
      },
      goTo: 'st_development',
    });
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, a)).toBe('Approve pressed and Risk is High');
    expect(toText(describeArrow(doc, a).sentence)).toBe('When Approve is pressed and Risk is High go to Development');
    const or = arrow({ when: { type: 'condition', condition: { anyOf: [{ pressed: 'btn_da_approve' }, { pressed: 'btn_da_reject' }] } } });
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, or)).toBe('Approve pressed or Reject pressed');
  });

  it('reads "When done" after an arrow that depends on answers as "In all other cases"', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    const stage = d.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_create_jira_issue') as Extract<Stage, { arrows: Arrow[] }>;
    const done = stage.arrows[0]!;
    expect(arrowLabel(d, done)).toBe('When done');
    expect(toText(describeArrow(d, done).sentence)).toBe('When done go to Development');
    stage.arrows.unshift({ id: 'ar_first', when: { type: 'condition', condition: { allOf: [] } }, goTo: null });
    expect(arrowLabel(d, done)).toBe('In all other cases');
    expect(toText(describeArrow(d, done).sentence)).toBe('In all other cases go to Development');
  });

  it('reads unfinished "when"s', () => {
    expect(sentence({ when: { type: 'condition' } })).toBe('When … go to (choose a stage)');
    expect(sentence({ when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: null } })).toBe('When … is pressed go to (choose a stage)');
    expect(sentence({ when: undefined as unknown as Arrow['when'] })).toBe('When … go to (choose a stage)');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, arrow({ when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: null } }))).toBe('… pressed');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, arrow({ when: { type: 'condition' } }))).toBe('…');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, arrow({ when: undefined as unknown as Arrow['when'] }))).toBe('…');
    expect(arrowLabel(doc, arrow({ when: { type: 'whenDone' } }))).toBe('When done');
  });

  it('says an unnamed stage and button', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    d.stages[1]!.name = '';
    expect(sentence({ goTo: 'st_domain_approval' }, d)).toBe('In all other cases go to (no name yet)');
  });
});

    expect(name('Close')).toBe('Close in Jira');
    expect(name('Create a Jira issue')).toBe('Create a Jira issue');
    expect(toText(describeAction(doc, { ...use, operation: 'other.thing@1' } as Action, env))).toBe('other.thing@1');
  });

    );

/** describeExpression, describeConstant, describeTemplate and the phrase helpers. */
import { describe as group, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Constant, Expression } from '@/contract';
import { fixture } from '../testkit';
import { describeConstant, describeExpression, describeTemplate, formatDate, hasMissing, isChip, isMissing, toText } from './index';
import { joinPhrases, lowerFirst, phrase, tidy } from './phrase';
import { testCatalogue } from './__tests__/test-catalogue';

const doc = fixture('change-request');
const say = (e: Expression) => toText(describeExpression(doc, e));
const con = (c: Constant) => toText(describeConstant(doc, c));

group('value references', () => {
  it('reads steps the way the mockups do', () => {
    expect(say({ value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }] })).toBe("Primary domain's approvers");
    expect(say({ value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_engineering_group' }, { directory: 'members' }] })).toBe(
      "members of Primary domain's engineering group",
    );
    expect(say({ value: 'v_title' })).toBe('Title');
  });

  it('is one value chip carrying the value ID', () => {
    const parts = describeExpression(doc, { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }] });
    expect(parts).toEqual([{ chip: 'value', label: "Primary domain's approvers", id: 'v_primary_domain' }]);
  });

  it('adds "if empty, use", unless short', () => {
    const e: Expression = { value: 'v_eng_lead', ifEmptyUse: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_default_lead' }] } };
    expect(say(e)).toBe("Eng lead (if empty, use Primary domain's default lead)");
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, e, {}, { short: true }))).toBe('Eng lead');
  });

  it('says a deleted value by its old name, flagged missing', () => {
    const d = { ...doc, removedNames: { v_gone: 'Old risk' } };
    const parts = describeExpression(d, { value: 'v_gone' });
    expect(toText(parts)).toBe('Old risk (deleted)');
    expect(hasMissing(parts)).toBe(true);
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, { value: 'v_gone' }))).toBe('something that was removed');
    expect(hasMissing(describeExpression(doc, { value: 'v_title', steps: [{ column: 'col_gone' }] }))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('says a value with no name yet', () => {
    const d = { ...doc, values: [...doc.values, { id: 'v_blank' as const, name: '' }] };
    expect(toText(describeExpression(d, { value: 'v_blank' }))).toBe('(no name yet)');
  });
});

group('request references', () => {
  it('says Requester and Started on', () => {
    expect(say({ request: 'requester' })).toBe('Requester');
    expect(say({ request: 'startedOn' })).toBe('Started on');
    expect(say({ request: 'requester', ifEmptyUse: { group: { directoryId: 'g', name: 'Platform team' } } })).toBe(
      'Requester (if empty, use Platform team)',
    );
  });
});

group('constants', () => {
  it('says each kind', () => {
    expect(con({ text: 'CHG' })).toBe('CHG');
    expect(con({ text: '' })).toBe('(empty text)');
    expect(con({ number: 1500 })).toBe('1,500');
    expect(con({ yesNo: true })).toBe('Yes');
    expect(con({ yesNo: false })).toBe('No');
    expect(con({ date: '2026-12-02' })).toBe('2 Dec 2026');
    expect(con({ weekday: 'friday' })).toBe('Friday');
    expect(con({ choice: 'ch_risk_high' })).toBe('High');
    expect(con({ choices: ['ch_risk_low', 'ch_risk_medium', 'ch_risk_high'] })).toBe('Low, Medium and High');
    expect(con({ row: 'row_internal_tools' })).toBe('Internal tools');
    expect(con({ button: 'btn_da_approve' })).toBe('Approve');
    expect(con({ person: { directoryId: 'p', name: 'Diego Santos' } })).toBe('Diego Santos');
    expect(con({ group: { directoryId: 'g', name: 'Payments approvers' } })).toBe('Payments approvers');
    expect(con({ people: [{ directoryId: 'a', name: 'Marcus Lee' }, { directoryId: 'b', name: 'Hannah Okafor' }] })).toBe(
      'Marcus Lee and Hannah Okafor',
    );
    expect(con({ connectionChoice: { stored: 'svc-1', label: 'Payments API' } })).toBe('Payments API');
    expect(con({ connectionChoice: { stored: 'svc-1', label: '' } })).toBe('svc-1');
  });

  it('gives the right chip kinds', () => {
    expect(describeConstant(doc, { person: { directoryId: 'p', name: 'Diego Santos' } })[0]).toMatchObject({ chip: 'person', id: 'p' });
    expect(describeConstant(doc, { group: { directoryId: 'g', name: 'X' } })[0]).toMatchObject({ chip: 'group' });
    expect(describeConstant(doc, { button: 'btn_da_approve' })[0]).toMatchObject({ chip: 'button', id: 'btn_da_approve' });
    expect(describeConstant(doc, { text: 'CHG' })[0]).toMatchObject({ chip: 'constant' });
  });

  it('flags missing choices, rows and buttons', () => {
    for (const c of [{ choice: 'ch_gone' }, { row: 'row_gone' }, { button: 'btn_gone' }, { person: { directoryId: 'x', name: '' } }] as Constant[]) {
      expect(hasMissing(describeConstant(doc, c))).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('formats dates and leaves odd ones as written', () => {
    expect(formatDate('2026-01-09')).toBe('9 Jan 2026');
    expect(formatDate('2026-13-01')).toBe('2026-13-01');
    expect(formatDate('soon')).toBe('soon');
  });
});

group('formulas, sentences, templates and what was sent', () => {
  it('shows a formula as its "Reads as" sentence, or "a formula" while that is empty', () => {
    expect(say({ formula: '{{v_title}}', readsAs: 'The title' })).toBe('The title');
    const empty = describeExpression(doc, { formula: '1', readsAs: '' });
    expect(toText(empty)).toBe('a formula');
    expect(hasMissing(empty)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('reads a sentence used as a value', () => {
    expect(say({ allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] })).toBe('Risk is High');
  });

  it('reads a template as text with chips', () => {
    const parts = describeTemplate(doc, ['Your Jira issue for this change is ready: ', { value: 'v_jira_issue' }]);
    expect(toText(parts)).toBe('Your Jira issue for this change is ready: Jira issue');
    expect(parts.filter(isChip)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(describeExpression(doc, ['a', 'b'])).toEqual(['ab']);
  });

  it('names a sent field after the trigger, else "Sent"', () => {
    const env = { catalogue: testCatalogue, trigger: 'helpdesk.ticketCreated@1' };
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: 'title' }, env))).toBe('Ticket: Title');
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: 'service.name' }, env))).toBe('Ticket: Service name');
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: 'unknown' }, env))).toBe('Ticket: unknown');
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: 'title' }))).toBe('Sent: title');
    expect(describeExpression(doc, { sentField: 'title' })[0]).toMatchObject({ chip: 'sent' });
  });

  it('reads nothing as "…", flagged missing', () => {
    expect(describeExpression(doc, undefined).every(isMissing)).toBe(true);
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, null))).toBe('…');
    expect(toText(describeExpression(doc, {} as Expression))).toBe('…');
  });
});

group('phrase helpers', () => {
  it('fills placeholders with phrases and merges plain text', () => {
    expect(phrase('describe.arrow.sentence', { when: ['When done'], goTo: 'Released' })).toEqual(['When done go to Released']);
    expect(phrase('describe.arrow.sentence', { when: ['When done'] })).toEqual(['When done go to {goTo}']);
    expect(tidy(['a', 'b', { chip: 'value', label: 'c' }, '', 'd'])).toEqual(['ab', { chip: 'value', label: 'c' }, 'd']);
  });

  it('joins lists and lowers first letters carefully', () => {
    expect(toText(joinPhrases([['A']], 'or'))).toBe('A');
    expect(toText(joinPhrases([['A'], ['B']], 'or'))).toBe('A or B');
    expect(toText(joinPhrases([['A'], ['B'], ['C']], 'and'))).toBe('A, B and C');
    expect(lowerFirst('Default lead')).toBe('default lead');
    expect(lowerFirst('API key')).toBe('API key');
    expect(lowerFirst('')).toBe('');
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/expression.ts\n===
/**
 * Anything that gives a value, in the author's words: value references with their steps
 * ("Primary domain's approvers", "members of Primary domain's engineering group"), "Requester" and
 * "Started on", constants of every kind ("2 Dec 2026", "Yes", a choice's label, a row by its list's
 * first column), templates (text with chips), formulas (their "Reads as" sentence), "If empty,
 * use ...", and what another system sent ("Ticket: Title").
 */
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow,
  Constant,
  DirectoryRef,
  Expression,
  RequestReference,
  Sentence,
  SentExpression,
  SentTemplate,
  Step,
  Template,
  ValueReference,
} from '@/contract';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { entryOf, fieldLabel, triggerThing } from './catalogue';
import { describeCondition, yesNoPredicate } from './condition';
import { buttonChip, deletedName, valueChip } from './names';
import { failureCodeLabel } from './value-choices';
import {
  chip,
  gap,
  joinPhrases,
  lowerFirst,
  missing,
  phrase,
  tidy,
  toText,
  w,
  type Chip,
  type DescribeEnv,
  type Phrase,
} from './phrase';

/** Options inside describe: `short` leaves out "(if empty, use ...)" (chips on diagram cards). */
export interface SayOptions {
  short?: boolean;
}

type Node = Expression | SentExpression;
type Slot = Node | Template | SentTemplate;

const has = <K extends string>(node: object, key: K): node is Record<K, unknown> =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(node, key);

/** An expression, a sent expression, or a template, in words. Absent or malformed reads as the gap word (describe.gap), flagged missing. */
export function describeExpression(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  expression: Slot | null | undefined,
  env: DescribeEnv = {},
  options: SayOptions = {},
): Phrase {
  if (expression === null || expression === undefined) return [gap()];
  if (Array.isArray(expression)) return describeTemplate(doc, expression, env);
  if (typeof expression !== 'object') return [gap()];
  if (has(expression, 'value') && typeof expression.value === 'string') return valueReference(doc, expression as ValueReference, env, options);
  if (has(expression, 'request')) return requestReference(doc, expression as RequestReference, env, options);
  if (has(expression, 'sentField')) return [sentChip(String(expression.sentField), env)];
  if (has(expression, 'formula')) return formulaWords((expression as { readsAs?: string }).readsAs);
  if (has(expression, 'allOf') || has(expression, 'anyOf')) return describeCondition(doc, expression as Sentence, env);
  return describeConstant(doc, expression as Constant, env);
}

/** Text with chips: strings as written, expressions in words. */
export function describeTemplate(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, template: Template | SentTemplate, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  for (const piece of template ?? []) {
    if (typeof piece === 'string') out.push(piece);
    else out.push(...describeExpression(doc, piece, env));
  }
  return tidy(out);
}

/** A formula's "Reads as" sentence; "a formula", flagged missing, while that is empty. */
export function formulaWords(readsAs: string | undefined): Phrase {
  return readsAs?.trim() ? [readsAs] : [missing(w('describe.formula'))];
}

/** The steps' words around a starting name: "Primary domain's approvers", "members of ...". */
function withSteps(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, start: string, steps: Step[] | undefined): string {
  let text = start;
  for (const step of steps ?? []) {
    if (has(step, 'column')) {
      const entry = find(doc, String(step.column));
      const column = entry?.kind === 'column' ? entry.item.name || w('describe.noName') : deletedName(doc, String(step.column));
      // A Yes/No column named verb-first reads as a statement, not a possession: "Primary domain
      // needs approval", never "Primary domain's needs approval" (editor-model.md section 5).
      const statement = entry?.kind === 'column' && entry.item.kind === 'yesNo' && !!yesNoPredicate(column, true);
      text = toText(phrase(statement ? 'describe.step.yesNoColumn' : 'describe.step.column', { of: text, column: lowerFirst(column) }));
    } else if (has(step, 'directory')) {
      text = toText(phrase('describe.step.members', { of: text }));
    }
  }
  return text;
}

/** True when a column step names something that is gone. */
const stepsMissing = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, steps: Step[] | undefined) =>
  (steps ?? []).some((s) => has(s, 'column') && find(doc, String(s.column))?.kind !== 'column');

function withFallback(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, main: Phrase, fallback: Expression | undefined, env: DescribeEnv, options: SayOptions): Phrase {
  if (!fallback || options.short) return main;
  return phrase('describe.ifEmptyUse', { main, fallback: describeExpression(doc, fallback, env, options) });
}

function valueReference(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, ref: ValueReference, env: DescribeEnv, options: SayOptions): Phrase {
  const base = valueChip(doc, ref.value);
  const label = withSteps(doc, base.label, ref.steps);
  const c = chip('value', label, ref.value, base.missing || stepsMissing(doc, ref.steps));
  return withFallback(doc, [c], ref.ifEmptyUse, env, options);
}

function requestReference(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, ref: RequestReference, env: DescribeEnv, options: SayOptions): Phrase {
  const name = ref.request === 'startedOn' ? w('describe.request.startedOn') : w('describe.request.requester');
  const c = chip('value', withSteps(doc, name, ref.steps), `request.${ref.request}`, stepsMissing(doc, ref.steps) || undefined);
  return withFallback(doc, [c], ref.ifEmptyUse, env, options);
}

/** "Ticket: Title" when the catalogue knows the trigger, else "Sent: title". */
export function sentChip(field: string, env: DescribeEnv): Chip {
  const thing = triggerThing(env.catalogue, env.trigger) ?? w('describe.sentThing');
  const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, env.trigger);
  const label = (entry?.kind === 'trigger' ? fieldLabel(entry.event, field) : undefined) ?? field;
  return chip('sent', toText(phrase('describe.sent', { thing, field: label })), field);
}

/** `YYYY-MM-DD` as "2 Dec 2026"; anything else as written. */
export function formatDate(date: string): string {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(date ?? '');
  const months = w('describe.months').split(' ');
  const month = m ? months[Number(m[2]) - 1] : undefined;
  if (!m || !month) return date ?? '';
  return `${Number(m[3])} ${month} ${m[1]}`;
}

const person = (ref: DirectoryRef | undefined, kind: 'person' | 'group'): Chip =>
  ref?.name ? chip(kind, ref.name, ref.directoryId) : chip(kind, w('describe.noName'), ref?.directoryId, true);

/** A typed constant in words. A failure code reads as the catalogue's label (`env.catalogue`), never as the code (E-29). */
export function describeConstant(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, constant: Constant, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  const c = constant as Record<string, unknown>;
  const is = (key: string) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c, key);
  if (is('text')) return [chip('constant', String(c.text ?? '') || w('describe.emptyText'))];
  if (is('number')) return [chip('constant', typeof c.number === 'number' ? c.number.toLocaleString('en-GB') : String(c.number))];
  if (is('yesNo')) return [chip('constant', w(c.yesNo ? 'describe.yes' : 'describe.no'))];
  if (is('date')) return [chip('constant', formatDate(String(c.date)))];
  if (is('weekday')) return [chip('constant', weekday(String(c.weekday)))];
  if (is('choice')) return [choiceChip(doc, String(c.choice))];
  if (is('choices')) return joinPhrases(((c.choices as string[]) ?? []).map((id) => [choiceChip(doc, id)]), 'and');
  if (is('row')) return [rowChip(doc, String(c.row))];
  if (is('button')) return [buttonChip(doc, String(c.button))];
  if (is('failureCode')) return [chip('constant', failureCodeLabel(doc, env.catalogue, String(c.failureCode)))];
  if (is('person')) return [person(c.person as DirectoryRef, 'person')];
  if (is('group')) return [person(c.group as DirectoryRef, 'group')];
  if (is('people')) return joinPhrases(((c.people as DirectoryRef[]) ?? []).map((p) => [person(p, 'person')]), 'and');
  if (is('connectionChoice')) {
    const choice = c.connectionChoice as { label?: string; stored?: unknown } | undefined;
    return [chip('constant', choice?.label || String(choice?.stored ?? ''))];
  }
  return [gap()];
}

const WEEKDAYS = ['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday'] as const;

function weekday(day: string): string {
  const known = WEEKDAYS.find((d) => d === day);
  return known ? w(`describe.weekday.${known}`) : day;
}

function choiceChip(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'choice') return chip('constant', deletedName(doc, id), id, true);
  return entry.item.label ? chip('constant', entry.item.label, id) : chip('constant', w('describe.noName'), id, true);
}

/** A row by its list's first column ("Payments"); "(no name yet)", flagged missing, when that cell is empty. */
export function rowChip(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (entry?.kind !== 'row') return chip('constant', deletedName(doc, id), id, true);
  const list = find(doc, entry.parents.list);
  const first = list?.kind === 'list' ? list.item.columns?.[0] : undefined;
  const cell = first ? entry.item.cells?.[first.id] : undefined;
  const label = cell ? toText(describeConstant(doc, cell)) : '';
  return label ? chip('constant', label, id) : chip('constant', w('describe.noName'), id, true);
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/failure.ts\n===
/**
 * What happens when an action that uses another system fails or is slow, said once for In words and
 * the action card, so the two never disagree (editor-model.md section 11 and ruling U-19;
 * docs/05-integrations.md, "Each door at a glance" and door 3). Three sentences, always in this order:
 *   1. a system that cannot be reached or answers unclearly is asked again, and the request is not stuck;
 *   2. a system that has not answered (a Wait for: not reported back) after the time the catalogue
 *      gives (`expectedWithinSeconds`) makes the people who look after stuck requests be told, and the
 *      request is not stuck;
 *   3. a clear failure: with "If it fails: Stop" the request is stuck and the people in "Stuck
 *      requests go to" are told; with "Carry on" it goes on and the values the author named record
 *      it (the Yes/No one whether it failed, the text one what went wrong).
 * The first mention of who is told says who they are ("Platform team, who look after stuck requests,
 * are told"); the second, in sentence 3, is short ("Platform team are told").
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, UseConnection } from '@/contract';
import type { WordKey } from '@/words';
import { connectionLabel, entryOf } from './catalogue';
import { valueChip } from './names';
import { chip, phrase, tidy, toText, w, type Chip, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';
import { describeStuckTold, type StuckPerson, type StuckToldOptions } from './stuck';

export interface IfItFailsEnv extends DescribeEnv {
  /** The people in "Stuck requests go to", by name. */
  stuckPeople?: readonly StuckPerson[];
}

export interface IfItFailsWords {
  /** "If Jira cannot be reached or its answer is unclear, Jira is asked again and the request is not stuck." */
  askedAgain: Phrase;
  /**
   * "If Jira has not answered after 15 minutes, Sam Carter, who looks after stuck requests, is told;
   * the request is not stuck." Absent when the catalogue does not say what the action is (no time is known).
   */
  slow?: Phrase;
  /** "If Jira says it failed, the request is stuck here and Sam Carter is told." or a "carries on" sentence. */
  failed: Phrase;
  /** All three, one after the other: what In words says. */
  sentence: Phrase;
  /** True when a clear failure leaves the request stuck ("If it fails: Stop"). */
  stops: boolean;
}

/** The time the catalogue gives in seconds, in words: "45 seconds", "15 minutes", "1 hour", "2 days" (rounded). */
export function durationWords(seconds: number): string {
  const s = Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds));
  const say = (n: number, one: 'second' | 'minute' | 'hour' | 'day'): string =>
    n === 1 ? w(`describe.time.${one}` as WordKey) : toText(phrase(`describe.time.${one}s` as WordKey, { n: String(n) }));
  if (s < 60) return say(s, 'second');
  if (s < 3600) return say(Math.round(s / 60), 'minute');
  if (s < 86400) return say(Math.round(s / 3600), 'hour');
  return say(Math.round(s / 86400), 'day');
}

/** The default the catalogue writes for a look-up or a "does something" when it names no time (catalogue.ts). */
const DEFAULT_EXPECTED_SECONDS = 900;

/**
 * The sentences of an action that uses a connection. `stuck`: how the first mention of who is told is
 * worded (see `describeStuckTold`: `{}` for "Sam Carter, who looks after stuck requests, is told",
 * `{ settingsHint: true }` to add "(change this in Settings)", `{ short: true }` when the reader has
 * already been told who they are). The second mention is always short. The connection is a chip.
 */
export function describeIfItFails(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  action: UseConnection,
  env: IfItFailsEnv = {},
  stuck: StuckToldOptions = {},
): IfItFailsWords {
  const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, action.operation);
  const connection: Chip = chip('connection', action.operation ? connectionLabel(env.catalogue, entry, action.operation) : '', entry?.connection);
  const operation = entry?.kind === 'operation' ? entry : undefined;
  const isAwait = operation?.sort === 'await';
  const askedAgain = phrase('describe.fails.askedAgain', { connection });

  const seconds = operation ? operation.expectedWithinSeconds || (isAwait ? 0 : DEFAULT_EXPECTED_SECONDS) : 0;
  const slow = seconds
    ? phrase(isAwait ? 'describe.fails.slowAwait' : 'describe.fails.slow', {
        connection,
        time: durationWords(seconds),
        who: describeStuckTold(env.stuckPeople, stuck),
      })
    : undefined;
  // Who is told was said in the slow sentence; the failure sentence names them again, short.
  const second: StuckToldOptions = slow ? { short: true } : stuck;

  const stops = action.ifItFails !== 'carryOn';
  let failed: Phrase;
  if (stops) failed = phrase('describe.fails.stop', { connection, stuck: describeStuckTold(env.stuckPeople, second) });
  else {
    const yes = action.saveFailureAs?.failed;
    const code = action.saveFailureAs?.code;
    if (yes && code) failed = phrase('describe.fails.carryOn.both', { connection, failed: valueChip(doc, yes), code: valueChip(doc, code) });
    else if (yes) failed = phrase('describe.fails.carryOn.failed', { connection, failed: valueChip(doc, yes) });
    else if (code) failed = phrase('describe.fails.carryOn.code', { connection, code: valueChip(doc, code) });
    else failed = phrase('describe.fails.carryOn.none', { connection });
  }
  const sentence = tidy([...askedAgain, ' ', ...(slow ? [...slow, ' '] : []), ...failed]);
  return { askedAgain, ...(slow ? { slow } : {}), failed, sentence, stops };
}

    severity: 'worthKnowing',
  },
  'stage.unreachable': { doc: cr, location: loc('st_rejected'), params: {}, severity: 'worthKnowing' },
  'task.askedMayBeEmpty': {
    doc: cr,
    location: loc('tk_development', 'whoIsAsked'),
    params: { reason: 'listMayBeEmpty', value: loc('v_eng_lead') },
    severity: 'worthKnowing',
  },
  'group.readInSameStep': { doc: cr, location: loc('btn_da_approve', 'enabledWhen.0'), params: { value: loc('v_eng_lead') } },
  'startsWhen.buttonNotOnStart': { doc: ig, location: loc('sw_helpdesk_ticket', 'button'), params: { button: 'btn_approve' } },
  'requester.mayBeEmpty': { doc: ig, location: loc('act_notify_deploy_failed', 'to'), params: { bindings: ['sw_helpdesk_ticket'] }, severity: 'worthKnowing' },
};

const said = <C extends FindingCode>(code: C): FindingWords => {
  const s = SAMPLES[code] as Sample<C>;
  return describeFinding(s.doc, finding(code, s), env);
};

const texts = (w: FindingWords) => [w.short, w.cause, w.effect ?? '', w.fix?.label ?? '', w.where];

// Engine words and other words never shown (editor-model.md section 1); "Wait for" is the one allowed use of "wait".
const BANNED = /\b(wait|otherwise|condition|node|step|route|variable|field|type|trigger|event|webhook|connector|integration|API|endpoint|payload|IDs?|undefined|null|NaN)\b/i;
const ID = /\b(wf|st|stat|tk|pg|q|tx|ch|btn|act|ar|v|ls|col|row|sw|told)_\w+|\w+\.\w+@\d/;
const CAMEL = /\b[a-z]+[A-Z]\w*\b/;

group('describeFinding covers every code', () => {
  it('has a sample for every code in the union, and every code is said', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(SAMPLES).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(FINDING_CODES).sort());
  });

  for (const code of Object.keys(FINDING_CODES) as FindingCode[]) {
    it(`says ${code} in plain words`, () => {
      const w = said(code);
      expect(w.short.length, 'short').toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(w.cause.length, 'cause').toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(w.where.length, 'where').toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(w.short.split(/\s+/).length, `short is short: ${w.short}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10);
      for (const text of texts(w)) {
        expect(text, `${code}: ${text}`).not.toMatch(ID);
        expect(text, `${code}: ${text}`).not.toMatch(CAMEL);
        expect(text.replace(/\bWait for\b/g, ''), `${code}: ${text}`).not.toMatch(BANNED);
        expect(text, `${code}: ${text}`).not.toMatch(/[{}]|findings\.|describe\.|…/);
        expect(text, `${code}: never the code`).not.toContain(code);
      }
    });
  }
});

    const at = { doc: cr, location: loc('ar_rf_other') };
    // Several earlier arrows together: named, each with its own Show me; never "what it checks is never true".
    const together = describeFinding(cr, finding('arrow.neverUsed', { ...at, params: { reason: 'earlierArrowAlwaysFits', covering: [loc('ar_rf_no_approval'), loc('ar_rf_other')] } }), env);
    expect(together.cause).toBe(
      'The arrow "In all other cases" can never be used: the arrows "Domain needs no approval (Internal tools)" and "In all other cases" above it always take the request first.',
    );
    expect(together.alsoShow?.map((a) => a.location)).toEqual([loc('ar_rf_no_approval'), loc('ar_rf_other')]);
    expect(together.cause).not.toContain('never true');
    // An older engine with no covering list still says the true reason.
    const above = describeFinding(cr, finding('arrow.neverUsed', { ...at, params: { reason: 'earlierArrowAlwaysFits' } }), env);
    expect(above.cause).toBe('The arrow "In all other cases" can never be used: the arrows above it always take the request first.');
    // Only the engine's conditionNeverTrue says that what it checks is never true.
    const never = describeFinding(cr, finding('arrow.neverUsed', { ...at, params: { reason: 'conditionNeverTrue' } }), env);
    expect(never.cause).toBe('The arrow "In all other cases" can never be used: what it checks is never true.');
    expect(never.alsoShow).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('a key the connection does not have is never shown', () => {
    const w = said('catalogue.unknownField');
    expect(w.where).toBe('Create Jira issue › Create a Jira issue › Send');

  });

  it('the engine bug detail is never shown', () => {

    expect(texts(w).join(' ')).not.toMatch(/TypeError|compileArrow/);
  });

group("the finding codes are core's, and each has words", () => {
  // Compile time: FINDING_CODES is a `Record<FindingCode, true>` with `FindingCode` from @workflow/core
  // (through '@/services'), so a code core adds without words here fails to compile, and so does a
  // code here that core does not have (an object literal may not have extra keys). The same holds
  // for DESCRIBERS in finding.ts and SAMPLES above.
  type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
  const exact: Equal<keyof typeof FINDING_CODES, FindingCode> = true;

  it('every code of the table in contract/core-api.md section 4 is one core reports, and the other way round', () => {
    // The frontend's tests run in frontend/; the contract folder is beside it.
    const api = readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), '../contract/core-api.md'), 'utf8');
    const table = api.slice(api.indexOf('## 4. `check`'), api.indexOf('## 5.'));
    const rows = [...table.matchAll(/^\| `([a-zA-Z]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)` \| (todo|worthKnowing) \|/gm)].map((m) => m[1]);
    expect(exact).toBe(true);
    expect(rows.length).toBeGreaterThan(40);
    expect([...rows].sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(FINDING_CODES).sort());
  });

  it('formula.notInProfile has words for each rule, the reserved key (E-27) included', () => {
    const at = { doc: cr, location: loc('ar_rf_no_approval', 'when.condition') };
    const said = (rule: 'timeZone' | 'unicodeClass' | 'reservedKey') =>
      describeFinding(cr, finding('formula.notInProfile', { ...at, params: { start: 0, end: 3, rule } }), env).cause;
    expect(said('reservedKey')).toMatch(/writes down a name that starts with \$, and such names are kept for the platform\. Start the name another way\.$/);
    expect(new Set([said('timeZone'), said('unicodeClass'), said('reservedKey')]).size).toBe(3);
  });

  it('parse.badFormat on a person or group the directory cannot read (E-27)', () => {
    const w = describeFinding(cr, { code: 'parse.badFormat', location: loc('tk_domain_approval', 'whoIsAsked'), params: { pointer: '/stages/1/tasks/0/whoIsAsked/group/directoryId', format: 'directoryId' } }, env);
    expect(w.short).toBe('To do: choose the person or group again');
    expect(w.cause).toMatch(/names a person or group that is not saved in a form the directory can read\. Nothing you did on screen caused this\.$/);
    expect(w.fix).toEqual({ kind: 'show', location: loc('tk_domain_approval', 'whoIsAsked'), label: 'Choose it again' });
    for (const text of texts(w)) expect(text).not.toMatch(/directoryId|format|pointer/);
  });

  it('an ending nothing leads to: "No request can ever finish at ...", nothing about asking anyone', () => {
    const w = said('stage.unreachable');
    expect(w.cause).toBe('No request can ever finish at Rejected.');
    expect(w.effect).toBeUndefined();
    const working = describeFinding(cr, finding('stage.unreachable', { doc: cr, location: loc('st_development'), params: {}, severity: 'worthKnowing' }), env);
    expect(working.cause).toBe('No request can ever get to Development.');
  });

  it('a new arrow with no words yet is named by its place, and its effect has no empty "When …," (swap defect)', () => {
    const doc = structuredClone(cr);
    const stage = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval') as WorkingStage;
    stage.arrows.push({ id: 'ar_new', when: { type: 'condition' }, goTo: null } as never);
    const n = stage.arrows.length;
    const goTo = describeFinding(doc, { code: 'item.partMissing', severity: 'todo', location: loc('ar_new', 'goTo'), params: {} }, env);
    expect(goTo.cause).toBe(`Arrow ${n} of Domain approval does not go anywhere yet.`);
    expect(goTo.effect).toBe('A request that takes it would be stuck in Domain approval.');
    const when = describeFinding(doc, { code: 'item.partMissing', severity: 'todo', location: loc('ar_new', 'when.condition'), params: {} }, env);
    expect(when.cause).toBe(`The "when" of arrow ${n} of Domain approval is not decided yet.`);
    for (const text of [...texts(goTo), ...texts(when)]) expect(text).not.toContain('…');
  });

  it('a typed-in choice question with no choices (E-32): named in quotes, with a fix that opens its choices', () => {
    const w = describeFinding(cr, { code: 'item.partMissing', severity: 'todo', location: loc('q_risk', 'choices'), params: {} }, env);
    expect(w.cause).toBe('The question "Risk" has no choices yet.');
    expect(w.effect).toBe('Nobody could answer it.');
    expect(w.fix).toEqual({ kind: 'show', location: loc('q_risk', 'choices'), label: 'Add its choices' });
  });

  it('parse.badFormat on a failure code not written as the catalogue writes codes (E-29)', () => {
    const w = describeFinding(ig, { code: 'parse.badFormat', location: loc('ar_dep_failed', 'when.condition.0.right'), params: { pointer: '/stages/2/arrows/0/when/condition/allOf/0/right/failureCode', format: 'failureCode' } }, env);
    expect(w.short).toBe('To do: choose again what went wrong');

  });

    const w = describeFinding(cr, finding('item.partMissing', { doc: cr, location: loc('ls_domains', 'rows'), params: {} }), env);

    expect(w.cause).toContain('Primary domain');

    expect(w.fix?.kind).not.toBe('show');
  });
});

/**
 * Every To do and Worth knowing item in words, made once here so the four screens that show them
 * (the line under a stage box, the strip at the top of the stage panel, the To do drawer, In words)
 * say the same thing. A finding (services `core.check`) is a code, a severity, a location and
 * params; `describeFinding` turns it into a short line, its cause in the author's words with the
 * things' current names, what would happen to a request, the one obvious fix where there is one,
 * and the place in words. `findingTone` says red (contradictory) or amber (unfinished), editor-model.md
 * section 7. Never an ID, never a code, never the engine's terms, never blame.
 * The words are in src/words/findings.ts.
 */
import type { Action, Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Expression, Location, ValueKind } from '@/contract';
import type { Finding, FindingCode, FindingParams, ParseProblem, ParseProblemCode } from '@/services';
import { t, words, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { find, getAction, getArrow, getQuestion, getStage, getTask, getWorkingStage, kindOfId, type Entry } from '../lookup';
import { fillSites } from '../walk';
import { describeExpression } from './expression';
import { fallbacksOf } from './value-card';
import { actionName } from './action';
import { arrowLabel, describeArrowWhen } from './arrow';
import { connectionLabel, entryOf, fieldLabel, triggerThing } from './catalogue';
import { describeCondition, describePressed, isOrGroup, joinGroups, taskNameOf } from './condition';
import { describeLocation, locationCrumbs, partSaidByItem } from './location';
import { describeNowhereToGo } from './negate';
import { deletedName, itemName } from './names';
import { hasMissing, joinEach, joinPhrases, lowerFirst, phrase, settingsLinked, toText, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';
import { describeWhoIsAsked } from './stage';
import { stuckToldText, type StuckPerson } from './stuck';

/** What describeFinding may use besides the document. */
export interface FindingEnv extends DescribeEnv {
  /**
   * The people in "Stuck requests go to", by name, a group marked: "Platform team, who look after
   * stuck requests, are told". Wins over `stuckRequestsGoTo`.
   */
  stuckPeople?: readonly StuckPerson[];
  /** The older form: one person's name ("Sam Carter"), read as one person. Use `stuckPeople`. */
  stuckRequestsGoTo?: string;
}

/** The people who look after stuck requests, from either form of the env. */
export function stuckPeopleOf(env: FindingEnv): readonly StuckPerson[] {
  if (env.stuckPeople) return env.stuckPeople;
  const name = env.stuckRequestsGoTo?.trim();
  return name ? [{ name }] : [];
}

/** Red: contradicts itself. Amber: not finished yet. Worth knowing: does not block publishing. */
export type FindingTone = 'contradictory' | 'unfinished' | 'worthKnowing';

/**
 * The one obvious fix of a finding, with what it needs; the screens decide how to carry it out
 * (each is one named command or opens the right picker). Absent where there is no single fix.
 */
export type FindingFix = { label: string } & (
  | { kind: 'chooseWhoIsAsked'; task: string }
  | { kind: 'chooseStage'; arrow: string }
  | { kind: 'addArrow'; stage: string; button?: string }
  | { kind: 'addOtherCasesArrow'; stage: string }
  | { kind: 'moveToBottom'; arrow: string }
  | { kind: 'moveAbove'; arrow: string; above: string }
  /** `use`: the fallback the value's other uses already have, offered by name; absent when there is none to offer. */
  | { kind: 'setIfEmptyUse'; item: string; part: string; use?: Expression }
  | { kind: 'chooseStatus'; stage: string }
  | { kind: 'fillAnswer'; binding: string; question: string }
  | { kind: 'carryOn'; action: string }
  | { kind: 'remove'; item: string; part?: string }
  | { kind: 'show'; location: Location }
);

export type FindingFixKind = FindingFix['kind'];

export interface FindingWords {
  /** For the line under a stage box, at most about 8 words: "To do: choose who is asked". */
  short: string;
  /** What is wrong, naming things by their current names. */
  cause: string;
  /** What would happen to a request. */
  effect?: string;
  /** `cause` as a phrase whose "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)" is the link part (`isSettingsLink`). */
  causeParts: Phrase;
  /** `effect` the same way. */
  effectParts?: Phrase;
  fix?: FindingFix;
  /** Other places worth seeing, each with its own "Show me" (the arrows that take the request first). */
  alsoShow?: { location: Location; label: string }[];
  /** The place, as a path: "Security review › Who is asked". */
  where: string;
  tone: FindingTone;
}

/**

/** Codes that are contradictions (red); every other To do is unfinished (amber). */
const CONTRADICTORY: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<FindingCode>([
  'item.brokenReference',
  'start.directoryInCondition',
  'feature.notInThisBuild',
  'clause.wordsDoNotFit',
  'clause.pressedOutsideStage',
