/**
 * In words (editor-model.md section 9): the whole workflow written out as numbered plain
 * paragraphs, read-only. One paragraph per stage in the order a request meets them (graph.ts),
 * the start stage first saying what the requester fills in and presses; each arrow as a sentence;
 * who is asked, with the sample in brackets when it comes from a list; actions folded in ("Reject
 * tells the requester and ends the request as Rejected"); what happens when an action fails and who
 * is told; endings last. A formula appears as its "Reads as" sentence. To do items from the check
 * appear inline where they belong.
 *
 * The result is structured (paragraphs, sentences, runs that know their place), never HTML; the
 * screen draws it and `inWordsText` makes the plain text for Copy. The words are in
 * src/words/inwords.ts; every part an existing describe function already says is said by it.
 */
import type { Action, Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow, Condition, Expression, Location, Stage, Task, UseConnection, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import type { Facts, Finding } from '@/services';
import { arrowsOutOf, isStartStage, orderFromStart } from '../graph';
import { find, getStage } from '../lookup';
import { arrowChoices } from './arrow-choices';
import { connectionLabel, entryOf } from './catalogue';
import { describeCondition, describePressed } from './condition';
import { describeConstant, describeExpression } from './expression';
import { describeFinding, findingTone, stuckPeopleOf, type FindingEnv, type FindingTone } from './finding';
import { describeIfItFails } from './failure';
import { withoutTrailingWait, actionName } from './action';
import { buttonChip, soundsPlural, stageChip, valueChip } from './names';
import { chip, isChip, isSettingsLink, joinEach, joinPhrases, lowerFirst, missing, phrase, toText, w, type Phrase, type Part } from './phrase';
import { describeStartsWhen } from './stage';
import { refersToGroup, subjectsOf, takesPlural } from './verb';

/** One run of text in a sentence. */
export interface InWordsRun {
  text: string;
  /** A stage or ending named in bold; it links to that stage on the Diagram tab. */
  stage?: string;
  /**
   * "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)", a link to Settings. In words' own sentences carry none
   * (editor-model.md section 11: in In words only stage names are links); a To do's words may.
   */
  settings?: boolean;
  /** "To do:", the lead words of a To do. */
  todoLead?: boolean;
  /** Something not filled in yet, or pointing at something deleted. */
  missing?: boolean;
}

export interface InWordsSentence {
  runs: InWordsRun[];
  /** The place the sentence is about: "Show me" for the whole sentence. */
  at: Location;
  /** Set on a To do from the check, shown inline in amber (or red) with "Fix this". */
  todo?: { finding: Finding; tone: FindingTone };
}

export interface InWordsParagraph {
  /** Stable key for lists. */
  key: string;
  /** A stage's paragraph, the arrows of a stage whose arrows need their own, the endings, or workflow-wide To do. */
  kind: 'stage' | 'arrows' | 'endings' | 'workflow';
  /** The stage the paragraph is about ("Change this on the diagram"); the first ending for the endings. */
  stageId?: string;
  at: Location;
  sentences: InWordsSentence[];
}

/** What In words may use besides the document. */
export interface InWordsEnv extends FindingEnv {
  /** The check's findings: To do items are written inline where they belong. */
  findings?: readonly Finding[];
  /** The engine's facts, for which arrows send a request back. Worked out from the arrows when absent. */
  facts?: Facts | null;
}

// ---- runs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function runsOf(said: Phrase): InWordsRun[] {
  const runs: InWordsRun[] = [];
  for (const part of said) {
    if (typeof part === 'string') {
      const last = runs[runs.length - 1];
      if (last && !last.stage && !last.settings && !last.todoLead && !last.missing) last.text += part;
      else runs.push({ text: part });
    } else if (isSettingsLink(part)) {
      runs.push({ text: part.text, settings: true });
    } else if (isChip(part)) {
      if (part.chip === 'stage' && part.id) runs.push(part.missing ? { text: part.label, missing: true } : { text: part.label, stage: part.id });
      else runs.push(part.missing ? { text: part.label, missing: true } : { text: part.label });
    } else runs.push({ text: part.text, missing: true });
  }
  return runs.filter((r) => r.text !== '');
}

const sentence = (said: Phrase, at: Location): InWordsSentence => ({ runs: runsOf(said), at });

/** The phrase with its first letter in capitals (the start of a sentence). */
function capital(said: Phrase): Phrase {
  const [first, ...rest] = said;
  if (first === undefined) return said;
  const up = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  if (typeof first === 'string') return [up(first), ...rest];
  if (isChip(first)) return [{ ...first, label: up(first.label) }, ...rest];
  return [{ ...first, text: up(first.text) }, ...rest];
}

/** The phrase as words in the middle of a sentence: its first letter in small letters. */
function lower(said: Phrase): Phrase {
  const [first, ...rest] = said;
  if (first === undefined) return said;
  if (typeof first === 'string') return [lowerFirst(first), ...rest];
  if (isChip(first)) return [{ ...first, label: lowerFirst(first.label) }, ...rest];
  return said;
}

/** "a Reason", "an Email"; a name that sounds plural ("Security notes") goes without. */
function withArticle(name: string): Phrase {
  if (soundsPlural(name)) return [name];
  return phrase(/^[aeiou]/i.test(name) ? 'inwords.an' : 'inwords.a', { name });
}

// ---- who is asked ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface Who {
  /** "the primary domain's approvers", "the Eng lead", "Security team", "the requester". */
  said: Phrase;
  plural: boolean;
  /** A group (or several people): "One answer is enough." */
  group: boolean;
  /** The sample's answer, when who is asked comes from a list. */
  sample?: string;
}

const has = (node: unknown, key: string): boolean => !!node && typeof node === 'object' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(node, key);

/** Who is asked, or who is told, as a person reads it in a sentence. Without "(if empty, use ...)". */
function whoOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expression: Expression, env: InWordsEnv): Who {
  const e = expression as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const steps = (e.steps as unknown[] | undefined) ?? [];
  // Whether "is asked" or "are asked" follows: the model's one rule (verb.ts).
  if (has(e, 'request') && steps.length === 0 && e.request === 'requester') {
    return { said: [w('inwords.requester')], plural: takesPlural(subjectsOf(doc, expression)), group: false };
  }
  if (has(e, 'value') && typeof e.value === 'string') {
    const said = describeExpression(doc, { ...(expression as object), ifEmptyUse: undefined } as Expression, env, { short: true });
    const label = toText(said);
    const named = steps.length > 0 ? lower(said) : said;
    return {
      said: phrase('inwords.the', { name: named }),
      plural: takesPlural(subjectsOf(doc, expression, label)),
      group: refersToGroup(doc, expression),
      sample: steps.length > 0 ? sampleOf(doc, expression) : undefined,
    };
  }
  if (has(e, 'group') || has(e, 'people')) {
    return { said: describeExpression(doc, expression, env), plural: takesPlural(subjectsOf(doc, expression)), group: true };
  }
  const said = describeExpression(doc, expression, env, { short: true });
  return { said, plural: takesPlural(subjectsOf(doc, expression, toText(said))), group: false };
}

/** The sample request's answer for a value read through list columns ("Payments approvers"). */
function sampleOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, expression: Expression): string | undefined {
  const ref = expression as { value?: string; steps?: Array<{ column?: string }> };
  if (!ref.value) return undefined;
  let answer = doc.sampleRequest?.answers?.[ref.value as keyof NonNullable<AuthoredWorkflow['sampleRequest']>['answers']];
  for (const step of ref.steps ?? []) {
    if (!answer || !step.column || !has(answer, 'row')) return undefined;
    const row = find(doc, (answer as { row: string }).row);
    if (row?.kind !== 'row') return undefined;
    answer = row.item.cells?.[step.column as keyof typeof row.item.cells];
  }
  if (!answer) return undefined;
  const text = toText(describeConstant(doc, answer));
  return text || undefined;
}

// ---- actions ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** A verb in the third person: "create" -> "creates", "push" -> "pushes", "apply" -> "applies". */
function thirdPerson(verb: string): string {
  const v = verb.toLowerCase();
  if (/(s|sh|ch|x|z|o)$/.test(v)) return `${v}es`;
  if (/[^aeiou]y$/.test(v)) return `${v.slice(0, -1)}ies`;
  return `${v}s`;
}

/**
 * A catalogue label as what the workflow does, with the connection after it: "Create a Jira issue"
 * in Jira gives "creates an issue"; "Look up a service" gives "looks up a service".
 */
function didWords(label: string, connection: string): string {
  const words = label.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const name = connection.trim().split(/\s+/).map((x) => x.toLowerCase());
  for (let i = 1; i + name.length <= words.length; i++) {
    if (name.every((x, j) => (words[i + j] ?? '').toLowerCase() === x)) {
      words.splice(i, name.length);
      break;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < words.length - 1; i++) {
    const next = words[i + 1] ?? '';
    if (words[i]?.toLowerCase() === 'a' && /^[aeiou]/i.test(next)) words[i] = 'an';
    if (words[i]?.toLowerCase() === 'an' && !/^[aeiou]/i.test(next)) words[i] = 'a';
  }
  const [verb = '', ...rest] = words;
  return [thirdPerson(verb), ...rest].join(' ');
}

/** What an action does, as words after "it": "tells the requester", "creates an issue in Jira". */
function actionDoes(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, action: Action, env: InWordsEnv, withOnlyWhen = true): Phrase {
  const does = actionDoesPlain(doc, action, env);
  if (!withOnlyWhen || !action.onlyWhen) return does;
  return phrase('inwords.does.onlyWhen', { does, condition: describeCondition(doc, action.onlyWhen, env) });
}

function actionDoesPlain(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, action: Action, env: InWordsEnv): Phrase {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'notify':
      return action.to ? phrase('inwords.does.notify', { who: whoOf(doc, action.to, env).said }) : [missing(w('inwords.does.unfinished'))];
    case 'saveValue':
      if (!action.save || !action.as) return lower(actionName(doc, action, env, true));
      return phrase('inwords.does.save', { what: describeExpression(doc, action.save, env, { short: true }), value: valueChip(doc, action.as) });
    case 'tellOtherSystems': {
      const told = action.tell ? find(doc, action.tell) : undefined;
      const thing = told?.kind === 'thingTold' && told.item.words?.trim() ? told.item.words : undefined;
      return thing ? phrase('inwords.does.tell', { thing }) : lower(actionName(doc, action, env));
    }
    case 'useConnection':
      return connectionDoes(doc, action, env);
    default:
      return [missing(w('inwords.does.unfinished'))];
  }
}

function connectionDoes(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, action: UseConnection, env: InWordsEnv): Phrase {
  const ref = action.operation;
  const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, ref);
  if (!ref || !entry || entry.kind !== 'operation' || !entry.label) return lower(actionName(doc, action, env));
  const name = connectionLabel(env.catalogue, entry, ref);
  const connection = chip('connection', name, entry.connection);
  if (entry.sort === 'await') {
    return phrase('inwords.does.await', { connection, what: lowerFirst(withoutTrailingWait(entry.label)) });
  }
  const label = entry.label.trim();
  const did = didWords(label, name);
  const said = label.toLowerCase().endsWith(` in ${name.toLowerCase()}`) ? [did] : phrase('inwords.does.connection', { did, connection });
  const saved = Object.values(action.saveResults ?? {}).filter(Boolean);
  if (entry.sort !== 'read' || saved.length === 0) return said;
  return phrase('inwords.does.saving', { did: said, values: joinPhrases(saved.map((v) => [valueChip(doc, v)]), 'and') });
}

function isAwait(action: Action, env: InWordsEnv): boolean {
  if (action.type !== 'useConnection') return false;
  const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, action.operation);
  return entry?.kind === 'operation' && entry.sort === 'await';
}

/**
 * The actions of a section, in order: "creates an issue in Jira and tells the Eng lead". After a
 * Wait for, what follows is said with "then", since it happens only once the other system answers.
 */
function joinActions(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, actions: Action[], env: InWordsEnv): Phrase {
  const groups: Action[][] = [[]];
  actions.forEach((action, i) => {
    (groups[groups.length - 1] as Action[]).push(action);
    if (isAwait(action, env) && i < actions.length - 1) groups.push([]);
  });
  const said = groups.map((g) => joinPhrases(g.map((a) => actionDoes(doc, a, env)), 'and'));
  return said.slice(1).reduce((all, next) => phrase('inwords.does.then', { first: all, next }), said[0] ?? []);
}

/**
 * What happens when each connection used here fails, in the words the action card uses
 * (`describeIfItFails`): "If Jira cannot be reached or its answer is unclear, Jira is asked again and
 * the request is not stuck. If Jira has not answered after 15 minutes, Sam Carter, who looks after
 * stuck requests, is told; the request is not stuck. If Jira says it failed, the request is stuck
 * here and Sam Carter is told." A Stop sentence is said once per connection in a section.
 */
function failures(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, actions: Action[], env: InWordsEnv): InWordsSentence[] {
  const out: InWordsSentence[] = [];
  const said = new Set<string>();
  const failEnv = { ...env, stuckPeople: stuckPeopleOf(env) };
  let named = false;
  for (const action of actions) {
    if (action.type !== 'useConnection' || !action.operation) continue;
    // The first mention here says who they are ("..., who look after stuck requests, are told"), later ones are short.
    const words = describeIfItFails(doc, action, failEnv, named ? { short: true } : {});
    if (words.stops) {
      const name = connectionLabel(env.catalogue, entryOf(env.catalogue, action.operation), action.operation);
      if (said.has(name)) continue;
      said.add(name);
    }
    named = named || !!words.slow || words.stops;
    out.push(sentence(words.sentence, { item: action.id, part: 'ifItFails' }));
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- arrows ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

type Ctx = { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; env: InWordsEnv; reached: Set<string> };

/** True when an arrow takes the request back to a stage every request has already passed through. */
function sendsBack(ctx: Ctx, from: Stage, arrow: Arrow): boolean {
  const fact = ctx.env.facts?.arrows?.[arrow.id as keyof Facts['arrows']];
  if (fact) return fact.sendsBack;
  const to = arrow.goTo;
  const doc = ctx.doc;
  if (!to || !getStage(doc, to) || getStage(doc, to)?.kind === 'ending') return false;
  if (to === from.id) return true;
  if (isStartStage(doc, to)) return ctx.reached.has(from.id);
  if (!ctx.reached.has(from.id)) return false;
  // `to` comes before `from` on every way from the start: without `to`, `from` cannot be reached.
  return !reachableAvoiding(doc, doc.start?.stage, to).has(from.id);
}

function reachableAvoiding(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, start: string | undefined, avoid: string | undefined): Set<string> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  if (!start || start === avoid) return seen;
  const queue = [start];
  seen.add(start);
  while (queue.length) {
    const id = queue.shift() as string;
    for (const arrow of arrowsOutOf(doc, id)) {
      const next = arrow.goTo;
      if (next && next !== avoid && !seen.has(next) && getStage(doc, next)) {
        seen.add(next);
        queue.push(next);
      }
    }
  }
  return seen;
}

/** True when another arrow of the stage also leads, later, to where this one goes: it goes "straight" there. */
function goesStraight(ctx: Ctx, stage: WorkingStage, arrow: Arrow): boolean {
  if (!arrow.goTo) return false;
  return stage.arrows.some((other) => other !== arrow && other.goTo && other.goTo !== arrow.goTo && reachableAvoiding(ctx.doc, other.goTo, stage.id).has(arrow.goTo as string));
}

type Subject = 'button' | 'request';

/** What the arrow does after its subject: "goes to X", "ends the request as X", "sends it back to X". */
function result(ctx: Ctx, stage: WorkingStage, arrow: Arrow, subject: Subject, straight = false): Phrase {
  const keys =
    subject === 'button'
      ? { go: 'inwords.does.goTo', straight: 'inwords.does.goTo', end: 'inwords.does.end', back: 'inwords.does.back', nowhere: 'inwords.does.nowhere' }
      : { go: 'inwords.moves.goTo', straight: 'inwords.moves.straight', end: 'inwords.moves.end', back: 'inwords.moves.back', nowhere: 'inwords.moves.nowhere' };
  if (!arrow.goTo) return [missing(w(keys.nowhere as 'inwords.does.nowhere'))];
  const target = getStage(ctx.doc, arrow.goTo);
  const s = stageChip(ctx.doc, arrow.goTo);
  if (target?.kind === 'ending') return phrase(keys.end as 'inwords.does.end', { stage: s });
  if (target && sendsBack(ctx, stage, arrow)) return phrase(keys.back as 'inwords.does.back', { stage: s });
  if (straight && target && goesStraight(ctx, stage, arrow)) return phrase(keys.straight as 'inwords.moves.straight', { stage: s });
  return phrase(keys.go as 'inwords.does.goTo', { stage: s });
}

/**
 * A condition arrow's "when", as read in a sentence. The author's "Words on the arrow" are used
 * when they say the same thing with a shorter subject ("Domain needs no approval" for "Primary
 * domain needs no approval"), read as "the domain needs no approval"; otherwise the condition's own
 * sentence. Then the list choices that take the arrow, in brackets: "(Internal tools)".
 */
function conditionWords(ctx: Ctx, arrow: Arrow): Phrase {
  const condition = arrow.when.type === 'condition' ? arrow.when.condition : undefined;
  const described = describeCondition(ctx.doc, condition, ctx.env);
  let said = described;
  const words = arrow.words?.trim();
  if (words) {
    const rest = words.split(/\s+/).slice(1);
    const plain = toText(described).toLowerCase();
    if (rest.length >= 2 && plain.endsWith(` ${rest.join(' ').toLowerCase()}`)) said = phrase('inwords.the', { name: lowerFirst(words) });
  }
  const choices = arrowChoices(ctx.doc, arrow);
  if (!choices?.length) return said;
  return phrase('inwords.choices', { condition: said, choices: joinPhrases(choices.map((c) => [c]), 'or') });
}

/** The single pressed button an action's "only when" waits for, if that is all it says. */
function onlyWhenPressed(action: Action): string | undefined {
  const c = action.onlyWhen as { allOf?: unknown[]; anyOf?: unknown[] } | undefined;
  const clauses = c?.allOf ?? c?.anyOf;
  if (!clauses || clauses.length !== 1) return undefined;
  const first = clauses[0] as { pressed?: string } | undefined;
  return first?.pressed ?? undefined;
}

/** True when each arrow is a plain button arrow of the one task, one per button: they read as "Approve goes to ...". */
function plainButtonArrows(stage: WorkingStage): boolean {
  if (stage.tasks.length !== 1) return false;
  const buttons = new Set((stage.tasks[0]?.buttons ?? []).map((b) => b.id));
  const used = new Set<string>();
  for (const arrow of stage.arrows) {
    if (arrow.when?.type !== 'buttonPressed' || arrow.onlyWhen || !arrow.when.button) return false;
    if (!buttons.has(arrow.when.button) || used.has(arrow.when.button)) return false;
    used.add(arrow.when.button);
  }
  return true;
}

/** The arrows as sentences, each with its place. Actions kept to one button are folded into that button's sentence. */
function arrowSentences(ctx: Ctx, stage: WorkingStage, folded: Map<string, Action[]>): InWordsSentence[] {
  const { doc, env } = ctx;
  const out: InWordsSentence[] = [];
  const narrowed = new Set<string>();
  const foldedDone = new Set<string>();
  stage.arrows.forEach((arrow, index) => {
    const at: Location = { item: arrow.id };
    const when = arrow.when;
    let said: Phrase;
    switch (when?.type) {
      case 'condition':
        said = phrase('inwords.arrow.if', { condition: conditionWords(ctx, arrow), moves: result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'request', true) });
        break;
      case 'buttonPressed': {
        const pressed = describePressed(doc, when.button);
        if (arrow.onlyWhen) {
          if (when.button) narrowed.add(when.button);
          const condition = joinEach([pressed, describeCondition(doc, arrow.onlyWhen, env)], 'and');
          said = phrase('inwords.arrow.ifPressed', { condition, does: result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'button') });
        } else {
          const actions = when.button && !foldedDone.has(when.button) ? (folded.get(when.button) ?? []) : [];
          if (when.button) foldedDone.add(when.button);
          const does = joinPhrases([...actions.map((a) => actionDoes(doc, a, env, false)), result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'button')], 'and');
          const key = when.button && narrowed.has(when.button) ? 'inwords.arrow.anyOtherTime' : 'inwords.arrow.whenPressed';
          said = phrase(key, { condition: pressed, does });
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'inAllOtherCases':
        said = phrase('inwords.arrow.otherCases', { moves: result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'request') });
        break;
      case 'whenDone': {
        const others = stage.arrows.slice(0, index).some((a) => a.when?.type === 'condition' || a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed');
        said = phrase(others ? 'inwords.arrow.otherCases' : 'inwords.arrow.whenDone', { moves: result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'request') });
        break;
      }
      default:
        said = phrase('inwords.arrow.unfinished', { moves: result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'request') });
    }
    out.push(sentence(said, at));
    if (arrow.goAsSoonAsTrue) out.push(sentence([w('inwords.arrow.asSoonAsTrue')], { item: arrow.id, part: 'goAsSoonAsTrue' }));
  });
  return out;
}

// ---- tasks -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const PICKED = new Set(['choice', 'multipleChoice', 'person', 'group']);

function questionsOf(task: Task) {
  return (task.form?.pages ?? []).flatMap((p) => (p.items ?? []).filter((i) => i.type === 'question'));
}

const labelOf = (label: string | undefined): Part => (label?.trim() ? label : missing(w('describe.noName')));

/** A label written as a question or a sentence ("Which laptop?"), which reads only when quoted in a list. */
const isSentenceLabel = (label: string | undefined): boolean => /[?!.:]$/.test(label?.trim() ?? '');

/** A question's label in a list: as written ("Title"), quoted when it is itself a question ('"Which laptop?"'). */
const questionLabel = (label: string | undefined): Phrase =>
  isSentenceLabel(label) ? phrase('describe.question.quoted', { label: (label as string).trim() }) : [labelOf(label)];

/** The "Show when" a question is asked under: its own, else its page's. */
function shownWhen(task: Task, questionId: string): Condition | undefined {
  for (const page of task.form?.pages ?? []) {
    const q = (page.items ?? []).find((i) => i.type === 'question' && i.id === questionId);
    if (q) return (q.type === 'question' ? q.showWhen : undefined) ?? page.showWhen;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** A question named in a sentence, with when it is asked if only sometimes: '"Which model exactly?" (only when Which laptop? is Other)'. */
function askedQuestion(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, q: { id: string; label?: string }, said: Phrase, env: InWordsEnv): Phrase {
  const when = shownWhen(task, q.id);
  return when ? phrase('describe.question.onlyWhen', { question: said, condition: describeCondition(doc, when, env) }) : said;
}

/** "They pick the Eng lead and can give a Reason." */
function questionsSentence(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, env: InWordsEnv): Phrase | undefined {
  const questions = questionsOf(task);
  if (questions.length === 0) return undefined;
  const picked = questions.filter((q) => PICKED.has(q.kind));
  // A Yes/No question is said, never given: "say whether Rollback tested" (and what it is needed to press).
  const whether = questions.filter((q) => q.kind === 'yesNo');
  const given = questions.filter((q) => !PICKED.has(q.kind) && q.kind !== 'yesNo');
  const parts: Phrase[] = [];
  const pickedSaid = (q: (typeof questions)[number]) => (isSentenceLabel(q.label) ? questionLabel(q.label) : phrase('inwords.the', { name: labelOf(q.label) }));
  const givenSaid = (q: (typeof questions)[number]) => (isSentenceLabel(q.label) ? questionLabel(q.label) : q.label?.trim() ? withArticle(q.label) : [labelOf(q.label)]);
  if (picked.length) parts.push(phrase('inwords.pick', { names: joinPhrases(picked.map((q) => askedQuestion(doc, task, q, pickedSaid(q), env)), 'and') }));
  if (whether.length) {
    const whetherSaid = (q: (typeof questions)[number]): Phrase => {
      const name = isSentenceLabel(q.label) ? questionLabel(q.label) : [labelOf(q.label)];
      const needs = task.buttons.filter((b) => q.neededForEveryButton || (b.neededToPress ?? []).includes(q.id));
      return needs.length ? phrase('inwords.neededToPress', { question: name, buttons: joinPhrases(needs.map((b) => [buttonChip(doc, b.id)]), 'and') }) : name;
    };
    parts.push(phrase('inwords.sayWhether', { names: joinPhrases(whether.map((q) => askedQuestion(doc, task, q, whetherSaid(q), env)), 'and') }));
  }
  if (given.length) parts.push(phrase('inwords.give', { names: joinPhrases(given.map((q) => askedQuestion(doc, task, q, givenSaid(q), env)), 'and') }));
  return phrase('inwords.questions', { parts: joinPhrases(parts, 'and') });
}

const buttonsOr = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task): Phrase => joinPhrases(task.buttons.map((b) => [buttonChip(doc, b.id)]), 'or');

/** "If there is no Eng lead, Primary domain's default lead is asked." */
function fallbackSentence(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, env: InWordsEnv): InWordsSentence | undefined {
  const who = task.whoIsAsked as { ifEmptyUse?: Expression } | undefined;
  if (!who?.ifEmptyUse || !task.whoIsAsked) return undefined;
  const main = describeExpression(doc, { ...(task.whoIsAsked as object), ifEmptyUse: undefined } as Expression, env, { short: true });
  const named = has(task.whoIsAsked, 'request') ? [lowerFirst(toText(main))] : main;
  const fallback = whoOf(doc, who.ifEmptyUse, env);
  const key = fallback.plural ? 'inwords.ifNobody.many' : 'inwords.ifNobody.one';
  return sentence(phrase(key, { main: named, fallback: describeExpression(doc, who.ifEmptyUse, env) }), {
    item: task.id,
    part: 'whoIsAsked.ifEmptyUse',
  });
}

// ---- paragraphs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function stageParagraphs(ctx: Ctx, stage: WorkingStage): InWordsParagraph[] {
  const { doc, env } = ctx;
  const start = isStartStage(doc, stage.id);
  const name = stageChip(doc, stage.id);
  const sentences: InWordsSentence[] = [];
  const stageAt: Location = { item: stage.id };
  const tasks = stage.tasks ?? [];
  const plain = plainButtonArrows(stage);

  // Actions after they respond that only happen for one button are told with that button.
  const folded = new Map<string, Action[]>();
  const after: Action[] = [];
  for (const action of stage.afterTheyRespond ?? []) {
    const button = tasks.length === 1 ? onlyWhenPressed(action) : undefined;
    const arrow = button ? stage.arrows.find((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === button && !a.onlyWhen) : undefined;
    if (button && arrow) folded.set(button, [...(folded.get(button) ?? []), action]);
    else after.push(action);
  }

  const doesList = (actions: Action[]) => joinActions(doc, actions, env);
  const separateArrows = tasks.length > 0 && !plain;

  if (tasks.length === 0) {
    // Automatic (or a stage with nothing asked): "<Stage> happens by itself: it ..."
    const actions = stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? [];
    if (actions.length) sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.auto', { stage: name, actions: doesList(actions) }), stageAt));
    else if (stage.kind === 'automatic') sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.auto.nothing', { stage: name }), stageAt));
    else sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.heading', { stage: name }), stageAt));
    if (!ctx.reached.has(stage.id) && !start) sentences.push(sentence([w('inwords.unreached')], stageAt));
    sentences.push(...failures(doc, actions, env));
    if (after.length) sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.after', { actions: doesList(after) }), { item: stage.id, part: 'afterTheyRespond' }));
    sentences.push(...failures(doc, after, env));
    sentences.push(...arrowSentences(ctx, stage, folded));
    return [{ key: stage.id, kind: 'stage', stageId: stage.id, at: stageAt, sentences }];
  }

  sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.heading', { stage: name }), stageAt));
  if (!ctx.reached.has(stage.id) && !start) sentences.push(sentence([w('inwords.unreached')], stageAt));

  const before = stage.whenThisStageStarts ?? [];
  if (before.length) {
    sentences.push(sentence(phrase(start ? 'inwords.start.sentBack' : 'inwords.before', { actions: doesList(before) }), { item: stage.id, part: 'whenThisStageStarts' }));
    sentences.push(...failures(doc, before, env));
  }

  if (tasks.length > 1) sentences.push(sentence([w('inwords.several')], { item: stage.id, part: 'tasks' }));

  const fallbacks: InWordsSentence[] = [];
  let toldWithWhich = false;
  for (const task of tasks) {
    const taskAt: Location = { item: task.id, part: 'whoIsAsked' };
    const single = tasks.length === 1;
    // One button with one plain arrow: "... and press Mark released, which ends the request as Released."
    const onlyButton = single && plain && task.buttons.length === 1 ? task.buttons[0] : undefined;
    const onlyArrow = onlyButton ? stage.arrows.find((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === onlyButton.id) : undefined;
    const then = (): Phrase => {
      if (!onlyButton || !onlyArrow) return [];
      toldWithWhich = true;
      const actions = folded.get(onlyButton.id) ?? [];
      return phrase('inwords.which', { does: joinPhrases([...actions.map((a) => actionDoes(doc, a, env, false)), result(ctx, stage, onlyArrow, 'button')], 'and') });
    };

    if (start && single) {
      const questions = questionsOf(task).map((q) => askedQuestion(doc, task, q, questionLabel(q.label), env));
      const buttons = buttonsOr(doc, task);
      const key = questions.length && task.buttons.length ? 'inwords.start.fillsIn' : questions.length ? 'inwords.start.fillsInOnly' : 'inwords.start.presses';
      if (questions.length || task.buttons.length) {
        sentences.push(sentence(phrase(key, { questions: joinPhrases(questions, 'and'), buttons, then: then() }), { item: task.id }));
      }
      // "A request also starts when Helpdesk: a ticket is created, only when ..." (editor-model.md section 10)
      for (const binding of doc.start?.startsWhen ?? []) {
        const said = lower(describeStartsWhen(doc, { ...binding, requester: undefined }, env));
        sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.start.also', { startsWhen: said }), { item: binding.id }));
        if (binding.requester) {
          const requester = describeExpression(doc, binding.requester, { ...env, trigger: binding.trigger });
          sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.start.requester', { requester }), { item: binding.id, part: 'requester' }));
        }
      }
    } else {
      const who = task.whoIsAsked ? whoOf(doc, task.whoIsAsked, env) : undefined;
      if (who) {
        const sample = who.sample ? phrase('inwords.sample', { sample: who.sample }) : [];
        if (stage.kind === 'work' && single) {
          const key = task.buttons.length
            ? who.plural ? 'inwords.work.many' : 'inwords.work.one'
            : who.plural ? 'inwords.work.noButton.many' : 'inwords.work.noButton.one';
          sentences.push(sentence(phrase(key, { who: capital(who.said), buttons: buttonsOr(doc, task), then: then() }), taskAt));
        } else {
          sentences.push(sentence(phrase(who.plural ? 'inwords.asked.many' : 'inwords.asked.one', { who: capital(who.said), sample }), taskAt));
        }
        if (who.group) sentences.push(sentence([w('inwords.oneAnswer')], taskAt));
      }
      if (!(stage.kind === 'work' && single)) {
        const questions = questionsSentence(doc, task, env);
        if (questions) sentences.push(sentence(questions, { item: task.id }));
      }
    }
    const fallback = start ? undefined : fallbackSentence(doc, task, env);
    if (fallback) fallbacks.push(fallback);
  }

  if (tasks.length > 1) sentences.push(sentence([w('inwords.several.checked')], { item: stage.id, part: 'arrows' }));
  if (after.length) {
    sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.after', { actions: doesList(after) }), { item: stage.id, part: 'afterTheyRespond' }));
  }
  sentences.push(...failures(doc, stage.afterTheyRespond ?? [], env));

  // Plain button arrows read in the stage's own paragraph: "Approve goes to Create Jira issue."
  if (plain && !toldWithWhich) {
    const task = tasks[0] as Task;
    for (const button of task.buttons) {
      const arrow = stage.arrows.find((a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === button.id);
      if (!arrow) continue;
      const actions = folded.get(button.id) ?? [];
      const does = joinPhrases([...actions.map((a) => actionDoes(doc, a, env, false)), result(ctx, stage, arrow, 'button')], 'and');
      sentences.push(sentence(phrase('inwords.button', { button: buttonChip(doc, button.id), does }), { item: arrow.id }));
    }
  }
  // (A work or start stage's lone button is said with "which" in its first sentence.)
  sentences.push(...fallbacks);

  const paragraphs: InWordsParagraph[] = [{ key: stage.id, kind: 'stage', stageId: stage.id, at: stageAt, sentences }];
  if (separateArrows && stage.arrows.length) {
    paragraphs.push({
      key: `${stage.id}:arrows`,
      kind: 'arrows',
      stageId: stage.id,
      at: { item: stage.id, part: 'arrows' },
      sentences: arrowSentences(ctx, stage, folded),
    });
  }
  return paragraphs;
}

function endingsParagraph(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, endings: Stage[]): InWordsParagraph | undefined {
  const first = endings[0];
  if (!first) return undefined;
  const names = joinPhrases(endings.map((e) => [stageChip(doc, e.id)]), 'or');
  const said = phrase(endings.length === 1 ? 'inwords.endings.one' : 'inwords.endings.many', { endings: names });
  return { key: 'endings', kind: 'endings', stageId: first.id, at: { item: first.id }, sentences: [sentence(said, { item: first.id })] };
}

// ---- To do, inline ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function todoSentence(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, finding: Finding, env: InWordsEnv): InWordsSentence {
  const words = describeFinding(doc, finding, env);
  const at = finding.location ?? { item: doc.id };
  return {
    runs: [{ text: w('inwords.todo'), todoLead: true }, { text: ` ${lowerFirst(words.cause)}` }],
    at,
    todo: { finding, tone: findingTone(finding) },
  };
}

/** The items a finding's place sits inside, innermost first: the item, its task, its stage. */
function placesOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, item: string): string[] {
  const entry = find(doc, item);
  if (!entry) return [item];
  const out = [item];
  if (entry.parents.task) out.push(entry.parents.task);
  if (entry.parents.stage) out.push(entry.parents.stage);
  return out;
}

function placeTodos(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, paragraphs: InWordsParagraph[], env: InWordsEnv): InWordsParagraph[] {
  const todos = (env.findings ?? []).filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo');
  if (todos.length === 0) return paragraphs;
  const workflowWide: InWordsSentence[] = [];
  for (const finding of todos) {
    const said = todoSentence(doc, finding, env);
    const places = placesOf(doc, finding.location?.item ?? doc.id);
    const stageId = places[places.length - 1];
    const stageParas = paragraphs.filter((p) => p.stageId === stageId && p.kind !== 'endings');
    if (stageParas.length === 0) {
      const ending = paragraphs.find((p) => p.kind === 'endings' && p.sentences.some((s) => s.runs.some((r) => r.stage === stageId)));
      if (ending) ending.sentences.push(said);
      else workflowWide.push(said);
      continue;
    }
    let placed = false;
    // The last sentence about the item itself, then about its task; else just after the stage's name.
    for (const place of places.slice(0, -1)) {
      for (const p of stageParas) {
        const at = p.sentences.map((s) => s.at.item).lastIndexOf(place);
        if (at >= 0 && !placed) {
          let after = at;
          while (p.sentences[after + 1]?.todo) after++;
          p.sentences.splice(after + 1, 0, said);
          placed = true;
        }
      }
      if (placed) break;
    }
    if (!placed) {
      const p = stageParas[0] as InWordsParagraph;
      let after = 0;
      while (p.sentences[after + 1]?.todo) after++;
      p.sentences.splice(Math.min(after + 1, p.sentences.length), 0, said);
    }
  }
  if (workflowWide.length) {
    paragraphs.unshift({ key: 'workflow', kind: 'workflow', at: { item: doc.id }, sentences: [sentence([w('inwords.workflowTodo')], { item: doc.id }), ...workflowWide] });
  }
  return paragraphs;
}

// ---- the whole workflow ----------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * The stages in the order a request meets them, for reading: a stage comes after every stage that
 * leads to it (arrows that go back are left out), ties broken by graph.ts's order from the start, so
 * the demo reads Request form, Domain approval, Create Jira issue, Development (orderFromStart alone
 * puts Create Jira issue before Domain approval, as the start's first arrow goes there). Stages no
 * arrow reaches follow; endings last, in the order the author keeps them.
 */
export function inWordsOrder(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): string[] {
  const bfs = orderFromStart(doc);
  const rank = new Map(bfs.map((id, i) => [id as string, i]));
  const start = doc.start?.stage;
  const reached = reachableAvoiding(doc, start, undefined);
  // Arrows that go back to a stage still being followed are left out (depth first from the start).
  const back = new Set<string>();
  const onPath = new Set<string>();
  const done = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (id: string) => {
    onPath.add(id);
    for (const arrow of arrowsOutOf(doc, id)) {
      const to = arrow.goTo;
      if (!to || !reached.has(to)) continue;
      if (onPath.has(to)) back.add(arrow.id);
      else if (!done.has(to)) visit(to);
    }
    onPath.delete(id);
    done.add(id);
  };
  if (start && reached.has(start)) visit(start);
  const into = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const id of reached) {
    for (const arrow of arrowsOutOf(doc, id)) {
      if (arrow.goTo && reached.has(arrow.goTo) && !back.has(arrow.id)) into.set(arrow.goTo, (into.get(arrow.goTo) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  }
  const order: string[] = [];
  const ready = [...reached].filter((id) => !into.get(id));
  while (ready.length) {
    ready.sort((a, b) => (rank.get(a) ?? 0) - (rank.get(b) ?? 0));
    const id = ready.shift() as string;
    order.push(id);
    for (const arrow of arrowsOutOf(doc, id)) {
      const to = arrow.goTo;
      if (!to || !reached.has(to) || back.has(arrow.id)) continue;
      const left = (into.get(to) ?? 0) - 1;
      into.set(to, left);
      if (left === 0) ready.push(to);
    }
  }
  const isEnding = (id: string) => getStage(doc, id)?.kind === 'ending';
  const working = [...order, ...bfs.filter((id) => !reached.has(id))].filter((id) => !isEnding(id));
  const endings = (doc.stages ?? []).filter((s) => s.kind === 'ending').map((s) => s.id as string);
  return [...working, ...endings];
}

/** The whole workflow as numbered plain paragraphs, in the order a request meets the stages. */
export function describeInWords(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, env: InWordsEnv = {}): InWordsParagraph[] {
  const order = inWordsOrder(doc);
  const ctx: Ctx = { doc, env, reached: reachableAvoiding(doc, doc.start?.stage, undefined) };
  const paragraphs: InWordsParagraph[] = [];
  const endings: Stage[] = [];
  for (const id of order) {
    const stage = getStage(doc, id);
    if (!stage) continue;
    if (stage.kind === 'ending') endings.push(stage);
    else paragraphs.push(...stageParagraphs(ctx, stage));
  }
  const last = endingsParagraph(doc, endings);
  if (last) paragraphs.push(last);
  return placeTodos(doc, paragraphs.map(tidyParagraph), env);
}

function tidyParagraph(p: InWordsParagraph): InWordsParagraph {
  return { ...p, sentences: p.sentences.filter((s) => s.runs.length > 0) };
}

/** One sentence as plain text. */
export const sentenceText = (s: InWordsSentence): string => s.runs.map((r) => r.text).join('');

/** One paragraph as plain text, its sentences joined by a space. */
export const paragraphText = (p: InWordsParagraph): string => p.sentences.map(sentenceText).join(' ');

/** The paragraphs as plain text for Copy: "1. Request form. The requester ...", a blank line between paragraphs. */
export function inWordsText(paragraphs: readonly InWordsParagraph[], title?: string): string {
  const body = paragraphs.map((p, i) => `${i + 1}. ${paragraphText(p)}`).join('\n\n');
  return title ? `${title}\n\n${body}\n` : `${body}\n`;
}

        }
      }
    }

===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/location.ts\n===
/**
 * A place in the document (authored-format.ts, Location) as a path a person can follow, for To do
 * items and history: "Domain approval › Reject › Needed to press". Item first (its stage, its task
 * when the stage asks several, the item's name), then the part in the panel's own words.
 */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import { words, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { find, getStage, getTask, nameOf, type Entry } from '../lookup';
import { actionName } from './action';
import { arrowLabel } from './arrow';
import { connectionLabel, entryOf, fieldLabel } from './catalogue';
import { taskNameOf } from './condition';
import { rowChip } from './expression';
import { deletedName, itemName, stageHasSeveralTasks } from './names';
import { phrase, toText, w, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';
import { describeStartsWhenName } from './stage';

/** The path to a location, its steps joined by " › ". */
export function describeLocation(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  return [locationCrumbs(doc, location, env).join(w('describe.where.separator'))];
}

/** The same path as separate steps. */
export function locationCrumbs(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location, env: DescribeEnv = {}): string[] {
  const entry = find(doc, location.item);
  const hasPart = !!location.part;
  const item = entry ? itemCrumbs(doc, entry, env, hasPart) : [deletedName(doc, location.item)];
  const part = hasPart ? partCrumbs(doc, entry, location.part as string, env) : [];
  // A step that only repeats the one before says nothing ("Create Jira issue › Create Jira issue").
  return [...item, ...part].filter((c, i, all) => c !== '' && (i === 0 || c.toLowerCase() !== all[i - 1]?.toLowerCase()));
}

const stageName = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string | undefined) => (id ? itemName(doc, id) : '');

function taskCrumbs(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, taskId: string | undefined, stageId: string | undefined): string[] {
  const task = getTask(doc, taskId);
  const several = !!task && stageHasSeveralTasks(doc, task.id);
  return [stageName(doc, stageId), ...(several && task ? [taskNameOf(doc, task)] : [])];
}

function itemCrumbs(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, entry: Entry, env: DescribeEnv, hasPart: boolean): string[] {
  const p = entry.parents;
  const name = nameOf(entry) || w('describe.noName');
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'workflow':
      return hasPart ? [] : [w('describe.where.workflow')];
    case 'stage':
      return [name];
    case 'task': {
      const crumbs = taskCrumbs(doc, entry.id, p.stage);
      return crumbs.length === 1 && !hasPart ? [...crumbs, w('describe.part.tasks')] : crumbs;
    }
    case 'page': {
      const task = getTask(doc, p.task);
      const n = (task?.form?.pages ?? []).findIndex((pg) => pg.id === entry.id) + 1;
      return [...taskCrumbs(doc, p.task, p.stage), entry.item.title || toText(phrase('describe.where.page', { n: String(n) }))];
    }
    case 'question':
    case 'button':
      return [...taskCrumbs(doc, p.task, p.stage), name];
    case 'text':
      return [...taskCrumbs(doc, p.task, p.stage), w('describe.where.text')];
    case 'choice':
      return [...taskCrumbs(doc, p.task, p.stage), itemName(doc, p.question ?? ''), name];
    case 'action':
      return [stageName(doc, p.stage), toText(actionName(doc, entry.item as Action, env, true))];
    case 'arrow': {
      // An arrow with no words yet is named by its place ("Arrow 3"), never "…".
      const label = arrowLabel(doc, entry.item);
      const n = (doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === p.stage) as { arrows?: { id: string }[] } | undefined)?.arrows?.findIndex((a) => a.id === entry.id) ?? -1;
      return [stageName(doc, p.stage), w('describe.part.arrows'), label === w('describe.gap') && n >= 0 ? w('describe.where.arrowN').replace('{n}', String(n + 1)) : label];
    }
    case 'value':
      return [w('describe.where.values'), name];
    case 'status':
      return [w('describe.where.statuses'), name];
    case 'thingTold':
      return [w('describe.where.told'), name];
    case 'list':
      return [name];
    case 'column':
      return [itemName(doc, p.list ?? ''), name];
    case 'row':
      return [itemName(doc, p.list ?? ''), rowChip(doc, entry.id).label];
    case 'startsWhen': {
      const start = getStage(doc, doc.start?.stage);
      return [start?.name ?? '', toText(describeStartsWhenName(entry.item, env))];
    }
    default:
      return [name];
  }
}

const partWord = (segment: string): string | undefined => {
  const key = `describe.part.${segment}`;
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(words, key) ? words[key as WordKey] : undefined;
};

/**
 * A field key under inputs / saveResults: the catalogue's label for it and the connection it
 * belongs to ("Assignee", "Jira") when known. The connection's own names are always said with it
 * (editor-model.md section 1): as an "In Jira" step here, or "In Jira this is called Assignee".
 */
export function connectionField(entry: Entry | undefined, group: string, key: string, env: DescribeEnv): { label: string; connection?: string } {
  if (entry?.kind === 'action' && entry.item.type === 'useConnection') {
    const op = entryOf(env.catalogue, entry.item.operation);
    if (op?.kind === 'operation') {
      const label = fieldLabel(group === 'saveResults' ? op.result : op.input, key);
      if (label) return { label, connection: connectionLabel(env.catalogue, op, op.id) };
    }
  }
  if (entry?.kind === 'question' && entry.item.choices?.from === 'source') {
    const source = entryOf(env.catalogue, entry.item.choices.source);
    if (source?.kind === 'dataSource') {
      const label = fieldLabel(source.input, key);
      if (label) return { label, connection: connectionLabel(env.catalogue, source, source.id) };
    }
  }
  return { label: key };
}

/** "In Jira › Assignee" for a connection's own field; the key alone when the catalogue lacks it. */
function fieldCrumbs(entry: Entry | undefined, group: string, key: string, env: DescribeEnv): string[] {
  const field = connectionField(entry, group, key, env);
  return field.connection ? [toText(phrase('describe.where.inConnection', { connection: field.connection })), field.label] : [field.label];
}

/**
 * Parts that the item's own steps already say, so they add nothing a person could follow: an
 * arrow's "When" and "Go to" (its label is its When; "Then go to" is where it goes), a text's
 * "Text", a Notify's "Notify" (its name says whom).
 */
export function partSaidByItem(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, location: Location): boolean {
  return !!location.part && saidByItem(find(doc, location.item), location.part.split('.')[0] ?? '');
}

function saidByItem(entry: Entry | undefined, head: string): boolean {
  switch (entry?.kind) {
    case 'arrow':
      return head === 'when' || head === 'goTo';
    case 'text':
      return head === 'content';
    case 'action':
      return entry.item.type === 'notify' && head === 'to';
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

function partCrumbs(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, entry: Entry | undefined, part: string, env: DescribeEnv): string[] {
  const [head = '', ...rest] = part.split('.');
  const tail = rest.join('.');
  if (saidByItem(entry, head)) return [];
  switch (head) {
    case 'sampleRequest':
      return [w('describe.where.sample'), ...(rest[1] ? [itemName(doc, rest[1])] : [])];
    case 'diagram':
      return [w('describe.where.diagram'), ...(rest[1] ? [itemName(doc, rest[1])] : [])];
    case 'start':
      return [w('describe.where.start')];
    case 'cells':
      return tail ? [itemName(doc, tail)] : [];
    case 'answers':
      return [w('describe.part.answers'), ...(tail ? [itemName(doc, tail)] : [])];
    case 'inputs': {
      // What is sent to a connection is said under its own name: "In Jira › Assignee", not "Send › Assignee".
      const crumbs = tail ? fieldCrumbs(entry, head, tail, env) : [];
      return crumbs.length > 1 ? crumbs : [partWord(head) ?? head, ...crumbs];
    }
    case 'saveResults':
    case 'values':
      return [partWord(head) ?? head, ...(tail ? fieldCrumbs(entry, head, tail, env) : [])];
    case 'choices':
      if (rest[0] === 'inputs') return [w('describe.part.choices'), ...(rest[1] ? fieldCrumbs(entry, 'inputs', rest.slice(1).join('.'), env) : [])];
      return [w('describe.part.choices'), ...subPart('choices', rest)];
    case 'saveFailureAs':
      return [w('describe.part.saveFailureAs'), ...subPart('saveFailureAs', rest)];
    case 'when':
      // An arrow's sentence is its "When" itself; its button is the button the "When" names.
      if (rest[0] === 'condition') return [w('describe.part.when'), ...rest.slice(1).map(segment)];
      return [w('describe.part.when'), ...subPart('when', rest)];
    case 'words':
      return [entry?.kind === 'arrow' ? w('describe.part.words') : w('describe.part.wordsPlain')];
    default:
      return [partWord(head) ?? head, ...rest.map(segment)];
  }
}

/** The words for `<head>.<sub>` ("Choices › From a list"), then any deeper segments. */
function subPart(head: string, rest: string[]): string[] {
  const [sub, ...deeper] = rest;
  if (!sub) return [];
  const word = partWord(`${head}.${sub}`);
  return word ? [word, ...deeper.map(segment)] : rest.map(segment);
}

/**
 * A later part segment as a word. A clause or template index ("part 3") is left out: the panel
 * shows the whole sentence, never numbered parts, so the number means nothing to an author.
 */
function segment(s: string): string {
  if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) return '';
  return partWord(s) ?? s;
}

/**
 * The names of things as chips: stages, buttons, values, statuses, lists, and a task's display
 * name. A reference to something deleted reads "<old name> (deleted)" from `removedNames`, flagged
 * missing; an empty name reads "(no name yet)", flagged missing.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Task } from '@/contract';
import { find, getButton, getList, getStage, getStatus, getValue, nameOf } from '../lookup';
import { chip, phrase, toText, w, type Chip, type ChipKind } from './phrase';

/** The words for an ID that is not in the document: its old name if kept, else "something that was removed". */
export function deletedName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): string {
  const old = doc.removedNames?.[id];
  return old ? toText(phrase('describe.deleted', { name: old })) : w('describe.removed');
}

/** A chip for a named item; missing when the item is gone or has no name yet. */
function named(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, kind: ChipKind, id: string, name: string | undefined): Chip {
  if (name === undefined) return chip(kind, deletedName(doc, id), id, true);
  if (!name.trim()) return chip(kind, w('describe.noName'), id, true);
  return chip(kind, name, id);
}

/** The name if the item exists ('' when it has none), undefined when it is gone. */
const nameIf = <T>(item: T | undefined, name: (item: T) => string | undefined) => (item ? (name(item) ?? '') : undefined);

export const stageChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip => named(doc, 'stage', id, nameIf(getStage(doc, id), (s) => s.name));
export const buttonChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip => named(doc, 'button', id, nameIf(getButton(doc, id), (b) => b.label));
export const valueChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip => named(doc, 'value', id, nameIf(getValue(doc, id), (v) => v.name));
export const statusChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip => named(doc, 'status', id, nameIf(getStatus(doc, id), (s) => s.words));
export const listChip = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): Chip => named(doc, 'list', id, nameIf(getList(doc, id), (l) => l.name));

/** Any item's name, or its deleted name. */
export function itemName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, id: string): string {
  const entry = find(doc, id);
  if (!entry) return deletedName(doc, id);
  return nameOf(entry) || w('describe.noName');
}

/** True when the task's stage asks several tasks, so its name must be said. */
export function stageHasSeveralTasks(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, taskId: string): boolean {
  const stageId = find(doc, taskId)?.parents.stage;
  const stage = getStage(doc, stageId);
  return !!stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' && (stage.tasks ?? []).length > 1;
}

/**
 * What a task is called where its name is needed: its own name, else who is asked ("Security
 * team"), else "Task 2" by its place in the stage.
 * `whoIsAsked` is passed in to avoid a cycle with the expression module.
 */
export function taskName(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, task: Task, whoIsAsked: (task: Task) => string): string {
  if (task.name?.trim()) return task.name;
  const who = task.whoIsAsked ? whoIsAsked(task) : '';
  if (who) return who;
  const stage = getStage(doc, find(doc, task.id)?.parents.stage);
  const n = stage && stage.kind !== 'ending' ? (stage.tasks ?? []).findIndex((t) => t.id === task.id) + 1 : 1;
  return toText(phrase('describe.where.task', { n: String(Math.max(n, 1)) }));
}

/**
 * Whether a task's name takes the plural verb ("Domain approvers press", "Security team presses"):
 * a last word ending in a single "s". Only a guess from the words: a task named by the one person it
 * asks is always singular, and condition.ts checks that first.
 */
export function soundsPlural(name: string): boolean {
  const last = name.trim().split(/\s+/).pop() ?? '';
  return /[^s]s$/i.test(last);
}

/** The opposite of a "when ...", and the "goes nowhere" To do sentence (editor-model.md section 3). */
import { describe as group, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Clause, Condition, Expression, Words, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { WORDS, WORDS_WITH_A_LIST, WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER } from '@/contract';
import { fixture } from '../testkit';
import { describeNegatedClause, describeNegatedCondition, describeNowhereToGo, hasMissing, toText } from './index';
import { oppositeWords } from './negate';

const doc = fixture('change-request');
const risk: Expression = { value: 'v_risk' };
const isHigh: Clause = { left: risk, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } };
const not = (c: Condition | null | undefined, d = doc) => toText(describeNegatedCondition(d, c));

group('describeNegatedClause', () => {
  it('uses the opposite word', () => {
    expect(toText(describeNegatedClause(doc, isHigh))).toBe('Risk is not High');
    expect(toText(describeNegatedClause(doc, { left: { value: 'v_title' }, words: 'text.isEmpty' }))).toBe('Title is filled');
  });

  it('says a pressed clause in the negative', () => {
    expect(toText(describeNegatedClause(doc, { pressed: 'btn_da_approve' }))).toBe('Approve is not pressed');
  });

  it('reads Yes/No naturally', () => {
    const c: Clause = { left: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_needs_approval' }] }, words: 'yesNo.isNo' };
    expect(toText(describeNegatedClause(doc, c))).toBe('Primary domain needs approval');
  });

  it('has words for every word of the builder', () => {
    for (const words of Object.values(WORDS).flat() as Words[]) {
      const nothingAfter = (WORDS_WITH_NOTHING_AFTER as readonly Words[]).includes(words);
      const withList = (WORDS_WITH_A_LIST as readonly Words[]).includes(words);
      const right = nothingAfter ? {} : { right: withList ? [{ text: 'A' }, { text: 'B' }] : { text: 'A' } };
      const said = toText(describeNegatedClause(doc, { left: { value: 'v_title' }, words, ...right } as Clause));
      expect(said, words).not.toMatch(/describe\.|\{/);
      // A Yes/No value used directly reads as its name: "Title" / "not title".
      if (words === 'yesNo.isYes') expect(said).toBe('not title');
      else if (words === 'yesNo.isNo') expect(said).toBe('Title');
      else expect(said, words).toMatch(/^(Title|it is not true that Title) /);
    }
  });

  it('pairs opposites both ways', () => {
    expect(oppositeWords('number.isMoreThan')).toBe('number.isAtMost');
    expect(oppositeWords('number.isAtMost')).toBe('number.isMoreThan');
    expect(oppositeWords('text.startsWith')).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('marks an unfinished clause', () => {
    expect(hasMissing(describeNegatedClause(doc, {}))).toBe(true);
    expect(hasMissing(describeNegatedClause(doc, { left: risk }))).toBe(true);
  });
});

group('describeNegatedCondition', () => {
  it('turns "and" into "or" and the other way round', () => {
    const big: Clause = { left: { value: 'v_title' }, words: 'text.contains', right: { text: 'x' } };
    expect(not({ allOf: [isHigh, big] })).toBe('Risk is not High or Title does not contain x');
    expect(not({ anyOf: [isHigh, big] })).toBe('Risk is not High and Title does not contain x');
  });

  it('says a formula in the negative by its "Reads as"', () => {
    expect(not({ formula: '{{v_risk}} == "x"', readsAs: 'Risk is x' })).toBe('it is not true that Risk is x');
  });

  it('says a formula with no "Reads as" yet in plain words, flagged unfinished', () => {
    expect(not({ formula: '{{v_risk}} == "x"', readsAs: '' })).toBe('the formula is not true');
    expect(not({ formula: '{{v_risk}} == "x"', readsAs: '  ' })).toBe('the formula is not true');
    expect(hasMissing(describeNegatedCondition(doc, { formula: 'x', readsAs: '' }))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('reads an absent or empty condition as a gap', () => {
    expect(hasMissing(describeNegatedCondition(doc, undefined))).toBe(true);
    expect(hasMissing(describeNegatedCondition(doc, null))).toBe(true);
    expect(hasMissing(describeNegatedCondition(doc, { allOf: [] }))).toBe(true);
  });
});

  it('says the case a narrowed arrow leaves out', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    const stage = d.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval') as WorkingStage;
    stage.arrows.find((a) => a.id === 'ar_da_approve')!.onlyWhen = { allOf: [isHigh] };
    expect(toText(describeNowhereToGo(d, 'btn_da_approve'))).toBe(
      'When Approve is pressed and Risk is not High, the request goes nowhere.',
    );
  });

  it('with no narrowed arrow, says the button alone', () => {
    const d = structuredClone(doc);
    const stage = d.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval') as WorkingStage;
    stage.arrows = stage.arrows.filter((a) => a.id !== 'ar_da_reject');
    expect(toText(describeNowhereToGo(d, 'btn_da_reject'))).toBe('When Reject is pressed, the request goes nowhere.');
  });

  it('copes with a button that is gone', () => {
    expect(hasMissing(describeNowhereToGo(doc, 'btn_gone'))).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * The opposite of a "when ..." in words, and the To do sentence built from it: "When Approve is
 * pressed and Risk is not High, the request goes nowhere." (editor-model.md section 3, a button
 * whose only arrows are narrowed with "+ only when ..."). "and" becomes "or" and the other way
 * round; each clause takes its opposite words ("is" / "is not", "is more than" / "is at most",
 * Yes / No read naturally). Only for saying it: nothing here works out whether a condition is true.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Clause, Condition, Words, WordsClause } from '@/contract';
import { words, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import { find, getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { clauseWithWords, describeClause, describePressed, joinGroups, type Group } from './condition';
import { formulaWords } from './expression';
import { gap, joinEach, missing, phrase, w, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';

/** Each of the builder's words and its opposite among the builder's own words. */
const OPPOSITE: Partial<Record<Words, Words>> = {};
const pair = (a: Words, b: Words) => {
  OPPOSITE[a] = b;
  OPPOSITE[b] = a;
};
pair('text.is', 'text.isNot');
pair('text.contains', 'text.doesNotContain');
pair('text.isFilled', 'text.isEmpty');
pair('number.is', 'number.isNot');
pair('number.isMoreThan', 'number.isAtMost');
pair('number.isLessThan', 'number.isAtLeast');
pair('number.isFilled', 'number.isEmpty');
pair('yesNo.isYes', 'yesNo.isNo');
pair('yesNo.isFilled', 'yesNo.isEmpty');
pair('date.isBefore', 'date.isOnOrAfter');
pair('date.isAfter', 'date.isOnOrBefore');
pair('date.isFilled', 'date.isEmpty');
pair('choice.is', 'choice.isNot');
pair('choice.isOneOf', 'choice.isNotOneOf');
pair('choice.isFilled', 'choice.isEmpty');
pair('person.is', 'person.isNot');
pair('person.isIn', 'person.isNotIn');
pair('person.isFilled', 'person.isEmpty');
pair('people.include', 'people.doNotInclude');
pair('people.areFilled', 'people.areEmpty');
pair('list.includes', 'list.doesNotInclude');
pair('list.isFilled', 'list.isEmpty');

/** The builder's opposite word, if it has one. Exported for tests. */
export const oppositeWords = (word: Words): Words | undefined => OPPOSITE[word];

/** The opposite of one clause: "Risk is not High", "Approve is not pressed". */
export function describeNegatedClause(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, clause: Clause, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  if (!clause || typeof clause !== 'object') return [gap()];
  if ('pressed' in clause) return describePressed(doc, clause.pressed, true);
  const c: WordsClause = clause;
  if (!c.words) return clauseWithWords(doc, c, [gap()], env);
  const opposite = OPPOSITE[c.words];
  if (opposite) return describeClause(doc, { ...c, words: opposite }, env);
  const key = `describe.not.words.${c.words}`;
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(words, key)) return clauseWithWords(doc, c, [words[key as WordKey]], env);
  return phrase('describe.not.formula', { condition: describeClause(doc, c, env) });
}

/** The opposite of a condition: "Risk is High and Amount is more than 100" -> "Risk is not High or Amount is at most 100". */
export function describeNegatedCondition(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, condition: Condition | null | undefined, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  if (!condition || typeof condition !== 'object') return [gap()];
  if ('formula' in condition) {
    // With no "Reads as" yet there is no sentence to negate: say it plainly, flagged unfinished.
    if (!condition.readsAs?.trim()) return [missing(w('describe.not.formulaUnread'))];
    return phrase('describe.not.formula', { condition: formulaWords(condition.readsAs) });
  }
  const all = 'allOf' in condition;
  const clauses: Clause[] = (all ? condition.allOf : condition.anyOf) ?? [];
  if (clauses.length === 0) return [gap()];
  return joinEach(clauses.map((c) => describeNegatedClause(doc, c, env)), all ? 'or' : 'and');
}

const negatesToOr = (c: Condition | null | undefined): boolean =>
  !!c && typeof c === 'object' && 'allOf' in c && (c.allOf ?? []).length > 1;

/**
 * The To do for a button whose arrows are all narrowed: "When Approve is pressed and Risk is not
 * High, the request goes nowhere." Takes the stage's arrows for that button that carry "+ only
 * when ..." and says the case none of them covers. With no such arrow it reads "When Approve is
 * pressed, the request goes nowhere." (stage.buttonHasNowhereToGo gives the button.)
 */
export function describeNowhereToGo(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, buttonId: string, env: DescribeEnv = {}): Phrase {
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, find(doc, buttonId)?.parents.stage);
  const narrowed = (stage?.arrows ?? []).filter(
    (a) => a.when?.type === 'buttonPressed' && a.when.button === buttonId && a.onlyWhen,
  );
  // The opposite of an "and" sentence of two or more is an "or" group: it reads "either ... or ...".
  const groups: Group[] = [
    { phrase: describePressed(doc, buttonId), or: false },
    ...narrowed.map((a) => ({ phrase: describeNegatedCondition(doc, a.onlyWhen, env), or: negatesToOr(a.onlyWhen) })),
  ];
  return phrase('describe.nowhereToGo', { when: joinGroups(groups) });
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/phrase.ts\n===
/**
 * The output of every describe function: a Phrase, a list of Parts that the UI renders as text and
 * chips, and that `toText` joins into a plain string. Also the small helpers that build phrases
 * from the words in src/words/describe.ts, whose `{name}` placeholders may be filled with chips.
 */
import { words, type WordKey } from '@/words';
import type { Catalogue, CatalogueRef } from '@/contract';

export type ChipKind =
  | 'value'
  | 'sent'
  | 'person'
  | 'group'
  | 'stage'
  | 'button'
  | 'status'
  | 'list'
  | 'connection'
  | 'constant';

/** Something the UI draws as a chip. `missing`: unfinished or pointing at something deleted. */
export interface Chip {
  chip: ChipKind;
  label: string;
  id?: string;
  missing?: boolean;
}

/** Plain words that stand for something not filled in yet ("…", "(choose a stage)"). */
export interface MissingText {
  text: string;
  missing: true;
}

/**
 * The word "Settings" in "(change this in Settings)", which links to the workflow's Settings
 * (editor-model.md section 9: every "is told" sentence about stuck requests links there). A place
 * that cannot link shows `text` as plain words; `toText` does.
 */
export interface SettingsLink {
  text: string;
  link: 'settings';
  missing?: undefined;
}

/**
 * A web address a request holds, as a link: `text` is what a person reads (an issue's key, or the
 * address without "http://"), `href` the address. A place that cannot link shows `text`; `toText` does.
 * Only `describeHeldValue` makes one, and only when asked to (`HeldValueEnv.links`).
 */
export interface WebLink {
  text: string;
  href: string;
  link: 'web';
  missing?: undefined;
}

export type Part = string | Chip | MissingText | SettingsLink | WebLink;
export type Phrase = Part[];

/** What a describe function may use besides the document. */
export interface DescribeEnv {
  /** The catalogue of connections, for the names of operations, sources and what was sent. */
  catalogue?: Catalogue;
  /** The trigger whose sent fields are being described (set by describeStartsWhen). */
  trigger?: CatalogueRef | string;
}

export const isChip = (part: Part): part is Chip => typeof part === 'object' && 'chip' in part;
export const isMissing = (part: Part): boolean => typeof part === 'object' && part.missing === true;
/** True for the "Settings" link part of a sentence about stuck requests. */
export const isSettingsLink = (part: Part): part is SettingsLink => typeof part === 'object' && 'link' in part && part.link === 'settings';
/** True for a web address said as a link (`WebLink`). */
export const isWebLink = (part: Part): part is WebLink => typeof part === 'object' && 'link' in part && part.link === 'web';

/** The link part: "Settings", to be drawn as a link to the workflow's Settings where a screen can. */
export const settingsLink = (): SettingsLink => ({ text: words['describe.settings'], link: 'settings' });

/**
 * Plain words with "(change this in Settings)" in them, as a phrase whose "Settings" is the link
 * part: for words that come as a string (a finding's cause and effect, the Glossary's Stuck line).
 * Text without those words comes back as one plain part.
 */
export function settingsLinked(text: string): Phrase {
  const hint = phrase('describe.changeInSettings', { settings: settingsLink() });
  const whole = toText(hint);
  const at = text.lastIndexOf(whole);
  if (at < 0) return text ? [text] : [];
  const out: Phrase = [];
  pushText(out, text.slice(0, at));
  for (const part of hint) push(out, part);
  pushText(out, text.slice(at + whole.length));
  return out;
}

/** The phrase as plain text (a link to Settings as its word, "Settings"): for places that cannot link. */
export function toText(phrase: Phrase): string {
  return phrase.map((p) => (typeof p === 'string' ? p : 'chip' in p ? p.label : p.text)).join('');
}

/** True when any part of the phrase is unfinished. */
export const hasMissing = (phrase: Phrase): boolean => phrase.some(isMissing);

export const chip = (kind: ChipKind, label: string, id?: string, missing?: boolean): Chip => {
  const c: Chip = { chip: kind, label };
  if (id !== undefined) c.id = id;
  if (missing) c.missing = true;
  return c;
};

export const missing = (text: string): MissingText => ({ text, missing: true });

/** "…", flagged missing: a part of a sentence not filled in yet. */
export const gap = (): MissingText => missing(words['describe.gap']);

/** The plain words for a key (no placeholders filled). */
export const w = (key: WordKey): string => words[key];

/**
 * The words for `key` with each `{name}` replaced by `fill[name]` (a phrase, a part or a string).
 * Placeholders without a fill stay as written, so they show up.
 */
export function phrase(key: WordKey, fill: Record<string, Phrase | Part> = {}): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  const text: string = words[key];
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)) {
    const name = m[1] as string;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fill, name)) continue;
    pushText(out, text.slice(last, m.index));
    const value = fill[name] as Phrase | Part;
    for (const part of Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]) push(out, part);
    last = (m.index ?? 0) + m[0].length;
  }
  pushText(out, text.slice(last));
  return out;
}

function pushText(out: Phrase, text: string) {
  if (text) push(out, text);
}

/** Appends a part, merging neighbouring strings so plain runs stay one part. */
function push(out: Phrase, part: Part) {
  if (typeof part === 'string') {
    if (!part) return;
    const prev = out[out.length - 1];
    if (typeof prev === 'string') out[out.length - 1] = prev + part;
    else out.push(part);
  } else out.push(part);
}

/** Phrases as a list: "A", "A or B", "A, B and C". */
export function joinPhrases(items: Phrase[], word: 'and' | 'or'): Phrase {
  const joiner = ` ${w(word === 'and' ? 'describe.and' : 'describe.or')} `;
  const out: Phrase = [];
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (i > 0) push(out, i === items.length - 1 ? joiner : w('describe.comma'));
    for (const part of item) push(out, part);
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Names as a list in the shared list words: "Helpdesk", "Helpdesk and Jira", "Helpdesk, Jira and
 * Deploy" ("or" for alternatives). The one list-joining function for plain names on every screen.
 */
export function joinNames(names: readonly string[], word: 'and' | 'or' = 'and'): string {
  return toText(joinPhrases(names.map((n) => [n]), word));
}

/** Phrases joined by a word between every pair: "A and B and C" (clauses of a sentence). */
export function joinEach(items: Phrase[], word: 'and' | 'or'): Phrase {
  const joiner = ` ${w(word === 'and' ? 'describe.and' : 'describe.or')} `;
  const out: Phrase = [];
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (i > 0) push(out, joiner);
    for (const part of item) push(out, part);
  });
  return out;
}

/** Merges neighbouring strings of a phrase built by hand. */
export function tidy(parts: Phrase): Phrase {
  const out: Phrase = [];
  for (const part of parts) push(out, part);
  return out;
}

/** "Approvers" -> "approvers", leaving "API key" and "Eng" names starting with two capitals alone. */
export function lowerFirst(text: string): string {
  if (text.length > 1 && text[1] === text[1]?.toUpperCase() && text[1] !== text[1]?.toLowerCase()) return text;
  return text.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + text.slice(1);
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/saves.ts\n===
/**
 * What an action that uses a connection saves, said one way on the stage box and in the panel
 * (mockups 01-editor and 07-actions): one result reads "Save the new issue as [Jira issue]", with
 * the catalogue's label for the result; several read "Save the results as", followed by each
 * result and its value ("Owner -> [Service owner]"). A result whose label the catalogue lacks is
 * never named by its key: the line then uses the "results" wording.
 */
import type { Action, AuthoredWorkflow, Stage } from '@/contract';
import { entryOf, fieldLabel } from './catalogue';
import { valueChip } from './names';
import { lowerFirst, phrase, tidy, toText, type Chip, type DescribeEnv, type Phrase } from './phrase';

/** One saved result: the action, the result's key and label (undefined when the catalogue lacks it), the value's chip. */
export interface SavedResult {
  action: string;
  field: string;
  label: string | undefined;
  value: Chip;
}

export interface SavesWords {
  /** "Save the new issue as" or "Save the results as". */
  lead: string;
  /** Each value saved, once, in the order the actions run. */
  results: SavedResult[];
  /** The whole line for one result ("Save the new issue as [Jira issue]"); the lead alone for several. */
  phrase: Phrase;
}

const actionsOf = (from: Action | Stage): Action[] => {
  if ('type' in from) return [from];
  if (from.kind === 'ending') return [];
  return [...(from.whenThisStageStarts ?? []), ...(from.afterTheyRespond ?? [])];
};

/** Every result an action (or every action of a stage) saves as a value, each value once. */
export function savedResultsOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, from: Action | Stage, env: DescribeEnv = {}): SavedResult[] {
  const out: SavedResult[] = [];
  for (const action of actionsOf(from)) {
    if (action.type !== 'useConnection') continue;
    const entry = entryOf(env.catalogue, action.operation ?? undefined);
    for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(action.saveResults ?? {})) {
      if (!value || out.some((r) => r.value.id === value)) continue;
      const label = entry?.kind === 'operation' ? fieldLabel(entry.result, field) : undefined;
      out.push({ action: action.id, field, label, value: valueChip(doc, value) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The "Save ... as" line of an action or a stage, or undefined when it saves nothing. The stage box
 * and the panel's connection card both use it, so they say it the same way.
 */
export function describeSaves(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, from: Action | Stage, env: DescribeEnv = {}): SavesWords | undefined {
  const results = savedResultsOf(doc, from, env);
  if (!results.length) return undefined;
  const one = results.length === 1 ? results[0] : undefined;
  if (one?.label) {
    const lead = toText(phrase('describe.saves.one', { result: lowerFirst(one.label) }));
    return { lead, results, phrase: tidy([lead, ' ', one.value]) };
  }
  const lead = toText(phrase('describe.saves.many'));
  return { lead, results, phrase: [lead] };
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/describe/sends-back.ts\n===
/**
 * An arrow that sends a request back to an earlier stage says "sends it back" and one line on what
 * that means (editor-model.md sections 2 and 3, mockups 01-editor, 03-routing and 10-several-at-once).
 * The line depends on the stage the arrow goes to:
 * - the start stage: "The requester is asked again and sees what they entered before.";
 * - a stage that asks someone: "The people there are asked again and see what was entered before.";
 * - a stage that asks nobody (Automatic, or a Blank stage with no task): "Deploy happens again."
 * Whether an arrow sends back is the check's fact (`facts.arrows[id].sendsBack`); this only words it.
 */
import type { Arrow, AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { getWorkingStage } from '../lookup';
import { itemName } from './names';
import { toText, phrase, w } from './phrase';

/** The tag on an arrow that sends a request back: "sends it back". */
export const sendsBackTag = (): string => w('describe.sendsBack');

/** What sending a request back to `stageId` means, by the kind of stage it is; undefined for an ending or no stage. */
export function describeSendsBack(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, target: Arrow | string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  const stageId = typeof target === 'string' || target == null ? target : target.goTo;
  if (!stageId) return undefined;
  const stage = getWorkingStage(doc, stageId);
  if (!stage) return undefined;
  if (doc.start?.stage === stage.id) return w('describe.sendsBack.start');
  if ((stage.tasks ?? []).length === 0) return toText(phrase('describe.sendsBack.automatic', { stage: itemName(doc, stage.id) }));
  return w('describe.sendsBack.asked');
}

group('who is told about a stuck request (B3)', () => {

    expect(stuckToldText(two)).toBe('Sam Carter and Priya Raman, who look after stuck requests, are told');
    expect(stuckToldText(sam, { tense: 'past' })).toBe('Sam Carter, who looks after stuck requests, was told');
    expect(stuckToldText(platform, { tense: 'past' })).toBe('Platform team, who look after stuck requests, were told');
    expect(stuckToldText([], { tense: 'past' })).toBe('the people who look after stuck requests were told');
    expect(stuckToldText(undefined)).toBe('the people who look after stuck requests are told');
  });

  it('has a short form for a second mention', () => {
    expect(stuckToldText(sam, { short: true })).toBe('Sam Carter is told');
    expect(stuckToldText(platform, { short: true })).toBe('Platform team are told');
    expect(stuckToldText(two, { short: true, tense: 'past' })).toBe('Sam Carter and Priya Raman were told');
  });

  it('names people and groups as chips', () => {

    expect(said.filter((p) => typeof p === 'object' && 'chip' in p)).toEqual([

    ]);
  });

group('a group as the subject takes a plural verb (one rule, verb.ts)', () => {
  it('decides the verb from a person, a group, several, or the words of a name', () => {
    expect(verbNumber({ kind: 'person' })).toBe('one');
    expect(verbNumber({ kind: 'group' })).toBe('many');
    expect(verbNumber([{ kind: 'person' }, { kind: 'person' }])).toBe('many');
    expect(verbNumber([])).toBe('many');
    expect(verbNumber({ kind: 'unknown', name: 'Eng lead' })).toBe('one');
    expect(verbNumber({ kind: 'unknown', name: 'Domain approvers' })).toBe('many');
  });

  it('reads who an expression names: the Requester, a person, a group, people, a value that holds a group', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    expect(verbNumber(subjectsOf(doc, { request: 'requester' }))).toBe('one');

    expect(verbNumber(subjectsOf(doc, { person: { directoryId: 'p', name: 'Sam Carter' } }))).toBe('one');
    expect(verbNumber(subjectsOf(doc, { value: 'v_eng_lead' }, 'Eng lead'))).toBe('one');
