/**
 * The hooks screens read the open workflow with. Every hook selects a small, stable piece, so it is
 * cheap to call from many components: a component re-renders only when its piece changes.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { useShallow } from 'zustand/react/shallow';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { ArrowFacts, Facts, Finding, May, Ref, Services, Settings, StageFacts, VersionSummary } from '@/services/types';
import { useServices } from '@/services/context';
import type { DescribeEnv } from '../describe/phrase';
import type { StuckPerson } from '../describe/stuck';
import { find } from '../lookup';
import { useEditor } from '../store';
import {
  fetchLabel, fetchScope, IDLE_SCOPE, labelOf, refKey, scopeSnapshot, subscribeLabels, subscribeScope,
  type ValuesInScopeResult,
} from './caches';
import { sessionServices } from './session';
import { useSession, type RevealRequest, type SaveFailure, type SessionStatus } from './state';

export const useSessionStatus = (): SessionStatus => useSession((s) => s.status);
/** The open workflow's server ID, or null. */
export const useSessionWorkflowId = (): string | null => useSession((s) => s.workflowId);
export const useSettings = (): Settings | null => useSession((s) => s.settings);
export const useMay = (): May => useSession((s) => s.may);
export const useCatalogue = (): Catalogue | null => useSession((s) => s.catalogue);
export const useSaveFailure = (): SaveFailure | null => useSession((s) => s.saveFailure);
export const useRevealRequest = (): RevealRequest | null => useSession((s) => s.reveal);

/** The published versions (newest first) and the live version's number (null: never published). */
export function useVersions(): { versions: VersionSummary[]; live: number | null } {
  return useSession(useShallow((s) => ({ versions: s.versions, live: s.liveVersion })));
}

// ── Findings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Every To do and Worth knowing, in document order (for the document `useCheckedDoc` names). */
export const useFindings = (): Finding[] => useSession((s) => s.findings);
/** The document the findings and facts were worked out for. */
export const useCheckedDoc = (): AuthoredWorkflow | null => useSession((s) => s.checkedDoc);
/** False while the findings and facts are a moment behind the document on screen. */
export function useCheckIsCurrent(): boolean {
  const checked = useCheckedDoc();
  const doc = useEditor((s) => s.doc);
  return checked !== null && checked === doc;
}

export const useTodoCount = (): number => useSession((s) => s.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo').length);
export const useWorthKnowingCount = (): number =>
  useSession((s) => s.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'worthKnowing').length);

/**
 * The findings at `itemId`; with `deep`, also those at anything inside it (by the parents in
 * lookup.ts: a stage's tasks, actions, arrows, pages, questions, buttons ...; a list's columns and
 * rows). To do first, then Worth knowing, each in document order.
 */
export function findingsFor(findings: readonly Finding[], doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null, itemId: string, deep = false): Finding[] {
  const inside = (id: string): boolean => {
    if (id === itemId) return true;
    if (!deep || !doc) return false;
    const parents = find(doc, id)?.parents;
    return !!parents && Object.values(parents).includes(itemId);
  };
  const mine = findings.filter((f) => inside(f.location.item));
  return [...mine.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo'), ...mine.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'todo')];
}

/** `findingsFor` as a hook: a stable array until the findings change. */
export function useFindingsFor(itemId: string | null | undefined, options: { deep?: boolean } = {}): Finding[] {
  const findings = useFindings();
  const checked = useCheckedDoc();
  const current = useEditor((s) => s.doc);
  const doc = checked ?? current;
  const deep = options.deep ?? false;
  return useMemo(() => (itemId ? findingsFor(findings, doc, itemId, deep) : []), [findings, doc, itemId, deep]);
}

// ── Facts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const useFacts = (): Facts | null => useSession((s) => s.facts);
export const useStageFacts = (stageId: string | null | undefined): StageFacts | undefined =>
  useSession((s) => (stageId ? s.facts?.stages[stageId as keyof Facts['stages']] : undefined));
export const useArrowFacts = (arrowId: string | null | undefined): ArrowFacts | undefined =>
  useSession((s) => (arrowId ? s.facts?.arrows[arrowId as keyof Facts['arrows']] : undefined));

// ── Values in scope ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * The values that exist at `at` and whether each is filled there (core.valuesInScope), for the
 * current document; cached per document object, so many components asking about the same place
 * cost one call. `{ loading, values }`: while loading, `values` is the last answer for that place.
 */
export function useValuesInScope(at: Location | null | undefined): ValuesInScopeResult {
  const doc = useEditor((s) => s.doc);
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  const item = at?.item;
  const part = at?.part;
  const place = useMemo<Location | null>(() => (item ? (part ? { item, part } : { item }) : null), [item, part]);
  const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeScope, () =>
    doc && place && catalogue ? scopeSnapshot(doc, place) : IDLE_SCOPE,
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const services = sessionServices();
    if (doc && place && catalogue && services) fetchScope(services, catalogue, doc, place);
  }, [doc, place, catalogue]);
  return snapshot;
}

// ── Words ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const NO_ENV: DescribeEnv = {};

/**
 * The one `env` every describe function takes (src/model/describe): today the catalogue, which
 * names operations, data sources and what another system sent. Directory names and the sample
 * request are read from the document itself. Stable until the catalogue changes.
 */
export function useDescribeEnv(): DescribeEnv {
  const catalogue = useCatalogue();
  return useMemo(() => (catalogue ? { catalogue } : NO_ENV), [catalogue]);
}

/**
 * The people in "Stuck requests go to" (the authors when none is set), each by the directory's name
 * and with groups marked, for describeStuckTold and FindingEnv.stuckPeople: "Platform team, who
 * look after stuck requests, are told". Someone whose name is not known yet is left out until it is
 * (an empty list reads "the people who look after stuck requests"). Stable while nothing changes.
 */
export function useStuckPeople(): readonly StuckPerson[] {
  const services: Services = useServices();
  const settings = useSettings();
  const refs = useMemo<readonly Ref[]>(
    () => (settings ? (settings.stuckRequestsGoTo?.length ? settings.stuckRequestsGoTo : settings.authors) : []),
    [settings],
  );
  const keys = refs.map((r) => refKey(r)).join('|');
  // Every name as one string, so the snapshot is stable while no name changes.
  const names = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeLabels, () => refs.map((r) => labelOf(refKey(r)) ?? '').join('\u0000'));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!services) return;
    for (const r of refs) fetchLabel(services, r);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [services, keys]);
  return useMemo(() => {
    const looked = names.split('\u0000');
    return refs.flatMap((r, i): StuckPerson[] => {
      const name = looked[i] || (r as { label?: string }).label;
      if (!name) return [];
      return [r.type === 'group' ? { name, group: true } : { name }];
    });
  }, [refs, names]);
}

/**
 * The directory's display name for a person or group (directory.lookup, asked once per page);
 * undefined until it is known. Works anywhere under a ServicesProvider (the app has one; a rendered
 * test must wrap one).
 */
export function useDirectoryLabel(ref: Ref | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  const services: Services = useServices();
  const type = ref?.type;
  const id = ref?.id;
  const key = type && id ? refKey({ type, id }) : null;
  const label = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeLabels, () => (key ? labelOf(key) : undefined));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (services && type && id) fetchLabel(services, { type, id });
  }, [services, type, id]);
  return label;
}

===\nfrontend/src/model/session/readOnly.ts\n===
/**
 * Read only: while the signed-in person may not change the open workflow (`may.edit` false), the
 * editor store refuses every edit, undo and redo, so nothing can be changed that could never be
 * saved. `run` is refused 'notFound', as it is when no workflow is open.
 *
 * The store (../store.ts) has no read-only switch of its own yet, so the session swaps its three
 * edit functions while the workflow is read only and puts the originals back when it is not.
 */
import { useEditor, type EditorState } from '../store';

type EditFunctions = Pick<EditorState, 'run' | 'undo' | 'redo'>;

let kept: EditFunctions | null = null;

const refused = (() => ({ refused: 'notFound' })) as unknown as EditorState['run'];
const nothing = () => undefined;

/** Makes the editor store refuse (on) or accept (off) edits, undo and redo. Safe to call again with the same value. */
export function setEditorReadOnly(on: boolean): void {
  if (on && !kept) {
    const { run, undo, redo } = useEditor.getState();
    kept = { run, undo, redo };
    useEditor.setState({ run: refused, undo: nothing, redo: nothing });
  } else if (!on && kept) {
    useEditor.setState(kept);
    kept = null;
  }
}

/** True while the editor store refuses edits. */
export function editorIsReadOnly(): boolean {
  return kept !== null;
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/session/reveal.ts\n===
/**
 * Where a "Show me" goes: which view of the editor shows the item at a location.
 *  - a stage, task, arrow or action (and the start, a status, a "Starts when", a thing told, the
 *    workflow itself): the Diagram tab, with the item selected;
 *  - a page, question, text, choice or button: the form editor of its stage and task (the frontend
 *    owner's ruling: a button is worded and ordered on the form editor);
 *  - a value, a list, or a list's column or row: the Values tab.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import { find, kindOfId } from '../lookup';

export type RevealTarget =
  | { view: 'diagram' }
  | { view: 'form'; stageId: string; taskId: string }
  | { view: 'values' };

/** The view that shows `location`. Unknown or deleted items go to the Diagram tab. */
export function revealTarget(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null, location: Location): RevealTarget {
  const entry = doc ? find(doc, location.item) : undefined;
  const kind = entry?.kind ?? kindOfId(location.item);
  switch (kind) {
    case 'page':
    case 'question':
    case 'text':
    case 'choice':
    case 'button': {
      const stageId = entry?.parents.stage;
      const taskId = entry?.parents.task;
      return stageId && taskId ? { view: 'form', stageId, taskId } : { view: 'diagram' };
    }
    case 'value':
    case 'list':
    case 'column':
    case 'row':
      return { view: 'values' };
    default:
      return { view: 'diagram' };
  }
}

/** The editor route (hash path, without '#') of a reveal target, for workflow `workflowId`. */
export function revealPath(workflowId: string, target: RevealTarget): string {
  const base = `/w/${encodeURIComponent(workflowId)}`;
  switch (target.view) {
    case 'form':
      return `${base}/form/${target.stageId}/${target.taskId}`;
    case 'values':
      return `${base}/values`;
    default:
      return base;
  }
}

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, StageId } from '@/contract';
import { createStandinServices } from '@/services';
import type { Finding, Result, SavedDraft, Services } from '@/services/types';
import { getStage, indexDoc } from '../lookup';
import { useEditor } from '../store';
import {
  AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS, CHECK_QUIET_MS, closeWorkflow, findingsFor, flushSave, openWorkflow, publish, reloadDraft,
  resetSessionForTests, reveal, revealPath, SAVE_RETRY_MS, revealTarget, useFindingsFor, useSession,
} from './index';

const DEMO = 'change-request';
const RELEASED = 'st_released' as StageId;

function deferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((r) => (resolve = r));
  return { promise, resolve };
}

const rename = (name: string) => useEditor.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: RELEASED, name });
const editor = () => useEditor.getState();
const session = () => useSession.getState();
const serverName = async (services: Services) => {
  const draft = await services.authoring.getDraft(DEMO);
  return draft.ok ? getStage(draft.value.authored, RELEASED)?.name : undefined;
};

let services: Services;

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.useFakeTimers();
  services = createStandinServices().services;
});

afterEach(() => {
  resetSessionForTests();
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

describe('openWorkflow', () => {
  it('loads the draft, settings, catalogue and versions into the stores', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    expect(session()).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', workflowId: DEMO, liveVersion: 3, may: { edit: true, publish: true, settings: true } });
    expect(session().settings?.name).toBeTruthy();
    expect(session().versions.map((v) => v.version)).toEqual([3, 2, 1]);
    expect(session().catalogue?.entries?.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(editor()).toMatchObject({ workflowId: DEMO, revision: 12, saveState: 'saved' });
    expect(getStage(editor().doc!, RELEASED)).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('checks the document as soon as it is loaded', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
    expect(session().checkedDoc).toBe(editor().doc);
    expect(session().facts?.stages[RELEASED]).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('says when the workflow does not exist', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, 'no-such-workflow');
    expect(session().status).toBe('notFound');
  });

  it('says when it could not be loaded', async () => {
    const broken = { ...services, catalogue: { getCatalogue: () => Promise.reject(new Error('down')) } };
    await openWorkflow(broken, DEMO);
    expect(session().status).toBe('error');
  });

  it('returns the same promise for the workflow already open, and survives open, close, open (StrictMode)', async () => {
    const load = vi.spyOn(services.authoring, 'getDraft');
    const first = openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    expect(openWorkflow(services, DEMO)).toBe(first);
    closeWorkflow();
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    await first;
    expect(session().status).toBe('ready');
    // The first open was closed before it asked for anything; only the second loaded.
    expect(load).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('closes the first workflow when another is opened', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    await openWorkflow(services, 'several-at-once');
    expect(session().workflowId).toBe('several-at-once');
    expect(editor().workflowId).toBe('several-at-once');
  });
});

describe('autosave', () => {
  it('saves once the document has been quiet for 800 ms, and the revision goes up', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    const save = vi.spyOn(services.authoring, 'saveDraft');
    rename('Shipped');
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('unsaved');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(500);
    rename('Shipped!');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS - 1);
    expect(save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(save.mock.calls[0]?.[1].baseRevision).toBe(12);
    expect(editor()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saved', revision: 13 });
    expect(await serverName(services)).toBe('Shipped!');
  });

  it('saves a change made while a save is in flight right after it', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    const real = services.authoring.saveDraft.bind(services.authoring);
    const gate = deferred<void>();
    const calls: number[] = [];
    services.authoring.saveDraft = async (id, args) => {
      calls.push(args.baseRevision);
      if (calls.length === 1) await gate.promise;
      return real(id, args);
    };
    rename('First');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('saving');
    rename('Second');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(calls).toEqual([12]);
    gate.resolve();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
    expect(calls).toEqual([12, 13]);
    expect(editor()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saved', revision: 14 });
    expect(await serverName(services)).toBe('Second');
  });

  it('stops on a stale revision, and reloadDraft recovers with the current draft', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    // Someone else saves first.
    const other = structuredClone(editor().doc!) as AuthoredWorkflow;
    getStage(other, RELEASED)!.name = 'Theirs';
    await services.authoring.saveDraft(DEMO, { baseRevision: 12, authored: other });

    const save = vi.spyOn(services.authoring, 'saveDraft');
    rename('Mine');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('conflict');
    rename('Mine again');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS * 2);
    expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('conflict');

    const reloaded = await reloadDraft();
    expect(reloaded.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(editor()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saved', revision: 13 });
    expect(getStage(editor().doc!, RELEASED)?.name).toBe('Theirs');

    rename('After reload');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(editor()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saved', revision: 14 });
  });

  it('keeps unsaved after another failure, says so, and tries again on the next change', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    const real = services.authoring.saveDraft.bind(services.authoring);
    let fail = true;
    services.authoring.saveDraft = async (id, args): Promise<Result<SavedDraft>> =>
      fail ? { ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'busy', params: {} }] } : real(id, args);
    rename('One');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('unsaved');
    expect(session().saveFailure).toEqual({ kind: 'refused', errors: [{ code: 'busy', params: {} }] });
    fail = false;
    rename('Two');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(editor()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saved', revision: 13 });
    expect(session().saveFailure).toBeNull();
  });

  it('tries a failed save again on its own every SAVE_RETRY_MS, with no edit and no screen mounted', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);
    const real = services.authoring.saveDraft.bind(services.authoring);
    let attempts = 0;
    services.authoring.saveDraft = async (id, args): Promise<Result<SavedDraft>> => {
      attempts += 1;
      if (attempts <= 2) throw new Error('offline');
      return real(id, args);
    };
    rename('Offline');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
    expect(attempts).toBe(1);
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('unsaved');
    expect(session().saveFailure).toEqual({ kind: 'unreachable' });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(SAVE_RETRY_MS - 1);
    expect(attempts).toBe(1);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    expect(attempts).toBe(2);

      attempts += 1;

    rename('Conflict');

    expect(attempts).toBe(2);
    expect(editor().saveState).toBe('conflict');

  it('flushSave saves at once; undoing back to what is saved needs no save', async () => {
    await openWorkflow(services, DEMO);

  it('closeWorkflow saves a pending change', async () => {

  it('closeWorkflow unloads the editor, so an edit made afterwards is refused, not silently lost', async () => {

===\nfrontend/src/model/session/session.ts\n===
/**
 * The editor session (docs/08, F9): opens a workflow into the editor store, autosaves it, checks
 * it, and closes it. One workflow is open at a time; opening another closes the first.
 *
 * Autosave: after an edit, once the document has been quiet for AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS, the draft is
 * saved with its revision. Edits made while a save is in flight are saved right after it. A
 * `stale-revision` refusal sets the save state 'conflict' and stops saving until `reloadDraft()`.
 * Any other failure keeps 'unsaved', is exposed as `saveFailure`, and is retried every
 * SAVE_RETRY_MS while nothing else changes (an edit saves after its own quiet period instead).
 *
 * Read only: when the signed-in person may not change the workflow (`may.edit` false when it is
 * opened, or a save refused `forbidden`), the editor store refuses edits (./readOnly.ts) and nothing
 * is saved or tried again; `useMay().edit` is false, so the frame can say so.
 *
 * Checking: after any change of the document (an edit, undo, redo or a load), once it has been
 * quiet for CHECK_QUIET_MS, `core.check` and `core.facts` run; a result that arrives for a
 * document that is no longer the current one is dropped.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { ApiError, PublishResult, Result, Services, Settings } from '@/services/types';
import { onDocChange, useEditor } from '../store';
import { clearScopeCache } from './caches';
import { setEditorReadOnly } from './readOnly';
import { initialSession, NO_MAY, useSession, type SaveFailure } from './state';

/** How long the document must be quiet before it is saved (F9). */
export const AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS = 800;
/** How long the document must be quiet before it is checked again. */
export const CHECK_QUIET_MS = 150;
/** How long after a failed save (other than a conflict) it is tried again, while nothing else changes. */
export const SAVE_RETRY_MS = 5000;

interface Active {
  id: string;
  services: Services;
  closed: boolean;
  /** The revision the next save is based on. */
  revision: number;
  /** The document object last known to be on the server. */
  lastSavedDoc: AuthoredWorkflow | null;
  /** True after a stale-revision refusal, until reloadDraft. */
  stopped: boolean;
  /** False when the signed-in person may not change the workflow: nothing is saved. */
  mayEdit: boolean;
  saveTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  checkTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  /** Counts down to trying a failed save again. */
  retryTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  running: Promise<void> | null;
  again: boolean;
  unsubscribe: (() => void)[];
  ready: Promise<void>;
}

let active: Active | null = null;
/** The save started by the last close, so the next open reads the draft after it. */
let lastFlush: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

const resolved = Promise.resolve();

/** The services of the open workflow, or null. For the caches in this folder. */
export function sessionServices(): Services | null {
  return active && !active.closed ? active.services : null;
}

function failure(errors: ApiError[]): Result<never> {
  return { ok: false, errors };
}

const NOT_OPEN: ApiError = { code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'workflow' } };

// ── Opening and closing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Opens workflow `workflowId`: loads its draft, Settings, the catalogue and the versions, puts the
 * draft in the editor store, then starts autosave and checking. Resolves when the document is in
 * the store (or the status says why not). Opening the workflow that is already open returns the
 * same promise; opening another closes the first.
 */
export function openWorkflow(services: Services, workflowId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (active && !active.closed && active.id === workflowId && active.services === services) return active.ready;
  closeWorkflow();
  const a: Active = {
    id: workflowId,
    services,
    closed: false,
    revision: 0,
    lastSavedDoc: null,
    stopped: false,
    mayEdit: true,
    saveTimer: undefined,
    checkTimer: undefined,
    retryTimer: undefined,
    running: null,
    again: false,
    unsubscribe: [],
    ready: resolved,
  };
  active = a;
  clearScopeCache();
  useSession.setState({ ...initialSession, workflowId, status: 'loading' });
  a.ready = load(a);
  return a.ready;
}

async function load(a: Active): Promise<void> {
  await lastFlush.catch(() => undefined);
  if (a.closed) return;
  const { authoring, catalogue } = a.services;
  let results;
  try {
    results = await Promise.all([
      authoring.getDraft(a.id),
      authoring.getSettings(a.id),
      catalogue.getCatalogue(),
      authoring.listVersions(a.id),
    ]);
  } catch {
    if (!a.closed) useSession.setState({ status: 'error' });
    return;
  }
  if (a.closed) return;
  const [draft, settings, cat, versions] = results;
  if (!draft.ok) {
    const notFound = draft.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'not-found');
    useSession.setState({ status: notFound ? 'notFound' : 'error', loadErrors: draft.errors });
    return;
  }
  if (!settings.ok || !cat.ok) {
    useSession.setState({ status: 'error', loadErrors: [...(settings.ok ? [] : settings.errors), ...(cat.ok ? [] : cat.errors)] });
    return;
  }
  const list = versions.ok ? versions.value : [];
  useEditor.getState().load(a.id, draft.value.authored, draft.value.revision);
  a.revision = draft.value.revision;
  a.lastSavedDoc = useEditor.getState().doc;
  a.mayEdit = draft.value.may.edit;
  setEditorReadOnly(!a.mayEdit);
  useSession.setState({
    status: 'ready',
    settings: settings.value,
    may: draft.value.may,
    catalogue: cat.value,
    versions: list,
    liveVersion: liveOf(list),
  });
  start(a);
}

const liveOf = (versions: { version: number }[]): number | null =>
  versions.reduce<number | null>((best, v) => (best === null || v.version > best ? v.version : best), null);

function start(a: Active) {
  a.unsubscribe.push(onDocChange(() => edited(a)));
  a.unsubscribe.push(
    useEditor.subscribe((state, previous) => {
      if (state.doc !== previous.doc) scheduleCheck(a);
    }),
  );
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') void flushSave();
    };
    const onPageHide = () => void flushSave();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', onPageHide);
    a.unsubscribe.push(() => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', onPageHide);
    });
  }
  void runCheck(a);
}

/**
 * Closes the open workflow: stops autosave and checking, and saves a pending change (in the
 * background; the next `openWorkflow` waits for it). Safe to call when nothing is open.
 */
export function closeWorkflow(): void {
  const a = active;
  if (!a) return;
  active = null;
  clearTimeout(a.saveTimer);
  clearTimeout(a.checkTimer);
  clearTimeout(a.retryTimer);
  a.saveTimer = undefined;
  a.retryTimer = undefined;
  for (const off of a.unsubscribe) off();
  a.unsubscribe = [];
  const editor = useEditor.getState();
  const doc = editor.workflowId === a.id ? editor.doc : null;
  const pending = !a.stopped && a.mayEdit && doc !== null && a.lastSavedDoc !== null && doc !== a.lastSavedDoc;
  a.closed = true;
  const before = a.running ?? resolved;
  lastFlush = pending ? before.then(() => (doc !== a.lastSavedDoc ? saveOnce(a, doc) : undefined)) : before;
  // The document was captured above for the last save; after this an edit is refused, not lost.
  if (editor.workflowId === a.id) editor.unload();
  setEditorReadOnly(false);
  useSession.setState({ ...initialSession });
}

// ── Autosave ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function edited(a: Active) {
  if (a.closed || !a.mayEdit) return;
  if (a.stopped) {
    // The store marks every edit 'unsaved'; after a conflict nothing is saved until reloadDraft, so say so.
    useEditor.getState().setSaveState('conflict');
    return;
  }
  clearTimeout(a.saveTimer);
  clearRetry(a);
  a.saveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    a.saveTimer = undefined;
    void runSaves(a);
  }, AUTOSAVE_QUIET_MS);
}

/** Saves until nothing is left to save; one save at a time. */
function runSaves(a: Active): Promise<void> {
  if (a.running) {
    a.again = true;
    return a.running;
  }
  a.running = (async () => {
    do {
      a.again = false;
      await saveOnce(a);
    } while (a.again && !a.closed && !a.stopped && a.mayEdit);
  })().finally(() => {
    a.running = null;
  });
  return a.running;
}

/** One save of `given` (by default the editor's document). Updates the stores only while the session is open. */
async function saveOnce(a: Active, given?: AuthoredWorkflow): Promise<void> {
  const editor = useEditor.getState();
  const doc = given ?? (editor.workflowId === a.id ? editor.doc : null);
  if (!doc || a.stopped || !a.mayEdit) return;
  if (doc === a.lastSavedDoc) {
    // Undone back to what is saved: nothing to send.
    clearRetry(a);
    if (!a.closed && editor.saveState === 'unsaved') editor.setSaveState('saved');
    if (!a.closed && useSession.getState().saveFailure) useSession.setState({ saveFailure: null });
    return;
  }
  if (!a.closed) editor.setSaveState('saving');
  let result;
  try {
    result = await a.services.authoring.saveDraft(a.id, { baseRevision: a.revision, authored: doc });
  } catch {
    if (!a.closed) failed(a, { kind: 'unreachable' });
    return;
  }
  if (result.ok) {
    clearRetry(a);
    a.revision = result.value.revision;
    a.lastSavedDoc = doc;
    if (a.closed) return;
    const now = useEditor.getState();
    if (now.doc === doc) {
      now.setSaveState('saved', a.revision);
    } else {
      now.setSaveState('unsaved', a.revision);
      // Changed while saving: save again now, unless a quiet period is already counting down.
      if (!a.saveTimer) a.again = true;
    }
    if (useSession.getState().saveFailure) useSession.setState({ saveFailure: null });
    return;
  }
  if (result.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'stale-revision')) {
    a.stopped = true;
    clearTimeout(a.saveTimer);
    a.saveTimer = undefined;
    clearRetry(a);
    if (!a.closed) useEditor.getState().setSaveState('conflict');
    return;
  }
  if (result.errors.some((e) => e.code === 'forbidden')) {
    // No longer (or never) allowed to change it: trying again cannot help. Read only from here.
    a.mayEdit = false;
    clearTimeout(a.saveTimer);
    a.saveTimer = undefined;
    clearRetry(a);
    if (a.closed) return;
    useEditor.getState().setSaveState('unsaved');
    setEditorReadOnly(true);
    const may = useSession.getState().may;
    useSession.setState({ saveFailure: { kind: 'refused', errors: result.errors }, may: { ...may, edit: false, publish: false } });
    return;
  }
  if (!a.closed) failed(a, { kind: 'refused', errors: result.errors });
}

/** A save failed (not a conflict): say so, and try again after SAVE_RETRY_MS unless something else saves first. */
function failed(a: Active, why: SaveFailure) {
  useEditor.getState().setSaveState('unsaved');
  useSession.setState({ saveFailure: why });
  clearRetry(a);
  a.retryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    a.retryTimer = undefined;
    // An edit since has its own quiet period running; that save covers the retry.
    if (!a.closed && !a.stopped && !a.saveTimer) void runSaves(a);
  }, SAVE_RETRY_MS);
}

function clearRetry(a: Active) {
  clearTimeout(a.retryTimer);
  a.retryTimer = undefined;
}

/** Saves a pending change now (skipping the quiet period) and resolves when every save has settled. */
export function flushSave(): Promise<void> {
  const a = active;
  if (!a) return lastFlush;
  clearTimeout(a.saveTimer);
  a.saveTimer = undefined;
  clearRetry(a);
  if (a.stopped || !a.mayEdit) return a.running ?? resolved;
  return runSaves(a);
}

/**
 * Loads the current draft from the server, replacing the document in the editor (the author's
 * unsaved edits are lost; the screen that calls it says so first), and starts saving again after
 * a conflict.
 */
export async function reloadDraft(): Promise<Result<void>> {
  const a = active;
  if (!a) return failure([NOT_OPEN]);
  clearTimeout(a.saveTimer);
  a.saveTimer = undefined;
  clearRetry(a);
  let draft;
  try {
    draft = await a.services.authoring.getDraft(a.id);
  } catch {
    return failure([{ code: 'internal', params: {} }]);
  }
  if (a.closed) return failure([NOT_OPEN]);
  if (!draft.ok) return draft;
  useEditor.getState().load(a.id, draft.value.authored, draft.value.revision);
  a.revision = draft.value.revision;
  a.lastSavedDoc = useEditor.getState().doc;
  a.stopped = false;
  a.mayEdit = draft.value.may.edit;
  setEditorReadOnly(!a.mayEdit);
  useSession.setState({ saveFailure: null, may: draft.value.may });
  return { ok: true, value: undefined };
}

// ── Checking ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function scheduleCheck(a: Active) {
  if (a.closed) return;
  clearTimeout(a.checkTimer);
  a.checkTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    a.checkTimer = undefined;
    void runCheck(a);
  }, CHECK_QUIET_MS);
}

async function runCheck(a: Active): Promise<void> {
  const doc = useEditor.getState().doc;
  const catalogue = useSession.getState().catalogue;
  if (!doc || !catalogue || a.closed) return;
  let findings, facts;
  try {
    [findings, facts] = await Promise.all([a.services.core.check(doc, catalogue), a.services.core.facts(doc, catalogue)]);
  } catch {
    return;
  }
  if (a.closed || useEditor.getState().doc !== doc) return;
  useSession.setState({ findings, facts, checkedDoc: doc });
}

// ── Settings and publishing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Replaces the workflow's Settings record (name, description, authors, Stuck requests go to). */
export async function saveSettings(next: Settings): Promise<Result<Settings>> {
  const a = active;
  if (!a) return failure([NOT_OPEN]);
  const result = await a.services.authoring.saveSettings(a.id, next);
  if (result.ok && !a.closed) useSession.setState({ settings: result.value });
  return result;
}

/** Renames the workflow (its Settings record; not an edit to the document, so not undoable). */
export function renameWorkflow(name: string): Promise<Result<Settings>> {
  const settings = useSession.getState().settings;
  if (!settings) return Promise.resolve(failure([NOT_OPEN]));
  return saveSettings({ ...settings, name });
}

/**
 * Publishes the draft: saves any pending change first, then publishes that revision with the
 * browser core's version. Returns the result or the refusal (`has-todo`, `stale-revision`,
 * `core-version-mismatch` ...). A save that failed is returned as the refusal instead of
 * publishing an older draft. Refreshes the versions after a publish.
 */
export async function publish(): Promise<Result<PublishResult>> {
  const a = active;
  if (!a) return failure([NOT_OPEN]);
  await flushSave();
  if (a.closed) return failure([NOT_OPEN]);
  const doc = useEditor.getState().doc;
  if (!a.stopped && doc !== a.lastSavedDoc) {
    const why = useSession.getState().saveFailure;
    return failure(why?.kind === 'refused' ? why.errors : [{ code: 'internal', params: {} }]);
  }
  const meta = await a.services.core.meta();
  const result = await a.services.authoring.publish(a.id, { revision: a.revision, coreVersion: meta.coreVersion });
  if (result.ok) await refreshVersions(a);
  return result;
}

async function refreshVersions(a: Active) {
  const versions = await a.services.authoring.listVersions(a.id);
  if (versions.ok && !a.closed) useSession.setState({ versions: versions.value, liveVersion: liveOf(versions.value) });
}

// ── Show me ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let nonce = 0;

/**
 * "Show me": selects `location` in the editor store and records a reveal request. The editor frame
 * turns it into navigation (Diagram tab, the form editor of its stage and task, or the Values tab);
 * the screen that shows the item scrolls it into view and flashes it (`useRevealRequest`).
 */
export function reveal(location: Location): void {
  useEditor.getState().select(location);
  nonce += 1;
  useSession.setState({ reveal: { location, nonce } });
}

/** For tests: forget the open workflow without saving anything. */
export function resetSessionForTests(): void {
  if (active) {
    clearTimeout(active.saveTimer);
    clearTimeout(active.checkTimer);
    clearTimeout(active.retryTimer);
    for (const off of active.unsubscribe) off();
    active.closed = true;
  }
  active = null;
  lastFlush = resolved;
  setEditorReadOnly(false);
  useSession.setState({ ...initialSession, may: NO_MAY });
}

/**
 * "Settings" inside a sentence (the `SettingsLink` part of a phrase, editor-model.md section 9:
 * every "is told" sentence about stuck requests links to Settings) opens the workflow's Settings.
 * The editor's frame (src/app/EditorLayout.tsx) says how, with `setSettingsOpener`; a screen only
 * calls `openSettings()`. Outside the editor nothing opens, and `openSettings()` says so (false).
 */
let opener: (() => void) | null = null;

/**
 * Says how Settings is opened (the editor's frame does, while its top bar is on screen). Returns
 * the function that takes it back again.
 */
export function setSettingsOpener(open: () => void): () => void {
  opener = open;
  return () => {
    if (opener === open) opener = null;
  };
}

/** Opens the workflow's Settings. False when there is none on screen to open. */
export function openSettings(): boolean {
  if (!opener) return false;
  opener();
  return true;
}

/** True while something on screen can open Settings (a link part is then drawn as a link). */
export const canOpenSettings = (): boolean => opener !== null;

/**
 * The session store: everything about the open workflow that is not the document itself. The
 * document, its revision, save state, selection and undo stay in the editor store (../store.ts).
 * Written only by this folder (session.ts and reveal.ts); screens read it through the hooks.
 */
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { ApiError, Facts, Finding, May, Settings, VersionSummary } from '@/services/types';

/** idle: nothing open. loading: being fetched. ready: on screen. notFound: no such workflow. error: could not be loaded. */
export type SessionStatus = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'notFound' | 'error';

/** Why the last save did not happen: refused by the server (other than a stale revision), or the call could not be made. */
export type SaveFailure = { kind: 'refused'; errors: ApiError[] } | { kind: 'unreachable' };

/** A "Show me": where to go. `nonce` changes on every request, so asking for the same place twice still moves. */
export interface RevealRequest {
  location: Location;
  nonce: number;
}

export interface SessionState {
  /** The server's workflow ID of the open workflow; null when none. */
  workflowId: string | null;
  status: SessionStatus;
  /** With status 'notFound' or 'error': what the server said, when it said something. */
  loadErrors: ApiError[];
  /** The server's record: name, description, authors, Stuck requests go to. */
  settings: Settings | null;
  /** What the signed-in person may do with this workflow. */
  may: May;
  catalogue: Catalogue | null;
  /** Published versions, newest first. */
  versions: VersionSummary[];
  /** The live version's number; null when never published. */
  liveVersion: number | null;
  /** The check's To do and Worth knowing, in document order, for `checkedDoc`. */
  findings: Finding[];
  /** The core's facts for `checkedDoc`. */
  facts: Facts | null;
  /** The document object the findings and facts were worked out for. When it is not the editor's doc, they are a moment behind. */
  checkedDoc: AuthoredWorkflow | null;
  /** Set when the last save failed (not a conflict); cleared by the next good save. */
  saveFailure: SaveFailure | null;
  /** The last "Show me". */
  reveal: RevealRequest | null;
}

export const NO_MAY: May = { edit: false, publish: false, settings: false };

export const initialSession: SessionState = {
  workflowId: null,
  status: 'idle',
  loadErrors: [],
  settings: null,
  may: NO_MAY,
  catalogue: null,
  versions: [],
  liveVersion: null,
  findings: [],
  facts: null,
  checkedDoc: null,
  saveFailure: null,
  reveal: null,
};

/** The session store, as a hook: `useSession((s) => s.status)`. Read only; the actions in this folder write it. */
export const useSession = create<SessionState>()(() => ({ ...initialSession }));

/**
 * Slots: how one feature shows another feature's part without importing it (docs/08: features share
 * only through model). Each slot has a name and fixed props. The feature that owns the part exports a
 * component with that name and props; src/app fills the slots once (src/app/slots.ts, SlotsProvider in
 * main.tsx); the feature that shows the part renders <Slot name="..." {...props} />.
 *
 * StageActions names what to show by id and edits the document itself. The editing slots
 * (WhenBuilder, FormulaEditor, ValueField, MessageField) are controlled: the caller passes the
 * current part of the document as `value` and stores what `onChange` gives with its own named
 * command, so the same control serves an arrow, a question, an action or a value.
 * FormView and ReadOnlyDiagram take the document as a prop, so they also serve pages outside the
 * editor (Try it, the live start, task and request pages).
 * Changing a slot's props, or adding a slot, is a change to this shared file: ask the frontend owner.
 */
import { createContext, createElement, useContext, type ComponentType, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type {
  AuthoredWorkflow, CatalogueRef, Condition, Expression, Formula, Location, SentCondition, SentExpression, SentTemplate,
  Template, ValueKind, WorkingStageKind,
} from '@/contract';
import type { Answers, ButtonState, KnownLookups, Ref, Refusal, Values } from '@/services';

/** Where in a stage a list of actions sits. 'automatic' is the whole body of an Automatic stage. */
export type ActionsPlace = 'stageStarts' | 'afterRespond' | 'automatic';

export type StageActionsProps = {
  /** The stage whose actions are shown; null when no stage is chosen yet (placeholders only). */
  stageId: string | null;
  place: ActionsPlace;
};

/**
 * The value and onChange of an editing slot. Inside a "Starts when" (`sent` given) only what the
 * other system sent can be read, so the format's Sent* shape is used there instead (authored-format.ts).
 */
export type Controlled<Normal, Sent> =
  | {
      /** Absent: the workflow's values are offered. */
      sent?: undefined;
      /** The current part of the document; undefined when empty. */
      value: Normal | undefined;
      /** Called with the new part, or undefined to empty it. The caller stores it with a named command. */
      onChange(next: Normal | undefined): void;
    }
  | {
      /** A "Starts when"'s catalogue entry: what it sends is offered instead of the workflow's values. */
      sent: CatalogueRef;
      /** The current part of the binding; undefined when empty. */
      value: Sent | undefined;
      /** Called with the new part, or undefined to empty it. */
      onChange(next: Sent | undefined): void;
    };

export type WhenBuilderProps = {
  /** Where the "when ..." is used (an arrow's `when.condition`, a question's `showWhen` ...): for the values in scope there and for findings. */
  at: Location;
  /** For a stage's arrows and "After they respond": offer "[button] is pressed" for this stage's buttons (named by task when it has several). */
  stageId?: string;
  /** The quiet text shown while empty, e.g. "+ only when ...". */
  addLabel?: string;
  /** Focus the builder when it appears (a new arrow made by dragging). */
  autoFocus?: boolean;
} & Controlled<Condition, SentCondition>;

export type FormulaEditorProps = {
  /** Where the formula stands: for the values in scope there and for findings. */
  at: Location;
  /** The formula; undefined when none is written yet. */
  value: Formula | undefined;
  /** Called with the new formula (text and "reads as"), or undefined to remove it. */
  onChange(next: Formula | undefined): void;
  /** What the result must be: 'yesNo' for a "when ...", or the kinds of value accepted. */
  gives: 'yesNo' | ValueKind[];
};

export type ValueFieldProps = {
  /** Where the slot is: for the values in scope there (and whether each may be empty) and for findings. */
  at: Location;
  /** The accessible name of the field, e.g. "Who is asked". */
  label: string;
  /** Kinds of value the slot accepts; absent: any. */
  accepts?: ValueKind[];
  /** A typed-in constant of an accepted kind is allowed (a date, a number, a person ...). */
  allowTyped?: boolean;
  /** Offer "If empty, use ..." on the chosen value. */
  allowIfEmptyUse?: boolean;
  /** Quiet text while empty. */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** 'field' (default): the full field with its details and notes. 'chip': only the value as a chip, to stand in a sentence. */
  look?: 'field' | 'chip';
} & Controlled<Expression, SentExpression>;

export type ValueChipProps = {
  /** The value shown; clicking the chip opens its small value card. */
  valueId: string;
};

export type MessageFieldProps = {
  /** Where the text is: for the values in scope there and for findings. */
  at: Location;
  /** The accessible name of the field, e.g. "Message". */
  label: string;
  /** Several lines (a notification message) rather than one (a summary). */
  multiline?: boolean;
} & Controlled<Template, SentTemplate>;

/** A kind of stage: a working kind, or an ending. */
export type StageKindChoice = WorkingStageKind | 'ending';

export type KindChooserProps = {
  /** Called with the kind chosen. */
  onChoose(kind: StageKindChoice): void;
  /** Offer Ending as well (false when the caller needs a working stage). */
  includeEnding?: boolean;
};

export type ListDialogProps = {
  /** The list kept with the workflow, e.g. the Domains list. */
  listId: string;
  open: boolean;
  /** Called to open or close the dialog; focus goes back to the control that opened it. */
  onOpenChange(open: boolean): void;
};

/**
 * The one form renderer (F6): the form editor's preview, Try it, and the live start and task pages
 * all show a task's form with it. It works out which pages, questions and texts show and which
 * buttons can be pressed by calling services `core.formState` itself, so every place agrees.
 */
export type FormViewProps = {
  /** The document the task belongs to: the draft in the editor and in Try it, the published version's document on live pages. */
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow;
  /** The task whose form is shown. */
  taskId: string;
  /** 'preview': the editor shows the form as people will see it, nothing is sent. 'answer': a person or a tester is answering. */
  mode: 'preview' | 'answer';
  /** The answers so far, by question ID. Hidden or unanswered questions are absent. */
  answers: Answers;
  /** Called with all the answers after a person changes one. The caller keeps them and passes them back as `answers`. */
  onAnswersChange(next: Answers): void;
  /** The request's values so far: for text with value chips, for Show when, and for showing earlier answers after a send-back. */
  values: Values;
  /** What a form's "when ..." may read about the request besides its values. Absent: no request yet (the start form, the editor). */
  request?: { requester?: Ref; startedOn?: string };
  /** The recorded directory lists the engine gave with the task (a group's people), in the shape services uses. Absent in the editor. */
  lookups?: KnownLookups;
  /**
   * Fetches the choices of a question whose choices come from a connection or the directory, for what the
   * person typed (`search`, '' for the first list). Absent in the editor's preview, which then shows the
   * catalogue's sample choices with a note that they are samples.
   */
  loadChoices?: (questionId: string, search: string) => Promise<{ stored: string | number; label: string }[]>;
  /** The engine's word on which buttons this viewer may press, and why not. Absent: the form's own rules only. */
  buttonStates?: ButtonState[];
  /** What the engine refused at the last press; each is shown in words at the question or button it names. */
  refusals?: Refusal[];
  /** Called with the button's ID when a person presses a button that can be pressed. Never called in 'preview'. */
  onPress?: (buttonId: string) => void;
  /** A press is being sent: the buttons cannot be pressed again until it is answered. */
  busy?: boolean;
  /** Shows the form as it was answered: nothing can be changed and no button can be pressed. */
  readOnly?: boolean;
};

/** The diagram without editing, for Try it and the request page. */
export type ReadOnlyDiagramProps = {
  /** The workflow drawn. Default: the open draft in the editor. */
  doc?: AuthoredWorkflow;
  /** Stage IDs where the request is now: these glow, and say so in words. */
  at?: string[];
  /** Stage IDs the request has been through. */
  visited?: string[];
  /** Arrow IDs the request took. */
  taken?: string[];
  /** A stage ID drawn as stuck, in words as well as colour. */
  stuckAt?: string;
  /** Called with a stage's ID when a person clicks it (or presses Enter on it). Absent: stages cannot be chosen. */
  onStageClick?: (stageId: string) => void;
  /** The accessible name of the diagram, e.g. "Where request 1042 is". */
  label: string;
};

/** On the start stage's panel, under Reached from: "+ Also start it from another system" and the "Starts when" cards it adds. */
export type AlsoStartsFromProps = {
  /** The start stage. The part edits the open draft's `start.startsWhen` with its own named commands. */
  stageId: string;
};

/** Every slot and its props. A slot's props never include `name` (that is the slot's own name). */
export type SlotProps = {
  /** features/actions: the actions of a stage, with "Add an action or save a value". Shown by features/panel. */
  StageActions: StageActionsProps;
  /** features/conditions: the "when ..." sentence builder. Shown by panel, forms, actions, values, connections. */
  WhenBuilder: WhenBuilderProps;
  /** features/conditions: the formula editor. Shown by values and by the WhenBuilder's "Write a formula". */
  FormulaEditor: FormulaEditorProps;
  /** features/values: one value slot with the value picker. Shown wherever a value is chosen. */
  ValueField: ValueFieldProps;
  /** features/values: a value's chip that opens its small value card. */
  ValueChip: ValueChipProps;
  /** features/values: text with value chips in it (a message, a summary). */
  MessageField: MessageFieldProps;
  /** features/diagram: the kinds of stage with their one-line explanations ("Which kind?"); content only. */
  KindChooser: KindChooserProps;
  /** features/values: a list kept with the workflow, in a dialog. */
  ListDialog: ListDialogProps;
  /** features/forms: the one form renderer. Shown by forms (preview), tryit and requests. */
  FormView: FormViewProps;
  /** features/diagram: the diagram without editing. Shown by tryit and requests. */
  ReadOnlyDiagram: ReadOnlyDiagramProps;
  /** features/connections: "+ Also start it from another system" and its "Starts when" cards. Shown by panel. */
  AlsoStartsFrom: AlsoStartsFromProps;
};

export type SlotName = keyof SlotProps;
export type Slots = { [K in SlotName]: ComponentType<SlotProps[K]> };

const nothing = () => null;

/** Unfilled slots render nothing (e.g. in a rendered test that does not provide them). */
export const emptySlots: Slots = {
  StageActions: nothing,
  WhenBuilder: nothing,
  FormulaEditor: nothing,
  ValueField: nothing,
  ValueChip: nothing,
  MessageField: nothing,
  KindChooser: nothing,
  ListDialog: nothing,
  FormView: nothing,
  ReadOnlyDiagram: nothing,
  AlsoStartsFrom: nothing,
};

const SlotsContext = createContext<Slots>(emptySlots);

/** Used once, by src/app, to fill the slots. Tests may pass some of them. */
export function SlotsProvider({ slots, children }: { slots: Partial<Slots>; children?: ReactNode }) {
  return createElement(SlotsContext.Provider, { value: { ...emptySlots, ...slots } }, children);
}

/** Renders the component that fills slot `name`, e.g. <Slot name="StageActions" stageId={id} place="stageStarts" />. */
export function Slot<K extends SlotName>(props: { name: K } & SlotProps[K]) {
  const { name, ...rest } = props;
  const component = useContext(SlotsContext)[name] as ComponentType<SlotProps[K]>;
  return createElement(component, rest as unknown as SlotProps[K]);
}

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { seededRandom } from './ids';
import { getStage } from './lookup';
import { createEditorStore, HISTORY_LIMIT, onDocChange } from './store';
import { assertWellFormed, createdId, fixture } from './testkit';

const fresh = (name: 'blank' | 'change-request' = 'change-request') => {
  const store = createEditorStore({ random: seededRandom(11) });
  store.getState().load('wf-server-1', fixture(name), 4);
  return store;
};

describe('editor store', () => {
  it('loads a copy, saved, with no history', () => {
    const doc = fixture('blank');
    const store = createEditorStore();
    store.getState().load('wf-1', doc, 2);
    const s = store.getState();
    expect(s.doc).toEqual(doc);
    expect(s.doc).not.toBe(doc);
    expect(s).toMatchObject({ workflowId: 'wf-1', revision: 2, saveState: 'saved', selection: null, past: [], future: [] });
  });

  it('after unload, nothing can be edited (an edit made while the screen goes away is refused, not lost)', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'Closing' });
    const listener = vi.fn();
    const off = onDocChange(listener, store);
    store.getState().unload();
    expect(store.getState()).toMatchObject({ workflowId: null, doc: null, past: [], future: [], selection: null, saveState: 'saved' });
    expect(store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'AfterClose' })).toEqual({ refused: 'notFound' });
    store.getState().undo();
    store.getState().redo();
    expect(store.getState().doc).toBeNull();
    expect(listener).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    off();
  });

  it('runs a command: new doc, history entry, unsaved', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    const result = store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'Shipped' });
    expect(result).toBeUndefined();
    const s = store.getState();
    expect(getStage(s.doc!, 'st_released')?.name).toBe('Shipped');
    expect(s.saveState).toBe('unsaved');
    expect(s.past.map((p) => p.name)).toEqual(['stage.rename']);
  });

  it('a refusal changes nothing; a no-op adds no history', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    const before = store.getState().doc;
    expect(store.getState().run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_request_form' })).toEqual({ refused: 'startStage' });
    expect(store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'Released' })).toBeUndefined();
    expect(store.getState().doc).toBe(before);
    expect(store.getState().past).toEqual([]);
    expect(store.getState().saveState).toBe('saved');
  });

  it('refuses when nothing is loaded', () => {
    expect(createEditorStore().getState().run('stage.add', { kind: 'form' })).toEqual({ refused: 'notFound' });
  });

  it('undo and redo round-trip a series of commands', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    const original = store.getState().doc;
    const { run } = store.getState();
    const stage = createdId(run('stage.add', { kind: 'approval', insertOn: 'ar_da_approve' }));
    run('task.add', { stage: stage as 'st_x' });
    run('button.add', { task: 'tk_development', label: 'Hold' });
    run('arrow.connect', { from: 'st_development', to: 'st_rejected' });
    run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_domain_approval' });
    const final = store.getState().doc;
    expect(store.getState().past).toHaveLength(5);

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) store.getState().undo();
    expect(store.getState().doc).toEqual(original);
    expect(store.getState().future).toHaveLength(5);
    store.getState().undo(); // nothing left: no change
    expect(store.getState().doc).toEqual(original);

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) store.getState().redo();
    expect(store.getState().doc).toEqual(final);
    assertWellFormed(store.getState().doc!);
    store.getState().redo(); // nothing left
    expect(store.getState().doc).toEqual(final);
  });

  it('undo gives back exactly the same document, key order too, after a delete that removed keys', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    const before = JSON.stringify(store.getState().doc);
    const { run } = store.getState();
    run('column.delete', { column: 'col_approvers' }); // removes a key from the middle of each row's cells
    run('question.setKind', { question: 'q_risk', kind: 'text' }); // drops the sample answer
    run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_domain_approval' });
    const after = JSON.stringify(store.getState().doc);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) store.getState().undo();
    expect(JSON.stringify(store.getState().doc)).toBe(before);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) store.getState().redo();
    expect(JSON.stringify(store.getState().doc)).toBe(after);
  });

  it('a new command clears redo', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'A' });
    store.getState().undo();
    expect(store.getState().future).toHaveLength(1);
    store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'B' });
    expect(store.getState().future).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keeps at most HISTORY_LIMIT undo steps', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    for (let i = 0; i < HISTORY_LIMIT + 5; i++) store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: `R${i}` });
    expect(store.getState().past).toHaveLength(HISTORY_LIMIT);
  });

  it('selection: set, kept while it exists, cleared when its item goes', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    store.getState().select({ item: 'st_rejected', part: 'name' });
    store.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_rejected', name: 'No' });
    expect(store.getState().selection).toEqual({ item: 'st_rejected', part: 'name' });
    store.getState().run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_rejected' });
    expect(store.getState().selection).toBeNull();
    store.getState().select(null);
    expect(store.getState().selection).toBeNull();
  });

  it('save state for the autosave wiring', () => {
    const store = fresh();
    store.getState().setSaveState('saving');
    expect(store.getState()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saving', revision: 4 });
    store.getState().setSaveState('saved', 5);
    expect(store.getState()).toMatchObject({ saveState: 'saved', revision: 5 });
    store.getState().setSaveState('conflict');
    expect(store.getState().saveState).toBe('conflict');
  });

  it('onDocChange fires on run, undo and redo, not on load or refusals', () => {
    const store = createEditorStore({ random: seededRandom(2) });
    const listener = vi.fn();
    const stop = onDocChange(listener, store);
    store.getState().load('wf-1', fixture('blank'), 1);
    expect(listener).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    store.getState().run('stage.add', { kind: 'work' });
    store.getState().run('stage.delete', { stage: 'st_request_form' });
    store.getState().undo();
    store.getState().redo();
    store.getState().select({ item: 'st_done' });
    expect(listener.mock.calls.map((c) => c[1].lastChange)).toEqual([
      { name: 'stage.add', via: 'run' },
      { name: 'stage.add', via: 'undo' },
      { name: 'stage.add', via: 'redo' },
    ]);
    store.getState().load('wf-2', fixture('blank'), 1);
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    stop();
    store.getState().run('stage.add', { kind: 'work' });
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });
});
===\nfrontend/src/model/store.ts\n===
/**
 * The editor's one store (docs/08, F2): the draft being edited, its revision and save state, what
 * is selected, and undo/redo. Every edit goes through `run(name, args)`, which applies a named
 * command (./commands/registry.ts) and keeps the document before and after it, so undo and redo give
 * back exactly the same document (same key order too), not just an equal one. The documents are
 * immutable and share their unchanged parts, so keeping both costs little. No service calls here:
 * the app wires autosave through `onDocChange`, and reports the save back with `setSaveState`.
 */
import { create, type StoreApi, type UseBoundStore } from 'zustand';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Location } from '@/contract';
import type { Random } from './ids';
import { find } from './lookup';
import { applyCommand, type ArgsOf, type CommandName, type Refusal, type ResultOf } from './commands/registry';

export type SaveState = 'saved' | 'unsaved' | 'saving' | 'conflict';

/** What is selected: an item (stage, arrow, task, question, action ...) and maybe a part of it; null for nothing. */
export type Selection = Location | null;

export interface HistoryEntry {
  /** The command's name, e.g. 'stage.add' (for an "Undo add stage" label). */
  name: CommandName;
  /** The document before the command (what undo gives back). */
  before: AuthoredWorkflow;
  /** The document after it (what redo gives back). */
  after: AuthoredWorkflow;
}

/** What last changed the document; null after load. */
export interface LastChange {
  name: CommandName;
  via: 'run' | 'undo' | 'redo';
}

export interface EditorState {
  /** The server's workflow ID (not the document's own `id`). */
  workflowId: string | null;
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow | null;
  /** The draft revision the document is based on (authoring-api.md: +1 on every save). */
  revision: number;
  saveState: SaveState;
  selection: Selection;
  past: HistoryEntry[];
  future: HistoryEntry[];
  lastChange: LastChange | null;

  /** Opens a draft: replaces the document, clears selection and history, marks it saved. */
  load(workflowId: string, doc: AuthoredWorkflow, revision: number): void;
  /**
   * Closes the draft: no document, no history, nothing selected. After it `run`, `undo` and `redo`
   * change nothing (`run` is refused 'notFound'), so an edit made while the screen goes away cannot
   * be applied and then never saved. The session calls it when the workflow is closed.
   */
  unload(): void;
  /** Applies a command. Returns its result, or its refusal (nothing changed then). */
  run<K extends CommandName>(name: K, args: ArgsOf<K>): ResultOf<K> | Refusal;
  undo(): void;
  redo(): void;
  select(selection: Selection): void;
  /** For the autosave wiring: 'saving' before a save, 'saved' with the new revision after, 'conflict' on a stale save. */
  setSaveState(state: SaveState, revision?: number): void;
}

/** Undo keeps at most this many steps. */
export const HISTORY_LIMIT = 200;

export interface EditorStoreOptions {
  /** Randomness for new IDs (tests pass a seeded one). */
  random?: Random;
}

/** The selection, or null when what it points at is gone. */
function keepSelection(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, selection: Selection): Selection {
  return selection && find(doc, selection.item) ? selection : null;
}

/** Creates an editor store. The app uses the one below; tests make their own. */
export function createEditorStore(options: EditorStoreOptions = {}): UseBoundStore<StoreApi<EditorState>> {
  const random = options.random ?? Math.random;
  return create<EditorState>()((set, get) => ({
    workflowId: null,
    doc: null,
    revision: 0,
    saveState: 'saved',
    selection: null,
    past: [],
    future: [],
    lastChange: null,

    load(workflowId, doc, revision) {
      set({
        workflowId,
        doc: structuredClone(doc),
        revision,
        saveState: 'saved',
        selection: null,
        past: [],
        future: [],
        lastChange: null,
      });
    },

    unload() {
      set({
        workflowId: null,
        doc: null,
        revision: 0,
        saveState: 'saved',
        selection: null,
        past: [],
        future: [],
        lastChange: null,
      });
    },

    run(name, args) {
      const { doc, past, selection } = get();
      if (!doc) return { refused: 'notFound' };
      const applied = applyCommand(doc, name, args, random);
      if (!applied.ok) return applied.refusal;
      if (applied.patches.length > 0) {
        set({
          doc: applied.doc,
          past: [...past, { name, before: doc, after: applied.doc }].slice(-HISTORY_LIMIT),
          future: [],
          saveState: 'unsaved',
          selection: keepSelection(applied.doc, selection),
          lastChange: { name, via: 'run' },
        });
      }
      return applied.result;
    },

    undo() {
      const { doc, past, future, selection } = get();
      const entry = past[past.length - 1];
      if (!doc || !entry) return;
      const next = entry.before;
      set({
        doc: next,
        past: past.slice(0, -1),
        future: [entry, ...future],
        saveState: 'unsaved',
        selection: keepSelection(next, selection),
        lastChange: { name: entry.name, via: 'undo' },
      });
    },

    redo() {
      const { doc, past, future, selection } = get();
      const entry = future[0];
      if (!doc || !entry) return;
      const next = entry.after;
      set({
        doc: next,
        past: [...past, entry],
        future: future.slice(1),
        saveState: 'unsaved',
        selection: keepSelection(next, selection),
        lastChange: { name: entry.name, via: 'redo' },
      });
    },

    select(selection) {
      set({ selection });
    },

    setSaveState(saveState, revision) {
      set(revision === undefined ? { saveState } : { saveState, revision });
    },
  }));
}

/** The editor's store, as a hook: `useEditor((s) => s.doc)`; also `useEditor.getState().run(...)`. */
export const useEditor = createEditorStore();

/**
 * Calls `listener` after every edit, undo or redo (not after load), with the new document.
 * For autosave. Returns the unsubscribe function.
 */
export function onDocChange(
  listener: (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, state: EditorState) => void,
  store: UseBoundStore<StoreApi<EditorState>> = useEditor,
): () => void {
  return store.subscribe((state, previous) => {
    if (state.doc && state.doc !== previous.doc && state.lastChange && state.workflowId === previous.workflowId) {
      listener(state.doc, state);
    }
  });
}
===\nfrontend/src/model/testkit.ts\n===
/**
 * Helpers for tests of commands (the model's and other builders'): a fresh copy of a fixture, and
 * `step`, which applies a command with a seeded ID source and fails the test if the result breaks
 * a structural rule. Not used by the app.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { fixtures, type FixtureName } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { seededRandom, type Random } from './ids';
import { structuralProblems } from './invariants';
import { applyCommand, isRefusal, type ArgsOf, type CommandName, type ResultOf } from './commands/registry';

/** A deep copy of a fixture, safe to change. */
export function fixture(name: FixtureName): AuthoredWorkflow {
  return structuredClone(fixtures[name]);
}

/** Throws with the problems listed when the document breaks a structural rule. */
export function assertWellFormed(doc: AuthoredWorkflow, after = ''): void {
  const problems = structuralProblems(doc);
  if (problems.length > 0) throw new Error(`Structural problems${after ? ` after ${after}` : ''}: ${JSON.stringify(problems)}`);
}

const defaultRandom = seededRandom(1);

/**
 * Applies a command that must not be refused, checks the structural rules and returns the new
 * document and the command's result.
 */
export function step<K extends CommandName>(
  doc: AuthoredWorkflow,
  name: K,
  args: ArgsOf<K>,
  random: Random = defaultRandom,
): { doc: AuthoredWorkflow; result: ResultOf<K> } {
  const applied = applyCommand(doc, name, args, random);
  if (!applied.ok) throw new Error(`${String(name)} was refused: ${applied.refusal.refused}`);
  assertWellFormed(applied.doc, String(name));
  return { doc: applied.doc, result: applied.result };
}

/** The new item's ID from a command that creates one. */
export function createdId(result: unknown): string {
  if (result && typeof result === 'object' && 'id' in result && typeof result.id === 'string' && !isRefusal(result)) return result.id;
  throw new Error(`Expected a created ID, got ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
}

/**
 * Every location walk produces follows the contract's list of reported parts (LOCATION_PARTS,
 * authored-format.ts).
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { LOCATION_PARTS, type ItemKind, type Location } from '@/contract';
import { FIXTURE_NAMES } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { allReferences, eachExpression, referencesTo, type Owner } from './walk';
import { fixture } from './testkit';

const segments = (part: string) => part.split('.');
const matches = (pattern: string, part: string): boolean => {
  const p = segments(pattern);
  const s = segments(part);
  return p.length === s.length && p.every((seg, i) => /^<.+>$/.test(seg) || seg === s[i]);
};

/**
 * True when `part` is a listed part of `kind`, or a listed part followed by deeper segments (a
 * clause or piece index, `readsAs` ...). A listed part that has listed parts under it (`when`,
 * `choices`, `whoIsAsked`) is a whole: anything under it must be listed itself.
 */
function partAllowed(kind: ItemKind, part: string): boolean {
  const listed: readonly string[] = LOCATION_PARTS[kind];
  for (const pattern of listed) {
    if (matches(pattern, part)) return true;
    const depth = segments(pattern).length;
    const head = segments(part).slice(0, depth).join('.');
    if (segments(part).length <= depth || !matches(pattern, head)) continue;
    const hasChildren = listed.some((other) => other !== pattern && other.startsWith(`${pattern}.`));
    if (!hasChildren) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Workflow-level places only the editor reports (never in a finding): sample answers and diagram positions. */
const editorOnly = (owner: Owner, location: Location) =>
  owner.kind === 'workflow' && /^(sampleRequest\.answers|diagram\.positions)\./.test(location.part ?? '');

describe('locations follow LOCATION_PARTS', () => {
  it('the rule itself', () => {
    expect(partAllowed('arrow', 'when.condition.0.right')).toBe(true);
    expect(partAllowed('arrow', 'when')).toBe(true);
    expect(partAllowed('arrow', 'when.0')).toBe(false);
    expect(partAllowed('question', 'choices.inputs.status')).toBe(true);
    expect(partAllowed('question', 'choices.other')).toBe(false);
    expect(partAllowed('action', 'message.1')).toBe(true);
    expect(partAllowed('task', 'whoIsAsked.ifEmptyUse')).toBe(true);
    expect(partAllowed('value', 'name')).toBe(false);
  });

  for (const name of FIXTURE_NAMES) {
    it(`every slot and reference in ${name}`, () => {
      const doc = fixture(name);
      const wrong: string[] = [];
      const check = (owner: Owner, location: Location) => {
        if (location.part === undefined || editorOnly(owner, location)) return;
        if (!partAllowed(owner.kind, location.part)) wrong.push(`${owner.kind} ${location.item}.${location.part}`);
      };
      eachExpression(doc, (_node, at) => check(at.owner, at.location));
      for (const ref of allReferences(doc)) check(ref.owner, ref.location);
      expect(wrong).toEqual([]);
    });
  }

  it('names the exact part of an arrow and of a list choice', () => {
    const doc = fixture('change-request');
    expect(referencesTo(doc, 'btn_da_reject').find((r) => r.how === 'arrowButton')?.location).toEqual({ item: 'ar_da_reject', part: 'when.button' });
    expect(referencesTo(doc, 'ls_domains').map((r) => r.location)).toEqual([{ item: 'q_primary_domain', part: 'choices.list' }]);
    const column = referencesTo(doc, 'col_domain').find((r) => r.how === 'column' && r.owner.kind === 'question');
    expect(column?.location).toEqual({ item: 'q_primary_domain', part: 'choices.shownColumn' });
  });
});
