/**
 * "Add sample requests" for the development host over HTTP (development only, never automatic):
 * as the seeded people (engine/DEV-HOST.md), over the same HTTP services the screens use, it starts
 * a few requests of the sample `change-request` so the lists are not empty:
 *
 * - finished: Priya starts it, Marcus approves it, Diego marks it released;
 * - in development: Priya starts it, Marcus approves it (the mock Jira makes the issue);
 * - waiting for approval: Priya starts it;
 * - nobody to ask: Lena starts one for Identity, whose approvers are Lena alone, who may not answer her own;
 * - an action that failed (only with the development controls): the mock Jira's next call fails;
 * - a refused start (only with the development controls): the mock Helpdesk sends a ticket for a
 *   service the service catalog does not know.
 *
 * The development host signs one person in for everyone (`PUT /session`): the person signed in
 * before is signed in again at the end.
 */
import type { ButtonId, QuestionId } from '@/contract';
import type { Answers, RequestId, Result, RuntimeService, SampleRequestKind, SampleRequestsReport, Services, TaskInstanceId } from '../types';

type Deps = Pick<Services, 'runtime' | 'session'> & { dev: Pick<NonNullable<Services['dev']>, 'mocks' | 'sendSample'> };

const WORKFLOW = 'change-request';
const SUBMIT = 'btn_rf_submit' as ButtonId;
const APPROVE = 'btn_da_approve' as ButtonId;
const RELEASED = 'btn_dev_mark_released' as ButtonId;
const user = (slug: string) => ({ type: 'user' as const, id: `dir-user-${slug}` });

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function must<T>(r: Result<T>): T {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.errors.map((e) => e.code).join(', '));
  return r.value;
}

/** The task the signed-in person is asked in this request, once the engine has opened it (calls and reads run after the turn). */
async function taskOf(runtime: RuntimeService, requestId: RequestId, timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<TaskInstanceId> {
  const until = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < until) {
    const page = must(await runtime.myTasks({ limit: 200 }));
    const task = page.items.find((t) => t.requestId === requestId);
    if (task) return task.task;
    await sleep(250);
  }
  throw new Error(`no task in ${requestId}`);
}

export async function addSampleRequests(deps: Deps, now: () => number = Date.now): Promise<SampleRequestsReport> {
  const { runtime, session } = deps;
  const report: SampleRequestsReport = { added: [], skipped: [] };
  const before = await session.whoAmI();
  const token = (n: number) => `sample-${now().toString(36)}-${n}`;
  let n = 0;
  const as = async (slug: string) => must(await session.signInAs(user(slug)));

  const start = async (slug: string, title: string, domain: string, date: string) => {
    await as(slug);
    const answers = { q_title: title, q_primary_domain: domain, q_planned_release_date: date, q_risk: 'ch_risk_medium' } as unknown as Answers;
    n += 1;
    return must(await runtime.start({ workflow: WORKFLOW, button: SUBMIT, answers, clientToken: token(n) }));
  };
  const approve = async (requestId: RequestId) => {
    await as('marcus-lee');
    const task = await taskOf(runtime, requestId);
    const leads = must(await runtime.choices({ form: { requestId, task }, question: 'q_eng_lead' as QuestionId, answers: {} }));
    const lead = leads.choices.find((c) => c.label === 'Diego Santos') ?? leads.choices[0];
    if (!lead) throw new Error('no lead to choose');
    must(await runtime.act({ requestId, task, button: APPROVE, answers: { q_eng_lead: lead.value } as unknown as Answers }));
  };
  const step = async (kind: SampleRequestKind, run: () => Promise<string | undefined>) => {
    try {
      const readableId = await run();
      report.added.push({ kind, ...(readableId ? { readableId } : {}) });
    } catch {
      report.skipped.push({ kind, why: 'failed' });
    }
  };

  try {
    await step('finished', async () => {
      const r = await start('priya-raman', 'Rotate the payment gateway keys', 'row_payments', '2026-12-02');
      await approve(r.requestId);
      await as('diego-santos');
      const task = await taskOf(runtime, r.requestId);
      must(await runtime.act({ requestId: r.requestId, task, button: RELEASED, answers: { q_release_notes: 'Keys rotated.' } as unknown as Answers }));
      return r.readableId;
    });
    await step('inDevelopment', async () => {
      const r = await start('priya-raman', 'Raise the checkout rate limit', 'row_payments', '2026-12-09');
      await approve(r.requestId);
      // Wait until Jira has made the issue and Diego is asked, so the next sample's Jira call is its own.
      await as('diego-santos');
      await taskOf(runtime, r.requestId);
      return r.readableId;
    });

    const controls = await deps.dev.mocks?.offered().catch(() => false);
    if (controls && deps.dev.mocks) {
      const mocks = deps.dev.mocks;
      await step('actionFailed', async () => {
        const r = await start('priya-raman', 'Move payment logs to the new store', 'row_payments', '2026-12-16');
        await mocks.set('jira', { failNext: true });
        await approve(r.requestId);
        return r.readableId;
      });
    } else {
      report.skipped.push({ kind: 'actionFailed', why: 'notOffered' });
    }

    await step('waitingForApproval', async () => (await start('priya-raman', 'Add a second payments region', 'row_payments', '2027-01-13')).readableId);
    await step('nobodyToAsk', async () => (await start('lena-fischer', 'Rotate the identity signing keys', 'row_identity', '2026-12-09')).readableId);

    if (controls) {
      await step('refusedStart', async () => {
        const answer = await deps.dev.sendSample('helpdesk.ticketCreated@1' as never, {
          key: `HD-${String(now()).slice(-5)}`,
          title: 'Turn on the new search',
          category: 'Service change',
          service: { stored: 'svc-search', label: 'Search' },
        });
        const refused = answer.ok && answer.value.results.some((x) => x.result === 'refused');
        if (!refused) throw new Error('not refused');
        return undefined;
      });
    } else {
      report.skipped.push({ kind: 'refusedStart', why: 'notOffered' });
    }
  } finally {
    await session.signInAs(before.ref).catch(() => undefined);
  }
  return report;
}
===\nfrontend/src/services/index.ts\n===
/**
 * The services the frontend calls (F4): the engine's real core (`core.ts`, over `@workflow/core`:
 * parse, check, facts, evaluate, form state, diff, compile), and the in-browser
 * stand-in for the server: its data side (authoring, whose publish is core's `compile`; catalogue,
 * directory, session; kept in localStorage) and the live side from `standin/runtime.ts` (the
 * request pages' runtime and the development host's `dev`), which runs every request on the
 * engine (`standin/runs.ts`) and keeps it in the same store as the moves the engine ran.
 * With `VITE_ENGINE_URL` set, the server side is instead the engine's real server over HTTP
 * (`http/`); `core` stays in the browser. Screens get the services through `useServices()` under
 * a `ServicesProvider`.
 */
import type { Services, Timestamp } from './types';
import { createAuthoring, type RequestCounts } from './standin/authoring';
import { catalogue, SAMPLE_CATALOGUE } from './standin/catalogue';
import { core } from './core';
import { directory } from './standin/directory';
import { createLive, requestCountsOf } from './standin/runtime';
import { seedState } from './standin/seed';
import { withSampleRequests } from './standin/seed-requests';
import { createSession } from './standin/session';
import { createHttpServices } from './http';
import { createStore, type KeyValueStorage, type StandinStore } from './standin/store';

export type * from './types';
/** The engine core's version the browser runs (`@workflow/core`'s package version; also `core.meta()`). */
export { coreVersion } from '@workflow/core';
export { ServicesProvider, useServices } from './context';
export { createHttpServices, CannotReachEngine } from './http';

export interface StandinOptions {
  /** Where to keep the data. Absent: memory only (tests). */
  storage?: KeyValueStorage;
  now?: () => Timestamp;
  requestCounts?: (workflow: string) => RequestCounts;
  /** Start with the sample requests in progress (the development app). Absent: no requests (tests). */
  sampleRequests?: boolean;
}

/** A complete set of stand-in services over a store of its own. */
export function createStandinServices(options: StandinOptions = {}): { services: Services; store: StandinStore } {
  const seed = options.sampleRequests ? () => withSampleRequests(seedState()) : seedState;
  const store = createStore({ seed, ...(options.storage ? { storage: options.storage } : {}) });
  const live = createLive({ store, catalogue: SAMPLE_CATALOGUE, ...(options.now ? { now: options.now } : {}) });
  const services: Services = {
    core,
    authoring: createAuthoring({
      store,
      check: (workflow, cat) => core.check(workflow, cat),
      compile: (workflow, cat, options) => core.compile(workflow, cat, options),
      parse: (doc) => core.parse(doc),
      catalogue: SAMPLE_CATALOGUE,
      meta: () => core.meta(),
      now: options.now ?? (() => new Date().toISOString()),
      requestCounts: options.requestCounts ?? requestCountsOf(store),
    }),
    runtime: live.runtime,
    catalogue,
    directory,
    session: createSession(store),
    dev: { ...live.dev, resetSampleData: () => store.reset() },
  };
  return { services, store };
}

function browserStorage(): KeyValueStorage | undefined {
  try {
    return typeof localStorage === 'undefined' ? undefined : localStorage;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * The one place that chooses the implementation: with `VITE_ENGINE_URL` set (e.g.
 * `http://127.0.0.1:8787`, the engine's development host) the server side is the engine over HTTP;
 * without it, the in-browser stand-in, exactly as before. `core` runs in the browser either way.
 */
const engineUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_ENGINE_URL as string | undefined)?.trim() || undefined;

function chosen(): { services: Services; reset?: () => void } {
  if (engineUrl) return { services: createHttpServices(engineUrl) };
  const standin = createStandinServices({ sampleRequests: true, ...(browserStorage() ? { storage: browserStorage() } : {}) });
  return { services: standin.services, reset: () => standin.store.reset() };
}

const app = chosen();

/** The services the app uses. */
export const services: Services = app.services;
/** Starts the stand-in's data again from the seed (for the development host); does nothing over HTTP. */
export const resetStandin = (): void => app.reset?.();

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow } from '@/contract';
import { fixtures } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import type { CoreMeta, Finding, Result } from '../types';
import { createAuthoring, DRAFT_LIMIT } from './authoring';
import { SAMPLE_CATALOGUE } from './catalogue';
import { seedState } from './seed';
import { compile } from '@workflow/core';
import { createSession } from './session';
import { createStore } from './store';

const META: CoreMeta = { coreVersion: '1.0.0', definitionFormatVersion: 1, authoredFormatVersions: { min: 0, max: 0 } };
const TODO: Finding = { code: 'item.partMissing', severity: 'todo', location: { item: 'ar_rf_submit', part: 'goTo' }, params: {} };
const WORTH: Finding = { code: 'stage.unreachable', severity: 'worthKnowing', location: { item: 'st_done' }, params: {} };
/** Publish is core's own compile, in publish mode. */
const COMPILE = { compile: async (...args: Parameters<typeof compile>) => compile(...args) };

function setup() {
  const store = createStore({ seed: seedState });
  let findings: Finding[] = [];
  let tick = 0;
  let checkGate: Promise<void> | undefined;
  const authoring = createAuthoring({
    store,
    check: async () => {
      await checkGate;
      return findings;
    },
    catalogue: SAMPLE_CATALOGUE,
    ...COMPILE,
    meta: async () => META,
    now: () => `2026-11-20T10:00:${String(tick++).padStart(2, '0')}.000Z`,
  });
  return {
    store,
    authoring,
    session: createSession(store),
    setFindings: (f: Finding[]) => { findings = f; },
    gate: (p: Promise<void> | undefined) => { checkGate = p; },
  };
}

function value<T>(r: Result<T>): T {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${r.errors.map((e) => e.code).join(', ')}`);
  return r.value;
}

function errorOf<T>(r: Result<T>) {
  if (r.ok) throw new Error('expected a refusal');
  return r.errors[0]!;
}

const edited = (doc: AuthoredWorkflow, name: string): AuthoredWorkflow => ({
  ...doc, stages: doc.stages.map((s, i) => (i === 0 ? { ...s, name } : s)),
});

    expect(several.liveVersion).toBe(1);
    expect(several.draft.changedSinceLive).toBe(false);
    expect(several.openRequests).toBe(0);

describe('publish and versions', () => {
  it("refuses while core's compile finds anything To do, with its To do findings, whatever the save's counts said", async () => {
    const { authoring, setFindings } = setup();
    // The save's check (a stand-in here) says nothing is To do; publish asks core itself.
    setFindings([]);
    const draft = value(await authoring.getDraft('change-request'));
    const broken = structuredClone(draft.authored);
    const form = broken.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval');
    if (!form || form.kind === 'ending') throw new Error('no approval stage');
    form.arrows = form.arrows.map((a) => (a.id === 'ar_da_reject' ? { ...a, goTo: null } : a)) as typeof form.arrows;
    const saved = value(await authoring.saveDraft('change-request', { baseRevision: draft.revision, authored: broken }));
    const err = errorOf(await authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: saved.revision, coreVersion: META.coreVersion }));
    expect(err.code).toBe('has-todo');
    if (err.code === 'has-todo') {
      expect(err.params.findings.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(err.params.findings.every((f) => f.severity === 'todo')).toBe(true);
      expect(err.params.findings).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ location: expect.objectContaining({ item: 'ar_da_reject' }) }));
    }
    expect(value(await authoring.listVersions('change-request'))).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it("keeps the version as core's published version: the compiled definition and the catalogue it was compiled with", async () => {
    const { authoring, store } = setup();
    const draft = value(await authoring.getDraft('change-request'));
    value(await authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: draft.revision, coreVersion: META.coreVersion }));
    const v4 = store.get().workflows.find((w) => w.id === 'change-request')!.versions.at(-1)!;
    expect(v4.version).toBe(4);
    const again = compile(v4.authored, SAMPLE_CATALOGUE, { mode: 'publish', workflow: 'change-request', version: 4, compiler: META.coreVersion });
    expect(again.ok && v4.definition).toEqual(again.ok && again.published);
    expect(v4.catalogue).toEqual(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE);
  });

  it('refuses another core version and a stale revision', async () => {
    const { authoring } = setup();
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: 12, coreVersion: '0.9.0' }))).toMatchObject({
      code: 'core-version-mismatch', params: { serverCoreVersion: '1.0.0', serverFormatVersion: 1 },
    });
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: 11, coreVersion: '1.0.0' })).code).toBe('stale-revision');
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.publish('nope', { revision: 1, coreVersion: '1.0.0' })).code).toBe('not-found');
  });

  it("returns compile's worth-knowing findings", async () => {
    const { authoring } = setup();
    const draft = value(await authoring.getDraft('integrated-sample'));
    const published = value(await authoring.publish('integrated-sample', { revision: draft.revision, coreVersion: '1.0.0' }));
    expect(published).toEqual({
      version: 2,
      findings: [expect.objectContaining({ code: 'requester.mayBeEmpty', severity: 'worthKnowing', location: { item: 'tk_request_form', part: 'whoIsAsked' } })],
    });
  });

  it('stores a new immutable version with the source', async () => {
    const { authoring } = setup();
    const draft = value(await authoring.getDraft('change-request'));
    const saved = value(await authoring.saveDraft('change-request', { baseRevision: draft.revision, authored: edited(draft.authored, 'Ask') }));
    const published = value(await authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: saved.revision, coreVersion: '1.0.0' }));
    expect(published).toEqual({ version: 4, findings: [] });

    const versions = value(await authoring.listVersions('change-request'));
    expect(versions.map((v) => v.version)).toEqual([4, 3, 2, 1]);
    expect(versions[0]).toMatchObject({ fromRevision: saved.revision, coreVersion: '1.0.0', formatVersion: 1, openRequests: 0 });

    value(await authoring.saveDraft('change-request', { baseRevision: saved.revision, authored: edited(draft.authored, 'Later') }));
    const v4 = value(await authoring.getVersion('change-request', 4));
    expect(v4.authored.stages[0]!.name).toBe('Ask');
    expect(value(await authoring.getDraft('change-request')).basedOnVersion).toBe(4);
    expect(value(await authoring.getVersion('change-request', 3)).authored).toEqual(fixtures['change-request']);
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.getVersion('change-request', 9))).toMatchObject({ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'version' } });
  });

  it('publishes a new workflow as version 1', async () => {
    const { authoring } = setup();
    const draft = value(await authoring.createWorkflow({ name: 'New' }));
    expect(value(await authoring.publish(draft.workflow, { revision: 1, coreVersion: '1.0.0' })).version).toBe(1);
    const row = value(await authoring.listWorkflows()).find((r) => r.id === draft.workflow)!;
    expect(row.liveVersion).toBe(1);
    expect(row.draft.changedSinceLive).toBe(false);
  });

  it('refuses to publish for someone who is not an author', async () => {
    const { authoring, session } = setup();
    await session.signInAs({ type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-priya-raman' });
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: 12, coreVersion: '1.0.0' })).code).toBe('forbidden');
  });
});

describe('settings', () => {
  it('reads the seeded record and replaces it whole, saying who changed it last and when', async () => {
    const { authoring, session } = setup();
    const settings = value(await authoring.getSettings('integrated-sample'));
    expect(settings.name).toBe('Service change');
    expect(settings.stuckRequestsGoTo).toEqual([{ type: 'group', id: 'dir-group-platform-team' }]);
    expect(settings.changedBy).toEqual({ type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-sam-carter' });
    const next = { name: 'Renamed', description: 'd', authors: [...settings.authors, { type: 'user' as const, id: 'dir-user-marcus-lee' }] };
    const saved = value(await authoring.saveSettings('integrated-sample', next));
    expect(saved).toEqual({ ...next, changedBy: { type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-sam-carter' }, changedAt: expect.any(String) });
    expect(value(await authoring.getSettings('integrated-sample'))).toEqual(saved);
    // A record read back may be sent again: its changedBy and changedAt are the server's, not the caller's.
    await session.signInAs({ type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-marcus-lee' });
    const again = value(await authoring.saveSettings('integrated-sample', { ...saved, changedBy: { type: 'user', id: 'x' }, changedAt: 'then' } as never));

    expect(again.changedAt).not.toBe('then');
  });

  it('refuses to leave a workflow without authors, and an empty Stuck requests go to', async () => {
    const { authoring } = setup();
    const err = errorOf(await authoring.saveSettings('change-request', { name: 'x', description: '', authors: [] }));
    expect(err.code).toBe('last-author');
    const sam = { type: 'user' as const, id: 'dir-user-sam-carter' };
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.saveSettings('change-request', { name: 'x', description: '', authors: [sam], stuckRequestsGoTo: [] })))
      .toEqual({ code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/stuckRequestsGoTo', problem: 'empty' } });

      .toEqual({ code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/name', problem: 'type' } });
  });

  it('counts a member of an author group as an author, and lets an author remove themselves', async () => {
    const { authoring, session } = setup();
    const group = { type: 'group' as const, id: 'dir-group-payments-approvers' };
    value(await authoring.saveSettings('change-request', { name: 'Change request', description: '', authors: [group] }));
    expect(value(await authoring.getDraft('change-request')).may.edit).toBe(false);
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.saveSettings('change-request', { name: 'x', description: '', authors: [group] })).code).toBe('forbidden');
    await session.signInAs({ type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-hannah-okafor' });
    expect(value(await authoring.getDraft('change-request')).may).toEqual({ edit: true, publish: true, settings: true });
    expect(errorOf(await authoring.getSettings('nope')).code).toBe('not-found');
  });
});

  });

===\nfrontend/src/services/standin/authoring.ts\n===
/**
 * The stand-in's authoring server (authoring-api.md Draft 3): the workflows list (with the
 * triggers its "Starts when" bindings use), create, the one draft per workflow with a revision
 * (stale saves refused with the current draft), publish (core's `compile` in publish mode: refused
 * while anything is To do, else the version keeps core's compiled definition and the catalogue, as
 * core's `PublishedVersion`), immutable versions, and each workflow's Settings record with who
 * changed it last. To do counts come from the core's check at every save, as the server does. Its
 * eleventh operation, the catalogue, is `catalogue.ts`.
 *
 * The stand-in directory always answers, so `membership-unavailable` never occurs here.
 */
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, Catalogue, CatalogueRef } from '@/contract';
import { fixtures } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { blankWorkflow } from '@workflow/core';
import type {
  ApiError, AuthoringService, CompileOptions, CompileResult, CoreMeta, Draft, Finding, May, ParseResult, Person, Result, ServerWorkflowId, Settings,
  SettingsRead, Timestamp, VersionNumber, VersionSummary, WorkflowSummary,
} from '../types';
import { groupsOf } from './directory';
import { currentPerson } from './session';
import { copy, findWorkflow, liveVersion, sameJson, type StandinStore, type StoredWorkflow } from './store';

/** A draft is at most 1 MiB of JSON (authoring-api.md section 3). */
export const DRAFT_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024;

/** How many requests a workflow has, for the list and the versions. The stand-in runtime supplies it. */
export interface RequestCounts {
  open: number;
  stuck: number;
  openByVersion: Partial<Record<VersionNumber, number>>;
}

export interface AuthoringDeps {
  store: StandinStore;
  /** The core's check, run at every save for the draft's counts (the server runs the same core). */
  check(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue): Promise<Finding[]>;
  /** The core's compile, run at publish in publish mode: it refuses a draft with a To do, else it is the version's definition. */
  compile(workflow: AuthoredWorkflow, catalogue: Catalogue, options: CompileOptions): Promise<CompileResult>;
  /** The core's parse, run at save (`invalid-document`). Absent: every document with a supported format version is read. */
  parse?(doc: unknown): Promise<ParseResult>;
  catalogue: Catalogue;
  /** The server core's versions. */
  meta(): Promise<CoreMeta>;
  now(): Timestamp;
  requestCounts?(workflow: ServerWorkflowId): RequestCounts;
}

const NO_REQUESTS: RequestCounts = { open: 0, stuck: 0, openByVersion: {} };

function fail<T>(error: ApiError): Result<T> {
  return { ok: false, errors: [error] };
}

const notFound = (what: 'workflow' | 'version') => fail<never>({ code: 'not-found', params: { what } });
const forbidden = () => fail<never>({ code: 'forbidden', params: { need: 'author' } });
const badBody = (field: string, problem: 'missing' | 'type' | 'empty') => fail<never>({ code: 'invalid-body', params: { field, problem } });

/** A person is an author if listed, or in a listed group. Platform admins may do what authors may. */
export function mayOf(person: Person, settings: Settings): May {
  const groups = groupsOf(person.ref.id);
  const author = settings.authors.some((a) => (a.type === 'user' ? a.id === person.ref.id : groups.includes(a.id)));
  const may = author || person.platformAdmin;
  return { edit: may, publish: may, settings: may };
}

function draftOf(w: StoredWorkflow, may: May): Draft {
  const d = w.draft;
  return {
    workflow: w.id,
    revision: d.revision,
    authored: copy(d.authored),
    savedAt: d.savedAt,
    savedBy: d.savedBy,
    ...(d.basedOnVersion !== undefined ? { basedOnVersion: d.basedOnVersion } : {}),
    may,
  };
}

function summaryOf(v: StoredWorkflow['versions'][number], counts: RequestCounts): VersionSummary {
  return {
    version: v.version, publishedAt: v.publishedAt, publishedBy: v.publishedBy, fromRevision: v.fromRevision,
    coreVersion: v.coreVersion, formatVersion: v.formatVersion, openRequests: counts.openByVersion[v.version] ?? 0,
  };
}

function settingsReadOf(w: StoredWorkflow): SettingsRead {
  return { ...copy(w.settings), changedBy: copy(w.settingsChanged.by), changedAt: w.settingsChanged.at };
}

/** The catalogue triggers a document's "Starts when" bindings use, in document order, without repeats. */
export function triggersOf(doc: AuthoredWorkflow | undefined): CatalogueRef[] {
  const out: CatalogueRef[] = [];
  for (const b of doc?.start?.startsWhen ?? []) if (b.trigger && !out.includes(b.trigger)) out.push(b.trigger);
  return out;
}

/** Refuses, in the server's order after the revision, a document that is too large or in a format version the core does not read. */
function refuseUnreadable(authored: unknown): ApiError | undefined {
  if (typeof authored !== 'object' || authored === null || Array.isArray(authored)) {
    return { code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/authored', problem: 'type' } };
  }
  if (JSON.stringify(authored).length > DRAFT_LIMIT) return { code: 'too-large', params: { limit: DRAFT_LIMIT } };
  const version = (authored as { formatVersion?: unknown }).formatVersion;
  if (version === undefined) return { code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/authored/formatVersion', problem: 'missing' } };
  if (version !== 0) {
    return { code: 'authored-format-unsupported', params: { version: typeof version === 'number' ? version : -1, min: 0, max: 0 } };
  }
  return undefined;
}

function counts(findings: readonly Finding[]) {
  return {
    todo: findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo').length,
    worthKnowing: findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'worthKnowing').length,
  };
}

/** Whether a Settings body has the shape the server takes; the first problem, else undefined. */
function settingsProblem(settings: Settings): Result<never> | undefined {
  if (typeof settings.name !== 'string') return badBody('/name', 'type');
  if (settings.description !== undefined && typeof settings.description !== 'string') return badBody('/description', 'type');
  if (!Array.isArray(settings.authors)) return badBody('/authors', 'type');
  if (settings.stuckRequestsGoTo !== undefined) {
    if (!Array.isArray(settings.stuckRequestsGoTo)) return badBody('/stuckRequestsGoTo', 'type');
    if (settings.stuckRequestsGoTo.length === 0) return badBody('/stuckRequestsGoTo', 'empty');
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function createAuthoring(deps: AuthoringDeps): AuthoringService {
  const { store } = deps;
  const requestCounts = (id: ServerWorkflowId) => deps.requestCounts?.(id) ?? NO_REQUESTS;
  const me = () => currentPerson(store);
  const stale = (w: StoredWorkflow) =>
    fail<never>({ code: 'stale-revision', params: { currentRevision: w.draft.revision, draft: draftOf(w, mayOf(me(), w.settings)) } });

  return {
    async listWorkflows() {
      const person = me();
      const rows = store.get().workflows.map((w): WorkflowSummary => {
        const live = liveVersion(w);
        const reqs = requestCounts(w.id);
        return {
          id: w.id,
          name: w.settings.name,
          description: w.settings.description,
          ...(live ? { liveVersion: live.version } : {}),
          draft: {
            revision: w.draft.revision, savedAt: w.draft.savedAt, savedBy: w.draft.savedBy,
            changedSinceLive: !live || !sameJson(live.authored, w.draft.authored),
            todo: w.draft.todo, worthKnowing: w.draft.worthKnowing,
          },
          triggers: { live: triggersOf(live?.authored), draft: triggersOf(w.draft.authored) },
          openRequests: reqs.open,
          stuckRequests: reqs.stuck,
          may: mayOf(person, w.settings),
        };
      });
      rows.sort((a, b) => b.draft.savedAt.localeCompare(a.draft.savedAt));
      return { ok: true, value: rows };
    },

    async createWorkflow({ name, description }) {
      if (typeof name !== 'string') return badBody('/name', 'type');
      if (description !== undefined && typeof description !== 'string') return badBody('/description', 'type');
      const person = me();
      // Core's blank workflow (authoring-api.md operation 2): contract/fixtures/blank.authored.json, under its own ID.
      const authored = blankWorkflow({ id: fixtures.blank.id });
      const found = counts(await deps.check(authored, deps.catalogue));
      const at = deps.now();
      let created: StoredWorkflow | undefined;
      store.update((s) => {
        created = {
          id: `wf-${s.nextWorkflow}`,
          settings: { name, description: description ?? '', authors: [person.ref] },
          settingsChanged: { by: person.ref, at },
          draft: { revision: 1, authored, savedAt: at, savedBy: person.ref, ...found },
          versions: [],
        };
        s.nextWorkflow += 1;
        s.workflows.push(created);
      });
      const w = created as StoredWorkflow;
      return { ok: true, value: draftOf(w, mayOf(person, w.settings)) };
    },

    async getDraft(id) {
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      return w ? { ok: true, value: draftOf(w, mayOf(me(), w.settings)) } : notFound('workflow');
    },

    async saveDraft(id, { baseRevision, authored }) {
      const before = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      if (!before) return notFound('workflow');
      if (!mayOf(me(), before.settings).edit) return forbidden();
      if (baseRevision !== before.draft.revision) return stale(before);
      const unreadable = refuseUnreadable(authored);
      if (unreadable) return fail(unreadable);
      const parsed = deps.parse ? await deps.parse(authored) : undefined;
      if (parsed && !parsed.ok) return fail({ code: 'invalid-document', params: { problems: parsed.problems } });
      const doc = copy(authored);
      const found = counts(await deps.check(doc, deps.catalogue));
      // Another save may have landed while the check ran: test the revision again before writing.
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id) as StoredWorkflow;
      if (baseRevision !== w.draft.revision) return stale(w);
      const savedAt = deps.now();
      const savedBy = me().ref;
      const live = liveVersion(w);
      store.update(() => {
        w.draft = {
          revision: w.draft.revision + 1, authored: doc, savedAt, savedBy,
          ...(live ? { basedOnVersion: live.version } : {}), ...found,
        };
      });
      return { ok: true, value: { revision: w.draft.revision, savedAt, ...found } };
    },

    async publish(id, { revision, coreVersion }) {
      const before = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      if (!before) return notFound('workflow');
      if (!mayOf(me(), before.settings).publish) return forbidden();
      const meta = await deps.meta();
      if (coreVersion !== meta.coreVersion) {
        return fail({
          code: 'core-version-mismatch',
          params: { serverCoreVersion: meta.coreVersion, serverFormatVersion: meta.definitionFormatVersion },
        });
      }
      if (revision !== before.draft.revision) return stale(before);
      const authored = copy(before.draft.authored);
      const catalogue = copy(deps.catalogue);
      const version = (liveVersion(before)?.version ?? 0) + 1;
      // The engine's publish: core compiles the draft; a draft with a To do is refused with its To dos.
      const compiled = await deps.compile(authored, catalogue, { mode: 'publish', workflow: id, version, compiler: meta.coreVersion });
      if (!compiled.ok) {
        const todo = compiled.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'todo');
        return fail({ code: 'has-todo', params: { findings: todo.length > 0 ? todo : compiled.findings } });
      }
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id) as StoredWorkflow;
      if (revision !== w.draft.revision) return stale(w);
      if ((liveVersion(w)?.version ?? 0) + 1 !== version) return stale(w);
      store.update(() => {
        w.versions.push({
          version, publishedAt: deps.now(), publishedBy: me().ref, fromRevision: revision,
          coreVersion: meta.coreVersion, formatVersion: meta.definitionFormatVersion, authored,
          definition: compiled.published, catalogue,
        });
      });
      return { ok: true, value: { version, findings: compiled.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'worthKnowing') } };
    },

    async listVersions(id) {
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      if (!w) return notFound('workflow');
      const reqs = requestCounts(id);
      return { ok: true, value: [...w.versions].sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version).map((v) => summaryOf(v, reqs)) };
    },

    async getVersion(id, version) {
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      if (!w) return notFound('workflow');
      const v = w.versions.find((x) => x.version === version);
      if (!v) return notFound('version');
      return { ok: true, value: { ...summaryOf(v, requestCounts(id)), authored: copy(v.authored) } };
    },

    async getSettings(id) {
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      return w ? { ok: true, value: settingsReadOf(w) } : notFound('workflow');
    },

    async saveSettings(id, settings) {
      const w = findWorkflow(store.get(), id);
      if (!w) return notFound('workflow');
      if (!mayOf(me(), w.settings).settings) return forbidden();
      const problem = settingsProblem(settings);
      if (problem) return problem;
      if (settings.authors.length === 0) return fail({ code: 'last-author', params: {} });
      // A SettingsRead sent back keeps `changedBy` and `changedAt` out: they are the server's.
      const next: Settings = copy({
        name: settings.name,
        description: settings.description ?? '',
        authors: settings.authors,
        ...(settings.stuckRequestsGoTo ? { stuckRequestsGoTo: settings.stuckRequestsGoTo } : {}),
      });
      const changed = { by: me().ref, at: deps.now() };
      store.update(() => {
        w.settings = next;
        w.settingsChanged = changed;
      });
      return { ok: true, value: settingsReadOf(w) };
    },

    getMeta: async () => ({ ok: true, value: copy(await deps.meta()) }),
  };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, CatalogueEntry, Field, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';
import { FIXTURE_NAMES, fixtureCatalogue, fixtures } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { catalogue, SAMPLE_CATALOGUE } from './catalogue';

const entry = (id: string): CatalogueEntry | undefined => SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries.find((e) => e.id === id);
const ids = (fields: Field[]) => fields.map((f) => f.id);

/** Every `{ sentField }` name anywhere in a JSON value. */
function sentFields(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.flatMap(sentFields);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return [];
  const own = 'sentField' in value ? [String((value as { sentField: unknown }).sentField)] : [];
  return [...own, ...Object.values(value).flatMap(sentFields)];
}

function working(doc: AuthoredWorkflow): WorkingStage[] {
  return doc.stages.filter((s): s is WorkingStage => s.kind !== 'ending');
}

describe('the sample catalogue', () => {
  it('is the contract\'s own mock catalogue (contract/fixtures/catalogue.json), not a copy', () => {
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE).toBe(fixtureCatalogue);
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.version).toMatch(/^cat1\./);
  });

  it('has the seven connections of the connected sample, all ready', () => {
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.connections.map((c) => c.label)).toEqual([
      'Directory', 'Service catalog', 'Helpdesk', 'Jira', 'Deploy pipeline', 'Email and Slack', 'Reporting',
    ]);
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.connections.every((c) => c.status === 'ready')).toBe(true);
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries.every((e) => e.status === 'ready')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('names the directory connection, which declares the members read and the group-members data source', () => {
    const dir = SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.directoryConnection;
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.connections.some((c) => c.id === dir)).toBe(true);
    const own = SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries.filter((e) => e.connection === dir).map((e) => [e.name, e.kind]);
    expect(own).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([['membersOf', 'operation'], ['groupMembers', 'dataSource']]));
  });

  it('gives the Helpdesk ticket the "service" field the integrated sample\'s binding reads', () => {
    const ticket = entry('helpdesk.ticketCreated@1');
    expect(ticket?.kind).toBe('trigger');
    if (ticket?.kind !== 'trigger') return;
    expect(ticket.event.find((f) => f.id === 'service')).toMatchObject({ kind: 'choiceFromConnection', required: true });
    expect(ticket.sample.event.service).toEqual({ stored: 'svc-payments-api', label: 'Payments API' });
  });

  it('names every entry <connection>.<name>@<version> after a connection it has, once', () => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (const e of SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries) {
      expect(e.id).toMatch(/^[a-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+@\d+$/);
      expect(e.id.split('.')[0]).toBe(e.connection);
      expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.connections.some((c) => c.id === e.connection)).toBe(true);
      expect(seen.has(e.id)).toBe(false);
      seen.add(e.id);
      expect(e.label).not.toBe('');
    }
  });

  it('gives each operation a sort, failure codes, a sample within its fields, and a default for doing it again', () => {
    for (const e of SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries) {
      if (e.kind !== 'operation') continue;
      expect(e.failureCodes.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const k of Object.keys(e.sample.input)) expect(ids(e.input)).toContain(k);
      for (const k of Object.keys(e.sample.result)) expect(ids(e.result)).toContain(k);
      for (const f of e.input.filter((x) => x.required)) expect(Object.keys(e.sample.input)).toContain(f.id);
      // Contract Draft 3: written out for write and await, null exactly for read; `await` likewise.
      if (e.sort === 'read') expect(e.onRepeat).toBeNull();
      else expect(e.onRepeat).toMatch(/^(once|again)$/);
      expect(e.await === null).toBe(e.sort !== 'await');
    }
    for (const e of SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries) {
      if (e.kind === 'dataSource') for (const item of e.sample.items) for (const k of Object.keys(item)) expect(ids(e.item)).toContain(k);
      if (e.kind === 'trigger') for (const k of Object.keys(e.sample.event)) expect(ids(e.event)).toContain(k);
    }
  });

  it('has Reporting as the one connection that is told what happened', () => {
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries.filter((e) => e.kind === 'eventSink').map((e) => e.connection)).toEqual(['reporting']);
  });

  it('has jira.createIssue@1 exactly as the contract states', () => {
    const jira = entry('jira.createIssue@1');
    expect(jira?.kind).toBe('operation');
    if (jira?.kind !== 'operation') return;
    expect(jira.input.map((f) => [f.id, f.kind, f.required])).toEqual([
      ['project', 'text', true], ['summary', 'text', true], ['description', 'longText', false], ['assignee', 'person', false],
    ]);
    expect(ids(jira.result)).toEqual(['key', 'url']);
  });

  it('resolves every catalogue reference and field id used in the fixtures', () => {
    let checked = 0;
    for (const name of FIXTURE_NAMES) {
      const doc = fixtures[name];
      for (const stage of working(doc)) {
        for (const action of [...stage.whenThisStageStarts, ...stage.afterTheyRespond]) {
          if (action.type !== 'useConnection' || !action.operation) continue;
          const op = entry(action.operation);
          expect(op?.kind, action.operation).toBe('operation');
          if (op?.kind !== 'operation') continue;
          for (const k of Object.keys(action.inputs)) expect(ids(op.input), `${action.id} input ${k}`).toContain(k);
          for (const k of Object.keys(action.saveResults)) expect(ids(op.result), `${action.id} result ${k}`).toContain(k);
          checked++;
        }
        for (const task of stage.tasks) {
          for (const page of task.form.pages) {
            for (const item of page.items) {
              if (item.type !== 'question' || item.choices?.from !== 'source' || !item.choices.source) continue;
              const source = entry(item.choices.source);
              expect(source?.kind, item.choices.source).toBe('dataSource');
              if (source?.kind !== 'dataSource') continue;
              for (const k of Object.keys(item.choices.inputs)) expect(ids(source.input)).toContain(k);
              for (const f of [item.choices.labelField, item.choices.storedField]) if (f) expect(ids(source.item)).toContain(f);
              checked++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      for (const binding of doc.start.startsWhen) {
        if (!binding.trigger) continue;
        const trigger = entry(binding.trigger);
        expect(trigger?.kind, binding.trigger).toBe('trigger');
        if (trigger?.kind !== 'trigger') continue;
        for (const f of sentFields(binding)) expect(ids(trigger.event), `sent field ${f}`).toContain(f.split('.')[0]);
        checked++;
      }
    }
    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(6);
  });

  it('hands out copies through the service', async () => {
    const a = await catalogue.getCatalogue();
    expect(a.ok && a.value).toEqual(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE);
    if (a.ok) a.value.connections.pop();
    expect(SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.connections).toHaveLength(7);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { FIXTURE_NAMES, fixtureRecords, fixtures } from '@/contract/fixtures';
import { directory, entryFor, GROUPS, groupsOf, lookup, membersOf, PEOPLE, search } from './directory';

/** Every `{ directoryId }` anywhere in a JSON value. */
function directoryIds(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.flatMap(directoryIds);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return [];
  const own = 'directoryId' in value ? [String((value as { directoryId: unknown }).directoryId)] : [];
  return [...own, ...Object.values(value).flatMap(directoryIds)];
}

describe('the demo directory', () => {
  it('has the demo people', () => {
    expect(PEOPLE.map((p) => p.label)).toEqual([
      'Priya Raman', 'Marcus Lee', 'Hannah Okafor', 'Diego Santos', 'Mei Tanaka', 'Sam Carter', 'Tom Becker', 'Lena Fischer', 'Arjun Mehta',
    ]);
  });

  it('knows every person and group the fixtures and their records name', () => {
    const ids = [
      ...FIXTURE_NAMES.flatMap((n) => directoryIds(fixtures[n])),
      ...FIXTURE_NAMES.flatMap((n) => fixtureRecords[n].stuckRequestsGoTo.map((r) => r.id)),
    ];
    for (const id of new Set(ids)) {
      const type = id.startsWith('dir-group-') ? 'group' : 'user';
      expect(entryFor({ type, id }), id).toBeDefined();
    }
  });

  });
});

describe('search', () => {
  it('finds by part of the name in any case, sorted by name', () => {

    expect(search('lee', ['user']).map((e) => e.label)).toEqual(['Marcus Lee']);
  });

  it('keeps to the types asked for, and gives everything for empty text', () => {
    expect(search('security', ['user'])).toEqual([]);
    expect(search('', ['user', 'group'])).toHaveLength(PEOPLE.length + GROUPS.length);
    expect(search('example.com', ['user'])).toHaveLength(PEOPLE.length);
  });
});

  it('gives names in the order asked, leaving out what it does not know', () => {
    const found = lookup([
      { type: 'group', id: 'dir-group-security-team' },
      { type: 'user', id: 'dir-user-nobody' },

/**
 * The stand-in Directory: the demo's people and groups (editor-model.md section 8 and the
 * fixtures' directory IDs), with search, names for references, and a group's people.
 * Memberships beyond the demo's (Payments approvers, Payments engineering) are made up.
 */
import type { CatalogueDirectoryRef, DirectoryEntry } from '@/contract';
import type { DirectoryService } from '../types';

interface DirectoryPerson {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  email: string;
}

interface DirectoryGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  detail: string;
  members: string[];
}

const person = (slug: string, label: string): DirectoryPerson => ({
  id: `dir-user-${slug}`,
  label,
  email: `${slug.replace('-', '.')}@example.com`,
});

export const PEOPLE: readonly DirectoryPerson[] = [
  person('priya-raman', 'Priya Raman'),
  person('marcus-lee', 'Marcus Lee'),
  person('hannah-okafor', 'Hannah Okafor'),
  person('diego-santos', 'Diego Santos'),
  person('mei-tanaka', 'Mei Tanaka'),
  person('sam-carter', 'Sam Carter'),
  person('tom-becker', 'Tom Becker'),
  person('lena-fischer', 'Lena Fischer'),
  person('arjun-mehta', 'Arjun Mehta'),
];

const user = (slug: string) => `dir-user-${slug}`;

export const GROUPS: readonly DirectoryGroup[] = [
  { id: 'dir-group-payments-approvers', label: 'Payments approvers', detail: 'Approve changes to Payments', members: [user('marcus-lee'), user('hannah-okafor')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-payments-engineering', label: 'Payments engineering', detail: 'Engineers who build Payments', members: [user('diego-santos'), user('mei-tanaka')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-identity-approvers', label: 'Identity approvers', detail: 'Approve changes to Identity', members: [user('lena-fischer')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-identity-engineering', label: 'Identity engineering', detail: 'Engineers who build Identity', members: [user('lena-fischer')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-data-platform-approvers', label: 'Data platform approvers', detail: 'Approve changes to the data platform', members: [user('arjun-mehta')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-data-platform-engineering', label: 'Data platform engineering', detail: 'Engineers who build the data platform', members: [user('arjun-mehta')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-internal-tools-engineering', label: 'Internal tools engineering', detail: 'Engineers who build internal tools', members: [user('tom-becker')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-security-team', label: 'Security team', detail: 'Reviews changes for security', members: [user('tom-becker'), user('lena-fischer')] },
  { id: 'dir-group-platform-team', label: 'Platform team', detail: 'Runs the deploy pipeline and the service catalog', members: [user('sam-carter'), user('diego-santos')] },
];

function entryOfPerson(p: DirectoryPerson): DirectoryEntry {
  return { type: 'user', id: p.id, label: p.label, detail: p.email };
}

function entryOfGroup(g: DirectoryGroup): DirectoryEntry {
  return { type: 'group', id: g.id, label: g.label, detail: g.detail };
}

/** The entry for a reference, or undefined when the directory has no such person or group. */
export function entryFor(ref: CatalogueDirectoryRef): DirectoryEntry | undefined {
  if (ref.type === 'user') {
    const p = PEOPLE.find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
    return p && entryOfPerson(p);
  }
  const g = GROUPS.find((x) => x.id === ref.id);
  return g && entryOfGroup(g);
}

/** The directory IDs of the groups a person is in. */
export function groupsOf(personId: string): string[] {
  return GROUPS.filter((g) => g.members.includes(personId)).map((g) => g.id);
}

/** People and groups whose name or detail contains the text (any case), sorted by name. Empty text: all of them. */
export function search(query: string, types: readonly ('user' | 'group')[]): DirectoryEntry[] {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const all = [
    ...(types.includes('user') ? PEOPLE.map(entryOfPerson) : []),
    ...(types.includes('group') ? GROUPS.map(entryOfGroup) : []),
  ];
  return all
    .filter((e) => !q || e.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (e.detail ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q))
    .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
}

/** Entries for the references, in the same order; references the directory does not know are left out. */
export function lookup(refs: readonly CatalogueDirectoryRef[]): DirectoryEntry[] {
  return refs.flatMap((r) => {
    const e = entryFor(r);
    return e ? [e] : [];
  });
}

/** The people in a group. A group the directory does not know has nobody in it. */
export function membersOf(group: CatalogueDirectoryRef): DirectoryEntry[] {
  if (group.type !== 'group') return [];
  const g = GROUPS.find((x) => x.id === group.id);
  if (!g) return [];
  return lookup(g.members.map((id) => ({ type: 'user', id })));
}

export const directory: DirectoryService = {
  search: async (query, types) => search(query, types),
  lookup: async (refs) => lookup(refs),
  membersOf: async (group) => membersOf(group),
};
===\nfrontend/src/services/standin/runs.ts\n===
/**
 * Live requests run on the engine. Core's root has one way to run requests in the browser: its test
 * host (`createTestHost`, the kernel's own turn function with the outside replaced by fakes). The
 * stand-in server gives every live request a host of its own, on the published version's document
 * and catalogue, and keeps the request as the MOVES that were run on it (a start, each answer, each
 * retry or close, each answer another system gave), because the host lets nothing else out: its
 * events stay inside it. Reading a request after a reload runs its moves again on a fresh host,
 * which gives the same request, since the host is deterministic.
 *
 * What the host fixes for the life of a request, and so the stand-in fixes too:
 * - nothing about time: each move carries the time it was really made (`at`), given to the host with
 *   the move and given again when the moves are run again (core-api.md 10.2, E-32); the host's own
 *   clock (`startAt`, one second per turn) only times a move kept before moves had times;
 * - the directory's groups (the stand-in directory, which never changes);
 * - who looks after stuck requests: the workflow's "Stuck requests go to", the platform admins, and
 *   everyone who already retried or closed it (so a recorded close still runs after the Settings
 *   changed);
 * - how the pretended other systems answer: a Look up and a "does something" answer at once with the
 *   catalogue's sample; a "Wait for" stays open until it is answered (`answer` move). A move may
 *   say otherwise for the calls opened in it (`calls`), which the seed uses for a failed deploy.
 *
 * Every host answers with request ID `R1` (one request per host); runtime.ts turns that into the
 * stand-in's own IDs.
 */
import type { ButtonId, Catalogue, CatalogueRef, StartsWhenId } from '@/contract';
import { createTestHost, type CallAnswer, type CallFake, type TestHost } from '@workflow/core';
import type { Answers, CallRef, Json, ReadableId, Ref, Refusal, RequestId, ServerWorkflowId, TaskInstanceId, Timestamp, VersionNumber } from '../types';
import { GROUPS } from './directory';
import type { StoredVersion } from './store';

/** The one request a request's own host holds. */
export const HOST_REQUEST: RequestId = 'R1';

/** One input the engine ran on a request. */
export type Move =
  /** A person submitted the start form. */
  | { kind: 'start'; as: Ref; button: ButtonId; answers: Answers }
  /** A "Starts when" binding started it from what another system sent. */
  | { kind: 'startFrom'; binding: StartsWhenId; sent: Record<string, Json> }
  | { kind: 'act'; as: Ref; task: TaskInstanceId; button: ButtonId; answers: Answers }
  | { kind: 'admin'; as: Ref; action: 'retry' | 'close'; reason: string }
  /** Another system answered a call the request was waiting on. */
  | { kind: 'answer'; call: CallRef; answer: CallAnswer };

/** How other systems answer the calls opened in one move, where that is not their default. Never the directory's operations. */
export type CallAnswers = Partial<Record<CatalogueRef, CallFake>>;

/** A move as kept: when it was made (RFC 3339; absent only in requests kept before moves had times), and its call answers. */
export type LoggedMove = Move & { at?: Timestamp; calls?: CallAnswers };

/** A live request as the stand-in server keeps it. */
export interface StoredRequest {
  id: RequestId;
  readableId: ReadableId;
  workflow: ServerWorkflowId;
  version: VersionNumber;
  /** When it started: the engine's clock for this request. */
  startAt: Timestamp;
  /** Oldest first; the first is the start. Only moves the engine accepted are kept. */
  moves: LoggedMove[];
}

const GROUP_FAKES: Partial<Record<string, string[]>> = Object.fromEntries(GROUPS.map((g) => [g.id, [...g.members]]));

/** How an operation answers unless a move says otherwise: a "Wait for" is held, anything else answers with its sample. */
function defaultAnswer(catalogue: Catalogue, operation: CatalogueRef): CallFake {
  const entry = catalogue.entries.find((e) => e.id === operation);
  return entry?.kind === 'operation' && entry.sort === 'await' ? { mode: 'hold' } : { mode: 'sample' };
}

function heldOperations(catalogue: Catalogue): CallAnswers {
  const out: CallAnswers = {};
  for (const e of catalogue.entries) if (e.kind === 'operation' && e.sort === 'await') out[e.id as CatalogueRef] = { mode: 'hold' };
  return out;
}

/** A fresh host for one request on a published version. */
export function newHost(version: StoredVersion, admins: readonly Ref[], startAt: Timestamp): TestHost {
  const made = createTestHost(version.authored, version.catalogue, {
    groups: GROUP_FAKES, stuckRequestsGoTo: admins.map((a) => ({ ...a })), startAt, calls: heldOperations(version.catalogue),
  });
  // A published version has no workflow-level To do, so this cannot happen unless core changed under a stored version.
  if (!made.ok) throw new Error(`core makes no host for this published version: ${JSON.stringify(made.findings)}`);
  return made.host;
}

export type MoveResult = { ok: true; started?: boolean } | { ok: false; refusals: Refusal[] };

/** Runs one move on a host, with its call answers for the calls opened in it. */
export function runMove(host: TestHost, catalogue: Catalogue, move: LoggedMove): MoveResult {
  const calls = Object.entries(move.calls ?? {}) as [CatalogueRef, CallFake][];
  for (const [operation, fake] of calls) host.setCallFake(operation, fake);
  try {
    return run(host, move);
  } finally {
    for (const [operation] of calls) host.setCallFake(operation, defaultAnswer(catalogue, operation));
  }
}

function run(host: TestHost, move: Move & { at?: Timestamp }): MoveResult {
  const at = move.at;
  switch (move.kind) {
    case 'start': {
      const out = host.start(move.as, move.button, move.answers, at);
      if (out.ok && out.requestId !== HOST_REQUEST) throw new Error(`a request's own host started ${out.requestId}`);
      return out.ok ? { ok: true, started: true } : out;
    }
    case 'startFrom': {
      const out = host.startFrom(move.binding, move.sent, at);
      if (out.ok && out.started && out.requestId !== HOST_REQUEST) throw new Error(`a request's own host started ${out.requestId}`);
      return out.ok ? { ok: true, started: out.started } : out;
    }
    case 'act':
      return host.act(move.as, HOST_REQUEST, move.task, move.button, move.answers, at);
    case 'admin':
      return host.admin(move.as, HOST_REQUEST, move.action, move.reason, at);
    case 'answer':
      return host.answerCall(move.call, move.answer, at);
  }
}

/** Hosts already running, per state object (a state read in from another tab starts empty), by request. */
const running = new WeakMap<object, Map<RequestId, { key: string; host: TestHost }>>();

const keyOf = (r: StoredRequest, admins: readonly Ref[]) => JSON.stringify([r.workflow, r.version, r.startAt, admins, r.moves]);

/**
 * The host that holds this request as its moves left it: the one already running, or a fresh one
 * with every move run again.
 */
export function hostOf(state: object, r: StoredRequest, version: StoredVersion, admins: readonly Ref[]): TestHost {
  let byId = running.get(state);
  if (!byId) running.set(state, (byId = new Map()));
  const key = keyOf(r, admins);
  const known = byId.get(r.id);
  if (known?.key === key) return known.host;
  const host = newHost(version, admins, r.startAt);
  for (const move of r.moves) {
    const out = runMove(host, version.catalogue, move);
    // The engine accepted each move when it was made, and the host is deterministic.
    if (!out.ok) throw new Error(`request ${r.id} does not run again: ${JSON.stringify(out.refusals)}`);
  }
  byId.set(r.id, { key, host });
  return host;
}

/** After a move was run on `host` and added to `r.moves`: the host is now the request's. */
export function keepHost(state: object, r: StoredRequest, admins: readonly Ref[], host: TestHost): void {
  let byId = running.get(state);
  if (!byId) running.set(state, (byId = new Map()));
  byId.set(r.id, { key: keyOf(r, admins), host });
}

/** A host with no request, for the start form's choices on a version (one per version and state). */
const formHosts = new WeakMap<object, Map<string, TestHost>>();

export function formHostOf(state: object, workflow: ServerWorkflowId, version: StoredVersion): TestHost {
  let byVersion = formHosts.get(state);
  if (!byVersion) formHosts.set(state, (byVersion = new Map()));
  const key = `${workflow}@${version.version}`;
  const known = byVersion.get(key);
  if (known) return known;
  const host = newHost(version, [], version.publishedAt);
  byVersion.set(key, host);
  return host;
}

/**
 * The stand-in runtime through the assembled services: real requests on published versions, as
 * the signed-in person, kept in the store (runtime-api.md Draft 3).

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { AuthoredWorkflow, WorkingStage } from '@/contract';

const user = (slug: string) => ({ type: 'user' as const, id: `dir-user-${slug}` });

  q_title: 'Rotate payment gateway API keys', q_primary_domain: domain, q_planned_release_date: '2026-12-02', q_risk: 'ch_risk_medium',
});

const TICKET = SAMPLE_CATALOGUE.entries.find((e) => e.id === 'helpdesk.ticketCreated@1');
const sampleEvent = TICKET?.kind === 'trigger' ? TICKET.sample.event : {};

function value<T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): T {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r.errors));
  return r.value;
}

function setup(options: { sampleRequests?: boolean } = {}) {
  let n = 0;
  return createStandinServices({ ...options, now: () => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 15, 10, 0, n++)).toISOString() });
}

async function as(services: Services, person: Ref) {
  value(await services.session.signInAs(person));
}

async function startDemo(services: Services, token = 'tok-1', domain = 'row_payments') {
  await as(services, priya);
  return value(await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: formAnswers(domain), clientToken: token }));
}

/** Runs one live operation directly on the store's state, as `person`, with other systems answering the calls it opens as `calls` say. */
function runAs<T>(store: StandinStore, person: Ref, calls: CallAnswers, run: (ctx: LiveContext) => T): T {
  let out: T | undefined;
  store.update((state) => {
    out = run({ state, now: () => '2026-11-15T09:00:00.000Z', catalogue: SAMPLE_CATALOGUE, me: personOf(person.id)!, calls });
  });
  return out as T;
}

/** Puts a version of the integrated sample in the store as published (compiled by core), with a change made to its document. */
function publishIntegrated(store: StandinStore, change: (doc: AuthoredWorkflow) => void): number {
  let version = 0;
  store.update((s) => {
    const w = findWorkflow(s, 'integrated-sample')!;
    const doc = copy(w.versions.at(-1)!.authored);
    change(doc);
    version = w.versions.length + 1;
    const compiled = compile(doc, SAMPLE_CATALOGUE, { mode: 'publish', workflow: w.id, version });
    if (!compiled.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(compiled.findings));
    w.versions.push({ ...copy(w.versions.at(-1)!), version, authored: doc, definition: compiled.published });
  });
  return version;
}

    (changed.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_development') as WorkingStage).name = 'Build';
    (changed.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval') as WorkingStage).tasks[0]!.buttons[0]!.label = 'OK';
    const saved = value(await services.authoring.saveDraft('change-request', { baseRevision: d2.revision, authored: changed }));
    expect(value(await services.authoring.publish('change-request', { revision: saved.revision, coreVersion: (await services.core.meta()).coreVersion })).version).toBe(5);

    await as(services, marcus);
    expect(value(await services.runtime.getTask({ requestId: started.requestId, task: taskId })).version).toBe(4);
    const source = value(await services.runtime.publishedSource({ workflow: 'change-request', version: 4 })).authored;
    expect((source.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval') as WorkingStage).tasks[0]!.buttons[0]!.label).toBe('Approve');
    const done = value(await services.runtime.act({ requestId: started.requestId, task: taskId, button: 'btn_da_approve', answers: { q_eng_lead: diego } }));
    expect(done).toEqual({ requestId: started.requestId, lastSeq: expect.any(Number), stopped: false });
    const request = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId }));
    expect(request).toMatchObject({ workflow: 'change-request', version: 4, stage: { item: 'st_development', part: 'tasks' } });
    expect(request.stuck).toBeUndefined();
    expect(request.values.v_jira_issue).toBe('CHG-101');
    // Live, a move records only the arrow taken and what it read, never the arrows that did not fit.
    const moves = request.story.filter((e) => e.code === 'moved');
    expect(moves.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const m of moves) expect(m.code === 'moved' && m.params.why && 'notFitting' in m.params.why).toBe(false);
    expect(value(await services.runtime.publishedSource({ workflow: 'change-request', version: 4 })).authored.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_development')?.name).toBe('Development');
    expect(value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ readableId: '1001' })).requestId).toBe(started.requestId);

    const versions = value(await services.authoring.listVersions('change-request'));
    expect(versions.find((v) => v.version === 4)?.openRequests).toBe(1);
    expect(value(await services.authoring.listWorkflows()).find((w) => w.id === 'change-request')?.openRequests).toBe(1);
  });

  it('starting: startable workflows, the start form, client tokens, refusals in their order', async () => {
    const { services } = setup();
    expect(value(await services.runtime.listStartable())).toEqual([
      { workflow: 'change-request', name: 'Change request', highestVersion: 3 },
      { workflow: 'several-at-once', name: 'Change request (with security review)', highestVersion: 1 },
      { workflow: 'integrated-sample', name: 'Service change', highestVersion: 1 },
    ]);
    const form = value(await services.runtime.startForm({ workflow: 'change-request' }));
    expect(form).toEqual({
      workflow: 'change-request', version: 3, stage: 'st_request_form', task: 'tk_request_form', name: 'Change request',
      buttonStates: [{ button: 'btn_rf_submit', available: true, refusals: [] }],
    });
    expect(await services.runtime.startForm({ workflow: 'change-request', version: 9 })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'version' } }] });
    expect(await services.runtime.startForm({ workflow: 'nope' })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'workflow' } }] });
    const never = value(await services.authoring.createWorkflow({ name: 'Never published' }));
    expect(await services.runtime.startForm({ workflow: never.workflow })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'version' } }] });

    const first = await startDemo(services, 'same');
    const again = await startDemo(services, 'same');
    expect(again).toMatchObject({ requestId: first.requestId, replayed: true });
    const other = await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: {}, clientToken: 'same' });
    expect(other).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'client-token-reused', params: { requestId: first.requestId } }] });
    expect(await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: {}, clientToken: 'bad token!' }))
      .toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/clientToken', problem: 'format' } }] });
    // An unknown button is a shape refusal: before the token is looked at.
    expect(await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_nope', answers: {}, clientToken: 'same' }))
      .toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'unknown-button', location: { item: 'tk_request_form' }, params: { button: 'btn_nope' } }] });
    const missing = await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: {}, clientToken: 'x2' });
    expect(missing.ok === false && missing.errors.map((e) => e.code)).toEqual(['invalid-data', 'invalid-data', 'invalid-data', 'invalid-data']);
    // A refused start keeps no token: the same token starts once the form is fixed.
    expect((await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: formAnswers(), clientToken: 'x2' })).ok).toBe(true);
    const bogus = await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: { ...formAnswers(), q_risk: 'ch_bogus' }, clientToken: 'x5' });
    expect(bogus).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'invalid-data', location: { item: 'q_risk', part: 'choices' }, params: { rule: 'not-a-choice' } }] });
    expect((await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'nope', button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: {}, clientToken: 'x3' })).ok).toBe(false);
    expect((await services.runtime.start({ workflow: 'change-request', version: 7, button: 'btn_rf_submit', answers: {}, clientToken: 'x4' })).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  it('retry and close: only Sam, from a page that is up to date; retry only for a stuck request; close for any open one', async () => {
    const { services } = setup();
    const started = await startDemo(services);
    const args = { requestId: started.requestId, reason: 'Duplicate', expectedLastSeq: started.lastSeq };
    expect(await services.runtime.close(args)).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-admin', params: {} }] });
    expect(value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId })).viewer.isAdmin).toBe(false);
    await as(services, sam);
    expect(value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId })).viewer.isAdmin).toBe(true);
    expect(await services.runtime.close({ ...args, reason: '   ' })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'reason-required', params: {} }] });
    expect(await services.runtime.close({ ...args, reason: 'x'.repeat(2001) })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/reason', problem: 'tooLong' } }] });
    expect(await services.runtime.retry({ ...args, expectedLastSeq: 0 })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'stale', params: { lastSeq: started.lastSeq } }] });
    // The request is waiting for Marcus, not stuck: retry is refused; close is allowed.
    expect(await services.runtime.retry(args)).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-stuck', params: {} }] });
    const closed = value(await services.runtime.close(args));
    expect(closed.stopped).toBe(false);
    const view = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId }));
    expect(view.closed).toMatchObject({ byAdmin: true });
    // The engine's story: the close, then Marcus's task, no longer needed because it was closed.
    expect(view.story.slice(-2)).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'closed', params: { by: { type: 'user', id: sam.id }, reason: 'Duplicate' } }),
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'task.noLongerNeeded', location: { item: 'tk_domain_approval' }, params: expect.objectContaining({ because: 'closed' }) }),
    ]);
    expect(await services.runtime.close({ ...args, expectedLastSeq: closed.lastSeq })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'request-closed', params: {} }] });
    expect(await services.runtime.retry({ ...args, requestId: 'nope' })).toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'request' } }] });
  });

  it('one stuck state, the same in the view, the list and the story; the detail only for the people who look after it; Retry for action-failed', async () => {
    const { services, store } = setup();
    const fails: CallAnswers = { 'servicecatalog.serviceDetails@1': { mode: 'fail', error: { code: 'service-not-found', message: 'No service with ID svc-payments-api.' } } };
    const started = value(runAs(store, priya, fails, (ctx) => startOn(ctx, { ...integratedStart, clientToken: 't1' })));
    expect(started.stopped).toBe(true);

    await as(services, priya);
    const seen = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId }));
    expect(seen.stuck).toEqual({ reason: 'action-failed', at: expect.any(String), location: { item: 'act_look_up_service' } });
    expect(seen.viewer.isAdmin).toBe(false);
    const entry = seen.story.find((e) => e.code === 'stuck');
    expect(entry).toMatchObject({ code: 'stuck', at: seen.stuck!.at, location: { item: 'act_look_up_service' }, params: { reason: 'action-failed' } });
    expect(entry?.code === 'stuck' && entry.params.admin).toBeUndefined();
    const rows = value(await services.runtime.listRequests({ stuck: true }));
    expect(rows.items.map((r) => [r.requestId, r.stuck])).toEqual([[started.requestId, { reason: 'action-failed', at: seen.stuck!.at, location: { item: 'act_look_up_service' } }]]);
    expect(value(await services.runtime.listRequests({ stuck: false })).items).toEqual([]);
    expect(value(await services.authoring.listWorkflows()).find((w) => w.id === 'integrated-sample')).toMatchObject({ openRequests: 1, stuckRequests: 1 });

    await as(services, sam);
    const admin = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId }));
    expect(admin.viewer.isAdmin).toBe(true);
    expect(admin.stuck?.admin).toMatchObject({ failureCode: 'service-not-found', attempts: 1 });

    // Retried, the look-up answers with its sample this time; the request goes on and waits for the deploy pipeline.
    const retried = value(await services.runtime.retry({ requestId: started.requestId, reason: 'Catalog fixed', expectedLastSeq: admin.lastSeq }));
    expect(retried.stopped).toBe(false);
    const after = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId }));
    expect(after.stuck).toBeUndefined();
    expect(after.story.map((e) => e.code)).toContain('retried');
    expect(after.actions.map((a) => a.location.item)).toEqual(['act_run_pipeline']);
    // The pipeline answers (development only): the request goes on to its end.
    const done = value(await services.dev!.answerWaiting({ requestId: started.requestId, action: 'act_run_pipeline', answer: { outcome: 'ok' } }));
    expect(done.stopped).toBe(false);
    expect(value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId })).closed).toMatchObject({ ending: 'st_deployed', byAdmin: false });
  });

  it('another system answers a waiting request (development only): with its sample, or failed with one of its failure codes', async () => {
    const { services } = setup();
    const dev = services.dev!;
    await as(services, priya);
    const a = value(await services.runtime.start({ ...integratedStart, clientToken: 't1' }));
    const b = value(await services.runtime.start({ ...integratedStart, clientToken: 't2' }));
    const waiting = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: a.requestId }));
    expect(waiting.actions).toEqual([{ location: { item: 'act_run_pipeline' }, sort: 'await', openedAt: expect.any(String) }]);
    expect(waiting.stuck).toBeUndefined();

    // Refusals: no such request; an action that is not waiting; a failure code the operation does not have.
    expect(await dev.answerWaiting({ requestId: 'nope', action: 'act_run_pipeline', answer: { outcome: 'ok' } }))
      .toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'request' } }] });
    expect(await dev.answerWaiting({ requestId: a.requestId, action: 'act_look_up_service', answer: { outcome: 'ok' } }))
      .toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'not-found', params: { what: 'call' } }] });
    expect(await dev.answerWaiting({ requestId: a.requestId, action: 'act_run_pipeline', answer: { outcome: 'failed', code: 'no-such-code' } }))
      .toEqual({ ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'invalid-body', params: { field: '/answer/code', problem: 'format' } }] });

    // Succeeded with the sample: the request goes on to its end, and the answer is in its history.
    value(await dev.answerWaiting({ requestId: a.requestId, action: 'act_run_pipeline', answer: { outcome: 'ok' } }));
    const ended = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: a.requestId }));
    expect(ended.closed).toMatchObject({ ending: 'st_deployed' });
    expect(ended.story).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'action.done', location: { item: 'act_run_pipeline' } }));
    // Answered once: it is no longer waiting.
    expect((await dev.answerWaiting({ requestId: a.requestId, action: 'act_run_pipeline', answer: { outcome: 'ok' } })).ok).toBe(false);

    // Failed with a failure code: the engine follows the action's "If it fails" (saved, then the fix-up stage).
    value(await dev.answerWaiting({ requestId: b.requestId, action: 'act_run_pipeline', answer: { outcome: 'failed', code: 'tests-failed' } }));
    const failed = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: b.requestId }));
    expect(failed.values.v_deploy_failure_code).toBe('tests-failed');
    expect(failed.story).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'action.failed', location: { item: 'act_run_pipeline' }, params: expect.objectContaining({ failureCode: 'tests-failed', carriedOn: true }) }));
  });

  it('each request runs on the engine: its view is what core\'s own host gives for the same moves', async () => {
    const { services, store } = setup();
    const started = await startDemo(services);
    await as(services, marcus);
    const task = value(await services.runtime.myTasks()).items[0]!;
    value(await services.runtime.act({ requestId: started.requestId, task: task.task, button: 'btn_da_approve', answers: { q_eng_lead: diego } }));
    const live = value(await services.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId }));

    const stored = runtimeData(store.get() as never).requests[0]!;
    expect(stored.moves.map((m) => m.kind)).toEqual(['start', 'act']);
    const made = createTestHost(fixtures['change-request'], SAMPLE_CATALOGUE, {
      groups: Object.fromEntries(GROUPS.map((g) => [g.id, [...g.members]])), stuckRequestsGoTo: [{ type: 'group', id: 'dir-group-platform-team' }],
      startAt: stored.startAt, calls: { 'deploy.runPipeline@1': { mode: 'hold' } },
    });
    if (!made.ok) throw new Error('no host');
    const h = made.host;
    // Each kept move carries the time it was made, and the host is given it (E-32).
    expect(stored.moves.every((m) => typeof m.at === 'string')).toBe(true);
    const s = h.start(priya, 'btn_rf_submit', formAnswers(), stored.moves[0]!.at);
    if (!s.ok) throw new Error('not started');
    const t = h.openTasks({ requestId: s.requestId })[0]!;
    expect(h.act(marcus, s.requestId, t.task, 'btn_da_approve', { q_eng_lead: diego }, stored.moves[1]!.at).ok).toBe(true);
    const direct = h.request(s.requestId, marcus);
    if ('ok' in direct) throw new Error('no view');
    expect(live.values).toEqual(direct.values);
    expect(live.stage).toEqual(direct.stage);
    expect(live.lastSeq).toBe(direct.lastSeq);
    expect(live.tasks.map((x) => [x.task, x.location, x.askedOf])).toEqual(direct.tasks.map((x) => [x.task, x.location, x.askedOf]));
    expect(live.story.map((e) => [e.code, e.at, e.location])).toEqual(direct.story.map((e) => [e.code, e.at, e.location]));
  });

  it('an answer from a source is looked up again when the person acts: not found is choice-unknown, and the source label is kept', async () => {

    // Read again from the kept moves on a fresh host (a reload): the same time.
    const two = createStandinServices({ storage, now: () => '2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z' }).services;
    await as(two, sam);
    expect(await closedAt(two)).toBe('2026-11-16T03:39:00.000Z');
    expect(value(await two.runtime.getRequest({ requestId: started.requestId })).story[0]?.at).toBe('2026-11-14T03:30:00.000Z');
  });
