test('a part is one line of chips, [Primary domain] [needs no approval], with what the arrow does for each domain', async ({ page }) => {
  await openStage(page, 'st_request_form');
  const when = page.locator('[data-at="ar_rf_no_approval"]').first();
  await when.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  const part = when.locator('[data-part="0"]');
  const value = part.getByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: answer or value/ });
  const words = part.getByRole('button', { name: 'Part 1: words: needs no approval' });
  // The value is one chip naming what the column is read from; the words say the column.
  await expect(part.locator('[data-chip-slot] > [aria-hidden="true"]').first()).toHaveText('Primary domain');
  // No "from ... · for the sample" line, no chevron box and no second ×: one × for the part.
  await expect(part.getByText(/for the sample/)).toBeHidden();
  const visibleRemoves = await part.getByRole('button', { name: /Remove|Clear/ }).evaluateAll((els) =>
    els.filter((el) => (el as HTMLElement).offsetParent !== null && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none').length,
  );
  expect(visibleRemoves).toBe(1);
  // The chip and the words sit on one line.
  const a = (await value.boundingBox())!;
  const b = (await words.boundingBox())!;
  expect(Math.abs(a.y + a.height / 2 - (b.y + b.height / 2))).toBeLessThan(4);
  expect(a.x + a.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(b.x);
  expect(a.height).toBeLessThan(36);

  const preview = when.getByRole('region', { name: 'What this arrow does for each domain' });
  await expect(preview).toBeVisible();
  await expect(preview.getByRole('row', { name: /Internal tools/ })).toContainText('Create Jira issue');
  await expect(preview.getByRole('row', { name: /Internal tools/ })).toContainText('This arrow');
  await expect(preview.getByRole('row', { name: /Payments/ })).toContainText('Domain approval');
  await expect(preview.getByRole('row', { name: /Payments/ })).not.toContainText('This arrow');

  // The chip opens the value picker, and focus comes back to it when the picker closes.
  await value.click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('dialog').last()).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(value).toBeFocused();
});

test('at the panel\'s narrowest (400px) a sentence with long names wraps and cuts no chip short', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.addInitScript(() => localStorage.setItem('editor.panelWidth', '400'));
  await openStage(page, 'st_domain_approval');
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const ed = (window as unknown as { __editor: { getState(): { run(n: string, a: unknown): unknown } } }).__editor.getState();
    ed.run('value.rename', { value: 'v_risk', name: 'Risk assessed by the requester before submitting' });
    ed.run('button.rename', { button: 'btn_da_approve', label: 'Approve this change for the whole domain' });
    ed.run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', { arrow: 'ar_da_approve', onlyWhen: { allOf: [
      { pressed: 'btn_da_approve' },
      { left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.isOneOf', right: [{ choice: 'ch_risk_high' }, { choice: 'ch_risk_medium' }] },
      { left: { value: 'v_title' }, words: 'text.contains', right: { text: 'a rather long piece of typed text to compare with' } },
    ] } });
  });
  const when = page.locator('[data-at="ar_da_approve"]').first();
  await when.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect(when.getByRole('group', { name: /^When Approve this change for the whole domain is pressed and Risk assessed/ })).toBeVisible();
  const problems = await when.evaluate((root) => {
    const box = root.getBoundingClientRect();
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (const el of root.querySelectorAll('[data-part] *')) {
      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      if (cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || cs.opacity === '0' || el.closest('[data-chip-slot] > :not([aria-hidden])')) continue;
      if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1 && cs.overflow !== 'visible') out.push(`cut short: ${el.textContent}`);
      if (cs.textOverflow === 'ellipsis' && el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1) out.push(`ends with ...: ${el.textContent}`);
      const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (b.width && b.right > box.right + 1) out.push(`past the edge: ${el.textContent}`);
    }
    return out;
  });
  expect(problems).toEqual([]);
  // The whole value name is seen, and the list is said in the order the "when ..." holds it.
  await expect(when.locator('[data-part="1"] [data-chip-slot] > [aria-hidden="true"]')).toHaveText('Risk assessed by the requester before submitting');
  await expect(when.getByRole('button', { name: 'Part 2: compared with: High or Medium' })).toBeVisible();
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The editor store the dev build puts on the page (src/app/main.tsx), seen from the test. */
type EditorOnPage = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { start: { stage: string; startsWhen: { trigger?: string; answers: Record<string, unknown> }[] } } | null;
    select(selection: { item: string }): void;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorOnPage };

const startsWhen = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc?.start.startsWhen);

async function openStartStage(page: Page, workflow: string) {
  await page.goto(`/#/w/${workflow}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc);
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const s = (window as Win).__editor!.getState();
    s.select({ item: s.doc!.start.stage });
  });
}

test('the demo: add a Starts when, fill the form from the ticket, see the To do for a needed question and fix it', async ({ page }) => {
  await openStartStage(page, 'change-request');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Also start it from another system' }).click();
  const card = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Also starts from another system' });
  const select = card.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Starts when', exact: true });
  await expect(select).toBeFocused();
  await select.selectOption({ label: 'Helpdesk: a ticket is created' });
  await expect.poll(async () => (await startsWhen(page))?.[0]?.trigger).toBe('helpdesk.ticketCreated@1');

  await expect(card.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Fill in the form from the ticket' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(card.getByRole('rowheader')).toHaveText(['Requester', 'Title', 'Description', 'Primary domain', 'Planned release date', 'Risk']);

  // Each needed question left empty is a To do, in the findings' words, with its fix.
  const titleTodo = card.getByText('Title is needed to press Submit, but nothing from the ticket fills it.');
  await expect(titleTodo).toBeVisible();
  await expect(card.getByText('Risk is needed to press Submit, but nothing from the ticket fills it.')).toBeVisible();

  // The fix opens the Title row's picker, which offers what the ticket sends.
  await card.getByRole('button', { name: 'Choose what fills Title' }).click();
  const option = page.getByRole('option', { name: /Ticket: Title/ }).first();
  await expect(option).toBeVisible();
  await option.click();
  await expect.poll(async () => (await startsWhen(page))?.[0]?.answers.q_title).toEqual({ sentField: 'title' });
  await expect(titleTodo).toBeHidden();
  // The sample beside it is the ticket's.
  await expect(card.getByRole('row', { name: /^Title/ })).toContainText('Raise payment API rate limit');
  await expect(card.getByText('Risk is needed to press Submit, but nothing from the ticket fills it.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(card).toContainText('Then the request goes on as if Submit had been pressed.');
});

test('integrated sample: the Starts when card shows names and chips in full, and a formula gets the full width', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
  await openStartStage(page, 'integrated-sample');
  const card = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Also starts from another system' });
  const select = card.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Starts when', exact: true });

  // Nothing in the "From the ticket" column is cut: each chip is as wide as its words.
  const table = card.getByRole('table');
  await expect(table.getByRole('rowheader')).toHaveText(['Requester', 'Summary', 'Service', 'Helpdesk ticket']);
  const clipped = await table.locator('td[data-from]').evaluateAll((cells) =>
    cells.flatMap((td) => [...td.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button, [role="textbox"]')].filter((el) => el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1 || el.getBoundingClientRect().right > td.getBoundingClientRect().right + 1).map((el) => el.textContent)),
  );
  expect(clipped).toEqual([]);
  // At the panel's width (480) the sample heading and every sample are readable in full: nothing is cut
  // and nothing runs past the card's edge (they go under what fills the question, and wrap).
  await expect(card.getByRole('columnheader', { name: 'Sample: ticket HD-2291' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(table.getByText('Raise payment API rate limit')).toBeVisible();
  const cardRight = (await card.boundingBox())!.x + (await card.boundingBox())!.width;
  const cut = await table.locator('th, td').evaluateAll(
    (cells, right) => cells.filter((c) => c.scrollWidth > c.clientWidth + 1 || c.getBoundingClientRect().right > (right as number) + 1).map((c) => c.textContent),
    cardRight,
  );
  expect(cut).toEqual([]);

  // A formula over what was sent: it gets the card's full width, so nothing in it is squeezed to a word a line.
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const s = (window as Win).__editor!.getState() as unknown as { run(n: string, a: unknown): unknown };
    s.run('startsWhen.setAnswer', { binding: 'sw_helpdesk_ticket', question: 'q_summary', answer: { formula: '', readsAs: '' } });
  });
  const formulaCell = table.locator('td[data-from][colspan="3"]');
  await expect(formulaCell).toBeVisible();
  const squeezed = await formulaCell.evaluate((td) => {
    const width = td.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return [...td.querySelectorAll('div, nav, section')]
      .map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect())
      .filter((r) => r.height > 200 && r.width < width * 0.6).length;
  });
  expect(squeezed).toBe(0);
  expect((await formulaCell.boundingBox())!.width).toBeGreaterThan(300);
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The editor store the dev build puts on the page (src/app/main.tsx), seen from the test. */
type Arrow = { id: string; goTo: string | null; when: { type: string } };
type Stage = { id: string; kind: string; name: string; arrows?: Arrow[] };
type EditorOnPage = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { stages: Stage[] } | null;
    selection: { item: string; part?: string } | null;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorOnPage };

const stages = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!.stages);
const selection = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().selection);
const stage = async (page: Page, id: string) => (await stages(page)).find((s) => s.id === id);
const box = (page: Page, name: string) => page.locator(`[data-stage-id]`, { has: page.getByText(name, { exact: true }) }).first();

async function open(page: Page) {
  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request');
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Diagram of the workflow' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('group', { name: /^Domain approval, Approval/ })).toBeVisible();
}

  await expect(da.getByText('Notify Requester (when Reject)')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Domain needs no approval \(Internal tools\)"/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add another ending' })).toBeVisible();
  // no numbers on the diagram
  const pills = await page.locator('[data-arrow-id]').allInnerTexts();
  for (const words of pills) expect(words).not.toMatch(/\d/);

test('"Add stage" in the toolbar adds a stage of the chosen kind, on its own, and shows it', async ({ page }) => {
  await open(page);
  const before = await stages(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add stage' }).click();
  const chooser = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Which kind of stage?' });
  await expect(chooser).toBeVisible();
  await chooser.getByRole('button', { name: /^Work/ }).click();
  await expect(chooser).toBeHidden();

  const after = await stages(page);
  expect(after).toHaveLength(before.length + 1);
  const added = after.find((s) => !before.some((b) => b.id === s.id)) as Stage;
  expect(added).toMatchObject({ kind: 'work', name: 'Work' });
  // on its own: no arrow goes to it
  expect(after.some((s) => s.arrows?.some((a) => a.goTo === added.id))).toBe(false);
  expect(await selection(page)).toMatchObject({ item: added.id });
  // the name is ready to change, and the diagram says what happened, with Undo
  await expect(page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stage name' })).toBeFocused();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'Done: Work added, on its own.' })).toBeVisible();
});

test('"+" on an arrow inserts a stage there, already wired on both sides', async ({ page }) => {
  await open(page);

});

/** The scale the (first) diagram on the page is drawn at. */
const drawnAt = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.react-flow__viewport') as Element).transform).a);

/** The request page shows where a request is as a strip of stages; the whole diagram is behind "See the whole of ...". */
async function requestDiagram(page: Page, id: string) {
  await page.goto(`/#/requests/${id}`);
  const whole = page.getByText(/^See the whole of /).first();
  await whole.waitFor({ timeout: 3000 }).catch(() => undefined);
  if (await whole.isVisible()) await whole.click();
  await expect(page.locator('.react-flow [data-here]').first()).toBeVisible();
}

test('the diagram without editing is never shrunk below 85%: Try it and the request page', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request/try');
  await expect(page.locator('.react-flow [data-here]').first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  expect(await drawnAt(page)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.85 - 0.001);
  await requestDiagram(page, '1001');
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  expect(await drawnAt(page)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.85 - 0.001);
  // where the request is shows
  const here = (await page.locator('[data-here]').first().boundingBox())!;
  const canvas = (await page.locator('.react-flow').first().boundingBox())!;
  expect(here.y).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(canvas.y - 1);
  expect(here.y + here.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(canvas.y + canvas.height + 1);
});

test('on the request page the mouse wheel over the diagram scrolls the page, not the diagram', async ({ page }) => {
  await requestDiagram(page, '1001');
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const flow = page.locator('.react-flow').first();
  await flow.evaluate((el) => {
    el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
    window.scrollBy(0, -80);
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  const before = (await flow.boundingBox())!;
  const view = () => page.locator('.react-flow__viewport').first().getAttribute('style');
  const drawn = await view();
  await page.mouse.move(before.x + before.width / 2, before.y + before.height / 2);
  await page.mouse.wheel(0, 300);
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  expect(await view()).toBe(drawn);
  expect((await flow.boundingBox())!.y).toBeLessThan(before.y - 50);
});

  expect(fromStart).toBeLessThan(da);
  expect(fromDa).toBeGreaterThan(da);
});

type Run = { getState(): { run(name: string, args: unknown): unknown; doc: { stages: Stage[] } | null } };
const run = (page: Page, name: string, args: unknown) =>
  page.evaluate(([n, a]) => ((window as unknown as { __editor: Run }).__editor.getState().run(n as string, a)), [name, args] as const);
/** Where every stage box is on screen, by its id. */
const boxesOnScreen = async (page: Page) => {
  const out: Record<string, { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }> = {};
  for (const el of await page.locator('.react-flow__node[data-id^="st_"]').all()) {
    const id = await el.getAttribute('data-id');
    const b = await el.boundingBox();
    if (id && b) out[id] = b;
  }
  return out;
};

/**
 * Where every stage box is once the diagram has stopped moving: read until two reads in a row agree
 * (a layout after a check, a fit of the view), so a test never measures a diagram half way.
 */
const settledBoxes = async (page: Page) => {
  let last = '';
  let boxes: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof boxesOnScreen>> = {};
  await expect
    .poll(
      async () => {
        boxes = await boxesOnScreen(page);
        const now = JSON.stringify(boxes);
        const same = now === last && Object.keys(boxes).length > 0;
        last = now;
        return same;
      },
      { intervals: [100, 100, 150, 250] },
    )
    .toBe(true);
  return boxes;
};

test('a stage added on the arrow of a new workflow: the main path goes straight down to the ending, the open arrow out to the right (mockup 02 approval-added)', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/#/');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New workflow' }).first().click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'New workflow' });
  await dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Name' }).fill('Laptop return');
  await dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Name' }).press('Enter');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Submit pressed"/ }).hover();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add a stage on "Submit pressed"' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'What should happen next?' }).getByRole('button', { name: /^Approval/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Reject pressed"/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);

  const approval = (await page.getByRole('group', { name: /^Approval, Approval/ }).boundingBox())!;
  const ending = (await page.locator('.react-flow__node-ending').first().boundingBox())!;
  const approve = (await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Approve pressed"/ }).boundingBox())!;
  const reject = (await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Reject pressed"/ }).boundingBox())!;
  const choose = (await page.locator('.react-flow__node-choose').first().boundingBox())!;
  const middle = (b: { x: number; width: number }) => b.x + b.width / 2;
  // Approve pressed: under the box, in its column, down to the ending in the same column
  expect(Math.abs(middle(ending) - middle(approval))).toBeLessThan(4);
  expect(approve.y).toBeGreaterThan(approval.y + approval.height - 2);
  expect(approve.x).toBeGreaterThan(approval.x);
  expect(approve.x + approve.width).toBeLessThan(approval.x + approval.width);
  // Reject pressed and "Choose a stage or ending": out to the right, beside the box
  expect(reject.x).toBeGreaterThan(approval.x + approval.width);
  expect(choose.x).toBeGreaterThan(reject.x + reject.width);
  expect(reject.y).toBeGreaterThan(approval.y);
  expect(reject.y + reject.height).toBeLessThan(approval.y + approval.height);
  // so the "+" tip on Approve pressed covers no other pill
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Approve pressed"/ }).hover();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add a stage on "Approve pressed"' }).hover();
  const tip = (await page.getByRole('tooltip').filter({ hasText: 'connected for you' }).boundingBox())!;
  const apart = tip.x + tip.width <= reject.x || reject.x + reject.width <= tip.x || tip.y + tip.height <= reject.y || reject.y + reject.height <= tip.y;
  expect(apart).toBe(true);

  // Reject pressed then gets an ending of its own: Approve pressed still runs straight down to its
  // ending, under the box; the new ending goes beside.
  const doc = await stages(page);
  const appr = doc.find((st) => st.kind === 'approval')!;
  const open = appr.arrows!.find((a) => !a.goTo)!;
  const done = appr.arrows!.find((a) => !!a.goTo)!.goTo!;
  await run(page, 'stage.add', { kind: 'ending', name: 'Rejected', pointArrow: open.id });
  await expect(page.locator('[data-stage-id]', { hasText: 'Rejected' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  const after = await boxesOnScreen(page);
  const approvalAfter = after[appr.id]!;
  const rejected = after[(await stages(page)).find((st) => st.kind === 'ending' && st.name === 'Rejected')!.id]!;
  expect(Math.abs(middle(after[done]!) - middle(approvalAfter))).toBeLessThan(4);
  expect(Math.abs(middle(rejected) - middle(approvalAfter))).toBeGreaterThan(rejected.width / 2);
});

test('an edit leaves the stages it does not touch where they were', async ({ page }) => {
  await open(page);
  // Measured once the first check has landed (the To do count is known) and the diagram has stopped moving.
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do/ }).first()).toBeVisible();
  const before = await settledBoxes(page);
  // an arrow with no stage chosen yet ("+ only when ..." in the panel adds one)
  await run(page, 'arrow.add', { stage: 'st_domain_approval' });
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /Choose a stage or ending/ }).first()).toBeVisible();
  // The check of the edit lands (Domain approval gets its to-do line), then the diagram settles.
  await expect(page.getByRole('group', { name: /^Domain approval, Approval/ })).toContainText(/To do/);
  const after = await settledBoxes(page);
  const shift = { x: after.st_request_form!.x - before.st_request_form!.x, y: after.st_request_form!.y - before.st_request_form!.y };
  // Domain approval itself may grow (its to-do line); the stages under it move down by that, no more.
  const grew = after.st_domain_approval!.height - before.st_domain_approval!.height;
  for (const id of Object.keys(before)) {
    expect(Math.abs(after[id]!.x - before[id]!.x - shift.x), id).toBeLessThan(2);
    const dy = after[id]!.y - before[id]!.y - shift.y;
    expect(dy, id).toBeGreaterThan(-2);
    expect(dy, id).toBeLessThan(grew + 2);
  }
});

test('a new arrow to a stage higher up goes back up to it: that stage stays above', async ({ page }) => {
  await open(page);
  const made = (await run(page, 'stage.add', { kind: 'work', insertOn: 'ar_cji_done' })) as { id: string };
  await expect(page.getByRole('group', { name: /^Work, Work/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  await run(page, 'arrow.connect', { from: made.id, to: 'st_domain_approval' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  const after = await boxesOnScreen(page);
  expect(after.st_domain_approval!.y).toBeLessThan(after.st_create_jira_issue!.y);
  expect(after.st_create_jira_issue!.y).toBeLessThan(after[made.id]!.y);
});

test('after an edit the view leaves no box half under the toolbar, and cuts nothing off at the left', async ({ page }) => {

/** The canvas on screen, and whether a rectangle lies whole inside it (below its toolbar row). */
const canvasOf = async (page: Page) => (await page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Diagram of the workflow' }).boundingBox())!;
type R = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
const inside = (r: R, c: R) => r.x >= c.x - 1 && r.x + r.width <= c.x + c.width + 1 && r.y >= c.y + 64 - 1 && r.y + r.height <= c.y + c.height + 1;
const apart = (a: R, b: R) => a.x + a.width <= b.x || b.x + b.width <= a.x || a.y + a.height <= b.y || b.y + b.height <= a.y;

test('after "+ only when ..." widens the layout, every arrow\'s words are in view, none cut at the panel (review fid-3)', async ({ page }) => {
  await open(page);
  // the author clicks the box first: a click is not moving the view by hand
  await page.getByRole('group', { name: /^Domain approval, Approval/ }).click();
  await run(page, 'arrow.add', { stage: 'st_domain_approval' });
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /Choose a stage or ending/ }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const c = await canvasOf(page);
  for (const el of await page.locator('[data-arrow-id]').all()) {
    const b = (await el.boundingBox())!;
    expect(b.x + b.width, await el.innerText()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(c.x + c.width);
    expect(b.x, await el.innerText()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(c.x);
  }
  // Whole (the checks above say it is inside the canvas); at a zoom such as 76% the browser's own

test('Tab to a box or pill off the edge moves the view to it, never scrolls the canvas out of place', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/#/w/integrated-sample');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Below:/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add stage' }).focus();
  const c = await canvasOf(page);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    // The browser's own scroll to the focused box comes as a scroll event on the next frame, which the
    // diagram undoes: wait for that, never read the canvas between the scroll and its undoing.
    await expect
      .poll(
        () =>
          page.evaluate(() => {
            const rf = document.querySelector('.react-flow');
            return rf ? rf.scrollTop + rf.scrollLeft : 0;
          }),
        { message: `after ${i + 1} Tabs` },
      )
      .toBe(0);
    const inCanvas = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement?.closest('.react-flow'));
    if (!inCanvas) continue;
    // The view moves to the focused box with an animation: wait for the box itself to be in view,
    // not for a fixed time that a busy machine may not keep.
    await expect
      .poll(
        () =>
          page.evaluate(() => {
            const r = document.activeElement!.getBoundingClientRect();
            return r.y;
          }),
        { message: `top after ${i + 1} Tabs` },
      )
      .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(c.y - 1);
    await expect
      .poll(
        () =>
          page.evaluate(() => {
            const r = document.activeElement!.getBoundingClientRect();
            return r.y + r.height;
          }),
        { message: `bottom after ${i + 1} Tabs` },
      )
      .toBeLessThanOrEqual(c.y + c.height + 1);
  }
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * The smoke run of the engine's development host (engine/packages/server/scripts/dev-host-smoke.mjs),
 * in the real UI over HTTP: the workflows list, change-request in the editor with To do (0), a
 * request started as Priya Raman, answered as Marcus Lee from My tasks, finished as the person asked
 * next (Diego Santos), and the request page's ending.
 *
 * Skipped unless ENGINE_APP_URL gives the address of a frontend dev server started in HTTP mode
 * (`VITE_ENGINE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787`, see README), with the development host running
 * (`npm run dev-host -- --seed` in engine/). The host signs one person in for every tab: run this
 * spec alone against it.
 */
const app = process.env.ENGINE_APP_URL;
test.skip(!app, 'Set ENGINE_APP_URL to a frontend dev server in HTTP mode to run this.');
test.use({ baseURL: app ?? 'http://localhost:5173' });
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

async function signInAs(page: Page, name: string) {
  const select = page.getByLabel('Signed in as');
  await expect(select).toBeVisible();
  await select.selectOption({ label: name });
  await expect(select.locator('option:checked')).toHaveText(name);
}

/** Opens the task of that title from My tasks; the engine opens tasks after its turn, so the list is read again until it is there. */
async function openTask(page: Page, title: string) {
  await page.goto('/#/tasks');
  await expect(async () => {
    // The page reads My tasks once when it opens: open it again until the task is listed.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: new RegExp(title) })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 2_000 });
  }).toPass({ timeout: 30_000 });
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: new RegExp(title) }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: title })).toBeVisible();
}

  test.setTimeout(120_000);
  const title = `Rotate the payment keys ${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

  await page.goto('/#/');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Workflows' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Engine at http/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Change request', { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();

  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /To do \(0\)/ })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20_000 });

  await page.goto('/#/requests');
  await signInAs(page, 'Priya Raman');
  await page.goto('/#/start/change-request');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Change request' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel('Title', { exact: true }).fill(title);
  await page.getByLabel('Primary domain', { exact: true }).selectOption({ label: 'Payments' });
  await page.getByLabel('Planned release date', { exact: true }).fill('2026-12-02');
  await page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Medium' }).check();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/requests\/\d+/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: title })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Waiting for approval').first()).toBeVisible();

  await signInAs(page, 'Marcus Lee');
  await openTask(page, title);
  await expect(page.getByText('Your turn:')).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Eng lead/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('listbox', { name: /Eng lead/ }).getByRole('option', { name: /Diego Santos/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Done: you pressed Approve' })).toBeVisible();

  // The person asked next: Diego, once the mock Jira has made the issue.
  await signInAs(page, 'Diego Santos');
  await openTask(page, title);
  await page.getByLabel('Release notes', { exact: true }).fill('Keys rotated.');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark released', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Done: you pressed Mark released' })).toBeVisible();

  // The request's page: it ended at Released.
  await page.goto('/#/requests');
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: title }).first().click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/requests\/\d+/);
  await expect(async () => {
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByText(/It ended at Released/).first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 2_000 });
  }).toPass({ timeout: 30_000 });
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: title })).toBeVisible();
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * features/forms in the running app, the defects of review round 2 (shots/review/fix2-forms.json):
 * the words of a question save as they are typed, so nothing moves under the next click (n1); read
 * only offers nothing that changes the form (n2); the form editor's bar under the editor's own (n3);
 * the outline's "if ..." line (n4); a button's name (n5); focus after moving a choice (n7); the text
 * people can read (n8); "Preview as" lists the requester (n9).
 */

type Item = { type: string; id: string; label?: string; showWhen?: unknown };
type Task = { id: string; buttons?: { id: string; label?: string; neededToPress?: string[] }[]; form: { pages: { items: Item[] }[] } };
type EditorStore = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { stages: { id: string; tasks?: Task[] }[] } | null;
    past: unknown[];
    run(name: string, args: unknown): unknown;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorStore };

const DOMAIN_APPROVAL = '/#/w/change-request/form/st_domain_approval/tk_domain_approval';
const REQUEST_FORM = '/#/w/change-request/form/st_request_form/tk_request_form';

const taskOf = (page: Page, stage: string) =>
  page.evaluate((st) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!.stages.find((s) => s.id === st)!.tasks![0]!, stage);

test('n1: the words of a new question save as they are typed, and the first click below them takes', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(DOMAIN_APPROVAL);
  const settings = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Settings' });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add a question' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /^Text/ }).click();
  const label = settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Question' });
  await expect(label).toBeFocused();
  await expect(settings).toContainText('has no words yet', { timeout: 8000 });
  await page.keyboard.type('Cost centre');
  // Still in the box: the To do has gone already, so nothing jumps under the next click.
  await expect(label).toBeFocused();
  await expect(settings).not.toContainText('has no words yet', { timeout: 8000 });
  await page.screenshot({ path: 'shots/fix2-forms-n1-typing.png' });
  const approve = settings.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Approve' });
  await approve.click();
  await expect(approve).toBeChecked();
  const task = await taskOf(page, 'st_domain_approval');
  const added = task.form.pages[0]!.items.at(-1)!;
  expect(added.label).toBe('Cost centre');
  expect(task.buttons!.find((b) => b.label === 'Approve')!.neededToPress).toContain(added.id);
});

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * features/forms in the running app, the defects of review round 1: typed-in choices go on with
 * Enter; a question whose choices come from a connection can be finished; the buttons panel opens
 * the card of the button clicked and offers "+ only when ..." on its arrow; Preview as.
 */

type Choices = { from: string; labelField?: string; storedField?: string; choices?: { label: string }[] };
type Item = { type: string; id: string; label?: string; choices?: Choices };
type EditorStore = {
  getState(): { doc: { stages: { id: string; tasks?: { id: string; form: { pages: { items: Item[] }[] } }[] }[] } | null };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorStore };

const REQUEST_FORM = '/#/w/change-request/form/st_request_form/tk_request_form';
const DOMAIN_APPROVAL = '/#/w/change-request/form/st_domain_approval/tk_domain_approval';

const lastItem = (page: import('@playwright/test').Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => {
    const doc = (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!;
    const items = doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_request_form')!.tasks![0]!.form.pages[0]!.items;
    return items[items.length - 1]!;
  });

test('typed-in choices: Enter keeps the choice and goes on to a new one', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(REQUEST_FORM);
  const settings = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Settings' });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add a question' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /One of several choices/ }).click();
  await settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Question' }).fill('Laptop');
  await settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Question' }).press('Enter');
  await settings.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add a choice' }).click();
  await expect(settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Choice 1' })).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.type('Standard');
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Choice 2' })).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.type('Developer');
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  const item = await lastItem(page);
  expect(item.choices?.choices?.map((c) => c.label)).toEqual(['Standard', 'Developer', '']);
});

test('choices from a connection: choosing the connection finishes the question, and To do says nothing about it', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(REQUEST_FORM);
  const settings = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Settings' });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add a question' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /One of several choices/ }).click();
  await settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Question' }).fill('Service');
  await settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Question' }).press('Enter');
  await settings.getByRole('radio', { name: /From a connection/ }).check();
  const connection = settings.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Connection' });
  const value = await connection.locator('option').evaluateAll((os) => (os as HTMLOptionElement[]).find((o) => o.value)!.value);
  await connection.selectOption(value);
  const item = await lastItem(page);
  expect(item.choices?.labelField).toBeTruthy();
  expect(item.choices?.storedField).toBeTruthy();
  await expect(settings).not.toContainText('has no choices yet', { timeout: 8000 });
  // Nothing in the To do list about Service's choices.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).not.toContainText(/Service.*Choices/);
});

test('buttons: the card of the button clicked opens; "+ only when ..." sits on its arrow', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(DOMAIN_APPROVAL);
  await page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Buttons' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Show the settings of Reject' }).click();
  const settings = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Settings' });
  await expect(settings.getByRole('button', { name: 'Collapse Reject' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  await expect(settings.getByRole('button', { name: 'Expand Approve' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  const group = settings.getByRole('group', { name: 'Only when, for the arrow of Reject' });
  await expect(group.getByRole('button', { name: /only when/ })).toBeVisible();
});

test('preview as: the request, who it was sent to, and whom to preview as', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(DOMAIN_APPROVAL);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Preview as/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Rotate payment gateway API keys' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Sent to .+\. One answer is enough/)).toBeVisible();
  const as = page.getByRole('group', { name: 'Preview as' });
  await expect(as.getByRole('radio')).not.toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(as.getByRole('radio', { checked: true })).toHaveCount(1);
});
===\nfrontend/tests/e2e/forms.spec.ts\n===
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * features/forms in the running app: the form editor of Domain approval. Add a question, make it
 * needed to press Approve, see what Approve says in the preview, give the question a Show when,
 * reload and find it all saved.
 */

type Question = { type: string; id: string; label: string; kind: string; showWhen?: unknown };
type EditorStore = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { stages: { id: string; tasks?: { id: string; form: { pages: { items: Question[] }[] }; buttons: { id: string; label: string; neededToPress: string[]; messageWhileDisabled?: string }[] }[] }[] } | null;
    saveState: string;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorStore };

const FORM = '/#/w/change-request/form/st_domain_approval/tk_domain_approval';

const task = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => {
    const doc = (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!;
    return doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_domain_approval')!.tasks![0]!;
  });

async function saved(page: Page) {
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().saveState)).toBe('saved');
}

test('add a question, make it needed for Approve, see Approve say so in the preview, add a Show when, reload: all saved', async ({ page }) => {
  // It reloads, and the first load of a fresh browser session can be slow on a loaded machine.
  test.slow();
  await page.goto(FORM);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText('Form for: Domain approval', { timeout: 30_000 });
  const settings = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Settings' });

  // + Add a question, by kind; its label is ready to type.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add a question' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /^Text:/ }).click();
  const label = settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Question' });
  await expect(label).toBeFocused();
  await label.fill('Ticket number');
  await label.press('Enter');
  await expect(settings.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Ticket number', exact: true })).toBeVisible();

  // Needed to press Approve: the question and the button bar say the same.
  await settings.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Approve' }).check();
  const form = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'The form as people will see it' });
  await expect(form.getByText('Needed to press: Approve').last()).toBeVisible();
  const approveCard = form.getByRole('region', { name: 'Buttons' }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ has: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show the settings of Approve' }) });
  await expect(approveCard).toContainText('Ticket number');
  let t = await task(page);
  const question = t.form.pages[0]!.items.find((i) => i.label === 'Ticket number')!;
  expect(t.buttons.find((b) => b.label === 'Approve')!.neededToPress).toContain(question.id);

  // The preview: Approve cannot be pressed, and says why in words.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Preview as/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Approve\s*: Needs: Eng lead and Ticket number\.$/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Ticket number' }).fill('HD-1');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Approve\s*: Needs: Eng lead\.$/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit preview' }).click();

  // The author's own message wins.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit buttons' }).click();
  const message = settings.getByRole('textbox', { name: "Message while Approve can't be pressed" });
  await message.fill('Choose a lead and give the ticket first.');
  await message.press('Enter');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Preview as/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Approve\s*: Choose a lead and give the ticket first\.$/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit preview' }).click();

  // Show when: built with the "when ..." builder, and what hiding costs is said.
  await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Pages' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Ticket number' }).click();
  await settings.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Show Ticket number only when ...' }).click();
  const when = settings.locator('[data-at]').filter({ has: page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: answer or value/ }) }).first();
  await when.getByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: answer or value/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('dialog').last().getByText('Risk', { exact: true }).first().click();
  await when.getByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: words/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'is', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('menu')).toHaveCount(0);
  await when.getByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: compared with/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'High' }).click();
  await expect(settings).toContainText('When hidden, Ticket number stays empty.');
  await expect(form).toContainText('Asked only when Risk is High');

  // Reload: everything is still there.
  await saved(page);
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText('Form for: Domain approval');
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'The form as people will see it' })).toContainText('Asked only when Risk is High');
  t = await task(page);
  const after = t.form.pages[0]!.items.find((i) => i.label === 'Ticket number')!;
  expect(after).toMatchObject({ kind: 'text', showWhen: { allOf: [{ left: { value: 'v_risk' }, words: 'choice.is', right: { choice: 'ch_risk_high' } }] } });
  const approve = t.buttons.find((b) => b.label === 'Approve')!;
  expect(approve.neededToPress).toContain(after.id);
  expect(approve.messageWhileDisabled).toBe('Choose a lead and give the ticket first.');
});

test('Switch form goes to another form of the workflow, and Back to diagram returns', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(FORM);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Switch form' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Request form' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveText('Form for: Request form');
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/form\/st_request_form\/tk_request_form$/);
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Back to diagram' }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/w\/change-request$/);
});

test('In words: a sentence is plain text, and the keyboard meets only stage names, each named for what it opens', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request/words');
  const list = page.getByRole('list', { name: 'The workflow, one paragraph per stage' });
  await expect(list.getByRole('listitem')).toHaveCount(6);
  const names: string[] = [];
  const first = list.getByRole('link').first();
  await first.focus();
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const inList = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement?.closest('ol'));
    if (!inList) break;
    names.push(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim() ?? ''));
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  }
  expect(names.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  for (const name of names) expect(name).toMatch(/^(Open .+ on the diagram|Change .+ on the diagram)$/);
  expect(names).not.toContain('.');
  // Request form's paragraph and the paragraph of its arrows have buttons of their own.
  expect(names).toContain('Change Request form on the diagram');
  expect(names).toContain('Change where Request form goes on the diagram');
  await list.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open Create Jira issue on the diagram' }).first().focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/w\/change-request$/);
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().selection?.item)).toBe('st_create_jira_issue');

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The editor store the dev build puts on the page (src/app/main.tsx), seen from the test. */
type Arrow = { id: string; goTo: string | null; when: { type: string; button?: string | null }; onlyWhen?: unknown };
type Stage = { id: string; name: string; status?: string; arrows?: Arrow[]; tasks?: { id: string; whoIsAsked?: unknown; buttons: { id: string; label: string }[] }[] };
type EditorOnPage = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { stages: Stage[]; statuses: { id: string; words: string; colour: string }[] } | null;
    select(location: { item: string } | null): void;
    selection: { item: string; part?: string } | null;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorOnPage };

/** Opens a workflow and chooses a stage (the diagram's click does the same: it selects the stage). */
async function openStage(page: Page, workflow: string, stageId: string) {
  await page.goto(`/#/w/${workflow}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !!(window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc);
  const panel = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'The chosen stage' });
  // The panel shows this stage, not one chosen while the editor was still opening (a selection made
  // too early can be replaced as the workflow's session settles): chosen again until it holds.
  const name = await page.evaluate((id) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!.stages.find((x) => x.id === id)!.name, stageId);
  await expect
    .poll(async () => {
      await page.evaluate((id) => {
        const editor = (window as Win).__editor!.getState();
        if (editor.selection?.item !== id) editor.select({ item: id });
      }, stageId);
      const box = panel.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stage name' });
      return (await box.count()) > 0 ? await box.inputValue() : null;
    })
    .toBe(name);
  return panel;
}

const stage = (page: Page, id: string) =>
  page.evaluate((s) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!.stages.find((x) => x.id === s)!, id);

test('rename a stage', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_development');
  const name = panel.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stage name' });
  await name.fill('Build and release');
  await name.press('Enter');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await stage(page, 'st_development')).name).toBe('Build and release');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Undo/ }).first()).toBeEnabled();
});

test('change a status: pick words already used, then new words and a colour', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_development');
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Status people see In development' }).click();
  let pop = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Status people see' });
  await pop.getByRole('button', { name: 'Waiting for approval' }).click();
  await expect(pop).toBeHidden();
  await expect(panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Status people see Waiting for approval' })).toBeFocused();
  expect((await stage(page, 'st_development')).status).toBe('stat_waiting_for_approval');

  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Status people see Waiting for approval' }).click();
  pop = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Status people see' });
  await pop.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Status words' }).fill('Being built');
  await pop.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Status words' }).press('Enter');
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Status people see Being built' }).click();
  pop = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Status people see' });
  await pop.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Teal' }).check();
  const colour = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const doc = (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!;
    const id = doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === 'st_development')!.status;
    return doc.statuses.find((x) => x.id === id)?.colour;
  });
  expect(colour).toBe('teal');
});

test('add an arrow and choose where it goes', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_request_form');
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add an arrow' }).click();
  const chooser = panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Choose a stage or ending' });
  await expect(chooser).toBeVisible();
  await chooser.click();
  const pop = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Where it goes' });
  await pop.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Find a stage or ending' }).fill('Dev');
  await pop.getByRole('button', { name: 'Development' }).click();
  await expect(panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Development' })).toBeFocused();
  const arrows = (await stage(page, 'st_request_form')).arrows!;
  expect(arrows.map((a) => a.goTo)).toEqual(['st_create_jira_issue', 'st_development', 'st_domain_approval']);
});

test('reorder arrows with the keyboard', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_request_form');
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add an arrow' }).click();
  const added = (await stage(page, 'st_request_form')).arrows![1]!.id;
  const list = panel.getByRole('list', { name: 'The arrows of Request form' });
  const up = list.getByRole('button', { name: /^Move up:/ }).nth(1);
  await up.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await stage(page, 'st_request_form')).arrows!.map((a) => a.id)[0]).toBe(added);
  // Focus stays on the arrow just moved, so it can be moved again; "In all other cases" stays last.
  await expect(list.getByRole('button', { name: /^Move up:/ }).first()).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(list.getByRole('button', { name: /^Move down:/ }).first()).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  const ids = (await stage(page, 'st_request_form')).arrows!.map((a) => a.id);
  expect(ids[1]).toBe(added);
  expect(ids[2]).toBe('ar_rf_other');
});

test('add a button and see its new arrow as a To do in the strip', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
  await expect(panel.getByText('Nothing to do on this stage.')).toBeVisible();
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add a button' }).click();
  const name = panel.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Button name' });
  await expect(name).toBeFocused();
  await name.fill('Escalate');
  await name.press('Enter');
  const strip = panel.getByRole('region', { name: 'To do and Worth knowing on this stage' });
  await expect(strip.getByText(/^To do:/).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(strip).toContainText('Escalate');
  await expect(panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Choose a stage or ending' })).toBeVisible();
  // The fix is in words ("Choose a stage or ending"), and takes focus to the control it names.
  await expect(strip.getByRole('button', { name: /^Show me/ })).toHaveCount(0);
  await strip.getByRole('button', { name: /^Choose a stage or ending:/ }).first().click();
  const chooser = panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Choose a stage or ending' });
  await expect(chooser.locator('xpath=ancestor::li[1]')).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
  await expect(chooser).toBeFocused();
});

test('"+ only when ..." adds a new arrow above the plain one, which stays', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
  await expect(panel.getByText('Only for some requests?')).toBeVisible();
  const approveRow = panel.locator('li', { has: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Where it goes: Create Jira issue' }) });
  await approveRow.getByRole('button', { name: '+ only when ...' }).click();
  // The "when ..." opens in place; the new arrow is made once its first part is chosen.
  await approveRow.getByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: answer or value/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('option', { name: /^Risk/ }).first().click();
  const arrows = async () => (await stage(page, 'st_domain_approval')).arrows!;
  await expect.poll(async () => (await arrows()).filter((a) => a.when.button === 'btn_da_approve').length).toBe(2);
  const list = await arrows();
  const approve = list.filter((a) => a.when.button === 'btn_da_approve');
  expect(approve[1]!.id).toBe('ar_da_approve');
  expect(approve[1]!.goTo).toBe('st_create_jira_issue');
  expect(approve[0]!.goTo).toBeNull();
  await expect(panel.getByText(/Placed above the plain Approve arrow/)).toBeVisible();
  // Focus is in the new arrow's "when", ready to pick what it depends on.
  const focusedIn = await page.evaluate((id) => !!document.activeElement?.closest(`[data-reveal="${id}"]`), approve[0]!.id);
  expect(focusedIn).toBe(true);
  // Its "only when" is not chosen yet: the plain arrow is not called "never used", and nothing offers
  // to move it back above the new one (03-routing, the new row), neither on the row nor in the strip.
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await expect(panel.getByText(/can never be used/)).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(panel.getByRole('button', { name: /^Move it above/ })).toHaveCount(0);
});

test('focus goes somewhere sensible after the delete question closes', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_development');
  const more = panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'More for this stage' });
  const ask = async () => {
    await more.focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Delete this stage' }).press('Enter');
    return page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Delete Development?' });
  };
  // Escape and Cancel: back to "More for this stage".
  await expect(await ask()).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(more).toBeFocused();
  const dialog = await ask();
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).press('Enter');
  await expect(more).toBeFocused();
  // Deleted: to the diagram, as the diagram's own Delete does.
  await (await ask()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete stage' }).press('Enter');
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Diagram of the workflow' })).toBeFocused();
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().doc!.stages.some((x) => x.id === 'st_development'))).toBe(false);
});

test('"Move it above" keeps focus on the arrow it moved', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_domain_approval');
  // A narrowed Approve arrow below the plain one can never be used.
  const id = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const ed = (window as unknown as { __editor: { getState(): { doc: { stages: { id: string; arrows: { when: { condition?: unknown } }[] }[] }; run(n: string, a: unknown): { id: string } } } }).__editor;
    const condition = ed.getState().doc.stages.find((x) => x.id === 'st_request_form')!.arrows[0]!.when.condition;
    const made = ed.getState().run('arrow.add', { stage: 'st_domain_approval', when: { type: 'buttonPressed', button: 'btn_da_approve' } });
    ed.getState().run('arrow.setOnlyWhen', { arrow: made.id, onlyWhen: condition });
    return made.id;
  });
  const row = panel.locator(`[data-reveal="${id}"]`);
  const move = row.getByRole('button', { name: /^Move it above/ });
  await expect(move).toBeVisible();
  await move.click();
  await expect.poll(async () => (await stage(page, 'st_domain_approval')).arrows!.findIndex((a) => a.id === id)).toBe(0);
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate((x) => !!document.activeElement?.closest(`[data-reveal="${x}"]`), id)).toBe(true);
});

type Runner = { getState(): { run(n: string, a: unknown): unknown } };
const run = (page: Page, name: string, args: unknown) =>
  page.evaluate(([n, a]) => ((window as unknown as { __editor: Runner }).__editor.getState().run(n as string, a)), [name, args] as const);

test('an arrow back up to an Automatic stage says the stage happens again, not that people are asked', async ({ page }) => {
  const panel = await openStage(page, 'change-request', 'st_development');
  // As a drag from Development onto Create Jira issue makes it: a "when ..." arrow to that stage.
  const made = (await run(page, 'arrow.add', { stage: 'st_development', when: { type: 'condition' } })) as { id: string };
  await run(page, 'arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: made.id, goTo: 'st_create_jira_issue' });
  const row = panel.locator(`[data-reveal="${made.id}"]`);
  await expect(row).toContainText('sends it back');
  await expect(row).toContainText('Create Jira issue happens again.');
  await expect(row).not.toContainText('asked again');
  await row.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await panel.screenshot({ path: 'shots/panel-sends-back-automatic.png' });
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * The pages people use (mockup 12): start a Change request, answer it as the approver and then as
 * the lead until it is Released; and open the stuck request as the person who looks after stuck
 * requests, Retry it, and see it move on. Each test starts from the stand-in's seed.
 */

async function signInAs(page: Page, name: string) {
  const select = page.getByLabel('Signed in as');
  await expect(select).toBeVisible();
  await select.selectOption({ label: name });
  await expect(select.locator('option:checked')).toHaveText(name);
}

async function openTask(page: Page, title: string) {
  await page.goto('/#/tasks');
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: new RegExp(title) }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: title })).toBeVisible();
}

test('start a Change request, answer it as the approver, then as the lead, to Released', async ({ page }) => {
  const title = 'Move payment logs to the new store';
  await page.goto('/#/requests');
  await signInAs(page, 'Priya Raman');

  await page.goto('/#/start/change-request');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Change request' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel('Title', { exact: true }).fill(title);
  await page.getByLabel('Primary domain', { exact: true }).selectOption({ label: 'Payments' });
  await page.getByLabel('Planned release date', { exact: true }).fill('2026-12-10');
  await page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Low' }).check();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/requests\/\d+/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: title })).toBeVisible();
  // Landed on the new request: the focus is on its heading.
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: title }).locator('[tabindex="-1"]')).toBeFocused();
  await expect(page.getByText('Your request is started.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Waiting for approval').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Payments approvers are asked/)).toBeVisible();

  // The approver: the task is listed via the group, and its page says it is their turn.
  await signInAs(page, 'Marcus Lee');
  await page.goto('/#/tasks');
  await expect(page.getByText('You are asked as one of Payments approvers').first()).toBeVisible();
  await openTask(page, title);
  await expect(page.getByText('Your turn:')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('One answer is enough: the first person in the group to answer decides.').first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Eng lead/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('listbox', { name: /Eng lead/ }).getByRole('option', { name: /Diego Santos/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Done: you pressed Approve' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Development: Diego Santos is asked/).first()).toBeVisible();

  // The lead marks it released: the request ends at Released.
  await signInAs(page, 'Diego Santos');
  await openTask(page, title);
  await page.getByLabel('Release notes', { exact: true }).fill('Logs now go to the new store.');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark released', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Done: you pressed Mark released' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/It ended at Released/).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Released', { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
});

test('the person who looks after stuck requests retries the stuck request, and it moves on', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/#/requests');
  await signInAs(page, 'Sam Carter');

  // Stuck first on the list, for the person who looks after them.
  const stuck = page.getByRole('table', { name: 'Stuck requests you look after' });
  await expect(stuck.getByRole('link', { name: 'Rotate the ledger signing keys' })).toBeVisible();
  await stuck.getByRole('link', { name: 'Rotate the ledger signing keys' }).click();

  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'This request is stuck at Fix deployment' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Create a Jira issue did not work, so nothing after it has happened yet.')).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByText('Technical detail').click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Project 'OPS' does not exist.")).toBeVisible();

  const retry = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry', exact: true });
  await retry.click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Retry this request?' });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  // A reason is needed: said in words, nothing sent.
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByText('Say why first.', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByLabel('Why are you retrying it?').fill('The OPS project exists now.');
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry', exact: true }).click();

  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'Retried. The page now shows where the request is.' })).toBeFocused();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'This request is stuck at Fix deployment' })).toBeHidden();
  // Asked again at Fix deployment (who is asked depends on the sample data).
  const path = page.getByRole('list', { name: 'The stages of request 1005, in order' });
  await expect(path.getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Fix deployment' })).toContainText('Now');
  await expect(page.getByText(/Sam Carter retried it: “The OPS project exists now.”/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Create a Jira issue was done/)).toBeVisible();
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The editor store the dev build puts on the page (src/app/main.tsx), seen from the test. */
type EditorOnPage = {
  getState(): {
    selection: { item: string; part?: string } | null;
    saveState: string;
    run(name: string, args: unknown): unknown;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorOnPage };

/**
 * Opens the demo and waits until its first check has come back ("To do (0)"). The first load of a
 * fresh context can take well over the 5 s an expectation waits by default when the machine is loaded
 * (the dev server compiles, the stand-in seeds, the check runs), so this one wait is load-sized;
 * every expectation after it is about the screen reacting, which the default covers.
 */
async function openDemo(page: Page) {
  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request');
  const top = page.getByRole('banner');
  await expect(top.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)', exact: true })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
  return top;
}

const saveState = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().saveState);
const run = (page: Page, name: string, args: unknown) =>
  page.evaluate(([n, a]) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().run(n as string, a), [name, args] as const);

test('deleting a stage blocks Publish; Show me goes to the arrow; once fixed, version 4 is published', async ({ page }) => {
  // A long journey with a publish and a reload: three times the default time, for a loaded machine.
  test.slow();
  const top = await openDemo(page);
  // The seed's draft is the same as version 3, so nothing is new to publish (as the workflows list says).
  await expect(top.getByText('Published', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByText('Version 3 is live', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  // Worth knowing is shown only when something is worth knowing (mockup 01: "To do (0)" alone).
  await expect(top.getByRole('button', { name: /^Worth knowing/ })).toHaveCount(0);
  // Nothing new: a plain greyed "Publish" (mockup 09), its reason in its tooltip and description, not on the label.
  const greyed = top.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish', exact: true });
  await expect(greyed).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
  await expect(greyed).toHaveText('Publish');
  await expect(greyed).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Nothing has changed since version 3');
  await greyed.hover();
  await expect(page.getByRole('tooltip')).toContainText('Nothing has changed since version 3');
  await top.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)', exact: true }).click();
  const empty = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'To do before publishing' });
  await expect(empty.getByText('Nothing to do, and nothing new to publish.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(empty.getByText('Change something to publish a new version.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(empty.getByText(/You can publish/)).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(empty.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish', exact: true })).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Nothing has changed since version 3');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(empty).toBeHidden();

  // Break the demo: Domain approval's "Reject pressed" arrow now goes to a deleted stage.
  await run(page, 'stage.delete', { stage: 'st_rejected' });
  const blocked = top.getByRole('button', { name: /^Publish · 1 to do first/ });
  await expect(blocked).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (1)', exact: true })).toBeVisible();

  // Pressing the greyed Publish opens the To do drawer.
  await blocked.click();

  await expect(drawer).toBeVisible();
  await expect(drawer.getByText('1 thing to do before version 4 can be published.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    drawer.getByText('The arrow "Reject pressed" goes to Rejected (deleted), a stage that is no longer in the workflow.'),
  ).toBeVisible();
  // Its fix is offered beside Show me (section 7), and no tone tag is shown (mockup 09).
  await expect(drawer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Choose another stage' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(drawer.getByText('Contradicts itself')).toHaveCount(0);

  // Show me: the arrow is chosen in the editor, and the drawer folds into a bar that stays usable.
  await drawer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show me' }).click();
  await expect(drawer).toBeHidden();
  const bar = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Going through what is left to do' });
  await expect(bar).toContainText('1 left');
  // "Next to do >" (mockup 09, show me): the chevron follows the words and is not read out.
  const nextToDo = bar.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next to do', exact: true });
  await expect(nextToDo.locator('svg:last-child[aria-hidden="true"] path')).toHaveAttribute('d', 'M6 4l4 4-4 4');
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().selection?.item)).toBe('ar_da_reject');

  // Fix it where it is (the stage panel's stage picker belongs to another feature; the store stands in for it).
  await run(page, 'arrow.setGoTo', { arrow: 'ar_da_reject', goTo: 'st_released' });
  await expect(bar).toContainText('Nothing left to do');
  await bar.getByRole('button', { name: 'All To do items' }).click();
  await expect(drawer.getByText('Nothing to do. You can publish.').first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(drawer).toBeHidden();
  // Focus goes back to Publish, which opened the drawer, and Publish is no longer greyed.
  const publishButton = top.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish', exact: true });
  await expect(publishButton).toBeFocused();

  // Publish: what changed, what it means for requests in progress, then version 4.
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Publish version 4?' });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  // Escape closes it and gives focus back to Publish; Enter opens it again.
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
  await expect(publishButton).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await expect(dialog.getByText('Nothing left to do.')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: 'What changed since version 3' })).toBeVisible();
  // Every change a full sentence, in the order a request meets the stages.
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('list', { name: 'What changed since version 3' }).getByRole('listitem')).toHaveText([
    'At Domain approval, the arrow "Reject pressed" now goes to Released.',
    'Ending Rejected deleted.',
  ]);
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Requests already in progress' })).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish version 4' }).click();
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();

  await expect(top.getByText('Published', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByText('Version 4 is live, published just now')).toBeVisible();
  const toast = page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'Version 4 is live.' });
  await expect(toast).toContainText('New requests use it from now on.');
  await expect(toast).not.toContainText('Version history');
  await toast.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' }).click();
  await expect(toast).toBeHidden();

  // After a reload with no edit, it is still published and there is nothing new to publish.
  await page.reload();
  // A reload loads the app again: as long a wait as the first opening.
  await expect(top.getByRole('button', { name: 'To do (0)', exact: true })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
  await expect(top.getByText('Version 4 is live', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByText('Published', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByText('Draft (not live)', { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
  const nothingNew = top.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish', exact: true });
  await expect(nothingNew).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
  await expect(nothingNew).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Nothing has changed since version 4');

  // The next edit starts a new draft.
  await run(page, 'stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'Shipped' });
  await expect(top.getByText('Draft (not live)', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByText('Version 4 is live', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(top.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish', exact: true })).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled');
});

// The editor's top bar at the mockups' 1440px (the frontend owner's ruling, fix round 2): ONE row,
// nothing overlapping, in every state. A long name is cut with "..." after 28 characters (the whole
// name in its accessible name); "Glossary" stays a word; the save state stays in words; To do and
// Worth knowing may both show. When room runs out the version line shortens first ("v 3 live"),
// then the tabs tighten; never the Glossary word, the save state or a count.
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

type Win = Window & { __editor?: { getState(): { saveState: string; run(n: string, a: unknown): unknown } } };

const NAME_28 = 'Change request for databases';
const views = (page: Page) => page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Views of this workflow' });
const bar = (page: Page) => page.locator('header').filter({ has: views(page) });
const run = (page: Page, name: string, args: unknown) =>
  page.evaluate(([n, a]) => void (window as Win).__editor!.getState().run(n as string, a), [name, args] as const);

/** The demo, renamed to a name of 28 characters (the longest the ruling asks to show whole). */
async function openDemoNamed(page: Page, name = NAME_28) {
  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request');
  await expect(views(page)).toBeVisible();
  await bar(page).getByRole('button', { name: /^Rename the workflow/ }).click();
  const box = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Name of the workflow' });
  await box.fill(name);
  await box.press('Enter');
  // A name over 28 characters is shown cut with "…" (WorkflowName), so the rename is checked by the button's accessible name.
  await expect(bar(page).getByRole('button', { name: `Rename the workflow: ${name}`, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
}

/** True when the element is drawn, not cut, and nothing covers its middle. */
async function seenWhole(page: Page, selector: string): Promise<string | true> {
  return page.evaluate((sel) => {
    const el = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(sel);
    if (!el) return `missing: ${sel}`;
    const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (b.width < 3 || b.height < 3) return `not drawn: ${sel}`;
    if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1) return `cut: ${sel} (${el.scrollWidth} > ${el.clientWidth})`;
    const hit = document.elementFromPoint(b.left + b.width / 2, b.top + b.height / 2);
    if (!hit || !(el.contains(hit) || hit.contains(el))) return `covered: ${sel}`;
    return true;
  }, selector);
}

/** Pairs of the bar's controls (and the save line) whose boxes overlap: none may. */
async function overlaps(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  return page.evaluate(() => {
    const header = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('header')).find((h) => h.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Views of this workflow"]'))!;
    const els = Array.from(header.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('a, button, [role="status"]')).filter((el) => {
      const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return b.width > 2 && b.height > 2 && !el.closest('[role="dialog"]');
    });
    const out: string[] = [];
    els.forEach((a, i) => {
      for (const b of els.slice(i + 1)) {
        if (a.contains(b) || b.contains(a)) continue;
        const r = a.getBoundingClientRect();
        const s = b.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = Math.min(r.right, s.right) - Math.max(r.left, s.left);
        const y = Math.min(r.bottom, s.bottom) - Math.max(r.top, s.top);
        if (x > 0.5 && y > 0.5) out.push(`${a.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? a.textContent} / ${b.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? b.textContent}`);
      }
    });
    return out;
  });
}

/** Everything the ruling lists, on one row, nothing overlapping; the name whole up to 28 characters, cut after. */
async function expectEverythingInFull(page: Page, name: string, save: RegExp) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(500); // the fit runs on the next frame after a change
  const header = bar(page);
  const box = await header.boundingBox();
  expect(box!.height, 'one row').toBeLessThanOrEqual(60);
  expect(await overlaps(page), 'nothing overlapping').toEqual([]);

  await expect(header.getByRole('link', { name: 'All workflows' })).toBeVisible();
  // the name: whole up to 28 characters; a longer one is cut with "...", whole in its accessible name
  const nameButton = header.getByRole('button', { name: /^Rename the workflow/ });
  await expect(nameButton).toBeVisible();
  expect(await nameButton.getAttribute('aria-label')).toContain(name);
  if (name.length <= 28) {
    const nameText = header.getByText(name, { exact: true });
    await expect(nameText).toBeVisible();
    expect(await nameText.evaluate((el) => el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth + 1)).toBe(true);
  }
  // the version badge and line
  await expect(header.getByText(/^(Draft \(not live\)|Published)$/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(header.locator('[data-topbar-shrink]')).toBeVisible();
  // the three tabs, with their words
  for (const tab of ['Diagram', 'In words', 'Values']) {
    const link = views(page).getByRole('link', { name: tab });
    await expect(link).toBeVisible();
    await expect(link).toHaveText(tab);
  }
  // "Glossary" as a word
  expect(await seenWhole(page, 'header [data-topbar-label]')).toBe(true);
  await expect(header.getByText('Glossary', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  // the save state in words
  const status = header.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: save }).first();
  await expect(status).toBeVisible();
  const seen = await status.evaluate((el) => {
    const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const hit = document.elementFromPoint(b.left + b.width / 2, b.top + b.height / 2);
    return b.width > 2 && !!hit && el.contains(hit);
  });
  expect(seen, 'save state seen').toBe(true);
  for (const button of [/^Undo/, /^Redo/, /^Settings$/, /^To do \(\d+\)$/, /^Publish/]) {

}

  await page.goto('/#/');
