  await expect(who).toBeVisible();
  const priya = await who.locator('option', { hasText: 'Priya Raman' }).getAttribute('value');
  await who.selectOption(priya!);
  await expect(who).toHaveValue(priya!);

  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request');
  await expect(views(page)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/You can look at this workflow but not change it: only its authors can/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(bar(page).getByText('Read only', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(bar(page).getByRole('button', { name: /^Undo/ })).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(bar(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-fit', /^[0-2]$/);

  const name = () =>
    page.evaluate(() => {
      const st = (window as Win).__editor!.getState() as unknown as { doc: { stages: { id: string; name: string }[] } };
      return st.doc.stages.find((s) => s.id === 'st_released')?.name;
    });
  const before = await name();
  await run(page, 'stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: 'Not mine' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  expect(await name()).toBe(before);
  await expect(page.getByText('Not saved. Trying again.')).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.reload();
  await expect(views(page)).toBeVisible();
  expect(await name()).toBe(before);
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The editor store the dev build puts on the page (src/app/main.tsx), seen from the test. */
type EditorOnPage = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { lists: { id: string; rows: { id: string; cells: Record<string, unknown> }[] }[] } | null;
    select(selection: { item: string }): void;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorOnPage };

async function openStage(page: Page, stage: string, workflow = 'change-request') {
  await page.goto(`/#/w/${workflow}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc);
  await page.evaluate((id) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().select({ item: id }), stage);
  // Selecting before the diagram has drawn can be lost: select again once it is there.
  await page.getByRole('application').waitFor();
  await page.evaluate((id) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().select({ item: id }), stage);
}

const cell = (page: Page, row: string, column: string) =>
  page.evaluate(
    ([r, c]) => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc?.lists.find((l) => l.id === 'ls_domains')?.rows.find((x) => x.id === r)?.cells[c!],
    [row, column],
  );

  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
  // Focus goes back to the link that opened the dialog.
  await expect(link).toBeFocused();

  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Domain needs no approval \(Identity or Internal tools\)"/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Arrow "Domain needs no approval \(Internal tools\)"/ })).toHaveCount(0);
});

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The editor store the dev build puts on the page (src/app/main.tsx), seen from the test. */
type EditorOnPage = {
  getState(): {
    doc: { stages: { id: string; tasks?: { id: string; whoIsAsked?: unknown }[] }[] } | null;
    select(selection: { item: string }): void;
  };
};
type Win = Window & { __editor?: EditorOnPage };

const whoIsAsked = (page: Page, stage: string) =>
  page.evaluate((id) => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc?.stages.find((s) => s.id === id)?.tasks?.[0]?.whoIsAsked, stage);

async function openStage(page: Page, stage: string, workflow = 'change-request') {
  await page.goto(`/#/w/${workflow}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => (window as Win).__editor?.getState().doc);
  await page.evaluate((id) => (window as Win).__editor!.getState().select({ item: id }), stage);
}

/** The panel's "Who is asked" field. The panel is built, so a missing field fails the test. */
async function whoField(page: Page) {
  const field = page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Who is asked: / }).first();
  await expect(field, 'The stage panel shows "Who is asked"').toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
  return field;
}

test("Development: Eng lead's fallback can be removed and offered again in place", async ({ page }) => {
  await openStage(page, 'st_development');
  const field = await whoField(page);
  await expect(field).toHaveAccessibleName('Who is asked: Eng lead');
  const fallback = page.getByRole('group', { name: 'If Eng lead is empty, ask' });
  await expect(fallback).toBeVisible();

  const card = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Who Development asks, for each kind of request' });
  await expect(card).toContainText("Primary domain's default lead.");

  await fallback.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear If Eng lead is empty, ask' }).click();
  // The sentence is the model's finding (describe); its punctuation is not this test's concern.
  await expect(page.getByText(/^Eng lead may be empty here[.:]/).last()).toBeVisible();
  await expect.poll(() => whoIsAsked(page, 'st_development')).toEqual({ value: 'v_eng_lead' });
  // Focus goes to the offer that comes back, not to the page.
  // The panel's To do strip offers the same fix as a button of the same name; this is the field's own offer.
  const offer = page
    .getByRole('button', { name: "If empty, ask Primary domain's default lead" })
    .and(page.locator(':not([role="region"][aria-label^="To do and Worth knowing"] *)'));
  await expect(offer).toBeFocused();
  await expect(card).toContainText('Eng lead is empty, so nobody is asked. The request is stuck here.');

  await offer.click();
  await expect.poll(() => whoIsAsked(page, 'st_development')).toEqual({
    value: 'v_eng_lead',
    ifEmptyUse: { value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_default_lead' }] },
  });
  await expect(fallback.getByRole('button', { name: "If Eng lead is empty, ask: Primary domain's default lead" })).toBeFocused();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: "Done: if Eng lead is empty, Development now asks Primary domain's default lead." })).toBeVisible();
});

test('Who is asked: Add "when ..." lets it depend on an answer, and the picker stays clear of the top bar', async ({ page }) => {
  await openStage(page, 'st_development');
  const field = await whoField(page);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear Who is asked' }).click();
  await field.click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Choose a value for Who is asked' });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();

  // Opens below the field, never over the top bar (To do, Publish). The panel scrolls to make room
  // as the picker opens; under a loaded dev server that takes a moment, so wait for it to settle.
  await expect
    .poll(async () => {
      const [p, f] = [await dialog.boundingBox(), await field.boundingBox()];
      return !!p && !!f && p.y >= f.y + f.height;
    })
    .toBe(true);
  const pop = (await dialog.boundingBox())!;
  const at = (await field.boundingBox())!;
  const toDo = (await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^To do/ }).first().boundingBox())!;
  expect(pop.y).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(at.y + at.height);
  expect(pop.y).toBeGreaterThan(toDo.y + toDo.height);
  expect(pop.y + pop.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(900);

  // The footer offers both links (editor-model.md section 4, ruling 8).
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Write a formula' })).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add "when ..."' }).click();
  const search = dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Search values' });
  await expect(search).toBeFocused();
  await expect(dialog.getByText('Who is asked can depend on an answer that is chosen from a list.', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
  const answers = dialog.getByRole('listbox', { name: 'Answers Who is asked can depend on' });
  await expect(answers.getByRole('group', { name: /^Depends on the answer to Primary domain/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(answers.getByRole('option', { name: /^Title/ })).toHaveCount(0);

  // Back to all values and in again, with the keyboard.
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'All values' }).click();
  await expect(search).toBeFocused();
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('listbox', { name: 'Values to choose from' })).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add "when ..."' }).click();

  await page.keyboard.type('approvers');
  await expect(answers.getByRole('option', { name: /^Primary domain's approvers/ })).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
  await expect(field).toBeFocused();
  await expect.poll(() => whoIsAsked(page, 'st_development')).toEqual({ value: 'v_primary_domain', steps: [{ column: 'col_approvers' }] });
});

test('saved again from another window: one true line with a short button at 1440, and the dialog says it was you', async ({ page, context }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
  type Probe = Window & {
    __editor?: { getState(): { saveState: string; run(name: string, args: unknown): unknown } };
  };
  const rename = (p: typeof page, name: string) =>
    p.evaluate((n) => void (window as Probe).__editor?.getState().run('stage.rename', { stage: 'st_released', name: n }), name);
  const saved = (p: typeof page) =>
    expect.poll(() => p.evaluate(() => (window as Probe).__editor?.getState().saveState)).toBe('saved');

  // Each window waits for the editor itself (its save state on screen), not for every module of the
  // dev server to finish loading (the load event), which under load can take longer than the test.
  await page.goto('/#/w/change-request', { waitUntil: 'commit' });
  const top = page.getByRole('banner');
  await expect(top.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'All changes saved' })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
  await rename(page, 'Dev A1');
  await saved(page);
  // The same person opens the workflow in a second window and saves there.
  const other = await context.newPage();
  await other.goto('/#/w/change-request', { waitUntil: 'commit' });
  await expect(other.getByRole('banner').getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'All changes saved' })).toBeVisible({
    timeout: 15_000,
  });
  await rename(other, 'Dev B');
  await saved(other);
  await rename(page, 'Dev A2');
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => (window as Probe).__editor?.getState().saveState)).toBe('conflict');

  const said = top.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'Not saved. A newer draft was saved.' });
  await expect(said).toBeVisible();
  // In sight only "Not saved." (the reason is read out with it, and the dialog explains).
  expect((await said.boundingBox())?.width).toBeLessThan(110);
  const button = top.getByRole('button', { name: 'Load the latest draft of this workflow' });
  await expect(button).toBeVisible();
  await expect(button).toHaveText('Load the latest');
  await expect(top.getByText(/Someone else/)).toHaveCount(0);
  // One line each, side by side, and the top bar stays one row.
  const line = await said.evaluate((el) => {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { h: r.height, lineHeight: parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).lineHeight) || 20 };
  });
  expect(line.h).toBeLessThan(line.lineHeight * 1.6);
  const b = await button.boundingBox();
  const s = await said.boundingBox();
  expect(b && b.height).toBeLessThan(32);
  expect(b && s && Math.abs(b.y + b.height / 2 - (s.y + s.height / 2))).toBeLessThan(4);
  expect((await top.boundingBox())?.height).toBeLessThan(64);
  await button.click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Load the latest draft?' });
  await expect(dialog.getByText(/^You saved it .+, in another window\.$/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(dialog.getByText(/^Not now keeps your changes on screen/)).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Not now' }).click();
  await expect(button).toBeFocused();
});

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { Button, Mark } from '@/ui';

describe('Button', () => {
  it('is a real button that runs onClick', async () => {
    const onClick = vi.fn();
    render(<Button onClick={onClick}>Try it</Button>);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try it' }));
    expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it('when blocked, stays focusable, says why, and does not run onClick', async () => {
    const onClick = vi.fn();
    render(
      <Button onClick={onClick} disabledReason="Publishing is possible once nothing is left to do">
        Publish
      </Button>,
    );
    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Publish.*nothing is left to do/ });
    expect(button).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    await userEvent.click(button);
    expect(onClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    button.blur();
    await userEvent.tab();
    expect(button).toHaveFocus();
  });
});

describe('Mark', () => {
  it('always carries its words, not only a colour', () => {
    render(
      <>
        <Mark variant="todo">choose who is asked</Mark>
        <Mark variant="worth" />
      </>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText('To do:')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('choose who is asked')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Worth knowing')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
===\nfrontend/tests/unit/slots.test.tsx\n===
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import type { Condition, Expression, Formula, Task, Template } from '@/contract';
import {
  indexDoc, openWorkflow, resetSessionForTests, Slot, SlotsProvider, useEditor, type AlsoStartsFromProps,
  type StageActionsProps, type StageKindChoice,
} from '@/model';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { createStandinServices, ServicesProvider, type Answers } from '@/services';
import { StagePanel } from '@/features/panel';
import { slots } from '@/app/slots';

afterEach(() => resetSessionForTests());

describe('model slots', () => {
  it("show another feature's part where the panel places it, with the props the slot names", async () => {
    const seen: StageActionsProps[] = [];
    function FakeActions(props: StageActionsProps) {
      seen.push(props);
      return <p>actions at {props.place}</p>;
    }
    const { services } = createStandinServices();
    await act(() => openWorkflow(services, 'change-request'));
    // With nothing chosen the panel only says to choose a stage, so a stage is chosen first.
    act(() => useEditor.getState().select({ item: 'st_domain_approval' }));
    render(
      <ServicesProvider services={services}>
        <SlotsProvider slots={{ StageActions: FakeActions }}>
          <MemoryRouter>
            <StagePanel />
          </MemoryRouter>
        </SlotsProvider>
      </ServicesProvider>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText('actions at stageStarts')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('actions at afterRespond')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(seen.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(seen.every((p) => p.stageId === 'st_domain_approval')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('render nothing when unfilled', () => {
    render(<Slot name="KindChooser" onChoose={() => undefined} />);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button')).toBeNull();
  });

  it("are filled by src/app with the features' own components, which are controlled", async () => {
    const { services } = createStandinServices();
    await act(() => openWorkflow(services, 'change-request'));
    const doc = useEditor.getState().doc!;
    const entries = [...indexDoc(doc).byId.values()];
    const arrow = entries.find((e) => e.kind === 'arrow')!;
    const stage = entries.find((e) => e.kind === 'stage' && e.item.kind !== 'ending' && e.id !== doc.start.stage)!;
    const list = doc.lists[0]!;

    const when = vi.fn<(next: Condition | undefined) => void>();
    const formula = vi.fn<(next: Formula | undefined) => void>();
    const value = vi.fn<(next: Expression | undefined) => void>();
    const message = vi.fn<(next: Template | undefined) => void>();
    const kind = vi.fn<(k: StageKindChoice) => void>();
    const listOpen = vi.fn<(open: boolean) => void>();

    // An opened "when ..." stays inside the builder until its first part is chosen; then that part is handed back.
    const alone = render(
      <SlotsProvider slots={slots}>
        <Slot name="WhenBuilder" at={{ item: arrow.id, part: 'when.condition' }} value={undefined} onChange={(next) => when(next)} />
      </SlotsProvider>,
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '+ only when ...' }));
    expect(when).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /^Part 1: answer or value/ }));
    const part = (await screen.findAllByRole('option')).find((o) => o.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true')!;
    fireEvent.click(part);

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { glossary, t, wordFiles, words } from '@/words';

describe('t()', () => {
  it('returns the words for a key', () => {
    expect(t('word.stage')).toBe('Stage');
    expect(t('version.draft')).toBe('Draft (not live)');
  });

  it('fills in {name} from params', () => {
    expect(t('todo.button', { n: 2 })).toBe('To do (2)');
    expect(t('forms.formFor', { stage: 'Domain approval' })).toBe('Form for: Domain approval');
  });

  it('leaves a placeholder in place when its param is missing, so it shows up', () => {
    expect(t('version.live', {})).toBe('Version {n} is live');
    expect(t('version.live')).toBe('Version {n} is live');
  });
});

describe('the words module', () => {
  it('keeps each feature to keys that start with its own name', () => {
    for (const [file, entries] of Object.entries(wordFiles)) {
      if (file === 'core') continue;
      for (const key of Object.keys(entries)) expect(key, `${key} in words/${file}.ts`).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${file}\\.`));
    }
  });

  it('never defines a key twice', () => {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const entries of Object.values(wordFiles)) for (const key of Object.keys(entries)) counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
    expect([...counts].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).map(([k]) => k)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('has the seven Glossary words', () => {
    expect(glossary.map((g) => t(g.word))).toEqual(['Stage', 'Task', 'Arrow', 'Value', 'Kind', 'To do', 'Stuck']);
  });

  it('puts no engine words on screen', () => {
    const banned = /\b(wait|outcome|transition|node|edge|variable|state machine|CEL)\b/i;
    // "Wait for" is the product name of the action that waits for another system (editor-model.md
    // section 10, note 10). "Don't wait for the others" is the one other allowed use (editor-model.md
    // section 1, ruling 1): the arrow that goes as soon as it fits when several tasks are asked.
    // "and wait until it reports back" is the reference's own sentence for a closed Wait for action
    // (editor-model.md section 10, "Does something and waits"; mockup 14-connections, the Deploy card).
    const allowed = (text: string) =>
      text
        .replace(/\bWait for\b/g, '')
        .replace(/\bDon't wait for the others\b/g, '')
        .replace(/\band wait until it reports back\b/g, '');
    const offenders = Object.entries(words).filter(([, text]) => banned.test(allowed(text)));
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('allows "Wait for" as a name but still bans "wait" on its own', () => {
    const banned = /\bwait\b/i;
    const allowed = (text: string) => text.replace(/\bWait for\b/g, '');
    expect(banned.test(allowed(words['describe.action.await'] ?? ''))).toBe(false);
    expect(banned.test(allowed('Please wait for it'))).toBe(true);
    expect(banned.test(allowed('Wait for Deploy, then wait'))).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * Records real answers of the engine's development host for the HTTP services' unit tests
 * (src/services/http/__fixtures__). Run once against a host started fresh with `--seed`:
 *
 *   (from engine/)   npm run dev-host -- --seed
 *   (from frontend/) node tools/record-engine-fixtures.mjs [http://127.0.0.1:8787]
 *
 * Each fixture is `{ request: { method, path, body? }, status, coreVersion, body }`: the request as
 * sent (the path relative to the API base, `/api/workflow/v1`) and the answer as received. The run
 * changes the host's data (it publishes, starts and finishes requests): restart the host afterwards
 * for a clean state. Nothing here is hand-written: every body is the server's.
 */
import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const origin = process.argv[2] ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:8787';
const base = `${origin}/api/workflow/v1`;
const out = fileURLToPath(new URL('../src/services/http/__fixtures__/', import.meta.url));
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });

let signedIn = 'dir-user-sam-carter';

/** Calls the API; `as` signs in as that person first (PUT /session), as the frontend does. */
async function call(name, method, path, body, as) {
  if (as && as !== signedIn) await signIn(as);
  const res = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: body === undefined ? {} : { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  const json = text === '' ? null : JSON.parse(text);
  const fixture = { request: { method, path, ...(body === undefined ? {} : { body }) }, status: res.status, coreVersion: res.headers.get('engine-core-version'), body: json };
  if (name) writeFileSync(`${out}${name}.json`, `${JSON.stringify(fixture, null, 2)}\n`);
  console.log(`${String(res.status).padEnd(4)} ${method} ${path}${name ? `  -> ${name}.json` : ''}`);
  return json;
}

async function signIn(id, name) {
  const person = await call(name, 'PUT', '/session', { person: { type: 'user', id } });
  signedIn = id;
  return person;
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function taskFor(requestId, as) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i += 1) {
    const page = await call(null, 'GET', '/my-tasks', undefined, as);
    const task = page.items.find((t) => t.requestId === requestId);
    if (task) return task;
    await sleep(100);
  }
  throw new Error(`no task for ${requestId} as ${as}`);
}

/** The helpdesk's signed delivery (Standard Webhooks with the mock's fixed test secret), as helpdesk-event.mjs sends it. */
async function hook(name, fields) {
  const key = Buffer.from('dev-host-helpdesk-inbound-key');
  const data = {
    key: 'HD-2291', title: 'Raise payment API rate limit', category: 'Service change',
    service: { id: 'svc-payments-api', name: 'Payments API' }, reporterEmail: 'priya.raman@example.test',
    ...fields,
  };
  data.url = `http://helpdesk.mock.test/tickets/${data.key}`;
  data.createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const body = JSON.stringify({ type: 'ticketCreated', data });
  const id = `${data.key}.created`;
  const ts = String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
  const sig = createHmac('sha256', key).update(`${id}.${ts}.${body}`).digest('base64');
  const res = await fetch(`${origin}/hooks/v1/events/helpdesk`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'webhook-id': id, 'webhook-timestamp': ts, 'webhook-signature': `v1,${sig}` },
    body,
  });
  const json = await res.json();
  writeFileSync(`${out}${name}.json`, `${JSON.stringify({ request: { method: 'POST', path: '/hooks/v1/events/helpdesk', fields }, status: res.status, body: json }, null, 2)}\n`);
  console.log(`${res.status}  hook ${JSON.stringify(fields)} -> ${name}.json`);
  return json;
}

async function dev(name, method, p, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${origin}${p}`, { method, headers: body === undefined ? {} : { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) });
  const json = await res.json();
  writeFileSync(`${out}${name}.json`, `${JSON.stringify({ request: { method, path: p, ...(body === undefined ? {} : { body }) }, status: res.status, body: json }, null, 2)}\n`);
  console.log(`${String(res.status).padEnd(4)} ${method} ${p}  -> ${name}.json`);
  return json;
}

===\nfrontend/tools/shoot.mjs\n===
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Screenshot one route of the running app.
 *   node tools/shoot.mjs <route> [name] [--width 1440] [--height 900] [--full]
 *   npm run shoot -- /w/change-request editor
 * Expects the dev or preview server on http://localhost:5173 (npm run dev); starts nothing itself.
 * Uses the system browser (PW_CHANNEL=chrome by default, or msedge). Writes shots/<name>.png.
 */
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';
import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const BASE = 'http://localhost:5173';
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const flag = (name, fallback) => {
  const i = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  return i >= 0 ? args.splice(i, 2)[1] : fallback;
};
const width = Number(flag('width', 1440));
const height = Number(flag('height', 900));
const fullIndex = args.indexOf('--full');
const fullPage = fullIndex >= 0;
if (fullPage) args.splice(fullIndex, 1);

const [routeArg, nameArg] = args;
if (!routeArg) {
  console.error('Usage: node tools/shoot.mjs <route> [name] [--width 1440 --height 900] [--full]');
  process.exit(2);
}
const route = routeArg.startsWith('/') ? routeArg : `/${routeArg}`;
const name = nameArg ?? (route.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || 'home');

try {
  await fetch(BASE, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) });
} catch {
  console.error(`Nothing answers on ${BASE}. Start the app first: npm run dev (or npm run build && npm run preview).`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const out = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'shots', `${name}.png`);
await mkdir(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });

const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: process.env.PW_CHANNEL ?? 'chrome' });
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } });
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/#${route}`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
  await page.evaluate('document.fonts.ready');
  const png = await page.screenshot({ path: out, fullPage });
  // The PNG's own size (IHDR: width and height at bytes 16 and 20), which differs from the viewport with --full.
  const size = `${png.readUInt32BE(16)}x${png.readUInt32BE(20)}`;
  console.log(`Wrote ${path.relative(process.cwd(), out)} (${size}, #${route}${fullPage ? ', full page' : ''})`);
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}

/// <reference types="vitest/config" />
import { defineConfig, defaultClientConditions, defaultServerConditions } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = fileURLToPath(new URL('.', import.meta.url));
/** The repo's contract/ folder (authored format, catalogue, fixtures), shared with the engine. */
const contract = fileURLToPath(new URL('../contract', import.meta.url));
/**
 * The engine's core package (`@workflow/core`, linked by `file:` in package.json) and the engine's
 * node_modules, where core's own dependencies (the CEL library, RE2) resolve from.
 */
const core = fileURLToPath(new URL('../engine/packages/core', import.meta.url));
const engineModules = fileURLToPath(new URL('../engine/node_modules', import.meta.url));
/**
 * `@workflow/core` is consumed as TypeScript source: its package exports put the `workflow-source`
 * condition first (engine/README-dev.md, "How another package consumes core"), so no build of core
 * is needed. tsconfig.json sets the same condition for TypeScript.
 */
const SOURCE_CONDITION = 'workflow-source';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      '@contract': contract,
      '@': fileURLToPath(new URL('./src', import.meta.url)),
    },
    conditions: [SOURCE_CONDITION, ...defaultClientConditions],
  },
  ssr: { resolve: { conditions: [SOURCE_CONDITION, ...defaultServerConditions] } },
  // The dev server may read the frontend itself, the contract folder beside it, and core's source
  // with its dependencies.
  server: { port: 5173, strictPort: true, fs: { allow: [here, contract, core, engineModules] } },
  preview: { port: 5173, strictPort: true },
  test: {
    environment: 'jsdom',
    include: ['tests/unit/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}', 'src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}'],
    setupFiles: ['tests/setup.ts'],
    css: false,
    // Rendered tests (jsdom, Testing Library, user-event) can take several seconds each when the
    // machine is busy; 20 s keeps them from failing under load without weakening what they check.
    testTimeout: 20_000,
    // One jsdom per worker instead of one per file, each file still in its own VM context (vitest's
    // own suggestion: it keeps per-file isolation and cuts the time spent creating environments).
    pool: 'vmThreads',
  },
});
